abstract_ko:
본 고안에 따른 서치라이트 부착 이동식 배연 기(E)의 구성 및 구조를 첨부된 도 1 를 참조하여 설명하면 다음과 같다. 
화재현장이나 건물화재 시 건물지하 및 건물 안에 고여 있는 연기나 유독성 가스들을 팬이 돌아가면서 밖으로 배출시키고 밖에 있는 공기를 건물내부로 유입시키는 장치에 서치라이트(B)를 부착하여 어두운 실내 및 유독가스로 인한 시야의 확보를 원활히 하여 건물 안에 갇힌 사람이나 구조대원의 안전한 구조 활동을 가능하게 하여, 화재진압 현장에서 화재의 근원을 즉시 파악할 수 있으며, 물의 사용량을 줄이고?연기로 인한 손실을 막아 사용자의 편리성 및 효율성을 높일 수 있게 하는 서치라이트 부착 이동식 배연 기(E)를 제공하며, 소비자의 욕구에 맞추는 새로운 제품의 출현을 위한 것이다.

title_en: Radio controlled combat training device and method of using the same
abstract_en: A moving, shooting, video recording, human-appearing combat training machine comprising of three major components referred to as the mobile base unit, the target body and an unattached control system is provided. The base unit has a chassis plate driven by a plurality of motors and a plurality of wheel assemblies within an exterior armor which protects internal components of the chassis from projectile impacts. The target body mounts to an extension plate affixed to the underside of the chassis plate of the base unit, creating an overall human appearing subject that moves in varying directions. The combat training machine returns fire by shooting projectiles while recording video with an electronic or mechanical sighting system for target and video playback for training analysis.

title_en: Manless spray apparatus
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A manless injection system is provided to enable to spray fire fighting solutions or agricultural chemical without an operator, thereby obtaining work stability. CONSTITUTION: A manless injection system comprises a moving body(10), nozzles(30), a hose combining part(50) and a control unit. The moving body is selected from a helicopter which can be operated wirelessly or with a wire, a mobile robot or a radio control vehicle. In the moving body, water tanks(20) are additionally installed between the hose clamp part and the nozzles. The nozzle is installed in the moving body. The nozzle is formed to spray water by installing an open and close valve which is automatically operated. The hose clamp part is connected to the nozzles. The hose clamp part is tightly connected to a hose(40) which is connected to the water source. The control unit comprises an input tool, a display tool and a controller. The input tool wirelessly controls the various configurations installed at the moving body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 물공급원에 연결된 호스가 설치되어 화재현장, 농장 등에서 무선 혹은 유선 조종을 통하여 소방수, 농약, 물 등을 분사하는 무인 분사 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Composite fire-extinguishing system for fire suppression
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A clustered fire extinguisher for suppressing the fire is provided to selectively spray fire extinguishing agent or CO2 according to the fire type. CONSTITUTION: A clustered fire extinguisher for suppressing the fire comprises a high pressure non-spray type fire-extinguishing tool(100), CO2 gas fire extinguishing tool(200), and a nozzle(300). The high pressure non-spray type fire-extinguishing tool suppresses the fire inside an obstacle by spraying a mixture including the fire extinguishing solution and abradant. The CO2 gas fire extinguishing tool suppresses the inside fire by spraying the CO2 gas inside the obstacle. The nozzle selectively sprays the mixture, fire extinguishing solution or CO2 gas.
abstract_ko: 이 발명의 화재진압용 복합형 소화장치는 소방수와 연마제의 혼합물을 분사해 장애물 벽체 등의 장애물층을 관통시킨 상태에서 그 내부에 소방수를 분사해 내부의 화재를 진압하는데 이용되는 고압 미분무 소화수단(100)과, 관통된 장애물층의 내부에 CO₂가스를 분사해 내부의 화재를 진압하는데 이용되는 CO₂가스 소화수단(200), 및 혼합물(소방수와 연마제), 소방수 또는 CO₂가스를 선택적으로 분사하는 분사수단(300)으로 구성된다.  이 발명은 소방수와 연마제의 혼합물을 분사해 장애물 벽체 등의 장애물층을 관통시킨 상태에서 그 내부에 소화제를 분사해 내부의 화재를 진압하되, 화재현장에 따라 소방수 또는 CO₂가스를 선택적으로 분사해 다양한 화재현장에서 효율적으로 화재를 진압할 수 있는 장점이 있다.  특히, 목조 문화재 건축물의 적심층에서의 화재시 소방수와 연마제의 혼합물을 분사해 장애물층인 강회층을 관통시킨 상태에서 그 내부의 적심층에 CO₂가스를 분사해 화재를 진압하되 CO₂가스의 질식효과를 이용해 화재를 진압함으로써, 목조 문화재 건축물의 손상을 최소화하면서 화재를 진압할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Whole electric control chamber of ocean drill repairing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric control chamber of an ocean drill repairing machine. The electric control chamber comprises a chamber body, wherein the chamber body is a standard container, the side walls of the standard container and the internal surface of the top plate of the standard container are provided with fitting-out plates, and an electrical insulation floor is paved on the internal surface of the bottom plate of the standard container; and the standard container is internally provided with modularization equipment, ventilating equipment, fire fighting devices, lighting facilities and communication equipment which are required by drilling rework operation; and the box body of the standard container is provided with an anti-explosion cable joint. The electric control chamber provided by the utility model adopts the standard container as the chamber body, and the interior of the container is reconstructed according to an outshore anticorrosion requirement and an electrical insulation requirement; the modularization equipment, ventilating equipment, fire fighting devices, lighting facilities and communication equipment which are required by drilling rework operation are arranged in a box, the anti-explosion cable joint is arranged and constructed like a jimmy, and the equipment and the chamber body are integrated; and the configuration is compact and reasonable, the space is saved, the whole transportation and the installation are convenient, and the space and construction time as well as construction cost of the ocean drill repairing machine are saved.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;CNOOC ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;TIANJIN CNOOC ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Emergency foldable security housing
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency foldable security housing, which can be rapidly and entirely folded. The emergency foldable security housing mainly comprises a roof, a base, side-face wall boards at both sides, combined foldable doors at both ends, and the like. Each side-face wall board consists of a side-face upper wall board and a side-face lower wall board; the side-face upper wall boards are hinged with the side-face lower wall boards through hinging pieces; and the side-face lower wall boards are hinged with a bottom boarding. The emergency foldable security housing provided by the invention has a reasonable and compact structure. The problems of seal, heat preservation, heat insulation, water prevention and air tightness of a foldable part can be entirely solved when the housing stands. The housing can be very rapidly folded, and is incomparable with an ordinary movable housing. The service life of the emergency foldable security housing is more than or equal to 50 years. The emergency foldable security housing is convenient to transport, and is particularly suitable for national emergency disaster relief storage, troops, armed police, fire protection, earthquake, seismic sea wave, disaster relief, construction in a construction site, travel, post-disaster spaces, and the like. The emergency foldable security housing brings convenience to air-sea-land transportation. The movable housing can be greatly applied to fields, such as reconstruction of disaster areas, temporary housing, construction sites and the like.

title_en: Prefabricated building component composited by concrete and fiber reinforced cement
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a prefabricated building component composited by concrete and fiber reinforced cement (PC-FRC). The prefabricated building component is suitable for building external wall decoration, building structure enclosure and energy-saving heat-preservation projects, especially suitable for fabricated residential industrialization projects, and also suitable for the people's livelihood fields including emergency of natural disasters, post-disaster reconstruction and the like. The prefabricated building component comprises a decoration surface layer, a fiber reinforced cement layer, a concrete structure layer, a heat preservation layer and a reinforcement cage, wherein the fiber reinforced cement layer is composited on the decoration surface layer and connected with the concrete structure layer, the heat preservation layer is laid in the concrete structure layer and completely wrapped by the concrete structure layer, and the reinforcement cage is laid in the concrete structure layer. The decoration surface layer, the fiber reinforced cement layer, the heat preservation layer and the concrete structure layer are all formed in a mould with modeling in a composite mode. Exposed reinforcing steel bars are arranged at the connection positions on the surface of the prefabricated building component and used for connecting prefabricated members and building structures. Hoisting built-in fittings are laid in the concrete structure layer.

title_en: Shock absorption type traffic sign
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A shock absorption type display board is provided to reduce the danger of life accidents while preventing the damage of a display board through the reconstitution of a pillar. CONSTITUTION: A shock absorption type display board(100) comprises a pillar(110), a display board(120), a coupling unit(130), and a shock absorbing unit(150). The pillar is perpendicularly installed on the surface and is comprised of a top pillar and a bottom pillar. The display board is combined on the top of the pillar and indicates a character or sign on a metal board using paint for radiation. The coupling unit is comprised of a first coupling clip and a second coupling clip. The first coupling clip unites a connector on the pillar. The second coupling clip unites the connector on the display board. The shock absorbing unit is placed between the top pillar and the bottom pillar and connects the top pillar and the bottom pillar by a wire. The shock absorbing unit comprises an absorption spring and a reconstruction spring.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 충격흡수형 표지판에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 차량의 충돌과 같은 외부의 충격시 표지판재가 결속되는 지주에서 탄력적으로 충격을 흡수하여 인명 사고의 위험을 줄이면서 충격후 지주의 복원에 의해 표지판의 파손을 방지할 수 있는 충격흡수형 표지판에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 충격흡수형 표지판은 지면에 수직으로 설치되고 상하로 분리되는 상측지주와 하측지주로 이루어지는 지주, 상기 지주의 상부에 결속되고 금속판에 발광용 도료로 문자나 기호를 표시하여 이루어지는 표지판재, ㄷ자 형태의 결속구와, 상기 결속구를 지주에 결속하는 제1결속클립과, 상기 결속구에 표지판재를 결속하는 제2결속클립으로 이루어지는 결속수단 및 상기 상측지주와 하측지주 사이에 개재되어 결합하되, 중앙의 와이어에 의해 상측지주와 하측지주가 텐션을 갖도록 연결되고, 상기 와이어의 외측에 하측의 흡수스프링과 상측의 복원스프링이 구비되며, 상기 흡수스프링과 복원스프링의 외측에 하측에서 상측으로 하측지주에 결합되는 고정관, 유동관과 상측지주에 결합되는 상측관이 구비되어 제1스페이서와 제2스페이서에 의해 분리되는 충격흡수수단을 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Hull communication network of ship using ultrasonic waves, and communication method thereof
title_ko: 초음파를 이용한 선박의 선체 통신망 및 그 통신방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hull communication network of a ship using ultrasonic waves, which takes advantage of the hull as medium, through a communicator that uses ultrasonic waves that easily pass through the hull structure of the ship, and a communication method thereof. In relation to a communication network of a complex hull made of at least one steel structure, the hull communication network of a ship using ultrasonic waves according to the present invention includes at least one ultrasonic terminal for exchanging data through ultrasonic communication and an ultrasonic - ultrasonic repeater for relaying the communication of the at least one ultrasonic terminal. Therefore, the hull communication network may be used as a sub communication network, i.e., for new communication in a ship, and not as a main communication network in situations that require communication in the ship. The present invention relates to a communication system using multi channel ultrasonic communication in a hull in order to transmit/receive a desired signal through multi channel communication by using ultrasonic waves in a complex hull and hull structure. In relation to a communication system using an ultrasonic converter in a hull, the communication system using a multi channel ultrasonic communication in a hull according to the present invention includes: a multi channel transmitter for preprocessing a data signal that is to be transmitted, converting a signal from a serial to parallel signal in order to digitally modulate an encoded signal, and converting an amplified output signal into sound waves in order to transmit the sound wave through a hull and air; a multi channel receiver for converting an ultrasonic signal, which is received from the multi channel transmitter, to an electrical signal in order to covert the ultrasonic signal into a digital signal, and serializing a parallel signal through a decoding process in order to playback an analog signal; and a relay device for amplifying a data signal, which is transmitted from the multi channel transmitter, in order to transmit the amplified data signal to the multi channel receiver. Since communication and relay are available using a hull and a hull structure, communication is provided in an area where communication is unavailable through a typical communication network, and is useful when disaster and emergency situations occur.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선박의 선체구조물을 잘 통과하는 초음파를 이용한 통신기를 이용하여 선체를 매질로 통신하기 위한 초음파를 이용한 선박의 선체 통신망 및 그 통신 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 초음파를 이용한 선박의 선체 통신망은, 하나 이상의 철 구조물로 구성된 복잡한 선체에서의 통신망에 있어서, 초음파 통신을 통해 데이터를 교환하기 위한 하나 이상의 초음파 단말기와 상기 하나 이상의 초음파 단말기의 통신을 중계하기 위한 초음파-초음파 리피터로 구성되어, 선박 내 통신이 필요한 다양한 상황에서 주 통신망이 아닌 부 통신망으로 새로운 선박 내 통신으로 사용할 수 있는 효과가 발생한다. 본 발명은 복잡한 선체 및 선체 구조물에서 초음파를 이용하여 다중 채널 통신을 통해 원하는 신호를 송수신하기 위한 선체에서의 다중채널 초음파 통신을 이용한 통신 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 선체에서의 다중채널 초음파 통신을 이용한 통신 시스템은 선체에서의 초음파 변환기를 이용한 통신 시스템에 있어서, 전송하고자하는 데이터 신호를 전처리하고, 신호를 직렬에서 병렬로 변환하여 부호화된 신호를 디지털 변조하고, 증폭된 출력신호를 음파로 변환하여 선체 및 공기를 통해 송신하기 위한 다중 채널 송신기와 상기 다중 채널 송신기로부터 수신된 초음파 신호를 전기신호로 변환하여 디지털 신호로 다시 변환하고, 복호화 과정을 거쳐 병렬 신호를 직렬화하여 아날로그 신호를 재생하기 위한 다중 채널 수신기와 상기 다중 채널 송신기로부터 송신되는 데이터 신호를 증폭하여 상기 다중 채널 수신기로 전송하기 위한 중계 장치를 포함하는 것으로서, 선체 및 선체 구조물을 이용하여 통신 및 중계를 하기 때문에 기존 통신망으로 불가능한 영역까지 통신이 가능하며 재난 및 위급한 상황이 발생했을 경우에도 유용하게 사용될 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: CHEJU NAT UNIV IND ACAD COOP;KOREA OCEAN RES DEV INST;BAE JIN HO;LEE CHONG HYUN;PAENG DONG GUK;LIM YONG KON;PARK JONG WON

title_en: Disaster prevention plan support system and program of the same
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster prevention plan support system or the like capable of generating rules for performing the occurrence/non-occurrence evaluation of a disaster, an accident and repair corresponding to a risk degree rank, which is highly accurate and excellent in versatility with a natural disaster or an accident in a building structure or the like or repair as an object, in consideration of performing inspections and the repair in future.SOLUTION: The disaster prevention plan support system includes: a risk degree computing part 12 for computing a disaster occurrence risk degree of an observation/inspection object part using a boundary of occurrence/non-occurrence of a disaster analyzed by SVM; a representative data extraction part 13 for extracting representative data 20 using the risk degree; a rank setting part 14 for reconstructing a separation surface using the representative data 20 and setting the risk degree rank; a rough set generation part 26 for forming a rough set; and a rank-classified evaluation rule generation part 27 for extracting the rules of a disaster, an accident and repair for each risk degree rank from the rough set.
assignees: UNIV YAMAGUCHI;NISHI NIPPON GIJUTSU KAIHATSU KK;CHUDEN GIJUTSU CONSULTANT KK;EIGHT JAPAN ENGINEERING CONSULTANTS INC;HOKKAIDO GIJUTSU CONSULTANT KK

title_en: Reconstruction structures for old building zone multi-unit underground space
abstract_en: The utility model relates to reconstruction structures for old building zone multi-unit underground space. The reconstruction structures comprise an overground building structure and an underground building structure, wherein a first ground load-bearing floor board layer is arranged between the overground building structure and the underground building structure, an adding elevator structure is arranged outside a fire-fighting stair exit of an old building of the overground building structure, extends to the underground building structure and is provided with an elevator barrel, four side walls of the underground building structure are reinforced concrete walls, the underground building structure is divided into two floors, floor boards are arranged between the two floors, a first underground floor is provided with business store room structures, business supporting building structures and fire-fighting equipment, a second underground floor is a garage, ground of the garage is arranged with reinforced concrete base boards on which a plurality of supporting constructional columns are arranged, all these supporting constructional columns extend upwards to the first ground load-bearing floor board layer, a first overground floor is provided with a ventilating opening leading to the ground, and a stairway from the garage to the ground is further arranged in the underground building structure. The reconstruction structures for old building zone multi-unit underground space realize green low carbon building construction having features of land saving, resource saving, energy saving, emission reduction, material saving, and the like by scientifically arranging various function reconstructions.

title_en: Design method based on synchronous dynamic random access memory (SDRAM) satellite-bone storage subfile reading and writing
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method based on synchronous dynamic random access memory (SDRAM) satellite-bone storage subfile reading and writing. The design method comprises a storage recording step and a storage playback step, wherein a writing indicator is not limited by a reading indicator, only when the writing indicator is overlapped with an initial address of an initial file, namely a storage is filled with loading data obtained at the time, the writing indicator can automatically stop recording; when the reading indicator is reading circulation when exceeding the writing indicator, repeated playback is carried out still. The design method can select the loading data obtained in a designated area or at designated time to preferentially download, guarantees timeliness of data, and improves emergency meeting efficiency of satellites in application fields such as intelligence support and disaster monitoring. The design method is used in a certain satellite data transmission subsystem.

title_en: Narrow space search and rescue training device and three-dimensional grid framework
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a narrow space rescue training device and a three-dimensional grid framework. The device comprises the three-dimensional grid framework, a plurality of barriers which are arranged in the framework, a plurality of metal meshes, and channels. The three-dimensional grid framework is composed of a plurality of screen boards which are arranged layer by layer and a plurality of vertical frame tubes which are inserted between two neighboring screen boards. A training unit can be formed by selecting the barriers and placing the selected barriers in a corresponding space unit in the framework, so various modes of fire-fighting training as well as search and rescue training can be satisfied in a narrow space. The framework is formed by assembling special components such as a plurality of multidirectional connectors, a plurality of frame tubes and the like, and the frame is made from black iron, so advantages of security, firmness, easy installation, easy disassembly and easy reconstruction are realized. Moreover, drawbacks of conventional fixation structure frameworks are overcome ideally, the framework can be disassembled and reconstructed into frameworks having different shapes, and the components such as the barriers and the like can be configured to form a new training device. Furthermore, the metal meshes having hooks are adopted in the framework, and the metal meshes are hanged on openings of space units on the outer wall surface of the framework, so training students who do not feel well in the process of training are easy to rescue, so that the personal safety of the training students is ensured.

title_en: Emergency torch combined with fire extinguisher
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency flashlight with a fire extinguisher is provided to allow a fixing body to fix on one side of a corridor, an office or a room and allow a moving body to connect to the fixing body, thereby automatically generating lighting and an alarm in emergency. CONSTITUTION: A rectification unit of a fixing body(2) supplies DC power to a socket(120). A moving body(1) includes a storage battery, a control board, a lamp(30) and a speaker(180). When the control board puts the moving body in the fixing body, the control board receives the DC power from an inserted plug(45). The control board charges the storage battery by the DC power. When the moving body is separated from the fixing body or a blackout is generated, the control board generates lighting of the lamp and an alarm of the speaker.
abstract_ko:
일반적인 손전등은  별도의 거치대가 마련되어 있지 않으므로 임의의 장소에 보관되거나 방치되는데 특히, 야간에 화재나 위급상황으로 정전이 발생하는 경우 어둠 속에서 손전등을 찾기 어려운 문제가 존재하며, 화재인 경우 초기 진압이나 화재현장을 신속하게 이탈하기 위해서는 소화기가 필요한데 기존의 소화기는 어두울 경우 찾기가 힘들어 필요할 때 효과적으로 사용하기가 힘든 문제점이 있다. 
본 발명은 고정체와 이동체로 구성되어 고정체는 눈에 잘 띄는 복도나 사무실 또는 방안의 일측에 고정하고, 이동체는 고정체에 체결되어 대기상태로 화재나 정전등의 비상시 자동으로 점등되고 경고음이 발생하여 쉽게 손전등을 찾아 사용하여 위험지역을 이탈하거나 기타 조치를 취할 수 있고 다른 사람들에도 경고할 수 있으며 또한, 이동체 내부에 소화기를 구비하여 초기화재 진압을 용이하게 할 수 있고 화재지역을 이탈시 탈출로 확보용으로 사용할 수 있는 장점이 있으며, 평상시 대기상태 중에도 고정체에서 이동체를 탈거시 경고음이 발생하므로 도난을 방지하는 효과와 더불어 다른 용도로 사용 후 사용자가 이동체를 다시 고정체에 원상복귀를 유도하는 효과도 있는 소화기를 구비하는 비상손전등이다.

title_en: ANT-based wireless fire-fighting network alarming and remote alarming system with fire detector
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to fire detecting and alarming devices, and relates to an ANT-based wireless fire-fighting network alarming and remote alarming system with a fire detector. The system comprises the fire detector, a hand-operated button, a repeater and a remote alarming gateway which build a wireless fire-fighting network based on the ANT protocol; the fire detector or the hand-operated button consists of a first coding unit, a first ANT unit, a first alarm unit, a detecting unit and a first power supply unit which are all connected with a first MCU (Microprogrammed Control Unit); and the remote alarming gateway consists of a second ANT unit, a second coding unit, a display unit, an input unit, a voice playback unit, a second alarm unit, a communication unit, a second power supply unit and a second back-up battery unit which are all connected with a second MCU. The ANT-based wireless fire-fighting network alarming and remote alarming system has the benefits of extremely low power consumption, high reliability, large support scale, high practicability, moderate cost and convenience in installation and construction.
assignees: SHANDONG BEIREN HUIZHI ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: System for transmitting air-defense and disaster-prevention alarms
abstract_en: The utility model provides a system for transmitting air-defense and disaster-prevention alarms. The system comprises a base station and a remote terminal small station which are connected by a communication network. The system is characterized in that the communication network includes a short-wave communication module for transmitting normal alarm information, and a satellite broadcast communication module for transmitting multimedia alarm information. According to the utility model, the requirements for transmitting air-defense and disaster-prevention alarms, such as security, interference resistance, interception resistance, damage resistance, rapid reconstruction and multimedia information transmission, are taken into consideration, and the requirements of the conventional alarm system are totally and effectively fulfilled by the combination application of short-wave communication technology, satellite broadcast communication technology and information return technology.
assignees: SHANGHAI WINSKY COMM TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Retrieval and reconstruction method of emergency plan
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban comprehensive emergency management, in particular to a retrieval and reconstruction method of a digital, structured and intelligent emergency plan. The emergency plan is divided into a plurality of dimensions and a plurality of layers in a structured way, and then retrieval is carried out by adopting a plurality of dimensions and a plurality of layers of attribute appointments and keywords; and reconstructing the primary emergency plan by combining with the real-time data of the event site, trend analysis, situation analysis and risk analysis. The method effectively solves the problems of the matching precision of the emergency plan and the actual emergency incident and the like; the method can be widely applied to determination of emergency plans of emergency events.
assignees: GUANGDONG ELECTRONICS INDUSTRY INST CO LTD;CLOUD COMPUTING INDUSTRY TECHNOLOGY INNOVATION AND INCUBATION CT CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Emergency folding security room
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency folding security room which can be integrally folded quickly. The emergency folding security room mainly comprises a roof, a base, side wall boards on the two sides, and combined folding doors at the two ends and other components, wherein the side wall boards consist of upper side wall boards and lower side wall boards; the upper side wall boards and the lower side wall boards are hinged through hinging components; and the lower side wall boards and a bottom surrounding board are also hinged through hinging components. The emergency folding security room is a novel folding mobile room and is reasonable and compact in structure; when the emergency folding security room is erected, sealing, heat-preserving, heat-insulating, water-proof and air-tight problems at folding parts are completely solved; the emergency folding security room is fast to fold, so that the emergency folding security room cannot be matched by an ordinary mobile room completely; the service life of the emergency folding security room is longer than 50 years, so that the emergency folding security room is particularly applicable to state emergency relief reserve, can be used as a room for military, armed polices, fire fighters, earthquake, tsunami, disaster relief, site construction, tourism and disasters and the like, and is convenient for land transport, sea transport and air transport; and the mobile rood is widely applied to disaster area reconstructions, temporary rooms, construction sites and other occasions.

title_en: Foreign language learning method
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A foreign language learning control method is provided to learn a structure and a generative principle of a foreign language by checking a fundamental difference between the foreign language and a native language. CONSTITUTION: Contents manufactured with a native language of a learner is played(S20). When a learning unit is selected from the contents, description data for building thinking in foreign language and interpreted words is outputted(S30,S40). Unit words composing the interpreted words are outputted and semantic completion is achieved by combining the words(S50-S80). [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) End; (S10) Is a content playback command inputted?; (S100) Sentence completion; (S20) Content playback; (S30) Is a learning unit selected?; (S40) Outputting explanation materials for constructing a foreign attitude and an interpretation word; (S50) Outputting expressions corresponding to a unit word of an interpretation word; (S60) Is a combination command inputted?; (S70) Outputting an explanation material for expressing an interpretation word as a foreign language by combining the expressions corresponding to an unit word; (S80) Are expressions corresponding to an unit word stably combined?; (S90) Returning an expression corresponding to an unit word to an original position
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 컨텐츠를 재생하는 컨텐츠 재생 단계, 컨텐츠에서 학습단위가 선택되면, 학습단위를 외국어식으로 재해석한 해석어와, 외국어식 사고 구축을 위한 설명 자료를 출력하는 사고 구축 단계, 해석어를 구성하는 단위어들을 출력하고 학습자의 조합 명령에 따라 단위어를 조합하여 의미적 완성을 이루는 의미 조합 단계 및 학습자의 명령에 따라 해석어의 외국어 표현을 형태적으로 완성하는 형태적 완성 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Truss system with pneumatic membrane compression bar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a truss system with a pneumatic membrane compression bar, belonging to the field of novel systems. According to thought that a long-span structure is spliced by using small member bars, the invention provides a novel through that a bearing structure is constructed by using flexible materials and the truss system is constructed on the basis of the pneumatic membrane compression bar. In such a structure, the pneumatic membrane compression bar is used as a compression member bar, and a cable is used as a pulled member bar. The pneumatic membrane compression bar is a flexible member bar when not being unaerated and is a rigid member bar with compression resistant rigidity after being aerated, and the compression resistant rigidity is decided by the diameter and inside pressure of the pneumatic membrane compression bar. The whole structural system is formed by splicing the flexible materials through hinged nodes, and the rigid pneumatic membrane compression bar is matched with a flexible prestress inhaul cable to simultaneously work after being aerated. The truss system is of a light truss structure which is really portable and easy to assemble so as to be particularly suitable for occasions requiring rapid moving and application while assembly; in addition, the truss system can be used as a roof structure, a temporary bridge and the like so as to have especially important significance for earthquake relief work and post-disaster reconstruction.

title_en: Reconstruction method for water-proof shell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconstruction method for a water-proof shell. The distribution condition of aquifers around an ore body is determined; reconstruction of the water-proof shell is performed in the aquifers; and a complete continuous water-proof key layer is formed around the ore body. The required thickness of a water-proof top plate is calculated in combination with an actual engineering condition and a mechanical principle. Whether damage occurs is judged by simulating water-proof shell stress, plastic zone and settlement distribution condition by utilizing Flac3d under an ore body mining condition. In engineering implementation, detection holes are firstly formed in the aquifers and positions of karst caves and fissures are determined by using a geological survey instrument, connection roadways are constructed in the aquifers around a middle section, and drilling and grouting underground chambers are constructed on parts of the roadway close to the fissures of the aquifers. Grouting holes are rationally arranged in the roadways and the underground chambers and encrypted grouting is performed, and finally, inter-hole CT (Computed Tomography) fluoroscopy is performed to check the grouting and water plugging effect. According to the method, a mine floor mining environment is reconstructed, so that mine floor mining is performed safely and efficiently, and geological disasters are effectively reduced.

title_en: Environment-friendly anti-seismic eco-house system suitable for mountainous areas
abstract_en: An environment-friendly anti-seismic eco-house system suitable for mountainous areas comprises a roof (1), walls (2), a stress framework system (3), a door and windows (4) and a light ceiling (5), a roof board is supported on a triangular wooden house frame in the stress framework system (3), the light ceiling (5) is arranged indoors, and the roof (1) and the indoor ceiling (5) form a large air space. Each wall (2) is manufactured in two ways: firstly, an external blockboard + wall wooden keels (air space) + an internal gypsum plaster board; and secondly, internal and external stucco surfaces + bi-layer mud and bamboo mixed fences + wall wooden keels. The door and windows (4) are manufactured in a conventional way, and an unclosed external corridor is arranged at an exit of an eco-house, so that a transition space is formed. The environment-friendly anti-seismic eco-house system suitable for the mountainous areas is environment-friendly and available in materials, good in structural anti-seismic performance and enclosure structure thermal performance, miniature in house, simple and convenient to construct and good in economy and can be widely applicable to post-disaster reconstruction in the mountainous areas.

title_en: Operation method of active type vehicle exterior protection safety system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active safety system for protecting outside of vehicle, which is used to reduce the impact force generated by the vehicle when accident happens, to effectively reduce the ratio of casualties and vehicle damage after accident, wherein the invention mainly arranges several groups of buffer devices (such as safety air bags) on the outside of the vehicle, such as the front and the rear bumper, and each group of buffer device can adopt sectional action in advance, so that each buffer device arranged outside the vehicle can generate action in sections before and during the collision, to reduce the impact force when the vehicle is collided or collided, and the buffer device has automatic removing function, after action, the air bag can be automatically removed in a very short time.

title_en: Chord tensioning truss structure capable of preventing collapsing caused by cable breakage
abstract_en: A chord tensioning truss structure capable of preventing collapsing caused by cable breakage comprises an upper chord truss, a plurality of vertical V-shaped support rods, a flexible lower chord stay cable, a plurality of anchorage devices with clamping sheets, a plurality of support rod connectors, a slidable hinge support and a fixed hinge support. The chord tensioning truss structure has the advantages of better anti-disaster capability: consecutive collapse of a conventional chord tensioning truss after cable breakage is avoided, a certain time is reserved for evacuation of operators under a chord tensioning truss, and safety is higher; convenience in construction: the anchorage devices with clamping sheets are reserved during cable arrangement, and mounted at two ends of a vertical stay cable limiter after tensioning, thereby being capable of jacking the vertical stay cable limiter; and high economic efficiency: tensioning performance of the flexible lower chord stay cable can be sufficiently developed, economy can be improved by fine design, time for evacuation of the operators under the chord tensioning truss structure after disaster can be provided, operator casualty and property loss can be reduced, local maintenance and reinforcement in post-disaster reconstruction can be realized, complete dismantling and reconstruction after collapsing of the truss structure can be avoided, and repeated investment is decreased.

title_en: A kind ofly be applicable to the rapid constructing method with aerated film depression bar truss
abstract_en: Be applicable to a rapid constructing method with aerated film depression bar truss, belong to technical field of construction.Step is as follows: one. the prestressed cable fixed length in processing factory to truss, and reserved installation regulates surplus; Two. complete the layout on truss support ground and basis at the construction field (site); Three. be filled with 50KPa ~ 70KPa air pressure inside to the air bag of aerated film depression bar; Four. assemble two truss structures; Five. next truss structure assembled on the basis of former two truss structures; Six. more truss structures are installed, until complete the assembled of overall trussed construction by the method for step 5; Seven. with the subsequent construction task of the trussed construction of installation overall trussed construction for working face completes; Eight. connect charger to the air bag of aerated film depression bar, complete all constructions of truss integral structure.Step of the present invention is easy, cost is low and can realize without scaffold construction, only needs little construction equipment, is applicable to gasbag-type membrane structure truss as temporary structure, for earthquake relief work and post-disaster reconstruction significant.

title_en: Insurence Tracking
abstract_en: A system/method adapted to aggregate vehicle or operator data for reconstructing a road event for authority purposes, said system comprising: a storage device with stored data (information) collected from an aggregating device (controller) in communication with at least one of various sensors, data capturing means, image capturing means, or metrics; a reporting module that evaluates collected information stored in the storage device to determine a driving behavior of a driver associated with the vehicle, and determine whether the driving behavior includes one or more triggering events that are one or more of operator-defined or authority-defined for communication to at least one of an authority source; a communication module enabling querying for at least one of said information by at least one of an authority source for reconstructing the road event of interest upon a threshold-grade road event triggered and relaying the reconstructed road event to at least one of an authority source for at least one of the authority purpose; wherein the authorized source is at least one of a Department of Motor Vehicle, insurance company, vehicle manufacturer, or law enforcement; and wherein the authority purpose is at least one of a revocation of license, filing of accident report, increasing or lowering insurance premiums, issuing a violation, or issuing a warning in real-time or postponed.

title_en: Apparatus and method for deciding optimal maintenance of electric facilities
title_ko: 전기설비 유지보수 결정 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus and a method thereof are provided to reduce electric installation management costs by providing the electric installation maintaining/repairing method depending on the replacement period for each electric installation and to reduce electric installation operation costs. CONSTITUTION: An electric installation maintaining/repairing decision apparatus comprises a forming unit(400) forming an electric installation schematic diagram using information which restructured the electric installation information and the accommodation chamber information corresponding to a specific condition; a setting unit(500) setting up an analysis item which is analyzed in the electric installation schematic diagram; a power outage cost function unit(600) selecting the power outage cost function corresponding to the accommodating chamber information; an analysis unit(700) calculating the reliability, failure rate, average life time, and the power outrage cost when a trouble occurs in the electric installation of the corresponding electric installation based on the restructured information, analysis item, and power outrage cost function; and a method determining unit(800) calculating the replacement period for each electric installation based on the result calculated from the analysis unit, and determining the remaining/repairing method of the electric installation depending on the calculated replacement period of each electric installation. [Reference numerals] (100) Electrical equipment information unit; (200,300) Reconstruction information unit; (400) Schematic diagram forming unit; (500) Setting unit; (600) Power outage cost function unit; (700) Analysis unit; (800) Method determining unit;
abstract_ko: 전기설비 유지보수 결정 장치는 전기설비 정보와 수용부하 정보를 특정 조건에 대응하게 재구성한 재구성 정보를 이용하여 전기설비 계통도를 형성하고, 전기설비 계통도에서 분석할 분석 항목을 설정하며, 수용부하 정보에 대응하는 정전비용함수를 선택한다. 다음, 전기설비 유지보수 결정 장치는 재구성 정보, 분석 항목 및 정전비용함수를 토대로 해당 전기설비의 신뢰도, 고장률, 평균수명 및 전기설비 고장발생시 정전 비용을 계산하고, 계산한 결과들을 토대로 전기설비 별 교체주기를 산출하고, 산출한 전기설비 별 교체주기에 따라 전기설비의 유지보수 방법을 결정한다.

title_en: Automatic fire notification system and method using camera and integrated notifying device for the same
title_ko: 카메라를 이용한 자동 화재 속보 시스템 및 방법, 이를 위한 통합 속보기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system and a method for automatic fire notification using a camera and an integrated notifying device for the same are provided to enable a quick and correct grasping of an operation room about a fire site. CONSTITUTION: A system for automatic fire notification comprises a fire sensor linked to a camera(110), an integrated notification device(130), an operation room server(150), and a terminal of a person concerned(160). The fire sensor linked to a camera is installed in a fire observation area such as a building and the like. The integrated notification device communicates wirelessly with the fire sensor linked to a camera. The operation room server communicates with the integrated notification device through a network(140). Common fire sensors(120a, 120b) are installed an area which does not require camera monitoring, and communicates with the integrated notification device. [Reference numerals] (110) Camera-interlinked fire sensor; (120a,120b) Fire sensor; (130) Integrated notification device; (140) Communication network; (150) Operation room server; (160) Concerned person terminal; (180) Notification device camera;
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 카메라를 이용한 자동 화재 속보 시스템 및 방법을 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 자동 화재 속보 시스템은 화재감시영역에 하나 이상 설치되는 카메라연동 화재감지기; 상기 카메라연동 화재감지기로부터 영상데이터와 화재감지신호를 수신하는 제1통신부와, 상기 화재감지신호를 수신한 후 화재신고신호를 생성하는 제어부와, 상기 화재신고신호와 상기 영상데이터를 통신망을 통해 송출하는 제2통신부를 포함하는 통합 속보기; 상기 통합 속보기로부터 상기 화재신고신호와 상기 영상데이터를 수신하여 상황실근무자가 확인할 수 있도록 표시하는 상황실서버를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면 화재현장의 카메라에서 획득한 영상데이터가 상황실서버로 자동 전송되므로 상황실 근무자가 영상을 통해 화재현장의 상황을 정확하게 확인할 수 있다. 따라서 상황실 근무자는 실제로 화재가 발생하였는지 아니면 화재감지기의 오작동에 의한 신고인지를 쉽게 확인할 수 있고, 출동할 소방대의 규모도 비교적 정확하게 판단할 수 있으므로 화재에 신속하고 정확하게 대처할 수 있다. 또한 수신기를 따로 설치하지 않아도 통합 속보기에서 다수 화재감지기의 신호를 직접 수신하여 상황실서버로 화재신고를 전송할 수 있으므로 설치비용이 절감되고 유지보수가 편리해지는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Mountain flood disaster monitoring and early-warning business platform system in medium or small rivers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain flood geological disaster monitoring and early-warning business platform system (short for MFDOWS). According to the mountain flood geological disaster monitoring and early-warning business platform system, an integral design including a disaster risk assessment model, a disaster indirect conditions, a face / point rainfall concept, integral monitoring, forecasting, assessment, alarming, and service business is introduced aiming at three main mountain flood geological disaster hazard-affected bodies, namely mountain rivers, dangerously weak reservoirs and geological disaster hidden points; a business process is reconstructed; business products are innovate; data of a radar net and an automatic observation station net are fully used; a result in a refined meso-scale numerical prediction model is used; a radar ration estimation technique (quantitative precipitation estimation / quantitative precipitation forecast) (QPE / QPF) is used; a large quantity of refined and diversified products which can be conveniently used by a forecaster or a server are obtained; and therefore the business platform which is capable of fast and effectively monitoring, forecasting, early warning and analyzing mountain flood geological disasters is established. The MFDOWS supports the subsystems such as a subsystem, a product generation subsystem, a product display and analysis subsystem, a serving product management subsystem, and a system maintenance subsystem. In addition, the mountain flood disaster monitoring and early-warning business platform system in medium or small rivers is convenient to operate, high in stability and reliability, good in performance, and good in application value.

title_en: Fast-assemble type fire-fighting outdoor evacuation stair
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stair with relatively strong fireproof performance, especially refers to a fast-assemble type fire-fighting outdoor evacuation stair, and the stair is suitable for fire-fighting reconstruction projects of various buildings. Structural features of the stair are that cartridge steel pipe connecting members are employed for connecting main support structures like pillars and cross beams, steel pipes forming the stair pillars and crossbeams are filled with water and are connected with a water tank through a water inlet and a pipeline, and crossbeams on a top of each stair platform are provided with fire-fighting nozzles; and a surface of the stair is provided with an antitheft net. The stair can be fast constructed in a construction site, large-scale engineering equipment is not needed, material cost, construction cost and time cost are reduced, the stair is provided with the antitheft net and an antitheft door, stealing is prevented, water is injected through a self-bring solar energy constant temperature water tank, so cooling water in the stair is not frozen, normal temperature can be kept under fire hazard high temperature, the stair is ensured no to fall under high temperature environment, the fire fighting nozzles can also automatically spray out water curtains for cooling, and reliable protection is timely provided for people in evacuation.

title_en: Three-dimensional joining clamp
abstract_en: A three-dimensional joining clamp comprises a left clamp body (1) and a right clamp body (2). A shaft coupling component (3) used for connecting a rotary shaft to the two clamp bodies is arranged between the left clamp body (1) and the right clamp body (2). The three-dimensional joining clamp has the advantages that two objects which are used randomly can be conveniently combined together and bear force exerted along two directions by a person, clamping looseness does not occur at the joint position, and the joined objects can be well fixed; and the three-dimensional joining clamp is small in size and capable of being carried along with the person, and can achieve connection by being used for any two objects at any time and at any place. Under an emergency situation or a situation that not a single specific device exists, the three-dimensional joining clamp can automatically stretch and contract and form a simple transport device by adjusting the transverse direction and the longitudinal direction to fix peripheral objects; and the three-dimensional joining clamp is particularly suitable for being popularized and used in places prone to disasters or being widely applied in a post-disaster reconstruction process, and more lives can be saved.

title_en: Grenade for fire fighting
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A grenade for putting out fire is provided to prevent a user from being insured by being used near a fire. CONSTITUTION: A grenade for putting out fire(100) comprises an outer cover(110) with a passing hole on the outside thereof and a space thereinside, a retarding agent for putting out a fire which is stored in the space inside the outer cover, a safety pin(130) for blocking a passing hole, a heat detecting sensor which is equipped near the outer cover and detects the heat of outer temperature and a blasting cap for igniting the retarding agent when the outer temperature is over a set temperature. The blasting cap ignites the retarding agent in the same way of a bimetal and thermocouple mode. The round of the outer cover comprises an outlet hole passing the retarding agent from the inside of the outer cover to the outside by the explosion of the blasting cap and an outer cover(118) for blocking the outlet hole and opening and closing the outlet hole during an explosion. Some parts of the outer cover with the outlet hole comprise a groove for holding the outer cover.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 구형상으로 내측에는 수용공간이 구비되며, 일측면에 관통공이 형성된 외피와, 상기 외피 내측의 수용공간에 저장되며, 화재를 진화하는 소화분말인 지연제와, 상기 외피의 관통공을 차단하는 안전핀과, 상기 외피의 내주면에 구비되며, 상기 관통공을 통해 유입되는 외부공기의 온도를 측정하는 열감지센서 및 상기 외피의 내부에 구비되며, 상기 열감지센서에서 측정한 외부공기의 온도가 설정온도를 넘는 경우 상기 지연제를 점화시키는 뇌관을 포함하는 소방용 수류탄을 제공한다. 
따라서, 원거리에서 투척할 수 있어 화재현장의 근거리에 접근하면서 발생될 수 있는 화염에 의한 사용자의 부상을 방지할 수 있고, 안전핀을 뽑은 후 투척하는 간단한 동작으로 인하여 신속하게 화재를 진화할 수 있으며, 외피의 내측 수용공간에 저장된 진화제가 복합적으로 화재를 진화할 수 있어 여러 종류의 화재에 신속하게 대응할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV ULSAN FOUND FOR IND COOP

title_en: Weight distribution and reduction shaft-type earthquake-resistant and base-isolation pendulum device, and construction method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device and a construction method, which prevent damage to a building by absorbing disaster energy and establishing compatibility between earthquake-resistant and base-isolation functions.SOLUTION: In a weight distribution and reduction shaft-type earthquake-resistant and base-isolation pendulum device, and a construction method, a main shaft 2 and a buried pile 1 are connected together so that kinetic energy bringing about movement resisting disaster energy can be theoretically cancelled. Its constitutive connection part is floating-mounted; a destruction control body is provided; compatibility between an adjustment function and earthquake-resistant and base-isolation functions capable of being replaced with all devices is established; three-dimensional energy can be absorbed; and adaptability to all kinds of earthquake-resistant and base-isolation reinforcement including the new construction and extension or reconstruction of a building is achieved.

title_en: Refuge chamber
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a refuge chamber. The refuge chamber comprises an air channel primary road, an air channel secondary road, a refuge area, a draught fan, a fireproof door and a power supply. The refuge area is arranged at one end of each floor of a building. In the building, areas except the refuge area serve as an office and life area. The air channel primary road is perpendicular to the building in a penetrating mode. The air channel secondary road is connected with the air channel primary road. The air channel secondary road is arranged in the refuge area. The draught fan is arranged on the first floor of the building. The draught fan is connected with the bottom end of the air channel primary road. The power source is connected with the draught fan. The fireproof door is arranged between the refuge area and the office and life area. The refuge chamber has the advantages that when a fire disaster happens, and people flee difficultly, people who flee difficultly in the building are provided with a safe refuge area by reconstructing the structure of the building, people wait to be rescued, the safety of people is guaranteed, and the survival rate is increased.

title_en: Apparatus for human behavior pattern recognition using affordance-based agent model
title_ko: 어포던스 기반 에이전트 모델을 이용한 인간 행동패턴 인식장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A human behavior pattern recognition device using an affordance based agent model is provided to offer a clue to predict human behavior in which a reproduction experiment is impossible and how to improve a design of environment regarding a result of the behavior. CONSTITUTION: A finite state model supplying unit(100) offers a formalized environment a schema about possibility of human behavior dynamically varying in the environment. An event generation module(200) executes an event on the formalized schema in the finite state model supplying unit. An agent module(300) predicts a behavior pattern of the human regarding the event by interacting adaptive acknowledge information of the human in the dynamic environment and generates a sequence of possible behaviors for achieving a goal. [Reference numerals] (100) Finite state model providing unit; (200) Event generation module; (300) Agent module; (310) Human behavior planner; (320) Environment agent unit; (330) Human agent unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자신의 주위 환경에 대한 인지정보를 바탕으로 목표(goal)를 달성하기 위하여 행하는 인간의 적응적인 행동패턴에 대한 모델링과 시뮬레이션을 통하여 재난 상황과 같이 실험으로는 재현할 수 없는 복잡하고 동적인 인간-환경시스템(human-environment system)에서 인간의 행동을 관찰, 예측, 통제할 수 있는 인간의 인지적 행위유발인자 (affordance) 기반 에이전트 모델을 이용한 인간 행동패턴 인식장치를 제공하는데 있다.
assignees: UNIV INJE IND ACAD COOPERATION;UNIST ACADEMY IND RES CORP

title_en: Method for human behavior pattern recognition using affordance-based agent model
title_ko: 어포던스 기반 에이전트 모델을 이용한 인간 행동패턴 인식방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method for recognizing behavior patterns by using an affordance-based agent model is provided to supply prediction and analysis abilities for efficient system design and management by predicting the behaviors of humans in a reappearance test impossible situation and supplying a single sentry about the improvement of environment design. CONSTITUTION: A schema of a unit space and an environment standardized for expressing and describing the behaviors of humans in a system is provided by using a finite state model methodology and an affordance theory(S10). If an initial event occurs, an agent type of the event is confirmed(S30). If the event is a human agent, the event is executed on the standardized schema based on recognition data about a behavior possible state in the environment. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) Application agent; (CC) Environment agent; (DD,GG,II,KK) No; (EE,HH,LL) Yes; (JJ) Standby; (S10) Provide a standardized schema; (S100) New environment event is generated?; (S20) Generate an initial event; (S30) Agent type?; (S40) Generated event is within a recognition range?; (S50) Establish an execution plan; (S60) Conditions of a behavior induction factor and a behavior performance factor within the recognition range are satisfied?; (S70) Update a position change of a human agent caused by a behavior; (S80) Target state is reached?; (S90) Update an environmental change caused by the laws of physics

title_en: Rural compositional residential structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a rural compositional residential structure which comprises a bearing structure and a ceiling, wherein the ceiling is fixedly mounted on the bearing structure, the bearing structure is composed of steel columns, steel beams and grade beams, the number and position of the steel column is set according to the house style, the lower parts of steel columns are connected to the grade beams which are pre-embedded in the ground, and the two ends of each steel beam are fixed at the upper parts of two steel columns. The structure provided by the invention is characterized in that the structure can be produced intensively by the factory pattern which facilitates quality controlling and material saving; the structure can be transported detachably, so that the transporting cost is saved, the on-site construction is less, the construction time is short, the roof weight is light, the anti-seismic level is high, the service life is long; and the structure is reusable, that is, when meet with the problems that the house is damaged by geological disasters or the house needs relocation, the bearing structure and the ceiling are reusable, so that the cost input of the house reconstruction is reduced.

title_en: Coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method based on swarm robot system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method after a disaster based on a swarm robot system. The coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method after the disaster based on the swarm robot system is characterized in that when a mine disaster occurs, a great number of automatically-movable intelligent robots with wireless communication functions are disposed underground, and the swarm of robots are used for searching remaining networks in an underworking and automatically form into columns to form the backbone of an underground communication network to rebuild the underground communication network. The coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method after the disaster based on the swarm robot system can assist a surface rescue command center to obtain underground relevant information for providing effective information support for accident rescue.

title_en: Apparatus for simulating climate change andmethod therefor
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus for simulating climate change and a method thereof are provided to offer a proper understanding tool for global warming to laymen and students by enabling to check global energy change directly. CONSTITUTION: An upper storage tank (50) is connected to a lower storage tank through a conveying pipe, and withdraws liquid stored in the lower storage tank through the conveying pipe by using a pump. A first, a second and a third storage tank (11,13,15) are installed between the upper storage tank and the lower storage tank. Upper connecting pipes (21,23,25) are installed between the upper storage tank and the first, the second or the third storage tank respectively, and make the liquid stored in the upper storage tank flow in to the first, the second and the third storage tank. Lower connecting pipes (31,33,35) are installed between the first, the second or the third storage tank and the lower storage tank respectively, and discharges the liquid flowed in the first, the second and the third storage tank to the lower storage tank. Horizontal connecting pipes (37,39) transport the liquid flowed in the first storage tank to the second storage tank, and transport the liquid flowed in the second storage tank to the third storage tank.

title_en: A kind of irradiating biological dose conversion method based on serum levels of iron/serum copper
abstract_en: The invention belongs to radiation biological dosimeter field, be specifically related to using serum levels of iron and serum copper as the feature problem estimating techniques of label.First adopt 2-(the bromo-2-of 5-adjoins pyridine diimide)-5-diethylaminophenol (5-Br-PADAP) spectrophotometric method to measure the concentration of irradiation mice serum iron and serum copper respectively, calculate the ratio of serum levels of iron and serum copper; Then the dose-effect curve of serum levels of iron/between serum copper and irradiation dose is set up.According to the dose-effect curve set up.This Genetically modified crops technology dose response scope is 0.5 ~ 7 Gy, operation and index analysis easy, within 30 minutes, radioactive dose information can be obtained, the requirement of biological dose reconstruction can be met.The present invention is good due to dose response, detects easy and can mass detection and possess widely used prospect in the biological dose estimation of Nuclear Accidents or Occupationally Exposed to Radiation personnel.

title_en: Intelligent tunnel fire escape system based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent tunnel fire escape system based on a wireless sensor network, which comprises a fire behavior information acquisition device, an emergency evacuation processing device and an evacuation indicating device which are sequentially connected, wherein the fire behavior information acquisition device adopts a fire detecting instrument; the emergency evacuation processing device comprises a receiving unit, a judging unit and a control unit which are sequentially connected, and is provided with a storage unit used for correlation data storage; the storage unit is connected with the judging unit; and the evacuation indicating device is used for indicating escape in a tunnel. The intelligent tunnel fire escape system can provide the quantity and positions of fire sources, the scale and the type of a fire, and a motion direction, a spread range and a flow velocity of flue gas in the funnel, can reconstruct a three-dimensional temperature field in the tunnel during the fire in real time, can conduct virtual dynamic display on fire behavior information in the tunnel, can adjust an indicating direction of the corresponding emergency evacuation indicating device in real time according to the practical fire behavior development state in the tunnel, and can ensure the safety of an evacuation route.
assignees: ZHEJIANG COOL ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Assembly method of self-propelled construction machinery
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an assembly method of a self-propelled construction machinery in an isolated disaster area and the like, by which an assembling work can be performed without using an assembly stand when it is required to eliminate an assembly stand and to use the self-propelled construction machinery such as a large-sized backhoe having a capacity required and targeted in the isolated disaster area and the like.SOLUTION: When introducing a self-propelled construction machinery equipped with suspending means required for reconstruction work in a disaster area and the like, the construction machinery is divided into a number of units and the units are transported by air. Then, the units are assembled on condition that the self-propelled construction machinery is used. In the assembling method of the self-propelled construction machinery: a relatively small-sized self-propelled construction machinery is assembled; a larger-sized self-propelled construction machinery of a next period including the heavy units is assembled by using the self-propelled construction machinery of an initial period; and thus assemblage of a larger machinery relies on a smaller machinery sequentially to assemble finally a targeted large-sized self-propelled construction machinery.

title_en: Unit bath type disaster shelter escape capsule separation and destruction property panic room device and method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device and a construction method for coping with any assumed disasters by easily mounting a unit bath type disaster shelter escape capsule separation/destruction property panic room device by new construction, extension/reconstruction, and outdoor installation.SOLUTION: In a unit bath type panic room device 1 which is a shelter escape capsule, by molding a frame by a component of different strength and hardness, human life is ensured and safety of rescue activity is improved during a disaster, disaster energy is suppressed, obstruction of a human body due to product breakage are prevented, and a facility of production accident independent prevention in a natural disaster or a fire, etc., that cannot be solved by a political measure of a country can be provided.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle sightseeing flying experience system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle sightseeing flying experience system. The unmanned aerial vehicle sightseeing flying experience system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a vehicle-mounted video-audio sensor, a flying attitude sensor, a multi-channel wireless data chain, a video-audio playback device, a multi-dimension dynamic experience cabin, a seat cabin attitude controller, a main control computer and a seat. The vehicle-mounted video-audio sensor and the flying attitude sensor are connected with a transmitter of the multi-channel data chain, a receiver is connected with the main control computer, the main control computer is connected with the seat cabin attitude controller, and the seat cabin attitude controller is connected with the seat and the video-audio playback device. The unmanned aerial vehicle sightseeing flying experience system can achieve live-action and real-time sightseeing flying experience in most scenic spots. The unmanned aerial vehicle tourism flight experience system is suitable for all crowds, and accidents of personal casualties will not happen. Compared with manned aerial touring and sightseeing flying experience, the unmanned aerial vehicle sightseeing flying experience system has substantive breakthrough in aspects such as adaptability and safety, reduces development cost and risks, and is good in economy.

title_en: Suspension type intelligent fire robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of suspension type intelligent fire robot, the rotating shaft of drive motors is connected with road wheel by transmission device, road wheel is for be placed on track and to drive fire-fighting robot to move, audio transceiver is used for audio broadcasting and speech talkback, ultrasonic radar is used for detecting obstacles thing, Visible Light Camera and infrared thermal imager are all installed on visible ray/thermal imaging double vision The Cloud Terrace and also can rotate freely, audio transceiver, ultrasonic radar, sensor, fire extinguisher bomb, Visible Light Camera and infrared thermal imager are corresponding with controller to be respectively connected, between controller with vehicle-mounted control computer, communication is connected, vehicle-mounted control computer carries out telecommunication by wireless network with administrative center and is connected.Robot can replace manually carrying out respectively patrolling and examining in tunnel a little patrol and examine work, have automatically patrol and examine in real time, protect personal safety and alarm, in time put out a fire process, remote monitoring, long-range real-time communication, data can preserve playback so that advantages such as analysis and summary.

title_en: Ultraviolet flame detector for automatic fire extinguishment system
abstract_en: An ultraviolet flame detector for an automatic fire extinguishment system is characterized by comprising two same detection passages. Each detection passage comprises five modules including a boost switch power source circuit module, a reconstruction circuit module, a discharge detection circuit module, a test circuit module, a power source module and an interface circuit module. Without a microcontroller and a digital integrated circuit, the ultraviolet flame detector has low requirement for a power supply. Each passage has a full self-checking function and can tell self circuit fault from fire alarm signals so that accurate alarm information can be provided for an automatic fire extinguishment controller. Nearly zero false alarms of products can be assured by the aid of a fire confirmation mechanism, fire disaster can be confirmed only by one fire detector, and the ultraviolet flame detector is high in effectiveness, reliability and reaction speed, simple in structure, firm, safe and applicable to popularization and application.

title_en: Amazake salmon
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a salmon processed food for salmon comeback movement and for the creation of Japanese tastes.SOLUTION: As salmon comeback movement on embankments (banks) for Tohoku (North East) Japan earthquake disaster reconstruction, an Amazake and salmon processed food 1 (in a can or plastic container) is provided by storing a boiled upstream-going salmon (salmon 2) together with the Amazake 3 as Japanese tastes in the same container.

title_en: A bandana for fire escape
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A hood for fire escape is provided to minimize generation of damage to human life by making quick evacuation possible while blocking direct damage from flame and poisonous gas in case of fire. CONSTITUTION: A hood for fire escape includes a head unit (10) surrounding a head section when wearing, a vision unit (20) corresponding to the eye, a respiratory unit (30) corresponding to the nose and mouth and a contractible unit (40) surrounding a neck section. The vision unit is prepared to view the outside. The hood is manufactured using a flame retardant thread while keeping naps removed for preventing hydroplaning.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재현장 탈출용 두건에 관한 것으로서, 밀봉 후 진공 포장하여 보관하는 가운데 화재 발생시 화염 및 유독가스로부터 직접적인 피해를 차단하는 가운데 신속한 대피가 가능하여 인명피해 발생을 최소화 할 수 있도록 하기 위한 것이다. 
이를 실현하기 위한 본 발명은, 사람의 머리에 착용이 가능한 두건(100)에 있어서, 상기 두건(100)은 방염실(1)로 직조되어져 있으며; 상기 두건(100)은 착용시 머리부위를 감싸는 헤드부(10)와, 눈 부위에 대응되는 투시부(20), 코와 입 부위에 대응되는 호흡기부(30), 그리고 목 부위를 감싸는 신축부(40)로 나뉘어지되, 상기 투시부(20)는 외부 투시가 가능하도록 구비된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Malfunction management system for water floating type photovoltaic power generator
title_ko: 수상 태양광 발전을 위한 이상 관리 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An abnormality management system for floating photovoltaic generation can actively respond to an abnormal situation which may occur in floating photovoltaic generation, and thereby can improve efficiency. CONSTITUTION: An abnormality management system for floating photovoltaic generation comprises a solar module (100) and a connection board (200). The solar module comprises a solar panel (110) producing electricity using sunlight and a support (120) supporting the solar panel. The connection board receives power produced by the solar panel and outputs it through a power cable for external connection. The connection board comprises a controller (220). The controller performs as an independent power source separated from a power source of the connection board, monitors an abnormal situation of floating photovoltaic generation through sensing by using a sensor, determines a cause of the abnormal situation, and responds according to a responding procedure pre-set for the abnormal situation. The controller improves the sensing level of an abnormal situation of a high priority based on priority of a cause of an abnormality according to predetermined condition or an output of the sensor. [Reference numerals] (110,AA) Solar panel; (120,BB) Support; (210) Sensing unit; (220) Controller; (230,235) Sensor
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수상 태양광 발전을 위한 이상 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 센싱을 통해 수상 태양광 발전에 대한 이상 상황을 감시하고 이상 상황의 발생 요인을 판단하며 그에 따른 대응 및 복구를 수행함으로써 수상 태양광 발전에서 발생할 수 있는 이상 발생 상황에 능동적으로 대처하도록 하여 수상 태양광 발전의 효율성을 높이며, 이상 상황의 발생 요인에 대해 대응 중요도의 순서대로 우선권을 재구성함으로써 재구성한 우선권에 따라 이상 상황의 감시 수준을 변경하고 대응의 수준을 변화시키도록 하여 수상 태양광 발전의 효율성을 극대화하고, 침수 여부, 기 설정된 수준 이상의 수위 변화, 온도 변화, 습도 변화 및 기상 변화 등을 이상 상황으로 판단하고 발생한 이상 상황에 따라 솔라 패널의 지지부를 1축 이상 틸팅하도록 제어함으로써 축 틸팅을 통해 이상 상황 발생을 효과적으로 예방 및 대응하도록 하여 수상 태양광 발전의 안정성을 효과적으로 확보하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Isobaric liquefying apparatus for natural gas
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an isobaric liquefying apparatus for natural gas and the apparatus comprises a pre-processing system for natural gas, a pre-cooling system, a liquefying system, a cold adding system, a storing system, a control system and a fire-fighting system. The cold adding system works in a way that a liquid refrigerant 20 from a refrigerant storing tank 19 becomes refrigerant superheated steam 16 via actions of a low temperature liquid pump 21 and a cool exchanger 18; the steam forms outlet dead steam 22 of an expansion machine 17 after actions expansion, pressure and temperature reducing by the expansion machine 17; the outlet dead steam 22 enters a condenser 9 which condenses methane and generates sub-cooled liquid methane; a low temperature refrigerant 15 from an upper tower 10 cools raw natural gas 1 via actions of a cool exchanger 6 and a cool exchanger 3; and the cooled raw natural gas 1 goes back to the refrigerant storing tank 19 via the cool exchanger 18, thereby forming a refrigerant cold capacity recycling loop. Compared with traditional advanced units, the isobaric liquefying apparatus for natural gas can save over 30% of energy and the apparatus is a breakthrough to traditional natural gas liquefying technology, thereby possessing obvious economic, social and environmental protecting effects.

abstract_ko:
본 고안은 화상예방보호 습포(수액흡수) 두건(모자)과 장갑에 관한 것으로 갑자기 발생한 화재현장에서 화재발생 초기(소방진화 기구 등의 조작 및 작동이 이뤄지기 이전)단계에 각 개인이 개별적으로 수십초 이내에 얼굴 전체부위와 손목 전체부위에 신속하게 착용하여 화기 및 매연발생으로 인한 화상피해 및 호홉기(기도.폐)질식 및 사망으로 이르는 피해를 보호방어 및 격리 차단해 줄 수 있도록 구성을 갖춘 습포(수액흡수) 두건과 장갑에 관한 것으로 
     다음과 같이 불연성이 있으며 피부 및 인체 친화성을 갖춘 것으로 브드럽고 가벼우며 통기성이 있고 수분흡수력이 놉은 면 또는 화기, 매연(유독가스) 등에 차단효과가 크며 피부보호성을 갖춘 기능성 섬유 또는 기능성을 갖춘 종이주변소재 등을 활용하여 머리 끝에서 목 하단부 둘레 전체를 덥어 착용하도록 모자형상을 띤 두건을 구성으로 갖춘 것과 손끝에서 손목 상부(의류상의 소매 하단부 둘레부위)부위까지 덥어서 착용할 수 있도록 장갑을 구성으로 갖춘 것으로 두건과 장갑의 구성 전체부위에 위생처리된 물(수액) 또는 피부와 인체에 친화성이 있으며 화기 및 매연(유독가스) 등에 방어 및 보호 차단력이 놉은 기능성을 갖춘 수액 등을 충만하도록 습포(수액흡수)처리해 준 것과 두건과 장갑을 수액과 함깨 (동봉) 방수력이 있는 비닐주변소재봉투 또는 밀폐용기 등에 담아 밀봉포장처리해 주어서 개인휴대 또는 가정 및 각종 대중이 이용하는 건물 및 이동교통수단 등의 내부에 비치해 주어서 긴급화재 발생시 각 개인이 본 고안 포장을 개봉 해체하여 신속하게 수초 또는  수십초 이내에 평소 무방비로 노출되 있던 얼굴 전체부위와 손목에 착용하여 화기 및 매연(유독가스)으로 부터 방어보호 또는 차단해 줄 수 있도록 구성을 갖춘 개인용구로서 화재발생 초기에 일어나는 피해로 부터 방어 및 보호해 주어 침착하게 다음 행동을(진화.대피.구조요청) 이룰 수 있도록 하여 인명피해 및 대형 참사를 막을 수 있도록 한 것이 본 고안 구성의 특징이며 활용성의 목적이다
