title_en: Experience room for emergency escape
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire refuge experience room is provided to experience various conditions occurring in case of fire by having multiple experience rooms, and to learn a coping method according to the various conditions. CONSTITUTION: An experience room main body (10) comprises multiple experience rooms. Each experience room comprises a speaker (80) and a smoke feeding unit (90), and is comprised so that the each experience room passes in order by being interconnected by a through hole (21). The speaker and the smoke feeding unit supply a smoke while playing a noise of an actual fire phenomenon. The each experience room comprises collapse experience rooms (31,32,33), a darkness experience room (40), a backfire experience room (50), an elevator experience room (60), a structure avoidance experience room (70), and an obstacle (34). The fire heat presentable unit (41) is equipped inside the each experience room, and reproduces a heat generated in case of fire. A door (22) is equipped in the through hole of the backfire experience room in order to feel a heat, and a mannequin is arranged inside the elevator experience room. The obstacle is formed with an elastic synthetic resin and a flexible material, and prevents an injury of an experience person.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재시 발생할 수 있는 다양한 상황을 효과적으로 체험하고, 피난 방법을 교육할 수 있도록 된 새로운 구조의 화재 피난 체험장에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 화재 피난 체험장은 화재발생시 발생될 수 있는 상황을 재현한 복수개의 체험실(31,32,33,40,50,60)이 구비되어, 체험자가 여러개의 체험실(31,32,33,40,50,60)을 통과하면서 실제 화재발생시 일어날 수 있는 다양한 조건을 체험하고 그에 따른 대처방법을 효과적으로 배울 수 있는 장점이 있다

title_en: Moving type air heart device for disaster relief with air compressor
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A movable air pressure heart machine is provided to suppress a fire by continuously supplying air to a main tank. CONSTITUTION: A movable air pressure heart machine comprises a main tank (10), a positive pressure type air respirator (20) which connects to the main tank and is provided with air from the main tank, an air pressure type working tool (30) which connects to the main tank and is provided with compressed air, and an air pressure distributor (40). The movable air pressure heart machine includes an auxiliary tank (110) which connects to the main tank and supplies compressed to the main tank, an air compressor motor (120) for filling the auxiliary tank with compressed air, a control unit which electrically connects to the air compressor motor, an on/off switch (140) which electrically connects to the control unit, and a power supply (150) which electrically connects to the on/off switch and supplies power to the air compressor motor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 에어콤프레셔가 구비된 이동식 공압하트머신이 개시되는 것으로, 압축공기가 수용되는 메인탱크(10)와 이 메인탱크(10)와 연결되어 메인탱크(10)로부터 공기를 공급받는 양압식공기호흡기(20)와, 상기 메인탱크(10)와 연결되어 압축공기를 공급받는 공압형작업공구(30)와 상기 메인탱크(10)와 상기 양압식공기호홉기(20)  및 상기 공압형작업공구(30)가 각각 연결되는 공압분배기(40)로 이루어진 공압하트머신에 있어서, 상기 메인탱크(10)와 연결되어 메인탱크(10)의 내부에 압축공기를 공급하는 보조탱크(110)와; 상기 보조탱크(110)의 내부에 압축공기를 충진하는 에어콤프레셔모터(120)와; 상기 에어콤프레셔모터(120)와 전기적으로 연결되는 제어부(130)와; 상기 제어부(130)와 전기적으로 연결되는 온/오프 스위치(140)와; 상기 온/오프스위치(140)와 전기적으로 연결되어 상기 에어콤프레셔모터(120)에 필요한 전력을 공급하는 전원공급체(150)가 더 구비되어 이루어진다. 
본 발명은 화재현장에서의 화재진압 및 인명구조시에 소방관의 호흡작용에 필요한 공기를 지속적으로 공급할 수 있고 공압형작업공구측에 필요한 압축공기를 지속적으로 공급할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 필터체에 의해 소방관의 호흡작용에 필요한 공기가 양압식공기호흡기측으로 공급되는 과정에서 불순물이 필터링되어 소방관에게 항상 청결한 상태의 공기만을 공급할 수 있다.

title_en: Suspension type intelligent fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a suspension type intelligent fire-fighting robot. A rotating shaft of a drive motor is connected with traveling wheels through a transmission device. The traveling wheels are arranged on tracks and drive the fire-fighting robot to move. A voice frequency receiver-transmitter is used for voice frequency broadcast and voice talking-back. An ultrasonic radar device is used for detecting obstructions. A visible camera and an infrared thermal imager are both installed on a visible/thermal imaging double-vision holder and can rotate freely. The voice frequency receiver-transmitter, the ultrasonic radar device, a sensor, a fire-extinguishing bullet, the visible camera and the infrared thermal imager are respectively connected with a controller in a corresponding mode. The controller is in communication connection with a vehicle-mounted control computer. The vehicle-mounted control computer is in remote communication connection with a management center through a wireless network. The suspension type intelligent fire-fighting robot can replace manpower for carrying out routing inspection work in each routing inspection point inside a tunnel, and has the advantages of carrying out real-time routing inspection automatically, protecting personal safety, giving an alarm in time, extinguishing fire in time, carrying out remote monitoring and remote real-time communication, saving data and carrying out playback of the data so as to facilitate analysis and summary, and the like.
assignees: CHENGDU HITOAI AUTOMATIC CONTROL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting pipe network joint protection device
abstract_en: A fire-fighting pipe network joint protection device belongs to the technical field of oil and gas field equipment. The outer circumference of one side of inner sheath connects and protects the card, and the fire-fighting pipeline is connected to the inner chamber of inner sheath, and fire control joint connects at the fire-fighting pipeline, and the outer circumference of the opposite side of inner sheath connects the oversheath, is connected with O type sealing washer between inner sheath and the oversheath, and the handle is connected to the terminal surface of oversheath. The utility model has the advantages that the water belt joint is protected from wind and sand and is tightly sealed; the fire-fighting is quick and convenient in use; in the oil field with special geographical environment and large sand storm, the application prospect is wide, the reconstruction cost is low, and the practical significance is great.

title_en: Meizoseismal area debris flow hidden risk point quick recognizing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meizoseismal area debris flow hidden risk point quick recognizing method. According to the method, drainage basins are divided according to a meizoseismal area vector topographic map to obtain areas of the drainage basins, the total area and the total volume of critical loose material sources which are needed by debris flows of each drainage basin are obtained through calculation, then the total area and the total volume of new loose material sources in drainage basins to be recognized are obtained through remote-sensing images and calculation, and finally the total area and the total volume of the new loose material sources in the drainage basins to be recognized are compared with the total area and the total volume of the critical loose material sources which are needed by the debris flows of the drainage basins so as to judge whether the drainage basins to be recognized are new debris flow hidden risk points or not after earthquakes. Compared with the prior art, the method enables the new loose solid material sources after the earthquakes to serve as the only debris flow recognition indicator, it is distinguished that a judging threshold value is a variable related to the areas of the drainage basins, supporting data are easy to obtain, the recognition precision is high, the debris flow hidden risk points of the meizoseismal area can be recognized reasonably and quickly, and reference is provided for site selection of post-disaster reconstruction in the meizoseismal area.

title_en: The signal sending device of monitoring included a protection circuit of solar cell and networking system
title_ko: 태양전지 보호회로와 네트워킹을 포함한 모니터링 신호 송출 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a monitoring signal transmitting device including a solar cell protection circuit and networking. The device includes a monitoring system which integrates a protection circuit onto a solar cell module to prevent fire accidents caused by a short circuit or over current, maintains the array structure of the solar cell module, enables a user to check the status of the solar cell module in real-time, and reorganizes the circuit using the measured voltage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 태양전지 보호회로와 네트워킹을 포함한 모니터링 신호 송출 장치에 관한 것으로, 태양전지모듈에 보호회로를 장착하여 누전, 과전류, 쇼트 등으로 인해 발생되는 화재를 예방하고 태양전지모듈의 어레이 구성을 유지하면서 사용자는 실시간으로 태양전지모듈의 상태를 확인하고 측정된 전압량으로 회로를 재구성하는 모니터링 시스템을 포함하는 장치를 제공함에 있다.

title_en: Methods for greening slope surface of decomposed granite soil
abstract_en: A greening method to control erosion of granite soil slope is disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the greening method to control erosion of granite soil slope is provided by comprising the steps of: preparing an erosion control stabilizer whose erosion control performance on granite soil slope is verified using a rainfall reproduction device which is capable of reproducing artificial rainfall; mixing to prepare greening materials by mixing water, seeds and fertilizers in the erosion control stabilizer whose erosion control performance described above is verified; spraying to form a vegetation base layer by spraying the greening materials which include the erosion control stabilizer whose erosion control performance described above is verified on granite soil slope. [Reference numerals] (S100) Step of preparing an erosion control stabilizer whose erosion control performance is verified; (S110) Step of preparing greening materials including the erosion control stabilizer whose erosion control performance is verified; (S120) Step of spraying the greening materials on granite soil slope
abstract_ko: 마사토 비탈면 침식방지 녹화공법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면, 인공강우를 재현할 수 있는 강우재현장치를 사용하여 마사토 비탈면에서의 침식방지 성능이 검증된 침식방지안정제를 준비하는 준비단계; 상기 침식방지 성능이 검증된 침식방지안정제에 물, 종자 및 비료 등을 혼합하여 녹화재료를 준비하는 혼합단계; 및 상기 마사토 비탈면 위에 상기 침식방지 성능이 검증된 침식방지안정제를 포함하는 녹화재료를 살포하여 식생기반층을 형성하는 살포단계를 포함하는 마사토 비탈면 침식방지 녹화공법이 제공된다.

title_en: Integrated processing system based on image sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated processing system based on an image sensor. The system comprises an image acquisition part and an image processing part. The system is characterized in that the image acquisition part comprises an image sensor and a CPLD, and an image enhancement processing module is arranged between the image sensor and the CPLD; and the image processing part comprises a processor, which is connected to the CPLD, an SDRAM, a flash memory and a display. As an improvement, the image enhancement processing module includes a synchronous receiving module and a frame reconstruction module which is electrically connected to the processor. The system reduces module-level buffer sizes during processing, so that a chip area is largely reduced and chip design costs are lowered. Besides, the system is advantaged by high reliability, ease of use, a high integrated level and low power consumption while being utilized in disaster detection systems.

title_en: Ground reinforcing structure for stone pagoda cultural heritage
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ground reinforcing structure for stone cultural properties for reinforcing the ground corresponding to the location on which a stone cultural properties are put or increasing the bearing capacity of ground and more specifically, to a ground reinforcing structure for stone cultural properties performing a compaction process on part of a soil layer using an reinforced binder with the more excellent reinforcement force than soil by a ground reinforcement method, which is one of conventional soil grounding methods (plate built soil grounding), for building a foundation while compacting only soil layer upon layer. The present invention can apply the conventional ground reinforcement method and the conventional material as possible when the basement located in the lower part of the stereobate of a stone cultural properties is reconstructed, and can ensure the structural stability and the sufficient bearing power as similar as possible at the time of the stone cultural properties restoration. [Reference numerals] (A) Conventional method; (A-1,A-2,B-1,B-2,C-1,C-2) Sample; (AA) Section; (B) Compacting method; (BB,EE) Soil 10 cm rodding; (C) Reinforcement material; (CC) Soil+deviced stone 15 cm rodding; (DD) Soil+deviced stone 15 cm mechanical compaction; (FF,GG,II) Soil 10 cm mechanical compaction; (HH) Quicklime 10 cm mechanical compaction; (JJ) Inorganic binder 10 cm mechanical compaction
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 석조문화재의 기단이 놓일 위치에 해당하는 지반을 보강하거나 지반의 지지력을 증가시키기 위한 석조문화재의 지반보강구조에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하면, 예부터 알려진 지정(地定) 방법 중에 하나인 단순히 흙만을 달고질 하여 층층히 다지면서 기초를 쌓아올리는 지반보강방법(판축지정)의 흙층의 일부를 흙보다 보강력이 우수한 보강바인더를 이용하여 다짐처리한 석조문화재의 지반보강구조에 관한 것이다. 
또한 본 발명은 석조문화재의 기단 하부에 위치한 기반을 재조성함에 있어 가능한 원래의 지반보강방법과 재료를 반영할 수 있는 효과를 얻을 수 있고; 석조문화재의 복원 시점과 유사한 정도의 구조적인 안정성과 충분한 지내력을 확보할 수 있는 효과를 얻을 수 있다.
assignees: NAT RESERCH INSTITUE OF CULTURAL PROPERTIES

title_en: Electric automobile charging and replacing station fire risk data evaluation method
abstract_en: An electric automobile charging and replacing station fire risk data evaluation method includes the steps: numerically simulating actual acquired data of fire scene main structures of a distribution room, a charging and replacing room and a monitoring room in an electric automobile charging and replacing station by a modeling tool to obtain a large number of simulated data, and screening or exhausting the fire development condition of a single room after catching fire and influence factors of the fire on the whole charging and replacing station; determining a data evaluation range; building a fire risk data hierarchy structure model; calculating the weight of each factor by a hierarchy analysis method; determining fire risk levels; judging whether the fire risk levels meet safety requirements or not, if the fire risk levels do not meet the safety requirements, calculating improving suggestion data according to fire risk and harmfulness obtained in the first step, returning to the fourth step according to the proposed suggestion data, reconstructing a judgment matrix, calculating the weight and performing evaluation until meeting evaluative criteria. Reliable data can be provided, and prediction accuracy is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method and equipment for recovering database data by using logs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and equipment for recovering database data by using logs. The method comprises the steps: converting business data in applications, which are distributed and run on one or more servers, into log data in real time in a predetermined format; receiving and storing the log data in one or more disaster backup log files; parsing the log data in the disaster backup log files in a predetermined time period into data with a database format, wherein the data with the database format is taken as parsed data; reconstructing the parsed data according to predetermined rules, so as to obtain reconstructed business data; updating the reconstructed business data to a standby database. The converting and receiving of the logs are real-time, so that when a database is damaged, data, lost after the last backup time point, of a regular database backup mechanism can be recovered.

title_en: Method for remote network digitalized acoustic image alarming and safety protection and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for remote network digitalized acoustic image alarming and safety protection and control. The method comprises the steps: according to the distribution of branches, a plurality of cameras, a plurality of inductors, a plurality of controllers and a plurality of sound collectors are arranged, are respectively connected with a digital video recording alarming host which is connected with a control center through a mobile communication network, a PSTN (Public Switched Telephone Network) and an internet; information display and touch equipment is arranged in the control center and is used for displaying cartographic information of a jurisdiction area and marking the networked branches at corresponding cartographic positions. The method for remote network digitalized acoustic image alarming and safety protection and control can be flexible for video adjustment, simple and fast for recorded video replaying, timely, fast and accurate in fire-fighting control, remote control, self maintenance and alert situation treatment, and wide in monitoring range, the field communication is added, and the control by other accessories can also be realized.
assignees: HUIZHOU MAO RONG INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Dry powder extinguisher
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of fire-fighting equipment, and discloses a dry powder extinguisher. The dry powder extinguisher comprises a barrel, a spray cylinder, a pressure valve, a siphon pipe, a safety catch, a lifting handle, a pressure handle and a voice playback component, wherein the spray cylinder is connected outside the barrel, and connected with the siphon pipe in the barrel; the lifting handle and the pressure handle are mounted on the siphon pipe; a shoulder strap is connected onto the lifting handle; the voice playback component is arranged at the upper part of the barrel; the voice playback component comprises a battery, a loudspeaker, a switch and a voice playback module; the battery is connected with the switch through a wire; the switch and the loudspeaker are connected with the voice playback module through wires; the switch is mounted at the pressure handle; a spacing room is arranged at the upper part of the barrel; the battery and the voice playback module are arranged in the spacing room; the loudspeaker and the switch are arranged on the inside wall of the spacing room. The dry powder extinguisher has the characteristics of simple structure and convenience for cleaning.

title_en: The Forecasting Methodology of many attribute events under wireless senser environment
abstract_en: The Forecasting Methodology of many attribute events under a kind of wireless senser environment, the method is according to the feature of many attribute events stream self, set up many attribute events field, flow of event is converted at equal intervals, for building the training sample file of forecast model, build bidirectional prediction model vertically and horizontally on this basis, many attribute events are predicted, and it is predicted Model Reconstruction adaptively according to the accumulation degree of inaccurate forecast, make prediction more accuracy, the method can be widely used in event-monitoring, natural disaster monitoring and early warning, health supervision, during climatic environment monitoring is applied with prediction etc..

title_en: Automatic fire notification system using camera and black box and integrated notifying device for the same
title_ko: 카메라와 블랙박스를 이용한 자동 화재 속보 시스템 및 이를 위한 통합 속보기
abstract_en: An automatic fire notification system using a camera is disclosed. The automatic fire notification system according to the present invention comprises: one or more camera-interworked fire detector installed in a fire monitoring area; an integrated notification device including a first communication unit for receiving image data and a fire detection signal from the camera-interworked fire detector; a control unit for generating a fire report signal after receiving the fire detection signal, a second communication unit for transmitting the fire report signal and the image data through a communication network, and a black box; and a situation room server for receiving the fire report signal and the image data from the integrated notification device and displaying the fire report signal and the image data so that a situation room worker can check a situation. According to the present invention, since the image data acquired by the camera of the fire site is automatically transmitted to the situation room server, the situation room worker can accurately check the situation of the fire site through the image. Also, the integrated notification device can directly receive signals of the plurality of fire detectors and transmit the fire report to the situation room server, even without installing separate receivers, thereby reducing installation costs and facilitating maintenance. Furthermore, it is possible to more accurately analyze the cause of the fire through the black box installed in the integrated notification machine. [Reference numerals] (110) Camera-interworked fire detector; (120a,120b) Fire detector; (130) Integrated notification device; (140) Communication network; (150) Situation room server; (160) Administrator server; (180) Notification camera; (AA) Black box
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 카메라를 이용한 자동 화재 속보 시스템을 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 자동 화재 속보 시스템은 화재감시영역에 하나 이상 설치되는 카메라연동 화재감지기; 상기 카메라연동 화재감지기로부터 영상데이터와 화재감지신호를 수신하는 제1통신부와, 상기 화재감지신호를 수신한 후 화재신고신호를 생성하는 제어부와, 상기 화재신고신호와 상기 영상데이터를 통신망을 통해 송출하는 제2통신부와, 블랙박스를 포함하는 통합 속보기; 상기 통합 속보기로부터 상기 화재신고신호와 상기 영상데이터를 수신하여 상황실근무자가 확인할 수 있도록 표시하는 상황실서버를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면 화재현장의 카메라에서 획득한 영상데이터가 상황실서버로 자동 전송되므로 상황실 근무자가 영상을 통해 화재현장의 상황을 정확하게 확인할 수 있다. 또한 수신기를 따로 설치하지 하지 않아도 통합 속보기에서 다수 화재감지기의 신호를 직접 수신하여 상황실서버로 화재신고를 전송할 수 있으므로 설치비용이 절감되고 유지보수가 편리해지는 이점이 있다. 또한 통합 속보기에 설치된 블랙박스를 통해 화재원인을 보다 정확히 분석할 수 있는 이점이 있다.
assignees: BAEK DOO E & E INTERNAT CO LTD

title_en: Quantitative analysis method for rubber composition of synthetic rubber and natural rubber compound
title_ko: 합성고무-천연고무 복합 고무의 고무 조성 정량분석 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis to precisely analyze a content of synthetic rubber and natural rubber in a rubber composition of synthetic rubber and natural rubber through a calibration curve by obtaining a calibration curve from a relative area ratio for each proportion after analyzing a standard rubber sample in which the content of synthetic rubber is provided with pyrolysis gas chromatography. A component of butyl rubber, natural rubber, is transformed with a particular mass spectrum to improve accuracy and reproducibility of analytical signal. Furthermore, optimum analyzing process is established by implementing a relative peak area control method. According to the quantitative analysis of the present invention, the content of the synthetic rubber and natural rubber is simply analyzed with excellent credibility based on the calibration curve obtained from the sample in which the content ratio is already provided; and result of the pyrolysis gas chromatography of the butyl rubber and natural rubber complex rubber composition which is unknown. Therefore, the present invention can be implemented usefully in material property of rubber parts, respond to quality problem, prevent poor quality and benchmarking, and can promote the prevention of poor product quality beforehand and improve quality. [Reference numerals] (AA) Butyl rubber (IIR); (BB) Natural rubber (NR)
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 합성고무-천연고무 복합고무 조성물의 합성고무 및 천연고무 함량을 정확하게 분석할 수 있는 정성 및 정량분석 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 합성고무 함량을 알고 있는 고무 표준샘플을 열분해 가스크로마토그래피 분석을 하고, 각 비율별 상대 면적비로부터 검량선을 구하여, 검량선으로부터 합성고무 함량을 정량하는 분석방법에 관한 것이다. 분석신호의 정확성 및 재현성을 향상시키기 위해서 부틸고무, 천연고무 성분을 특정질량 스펙트럼으로 변형시키고, 상대피크면적법을 적용하여 분석하는 최적의 분석 프로세스를 정립하였다. 본 발명의 정량분석 방법에 의하면 함량비를 알고 있는 시료로부터 구한 검량선과 미지의 부틸고무-천연고무 복합고무 조성물의 열분해 가스크로마토그래피 결과로부터, 합성고무 및 천연고무 함량을 간단하면서도 우수한 신뢰도로 분석할 수 있으므로, 고무부품의 재료규격 준수확인, 품질문제에의 대응, 불량예방 및 벤치마킹 등에 유용하게 적용하여 제품 불량을 미연에 방지하고, 품질 향상에 기여할 수 있다.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;KIA MOTORS CORP

title_en: System for managing a carried out closed-circuit television image and method for managing a carried out closed-circuit television image using the same
title_ko: 반출영상 관리시스템 및 이를 이용한 반출영상 관리방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a carry-out image management system for preventing an indiscriminate carry-out of personal information about CCTV image data which is carried out and a carry-out image management method using the same. The carry-out image management system includes an application form writing module, a map screen display module, an inquiry screen display module, an approval module, an encryption module, a download module, a playback authentication module, and an image playback module. The application writing module obtains carry-out application data which is filled in a carry-out application form by providing the carry-out application form according to a request for the filling of the carry-out application form by a carry-out applicant. The map screen display module displays multiple CCTV locations on a map by making the locations correspond to places which are written in the carry-out application form. The inquiry screen display module displays an application list inquiry screen by the carry-out applicant. The approval module approves after a carry-out manager confirms application detailed information. The encryption module encrypts a carry-out image. The download module enables the carry-out applicant to download the encrypted carry-out image. The playback authentication module processes a playback authentication process according to a playback request of the downloaded encrypted carry-out image. The image playback module outputs a no-playback message in case the number of playbacks of a CCTV image exceeds the set number of playbacks and plays an encrypted CCTV image by encrypting the CCTV image in case the number of playbacks of the CCTV image is not more than the set number of playbacks. [Reference numerals] (110) Image carry-out management server; (111) Application form writing module; (112) Map screen display module; (113) Search screen display module; (114) Approval module; (115) Encryption module; (116) Download module; (117) Result processing module; (118) Search module; (119) Mosaic processing module; (130) Image carry-out playback server; (131) Playback authentication module; (132) Image playback module; (AA) ID storage DB; (BB) Encryption key storage DB; (CC) Original image DB; (DD) Carry-out image DB
abstract_ko: 반출된 CCTV 영상자료에 대한 개인 정보의 무분별한 유출을 방지하기 위한 반출영상 관리시스템 및 이를 이용한 반출영상 관리방법이 개시된다. 반출영상 관리시스템은 신청서 작성모듈, 지도화면 표시모듈, 조회화면 표시모듈, 승인모듈, 암호화모듈, 다운로드모듈, 재생인증모듈 및 영상재생모듈을 포함한다. 신청서 작성모듈은 반출신청자에 의한 반출신청서의 작성이 요청됨에 따라 상기 반출신청서를 제공하여 상기 반출신청서에 기입된 반출신청데이터를 획득한다. 지도화면 표시모듈은 상기 반출신청서에 기입된 장소에 대응하여 지도상에 복수의 CCTV위치들을 표시한다. 조회화면 표시모듈은 반출신청자에 의한 신청목록 조회 화면을 표시한다. 승인모듈은 반출관리자가 신청 상세정보를 확인후 승인한다. 암호화모듈은 반출영상을 암호화한다. 다운로드모듈은 반출신청자가 암호화된 반출영상을 다운로드한다. 재생인증모듈은 다운로드된 암호화된 반출영상의 재생요청에 따라 재생인증절차를 진행한다. 영상재생모듈은 CCTV 영상의 재생횟수가 설정된 재생횟수를 초과하는 경우, 재생불가 메시지를 출력하고, CCTV 영상의 재생횟수가 설정된 재생횟수 이하인 경우, CCTV 영상을 복호화하여 복호화된 CCTV 영상을 재생한다.

title_en: Falling-proof concrete grid structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a falling-proof concrete grid structure which is round in the outer shape. Concrete and built-in steel bars form a hollow frame structure, a round rib and crossing ribs form the concrete grid structure, and a plurality of large holes (notches) are arranged between the round rib and the crossing ribs and among the crossing ribs. A hole between rib plates enables rain water to flow into a sewer, and drainage function of an inspection well is not influenced. An open groove is reserved in the round rib for mounting and fixing inside a well hole. The concrete grid structure is arranged inside an inspection well and below a manhole cover. The falling-proof concrete grid structure can be applied to a newly-built inspection well and can also be applied to reconstruction of a well-built inspection well, the installation is easy and the use is convenient. In the case when the manhole cover is missing or broken, or the manhole cover is washed away due to flood, pedestrians or vehicles can be prevented from falling in the well due to the concrete grid structure, casualties and property losses are avoided, and safety is improved. The concrete grid structure can adopt self-compacting concrete, reactive powder concrete, ceramsite concrete, common concrete and the like. The concrete grid structure is durable, fireproof, aging-resisting and long in service life, easy in manufacturing and low in cost.

title_en: Falling-proof concrete grid structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a falling-proof concrete grid structure. Concrete and built-in steel bars form a hollow frame structure; a triangular rib and a round rib are crossed to form the concrete grid structure; a large hole is arranged between the round rib and the triangular rib; a large hole is arranged in the center of the triangular rib; and a U-shaped groove is reserved on the bottom face of the upper end part of the triangular rib. The concrete grid structure is arranged inside an inspection well and below a manhole cover. The falling-proof concrete grid structure can be applied to a newly-built inspection well and can also be applied to reconstruction of a well-built inspection well, the installation is easy and the use is convenient. In the case when the manhole cover is missing or broken, or the manhole cover is washed away due to flood, pedestrians or vehicles can be prevented from falling in the well due to the concrete grid structure, casualties and property losses are avoided, and safety is improved. The concrete grid structure can adopt self-compacting concrete, reactive powder concrete, ceramsite concrete, common concrete and the like. The concrete grid structure is durable, fireproof, aging-resisting and long in service life, easy in manufacturing and low in cost.

title_en: All-terrain surface adaptive relief vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-terrain surface adaptive relief vehicle comprising a frame (10), four suspensions, and a control system. The suspensions the same in structure are symmetrically disposed on two sides of the frame. Every suspension set is hinged to the frame. The suspensions can freely rotate with certain degrees of freedom in a model machine longitudinal plane. The included angles between the suspensions and the frame change with changes in terrains, so that the function of contour adapting in the longitudinal plane is achieved. After disasters such as an earthquake occur, complex geographical environments and damage to roads thereby severely affect relief work; in order to focus on the limitation, the vehicle providing conveniences for work in the complex disaster sites is designed, and a powerful tool is provided for rescue and relief work and post-disaster reconstruction.
assignees: SHANGHAI CITY MINHANG DISTR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY PROT ASS

title_en: Remote network digitalization acoustic image alarm and safety prevention control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote network digitalization acoustic image alarm and safety prevention control system. The system comprises a digital hard disc video alarm host, a camera, a sensor, a controller, a sound gather, a controller, a controller and an emergency button which are installed at fortified places or network points, and a remotely disposed control center. The camera, the sensor, the controller, the sound gatherer, the controller and the emergency button are respectively connected with the digital hard disc video alarm host; and the digital hard disc video alarm host is connected with the control center through a mobile communication network, a PSTN and the Internet. The remote network digitalization acoustic image alarm and safety prevention control system has the advantages of flexible video adjustment, simple video playback, fire-fighting control, remote control, self-maintenance, timely, rapid and accurate alarm handling, enhanced on-site communication, wide monitoring scope, and realized control of other accessories.
assignees: HUIZHOU MAO RONG INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional high-altitude rescue fire fighting truck
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional high-altitude rescue fire fighting truck which mainly comprises a vehicle chassis with a telescopic support leg, a rotary platform, a jacking hydraulic cylinder, a telescopic arm, a telescopic sleeving barrel, a slide, a winch, a descent control device, a lifting rescue cabin and a high-altitude rescue platform. The multifunctional high-altitude rescue fire fighting truck is characterized in that the jacking hydraulic cylinder is connected with the telescopic arm, the telescopic arm and the telescopic sleeving barrel are arranged in parallel, the downside of the telescopic sleeving barrel of a base section at the bottommost layer is connected with the slide, the top end of a section of the topmost layer of the telescopic arm is connected with the high-altitude rescue platform, and the downside of the telescopic arm is used for suspending the lifting rescue cabin through a rope of the winch. Because the multifunctional high-altitude rescue fire fighting truck is simultaneously provided with two rescuing channels, escaping persons can be continuously conveyed, thus the rescuing efficiency of the persons is greatly increased; and because the structure is similar to that of an existing straight arm telescopic crane, the structure can be reconstructed on the basis of an existing crane, thus the production cost is lowered; and because the rescuing efficiency of the multifunctional high-altitude rescue fire fighting truck is far higher than that of an existing aerial ladder truck, the multifunctional high-altitude rescue fire fighting truck replaces the existing aerial ladder truck to become a main force of fire control rescuing of a high-rise building in future.

title_en: Power transmission line icing prediction method and system based on IOWA operator combined prediction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line icing prediction method and system based on an IOWA operator combined prediction model, which decompose ice disaster influence factors and icing data one by one through wavelet decomposition to obtain a wavelet coefficient and a scale coefficient; obtaining an influence factor profile sequence and a detail sequence, an icing quality profile sequence and a detail sequence, and an icing thickness profile sequence and a detail sequence by utilizing the wavelet coefficient and the scale coefficient, and performing nonlinear regression on each meteorological factor and the power transmission line factor one by one to obtain a fitting equation of icing thickness and quality; establishing a combined prediction model based on an IOWA operator for the equations, solving a combined prediction weighting vector and an induction value sequence, generating a general picture predicted value sequence and a detail predicted value sequence of icing quality and thickness, and solving a wavelet coefficient and a scale coefficient; and then obtaining a predicted value sequence of the icing thickness and quality by adopting a wavelet reconstruction algorithm. The icing prediction method and the icing prediction system have the advantages of high speed, good extrapolation, credible result and the like.

title_en: Fire control broadcasting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire control broadcasting system. The fire control broadcasting system comprises a plurality of fire detectors, a fire alarm controller, a linkage controller and a broadcast recording and playback device, wherein the fire detectors are arranged in multiple regions in a building, the fire alarm controller is connected with the fire detectors, the linkage controller is connected with the fire alarm controller, and the broadcast recording and playback device is connected with the linkage controller. An output end of the broadcast recording and playback device is connected with a broadcasting power amplifier. The broadcasting power amplifier is connected with a working condition indicator light. An output end of the broadcasting power amplifier is connected with a multiple-wire region control disk and a bus region control disk. Output ends of the multiple-wire region control disk are connected with a plurality of ceiling type loudspeaker boxes and a plurality of wall-mounted loudspeaker boxes. Output ends of the bus region control disk are connected with a bus switching control module. Output ends of the bus switching control module are connected with a plurality of ceiling type loudspeaker boxes and a plurality of wall-mounted loudspeaker boxes. The fire control broadcasting system is reasonable in design, capable of controlling a fire scene, reminding people to leave the fire scene timely, preventing secondary damage caused by chaos in the fire scene, convenient to maintain, high in practicality and convenient to popularize and use.
assignees: XI AN ALL SAFE SCI & TECH CO

title_en: Method, device and system for network connection disaster recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, device and system for network connection disaster recovery. The network connection disaster recovery method comprises: sending fist access request information to an authentication server, and receiving first access request response information sent by the authentication server, the first access request response information comprising proxy address set information; by use of a proxy address set, selecting a proxy device capable of establishing connection with a network access device as a current proxy device; and sending connection request response information to a user terminal so that the user terminal can conveniently establish connection with the current proxy device. According to the invention, the authentication server provides multiple proxy address information for the network access device, and the network access device queries the proxy device capable of establishing connection with the network access device from the proxy address information so that the success rate of network connection is improved without reconstructing a conventional network, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Additives for reducing asphyxiant harmful gases and reinforciing fire-extinguishing effect in the event of fire, and fire-extinguishing water, fire-extinguishing agent, anti-flaming paints, fireproof panits and fire-resistant paints comprising the same
title_ko: 화재시의 질식성 유해가스 저감 및 소화효과 보강용 첨가제, 및 이를 함유하는 소방용수, 소화약제, 방염도료, 난연도료, 및 내화도료
abstract_en: The present invention relates to additives for reducing asphyxiant harmful gases and reinforcing fire-extinguishing effects in the event of fire by being added to fire-extinguishing water, fire-extinguishing agents, flame-proof paints, flame-retardant paints and fire-resistant paints. Additives according to one embodiment comprise acetyl acetone solution of at least one among Pt, Pd and Au; titanium butoxide; a mixed liquid of butanol and methyl ethyl ketone; hydrochloric acid; and water. Additives according to another embodiment of the present invention comprise PtCl6; acetone solution of Pd; titanium isopropoxide; a mixed liquid of 2-butanoland methyl ethyl ketone; methanol; nitric acid; and water. The present invention can reduce asphyxiant harmful gases such as CO, SOx, NOx , etc. that are inevitably produced at sites of fire, and reinforce fire-extinguishing effects by using CO2 which is a reaction product.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방용수나 소화약제, 또는 방염도료, 난연도료, 내화도료 등에 첨가되어 화재시 화재 현장의 질식성 유해가스를 저감하고 소화효과를 보강하기 위한 첨가제에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일태양에 의한 첨가제는 Pt, Pd, 및 Au 중 적어도 하나의 아세틸아세톤 용액; 티타늄부톡사이드; 부탄올 및 메틸에틸케톤 혼합액; 염산; 및 물을 포함한다. 또, 본 발명의 다른 태양에 의한 첨가제는 PtCl 6 ; Pd의 아세톤 용액; 티타늄이소프로폭사이드; 2-부탄올 및 메틸에틸케톤 혼합액; 메탄올; 질산; 및 물을 포함한다. 본 발명은 화재현장에서 필연적으로 발생하는 CO, SOx, NOx 등의 질식성 유해가스를 저감하고 반응 생성물인 CO 2 로 소화효과를 보강 할 수 있다.
assignees: CERA CHEM CO LTD;PARK HONG WOOK

title_en: Flight simulator apparatus for implementing the same flight environment with battlefield-situation
title_ko: 전장 상황과 동일한 비행 환경을 구현하는 비행 시뮬레이터 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flight simulator apparatus enabling a flight trainer (for instance, a cabin crew in an operation room and a pilot in a mock cockpit) to do the flight simulation in the field virtual environment same as the actual flying by operating in conjunction with a tactical mission trainer (TMT) and an operating flight trainer (OFT) each other. In one mode of embodiment, the flight simulator apparatus provided by the invention is composed of the TMT for training the crew of the aircraft and the OFT operated in conjunction with the TMT for training the pilot thereof.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전술 임무 트레이너(Tactical Mission Trainer: TMT)와 비행절차훈련 트레이너(Operating Flight Trainer: OFT)를 상호 연동하여 운영함으로써, 비행 훈련자(예컨대, 조작실부의 승무원 및 조종실부의 조종사)가 실제와 동일한 가상의 전장 환경에서 항공기를 모의 비행할 수 있도록 설계한 비행 시뮬레이터 장치에 관한 것이다. 
이를 실현하기 위한 일 형태로서 본 발명은, 항공기의 승무원 훈련용 전술 임무 트레이너(Tactical Mission Trainer: TMT) 및 상기 전술 임무 트레이너와 연동하여 운용되는 항공기의 조종사 훈련용 비행절차훈련 트레이너(Operating Flight Trainer: OFT)로 구성되는 비행 시뮬레이터 장치로서, 상기 전술 임무 트레이너는, 항공기의 승무원이 탑승하는 모의 장치로서 실제와 동일한 항공기 장비(aircraft equipment)들과 그 제어 장치를 구비하는 조작실부; 가상의 전투 환경을 재현하는 연산 처리 과정을 수행하는 전술 처리부; 상기 조작실부로부터 수신되는 상기 항공기 장비들에 관한 조작 신호에 대응하는 프로세스들을 생성 및 스케줄링하여 상기 전술 처리부의 상기 가상의 전투 환경을 재현하는 연산 처리 과정의 실행을 지시하는 비행운영 처리부; 및 상기 전술 처리부와 상기 비행운영 처리부 간의 데이터 송수신을 지원하는 통신 인터페이스부를 포함하되, 상기 통신 인터페이스부는 이더넷 프로토콜 모듈과, MIL-STD-1553 프로토콜 모듈과, ARINC 429 프로토콜 모듈을 포함하도록 구성되어 상기 전술 처리부와 상기 비행운영 처리부와의 실시간 상호 연동 동작을 가능하게 하는, 비행 시뮬레이터 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Excavator for fire extinguish
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting excavator and, more specifically, to a firefighting excavator which enables users to extinguish a fire by removing wreckage on the scene of a fire caused by wood or trash as an outlet conduit nozzle on the excavator moves with a bucket of the excavator to spray water. To achieve this, the present invention for enabling users to extinguish a fire caused by wood or trash and to extinguish live embers using heavy equipment such as an excavator may include a nozzle anchoring part on a boom of the excavator to anchor the outlet conduit, and an outlet conduit nozzle which can be mounted on the nozzle anchoring part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방용 굴삭기에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 굴삭기에 방수관창 등을 구비하여 굴삭기의 버켓이 움직임에 따라 방수관창이 따라 움직이면서 물을 분사할 수 있도록 하여 목재화재나 쓰레기화재 등과 같이 잔해물을 제거해 가면서 진화작업을 하여야 하는 화재현장에서 용이하게 사용할 수 있는 소방용 굴삭기에 관한 것이다. 
상기의 목적을 달성하기 위한 기술적 사상으로서의 본 발명은, 굴삭기 등과 같은 중장비를 이용하여 목재화재 또는 쓰레기화재 등을 진압하고 잔불제거를 하는데 있어서, 상기 굴삭기의 붐에는 방수관창을 고정하는 관창고정부가 구비되고, 상기 관창고정부에는 방수관창이 장착될 수 있다.

title_en: Mobile robot fire fighting system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a movable robot fire suppression system comprising a pressing pump discharging pressurizing fire water; an air compressor producing compressed air; a power unit supplying power to the pressing pump and the air compressor; a fire extinguishing agent tank storing a fixed amount of a fire extinguishing agent such as foam; a mixing device unit manufacturing a chemical fire extinguishing agent by mixing the fire extinguishing agent, the pressurizing fire water, and the compressed air; a hose reel system; a firefighting robot easily suppressing a fire; a control unit driving and controlling the pressing pump, the air compressor, the power unit, the mixing device unit, and the firefighting robot; a van type transfer vehicle rapidly driving on a fire scene; and a lamp device allowing the firefighting robot to vertically move without other devices such as a crane.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 기동형 로봇 화재진압 시스템은 소화전에서 소방수를 공급받아 가압시켜 가압소방수를 배출하는 가압펌프와; 압축공기를 생산하는 에어컴프레셔와; 상기 가압펌프와 에어컴프레셔에 동력을 공급하는 동력부와; 폼 등 일정량의 소화약제를 저장하는 소화약제탱크와; A급 화재진압을 위해 상기 가압소방수가 그대로 통과하거나, B급 화재진압 약재의 효과적인 발포를 위해 상기 소화약제와 가압소방수와 압축공기를 혼합하여 화학화재 약제를 제조하는 혼합장치부와; 상기 혼합장치부를 거친 상기 가압소방수나 화학화재 약제를 방출하는 통로가 되는 소방호스와 상기 소방호스를 걸어두는 호스릴과 소방노즐을 포함하며, 소방로봇에 결합하거나 직접 소방호스의 말단에 소방노즐을 결합하여 방사하는 호스릴 시스템과; 상기 가압소방수나 화학화재 약제를 이송하는 상기 소방호스가 가압소방수 인입부에 결합되어 화재 진압 시에 소방관이 접근하기 어려운 협소지역에 투입시켜 용이하게 화재를 진압하는 소방로봇과; 상기 가압펌프, 에어컴프레셔, 동력부, 혼합장치부 및 소방로봇을 운전하고 제어하는 제어부와; 상기 가압펌프, 에어컴프레셔, 동력부, 약재탱크, 혼합장치부, 호스릴 시스템, 제어부 및 소방로봇이 설치 또는 적재되어 화재 현장을 신속히 이송할 수 있는 승합차 타입의 이송차량과; 상기 이송차량에 설치되어 상기 소방로봇이 크레인과 같은 다른 장치의 도움없이 오르내릴 수 있게 하는 램프장치로 구성된다. 
본 발명의 기동형 로봇 화재진압 시스템에 따르면 기동성이 뛰어나고 소형차량에 탑재되므로 신속한 화재현장 접근이 가능하고, A급 화재 시 10kg/㎠ G의 가압소방수를 배출할 수 있으며, 대형소방차 또는 화학차 없이 소화전만을 이용하여 B급 화재진압 가능하고, 화학약제 방수 시에는 방수하기 전에 혼합장치부에서 강제적으로 압축공기로 혼합하여 최적의 발포 상태를 유지할 수 있으며, 전복주행이 가능한 소방로봇을 적용함으로써 최악 조건의 화재현장에 소방로봇을 직접 투입할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: All-terrain disaster relief forcible entry device
abstract_en: An all-terrain disaster relief forcible entry device is mainly composed of a road clearing shovel, a front track type traction chassis, a lifting device, a hinging steering mechanism, a rear track type traction chassis and a forcible entry excavation device. The all-terrain disaster relief forcible entry device integrates functions of forcible entry, excavation, lifting, carrying and road clearing. The all-terrain disaster relief forcible entry device is high in mobility and passing capability and can walk in complex terrains such as mountainous regions, snow fields, marsh land and deserts. The all-terrain disaster relief forcible entry device can serve as a disaster relief device, is applied to forcible entry and removal against obstacles on the sites of major disasters such as earthquakes, debris flow and landslide, can also serve as an ordinary engineering machine and is widely applied to the fields of post-disaster reconstruction and construction at ordinary time and the like.

title_en: Nuclear accident consequence assessment and auxiliary decision integrated platform and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear accident consequence assessment and auxiliary decision integrated platform and method. In the accident early emergency response period, on one hand, the radiation dose of radioactive emission of a nuclear power plant accident to the public is calculated and assessed in real time through the platform according to weather data and accident source terms, on the other hand, the track and the distribution of radioactive smoke cloud in the accident process and the range and the degree of the radioactive consequence possibly caused to the public are predicted according to the accident source terms and predicated wind fields, and emergency protection action which should be taken by all residence points in influenced areas and radioactive doses which can be prevented by the public after action is taken are given through a geography information subsystem in the platform according to the assessment and predication results, so that a technical basis and a method are provided for emergency decisions of a nuclear power plant in an accident period.
assignees: SUZHOU NUCLEAR POWER RES INST;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER

title_en: Cloud deck fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud deck fire-fighting robot. The cloud deck fire-fighting robot comprises a cloud deck, wherein the cloud deck is connected with a water gun and is provided with a monitoring camera and a rotary part; the cloud deck is rotated by the rotary part; the water gun is further connected with a fire extinguishing agent supplying system; the monitoring camera is used for remotely monitoring; the cloud deck is used for driving the water gun to be collimated with a fire point; the fire extinguishing agent supplying system is used for controlling the water gun to spray a fire extinguishing agent or not; the cloud deck and a fire extinguishing agent control system are remotely controlled to finish movement. The cloud deck fire-fighting robot can rapidly respond when the fire point appears and can be remotely controlled to extinguish a fire, so as to reduce the loss caused by fire disasters to be lowest as soon as possible; an existing video monitoring system can also be combined to carry out upgrading and reconstruction, the deployment is rapidly carried out and the deployment cost is reduced.

title_en: A kind of production, manage, the anti-Ore-controlling Role of fire in three-in-one place of staying
abstract_en: A kind of production, manage, the anti-Ore-controlling Role of fire in three-in-one place of staying, including be arranged on escape stair (14), produce/storage room (17), manage room (18), lodging room (16) in free-standing smoke sensitive fire hazard detection alarm (19), also include quick fire-fighting spraying extinguishing device；Described quick fire-fighting spraying extinguishing device, (5) it is connected with total water-supply-pipe including multiple layering water-supply-pipes, total water-supply-pipe water inlet end (5) be provided with fire protection pipeline interface (10), helical vane type water meter (8) with soft sealing gate valve (7), be connected with multiple rapid response sprinkler (1) below each layering water-supply-pipe.Its advantage is: the present invention carries out appropriate reconstruction according to the present situation in three-in-one place, can low at hydraulic pressure, space is crowded, personnel's fire-fighting consciousness thin etc. under the conditions of effectively solve to produce, manage, problem that three-in-one place fire fighting device shortage of staying, disaster hidden-trouble are serious, strengthen its fire savety.

title_en: A kind of data reconstruction method and device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of data reconstruction method and device, is related to field of data storage.Method includes：In a disaster recovery database being stored on disaster tolerance main frame to the array data come from production host duplication；Array data in the disaster recovery database produces snapshot copy, and is stored in the snapshot database of the disaster tolerance main frame；When the disaster recovery database makes a mistake, according to the error log of the disaster recovery database, a snapshot copy nearest when being made a mistake from the array data is obtained；According to the snapshot copy, the disaster recovery database made a mistake is recovered.The present invention is backed up the data in disaster recovery database using snapping technique, when mistake occur in the data that disaster recovery database records production main frame, disaster recovery database can be recovered by a snapshot copy nearest apart from the wrong time of origin.

title_en: Quick chemical leakage predicating and warning emergency response decision-making method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quick chemical leakage predicating and warning emergency response decision-making method which combines diffusion model simulation with a neural network and a gas sensor system and is applied to quick warning and aid decision making of leakage of harmful gas in an industrial park. The method includes park risk factor identification, numerical simulation, data screening, neural network training and sensor system and neural network model integration, wherein the park risk factor identification is used for identifying various possible leakage accidents, the numerical simulation includes simulating all the possible accidents to obtain a range of influences of the harmful gas, the data screening includes extracting and reconstructing an effective part in a numerical simulation result according to actual sensor layout, the neural network training includes training specific neural network models by the aid of screened data so as to acquire model parameters aiming for the specific industrial park and surrounding conditions and using redundant data for parameter validation, and sensor system and neural network model integration includes combining the models with a sensor DCS (distributed control system).

title_en: Method of managing traffic accicident information using electronic recording device of vehicle and apparatus for the same
title_ko: 차량 블랙박스와 연동한 교통사고 정보 관리 방법 및 이를 위한 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for managing traffic accident information using a black box. The method for managing traffic accident information using a black box according to the present invention comprises the steps of: recognizing an accident situation by detecting an image or a sound of a predetermined pattern from a neighboring vehicle in the event of a traffic accident; generating transmission information by selecting information related to the accident situation from the information collected by a black box of the neighboring vehicle and sending the transmission information to an integrated management server along with time information and position information; integrating and reconfiguring the received transmission information per accident by classifying the received transmission information according to time and position by the integrated management server; and performing accident determination using the integrated and reconfigured information and informing an accident handling service server of the accident determination to perform an accident handling service.
abstract_ko: 블랙박스와 연동한 교통사고 정보 관리 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.  본 발명에 따른 블랙박스와 연동한 교통사고 정보 관리 방법은, 교통사고 발생시 주변 차량에서 기설정된 패턴의 영상이나 음향을 감지하여 사고 상황을 인식하는 단계; 상기 주변 차량이 블랙박스에 수집된 정보 중 상기 사고 상황과 관련된 정보를 선별하여 송신 정보를 생성하고, 상기 송신 정보를 시간 정보 및 위치 정보와 함께 통합 관리 서버로 전송하는 단계; 상기 통합 관리 서버가 수신된 송신 정보를 시간과 위치를 기준으로 분류하여 사고별로 통합 및 재구성하는 단계; 및 상기 통합 및 재구성된 정보를 이용하여 사고 판정을 수행하고, 상기 사고 판정을 받은 경우 사고 처리 서비스 서버로 통보하여 사고 처리 서비스가 수행되도록 하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: an apparatus for making fire explosion painting of ship
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an experimental apparatus for reproducing fire explosion occurring when painting a ship, capable of making a user to recognize danger of fire explosion in advance before a painting work when the ship is built, being used for a safety education, easily confirming the material safety data sheet (MSDS) flashing point of a painting material, especially a new painting material, and significantly increasing the safety of work by recognizing the flashing point of painting spray by the confirming work. The experimental apparatus for reducing fire explosion occurring when painting a ship comprises a chamber (10) having a space part with an opening side; a sealing means (20) forming a sealing space by being coupled to the chamber (10); an injecting unit (30) injecting a painting material into the chamber (10); a temperature and humidity measuring device (40) sensing the temperature and humidity in the chamber (10); a gas sensor (50) sensing the content of gas in the chamber (10); an ignition source (60) igniting in the chamber (10); and a thermostatic heat patch (70) attached to the outside of the chamber (10).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박의 건조 시 도장작업 전 화재폭발의 위험성을 미리 인지할 수 있도록 함과 동시에 안전교육용으로도 사용할 수 있도록 하고, 또한 도장재료 특히 신규 도장재료의 물질안전보건자료(MSDS) 인화점을 용이하게 검증할 수 있도록 하며. 그리고 이를 통해 도장 스프레이의 인화점을 파악하여 작업의 안전성을 한층 더 증대시킬 수 있도록 한 선박의 도장작업 시 화재폭발재현 실험장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 일측이 개방된 공간부를 갖는 챔버(10); 상기 챔버(10)에 결합되어 밀폐공간을 형성하는 밀폐수단(20); 상기 챔버(10)의 내부로 도장재료를 주입하는 주입부(30); 상기 챔버(10)의 내부 온습도를 감지하는 온습도측정기(40); 상기 챔버(10)의 내부 가스농도를 감지하는 가스검지기(50); 상기 챔버(10)의 내부에 점화를 하기 위한 점화원(60); 상기 챔버(10)의 외부에 부착되는 온도조절용 열패치(70)를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Country prefabricated steel structure residence system and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a country prefabricated steel structure residence system and a construction method of the country prefabricated steel structure residence system. The country prefabricated steel structure residence system comprises plane assembling units, stereoscopic assembling units, stair assembling units and independent component units. The plane assembling units comprise steel pipe concrete columns and H-steel beams forming rectangular frames, each stereoscopic assembling unit is defined by four plane assembling units, a herringbone support is arranged in at least one plane assembling unit in each stereoscopic assembling unit, and a light structure triangular roof truss is arranged on the top layer. Sleeves are welded to vertical connecting column joints at the lower ends of the steel pipe concrete columns, the sleeves are welded to the H-steel beams, and reinforcing plates are further arranged at the joint points where the steel pipe concrete columns and the H-steel beams are connected. Reinforced concrete foundation columns are connected to the bottoms of the steel pipe concrete columns on the first layer, and independent reinforced concrete foundations are further arranged at the bottoms of the reinforced concrete foundation columns. The system is convenient to assemble, short in using time and capable of being widely applied to rural residences and post-disaster reconstruction projects.
assignees: BEIJING AEIDO ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Smoke thermal imaging fire automatic positioning detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a smoke thermal imaging fire automatic positioning detection system and method. All photoelectric smoke detectors are encoded through an encoder, the position serial number of each detector is made to correspond to a thermal imaging view field, and thus the specific position of a fire can be determined. A thermal imager is used for monitoring the field, the fire behavior can be discovered earlier compared with a common video detector, and the system and method are particularly suitable for hazardous places such as aircraft cargo spaces, nuclear power stations and high voltage transformer substations where people cannot enter easily. When a smoke alarm gives out a fire alarm, at the moment, if no excessive heat video areas are captured by the thermal imager, the fire alarm can be removed, and accordingly loss caused by a fake fire alarm can be lowered. The multi-working mode and multi-interface design is adopted, the practicability can be improved, and equipment transformation in the later period is facilitated. Smoke signal detection and thermal image detection are combined, an intelligent information processing method is used for detecting and positioning fires, and accordingly the intelligence of fire fighting equipment is promoted. The place where the smoke alarm has already been mounted can be upgraded and reconstructed, and the robustness of a detection result can also be improved.

title_en: Control circuit of low-voltage switch box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control circuit of a low-voltage switch box, which is characterized in that: a normal open contact of a fire-fighting relay KA is in series to a coil loop of a switched shunt trip QF. Because the circuit structure above mentioned is adopted, the control circuit of the low-voltage switch box can accurately cut off a switching power supply in real time by using the fire-fighting relay KA. The reliability of power supply is improved, and the security of power supply is guaranteed. extra cost is prevented, and wide-range popularization and reconstruction are suitable.

title_en: Apparatus, system and method for reviewing game information by referees
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to an apparatus, system and method, and more particularly to an apparatus, system and method providing for referees to communicate with each other and/or other officiators on or off the field using an article of headwear equipped with communication means attached thereto, where the communication means is in communication with at least one portable remote terminal and as such the referee can dynamically receive electronic communications concerning video replays, field incidents on or off the field, play calls, signal calls, etc., from other referees on/or off the field or court.

title_en: End, wall limit concave waves masonry wall
abstract_en: The present invention is that end, a kind of wall limit concave waves masonry wall, solves masonry wall causes anti-seismic performance and shake under earthquake in sloping section shear failure form after and fits the problem of repairing poor performance.Masonry is positioned at the upper limb at arbitrary hole or lower edge absolute altitude place without the Qiang Duan left and right sides, hole and is provided with to masonry without the recessed indent hole of hole wall intersegmental part, the internally recessed horizontal dimension in indent hole is less than or equal to masonry without 1/3rd of the Qiang Duan left and right sides, hole back gauge, filling flexible thing in indent hole.Working mechanism of the present invention is novel, effectively can prevent the shear failure of masonry wall, realize normal section bending crack form; Can improve ductility and the energy dissipation capacity of masonry wall, suitable repairing property after greatly strengthening shake, repairs difficulty after alleviating the earthquake resistant engineering disaster relief and shake; Its easy construction, cost amplitude of variation is small, is applicable to the provide fortification against earthquakes masonry structure building construction in district, strengthening reconstruction and post earthquake recovery of general masonry project facility, particularly highlight lines and rebuilds.

title_en: Technical method for applying no-backup disaster recovery based on cloud computing platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a technical method for applying no-backup disaster recovery based on a cloud computing platform. A virtual machine is recovered through a memory extraction technology XML mode; when a virtual machine system is subject to damage and faults or the virtual machine is lost, system files are recovered by calling mapping files related to a memory and a core module, and a virtual machine state which is five minutes prior to the occurrence of the problem is recovered. The technical method comprises a first step of virtual machine log information storage, a second step of indexing, a third step of memory frame reconstruction and a fourth step of biomimetic recovery. Compared with the prior art, the technical method has the advantages that on the conditions of no backup, all data on the virtual machine system and the virtual machine are automatically recovered, and stability and safety of the cloud computing virtual machine are improved; resource consumption is reduced and the resource utilization rate is improved; device investment and the number of maintainers are reduced and cost is effectively reduced; the virtual machine state which is five minutes prior to the occurrence of the problem can be recovered only through 3-7 minutes, and efficiency is high.

title_en: The method of humidifying recharged dry air in breathing apparatus
title_ko: 공기호흡기 용기에 충전된 건조공기의 호흡시 가습 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명품은 기존 공기호흡기의 건조한 공기를 화재현장이나 밀폐된 공간에서 사용자가 장시간 호흡할 경우 목(기도)마름 현상 및 심폐기능 장애를 해소 하기위해 고안한 것이다. 
기존 공기호흡기는 고압으로 충전된 건조한 공기를 감압기를 거쳐 대기압상태로 약 한 시간 정도 호흡할 수 있는 것으로 공기의 변질을 막기 위해 대기의 공기를 충전시에 충전기(COMPRESSOR)에서 완전 제습되기 때문에 호흡과정에 별도의 가습기능이 없다. 
따라서, 공기통에서 호흡기마스크에 이르는 과정에 가습기능 부품을 부설하여 쾌적한 공기로 사용자의 호흡이 가능하여 장시간의 활동에도 목마름 현상 및 폐기능 손상 장애를 해소하는 것이다.

title_en: Brickmaking moving factory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a brickmaking moving factory which comprises an integration box, a tray warehouse, a forming machine, a storage hopper, a brick stacking device, a film winding device and a center control device. The tray warehouse, the forming machine, the storage hopper, the brick stacking device, the film winding device and the center control device are arranged in the integration box, a tray inlet and a brick outlet are formed in the front face and the right face of the integration box respectively, the tray warehouse, the forming machine and the film winding machine are sequentially arranged in the integration box from left to right, and the storage hopper and the brick stacking device are arranged at the front position and the back position of the forming machine in an adaptation mode, and a tray conveying line is arranged on the bottom face of the integration box. The brickmaking moving factory is particularly suitable for solid waste treatment such as post-disaster reconstruction and post-war reconstruction, the moving factory can be driven to the scene, construction waste is converted into various wall bricks, floor tiles and road edge bricks on site, solid waste generated by oilfield exploiting can be converted into floor tiles for a well area, artificial stone for road repairing of the mine area and the like through the moving treatment line, and field installation, consumable items, manual work, auxiliary facilities and logistics transportation are removed, and the factory is environmentally friendly, high in integration and high in automation and utilizes the waste.
assignees: FUJIAN EXCELLENCE HONCHA BUILDING MATERIAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation guidance system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable an evacuation guidance announcement informing an evacuee of distances to an evacuation gate through directional loudspeakers arranged at predetermined intervals to be continuously, clearly and reliably heard by the evacuee while the same is moving.SOLUTION: In an evacuation guidance system, directional loudspeakers 14-1 to 14-4 are arranged in a corridor 32 leading to an evacuation site at predetermined intervals and announcement phrases of an evacuation guidance announcement informing an evacuee of distances to an evacuation gate 34 are output when a fire breaks out. An announcement playback device sets an announcement cycle so that at least two cycles are included in transit time to pass through each protective range on the basis of transit distances in the respective protective ranges 36-1 to 36-4 of the directional loudspeakers 14-1 to 14-4 and a moving speed of the evacuee. The announcement phrases of the evacuation guidance announcement are repeatedly output through the directional loudspeakers 14-1 to 14-4 with the announcement cycle. Thus, the evacuee can hear at least one complete cycle of the announcement phrase from beginning to end while the evacuee passes through respective protective ranges 36-1 to 36-4 of the directional loudspeakers 14-1 to 14-4.

title_en: Remote network digital audio-visual alarm and safety protection control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a remote network digital audio-visual alarm and safety protection control system. The system comprises a digital hard disk video alarm host machine disposed in a protected area or a spot, a camera, an inductor, a controller, a sound gatherer, an emergency button and a remote control center. The camera, the inductor, the controller, the sound gatherer and the emergency button are connected to the digital hard disk video alarm host machine. The digital hard disk video alarm host machine is connected to the control center through a communication network, a PSTN network and the Internet. The remote network digital audio-visual alarm and safety protection control system enables flexible video adjustment, simple video playback, fire-fighting control, remote control, self-maintenance, timely, rapid and accurate alarm handling, on-site communication, wide monitor scope, and other accessory control.
assignees: HUIZHOU MAO RONG INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Information transmission device, and information transmission method and program
abstract_en: Provided is an information transmission device that can reduce the effort related to confirming disaster information. An outdoor child station reception/ public address broadcast unit (1) receives disaster information over a wireless disaster system and transmits the disaster information received in a voice output format. A recording/playback unit (4) records the disaster information. A weak FM transmitter (5) transmits the disaster information recorded by the recording/playback unit (4) in an output format other than the voice output format.

title_en: Horse-riding simulation system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a horse-riding simulation system. The present invention comprises: a sensor part including at least one sensor for sensing the motion of a user to generate a sensing signal; a control device for generating a control signal by selecting at least one pattern among previously stored multiple horse-riding patterns, in response to a command input by the user, and then analyzing the selected pattern and the sensing signal applied from the sensor part; a driving part including at least one motor device and multiple mechanical joints and reproducing the motion of a horse into mechanical movement in response to the control signal applied from the control device; a saddle for allowing the user to ride thereon and transmitting the mechanical motion of the driving part to the riding user; and at least one sonic vibration generator for reproducing the motion of the horse into sonic vibration in response to the control signal applied from the control device. Accordingly, a great exercise effect can be obtained for a short period of time through the sonic vibration method, and the muscular motion or respiration of the actual horse can be reproduced by adjusting the frequency of sonic vibration, thereby allowing the user to experience more real horse-riding.
abstract_ko: 승마 시뮬레이션 시스템을 공개한다.  본 발명은 사용자의 움직임을 감지하여 센싱 신호를 발생하는 적어도 하나의 센서를 포함하는 센서부, 사용자가 입력하는 명령에 대응하여 기저장된 복수개의 승마 패턴 중 적어도 하나의 패턴을 선택하고, 선택된 패턴과 센서부에서 인가되는 센싱 신호를 분석하여 제어 신호를 발생하는 제어 장치, 적어도 하나의 전동 기기와 복수개의 기계적 관절을 구비하여 제어 장치에서 인가되는 제어 신호에 응답하여  말의 움직임을 기계적 운동으로 재현하는 구동부, 사용자가 탑승할 수 있으며, 구동부의 기계적 움직임을 탑승한 사용자에게 전달하는 안장, 및 제어 장치에서 인가되는 제어 신호에 응답하여 말의 움직임을 음파 진동으로 재현하는 적어도 하나의 음파진동 발생기를 포함한다.  따라서, 음파 진동의 진동 요법으로 인해 짧은 시간에 큰 운동 효과를 낼 수 있으며, 음파 진동의 주파수를 조절하여 실제 말의 근육의 움직임이나 호흡 등을 재현하여, 사용자가 사실감 높은 승마 체험을 할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Carbon dioxide safety fire extinguishing system preventing choking accidents and carbon dioxide safety fire extinguishing method
title_ko: 질식사고를 방지하는 이산화탄소 안전 소화설비 및 이산화탄소 안전 소화방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a CO2-SAFE fire extinguishing system and a CO2-SAFE fire extinguishing method. According to the present invention, excessive CO2 injection can be blocked through human presence detection even when a fire detector detects a fire in an automatic mode and persons at a fire scene can be protected from a suffocation accident attributable to remaining CO2 during follow-up fire suppression or fire scene restoration after CO2 injection. The present invention includes a fire detector that is disposed in a protective zone of a building and detects a fire before signal transmission; an injection nozzle that is disposed in the protective zone for CO2 injection; a concentration gauge that is disposed in the protective zone and measures the concentration of CO2 remaining in the protective zone before signal transmission; a door lock that is disposed in a door of the protective zone to lock or unlock the door; and a controller that determines fire occurrence in the protective zone based on the signal transmitted from the fire detector and controls CO2 to be injected through the injection nozzle. The controller controls the door lock based on the signal transmitted from the concentration gauge after CO2 injection is completed so that the door of the protective zone remains locked in a case where the concentration of the CO2 remaining in the protective zone exceeds a set reference value and the door of the protective zone is unlocked in a case where the concentration of the CO2 remaining in the protective zone is equal to or below the set reference value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자동모드에서 화재감지기가 화재를 감지하더라도 재실자를 감지하여 이산화탄소의 무분별한 분사를 차단하는 것에 그치지 않고 이산화탄소가 분사된 이후에도 후속적인 화재진압이나 화재현장 복구시 잔존하는 이산화탄소로 인해 현장요원들이 질식사고를 당하지 않도록 한 이산화탄소 안전 소화설비 및 이산화탄소 안전 소화방법으로서, 건물 내 방호구역에 설치되고 화재발생을 감지하여 신호를 전달하는 화재감지기와; 상기 방호구역에 설치되어 이산화탄소를 분사하는 분사노즐과; 상기 방호구역에 설치되어 상기 방호구역 내부에 잔존하는 이산화탄소의 농도를 측정하여 신호를 전달하는 농도측정기와; 상기 방호구역의 출입문에 설치되어 상기 출입문을 잠금 상태로 만들거나 잠금 상태를 해제하는 도어락과; 상기 화재감지기로부터 전달받은 신호를 근거로 상기 방호구역의 화재발생 여부를 판단하고 상기 분사노즐을 통해 이산화탄소가 분사되도록 제어하며, 이산화탄소의 분사가 완료된 후에는 상기 농도측정기로부터 전달받은 신호를 근거로 상기 방호구역 내부에 잔존하는 이산화탄소의 농도가 설정된 기준치를 초과하는 경우에는 상기 방호구역의 출입문을 잠금 상태로 유지하고, 반대로 상기 방호구역 내부에 잔존하는 이산화탄소의 농도가 설정된 기준치 이하인 경우에는 상기 방호구역의 출입문을 잠금 상태로부터 해제하도록 상기 도어락을 제어하는 제어기를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Unmanned plane for fire reconnaissance and fire-fighters
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radio-controlled plane for reconnaissance at a fire site and fire suppression that can be sent quickly to the fire site where a fireman can hardly enter. The radio-controlled plane includes a plane unit configured to be radio-controlled; a fire suppression unit mounted to the bottom surface of the plane unit and equipped with a plurality of fire-fighting solution ampoules to discharge the ampoules to the fire site; a camera transmission unit mounted to the fire suppression unit to photograph and transmit situations of the fire site and a moving path of the ampoules in real time; a control unit for displaying the fire site image received from the camera transmission unit and transmitting a discharge signal of the ampoules to the fire suppression unit; and a controller for controlling the plane unit and the fire suppression unit in response to the control signal received from the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방대원이 진입하기 어려운 화재현장에 빠르게 투입시키기에 적합한 화재현장 정찰 및 화재진압용 무인비행기를 개시한다. 개시된 본 발명에 따른 화재현장 정찰 및 화재진압용 무인비행기는, 무선 비행이 가능한 비행유닛; 상기 비행유닛의 하면에 장착되며, 내부에 복수의 소화용액 앰플들이 탑재되어 화재현장에 상기 소화용액 앰플들을 발사 및 투하하는 화재진압유닛; 상기 화재진압유닛에 장착되며, 화재현장 상황 및 소화용액 앰플의 이동 경로를 촬영하여 실시간 송신하는 카메라 송신유닛; 상기 카메라 송신유닛으로부터 수신된 화재현장 영상을 표시하고 상기 화재진압유닛에 상기 소화용액 앰플의 발사 및 투하 신호를 송신하는 관제유닛; 및 상기 관제유닛으로부터 수신된 관제신호에 따라 상기 비행유닛 및 화재진압유닛을 제어하는 제어유닛;을 포함한다.

title_en: Rural assembled steel structure residence system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rural assembled steel structure residence system, which comprises plane splicing units, a three-dimensional splicing unit, a stair splicing unit and a single component splicing unit, wherein each plane splicing unit comprises steel pipe concrete posts and H steel beams; the steel pipe concrete posts form a rectangular framework; the four plane splicing units define the three-dimensional splicing unit; a herringbone supporter is also arranged in at least one plane splicing unit arranged in the three-dimensional splicing unit; the top layer is provided with a light-weight steel structure triangular house frame; a sleeve is welded with a vertical connecting post joint arranged at the lower end of each steel pipe concrete post; the sleeves are welded with the H steel beams; reinforcing plates are also arranged in positions of nodes for connecting the steel pipe concrete posts and the H steel beams; the bottoms of the first layer steel pipe concrete posts are also connected and provided with reinforced concrete foundation posts; the bottoms of the reinforced concrete foundation posts are also provided with an independent reinforced concrete foundation. The rural assembled steel structure residence system has the advantages that the splicing is convenient; the time consumption is low; and the rural assembled steel structure residence system can be widely applied to rural residence and post-disaster reconstruction engineering.
assignees: BEIJING AEIDO ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Electric power supporting method taking adjacent systems into consideration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power supporting method taking adjacent systems into consideration, and relates to the field of recovery and control of an electric power system. The method comprises the following steps: a, establishing an object function; b, contracting a node; c, calculating a line betweenness; and d, optimizing and recovering a line. According to the invention, through recovering a generator and a load as much as possible and searching for an optimal power delivery path, the network reconstruction process is accelerated, and the path recovery time is shortened. Besides, path recovery and power support of adjacent electric power systems in the condition of a climate disaster are taken into consideration, and black-start recovery after an electric power system fails completely is safer and more reliable.

title_en: Factory is moved in a kind of brickmaking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of brickmaking and moves factory, comprises integral box and is arranged on pallet storehouse, forming machine, storage bin hopper, buttress brick device, thin film winding machine and the control device in this integral box; The front of integral box and the right side form respectively into pallet mouth and brick outlet; Pallet storehouse, forming machine and thin film winding machine are installed successively from left to right in integral box, and storage bin hopper and buttress brick device are in the adaptive installation of forming machine front and back position; On the bottom surface of integral box, be also provided with pallet pipeline.This novel brickmaking is moved factory and is applicable to especially in the solid waste processing such as post-disaster reconstruction or post-war reconstruction, and scene can be reached by mobile factory, on the spot building waste is converted to various wall bricks, floor tile, curb brick; The solid waste that oilfield exploitation produces, the mobile line of processing converts it to artificial stone that floor tile for wellblock, mining area repair the roads etc.Exempt from on-the-spot installation, exempt from consumptive material, manpower-free, exempt from auxiliary equipment, exempt from logistics transhipment, environmental protection, profit are given up, highly integrated, increasingly automated.
