title_en: Image rebuilding method, device and system for reactor core fused mass status monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of image rebuilding method, equipment for reconstructing image and monitoring system for reactor core fused mass status monitoring.The method comprising the steps of：The system model of monitoring object is established, obtains sytem matrixes of cosmic ray μ through the data for projection and image of monitoring object；Initialisation image；Obtain the real projection data that cosmic ray μ passes through monitoring object；Image based on initialization, real projection data, sytem matrix carry out algebraically iteration to image；And be combined by the reconstruction image for the reactor core molten condition for obtaining algebraically iteration with the system model of monitoring object, obtain the final image of reactor core fused mass state.Technique according to the invention scheme, quickly and accurately reactor core state can be monitored, enable to emergency command personnel to understand accurate accident process in time according to the reconstructed results of the present invention, and then propose more effective accident mitigation measure.

title_en: A safety banister for evacuaton a fire
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety fire escape shelf for evacuation. A first rotating shaft rotating a frame of a rotation support inward and outward of a building is coupled to an upper surface of a window frame, a handrail, or an upper surface of a wall. A second rotating shaft rotating to fold a bottom part is coupled to an end of the frame. Foldable support connecting parts are connected to a pair of frames and both sides of the bottom part. The safety fire escape shelf for evacuation makes the bottom part to be placed in the air in an one-touch manner by moving the rotation support arranged in a building over a wind frame or a handrail at the time of fire, thereby temporarily evacuating a user from a fire. According to the present invention, the safety fire escape shelf for evacuation can prevent damage due to an external element by arranging a structure in a building, can preserve the appearance of a building, can be arranged and used for a long time by being protected from rainwater, dusts or the likes, can be easily maintained and repaired by storing the structure in a building, can increase a space utility efficiency by arranging the structure in a folded state, and can quickly evacuate a user by making a temporary shelter in an one-touch manner of moving the structure over a window frame or a handrail in the case of emergency.

본 발명은 화재 대피용 안전 난간대에 관한 것으로, 창틀, 난간 혹은 벽체 상면에 회전지지체의 프레임을 건물 내,외부로 회전시키는 제1회전축을 결합하고, 프레임 말단에 바닥부를 절첩 가능하게 회전시키는 제2회전축을 결합하며, 한 쌍의 프레임과 바닥부 양 측면에 절첩되는 각각의 지탱연결부를 연결하고, 화재발생시 건물 내부에 배치된 회전지지체를 창틀 혹은 난간 넘어로 넘김으로써, 원터치 방식으로 바닥부가 공중에 부양되어 화재현장에서 사용자를 임시 대피시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Fire wood type hot blaster boiler having fire extinguishing function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firewood boiler including: an outer housing having a fuel input door through which firewood is inputted, an ash discharge door engaged to a lower portion of the fuel input door to be able to be opened or closed, and a chimney through which combustion gas is discharged outwardly; a combustion chamber communicating with the fuel input door and the ash discharge door, in which the firewood fuel is burned; a blower for supplying outer air to the combustion chamber; a primary heat exchange chamber for receiving the combustion gas generated from the combustion chamber to carry out primary heat exchange with heating water; a secondary heat exchange chamber disposed above the primary combustion chamber and connected to the chimney, through which the combustion gas passing the primary combustion chamber moves to carry out secondary heat exchange with the heating water; and a fire suppression unit provided on the outer wall of the outer housing to detect generation of fire around the outer housing and to spray fire fighting water to a firing spot at outbreak of fire. The primary heat exchange chamber includes: a combustion chamber connecting pipe connected to the combustion chamber; a heating water pipe disposed in a horizontal direction to the moving direction of the combustion gas, through which the heating water flows; a plurality of vertical branched pipes disposed at an interval in a vertical direction, through which the combustion gas fed from the combustion chamber flows; and a vertical combined pipe formed by combining the vertical branched pipes and connected to the bottom surface of the secondary heat exchange chamber. The fire suppression unit has: a fire detecting portion provided on the outside of the outer housing to detect the outbreak of fire; and a plurality of spray nozzles provided on the outside of the outer housing to spray the fire fighting water to the fire spot.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 화목보일러에 관한 것으로서, 화목연료가 투입되는 연료투입도어 및 상기 연료투입도어의 하부에 구비되는 재배출도어가 개폐가능하게 결합되며, 연소가스가 외부로 배기되는 연통이 결합된 외부하우징과; 상기 연료투입도어 및 상기 재배출도어와 연통되게 형성되며 화목연료가 연소되는 연소실과; 상기 연소실로 외기를 공급하는 송풍기와; 상기 연소실에서 연소된 연소가스가 이동하며 난방수와 1차 열교환이 진행되는 1차열교환실과; 상기 1차연소실의 상부에 배치되며 상기 연통과 결합되고, 상기 1차연소실을 경유한 연소가스가 이동하며 난방수와 2차 열교환이 이루어지는 2차열교환실을 포함하며, 상기 외부하우징의 외벽면에 구비되어 상기 외부하우징 주변의 화재발생여부를 감지하고, 화재발생시 소화수를 화재현장으로 분사하는 화재진압부를 포함하며, 상기 1차열교환실은, 상기 연소실과 연결되는 연소실연결관과; 연소가스의 이동방향에 가로방향으로 배치되며 내부에 난방수가 유동하는 난방수파이프와; 수직방향으로 서로 이격되게 배치되며 상기 연소실로부터 유입된 연소가스가 이동되는 복수개의 수직분기관과, 상기 복수개의 수직분기관이 병합되어 상기 2차열교환실의 바닥면으로 연결되는 수직병합관을 포함하며; 상기 화재진압부는, 상기 외부하우징의 외측에 구비되어 화재발생을 감지하는 화재감지부와; 상기 외부하우징의 외측에 구비되어 화재현장으로 소화수를 분사하는 복수개의 분사노즐을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Backup method and backup device for database as well as electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a backup method and a backup device for a database as well as electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps of acquiring a physical backup of the database and acquiring a first backup point corresponding to the physical backup; acquiring a logical log backup between the first backup point and a second backup point; performing operation playback on the physical backup according to the logical log backup to generate a physical backup corresponding to the second backup point. According to the backup method in the embodiment disclosed by the invention, an operation requirement of a user on the database is prevented from being blocked during backup, reasonable arrangement of the backup frequency of the database is facilitated, and the operation experience of the user is improved; in addition, incremental backup is realized through the logical log backup between two backup points, so the backup efficiency of the database is improved. Besides, multilevel data disaster tolerance can be realized, so the possibility that the data in the database are lost or damaged due to faults or accidents is reduced.

title_en: Reclaimed concrete U-shaped rib dumbbell type columnar pier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reclaimed concrete U-shaped rib dumbbell type columnar pier which is formed by welding two steel plates and two round steel tubes with U-shaped steel grooves, wherein common aggregate concrete is cast in the U-shaped steel grooves and between the two parallel steel plates; reclaimed aggregate concrete is cast in the round steel pipes. The reclaimed concrete U-shaped rib dumbbell type columnar pier can be used for solving the problem of reclaimed concrete use limitation caused by poor strength, poor endurance quality and the like, is beneficial to popularization and application of the reclaimed concrete in bridge engineering and engineering rubbish recycling, and can be applied to skew bridges in regions with higher earthquake intensity and regions with difficulty in constructional material transportation; as for the bridges destroyed by earthquake, the destroyed bridges can be immediately crushed to obtain reclaimed aggregates, and the reclaimed aggregates are used for replacing part of natural aggregates to repair or reconstruct the bridges, so that the transportation cost is reduced and post-disaster reconstruction can be recovered well.

title_en: Recycled concrete Z-shaped pier stud
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recycled concrete Z-shaped pier stud, which is formed by welding two steel plates and two round steel pipes respectively with a U-shaped steel groove; ordinary aggregate concrete is cast in the U-shaped steel grooves and between the two parallel steel plates; recycled aggregate concrete is cast in the round steel pipes. The recycled concrete Z-shaped pier stud disclosed by the invention is capable of overcoming the problem that the use of recycled concrete is limited due to the fact that strength and endurance quality are poor and the like, is in favor of popularization and application and engineering garbage recycling of the recycled concrete in bridge engineering, and can be applied to skew bridges in regions with strong seismic intensity and regions that building materials are difficult to transport; for bridges damaged by earthquakes, the damaged bridges can be immediately crushed into the recycled concrete, and natural aggregate is replaced with part of the recycled concrete to repair or rebuild the bridges, so that the transport cost is reduced, and post-disaster reconstruction is advantageously recovered.

title_en: A kind of data reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of data reconstruction method, the network data recovery under cloud environment can be realized.Each network node under cloud environment provides a data backup area, for storing the Backup Data of other network nodes; When other network nodes propose data recovery request, recover data from the data backup district of target network node to the network node proposing data recovery request; Redundancy backup and the recovery of particular case lower network data is carried out by disaster tolerance redundant storage center; Carry out the overall situation by cloud control center to the network data recovery under cloud environment to control, regularly can provide the ability scoring screening of date restoring to all-network node, to improve the efficiency of cloud environment lower network date restoring.

title_en: Regeneration concrete band U rib dumbbell shape columnar pier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of regeneration concrete band U rib dumbbell shape columnar pier, be welded to form by two round steel pipes of two block plates and band U-shaped steel tank, build general aggregate concrete in U-shaped steel tank and between two parallel block plates, regenerated aggregate concrete is built in round steel pipe inside.The utility model overcomes because intensity and endurance quality difference etc. cause regeneration concrete to use limited problem, be conducive to regeneration concrete applying and engineering garbage as resource in bridge engineering, can be applicable to earthquake intensity larger area, constructional materials is difficult to the Skew Bridge in region that transports; For by the bridge after seismic damage, immediately the bridge fragmentation of destruction can be gone out regeneration aggregate, repair with regeneration aggregate Some substitute natural aggregate or rebuild bridge, decreasing cost of transportation, be conducive to recovering post-disaster reconstruction.

title_en: A portable oxygen-supplying mask
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 미세먼지 및 인체에 유해한 가스가 발생되는 산업현장이나 화재현장 등과 같은 장소에서 비상시 용이하게 사용할 수 있는 휴대용 산소 마스크에 관한 것이다. 
이를 실현하기 위한 본 고안은 코를 전체적으로 덮을 수 있도록 내부에 수용공간(111)이 마련되고, 밀폐를 위해 적어도 가장자리가 안면부에 밀착되도록 하는 한편 콧구멍과 대향하는 부위에 산소유입공(113) 및 배출공(115)이 관통 형성되는 하우징(110); 상기 배출공(115)에 일단이 연통되게 연결되고, 타단이 콧구멍 속에 일정깊이 삽입되도록 연장 형성되는 한편 외주면에 상기 수용공간(111) 내의 산소를 흡입할 수 있도록 흡입공(121)이 관통 형성되는 튜브형상의 삽입부(120); 및 상기 산소유입공(113)에 연결튜브(133)를 매개로 연결되어 상기 수용공간(111) 내에 산소를 공급해주는 산소공급부(130);를 포함하여 구성되되, 상기 흡입공(121)과 배출공(115)에는 서로 반대로 작동하는 일방향 체크밸브(124)(125)가 제각기 구비되어, 숨을 들이마실 때는 상기 흡입공(121)이 개방되고, 숨을 내쉴 때는 상기 배출공(115)이 개방되도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Learning Language and Computer-Readable Recording Medium with Program Therefor
title_ko: 언어 학습장치, 방법 및 이를 위한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device and a method for learning a language and a computer readable recording medium for the same. The device for learning a language, which is a device for performing language learning by interlocking with a content providing device, comprises: a video playback unit to receive learning video data corresponding to an inputted learning request signal from a content providing device and play the learning video data in a video region; a script playback unit to play script data corresponding to the learning video data in a script region by matching the script data with the learning video data; and a learning function providing unit to display an icon, which provides a learning function for controlling at least one of the learning video data and the script data, in a control region.
abstract_ko:
언어 학습장치, 방법 및 이를 위한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체를 개시한다. 
콘텐츠 제공장치와 연동하여 언어 학습을 수행하기 위한 장치에 있어서, 입력된 학습 요청신호에 대응하는 학습영상 데이터를 상기 콘텐츠 제공장치로부터 수신하며, 상기 학습영상 데이터를 영상 영역에 재생하는 영상 재생부; 상기 학습영상 데이터에 대응하는 스크립트 데이터를 상기 학습영상 데이터와 매칭하여 스크립트 영역에 재생하는 스크립트 재생부; 및 상기 학습영상 데이터 및 상기 스크립트 데이터 중 적어도 하나 이상의 데이터를 제어하기 위한 학습기능을 제공하는 아이콘을 제어 영역에 디스플레이하는 학습기능 제공부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 언어 학습장치를 제공한다.

title_en: A kind of earthquake proof construction energy-dissipation shock-absorbing damp component
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of earthquake proof construction energy-dissipation shock-absorbing damp component, especially a kind of energy-dissipating and shock-absorbing shearing-type mild steel damper component improving building aseismicity performance, is characterized in that: comprise agent structure (1) and energy dissipator; Described energy dissipator comprises damper member (2), embedded part (3), clamping plate (6); Described damper member (2) comprises junction plate (5) and damper (8); Described buried plate (4) is connected with damper (8) by described junction plate (5); Described clamping plate (6) are in the both sides of described junction plate (5); Described clamping plate (6) to be interfixed described junction plate (5) by bolt.The utility model is applicable to be had critical function, Dense crowd public place, building function complexity, needs providing fortification against earthquakes of the new building of reply disaster requirement, the strengthening reconstruction of existent building and maintenance, the constraint that prototype structure realizes building function can be broken through simultaneously, improve building diversity and comfortableness, significantly reduce cost, difficulty of construction, save the duration, improve safety.

title_en: Safety Helmet for firefighting
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire helmet used as a safety equipment in case of fire and, more specifically, to a fire helmet which can conveniently couple a flashlight on a safety helmet and use the same by a fixing member and a coupling member coupled on one side of the safety helmet, and forms an electric whistle inside the fixing member to readily transfer a signal by a fireman who extinguishes fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재를 진압하는 소방관의 안정적인 시야 확보와 신호교환을 이룰 수 있도록 하는 소방용 안전모에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 구성은 화재진압시 안전장비로 사용되는 소방용 안전모에 있어서, 상기 안전모의 일측에는 내측으로 전자휘슬의 삽입이 가능하게 형성되는 고정부재가 탈착 가능하게 결합되고, 상기 고정부재에는 후레시의 결합 사용이 가능하게 형성되는 결합부재가 탈착 가능하게 결합되어 구성될 수 있다. 
이상과 같은 본 발명은, 첫째, 화재현장에서 작업을 이루는 작업자의 머리부위를 보호하기 위하여 착용하는 소방용 안전모로써, 화재를 진압하는 작업자의 안정적인 시야 확보를 이룰 수 있도록 하고, 작업자 간의 신호전달이 편리하게 이루어질 수 있도록 하여 안정적이고 효율적인 화재진압을 이룰 수 있다. 
둘째, 복잡한 구성 없이도 안전모의 외측에 탈착 가능하게 결합되는 고정부재와 결합부재의 구성을 통하여 조명을 이룰 수 있는 후레시와, 소리신호를 발생시킬 수 있는 전자휘슬을 편리하게 탈,부착 가능하게 결합하며 사용할 수 있어 불필요한 제작비용 및 유지비용이 증대되는 것을 방지하며 안정적인 사용을 이룰 수 있다. 
셋째, 조립, 분리가 가능하게 구성되는 고정부재, 결합부재, 후레시, 전자휘슬의 구성을 통하여 사용 중 어느 하나가 파손되더라도 손쉽게 교체하여 사용할 수 있어 사용상 편리함은 물론 제작원가 및 유지비용 절감 등의 효과를 얻을 수 있다. 
넷째, 안전모에 구비되는 복잡한 구성으로 인하여 안전모를 착용한 작업자의 머리부위가 손상될 수 있는 문제를 미연에 방지하여 작업자의 머리부위를 효율적으로 보호할 수 있음은 물론이고, 불필요한 장비의 부착 없이도 작업자의 원활한 시야 확보와 신호전달을 이룰 수 있도록 할 수 있어 급박한 작업환경에서도 편리하고 효율적인 사용이 가능하여 작업자의 안정성을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Power grid disaster recovery control model modeling method based on CIM standard
abstract_en: Provided is a power grid disaster recovery control model modeling method based on the CIM standard. The method comprises the steps of unit start-up optimization model building, network reconstruction optimized mathematical model building and load recovery optimized mathematical model building, and the directions of a unit start-up optimization model, a network reconstruction optimized mathematical model and a load recovery optimized mathematical model are adopted. A power grid analysis model for fault recovery treatment is constructed, an improved model minimum spanning tree fault recovery treatment method for online application is provided, on the basis of modeling a complex regional power grid, the search range and growing direction of a minimum tree are dynamically adjusted according to the current attribute and real-time path weight of a subsystem in the model, and therefore fast search for an optimal recovery path is achieved. The overall disaster recovery complexity is technologically avoided, and the overall system obtained after disaster recovery is made to be in the state better than that before the disaster recovery, and the continuity of service stability is guaranteed.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCH CONTROL CT OF GUIZHOU GRID CO LTD;SHENZHEN E LINK INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of sacrifice uses electronics incinerator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of sacrifice electronics incinerator.Comprise electronic identification label read write line, circuit module, playback module and the image image-forming module that can identify electronic identification label.By utilizing electronic identification label, by conjunction with digitlization display imaging technique to the analyzing and processing of its storage data, showing the image/sound corresponding with data results, presenting the sacrifice effect of simulation.Its advantage is to solve owing to burning environmental pollution that article bring, disaster hidden-trouble, and cheap, and can reuse, be convenient to upgrade, be substitutes and complements good in offering a sacrifice to gods or ancestors at present.
assignees: BEIJING LINGZHONG BOTONG TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Communication early-warning machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a communication early-warning machine which solves technical problems that existing communication early-warning machines are large in size, high in power consumption, low in integration level and incapable of setting warning priorities. The machine comprises a master control unit, a power module, a key processing unit, a GPRS/GSM (general packet radio service/global system for mobile communications) module, an audio mixing unit, a speech synthesis unit, an interphone module, a microphone processing unit, a recording and playback unit, a power amplification module and a frequency modulation transmission station, wherein the master control unit is provided with an SPI (serial peripheral interface), and the GPRS/GSM module, the speech synthesis unit and the recording and playback unit are connected with the SPI respectively; the audio mixing unit is connected with the GPRS/GSM module; the speech synthesis unit, the interphone module and the microphone processing unit are arranged between the audio mixing unit and the master control unit respectively; the recording and playback unit, the power amplification module and the frequency modulation transmission station are connected with the audio mixing unit respectively; the speech synthesis unit comprises an XFS4041A chip and an XFS4041B chip. The machine is widely applied to prevention and treatment engineering of water conservancy, meteorology, geological disasters and the like.
assignees: XI AN SUMMIT TECHNOLOGIES CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic adjustable lightning rod device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lightning protection, and provides a hydraulic adjustable lightning rod device which includes an adjustable lightning rod part and a hydropneumatic lifting part connected with the adjustable lightning rod part in a matching manner, wherein a hydraulic telescopic column of the hydraulic part drives an extension rod of the lightning rod part to realize the up-and-down adjustment. Therefore, the lightning rod device provided by the invention can solve the problem that the height of the lightning rod needs to be adjusted in special circumstances and achieves the purpose of lightning protection more effectively; the lightning rod device is large in lightning protection scope and good in lightning protection effect, and can be applied widely to occasions such as post-disaster reconstructions and concentrated lightning protection.
assignees: SHAANXI HENGFA ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for achieving automatic K-DB main and standby disaster recovery cluster switching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for achieving automatic K-DB main and standby disaster recovery cluster switching, and relates to the application technology of a computer database and middleware. All resource health conditions of a main node are monitored based on the middleware of a host on nodes, and whether automatic switching is carried out on the  main node and a backup node in a K-DB standby cluster or not is determined; the various resource health conditions of the main node in the cluster are monitored through a middleware monitoring module, and when abnormality happens, the control module carries out automatic main and backup node switching and floating IP drifting according to monitoring, and the cluster is tried to be reconstructed according to the situation; the consistency and integrity of data of the cluster can be guaranteed, and the external service interrupting time in a service system is obviously shortened.

title_en: Individual soldier fire protection and disaster rescue equipment and system based on infrared three-dimensional imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses individual soldier fire protection and disaster rescue equipment based on infrared three-dimensional imaging, which can overcome the difficult that the field view is blocked, provide effective field information to fire protection and disaster rescue personnel and is convenient for developing fire protection and disaster rescue. The equipment comprises a pair of intelligent glasses and an intelligent terminal; the pair of intelligent glasses comprises an infrared transmitter, an infrared camera, a colorful camera, an intelligent glass processor, a mini-type projector and intelligent glass lenses; the intelligent terminal comprises an intelligent terminal processor, an intelligent terminal memory, an intelligent glass communication interface and an external communication interface; a clearer field image can be provided by comparing driving infrared three-dimensional image reconstruction with ordinary thermal imagery; meanwhile, the distance of an object can be detected to form depth information so as to build a three-dimensional image coinciding with the practical environment of a field by adopting a way of transmitting infrared laser in driving infrared three-dimensional image reconstruction. The invention further provides a corresponding individual soldier fire protection and disaster rescue system based on infrared three-dimensional imaging.

title_en: Adjustable lightning rod device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of lightning protection technologies and provides an adjustable lightning rod device. The adjustable lightning rod device comprises a lightning protection main rod and a supporting rod arranged in the lightning protection main rod, wherein a lightning rod is arranged on the upper part of the supporting rod, and a chute is arranged in the lightning protection main rod; a rotating shaft, which is connected to the lightning protection main rod through a bearing and is vertical to the axial direction of the main rod, is arranged on the outer wall of the lightning protection main rod; a gear is arranged on the inner end of the rotating shaft and a hand wheel is arranged on the outer end of the rotating shaft; a slide bar matched with the chute is arranged on one side of the supporting rod; the supporting rod is provided with a rack engaged with the gear; and the bottom of the chute is connected to a ground wire. According to the invention, the need of adjusting the height of the lightning rod in special circumstances can be met, and the purpose of lightning protection can be effectively achieved. The adjustable lightning rod device has the advantages of large lightning protection range and good lightening protection effect, and can be widely applied to the occasions of post-disaster reconstruction and centralized lightning protection.
assignees: SHAANXI HENGFA ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Lightning protection vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lightning protection, and provides a lightning protection vehicle. The lightning protection vehicle comprises a lightning protection vehicle part, and an adjustable lightning protection rod part and a hydraulic pneumatic lifting part which are arranged on the lightning protection vehicle part, wherein the hydraulic pneumatic lifting part is matched and connected with the adjustable lightning protection rod part; and a hydraulic telescopic leg of a hydraulic part drives a telescopic link of the lightning protection rod part to achieve up-and-down adjustment. Therefore, the lightning protection vehicle can achieve an emergency lightning protection rod demand due to a particular case, is particularly used for lightning protection after a natural disaster, is wide in lightning protection range and good in lightning protection effect, and can be widely applied to occasions of post-disaster reconstruction and concentrated lightning protection.
assignees: SHAANXI HENGFA ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Real-time wireless sensor network routing method supporting large-scale node application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time wireless sensor network routing method supporting large-scale node application. A network is constructed by combining a core cluster head routing mechanism and a flat routing mechanism, so that routing is determined by frequency, and is independent of a specific node; a cooperative processing strategy and an energy balancing strategy are adopted between the nodes; the network is divided into grids according to the space density of the nodes, and an isolated point reduction optimization measure is adopted. According to the method, inter-network cluster-based routing signal interference is reduced, the problem of network disasters caused by routing node failures is solved, the reconstruction frequency of network clusters can be maximally reduced, the maintenance overhead of the clusters is reduced, and the response real-time performance of the whole network is improved.

title_en: Regeneration concrete Z-type pier stud
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of regeneration concrete Z-type pier stud, be welded to form by two round steel pipes of two block plates and band U-shaped steel tank, build general aggregate concrete in U-shaped steel tank and between two parallel block plates, regenerated aggregate concrete is built in round steel pipe inside.The utility model overcomes because intensity and endurance quality difference etc. cause regeneration concrete to use limited problem, be conducive to regeneration concrete applying and engineering garbage as resource in bridge engineering, can be applicable to earthquake intensity larger area, constructional materials is difficult to the Skew Bridge in region that transports; For by the bridge after seismic damage, immediately the bridge fragmentation of destruction can be gone out regeneration aggregate, repair with regeneration aggregate Some substitute natural aggregate or rebuild bridge, decreasing cost of transportation, be conducive to recovering post-disaster reconstruction.

title_en: A kind of coal mine gas monitoring and controlling system of fuzzy control
abstract_en: The coal mine gas monitoring and controlling system of a kind of fuzzy control that the utility model provides, comprises underground part and aboveground part; Described underground part is primarily of multiple single-chip microcomputer and multiple sensor composition; Sensor is arranged on multiple monitoring point, down-hole; Described aboveground part is primarily of control chip, special device, controller and remote monitoring center composition, and control chip, special device, controller and remote monitoring center communicate to connect successively; The single-chip microcomputer of described underground part is connected to control chip based on RS-485 bus.The utility model is in conjunction with fuzzy control technology and DSP technology, the Optimizing Reconstruction of coal-mine gas monitoring in intellectuality, automation is made to obtain fabulous hardware supported, ensure that effective enhancing, the safety hazards of Integrate Natural Disasters Prevention anti-disaster ability greatly reduce the hardware guarantee be provided with truly thus, thus downhole safety production can be made to be protected.

title_en: New house light steel structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a new house light steel structure, and belongs to the architectural field. The technology of the new house light steel structure is characterized in that the new house light steel structure comprises a concave-convex steel mixed plate face and concave-convex pipes, the high-strength concave-convex steel mixed plate face is formed by a concave-convex steel plate and a cementing material, and are additionally arranged on the steel structure wallboard face and the steel structure floor plate bottom face. The thickness of the concave-convex steel plate is selected according to the structural bearing capacity, and the concave-convex pipes with any shapes and diameters are made, the bending strength is greatly improved, and the bearing capacity is increased. The concave-convex pipes which are used for bearing are additionally arranged in a prefabricated assembled steel structure wallboard and a steel structure floor plate. The bearing capacity can be increased by the concave-convex pipes through transverse reinforced ribs and longitudinal reinforced ribs, materials of the reinforced ribs can be selected from reinforcing steel bars, steel strips, steel stranding belts and the like, and the method for the reinforced ribs can be selected from spot welding and binding. Prestressed steel stranding belts can be closely bound to the cementing material to form the high-strength steel structure wallboard and the steel structure floor plate, and steel structure wallboard and the steel structure floor plate are applicable to a prefabricated assembled steel structure of a civil building. According to the new house light steel structure, the structural stress of steel is fully utilized, saving of the steel starts from decreasing the dead weight, and the advantages of being energy conserving, environmentally friendly, rapid in the post-disaster reconstruction, and efficient in building are shown.

title_en: Gas fire-extinguishing facility pressure signal valve
abstract_en: A kind of gas fire-extinguishing facility pressure signal valve, comprise valve body (1), self-lock pin (2), push rod (3), touch switch (4), support (5), datawire (8), tenminal block (9), working principle is, during extinguishing agent release, pipe network gas promotes push rod by valve body suction port, push rod connects touch switch, and this signal reaches fire alarming and controlling center by datawire, tenminal block, and the audible-visual annunciator that touch switch is connected on support simultaneously sends acoustooptic alarm.Gas fire-extinguishing facility pressure signal valve arrangement of the present utility model is simple, after action while sending signal to control centre, self also can send acoustooptic alarm, reminds attendant to safeguard in time, ensure that fire-fighting equipment at any time can be normally used, stopped undetected potential safety hazard.
assignees: JIANGXI JIAN AN FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of individual soldier's fire control and disaster rescue equipment based on infrared three-dimensional imaging and system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of individual soldier's fire control and disaster rescue equipment based on infrared three-dimensional imaging, on-the-spot unsighted difficulty can be overcome, for fire control and disaster rescue personnel provide effective field data, be convenient to carrying out of fire control and disaster rescue work.Described equipment comprises intelligent glasses and intelligent terminal, and described intelligent glasses comprises infrared transmitter, infrared camera, colour imagery shot, intelligent glasses processor, micro projector and intelligent glasses eyeglass; Described intelligent terminal comprises intelligent terminal processor, intelligent terminal memory, intelligent glasses communication interface and external communication interface; Adopt active infrared three-dimensional reconstruction image to compare with general thermal imaging, image scene more clearly can be provided; Simultaneously active infrared three-dimensional reconstruction image adopts the mode of launching infrared laser, can the distance of detecting object, and Formation Depth information, builds 3-D view, match with the actual environment at scene.The utility model additionally provides the individual soldier's fire control and disaster rescue system based on infrared three-dimensional imaging.
assignees: NISEN SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY HUBEI CO LTD

title_en: Recovery of a network infrastructure to facilitate business continuity
abstract_en: Methods and systems for disaster recovery of a network infrastructure to facilitate business continuity. A method including capturing, by at least one computer device, data and ecology information about an entire existing network infrastructure. The method further including generating, by the at least one computer device, a generalized descriptive language for the captured data and ecology information. The method further including reconstructing, by the at least one computer device, the entire existing network infrastructure by introducing functionally equivalent components that correspond to the generalized descriptive language.

title_en: Safety Device for Entry Scene of Fire
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 소방대원이 인명구조 및 화재진압 등을 위하여 화재현장에 진입할 때 소방대원의 안전을 도모하기 위한 안전장비에 관한 것으로, 상단에 로프(14)가 출입하는 통공(11)이 형성되고 하단에 안전벨트를 고정할 수 있는 고리(12)가 형성되며 내부에 공간부가 형성된 케이스(10); 상기 케이스(10) 외부로 인출된 로프(14) 단부에 결합 고정된 체결부재(15); 상기 케이스(10) 내부 일측에 고정 설치되어 일정 길이의 로프(14)가 탄성에 의하여 감겨 있는 로프 권취기(13); 상기 케이스(10) 내부 일측에 고정 설치된 베이스플레이트(16) 상부에 고정 결합된 반원기둥 형상의 마찰부재(17); 상기 마찰부재(17)와 일정 간격을 두고 베이스플레이트(16) 중심부에 힌지(19)로 결합되고 편심 형성된 스토퍼(18), 및 상기 케이스(10) 외측에서 상부가 상기 힌지(19)와 연장 결합되고 내측에 비틀림 스프링(21)이 결합된 핸들(20)을 포함하여 이루어진 것이다. 본 고안은 화재현장 또는 구조현장에서 안전 장비를 착용한 소방대원에게 화재진압이나 인명구조를 하는 동안 소방대원의 낙하사고 예방과 퇴로확보 등의 안전사고에 대비할 수 있고, 암벽이나 산악 등반 등에 적용할 경우에 등산객의 안전을 도모할 수 있으며, 고공작업이나 하천 또는 맨홀 진입 때에도 안전한 활동을 도모할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Life-saving Apparatus for both Rescue and Fire Fighting at a Fire
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a lifesaving apparatus functioning as a firefighting apparatus, comprising: a moving vehicle having an adjusting device to allow a rescue team to get on and approach the scene of a fire; an insulation bellows pipe one end of which is connected to the moving vehicle and the other end of which is connected to the outside to be unfolded with the movement of the moving vehicle and to supply outside air to the inside of the moving vehicle; an extinguishing system installed in the moving vehicle to inject an extinguishing liquid in order to allow the moving vehicle to extinguish a fire while moving; and a cooling device to protect the moving vehicle or the insulation bellows pipe in the scene of a fire by cooling the outside of the moving vehicle or the insulation bellows pipe. Therefore, the lifesaving apparatus functioning as a firefighting apparatus moves to the scene of a fire and allows a rescue team to approach the scene of a fire to carry out firefighting and lifesaving at the same time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재진화 겸용 인명구조장치에 관한 것으로서, 구조대가 탑승하여 화재현장까지 접근하도록 조정장치가 구비된 이동차량과, 상기 이동차량에 일단이 연결되고 타단은 외부에 연결되어 상기 이동차량의 이동에 따라 펼쳐짐이 가능하며, 외부의 공기를 상기 이동차량 내부까지 공급가능하도록 설치되는 단열주름관과, 상기 이동차량이 이동하면서 화재를 진압할 수 있도록 상기 이동차량에 설치되어 소화액을 분사하는 소화장치와, 상기 단열주름관 또는 상기 이동차량의 외부를 냉각시켜 화재 현장에서 상기 단열주름관 또는 이동차량을 보호하기 위한 냉각장치를 포함함으로써, 고온의 화재현장으로 이동이 가능하여 구조대가 화재현장으로 직접 진입하여 진화작업과 인명구조작업을 동시에 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Life-saving equipment for fire to enter
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a lifesaving apparatus capable of approaching the scene of a fire, comprising: an insulation bellows pipe of which one end is installed outside the scene of a fire and of which the other end is extended in a longitudinal direction to approach the scene of a fire; a diameter increase ring joined to the inner side of the insulation bellows pipe at a predetermined distance; a firefighting hose joined to the inner circumference of the diameter increase ring to be supported; a cooling hose mounted at the outer top of the insulation bellow pipe to inject water for cooling the insulation bellows pipe; and a moving unit mounted at the outer bottom of the insulation bellows pipe to allow the movement of the insulation bellows pipe. Therefore, the lifesaving apparatus capable of approaching the scene of a fire moves to the scene of a fire and allows a rescue team to approach the scene of a fire to carry out firefighting and lifesaving at the same time.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재현장으로 진입가능한 인명구조장치에 관한 것으로.  
일단은 상기 화재현장의 외부에 설치되며, 타단은 상기 화재현장의 내부로 진입되도록 길이방향으로 신축가능한 단열주름관과, 상기 단열주름관의 내부에 일정간격 이격되어 결합되는 확관링과, 상기 확관링의 내주연에 결합되어 지지되는 소방호스와, 상기 주름관의 외부 상단에 장착되며, 주름관의 냉각을 위해 물이 분사되는 냉각호스와, 상기 단열주름관의 외부 하단에 장착되어 상기 단열주름관이 이동 가능하도록 하는 이동수단;을 포함함으로써, 고온의 화재현장으로 이동이 가능하여 구조대가 화재현장으로 직접 진입하여 진화작업과 인명구조작업을 동시에 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Automatic-detection fire-extinguishing sprayer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire-fighting tool, specifically to an automatic-detection fire-extinguishing sprayer. The automatic-detection fire-extinguishing sprayer comprises a sprayer head (1), a cardan shaft (2), an infrared detector (3), a rail (4), a signal processor (5) and a motor (6), and is characterized in that the tail end of the sprayer head (1) is connected with the cardan shaft (2), the infrared detector (3) is arranged at one side of the center of the cardan shaft (2), the upper end of the cardan shaft (2) is connected with the rail (4), and the right side of the cardan shaft (2) is connected with the signal processor (5) and the motor (6). The automatic-detection fire-extinguishing sprayer has a simple structure, is reasonably constructed, exerts good effect on fire-fighting reconstruction of old buildings and is capable of detecting a fire source on time and accurately extinguishing a fire at a fixed site.

title_en: Remote sensing image fusion method based on multi-redundancy dictionary and sparse reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image fusion method based on multi-redundancy dictionary and sparse reconstruction and mainly solves the problem that spectral information and spatial resolution are imbalanced in multi-spectrum and panchromatic image fusion process. The remote sensing image fusion method includes steps of 1, splitting high-resolution panchromatic image and low-resolution multi-spectrum image blocks; 2, summing various wave bands linearly of the low-resolution multi-spectrum image blocks to obtain low-resolution spectrum-strength image blocks; 3, acquiring the high-resolution spectrum-strength image blocks according to the low-resolution spectrum-strength image blocks; 4, acquiring fusion image blocks according to the high-resolution spectrum-strength image blocks and the low-resolution multi-spectrum image blocks; 5, combining the fusion image blocks to obtain fusion images. The remote sensing image fusion method has the advantages of spectrum retainability and high spatial resolution of the fusion images and can be used for object identification, meteorological monitoring, environmental monitoring, urban planning and disaster and damage prevention and reduction.

title_en: 3D visualization training simulative training method and system based on mobile internet
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 3D visualization training simulative training method based on a mobile internet. The method comprises the steps that a control end judges whether a training task exists in a local database, and if yes, the training task is loaded; a client side is connected with a registering control end; the control end sends a ready order to the client side; the client side sends the feedback signals of connecting completing to the control end; the control end judges whether the feedback signals of connecting completing of the client side are received, and if yes, a training starting order is sent to the client side connected with the control end; the client end judges whether the training task exists in the local database, and if yes, the training task is loaded; the client side selects a role according to the configuration files in the training task; and the loaded training task is started to be carried out, meanwhile, a training log generated during a training process is recorded and stored, and according to the training log, training task playback is carried out. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that training cost is greatly lowered, real-scene fire protection can be simulated really, and training danger is low.
assignees: SHANGHAI SUN3D TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Synchronous satellite forest fire monitoring weak signal layered denoising method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synchronous satellite forest fire monitoring weak signal layered denoising method, which belongs to the field of synchronous satellite digital signal processing. The method comprises steps: (1) a satellite signal is read in a two-dimensional digital matrix; (2) a Roberts operator is used for extracting a main body contour of the signal; (3) salt and pepper noise is eliminated through adaptive spatial filtering; (4) Gaussian noise is eliminated through wavelet decomposition and reconstruction; and (5) signal synthesis is carried out, and a satellite signal after denoising is outputted. Through a theoretical model and actual satellite data test, the denoising effects are obvious, and the method is strongly targeted.

title_en: System and method for simulated firearms training
abstract_en: A simulated firearm comprises an integrated camera that is disposed within the firearm where the barrel of a standard firearm would normally be. The camera is used to capture video and still images of one or more training exercises, with simulated “hits” being superimposed on a video stream or still photographic image of the training exercise, as captured by camera. This allows the trainee to replay the video stream and/or view and analyze the placement of the “hits” on the target, thereby enhancing the overall training paradigm. Also disclosed is a method of using a simulated firearm where certain video or still images of the training scenario are captured for later review and analysis. The video and still images can be captured automatically based on the activation of the trigger mechanism on the simulated firearm or in a manual fashion by the trainee or an instructor providing the training scenario.

title_en: Data management system and method for supporting high-speed playback
title_ko: 고속 배속의 녹화재생을 지원하기 위한 데이터 관리 시스템 및 그 관리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a data management system for supporting high-speed recording and playing. The data management system classifies traffic control data in various formats based on the format, stores the traffic control data, and selectively extracts data based on the requested recording and playing speed. Therefore, the data management system enables recorded contents to be continuously and naturally played even at a high recording and playing speed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고속 배속의 녹화재생을 지원하기 위한 데이터 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 다양한 형태의 관제용 데이터를 데이터의 형태에 따라 분류하여 저장하고 요청된 녹화재생배속에 따라 선별적으로 데이터를 추출함으로써 고배속으로 녹화재생시에도 녹화된 내용이 끊김 없이 자연스럽게 재생될 수 있도록 해준다.

title_en: Railway emergency auxiliary rescue three-dimensional virtual electronic sand table system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway emergency auxiliary rescue three-dimensional virtual electronic sand table system, which is used for assisting a railway accident emergency rescue department to quickly make an effective railway accident emergency rescue decision plan. The railway emergency auxiliary rescue three-dimensional virtual electronic sand table system consists of an image collecting module, an image identifying module, a three-dimensional model coupling module, a three-dimensional scene visualizing module and a mechanism kinematics simulating module. The railway emergency auxiliary rescue three-dimensional virtual electronic sand table system has the advantages that the three-dimensional scene of the train accident site is quickly reconstructed by the three-dimensional visualizing simulating module, so as to show a visual train accident three-dimensional scene sand table model, further construct various mechanism kinematics simulating modules to simulate the train accident emergency rescue, and provide the reference for the making of the train emergency accident rescue plan.

title_en: Communication apparatus and method for fire fighting
abstract_en: Proposed are a communications apparatus and a method for firefighting to transmit an emergency alarm voice set as a voice directly spoken by a wearer through a microphone or voice data recorded by a voice of the wearer to neighbors when an emergency situation happens to the wearer. The proposed communications apparatus for the firefighting comprises: a setting unit to set a communications environment for a communications with communications apparatuses for the firefighting which are inputted in a fire site; a sensing unit to sense the movement of a wearer; a determining unit to determine whether an emergency situation happens to the wearer based on the set time setting value and the movement of the wearer detected by the sensing unit; and a communications unit to transmit an emergency alarm voice set as the voice of the wearer to the communications apparatuses for the firefighting set as the same communications environment as a communications environment set among the communications apparatuses for the firefighting when the determining unit determines the emergency situation happens to the wearer.
abstract_ko: 착용자의 응급상황 발생시 착용자의 목소리로 녹음된 음성 데이터 또는 마이크를 통해 착용자가 직접 발음한 음성으로 설정되는 응급 알람음성을 주변인에게 전송하도록 한 소방용 통신 장치 및 방법이 제시된다. 제시된 소방용 통신 장치는 화재현장에 투입된 복수의 소방용 통신 장치들과의 통신을 위한 통신환경을 설정하는 설정부; 착용자의 움직임을 감지하는 감지부; 감지부에서 감지한 착용자의 움직임 및 기설정된 시간 설정값을 근거로 착용자의 응급상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 판단부; 및 판단부에서 착용자의 응급상황 발생으로 판단하면 복수의 소방용 통신 장치들 중에서 설정된 통신환경과 동일한 통신환경으로 설정된 소방용 통신 장치들에게로 착용자의 음성으로 설정된 응급 알람음성을 전송하는 통신부를 포함한다.

title_en: Disconnect type gas filtering apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a separate type gas purifying apparatus, which purifies smoke in an industrial field or poisonous gas in a site of fire by a breath of a user with a mouth, thereby providing purified air. The apparatus comprises: a main gas purification main body (10) which has an inner space opened into both ends, and in which one end is held by the mouth of the user to aspirate air; a plurality of sub gas purification main bodies (40) which have the inner space opened into both ends, and are connected to the other end of the main gas purification main body (10) to be detached from the same in a multi-stage to have the inner space connected to each other; a gas purification member (20) which is respectively included in the main gas purification main body (10) and the sub gas purification main body (40), to purify the gas aspirated with the air when the user holds the main gas purification main body (10) and aspirates the air; and a finishing member (30) which allows ventilation between the air and the gas and is respectively included in the main gas purification main body (10) and the sub gas purification main body (40) to prevent the gas purification members (20) from being separated from the main gas purification main body (10) and the sub gas purification main body (40).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사용자가 입으로 호흡함에 의해 산업현장의 매연이나 화재현장의 유독가스를 정화하여 정화된 공기를 제공할 수 있는 분리형 가스 정화 장치에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명의 특징은, 내부공간이 양단으로 개방되고, 사용자가 일단을 입으로 물어서 공기를 흡입하는 메인가스정화본체(10)와, 내부공간이 양단으로 개방되고, 다단으로 분리가능하게 연결된 상태로 메인가스정화본체(10)의 타단에 분리가능하게 연결되어 내부공간들이 서로 연통되는 복수의 서브가스정화본체(40)와, 메인가스정화본체(10) 및 서브가스정화본체(40)들의 내부공간에 각각 내장되어 메인가스정화본체(10)를 사용자가 입으로 물어서 공기를 흡입하면 공기와 함께 흡입되는 가스를 정화하는 가스정화부재(20)와, 공기와 가스의 유통됨을 허용하면서 가스정화부재(20)들이 메인가스정화본체(10) 및 서브가스정화본체(40)들에서 이탈됨을 방지하도록 메인가스정화본체(10) 및 서브가스정화본체(40)들에 각각 구비되는 마감부재(30)를 포함한다.

title_en: Communication system, image processing apparatus, and additional information output method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To output disaster relevant information necessary for disaster prevention and reconstruction at the time other than the occurrence of disaster.SOLUTION: A communication system 1 receives and determines, between image forming apparatuses Gk1 to Gkn for transmitting communication information and image forming apparatuses Gk1 to Gkn for receiving the communication information, addition designation information designating additional information to be added to the communication information; and the reception-side image forming apparatuses Gk1 to Gkn acquire additional information corresponding to the determined addition designation information from an advertisement server SV providing additional information, add the additional information to the communication information and output the resulting information. In this case, the reception-side image forming apparatuses Gk1 to Gkn determine addition designation information on the basis of addition designation information designating additional information permitting the addition to the communication information acquired by an operation display unit 27 and addition designation information received from the transmission-side image forming apparatuses Gk1 to Gkn, and acquire additional information from the advertisement server SV; however, if any one of the pieces of addition designation information designates disaster-related information, preferentially acquire the disaster-related information as the additional information.

title_en: Power grid anti-accident maneuver process graphic presentation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid anti-accident maneuver process graphic presentation method and belongs to the technical field of power system simulated training. The method comprises the steps of reading an event list of a power grid training simulation system and acquiring all events of power grid anti-accident maneuver; selecting out events to be operated and executed by maneuver personnel according to types of events and operation objectives, and recording associated accompanying events automatically generated by the simulation system; recording all operation processes of the maneuver personnel in a time sequence and obtaining influences of operation events on a simulated power grid; graphically presenting the influences of the simulated operation events on equipment of the simulated power grid, including simulated power grid equipment fault, substation power loss and restoration, load loss and restoration and equipment overload and restoration; saving initial state data of the simulated power grid and operation sequence information of the maneuver personnel to realize the saving and playback of the maneuver process. The method improves the presentation effect of the anti-accident maneuver process.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING KING STAR HI TECH SYSTEM CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: A kind of Debris-flow Hazards appraisal procedure and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Debris-flow Hazards appraisal procedure and application.The Debris-flow Hazards appraisal procedure is based on unmanned plane data, carry out the extraction and analysis of Debris Flow Deposition area's deposition thickness and bulky grain stone size information, it is applied to along journey motive material force process analysis procedure analysis, mud-rock flow stream is finally inversed by along journey kinetic parameter, the analysis that quantification is carried out along journey destructiveness to Zai Hou Debris Flow Depositions area, so as to realize Disaster rapid evaluation.This method is based on the actual conditions measurement data of field, dynamic inversion can be carried out to the whole spatial dimension in particular measurement region, and then to the analysis that zonal quantification is carried out along journey destructiveness in Zai Hou Debris Flow Depositions area, serve after calamity to sue and labour and designed with post-disaster reconstruction.

title_en: A kind of Ionospheric Tomography imaging hybrid inversion method based on method of conjugate gradient
abstract_en: A kind of Ionospheric Tomography imaging hybrid inversion method based on method of conjugate gradient.This invention is based on considering that the absolute and relative total electron content of scattering effect calculates, and the hybrid inversion method adopting multiplication algebra Reconstruction Method and method of conjugate gradient to combine, carries out high precision inverting based on Ionospheric Tomography imaging technique to electron density space distribution.First, adopt three frequency bootstrap informations, consider ionospheric scattering effect, in absolute and relative total electron density inverting, all add scattering effect time delay item, divided by three frequency differences and obtain ionosphere total electron content; Secondly, inverting district is treated in selected ionosphere, calculates, obtain the projection matrix of tomography in conjunction with space geometry; Finally, the hybrid inversion method adopting multiplication algebra restructing algorithm and method of conjugate gradient to combine obtains ionospheric electron density distribution.The advantages such as it is high that the present invention has precision, good reliability, can be used for the airspace monitoring for ionospheric electron density and earthquake disaster prediction etc.

title_en: Storage aggregate restoration
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are provided for controlling restoration of a storage aggregate. For example, a local storage device, located at a first storage site, and a remote storage device, located at a second storage site, may be assigned to a first storage aggregate. Responsive to a disaster of the first storage site, a gate may be created for the local storage device. The gate may block automated reconstruction and/or automated synchronization that may otherwise occur with respect to the local storage device. Until the local storage device is restored, the remote storage device may be used to service I/O requests that were otherwise directed to the local storage device. Responsive to receiving a user restoration command, the gate may be removed from the local storage device. Synchronization between the local storage device and the remote storage device may then be facilitated.

title_en: Server and method for processing virtual traiming data file
title_ko: 서버 및 가상 훈련 데이터 파일의 처리 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for processing a virtual training data file. The processing method is used to process a virtual training data file or replay a data file generated for each trainee or player in 3D virtual fire training by driving a 3D virtual fire training program module installed in a client from a server. The method includes: a process of receiving a storage request regarding the replay data file from the client; and a process of linking a virtual training file header including the 3D virtual fire training identification information executed by each player according to the received storage request and the replay data; and a process of storing the virtual training file header and replay data linked according to the control operation of a file processing module to different track files for the respective players in a database in a distributed manner.
abstract_ko: 가상 훈련 데이터 파일의 처리방법이 개시된다. 이 처리방법은 서버에서 클라이언트에 설치된 3D 가상 소방 훈련 프로그램 모듈을 구동하여, 3D 가상 소방 훈련에서 훈련 참여자(이하, 플레이어) 별로 생성된 가상 훈련 데이터 파일(또는 리플레이 데이터 파일)을 처리하는 방법으로서, 상기 클라이언트로부터 상기 리플레이 데이터 파일의 저장 요청을 수신하는 과정과, 수신된 상기 저장 요청에 따라 각 플레이어가 수행한 3D 가상 소방 훈련의 식별 정보를 포함하는 가상 훈련 파일 헤더와 상기 리플레이 데이터를 연계하는 과정 및 상기 파일 처리 모듈의 제어에 따라 연계된 상기 가상 훈련 파일 헤더와 상기 리플레이 데이터를 각 플레이어별 서로 다른 트랙 파일로 데이터베이스에 분산 저장하는 과정을 포함한다.

title_en: Recorded video and real-time promotional vehicles
title_ko: 실시간 및 녹화 영상 홍보용 차량
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vehicle for promoting a video recorded in real time or recorded in advance. More particularly, a recorded video, a real-time video, and a promotional phrase video can be simultaneously selected and broadcast by dividing a screen of a monitor mounted in a vehicle, and thereby it is possible to broadcast a planned advertising through a planned and recorded broadcast video and a promotional phrase video and to broadcast a real-time video fit for an actual situation and therefore it is possible to improve an advertising effect. The vehicle of the present invention comprises: a moving part formed with a vehicle which is open in one side surface; a recording and playback monitor for displaying a video inside the vehicle of the moving part; a real-time video playback monitor connected to a photographing camera and playing back a real-time video; and a display unit formed with a text playback monitor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실시간 및 녹화 영상 홍보용 차량에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 차량에 장착되는 모니터를 구획하여 녹화영상과 실시간 영상 및 선전문구영상을 동시에 선택하여 방송할 수 있어 계획된 녹화 방송과 선전문구영상을 통하여 계획된 광고와 현장 상황에 맞는 실시간 영상을 방송하여 광고의 효과를 높일 수 있는 실시간 및 녹화 영상 홍보용 차량에 관한 것이다. 
상기의 본 발명은 일측면이 개방된 차량으로 형성된 이동부와, 상기 이동부의 차량 내부에 영상을 나타낼 수 있는 녹화재생모니터와, 촬영카메라와 연결되어 실시간 영상을 재생하는 실시간영상재생모니터와, 문자재생모니터로 형성된 디스플레이부로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Novel escape house
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel escape house. The novel escape house comprises a house body, in which safe belts and safe handles, a safe air bag, an LED illuminating lamp, a computer board and a signal emitter, a safe purifying device, an oxygen generator, a safe tool box and a water tank. The safe belts and safe handles are mounted to the bottom end of the safe air bag. The computer board and the signal emitter and the oxygen generator are arranged on two sides of the upper end of the house body. The safe purifying device is located in the middle of the house body. The LED illuminating lamp is mounted at the middle-upper end of the house body. The safe tool box is arranged at the upper portion of the bottom end of the house body. The water tank is arranged at the lower end of a floor of the house body. The LED illuminating lamp, the computer board and the signal emitter, the safe purifying device and the oxygen generator are connected with an external power source and a water source port at the side end of the house body. The novel escape house can be directly installed in the interior of the room and functions as a shelter in case of fire, earthquakes and other disasters. Due to the fact that a product is independently arranged, damage to the house is avoided during reconstruction of a safe house.

title_en: Panchromatic-and-compressed-spectral-imaging-based image super-resolution system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a panchromatic-and-compressed-spectral-imaging-based image super-resolution system and method. With the method and system, problems of poor image reconstruction quality and low spatial resolution of an array detector in the prior art can be solved. The imaging system comprises two paths of observation channels and an image reconstruction processor. The first path of observation channel is formed by an objective lens, a coding template, a band-pass filter, a relay lens group, a double-amici-prism unit and an array detector to obtain a compressed spectral observation image; and the second path of observation channel is formed by an objective lens, a band-pass filter, and an array detector to obtain a panchromatic spectral observation image. The spectral observation images from the two paths are processed by the image reconstruction processor; and with the sparsity of the spectral images, non-linear optimization is solved to realize super-resolution reconstruction of the images. According to the invention, an image with a high spatial resolution can be obtained; and the system and method can be used for obtaining super-resolution images for geographical remote sensing, meteorological observation, and disaster prevention.

title_en: Accident handles and fire control simulation rehearsal device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire -fighting equipment field especially relates to an accident handles and fire control simulation rehearsal device. It includes central data processor, input terminal, outlet terminal, portable emulation fire extinguisher and data acquisition device, the data processor of central authorities is connected with input terminal, outlet terminal and data acquisition device respectively, portable emulation fire extinguisher and outlet terminal signal connection, data acquisition device and outlet terminal signal connection. The utility model discloses a connect the data acquisition device on central data processor, feed back to central data processor after the condition of the putting out a fire collection with the condition of the scene of fire of outlet terminal output and portable emulation fire extinguisher, after central data processor computing, carry out final display through the outlet terminal, can carry out the instant playback to the condition of putting out a fire of portable emulation fire extinguisher, and then give other people the sensation at the scene, the degree of impression of scene of fire has been improved, the effect of fire -fighting drill also can have further been promoted.
assignees: SINO SAFETY INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting integrated control system applied to electric automobile electric charging station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire-fighting integrated control system applied to electric automobile electric charging station, including gas extinguishing system, water fire-extinguishing system, fire detection alarm system and ventilation smoke extraction system, the working condition of each fire-fighting subsystem can be monitored by integrated system control panel.The quantity of each fire-fighting subsystem, simple installation can arbitrarily be increased and decreased according to the actual conditions of electric automobile electric charging station；After enlarging or reconstruction occur for electric automobile electric charging station, fire-fighting integrated control system can increase fire-fighting subsystem on the original basis, there is provided lasting security against fire guarantee, considers economy to greatest extent on the basis of safety is ensured.

title_en: Anti-seismic steel structure portable house
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-seismic steel structure portable house, and relates to the technical field of steel structures. The anti-seismic steel structure portable house comprises a steel structure framework and a wall body. The steel structure framework comprises four stand columns, a plurality of connecting cross beams and a roof beam. The four stand columns are arranged all around, and the connecting cross beams are arranged at the top ends of every two adjacent stand columns and used for connecting the four stand columns in a reinforced mode. The roof beam is arranged above the stand columns and used for supporting a roof. The roof beam comprises beam bodies, a plurality of ribs and webs. The beam bodies comprise the upper beam body and the lower beam body, the left web and the right web are welded with the upper beam body and the lower beam body, and the ribs are welded in the space defined by the left web, the right web, the upper beam body and the lower beam body. The steel structure portable house is high in safety level and capable of achieving earthquake prevention and earthquake resistance and is used in temporary shelters in the post-disaster reconstruction process, and therefore a safe dwelling environment is provided for people afflicted by an earthquake.
assignees: SICHUAN LANTIAN NET RACK AND STEEL STRUCTURE ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Exit Guidance Light with Voice Information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an exit guide lamp having a function of a voice guide and, more specifically, to an exit guide lamp having a function of a voice guide which guides people to an exit of the shortest distance, wherein in case of emergency such as a fire, anyone can change a voice guide and a direction of an arrow to guide people from a current location to an exit of the shortest distance, located in a direction opposite to a location of emergency such as a fire, thereby helping people safely be evacuated and minimizing the loss of life. The present invention relates to an exit guide lamp (10) having a function a voice guide which guides people to an exit of the shortest distance, wherein the exit guide lamp (10) is composed of a power supply (3) supplied with power by a commercial electric power (1) and a secondary battery (2), wherein the power supply (3) controls an emergency lamp (5), an arrow guide lamp (6), a fire sensor (8), and a voice playback unit (7) through a control unit (4).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 음성안내 기능을 가진 출구 유도등에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 화재 등의 비상사태 시 임의의 사람이 현재 위치하는 지점으로부터 화재 등 비상사태지점의 반대 방향에 위치하는 최단거리의 출구로 음성안내 및 화살표식의 방향을 변화, 유도시켜 줌으로써 사람들이 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 하여 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있는 최단 거리 출구를 유도하는 음성안내 기능을 가진 출구 유도등에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 상용전원(1)과 2차 전지(2)로 전원을 공급하는 전원부(3)로 구성되고, 상기 전원부(3)는 제어부(4)에 의해 비상등(5), 화살표 유도등(6), 화재감지센서(8), 음성재생부(7)를 제어하여 최단 거리 출구를 유도하는 음성안내 기능을 가진 출구 유도등(10)이다. 
본 발명은 화재 등의 비상사태 시 임의의 사람이 현재 위치하는 지점으로부터 화재 등 비상사태지점의 반대 방향에 위치하는 최단거리의 출구로 음성안내 및 화살표식의 방향을 변화, 유도시켜 줌으로써 사람들이 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 하여 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과를 얻을 수 있다.

title_en: System and Method for Measuring and Monitoring Seismic data Applied to the City Building
title_ko: 도시건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for measuring and monitoring seismic data applied to a city building capable of preventing false detection and false alarm, and quickly inspecting effectiveness of an occurred event and rapidity of seismic event detection for construction of an earthquake quickly warning system for earthquake disaster alleviation of a city building. Moreover, the system for measuring and monitoring seismic data applied to a city building comprises: multiple seismic data measuring systems located at a distance different from an object to be monitored, and for performing pre-detector of an earthquake event by having a GPS receive module and an earthquake acceleration sensor; and an earthquake monitoring system for re-forming a noise-removed and single stacked data by visual-synchronization processing data transmitted from the multiple seismic data, and for finally determining whether of occurrence of an earthquake event by utilizing the pre-detected result and post-process detected result of an earthquake event in each of seismic data measuring systems by post-process detecting in order to check whether of occurrence of an earthquake event.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도시건축물의 지진재해경감을 위한 지진신속경보체계 구축을 위하여 지진 이벤트 감지의 신속성 및 발생 이벤트의 유효성을 빠르게 검사하고 오검출 및 오경보를 방지할 수 있도록 한 도시건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 감시 대상물과 서로 다른 거리에 위치하고, GPS 수신모듈과 지진가속도센서를 포함하고 지진이벤트의 사전 검출을 수행하는 복수 개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들;상기 복수 개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들로부터 전송된 데이터를 시각 동기화 처리하여 잡음제거 및 단일 중합데이터로 재구성하고, 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 확인하기 위해 후처리 검출을 하여 각각의 지진 데이터 측정시스템에서의 지진이벤트 사전검출 결과와 후처리 검출결과를 활용하여 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 최종 판별하는 지진 감시시스템;을 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: A firefighting time check system and flashlight
title_ko: 소방시간 체크시스템 및 상기 체크시스템에서 사용되는 무선통신용 인식칩을 장착한 손전등
abstract_en: A firefighting time check system according to the present invention can use a communication method such as an ultra-wideband (UWB) method or radio-frequency identification (RFID) scanner method by installing a wireless communication recognition chip such as an RFID, an UWB chip to an absolutely portable flashlight when a fireman goes into fires or various disaster sites. It can easily check the access and the position of the fireman who goes to the fire or various disaster sites. The access time of the fire site of firemen can be accurately managed by an access control scanner which can check access through the recognition chip of the flashlight. The proper compensation and placement for the firemen can carried out by managing a fire fighting time at the firefighting site of the firemen.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 소방시간 체크시스템은 소방관등이 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동 시 반드시 휴대하는 손전등에 RFID, UWB칩 등의 무선통신용 인식칩을 장착하여 UWB 방식 또는 RFID 스캐너방식 등과 같은 통신방식을 이용할 수 있어 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동하는 소방관등의 입출입 및 위치를 손쉽게 파악할 수 있으며, 상기 손전등의 인식칩을 통해 입출입을 체크할 수 있는 출입통제 스캐너에 의하여 소방관들의 화재현장의 입출입시간이 정확하게 관리될 수가 있게 되어 소방관들의 소방현장에서 소방작업시간이 철저하게 관리되어 소방인력의 적절한 보상과 인력배치가 가능하게 된다.

title_en: fire extinguisher safety pin
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety pin of a fire extinguisher which can be drawn easily. Fire extinguishers with a safety pin on sale usually have the safety pin installed next to a handle. Therefore, a using method is different for a left-handed person and a right-handed person and ordinary people except for fire-extinguishing experts cannot but be perplexed on a fire scene. Therefore, people try to draw a safety pin while strongly grabbing upper and lower handles without awareness. The present invention has been prevented after seeing the event. People are taught to draw a safety pin without strongly grabbing the upper and lower handles. The safety pin is drawn easily if a user does things as taught. But anyone is perplexed on a fire scene. Particularly, if a fire occurs at home or when a user is alone, the user is more perplexed and cannot do things as taught. It is all the more true when it comes to housewives or the old and the weak or children. If the upper and lower handles of a fire extinguisher are grabbed strongly, pressure is exerted on the safety pin installed next to the handles to prevent the safety pin from being drawn. If perplexed, ordinary people exert a stronger force. Also, a traditional fire extinguisher has a safety pin at one side and has different using methods for a left-handed person and a right-handed person. The present invention has a safety pin installed on the upper end of a handle and has a safety pin indicating arrow to enable anyone to see the safety pin well. The safety pin can be drawn easily and the fire extinguisher can be used swiftly on a fire scene, wherein fire extinguishment at an early state is important, whether the upper and lower hands are grabbed strongly or not and whether a user is right-handed or left-handed. Particularly, the present invention can be used easily by people who have not used a fire extinguisher, housewives, the old and the weak, children, etc.
abstract_ko:
본 발명품은 쉽게 뽑을수 있는 소화기 안전핀에 관한것으로 현재 시중에 보급되어 있는 안전핀이 설치되어 있는 소화기는 대부분 손잡이 옆에 설치되어 있어서 왼손 잡이와 오른손 잡이의 사용방법이 다를 뿐만아니라 전문 진화요원 외에 일반인은 화재현장에서 당황할 수 밖에 없기에 본인도 모르는 사이에 상 하 손잡이를 힘껏 움켜쥐고 안전핀을 뽑으려고 하는것을 목격하고 발명을 하게 되었다. 
교육 받을 때는 안전핀을 뽑을때 상 하 손잡이를 움켜 쥐어 힘을 주지 말고 뽑으라고 교육을 한다, 교육 받으데로 하면 안전핀은 쉽게 빠진다. 
그러나 화재가 발생하면 누구나 당황한다, 특히 가정집이나 혼자 있을때 화재가 발생하면 더욱더 당황하여 교육 받은데로 하기가 어렵다는게 문제다. 
가정주부나 노약자 어린이는 더욱더 그렇다. 
소화기 상 하 손잡이를 힘껏 움켜쥐면 손잡이 옆에 설치된 안전핀은 압력이 가해져 안전핀이 빠지지 않는다,당황하면 더욱더 힘을주는게 대부분의 사람들이다. 
기존 소화기는 안전핀이 한쪽 옆에 있기에 왼손잡이 와 오른손잡이의 사용방법 또한 다르다. 
본 발명품은 안전핀이 손잡이 상단에 설치되어 있고 안전핀 표시 화살표가 있기에 누구나 잘 볼수가 있으며, 상 하 손잡이를 힘껏 움켜쥐든 힘을 주지안든 왼손 잡이든 오른손 잡이든 쉽게 뽑을수 있어서 초기 진화가 중요한 화재 현장에서 신속하게 사용할수 있으며,특히 소화기를 사용해본 경험이 없는 사람,가정주부,노약자,어린이등 모두 쉽게 사용할 수 있다고 본 발명인은생각한다.

title_en: mechanical suspension device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mechanical suspension device, including guide rod, hanger bar and clamping block, hanger bar is matched with the guide rod along longitudinal sliding motion, and clamping block is flexibly connected in guide rod and provided with making through hole that hanger bar passes through and the through-hole diameter is more than the hanger bar external diameter, and the present apparatus can be used in rural area, post-disaster reconstruction area and the remote area of backwardness, the suspension arrangement is simple in construction, manufacture difficulty is small, and is easy to dismount, and easily operates, applicable crowd is wider, while easy to maintenance.

title_en: Steel-structure movable board room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steel-structure movable board room and relates to the technical field of steel structures. The steel-structure movable board room comprises a steel structure framework and walls. The steel structure framework comprises four stand columns, a plurality of connecting cross beams and a roof beam. The four stand columns are arranged on the periphery. Each connecting cross beam is arranged at the top ends of the two corresponding adjacent stand columns, and the connecting cross beams are used for being connected with the four stand columns in a reinforced mode. The roof beam is arranged above the stand columns and used for supporting a roof. Each wall is fixedly connected between the two corresponding adjacent stand columns and composed of an inner-layer steel board, a vacuum board, a foam board and an outer layer steel board in sequence from inside to outside. The steel-structure movable board room is high in safety level, capable of insulating heat and preserving heat and fireproof, is used as a shelter in the reconstructing process after disasters and provides a safe and comfortable living environment for people afflicted by a natural disaster.
assignees: SICHUAN LANTIAN NET RACK STEEL STRUCTURE ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Heat-isolation heat-preserving steel structure board room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat-isolation heat-preserving steel structure board room, and relates to the technical field of steel structures. The board room comprises a steel structure framework and walls. The steel structure framework comprises four upright columns, a plurality of connection cross beams and a roof beam. The four upright columns are arranged on the periphery, each connection cross beam is arranged at the top ends of the two corresponding upright columns, and the connection cross beams are used for being connected with the four upright columns in a reinforced mode; the roof beam is arranged above the upright columns and used for supporting a roof; each wall is fixedly connected between the two corresponding adjacent upright columns; each wall is composed of an inner layer steel plate, a vacuum plate, a foam plate and an outer layer steel plate from inside to outside. The heat-isolation heat-preserving steel structure movable board room high in safety level, capable of insulating heat and preserving heat and fireproof is provided and used for a shelter in the post-disaster reconstruction process, and a safe and comfortable living environment is provided for people afflicted by natural disasters.

title_en: Many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft with function is reconnoitered in fire control

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography sequence image-based slope three-dimension reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography sequence image-based slope three-dimension reconstruction method. The method includes the following steps that: feature region matching and feature point pair extraction are performed on un-calibrated unmanned aerial vehicle multi-view aerial photography sequence images through adopting a feature matching-based algorithm; the geometric structure of a slope and the motion parameters of a camera are calculated through adopting bundle adjustment structure from motion and based on disorder matching feature points, and therefore, a sparse slope three-dimensional point cloud model can be obtained; the sparse slope three-dimensional point cloud model is processed through adopting a patch-based multi-view stereo vision algorithm, so that the sparse slope three-dimensional point cloud model can be diffused to a dense slope three-dimensional point cloud model; and the surface mesh of the slope is reconstructed through adopting Poisson reconstruction algorithm, and the texture information of the surface of the slop is mapped onto a mesh model, and therefore, a vivid three-dimensional slope model with high resolution can be constructed. The unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography sequence image-based slope three-dimension reconstruction method of the invention has the advantages of low cost, flexibility, portability, high imaging resolution, short operating period, suitability for survey of high-risk areas and the like. With the method adopted, the application of low-altitude photogrammetry and computer vision technology to the geological engineering disaster prevention and reduction field can be greatly prompted.
