title_en: Disaster preparedness education system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for fire control education and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation education using an automatic defibrillator. The system includes: a main body (10) including a fire hydrant chamber (11) for accommodating a fire hydrant (40) therein, an AED chamber (12) for accommodating the automatic defibrillator, and a dummy chamber (13) for accommodating a dummy for the cardiopulmonary resuscitation practice; an education monitor unit (20) which includes a microphone terminal (21), a speaker (22), and a monitor (23) which enable an instructor to provide an audiovisual education on an upper portion of the main body (10) and also includes a rotation means (25) which rotates from the main body (10) to a rear side to obtain a space and to easily move; and a supply unit (30) which is arranged on a rear side of the main body (10) to mount a fire extinguisher (50) and has a compressor (31), an air tank (32), and a water tank (33) to supply compressed air and water. According to the present invention, the fire extinguisher, the fire hydrant, and the automatic defibrillator are stacked into one unit and can be stored so that education and practice of the cardiopulmonary resuscitation and fire control can be performed by using the fire extinguisher, the fire hydrant, and the automatic defibrillator. The system reproduces a site of fire breakout which is the same as an actual site, can provide field practice education, is portable, and enables a user to obtain a space.

title_en: Shape-memory alloy stranded wire self-centering frictional buckling-restrained brace
abstract_en: The invention provides a shape-memory alloy stranded wire self-centering frictional buckling-restrained brace, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and shock absorption. The shape-memory alloy stranded wire self-centering frictional buckling-restrained brace is mainly composed of a linear steel plate inner core, an inner steel sleeve, an outer steel sleeve, friction plates, high-strength bolts, shape-memory alloy stranded wires, a left end plate, a right end plate, backing plates and anchorage devices; the two ends of the linear steel plate inner core are hinged to stiffening ribs which are connected to the left end plate and the right end plate respectively. The inner steel sleeve serves as a peripheral restriction steel sleeve to be arranged outside the linear steel plate in a sleeving mode, the linear steel plate is arranged in the inner steel sleeve in an opposite angle inclined mode, and a certain gap exists between the inner steel sleeve and the linear steel plate inner core. The inner steel sleeve is connected with the right end plate, the outer steel sleeve is connected with the left end plate, the friction plates are installed between the mutually nested portions of the inner steel sleeve and the outer steel sleeve through the high-strength bolts, and the shape-memory alloy stranded wires are anchored between the inner steel sleeve and the outer steel sleeve through the anchorage devices after being pre-stretched. By means of the shape-memory alloy stranded wire self-centering frictional buckling-restrained brace, the problem that due to the fact that for a conventional brace, excessive residual deformation occurs under the action of a large earthquake or an intermediate-earthquake, the post-earthquake maintenance and reconstruction cost is increased is solved.

title_en: Apparatus and method for emergency rescue service of emergency call system

abstract_en: Provided are an emergency rescue device of an emergency call system, and a method thereof, capable of generating a rescue activity guideline by restructuring an accident scene based on option information provided with basic information for a vehicle and a driver. The emergency rescue device of emergency call system according to the present invention comprises: a basic information obtaining unit which obtains the basic information including a position in which a vehicle accident is generated from the vehicle in which the vehicle accident is generated; an option information obtaining unit which obtains information for the vehicle at a time when the vehicle accident is generated, a prior time of the time when the vehicle accident is generated, and a posterior time of the time when the vehicle accident is generated, and obtains the option information including the information for passengers in the vehicle; an accident restructuring unit which estimates the type of the vehicle accident, and a current situation of the passengers in the vehicle based on the option information; and a rescue activity guideline generating unit which generates the rescue activity guideline based on the type of the vehicle accident and the current situation of the passengers in the vehicle.

title_en: LTE network gateway pool disaster tolerance method, device and system

title_en: Shooting system using laser beam
abstract_en: A shooting training system, according to the present invention, which uses a laser beam, comprises: a beam projector that projects training images for various types of shooting, such as clay pigeon shooting, actual distance shooting, and target shooting, onto a shooting screen; a shooting device that applies a laser beam to an aiming point on the shooting screen when a user aims at the aiming point and pulls a trigger; a camera module that photographs the laser beam applied to the shooting screen; a computer device that determines whether the laser beam has hit the target area of the shooting training image projected onto the shooting screen by comparing the target area and the point where the laser beam has been detected, and outputs an image and a sound according to the determination result; and a control unit that detects whether the shooting device has been fired and when the shooting device was fired, wherein the computer device detects the applied laser beam by driving the camera module when the control unit determines that the shooting device has been fired. The present invention has implemented the shooting training system using a laser beam to allow the laser beam to be shown on an aiming point when the shooting device is fired, thereby making it possible to determine whether the laser beam has hit a target area. In addition, the present invention enables a user to identify his/her targeting with the naked eye to reproduce a psychological effect and property brought about by shooting as they are.

title_en: Device for preventing backward sliding caused by power outage in running of electrocar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for preventing backward sliding caused by power outage in running of an electrocar. The device comprises a detection control unit, an electronic brake unit and current sensors; the electrocar is a rear-wheel-driven type electrocar; the current sensors are connected in series to a circuit of a rear-wheel-driving motor and are used for detecting the current of the rear-wheel-driving motor; the output ends of the current sensorsare connected with the detection control unit; the detection control unit is also connected with the electronic brake unit and is capable of controlling the action of the electronic brake unit. The invention also discloses a control method of the device for preventing backward sliding caused by power outage in running of the electrocar. According to the device disclosed by the invention, the current sensors connected in series are used for detecting the real-time current of each power motor as elementary judgment basis; electronic brakesare automatically controlled to execute and cancel braking action in order to effectively reduce the occurrence probability of accidents caused by unexpected power outage when the electrocar is on an upslope, and a timely and reliable protection effect is played; the structural design of the original car is not affected by installation of the device; the device can be installed directly; the reconstruction cost of the car is low; and the control method disclosed by the invention is simple, flexible, convenient to operate, capable of being set automatically or manually, and high in practicability.
assignees: GUANGDONG TIANFEI NIDI NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Permeable pavement based urban road time-delay drainage structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a permeable pavement based urban road time-delay drainage structure, which comprises a first sand-gravel cushion, a flexible base and a road surface that are arranged from bottom up. The road surface falls into a motor way and a non-motor way two parts in a transverse direction, and the non-motor way is located outside the motor way; in terms of the motor way, soil base is located below the first sand-gravel cushion, and a first lower seal coat is arranged between the first sand-gravel cushion and the soil base; in terms of the non-motor way, a gravel water storage layer is arranged below the first sand-gravel cushion, a second sand-gravel cushion is laid below the gravel water storage layer, soil base is located below the second sand-gravel cushion, and a second lower seal coat is arranged between the second sand-gravel cushion and the soil base. The permeable pavement based urban road time-delay drainage structure provided by the invention can effectively prevent road surface water logging and urban internal flood disasters, is especially suitable for urban roads with large short-term rainfall and drainage pipeline network reconstruction difficulty in low-lying areas.

title_en: Accumulated profile space structure information analysis method based on three-dimensional laser scanning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accumulated profile space structure information analysis method based on three-dimensional laser scanning. The method comprises the steps that an accumulated profile image obtained through three-dimensional laser scanning is processed, and the image is segmented through image binaryzation and a watershed algorithm to acquire a block stone boundary contour diagram; the number of point clouds is delineated through a boundary, and block stone space information is acquired through correction, wherein a profile segmented through a point cloud segmentation algorithm, a three-dimensional surface coordinate system is converted into a two-dimensional plane coordinate system X-O-Y, all points in the point clouds are projected to a two-dimensional profile, and height values are converted into gray values; the two-dimensional image is segmented, the particle size and space structure information of stone blocks is derived reversely according to the existing parameters. According to the method, through nondestructive accumulated profile space information extraction based on three-dimensional laser scanning, extraction on the geometrical information, the space structure and fabric information and the accumulation position and period information of the accumulated profile block stones and estimation on the accumulation scale are achieved, and the method is used for supporting ancient disaster reconstruction, geomorphic evolution analysis, accumulation body stability analysis, engineering route selection and design and the like.
assignees: CHENGDU INST OF MOUNTAIN HAZARDS AND ENV CHINESE ACAD OF SCIENCES

title_en: Apparatus for replaying rescue information of rescue worker and method thereof
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an apparatus to replay rescue information to learn disaster rescue information by analyzing the disaster rescue information. According to an embodiment proposed in the present specification, the apparatus to replay rescue information comprises a data obtaining unit to receive situation information in each time for a plurality of rescue workers received from a terminal given to the rescue workers and to obtain site information for a rescue site from an external apparatus and a direction command in each time of a rescue command center. The situation information in each time comprises one or more from the position information of the rescue worker, body change situation information, and environmental information and one or more from ages, gender, and body change situation information of a rescue target. The apparatus to replay rescue information comprises a replaying unit to receive a replaying start signal from an input unit and to store fact information aggregated by collecting the obtained situation information, site information, and direction command in each time along with order of time series and to display the fact information by replaying the fact information.

title_en: Detachable large-span pre-stressed integral tension awning and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detachable large-span pre-stressed integral tension awning and a construction method thereof. The awning comprises more than two integral tension cable truss units, pin type connecting pieces and membranes, wherein the more than two integral tension cable truss units are arranged in parallel; the pin type connecting pieces are arranged between two adjacent integral tension cable truss units; the membranes are paved between valley cables and ridge cables of the integral tension cable truss units; each of the integral tension cable truss units consists of a group of ridge cables, two groups of valley cables, support trusses, end part outer cables, inner oblique cables, end part oblique columns and oblique column upper horizontal supports; and each of the pin type connecting pieces consists of two semispherical joints, two cable clamping joints, pin shafts and connecting plates. The trusses can form a stable structural system, and can be combined freely; the detachable large-span pre-stressed integral tension awning has the advantages of high overall stability and convenience in assembling and disassembling, and can be applied to remote reconstruction of industrial material storing awnings, mining of open pit quarries and coal yards and large-area open archaeology operation, and can be taken as a temporary disaster relief resident settlement area, a hospital in wartime, a conventional article warehouse in wartime; a larger-span structure can be realized.

title_en: Device and method for cooling DPF room of vehicle
title_ko: 상용 차량의 머플러 룸 냉각 시스템 및 이의 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a muffler compartment cooling system of a commercial vehicle and a control method thereof, and more specifically, to a muffler compartment cooling system and a control method thereof, preventing heat damage and a fire to a peripheral part due to high temperatures caused by replaying a diesel particulate filter (DPF). At least one DPF cooling fan is mounted on a muffler compartment of the commercially vehicle to induce outer air into the muffler compartment, thereby lowering the temperature of the muffler compartment, and the cooling fan is controlled to be operated depending on the operational state of the DPF and the atmospheric temperature condition, thereby improving durability of the cooling fan. When a fault occurs in the cooling fan, a procedure to lower the temperature of the muffler compartment such as reducing engine output or the like is performed, thereby preserving the thermally damaged part and preventing a fire.
abstract_ko:

title_en: The environmental protection united low pressure supercooled liquid production technique of combustible ice well pattern
abstract_en: Energy development reservoir reconstruction under the invention possession.It is characterized in that mining principle is the environmental protection united low pressure supercooling liquefaction technology of well pattern.So that combustible ice is liquefied using well pattern supercooling liquefaction technology, becomes cold fluid, free methane；Nanometer slit reduction slit pressure, individual well pump drainage reduction shaft bottom nearby pressure, the whole reduction well control areal pressure of more well pressure drops superposition are expanded using well pattern simultaneously, combining reduces pressure, realizes combustible ice reservoir entirety low pressure；It is comprehensive to use the measures such as carbon dioxide hydrate or the displacement of nitrogen hydrate, underground heat heating, rapidly and efficiently improve entire development zone combustible ice liquefaction free methane speed.Multi-period gulp down less is spat fastly；Free methane gas is only inside combustible ice stratum, in wellbore tubular and collection transmission pipe network internal flow；The gap of spontaneous carbon dioxide hydrate, nitrogen hydrate displacement free methane, these three measures ensure to control combustible ice industrialization exploitation safe and environment-friendlyly, prevent gas blowout accident, prevent tsunami, submarine landslide, seawater from the disasters such as poisoning.

title_en: Imbibition drainage method
abstract_en: The invention provides an imbibition drainage method. The method involves the process that in order to treat a rising soil disaster of a track bed of a railway ballast track, a dredging method is used, a drainage system in a rising soil section is partially reconstructed, and the capillary action of water in a track bed body and the imbibition function of a drainage material are used for organically guiding saturated water in the track bed out of a roadbed. The method is specifically implemented through the steps that firstly, a blind ditch which is at a certain depth and in the same direction as sleepers is formed between the sleepers at the rising soil position, a layer of water collecting sand bed is laid at the bottom of the blind ditch, due to the funneling effect of the blind ditch, the saturated water in the track bed rapidly seeps into the water collecting sand bed, and water, soil and residues are rapidly separated; and then water is rapidly separated from the sand bed and continuously drained to a side ditch through an imbibition drainage pipe embedded in the water collecting sand bed, and therefore the purpose that the saturated water in the track bed is guided out of the roadbed is achieved. By the adoption of the method, water is drained through three steps, a drainage system is not clogged, and the method has the beneficial effects that water is actively sucked and drained, no rock ballast soil flows away, safety and reliability are achieved, and the rising soil disaster of the track bed can be effectively treated.

title_en: Complementary filtering method for disaster relief unmanned aerial vehicle attitude control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complementary filtering method for disaster relief unmanned aerial vehicle attitude control, comprising the following steps: (1) as the output of an accelerometer contains high-level noise, low-pass filtering is carried out on the calculated value of the accelerometer before data fusion to filter out noise interference and cumulative increment; (2) as a gyroscope has the phenomenon of temperature drift in a static state, high-pass filtering is carried out on the calculated value of the gyroscope; and (3) as the accelerometer has good low-frequency characteristics in calculating the attitude angle and poor high-frequency characteristics while the gyroscope has good high-frequency dynamic characteristics, data reconstruction and fusion are carried out by making use of the complementary frequency characteristics of the accelerometer and the gyroscope. By using the method, the value of the attitude angle can be calculated accurately, and the attitude of an unmanned aerial vehicle can be controlled.
assignees: TIANJIN ACAD FOR INTELLIGENT RECOGNITION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating life loss caused by dam-break flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the life loss caused by a dam-break flood. The method is characterized by comprising four progressive calculation modules of a life loss data selection module, a life loss influence factor module, a life loss sub-module and a coupling module. By the method for calculating the life loss caused by the dam-break flood, important influence factors of the life loss caused by the dam-break flood are screened; four life loss sub-modules of a disaster-causing factor sub-module, a hazard inducing environment sub-module, a hazard-affected body sub-module and a disaster relief capacity sub-module are built; and a life loss coupling model is built. The method can be applied to life loss and life loss rate calculation under various dam break conditions in the China; life loss post-disaster evaluation can be carried out on broken reservoirs; life loss risk prediction can be carried out on unbroken reservoirs; and a scientific calculation method is provided for post-disaster reconstruction and pre-disaster prevention and prediction.

title_en: Accumulation section spatial structural form analysis method based on body-sensing camera work
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of accumulation section spatial structural form analysis method based on body-sensing camera work, and accumulation section is scanned using body-sensing camera machine, to obtaining cloud data after the scan image data fusion of section；To cut-point cloud section after a cloud parameter setting, the ax+by+cz+d=0 of section plane 4 parameters are determined：Split section using point cloud segmentation algorithm, three-dimension curved surface coordinate system is changed into two-dimensional plane coordinate system X O Y, point all in a cloud is all projected two dimensional cross-section, height value is converted gray value；Finally split two dimensional image, the anti-particle diameter and spatial structural form for releasing stone.The present invention carries out the reconstruction of three-dimensional spatial information using body-sensing tomography algorithm to high steep accumulation section, realize and accumulate section block stone geological information, space structure and group structure, the extraction of accumulation horizon position and phase time information and the estimation of accumulation scale, for supporting ancient disaster reconstruction, Landform Evolution analysis, accumulation body stability analysis and engineering selected routes and design etc..

title_en: Use method of tea enzyme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a use method of tea enzyme. Before first picking and second picking of tea, tea enzyme is employed to treat tea at a time interval of 5-6d, and before sunrise, tea enzyme is used for spraying tea so as to effectively prevent late frost disasters. The enzyme organic fertilizer developed by the invention contains a variety of beneficial strains, and sugar, amino acids, organic acids, vitamins, mycin and Fe, Mn, Cu, Zn, B and other minerals, can improve the fertilizer utilization rate, supplement trace elements deficient in tea, improve tea yield and quality, and reduce environmental pollution caused by heavy application of chemical fertilizers, etc. After use of the enzyme in tea gardens, soil can be improved, fertilizer efficiency is increased, at the same time soil hardening and fertility degradation caused by long-term reconstruction of tea gardens can be avoided, tea tree growth is promoted, tea tree bud head density and one-hundred-bud weight of bud tips are increased, so that the tea yield is improved, and the frost-resistant function can be effectively achieved.
assignees: GUIZHOU KAIYANG LANZHI TEA DEV CO LTD

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane real-time map method for reconstructing
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of unmanned plane real-time map method for reconstructing, obtains the three-dimensional map of its ambient enviroment in real time using unmanned plane and realizes the positioning to itself.In this method, unmanned vehicle flies in unknown spatial domain, under the conditions of self-position is uncertain, by detection to environmental information and compare, extraction and matching to the characteristic information of environment, come obtain itself positioning and carry out three-dimensional map structure, further include fusion and the image mosaic technology of geography information.Present invention can apply to battlefield demand (such as unmanned plane autonomous flight, attacks)；The calamity emergencies such as fire/earthquake/flood are rescued；Unmanned plane security administration monitoring etc..This method is compared with the conventional method, either position excursion amount, angle drift amount or absolute error are all in above the average, this method obtains environment compared with multi information, and compared with complete dense method, the experimental precision of this method can still reach using standard, and can directly be run on CPU, real-time is good.

title_en: Method for reconstructing disaster data file directory structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reconstructing a disaster data file directory structure and belongs to the field of data disaster recovery. The method includes the steps that 101, key information FILE0 is scanned step by step to restore all data in a disk, wherein the data includes normal data, obliterated data and deleted data; 102, all the restored data is analyzed, the data is classified through file type numbers and classified into fold data and file data; the fold data is saved in a database table 1, same-content directory information in the fold data is screened and filtered out, and it is guaranteed that no repeated or same directory information exists; the file data is saved in a database table 2; 103, all data information in a database is read and analyzed, relation of subordination of the data information is determined, and the disaster data file directory structure is reconstructed. By means of the method, file types can be fast differentiated, and the data file directory structure with the hierarchical relation can be fast built.
assignees: SICHUAN MWH INFORMATION SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Agricultural drought grade monitoring method based on temperature vegetation drought index (TVDI)
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural drought grade monitoring method based on a temperature vegetation drought index (TVDI). The method comprises the following steps of: 1, data preparation; 2, land surface temperature (LST) data reconstruction; 3, construction of crop plantation area normalized difference vegetation index-land surface temperature (NDVI-LST) feature space; 4, TVDI calculation; and 5, drought grade monitoring based on the TVDI. The invention brings forward an LST data reconstruction method based on multi-year background values and area fluctuation values, a cultivated land area multi-year NDVI-LST feature space is constructed for crops, the TVDI is calculated, a crop drought grade monitoring model based on a supervision classification idea is designed for drought grade remote sensing monitoring, the model can quite accurately reflect drought threat degrees of the crops under difference conditions in real time, and the method has great significance in monitoring, early warning and prevention of agricultural disasters.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING NORMAL;NAT DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF CHINA

title_en: Controller for engine pump
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a controller for an engine pump. The controller of the present invention includes: a speed control lever which is extended from an engine delivering power to a pump transferring firewater stored in a firewater tank to a firewater discharge part and is rotatably installed and controls a driving speed of the engine; a display part which displays flux of the pump varying in accordance with a position of the speed control lever, and displays a fire fighting state of a fire breakout site; a manipulation part including a driving knob generating a driving signal to start driving of the engine, a stop knob generating a stop signal to stop driving of the engine, and a control knob generating a variation signal to change the position of the speed control lever; a control part transmitting a control signal and transmitting an output signal to the display part by receiving the driving signal, the stop signal or the control signal transmitted from the manipulation part; a control delivery part to change the position of the speed control lever by receiving the control signal transmitted from the control part; and a position fixing part which constrains the control knob to prevent the position of the control knob from being changed if the manipulation of the control knob is completed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 소방수탱크에 저장되는 소방수를 소방수배출부 측으로 압송시키는 펌프에 동력을 전달하는 엔진으로부터 연장되고 회전 가능하게 설치되며 엔진의 구동속도를 조절하는 속도조절레버; 상기 속도조절레버의 위치에 따라 가변되는 상기 펌프의 유량을 표시하고 화재현장의 화재 진압상태를 표시하는 디스플레이부; 상기 엔진의 구동을 개시하도록 구동신호를 발생시키는 구동노브, 상기 엔진의 구동을 정지시키도록 정지신호를 발생시키는 정지노브, 및 상기 속도조절레버의 위치를 가변시키도록 가변신호를 발생시키는 조절노브를 포함하는 조작부; 상기 조작부로부터 송신되는 구동신호, 정지신호 또는 조절신호를 수신하여 제어신호를 송신하고 상기 디스플레이부에 출력신호를 송신하는 제어부; 상기 제어부로부터 송신되는 제어신호를 수신하여 상기 속도조절레버의 위치를 가변시키는 조절전달부; 및 상기 조절노브의 조작이 완료되면 상기 조절노브의 위치가 가변되지 않도록 상기 조절노브를 구속하는 위치고정부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Spectrum camera based on all-pass single-template complementary sampling and imaging method
abstract_en: The invention provides a spectrum camera based on all-pass single-template complementary sampling and an imaging method for solving a technical problem that a conventional spectral imaging system is complex in structure and poor in spectral image reconstruction quality. The spectrum camera comprises a lens group, an encoding module, an observation module, and an image reconstruction processing module. The lens group is composed of a group of lenses. The encoding module uses an area array structure formed by random combination of multiple transmission array elements and reflection array elements, and forms an acute angle with the transmission direction of the spectral image, and is used for randomly encoding the transmission information and the reflection information of the spectral image. The observation module comprises a transmission observation module and a reflection observation module and is used for performing transmission observation and reflection observation on the encoded spectral image. The image reconstruction processing module simultaneously fuses two observation results to reconstruct the spectral image. The spectrum camera is simple in system structure, high in luminous flux, and short in exposure time, and can be used in the fields of mineral exploration, natural disaster monitoring, and military reconnaissance.

title_en: Web-gis based integrated water information display system for climate changes and relevant methodology
title_ko: 웹-gis 기반의 기후변화 대응을 위한 통합 물 정보 표출 시스템 및 이를 이용한 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a web GIS-based integrated water information display system for climate changes and a method using the same. The web GIS-based integrated water information display system can check demands and supplies by region and use and various water resource information, check changes in water resources and water shortage regions in real time in an emergency, and provide an integrated water information display environment for a rapid and effective response to the emergency due to climate changes by referring to the reproduction of a scenario established under emergency conditions. The web GIS-based integrated water information display system comprises an integrated water information database, a control and processing unit, a GIS processing unit, a GUI unit, and a display unit. The GIS processing unit displays water resource information and facility location information on a map.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 웹-GIS 기반의 기후변화 대응을 위한 통합 물 정보 시스템 및 이를 이용한 방법에 관한 것으로, 웹 환경에서 GIS 기반의 통합 물 정보 표출 시스템을 통하여, 지역별, 용도별 수요량 및 공급량과 다양한 수자원 정보를 조회할 수 있으며, 비상상황 발생 시 실시간 수자원 변화 및 물 부족 지역을 파악이 가능하며, 비상상황 조건으로 구축된 시나리오 재현을 참조하여 기후변화에 따른 비상상황 시 빠르고 효과적인 대응을 위한 통합 물 정보 표출 환경을 제공하고 이를 이용하는 방법을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Hyper-spectral image end member extraction algorithm based on quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hyper-spectral image end member extraction algorithm based on a quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithm. Particles are encoded through row-column encoding to improve the efficiency of search, and a cooperation mechanism is introduced to update the individual optimal location of particles and the historical optimal location of groups to avoid the problem of 'dimension disaster'. In the aspect of objective function design, a maximum volume objective function and a minimum reconstruction residual error objective function are ingeniously combined to select an optimal end member combination. End member extraction can be implemented at reasonable time cost. The searched optimal end member is robust to noise.

title_en: System for setting Knowledge Based Underwater Acoustic Communication Environment and Method of the Same
title_ko: 지식기반을 활용한 수중음파 통신환경 설정 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a system and a method to set a knowledge-based sound navigation and ranging (SONAR) communication environment capable of reconstructing a network by additionally applying the knowledge-based system to an intelligent data link layer system to progress an adaptive method included in an existing SBMAC and by changing an access control method of a network according to a state of a current channel, a type of a traffic, various securities, an attack, a noise, and disaster information. The system to set a knowledge based SONAR communication environment comprises: a knowledge-based reasoning unit to perform a decision making to form a network based on a transmission variable deducted through a SCB, a current network type, and a value of MIB.

title_en: multi-functional safe mask
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety facial mask. More specifically, the present invention relates to a multi-functional safety facial mask which includes: a facial body tightly adhering to a face; a filter part filtering out harmful smoke; an upper end clamping part extending from the top of the facial body; a lateral side clamping part extending from side to side of the facial body; a clamping string coupled to the upper end clamping part and a lateral side clamping part; and a dial device around which the clamping string is wound. The multi-functional safety facial mask of the present invention can be quickly put on, and keeps tightness. Furthermore, additional functions required in a scene of a fire such as reserving sight and communication can be carried out.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle navigation method based on real-time online map generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle navigation method based on real-time online map generation. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle navigation method, the online reconstruction of a map on an unmanned aerial vehicle is realized, the reconstructed map is sent back to the ground through a high-bandwidth data transmission link, and a ground terminal is used for carrying out navigation decision according to a regional map sent back by the unmanned aerial vehicle, setting route information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and sending the route information to the unmanned aerial vehicle; and an aircraft-based small-size computer of the unmanned aerial vehicle carries out a directional flight task according to the route information, self-reconstructed regional map information and self-location information. By virtue of the unmanned aerial vehicle navigation method, the unmanned aerial vehicle can fly in an unknown airspace, acquires the location by virtue of the exploration and comparison of environmental information and the extraction and matching of environmental feature information when the location of the unmanned aerial vehicle is not determined and carries out the construction of a three-dimensional map and navigation. The unmanned aerial vehicle navigation method can be applied to the battlefield requirements, the emergency rescue of fire/earthquake/flood and the like and the security administration and monitoring of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Gas filtering apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas purification apparatus which purifies exhausts of industrial field or poisonous gas in fire scenes by allowing a user to mouth inhale so as to provide purified air. The gas purification apparatus of the present invention comprises: a gas purification main body (10) whose inner space is opened to both ends thereof, and which allows the user to bite one end thereof by mouth to inhale air; a gas purification member (20) which is mounted in the inner space of the gas purification main body (10) to purify gas, inhaled with air through the other end of the gas purification main body (10) when the user bites one end of the gas purification main body (10) to inhale the air; and a finishing member (30) which allows distribution of air and gas, and finishes the other end of the gas purification main body (10).

title_en: Double-wall type ribbed stone cutoff wall and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-wall type ribbed stone cutoff wall and a construction method thereof. The double-wall type ribbed stone cutoff wall comprises a strip-shaped basic stone cutoff wall body. A plurality of impact-resistant stone cutoff wall bodies are arranged on the surface, facing a falling stone generating zone, of the basic stone cutoff wall body, and the distances between the impact-resistant stone cutoff wall bodies and the basic stone cutoff wall body are equal. The basic stone cutoff wall body is connected with the impact-resistant stone cutoff wall bodies through connecting parts. When falling stone impacts the wall, because the impact-resistant stone cutoff wall bodies bear a large proportion of impact stress and absorb the vast majority of deformation, the basic stone cutoff wall body which is a basic structure behind the impact-resistant stone cutoff wall bodies is not prone to damage, and the stability and safety of the system are high. The impact-resistant stone cutoff wall bodies bear the major impact stress of the falling stone and thus are prone to damage, but the impact-resistant stone cutoff wall bodies are disconnected, so that only the damaged impact-resistant stone cutoff wall bodies need to be dismounted and reconstructed during maintenance. Meanwhile, the construction method of the stone cutoff wall is further provided. The double-wall type ribbed stone cutoff wall and the construction method thereof have the advantages that construction is fast, post-disaster repairing is easy, and investment is small.

abstract_en: The present invention provides an infant safety experiential education system comprising: an experience chamber which is a space for accommodating one or more educators; screens formed on three side surface walls excluding an entrance side for forming the experience chamber; a projector capable of projecting educational audiovisual contents on the screen; a motion sensor for recognizing motions of the educators accommodated in the experience chamber; and a game server for generating a game program by receiving measured and transmitted position and behavior data of the educators from the motion sensor. According to the present invention, realization of a situation which may occur in actual life and a coping method corresponding thereto can be experienced by a motion sensor and playing-type contents. Thus, preparing and coping abilities with respect to life safety accidents can be improved, and more realistic safety education can be performed.

title_en: Three-dimensional emergency drilling virtual system and construction method and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional emergency drilling virtual system and a construction method and a use method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The three-dimensional emergency drilling virtual system comprises a rescue equipment module, a drilling communication module, a drilling evaluation module and a process playback module. The three-dimensional emergency drilling virtual system also comprises a scene management module, an accident simulation module, a user role management module, a drilling monitoring and management module and a data service module. A user logs in the system through the user role management module. The user role management module extracts data from the accident simulation module, the data service module, the scene management module and the rescue equipment module so as to perform rescue operation. The data service module provides the relevant data of rescue operation to the monitoring and management module. The monitoring and management module writes the rescue operation data in a drilling real-time database through the data service module. Drilling, training and examination are normalized so that the safety consciousness of employees and the emergency disposal skills for emergency can be greatly enhanced.

title_en: Risk assessment method for safety of grounding device based on ALARP principle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method for the safety of a grounding device based on the ALARP principle. Random quantities of body resistance, soil surface resistivity and grounding short-circuit fault duration are taken into consideration, and the risk probability of personal injury accidents of the grounding device is calculated. The risk of personal injury near the grounding device is assessed on the basis of the ALARP principle. Random characteristic analysis is carried out on the body resistance, the soil surface resistivity and the short-circuit current duration according to statistical test data; the probability PT1 of contact potential and the probability PS1 of step potential, which may endanger personal safety, of the grounding device are calculated based on a probabilistic method; the probability P2 of a dangerous voltage of human is calculated; the probabilities PT=PT1P2 and PS=PS1P2 of personal safety injury are obtained; and the risk probability of personal safety injury is assessed according the ALARP principle, and the grounding device is designed and reconstructed according to the risk level. Thus, a new method to assess safety risk of the grounding device is provided.

title_en: A kind of multi-index amalgamation landslide detection method based on high-resolution remote sensing image
abstract_en: The multi-index amalgamation landslide detection method based on high-resolution remote sensing image that the present invention relates to a kind of, comprising the following steps: (1) acquire high-resolution remote sensing image and stereogram；(2) it generates digital elevation model and carries out the calculating of features of terrain index；(3) remote sensing image is pre-processed；(4) remote sensing image image fusion is divided；(5) go out suitable characters of ground object index for different scale layer choosing and obtain their value；(6) by features of terrain index with characters of ground object index fusion treatment and by each characteristic index compared with the rule set of setting, realize landslide detection.Compared with prior art, the invention avoids the excessively scattered brought influence of noises in landslide areas provides support to solve the problems, such as that landslide identification caused by injuring naturally because of earthquake etc. extracts for post-disaster reconstruction reparation；Used characteristic index is able to reflect selected survey region atural object feature, and threshold value corresponding to characteristic index is unique, by the combination of feature and the determination of threshold value, successfully extracts research area landslide.

title_en: System and method for constructing of respose on disaster based on scenario
title_ko: 시나리오 기반 재난 대응 구축 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system to construct a disaster response based on a scenario. The system to construct a disaster response based on a scenario comprises: a scenario planning unit that a user logs in and configures a simulation environment to simulate a scenario by disaster type; a disaster type-based scenario generation unit to generate a scenario in accordance with the user conditions and the simulation environment configured by the scenario planning unit, wherein the scenario is generated by combining a standard operation procedure (SOP) corresponding to a disaster management step by disaster type, emergency support function and geographic information; a simulation unit to execute a simulation to realize a scenario with respect to the disaster type-based scenario generated by the scenario generation unit, generate an emergency warning along the scenario, distribute response resources in accordance with a crisis situation, manage a command system and recover the disaster situation; a post-event analysis unit to generate user assessment data in accordance with the simulated results, generate and store a report; and a disaster variable introduction unit to search not only analyzed disaster variables but also disaster type-based disaster variables from a variety of internet webpages using a web robot module and provide the searched disaster variables to the scenario generation unit.

title_en: Optimized disaster-recovery-as-a-service system
abstract_en: Methods, computer program products, and systems are presented. The methods include, for instance: enabling a client of a source site protected by a disaster recovery service, to select one or more value-added service to be performed by a data protection service provider in addition to the disaster recovery service. Respective dataset associated with a service is identified and analyzed to minimize the amount of dataset to replicate from the source site to a target site run by the data protection service provider, and a policy dictating when and how to replicate which dataset is configured. Upon being triggered, the data protection service provider performs the service by use of the dataset at the target site, the dataset either replicated according to the policy from the source site or being reconstructed from the transferred dataset when necessary.

title_en: Fire Ballon
abstract_en: A hot air balloon, which is an air delivery fire suppression device, is disclosed. The hot air balloon, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises: a hot air balloon unit which has a hot air balloon flying in the air and a gondola hung on the hot air balloon; a photographing device which is installed in the hot air balloon unit and acquires the image information of a fire site to transmit the image information to an image display part arranged on the ground; a fire extinguishing device which is installed in the gondola and receives the water from a ground water supply device through a water supply hose to sprinkle the received water to the fire site; and a control part which controls the operation of the hot air balloon unit, the photographing device, and the fire extinguishing device according to the order of an operation part, wherein the operation part is manipulated on the ground while seeing the image display part to control the movement of the hot air balloon unit and the operation of the fire extinguishing device.

title_en: Gully region drought slope water and soil conservation method

title_en: A fire fighting robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting robot dispatched to the scene of a fire. The present invention comprises: a mobile platform including a driving device to move by itself while supporting a device of a robot; a caterpillar track operating device installed on both side edges of the mobile platform to enable smooth driving as well as easily passing through an obstacle; a firefighting cannon installed on the mobile platform to spray firewater to the scene of a fire; a sensor unit exploring a fire spot and securing sight; an integrated controller controlling the entire operating part of the robot; a cooling system embedding an inert refrigerant tank, and cooling the operating part by supplying an inert refrigerant if temperature increases to more than a predetermined level; and a free spray nozzle forming a water screen to prevent an increase in the temperature of the robot body when suppressing the fire. Therefore, the firefighting robot is capable of being dispatched to the scene of a fire without interruptions by obstacles by using a caterpillar track, remotely exploring and suppressing the fire spot, and effectively suppressing the fire by using a self-cooling unit.

title_en: Building damage degree evaluation method based on interference synthetic aperture radar data
abstract_en: The invention provides a building damage degree evaluation method based on the interference synthetic aperture radar data and a system. The method comprises steps that post-earthquake interference synthetic aperture radar data pairs of one same observation area are inputted; the post-earthquake interference synthetic aperture radar data pairs of one same observation area are pre-processed; coherent coefficients of the post-earthquake interference synthetic aperture radar data pairs of one same observation area are calculated, and a coherent coefficient map is further acquired; texture analysis on the coherent coefficient map is further carried out to determine interference synthetic aperture radar images to evaluate a damage degree of buildings in the observation area. Through the method, a building damage degree evaluation result of an earthquake disaster area without any available pre-earthquake remote sensing data can be rapidly acquired through directly utilizing the post-earthquake interference synthetic aperture radar data, so relevant disaster mitigation disaster rescue departments are facilitated to rapidly make and implement a post-earthquake scheme on the basis of the evaluation result to develop post-disaster recovery reconstruction works.

title_en: Precast assembled bridge pier manufactured from U-shaped reinforcing steel bars, and connection process of precast assembled bridge pier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precast assembled bridge pier manufactured from U-shaped reinforcing steel bars. The precast assembled bridge pier comprises a pier body and a bearing platform, wherein the pier body comprises a U-shaped reinforcing steel bar cage and a pier stud, a plurality of U-shaped reinforcing steel bars are mutually spaced by a certain distance and are crisscrossed to form the U-shaped reinforcing steel bar cage, and the pier stud is cast at one end of the U-shaped reinforcing steel bar cage; a groove is formed in the bearing platform, and the other end of the U-shaped reinforcing steel bar cage is arranged in the groove; a plurality of holes are formed in each of the four side surfaces of the bearing platform, and reinforcing steel bars penetrate through the holes; a reinforcing steel bar mesh is formed by the reinforcing steel bars and the U-shaped reinforcing steel bar cage, and finally concrete is cast. The invention further discloses a connection process of the precast assembled bridge pier. According to the precast assembled bridge pier and the connection process thereof disclosed by the invention, a mutual crossed and meshed manner of the U-shaped reinforcing steel bars and the reinforcing steel bars (the reinforcing steel bars penetrated subsequently) is adopted between the bearing platform and the pier body, so that the integrity between the bridge pier and the concrete, and the seismic performance of the bridge pier are greatly enhanced, and the construction speed of the bridge pier is accelerated; and the precast assembled bridge pier and the connection process thereof are suitable for the rapid construction of an urban rail transit bridge or the connection of relevant parts, and also have a certain significance on the reconstruction after disasters.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for guiding to an indoor evacuation route The system includes: a map server which receives map information, stores the same in a database, and generates a disaster evacuation graph based on the map information; a route server which receives the disaster evacuation graph from the map server and generates an evacuation route based on position information of a user terminal; and the user terminal which transmits, to the route server, position-related information received through communications with a beacon for position determination installed inside a building, receives the evacuation route generated by the route server, and displays the evacuation route on a screen. According to the present invention, the system partitions an arbitrary area around a beacon, which is installed in a building to determine a position, not displaying all space areas for rendering disaster evacuation graphs as peak points, reduces the graphs in scale by connecting the arbitrary area with edges, updates properties of the edges in the arbitrary area if the properties of the edges are changed according to change in position information of a user terminal. Thus, it is possible to reduce an operation time for route search. In addition, the evacuation route is calculated by using a graph wherein weights of the properties of each of the edges are updated, and it is possible to reduce an average evacuation time of people in a different space, or reconfigure a route for the people not to gather in a specific space. Accordingly, the system facilitates guidance to a more effective route in real time without an operation load for the router search.

본 발명은 실내 대피경로 안내 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 지도정보를 수신하여 데이터베이스에 저장하고, 상기 지도정보를 기초로 하여 재난대피 그래프를 생성하는 맵서버와, 상기 맵서버에서 생성된 재난대피 그래프를 전송받고, 사용자 단말의 측위정보에 기초한 대피경로를 생성하는 경로서버와, 건물내 설치된 측위용 비컨과 통신을 통해 수신한 측위관련 정보를 상기 경로서버로 전송하며, 상기 경로서버에서 생성된 대피경로를 전송받아 화면으로 디스플레이되는 사용자 단말을 포함하여 제공된다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 재난대피 그래프를 구성하기 위한 모든 공간영역을 정점으로 표현하지 않고, 건물내 설치된 측위용 비컨을 중심으로 하는 임의 영역을 구획하고, 임의 영역을 간선으로 연결하여 그래프의 규모를 축소시키고, 임의 영역내의 사용자 단말 위치정보 변화에 따라 간선 속성값이 변경될 경우 임의 영역내의 간선 속성값만 갱신되도록 하여, 경로탐색 연산시간을 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 각 간선마다 속성값 가중치가 갱신된 그래프를 이용하여 대피경로가 산출되도록 하여 서로 다른 공간내에 있는 사람들의 평균 대피시간을 줄이거나, 특정 공간으로 사람들이 많이 몰리지 않도록 경로를 재구성할 수 있어, 경로탐색 연산부하 없이 실시간으로 보다 효과적인 경로안내가 이루어지도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: The unmanned air vehicle for castaway tracking
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned air vehicle comprising: a body; a camera for photographing the front; a microphone for receiving an external sound; a speaker capable of delivering sound to the outside; a directional antenna oriented in a moving direction; a proximity sensor for detecting an obstacle; an environmental sensor for sensing a surrounding environmental condition; and a steering antenna for transmitting control information. By inputting the unmanned air vehicle into various disaster sites such as a fire site or a collapse site to rescue a castaway, the unmanned air vehicle can rapidly find a castaway without inputting manpower into a high-risk site, thereby providing a safe route where a rescue team can enter.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 몸체와 정면을 촬영하는 카메라, 외부의 소리를 입력 받을 수 있는 마이크, 소리를 외부로 전달 가능한 스피커, 이동 방향을 지향하는 지향성 안테나, 장애물을 감지하는 근접센서, 주변의 환경 상태를 감지하는 환경센서, 및 제어 정보를 전달하는 조종 안테나를 포함하는 무인 비행체를 투입하여 화재현장이나 붕괴현장과 같은 각종 재해현장에서 피치 못할 상황으로 대피하지 못한 조난자를 구조하는데 있어서, 고 위험의 현장에 인력을 투입하는 대신 신속하게 조난자를 탐색하여, 구조대가 투입될 수 있는 안전한 경로를 제공하는데 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method for Training Radiation Emergency Field Exploration Based on Postulated Accident
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method to train a radiation emergency field exploration based on postulated accident, capable of designing a postulated accident scenario similar to an actual radiation accident and then collecting virtual position-based exploration data in real time from an actual site in accordance with the designed scenario and enabling a central control center to reform a distribution state of leaked radiation. More specifically, in order to quickly identify radiation distribution information of an accident scene in the event of a radiation emergency, the method to train a radiation emergency field exploration employs: a plurality of radiation monitors securing radiation level distribution data; a monitoring network including a management server wirelessly communicating with the monitors; and a training server wirelessly communicating with the monitors. The method includes a scenario setting step, a postulated radiation level detection step, and a postulated radiation distribution information obtaining step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실제 방사선비상 사고와 유사하게 가상사고 시나리오를 설계하고, 이렇게 설계된 시나리오에 따라 실제 현장에서 실시간으로 가상의 위치기반 탐사데이터를 수집하고 중앙관제센터에서 유출 방사선의 분포현황을 재구성하도록 훈련할 수 있는 가상사고 기반 방사선비상 현장탐사 훈련방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 방사선비상시 신속하게 사고지역의 방사선분포정보를 파악할 수 있도록 방사선 준위 분포 데이터 확보를 위한 복수의 방사선 감시기, 상기 감시기와 무선통신하는 운영서버를 포함하는 감시네트워크, 및 상기 감시기와 무선통신하는 훈련서버를 활용한 가상사고 기반 방사선비상 현장탐사 훈련방법으로서, 시나리오설정과정, 가상방사선준위탐사과정 및 가상방사선분포정보획득과정을 포함하는 가상사고 기반 방사선비상 현장탐사 훈련방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of seat that can be used for ground post-earthquake emergency response
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of seat that can be used for ground post-earthquake emergency response, including seat body, the first overcover is provided with by support above seat body.This utility model is a kind of to can be used for the seat of ground post-earthquake emergency response, effectively can solve the very first time can obtain refuge after calamity, is post-disaster reconstruction or builds and serve interim transition buffer effect；The demand of the needs separate space such as child, patient, old man can also be met simultaneously.

title_en: All-steel self-restoring buckling-restrained brace based on disc spring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-steel self-restoring buckling-restrained brace based on a disc spring, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and shock absorption for civil engineering. The all-steel self-restoring buckling-restrained brace is mainly composed of an in-line steel plate inner core, a stiffening rib, a non-bonding material, an inner sleeve, an outer sleeve, the combined disc spring, a stop block, a stop plate, a left connection plate and a right connection plate. The brace is composed of a buckling-restrained part and a self-restoring part, the buckling-restrained part is composed of the in-line steel plate inner core, the stiffening rib, the non-bonding material, the inner sleeve, the left connection plate and the right connection plate, and the self-restoring part is composed of the inner sleeve, the disc spring, the stop block, the stop plate and the outer sleeve. The buckling-restrained brace disclosed by the invention is capable of effectively solving the problems of the increased post-earthquake maintenance and reconstruction cost due to the excessive residual deformation of the buckling-restrained brace under the action of a major earthquake or a medium earthquake, and high cost, low ultimate elastic deformation capacity and the like of a self-restoring material in an existing self-restoring energy dissipating brace. The all-steel self-restoring buckling-restrained brace based on the disc spring is simple in structure, clear in working mechanism, economic and applicable, and stable in performance.

title_en: Mine emergency rescue black box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine emergency rescue black box, including processor module, processor module is connected with video module, audio frequency module, communication module, this ampere of power module, environmental parameter perceiving module, storage module and LCD display module respectively, and whole equipment is always supplied power by the power supply of this ampere of power module, and whole circuit design accords with essential safe principle. Use the device can realize gathering high definition video image, audio signal and environmental parameter under the black environment entirely even at the low light level, can show all -sidedly and accurately, take notes, upload with on -the -spot truth and the rescue process in playback disaster area, the whole low power dissipation of equipment, light in weight, small, with low costs and easy to maintain.

title_en: Portable fire fighting system
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 손목 형 무선송신기와 연동하여 건설현장의 용접 또는 용단 작업중에 발생하는 불꽃이 주변 스티로폼, 목재 등 가연성 물질 자재에 인화되어 화재발생시 음향과 불빛을 통해 소화기의 위치를 표시하여 쉽게 소화기를 찾을 수 있도록 하고, 화재현장을 벗어나지 않고 화재 초기 진화 대처와 동시에 발화장소 밖에 상주하고 있는 작업자에게 알려 신속히 대피할 수 있게 하는 휴대형 간이 소방시설 장치에 관한 것으로서, 작업공간을 이동하여 설치할 수 있는 본체부, 작업환경을 상시 영상녹화 및 저장하는 영상녹화부, 손목형 송신기와 연동하여 화재신호를 수신하는 무선수신부와 주변 화재를 실시간 감시하는 연기감지기의 신호를 수신하는 수신부, 상기 수신부의 신호를 입력으로 소화기의 위치를 표시하고 화재 발생을 음향으로 알리는 표시부 및 주변 다른 장치에 동시 제어할 수 있도록 하는 무선중계 부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 손목 형 무선송신기와 연동하여 화재현장을 이탈하지 않고 표시부에 의하여 소화기 위치확인이 가능하여 신속한 화재 초기 진화와 상기 제어부에 형성되는 무선중계 부에 의하여 주변의 다른 휴대형 간이 소방시설 장치 및 소화전을 동시에 제어하여 전역으로 확대 전달할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: electronic socket of supporting media playback
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic socket supporting the playback of media, capable of having safety functions for the prevention of an electric shock, the reduction of standby power, and the prevention of a fire while having a function to play back media while being charged. The electronic socket comprises: a safety socket part including a cutoff switch to cut off input power when turned on, and turning on the cutoff switch as at least one among a current value, a voltage value, a resistance value, a resonance value, and a frequency value, which are measured from an output terminal of the cutoff switch, is sensed in a range of a value corresponding to at least one among a human body contact state, a conductor contact state, a standby power state, and an overload state; a wired/wireless charging part charging a terminal, which is connected by wire or wirelessly, by using the input power; a media playback part playing back a pre-stored media file or media file received from the terminal by wire or wirelessly; and a control part controlling the operation of the safety socket part, the charging part, and the media playback part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 감전 방지, 대기전력 저감 및 화재 방지를 위한 안전기능을 가지면서 충전 중 미디어 재생 기능도 가지는 미디어 재생을 지원하는 전자식 콘센트에 관한 것으로, 온 동작 시에 입력 전원을 차단하는 차단 스위치를 구비하며, 상기 차단 스위치의 출력단에서 측정된 전류 값과 전압 값과 저항 값과 공진 값과 주파수 중 적어도 하나가 인체 접촉 상태와 전도체 접촉 상태와 대기전력 상태와 과부하 상태 중 어느 하나에 해당하는 값의 범위로 감지됨에 따라 상기 차단 스위치를 온 동작시키는 안전 콘센트부와, 상기 입력 전원을 사용하여 유선 또는 무선으로 연결된 단말기를 충전하는 유무선 충전부와, 상기 단말기로부터 유선 또는 무선으로 수신한 미디어파일이나 미리 저장된 미디어파일을 재생하는 미디어재생부와, 상기 안전 콘센트부와 상기 충전부와 상기 미디어재생부의 동작을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성되는 것이 특징인 발명이다.

title_en: Fire fighting garment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting garment using the Leidenfrost phenomenon in which water, discharged from the surface of a firefighting garment, is in a hot environment and evaporates into vapor. The firefighting garment comprises: an intermediate layer storing a small amount of water to prevent radiant heat of flame on the scene of a fire; a partition effectively distributing water on the entire body; and a mist discharge device in which a certain amount of water is automatically sprayed on the surface of the firefighting garment through micro-holes for a period of time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방화복 표면에서 방출되는 물이 뜨거운 환경을 만나 수증기로 증발하는 라이덴프로스트 효과를 이용한 소방용 방화복에 관한 것으로, 화재현장에서 화염의 복사열을 방지하기 위하여 소방용 방화복 중간층에 소량의 물을 저장하고 물의 양이 적어도 온몸에 효율적으로 분배할 수 있게 하는 칸막이를 설치하였으며, 방화복 표면으로 일정 시간동안 일정량의 물이 미세구멍을 통해 스프레이 형식으로 자동 분사되는 미스트 배출장치를 포함하는 소방용 방화복에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Damage Control Management System Capable of Realistic Damage Control On Board Training for Naval Ships
title_ko: 실전적 손상통제 함상훈련 기능을 갖춘 함정 손상통제관리시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a vessel damage control management system having a practical damage control on-board training function, which comprises: a damage prediction module predicting damage to a virtual disaster when the virtual disaster is defined; a damage detection sensor virtual regeneration module virtually generating detection data of a damage detection sensor in accordance with damage predicted by a damage prediction module; and a damage control management server generating and displaying damage situation data including a type and a range of damage according to the virtual detection data virtually generated by the damage detection sensor virtual regeneration module.
abstract_ko: 가상 재해가 정의되면, 가상 재해에 대한 손상을 예측하는 손상 예측 모듈,손상 예측 모듈에 의해 예측된 손상에 부합하도록 손상 감지 센서의 감지 데이터를 가상으로 생성하는 손상 감지센서 가상재현 모듈, 및 손상 감지센서 가상재현 모듈에 의해 가상으로 생성된 가상 감지 데이터에 따라서 손상 상황 데이터 - 손상의 종류 및 손상의 범위를 포함 - 를 생성하여 표시하는 손상통제관리 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 실전적 손상통제 함상훈련 기능을 갖춘 함정 손상통제관리시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Portable somke and insulation mask which is possible suppling air
title_ko: 산소공급이 가능한 휴대용 방연 및 단열, 두건형태의 마스크
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable smoke prevention and insulation mask in a hood form for users to wear in case of fire, and more specifically, to a portable smoke prevention and insulation mask in a hood form which is possible to supply air; is easily to carry and wear; protects the users from harmful gas and heat of a fire site; and supplies air to the users while the users are escaping the fire site, thereby allowing the users to maintain respiration.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재발생시 착용하는 휴대용 방염 및 단열, 두건형태의 마스크에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 휴대 및 착용이 용이하고 화재현장의 유해가스와 열기로부터 보호함과 아울러 착용자가 화재현장을 빠져나가는 동안에 산소를 공급하여 호흡을 유지할 수 있게 하는 산소공급이 가능한 휴대용 방연 및 단열, 두건형태의 마스크에 관한 것이다.
