title_en: Combined energy dissipation shed frame structure for preventing rockfall of high and steep slope in earthquake region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined energy dissipation shed frame structure for preventing rock rolling-down hazards of a high and steep slope in highway construction, and belongs to the field of highway disaster prevention and control and post-disaster reconstruction engineering in an earthquake region. The combined energy dissipation shed frame structure is composed of a top surface anti-impact system tightly connected with an existing slope, a top surface supporting system composed of a three-dimensional steel frame system, a shed frame main structure composed of a cross beam and supporting steel tube stand columns on the two sides, a close-to-mountain side anchoring system for anchoring the top surface anti-impact system and the shed frame main structure, and a cast-in-place concrete bed formed by welding fixing pedestals to the bottoms of the steel tube stand columns and driving the fixing pedestals into a foundation through anchor rods. According to the combined energy dissipation shed frame structure, potential safety hazards caused by crag rockfall of a high and steep slope in an earthquake region to highway construction and vehicle driving are prevented, and the stability and seismic capacity of the shed frame structure are effectively improved. Compared with a traditional shed tunnel structure, the combined energy dissipation shed frame structure greatly shortens construction time and is beneficial to rapid traffic keeping and anti-disaster capacity improving.

title_en: Mountain boundary automatic extraction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountain boundary automatic extraction method, which comprises the steps of obtaining mountain boundary surface, ridge line and valley line data; associating a surface through which the ridge line passes based on ridge line data, and primarily forming a mountain body boundary; searching a surface which has an adjacent relation with a mountain body boundary, and associating the surfaces which meet the conditions by taking a valley line as a constraint; and (4) associating the faces outside the rule constraint condition to finally form the mountain boundary of the geographic scale. The invention is based on mountain boundary surface data, takes a terrain characteristic line as a constraint condition, associates the surfaces meeting the condition, realizes the automatic extraction of the mountain boundary in geographic scale, has more complete mountain after extraction and relatively reasonable scale, can directly meet the requirement of geographic research, can become the basis for constructing a mountain object, and provides effective support for geomorphology and human literature characteristic analysis, mountain reconstruction after geological disasters and terrain multi-scale synthesis.

title_en: A kind of consideration wind pressure relevance and wind speed direction metal Roof disaster caused by a windstorm estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of consideration wind pressure relevances and wind speed direction metal Roof disaster caused by a windstorm estimation method, estimate the charming appearance and behaviour loss of metal structure roof boarding.In calculating process, the external wind pressure of roofing is obtained using POD interpolation；Internal pressure is obtained by simulation；Roof boarding connecting elements internal force is calculated using face method is influenced, and corresponding extreme value internal force is acquired by Gumbel conversion；With Monte Carlo simulation, roof boarding failure probability and integral roofing loss late are estimated, wherein connecting elements internal force correlation is considered by Nataf transformation；By the directionality of wind in view of obtaining the integrated charming appearance and behaviour earthquake loss estimation methodology of metal roofing board in charming appearance and behaviour estimated amount of damage.The method of the present invention carries out the reconstruction of roofing external wind pressure by POD method interpolation, to consider existing relevance between wind pressure, influence of the wind load correlation for roof boarding charming appearance and behaviour loss appraisal is quantified, and at the same time considering that wind pressure relevance and wind speed direction carry out charming appearance and behaviour estimated amount of damage to sheet-metal roofing.

title_en: Disaster degree appraisal procedure, system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a kind of Disaster degree appraisal procedure, system and electronic equipment.The method is applied to the disaster with natural calamity as main cause.Methods described includes：Obtain the data of disaster；According to similarity judge index, at least one similar cases are selected；At least one similar cases and at least one similarity of the disaster is assessed to obtain the weight of each similar cases；And by weighted comprehensive assessment models, obtain the condition of a disaster assessment result.The Disaster degree appraisal procedure that the disclosure is provided, to devastated, carries out the impaired analysis of multi-C stereo, improves rescue and reconstruction efficiency after natural calamity.

title_en: Flame/smog recognition methods after forest map picture cutting based on RGB reconstruct
abstract_en: Flame/smog recognition methods after forest map picture cutting based on RGB reconstruct, the present invention relates to the flame/smog identification technology being based on after the forest map picture cutting of RGB reconstruct.System relevance grade the invention aims to solve existing flame/smog recognition methods is low, False Rate problem high.The method is：Difference of the present invention based on flame, smoke region and background area RGB three-component values, at utmost destroys background area, constantly to reduce target area.During target area is reduced, and only consider the most obvious region of feature, that is, meet those maximum connected regions of the area of feature, delete region that is small, being likely to result in erroneous judgement.Through reinforcing flame characteristic amendment gray scale formula manipulation after, then after filtering, cutting, corrosion and expand, judge smog or flame suspicious region according to non-negative element proportion.The present invention is applied to the occasion of identification flame/smog in forest fire protection.

title_en: A kind of cable duct fire test and fire plant Testing Platform
abstract_en: A kind of cable duct fire test and fire plant Testing Platform, including testing stand main body and the supporting ventilating system, supporting fire detecting system, supporting fire extinguishing system, supporting smoke processing system and the supporting TT＆C system that are arranged in testing stand main body.The utility model to cable duct fire suitable for being reconstructed experiment, cable duct fire scenario can be reappeared, and to the burning things which may cause a fire disaster image behavior under fire scenario, HRR, smoke movement feature, detection and can put out a fire to save life and property and carry out comprehensive system research, and all kinds of fire plant performances can be tested and evaluated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of combined fire disaster escaping physical efficiency outward bound equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of combined fire disaster escaping physical efficiency outward bound equipment, belong to physical culture training clothing arts, including lobby, opisthodome and fire simulation tunnel between the two, fire simulation tunnel is domed, one end attaches ground, the other end is hanging, and its free end is provided with the 3~6m for fixing on the ground prompt drop bars high, and training main equipment is additionally provided with fire simulation tunnel；The training device is additionally provided with emulation dense smoke equipment in fire simulation tunnel, extra exit Warning Mark and infrared pick-up equipment, and they communicate with control terminal, control terminal communicates with display screen, video intercom device and TV replay system again, display screen and video intercom device are arranged in lobby, and TV replay system and stop button are arranged in opisthodome.The utility model specific aim and strong operability, have dramatically cultivated student's fire disaster escaping ability.

title_en: Disaster recovery of cloud resources
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention relate to a method for different services registered with a cloud infrastructure in the event of a disaster to be recoverable. It also relates to a process for a resource provider to recover and reconstruct its cloud resource information by scanning the actual available resources. The resource provider will synchronize the resource with the central service to obtain updated consumer and subscription information. In the case where the central service fails and recovers from a backup, the central service should synchronize with the resource provider to update its resource information.

title_en: Fireproof apparatus for firefighting with imporved heat blocking efficiency
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire fighting apparatus with an improved thermal efficiency, and more particularly, to a fire fighting apparatus capable of preventing flames or smoke from being spread in case of fire to enable people to have enough time for emergency escape from a scene of fire. Also, the present invention relates to the fire fighting apparatus configured to enable a round bar to move down smoothly and a wound fireproof fabric to be unwound smoothly in accordance with the opening of a cover.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 열차단 효율을 높인 소방용 방화기구에 관한 것으로써, 더욱 상세하게는 화재발생 시 화염이나 연기의 확산을 차단하여 화재현장으로부터 긴급 피난할 수 있는 시간적 여유를 확보할 수 있도록 하는 한편, 덮개의 개방에 따라 원형봉의 하강 및 권취된 방화천의 풀림이 원활하게 이루어지도록 하기 위한 열차단 효율을 높인 소방용 방화기구에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane reconnaissance method based on the generation of real-time online map
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of unmanned plane reconnaissance method based on the generation of real-time online map, and unmanned plane first treats investigation region according to setting Route reform, shoots normal video, and extraction standard key frame of video：And according to normal video, according to real-time online ground drawing generating method, the image sequence of normal video is generated into global map；Then unmanned plane is treated investigation region and is carried out investigations flight according to setting air route, shoots new video, and on the basis of map real-time online map reconstruction is realized, the geography information of automatic comparative analysis different time changes, and warning message is generated on map.The present invention can be used for boundary line patrol and scout, and bank line patrol in coastline is scouted, oil pipeline inspection etc., it may also be used for emergent mapping in real time, at aspects such as Sudden Geological Hazards, forest fire, point duties, there is extensive purposes.

title_en: A kind of map constructing method for earthquake-stricken area communication failure region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of map constructing method for earthquake-stricken area communication failure region, belong to post-disaster reconstruction device field, including aerial reconnaissance device and land detection device；The aerial reconnaissance device includes aircraft, binocular vision module, map revision module and air navigation module；The land detection device includes carrier, land sensing module, map structuring module and area navigation module；Wherein, aerial reconnaissance device is connected with land detection device by ZigBee communication module communication.Aerial reconnaissance device is interconnected with land detection device by independently communicating, map and information to be rescued after calamity, effectively save manpower can be obtained rapidly, and shortens detection time, significantly improves rescue efficiency.

title_en: Dual Fire Hose
title_ko: 내.외측재킷부의 위사가 서로 반대방향으로 제직된 이중소방호스 및 그 제조장치.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 내측재킷부를 이루는 내측경사에 교차제직되는 내측위사의 교차제직방향과 외측재킷부를 이루는 외측경사에 교차제직되는 외측위사의 교차제직방향을 서로 달리하여 내,외측재킷부로 구성된 소방호스를 권취상태에서 길게 펼쳐 가압시에 내측재킷부와 외측재킷부가 서로 반대로 비틀어지는 힘으로 인해 내.외측재킷부의 비틀리는 힘을 서로 상쇄시켜 소방호스가 비틀어져서 소방호스가 꼬이지않고 일직선으로 곧게 펼친상태를 유지하게 하고, 소방호스의 구성인 외측재킷부의 칼라부재를 설치하여 소방호스의 펼친길이에서 소방호스가 꼬일경우에 꼬인횟수를 손쉽게 알 수 있으며, 소방호스의 구성인 외측재킷부에 축광부재를 설치하여 야간 또는 어두운 실내 주야간화재현장에서 소방호스를 보다 용이하게 식별하도록 한 내.외측재킷부의 위사가 서로 반대방향으로 제직된 이중소방호스 및 그 제조장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing realistic language learning contents based on virtual reality and voice recognition
title_ko: 가상현실 및 음성인식 기반의 실감 어학학습 콘텐츠 제공 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실 및 음성인식 기반의 실감 어학학습 콘텐츠를 제공하기 위한 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 장치는 저장모듈과 영사모듈과 오디오모듈과 음성인식모듈과 콘텐츠 제공모듈을 포함한다. 저장모듈은 가상현실을 재현하기 위한 영상 및 음성을 포함하는 콘텐츠를 저장한다. 영사모듈은 영상을 영사하고, 오디오모듈은 음성을 입력받거나 출력한다. 음성인식모듈은 오디오모듈로부터 수신되는 가상현실의 객체에 대한 사용자의 답변 혹은 질문을 음성인식하여 음성인식 결과를 출력한다. 콘텐츠 제공모듈은 음성인식 결과에 따라 사용자의 답변 혹은 질문을 평가하고, 평가 결과에 대응하여 객체가 사용자의 답변 혹은 질문에 대해 응답하는 음성 및 영상을 포함하는 콘텐츠를 영상모듈 및 오디오모듈이 출력하도록 제공한다.

title_en: Disaster prevention apparatus using air chamber in bottom of a ship
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선저의 에어 챔버를 이용한 방재장치에 관한 것으로, 기존 공기 윤활시스템(AIR LUBRICATION SYSTEM: ALS)을 활용하는 것으로, 선저에 형성되는 에어 챔버에 에어를 공급하거나, 선저의 해수를 흡입하기 위하여 선체에 설치되는 에어 해수 겸용 배관이 설치되고, 에어 해수 겸용 배관의 중간에는 에어 챔버에 에어를 공급하거나 방재를 위해서 선저의 해수를 흡입하는 펌프가 설치됨으로써, 기존 공기 윤활시스템의 에어 챔버와 연결된 에어 홀을 통해서 해수를 흡입하여 화재현장에 고압 분사하여, 화재진압용수로 사용할 수 있으며, 방재장치를 기존 공기 윤활 시스템과는 별도로 구성할 필요가 없어서 의장품 설치의 제약을 받지 않으며, 운용에 있어서도 호환성이 가능하여 공기 윤활모드와 방재모드를 선택적으로 사용할 수 있다.

title_en: Concrete construction method has a fixation with sound-absorbing effect
title_ko: 고정력과 흡음효과를 가지는 콘크리트 구조물 시공방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 고정력과 흡음효과를 가지는 콘크리트 구조물 시공방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 내측에 상하부로 일정간격으로 다수의 슬라이드홀(111)이 형성되고, 각각의 슬라이드홀(111)의 일측으로 일정간격으로 다수의 고정홈(113)이 형성되는 다수의 제1철근고정대(110)와, 상기 제1철근고정대(110)와 동일한 구조를 가지되 고정홈(123)의 높이가 다르게 형성되는 한 쌍의 제2철근고정대(120)로 구성되는 고정대(100)를 구성하여, 각각의 제1,2철근고정대(110, 120)가 상호 마주하게 배치하는 철근고정대배치단계(S10); 가로방향과 세로방향으로 설치되는 철근(210, 220)들을 각각의 슬라이드홀(111, 121)에 각각 끼움시킨 후, 원하는 높이에 맞는 고정홈(113, 123)에 고정시켜 상기 철근(210, 220)들이 교차되게 배치하는 철근배치단계(S20); 상기 철근(210, 220)이 교차되는 부분에 상기 철근(210, 220)이 뒤틀리지 않게 고정부재(300)로 끼워 고정하는 고정부재구성단계(S30); 상기 고정부재(300)의 외측이 감싸며 흡음, 단열 및 충격을 완화시킬 수 있도록 흡음재(400)를 구성하는 흡음재구성단계(S40); 상기 철근(210, 220)과 시공하려는 콘크리트 구조물(10)의 사면이 감싸지도록 각각의 형틀(500)을 구성하여 콘크리트타설공간(510)을 확보하는 형틀구성단계(S50); 상기 콘크리트타설공간(510)에 콘크리트(600)를 타설하는 콘크리트타설단계(S600); 로 이루어짐으로써, 건축물의 벽체 등의 구조물을 시공함에 있어 콘크리트 타설 시, 철근고정부의 구성을 통해 원하는 위치 및 높이와 일정간격으로 균일하게 철근을 고정되게 배치하고 각각의 철근이 교차하는 부분에 고정부재로 뒤틀리지 않게 고정함으로써, 구조물의 전체적인 균일한 내구성을 확보할 수 있음과 더불어, 콘크리트의 내부에 일정간격으로 구성되는 흡음재에 의해 진동 및 소음과 단열과 화재를 억제할 수 있는 통상의 콘크리트 구조물과 동일한 효과를 가질 수 있어, 구조물의 부피축소를 통한 설치비용을 절감시킬 수가 있으며, 작업시간 단축 및 작업의 편리성을 부여토록 하는 획기적인 발명인 것이다.
assignees: MIRAE GREEN CO LTD;JEONG SEUNG U

title_en: A kind of fire fighting truck recognition methods of the nuclear sparse expression grader based on cost-sensitive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire fighting truck recognition methods of the nuclear sparse expression grader based on cost-sensitive, belong to fire fighting truck automatic identifying method technical field.This method is the HOG features and color characteristic for first extracting training sample, then by a mapping function HOG features The characteristic vector of a higher order is mapped as, basis matrix is obtained；The HOG features and color characteristic of detection sample are extracted again, using the nuclear sparse expression model reconstruction test sample feature based on cost-sensitive, are finally obtained the optimal solution of the model, are completed the identification of fire fighting truck.The present invention has used a kind of color description method independently of illumination condition based on invariant, this method has good robustness in actual use during color characteristic is extracted.The present invention combines HOG features and color characteristic using a kind of nuclear sparse expression model of cost-sensitive, as a result relatively stable.

title_en: A kind of architecture system of intelligent fire car
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of architecture system of intelligent fire car, including framework, the framework is the intelligent management system and intelligent instrumentation system using fire fighting truck as business core, business and monitor terminal are cloud screens, the carrier of the cloud screen is fire fighting truck, mobile intelligent terminal is intelligent vehicle-carried tablet personal computer, there are automobile navigation, driving recording playback, actual combat quick search, decision-making assistant information, the function of vehicle multidate information, it is the opening of Mobile solution access, interconnect, the ecological platform of mobile, is linked with combat operations center large-size screen monitors.The present invention passes through intelligent management system and intelligent instrumentation system, realize the quick dynamic management to fire-fighting equipment, equipment information is set intuitively to change, cammander is set to obtain equipment decision data content, data analysis is animation, to equipping data information access, inquiring about promptness, convenience, equipment study facilitation is realized, alarm point position and the required equipment of prediction scheme for 119 systems that obtain is realized.

title_en: A kind of high resolution image disaster object fast partition method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of high resolution image disaster object fast partition method, it includes：S1：Obtain high resolution image；S2：The multiband Morphological Gradient of read high resolution image is calculated, multiband Morphological Gradient image is obtained；S3：Morphological reconstruction is carried out to multiband Morphological Gradient image, to obtain the gradient image after morphological reconstruction；S4：Gradient image is divided into four image blocks according to predetermined ratio；S5：The grey scale variance of each image block is calculated, judges whether the grey scale variance of each image block is more than predetermined threshold；S6：If greater than predetermined threshold, then corresponding image block is divided into four image blocks again according to predetermined ratio, and repeat step S5；Otherwise the gradient image after output is split；S7：Characteristic parameter according to disaster characteristic is characterized carries out Boundary Recognition extraction to the gradient image after segmentation, exports disaster object information.This method can improve Image Segmentation efficiency.

title_en: All Terrain Vehicles for Fire Suppression
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사륜 오토바이의 상부 전방영역과 후방영역에 화재를 진압할 수 있는 각종장비를 탑재하고, 아울러 소방차와 연결할 수 있는 장치를 탑재하여 산악지역과 고지대 인구밀집 지역에서 물을 외부로부터 공급받아 고압펌프에 의해 압력이 높아진 상태의 물을 화재현장에 집중적으로 투여토록 함으로서 초기에 화재를 진압토록 하는 것을 특징으로 하는 화재진압용 사륜 오토바이에 관한 것으로, 조향핸들 전면의 차체 상부에 브라켓을 통해 적어도 2개 탑재되는 축합식 분말 소화기와; 차체의 탑승자 좌석 후단에 설치되며 소방용 호스가 다수회 권취된 소방호스 릴과; 차체의 후방에 브라켓을 통해 고정되며 분사용 건을 장착하여 소방용 물을 외부로 분사시키기 위한 분사용 건 거치대와; 소방호스 릴로부터 출력되는 소방호스가 연결되고 다른 일측에 분사용 건의 입력측이 연결되며 고압의 펌핑작용으로 소방호스 릴로부터 전달되는 물을 분사용 건으로 이송시키는 고압펌프와; 사륜 오토바이로 절달되는 충격을 최대한 완화할 수 있도록 구동엔진에서 바퀴로 동력을 전달하는 추진축 상에 설치하는 충격완화장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of combination of true triaxial sound plus unloading test system based on Hopkinson pressure bar
abstract_en: The present invention realizes a kind of experimental provision to coal petrography sample coupled static-dynamic loadingi, the specifically related to a kind of combination of true triaxial sound plus unloading test system based on Hopkinson pressure bar, suitable for mine dynamic impact problem disaster formation research and experiment room simulation reconstruction, dynamic, the controllable and different sound combining form loading of coal petrography sample can be realized, simulate a variety of stress-wave loading modes of coal petrography material, the impact phenomenon of the reproducible live coal and rock of true triaxial characteristic of system.The main static load pressure apparatus, the dynamic load device of X-direction application dynamic loading and moment unloading falling device for applying dead load by three directions is constituted, it is mutually combined by axial sound device and confined pressure, study coal body and shaken the mechanism that the effect of iso-stress ripple induces impact failure by ore deposit, set up impulsion pressure generation model overall under the conditions of sound is carried, the force action of each influence factor is studied, impact is induced for ore deposit shake and preventing and treating provides theoretical foundation.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;CHANGCHUN RES INSTITUTE FOR MECHANISM SCIENCE CO LTD

title_en: The Time-frequency Spectrum Analysis method and system of earth natural pulses electromagnetic field data processing
abstract_en: The Time-frequency Spectrum Analysis method and system for the earth natural pulses electromagnetic field data processing that the present invention is provided, it is to be directed to earth natural pulses electromagnetic field (ENPEMF) signal before geological disaster and carries out time frequency analysis, using after improvement based on non-linear matches algorithm (NMP) reconstruct ENPEMF signals, the characteristics of reaching noise reduction, in conjunction with synchronous compression wavelet transformation (SST), the time-frequency characteristic of ground ENPEMF data is obtained, according to influence of the Variation Features of Time-frequency Spectrum Analysis earth natural pulses electromagnetic field data for prediction earthquake.The present invention uses NMP SST Time-Frequency Analysis Method datas, and the problem analysis of earth natural pulses electromagnetic field signal data is solved from method, to provide the theoretical foundation of indispensability from Algorithm Analysis angle Study of Seismic precursor information；The algorithm can also be applied to the multinomial research in other non-stationary signal fields, there is preferable market application foreground.

title_en: A kind of Information Security protection system and electric power application system data guard method based on asynchronous remote mirror image
abstract_en: System, including log pattern are protected the invention discloses a kind of Information Security based on asynchronous remote mirror image, the modification to local data is completed；Snapshot module, by cow mechanism, a snapshot is done to local data；Monitoring module, checks continually on whether main system has new data variation；Playback module, pulls daily record and the data of main system, and carrying out replay operations from system.A kind of electric power application system data guard method is additionally provided, is comprised the following steps：Monitoring module starts；Monitoring module finds that main system has data renewal, notifies playback module to carry out data syn-chronization；Playback module pulls newest log information, and is reset, and carries out metadata synchronous；The data in main system in snapshot are contrasted with from the data in system, carrying out data syn-chronization.A Remote Switched Port Analyzer is constructed to storage system, when primary data center is by artificial or natural disaster, data IO can be switched in mirror-image system immediately, so as to ensure the normal operation of operation system.

title_en: Biped robot for high-speed running
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biped robot for high-speed running. More specifically, the biped robot for high-speed running is provided as a biped robot capable of quickly transferring goods on various terrain in which the biped robot only presents as a lower half structure to reduce necessity about delicate control of motion, realizing a successive and large stride running motion from a single motor. An objective of the present invention is to provide the biped robot capable of high-speed running on various terrain. In order to quickly transfer relief goods or a critically ill patient over several obstacles in a natural disaster or a war situation, the biped robot for high-speed running with large stride realizes exactly a Gallimimus leg structure and running mechanism.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고속주행에 용이한 이족보행 로봇에 관한 것이다. 더욱 자세히는, 다양한 지형에서 물자를 빠른 속도로 운반할 수 있는 이족보행 로봇을 제공하되 동작의 섬세한 제어에 대한 필요성을 줄이기 위해 하반신 구조만 존재하도록 하고 단일 모터로부터 연속적인 큰 보폭의 주행 동작을 구현하는 고속주행용 이족보행 하반신 로봇에 관한 것이다. 본 발명을 통해 궁극적으로 해결하고자 하는 과제는 다양한 지형에서 고속주행이 가능한 이족로봇을 제공하는데에 있다. 자연재해, 혹은 전쟁 상황 속에서 여러 장애물을 넘어 신속하게 구호물품 혹은 위급환자를 운반하기 위해, 갈리미무스(Gallimimus)의 다리 구조와 주행 매커니즘을 그대로 재현하여 큰 폭으로 달리는 고속주행용 이족보행 하반신 로봇을 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: Portable embedded micro pressure tester
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the portable embedded micro pressure tester of one kind, including central processing unit, the input of central processing unit is electrically connected with battery and operation port, and the output end of central processing unit is electrically connected with positioning indicator and playback module, and the output end of playback module is electrically connected with interface；It also includes a sensor, the output end of the sensor is electrically connected with signal-conditioning unit, the output end of signal-conditioning unit is electrically connected with filtration module, the output end of filtration module is electrically connected with A/D converter and self adoptive trigger, and the output end of A/D converter and self adoptive trigger is electrically connected with the input of central processing unit；It also includes a memory, and the memory is connected with central processing unit.The utility model can be applied to firefighterses how effectively to prevent harm of the explosion wave to itself, can also provide engineering application value for the design of explosive place internal structure facility, apply also for cabin pressure measxurement in frontier defense marine police vessel.

title_en: A kind of monitoring device of driver's health
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of monitoring device of driver's health, including housing, battery is provided with housing, accumulator channel wire is sequentially connected single-chip microcomputer, A/D converter, display screen, relay and brain wave sensor and forms closed-loop path；Relay also connects EGC sensor parallel with one another, recording playback module and GPRS module by wire；Display location is in surface of shell；Single-chip microcomputer, A/D converter and relay are respectively positioned in housing.The utility model by using brain wave sensor and EGC sensor use, not only monitor health of the driver in driving, and traffic safety of the driver in emergency situations can be avoided, reduction that can be limited is because the security incident that the health of driver is produced, it is simple in construction, there is good use value.

title_en: A kind of snake-shaped robot of modular reconfigurable
abstract_en: A kind of snake-shaped robot of modular reconfigurable, it is related to a kind of snake-shaped robot.The present invention solves the problem of existing snake-shaped robot has small reverse backlash, driving force, controlling cycle length, control accuracy is poor, structure is not compact enough.The snake-shaped robot of restructural is joined end to end by a series of modularized joints and constituted, adjacent 90 ° of two modularized joint intervals arrangement, electrical connection is realized by spring stylus mode, the modularized joint realizes the rotary motion of simple joint by the way of driven by Brush-Less DC motor harmonic speed reducer, with structural module, configuration is compact, the advantages of load capacity is strong, the snake-shaped robot can be separated at adjacent segment in different operating environments, so as to be reconstructed into two or more snake-shaped robots, similarly, a snake-shaped robot can be reconfigurable into by two or more snake-shaped robots.The present invention is applied to the fields such as pipe detection, disaster relief, the planet surface exploration of aerospace.

title_en: Apparatus of electorical black box for analyzing cause of arc interruption
title_ko: 아크 차단원인 분석을 위한 블랙박스 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a black box apparatus. More specifically, the black box apparatus comprises: a control unit installed on a power line, and receiving data detected from a current transformer (CT) to detect a current, a zero current transformer (ZCT) to detect earth leakage, and a voltage detection unit to detect a voltage; and a cutoff unit receiving a signal from the control unit to operate a switch, thereby cutting off power. The control unit comprises: an operation unit to operate the data detected from the CT, the ZCT, and the voltage detection unit; a determination unit using a result of the operation unit to determine an arc; and a storage unit to store the data up to a predetermined time point before operation when the cutoff unit is operated to cut off the power. Thus, representation and cause analysis to prevent occurrence of an electronic fire are able to be correctly performed, and a momentarily generated unstable item of a power apparatus is able to be understood.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 블랙박스 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 전원 선로 상에 설치되며, 전류를 검출하는 CT, 누전을 검출하는 ZCT 및 전압을 검출하는 전압검출부로부터 검출된 데이터를 수신하는 제어부 및 상기 제어부로부터 신호를 전달받아 스위치를 작동시킴으로써 전원을 차단하는 차단부를 포함하되, 상기 제어부는, 상기 CT, ZCT 및 전압검출부로부터 검출된 데이터를 연산하는 연산부, 상기 연산부의 결과를 이용하여 아크 여부를 판단하는 판단부 및 상기 차단부가 작동하여 전원을 차단하는 경우, 그 작동 이전 미리 정해진 시점까지의 데이터를 저장하는 저장부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하여, 전기화재 발생을 예방하기 위한 재현과 원인 분석을 정확하게 할 수 있으며, 순간적으로 발생하는 전원장치의 불안정한 사항을 파악할 수 있는 아크 차단원인 분석을 위한 블랙박스 장치에 관한 것이다.
assignees: HAN SAN AMS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Seismic region debris flow volume weight calculation method based on debris flow solid particle size
abstract_en: the invention discloses an earthquake region debris flow volume weight calculation method based on debris flow solid particle size, which determines the channel longitudinal gradient J, debris flow depth h, channel gradient α and, debris flow solid particle volume weight gamma of a debris flow ditch through the means of field investigation, measurement, sampling, debris flow ditch characteristic parameter extraction and the like of a debris flow ditch in Wenchuan earthquake region s viscosity coefficient η of the slurry-rock fluid, particle diameter d of solid particles of the slurry-rock flow i (ii) a Compared with the prior art, the method is based on strict theoretical derivation, can reasonably and accurately reflect the mud-rock flow volume weight with low content of sticky particles in the Wenchuan earthquake region, provides a theoretical basis for the mud-rock flow prevention design in post-disaster reconstruction of the earthquake region, has high calculation result precision, and meets the actual engineering requirements.

title_en: A kind of earthquake region mud-rock flow unit weight computational methods based on mud-rock flow solid grain size
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of earthquake region mud-rock flow unit weight computational methods based on mud-rock flow solid grain size, this method passes through the means such as the field investigation of Wenchuan earthquake region debris flow gully, measurement, sampling and debris flow gully characteristic parameter extraction, determine the raceway groove longitudinal river slope J of debris flow gully, mud-rock flow flow depth h, fall of channel α, mud-rock flow solid particle unit weight γ s , the coefficient of viscosity η of mud-rock flow, mud-rock flow solid grain size d i ；Resulting parameter is substituted into calculation formula to obtain earthquake region mud-rock flow unit weight predicted value.Compared with prior art, the present invention rationally can accurately reflect the mud-rock flow unit weight of the low sticky content in Wenchuan earthquake region based on tight theory deduction, and theoretical foundation is provided for the debris flow design in the post-disaster reconstruction of earthquake region, computational solution precision is high, meets actual requirement of engineering.

title_en: Antivibrating bed stead and its bed body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Antivibrating bed stead and its bed body, the bed body includes cuboid framework, the cuboid framework includes structural column and support column, the structural column includes many vertical posts positioned at each angle of cuboid framework, the support column is provided with Damper Braces located at the plane where the upper top surface, bottom surface of cuboid framework, cuboid framework parallel to two opposite flanks of width.The Antivibrating bed stead includes the mattress of above-mentioned bed body and embedded with hydraulic bumper.Duration for being occurred according to earthquake disaster extremely short situation, daily usual bed is carried out the strengthening reconstruction of structure, creates the living space of safety, can hide temporarily when the personnel of taking refuge can not escape from time.
assignees: GUANGDONG ZHONGKE HUADA TEST CO LTD

title_en: A kind of data processing method of the remote scanning based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of data processing method of the remote scanning based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform, is that a kind of easily operated, measurement is accurate, unmanned plane remote scanning method rapidly and efficiently.The present invention is used as measuring table using unmanned plane, real-time correction-compensation is carried out to the data in measurement process and there is significant difference in data processing with prior art, data fusion method proposed by the invention not only solves the mobile problem of measuring table, also platform rotation, the vibration in measurement process are compensated, and solve the spacescan in long-range motion process.Abundant scanning result has important Practical significance for application fields such as the disaster scenes such as cave research, tunnel rescue, earthquake/fire reconstructions, and complete, accurate, abundant three-dimensional result has important application value.

title_en: A kind of code classification method based on neutral net language model
abstract_en: Belong to field of software engineering, disclose a kind of code classification method based on neutral net language model, be AST trees first by code conversion, initialize the node c of AST trees i Vector, utilize child's node t x Vector obtain n omicronn-leaf child node p k Reconstruct vector；Using AST_Node2Vec models to the node c i Vector be updated, if being unsatisfactory for cycling condition, continue cycling through；If meeting cycling condition, the reconstruct vector of the n omicronn-leaf child node after exporting the AST trees that have updated node vector and updating；Using the reconstruct vector of the n omicronn-leaf child node after have updated the AST trees of node vector and updating as the input of the convolutional neural networks based on tree, the classification to code is completed using the convolutional neural networks based on tree；Dimension disaster problem can effectively be avoided by carrying out classification to code using this method, while can show that similitude semantically, can be good at that code is classified according to functions.

title_en: CAE mechanical simulation method based on BIM information model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CAE mechanical simulation method based on a BIM information model, which comprises the steps of reconstructing a BIM building three-dimensional geometric model through a grid simplification system, and importing the simplified BIM three-dimensional model into a CAE mechanical simulation system; extracting data information in a BIM information model system, judging the attribute of the change information, transmitting data influencing the mechanical simulation to a CAE mechanical simulation system, and driving the CAE mechanical simulation system to update; and feeding back the mechanical information obtained by the updated CAE mechanical simulation model to the BIM information model, and displaying the calculated mechanical information from the BIM information model. When building designers design on the BIM by applying the method, the mechanical information can be referred to, the design efficiency is improved, in addition, the effective early warning can be carried out on the disasters caused by stress damage in the construction process in the later period, meanwhile, the repeated modeling is avoided, and the cost is saved.

title_en: A kind of electric automatization power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of electric automatization power distribution cabinet, including power distribution cabinet body, both sides at the top and bottom of the power distribution cabinet body are installed with L-shaped safe edge, roll-over protective structure is installed between the safe edge of power distribution cabinet body bottom, the roll-over protective structure inner chamber is provided with the table procedure controller being connected with power distribution cabinet body bottom；The air pump being arranged between safe edge is installed at the top of the power distribution cabinet body, pressure sensor is provided with the top of the air pump.The utility model is by setting appendix, escape pipe, air pump, safe edge, roller, spring leaf, bearing, motor, rotating shaft, air bag, gas outlet, connection sealing ring, spring leaf fixing band, table procedure controller and pressure sensor; can be when occurring earthquake; power distribution cabinet body is sealed; power distribution cabinet body is protected; avoid the electrical equipment inside power distribution cabinet body from being damaged, greatly reduce the cost at post-disaster reconstruction home.

title_en: A kind of remote sensing image landslide monomer division methods
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of remote sensing image landslide monomer division methods.This method includes：Based on the multispectral image data and dem data of survey region, carries out landslide extraction and obtain landslide object；NDVI standard deviation threshold methods are set, are merged obtained landslide object using blending algorithm；Making fused landslide object using the common boundary length threshold between landslide, further fusion obtains landslide trunk；And account for landslide perimeter percentage threshold using common boundary and landslide trunk is merged with surrounding landslide object, obtain landslide monomer.The landslide object that extraction obtains can be then divided into landslide monomer one by one by landslide monomer division methods according to the present invention, avoid the occurrence of unreasonable huge landslide areas.Particularly, rapid evaluation can be carried out to a wide range of landslide disaster caused by earthquake or heavy showers, obtains the area and quantity of landslide disaster, reference is provided for emergency management and rescue after calamity and restoration and reconstruction work.

title_en: Light line of water hose for firefighting
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a light line for a firefighting water pipe. The light line for a firefighting water pipe comprises: a firefighting water hose connected to a firefighting pump vehicle, or a fire hydrant or storage box of a building; a light line body having LED light-emitting chips installed therein at predetermined intervals to emit light, and having an LED light line hose to supply electricity to a positive (+) terminal ring and a negative (-) terminal ring; an LED lighting pipe having a plurality of LED lighting lamps to illuminate the front side; and a firefighter front transparent protector. According to the present invention, the light line for the firefighting water pipe can be easily and inexpensively implemented at an actual fire site, and can prevent a safety-related accident in advance.

title_en: Evacuation facilities for fire escape in high-rise buildings
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire evacuation facility for a high-rise building, which enables rapid evacuation from a fire site without moving to an upper or a lower floor, or to a next door when a fire breaks out in a high-rise building such as an apartment, a villa, a townhouse, a hotel, or a studio apartment. For the fire evacuation facility, one or two vertical rods (11) on the existing balustrade (10) installed in the balcony are formed to be detachable from a horizontal bar (12) for easy access of people, an anchor bolt (30) is fixed to the existing balustrade (10) and a concrete wall surface (20), and an evacuation facility (100) is installed in both one side end of the balustrade (10) and the concrete wall surface (20) at one side of the vertical rod (11) which is not directly interrupted by fire flames and smoke in case of fire. In addition, the evacuation facility (100) comprises: a solid frame (110) of which the upper part is open and four sides are formed of solid steel structures; a bottom plate (120) which is installed and fixed in the inner side of the lower part of the solid frame so that evacuated people cannot see under the bottom, has holes (121) for water flow and ventilation, and has an outdoor unit seating groove (122) at one side of the edge thereof in order to seat and fix an outdoor unit of an air-conditioner in an embedded type; a solar cell (130) which is installed and fixed in the round of a side surface of the solid frame (110) in order to generate electric power through photovoltaic power station; and a plurality of fixing bodies (140) which correspond to the anchor bolt (30) so that the solid frame (100) can be firmly fixed to the anchor bolt (30).

베란다에 설치된 기존 난간(10)의 세로봉(11) 1 내지 2개를 사람의 출입이 용이하도록 수평바(12)와 분리 및 결합 가능하도록 구성한 것과, 상기 기존 난간(10) 및 콘크리트 벽면(20)에 앵커볼트(30)를 고정시키는 것과, 상기 난간(10)의 일측 끝단 및 화재발생시 화염과 연기로부터 직접적인 간섭을 받지 않는 세로봉(11)일측의 콘크리트 벽면(20)에 의해 엄폐가 되도록 대피시설물(100)을 설치하되, 상기 대피시설물(100)은 상부가 개방되며 4면이 입체형의 철구조물로 구성되는 입체프레임(110)과, 상기 입체프레임의 하측 내부에 설치고정되어 사람들이 대피한 상태에서 아래가 보이지 않으면서 통수 및 통기가 가능하도록 타공(121)이 형성되며, 가장자리 일측으로 에어컨 실외기가 매립형으로 안착고정될 수 있도록 실외기 안착홈(122)이 형성된 바닥판(120)과, 상기 입체프레임(110)의 측면 둘레에 설치고정되어 태양광발전소를 통해 전기를 생산할 수 있도록 하는 태양광전지(130)와, 상기 앵커볼트(30)에 입체프레임(100)이 견고하게 고정될 수 있도록 앵커볼트(30)에 대응되는 다수 개의 고정체(140)를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Fire extinguisher usage sensing system and fire extinguisher usage sensing method using the same
title_ko: 소화기 사용 감지 시스템 및 이를 이용한 소화기 사용 감지 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fire extinguisher usage sensing system and a fire extinguisher usage sensing method using the same. The fire extinguisher usage sensing system of the present invention comprises: a sensing device sensing an operation of a fire extinguisher; a wireless router connecting a sensing device to communication network; and a server receiving a signal of the sensing device through the communication network, and automatically recording operation information of the fire extinguisher. According to the present invention, the fire extinguisher usage sensing system and the fire extinguisher usage sensing method using the same can reproduce a fire situation and a digestion activity in a similar manner of an actual situation, can accurately train a trainee of a usage method of the fire extinguisher in a reproduction process, and automatically sense, control, and record a fire extinguish training course in a remote area.
abstract_ko: 소화기 사용 감지 시스템 및 이를 이용한 소화기 사용 감지 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 소화기 사용 감지 시스템은, 소화기의 작동을 감지하는 감지장치; 감지장치를 통신망에 접속시키는 무선공유기; 및 통신망을 통해 감지장치의 신호를 수신하여 소화기의 작동정보를 자동으로 기록하는 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 화재상황 및 소화활동을 실제와 유사하게 재현할 수 있으며, 재현과정에서 훈련자에게 소화기의 사용방법을 정확히 숙지시킬 수 있고, 소화훈련과정이 원격지에서 자동으로 감지, 통제 및 기록되도록 이루어지는 소화기 사용 감지 시스템 및 이를 이용한 소화기 사용 감지 방법을 제공할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: A multipurpose drone for extinguishing fire and saving a life
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multipurpose unmanned aerial vehicle capable of extinguishing fire and saving a life, which is used to rapidly airdrop a plurality of lifesaving airbags and a plurality of grenades into a scene of an accident in time of emergency while freely flying and manually flying through remote controlling. The multipurpose unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an aerial vehicle control unit and a fluid injection unit. The aerial vehicle control unit has a plurality of rotors generating lifting force or thrust force required for vertical elevation of an aerial vehicle housing, has a plurality of grenade storage parts and airbag storage parts, which are formed inside the aerial vehicle housing to allow a plurality of grenades and airbags to be detachably received thereinto, respectively, and controls an operation of injecting a fluid into expandable tubes and the airbags while controlling free fight or manual flight of the aerial vehicle housing by driving the rotors. The fluid injection unit is installed inside the aerial vehicle housing and is controlled by the aerial vehicle control unit to inject compressed fluid into each of a plurality of expandable tubes and the plurality of air bags. The multipurpose unmanned aerial vehicle arrives at an accident occurring place, which has a difficulty to allow direct approaching of a firefighter or an ambulance worker in time of emergency, to selectively airdrop a plurality of airbags to a plurality of persons to be rescued and throwing a plurality of grenades filled with a fire extinguishing agent to a place where a fire accident occurs, thereby rapidly suppressing fire.

title_en: Compressed spectrum imaging system and imaging method based on RGB channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of compressed spectrum imaging system based on RGB channel, the spectrum picture for mainly solving existing aliasing coded sample reconstructs the problem of resolution ratio is low.It includes spectrum picture observation module (1) and image reconstruction process module (2), and spectrum picture observation module (1) includes：Beam splitter (11), for the incident beam of spectrum picture to be divided into the two-way light beam that information is identical, direction is different；Compressed spectrum observation submodule (12), for obtaining the observed image information after encoding；RGB observation submodules (13), the RGB observed images for obtaining spectrum picture；The image reconstruction process module (2), compressed encoding observation and RGB observed results that spectrum picture is observed to the spectrum picture of module output completed after simultaneous fusion the reconstruct of spectrum picture, obtain original spectrum image.Present invention reconstruct high resolution, is obtained available for the multispectral image in resource exploration, geological disaster detection and medical diagnosis.

title_en: Method for estimating natural drought index by computer
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 컴퓨터가 수행하는 자연가뭄지수 산정 방법은, 강수량, 토양수분량 및 유출량을 포함하는 자연가뭄변수의 상관관계를 분석하는 단계; 주성분 분석을 이용하여 상기 자연가뭄변수를 결합하는 단계; 및 경험적 누가확률값을 이용하여 자연가뭄지수를 산정하는 단계;를 포함하며, 상기 자연가뭄지수는 자연상태의 기상학적 가뭄상황, 수문학적 가뭄상황 및 농업적 가뭄상황을 종합적으로 반영할 수 있다. 본 발명에 따른 자연가뭄지수는 가뭄의 시작과 끝을 정확하게 재현하여 가뭄감시 및 대응에 유용하게 사용될 수 있고, 가뭄의 발생간격 및 지속기간을 적절하게 재현하여 가뭄대응을 위한 장기적인 대책수립에 활용될 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of power system rack reconstructing method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of power system rack reconstructing method and device, this method includes：Power system is tentatively recovered based on black starting-up unit and fired power generating unit are grid-connected, form rack reconfiguration system at initial stage；The historical data exerted oneself according to wind turbine, obtains and reconstructs moment corresponding wind turbine with rack and exert oneself in real time prediction data；Prediction data of being exerted oneself in real time based on wind turbine and rack reconfiguration system at initial stage, calculate the maximum of the line security risk conditions when recovering load maximum, and calculate the minimum value of the line security risk conditions when line condition venture worth is minimum；According to the maximum of the line security risk conditions and the minimum value of line security risk conditions, and rack at the initial stage reconfiguration system, the pre- structure model of next stage rack is built；Based on the pre- structure model of the rack, rationally pre- network forming frame is obtained.The embodiment of the present invention enables to wind turbine to participate in the power system recovery after large-scale blackout.

title_en: A kind of water-saturated state lower channel accumulation body destroys the Forecasting Methodology at angle
abstract_en: The invention discloses the Forecasting Methodology that a kind of water-saturated state lower channel accumulation body destroys angle, this method determines the deposit unit weight γ of debris flow gully by means such as the field investigation of earthquake region debris flow gully, measurement, sampling and debris flow gully characteristic parameter extractions S , deposit thickness h, deposit saturation internal friction angle θ, the porosity ε, any deposit thickness △ h, ditch bed gradient α of deposit；Resulting parameter is substituted into calculation formula to determine destruction angle of the raceway groove deposit of earthquake region mud-rock flow under water-saturated state.Compared with prior art, the present invention rationally can accurately be reflected destruction angle of the Wenchuan earthquake region mud-rock flow raceway groove deposit under rainfall water-saturated state, theoretical foundation is provided for the debris flow in the post-disaster reconstruction of earthquake region based on tight theory deduction, computational solution precision is high, meets actual requirement of engineering.

title_en: Autonomous driving railway drone for mobilization to the scene of the fire
title_ko: 철도 화재현장 출동을 위한 자율비행 방식의 무인비행체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an autonomous driving railway drone which comprises: a drone body (1) having a rotating blade (2) for flight; a fan head member (3) capable of being in contact with a train line (200) arranged in a railway tunnel; and an autonomous driving controller (4) controlling autonomous driving operation of the drone (100). Therefore, the drone can be quickly mobilized and inputted for rescue activity at the scene of a fire generated in a GPS shadow zone such as a railway tunnel or the like in which a position of the drone is not grasped.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 비행을 위한 회전날개(2)를 구비한 비행 본체(1)와, 철도터널 내에 배치된 전차선(200)에 닿을 수 있는 팬헤드 부재(3)와, 무인비행체(100)의 자율비행 작동을 제어하는 자율비행 제어기(4)를 포함하여 구성되어, 철도터널 등과 같이 GPS에 의한 무인비행체의 위치 파악이 불가능한 "GPS 음영 지역"에서 발생한 화재 현장에 구난활동(救難活動)을 위하여 신속하게 출동하여 투입될 수 있는 자율비행 방식의 무인비행체에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Energy -conserving portable multifunctional road guardrail
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy -conserving portable multifunctional road guardrail mainly relates to an energy -conserving road guardrail. Including adapter sleeve, head rod, second connecting rod, support frame, connection rope and base, be equipped with the light on the head rod, be equipped with solar cell panel on the second connecting rod, be equipped with pole groove, battery and photosensitive sensor in the base, the battery is connected with solar cell panel, battery and illumination lamp connection, battery switch and photosensitive sensor are connected, the base bottom surface is equipped with the universal wheel. The utility model has the advantages of can carry out the lane to the road as road guardrail, can regard as the street lamp again, road lighting is given to the time at night, and moreover through setting up photosensitive sensor, when dusk light was dark, photosensitive sensor can open by the control batteries switch after sensing the signal, opens the light and is used for for road lighting, in the reconstruction of disaster area, time of disaster area rescue and reconstruction has been shortened greatly.

title_en: A kind of special flowmeter of fire hydrant
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to fire-fighting domain, it is related specifically to a kind of special flowmeter of fire hydrant, connection is connected with the valve body of fire hydrant, including flow sensor 1, extension tube 2, integrator 3, the flow sensor is serially connected with the bottom of the valve body, one end of the extension tube is connected to the side of the flow sensor, and the integrator of its other end connection on the outside of the valve body, the inside of extension tube has the connecting line that signal connects the flow sensor and the integrator.The beneficial effects of the utility model are：For the intellectuality of common fire hydrant, either new clothes or Reconstruction in field, operation is all simple and easy, greatly reduces construction cost.

title_en: Meter and the bulk transmission grid searching method of component synthesis importance and Survivabilities of Networks
abstract_en: A kind of meter and the bulk transmission grid searching method of component synthesis importance and Survivabilities of Networks, including：On the basis of conventional electrical betweenness, economic factor, the index of structure evaluation branch road importance are introduced；According to nodes neighbors information and gather coefficient structure evaluation node importance index；Based on branch road and pitch point importance index, and network integrated invulnerability index is introduced, structure considers component importance and the bulk transmission grid mathematical modeling of Survivabilities of Networks；Implementation steps based on guiding fireworks algorithm to the model.Circuit importance index, pitch point importance index and Survivabilities of Networks index are combined by the present invention, construct the bulk transmission grid mathematical modeling for considering component synthesis importance and Survivabilities of Networks, model more can comprehensively assess the importance of circuit and node in power system, make every effort to obtain bulk transmission grid the most rational, be favorably improved the ability that power network resists power outage.The present invention is applied to the structure of power network bulk transmission grid and the reconstruction calculations of power network.

title_en: The method, apparatus and webmaster MANO systems of a kind of core net virtualization system shared disk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method of core net virtualization system shared disk, device and webmaster MANO systems, the present invention is by the way that all virtual machines are reconstructed, create the respective magnetic disc shares bus of virtual machine, all virtual machines are accessed into default virtual disk by the magnetic disc shares bus of its own again, so that different virtual machines shares the virtual disk, obtain the shared disk of core net virtualization system, so as to effectively prevent, easily there is data entanglement in data syn-chronization in cloud management system of the prior art or lock in time is inconsistent, caused by cloud management system disaster tolerance risk it is larger the problem of.

title_en: System, apparatus and method for providing service of an orally narrated fairy tale
title_ko: 구연동화 서비스 제공 시스템, 장치 및 구연동화 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fairytale storytelling service providing system and a fairytale storytelling service providing method. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the fairytale storytelling service includes: a first providing unit which provides an e-book list to be made into fairytale storytelling contents by a request from a user accessing a fairytale storytelling service providing site or a fairytale storytelling service providing application; a first reception unit which transmits a selected e-book to the user terminal in response to a selection signal for selecting one among e-books in the e-book list and receives voice recording signals of a user corresponding to the text included in pages of the e-book when the e-book is output to the user terminal; a synchronization processing unit for synchronizing and storing the voice recording signals of the user and images corresponding to the text in the e-book; and a generation unit generating a fairytale storytelling content playback list configuring the e-book and the voice recording signals of the user as a set; and a first transmission unit transmitting the voice recording signals and the images of the e-book to a fairytale storytelling content playback device to play the images and voice recording signals of the e-book in response to the selection of the fairytale storytelling content when receiving a fairytale storytelling selecting signal from a user for selecting the fairytale storytelling content in the fairytale storytelling content playback list.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구연동화 서비스 제공 시스템 및 구연동화 서비스 제공 방법 에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 구연동화 서비스 제공 시스템은, 구연동화 서비스 제공 어플리케이션 또는 구연동화 서비스 제공 사이트에 접속한 사용자의 요청에 의해 구연동화로 제작할 전자책 리스트를 사용자 단말기에 제공하는 제1 제공부와, 전자책 리스트 중 어느 한 전자책 선택 신호에 대응하여, 선택한 전자책을 사용자 단말기로 전송하고, 사용자 단말기에 전자책이 출력되면 전자책의 페이지에 포함되는 지문에 대응하는 사용자의 음성 녹음 신호를 수신하는 제1 수신부와, 전자책의 지문에 대응하는 이미지 및 사용자의 음성 녹음 신호를 동기화하여 저장하는 동기화 처리부와, 전자책 및 사용자의 음성 녹음 신호를 하나의 세트로 구성한 구연동화 재생 리스트를 생성하는 생성부; 및 구연동화 재생 리스트 상에서 사용자에 의한 어느 한 구연동화 선택신호를 수신하면, 선택한 구연동화에 대응하여 전자책의 이미지 및 음성 녹음 신호가 동시에 재생되도록 전자책의 이미지 및 음성 녹음 신호를 구연동화 재생장치에 전송하는 제1 전송부를 포함한다.

title_en: electronic socket of supporting media playback
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic socket for supporting media reproduction, which includes safety functions for preventing electric shock, reducing standby power and preventing fire, and also includes a media reproduction function during a charging process. The electronic socket for supporting media reproduction comprises: a safety socket unit; a wired/wireless charging unit; a media reproduction unit; and a controlling unit. The safety socket unit includes a blocking switch for blocking input power at a time of on-operation; and turns on the blocking switch when at least one among a current value, a voltage value, a resistance value, a resonance value, and a frequency measured in an output end of the blocking switch is sensed within a range of a value corresponding to one among a human body touch state, a conductor touch state, a standby power state, and an overload state. The wired/wireless charging unit charges a wired or wireless connected terminal by using the input power. The media reproduction unit reproduces a wired or wireless received media file from the terminal, or a stored media file. The controlling unit controls operations of the safety socket unit, the charging unit, and the media reproduction unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 감전 방지, 대기전력 저감 및 화재 방지를 위한 안전기능을 가지면서 충전 중 미디어 재생 기능도 가지는 미디어 재생을 지원하는 전자식 콘센트에 관한 것으로, 온 동작 시에 입력 전원을 차단하는 차단 스위치를 구비하며, 상기 차단 스위치의 출력단에서 측정된 전류 값과 전압 값과 저항 값과 공진 값과 주파수 중 적어도 하나가 인체 접촉 상태와 전도체 접촉 상태와 대기전력 상태와 과부하 상태 중 어느 하나에 해당하는 값의 범위로 감지됨에 따라 상기 차단 스위치를 온 동작시키는 안전 콘센트부와, 상기 입력 전원을 사용하여 유선 또는 무선으로 연결된 단말기를 충전하는 유무선 충전부와, 상기 단말기로부터 유선 또는 무선으로 수신한 미디어파일이나 미리 저장된 미디어파일을 재생하는 미디어재생부와, 상기 안전 콘센트부와 상기 충전부와 상기 미디어재생부의 동작을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성되는 것이 특징인 발명이다.

title_en: Robot mobility test system with collapse simulation
title_ko: 붕괴 상황을 모사한 로봇 주행 시험 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot mobility test system with a collapse simulation. According to the present invention, the robot mobility test system with a collapse simulation comprises: a plurality of sensor modules installed along a plurality of sections of a track sensing a robot moving on the track; a falling module installed in a set point of the track, dropping a falling object based on a control signal; and a control module calculating a time point on which the robot reaches the set point using a position or speed of the robot obtained from the sensing information of the sensor module, and transmitting the control signal generated based on an arrival time to the falling module. The robot mobility test system with a collapse simulation in accordance with the present invention is able to objectively and quantitatively reproduce a collision and avoidance situation with a falling object occurring in a collapse disaster site by dropping the falling object, which simulates an actual collapse situation, to the moving robot; and is able to be utilized to evaluate a performance of a disaster robot.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 붕괴 상황을 모사한 로봇 주행 시험 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 트랙의 복수의 구간을 따라 각각 설치되며 상기 트랙을 주행하는 로봇을 감지하는 복수의 센서 모듈과, 상기 트랙의 설정 지점에 설치되며 제어 신호를 기초로 낙하물을 하강시키는 낙하 모듈, 및 상기 센서 모듈의 감지 정보로부터 획득되는 로봇의 위치 또는 속도를 이용하여 상기 로봇이 상기 설정 지점에 도달하는 시점을 연산하며 상기 도달 시점을 기초로 생성한 상기 제어 신호를 상기 낙하 모듈로 전송하는 제어 모듈을 포함하는 붕괴 상황을 모사한 로봇 주행 시험 시스템을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따른 붕괴 상황을 모사한 로봇 주행 시험 시스템에 따르면, 실제 붕괴 상황을 모사한 낙하물을 주행 중인 로봇을 향해 낙하시켜 붕괴 재난 현장에서 발생하는 낙하물과의 충돌 및 회피 상황을 객관적이고 정량적으로 재현할 수 있으며 재난 로봇의 성능 평가에 활용될 수 있는 이점이 있다.

title_en: The apparatus for hydrogen fire testing due to electrostatic ignition in plant facility
title_ko: 플랜트 시설 내에서 정전기에 의한 수소화재 시험장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for testing of a hydrogen fire caused by static electricity in a plant facility. The apparatus comprises: a test chamber (100) in a plant facility; a hydrogen storage device (220); a hydrogen supply pipe (210), one end of which is connected to the hydrogen storage device (220) and the other end is positioned on one side in the test chamber (100) and is connected to a hydrogen supply nozzle unit (200) discharging hydrogen gas, and which supplies the hydrogen gas in the hydrogen storage device (220) into the test chamber (100); a charging unit (300) which is made of a non-conductor, is separated from the hydrogen supply nozzle unit (200) at a predetermined distance, and blocks an inner cross section of the test chamber (100) such that the hydrogen gas is distributed to only one side of the test chamber (100); a static electricity generator (400) which comes in contact with one surface of the charging unit (300) directed to the hydrogen supply nozzle unit (200) and accumulates static electricity; a ground unit (410) which is made of a conductor, and is positioned to be separated vertically upwards from the hydrogen supply nozzle unit (200) at a predetermined distance; an additional ground unit (420) which is made of a conductor, and is disposed between the ground unit (410) and the hydrogen supply nozzle unit (200); a static electricity measurement device (110) which measures the amount of static electricity of the charging unit (300) horizontally corresponding to the hydrogen supply nozzle unit (200), the ground unit (410), and the additional ground unit (420); and a thermal image camera (120) which checks whether a hydrogen fire occurs by static electricity. Accordingly, it is possible to check whether a hydrogen fire occurs in accordance with the flow rate of hydrogen gas or the concentration of hydrogen gas and the amount of static electricity, and it is possible to reproduce an actual hydrogen fire site.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 플랜트 시설 내에서 정전기에 의한 수소화재 시험장치에 관한 것으로, 플랜트 시설 내의 시험챔버(100); 수소저장장치(220); 일단은 상기 수소저장장치(220)와 연결되고, 타단은 상기 시험챔버(100) 내부의 일측에 위치하여 수소가스를 배출하는 수소공급노즐부(200)과 연결되어, 상기 수소저장장치(220)의 수소가스를 상기 시험챔버(100) 내부로 공급하는 수소공급배관(210); 상기 수소공급노즐부(200)와 일정간격 이격되며, 수소가스가 상기 시험챔버(100)의 일측에만 분포하도록 상기 시험챔버(100) 내부 단면을 막는 부도체 재질인 대전부(300); 상기 수소공급노즐부(200)를 향하는 상기 대전부(300)의 일면에 접촉되어 정전기를 축적시키는 정전기발생기(400); 상기 수소공급노즐부(200)에서 수직 상부로 일정간격 이격되어 위치한 도체 재질인 접지부(410); 상기 접지부(410)와 상기 수소공급노즐부(200) 사이에 배치되는 도체 재질인 추가접지부(420); 상기 수소공급노즐부(200), 접지부(410) 및 상기 추가접지부(420)에 수평하게 대응되는 상기 대전부(300)의 정전기량을 측정하는 정전기량 측정기(110); 정전기에 의해 수소화재가 발생하는지 여부를 확인하는 열화상카메라(120);를 포함하여, 수소가스의 유량 또는 수소가스의 농도와 정전기량에 따라 수소화재가 발생하는지 여부를 확인하고, 실재 수소화재 현장을 재현할 수 있다.

title_en: Complaints handling system using CCTV
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a civil complaint handling system using a CCTV and, more specifically, relates to a civil complaint handling system using a CCTV, capable of easily identifying a spot, which requires the addition of CCTV, by making data of received civil complaints. To achieve the purpose, the present invention includes: a plurality of CCTV (11) installed at an entrance of a building, at an entrance of a parking lot, and in a parking lot; an image photographing unit recording an image and a sound, including a black box in a vehicle and a smartphone of a general person; a civil complaint receiving part analyzing civil complaint content and classifying the content into detail items such as position, date, time, and situation; an image editing part editing a playback time for an image about a civil complaint passed by a civil complaint verification part; an image supply part storing a final file in a streaming server and a backup server; and a survey part examining the satisfaction of a corresponding civil complaint raiser about a handling procedure for the civil complaint after the deletion of the final file in the streaming server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 CCTV를 이용한 민원처리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 각 지자체별로 운영하고 있는 CCTV 통합센터에서 특정위치에서 발생한 사건 및 사고접수와 관련된 영상을 사건 및 사고와 관련된 민원인에게 제공함으로써 접수부터 해결까지 소요되는 시간을 단축할 수 있고, 접수된 민원 내용을 데이터화하여 CCTV 의 확충이 필요한 위치 등을 쉽게 파악할 수 있도록 한 CCTV를 이용한 민원처리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은, 도로의 교차로, 지주 등과 같은 도로시설물, 건물의 내부 및 외부 벽면, 건물의 입구, 주차장의 출입구, 주차장의 내부 등에 설치된 복수의 CCTV(11)와, 일반인이 소지한 스마트폰 및 차량내에 설치된 블랙박스 등을 포함한 영상 및 소리를 녹화하는 영상촬영수단과, 상기 영상촬영수단을 통해 촬영된 후 전송된 영상을 저장하고 관리하되, 등록된 관리자만이 상기 영상을 저장하고 관리할 수 있도록 하는 중앙관제실 및 민원인이 신청한 민원 내용을 분석하여 위치, 날짜, 시간, 상황 등의 세부항목으로 정리하는 민원접수부와, 상기 민원접수부를 통해 전달된 민원의 세부항목이 상기 영상촬영수단에서 녹화된 영상의 해당 위치, 날짜, 시간에 촬영된 영상이 일치하는지를 검증하는 민원검증부와, 상기 민원검증부를 통과한 민원과 관련된 촬영 영상의 재생 시간을 편집하는 영상편집부와, 촬영 영상에서 해당 민원과 관련 없는 부분을 모자이크 처리하는 정보보호처리부와, 상기 정보보호처리부를 통과한 촬영 영상을 재확인하여 모자이크 처리가 필요한 부분에 처리되지 않은 부분이 있는지를 확인하는 영상검증부와, 상기 영상검증부를 통과한 최종파일을 스트리밍서버와 백업서버에 저장하는 영상공급부 및 민원인에게 제공된 최종파일이 상기 스트리밍서버에서 삭제된 후 민원을 접수한 민원인에게 해당 민원의 처리과정에 대한 만족도를 조사하는 설문조사부를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: The informaton collection system by using drone
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an information collection system using a drone and, more specifically, relates to the information collection system using a drone to collect information by throwing a sensor for collecting data by using a drone. The information collection system using a drone according to the present invention comprises: a sensor means; and a drone. The sensor means includes a sensor which collects data, and a transmission unit which transmits the data connected by the sensor. The drone includes a throwing unit which holds and throws the sensor means, and a transmission and reception unit which receives the data transmitted from the transmission unit, and transmits the received data. In addition, it is preferable that the sensor means further includes a speaker unit which receives voice from a microphone and emits the voice. According to the present invention, the drone can rapidly arrive at a fire site or a disaster site. Therefore, the drone can be rapidly dispatched even to a disaster site to which humans have difficulty approaching, and can arrive at the disaster site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드론을 활용한 정보수집 시스템에 대한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 드론을 사용하여 데이터를 수집하는 센서를 투척하여 정보를 수집할 수 있는 드론을 활용한 정보수집 시스템에 대한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 드론을 활용한 정보수집 시스템은 센서수단과, 드론을 포함한다. 상기 센서수단은 데이터를 수집하는 센서와, 상기 센서에서 수집된 데이터를 송신하는 송신부를 구비한다. 상기 드론은 상기 센서수단을 파지하여 투척하는 투척부와, 상기 송신부에서 송신된 데이터를 수신하고 수신된 데이터를 송신하는 송수신부를 구비한다. 
또한, 상기의 정보수집 시스템에 있어서, 상기 센서수단은 마이크로부터 음성을 수신받아서 방출하는 스피커부를 더 구비하는 것이 바람직하다. 
본 발명에 의하면 드론은 화재현장이나 재난 현장에 신속히 도착할 수 있다. 그래서 사람이 접근하기 어려운 재난 현장에도 신속히 출동하여 재난 현장에 도착할 수 있다.

title_en: Estimation Method of Radioactivity
abstract_en: Provided is a method for estimating radioactivity. The method for estimating radioactivity comprises the steps of: obtaining list-mode data where position coordinates and energy values when radiation generated by a radiation source is incident to a radiation measuring instrument and Compton scattering occurs, and position coordinates and energy values when photoelectric absorption occurs after scattering are listed; obtaining three-dimensional position coordinates having a point cloud shape with regard to information on topography or a surface of a structure around the radiation source to set an image space; performing a list-mode maximum likelihood expectation maximization (LMMLEM)-based algorithm with regard to the image space, where projection and back-projection of the list-mode data are repeatedly operated to reconstruct an image of the radiation source, wherein the algorithm includes a system matrix having an element of probability that the radiation is incident to the radiation measuring instrument in each point of the image space. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a method for estimating radioactivity, where a position and intensity of radiation can be estimated in a single fixed position.
abstract_ko: 방사능의 추정 방법이 제공된다. 방사능의 추정 방법은 방사선원에서 발생된 방사선이 방사선 계측기에 입사하여 콤프턴(Compton) 산란되는 위치 좌표 및 에너지 값과, 산란된 후 상기 방사선 계측기에 광전 흡수되는 위치 좌표 및 에너지 값을 나열한 리스트 모드(list-mode) 데이터를 획득하는 단계, 상기 방사선원 주변의 지형 또는 구조물의 표면 정보에 대해 점 구름 형태의 3차원 위치 좌표를 획득하여 영상 공간으로 설정하는 단계 및 상기 영상 공간에 대해, 상기 리스트 모드 데이터로 투사 과정과 역투사 과정을 반복 연산하는, 리스트 모드 최대 우도 기대 값 최대화(list-mode maximum likelihood expectation maximization, LMMLEM) 기반의 알고리즘을 수행하여 상기 방사선원의 영상을 재구성하는 단계를 포함하되, 상기 알고리즘은, 상기 영상 공간의 각 지점에서 상기 방사선 계측기로 상기 방사선이 입사될 확률을 원소로 하는 시스템 행렬을 포함한다.

title_en: Fire extinguisher for training of virtual reality
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, the present invention relates to a fire extinguisher for training in virtual reality, allowing a user to experience a method of using the fire extinguisher to put out fire by extinguishment. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the fire extinguisher for training in virtual reality can be used by the following steps: the user finds out the fire extinguisher when virtual fire takes place in virtual reality; the user moves with the fire extinguisher; and the user positions a nozzle toward the fire. It is possible to create indoor fire extinguishing situation similar to reality.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 가상현실의 훈련용 소화기는, 소화를 이용하여 화재를 진압하도록 소화기의 사용법을 체험할 수 있도록 하는 가상현실의 훈련용 소화기에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 가상현실의 훈련용 소화기는, 가상현실 내에서 가상의 화재를 발생시키면, 체험자는 소화기를 찾고, 그 소화기를 들고 이동하며, 노즐을 화염을 향하여 조준하도록 하는 과정을 포함하도록 함으로써, 실제 화재 진압 상황을 좀 더 현실감 있게 재현할 수 있다.

title_en: Railcar liquid crystal display device failure cruising inspection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of railcar liquid crystal display device failure cruising inspection system, it includes system architecture module, user passes through internent access system by mobile phone, flat board, computer, www application server is accessed in system service side through fire wall, and database server is terminated after application server；Technical Architecture module, bottom is non-relational database layer, for the relation data for storing the system, non-relation data；Last layer is that WEB Server are engaged in layer again, and WEB back-end services etc. are write in this layer of use nodejs technologies of increasing income.The present invention improves the routing inspection efficiency of railcar LCD video playback apparatus and the accuracy of record, improves the feedback and Statistical Speed of inspection information, improves transmission promptness, convenience, the accuracy of device fault information.

title_en: Methods and systems for generating time-synchronized audio messages of different content in a talkgroup
abstract_en: Methods and systems for generating time-synchronized audio messages of different content in a talkgroup. One system includes an electronic computing device that includes an electronic processor configured to generate first public safety incident information as a function of context information of a first member of a talkgroup, and second public safety incident information as a function of context information of a second member of the talkgroup. The second public safety incident information is different than the first public safety incident information. The electronic processor is further configured to generate a first audio message including the first public safety incident information sized according to a time window and a second audio message including the second public safety incident information sized according to the time window such that a playback time of the first audio message is approximately the same as a playback time of the second audio message.

title_en: A kind of earthquake building recognition method based on multidate radar image texture feature
abstract_en: The invention belongs to SAR image identification technology field, more particularly to a kind of earthquake building recognition method based on multidate radar image texture feature.Earthquake building recognition method based on multidate radar image texture feature, it comprises the following steps：A. title_en: Method for reconstructing gas geological tracing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for reconstructing geological gas source tracing, and belongs to the field of geological exploration. The method comprises three parts: the coal-forming environment and a three-dimensional space model thereof are restored through three-dimensional reconstruction, and basic conditions of gas formation and storage, coal body primary structure and physical and mechanical properties of storage are recognized; and combining the tectonic evolution of the coal measure strata with the associated methane gas accumulation rule by the geologic body tectonic evolution and the reconstruction of the historical gas generation, storage and dispersion processes, inverting the coal bed accumulation time-space change and the historical gas generation, storage and dispersion processes, and establishing a dynamic gas geological model. And carrying out numerical simulation and similar simulation experiments on quantitative reconstruction of the gas geological vestige characteristics, respectively establishing different gas geological vestige characteristics and gas correlation models, and matching typical geological vestige and coal bed gas occurrence rules. The method can analyze the process from generation to later-stage reformation of the coal bed gas, thereby being suitable for various geological conditions to disclose the gas reservoir process and the disaster-causing mechanism and guide the safe production and the development of the coal bed gas.

title_en: Power distribution network neutral point grounding type transformation method based on interval number theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformation method of a neutral point grounding mode of a power distribution network based on an interval number theory, which comprises the following steps: 1. reading relevant information of all distribution lines in a power supply area; 2. respectively calculating the tripping rate of the distribution line when a single-phase ground fault occurs under two modes of grounding of a neutral point of the distribution network through an arc suppression coil and grounding through a small resistor; 3. generating the number of intervals of single-phase earth faults of each distribution line based on three factors of external force damage, natural disasters and equipment faults; 4. establishing a full life cycle cost-saving model of a power distribution network neutral point grounding mode reconstruction project; 5. and solving the model to determine the specific grounding mode and the transformation sequence of the neutral points to be transformed in the power distribution network. The method can avoid the defects of the existing neutral point grounding reconstruction decision method, meets the requirement of safe and reliable operation of the power distribution network, and simultaneously maximizes the cost saving in the whole life cycle of the neutral point grounding reconstruction of the power distribution network.

title_en: Fire Forensic Report System
abstract_en: The present technology relates to a fire investigation result reporting system. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a report can be conveniently written and drafted by using a mobile device in a fire site requiring a quick initial report and an on-site approval is possible. A cause analysis and a preventive measure for a fire can be efficiently set by integrally managing a site investigation report based on a cloud environment. The fire investigation result reporting system according to the present invention includes a report writing unit for writing a fire investigation report, a fire investigation information input unit, a cloud database unit for storing the fire investigation report written by the report writing unit, a report approving unit for receiving and checking a result through the cloud database unit, a report searching unit for selectively outputting item information, and a report sharing unit for sharing the fire investigation report stored in the cloud database unit.

title_en: Indoor track reconstruction method and system integrating IMU and vision sensor
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an indoor high-precision track reconstruction method fusing an IMU and a vision sensor, which comprises the following steps: receiving real-time acquisition data sent by an IMU; predicting and optimizing the motion trail of the pedestrian according to the real-time collected data; receiving indoor environment information acquired by a visual sensor; and positioning and correcting the motion trail of the pedestrian according to the indoor environment information and the real-time collected data, and reconstructing to obtain the final motion trail of the pedestrian. The embodiment of the invention also provides an indoor high-precision track reconstruction system integrating the IMU and the vision sensor. The invention is suitable for key problems of fire-fighting emergency in complex environment, emergency rescue in emergency, self-positioning in unknown environment, target finding and the like, wherein the position of the target can not be predicted.

title_en: Method for managing traffic accident
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for handling a traffic accident, capable of completely substituting an existing field investigation method in which a professional traffic accident investigator goes to a field and investigates a traffic accident, with an online method for handling a traffic accident. The present invention also provides a user-centered system for handling a traffic accident, capable of enabling even ordinary people to handle the traffic accident only by following instructions of an application after executing the application of a mobile terminal.
