The system for handling a traffic accident collects a field investigation result formed by a police/ insurance company investigator terminal (20) and traffic accident information on the accident field by a traffic accident witness (10′), a passenger terminal (10), or a driver terminal (10) in the accident field in which the traffic accident occurs. The system for handling a traffic accident also transmits the information collected to an integrated control center (70). After the system for handling a traffic accident forms significant event information by integrating vehicle driving information, the field investigation result, and information on a device attached to a vehicle, the event information is transmitted to a mobile terminal (60) by a communication module. The event information is reintegrated with the information collected by the terminal by an application of the mobile terminal (60). The application of the mobile terminal induces collection of a traffic accident record so that the information collected by the terminal by the application of the mobile terminal (60) includes detailed information capable of restructuring the traffic accident, such as the cause of the traffic accident, information about who is responsible, injury, and extent of damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 기존의 교통사고 조사 전문가가 현장에 출동하여 조사하는 현장조사 방식을 완전 대체가능한, 사고처리를 온전히 온라인으로 대체할 수 있도록 하는 교통사고 처리 방법을 제공하며, 일반인들이라도, 모바일 단말기의 어플을 실행시키고 나서 어플에서 지시하는 대로만 따라하기만 하면 교통사고 처리가 가능한 유저 중심의 교통사고 처리 시스템을 제공하는 것으로, 교통사고가 발생한 사고 현장의 운전자나 탑승자 단말(10)이나 현장의 교통사고 목격자(10')의 사고 현장의 교통사고 정보 및 경찰/보험사 조사요원 단말(20)에 의한 현장조사 결과물이 차량에 부착된 장치의 정보와 함께 모바일 단말(60)을 통해 수집되어지고, 이러한 수집된 정보가 통합관제센터(70)로 전송되어지는 교통사고 처리 시스템으로서, 차량운행 정보, 현장조사 결과물 및 차량에 부착된 장치의 정보가 함께 통합됨으로써 의미있는 이벤트 정보를 형성된 후, 통신모듈을 통해 모바일 단말(60)로 전송되어지고, 모바일 단말(60)의 어플에 의해 단말 자체에 의해 수집된 정보와 재통합되며, 모바일 단말(60)의 어플에 의해 단말 자체에 의해 수집되는 정보는, 교통사고의 원인과 책임 소재, 그리고 부상의 정도와 피해 규모 등, 교통사고의 재구성이 가능할 정도의 상세한 정보를 포함하도록, 모바일 단말의 어플이 교통 사고 기록의 수집을 유도하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Urban fire simulation apparatus and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a city fire simulation device. The city fire simulation device comprises: a modeling control unit reproducing a building of an area to be simulated by including a location information collection module collecting the location of the area to be simulated, an information input module inputting building information of the area, and a data output module modeling the collected location information and inputted building information and converting the same into data; a simulation control unit reproducing the occurrence of fire in the simulated building by including a data input module inputting a local building structure modeled by the modeling control unit and inputting a fire occurrence calculation condition, a simulation reproducing module reproducing the fire simulation in the building structure of the input area, and a data output module outputting data based on the reproduced simulation result; and a storage unit storing overall data necessary for the modeling control unit and the simulation control unit. According to the present invention, human injury and property damage caused by fire can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도시 화재 시뮬레이션 장치에 관한 것으로, 구현할 지역의 위치를 수집하는 위치정보 수집모듈, 상기 지역의 건물 정보를 입력하는 정보 입력모듈, 및 상기 수집된 위치정보와 입력된 건물정보를 모델링하여 데이터화 시키는 데이터 출력모듈을 포함하여 구현할 지역의 건축물을 재현하는 모델링 제어부; 상기 모델링 제어부에서 모델링한 지역 건축 구조를 입력하고, 화재발생 계산 조건을 입력하는 데이터 입력모듈, 상기 입력된 지역의 건축 구조에 화재 시뮬레이션을 재현하는 시뮬레이션 재현 모듈, 및 상기 재현된 시뮬레이션 결과를 토대로 데이터를 출력하는 데이터 출력모듈을 포함하여 재현된 건축물에 화재 발생을 재현하는 시뮬레이션 제어부; 및 상기 모델링 제어부 및 상기 시뮬레이션 제어부에 필요한 전반적인 데이터를 저장하고 있는 저장부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of fire telephone call simulated training system
abstract_en: The utility model proposes a kind of fire telephone call simulated training systems, including main frame, speech input device and the display shell and installation on the shell, speech input device includes microphone, telephone key-press and the signal gathering unit for converting a signal into ASCII character, and microphone and display are connected respectively with main frame；Telephone key-press is connected with signal gathering unit, and signal gathering unit is communicated by serial line interface with main frame；Voice recognition unit, scoring unit and video playback unit are installed, voice recognition unit is used to identify the voice signal that speech input device is sent, and recognition result is sent to scoring unit and is scored on main frame.The utility model can realize the simulated training that people are carried out with fire telephone call, and the fire safety for improving people is realized, and the processing procedure that people are further appreciated that and grasped with fire accident has positive meaning.

title_en: Experimental apparatus for wall roughness generation in mock-up tunnel
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an experimental apparatus for generating wall roughness in a mock-up tunnel. More particularly, the present invention includes: a roughness reproducing plate having a plate shape and provided at one end surface thereof with a wall roughness equivalent configuration for simulating wall roughness in an actual tunnel; a roughness reproducing plate holder for pressing and fixing both surfaces at an opposite end portions of the roughness reproducing plate; a holder rotation shaft bar having a circular rod shape, having a length longer than lengths of both sides of the roughness reproducing plate holder, and fixed to an opposite side of the roughness reproducing plate holder while being parallel with the roughness reproducing plate; an upper fixing frame having a table shape which has four supporting legs without a top plate and a connection part for connecting the supporting legs, in which two rotation shaft supporting plates having rotation shaft holes are disposed between the supporting legs so as to face each other; a lower fixing frame having a plate shape and disposed under the upper fixing frame, in which the supporting legs are fixed to the lower fixing frame; and a tunnel mock-up bottom fixing support allowing a wall in a mock-up tunnel to be directed upward, and fixed to an upper surface of the lower fixing frame. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a tunnel ventilation/disaster prevention experiment with a mock-up including a wall roughness effect is performed by forming the wall roughness, which is quantitatively simulated by using a simple mechanism, in the mock-up tunnel.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모형 터널내 벽면조도 생성 실험장치에 대한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 본 발명은 판형이며 실제터널내 벽면 조도를 모사한 벽면조도등가형상이 일측 끝단면에 형성된 조도재현판; 상기 조도재현판의 타측 끝부분 양면을 압착하여 고정하는 조도재현판홀더; 원형봉형상이며 상기  조도재현판홀더 의 양측길이보다 더 길고, 상기  조도재현판홀더 의 타측에, 상기 조도재현판과 나란하게 고정되는 홀더회전축막대; 네 개의 지지다리를 상기 지지다리 사이를 연결하는 연결부를 갖고 상판이 없는 테이블 형상이며, 회전축구멍이 형성된 두 개의 회전축지지판이 서로 마주보도록 상기 지지다리 사이에 배치되는 상부고정프레임; 판형이며 상기 상부고정프레임 하부에 배치되되 상기 지지다리가 고정되는 하부고정프레임; 및 상기 모형터널내 벽면이 위를 향하도록 거치되고 상기 하부고정프레임의 상면에 고정되는  터널모형하부고정지지대 를 포함하며, 상기 조도재현판과 상기 홀더회전축막대는 상기 조도재현판홀더에 고정되고, 상기 홀더회전축막대의 길이방향 양측 끝부분은 상기 회전축구멍에 삽입되어 상기 회전축지지판에 걸침되고, 상기 모형터널이 상기 터널모형하부고정지지대에 거치되어 상기 하부고정프레임의 상면에 고정되되 상기 상부고정프레임의 상기 지지다리가 형성하는 공간내부에 배치되어 상기 조도재현판의 상기 벽면조도등가형상이 형성된 일측 끝단면이 상기 모형터널내 벽면에 인접하고 상기 홀더회전축막대의 중십축의 연직 하방에 상기 모형터널의 중심축이 위치하며 상기 홀더회전축막대가 회전함에 따라서 상기 조도재현판이 회전할 때 상기 벽면조도등가형상과 상기 모형터널내 벽면의 이격거리가 동일하도록 배치되어, 상기 모형터널내 벽면에 벽면조도를 생성하기 위한 도포재를 도포하고, 상기 홀더회전축막대를 회전하여 상기 벽면조도등가형상이 상기 모형터널내 벽면에 벽면조도가 생성되도록 하는 벽면 모형터널내 벽면조도 생성 실험장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: After action review apparatus for rescue simulation and control method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an after action review apparatus for rescue simulation which is formed to enable users to have after action review on rescue training based on a virtual training environment that reproduces accident scenes, thereby improving the ability to cope with disaster situations through the close analysis on the rescue training using the after action review. The present invention also relates to an operation method of the after action review apparatus for rescue simulation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사고현장을 재현한 가상의 훈련환경을 기반으로 진행된 구조훈련에 대해서 사후 강평이 가능하도록 구현함으로써, 사후 강평을 통해 구조훈련에 대한 면밀 분석이 가능해지므로 재난 상황 대처 능력을 제고시킬 수 있다. 구조훈련강평장치 및 그 동작 방법을 제안한다.

title_en: Apparatus for marine rescue simulation and control method thereof
abstract_en: Suggested are an apparatus for marine rescue simulation and an operation method thereof, which provide a 3D-based virtual training environment capable of reproducing marine accidents through a virtual training scenario, to enable marine rescue training based on team integration, in which many trainees participate simultaneously in preparation for marine accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상훈련 시나리오를 통해 해양사고를 재현할 수 있는 3D 기반의 가상의 훈련환경을 제공함으로써, 해양사고에 대비하여 다수의 훈련자가 동시 참여하는 팀 통합 기반의 해양구조훈련을 가능하게 하는 해양구조훈련장치 및 그 동작 방법을 제안한다.

title_en: A kind of intelligent early-warning fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent early-warning fire extinguishing system is to be related to plus layer reconstruction private residence is lived in groups room, dormitory, color steel makeshift house, electric bicycle concentrated area, use a kind of collection smokescope early warning used in liquefied gas cooker collective kitchen, gas leak early warning, toxic gas early warning, emergency light illuminates, escape hatch board indicates, loudspeaker alarm, voice is dredged, extinguishing chemical spray is in the intellectual monitoring fire-fighting equipment of one, occur that during fire smoke monitoring can be started immediately, gas leakage monitors, monitoring poisonous gas, early warning, system controller controls loudspeaker to alarm by software, voice is dredged, emergency light illuminates, escape hatch board lights, and to neighbouring bicycle parking region ignition point sprinkling fire-distinguishing agent, automatically the concurrent location information of 119 fire alarms is broadcast in mobile terminal.

title_en: A kind of filler based on discarded common brick is in the method for metal mine consolidated fill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of filler based on discarded common brick metal mine consolidated fill method.The method of this filling includes the following steps：1) preparation in place is filled；2) preparation of red brick powder is discarded；3) the preliminary mixing of filler；4) secondary agitation of filler；5) it fills.It is on duty that filling process of the present invention is not required to very important person in stowing operation, and staff does not have to enter filling area in stowing operation, need to be only fed in ground support and observation exhaust outlet is paid attention to outside filling area, ensure that the safety in stowing operation.The placement method of the present invention, with largely discarding common brick during reconstructing, is conducive to save the soil in city, while be also beneficial to ensure the stabilization of stope ground pressure, reduces the probability of happening of geological disaster using city construction.
assignees: SOLID ROCK TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma focus automatic segmentation method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nasopharyngeal carcinoma focus automatic segmentation method and a nasopharyngeal carcinoma focus automatic segmentation system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: registering the PET image and the CT image of the nasopharyngeal carcinoma to obtain a registered PET image and a registered CT image; and inputting the registered PET image and CT image into a convolutional neural network for feature extraction and score map reconstruction to obtain a segmentation result map of the nasopharyngeal carcinoma focus. The method registers the PET image and the CT image of the nasopharyngeal carcinoma and automatically segments the nasopharyngeal carcinoma focus through the convolutional neural network, and compared with a manual segmentation mode of a doctor, the method is more objective and accurate; the convolutional neural network in deep learning is adopted, the consistency is better, the characteristic learning capability is stronger, the problems that dimension disasters are easy to fall into local optimum and the like are solved, the focus segmentation can be carried out on the multi-mode image of the PET-CT image, and the application range is wider. The invention can be widely applied to the field of medical image processing.

title_en: Method and apparatus for determining sensor data reliability at an incident scene for real-time and post-incident processing
abstract_en: An electronic processor is configured to determine sensor data reliability at an incident scene for real-time and post-incident processing. The electronic processor receives primary sensor data from a primary data source, retrieves secondary data associated with the primary sensor data, calculates a reliability index for the primary sensor data using the secondary data; compares the reliability index to a threshold and one of executes a particular action and applies a particular policy as a function of the comparison.

title_en: Portable smoke ventilator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ventilator and, more specifically, relates to a portable smoke ventilator which can be portable to be conveniently installed and used anywhere in the scene of a fire. A poisonous gas is quickly ventilated to prevent a secondary life accident, and a firefighter can quickly enter to quickly extinguish a fire. Moreover, air colliding with a vein is smoothly induced to prevent an impact generated in an end of the vein for vibration or noise to be prevented. In addition, stability of operation is secured, and ventilation efficiency can be improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 송풍기에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 휴대가 가능하여 화재현장 어디서든지 간편하게 설치 및 사용이 가능하며, 신속한 유독가스의 배기로 유독가스로 인한 2차 인명사고의 예방과 소방관의 신속한 진입으로 신속한 화재 진압이 가능하게 하며, 또한 베인에 충돌되는 공기의 원활한 유도로 베인 단부에서 발생 되는 충격을 방지하여 진동이나 소음이 방지되게 하는 등 구동상의 안정성 확보 및 배기 효율의 향상을 가져오게 하기 위한 휴대용 배연 송풍기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of geological disaster rubble processing equipment for pulverizing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of processing equipment for pulverizing more particularly to a kind of geological disaster rubble processing equipment for pulverizing.The technical problem to be solved in the present invention is to provide a kind of machineries to replace artificial geological disaster rubble processing equipment for pulverizing.The present invention provides such a geological disaster rubble processing equipment for pulverizing, include fixed frame etc.；Fixed frame upper right quarter is equipped with motor, cam is installed on motor, head rod is equipped with by axis pin rotary type on cam, head rod left part rotary type is equipped with stripper plate, stripper plate is connected by axis pin rotary type with fixed frame, upside is equipped with regulating device in the middle part of fixed frame, and regulating device upper right quarter is equipped with baffle.Invention achieves effects easy to use, highly practical, work efficiency is high, the rubble generated in geological disaster can be rapidly completed using this equipment, save a large amount of manual labors, accelerate the reconstruction after calamity, the dust generated in the course of work is few, reduces influence of the dust to staff.

title_en: Interphone system having outdoor information collection function
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To function an entrance slave unit as outdoor information collection means if a power failure occurs during occurrence of a disaster, to always sound-record and video-record a status of an entrance periphery for a contribution to rescue operation, and to sound-record and replay a message.SOLUTION: When a power failure of a trunk line L is detected by a trunk line voltage monitoring unit 36, a CPU 37 of a sound-recording and video-recording device 3 controls a battery 4 and supplies electric power to an entrance slave unit 2. When a microphone 23 and a camera 21 of the entrance slave unit 2 operate, the CPU 37 stores received sound and video in a sound-recording and video-recording memory 35. When a resident or a passer-by speaks while depressing a message button 31, the CPU 37 of the sound-recording and video-recording device 3 stores sound input from the microphone 23 in the sound-recording and video-recording memory 35 as a message. When a replay button 32 is depressed, the CPU 37 reads the message from the sound-recording and video-recording memory 35 and causes the message to be output from a speaker 23.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of spray prewarning controller
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of spray prewarning controller, belongs to fire control technology field, it is characterised in that：Including trigger mechanism, including fixed frame, it is fixedly connected with applicator or metope；Trigger member is connected with the fixed frame, and the trigger member is directed toward applicator, or is contacted with applicator, and work is sprayed for triggering applicator；The trigger member is connected with electric wire or pipe fitting, by electric current or pressure activated.Fire-fighting spray device intellectualized reconstruction is reached, realization gives warning in advance, triggers in advance and the purpose of the operation is stable.
assignees: ZHUJI HAIWANG FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method based on convergence face three-dimensional reconstruction estimation Your Majesty liter/down draft speed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of methods based on convergence face three-dimensional reconstruction estimation Your Majesty liter/down draft speed, the described method comprises the following steps：First, Doppler radar base data is subjected to coordinate system conversion, reflectance map is first passed through in new coordinate system A to determine airflow field detection range and be mapped in radial velocity map, interpolation obtains 70 layers of contour radial velocity map again, convergency point is therefrom extracted, Your Majesty's liter, down draft velocity projections figure and the three-dimensional coordinate for calculating convergency point are drawn；Then, three-dimensional convergence face is built using Delaunay Triangulation method, the convergence face inclination angle on convergence face at each convergency point is calculated using geometrical relationship；Your Majesty's liter, down draft speed are corrected using this inclination angle.This method realizes the fining that the identification forecast of convection weather disaster is promoted based on convergence face three-dimensional reconstruction estimation Your Majesty liter/down draft speed and scientific.

title_en: Novel swallow few wooden structure container building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel nearly wooden structure container building of swallow, including underframe, stand, top frame, wallboard and roof, three crossbeam is equallyd divide into according to the nearly modulus of swallow to the underframe: and the junction of crossbeam and underframe is equipped with the stand perpendicular with the horizontal plane: five upright posts are respectively arranged on the long edges of the two sides of the bottom frame; and the distance between every two upright posts is about 2200 MM; the top end of the upright post is provided with a top frame; three equal-dividing cross beams are arranged in the top frame; the beam spacing is about 2200 MM; a side face fixed through a plurality of wall boards in a laminated mode is arranged between every two upright columns; the bottom frame, the upright posts, the top frame, the wallboard, the top plate and the wallboard form a swallow-shaped box. The novel wood structure has the characteristics of environmental protection and environmental friendliness; the method can be widely applied to scenic spot development with high environmental requirements, new rural construction, construction of special towns, disaster area reconstruction projects and the like; the functions are various, and different functions such as residence, education, business, office and the like can be realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI DINGJI ARCH DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for generating minimum accident information for use in a vehicle emergency rescue system and method for the same
title_ko: 차량 긴급 구난 체계에서 사용하기 위한 최소 사고 정보를 생성하는 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention provides an apparatus for generating minimum accident information. The apparatus comprises: an accident information collecting unit collecting accident information from a moving object accident information collecting device; an accident information reconstructing unit reconstructing the accident information to match a predetermined data type and value; and a minimum accident information generating unit composed of version information of minimum accident information, basic information, which is an essential element including an accident occurrence time, control information, and a position of an accident vehicle, and optional information, which can be additionally included as needed for accident situation identification and lifesaving according to an operation method, using the reconstructed accident information and generating the minimum accident information having a predetermined structure.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 이동체 사고 정보 수집 장치로부터 사고 정보를 수집하는 사고 정보 수집부; 상기 사고 정보를 기정의된 데이터 타입과 값에 부합하도록 재구축하는 사고 정보 재구축부; 및 상기 재구축된 사고 정보를 이용하여 최소 사고 정보의 버전 정보와, 사고 발생 시각, 제어 정보 및 사고 차량의 위치를 포함하는 필수적 요소인 기본 정보와, 작동 방식에 따라 사고 상황 파악 및 인명 구조에 필요하여 부가적으로 포함될 수 있는 선택 정보로 구성되어 기정의된 구조를 갖는 최소 사고 정보를 생성하는 최소 사고 정보 생성부 를 포함하는 최소 사고 정보를 생성하는 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Fire plant integrated monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire plant integrated monitoring systems, the power supply of each electricity consumption fire plant and every technology requirement of stand-by power supply working condition can effectively be monitored in real time in fire protection control room, the appearance of the important fire plant of monitor video instant playback can also be utilized intact to determine if, be suitable for industrial, the civilian and commercial building of newly-built enlarging and reconstruction.As a kind of fire-fighting pre-alarm system, advantage be can be integrated alarm in advance fire-fighting installation's power source failure, fire plant is unable to normal use and leads to the sprawling that cannot efficiently control fire when fire being avoided to occur, and fire-fighting equipment is efficiently and rapidly devoted oneself to work when fire being enable to occur；Further, this system will be by all monitoring information transmissions to fire chief department, not only objectively realize that the multiple monitoring to fire plant, subjectivity also add pressure and the resolution of the fire-fighting work of infrastructure management company, the normal operation of fire-fighting pre-alarm work can be effectively ensured.

title_en: Comprehensive treatment solution for underground engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive treatment solution for underground engineering, which comprises the following steps: radon prevention and treatment; updating and modifying facility equipment; engineering supporting facilities and functional areas are transformed; safety defense and disaster prevention facility renovation; engineering camouflage protection; managing a facility equipment operation and maintenance system; internal communication and information publishing; upgrading and modifying an audio and video monitoring system; and (5) upgrading and transforming an automatic network. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention aims at the fields of air purification, ventilation protection, air conditioning dehumidification, water purification, sewage treatment, electric power guarantee, equipment operation and maintenance, command communication, safety precaution, engineering protection, efficiency evaluation and the like of underground projects such as civil air defense projects, underground pipe galleries and the like, and carries out scheme design, upgrading and reconstruction and high-tech product access, thereby effectively solving various problems of over standard radon gas, equipment aging, low automation degree, single camouflage means and the like of the underground projects and realizing comprehensive treatment.

title_en: Reinforced extinguishing agent for removal of carbon monooxide and producing method thereof
title_ko: 일산화탄소 제거기능이 있는 강화액 소화약제 및 이의 제조방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a reinforced fire extinguishing agent having a function of removing carbon monoxide, in which a metal-supported catalyst having a fine particle size capable of completely oxidizing carbon monoxide to a fire extinguishing agent is dispersed. In addition to general fire extinguishing performance, carbon monoxide removal performance is performed to reduce casualties caused by monoxide poisoning at the scene of a fire and to increase the fire extinguishing performance of the reinforced fire extinguishing agent by consuming oxygen at the scene of the fire in a process of completely oxidizing the carbon monoxide.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재진압용 강화액 소화약제에 일산화탄소를 완전산화시킬 수 있는 초미립크기의 금속담지촉매를 분산시킨 일산화탄소 제거기능을 가진 강화액 소화약제에 관한 것으로, 일반적인 소화성능 외에 일산화탄소 제거성능을 가지므로 화재현장에서 일산화중독으로 인한 인명피해를 줄일 수 있으며  일산화탄소를 완전산화시키는 과정에 화재현장의 산소를 소모함으로써 강화액 소화약제의 소화성능을 증대시킨다.
assignees: CHUNNAM TECHNO UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMY COOPERRATION FOUNDATION;HONGKYO POLYTECH INC

title_en: Remodeling procedure after a kind of natural rubber woods calamity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to natural rubber woods post-disaster reconstruction technical field, remodeling procedure after a kind of natural rubber woods calamity, the integrated treatment measure for taking " support, prevent, controlling " three to combine are disclosed；Water and fertilizer management after " foster " calamity using reinforcement and reduction rubber tapping intensity；It is " anti-" to be rotted using the xylem for preventing bark beetle from causing harm, anti-wound exposes；" controlling " promotes healing using wound is administered；The rubber tree growth not handled after calamity is slower, is remolded after calamity notable to the increment impact effect of rubber tree；Disaster-stricken processing rubber tree restoration ecosystem speed is fast, resists bark beetle infringement, and the wind-fall tree death rate grows rubber tree level close to no calamity naturally.The present invention opens rubber tapping tree fire 3.5 kilograms of 1 annual yield of cave of post-processing；2.7 kilograms not handled after disaster-stricken；It is not disaster-stricken to grow 3.6 kilograms of gum naturally；It can be seen that influence of the calamity post-processing to the resistance of rubber tree, yield effect significant effect.

title_en: Random background encourages the fully mechanized coal face environmental hazard early warning system and method for early warning of anchor pole array sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses fully mechanized coal face environmental hazard early warning systems and method for early warning that random background encourages anchor pole array sensing, the present invention is based on single anchor pole sensing device, sensing device is installed on the anchor pole in fully mechanized coal face both sides back production lane, is allowed to form anchor pole sensor array.Regard anchor pole array as electrode to the method calculating coal petrography field domain distribution of conductivity by electrical resistance tomography and reconstructs internal coal seam resistivity distributed image, the coal petrography velocity of sound distributed image formed in conjunction with each anchor pole sonic tomography, it more accurately and efficiently analyzes and judges can be predicted most of geology accidents such as work sweat, roof fall, landslide, final above-mentioned data and result cloud server is uploaded to by wireless module and store and can be in wechat public platform real time inspection.The problem of constructing under the conditions of halt production the present invention overcomes conventional method needs, improves flexibility and the real-time of system；The system structure is simple, it is convenient to realize, uses simple operation.

title_en: The Concrete after Fire bridge security status assessment method of Coupled Numerical Simulation technology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the Concrete after Fire bridge security status assessment methods of Coupled Numerical Simulation technology, include the following steps：A, preliminary investigation scheme is worked out；B, trial inspection；C, digital reconstruction is analyzed；D, detection in detail；E, establishment report.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows：By the way that traditional detection method and numerical simulation analysis are combined, propose the detection of Concrete after Fire beam bridge and appraisal procedure, in the method, specify project and content that concrete beam bridge should detect after by fire, increase the criterion to bridge fire damage disease, the estimation flow of technology status after concrete beam bridge fire damage calamity is defined, realizes and quantization assessment is carried out to the bridge after fire.
assignees: ANHUI TRANSP HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;ANHUI EXPRESSWAY TEST AND DETECTION RES & DEVELOPMENT CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Simulator and simulation system for brain training based on behavior modeling
title_ko: 행동모방학습 기반의 뇌 훈련 시뮬레이터 및 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a simulator and a simulation system for brain training. The brain training simulator comprises: a communication unit for sending training content to a training apparatus so that the content is displayed on the training apparatus; an input unit for acquiring brain signals of a user on the basis of a non-invasive brain activation measurement method; and a control unit for determining the intention of the user on the basis of the acquired brain signal data and preset intention data. The control unit determines, as the intention of the user, the preset intention data that matches the brain signal data, controls the action of the training apparatus on the basis of the determined intention of the user, controls the playback of the training content so as to correspond to the action of the training apparatus, and provides the user with feedback for inducing brain activation.
abstract_ko: 뇌 훈련 시뮬레이터 및 시뮬레이션 시스템이 개시된다. 뇌 훈련 시뮬레이터는 훈련 장치에서 디스플레이되도록 훈련 장치로 훈련 컨텐츠를 전송하는 통신부, 비침습적 뇌 활성화 측정 방법에 기초하여 사용자의 뇌 신호를 획득하는 입력부 및 획득된 뇌 신호의 데이터와 기 설정된 의도 데이터에 기초하여 사용자의 의도를 판단하는 제어부를 포함하고, 제어부는 뇌 신호의 데이터와 매칭되는 기 설정된 의도 데이터를 사용자의 의도로 판단하고, 판단된 사용자의 의도에 기초하여 훈련 장치의 동작을 제어하며, 훈련 장치의 동작에 대응되도록 훈련 컨텐츠의 재생을 제어하고, 사용자에게 뇌 활성을 유도하기 위한 피드백을 제공한다.

title_en: The secure equipments needed to fire combat
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire suppression equipment that is capable of providing hammer, tongs, helmets, filters, and the like required to suppress fires generated from different fire sites and differently handling different fire causes. According to the present invention, the fire suppression equipment includes: large capacity filters, air suction devices, and covers and screens, which are necessary for fire suppression of chemical factories; fire covers and screens, and oil tank covers and screens, which are necessary for fire suppression of construction sites; fire covers and screens and escape devices which are necessary for fire suppression of high-rise buildings; filters sucking smoke; large capacity filters necessary to suck smoke generated from a forest fire; large capacity air layer water tanks, drone type equipment having a filter mounted thereon, and a tube ladder, which are necessary for forest fire suppression; air layer vehicle bridges; fire car covers and screens, smoke sucking filters, and water tanks, which are necessary for road fire suppression; fire covers and screens (doors) and smoke sucking filters, which are necessary for fire suppression on underground (subway) or tunnel (vehicle); and air circulation air pipes having a plurality of inlets and outlets formed on the air pipes in the advancing direction of the underground (subway) or tunnel (vehicle) and on the air pipes in the opposite direction to the advancing direction.

title_en: A kind of disaster target imaging method under reinforcement echo interference
abstract_en: A kind of disaster target imaging method under being interfered the invention discloses reinforcement echo.This method becomes radar return signal of changing commanders first with Fhyp-curvelet and projects to multiple scale spaces, the energy of each target echo is separated from each other and each self aggregation in all scale spaces, then Space-time domain is changed in contravariant after filtering out reinforcing bar component in multiscale space, obtain containing only the data of disaster target echo, the data after reconstruct are transformed into wave-number domain again, the characteristics of velocity of EM-waves changes in multi-layer underground medium is considered under the domain, finally contravariant changes to Space-time domain and carries out disaster target imaging again.The method of the present invention is all made of quick Processing Algorithm, effectively reduces computational complexity, and the disaster target imaging under reinforcement echo interference multi-layer underground medium.

title_en: Smoke-free, Fire-resistant Sliding Tube Structure for Emergency Escape in High-rise Buildings
title_ko: 고층건물 비상탈출용도의 내화·방연 구조로 된 도관 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency escape device which can be used for emergency escape of people living in a building in case of a big fire in a high-rise building. By using a tube structure protected by a fire-resistant and smoke-free device, people in the high-rise building and a skyscraper are able to quickly and safely escape from the fire to evacuate to the ground.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고층빌딩에서 대형화재가 발생하면 건물에 거주하는 사람들이 비상탈출 할 수 있는 방법이 사실상 없는 문제를 해결하기 위한 것으로, 고층 및 초고층 건물 내에 있는 사람들이 내화 및 방연 장치로 보호되는 도관 구조를 통해 신속하고도 안전하게 화재현장을 빠져나와 지상으로 대피를 할 수 있게 한 비상탈출 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of reply assembling type steel structure beam-column connection certainly for defending disaster-ridden evil
abstract_en: A kind of anti-Progressive Collapse reinforcement means and bracing means suitable for steel pipe column and H-shaped beam connecting node, belongs to construction engineering technical field.The device includes lower flange of girder edge stiffening plate, partition stiffening plate, cover board and connection bolt.This method is, on the basis of beam has used full weldering connection or edge of a wing welding, the bolted connection type of web to be connected with column and partition, lower flange of girder edge and lower partition are reinforced by welding stiffening plate in join domain two sides, and lower flange of girder edge is again coupled to reinforce by cover board with lower partition using plain bolt.The present invention can be improved the vertical bearing capacity of node lower post failure posterior nodal point minor structure, significantly improve the anti-Progressive Collapse performance of structure, can be used for the strengthening reconstruction of important building by reinforcing to steel frame beam column joint.
assignees: SHANGHAI TONGPAI ARCHITECTURAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of reasoning by cases method towards hazardous chemical accident emergency aid decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of reasoning by cases method towards hazardous chemical accident emergency aid decision, step includes：1, have the Accident Characteristic of accident case to hazardous chemical and its emergency management and rescue process carries out structuring expression, and the sample cases as emergency aid decision.2, collection site waits for the characteristic information parameter of decision accident, based on parameter values attributes extraction rule, converts numerical attribute for the text information of characteristic information parameter, constitutes reasoning evaluation set.3, weight is set, and the local similarity and sample cases overall similarity of each Accident Characteristic parameter, filter out the alternative case of a certain number of decisions in computational reasoning evaluation set.4, by comparing, the similarity highest alternative case stage emergency management and rescue parameter information is reconstructed and is assigned should be to decision accident, as aid decision result of meeting an urgent need.The present invention can improve emergency disposal efficiency in the efficiency and applicability for guaranteeing emergency decision-making assistant information to a certain degree.

title_en: A kind of intelligent early-warning fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent early-warning fire extinguishing system is to be related to plus layer reconstruction private residence is lived in groups room, dormitory, color steel makeshift house, electric bicycle concentrated area, use a kind of collection smokescope early warning used in liquefied gas cooker collective kitchen, gas leak early warning, toxic gas early warning, emergency light illumination, the instruction of escape hatch board, loudspeaker alarm, voice is dredged, extinguishing chemical spray is in the intellectual monitoring fire-fighting equipment of one, occur that smoke monitoring can be started immediately when fire, gas leakage monitoring, monitoring poisonous gas, early warning, system controller is alarmed by software control loudspeaker, voice is dredged, emergency light illumination, escape hatch board lights, and to neighbouring bicycle parking region ignition point sprinkling fire-distinguishing agent, the automatic concurrent location information of 119 fire alarm in mobile terminal.

title_en: Mine earthquake disaster distinguishing and signal reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for distinguishing mine earthquake disasters and reconstructing signals, which comprises the following steps: receiving mine earthquake data from distributed mine earthquake monitoring nodes in a monitoring area through a high-speed Ethernet by utilizing an edge computing server; representing the mineral seismic data as a sparse matrix; training the sparse matrix through a multiple neural network model and judging a disaster result; and reconstructing the mine earthquake signal through an improved sparsity self-adaptive matching tracking algorithm. According to the invention, the mine earthquake monitoring and inversion method is combined with the deep learning technology, so that the influence of various interferences in the monitoring environment can be greatly reduced, the mine earthquake disaster discrimination and the original mine earthquake signal reconstruction precision are improved, and the inversion result is more accurate.

title_en: Dynamic recovery system and method for power distribution network based on cell apoptosis algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic recovery system and a dynamic recovery method for a power distribution network based on an apoptosis algorithm, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises an information acquisition agent module, a load agent module, an emergency maintenance team agent module, a data processing agent module, a restorability evaluation agent module, a tree agent module to be restored, a cooperative agent module and a control center agent module; by taking the physiological characteristics of cells as reference, the network reconstruction and emergency repair problem is decomposed into a plurality of continuous steps, the optimization difficulty of each step is reduced, and the problem that dimension disaster is easily generated when the traditional method is used for optimizing for multiple times is solved; determining the recovery mode of the tree to be recovered in each time period according to the recoverability evaluation value, determining the most important recovery target in the stage according to each mode, and simplifying the problems of complex optimization in the recovery process and long recovery time caused by multi-target optimization in the recovery process; the fault recovery and the emergency repair are coordinated to consider the recovery scheme, so that the recovery efficiency is improved, the economic loss is reduced, and the method is suitable for the large-area power failure problem of a multi-fault large power grid system.

title_en: Simulation flame interaction device for multi-person fire extinguishing training
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulated flame interaction device for multi-person fire extinguishing training, wherein a display board is arranged in a shell; the display board, the display module, the sound effect module and the control module are electrically connected; the control module is electrically connected with the environment signal receiving module, the optical frequency signal receiving module and the inflammation light control module; the environment signal receiving module and the optical frequency signal receiving module output electric signals to the control module; the control module is electrically connected with the control display module; the display module is electrically connected with the display plate and outputs the display plate; the control module is electrically connected with the driving circuit module and the motion module; the driving circuit module drives the motion module; the control module is electrically connected with the sound effect module; the sound effect module is electrically connected with the sound effect playback module and the interactive voice logic; the internal projection type flame simulation technology is adopted, so that the simulation flame is smooth and has extremely low energy consumption; low power consumption and mute function.

title_en: System for generating building model based on inertial navigation positioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for generating a building model based on inertial navigation positioning equipment, which comprises an inertial navigation module, information processing and transmission terminal hardware equipment, a data acquisition and processing module, a building three-dimensional model reconstruction module, a three-dimensional building display module and other software parts. The method comprises the steps of acquiring basic information such as the outer contour, the position of key facilities, a walking track and the like of a building through an inertial navigation module, determining the height, the number of floors and the internal layout of the building through a data acquisition and processing module, and rapidly constructing a three-dimensional model of the building according to acquired and processed building data and a triangulation algorithm based on convex-concave judgment. By the method, the rapid modeling can be performed on the social key units in the fire fighting field, and the fire fighter can generate the visual building model through six familiarity with the patrol, so that data support is provided for the fire fighter to master the position of the fire fighter and the position of fire fighting resources when the fire fighter carries out a fire fighting rescue task.

title_en: A kind of cryptographic key factor generation method of root key
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of cryptographic key factor generation methods of root key, cryptographic key factor is generated one by one and is input in encryption equipment by cryptographic key factor generating means, cryptographic key factor generating means include opaque cuboid box, the first wheel shaft and the second wheel shaft side by side is equipped in cuboid box, equipped with the reel for being printed on continuation character on first wheel shaft, it rolls up on the second wheel shaft the starting point of reel, the top surface of cuboid box is equipped with the first button and the second button, and the first hole and the second hole above the first wheel shaft of face, just expose a character on reel in the first hole, expose the blank parts between the character and character late of the first hole face in the second hole.Compared with prior art, the method of the present invention determines the sufficiently random property of the cryptographic key factor of root key by multiple randomness, it can guarantee to establish root key and whole keys in the case that anyone does not know factor values, the mechanism that is provided simultaneously with guarantees that root key can be reconstructed when a disaster occurs.
assignees: SHANGHAI VOICEONLINE NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of signal generator with fire-fighting signal linkage function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of signal generators with fire-fighting signal linkage function, it is characterised in that including sequentially connected signal acquisition circuit, MCU processor, audio recording and playback circuitry module, the first audio amplifier circuit；Urgent call microphone and the second audio amplifier circuit being connect with the urgent call microphone；It further include the switching switch being connect respectively with the first audio amplifier circuit and the second audio amplifier circuit, the control terminal of the switching switch connects the MCU processor；The input terminal of the signal acquisition circuit is connect with fire-fighting center or fire-fighting equipment.Public address system and the monitoring system of fire protection are organically combined, keeps fire broadcast more flexible effective.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting emergency headlamp of adjustable intensity of light
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting emergency headlamps of adjustable intensity of light, including metal plastic-spraying lamp box and display screen, the upper end of the metal plastic-spraying lamp box is equipped with rotation axis, the outer surface of the metal plastic-spraying lamp box is equipped with loudspeaker, and the upper end of loudspeaker is movably installed with brightness control panel, the side of the display screen is equipped with buzzer siren, the upper end of the buzzer siren is fixedly installed with alarm lamp, the inside of the metal plastic-spraying lamp box is equipped with battery, and the other side of battery is fixedly installed with speech chip, the side of the speech chip is equipped with playback circuit.A kind of fire-fighting emergency headlamp of adjustable intensity of light described in the utility model, equipped with rotation axis, brightness control panel, buzzer siren and speech chip, security level can be improved, and it can the direction of flexible modulation lamp and the brightness of lamp, it can also voice broadcast, stable order is applicable in different operating situation, brings better prospect of the application.
assignees: SIDIEN SHENZHEN INTELLIGENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: fire suspension drone for skyscrapers
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire suppressing drone for skyscrapers with a new structure, which is able to effectively suppress fire occurring in skyscrapers. When a fire occurs, the fire suppressing drone for skyscrapers according to the present invention flies up to the height of the fire and directly ejects water to a fire site through an ejection nozzle (40) such that the fire having occurred at a high floor where water from a conventional fire truck is not able to reach can be effectively suppressed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 초고층건물에서 발생된 화재를 효과적으로 진압할 수 있도록 된 새로운 구조의 초고층건물 화재진압용 드론에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 초고층건물 화재 진압용 드론은 화재가 발생될 경우, 화재가 발생된 높이까지 날아올라가 분사노즐(40)을 통해 화재현장에 직접 물을 분사함으로,  종래의 소방차에서 물을 분사할 수 없는 높은 층에서 발생된 화재를 효과적으로 진압할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: fire suppression drone
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire suppression drone. More specifically, the present invention relates to the fire suppression drone for facilitating entry into scene of a fire and preventing functional restrictions of lenses and cameras due to soot. The fire suppression drone of the present invention also comprises: a body having a control unit built therein and having a plurality of cameras arranged along the outer circumferential surface thereof; a rotor unit including a plurality of motors disposed on the side surface of the body and a rotor coupled to each of the motors; a plurality of guides disposed on the lower surface of the body and spaced apart from each other; a plurality of fire extinguishing balls embedded in a fire extinguishing medium and arranged above and below the guides; and a grip unit disposed at an end unit of the guide to support the fire extinguishing balls at the lowermost end and to drop the fire extinguishing balls disposed at the lowest end in accordance with a control of the control unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재진압용 드론에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 화재현장으로의 진입이 용이하며, 그을음으로 인한 렌즈 및 카메라의 기능적 제약을 방지하기 위한 화재진압용 드론에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 제어부가 내장되고, 외주면을 따라 복수 개의 카메라가 배치된 몸체와 상기 몸체의 측면으로 배치되는 복수 개의 모터 및 각 모터에 결합되는 로터로 구성된 로터부와 상기 몸체의 하면에 상호 이격되어 하향으로 배치되는 복수 개의 가이드와 소화 약재가 내장되어 상기 가이드 사이에 상,하로 배치되는 복수 개의 소화 볼과 상기 가이드의 단부에 배치되어 최하단에 배치된 소화 볼을 지지하되, 제어부의 제어에 따라 최하단에 배치된 소화 볼을 낙하시키기 위한 그립부를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Water level warning algorithm after a kind of water bursting in mine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to water level warning algorithms after a kind of water bursting in mine, belong to field of coal mine safety.Water bursting in mine accident is sudden strong, breaks with tremendous force, tends not to make accurate judgment to gushing water intensity, the infringement range of floods, delay the disaster relief time.To solve the problems, such as water level early warning after water bursting in mine, The present invention gives standards and method that water level sensor is arranged according to mine laneway connected graph；The water level information obtained according to water level sensor, by reconstructing mine laneway connected graph, calculate node capacity, water level cut set, after obtaining underground anywhere gushing water, the variation of water level and water inrush quantity, the relationship of tunnel submergence ratio in each water level cut set (being made of several tunnels), and then determine that water bursting in mine intensity and mine are flooded range.

title_en: A kind of emergency geography information quick draw graphics system and its drafting method
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of emergency geography information quick draw graphics system, mainly for the demand in processing emergency emergency event to mapping service, based on emergency thematic data base, design emergency drawing module architectures, optimize geo-spatial data and quickly goes out diagram technology process, Data Integration is provided, the volume of data management tool such as data base administration, realize Data Integration, the template that charts customizes and selection, range of charting definition, figure ornament generates, map denotation and editor, special topic is marked and drawed, map output, the functions such as monitoring printing, meet the polar plot of standard map sheet and any figure amplitude range, striograph, the superposition of the multiple formats data such as shading map goes out figure demand.System can provide specification, efficient drawing service for solution of emergent event；For the data management of emergency, evaluation analysis, preventing and reducing natural disasters provides scientific basis support and real-time, efficient, specification geography information mapping services guarantee with decisions such as post-disaster reconstructions.

title_en: Redis-based centralized cache queue service architecture method and network structure
abstract_en: The architecture method and the network structure adopt the centralized cache queue service technology of Redis, and the Redis application service is deployed on the cache queue server according to a Master/Slave mode, so that disaster tolerance of the node data and service is realized, and when the Master node is down, the Slave node is automatically replaced. Through a Sentinel technology, a plurality of cache queue servers are clustered, and when the existing cache queue service cannot meet the performance requirements of the current Internet application, new nodes can be deployed to dynamically add into the cache queue constructed by the Sentinel. The cache queue service client program subjected to reconstruction and encapsulation provides the operation capability of the cache queue service cluster, the fragmentation position of the data storage is calculated through a built-in uniqueness algorithm, and the service capability provided by Sentinel is combined, so that the cache queue service client program can be rapidly and accurately positioned to the corresponding cache queue node group, and the problem of horizontal expansion of the cache queue service is perfectly solved.

title_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure based on deepness belief network
abstract_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure disclosed by the invention based on deepness belief network, initially sets up Landslide Monitoring early warning system, acquires a large amount of disaster incitants, screens with MIV algorithm, filters out major casualty incitant；The disaster incitant filtered out is standardized process, is divided into test sample and training sample in specific proportions；Then, the landslide disaster forecasting model based on deepness belief network is constructed, setting structure is two layers of RBM and three layer of BP network composition；Using CD algorithm to RBM pre-training, network parameter is updated；Learnt using genetic algorithm supervised training, guarantees DBN network total optimization；Finally, the landslide disaster forecasting model that reconstruct has optimized, carries out landslide grade classification to output result, forecasts landslide possibility occurrence.Method disclosed by the invention accelerates convergence rate, prevents from falling into local optimum, promote landslide disaster forecast precision by extracting feature disaster incitant.

title_en: Air-cushion type aerotrain and whole roadbed rail system
abstract_en: It is an advantage of the invention that the systems technology is the original innovation to the primary comprehensive integrated form of High-sped Trains, air cushion suspension technology and railway technology, it can effectively solve safe, the compatible, cost of existing wheel family car and magnetic suspension train in the presence of development, various problems such as operation cost, the system has also fully taken into account the multi-party factors such as construction, operation cost, social diameter Ji benefit in the design, and promotion, reconstruction can be transformed to existing line into new aerotrain and mark rail train parallel line.Furthermore the traffic capacity of special type track basal plane and road heart backing plate can also be made full use of, make the route under special circumstances: such as war preparedness combats a natural disaster in emergency circumstances to become the urgent passage of war preparedness or disaster relief vehicle, passes through channel.

title_en: System for Instructional visual content using Automatically convert images from electronic documents
title_ko: 전자문서의 이미지 자동변환을 통한 강의영상 컨텐츠 제작시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for creating lecture video content using automatic conversion of an image of an electronic document and, more specifically, to a system for creating lecture video content using automatic conversion of an image of an electronic document which allows anyone to easily create a video without expert knowledge about video editing, and simultaneously and automatically edits lecture data and a lecture video to be used when creating lectures of various fields such as public safety, broadcasting, education, and culture. The system for creating lecture video content using automatic conversion of an image of an electronic document comprises: a template selection unit to select one or more templates from a template database storing a plurality of templates with different arrangement methods and designs to insert a lecture video and lecture data; a registration unit separated into a first registration unit for registering a lecture video and a second registration unit for registering lecture data to load a lecture video and lecture data in the separated first and second registration units; a conversion unit to detect a file format of loaded data when a lecture video and lecture data are registered by the registration unit to convert the file format into an image file format to be used in video editing by undergoing a conversion process at least once in accordance with the file format; a position setting unit to arrange at least one image file converted by the conversion unit to allow the content thereof to correspond to a playback zone of the lecture video; and a rendering unit to encode the file edited by the position setting unit to create lecture video content.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전자문서의 이미지 자동변환을 통한 강의영상 컨텐츠 제작시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 영상 편집에 관한 전문지식이 없어도 누구나 손쉽게 영상을 제작할 수 있도록 하며, 강의자료와 강의영상을 동시에 자동편집할 수 있어 공공안전, 방송, 교육, 문화 등 다양한 분야의 강의제작 시에 활용될 수 있도록 하는 전자문서의 이미지 자동변환을 통한 강의영상 컨텐츠 제작시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해, 본 발명은 강의영상 및 강의자료를 삽입하기 위한 각기 다른 배치방식과 디자인으로 구성된 복수 개의 템플릿이 저장된 템플릿 DB로부터 어느 하나 이상의 템플릿을 선택할 수 있도록 하는 템플릿 선택부; 강의영상을 등록하는 제1 등록부와 강의자료를 등록하는 제2 등록부로 분리되어 구성되고, 각기 분리되어 구성된 제1 등록부와 제2 등록부에 각각의 강의영상 및 강의자료를 탑재하도록 하는 등록부; 등록부에 의해 강의영상 및 강의자료가 등록되면 탑재된 자료의 파일형식을 검출하여 파일형식에 따라 적어도 1회 이상의 변환과정을 거쳐 영상편집에 이용할 수 있는 이미지 파일형태로 변환처리하는 변환부; 변환부에 의해 변환된 적어도 하나 이상의 이미지 파일을 강의영상의 재생구간에 따라 그 내용이 대응되도록 배치시키는 위치설정부; 위치설정부에 의해 편집된 파일을 인코딩하여 강의영상 컨텐츠를 생성하는 렌더링부를 포함하는 전자문서의 이미지 자동변환을 통한 강의영상 컨텐츠 제작시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Outdoor movable intelligent pump house for emergency rescue water supply
abstract_en: The invention relates to an outdoor type mobile intelligent pump house capable of being used for emergency rescue water supply, which comprises a full-frequency water supply equipment system, an intelligent electric control system, a security monitoring system, a water quality security guarantee system, a pump house environment system, a pipe network anomaly protection system, a GIS system, a water supply intelligent cloud management system, an artificial engineering management system and an operation and maintenance guarantee system; an outdoor movable intelligent pump house for emergency water supply needs a water inlet main pipe to be connected with one end of a temporary pipe network, and a water outlet main pipe is connected with the other water outlet end of the temporary pipe network. The outdoor movable intelligent pump house for emergency water supply provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure and convenience in use, can realize intelligent safety water supply management of emergency water supply or temporary pipe network emergency water supply in natural disasters in old community reconstruction, ensures water consumption and pressure requirements of users, simultaneously avoids secondary pollution risks, is flexible in transportation, is convenient to install and is stable in operation.

title_en: A kind of City-scale Flooding Risk appraisal procedure based on chain structure
abstract_en: The City-scale Flooding Risk appraisal procedure based on chain structure that the invention discloses a kind of, include the following steps: (1) building based on the Urban Flood Waterlogging risk evaluation model of chain structure: then Flood inducing factors needed for determining chain structure, pregnant calamity environment and the big driven factor of hazard-affected body three utilize three big driven factors and its corresponding Index Establishment serial structure, sector structure and parallel organization relationship；(2) it determines and quantifies Flood inducing factors index, pregnant calamity environmental index and hazard-affected body index；(3) the Urban Flood Waterlogging risk model based on chain structure calculates Urban Flood Waterlogging value-at-risk, and carries out rank zoning to risk.The method of the present invention is all of great significance for city flood control, disaster alarm and prevention, urban planning, drainage reconstruction etc., can provide a degree of guidance to reduce the even casualties of economic loss caused by Urban Flood Waterlogging.

title_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure based on KPCA-FOA-LSSVM
abstract_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure disclosed by the invention based on KPCA-FOA-LSSVM, initially set up slip mass real-time system for monitoring and pre-warning, the real time data for obtaining monitoring section filters out landslide with core principle component analysis method and major influence factors occurs as input variable after its standardization；Building is based on LSSVM landslide disaster forecasting model；Then parameter optimization is carried out with drosophila algorithm, updates network parameter；The landslide disaster forecasting model optimized is finally reconstructed, output Landslide corresponds to plague grade, completes forecast.Method disclosed by the invention obtains monitoring data by establishing slip mass real-time system for monitoring and pre-warning, training output Landslide in the least square support vector machines model based on drosophila algorithm optimization is utilized after core principle component analysis filters out major influence factors, forecast efficiency is promoted, accuracy is increased.

title_en: Grout composition for pre-placed aggregate concrete and pre-placed aggregate concrete using the same
title_ko: 프리플레이스트 콘크리트용 그라우트 조성물 및 이를 이용한 프리플레이스트 콘크리트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a grout composition for preplaced concrete and preplaced concrete using the same. More particularly, an atomizing oxide slag, which is produced by an atomizing method and has excellent fluidity due to the spherical shape and has high specific gravity to have a self-weighting performance, is used as a fine grout aggregate. The present invention solves the physical, constructional, and economical problems that the conventional grout composition has insufficient fluidity and fastness so that an additional fast curing material or various admixtures are needed. The present invention has an excellent effect of increasing the recycling of the oxide slag as a by-product generated in the steel manufacturing process wherein the oxide slag corresponds to 80% of the steelmaking slag generated in the electric furnace and enabling the quick recovery.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 프리플레이스트 콘크리트용 그라우트 조성물 및 이를 이용한 프리플레이스트 콘크리트에 관한 것으로, 보가 상세하게는, 아토마이징 공법으로 생산되어 구형의 형상으로 유동성이 매우 우수하고 비중이 높아 자중성능이 있는 아토마이징 산화슬래그를 그라우트 잔골재로 사용하여 종래의 그라우트 조성물이 가지는 미흡한 유동성, 속경성이 없어 별도의 속경재를 사용하거나 여러 혼화재를 사용해야 하는 등의 물성상, 시공상 경제상의 문제점을 해결하고, 철강 제조공정에서 발생되는 부산물로서 전기로에서 발생되는 제강슬래그중 80%에 해당하는 산화슬래그의 재활용을 확대하며 신속 복구가 가능한 우수한 효과가 있는 프리플레이스트 콘크리트용 그라우트 조성물 및 이를 이용한 프리플레이스트 콘크리트에 관한 것이다.
assignees: NAT UNIV KONGJU IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Fire Extinguisher Bomb With Curved Shape At Both Ends
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguisher bomb with both curved ends, capable of allowing a fire extinguisher bomb pitched to a fire site to eject fire extinguishing agents to a heat source of the fire site while maintaining a posture capable of efficiently spraying the fire extinguishing agents. According to the present invention, the fire extinguisher bomb with both curved ends comprises: an outer enclosure part including a gas vessel part having a storage space therein to fill the storage space with gas and a motor part to control opening/closing of the gas vessel part, and having a curved surface having a spray hole perforated on one and the other end surfaces; an inner enclosure part installed in the storage space to allow one end to communicate with the spray hole and allow the other end to communicate with the gas vessel part, and having the fire extinguishing agents filled therein; and a fire sensor unit installed to expose one surface to the outer surface of the outer enclosure part and place the other surface in the storage space to detect heat, and generating a path for applying voltage to the motor unit when the temperature of the heat is equal to or greater than a set temperature.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재현장에 투척된 소화기가 소화약제를 효율적으로 분사시킬 수 있는 자세를 유지하며 화재 현상의 열원으로 소화약제를 분출시킬 수 있는 양단이 곡선형인 소화탄에 관한 것이다. 
이러한 양단이 곡선형인 소화탄은 내부에 수용공간이 형성되어 수용공간에 가스가 채워진 가스용기부와 가스용기부의 개폐를 제어하는 모터부가 설치되며, 일단면과 타단면에 분사구가 타공 된 만곡면이 형성된 외함부; 
수용공간에 설치되어 일단이 분사구와 연통되고 타단이 가스용기부와 연통되며, 내부에 소화약제가 채워진 내함부; 및 
일면이 외함부의 외측면에 노출되고 타면이 수용공간에 위치하도록 설치되어, 일면에서 외함부의 외측면에서 열을 감지하며, 열의 온도가 설정온도 이상이 되면, 모터부에 인가되는 전압의 인가 경로를 생성하는 화재감지센서부를 포함한다.

title_en: Flood losses appraisal procedure and system based on statistical yearbook and geography information
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of flood losses appraisal procedure and system based on statistical yearbook and geography information, and the method includes the steps 1: determining flood inundation on tracks feature；Step 2: socioeconomic data is associated with map datum foundation；Step 3: flood inundation on tracks feature being superimposed with associated socioeconomic data and map datum has been established carrying out topology, comprehensive analysis flood damage influences；Step 4: establishing flood inundation on tracks feature and property loss rate relation table and/or relation curve；Step 5: calculating economic loss of flood.The progress that method and system of the invention can be influenced and be lost caused by flood damage is effectively analyzed and is assessed, and is taken precautions against natural calamities, is combated a natural disaster for formulation, the disaster relief and post-disaster reconstruction scheme provide important evidence.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: A kind of emergency water purification car
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of emergency water purification car, including vehicle-mounted box, cabinet is successively arranged generator bay, control equipment compartment and purifier cabin from cockpit to tailstock direction；Generator bay is equipped with generator and generator maintenance door, and clothing issue room is equipped with above generator, and clothing issue room is equipped with storing hatch door；It controls equipment compartment and is equipped with equipment enclosure, air conditioner integrated machine, air-conditioner air outlet, maintenance door, entrance door and preceding getting-on ladder；Purifier cabin is equipped with water purification equipment, exhaust fan, water outlet water inlet, tilt-up door, upper water and sewage door, electric heater, purifier cabin and generator bay and is separated by partition wall, and partition wall is equipped with partition door, and the passageway in purifier cabin is disposed with floating drum.The present invention has vehicle-mounted power generating source system, can satisfy in face of emergency event and serious the condition of a disaster and heavy post-disaster reconstruction mission requirements, can quickly set out, and reaches designated position, and carry out the work rapidly.

title_en: Eaves of thatched roof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eave of a thatched roof, wherein the eave comprises: an eave base part (1) including a roof frame part (11), an eave end part (12), an eave support part (13), and an eave coupling protrusion (14); and eave straw (2). Even when construction is performed with artificial straw, an eave is seen to be thick. A sufficient volume is provided, so that the entire roof can be seen to be voluminous as if straw has been accumulated on the roof for a long time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 초가지붕의 처마로서, 이를 보다 상세히 설명하면 초가(草家)의 지붕에서 처마부분의 시공을 쉽고 빠르게 할 수 있으면서도 짚을 두껍게 시공할 수 있어 전통적인 느낌과 고풍을 재현코자 한 것으로서, 상기 본 발명은 상기한 발명의 과제를 해결하기 위한 구체적인 수단으로 본 발명에서는 초가지붕의 처마구조를 구성함에 있어서, 주거공간프레임의 상부에 설치되는 지붕골격부와, 지붕골격부의 끝단에 형성된 처마단부와, 처마단부에서 지붕골격부 방향으로 연장된 처마지지부와, 처마단부에서 돌출형성된 처마결합돌기로 이루어진 처마베이스부와 처마결합돌기에 결합되어 처마지지부에 안치되면서 짚이 두껍게 외측으로 뻗은 처마짚이 포함된 것을 특징으로 하며, 이러한 본 발명에 의해 실제짚을 이용한 초가가 1~2년에 한번씩 교체를 해줘야하는 것에 비하여 인조짚을 이용하므로 직사광선에 의해 쉽게 변색되지 않아 교체주기가 10년 이상으로 늘어나는 높은 내구성을 갖게 되며, 인조짚은 합성수지로 제조되므로 벌레가 끼지 않아 청결하고, 인조가공품으로 저렴한 비용으로 대량생산도 가능하며, 난연성(難燃性)을 갖도록 제작되므로 화재에서 취약한 실제짚에 비해 안정성이 높아지는 큰 효과가 있다. 상기의 효과를 갖는 인조짚을 처마부분에 두껍게 시공하므로 실제 초가지붕의 처마와 동일한 미감을 주어, 전통성을 살리면서 심미감도 향상시킬 수 있다. 세월이 흐름에 따라 처마에 설치된 인조짚이 아래로 처지는 것을 처마지지부가 받쳐 막아주므로 오랜시간 동일한 미감을 유지할 수 있게 된다. 또한 시공에 있어서 처마베이스부의 처마결합돌기에 걸림, 결합만 하면 되므로 설치가 신속하면서 극히 용이하며, 실무에도 쉽게 적용이 가능하다. 필요에 따라 교체도 용이하여 전체적으로 설치비와 제조비가 절감되는 등 다수의 효과를 기대할 수 있는 발명이다.

title_en: Foreign language learning method and device for implementing same
title_ko: 외국어 학습 방법 및 이를 실행하는 장치
abstract_en: A foreign language learning method according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a step of analyzing a script of first language voice data recorded in a first language, and respectively dividing, into specific units, first language data created in the first language and second language data obtained by translating the first language data into a second language; a step of allocating a different instruction number for each of the specific units; a step of respectively determining, in the first language voice data, the start time and the end time of playback of a sentence corresponding to an instruction number; and a step in which, for each of the specific units, a part of the first language data, a part of the second language data, and the start time and end time of the first language voice data which correspond to an instruction number are respectively associated with the relevant instruction number and saved in a database for learning the foreign language.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 외국어 학습 방법은 제1 언어로 녹음된 제1 언어 음성 데이터의 스크립트를 분석하여 상기 제1 언어로 작성된 제1 언어 데이터 및 상기 제1 언어 데이터를 제2 언어로 번역된 제2 언어 데이터 각각을 특정 단위로 구분하는 단계, 상기 특정 단위 별로 서로 다른 지시 번호를 할당하는 단계, 상기 제1 언어 음성 데이터에서 상기 지시 번호에 해당하는 문장이 재생되는 시작 시간 및 종료 시간을 각각 결정하는 단계 및 상기 특정 단위 별로 지시 번호에 해당하는 제1 언어 데이터의 일부분, 제2 언어 데이터의 일부분, 상기 제1 언어 음성 데이터의 시작 시간 및 종료 시간 각각을 해당 지시 번호와 대응시켜 외국어 학습용 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Kinect Sensor and IMU based Motion Tracking Method for Indoor Fire Hydrant Usage Training
title_ko: 옥내 소화전 사용 훈련을 위한 키넥트 센서 및 imu 기반 모션 트래킹 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a Kinect sensor for training an indoor fire hydrant and an IMU-based motion tracking system and method. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the motion tracking system comprises: a processor recognizing a motion of a mechanism from motion data generated by a motion sensor generating the motion data for the mechanism in a hand of a user; and a computing system tracking a motion of the user by fusing a recognition result of a motion recognition system recognizing the motion of the user through shooting and a recognition result of the motion sensor. Thus, the construction of the motion tracking system of a trainee using an indoor fire hydrant to support post-criticism and debriefing at a low cost is possible, robust motion tracking on occlusion of another arm by one arm is possible, and robust motion tracking for position errors in adjacent hands is possible.
abstract_ko: 옥내 소화전 사용 훈련을 위한 키넥트 센서 및 IMU 기반 모션 트래킹 시스템과 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 모션 트래킹 시스템은, 사용자가 손에 든 기구에 대한 모션 데이터들을 생성하는 모션 센서가 생성한 모션 데이터들로부터 기구의 모션을 인식하는 처리부 및 촬영을 통해 사용자의 모션을 인식하는 모션 인식 시스템의 인식 결과와 모션 센서의 인식 결과를 융합하여, 사용자의 모션을 트래킹하는 컴퓨팅 시스템을 포함한다. 이에 의해, 저비용으로 사후강평, 디브리핑을 지원하기 위한 옥내 소화전 사용 훈련자의 모션 트래킹 시스템 구축이 가능하며, 한 팔에 의한 다른 팔의 가려짐에 강건한 모션 트래킹이 가능하고, 인접한 양손의 위치 오류에 강건한 모션 트래킹이 가능하다.

title_en: Power distribution network disaster prevention backbone network frame planning method based on Steiner tree model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network disaster prevention backbone network frame planning method based on a Steiner tree model. The method comprises the steps that firstly, on the basis of meeting power supply of important users of the power distribution network under typical disaster conditions, a Steiner tree model of a disaster prevention backbone grid of the power distribution network is established on the basis of the fact that the construction cost and the disaster risk of lines and towers are minimum and on the basis of network connectivity constraint and tide constraint; and solving the optimization model by using a binary particle swarm algorithm to obtain an optimal backbone grid frame scheme, so as to realize power supply of the power grid to important users under disasters. The invention considers the comprehensive cost of differential reconstruction of the backbone network frame, ensures the power supply of the power grid to important loads in disaster and improves the power supply capability of the power grid under the disaster.

title_en: Multi-robot cooperative positioning and fusion image building method under air-ground multi-view angles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for cooperatively positioning and fusing and establishing images of multiple robots under space and ground multiple visual angles. And optimizing a three-dimensional point cloud map of a mapping and positioning system and a six-degree-of-freedom pose of the robot by specific visual features attached to the robot. The reconstruction and positioning accuracy is remarkably improved by the aid of a pose optimization and map fusion algorithm based on visual features, the map scale is corrected, local maps of all robots can be shared among a plurality of heterogeneous robots, the coverage rate of three-dimensional reconstruction is improved, and reliable environment information is rapidly provided for situations such as mission planning, disaster environment search and rescue, military counterterrorism and the like.

title_en: Reconstruction of Structural Section Using Waterproofing and Polishing Material of Ceramic Mortar
title_ko: 세라믹 몰탈 방수·방식 재료를 이용한 구조물 단면복구공법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a structure cross section restoration method using a waterproof and anti-corrosive material of ceramic mortar. The method comprises: a step (S10) of performing a penetrative coating on a cracked part of a cross section to be restored by using a hardener including 30-60 parts by weight of S.B.R latex, 20-40 parts by weight of E.V.A adhesive, 5-10 parts by weight of sodium bentonite, 4-8 parts by weight of acrylic adhesive, and 10-20 parts by weight of lactate based on 100 parts by weight of distilled water; a step (S20) of forming a primer layer by coating a cross section to be restored by using the hardener; a step (S30) of forming a restoration layer on the upper part of the primer layer by using a mortar mixture mixed with the hardener and a powder main substance including 80-120 parts by weight of jade powder, 150-250 parts by weight of silica sand, 40-60 parts by weight of silicate powder, 3-10 parts by weight of a vitric material, 1-3 parts by weight of earth, 3-10 parts by weight of methylcellulose, 3-10 parts by weight of microfiber, 5-15 of steel slag, and 0.1-0.5 part by weight of pigment based on 100 parts by weight of Portland cement; and a step (S40) of forming a finishing layer by coating the upper part of the restoration layer with the hardener. The method of the present invention increases durability such as corrosion resistance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 증류수 100중량부에 대해 S.B.R 라텍스 30 내지 60중량부, E.V.A 접착제 20 내지 40중량부, 소디움벤조나이트 5 내지 10중량부, 아크릴계점착제 4 내지 8중량부, 유산소다 10 내지 20중량부를 포함하는 경화재를 이용하여 복구될 단면의 균열부위에 침투도장을 하는 단계(S10); 상기 경화재를 이용하여 복구될 단면을 도장하여 프라이머층을 형성하는 단계(S20); 포오틀랜드 시멘트 100중량부에 대해 옥 파우더 80 내지 120중량부, 규사 150 내지 250중량부, 규석분 40 내지 60중량부, 유리질 3 내지 10중량부, 회토류 1 내지 3중량부, 메틸셀로우즈 3 내지 10중량부, 마이크로섬유 3 내지 10중량부, 스틸슬래그 5 내지 15중량부, 안료 0.1 내지 0.5중량부를 포함하는 파우더주재와 상기 경화재를 혼합한 혼합몰탈을 이용하여 상기 프라이머층 상부에 복구층을 형성하는 단계(S30); 상기 복구층의 상부에 상기 경화재를 도포하여 마감층을 형성하는 단계(S40);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 세라믹 몰탈 방수·방식 재료를 이용한 구조물 단면복구공법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for pushing video content
abstract_en: Disclosed are a video content push method and apparatus, the method comprising: when a primary disaster recovery system of a video recommendation service fails, activating a standby disaster recovery system; receiving a video access request sent by an application client, and invoking first historical video content stored in middleware and obtained from historical video recommendations of the video recommendation service according to a preset proportion; pushing the first historical video content to the application client for playback. The method removes the dependence of recovery on other services, so that a recovery solution is more robust, thereby increasing the stability of video content pushing.
assignees: BEIJING MICROLIVE VISION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resource allocation and network reconstruction optimization method for improving resilience of elastic power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a resource allocation and network reconstruction optimization method for improving the resilience of an elastic power distribution network, which comprises the steps of inputting the structural parameters of the power distribution network and the original data of loads and photovoltaic dispatching cycles; inputting upper optimization variables: initializing parameters of distributed power supply access position and capacity, tie line connecting node position, population scale and particle swarm with maximum iteration times; inputting a lower-layer optimization variable: initializing parameters of a switching state of a contact switch, an extreme disaster scene, a population scale and iteration times; performing optimal configuration on the elastic resources according to the upper-layer elastic resource optimal configuration model to obtain an optimal configuration result with optimal economy and maximum resilience; and according to the upper-layer optimized configuration result, executing a lower-layer network reconstruction optimization model by utilizing a PSO algorithm, and optimizing the switching state of the lower-layer network reconstruction interconnection switch to obtain a reconstruction result with the maximum resilience. The method and the system improve the restoring force of the elastic power distribution network after the extreme disaster accident, and guide power distribution network planning and operation management departments to carry out scientific planning.

title_en: The appraisal procedure of urban air-quality based on social network media data
