abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of appraisal procedures of urban air-quality based on social network media data, first using social network media data as data source, data relevant to urban air pollution are extracted from historical data therein, corresponding monitoring data are obtained from air quality monitoring point simultaneously, wherein, the acquisition of urban air pollution related data obtains in terms of the description of the direct environment air of user and contamination accident describe two, and with Environment Pollution Event type, rasterizing city position, social media attribute factor is that reconstruct is guided, it is reconstructed into the multi-modal urban air pollution elementary event data with complete semantic function；Then the urban air pollution event correlation extracted in social network media data is quantized to urban air-quality；The last correlation model according to urban air pollution event and air quality assesses urban air-quality.The present invention solves the problems, such as that existing urban air pollution event monitoring technology is deficient.

title_en: Rock mass acoustic emission signal feature extraction method based on variational mode reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock mass acoustic emission signal characteristic extraction method based on variational mode reconstruction. The extraction method comprises the steps of firstly, collecting rock acoustic emission signals; combining a variational mode decomposition algorithm with a correlation coefficient to provide a selection principle of an effective component, extracting the effective component through the selection principle, reconstructing the effective component, and further extracting an effective acoustic emission signal under strong background noise; then dividing the stress-strain curve into four stages according to the change of the elastic modulus: and finally, respectively extracting waveform parameter characteristics, time domain characteristics, frequency domain characteristics and entropy characteristics of the acoustic emission reconstruction signals at four stages. The method can accurately extract the waveform parameter characteristics, time domain characteristics, frequency domain characteristics and entropy characteristics of the emission signals, provides basis for on-site observation and prediction of the damage degree of the rock mass structure, and further effectively prevents related natural disasters.

title_en: A system that shares image with location of fire place and position of fire extinguisher when a fire occurs
title_ko: 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for sharing a position and an image of an occurrence place and a fire extinguisher when a fire occurs capable of quickly taking an initial action against fire occurrence. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a user device held by members in a large-scale industrial facility, operated by execution of user operation of a first finder to propagate fire occurrence situation information when a fire occurs, and enabling each member to share the propagated fire occurrence situation information with each other; and a service control server receiving the fire occurrence situation information of the first finder to provide fire occurrence position information and map information including location information of a fire facility based on location information of the user device of the first finder.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템으로서, 대규모 공장이나 여러 개의 구획으로 구성되는 대규모 산업시설에서의 구성원들이 휴대하며, 화재발생 시에 최초 발견자의 사용자 조작 실행에 따라 구동되어 화재발생 상황 정보를 전파하고, 각 구성원들이 전파되는 화재발생 상황 정보를 공유하는 사용자 디바이스; 및 상기 사용자 디바이스와 무선통신 방식으로 연동하며, 최초 발견자의 화재발생 상황 정보를 수신하여 그에 대응하는 화재발생 초기 대응이 가능하도록 화재발생 최초 발견자의 사용자 디바이스의 위치 정보에 기초한 화재발생 위치 정보와 소방시설의 위치 정보가 포함된 맵 정보를 제공하는 서비스 관제서버를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템에 따르면, 대규모 산업시설의 구성원들이 휴대하는 사용자 디바이스를 통해 특정 앱을 실행하는 상태에서, 화재발생을 최초 발견한 구성원이 화재발생 사실을 나머지 구성원들과 공유할 수 있도록 구성함으로써, 대규모 산업시설에서 발생되는 화재발생에 대한 신속한 초기대응이 가능하고, 그에 따른 화재 확산을 막아 2차적인 인명 및 재산 피해가 최소화될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 특정 앱을 실행하는 사용자 디바이스들 간에 화재발생을 전파하여 서로 공유하되, 화재발생을 최초 발견하여 전파한 구성원의 사용자 디바이스의 위치 정보를 기반으로 정확한 화재발생 장소와 근처의 소방시설의 위치를 건물의 도면 맵 정보로 제공하고, 그에 따른 화재발생 초기에 성공적인 화재진압 대처가 가능하도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 화재 최초 발견자가 특정 앱의 동영상 촬영 및 음성 기능을 이용하여 특정 앱을 공유하는 구성원들이 화재현장으로 도우러 오면서 현장상황을 정확하게 파악하며 올 수 있도록 초기 화재현장을 지속적으로 전파할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for providing fire information with lifesaving information in fire management system
title_ko: 화재 관리 시스템에서의 인명구조정보를 포함하는 화재정보 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing fire information including lifesaving information in a fire management system to facilitate fire extinguishing. According to the present invention, the method for providing fire information including lifesaving information comprises: a first step of monitoring whether fire outbreak information is received; a second step of determining whether a sound source of a collected speech is a previously registered rescue speech; a third step of generating rescue speech data; a fourth step of providing a control terminal with fire information including lifesaving data and the fire outbreak information; and a fifth step of requesting the fire management server to generate fire status information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 정보와 함께 화재 현장에 위치하는 사람에 대한 상태정보를 제공함으로써, 화재 발생시 화재 진압을 용이하게 함과 더불어, 화재 현장의 인명 구조를 극대화할 수 있도록 해 주는 기술에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 화재 관리 시스템에서의 인명구조정보를 포함하는 화재정보 제공방법은, 스마트 어댑터에서 화재 감지정보를 포함하는 화재 발생정보가 수신되는지를 감시하는 제1 단계와, 스마트 어댑터에서 주변 음성 신호를 수집하고, 수집된 음성의 음원이 기 등록된 구난 음성인지를 판단하는 제2 단계, 스마트 어댑터에서 상기 제1 단계에서 화재 발생정보가 수신되거나 또는 상기 제2 단계에서 구난 음성이 수신된 경우, 이후 수신되는 구난 음성에 대하여 구난자의 억양, 톤, 떨림, 빠르기 중 적어도 하나 이상을 포함하는 음성패턴 데이터를 생성하고, 해당 음원과 음성패턴 데이터를 포함하는 구난음성데이터를 생성하는 제3 단계, 스마트 어댑터에서 자신의 어댑터 코드와 적어도 하나 이상의 서로 다른 구난 음성에 대한 구난음성데이터를 포함하는 구난인명데이터를 생성하고, 이 구난인명 데이터와 화재 발생정보를 포함하는 화재정보를 제어단말로 제공하는 제4 단계 및, 제어 단말에서 스마트 어댑터로부터 제공되는 화재 정보를 분석하여 화재 발생 현황을 예측함과 더불어, 구난인명데이터를 근거로 구난자 수와 구난자 이동 현황을 추정하고, 구난인명정보를 포함하는 화재현황정보를 생성하여 화재 관리 서버로 제공하거나, 또는 스마트 어댑터로부터 제공되는 화재 정보를 화재 관리 서버로 제공하여 화재 관리 서버에서 화재현황정보를 생성하도록 요청하는 제5 단계를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Intelligent fire prevention and extinguishing alarm device and method for roast chicken storage warehouse
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire prevention and extinguishing alarm device and method for a roast chicken storage warehouse, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent fire prevention and alarm. The fire early warning function is realized, early warning can be realized, the concept that the early warning and prevention are larger than the post-disaster reconstruction is realized, and the centralized and rapid fire extinguishing function of the fire-proof and fire-extinguishing warning device is realized.

title_en: The recognition methods of urban air pollution event in social network media data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of recognition methods of urban air pollution event in social network media data, first using social network media data as data source, data relevant to urban air pollution are extracted from historical data therein, wherein, the acquisition of urban air pollution related data obtains in terms of the description of the direct environment air of user and contamination accident describe two, and guided with Environment Pollution Event type, rasterizing city position, social media attribute for reconstruct, it is reconstructed into the multi-modal urban air pollution elementary event data with complete semantic function；Then urban air pollution event recognition index set is extracted from social network media data；It is last that the urban air pollution event in social network media data is identified according to urban air pollution important monitored data analysis.The present invention solves the problems, such as that existing urban air pollution event monitoring technology is deficient.

title_en: Playback method and system based on the network direct broadcasting of HLS protocol after fault recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of playback method and system based on the network direct broadcasting of HLS protocol after fault recovery, it is related to the downloading of HLS protocol Streaming Media and plays field.The step of this method includes: client requests M3U8 list to local to server-side, includes the duration of several TS fragments and each TS fragment in M3U8 list；Client downloads TS fragment according to local M3U8 list；The TS fragment of downloading is decoded and is shown by client；Client regularly updates local M3U8 list；After network failure and network disaster recovery occurs, client, which obtains, needs the duration T3 for the TS fragment downloaded to update local M3U8 list if T-T4 >=T3, and wherein T represents network failure generation duration, and T4 represents client download requests duration.The present invention can save the time-consuming expense of unnecessary request, quickly restore to play as far as possible with this, and then improve user experience.

title_en: A kind of monitoring system, monitoring method and method for early warning for coal mine roadway country rock disaster

title_en: Consistency group restoration from a secondary site
abstract_en: Techniques for replay of groups of I/Os for disaster recovery. At a primary site, a plurality of primary site computing entities that are to be restored from the secondary computing site after a disaster recovery event are identified as belonging to an entity group. At the primary site, I/O commands that are performed over any of the entities of the entity group are observed and streamed to the secondary site, where they are persisted into a log. Periodically, the primary site sends the secondary site an I/O map that associates a time with an indication of the last performed I/O commands pertaining to any observed I/O commands that had been performed over any one or more of the computing entities of the entity group. Upon receiving a disaster recovery request, the most recent I/O map and the secondary site log are processed to construct a snapshot for the entity group.

title_en: Virtual machine rapid evacuation method based on disaster early warning time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly evacuating virtual machines based on disaster early warning time, and belongs to the technical field of cloud computing. Aiming at the serious threat of a large-scale disaster to physical nodes of a backbone network, the method reconstructs and evacuates the threatened virtual network and related nodes thereof according to disaster early warning time, the memory size of the virtual machine and the downtime of the virtual machine. The method adopts a post-copy migration technology, allocates the optimal evacuation path and initial bandwidth for the virtual machine to be evacuated under the migration flow balance principle, dynamically adjusts the bandwidth on the evacuation path according to the network resource condition, and maximizes the evacuation completion rate of the virtual machine within the early warning time.

title_en: Debris flow prediction method based on PCA and mixed kernel function LSSVR
abstract_en: The debris flow prediction method based on PCA and mixed kernel function LSSVR comprises the steps of firstly, establishing a debris flow monitoring and early warning system, obtaining influence factors of initial debris flow disaster occurrence, and reducing the dimension of the obtained initial influence factors through PCA; secondly, constructing a mixed kernel function LSSVR debris flow disaster model by using the initial influence factors after dimensionality reduction; then, optimizing the established mixed kernel function LSSVR debris flow disaster model by using a whale algorithm to obtain optimized combined model parameters; and finally, reconstructing a mixed kernel function LSSVR debris flow disaster model by using the obtained combination model parameters, and outputting a debris flow occurrence prediction result. The method disclosed by the invention greatly reduces the complexity of the model structure and prevents dimension disasters; and a mixed kernel function mechanism is introduced to balance the learning capability and the generalization capability of the model, so that the prediction accuracy is improved.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a language learning device and a control method thereof. The device comprises: a storage unit for storing vocal cord vibration start time corresponding to each word; a rhythm selecting unit for selecting a learning rhythm; a learning target selecting unit for selecting at least one word as a learning target word according to a request of a user; an extraction unit for extracting the vocal cord vibration start time corresponding to each of the learning target words selected by the learning target selecting unit from the storage unit; and a playback processing unit for controlling a pronunciation voice signal corresponding to each of the learning target words to be played back in a predetermined order according to the learning rhythm selected by the rhythm selecting unit and reflecting the vocal cord vibration start time corresponding to each of the learning target words extracted by the extraction unit at a playback start time of each pronunciation voice signal. Thus, the present invention can increase efficiency of language learning.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 언어 학습을 위한 장치 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 언어 학습 처리 장치는, 각 단어에 대응되는 성대 진동 시작 시간을 저장한 저장부와; 학습 리듬을 선정하는 리듬 선정부와; 사용자의 요청에 따라 적어도 하나의 단어를 학습 대상 단어로 선정하는 학습 대상 선정부와; 상기 학습 대상 선정부에 의해 선정된 학습 대상 단어 각각에 대응되는 성대 진동 시작 시간을 상기 저장부로부터 추출하는 추출부와; 상기 학습 대상 단어 각각에 대응되는 발음 음성 신호가 상기 리듬 선정부에서 선정한 학습 리듬에 맞춰 기 설정된 순서대로 재생되도록 제어하되, 상기 추출부에서 추출한 각 학습 대상 단어에 대응되는 성대 진동 시작 시간이 각 발음 음성 신호의 재생 시작 시점에 반영되도록 하는 재생 처리부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Data replication disaster recovery method and disaster recovery system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of disaster recovery, and discloses a data replication disaster recovery method and a disaster recovery system. The method comprises the following steps: returning a write completion to respond to the next data write request after synchronously writing the data write request to the production server and the emergency server; the data corresponding to the data writing request is asynchronously written into the production server and the disaster recovery server, and the data writing conditions on the production server and the disaster recovery server during asynchronous data writing are synchronously recorded into the production server and the emergency server; when the reconstruction condition is met, the disaster recovery server reconstructs data consistent with the production server according to asynchronously written data, a data writing request acquired from the emergency server and a data writing condition. The embodiment of the invention can greatly improve the usability of the data disaster recovery copy while ensuring the reliability of the data disaster recovery copy.

title_en: Collection of crash data using autonomous or semi-autonomous drones
abstract_en: A system for collecting vehicle crash data at a vehicle crash site of a vehicle crash is provided. The system may include an emergency response unit that includes an emergency response vehicle and an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) that is automatically deployed from the emergency response vehicle at the vehicle crash site. The UAV may be an autonomous or semi-autonomous drone, and include a processor, memory, and sensor, wherein the sensor collects vehicle crash data (such as image, video, or audio) at the crash site. The system may include a remote computing device and an insurance computing device to process the vehicle crash data collected by the UAV and/or initiate a crash insurance claim. The vehicle crash data may be used for one or more insurance-related purposes or activities, such as handling, adjusting, or generating auto or homeowners insurance claims; crash reconstruction; fault determination; damaged vehicle repair; and/or buildup identification.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Wireless fire alarm system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wireless fire alarm system and a method thereof. Unlike existing wired communications of automated fire detection equipment including a detector, a transmitter, a repeater, and a receiver in the field of firefighting, provided is the wireless fire alarm system, in which a state of a temperature (heat) flame combustion product (smoke such as a toxic gas) or the like is immediately sensed through a wireless detector (A) for recognizing the fire or any accident situation first, and then a fire detection signal of the wireless detector (A) and a button signal or a voice signal of a wired/wireless transmitter (D) are immediately transmitted to other devices such as a repeater, a receiver, or the like through wireless communication, while the signals are automatically connected and transmitted to an external institution such as a fire station or the like through a wireless repeater and a wireless receiver based on a starting point of the wireless detector or the wired/wireless transmitter. Accordingly, by quickly responding to various disasters and accidents such as fire, gas explosion accidents or the like through 119 reports and emergency dispatch of fire trucks, ambulances or the like, lots of lives can be rescued from the fire, smoke, toxic gas or the like in a fire scene, and property damage can be significantly reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선 화재경보시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 소방분야에서 기존의 감지기  발신기  중계기  수신기를 포함하는 자동화재 탐지설비의 유선통신(有線通信)과 달리, 화재나 어떤 사고발생 상황을 가장 먼저 인지하는 무선감지기(A)를 통하여 온도(열)  불꽃  연소생성물(유독가스 등의 연기) 등의 상태를 즉각 감지한 후 무선감지기(A)의 화재감지신호 및 유무선발신기(D)의 버튼신호 또는 음성신호를 무선통신(無線通信)을 통해 중계기 및 수신기 등의 타 기기로 곧 바로 전송토록 하는 한편, 이러한 무선감지기 또는 유무선발신기를 출발점으로 해서 무선중계기 및 무선수신기를 거쳐 소방서 등의 외부기관으로 자동적으로 연계 전송토록 하는 무선 화재경보시스템을 제공하며, 이를 통해 119 신고와 소방차 및 구급차 등의 긴급출동을 통해 화재와 가스폭발사고 등 다양한 재난 안전사고에 신속히 대응하도록 함으로써 화재현장에서 화염과 연기, 유독가스 등에 의해 많은 인명을 구조함과 아울러 재산피해를 현저히 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of barnacle body house wall reinforcement means
abstract_en: The present invention relates to building strengthening technical fields, and in particular to a kind of barnacle body house wall reinforcement means avoids the reconstruction of the dismounting to former stone structure, will not damage to original structure；It is bound using steel tie fixed steel bars net through walls and with steel mesh secured, make to form framework of steel reinforcement on the inside of stone structure wall, so that wall and steel mesh can common stress, greatly improve the intensity and shock resistance of stone structure wall, further improve the globality of wall, the deformation performance of shearing resistance, the bending resistance of stone structure wall, and construction is simple, economical rationality can be improved well；Wall puzzle joint substantially increases the plumpness and aesthetics of puzzle joint using the method for " first jointing, grouting behind shaft or drift lining "；Reduce personnel caused by the disasters such as earthquake, typhoon and property loss, increase the service life in house, more safe and reliable living environment is provided for peasant.
assignees: UNIV FUJIAN TECHNOLOGY;FUJIAN QIANYE CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;FUZHOU JINGYAN ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for monitoring the scene of fire
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a system for monitoring the scene of a fire and a method thereof capable of understanding conditions with respect to each firefighter on the scene of a fire and managing the personal history while being capable of monitoring the scene of the fire. According to the present invention, the monitoring system comprises: a first terminal enabling mutual communication; a second terminal communicating with the first terminal; and a server communicating with the second terminal. The first terminal obtains position information and condition information from a sensor located inside. The second terminal receives the position information and condition information from the first terminal and monitors operations of the first terminal based on the position information and condition information. The server receives and manages monitoring information with respect to the operations of the first terminal from the second terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 상호 통신 가능한 제1 단말기, 상기 제1 단말기와 통신 가능한 제2 단말기, 및 상기 제2 단말기와 통신 가능한 서버를 포함하는 모니터링 시스템에 있어서, 상기 제1 단말기는, 내부에 구비된 센서로부터 위치정보 및 상태정보를 획득하고; 상기 제2 단말기는, 상기 제1 단말기로부터 위치정보 및 상태정보를 수신하고, 상기 위치정보 및 상태정보를 기초로 제1 단말기의 동작을 모니터링하고; 상기 서버는, 상기 제2 단말기로부터 상기 제1 단말기의 동작에 대한 모니터링정보를 수신하여 관리한다.

title_en: Motor vehicle accident analysis method based on uncertainty theory and genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The motor vehicle accident analysis method based on uncertainty theory and genetic algorithm that the invention discloses a kind of, the method reproduce scene when accident occurs for reduction motor vehicle by Data Management Analysis.This method passes through the collected data in the scene of the accident first and establishes speed prediction model, uncertain for input parameter carries out speed uncertainty evaluation, obtain the value interval of car crass speed, whether exceed the speed limit for accurate judgement automobile, optimum collision speed is solved with genetic Optimization Algorithm, finally combines Computer Simulation and injury of human contrast verification.Computational accuracy and reliability can be improved in automobile and electric bicycle accident reconstruction in the present invention, it to accident responsibility judgement and traffic accident prevention important in inhibiting, while may be that automobile and electric bicycle manufacturer provide fundamental basis in safety Design, provide reference frame for establishing and improve for traffic safety relevant laws and regulations.

title_en: A kind of smog root node detection method under remote complex environment based on MSER
abstract_en: The invention belongs to forest fire protection and video object detection field more particularly to a kind of remote mist source root node detection methods based on video.The present invention first pre-processes video image, and preprocessing process is the execution of two kinds of filtering algorithms.Secondly the rejecting to pretreated image progress chaff interferent is completed, rejecting process include that the convex closure of all kinds of coordinate points after progress angle point calculating, the automatic cluster division of angle point and automatic cluster calculates.Then recombination is split to image, convex closure area pixel is found out in original image, and it is substituted with [0,0,0] rgb pixel value.Next the extracted region based on MSER+ algorithm is carried out to reconstructed picture, and finds the connected domain alternative point in each region MSER.It is calculated finally, the MSER alternative point of continuous multiple frames image is carried out the statistics of the radius based on Euclidean distance, searches out the region within the scope of specified circumference comprising multiple alternative points, and calculate the pixel level position of smog root according to the alternative point in region.

title_en: Foundation and satellite-borne radar precipitation data fusion method based on wavelet domain regularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground and satellite-borne radar precipitation data fusion method based on wavelet domain regularization. The fusion process of the invention considers the uncertainty of precipitation estimation of different sensors and the wavelet domain statistical characteristics of precipitation data, and the fusion result reduces the uncertainty of a single sensor, and simultaneously can better maintain and reconstruct the detail characteristics of strong precipitation extreme value, small-scale change and the like, thereby being more beneficial to monitoring and forecasting the strong disaster weather such as flood monitoring and the like.

title_en: Tunnel fire-fighting system based on DTU and safety control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel fire-fighting system based on a DTU and a safety control method thereof. Introducing DTU equipment into a tunnel fire-fighting system, wherein the DTU equipment is novel equipment based on the technology of the Internet of things, namely, the equipment can be networked, and meanwhile, programming control connection equipment is written; embedding a SIM card on the DTU to enable a corresponding server to communicate with the DTU; and all communication ports on the market are supported, and communication can be realized through interfaces and protocols provided by the PLC. And the brand models of the PLC or the controller adopted by the fire protection systems of a plurality of tunnels are different, the program of the PLC or the controller is not standard, even the control requirement cannot be met, and the reconstruction cost is increased, so that the program based on the DTU equipment is necessary to standardize all tunnel system programs, the cost is reduced by unified management, and the water quantity of a high reservoir is ensured to be sufficient by comprehensive monitoring.

title_en: A kind of pulse earthquake motion analogy method based on focal fault model
abstract_en: The pulse earthquake motion analogy method based on focal fault model that the invention discloses a kind of.The present invention is based on pulsedly vibration data libraries, in conjunction with the mountain relief effect model of pulse ground motion attenuation laws and foundation, by earthquake synthesis technology pulse earthquake motion time history can be produced according to grid in survey region, quantitative expression is carried out to pulse earthquake motion using pulse quantitative method, it is proposed the artificial replay method of pulse earthquake motion, it is provided for Related Research Domain and enriches reasonable artificial pulse earthquake motion, Research foundation is established, the assessment etc. for disaster after the perfect and shake of earthquake resistant design code provides data support.

title_en: Three-dimensional reconstruction method based on half-peak probability density distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional reconstruction based on half-peak probability density distributionThe method comprises the following steps: slicing the three-dimensional point cloud along the Z-axis direction to obtain N spatial layers; extracting scatter information in the ith space layer and projecting the scatter information to Z i A plane; construction of Z i Drawing a three-dimensional probability density graph by using membership functions of each grid and each scatter point of a plane; over three-dimensional probability density map half-peak value w max/2 Making a plane parallel to the XOY plane, and intersecting the three-dimensional probability density map to obtain a contour L XY The contour L XY Reconstructing a contour for a radiation source corresponding to the ith spatial layer; and sequentially superposing the radioactive source reconstruction outlines corresponding to the N spatial layers to obtain a radioactive source three-dimensional reconstruction model. The method can be applied to the field of nuclear power, and can realize the rapid reconstruction of the radioactive source and the accurate reconstruction of the outline of the retired radioactive source after nuclear accidents occur.

title_en: Method of reconstructing block wall insufficient in strength into fence, and metal fitting used for same method
abstract_en: To provide a method of reconstructing a block wall insufficient in strength into a fence as the block wall insufficient in strength may collapse in a case of an earthquake etc., to cause such a disaster that a passerby is caught under the block wall.SOLUTION: A method of reconstructing a block wall into a fence according to the present invention includes: taking down the block wall 3 except its substrate concrete base 2; and fitting a fixed member 12 having a vertical reinforcement 10 and a fence strut fixture 11 in a hole 8 of the left substrate concrete base 2. The fence strut fixture 11 is fitted in a cavity 15 of a fence strut 13 to install the fence strut 13, and a reinforcing member 17 for a fence plate 18 is inserted into a lengthwise groove 16 that the fence strut 13 has to install the fence 19.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5a

title_en: System and method for detecting diffusion dynamic deflagration temperature of combustible dust cloud cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection system and a detection method for combustible dust cloud diffusion dynamic deflagration temperature. The invention adopts a dust deflagration temperature sensor, a temperature conduction sensitive element, a sensor support piece, an integrated processing circuit and a computer; the method can accurately measure the deflagration temperature of the combustible dust in real time, realize the reconstruction of a temperature field, reduce and prevent the occurrence of accidental explosion events of the combustible dust, and reduce the serious damage, casualties and economic loss to the surrounding environment; the method realizes the property identification and damage consequence evaluation of the dust explosion event and aims to solve the difficulty in engineering measurement; according to the invention, the relation expression of the ultrasonic speed and the deflagration temperature is established according to the speed change of the temperature conduction sensitive element and the pulse ultrasonic wave in the propagation of the temperature conduction sensitive element and the pulse ultrasonic wave, so that the real-time dynamic determination of the dust diffusion deflagration temperature is realized, and the method has objective application value and research value.

title_en: A can of air compression
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air compression can, capable of reducing purchase costs as well as solving the inconvenience of re-purchase. The air compression can of the present invention comprises: a sealed container body for storing compressed air; an air discharge tube for discharging the compressed air; a pressure gage for measuring and displaying the compressed air; and a compression pump device unit operated to inject the compressed air into the sealed container body.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공기 압축 캔에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 공기 압축 캔으로서, 사용자가 산소 호흡에 사용할 수 있도록 내부에 압축된 공기를 저장하는 밀폐용기 본체; 상기 밀폐용기 본체의 상단 일 측면에 체결되어, 상기 밀폐용기 본체의 내부에 압축된 공기를 사용자가 산소 호흡에 사용할 수 있도록 압축된 공기를 토출하는 공기 배출 관; 상기 밀폐용기 본체의 상단 일 측면에 체결되어, 상기 밀폐용기 본체의 내부에 압축된 공기를 측정하여 표시하는 압력 게이지; 및 상기 밀폐용기 본체의 상부 면을 통해 외부 공기를 흡입하여 상기 밀폐용기 본체의 내부로 압축된 공기가 주입될 수 있도록 작동하는 압축펌프 장치부를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 공기 압축 캔에 따르면, 밀폐용기 본체와 공기 배출 관과 압력 게이지 및 압축펌프 장치부를 포함하는 공기 압축 캔을 구성함으로써, 밀폐용기 본체에 압축된 공기를 편리하게 흡입 사용함은 물론, 압력 게이지 상태에 따라 사용자가 수시로 공기를 압축 주입하여 재사용할 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 압축펌프 장치부를 이용한 사용자의 펌핑 조작에 따라 외부 공기를 수시로 압축하여 밀폐용기 본체에 저장할 수 있도록 구성함으로써, 기존의 휴대용 산소 캔이 한 번 쓰고 버려짐에 따라 발생되는 폐기물 증가 및 자원의 낭비를 줄여 주고, 특히 사용자의 재구매의 번거로움 해소와 함께 구매 비용이 절감될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 휴대형으로 물속 호흡의 물놀이, 화재현장은 물론, 정화조와 같은 공기 질이 나쁜 다양한 작업 현장에서 먼지 마스크와 결합해서 편리하게 사용할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: System for Instructional visual content using Automatically convert images from electronic documents
title_ko: 전자문서의 이미지 자동변환을 통한 강의영상 컨텐츠 제작시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for producing lecture video content using automatic image conversion for electronic documents. More specifically, the present invention relates to the system for producing lecture video content using automatic image conversion for electronic documents, which enables everybody to easily produce a video without expertise on video editing and enables lecture materials and lecture videos to be automatically edited at the same time, thereby being used for lecture production in various fields such as public safety, broadcasting, education, and culture. To this end, the system for producing lecture video content using automatic image conversion for electronic documents comprises: a template selection unit enabling a user to select one or more templates from a template DB in which a plurality of templates including different layout methods and designs for inserting lecture videos and lecture materials are stored; a registration unit divided into a first registration unit for registering lecture videos and a second registration unit for registering lecture materials and registering the lecture videos and materials in the divided first and second registration units, respectively; a conversion unit, when the lecture videos and the lecture materials are registered by the registration unit, detecting a file format of the registered materials and converting the materials into an image file format which can be used for video editing through at least one conversion process according to the file format; a position setting unit arranging at least one image file converted by the conversion unit in order to correspond the content of the same to playback sections of the lecture videos; and a rendering unit generating lecture video content by encoding the file edited by the position setting unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전자문서의 이미지 자동변환을 통한 강의영상 컨텐츠 제작시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 영상 편집에 관한 전문지식이 없어도 누구나 손쉽게 영상을 제작할 수 있도록 하며, 강의자료와 강의영상을 동시에 자동편집할 수 있어 공공안전, 방송, 교육, 문화 등 다양한 분야의 강의제작 시에 활용될 수 있도록 하는 전자문서의 이미지 자동변환을 통한 강의영상 컨텐츠 제작시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해, 본 발명은 강의영상 및 강의자료를 삽입하기 위한 각기 다른 배치방식과 디자인으로 구성된 복수 개의 템플릿이 저장된 템플릿 DB로부터 어느 하나 이상의 템플릿을 선택할 수 있도록 하는 템플릿 선택부; 강의영상을 등록하는 제1 등록부와 강의자료를 등록하는 제2 등록부로 분리되어 구성되고, 각기 분리되어 구성된 제1 등록부와 제2 등록부에 각각의 강의영상 및 강의자료를 탑재하도록 하는 등록부; 등록부에 의해 강의영상 및 강의자료가 등록되면 탑재된 자료의 파일형식을 검출하여 파일형식에 따라 적어도 1회 이상의 변환과정을 거쳐 영상편집에 이용할 수 있는 이미지 파일형태로 변환처리하는 변환부; 변환부에 의해 변환된 적어도 하나 이상의 이미지 파일을 강의영상의 재생구간에 따라 그 내용이 대응되도록 배치시키는 위치설정부; 위치설정부에 의해 편집된 파일을 인코딩하여 강의영상 컨텐츠를 생성하는 렌더링부를 포함하는 전자문서의 이미지 자동변환을 통한 강의영상 컨텐츠 제작시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: High resolution image houseclearing based on BFD-IGA-SVM model quickly supervises identification
abstract_en: The present invention discloses the high resolution image houseclearing based on BFD-IGA-SVM model and quickly supervises identification, on the basis of building construction target signature system, pass through multi-scale division, construct the object of high-resolution remote sensing image, imaged object is the carrier of feature and knowledge representation, accurate to construct the basis that imaged object is succeeding target identification；Characteristic variable is extracted, by combining ReliefF algorithm, genetic algorithm and supporting vector machine model, feature is optimized and preferably, forms house optimal feature subset；The character subset optimal to house carries out houseclearing extraction and identification, and its sensitivity is compared with correlation technique.The application precision with higher and good robustness, greatly improve buildings extraction efficiency, for houseclearing rapidly extracting live after calamity, have good application value, critically important information support is played to post-disaster reconstruction and Quick rescue.

title_en: A kind of emergency water purification car
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of emergency water purification car, including vehicle-mounted box, and cabinet is successively arranged generator bay, control equipment compartment and purifier cabin from cockpit to tailstock direction；Generator bay is equipped with generator and generator maintenance door, and clothing issue room is equipped with above generator, and clothing issue room is equipped with storing hatch door；It controls equipment compartment and is equipped with equipment enclosure, air conditioner integrated machine, air-conditioner air outlet, maintenance door, entrance door and preceding getting-on ladder；Purifier cabin is equipped with water purification equipment, exhaust fan, water outlet water inlet, tilt-up door, upper water and sewage door, electric heater, purifier cabin and generator bay and is separated by partition wall, and partition wall is equipped with partition door, and the passageway in purifier cabin is disposed with floating drum.The utility model has vehicle-mounted power generating source system, can satisfy in face of emergency event and serious the condition of a disaster and heavy post-disaster reconstruction mission requirements, can quickly set out, and reaches designated position, and carry out the work rapidly.

title_en: Integrated registration and display system based on underground space and ground characteristics on electronic map based on intelligent monitoring of safety incident response
title_ko: 안전사고 대응 지능형 모니터링에 따른 전자지도상에 지하공간 및 지반특성치 기반의 통합 등록 및 표출 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated registration and display system based on an underground space and ground characteristics on an electronic map by intelligent monitoring of an accident response and, more specifically, to a method which analyzes and processes existing public data and user-defined data for a disaster accident linked to an underground space and ground to display the data on a geography-based electronic map to increase social recognition and prevent disasters, and is required for emergency responses when disasters occur. The present invention contributes to a wide range of algorithms to effectively enforce a special act on underground safety management, reproduces underground water behavior in a real aquifer by creating a model suitable for an aquifer of a target area, and provides two-dimensional and three-dimensional data devoted to reality during numerical analysis of underground modeling for predicting changes of an underground water system which can occur in the future. Content of the system and the method which can be variously accessed and used by ordinary people and experts can be widely provided in two-dimensional and three-dimensional forms for the underground space and the ground in cooperation with internet portal businesses.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안전사고 대응 지능형 모니터링에 따른 전자지도상에 지하공간 및 지반특성치 기반의 통합 등록 및 표출 시스템으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 지하공간 및 지반과 결부되어 발생되는 재난안전사고에 대하여 기존의 공공데이터 및 사용자정의 데이터를 분석가공하여 지리학적 기반의 전자지도상에 표출함으로서 사회적 인식 증대와 더불어 재난의 사전예방 및 재난발생시 긴급대응에 필요한 방법을 제시한다.

title_en: Urban architecture fire spalling degree Prediction System and application based on Internet of Things and BIM
abstract_en: The present invention relates to urban architecture fire spalling degree Prediction Systems and application based on Internet of Things and BIM.The invention includes: the Visualized Urban Outer Prestress BIM buildings model, embedded-type sensor, the explosion risk analysis model based on BIM technology.Concrete construction model is established by BIM first, assigns construction material attribute information in a model；It is associated with BIM model by the collected temperature and humidity information of the embedded-type sensor being arranged in building, carry out real-time update, storage；By burst risk evaluation model data are extracted and are analyzed, and by analysis result pass back in BIM model, in a model display alarm information and reach explosion required time；Finally it can determine that position occurs for explosion by model orientation.The present invention, which is beneficial in that, to predict the explosion risk of concrete after fire generation, and can estimate the explosion time of concrete, and the position that will be burst is accurately positioned out.Technical support is provided for Post disaster relief feasibility, and provides reference to building post-disaster reconstruction.
assignees: HEBEI BUILDING SCIENCE AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of distribution network restoration power quantitative evaluating method for considering communication and influencing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of distribution network restoration power quantitative evaluating methods for considering communication and influencing, and obtain the distribution network system running state information in extreme disaster coverage area first；After extreme disaster occurs, according to power distribution network physical state information, communication failure is not considered, consider the optimization aim including breakdown repair after the reconstruct of the rack of power distribution network and calamity, obtain the load variations curve A of regional distribution network；It is next assumed that the recovery of power distribution network cannot be completed according to set objective when communication system failure, distribution network load change curve B is obtained；Finally the influence by communication system under extreme disaster to distribution network restoration power is set to the area surrounded by curve A and curve B.The present invention can more accurately assess the restoring force size of power distribution network under extreme disaster, and quantitative analyze influence of the communication system failure to distribution network restoration power under extreme disaster.

title_en: A kind of Longspan Bridge topology ambiguity three-dimensional rebuilding method based on computer vision
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Longspan Bridge topology ambiguity three-dimensional rebuilding method based on computer vision, belongs to Health Monitoring for Civil Engineering and field of preventing and reducing natural disasters.Automation this method solve the prior art in Longspan Bridge is failed based on 3-dimensional reconstruction, it is still necessary to the problem of artificial modeling and manual intervention.Three-dimensional reconstruction network of the present invention by establishing the CAD data collection of Longspan Bridge and based on computer vision and deep learning, the network can render the parametrization threedimensional model for learning Longspan Bridge in image and three-dimensional point cloud from multi-angle of view；Then the three-dimensional reconstruction network is trained using the data set of foundation, obtains trained model, uses multiple constraint loss function in training process；The image of bridge to be reconstructed and point cloud are finally input to the model of training inclination described in step 3, obtain parametrization three-dimensional reconstruction result.The present invention is suitable for Health Monitoring for Civil Engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters.

title_en: Underground engineering geological disaster slip casting effect method of real-time
abstract_en: A kind of underground engineering geological disaster slip casting effect method of real-time of the disclosure, the true form, development scale and point cloud information for obtaining geological disaster (cavity type) using 3 D laser scanning digitizing technique by injected hole are provided, contrast sample's initial information is collected；After slip casting, wave velocity method data acquisition all working is completed in earth's surface, geological structure playback and imaging are then carried out to the elastic wave data obtained after slip casting by migration technology, achievement diagram is intuitive simple and readily discernible.It, can the more acurrate validity for judging slip casting effect by the change and progress trend of geological condition before and after comparative analysis slip casting.

title_en: Mobile and augmented reality based depth and thermal fusion scan
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described for mobile and augmented reality-based depth and thermal fusion scan imaging. Some embodiments of the present technology use sophisticated techniques to fuse information from both thermal and depth imaging channels together to achieve synergistic effects for object recognition and personal identification. Hence, the techniques used in various embodiments provide a much better solution for, say, first responders, disaster relief agents, search and rescue, and law enforcement officials to gather more detailed forensic data. Some embodiments provide a series of unique features including small size, wearable devices, and ability to feed fused depth and thermal streams into AR glasses. In addition, some embodiments use a two-layer architecture for performing device local fusion and cloud-based platform for integration of data from multiple devices and cross-scene analysis and reconstruction.

title_en: A kind of coastal cities multi-source flood method for numerical simulation based on GIS grid operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of coastal cities multi-source flood method for numerical simulation based on GIS grid operation, this method are equipped with parameter setting module, surface data input module, hydrology multi-boundary Condition input module, the instant analog module of flood numerical value and visualization output module.The setting simulation basic parameter in parameter setting module；It includes terrain data, land type, soil types and pipe network data that the substantially geographical information of survey region is inputted in surface data input module；It includes waterlogging, three kinds of flood and waterlog kinds of seashore storm tide and river flood that multi-source flood sequential file is inputted in hydrology multi-boundary Condition input module；It visualizes output module and output file format classification is set；The starting operation instant analog module of flood numerical value, by instant playback multi-source flood numerical simulation result.The present invention is based on GIS grid operation, disaster scene that simulation and forecast coastal cities multi-source flood is met and discussed.

title_en: A kind of pulse seismic response method for establishing model considering mountain relief effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of pulse seismic response method for establishing model for considering mountain relief effect.Nearly fault region often generates strong pulse earthquake motion, and mountain relief can cause apparent enlarge-effect to pulse earthquake motion.The present invention has confirmed mountain relief to obvious enlarge-effect existing for pulse earthquake motion by comparing trapezoidal mountain model and acceleration table value of the free field model under pulsedly shock effect.Therefore, when mountain area carries out nearly fault region Seismic Risk Evaluation, need to consider mountain relief to the enlarge-effect of pulse earthquake motion, thus emergency response and earthquake reconstruction planning when assessment of taking precautions against natural calamities before being more nearly actual shaken, shake.

title_en: Emulating high-frequency application-consistent snapshots by forming restore point data sets based on remote site replay of i/o commands
abstract_en: The disclosed systems emulate high-frequency application-consistent snapshots by forming restore point data sets based on remote site replay of I/O commands. A method embodiment commences upon identifying a primary computing site and a secondary computing site, then identifying an application to be restored from the secondary computing site after a disaster. Prior to the disaster, a group of computing entities of the application to be restored from the secondary computing site are identified. Input/output operations that are performed over any of the computing entities at the primary site are streamed to the secondary site where they are stored. An I/O map that associates a time with an indication of a last received I/O command that had been performed over a changing set of computing entities is sent to the secondary site. An agent at the secondary site accesses the I/O map and the streamed-over I/Os to construct recovery data.

title_en: A kind of electric power pylon Analysis of Economic Loss method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of electric power pylon Analysis of Economic Loss method, and the Analysis of Economic Loss method comprises steps of determining that the status of electric power pylon；Determine the cost of Maintenance and Repair or the reconstruction of electric power pylon；By the model of economic loss of electric power pylon, economic loss after electric power pylon disaster caused by a windstorm is determined.Electric power pylon Analysis of Economic Loss method of the invention, economic loss caused by destroying in disaster caused by a windstorm as electric power pylon is carried out emphatically to be modeled, early warning is lost to provide effective disaster caused by a windstorm for the electric power pylon in network system, and can be used as the preparation foundation restored after calamity.

title_en: Remote sensing image burned area analysis method combining superpixels and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote sensing image burned area analysis method combining superpixels and deep learning. And classifying the burned areas and the non-burned areas of the new samples by using the trained classifier, and calculating the affected area. The method can quickly and effectively evaluate the disaster area, avoids the defects of large workload, poor timeliness and the like of the traditional manual field measurement method, and plays an important guiding role in recovering and reconstructing work after forest fire disaster.

title_en: Fire emergency notification system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire emergency notification system comprising: a detection sensor unit installed in a fire extinguishing device disposed in a building to extinguish a fire, detecting the operation of the fire extinguishing device, and transmitting an operating signal when the fire extinguishing device is operated; a photographing unit installed in the building or carried by an insider located inside the building to photograph a scene in the building where a fire occurs when the fire occurs; a management module activating an emergency signal by determining that the fire has occurred when receiving the operating signal from the detection sensor unit, and executing the photographing unit to photograph the scene of the fire when the emergency signal is activated; and a control server configured to communicate with the management module to receive, from the management module, fire scene information including the emergency signal and image information captured by the photographing unit, and to transmit the received fire scene information to a situation handling terminal. According to the present invention, the fire emergency notification system provides a fire department or a safety officer with a real-time fire scene image from a camera installed in the building or a wireless terminal carried by the insider when the insider located inside the building operates the fire extinguishing device, thereby enabling the fire department to recognize the occurrence of the fire more quickly, recognize a fire scene situation more accurately through a captured image, and respond to the fire rapidly.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Fire-fighting experiential method, device and terminal device based on VR
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of fire-fighting experiential method, device and terminal device based on VR, which comprises obtain the corresponding project label of fire-fighting experience project that user specifies；The corresponding default VR scene of the project label is obtained according to the project label；User's sight orientation is detected, and plays the default VR scene in the corresponding region in user's sight orientation；It during playing the default VR scene, detects whether to receive triggering idsplay order, the triggering idsplay order carries node identification, if receiving triggering idsplay order, loads corresponding data according to the node identification and is shown；It during playing default VR scene, detects whether to receive user's control instruction, if receiving user's control instruction, the playback progress of the default VR scene is adjusted according to user's control instruction.Fire-fighting experiential method, device and terminal device provided by the invention based on VR can reduce the human cost and material resources cost of fire safety education.

title_en: Engineering slurry and dregs alternating layers backfill pit foundation structure and reconstruction ground based method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of engineering slurry and dregs alternating layers backfill pit foundation structure and reconstruction ground based methods.Including the vacuum chimney filter net, sand bedding course and mud dregs structural unit being laid in discarded pit；Discarded pit bottom surface is equipped with one layer of vacuum chimney filter net, is made of more parallel lateral vacuum chimney filters, more parallel longitudinal vacuum chimney filter square crossing layings；The online face of vacuum chimney filter is laid with sand bedding course again, successively laying multilayer mud dregs structural unit is repeated above sand bedding course, every layer of mud dregs structural unit includes successively being laid with arrangement geotextile layer, consolidation mud layer, soil engineering composite drainage network, engineering dregs layer from top to bottom.The engineering slurry and dregs that the present invention is generated using Process of Urban Development backfill discarded pit, the disposition pressure of city flood tide engineering dregs and engineering slurry can be effectively relieved, solve the problems, such as geological disaster and the ecological environment destruction of disposition and the exposed initiation in discarded pit lack of standardization, and it building foundation, realization land resource can regenerate again.

title_en: fire engine water replenishment system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire engine replenishment system. More specifically, the fire engine replenishment system includes: a fire engine sent to the scene of a fire with water to extinguish a fire; a valve installed on the fire engine to be transported in general, but selectively installed on a spot adjacent to the fire engine to be connected to the fire engine through a hose in case of the need to replenish the fire engine; a standpipe connected to the valve through the hose; a water supply pipe connected to the standpipe to supply water for firefighting; and a hydrant spindle opening or closing the water supply pipe. Therefore, since the replenishment procedure for the fire engine can be completed by simply opening the valve and installing the hose in the fire engine without the manipulation of the hydrant spindle, the distance firefighters have to move for replenishment work can be minimized, so time for replenishment work can be shortened.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방차량 충수 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게 화재 발생 시 소화용수를 싣고 화재현장으로 출동하는 소방차량과 평상시에는 상기 소방차량에 탑재하여 운반되다가, 상기 소방차량의 충수 필요시에 선택적으로 상기 소방차량에 인접한 지점에 설치되어 상기 소방차량과 호스에 의해 연결되는 밸브와 상기 밸브와 호스에 의해 연결되는 스탠드 파이프와 상기 스탠드 파이프와 연결되어 소화용수를 공급하는 상수도배관과 상기 상수도배관을 개폐하는 소화전스핀들을 포함하며, 상기 소방차량의 충수 과정에서 상기 소화전스핀들을 조작할 필요없이, 상기 밸브를 개폐하고 상기 호스를 소방차량에 착탈하는 작업만으로 충수 과정이 이루어질 수 있으므로, 충수 작업 시 소방관이 이동하는 거리를 최소화하여 충수시간이 단축될 수 있도록 하는 것에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Remote sensing image change detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image change detection method using a low-rank prior learning judgment dictionary, which mainly improves the accuracy of unsupervised remote sensing image change detection and replaces automatic threshold selection by learning a change judgment dictionary and an invariant judgment dictionary. The method comprises the following steps: (1) respectively inputting two multi-temporal remote sensing images to be detected; (2) the super-pixel segmentation difference image is obtained to obtain a super-pixel total sample; (3) learning a global dictionary and a sparse coefficient for the superpixel total samples; (4) selecting samples according to the low-rank representation of the sparse coefficient matrix; (5) respectively learning dictionaries by using the variation samples and the invariant samples; (6) and calculating the reconstruction error of each pixel point neighborhood block under the judgment dictionary, and comparing the reconstruction errors to obtain a variation region binary image. The invention can select the change sample and the invariable sample without supervision for change detection, and can be used in remote sensing fields of disaster assessment, city expansion detection, land coverage, utilization detection and the like.

title_en: SVG technology-based ship disaster plotting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ship disaster plotting method based on SVG technology, which comprises the following steps: step S100: SVG data is manufactured and released; step S200: SVG data request and display; step S300: plotting SVG disaster situation; step S400: synchronization of the plot data; step S500: storage of plot data; step S600: playback of the plot data. The SVG technology is used as a key point of a solution for constructing a ship deck and an information data container, realizes basic GIS functions of enlarging, reducing, translating and the like of a deck map, improves the display precision of images and data in a ship safety system, and improves user experience.

title_en: The mixed function station design scheme of digital seismograph cross-station and power station
abstract_en: In using wire-link telemetry seismographic oil exploration production, frequent occurrence because cable fracture or individual site disasters, which cause communication disruption, to stop production the case where.Ground observation construction team is huge, and the reparation for falling into a long wait communication network will cause heavy economic losses.The present invention relates to the manufacturing technologies of wire-link telemetry digital seismograph, provide the mixed function station design scheme of a kind of digital seismograph cross-station and power station.The mixed function station that the present invention designs, which can be switched fast, executes cross-station function or power station function, and in field, prospecting network network occurs quickly establish redundant communication links when communication failure, can reconstructing system communication function without waiting for fault restoration.The seismic data being previously interrupted not only can be all recycled, and normal production process can be recovered immediately, realizes the field seismic prospecting production process without downtime.
