title_en: BIM-based steel structure bridge informatization operation and maintenance system and processing method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of buildings, and discloses a BIM-based steel structure bridge informatization operation and maintenance system and a processing method thereof, which are used for collecting state information of a bridge, formatting operation and maintenance information data, completing first reconstruction of the operation and maintenance information and realizing conversion from three dimensions to two dimensions; storing bridge state information and establishing a structural health state core fingerprint library; and the service state and the operation and maintenance scheme of the bridge are evaluated from the aspects of safety, economy, sustainability and disaster prevention performance, and an evaluation report is given. Compared with the traditional operation and maintenance system, the information creation process of the invention is more comprehensive and complete; the visual feature of the invention can also carry out visual processing on the operation and maintenance information, thereby helping operation and maintenance personnel to read the information quickly by combining visual graphics; the invention combines the information technology advantages of BIM technology, realizes the bidirectional docking with cloud technology, carries out cloud storage processing on massive operation and maintenance data, and reduces the requirement of an operation and maintenance system on hardware.

title_en: Site-consolidated disaster-recovery with synchronous-to-asynchronous traffic conversion
abstract_en: A disaster-recovery system contains a networked array of synchronous-to-asynchronous converter (SATC) modules that connect source databases to target backup databases. During backup, the system replicates each source-database transaction through a chain of these SATCs to a corresponding target, storing a local copy of the transaction on each SATC along the way. Each transaction's path between its source-target pair is identified by a set of tracking entries, where each entry identifies one SATC in the path. Before initiating a recovery operation, the system regenerates the tracking entries in order to reconstruct paths to source databases. The system then synchronously searches SATCs along each path for local copies of lost transactions that had not time to be fully replicated before the occurrence of a catastrophic failure. The full-blown recovery is started only after all lost transactions have been properly replicated to target databases.

title_en: Fire extinguisher practice equipment for fire fight training
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire extinguisher training equipment for a fire drill using a fire extinguisher spraying water instead of fire extinguishing powder and, more specifically, to fire extinguisher training equipment in which first, second, third spaces (11, 12, 13) are formed in front and rear portions by first and second transparent plates of a body portion (10). The first space (11) has an opened front portion to spray water of a fire extinguisher. The second space (12) penetrates the first space (11) to vertically and axially provide a target indicating an ignition point. The third space (13) is provided with a flame reproducing unit (30) which reproduces a fire situation by enabling a flame reproducing film to flutter and pulsate by a blowing force such that red light and blue light are emitted like flames. By accurately hitting the target marking the ignition point in front of the body portion using the water sprayed from the fire extinguisher, the target is knocked down for a certain period to practice extinguishing a fire. The flame reproducing unit creates a real fire situation to provide a safe and realistic feeling of extinguishing a real fire, thereby achieving double practice effects.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화 분말 대신 물을 분사하는 소화기를 이용하여 소방 훈련을 하는 소화기 실습 장비에 관한 것으로, 좀더 상세하게는 몸체부(10)의 제1,2 투명판에 의해 제1,2,3 공간부(11)(12)(13)를 전후로 형성하되, 상기 제1 공간부(11)는 소화기의 물을 분사하도록 전방을 개방되게 형성하고, 제2 공간부(12)는 제1 공간부(11)와 관통 형성하여 발화 지점을 표시하는 타켓을 수직으로 축 설치하며, 제3 공간부(13)에는 불꽃 재현막이 송풍력에 의해 펄럭이며 파동하면서 적,청 색광을 발하여 불꽃과 같이 연출되면서 화재 상황을 재현하는 불꽃 재현부(30)를 설치 구성하므로 소화기에서 분사되는 물로 본체부 전방에서 발화 지점을 표시하는 타켓을 정확히 맞추는 것에 의해 타켓을 일정 시간 넘어뜨려 화재를 진화하도록 실습하되, 불꽃 재현부에 의해 실제 화재 상황을 연출하므로 안전하면서도 실제 화재를 진화하는 듯한 현실감을 갖도록 하기 때문에 실습 효과를 배가하도록 하는데 그 특징이 있다.

title_en: Production safety accident scene construction and emergency capacity construction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production safety accident scene construction and emergency capacity construction system, which adopts a technical route of scene analysis, task combing and capacity evaluation, and comprises risk management and emergency work management, wherein the risk management and the emergency work management are carried out in a circulating way, and the emergency work management comprises four processes of emergency preparation, emergency response, restoration reconstruction and prevention and disaster reduction. According to the invention, through research and judgment based on a large number of related typical accident cases at home and abroad, the logic chain and the common law of occurrence and development of related major accidents are researched and mastered, the core elements of the scenes are determined, the risk list and the task combing list are listed, a foundation is laid for construction of the related scenes and improvement of emergency capacity, the typical scenes of the typical cases are constructed through quantitative analysis of accident consequences based on mathematical modeling and computer simulation, the related emergency tasks of key nodes of the scenes are determined, and the practicability of construction of production safety scenes is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGZHIAN CO LTD;HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG CHONGQING LIANGJIANG GAS TURBINE POWER GENERATION CO LTD;CHANGCHUN THERMAL POWER PLANT OF HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: retrospective dosimetry method with high flux and stable signal intensity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a retrospective dosimetry method with high flux and stable signal intensity, which comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing on-site table salt into a plurality of dosage elements; secondly, detecting each dosage element by using a pulse photoluminescence technology, and determining the detection times n required by the dosage element with the highest dosage on the premise of completely exciting the dosage information of the table salt; thirdly, detecting each dosage element irradiated with different dosages for n times to obtain the relationship between the salt OSL signal and the absorbed dosage; and fourthly, measuring the photoluminescence signal of the on-site table salt, and calculating the table salt absorbed dose according to the relation between the table salt OSL signal and the absorbed dose. The invention provides a retrospective dosimetry method with high flux and stable signal intensity by taking salt as a retrospective dosage material based on a photoluminescence technology, can effectively measure the radiation absorption dosage of the on-site salt in an emergency nuclear leakage event, and provides a measurement method with high flux and stable signal intensity for measuring the public dosage in a nuclear accident.

title_en: System for gaming education of multi participation using laser position realize
title_ko: 레이저위치 인식 기술을 이용한 다수 참여 교육용 게임 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a game system for multi-participation education using a laser position recognition technique, comprising: a content replay module to scan content corresponding to a received scenario on a screen; an infrared (IR) LED module to measure a change in the intensity of emitted infrared light to detect position coordinates where a ball is hit; and a game module to control the content replay unit to scan content corresponding to a next stage if the position coordinates where the ball is hit are coordinates pre-matched to a quiz included in scanned content. The IR LED module includes: a plurality of infrared units provided to face each other around the screen and emit infrared light to positions opposite to each other; and a detection unit to detect position coordinates of a point where the intensity of the emitted infrared light changes as position coordinates where the ball is hit on the screen. According to the present invention, a laser sensor and the IR LED module are constructed on the screen to correspond to x and y coordinate values to extract disk-shaped distance information for a ball thrown by a user and provide a ball throwing game to recognize an accurate hitting position for content scanned on the screen, thereby providing voluntary participation and motivation of a learner, competition induction, group decisions, agility, and new experience every time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 레이저위치 인식 기술을 이용한 다수 참여 교육용 게임 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 입력받은 시나리오와 대응하는 콘텐츠를 스크린에 주사하는 콘텐츠 재생모듈; 조사되는 적외선 세기의 변화를 측정하여 공이 타격된 위치좌표를 검출하는 IR LED모듈; 공이 타격된 위치좌표가 주사된 콘텐츠에 포함된 퀴즈와 기 매칭된 좌표인 경우, 다음 스테이지에 해당하는 콘텐츠를 주사하도록 콘텐츠 재생부를 제어하는 게임모듈을 포함하되, IR LED모듈은, 스크린을 에둘러 서로 마주보도록 복수개로 구비되되, 서로 마주보도록 대향된 위치로 적외선을 조사하는 적외선부; 및 조사되는 적외선 세기가 변하는 지점의 위치좌표를 스크린에 공이 타격된 위치좌표로 검출하는 검출부를 포함한다. 상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, x, y 좌표값과 대응하도록 스크린에 IR LED모듈 및 레이저센서를 구성하여 사용자가 던진 공에 대한 원반형 거리정보 추출하고, 스크린에 주사된 콘텐츠에 대한 정확한 타격 위치를 인식하는 공 던지기 게임을 제공함으로써, 학습자의 자발적 참여와 동기부여, 경쟁심 유발, 집단의사결정, 민첩성, 및 매번 새로운 경험을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Flood storage and detention distinguishing flood distribution method based on complete information dynamic non-cooperative master-slave game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood storage and stagnation distinguishing flood distribution method based on a complete information dynamic non-cooperative master-slave game. And taking the upstream stagnation area as a prior game player to make a decision preferentially, taking the downstream stagnation area as a subordinate game player to act subsequently according to the upstream decision information, and feeding the decision information back to the upstream stagnation area to prompt the upstream stagnation area to adjust the strategy thereof, so that an interactive feedback decision process is formed, multiple rounds are carried out by considering the game, and the two parties maximize the effectiveness thereof through continuous competition and balance. The subordinate gamblers grasp the possible decisions of the leading gamblers, and simultaneously, the leading gamblers completely master the decision behaviors of the subordinate gamblers, thereby realizing flood storage and flood detention and flood distribution. According to the invention, through a non-cooperative game means, interaction and restriction behaviors among all main bodies in flood diversion planning are simulated, a stable Nash equilibrium decision scheme is sought, effective and reasonable flood diversion is realized, flood damage is reduced, and post-disaster reconstruction capability is improved.

title_en: Disaster recovery processing method for 5G network slice
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery processing method of 5G network slices, which ensures uninterrupted service by reconstructing a network slice set and establishing the disaster recovery slice set and by the non-perception switching of abnormal slice users under the condition that the 5G network slices are abnormal, avoids the influence of slice abnormality on the service, effectively improves the service quality of the network slices, is convenient for sharing disaster recovery resources and effectively improves the utilization rate of the disaster recovery resources.

title_en: Flood prevention material rescue distribution method based on non-dominated artificial bee colony
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood prevention goods and materials rescue distribution method based on a non-dominated artificial bee colony, which is characterized by establishing a flood prevention goods and materials distribution optimization model based on warehouse goods and materials storage quantity constraint, goods and materials demand constraint and flood prevention goods and materials delivery time constraint, initializing a food source by adopting three methods of large-scale storage warehouse priority, disaster demand priority and random distribution, and providing a demand adaptation value, a goods and materials satisfaction rate variance adaptation value and a transmission time adaptation value of the food source; in the bee hiring stage, a high-dimensional matrix local search method, population classification and elimination are adopted to reduce the space complexity; in the bee following stage, the food source is updated through cross operation, and the search range of the population is expanded; in the scout bee stage, the last food source, the repeated food source and the food source reaching the upper evolutionary limit number are selected to be reconstructed. The flood prevention material distribution method can optimize flood prevention material distribution, save rescue material distribution time, balance material distribution of various disaster areas and improve the overall flood prevention material distribution efficiency.

title_en: High-precision format simulation method for one-dimensional ice-water coupled motion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision format simulation method for one-dimensional ice water coupling motion, and belongs to the field of forecasting of river ice disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining boundary conditions, controlling an equation, uniformly dispersing ice-water coupling motion, calculating surface flux, calculating shallow water wave velocity under the ice-water coupling condition and calculating a high-precision format. The method uniformly disperses ice and hydrodynamic equations into a high-precision Godunov format, calculates the interface flux by adopting an HLL approximate Riemann solution, replaces the average water depth of a section with equivalent water depth, performs piecewise linear reconstruction on basic variables of each unit in space, and improves the precision of the numerical solution to second order integrally by adopting a prediction-correction method in time. The high-precision format simulation method for ice-water coupled motion provided by the invention has higher forecasting precision on the water level and the ice thickness of the riverway in the ice season, particularly, the equivalent water depth method is adopted to replace the average water depth method to calculate the wave velocity of shallow water, the water level forecasting precision can be obviously improved, and the research result has great significance on preventing and controlling the ice disaster of the riverway.
assignees: CHINA WATER NORTHEASTERN INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Energy-saving construction process for old building transformation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving construction process for old building reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of firstly, replanning an old cell; step two, seismic reinforcement of the old building; step three, building a new building; step four, residents move to new residents; fifthly, public facilities are built; mastering the aging condition of the old building according to the building drawing, the structure drawing and the construction drawing of the old building, and determining a reconstruction construction scheme; re-planning an old building with the original star chess cloth, then performing earthquake resistance and reinforcement on the old building, and building a new floor on the old building; residents in other old buildings are moved to new buildings; completely removing the emptied old building, carrying out log and size scratching on the old building, and planting trees, forestation and planting flowers and grass; building public facilities; the invention not only creates a nice living environment, but also meets the living demands to be solved urgently, thereby greatly improving the living quality of residents; solves the problems of difficult housing, difficult parking, difficult vegetable buying, body building, cultural entertainment, no place for dancing and drinking songs and unsmooth fire fighting access of residents.

title_en: An Airdrop device of fire extinguishing ball for drone
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for airdropping a fire extinguishing ball with a drone, capable of loading multiple fire extinguishing balls on a drone and airdropping the multiple fire extinguishing balls to a fire scene. The device for airdropping a fire extinguishing ball with a drone enables a stable flight by preventing the center of gravity in the drone from being largely changed when the fire extinguishing ball is airdropped. The device for airdropping a fire extinguishing ball with a drone comprises: a loading frame (100) including an installation unit (110) to be installed on a landing gear (G) of the drone on both sides of the lower part, wherein the lower side of the loading frame (100) is open; a loading frame (200, 200′) installed to be inclined upwards from both left and right sides of the loading frame (100) to the outside and including the multiple fire extinguishing balls (B) piled on the inside, wherein the loading frame (200, 200′) has an inlet (210, 210′) on the outside and has an outlet (220, 220′) connected to the open lower side of the loading frame (100) on the inner side; and an airdrop controller (300, 300′) installed on the outlet (220, 220′) of the loading frame (200, 200′) and alternately airdropping the fire extinguishing ball (B) loaded on the loading frame (200, 200′) on the left and right.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 복수의 소화탄을 드론에 탑재하여 화재현장의 공중에서 투하할 수 있도록 한 드론 탑재용 소화탄 투하장치에 관한 것으로, 소화탄의 투척시 드론의 무게중심이 크게 변동되지 않도록 하여 안정적인 비행이 가능하도록 한 것인바, 드론의 랜딩기어(G)에 장착하기 위한 장착부(110)가 하부 양측에 구비되고 하방으로는 개방된 탑재 프레임(100)과, 상기 탑재 프레임(100)의 좌우 양측에서 외측으로 상향 경사지게 설치되고 내부에 복수의 소화탄(B)이 적재되며, 외측에는 투입구(210,210')가 형성되고 내측에는 상기 탑재 프레임(100)의 개방된 하방으로 연통된 배출구(220,220')가 형성된 적재틀(200,200')과, 상기 적재틀(200,200')의 배출구(220,220') 측에 구비되어 좌,우측의 적재틀(200,200')에 적재된 소화탄(B)을 하나씩 번갈아 투하하도록 하는 투하제어기(300,300')를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Automobile passenger collision damage prediction method and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for predicting collision damage of an automobile passenger and computer equipment. The automobile passenger collision damage prediction method comprises the step of generating a verification database, wherein the verification database comprises a vehicle collision curve database and a passenger damage database. And establishing a mass spring model, and performing parameter calibration on the mass spring model by using the verification database. And reconstructing accidents under various collision working conditions by using the mass spring model to obtain a damage prediction result. According to the method, a rapid and objective damage prediction model is established through multi-level and multi-angle modeling. Because the mass spring model is simple and low in consumption, accidents under different collision working conditions are reconstructed by using the mass spring model, and rapid and reliable damage prediction is realized.

title_en: Method and system for detecting three-dimensional rainfall field by three-dimensional satellite-ground link dense-mesh network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for detecting a three-dimensional rainfall field by a three-dimensional satellite-ground link dense mesh, wherein the method comprises the following steps of utilizing a multi-ground station-multi-satellite source to form the three-dimensional satellite-ground link dense mesh to detect the distribution of the three-dimensional rainfall field: forming a ground observation network by utilizing a plurality of existing or erected satellite antennas, receiving a plurality of satellite signals, and forming a densely-woven three-dimensional network by a plurality of satellite-ground links; the spatial distribution of the attenuation coefficient is obtained by analyzing the relation among the satellite-ground link signal intensity information, the rainfall attenuation coefficient and the satellite-ground link length, the spatial distribution of rainfall is inverted according to the relation model of the attenuation coefficient and the rainfall intensity, and the reconstruction, visualization and dynamic display of the three-dimensional rainfall field are completed by combining with a GIS map. The invention utilizes the satellite-ground link network to complete the reconstruction of the three-dimensional rainfall field, can provide accurate rainfall data with large range and high resolution, and provides key data for water resource management, agricultural development, urban waterlogging monitoring, natural disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Method for Reconstructing Image through Central Management of Data
title_ko: 데이터의 중앙 관리를 통한 영상 재구성 방법
abstract_en: Provided is an image reconstruction method which comprises the following steps: detecting vehicle information using a plurality of sensors; determining whether an accident with respect to a host vehicle occurs based on the vehicle information; capturing, when it is determined that the accident with respect to a host vehicle has occurred, a first image of the surroundings and storing the vehicle information; transmitting accident occurrence information of the host vehicle together with the first image and the vehicle information to a traffic management server; tracking an accident occurrence location by using GPS information included in the vehicle information; requesting a second image with respect to the accident occurrence location to a surrounding vehicle and an infrastructure device located within a predetermined radius around the accident occurrence location; and generating a 3D image that has the accident occurrence location at the center, based on the vehicle information, the first image, and the second image. According to the present invention, it is possible to obtain images for accident investigation even when a black box of an accident vehicle fails to store images due to shock or accident images cannot be confirmed due to a blind spot.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 복수의 센서를 이용하여 차량 정보를 감지하는 단계, 상기 차량 정보에 기초하여 자차의 사고 발생 여부를 판단하는 단계, 상기 자차의 사고가 발생한 것으로 판단되면, 주변에 대한 제1 영상을 촬영하고 상기 차량 정보를 저장하는 단계, 상기 자차의 사고 발생 정보를 상기 제1 영상 및 상기 차량 정보와 함께 교통관리 서버로 전송하는 단계, 상기 차량 정보에 포함된 GPS 정보를 이용하여 사고 발생 위치를 추적하는 단계, 상기 사고 발생 위치를 중심으로 일정 반경 이내에 있는 주변 차량 및 인프라 기기에 사고 발생 위치에 대한 제2 영상을 요청하는 단계 및 상기 차량 정보, 제1 영상 및 제2 영상에 기초하여 사고 발생 위치를 중심으로 하는 삼차원 영상을 생성하는 단계를 포함하는 영상 재구성 방법을 제공한다. 본 개시에 의하면 사고차량의 블랙박스가 충격으로 인해 영상이 저장되지 않거나 사각지대로 인해 사고영상을 확인할 수 없어도 사고조사를 위한 영상을 획득할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for selecting spectral bandwidth of hyperspectral image and spectral bandwidth selection apparatus using the same
title_ko: 초분광 영상의 분광 밴드 선택 방법 및 이를 이용하는 분광 밴드 설정 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for selecting a spectral band of a hyperspectral image and a spectral band setting apparatus using the same which can select a spectral band for data capacity reduction. The method comprises: a step of receiving a hyperspectral image obtained by photographing a fire site by a hyperspectral camera; a step of extracting an i^th spectral band and a j^th spectral band among N spectral bands included in the hyperspectral image as a band pair, and calculating a normalized difference index (NDI) for the band pair to generate a result image; a step of setting M thresholds, and applying the thresholds to the result image to individually generate M binary images corresponding to the thresholds; a step of comparing pixels detected as a flame in the binary images and pixels corresponding to a real flame to calculate a false positive rate (FPR) and a true positive rate (TPR) of the binary images, and using the FPR and the TPR of the M binary images to generate a receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve; a step of calculating an area-under-the-curve (AUC) value for the ROC curve to set the AUC value as an AUC index for the band pair; and a step of calculating the AUC indices for N x N band pairs selectable in the hyperspectral image, and comparing the AUC indices to set a fire detection band pair used in real-time fire detection among the band pairs.
abstract_ko: 본 출원은 초분광 영상의 분광 밴드 선택 방법 및 이를 이용하는 분광 밴드 설정 장치에 관한 것으로서, 초분광 카메라로 화재현장을 촬영한 초분광 영상을 수신하는 단계; 상기 초분광 영상에 포함된 N개의 분광 밴드 중에서 i번째 분광 밴드와 j번째 분광 밴드를 밴드쌍으로 추출하고, 상기 밴드쌍에 대한 NDI(Normalized Difference Index)를 계산하여 결과영상을 생성하는 단계; M개의 문턱값을 설정하고, 상기 결과영상에 각각의 문턱값을 적용하여 상기 문턱값에 대응하는 M개의 이진화 영상을 개별적으로 생성하는 단계; 상기 이진화 영상에서 화염으로 검출된 픽셀들과, 실제 화염에 대응하는 픽셀들을 비교하여, 상기 이진화 영상의 FPR(False Positive Rate) 및 TPR(True Positive Rate)을 계산하고, 상기 M개의 이진화 영상들의 FPR 및 TPR을 이용하여 ROC(Receiver Operation Characteristic) 곡선을 생성하는 단계; 상기 ROC 곡선에 대한 AUC(Area Under the Curve)값을 계산하여, 상기 밴드쌍에 대한 AUC 인덱스로 설정하는 단계; 및 상기 초분광 영상 중에서 선택가능한 전체 N × N개 밴드쌍 대해 상기 AUC 인덱스를 계산하고, 상기 AUC 인덱스를 비교하여 상기 밴드쌍 중에서 실시간 화재 감지에 사용하는 화재감지 밴드쌍을 설정하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for reconstructing vertical rainfall field based on satellite-ground link scanning
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for scanning and reconstructing a vertical rainfall field based on satellite-to-ground links, which comprises the steps of constructing a plurality of satellite signal receiving ends to receive polar orbit satellite signals to form a plurality of satellite-to-ground links; gridding a vertical area to be reconstructed; the spatial distribution of the attenuation coefficient is obtained by analyzing the relation among the satellite-ground link signal intensity information, the rainfall attenuation coefficient and the satellite-ground link length, the spatial distribution of rainfall is inverted according to the relation model of the attenuation coefficient and the rainfall intensity, rainfall information on a vertical space is generated, and finally the rainfall information and a detection area are combined to reconstruct a vertical rainfall field. The method not only makes up the defects of detecting the vertical rainfall field by the traditional means, but also has the advantages of high space-time resolution, low cost and the like, and provides important data support and guarantee for water resource management, agricultural development, natural disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Decision method and device for post-disaster first-aid repair of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decision-making method and a decision-making device for post-disaster repair of a power distribution network, which are used for acquiring fault information distribution and transformation level disaster loss information, emergency maintenance team information and material transport vehicle information under disaster conditions, establishing a power distribution network frame reconstruction and material personnel allocation auxiliary decision-making model by taking distribution network fault point selection, emergency maintenance team information and material scheduling as decision variables on the premise of meeting distribution network operation constraints and path planning constraints, wherein the model comprises a lower layer connecting line action scheme determination model taking the maximum recovery load as a target and an upper layer construction team and material scheduling scheme determination model taking the minimum total loss power in the emergency maintenance process as a target; and solving the allocation auxiliary decision model by adopting an upper-layer iteration solving method and a lower-layer iteration solving method, and finally determining a post-disaster emergency repair decision scheme of the power distribution network. The invention fully considers the problem that the cooperative action of construction teams and material vehicles often cannot achieve the target of minimum economic loss, and simplifies the coding of each part of solution.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Tunnel fire safety control system based on DTU
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tunnel fire safety control system based on DTU, tunnel fire safety control system comprises cistern, fire pump, PLC and DTU equipment. The DTU equipment is introduced into a tunnel fire-fighting system, is novel equipment based on the technology of the Internet of things, and can be networked and programmed to control connection equipment; embedding an SIM card on the DTU to enable a corresponding server to communicate with the DTU; and all communication ports on the market are supported, and the communication with the communication ports can be realized through the interfaces and the protocols provided by the PLC. And the fire-fighting systems of a plurality of tunnels adopt different brands and models of PLC or controllers, the programs of the PLC or controllers are not standard, even the control requirements can not be met, and the reconstruction cost is increased, so that the programs of all the tunnel systems need to be standardized by adopting the programs based on DTU equipment, the cost is reduced by unified management, and the water quantity of the high-level reservoir can be ensured to be sufficient by comprehensive monitoring.

title_en: Aerospace reservoir and shore integrated emergency survey data fusion and integrated display system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an air-space reservoir-shore integrated emergency survey data fusion and integrated display system and method, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises a data acquisition and transmission module, a data extraction module, a data management module, a data registration module, a data splicing module, a data analysis and processing module, a data fusion module and a three-dimensional scene reconstruction module; the data extraction module: the data acquisition and transmission module is connected with the data acquisition and transmission module; the data management module: the data extraction module is connected with the data acquisition module; the data registration module: the data management module is connected with the data management module; the data splicing module: the data management module is connected with the data management module; the data analysis and processing module: the data management module is connected with the data management module; the data fusion module: is connected with the data analysis and processing module; the three-dimensional scene reconstruction module: and is connected with the data analysis and processing module. The invention can rapidly and accurately carry out detailed survey on the range and the condition of the disaster area and obtain the survey result.

title_en: Fire extinguisher practice equipment for fire fight training
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire extinguisher practice equipment for firefighting training by using a fire extinguisher which sprays water instead of fire extinguishing powder. More specifically, a first, a second, and a third space unit (11, 12, 13) are formed on a front and a rear by a first and a second transparent plate of a body unit (10). The first space unit (11) is formed to have an opened front portion to spray water of a fire extinguisher. The second space unit (12) vertically and axially installs a target formed through the first space unit (11) to display an ignition point. A flame reproducing unit (30) to reproduce a fire situation while a flame reproducing membrane flutters and waves by blowing power and emits red and blue lights to be presented like flames is installed in the third space unit (13). Therefore, practice is carried out to extinguish a fire by toppling a target displaying an ignition point in front of the main body unit for a prescribed period of time by accurately hitting the target with water sprayed from a fire extinguisher. Since a real fire situation is staged by the flame reproducing unit, a safe and realistic sensation is provided as if a real fire is extinguished. Therefore, practice effects are doubled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화 분말 대신 물을 분사하는 소화기를 이용하여 소방 훈련을 하는 소화기 실습 장비에 관한 것으로, 좀더 상세하게는 몸체부(10)의 제1,2 투명판에 의해 제1,2,3 공간부(11)(12)(13)를 전후로 형성하되, 상기 제1 공간부(11)는 소화기의 물을 분사하도록 전방을 개방되게 형성하고, 제2 공간부(12)는 제1 공간부(11)와 관통 형성하여 발화 지점을 표시하는 타켓을 수직으로 축 설치하며, 제3 공간부(13)에는 불꽃 재현막이 송풍력에 의해 펄럭이며 파동하면서 적,청 색광을 발하여 불꽃과 같이 연출되면서 화재 상황을 재현하는 불꽃 재현부(30)를 설치 구성하므로 소화기에서 분사되는 물로 본체부 전방에서 발화 지점을 표시하는 타켓을 정확히 맞추는 것에 의해 타켓을 일정 시간 넘어뜨려 화재를 진화하도록 실습하되, 불꽃 재현부에 의해 실제 화재 상황을 연출하므로 안전하면서도 실제 화재를 진화하는 듯한 현실감을 갖도록 하기 때문에 실습 효과를 배가하도록 하는데 그 특징이 있다.

title_en: Mini escape mask in cuddly toy
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a character doll equipped with a subminiature escape mask that can be used to escape from an air pocket of a ship just before sinking or which is overturned in the event of an accident such as a fire site full of hazardous gas or sinking of a ship, wherein the character doll is a device which allows a user to escape by self-breathing by putting out an emergency mask and a plastic bag inside the character doll in case of emergency by opening the character doll, in which the user usually attaches a popular animal or a human character doll to a cell phone or a bag.
abstract_ko: 이 발명은 유해가스가 충만한 화재현장이나 선박 침몰 등의 사고발생시 침몰 직전 또는 전복된 선박의 에어 포켓에서 탈출에 사용할 수 있는 초소형 비상탈출마스크가 내장된 캐릭터 인형에 관한 것으로, 평소 인기 있는 동물이나 사람의 캐릭터 인형을 휴대전화나 가방에 부착하고 다니다가 비상시 캐릭터 인형을 열고 내부에 들어 있는 비상탈출마스크와 비닐봉지를 꺼내어 자가호흡을 하면서 탈출할 수 있는 장치이다.

title_en: Aluminum alloy framework building structure wall capable of being assembled and connected and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aluminum alloy framework building structure wall capable of being assembled and connected and a preparation method thereof, wherein the aluminum alloy framework building structure wall comprises aluminum alloy strips, connecting pieces and assembling pieces, double-layer aluminum alloy frameworks are assembled into a space framework through the connecting pieces, and each layer of aluminum alloy framework is formed by the aluminum alloy strips in a transverse and longitudinal staggered arrangement; the assembly parts are arranged on the top surface and the bottom surface of the aluminum alloy framework, and concrete is poured to form the aluminum alloy framework building structure wall. The aluminum alloy has good mechanical property and is rust-resistant. The poured concrete can adopt lightweight concrete, recycled aggregate concrete and the like, so that the wall has the advantages of light weight, high strength, environmental protection, no toxicity, convenient construction, durability, ecological environment friendliness and industrialized modular production, can be used for building structure walls, and can also be used in the fields of temporary building, emergency relief, post-disaster reconstruction and the like. Therefore, the wall body has an important application prospect in the field of buildings.

title_en: Method and apparatus for a mechanism of disaster recovery and instance refresh in an event recordation system
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for a mechanism of disaster recovery and instance refresh in an event recordation system are described. A first request for events associated with a first topic is received. A first set of events associated with the first topic are retrieved from a primary event recordation system. Each event from the first set of events includes a first commit identifier indicating the order with which each event is stored in the primary event recordation system. For each event from the first set of events a first replay identifier is determined based on the first commit identifier and a first value of a low commit identifier. The first replay identifier is exposed to event consumers for identifying the event. In response to the first request each event from the first set of events is transmitted with the replay identifier.

title_en: Post-disaster recovery system, method and device for virtualization system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a system, a method and a device for recovering a virtualized system after a disaster and a readable storage medium, which are applied to a CFS storage pool and comprise the following steps: the area determining module is used for acquiring a recording area for recording CFS storage domain information on the data disc; the information writing module is used for writing the information of the new CFS storage domain reconstructed after the disaster into the recording area; the checking and mounting module is used for checking whether the CFS storage pool is consistent with the configuration information of the corresponding host in the CFS storage domain; if so, mounting the data disk on the corresponding host to complete the recovery of the CFS storage pool. The method and the device are realized through a program, the mapping between the host and the CFS storage pool corresponding to the data disk can be quickly and accurately established, parameters in configuration files on the host do not need to be modified, the accuracy is high, the post-disaster recovery speed of the virtualization system is improved, and the time cost and the labor cost are greatly saved.

title_en: Apparatus and method for fire fighting in hospital based on a Virtual Reality
title_ko: 가상현실 기반의 의료 시설 화재 훈련 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for fire training in medical facilities based on virtual reality. The apparatus comprises: a content providing unit which stores and provides, by each medical facility, fire training content including joint content for guiding a fire fighting process while reproducing a fire situation, medical staff content for sequentially guiding medical device operation procedures and patient evacuation guidance procedures to minimize fire damage, and patient content for guiding fire evacuation procedures corresponding to patient disease levels; a training object confirmation unit which checks medical facilities and user identifications to perform the fire training, and further checks the disease level of a user when the user identification is a patient; a user feedback analysis unit which calculates a user behavior value based on a signal fed back from a virtual reality reproduction device; and a control unit which selects the fire training content of the medical facility confirmed by the training object confirmation unit, when the user identification is a medical staff, sequentially provides the joint content and the medical staff content of the selected fire training content, when the user identification is a patient, sequentially provides the joint content and the patient content of the selected fire training content, compares and analyzes a preset behavior guideline and the user behavior value, and adjusts content provision content according to the comparison and analysis result. The present invention can maximize benefits of fire training.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실 기반의 의료 시설 화재 훈련 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 이는 화재 상황을 재현하면서 화재 진압 절차를 안내하는 공동 컨텐츠, 화재 피해 최소화를 위한 의료 기기 조작 절차와 환자 대피 유도 절차를 순차 안내하는 의료진용 컨텐츠, 환자 질환 정도에 대응되는 화재 대피 절차를 안내하는 환자용 컨텐츠를 포함하는 화재 훈련용 컨텐츠를 의료 시설별로 구분하여 저장 및 제공하는 컨텐츠 제공부; 화재 훈련을 수행할 의료 시설 및 사용자 신분을 확인하되, 상기 사용자 신분이 환자인 경우에는 상기 사용자의 질환 정도를 추가 확인하는 훈련 대상 확인부; 상기 가상현실 재현기기로부터 피드백되는 신호를 기반으로 사용자 행동값을 산출하는 사용자 피드백 분석부; 및 상기 훈련 대상 확인부에 의해 확인된 의료 시설의 화재 훈련용 컨텐츠를 선택한 후, 상기 사용자 신분이 의료진인 경우에는 상기 선택된 화재 훈련용 컨텐츠의 공동 컨텐츠와 상기 의료진용 컨텐츠를 순차 제공하고, 상기 사용자 신분이 환자인 경우에는 상기 선택된 화재 훈련용 컨텐츠의 상기 공동 컨텐츠와 상기 환자용 컨텐츠를 순차 제공하되, 기 설정된 행동 지침과 상기 사용자 행동 값을 비교 분석한 후, 상기 비교 분석 결과에 따라 컨텐츠 제공 내용을 조정하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: National Competency Standards-based Construction Machine Training System and Method
title_ko: 국가직무능력표준(ncs) 기반 건설기계 실습교육 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system and a method for construction machine field education based on the national competency standard (NCS). As a new alternative for supplementing and reinforcing construction machine field education (manipulation training) by utilizing high technologies, the present invention can provide a manipulator with sufficient field education to improve learning effects by adding experiential and field education to the education guide of the NCS in actual equipment education; can supplement insufficient job competency through safe field education; can reduce danger in a safe environment by implementing a virtual environment similar to an actual construction machine manipulating field through computer simulation and manipulating and practicing a virtual object converged with hardware as if it is real; can lay a foundation of competitiveness of a construction machine educational institute by shortening a training period and reducing field education costs; can provide hands-on experience such as the sense of manipulation through application of an actual controller by utilizing a VR HMD simulator which reproduces the operating environment of an actual construction machine, in the field education and training for acquiring an operation license; can implement the motion state of an excavator similarly to the actual situation; and, in particular, can allow the manipulator to be immersed as if being in the actual situation by applying the VR HMD and responding to an active behavior of the manipulator. In addition, the system for construction machine field education based on the NCS comprises an NCS server, a field education system server, and a plurality of simulators.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 첨단 기술을 활용하여 건설기계 실습교육(조종훈련)을 보완, 강화할 수 있는 새로운 대안으로 실장비 교육에서 체험형, 실습교육을 국가직무능력표준(NCS)의 교육 지침에 추가함으로써 조종사에게 충분한 실습교육을 제공하여 학습적 효과를 향상시키고, 안전한 실습교육을 통해 부족한 직무능력을 보완할 수 있고, 건설기계 조종 현장과 유사한 가상환경을 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션으로 구현, 하드웨어와 융합된 가상의 물체를 실제처럼 조작·실습함으로써 안전한 환경에서 위험을 줄이고, 훈련기간 단축과 실습교육 비용절감을 통해 건설기계 교육학원 경쟁력의 기반을 마련할 수 있고, 실제 건설기계의 운용 환경을 재현한 VR HMD 시뮬레이터를 조종면허 취득을 위한 실습 교육훈련에 활용하여 실제 콘트롤러를 적용해 조작감 등을 몸으로 체험할 수 있으며, 굴삭기의 운동 현상도 실제 상황과 유사하게 구현하며, 특히 VR HMD를 적용하여 운용자의 능동적 행동에 대응함으로써 실제 상황처럼 몰입이 가능한 국가직무능력표준(NCS) 기반 건설기계 실습교육 시스템 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Shooting nozzle for both water and foam
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a spray nozzle for both water and foam, including: a gun coupling tube (110) coupled to a tip of a spray gun; a foam supply nozzle (120) detachably coupled to the gun coupling tube (110) and spraying foam into a fire site; a water supply nozzle (130) detachably coupled to the gun coupling pipe (110) and spraying water into the fire site; and a bridge (140) which connects the foam supply nozzle (120) and the water supply nozzle (130) to each other to allow the foam supply pipe (120) and the water supply nozzle (130) to be selectively coupled to the gun coupling pipe (110).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 포소화약제 겸용 분사노즐에 관한 것으로서, 상기 분사건의 선단에 결합되는 건결합관(110)과; 상기 건결합관(110)에 착탈가능하게 결합되며, 화재현장으로 포를 분사하는 포공급노즐(120)과; 상기 건결합관(110)에 착탈가능하게 결합되며, 화재현장으로 물을 분사하는 물공급노즐(130)과; 상기 포공급노즐(120)과 상기 물공급노즐(130)을 서로 연결하여, 상기 건결합관(110)에 상기 포공급노즐(120)과 상기 물공급노즐(130)이 선택적으로 결합될 수 있게 지지하는 브릿지(140)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Intelligent protection system for reconstructing and expanding highway slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent protection system for reconstructing and expanding a highway slope, which comprises: an intelligent monitoring module; a guard, comprising: the fixing devices are detachably and fixedly connected with each other; the fixing device includes: the main rod is of a hollow structure, and a plurality of first holes are formed in the longitudinal direction of the main rod; pouring slurry into the main rod, wherein the slurry comprises a soil adhesive; the inserting plates are uniformly arranged on the periphery of the main rod at intervals; the connecting plate is connected between the parallel adjacent inserting plates, a cavity is formed in one side, facing the slope, of the connecting plate, movable supporting plates are arranged in the cavity, each supporting plate comprises a first supporting plate and a second supporting plate connected to the outer side of the corresponding first supporting plate, and a plurality of second holes are formed in the corresponding second supporting plate. The slope reinforcement structure has a good stabilizing effect, is beneficial to building integral reinforcement on a slope, timely discovers and prevents possible slope disaster phenomena, and further has a buffer structure for reducing disaster occurrence.

title_en: Grouting reinforcement transformation method for coal seam floor limestone confined aquifer
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal mine water disaster prevention and control, and provides a grouting reinforcement and reconstruction method for a coal bed bottom plate limestone confined aquifer, wherein a grouting reinforcement and reconstruction engineering scheme is designed for the coal bed bottom plate limestone confined aquifer, a grouting reinforcement and reconstruction range is determined, then, drilling plane positions are designed according to a grid method, and drilling holes are uniformly distributed; the drill holes in the drill site are uniformly arranged in an umbrella shape, and the design direction of the drill holes is vertical or oblique to the development direction of the fracture structure and the crack; then, carrying out drilling and grouting engineering construction, arranging a drilling field for drilling and grouting work in the same gate way, arranging a set of drilling and grouting equipment in the same drilling field, continuously carrying out drilling and grouting operation, grouting immediately after one drilling construction is finished, and then constructing another drilling; and finally, carrying out grouting effect inspection and evaluation. The safe, environment-friendly, high-quality and efficient mining of the fully mechanized coal mining face threatened by the water hazard of the coal bed floor limestone confined aquifer is realized by grouting, reinforcing and transforming the coal bed floor limestone confined aquifer.

title_en: Risk quantitative evaluation method and device for geological disaster chain after strong earthquake
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster risk assessment, in particular to a quantitative risk assessment method for a geological disaster chain after a strong earthquake. According to the method, a complete risk evaluation framework system of the post-earthquake geological disaster chain is set up, so that the interaction among all disasters can be quantitatively evaluated, the interaction between the disasters and the vulnerability of a disaster bearing body can be quantitatively evaluated, the potential danger degree of the disaster chain can be comprehensively and accurately evaluated, and reference is made for decision of a post-disaster reconstruction scheme.

title_en: Special buoyancy ladder device for six-storey building
abstract_en: A special device of a six-storey buoyancy ladder, belonging to the technical field of building stairs. In the early stage of the building of the fifth floor and the sixth floor, a few elevators are arranged. At present, the building main body structure cannot be reconstructed by adding the elevator, and the invention of the buoyancy elevator brings hope for solving the problem. The invention drives the buoyancy platform to lift through the lifting of the water level of the buoyancy ladder pool, thereby providing convenience for the residential building group to go upstairs and downstairs. Firstly, a buoyancy ladder pool with required height and capacity is built, and the buoyancy ladder pool is built at the exit of each unit corridor without influencing the entrance and exit of the pedestrian stairs. The invention adopts a circular buoyancy ladder water pool. A specially-made buoyancy platform is placed in the water pool, and the purpose of going upstairs and downstairs is achieved by utilizing the lifting of the buoyancy platform. Two groups of high-pressure water pipes are arranged on the outer wall of the water pool, so that the orderly ascending of the buoyancy platform is controlled. The lower part of the buoyancy lift pool is provided with a water drain gate, so that the orderly descending of the buoyancy platform is controlled. Meanwhile, when the resident encounters a disaster, a path for rescue and escape is provided.

title_en: Fire-fighting gun turret water cannon valve line transformation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for modifying a valve line of a water monitor of a fire-fighting gun turret, which comprises the following steps: step 1: the problems of the original fire monitor valve can be known by looking deeply at the site; step 2: on the basis of skillfully mastering the control principle of a limetock actuator, skillfully mastering an electrical control system of a fire monitor valve; and step 3: then, carrying out a plurality of field detections, perfecting and drawing a circuit diagram; and 4, step 4: then adding a valve power supply control switch; and 5: and finally completing line reconstruction through disconnecting, wiring and debugging. According to the method for modifying the valve line of the water monitor of the fire monitor tower, the valve line of the fire monitor can be more durable and safer, the production and maintenance cost can be reduced, the quality of the valve line of the fire monitor and the maintenance efficiency of the valve line of the fire monitor are improved through the improvement method of disconnecting and wiring, the waste is greatly reduced, and the method is suitable for popularization and use.

title_en: Intelligent warning device for forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The utility model provides a forest is intelligent warning device for fire prevention. Intelligent warning device for forest fire prevention includes: a box body; the motor is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the box body; the first bevel gear is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the motor; the two screws are rotatably arranged in the box body; the second bevel gear is fixedly sleeved on any one screw, and the first bevel gear is meshed with the second bevel gear; the two gears are fixedly sleeved on the corresponding screw rods respectively; the chain is hinged on the two gears; the partition plate is fixedly arranged in the box body; the device plate is sleeved on the two screw rods in a threaded manner. The utility model provides an intelligent warning device for forest fire prevention has the speech playback function, and the stronger advantage of protective capacities.

title_en: Fire-fighting propaganda car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting propaganda car which is of a carriage body type structure and comprises a carriage, wherein the carriage comprises a fire-fighting knowledge experience area, a generator area and a multimedia audio-visual playing system; fire control knowledge experience district with multimedia audio-visual playback system all establishes the left and right sides in carriage, fire control knowledge experience district includes 119 warning experience systems, family's conflagration hidden danger investigation interactive system, handheld fire extinguisher experience system, the rescue equipment of putting out a fire experiences display system, kitchen fire control safety experience system, electrical apparatus short circuit experiment platform, fire control knowledge and speedily answers system and building scene of a fire smog diffusion presentation system, the front portion in carriage one side is established in the generator district, just be equipped with the generator for the equipment power supply in the generator district. The utility model provides a fire control campaign vehicle has solved current fire control campaign vehicle function singleness, and the audience is difficult to the problem of the more comprehensive various situations that appear in experiencing the conflagration, is a functional diversity's fire control campaign vehicle.

title_en: Conference railway passenger car equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conference railway passenger car device, which relates to the technical field of railway conference passenger cars and comprises a car body, a steel structure, electrical equipment, water supply equipment, fire fighting equipment, in-car equipment and weak current equipment; specifically, a YW25B type passenger car is adopted, and subsequent reconstruction is carried out on the original passenger car on the basis of removing all equipment in the original passenger car; the steel structure comprises a power through wire slot, a branch box, a power connector mounting seat, a communication connector mounting seat, an air conditioner external unit mounting seat, a hanging seat, a welding partition wall, a round head plate, a top plate iron, a floor iron and a top plate hanging rib; the water supply equipment comprises a water tank, a water pipe, a water dispenser, a water passing device and a quick connector; the railway passenger car equipment special for the conference is provided, office and training at a remote office point are realized, and the railway passenger car equipment can be operated to the position of workers for office and training so as to be organized conveniently.

title_en: Vacuum degree associated partial discharge signal processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for processing vacuum degree associated partial discharge signals, and belongs to the technical field of signal processing optimization. Firstly, performing dimensionality reduction on a partial discharge signal with nonlinear structural characteristics detected by a transient ground voltage sensor, and then, researching the relationship between dimensionality reduced data and vacuum degree, thereby realizing the detection of the vacuum degree. The dimension reduction method comprises the following steps: first, each sample is searched k A plurality of neighboring points; secondly, reconstructing a weight seed matrix according to the neighbor points of each sample point W (ii) a Finally, according to W Matrix calculation matrix M Then to the matrix M And solving the eigenvector corresponding to the obtained non-zero eigenvalue. The method can process nonlinear high-dimensional partial discharge data, effectively avoid dimension disaster, well save the data correlation between local neighborhoods, and has the advantages of centralizing partial discharge characteristic parameters, improving the precision of the detection method and the like.
assignees: YUXI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multipurpose training equipment for fire fighting
abstract_en: The present invention relates to multipurpose training equipment for firefighting, and more particularly to multipurpose training equipment for firefighting comprising: a base frame part constituting an overall exterior frame of the equipment; a diving training tank formed inside the base frame part, having an opened upper surface and configured to store water therein; a boat motor inspection training room installed on the other side of the diving training tank in the base frame part with a structure capable of introducing water stored in the diving training tank, and having an inner space for storing water at a predetermined water level. According to the present invention, the equipment enables that fire drills are conducted while reproducing situations similar to or same as real disaster situations, to offer repetitive experiences and learning on various disaster occurrences, and accordingly, to give training for active response in the field where real disaster events occur and for effective initial response to disasters.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 소방용 다목적 훈련설비에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는, 전체 외관 틀을 이루는 베이스 프레임부와, 베이스 프레임부의 내측에는 상면이 개방되고 내부에 물이 저장되는 잠수훈련용 수조와, 베이스 프레임부에는 잠수훈련용 수조에 저장된 물이 공급 가능한 구조로 잠수훈련용 수조의 타측에 설치되고, 내부에 일정 높이의 물이 저장되는 내부 공간이 마련된 보트모터 점검 훈련실을 포함하는 소방용 다목적 훈련설비에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 실제 재난상황과 유사하거나 동일한 상황을 재현하면서 소방훈련을 실시하도록 하여 각종의 재난재해 발생을 미연에 반복 체험 및 습득할 수 있도록 할 수 있고, 이에 따라 실제적인 재난재해 발생 현장에서 상황에 따라 능동적으로 대처할 수 있도록 훈련할 수 있으며, 재난재해의 초기진압에 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 훈련할 수 있다.

title_en: Multipurpose training equipment for fire fighting
abstract_en: The present invention relates to multi-purpose firefighting training equipment, and more specifically, to a multi-purpose firefighting training facility which comprises: a base frame unit forming the entire exterior frame; a water tank for diving training formed in an inner side of the base frame, including an opened upper surface, and storing water therein; stairs installed on one side of the water tank for diving training and guiding to an opened upper portion of the water tank for diving training; a manhole rescue training room installed on one side of the water tank for diving training, provided with an inner space having a predetermined height, and including a manhole formed on an upper surface; and a valley life-saving training unit connecting, with each other, a pair of vertical poles corresponding to each other and installed on both ends of an outer side of the base frame unit to face each other, and provided with a wire rope positioned to cross an upper side of the water tank for diving training. According to the present invention, use of the equipment enables users to practice a firefighting training by simulating a disaster situation that is similar or identical to an actual disaster, so that the users can repeatedly experience the occurrence of various disasters, thereby acquiring knowledge to cope with the disasters in advance. Accordingly, the users can be trained to actively cope with a situation at an actual disaster site, and can be trained to effectively carry out initial suppression of the disaster.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 소방용 다목적 훈련설비에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는, 전체 외관 틀을 이루는 베이스 프레임부와, 베이스 프레임부의 내측에는 상면이 개방되고 내부에 물이 저장되는 잠수훈련용 수조와, 잠수훈련용 수조의 일측에 설치되어 잠수훈련용 수조의 개방된 상부로 올라갈 수 있도록 안내하는 계단과, 잠수훈련용 수조의 일측에 설치되며, 일정 높이의 내부공간이 마련되고 상면에 맨홀이 형성된 맨홀 구조 훈련실 및 베이스 프레임부의 외측 양단에 각각 설치되어 서로 마주보며 대응하는 한 쌍의 수직 폴대를 연결하되 잠수훈련용 수조의 상측을 가로질러 위치하는 와이어로프를 구비한 계곡인명 구조 훈련부를 포함하는 소방용 다목적 훈련설비에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 실제 재난상황과 유사하거나 동일한 상황을 재현하면서 소방훈련을 실시하도록 하여 각종의 재난재해 발생을 미연에 반복 체험 및 습득할 수 있도록 할 수 있고, 이에 따라 실제적인 재난재해 발생 현장에서 상황에 따라 능동적으로 대처할 수 있도록 훈련할 수 있으며, 재난재해의 초기진압에 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 훈련할 수 있다.

title_en: Landslide hazard prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster risk assessment, in particular to a landslide disaster prediction method and a landslide disaster prediction device.A digital terrain model is established at first, a research area is divided into grids, each grid is regarded as a unit, and geological and rainfall distribution information required by each unit is given; performing infiltration analysis to obtain the pore water pressure; calculating a safety coefficient by using an infinite slope model based on the pore water pressure, and solving the instability probability to judge the stability and reliability of the slope; collecting a large amount of historical landslide data, and obtaining an empirical relation for calculating the average value of the landslide movement distance through regression analysis; grouping unstable units with at least one side or one corner connected into a group, regarding the group as a landslide, confirming the position and the volume of the landslide, taking the landslide motion distance relation as a landslide motion resting condition, evaluating the motion track and the accumulation position of a landslide body, further predicting the influence range of the landslide, and providing scientific basis for post-disaster reconstruction and disaster early warning work.

title_en: Rocker slider type wheel-track form reconfigurable walking mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rocker slider type wheel-track form reconfigurable walking mechanism, which comprises a main body connecting support member, a power member, a wheel-track member and an unfolding mechanism, wherein the main body connecting support member is connected with the power member; when the deformation mechanisms are completely unfolded, the stability is good, the advantage of flexible movement is achieved, and wheel/track switching movement can be achieved, the reconstruction assembly comprises two deformation mechanisms which are symmetrically arranged about a longitudinal symmetry plane, the two groups of unfolding mechanisms are similar in structure, the two deformation mechanisms are respectively connected with the outer wheel connecting piece and the central connecting piece through revolute pairs and are connected with the machine body, and the rapid switching of the wheel/track movement form of the walking mechanism can be achieved through the folding and unfolding deformation of the two deformation mechanisms; the invention has high stability, and can be applied to a post-disaster rescue and reconnaissance exploration robot and a quick rescue moving mechanism.

title_en: Remote sensing image landslide automatic detection method based on three-dimensional space-channel attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote sensing image landslide automatic detection method based on a three-dimensional space-channel attention mechanism. And manually marking the remote sensing image and cutting a landslide sample to construct a sample library, then training a convolutional neural network based on a three-dimensional space-channel attention mechanism, and learning the characteristics of various landslide examples on the remote sensing image. And carrying out landslide detection on the new remote sensing image by using the trained network model, and realizing automatic and accurate identification of a landslide target on the remote sensing image. The invention has the following advantages: the method has strong robustness, and is more suitable for landslide detection tasks on remote sensing images than an original backbone network and other existing attention methods; for the condition containing various interference factors, the method has better anti-interference capability and can obtain higher identification accuracy; the method can be used for preventing landslide disasters, reconstructing after disasters, updating landslide databases and the like.

title_en: But butt joint reconsitution spherical robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a butt-joint reconfigurable spherical robot which has high maneuverability when a single ball moves, and can be in a snake shape or a quadruped shape after being in butt joint reconfiguration after a plurality of balls. The spherical robot is modularly designed on the basis of single-ball motion, and two swinging interfaces and four fixed interfaces ensure that the spherical robot can be in spherical butt joint with other units to be reconstructed into a snake-shaped robot or quadruped robot configuration. The robot can realize various motion modes such as all-directional single body rolling, snakelike advancing, four-foot walking, cooperative operation and the like through butt joint reconstruction. The spherical robot has the advantages that the spherical robot has high maneuvering capability of a single ball, can be reconstructed into a robot with other configurations after being butted, greatly expands the functions of the spherical robot, and greatly widens the application field. The invention can adapt to field complex environment and terrain, and can adapt to unstructured dynamic unknown environment such as field reconnaissance, disaster relief emergency and the like, and the invention can play an important role in the fields of military reconnaissance, disaster relief and the like.

title_en: Method for compiling transportation helicopter fire fighting comprehensive task spectrum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for compiling a fire fighting comprehensive task spectrum of a transport helicopter, which comprises the steps of taking a gas turbine rotating speed spectrum as a basic spectrum compiling parameter, dividing a task section into a take-off section, a middle section and a landing section, dividing the middle section into a plurality of fire fighting work cycle task sections, carrying out statistical analysis on mathematical characteristics of control parameters of each typical task section, determining the average fire fighting cycle number of the middle section, sampling and reconstructing a plurality of fire fighting work cycles according to the mathematical characteristics of the control parameters of the task sections, splicing the fire fighting work cycles to form the middle section, and combining the middle section with the take-off section and the landing section to form the comprehensive task spectrum; the method is simple and intuitive, and the description is accurate; the typical task cycle is taken as a typical task segment, and the typical task segment is taken as a spectrum compiling unit of a comprehensive task spectrum by establishing a mathematical model and a description method of the typical task segment, so that the method is more reasonable and has stronger universality compared with a load spectrum simulation method taking a single task segment as a spectrum compiling unit.

title_en: Peristaltic robot based on shape memory alloy
abstract_en: A peristaltic robot based on shape memory alloy is formed by superposing an active stress layer, a lower memory layer, an adhesive layer, an upper memory layer and a passive stress layer and is divided into a plurality of shape memory driving units through hinge strips. The invention is based on the principle that the thermal expansion coefficients of different materials are not matched with the automatic deformation of a structure, utilizes the shape memory alloy material, and is formed by designing the two-dimensional plane outline, thereby ensuring the rapid crawling capability of the micro-robot, greatly simplifying the structure, ensuring the design scheme of the robot to meet the requirements for manufacturing by utilizing an MEMS (micro-electromechanical systems) preparation process, having the advantages of structural function integration, small size, high crawling speed, convenient control and low production cost, having wide application range, being beneficial to military reconnaissance tasks and post-disaster reconstruction, reducing the complexity of interventional medical implementation and the cost of medical instruments, improving the accuracy and the popularity of operations, improving the accuracy and the efficiency of maintenance in micro-pipelines, and having wide military and civil dual-purpose prospects.

title_en: Automatic Fire Extinguisher System to sense fire and to search position automatically
title_ko: 화재의 자동감지 및 자동위치추적이 가능한 자동소화시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic fire extinguishing system capable of automatic detection of fire and automatic location tracking of a fire, which comprises: an input control unit (100) detecting the occurrence of a fire and providing image information and fire information of a fire site to a control unit; a control operation unit (200) analyzing image information provided from the input control unit (100) and providing the information to a driving control unit (300) so that firefighting water is sprayed at an ignition point; and a driving control unit (300) controlling the driving of a spray unit (310) through the information provided from the control operation unit (200).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재의 자동감지 및 자동위치추적이 가능한 자동소화시스템에 관한 것으로서, 화재발생을 감지하여 화재현장의 화상정보 및 화재정보를 제어부로 제공하는 입력제어부(100); 상기 입력제어부(100)로부터 제공받은 화상정보를 분석하여, 소방용수가 발화점에 분사되도록 구동제어부(300)에 정보를 제공하는 제어연산부(200); 및 상기 제어연산부(200)로부터 제공받은 정보를 통해, 분사부(310)의 구동을 제어하는 구동제어부(300);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하다.

title_en: The Development Of 360 Video-Content Technology Able To Experience The Timeline Of Cultural Assets
title_ko: 문화재 타임라인 체험이 가능한 360도 영상 콘텐츠 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a 360-degree video content system for providing a cultural asset timeline experience to a user, and more particularly, to technique development for reconstructing and creating existing cultural asset content into 360-degree video content to provide a 360-degree cultural asset content service, and a 360-degree video content system for providing a cultural asset timeline experience to a user by providing a reference content service using the same. The 360-degree video content system for providing a cultural asset timeline experience to a user comprises: a time-based cultural asset content part (10); a storytelling-based cultural content creation tool part (20); a strategy content part (30); and a content manager (40).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 문화재 타임라인 체험이 가능한 360도 영상 콘텐츠 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 문화재 360도 영상 콘텐츠 서비스를 위해 기존의 문화재 콘텐츠를 360도 영상 콘텐츠로 재구성하고 저작하는 기술개발 및 이를 활용한 레퍼런스 콘텐츠 서비스를 제공할 수 있는 문화재 타임라인 체험이 가능한 360도 영상 콘텐츠 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System and method for post-route analysis of an autonomous vehicle
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system and method for driving organization and subsequent analysis of an autonomous vehicle. In an exemplary aspect, the system and method comprise dividing a path of a vehicle into a plurality of segments based on predetermined conditions; monitoring both behavior of the vehicle and driving conditions during each of the plurality of segments; storing the behavior and the driving conditions in a plurality of records of an immutable storage; determining whether an accident has occurred involving the vehicle; in response to determining that the accident has occurred, retrieving for the plurality of segments the behavior and the driving conditions from the immutable storage; reconstructing the path using the retrieved behavior and the driving conditions and the plurality of segments; and analyzing the reconstructed path to determine a cause of the accident.

title_en: Method and system for generating an automated police report
abstract_en: The present disclosure generally relates to generating an automated police report after an accident. For example, a police officer may scan in an insurance card barcode, a VIN barcode, a driver's license number, etc., to populate fields of the automated police report. The automated police report may also include telematics data from an associated vehicle to determine an impact of a collision, a time and location of the collision, etc. A scene of the accident may also be reconstructed using satellite images and/or video taken at the time of the accident. For example, the scene may be reconstructed based on image sensors on the vehicle, weather data at the time of the collision, data communicated vehicle-to-vehicle from another vehicle, telematics data, etc. Images of the reconstructed scene and/or images of the actual scene from the satellite video may be included in the automated police report.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: System and method for simulating and analyzing marine accident
title_ko: 해양사고 재현 및 분석 시스템과 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for simulating and analyzing a marine accident and, more specifically, to a system and a method for simulating and analyzing a marine accident, wherein the system receives and stores data of fact information and estimation related to a marine accident, extracts data based on space-time conditions and format and types of data to process the data to be suitable for reproduction and visualization, generates events that perform a specified function when reproducing the marine accident, selectively combines extracted and processed data and events to generate scenario data, and performs chart-based visualization for the scenario data and processing of events.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해양사고 재현 및 분석 시스템과 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 특히 해양사고 관련 사실 정보와 추정 또는 예측 정보의 데이터를 입력받아 저장하고 시공간 조건과 데이터의 종류 및 형식을 기준으로 데이터를 추출하여 재현 및 가시화에 적합하도록 가공하고, 해양사고 재현 시에 지정된 기능을 수행하는 이벤트 들을 생성하고, 추출 및 가공된 데이터와 이벤트 들을 선택적으로 조합하여 시나리오 데이터를 생성하고, 시나리오 데이터에 대한 해도 기반 가시화 및 이벤트 처리를 수행하는 해양사고 재현 및 분석 시스템과 그 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Human rescue control system using radar human body detection sensor installed in a building
title_ko: 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a life rescue control system using a radar human body detecting sensor installed in a building. According to the present invention, the life rescue control system comprises: a radar human body detecting sensor installed on one side of each room inside a building; a server for receiving scene data; an emergency rescue center; and a scene command center for providing command for life rescue. According to the present invention, efficient life rescue can be implemented in case of fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인명구출 제어시스템에 관한 것으로서, 특히 건물의 각 방에 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용하여, 화재발생시 각 방에 사람이 있는 지를 검출하여 응급구조센터로 발송하고, 응급구조센터에서 현장의 소방관에게 정보를 송출하여 효과적인 인물구출이 가능하도록 구현된 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지 센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템에 관한 것이다.   
종래에는 다급한 화재현장에서 어디에 구조할 인명이 있는 지 확인할 수 있는 방법이 없었는데, 본 발명은 건물 내부 각 룸(room)의 일측에 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서와; 상기 레이더 인체감지센서에서 전달된 생체신호에 따라 룸 넘버와 인명의 존재여부를 포함하는 현장데이터를 전달받는 서버와; 상기 서버의 통신모듈을 통해 현장데이터를 수신하는 응급구조센터와; 상기 응급구조센터에서 송신된 현장데이터를 통해 화재현장에 실제 존재하고 있는 인명에 대한 정보를 파악하여 인명구조를 지휘하는 현장지휘센터를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템을 제안한다. 
따라서 본 발명은 호흡감지센서 및 심박감지센서가 소방관의 호흡수 및 심박수를 감지하고, 설정범위를 벗어나면 엘이디 점등과 진동 및 경보음을 발생할 수 있는 무선신호를 송출함으로써 사용자가 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 하여 긴박한 상황에서 더욱 안전하게 대처할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한, 소방관의 진압복 내측에 착용하는 셔츠 또는 속옷에 부착할 수 있도록 구성됨으로써 생체신호의 감지가 더욱 용이하고, 휴대 및 사용이 더욱 편리한 효과가 있다.

title_en: A fire engine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned waterproof fire truck, which comprises: a vehicle body (10) installed with a rotary turntable (15) on an upper portion thereof; a boom structure (20) installed in the turntable (15), and including a plurality of upwardly extending booms; a vertical driving support unit (30) installed at an end of the boom structure (20); a box bracket (40) supported with respect to the vertical driving support unit (30); a composite injection nozzle unit (50) installed in the box bracket (40), and injecting introduced firefighting water in a direct or non-mist form; a photographing unit (60) installed in a front side of the box bracket (40) to photograph a fire site; and a display (not shown) for wirelessly receiving an image photographed by the photographing unit (60) to display the same. According to the present invention, firefighting water can be accurately injected to an ignition point.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인방수 소방차에 관한 것으로서, 상부에 회동되는 턴테이블(15)이 설치된 차량본체(10)와; 턴테이블(15)에 설치되는 것으로서 상방으로 연장되는 다수의 붐으로 구성된 붐구조체(20)와; 붐구조체(20)의 단부에서 설치되는 상하구동지지부(30)와; 상하구동지지부(30)에 대하여 지지되는 박스브라켓(40)과; 박스브라켓(40)에 설치되는 것으로서, 유입되는 소방수를 직수 형태 또는 미분무 형태로 분사하는 복합분사노즐부(50)와; 박스브라켓(40)의 전방측에 설치되어 화재현장을 촬영하는 촬영부(60)와; 촬영부(60)로부터 촬영된 영상을 무선으로 수신하여 영상으로 표시하는 디스플레이(미도시);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
