title_en: Trailer type multi-surface folding type deformable recreational vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trailable multi-surface folding type deformable recreational vehicle which comprises a main body frame, a left box body and a right box body, wherein the left box body and the right box body are respectively arranged on two sides of the main body frame, the left box body and the right box body are both detachably arranged with the main body frame, and the main body frame comprises a cover plate at the top and side plates on two sides. A plurality of iron hinges are adopted, and the wall boards in different degrees are pushed, pulled and folded, so that the space is greatly expanded, a user can have a large space, and the requirements of multiple people can be met. And accomodate the back with the folding wallboard that the outside was expanded, volume when can reducing the delivery to car as a house also convenient more is quick when turning to. The multifunctional intelligent house can be widely applied to accommodation in various occasions such as motor home hotels, personal outing tourism, government epidemic prevention, emergency disaster relief and the like, can be subjected to various internal reconstruction, meets the requirements of different occasions, particularly meets the requirement of government epidemic prevention, and can be used in places of hospitals as isolation wards.
assignees: SUNRISE SMART BUILD IT CO LTD

title_en: Side slope DEM generation method based on ground three-dimensional laser point cloud
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope DEM generation method based on ground three-dimensional laser point cloud. Acquiring three-dimensional laser point cloud data reflecting the global characteristics of the surface of the slope by using a three-dimensional laser scanning system, and performing planar projection interpolation on the three-dimensional laser point cloud on the surface of the slope on the basis of a moving least square principle to obtain an interpolated reconstructed three-dimensional point cloud of the slope; then calculating the adjacent average distance of the three-dimensional point cloud K, identifying cavity repair point cloud from the interpolation reconstruction three-dimensional point cloud, and fusing the cavity repair point cloud into the original three-dimensional laser point cloud so as to realize the self-adaptive cavity repair of the three-dimensional laser point cloud; and finally, fitting a projection plane by using an MLS principle, performing point cloud normal vector calculation, constructing a DEM triangulation network model by using a Delaunay criterion, and organizing and managing the triangular patch by using a half-edge data structure. The method can utilize the discrete point cloud data to construct the slope DEM, and provide abundant terrain information for the aspects of digital disaster reduction, resource exploitation, safe production and the like.

title_en: Internal and external joint gunning reinforced fireproof plate type node structure and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an internal and external joint gunning reinforced fireproof plate type node structure and a use method thereof, which are used for judging that a fire disaster occurs; starting a pressurized water supply system, enabling water to flow from an outer pipe into a disc-shaped spray head body through an inner sliding pipe and impact a cambered surface bottom shell, enabling the disc-shaped spray head body to drive an inner sliding pipe ridge to slide along a pipe orifice reducing ring, enabling the cambered surface bottom shell to touch a lower node disc cover to fall off, enabling the inner sliding pipe ridge to continuously slide along the pipe orifice reducing ring until the surface of a gasket I contacts with the surface of a gasket II, spraying water mist from twelve nozzles at full pressure at the moment, completely wrapping the inside and outside of a plate-type node, and realizing heat insulation and cooling of the whole plate-type node; judging that the fire is extinguished, closing the water supply system, and reversely pushing the dish-shaped spray head body to drive the inner slide pipe ridge to slide along the pipe orifice shrinkage ring until the inner slide pipe ridge is stored and reset; and covering the lower node tray cover into the lower node tray hole. The invention provides a reference for the fireproof protection design of the newly-built aluminum alloy net shell and the fireproof modification and the revision of related standards during reconstruction and extension, and has huge social and economic and public safety benefits.

title_en: Application method of internal spray type fireproof plate type node structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a use method of an internal spray type fireproof plate type node structure, which is used for judging that a fire disaster occurs; a pressurized water supply system is started for a water supply pipe, water mist is sprayed out from a nozzle I connected with a node disc short pipe I, and a hollow node area formed by six chamfer I-shaped beams, an upper node disc and a lower node disc is filled with the water mist; meanwhile, water mist is sprayed out from a nozzle I connected with six I-shaped beams Liang Wanguan I, and the surfaces of rectangular webs within the half length range of the six chamfer I-shaped beams and the inner surfaces of chamfer upper flanges and chamfer lower flanges connected with the rectangular webs are covered with the water mist; continuing to spray, wrapping the whole plate-type node by water mist, so that the purposes of heat insulation and temperature reduction and aluminum alloy component temperature inhibition are realized; and judging that the fire is extinguished, and ensuring that the aluminum alloy component is cooled to room temperature to close the water supply system. The invention provides a reference for the fireproof protection design of the newly-built aluminum alloy net shell structural member and the fireproof modification and revision of related standards during reconstruction and expansion, and is beneficial to improving the safety development level of the space structure in China.

title_en: Wisdom fire extinguishing system based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting system based on the Internet of things, wherein an environmental parameter acquisition module acquires environmental parameters in a region to be monitored and feeds back the acquired data to a Personal Computer (PC) in real time, the PC is internally provided with an operating data post-processing system which comprises a data storage module, a fire early warning module, a task track planning module and a visual playback module, and the visual playback module realizes the playback of fire conditions in a three-dimensional simulation mode on the basis of construction drawings of the region to be monitored, the data acquired by the environmental parameter acquisition module and tasks and tracks of a fire-fighting robot and an evacuation robot. The method and the system can quickly find the fire or fire safety hidden danger in the area to be detected and generate a corresponding fire-fighting task, thereby quickly realizing the control and removal of the fire or fire safety hidden danger.
assignees: URUMQI FUDI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;XINJIANG XINFUDI INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD;XINJIANG NEW DEV VOCATIONAL SKILLS TRAINING SCHOOL

title_en: Laboratory stirring fire fighting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a stirring defoaming device for a laboratory, which carries out interlayer reconstruction on an original defoaming stainless steel barrel, and adds a cooling function and a vacuumizing function besides keeping the original stirring function; make all devices concentrate on mobilizable platform, main part platform comprises main part support and top mount and bottom mount, and the control end of motor connects machine controller, and the motor support setting is put on the central point of top mount, and the stirring rod on the defoaming cauldron passes through the shaft coupling and is connected with the motor shaft, the defoaming cauldron is provided with cooling water intermediate layer and evacuating device.
assignees: SHANDONG YUANZHENG DETECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for simulating damming process of barrier lake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-sand coupling simulation method for a damming lake bursting process, which relates to the field of water disaster defense and comprises the steps of describing a damming lake bursting forming and developing process by adopting a complete water-sand coupling control equation, solving the complete water-sand coupling control equation by adopting a finite volume method in a high-precision MUSC L-TVD-H LL C format, reconstructing interface Riemann value variables by using MUSC L to enable the interface Riemann value variables to reach second-order precision, inhibiting numerical oscillation by using a TVD algorithm, calculating Riemann flux by using H LL C, dispersing terrain source items by using a local terrain correction and water depth reconstruction technology, dispersing resistance source items by adopting an implicit method, and processing a gravity collapse simulation bursting process by adopting a simple geometric method.
assignees: CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENT RES INST CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Composition for detecting ATP in cells, and method for measuring microbial contamination degree of cultural property or documentary using the same
title_ko: 세포 내 atp 검출용 조성물, 및 이를 이용한 문화재 또는 기록물의 미생물 오염도 측정 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for detecting ATP in cells, and more specifically, to a reagent for detecting ATP in cells unique to the present invention, which can easily and quickly obtain reproducible and reliable data for not only bacteria but also other microbial cells such as fungi, a method for measuring the level of microorganisms using the same, and a method for measuring microbial contamination degree on a cultural property or a record using the same.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 세포 내 ATP 검출용 조성물에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 세균 뿐만아니라 진균 등의 다른 미생물 세포에 대해서도 재현성 및 신뢰성 있는 데이터를 쉽고 빠르게 수득 가능한 본 발명 특유의 세포 내 ATP 검출 시약과, 이를 이용한 미생물 수준 측정 방법, 이를 이용한 문화재 또는 기록물의 미생물에 대한 오염도를 측정하는 방법에 대한 것이다.

title_en: Traffic accident influence factor spatial effect analysis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic accident influence factor space effect analysis method which comprises the following steps of dividing a space research area of a traffic accident, obtaining an explanation variable and an explained variable required by modeling, deleting unreasonable explained variables, constructing space weight matrixes of incidence relations among different types of characterization research areas, carrying out space autocorrelation test, constructing an O L S model, adjusting the fitting goodness value to be maximum through F test, deleting the explanation variable which does not pass t test, reconstructing an O L S model, carrying out Lagrangian multiplier test on O L S model residual errors, re-incorporating the deleted explanation variable, constructing a plurality of space durene models, selecting an optimal space durene model and a final explanation variable, and carrying out quantitative analysis on the space effect of the traffic accident influence factors in the area.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY AND EDUCATION CHINA VOCATIONAL TRAINING INSTRUCTOR TRAINING CENTER

title_en: New fire service of high building
abstract_en: When a fire occurred in a conventional high-rise building, there has been a lot of difficulties in extinguishing the fire because a height of a fire ladder truck is limited. To solve the problem, proposed is the present invention which installs a fire suppression crane on the roof of the high-rise building, attaches a fire extinguishing house equipped with special equipment to a crane line, and puts the fire extinguishing house into a fire site quickly and accurately, thereby extinguishing the fire and saving precious lives.

title_en: Elastic power distribution network post-disaster recovery control method based on electricity-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas comprehensive energy system-based elastic power distribution network post-disaster recovery control method, which comprises the following steps of: carrying out power flow modeling on the network according to the fault; the method comprises the steps that with the aim of minimizing the cost of all recovery loss load post-disaster recovery strategies, an optimal coordination scheme is obtained for three post-disaster recovery measure models, namely a network reconstruction model, a diesel generator model and a gas turbine model; and judging whether the formed micro-grid meets the reliable operation condition, if not, moving the MESS according to the optimal path scheme until the formed micro-grid meets the reliable operation condition. The elastic power distribution network after-disaster recovery control operation method based on the electricity-gas comprehensive energy improves the elasticity of the power distribution network by three optimization strategies of network reconstruction, energy supply of a diesel generator or a MESS and energy supply of a natural gas network through a gas turbine and taking the lowest cost of the after-disaster recovery strategy as an optimization target, and guarantees quick and effective maximum recovery of power supply load by taking rescue load as a load constraint condition.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;QINGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fire blanket
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 화재현장에서 사용되는 개인용 방염포로서 방염소재로 이루어진 다각형 형태의 본체(11)와 본체(11)의 어느 한 면에  서로 마주보고 형성된 손끼움부(12)와 두개의 손끼움부(12)의 사이에 형성된 두개의 손끼움부(12)를 이은 선에 수직한 가상의 선상에 위치한 머리끼움부(13) 를 포함하여 화재시에 손끼움부(12)에 양손을 끼우고 머리끼움부(13)에 쓰고 몸을 덮음으로써 화재시에 불꽃과 열기를 피해 안전한 장소로 이동을 할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: Systems, methods and computer program product for supervision & improvement of officer performance
abstract_en: A system, methods and computer program product for law enforcement performance management is disclosed. The contemplated invention makes use of processors and modules for the collection, analysis and operation of system components regarding a law enforcement official's conduct, analysis and review before, during and after an incident. Additional aspects of the contemplated invention contemplate use of modules and sub-modules for incident data collection, post-incident training, analysis and review.

title_en: Remote Controllable fire fighting truck
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remotely controllable waterproof cloth and, more specifically, to a waterproof cloth having excellent accessibility for effective firefighting. According to the present invention, the waterproof cloth comprises: a body in which a fire hose is loaded; a track wheel coupled to a lower part of the body; and a waterproof cloth unit installed on a front side of the body to spray firefighting water at high pressure to a fire point.
abstract_ko:
본 개시는 사전 제작된 대형 소방차에 탑재하여 이동성과 기동성을 갖되 자체 동력으로 주행이 가능하여 화재 진압에 대한 유리한 위치 선정 및 접근성이 우수하고, 화재의 초기 진압성이 우수하여 인명을 보호하고, 재산피해를 최대한으로 억제가 가능하며, 소방호스가 탑재되어 있어 대형 소방차로부터 무거운 소방호스를 현장까지 운반해야되는 기존의 소방호스 제공방법이 개선되고, 이를 통해 소방전 등과 연결이 용이하여 화재 및 주변환경에 대한 적극적인 대처가 가능해져 화재 진압의 유리함이 제공되고, 골목길 등의 좁은 통행로의 각종 장애물을 피해 무거운 소방호스를 화재현장까지 운반이 가능하여 시간 소비의 낭비가 발생되지 않아 초기 진압이 유리하며, 원격 컨트롤에 따른 무인 이동이 가능하여 화재 현장에 투입된 소방관이 화염과 연소에 의한 유독가스 및 건물 붕괴, 고온의 화염이 발생하고 폭발 등의 위험을 받는 종래 문제점이 해결되고, 계단이나 건물 붕괴 등으로 인한 잔해에 따른 장애물 통과에 대한 극복이 유리하고, 좁은 공간이나 사람이 출입할 수 없는 곳에 접근이 유리해 효과적인 화재 진압이 가능하며, 화재 진압을 위한 복합적인 기술과 기능의 접목으로 인해 효과적인 화재 진압이 가능하고, 화재 현장에서의 소방 활동성이 보장되어 소방로봇 개발과 보급에 대한 발판이 되고, 화재현장으로 소방호스를 이동해 화재 진압을 함으로써 고압대 유량의 방수가 어려운 종래의 문제점이 개선되는 장점을 갖는 원격 컨트롤이 가능한 방수포에 관한 것이다. 
본 개시의 실시예에 따른 원격 컨트롤이 가능한 방수포는 소방호스가 적재되며, 기제작된 소방차에 상하차되는 몸체와, 상기 몸체의 하부에 결합되되, 계단 또는 건물 붕괴 등으로 인한 장애물을 통과하여 상기 몸체가 화재 진압을 위한 장소로 위치 이동되도록 주행시키는 궤도바퀴 및 상기 몸체의 전방측에 설치되되, 소방차 또는 소화전 등으로부터 공급되는 소방수를 화재 지점에 고압으로 분사하는 방수포를 포함하고, 상기 몸체와 상기 궤도바퀴 및 상기 방수포는 원격에 의한 무인으로 작동된다.

title_en: A broadcasting system for implementing broadcast control and optimal evacuation path using artificial intelligence
title_ko: Ai를 이용하는 방송제어 및 최적 대피로를 구현하는 재난 방송시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster broadcasting system which implements broadcasting control and optimal evacuation routes using AI. The system comprises a plurality of sensor units (100), a plurality of microphones (200), a main broadcasting server (300), a piece of broadcasting equipment (400), and one or more manager terminals (500). According to the present invention, the abnormal state of the broadcasting equipment can be accurately analyzed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 스피커에서 출력되는 소리를 수집 및 분석하여 방송 장비의 출력 상태를 점검하고 문제가 발견되는 즉시 자체 대응하되 지속되는 문제의 해결을 요청하기 위한 메시지를 관리자 단말기로 전송하며, 건물 내부의 환경 정보 및 소리를 수집 및 분석하여 재난 발생을 판단하고, 판단에 따른 메시지를 생성 후 방송 및 신고하여 재난 발생을 전파하며, 최적의 대피로를 산출하여 안내하고, 판단의 사후 평가 및 딥러닝 방식으로 재난 상황을 반복 학습하여 판단의 정확도를 향상시킬 수 있는 방송제어 및 재난 방송시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 AI를 이용하는 방송제어 및 최적 대피로를 구현하는 재난 방송시스템은 건물 내부에 분산 배치되어 환경 정보를 수집하는 복수 개의 센서부, 건물 내부에 분산 배치되어 소리를 수집하는 복수 개의 마이크, 구글의 텐서플로가 적용되어, 수집된 환경 정보와 기저장된 재난 정보를 비교 분석하여 건물 내부의 재난 발생을 판단하고, 다익스트라 알고리즘을 이용하여 재난 구역을 회피한 복수 개의 최적 대피로를 산출하며, 재난 발생 판단에 의해 재난 상황을 공지하는 재난 메시지를 생성하여 외부로 전송하고, 관리자 단말기로부터의 피드백을 통해 딥러닝 방식으로 재난 상황을 반복 학습하며, 수집된 소리를 분석하여 방송 장비의 상태를 점검하고, 발견된 문제에 대응하며, 문제가 지속되는 방송 장비의 증상을 문자화한 증상 메시지를 관리자 단말기로 전송하는 메인 방송서버, 재난 메시지를 기반으로 건물 내부의 재난 발생을 구내 방송하여 전파하는 방송 장비 및, 재난 메시지 및 증상 메시지를 수신하여 화면에 표시 가능하고, 메인 방송서버에 피드백 가능한 하나 이상의 관리자 단말기를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire extinguish system for indoor
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실내용 화재감지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 화재발생시 불꽃감지와 가연성 물질의 연소시 발생되는 연소가스 및 유독가스를 감지하기 위한 센서가 한 개 이상 구비되어 각 센서에서 감지된 신호를 수신하는 센서관리모듈(20); 상기 센서관리모듈(20)에서 수신된 신호를 분석하여 인체 유해가스로 판단된 경우 실내에서 설치된 환기장치(42) 또는 배기장치(44)의 동작을 제어하는 환기제어모듈(40)과, 상기 센서관리모듈(20)에서 수신된 신호를 분석하여 화재로 판단된 경우 천정에 설치된 스프링쿨러를 동작시키거나 분무용 소화약제를 살포하도록 제어하는 소화장치제어모듈(60)과, 상기 센서관리모듈(20)에서 수신된 신호가 화재로 판단된 경우 외부로 화재경보를 알리도록 제어하는 화재경보발생모듈(50) 및 상기 각 모듈의 제어를 위한 마이컴이 구비되는 통합제어모듈(30);을 포함하되, 상기 통합제어모듈(30)에는 상기 센서관리모듈(20)에서 수신된 신호를 분석하여 화재 또는 가스 유입을 감지한 경우 실내 일측에 설치된 산소공급블록(72)을 개방 또는 낙하시키도록 제어하는 산소공급제어모듈(70)이 더 포함되고, 상기 산소공급블록(72)은 산소저장탱크에 연결되어 산소공급이 이루어지는 산소공급호스(73)와, 상기 산소공급호스(73)의 말단에 연결되어 화재현장에 있는 사람이 착용하여 공급된 산소로 호흡이 가능하도록 하는 산소공급마스크(74)를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Visual analysis and processing method for fire of large public building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual analysis processing method for fire of a large public building, which comprises the following steps that fire analysis needs to be carried out on a subway building, and the following steps are needed: the method comprises the steps of fire scene 360-degree panoramic image storage → fire scene material evidence reduction hotspot addition → roaming and jumping among a plurality of fire scene images → real scene and virtual character of the fire scene → animation creation of surrounding environment → fire scene image measurement → three-dimensional reconstruction of the fire scene → animation simulation of the fire process → reporting demonstration file of the fire scene. The invention utilizes the panoramic image, the scene real scene, the virtual character, the animation establishment of the surrounding environment and the scene image measurement to establish the virtual building engineering three-dimensional model, the digital technology provides the subway building scene for the model, simulates the fire trend and the fire scene change in the building under different environments, compares the existing fire scene, and can be used as the fire early warning demonstration reference after the summary.

title_en: Fire Field Search System
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire site search system. More specifically, according to the present invention, the fire site search system provides a control unit and a setting module of the control unit, sets the body temperature of a person with the setting module unlike objects in the urgent fire site where every minute counts, maintains the body temperature for more than a certain period of time, operates an alarm unit only when the movement is within a certain distance, improves the accuracy when searching for rescuers, and aids in the search.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 현장 수색 시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 본 발명에 의하면, 제어부와 제어부의 설정모듈을 구비함으로써, 촌각을 다투는 긴박한 화재현장에서 물체와는 달리 사람의 체온을 설정모듈로 설정하고 일정 시간 이상 체온을 유지 및 움직임이 일정 거리 이내이어야만 알림부가 동작하게끔 하여 구조대상자를 수색하는 데 정확도를 높이고, 수색에 도움을 주는 화재 현장 수색 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent linkage implementation method for auxiliary equipment of transformer substation based on alarm driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation auxiliary equipment intelligent linkage implementation method based on alarm driving, which comprises the following steps: (1) the auxiliary equipment monitoring system, the fire fighting system and the main equipment monitoring system send data information to the alarm service module; (2) the reconstructed alarm service module sends linkage alarm information to a linkage strategy processing process; (3) configuring a linkage alarm triggering condition, and carrying out initialization setting on a linkage strategy processing process according to the triggering condition; (4) importing linkage strategy database data; (5) and the linkage strategy processing process responds to the alarm information message and sends the linkage execution queue to the linkage execution process for execution. The intelligent linkage function and other modules of the substation auxiliary equipment monitoring system are deeply fused and reused, linkage strategy processing and result execution are decoupled, intelligent linkage function deployment cost is saved, real-time performance and flexibility are achieved, and distributed deployment across auxiliary equipment subsystems and safety zones is achieved.
assignees: NARI RELAYS ELECTRIC CO LTD;NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH

title_en: Smoke diffuser for fire drill and smoke diffusing system comprising it
title_ko: 소방 훈련용 연기 확산장치 및 이를 포함하는 연기 확산시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smoke diffusing device for fire fighting training, capable of reproducing a smoke diffusion phenomenon such as actual smoke in the upper part of a fire fighting training space, and a smoke diffusing system including the same. The smoke diffusing device for fire fighting training according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a smoke generating unit for generating smoke; a smoke mixing unit for generating mixed smoke by mixing the smoke generated by the smoke generating unit with helium gas; and a smoke discharge unit for discharging the smoke mixed in the smoke mixing unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방 훈련 공간의 상층부에 실제의 연기와 같은 연기 확산 현상을 재현할 수 있는 소방 훈련용 연기 확산장치 및 이를 포함하는 연기 확산시스템에 관한 것으로,  
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 소방 훈련용 연기 확산장치는, 
연기를 발생시키는 연기 발생부; 상기 연기 발생부에서 발생된 연기와 헬륨가스를 혼합시켜서 혼합연기를 발생시키는 연기 혼합부; 상기 연기 혼합부에서 혼합된 혼합연기를 배출시키는 연기 배출부를 포함한다.

title_en: Universal hatchet for fire fighting
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a universal hatchet for firefighting which is frequently used when removing an obstacle at a fire extinguishing scene. The present invention realizes a multifunctional hatchet of a novel form which is lightweight, is conveniently carried, and can be used to perform various functions including those of a hatchet, a chisel, and a crowbar when a firefighter enters a building to safely and quickly extinguish the fire at the fire scene. Specifically, since the length of the hatchet handle can be increased or decreased, the universal hatchet can be effectively used in a narrow environment on a fire scene and a situation where an object to be destroyed is at a high place or requires a large force and hence the overall safety and efficiency in fire extinguishing can be secured.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재진화 현장에서 장애물을 제거할 때 많이 사용되는 소방용 만능도끼에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 소방대원이 건물 내부로 진입하여 화재를 진압하는 과정에서 가볍고 휴대가 간편하며 도끼, 정, 노루발못뽑이 등의 다양한 기능을 활용할 수 있는 새로운 형태의 다기능 도끼를 구현함으로써, 화재현장에서 안전하고 신속하게 화재를 진압할 수 있으며, 특히 도끼 자루의 길이를 늘리거나 줄일 수 있기 때문에 화재현장의 좁은 환경에서는 물론 파괴 대상이 놓은 장소에 있거나 큰 힘이 필요한 상황에서도 유용하게 사용할 수 있는 등 전반적으로 화재 진압의 안전성과 효율성을 확보할 수 있는 소방용 만능도끼를 제공한다.

title_en: Foreign language learning system and foreign language learning method using electronic pen
title_ko: 전자펜을 이용한 외국어 학습 시스템 및 외국어 학습 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a foreign language learning system using an electronic pen to increase learning efficiency and a foreign language learning method thereof. According to the present invention, the foreign language learning system using an electronic pen comprises: a teaching material formed of pages having dot codes printed thereon and displaying foreign language learning content for each step by each page; the electronic pen including a correct recognition module detecting the dot code to recognize coordinate information, a lecture playback module outputting a voice lecture of the foreign language learning content corresponding to the coordinate information through an embedded speaker, and a recording module recording a foreign language pronunciation of a learner, and transmitting the recorded foreign language pronunciation of the learner to a learner terminal; and the learner terminal configured to perform communications with the electronic pen, receiving the foreign language pronunciation of the learner from the electronic pen, and including a pronunciation comparison/playback module alternatively playing a native foreign language pronunciation of the corresponding foreign language learning content with the foreign language pronunciation of the learner to perform pronunciation comparison for the learner.
abstract_ko: 전자펜을 이용한 외국어 학습 시스템 및 학습 방법이 개시된다. 개시된 전자펜을 이용한 외국어 학습 시스템은 닷코드(dot code)가 인쇄된 용지로 이루어지며, 각 페이지마다 스텝별로 외국어 학습내용이 표시되도록 구성된 학습교재; 상기 닷코드를 감지하여 좌표정보를 인식하는 좌표인식모듈과, 상기 좌표정보에 대응되는 외국어 학습내용에 대한 음성강의를 내장 스피커로 재생하는 강의 재생모듈과, 학습자의 외국어 발음을 녹음하고, 녹음된 학습자의 외국어 발음을 학습자 단말로 전송하는 녹음모듈을 포함하도록 구성된 전자펜; 상기 전자펜과 통신 가능하도록 구성되며, 상기 전자펜으로부터 상기 학습자의 외국어 발음을 수신하고, 해당 외국어 학습 내용에 대한 원어민 발음과 상기 학습자 외국어 발음을 교대로 재생함으로써 학습자의 발음비교가 이루어지도록 하는 발음 비교 재생 모듈을 구비한 학습자 단말;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Construction method of inorganic non-combustible foam insulation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for constructing an inorganic nonflammable foam insulating material, which can fill a space between an outer wall and an exterior material with the inorganic nonflammable foam insulating material without demolishing the exterior material such as marble or bricks of a building, thereby insulating the wall, preventing a fire from being spread to the other floor when the fire occurs, and excluding reconstruction after the exterior material is demolished for filling the inorganic nonflammable foam insulating material so that a cost can be reduced and a construction period can be shortened.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무기질 불연폼 단열재의 시공방법에 관한 것으로, 건축물의 대리석 또는 벽돌 등의 외장재를 철거하지 않고 외벽과 외장재 사이의 공간에 무기질 불연품 단열재를 충진시킬 수 있어서, 단열과 화재 발생시 다른 층으로 화재가 확산되는 것을 방지할 수 있고, 무기질 불연품 단열재의 충진을 위해 외장재 철거 후 재시공을 배제시킬 수 있어서 그에 따른 비용을 절감시킬 수 있으며, 공사기간을 단축시킬 수 있도록 구성된다.

title_en: training apparatus for pronunciation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for training pronunciation, comprising: a body which is formed to be gripped by a hand to be portable and on which a speaker and a microphone are mounted; a memory unit in which training guide word sounds enabling a user to audibly hear words by phoneme in Korean are classified and recorded according to a plurality of set difficulty levels; an operation unit which is provided in the body and equipped with a plurality of operation keys including replay and recording of the training guide word sounds; and a control unit which replays word sounds recorded in the memory unit to correspond to the operation keys operated by the operation unit, and records practice sounds input through the microphone in the memory unit when the operation keys indicating recording are operated. According to the apparatus for training pronunciation, infants and cognitively disabled persons can also perform articulation training while playing with apparatus for training pronunciation like toys, thereby improving training effect.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 발음 훈련 장치에 관한 것으로서, 휴대가 가능하게 손으로 파지할 수 있게 형성되며 스피커와 마이크로폰이 장착된 본체와, 국어의 음소별 낱말을 청각적으로 들을 수 있게 된 훈련가이드 낱말음이 설정된 복수의 난이도 레벨에 따라 분류되어 기록된 기억부와, 본체에 마련되어 훈련가이드 낱말음의 재생, 녹음을 포함한 다수의 조작키가 마련된 조작부와, 조작부에 의해 조작된 조작키에 대응되게  기억부에 기록된 낱말음을 재생되게 하고, 녹음을 지시하는 조작키가 조작되면 마이크로폰을 통해 입력되는 연습음을 기억부에 기록되게 처리하는 제어부를 구비한다. 이러한 발음 훈련 장치에 의하면, 유아 및 인지 장애자들도 장난감처럼 갖고 놀면서 조음 훈련을 할 수 있어 훈련 효과를 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: System and environment simulation method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion display technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and an environment simulation method based on a multi-source heterogeneous data fusion display technology, wherein the system comprises a vector data fusion display module, an image data fusion display module, a three-dimensional model data fusion display module, a site detection related data fusion display module and a POI module; the environmental simulation method of the system completes simulation of the disaster area field environment through a plurality of steps; the invention focuses on the reconstruction of disaster area sites by utilizing multi-source heterogeneous data simulation, concentrates the data of different sources, different data formats and different storage modes into one scene, uniformly displays the data, and aims at truly restoring the site situation by adopting a three-dimensional and animation rendering display mode, so that the fusion and display of the multi-source heterogeneous data are realized, the complexity of multi-source heterogeneous data utilization is reduced, a decision maker is faced with a data form which is not scattered and abstract any more, and the decision maker can more intuitively understand and judge the site situation in the highly simulated scene.

title_en: Converter transformer oil pit fire insulation test platform and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a converter transformer oil pit fire insulation test platform and a test method, wherein the test platform comprises a simulated overflow fire source, a flame-retardant fire insulation layer, a simulated oil conservator, a matched fire extinguishing system and a matched measurement and control system; the test method comprises the following steps: preheating oil injection of a simulation oil conservator, injecting oil into an opening oil pool, igniting the opening oil pool, recording flow, extinguishing a fire by a flame-retardant fire-isolating layer, extinguishing the fire by the opening oil pool, closing a test platform and repeating the test. The invention has the advantages that: the converter transformer oil pit fire insulation test platform and the test method are provided, an accident oil pit fire scene caused by converter transformer overflow fire is reconstructed, the research on the influence of different flame-retardant fire insulation materials and different flame-retardant layer thicknesses on the flame-retardant fire insulation effect of the oil pit is realized, the research on the influence of a fire water fire extinguishing process on fire spread is realized, the research on the risk that an oil-water mixture overflows the accident oil pit in the fire water fire extinguishing process is carried out, and the research on the effectiveness and the nozzle parameter optimization design of a bottom layer fixed fire extinguishing system at the position of an accident oil pit is protected.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent integrated fire-fighting mobile pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent integrated fire-fighting mobile pump, which comprises a fire-fighting pump group, a fire-fighting pump voltage-stabilizing pump group, an electric shock point pressure gauge, a voltage-stabilizing cabinet and a fire-fighting control cabinet, wherein the fire-fighting control cabinet controls the fire-fighting pump group; the pressure stabilizing cabinet controls a pressure stabilizing pump set of the fire pump; different pressure values set by the electric shock point pressure gauge send different signals to the fire control cabinet or the pressure stabilizing cabinet to switch on and off of the fire pump set or the fire pump pressure stabilizing pump set according to the different pressure values; the utility model has the technical effects that the reconstruction and the maintenance do not need to temporarily install and remove other equipment each time; the intelligent and integrated level is high, the installation is flexible and simple, and the control operation is simple; the intelligent container module prevents the shovel from being changed, and the equipment is convenient to disassemble, assemble and move; real-time wireless data transmission without manual on-site duty or periodic inspection; the labor cost is reduced to the maximum extent, and the working efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI ELECTRIC HIGH VOLTAGE IND CO LTD

title_en: Business model utilizing local restaurants to deliver meals to elderly people and singles who are not good at cooking
abstract_en: To provide a system for delivering nutritious and balanced meals to elderly peoples and singles according to this business model.SOLUTION: A menu table is created by selection from cooked cuisines of many local restaurants, and based on this, a management organization creates monthly and weekly menus. Each restaurant cooks according to the created menu, and delivers cuisines and side dishes after determining their prices. A nutrition management leader prepares meals that are nutritious and balanced using the cuisines and side dishes from the restaurants. The meals are delivered to member users at desired time in the morning, noon, and evening. This business model is a system that can be used as it is in a shopping district where vacant stores are conspicuous and a reconstructed shopping district after an earthquake disaster.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Database disaster tolerance method, device, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a database disaster tolerance method, equipment, a server and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a notification message from a first server in the plurality of servers, wherein the notification message is used for indicating that the first server stores the specified data to the first management and control component; selecting a second server from the plurality of servers, and sending a first instruction to the first server, wherein the first instruction is used for instructing the first management and control assembly to backup the specified data to a second management and control assembly in the second server; and when the first server stops working, sending a second instruction to the second server, wherein the second instruction is used for instructing the second server to reconstruct the database based on the backed-up specified data, so that the target database recovers the same database instance as before, the first server is replaced to continue providing service, and the continuity of cross-region disaster tolerance is ensured.

title_en: Emergency guide apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a linear emergency guide apparatus for extinguishing fire, in which a pair of wires come out in different directions from each other such that a user can rapidly find the way to escape from a site on fire or the like, and when a light-emitting wire is broken, the broken light-emitting wire can be separated and discarded and at the same time, and the light-emitting wire can be reused to be electrically connected. More specifically, the linear emergency guide apparatus for extinguishing fire comprises: a housing; a pair of winding rolls placed in the housing to rotate in the opposite directions to each other; and light-emitting wires wound on the outer surface of the winding rolls to come out and to be wound for a certain length, and emitting light by a power supply applied from a control means. The winding rolls include: a first roller; a second roller; and a rotary shaft placed between the first roller and the second roller to be rotatably axially engaged.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 한 쌍의 와이어가 서로 다른 방향으로 권출되어 화재현장 등에서 신속하게 살아나갈 수 있는 길을 찾을 수 있음은 물론, 발광와이어가 파손시에 파손된 해당 발광와이어를 분리하게 폐기함과 동시에 전기적으로 서로 연결되게 발광와이어를 재사용할 수 있는 소방용 선형 비상유도장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 하우징과, 상기 하우징 내부에 한 쌍이 서로 반대방향으로 회전할 수 있도록 구비되는 권선롤 및 각각의 상기 권선롤 외면에 권출 및 권취 가능하게 소정길이를 갖도록 감겨지되 제어수단에서 인가되는 전원에 의해 발광하는 발광와이어를 포함하되, 상기 권선롤은 제1롤러, 제2롤러 및 상기 제1롤러와 상기 제2롤러의 사이에 배치되어 회전가능하게 축 결합하는 회전축을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire engine with environment-friendly fire-extinguish water feeding pipe system having magnetization property
title_ko: 자력특성을 갖는 친환경 화재진압 급수배관시스템을 구비한 소방차
abstract_en: A fire engine equipped with an eco-friendly fire suppression water supply piping system having magnetic properties according to the present invention includes: a vehicle (10) that can be boarded and is operated by engine drive; a water tank (20) mounted on the vehicle (10) and storing firefighting water; a foam tank (30) installed at the rear end of the water tank (20) and storing foam; a hose storage box (40) installed at the top of the water tank (20) and storing fire hoses; and a water discharge gun (50) that discharges the firefighting water from the eco-friendly fire suppression water supply piping system (1000) with an ion-activated magnetization treatment function to a fire site. The eco-friendly fire suppression water supply piping system (1000) includes: a first pressure delivery pipe (100) that communicates with the water tank (20) and transmits the firefighting water by a high pressure pump (P); a distributor (200) connected to the first pressure delivery pipe (100) and having a distribution port (201) in the outlet direction to lower a flow rate; a plurality of second pressure delivery pipes (300) connected in parallel with the distribution port (201); a pipe joint device (400) that is independently connected to the first and second pressure delivery pipes (100, 300) to transmit the firefighting water, and suppresses a combustion reaction of the firefighting water by increasing the function of ionic bonding with substances generated in a fire source.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 자력특성을 갖는 친환경 화재진압 급수배관시스템을 구비한 소방차는, 탑승 가능하며, 엔진구동에 의해 작동하는 차량(10); 상기 차량(10)에 탑재되며 소방용수를 저장하는 물탱크(20); 상기 물탱크(20)의 후단에 설치되며 폼(foam)을 저장하는 폼탱크(30); 상기 물탱크(20)의 상단에 설치되며 소방호스를 보관하는 호스보관함(40); 및 이온활성 자화처리 기능을 가진 친환경 화재진압 급수배관시스템(1000)으로부터 유입되는 소방용수를 화재현장으로 토출하는 방수총(50);을 포함하되, 상기 친환경 화재진압 급수배관시스템(1000)은, 상기 물탱크(20)와 연통되며, 고압펌프(P)에 의해 소방용수를 이송하는 제1 압송관(100); 상기 제1 압송관(100)과 연결되고 유량을 낮추기 위해 출구 방향으로 분배구(201)가 형성된 분배기(200); 상기 분배구(201)와 병렬 연결되는 복수의 제2 압송관(300); 상기 제1 압송관(100) 및 제2 압송관(300)에 상호 독립적으로 체결되어 소방용수를 이송시키되, 소방용수를 화원에서 발생된 물질과 이온결합 기능을 상승시켜 연소반응을 억제시키는 관이음장치(400);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Construction site process management system using drone and construction site process management method using the same
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 건설현장 공정관리 시스템 및 그를 이용한 건설현장 공정관리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a construction site process managing system using a drone and a construction site process managing method using the same, capable of managing a construction site process by using a drone, managing site risks such as incorrect construction, over-construction, construction equipment, input and output of materials, and fire, and safely managing a risk area difficult to be accessed by a person in a construction site. The construction site process managing system using the drone of the present invention comprises: a drone (100) for obtaining an image, and thermal image information using a ground control point (GCP) of a construction site; a process management server (200) for producing a digital surface model (DSM) and a digital elevation model (DEM) by using a point classification method after image matching through the GCP observation for each image and then, extracting a point cloud in order to reproduce precise 3D data for an image photographed by the drone (100), producing an orthoimage by producing a true orthoimage or a normal orthoimage using the DSM and the DEM, and comparing the produced orthoimage with pre-designed data of the construction site to perform a process management including a current progress status, incorrect construction and over-construction management; a drone controller (ground control equipment) (300) including a flight control computer for controlling the drone (100); and a data transceiving terminal (500) for transceiving data with the drone controller (300) and the process management server (200).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론을 이용하여 건설현장의 공정을 관리하고, 오시공이나 과시공 및 건설장비, 자재의 입출력과 화재와 같은 현장위험 관리 및 건설현장에서 사람의 접근이 어려운 위험지역을 안전하게 관리할 수 있는 드론을 이용한 건설현장 공정관리 시스템 및 그를 이용한 건설현장 공정관리 방법에 관한 것으로, 건설현장의 지상기준점(GCP)을 이용한 이미지, 열화상 정보를 획득하는 드론(100); 상기 드론(100)에서 촬영된 영상에 대한 정밀한 3D 데이터 재현하기 위하여 각 영상별 지상기준점 관측을 통한 영상정합 후 포인트 클라우드(Point Cloud) 추출 후 포인트 분류 기법 이용하여 수치표면모델(DSM) 및 수치표고모델(DEM)을 제작하고, 상기 수치표면모델(DSM) 및 수치표고모델(DEM)을 이용한 True Ortho lmage 또는 Nomal Ortho lmage 제작을 통해 정사영상을 제작하고, 상기 제작된 정사영상에서 상기 건설현장의 미리 설계된 데이터와 비교하여 현재 진행상황과, 오시공, 과시공을 포함하는 공정관리를 수행하는 공정관리서버(200); 상기 드론(100)을 조종하는 비행제어 컴퓨터로 구성되는 드론조종기(지상관제장비)(300); 및 상기 드론조정기(300)와 상기 공정관리 서버(200)와 데이터를 송수신하는 데이터 송수신 단말기(500);를 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 드론을 이용한 건설현장 공정관리 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Combined disc spring sliding friction self-resetting energy dissipation damper
abstract_en: A combined disc spring sliding friction self-resetting energy dissipation damper belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and shock absorption. The upper and lower wavy outer sleeves and the left and right wedge-shaped inner cores are made of steel with higher strength. The left wedge-shaped inner core and the right wedge-shaped inner core are respectively welded with the left end plate and the right end plate. The inner sides of the upper and lower wavy outer sleeves are provided with grooves matched with the shapes of the wedge-shaped inner cores, and the wedge-shaped inner cores are arranged in the grooves of the upper and lower wavy outer sleeves. The high-strength bolt connects the upper and lower wavy outer sleeves together through an anchorage device, and the prepressing combined disc spring is strung on the high-strength bolt rod. The invention can meet the requirements of deformation and bearing capacity of the structure under the action of earthquake. The damper has the advantages of simple structure, clear working mechanism and strong energy consumption performance and self-resetting performance. The invention aims to solve the problems that the maintenance and reconstruction cost after the earthquake is increased and the energy consumption capability is insufficient because the common energy consumption damper has excessive residual deformation under the action of the large earthquake or the medium earthquake.

title_en: Memory alloy ring sliding friction self-resetting energy dissipation damper
abstract_en: A memory alloy ring sliding friction self-resetting energy dissipation damper belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and shock absorption. The self-resetting energy dissipation damper with the sliding friction of the memory alloy ring mainly comprises an upper semicircular outer sleeve, a lower semicircular outer sleeve, a wedge-shaped inner core, an end plate and the memory alloy ring. The upper and lower semicircular outer sleeves and the left and right wedge-shaped inner cores are made of steel with higher strength. The left wedge-shaped inner core and the right wedge-shaped inner core are respectively welded with the left end plate and the right end plate. The inner sides of the upper and lower semicircular outer sleeves are provided with grooves matched with the wedge-shaped inner cores in shape, and the wedge-shaped inner cores are arranged in the grooves of the upper and lower semicircular outer sleeves. The memory alloy ring is used for sleeving the upper semicircular outer sleeve and the lower semicircular outer sleeve together. The invention can meet the requirements of deformation and bearing capacity of the structure under the action of earthquake. The damper has the advantages of simple structure, clear working mechanism and strong energy consumption performance and self-resetting performance. The invention aims to solve the problems that the maintenance and reconstruction cost after the earthquake is increased and the energy consumption capability is insufficient because the common energy consumption damper has excessive residual deformation under the action of the large earthquake or the medium earthquake.

title_en: Multidirectional fully-variable-resolution regularization tomography method for surrounding rock of coal mine working face
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine working face surrounding rock transmission seismic wave first-arrival tomography method, in particular to a multidirectional anisotropic total variation regularization tomography method. The method mainly comprises the following steps: firstly, picking up a first arrival of the transmitted seismic waves; then, reading the coordinates of the shot point and the wave detection point to establish a transmitted wave observation system, and carrying out mesh subdivision on an observation area to obtain a ray length matrix in the mesh; and finally, solving the multidirectional anisotropic total variation regularization target function by using a Split-Bregman iterative algorithm to obtain a speed cloud picture in the working surface, comprehensively explaining the speed cloud picture by combining with the geological data disclosed by the working surface, and drawing a geological disaster-causing body distribution map in the working surface. Compared with the conventional tomography method, the algebraic iterative method and the combined iterative reconstruction method have the characteristics of high imaging precision, high calculation speed and suitability for actual data processing.

title_ko: 아파트 화재대피공간 및 세대별 비상통로를 통한 화재피난시설
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire escape space in an apartment house using emergency stairs as the escape space in the stair type apartment house, and an emergency passage for each household. A system in the fire escape space using the emergency stairs and the emergency passage for each household prepares against fires while having all survival requirements for people escaping to the escape space until the fires are completely extinguished, substantially, so that life damage is maximally reduced in a fire site when the large-sized fires occur in a large-sized building, thereby securing safety.
abstract_ko:
계단형 아파트에서 비상계단을 대피공간으로 활용한 아파트화재대피공간과 세대별 비상통로에 관한 발명이다. 
본 발명의 비상계단을 활용한 화재대피공간과 세대별 비상통로에 대한 시스템은 , 
대형건물에서 대형화재가 발생하였을 경우 , 
화재현장에서의 인명피해를 최대한 줄이기 위해서 실질적으로 화재가 완전하게 진화될때까지 대피공간으로 대피한 사람들이 생존하기 위한 모든 요건을 갖추고 대비하여, 안전성을 확보하고자 하는 것이다.

title_en: Conference railway passenger car equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a conference railway passenger car device, which relates to the technical field of railway conference passenger cars and comprises a car body, a steel structure, an electrical device, a water supply device, a fire fighting device, an in-car device and a weak current device; specifically, a YW25B type passenger car is adopted, and subsequent reconstruction is carried out on the original passenger car on the basis of removing all equipment in the original passenger car; the steel structure comprises a power through wire slot, a branch box, a power connector mounting seat, a communication connector mounting seat, an air conditioner external unit mounting seat, a hanging seat, a welding partition wall, a round head plate, a top plate iron, a floor iron and a top plate hanging rib; the water supply equipment comprises a water tank, a water pipe, a water dispenser, a water passing device and a quick connector; the railway passenger car equipment special for the conference is provided, office and training at a remote office point are realized, and the railway passenger car equipment can be operated to the position of workers for office and training so as to be organized conveniently.

title_en: Fire-fighting interactive experience system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire control is interactive experiences system, through setting up projector and projection screen, by the projector with the fire scene projection of virtualization on the projection screen, audio playback device, audible-visual annunciator, smoke release and heating device remove the environment atmosphere who founds the fire scene, then when experience person operation emulation fire extinguishing apparatus is to the fire scene fire source on the projection screen when putting out a fire the operation, then by the instruction control flame size of projector according to positioner and controller, thereby under the condition under building more lifelike fire scene, experience person's fire control training demand has been satisfied.
assignees: 3D NEW CULTURE CO LTD NINGBO CHINA

title_en: Data disaster recovery reconstruction method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data disaster recovery reconstruction method, a system, a device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of disaster recovery reconstruction. When the method is applied to an access platform of a data disaster recovery reconstruction system, the data disaster recovery reconstruction system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a main cluster platform, a standby cluster platform and an access platform. The access platform is respectively in communication connection with the main cluster platform and the standby cluster platform; the access platform receives an access request, wherein the access request comprises: an address of a primary cluster platform; and if the main cluster platform fails, the access platform forwards the access request to the standby cluster platform. By simultaneously establishing the main cluster platform and the standby cluster platform, when the main cluster platform fails, the standby cluster platform can be switched to in time, so that the service data can be restored in time, and the timeliness and the stability of the restoration of the power data system are improved.

title_en: Disaster recovery processing method and device, mobile terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster recovery processing method, a disaster recovery processing device, a mobile terminal and a storage medium, wherein the disaster recovery processing method comprises the following steps: when a data writing request is received, writing data to be written corresponding to the data writing request into the main server; synchronously copying the data to be written to the buffer server; and asynchronously copying the data to be written into the disaster recovery server, wherein the storage capacity of the buffer server is larger than or equal to the total input and output amount of asynchronous time difference from the main server to the disaster recovery server. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the problem of write operation delay caused by waiting for the completion of writing of the disaster recovery node can be avoided, and the complete data copy of the main server can be reconstructed.

title_en: Large-field-of-view optical dynamic deformation measurement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-field optical dynamic deformation measuring method, which comprises the following steps: s1: the installation equipment is used for connecting at least two cameras with the computer; s2: arranging a target, and sticking the target on the surface of a measured object; or, sticking targets on the surface of the measured object and around the measured object; s3: measuring a distance between each camera and a plurality of targets; s4: calculating external parameters of each camera; s5: and (3) deformation measurement, namely performing three-dimensional reconstruction according to the camera external parameters, shooting the deformation process of the actual measured object, and performing target coordinate three-dimensional reconstruction on the image shot by each camera in each deformation state to obtain deformation data of the measured object in the deformation process. The invention can realize camera calibration and deformation measurement in a large view field range, and is convenient for popularization and application in the fields of bridge detection, wind power inspection, power maintenance, geological research, disaster rescue, national defense and the like.
assignees: THE SECOND AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF XIAN JIAOTONG UNIV

title_en: Disaster management system using 3D BIM object model and disaster management Method
title_ko: 3차원 bim 객체 모델을 이용한 재난관리 시스템 및 재난관리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster management method and a disaster management system using a three-dimensional BIM object model which use BIM and GIS data to reproduce an actual physical world in a virtual space to realize a three-dimensional object model, sense a disaster occurrence in a disaster situation such as a fire, an earthquake, and storm and flood damage, and provide an optimal evacuation path. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the disaster management system using a three-dimensional BIM object model comprises: a plurality of disaster sensing units which are arranged in a preset area and transmit location information and disaster sensing information for sensing whether a disaster situation occurs; and a disaster management server to use BIM data for virtually modeling a building and GIS data for integrating and processing geography data for occupying a spatial location and property data associated with the geography data to construct a three-dimensional BIM object model, and determine whether a disaster occurs by disaster sensing information transmitted from the disaster sensing unit to generate an evacuation path on the three-dimensional BIM object model if a disaster occurs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 BIM 및 GIS 데이터를 이용하여 현실의 물리적 세계를 가상의 공간에 재현하여 3차원 객체 모델을 구현하고, 화재, 지진, 풍수해 등 재난상황에서 재난 발생을 감지하고 최적의 대피경로를 제공할 수 있는 3차원 BIM 객체 모델을 이용한 재난관리 시스템 및 재난관리 방법에 관한 것으로,  
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 3차원 BIM 객체 모델을 이용한 재난관리 시스템은, 기설정된 영역 내에 복수개로 배치되며 재난상황 발생 여부를 감지하는 재난 감지정보와 위치 정보를 전송하는 재난 감지부; 가상으로 건물을 모델링하기 위한 BIM 데이터와 공간상 위치를 점유하는 지리 자료와 상기 지리 자료와 관련된 속성 자료를 통합 처리하는 GIS 데이터를 이용하여 3차원 BIM 객체 모델을 구축하며, 상기 재난 감지부로부터 전송된 재난 감지정보로 재난 발생 여부를 판단하여 재난이 발생한 경우 상기 3차원 BIM 객체 모델 상에 대피경로를 생성하는 재난관리 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: 3D Modularization and Method of CT Image Information for the Restoration of Cultural Heritage
title_ko: 문화재 보존 복원을 위한 ct영상정보의 3d모듈링 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention is to accurately model a three-dimensional shape of a metallic cultural heritage and provides a method for performing CT imaging on an imaging target object and performing 3D modeling by removing external and internal noise from the data of the imaged CT image information. In addition, the present invention is to provide an accurate internal shape of a cultural heritage invisible to the naked eye by removing noise attributable to the light reflection unique to the metallic cultural heritage by a filter, a histogram method, or the like in the process of image information extraction through CT imaging. In the method for 3D modularization of CT image information for preserving and restoring cultural heritage according to the present invention, a CT image resulting from continuous cultural heritage (imaging target) imaging is extracted along with three-dimensional image information from the CT image. Image data and resolution data are separated from the CT image information and stored. Then, a binarized image is extracted by noise removal from the image data and a cross-sectional outline is extracted with respect to the shape of the imaging target. Outline point data is extracted from the extracted outline, internal noise is removed by filling the extracted outline, and then noise information on the extracted outline is removed. Then, the three-dimensional shape of the imaging target is reconfigured from the point data.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 금속류 문화재의 3차원 형상을 정확하게 모델링하기 위한 것으로, 촬영대상물체를 CT촬영하고 촬영된 CT영상정보의 데이터 외부 및 내부의 노이즈를 제거하여 3D모델링하기 위한 방법을 제공한다. 또한 본 발명은 CT촬영을 통한 영상정보를 추출하는 과정에서 필터 및 히스토그램 방법 등으로 금속문화재 특유의 빛반사로 인한 노이즈의 제거를 통해 육안으로 확인할 수 없는 문화재 내부의 정확한 형상을 제공하기 위함이다. 
본 발명에 따른 문화재의 보존 복원을 위한 CT영상정보의 3D모듈링 방법은 촬영대상물인 문화재를 연속 촬영한 CT영상, 및 상기 CT영상으로부터 3차원 영상에 대한 정보를 추출하고, 상기 CT 영상정보에서 영상데이터와 해상도 데이터를 분리하여 저장한 다음 상기 영상 데이터에서  노이즈를 제거하여 이진화 영상을 추출하여 촬영 대상물의 형상에 대한 단면의 외곽선을 추출한다. 
상기 추출된 외곽선으로부터 외곽선의 포인트 데이터를 추출하고, 상기 추출된 외곽선의 내부를 채워서 내부 노이즈를 제거하며, 여 추출한 외곽선의 노이즈 정보를 제거한 다음, 상기 포인트 데이터로부터 촬영대상물의 3차원 형상을 재구성하는 것이다.

title_en: Earthquake disaster assessment method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an earthquake disaster assessment method and system, comprising the following steps: acquiring abnormal values of the quantity of the mobile phone position data within a preset range around the earthquake center before and after the earthquake in a grid mode; calculating the difference of the quantity change rate of the mobile phone position data in each grid; calculating semantic loss degrees in each grid according to social media text data before and after an earthquake occurs; acquiring a disaster evaluation average value in each grid according to the quantity abnormal value, the quantity change rate difference and the semantic loss degree in each grid; and obtaining disaster evaluation grading results in each grid according to the ranking of the disaster evaluation average values. According to the earthquake disaster evaluation method and system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the disaster influence level is determined through the population change information of the mobile phone signaling data and the semantic information of the social media data, the disaster situation evaluation is carried out by utilizing the information from different sources to the greatest extent by utilizing the advantage complementation among the data, and data support is provided for assisting disaster management such as emergency rescue, post-disaster reconstruction and the like.

title_en: Fire-fighting data reading and interaction method based on BIM lightweight
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM lightweight-based fire-fighting data reading and interaction method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out component processing on the whole BIM model data to obtain each same component in the BIM model, establishing a database, and carrying out data labeling; identifying the fire fighting equipment data of the first database and the acquired fire fighting equipment data; and (5) carrying out light weight processing on the database data by corresponding binding and data change. The method takes the light BIM model as a building component data base, provides a digital twin data model of a building physical structure 1:1 for fire-fighting intelligent scene application through low-cost reconstruction model component rendering, component labeling, fire-fighting database matching and external fire-fighting real-time data acquisition, and enhances fire-fighting scene application such as fire-fighting facility operation and maintenance, and has important significance.

title_en: Active or passive communication equipment synthesizes collection and shelves
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active or passive communication equipment comprehensive container frame, which comprises a box body, wherein a box door is arranged on the front side of the box body, and the box door is hinged with the box body; a plurality of automatic closing devices are arranged in the box body, and access holes are horizontally formed in the positions, close to the top of each automatic closing device, of the rear side of the box body; according to the invention, the plurality of automatic protection devices are arranged in the box body, when flood occurs, water can generate upward buoyancy on the floating ring to enable the floating ring to ascend, finally the square frame enters the mounting cover and is attached to the inner wall of the mounting cover, the inserted rubber ring is inserted into the insertion groove and is extruded and deformed to ensure close attachment with the groove wall of the insertion groove, and meanwhile, after the inserted rubber ring is bent and pushed into the insertion groove, the attached rubber ring is completely contacted with the bottom surface of the mounting cover, so that the communication equipment in the bottom plate and the mounting cover can be protected, the water soaking phenomenon is avoided, the use can be recovered at first time, and the successful reconstruction after disaster is ensured.

title_en: Power grid rainstorm disaster long-term prediction method, device and system
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a power grid rainstorm disaster long-term prediction method, device and system. The method comprises the following steps: selecting a historical power grid precipitation data sequence of N months before a month to be tested in a target area, wherein N is greater than or equal to 4; decomposing the historical power grid rainfall data sequence into J power grid rainfall data sequences under different modes through wavelet decomposition, wherein J is log 2 An integer portion of N; predicting the power grid precipitation data sequence under each mode through an autoregressive moving average model; and restoring the power grid rainfall data sequence under each mode into the power grid rainfall prediction data sequence of the month to be detected through wavelet reconstruction. The embodiment of the disclosure performs wavelet decomposition, autoregressive moving average operation and wavelet reconstruction on the historical power grid rainfall data sequence of N months before the month to be measured,and a power grid rainfall prediction data sequence is generated, so that the power grid rainstorm disaster can be predicted for a long time.

title_en: Deterioration simulation system for falling zone of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster research, in particular to a reservoir area hydro-fluctuation belt degradation simulation system. The technical scheme simulates the rock mechanical property change of the falling zone rock mass under different water levels, different pressures and different temperature environments, the damage effect of pore water to the rock mass and the deterioration effect of dry-wet circulation to the rock mass, the method is used for improving the ecological restoration capacity and the landscape reconstruction capacity of the bank slope of the reservoir area, reducing the risk of secondary geological disasters in the reservoir area, improving the early warning and forecasting capacity of the geological disasters and guaranteeing the life and property safety of people.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Transmission tower grounding state sensing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission tower grounding state sensing device which comprises an impact current wave generation module, an acquisition module, an A/D conversion module, a data processing module, a data storage module, a judgment module and a mobile terminal, wherein the impact current wave generation module, the acquisition module, the A/D conversion module, the data processing module, the data storage module, the judgment module and the mobile terminal are sequentially connected through wireless communication. The method and the device realize online monitoring of the grounding grid conduction condition of the tower grounding grid under the condition of no power outage and no excavation of the grounding grid, find accident potential in time, locate fault points in time, provide scientific and reliable basis for maintenance and reconstruction of the grounding grid in time, prevent possible damage caused by grounding grid faults and guarantee safe and reliable operation of a power system.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foldable deformation car as a house of trailer multiaspect, including main body frame, left box and right box, left side box and right box are installed respectively in main body frame's both sides, left side box and the equal detachable of right box and main body frame installation, main body frame includes the apron at top and the curb plate of both sides. And accomodate the back with the folding wallboard that the outside was expanded, volume when can reducing the delivery to car as a house also convenient more is quick when turning to. The multifunctional intelligent house can be widely applied to accommodation in various occasions such as motor home hotels, personal outing tourism, government epidemic prevention, emergency disaster relief and the like, can be subjected to various internal reconstruction, meets the requirements of different occasions, particularly meets the requirement of government epidemic prevention, and can be used in places of hospitals as isolation wards.

title_en: Smoke and Fume Exhaust Device for Fire Suppression using Vortex
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smoke and fume exhaust apparatus for fire extinguishing using an eddy current, which is portable so as to be quickly installed and used at the fire site, reduces the number of casualties by collecting smoke and toxic gas generated at the fire site using eddy currents and discharging the smoke and toxic gas to the outside, and helps firefighters ensure visibility and safety so that the firefighters can rapidly suppress the fire. According to the present invention, a smoke and fume exhaust apparatus for discharging toxic gases including smoke comprises: a body in which a first actuator and a second actuator are built; a post having a hollow structure and connected to an upper surface of the body; a rotating transmission shaft which is inserted into the post, and in which the lower end is connected to the first actuator to rotate and a first gear is coupled to the upper end; an intake duct horizontally connected to the upper end of the post; and a first fan rotating by receiving a rotational force from the first gear along a center axis of the intake duct.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대가 가능하여 화재현장에 신속하게 설치하여 사용할 수 있으며, 와류를 이용하여 화재현장에서 발생하는 연기와 유독가스를 포집하여 외부로 배출시킴으로서 이로 인한 인명사고를 줄이고, 소방관의 시야 및 안전을 확보할 수 있게 도와주어 신속한 진압이 가능하도록 하는 와류를 이용한 화재진압용 배연장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Auto extinguishing system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic fire-extinguishing system which comprises: a starting container operator (10) which is operated by heat due to fire or a smoke detection signal; a starting container (20) which spurts starting gas (20); a first flow path (30) which passes through; a first branch pipe (40) which branches the starting gas flowing along the first flow path; a second flow path (50) which guides the flow toward a fire-extinguishing agent container; an actuator flow path (60) which guides the flow toward an actuator; a first opening/closing valve (70) connected to an end unit of the second flow path; the actuator (80) connected to an end unit of the actuator flow path; a second opening/closing valve (90) which realizes the same opening/closing operation of the first opening/closing valve; a third flow path (100) which guides the starting gas toward a needle valve of the fire-extinguishing agent container; an agent guide flow path (110) which guides the fire-extinguishing agent of the fire-extinguishing agent container, from which the fire-extinguishing agent is spurted through the needle valve opened by a pressurizing force of the starting gas, toward the second opening/closing valve; and an agent spurting flow path (120) which guides the fire-extinguishing agent of the agent guide flow path to be spurted to the outside which is a site on fire in accordance with the opening of the second opening/closing valve. Accordingly, the present invention is able to gain effects to unify the supply of starting gas for spurting the fire-extinguishing agent and the opening of the agent spurting flow path for extinguishing fire basically without dualizing the two, to rapidly extinguish fire, to omit an additional work in accordance with the conventional dualization, and to promote the improvement of reliability and competitiveness for the automatic fire-extinguishing system in general.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자동 소화 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 화재 발생에 따른 열 또는 연기감지신호에 의해 작동되는 기동용기작동기(10); 기동가스를 분출시키는 기동용기(20); 상기 경유하는 제1유로(30); 상기 제1유로를 따라 흐르는 상기 기동가스를 분기시키는 제1분기관(40); 소화약제용기측으로의 흐름을 안내하는 제2유로(50); 액츄에이터측으로의 흐름을 안내하는 액츄에이터유로(60); 상기 제2유로의 단부에 연결되는 제1개폐밸브(70); 상기 액츄에이터유로의 단부에 연결되는 액츄에이터(80); 상기 제1개폐밸브와 동일한 개폐동작을 구현하는 제2개폐밸브(90); 상기 기동가스를 상기 소화약재용기의 니들밸브로 안내하는 제3유로(100); 상기 기동가스의 가압력에 의해 개방된 상기 니들밸브를 통해 분출되는 상기 소화약재용기의 소화약재를 상기 제2개폐밸브까지 안내하는 약재안내유로(110); 및 상기 제2개폐밸브의 개방에 따라 상기 약재안내유로의 소화약재를 화재현장인 외부로 분출되도록 안내하는 약재분출유로(120);을 포함한다. 따라서, 기본적으로 소화약재의 분출을 위한 기동가스의 공급과 소화작업을 위한 약재분출유로의 개방이 이원화되지 않고 단일화되도록 하여, 이에 따른 신속한 화재진압은 물론 기존의 이원화에 따른 추가 작업이 삭제되면서 전반적으로 자동 소화 시스템에 대한 신뢰성 및 경쟁력 향상을 도모할 수 있게 되는 등의 효과를 얻을 수 있다.

title_en: Post-earthquake high-resolution remote sensing image earthquake damage building detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting earthquake damage of a building by using post-earthquake high resolution remote sensing images. Firstly, extracting a potential building set through WJSEG segmentation and a group of non-building screening rules; secondly, a seismic damage visual dictionary model is constructed by utilizing the characteristics of spectrum, texture and geometric morphology, and a semantic gap from pixels to seismic damage characteristics is spanned; on the basis, a visual dictionary optimization strategy based on intra-class and inter-class penalty factors is designed, and information redundancy and evidence conflict are reduced; and finally, further dividing the buildings into intact buildings, partial earthquake damage buildings and ruins through a random forest classifier. The experimental result shows that the overall precision of the method reaches more than 85 percent, so that key decision support information can be provided for emergency response rescue after earthquake and reconstruction after disaster.

title_en: Vehicle black box to which SAT variable block method is applied
title_ko: Sat 가변 데이터블록 방식이 적용되는 차량용 블랙박스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vehicle black box using an smart allocation table (SAT) variable data block method capable of acquiring an effective high-quality black box video for a sufficient period of time by storing recorded video data by varying the size of a data block for storing data when an event occurs or a manual is stored by applying a data storage algorithm using an SAT method that uses multiple partitions. The vehicle black box using an SAT variable data block method comprises: a recording part that acquires video data by recording the external environment of the vehicle; a storage part consisting of a header (H) area, a data (D) area, and a sector (S) area to store the video data in a multi-partition method consisting of normal/parking/event/manual partitions; and a control part that controls the storage part and displays the recorded video data in a playback part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차량용 블랙박스에 관한 것으로서, 멀티파티션을 이용한 에스에이티(SAT; Smart Allocation table) 방식의 데이터 저장 알고리즘을 적용된 SAT 가변 데이터블록 방식이 적용된 차량용 블랙박스에 관한 것이다.  종래의 차량용 블랙박스에서서는 사용되는 FAT 방식은 녹화중간의 사고시 저장이 불가능하고, 개인정보 및 사생활 침해 가능하며, 녹화재생이 복잡하여 속도가 저하되고, 저장매체인 SDCard 의 주기적인 포맷 필요할 뿐만 아니라, 일반 Tool 로 위변조 가능하여 블랙박스 영상의 증거가 조작될 위험성이 매우 높은 단점이 있으므로, 이를 개선하기 위한 본 발명은 차량의 외부 환경을 촬영하여 영상데이터를 취득하는 촬영부와, 헤더(H) 영역과 데이터(D) 영역 및 섹터(S) 영역으로 구성되어 상기 영상데이터를 노말/파킹/이벤트/매뉴얼 파티션으로 이루어진 멀티 파티션 방식으로 저장하는 저장부와, 상기 저장부를 제어하고 촬영된 영상데이터를 재생부로 디스플레이하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성된 차량용 블랙박스에 있어서, 제어부는 OS 상에서 API(Application Program Interface)를 생성하여 사용자가 데이터를 기록할 수 있도록 에스에이티(SAT; Smart Allocation table) 방식에 의해 저장부의 노말 파티션 또는 파킹 파티션에 영상데이터를 저장하다가, 이벤트가 발생하거나 매뉴얼 저장이 발생되는 시점부터 이벤트 파티션 또는 매뉴얼 파티션으로 지정된 각각의 데이터블록에 시간순서에 따라 구분하여 동시에 저장하며, 노말 상태 또는 파킹 상태에서 이벤트 또는 매뉴얼 상태로 전환시 노말 파티션 또는 파킹 파티션의 데이터블록중 데이터(D) 영역의 크기를 감소시키고, 상기 감소된 크기만큼 이벤트 파티션 또는 매뉴얼 파티션의 데이터블록중 데이터(D) 영역의 크기를 증가시키는 가변블록 방식으로 운영하며, 상기 제어부에서는 노말 파티션 또는 파킹 파티션에서 감소되는 데이터블록의 크기에 비례하여 노말 파티션 또는 파킹 파티션에 가변 프레임 레이트 (Valuable Framd rate)를 적용하여 다운된 촬영 프레임으로 전체 저장시간을 동일하게 유지하고, 촬영부에서 전달된 영상데이터를 암호화하여 저장부로 저장하고, 상기 저장부에 저장된 암호화된 영상데이터를 다시 복호화하여 재생부로 전달하는 암호화부에서는 LEA(Light Encreption Algorism)를 적용하여 암호화과정에서 영상데이터의 블록단위 배열을 랜덤으로 재배열하고, 복호화과정에서 재배열된 블록단위 배열을 다시 원상으로 복원하며, SAT에 적용되는 API중 라운드 함수에서 ARX(Addition, Rotation, XoR) 연산을 사용하여 안전성을 향상시키고, 상기 저장부의 데이터를 복사하거나, 저장부를 분리하여 외부 컴퓨터에서 영상데이터를 시청하는 경우에는 암호화부의 LEA(Light Encreption Algorism)가 적용된 SAT 뷰어(Viewer)를 사용하는 것을 특징으로 하는 SAT 가변 데이터블록 방식이 적용된 차량용 블랙박스를 제안한다.  따라서, 본 발명에 의한 SAT 가변 데이터블록 방식이 적용된 차량용 블랙박스는 촬영된 영상데이터를 멀티파티션을 이용한 에스에이티(SAT; Smart Allocation table) 방식의 데이터 저장 알고리즘을 적용하여, API List의 OS 함수에 의해 저장 장치에 직접 기록할 수 있고, 저장장치의 물리적인 위치를 계산하여 테이블을 생성하고, 데이터를 저장 장치의 특정 위치에 기록할수 있으며, 파일 구조가 아닌 인덱스 및 북마크 구조 방식으로 파일 종료가 불필요하며, 비상종료시에도 파일 저장에 대한 안정성이 확보되고, 대용량 데이터의 저장시 시간 순서의 먼저 기록된 데이터를 순차적으로 덮어쓰기 하면 자동으로 최근 데이터만 남게 되므로, 공간 확보를 검색 및 삭제 연산이 불필요하므로, 유지관리의 편의성이 대폭적으로 향상되는 효과가 있다. 또한, SAT 가변 데이터블록 방식이 적용되는 차량용 블랙박스는 이벤트 또는 매뉴얼 발생시 데이터가 저장되는 데이터블록의 크기를 가변시키면서 저장하여, 충분한 시간동안 고화질의 실효성있는 블랙박스 영상을 취득할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Soil dehumidification and fertilization all-in-one machine after flood and fertilization method
abstract_en: According to the soil dehumidification and fertilization integrated machine and the fertilization method after flood disasters, water is drained immediately after the flood disasters, the water is drained from high to low according to the height of a field piece, if the water drainage period is high-temperature weather, a certain water layer is covered on the soil surface during the water drainage, if the water drainage period is rainy, the water is drained at one time, and the field is placed after the water is drained; digging a plurality of parallel ditches in a farmland range, and sprinkling one or a combination of more of perlite, soil loosening compound fertilizer and organic fertilizer in the ditches; then water-absorbing and water-retaining materials are spread, soil in the ditch is compacted, and soil is finely prepared to achieve the purpose of leveling the soil. By the three-in-one post-disaster reconstruction fertilizing method of the fertilizer, the soil can be dehumidified and dried, the fertilizer nutrients cannot be lost, the soil fertility can be quickly restored to a culturable level, and the method is favorable for grabbing and restoring agricultural production work after flood disasters.

title_en: Power transmission line differential mountain fire prevention strategy analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for analyzing a differential mountain fire prevention strategy of a power transmission line, which comprises the following steps of: obtaining difference data of external environments, wherein the difference data of the external environments comprise vegetation feature data of a power transmission line corridor, meteorological feature data of the power transmission line corridor, topographic feature data of the power transmission line corridor and fire custom data of the power transmission line corridor, and performing multi-dimensional difference analysis on the power transmission line based on the difference data of the external environments; calculating a quantitative risk assessment value of the power transmission line forest fire disaster one by the base tower; and outputting a mountain fire prevention measure configuration scheme based on the power transmission line mountain fire prevention configuration strategy according to the quantitative risk evaluation result. The invention can improve the operation reliability of the power transmission line, avoid resource waste caused by unreasonable design and reconstruction, and further effectively improve the technical performance and the economical efficiency of the mountain fire prevention project.
assignees: HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD WENCHANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Early smoke detection method for forest fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting early smoke of forest fires, which comprises the steps of obtaining video experimental source video data of early smoke of forest fires through a multi-rotor aircraft; extracting the background of the video according to the background fuzzy model, then decomposing the frame image of the video through two-dimensional discrete wavelet transform, and reconstructing to finish the feature discrimination of the smoke. The method and the device respectively use two groups of source video data of the traditional remote side shooting angle and the close-range aerial shooting angle for detection and comparison. The detection method provided by the invention can better avoid and eliminate the interference of sky, cloud, fog and the like on the early-stage smoke detection of forest fire, so as to improve the accuracy of the early-stage smoke detection of forest fire.

title_en: Highway network data management system
