abstract_en: The invention provides a road network data management system, which comprises a public basic data management subsystem, a road surface basic data subsystem, a bridge and culvert basic data management subsystem and a standardized pile number subsystem, wherein the public basic data management subsystem comprises a public basic data management subsystem, a road surface basic data management subsystem, a bridge and culvert basic data management subsystem and a standardized pile number subsystem; the public basic data management subsystem comprises a route management unit and a route pile number conversion unit, and the pavement basic data subsystem comprises a pavement disaster management unit; the bridge and culvert basic data management subsystem comprises a bridge information management unit and a culvert information management unit; the standardized pile number subsystem is used for storing standardized pile numbers, mapping the standardized pile numbers and pile number ranges contained in other management units one by one, and associating the standardized pile numbers with the corresponding pile number ranges; the standardized pile numbers are used for realizing the management of the road network data under different systems and different management systems, the pile numbers under various different systems are unified, the data of the large-scale road network are effectively managed, and the road network can be favorably applied to road projects such as road maintenance, road construction reconstruction and the like.
assignees: GUANGDONG HUALU TRANSP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Government affair data safety supervision system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of government affair data safety supervision, and discloses a government affair data safety supervision system, which comprises: deploying a chip-level firewall and access authentication system software on a special operating system deployed in a government affair database, and monitoring and deploying a database audit device a in a government affair database region by-pass; the chip-level firewall limits illegal users who pass the software authentication of the non-access authentication system to access the government affair database; when a user requests to access the government database, only the security authentication of the identity of the user through the access authentication system software is carried out, and the chip-level firewall allows the user to access the government database; the database auditing equipment a records all behaviors of accessing the government affair database, and omnibearing fine-grained auditing such as adding, deleting, modifying and checking operations of the government affair database, and supports the process and behavior playback function. The invention solves the technical problem of how to realize the security protection of government affair data in the process of promoting government affair disclosure and information sharing.

title_en: Zigbee network disaster recovery backup system, method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a Zigbee network disaster recovery system, a method, a device and a storage medium, and the technical scheme is as follows: after a first Zigbee gateway in a Zigbee network fails, a mobile terminal upgrades a first Zigbee device in a plurality of Zigbee devices to a Zigbee disaster backup gateway, and transmits Zigbee networking information of the Zigbee network stored in a cloud service platform to the Zigbee disaster backup gateway, so that the Zigbee disaster backup gateway and other Zigbee devices in the plurality of Zigbee devices perform Zigbee routing protocol message interaction to update a routing table, and complete Zigbee network reconstruction, and then the mobile terminal and the Zigbee disaster backup gateway are matched to realize the function of the first Zigbee gateway. The intelligent home system breakdown problem caused by the Zigbee gateway failure can be solved.

title_en: Automatic ejection technique and skydiving training system for improving pilot safety during transition to autonomous fighter jets
abstract_en: To improve pilot safety during the transition to fully autonomous fleets of fighter jets having better warrior capabilities.SOLUTION: Provided is an integrated pilot autonomous ejection system with skydiving safety/training, which combines sensors, hardware and software technologies to improve pilot training and safety. It offers pilots state-of-the-art cost-effective virtual reality skydiving and flight simulation training to prepare pilots for skydiving after ejections and for the dangers of vertigo and G-LOC, which can result in a crash in seconds. Related flight data, including information from cameras constantly monitoring pilots, can be used for debriefings/accident investigations which can be done in minutes.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Composite sensor fire detection apparatus and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for detecting a fire using a composite sensor, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the apparatus for detecting a fire using a composite sensor comprises: a communication unit (110); a memory unit (120); a battery unit (130) for supplying power; a fire detection composite sensor unit (150); a buzzer (160) for generating warning sound; and a control unit (180). According to the present invention, a fire can be suppressed at an early stage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 복합센서 화재감지에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 화재 발생시 발생하는 열, 연기, 불꽃 또는 연소생성물질을 감지하여 화재 발생시 안전하고 빠른 피난을 유도, 화재의 조기 진압을 위한 소방활동의 개시를 알리기 위한 복합센서 화재감지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  이와 같은 본 발명은 화재를 복합적으로 감지하는 복합센서 화재감지 장치에 있어서, 유무선 통신이 가능하도록 구성되는 통신부(110); 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100) 식별정보(ID)와 함께 상기 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100) 설치업체의 주소정보, 관리자 스마트폰 번호 정보, 주변 소방서 번호 정보, 업종, 조명 정보가 저장되고, 관리자의 스마트폰 번호 정보, 주변 소방서 번호 정보가 저장되는 메모리부(120); 상기 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100)에 필요로 하는 전원을 공급하는 배터리부(130); 화재를 복합적으로 감지하는 다수의 센서가 하나의 모듈로 구성되어, 화재현장에서 발생될 수 있는 연기, 온도상승 및 불꽃을 감지하기 위하여 연기센서(151), 온도센서(152) 및 화염감지센서(153)가 하나의 모듈로 구성되는 화재감지 복합센서부(150); 화재감지시나 상기 화재감지 복합센서부(150)의 이상(고장) 발생시 경고음을 발생시키는 부저(160); 및 상기 통신부(110), 메모리부(120), 배터리부(130), 화재감지 복합센서부(150) 및 부저(160)를 제어하며, 미리 설정된 주기마다 상기 화재감지 복합센서부(150)의 센서들을 미리 설정된 주기로 기동(파워 온)시켜 센싱(측정)된 데이터에 따라 화재가 아니면 설정주기까지 슬립(파워 오프)모드로 전환시키고, 화재인 것이 감지되면 상기 연기센서(151), 온도센서(152) 및 화염감지센서(153)로부터의 감지에 대하여, 연기인지, 온도이상인지, 화염감지인지 아니면 하나 이상의 복합적인 감지인지를 판단하고, 이를 상기 메모리부(120)를 참조하여 관리자 스마트폰 번호 정보에 따라 관리자 스마트폰으로 해당 화재정보를 상기 통신부(110)를 통해 전송하거나, 소방서 서버로 화재가 발생한 상기 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100) 설치업체의 주소정보, 업종정보, 화재정보를 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부(180);를 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 복합센서 화재감지 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Fire propagation prevention structure through drain pipe of building
title_ko: 건축물의 배수파이프를 통한 화재 전파 차단구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire spread blocking structure using a drain pipe of a building. According to the present invention, the fire spread blocking structure using a drain pipe of a building comprises: a wall fixture; a position fixture mounted in a fixture mounting space of the wall fixture; a drain pipe support; a fire extinguishing unit consisting of a fire extinguishing solution storage container and a fire extinguishing solution moving pipe; and a fire detection sensor. According to the present invention, reconstruction costs can be reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물의 배수파이프를 통한 화재 전파 차단구조에 관한 것으로서, 벽면에 배면이 밀착되고 내부에 형성되는 체결공에 결합되는 체결구를 통해 벽면에 고정되는 고정 수직면과 상기 고정 수직면의 끝단에 직각 형상으로 형성되고 상부에는 소화액 저장통을 지지할 수 있도록 지지면이 형성되는 고정 직각면과 상기 고정 직각면의 끝단에 형성되고 내부에 고정구 장착공간이 형성되며 하부에는 관통공이 형성된 하부 지지면이 형성되는 벽면 고정구; 상기 벽면 고정구의 고정구 장착공간에 장착되고, 중공형상으로 중앙에 배수파이프 장착공간이 형성되며, 내부에는 소화액이 공급되는 소화액 통로와 간격을 두고 배수파이프 지지구 결합부가 형성되고, 내면에는 상기 소화액 통로에 유입되는 소화액을 상기 배수파이프 장착공간에 배출할 수 있도록 간격을 두고 소화액 배출 통로가 형성되며, 상부에는 상기 소화액 통로와 연통되는 지지구 결합공이 형성되는 위치 고정구; 상기 위치 고정구의 배수파이프 지지구 결합부에 각각 장착되고, 내면이 배수파이프를 지지하고 외면에는 스프링 지지홈이 형성되는 배수파이프 밀착부재와 상기 배수파이프 지지구 결합부에 나선결합되고 내면으로 스프링 지지홈이 형성되는 마감체결부재와 상기 배수파이프 밀착부재의 스프링 지지홈과 마감체결부재의 스프링 지지홈에 양단이 지지되는 완충 스프링으로 구성되는 배수파이프 지지구; 상기 벽면 고정구의 지지면의 상부에 장착되고 내부에 소화액이 수용되는 소화액 저장통과 상기 소화액 저장통의 배출공에 일단이 결합되고  타 단은 위치 고정구의 지지구 결합공이 결합되며 도중에는 전자밸브가 장착되는 소화액 이동 파이프로 구성되는 소화부; 상기 위치 고정구의 내면에 적어도 하나 이상 장착되고 상기 배수파이프의 화재를 감지하여 상기 소화부의 전자밸브에 개폐신호를 전달하는 화재 감지 센서;를 포함한다.

본 접철식 빙글이 미끄럼틀 머신기는 전세계적으로 아파트, 빌딩 등이 고층빌딩으로 건축되는 추세에 비해서 지진이나 비상화재 탈출시 전혀 무방비이고 즉시로 탈출구가 없다는게 현실이다 그래서 
본 고안 머신기는 즉시로 화재현장에 있는 자동머신기를 아파트나 빌딩 관리자가 즉시 사용하여 소방차가 오기전에 고귀한 인명을 구하는 구출용이 된다는 것이다 어마어마하게 많은 아파트, 빌딩에는 전세계적으로 꼭 필요한 비상시 사용되는 안전장치기이다

title_en: Emergency fire hydrant for outdoor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an outdoor emergency fire-fighting box, which allows a resident to perform initial fire suppression before a fire truck arrives at the fire site, and allows a fire-fighting hose to be quickly dragged to the fire scene in a state in which the opening unit of an enclosure is rotated towards the direction of the fire in case of emergency. To this end, the present invention comprises: a fixated disk (100) fixated to the floor and having an insertion hole (110) inserted into a fire hydrant (10); a rotating disk (200) installed at the upper portion of the fixated disk (100) and having an insertion hole (210) inserted into the fire hydrant (10); an enclosure (300) formed in a semi-cylindrical shape to be fixated to the upper portion of the rotating disk (200) and having an opening unit (310) and a domed roof (320); a door (400) formed in a semi-cylindrical shape to be installed to be concentrically rotatable on the inside of the enclosure (300) to open and close the opening unit (310); a hose reel (500) composed of disks (510, 520) arranged in the enclosure (300), a coupling (530) connected to an angle valve (11) of the fire hydrant (10) by a connecting hose (531) to rotatably support the disks (510, 520), and a fire-fighting hose (540) wound between the disks (510, 520) and having a water gun (541); and a reel support member (600) installed at the lower portion of a roof (320) to rotatably support the hose reel (500).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방차가 화재현장 도착 전까지 주민이 초기 화재진압을 수행할 수 있고, 비상시 함체의 개방부를 화재방향으로 회전시킨 상태에서 소방호스를 화재현장으로 신속하게 끌고 갈 수 있는 옥외 비상 소방함에 관한 것으로, 바닥에 고정되어 소화전(10)에 끼워지는 삽입공(110)을 구비하는 고정원판(100); 고정원판(100)의 상부에 설치되어 소화전(10)에 끼워지는 삽입공(210)을 구비하는 회전원판(200); 회전원판(200)의 상부에 고정되어 개방부(310) 및 돔형의 지붕(320)을 구비하는 반원통형으로 형성된 함체(300); 함체(300)의 내측에 동심원상으로 회전가능하게 설치되어 개방부(310)를 개폐하는 반원통형으로 형성된 도어(400); 함체(300)의 내부에 배치되는 디스크(510)(520)와, 소화전(10)의 앵글밸브(11)와 연결호스(531)로 연결되어 디스크(510)(520)를 회전가능하게 지지하는 커플링(530)과, 디스크(510)(520) 사이에 권취되어 관창(541)을 구비하는 소방호스(540)로 이루어지는 호스릴(500); 지붕(320)의 하부에 설치되어 호스릴(500)을 회전가능하게 지지하는 릴지지부재(600)를 포함한다.

title_en: Manufacturing method of fire-fighting sheet for fire suppression using basalt
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire-fighting fabric (fabric sheet) covering an evacuee or covering a fire site when a fire occurs, and to a method for manufacturing a fire-fighting fabric for fire suppression using basalt, which comprises the steps of: crushing basalt, removing foreign materials and powder with lower hardness, and selecting only grains with 1 mm or more using a selector; crushing the selected basalt grains with 1 mm or more into basalt grains with 3 mm or less and then selecting metal using a magnetic selector; mixing 70-90 wt% of the crushed basalt powder, 9.4-29.4 wt% of polyethylene (PE), 0.2 wt% of an oxidizer, 0.2 wt% of a dispersant, and 0.2 wt% of a UV stabilizer to form a basalt mixture; allowing a hopper to move the basalt mixture to a mixer and allow the mixer to mix the basalt mixture at 145-160°C for 25-30 minutes; allowing an extruder to extrude the mixed basalt mixture at 300-320°C and to form chip-shaped basalt pellets; allowing a heating furnace to heat and melt the chip-shaped basalt pellets at 1200-1700°C, to push the melted liquid toward a small-sized hole of the extruder, to melt-spin the melted liquid, then to cool and solidify the melt-spun basalt and to form multiple strands of filaments; winding predetermined multiple strands of the formed filaments around a bobbin to form basalt yarn; and weaving a basalt fabric sheet using the wound basalt yarn to manufacture a fire-fighting fabric.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재발생시에 대피자가 덮거나 또는 화재현장을 덮는 소방포(직물시트)에 관한 것으로서, 현무암을 분쇄하여 이물질과 경도가 떨어지는 분말을 제거한 후 1㎜이상의 알갱이만 선별기를 이용하여 선별하는 단계; 상기 선별된 1㎜ 이상의 현무암 알갱이를 분쇄하여 3㎜ 이하로 분쇄한 후 자석선별기를 이용하여 금속을 선별하는 단계; 상기 분쇄된 현무암 분말 90∼70중량%, 폴리에틸렌(PE) 29.4∼9.4중량%, 산화제 0.2중량%, 분산제 0.2%, UV안정제 0.2중량%를 혼합 믹싱하여 현무암 혼합물을 형성하는 단계; 상기 현무암 혼합물을 호퍼를 통하여 믹싱기에서 145℃∼160℃로 25분∼30분간 믹싱하는 단계; 상기 믹싱된 현무암 혼합물을 300℃∼320℃에서 압출기로 압출하여 칩 형태의 현무암 펠렛(pellet)으로 형성하는 단계; 상기 칩 형태의 현무암 펠렛을 가열로에서 1200℃∼1700℃로 가열하여 용융시기면서 용융액을 압출기의 작은 구멍으로 밀어 용융방사 후 냉각, 고화시켜 다수가닥으로 된 필라멘트로 성형하는 단계; 상기 성형된 필라맨트를 소정의 복수 가닥으로 보빈에 권선하여 현무암 섬유사를 형성하는 단계; 상기 권선된 현무암 섬유사를 이용하여 현무암 직물 시트로 직조하여 소방포를 포함하는 현무암을 이용한 화재진압용 소방포 제조방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: High-resolution remote sensing image post-earthquake building detection method based on sparse dictionary
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sparse dictionary-based high-resolution remote sensing image post-earthquake building detection method. Belongs to the field of remote sensing and photogrammetry; the method comprises the following specific steps: 1. extracting a potential building set and constructing a multi-feature earthquake damage visual dictionary; 2. constructing a context relation based on spatial pixels in a visual dictionary; 3. the sparse expression of the visual dictionary can realize more detailed expression of the characteristics of the original image; 4. and obtaining a final detection result through earthquake damage building detection based on SVM classification. After an earthquake occurs, the method can quickly and accurately judge the position of the earthquake-damaged building, and has important effects on carrying out emergency rescue and disaster assessment after the earthquake; the method is characterized in that a plurality of groups of high-resolution remote sensing images after the earthquake in different areas and different sensors are tested; meanwhile, through further division of intact buildings, partial earthquake-damaged buildings and ruins in detection results, key decision support can be provided for emergency response rescue after earthquake and reconstruction after disaster.

title_en: Disaster monitoring and early warning method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster monitoring and early warning method, a disaster monitoring and early warning device, disaster monitoring and early warning equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a region to be monitored corresponding to crops, regularly acquiring the current latest remote sensing image of the region to be monitored, preprocessing the current latest remote sensing image, calculating to obtain a normalized vegetation index NDVI based on the preprocessed remote sensing image to be used as the current NDVI, acquiring historical NDVI in a preset storage region, comparing the current NDVI with the historical NDVI to obtain a monitoring result, and executing an early warning measure based on the monitoring result. The disaster assessment method has the advantages that the real-time monitoring is realized, the disaster is timely fed back to relevant departments, measures can be rapidly taken, the loss in a larger range is avoided, and the subsequent disaster assessment and reconstruction work is facilitated.

title_en: Converter transformer oil pit fire insulation test platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a converter transformer oil pit fire insulation test platform, which comprises a simulated overflow fire source, a flame-retardant fire insulation layer, a simulated oil conservator, a matched fire extinguishing system and a matched measurement and control system; the simulated overflow fire source comprises a simulated oil pit and an open oil pool, and the simulated oil pit is covered with a flame-retardant fire-proof layer. The utility model has the advantages that: the converter transformer oil pit fire insulation test platform reconstructs an accident oil pit fire scene caused by converter transformer overflow fire, the influence research of different flame-retardant fire insulation materials and different flame-retardant layer thicknesses on the flame-retardant fire insulation effect of the oil pit is realized, the influence research of a fire water fire extinguishing process on fire spread is realized, the risk research of the accident oil pit caused by overflow of an oil-water mixture in the fire water fire extinguishing process is realized, and the effectiveness and nozzle parameter optimization design research of a bottom layer fixed fire extinguishing system at the position of the protection accident oil pit is also realized.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Converter transformer overflowing fire simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a converter transformer overflowing fire simulation device, which comprises a simulation oil pit, an internal fire source of an oil tank, an opening oil tank and a flame-retardant fire-isolating layer, wherein two opposite side walls of the opening oil tank are provided with simulation net side sleeve lifting seat oil overflow ports, side walls adjacent to the two opposite side walls are obliquely provided with simulation valve side sleeves, and an ignition device is arranged in the opening oil tank; the oil tank is communicated to a simulated oil storage cabinet in the open oil pool through an oil pipeline, and an oil pumping device is arranged on the oil pipeline. The utility model has the advantages that: the simulation system can reconstruct the overflow fire scene caused by the explosion of the network side sleeve, the valve side sleeve, the top of the oil tank and the like of the converter transformer, realize the simulation of the fire scenes of the network side sleeve, the valve side sleeve, the oil tank body, the oil pit and the like with different sizes, and also realize the high-temperature hot oil fire simulation of the oil overflow of the fire heating transformer in the oil tank.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: System for predicting residual stress distribution of fire-damaged concrete structure, and method for the same
title_ko: 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물의 잔존응력분포 예측 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for predicting a residual stress distribution of a fire-damaged concrete structure and a method thereof which can predict a residual stress distribution in a fire-damaged concrete structure by analyzing a fire-damaged concrete structure sample collected at a site to predict a fire temperature curve and a fire damage temperature of a concrete structure and then using the predicted results, easily derive an overall residual stress distribution for each member of the fire-damaged concrete structure as well as the residual strength of a sampled location by checking the fire damage temperature distribution of the entire fire-damaged concrete structure, and clearly determine whether to restore the fire-damaged concrete structure or reconstruct the fire-damaged concrete structure after removal in accordance with the overall residual stress distribution of each member of the fire-damaged concrete structure. The system for predicting the residual stress distribution of a fire-damaged concrete structure comprises a fire-damaged concrete structure sample, a chemical analysis unit, a depth-wise residual chemical amount determination unit, a depth-wise fire damage temperature calculation unit, a fire damage temperature distribution deriving unit, a high-temperature condition-wise strength degradation rate DB, a depth-wise residual stress calculation unit, and a residual stress distribution deriving unit.
abstract_ko: 현장에서 채취한 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물 샘플을 분석하여 콘크리트 구조물의 화재피해온도와 화재온도곡선을 예측한 후, 그 결과를 활용하여 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물 내부의 잔존응력분포를 예측할 수 있으며, 또한, 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물 전체의 화재피해온도분포를 확인함으로써 샘플링한 위치의 잔존강도뿐만 아니라 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물의 부재별 전체의 잔존응력분포를 용이하게 도출할 수 있고, 또한, 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물의 부재별 전체의 잔존응력분포에 따라 화재손상을 입은 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물을 복구할지 아니면 철거 후 재건축할지 여부를 명확하게 결정할 수 있는, 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물의 잔존응력분포 예측 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Delivery route management method and delivery route management device
abstract_en: To provide a delivery route management method and a delivery route management device capable of reducing an opportunity loss by an automatic vending machine which should undergo emergency response in the case that there is the automatic vending machine that should undergo the emergency response during work following a predetermined delivery route.SOLUTION: A delivery route of a worker performing patrol work to a plurality of automatic vending machines is determined in advance, and the predetermined delivery route before starting a patrol is distributed to a portable terminal device of the worker (step S110). After that, present state information being a present state of each automatic vending machine during work following the delivery route is acquired (step S120). After that, if there is an emergency response automatic vending machine requiring emergency response on the basis of the present state information, a present delivery route is reconstructed in a delivery route with a pilot order of the emergency response automatic vending machine being a top priority, and the portable terminal device of the worker of the reconstructed delivery route is notified of the reconstructed delivery route (step S140, 150).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Real-time optimized scheduling method for thermoelectric combined system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time optimization scheduling method of a combined heat and power system, which comprises the steps of establishing a daily real-time scheduling model of the combined heat and power system according to technical parameters of elements in the combined heat and power system, and reconstructing the daily real-time scheduling model of the combined heat and power system into a Markov decision process; constructing a combined heat and power system at S t Optimal operation cost function from time T to time T of total scheduling domain under state State variable S based on combined heat and power system at time t t Combining random factors of the combined heat and power system at the time t, by minimizing an optimal operation cost function,solving the Markov decision process to obtain the optimal decision of the combined heat and power system at the time t, wherein, is an aggregated, decided state variable; the invention adopts a state variable aggregation mode to greatly reduce the difficulty of mapping the state variable into a value function, solves the problem of dimension disaster of the system state space, and can quickly and accurately carry out real-time optimized scheduling on the combined heat and power system.

title_en: Intelligent fire early warning system and method based on visual perception three-dimensional reconstruction technology
abstract_en: The application provides a fire intelligent early warning system and method based on a visual perception three-dimensional reconstruction technology, and relates to the technical field of image processing. The system comprises: the imaging module is used for acquiring an image of an area to be monitored and sending the image to the signal acquisition module; the signal acquisition module is used for receiving the image and sending the image to the intelligent control module; the intelligent control module is used for receiving the images, analyzing the images by adopting a preset algorithm, determining fire parameters and giving out early warning based on the fire parameters; and the power supply module is used for supplying power to the imaging module, the signal acquisition module and the intelligent control module. According to the method and the device, the image of the area to be monitored is obtained, the pushing is analyzed, key factors of a fire scene are analyzed based on a visual perception three-dimensional reconstruction technology, the real situation of the fire scene is obtained, the intelligent judgment of the fire alarm condition is carried out by utilizing a fuzzy algorithm according to the specific parameters, and effective technical support is provided for accurate fire rescue.
assignees: ZHIJIANG COLLEGE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Automatic locking device of transformer respirator
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power emergency protection devices, and particularly relates to an automatic locking device of a transformer respirator, in particular to a transformer fire protection device. The application comprises an oil storage cabinet and a moisture absorber, wherein the upper part of the outer wall of a breather locking device is connected with a lower flange of a breathing pipeline of the oil storage cabinet, and the lower part of the outer wall of the breather locking device is connected with an upper flange of the moisture absorber; the inside baffle wall that is equipped with of oil storage cabinet breathing pipeline, inside baffle wall are connected with the action baffle, and the action baffle is connected with the spacing pull rod on the respirator blocking device outer wall. The application can inhibit the overflow degree of insulating oil in the oil storage cabinet when the transformer body has fire disaster. The device has the advantages of easy recovery after action, reliable sealing after action and the like, has wide application range, low transformation cost and easy replacement, can ensure the reliability and the sealing performance of the device before action, has the instant action and the easy recovery after action when receiving signals, and is more reliable and stable in operation.

title_en: Redis-canal cross-machine room cache synchronization system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Redis-canal cross-machine room cache synchronization system, which is realized based on a Redis replication protocol, uses PSYNC commands to obtain write commands generated by Redis master nodes in real time, and replays the commands in a target end machine room through a synchronization system, wherein the whole system is divided into three layers: a console Apollo, a node discovery and data retention layer ZK, a data synchronization layer Redis-canal. The method is realized based on a Redis replication protocol, a PSYNC command is used for acquiring a write command generated by a Redis main node in real time, and the command is replayed in a target end machine room through a synchronization system; based on a Redis replication protocol scheme, improvement and optimization are carried out, and the following 3 problems are solved: 1. bidirectional synchronization is supported; 2. supporting cluster mode synchronization; 3. and the disaster tolerance capability of the synchronous system is supported.

title_en: Collapse rock disaster scene reappearing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collapse rock disaster scene reappearing method, which comprises the steps of constructing an integral panoramic three-dimensional model and a local collapse rock three-dimensional model, and extracting topographic and structural surface elements of a collapse rock disaster; taking the geometric surfaces forming the rock rolling body as polygonal surfaces surrounded by a series of vertexes, and establishing a rock rolling block body model; reconstructing a three-dimensional ground surface grid of the collapse rock disaster scene through the ground surface contour line control points and the material properties of the control points, and constructing a sliding bed block system model by utilizing the three-dimensional ground surface grid; and acquiring a triangular mesh of a collapsed body outline and a deterministic structural surface, generating a three-dimensional random joint network in the collapsed body outline by using the geometric elements of the random joint surface, constructing a collapsed block system, acquiring a collapsed rolling stone disaster scene graph, and realizing the simulation of the whole disaster evolution process. The method realizes seamless connection and effective fusion of data of measurement, model and calculation, reproduces the scene evolution process of the collapse rock disaster, and has the advantages of advanced technology, simple and convenient operation and the like.

title_en: Adaptive multifocal restoration method based on plankton digital holographic image
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and particularly discloses a self-adaptive multifocal restoration method based on plankton digital holographic images, which comprises the steps of firstly shooting a holographic in-situ image, then reconstructing the in-situ image, performing edge detection and threshold segmentation on the reconstructed image to obtain contour information of plankton in the reconstructed image, shearing the reconstructed image data set according to the contour information to obtain a target image data set, generating a definition index based on the gradient and variance of the target image, screening out the clearest target image based on the definition index, splicing the clearest target image to the in-situ image according to the original coordinates, clear images of plankton can be extracted, the problem of huge data processing existing in an acquisition system is effectively solved, the engineering quantity of marine plankton detection is effectively simplified, and further, the change of the number of plankton is effectively monitored, so that disasters such as red tide are forecasted.

title_en: Three-dimensional point cloud reconstruction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a three-dimensional point cloud reconstruction method, a three-dimensional point cloud reconstruction device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original three-dimensional point cloud of a target object, wherein the original three-dimensional point cloud comprises a first number of points; performing UV expansion on the original three-dimensional point cloud according to a first preset mapping relation to obtain an original UV image; inputting an original UV image into a pre-trained image hyper-resolution model to obtain a target hyper-resolution UV image of a target object, wherein the image hyper-resolution model is a model obtained by training a convolutional neural network according to a preset training set, and the preset training set comprises a sample low-resolution UV image and a sample hyper-resolution UV image of a sample object; and sampling the target hyper-resolution UV image according to a second preset mapping relation to obtain hyper-resolution three-dimensional point cloud of the target object. By applying the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, the problem that disaster is brought to the video memory when the 3D point cloud is subjected to the super-resolution processing is solved.
assignees: BEIJING QIYI CENTURY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire damage identification method for continuous beam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire damage identification method for a continuous beam, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a three-span beam structure model; s2, setting a working condition type N, and constructing a training sample A; s3, setting parameters and training a classification network of the support vector machine; s4, constructing a detection sample B by using the actual measurement modal parameters to obtain a classification predicted value of the fire condition; s5, reconstructing a training sample A1 and a fire time T; s6, constructing a wavelet neural network regression algorithm to form a regression detection model of the damage degree under a specific working condition; s7, constructing a detection sample B by using the actual measurement modal parameters to obtain a predicted value of the fire time; and S8, comparing with a threshold, outputting a result when ER is less than or equal to 5 percent and MAC is more than or equal to 0.95, and otherwise, returning to S1. The method has the advantages that the fire position and the damage degree can be effectively obtained, the method is used for guiding and perfecting the fire-resistant calculation theory of the engineering structure, and the method has important engineering significance.

title_en: Bone conduction voice enhancement method based on generation of countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of voice signal processing and deep learning, and aims to enable bone conduction equipment to obtain a better effect in extremely strong noise industries such as fire fighting, special duty, mining, emergency rescue and the like and obtain good voice communication quality under a strong noise background. Therefore, the technical scheme adopted by the invention is that based on a bone conduction voice enhancement method for generating an antagonistic network, preprocessing including short-time Fourier transform and cutting is carried out on collected bone conduction voice and air conduction voice; secondly, inputting the voice data obtained by preprocessing into a constructed confrontation generation network for training; and finally, inputting the bone conduction voice to be enhanced into the generator G of the confrontation generation network which is trained, and performing inverse short-time Fourier transform reconstruction on the obtained output result to generate the enhanced bone conduction voice. The method is mainly applied to the occasions of processing the bone conduction voice signals.

title_en: Landslide process analysis method, process numerical value reconstruction method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide process analysis method, a process numerical reconstruction method and application. The landslide disaster process analysis method provided by the invention is characterized in that an original landslide seismic signal is taken as a basis, IMF (inertial measurement function) principal component signals are extracted, time-frequency spectrum transformation is carried out, and then 5 stages of a landslide process are divided according to frequency energy characteristics of different time periods in the landslide seismic signal. The method extracts the transition stage of the landslide process for the first time. The invention provides an application of a landslide disaster process analysis method in landslide disaster analysis, landslide disaster emergency response scheme design and landslide event mathematical modeling. The invention also provides a landslide process numerical simulation reconstruction method, which is used for carrying out the numerical simulation reconstruction of the landslide process on the basis of the energy data evolution of the landslide seismic signals. And the application of the reconstruction method in landslide disaster analysis and landslide disaster emergency response scheme design. The method improves the abundance degree of landslide disaster basic data and the effectiveness of the disaster prevention and control emergency scheme, and has remarkable social benefit.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;CHANGAN UNIV;INST GEOPHYSICS CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Method for evaluating damage condition of equipment of sewage treatment plant in flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method of damage conditions of equipment of a sewage treatment plant in flood, aiming at the problem that the damage conditions of extremely complicated equipment in the sewage treatment plant after the flood are difficult to accurately and truly evaluate by artificial subjective judgment, according to the principle of easy acquisition and representativeness, the appearance damage grade, the equipment integrity grade, the water inlet damage grade and other damage grades are selected as the evaluation indexes of the damage conditions of the equipment, and an equipment damage evaluation system of the sewage treatment plant after the flood is constructed. And grading the 4 state indexes according to an index evaluation principle, and quantitatively assigning values to the evaluation grades. On the basis, the influence of the equipment short plate problem on the normal operation of the equipment is considered according to the wooden barrel theory, the damaged condition of the equipment is comprehensively and quantitatively evaluated by adopting a mathematical model, and the treatment measures of the damaged equipment are determined according to the evaluation result. The method can reasonably judge the treatment measures of the original equipment, promote the orderly implementation of the project and provide a basis for scientific estimation of the post-disaster restoration and reconstruction project investment.
assignees: SHAANXI INST OF URBAN & RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN

title_en: Geological disaster evaluation method for different stages before and after strong earthquake
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster evaluation method for different stages before and after strong earthquake. The method comprises the following steps: pre-earthquake assessment stage: a logistic regression method is adopted, potential strong shock areas are pre-evaluated based on historical shock examples of areas to be evaluated, and landslide occurrence probability of the areas to be evaluated under different earthquake shocks is evaluated; earthquake time response stage: adopting a Newmark method to conduct rapid emergency risk mapping in a short period after earthquake; emergency treatment: in a short time after an earthquake occurs, quickly acquiring remote sensing images after the earthquake, constructing a partial landslide database, and carrying out medium-term earthquake landslide space analysis and risk evaluation by utilizing incomplete landslide data interpretation results in combination with earthquake data, topography data and geological data; and (3) recovering a reconstruction stage: and in a long time after the earthquake occurs, constructing a complete landslide database by adopting a high-quality remote sensing image after the earthquake, and further carrying out earthquake landslide space analysis and risk evaluation.

title_en: Construction system of criminal suspect knowledge network using public security information and Method thereof
title_ko: 치안정보를 활용한 범죄인물 지식망 구축 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention uses various big data analysis techniques and search techniques based on an integrated security information data bank to create a human node with criminals and their related people and build a criminal person knowledge network by reconstructing incident contents through past criminal record information and correlation information with similar cases to provide a user with three-dimensional information related to a suspect.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통합 치안정보 데이터 뱅크를 기반으로 다양한 빅데이터 분석기법과 검색기법을 활용하여 범죄인물 및 그 연관인물들로 인명 노드를 생성하고, 과거 범죄기록 정보 및 유사사건과의 연관성 정보를 통해 사건 내용을 재구성하여 범죄인물 지식망을 구축하고 사용자에게 용의자와 관련된 입체적인 정보를 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Large civil engineering structure water leakage condition reconstruction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep learning-based water leakage condition reconstruction method for a large civil engineering structure, which can obtain Received Signal Strength Indication (RSSI) data through measurement according to a radio wave propagation path loss principle and obtain a loss factor distribution image through a water leakage condition reconstruction model. According to the method, the reconstruction of the leakage water state of the large civil engineering structure can be realized more timely on a large area and a large scale through the easily obtained correlation mapping relation between the RSSI data and the loss factor distribution image, and the structural damage, economic loss and casualties caused by the leakage water disaster can be reduced.

title_en: Underground personnel positioning system for mine safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground personnel positioning system for mine safety, which comprises a hand ring, a geomagnetic sensor, a three-dimensional attitude sensor and an intelligent control terminal, wherein the geomagnetic sensor and the three-dimensional attitude sensor are arranged in the hand ring, the intelligent control terminal is in wireless communication with the hand ring and is used for driving a corresponding character model to move in a built mine three-dimensional model according to received data collected by the three-dimensional attitude sensor, calculating the position of underground personnel according to the data collected by the geomagnetic sensor and the three-dimensional attitude sensor, realizing the accurate measurement of underground personnel distribution and personnel quantity, and simultaneously realizing the acquisition of the position of the character model at a certain time point in a script playback mode when accidental communication interruption occurs, thereby reducing the search and rescue range; a mine three-dimensional model is built on the basis of a design drawing of a mine, and a corresponding character model is driven to move in the built mine three-dimensional model according to data collected by a received three-dimensional attitude sensor, so that the visualization of the position of mine personnel is realized.
assignees: LANZHOU RESOURCES & ENV VOC TECH COLLEGE

title_en: CFD-based power transmission line icing state simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CFD-based power transmission line icing state simulation method, which belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster prevention of a power system and comprises the following steps: establishing a power transmission line wind tunnel model by utilizing computational fluid mechanics simulation software; carrying out grid division on the ice coating area of the power transmission line, and calculating the distribution of the airflow field around the power transmission line; establishing a motion equation of cooling water drops in the air, analyzing and solving a water drop running track, and further obtaining a water drop local impact coefficient; solving the icing quality of the power transmission line; calculating the icing forms of the power transmission line under different time step lengths, determining boundary movement and reconstructing; and analyzing the influence of different factors on the icing form of the power transmission line. The method adopts the computational fluid software to perform mixed grid division, is favorable for presenting true simulation of the icing form of the power transmission line, and simultaneously calculates the motion collision coefficient of the cooling water drops and the freezing coefficient of the control body of the surface unit of the power transmission line, so that the reliability of the change result of the icing form of the power transmission line is high.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Prefabricated type foundation bearing platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prefabricated foundation bearing platform, which comprises a steel structure bearing platform and a bearing platform base, wherein a vibration isolation device is arranged on the bearing platform base, the steel structure bearing platform is arranged on the vibration isolation device, the bearing platform base comprises a first upper template, a first lower template and a plurality of first supporting steel beams, the size of the first upper template is smaller than that of the first lower template, the first supporting steel beams are arranged between the first upper template and the first lower template, a first supporting template is also arranged between the first upper template and the first lower template, and the first upper template, the first lower template, the first supporting steel beams and the first supporting template are enclosed to form a cubic structure with a narrow top and a wide bottom, so that the whole foundation bearing platform has good anti-pulling performance and the risk of a building damaged in a natural disaster can be effectively reduced; the invention does not need to carry out cast-in-place, is simple to assemble, can be quickly built in a disaster area, and is beneficial to quickly promoting the reconstruction work in the disaster area after the disaster.

title_en: Apparatus and method for foreign language tutoring using lecturing contents
title_ko: 강의 콘텐츠를 이용한 외국어 교습 방법 및 이를 위한 장치
abstract_en: A foreign language teaching method using lecture content according to an embodiment of the present disclosure comprises the steps of: outputting, through a display device, lecture content including a plurality of subtitles and audio and video data related to the subtitles received from a database, in response to an input of an instructor; playing the audio corresponding to a playback section of a video for each sentence or word, in response to the input of the instructor received through a playback setting interface; displaying a first interface for learning words related to the lecture content through the display device, in response to the input of the instructor; displaying a second interface for reading comprehension learning related to the lecture content through the display device, in response to the input of the instructor; and displaying a third interface for learning conversation related to the lecture content through the display device, in response to the input of the instructor.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 강의 콘텐츠를 이용한 외국어 교습 방법은, 강사의 입력에 응답하여, 데이터베이스로부터 수신한 복수의 자막, 자막과 연관된 오디오 및 영상 데이터가 포함된 강의 콘텐츠를 디스플레이 장치를 통해 출력하는 단계, 재생 설정 인터페이스를 통해 수신한 강사의 입력에 응답하여, 영상의 재생 구간에 대응하는 오디오를 문장 또는 단어 별로 재생하는 단계, 강사의 입력에 응답하여, 강의 콘텐츠와 연관된 단어 학습을 위한 제1 인터페이스를 디스플레이 장치를 통해 표시하는 단계, 강사의 입력에 응답하여, 강의 콘텐츠와 연관된 독해 학습을 위한 제2 인터페이스를 디스플레이 장치를 통해 표시하는 단계 및 강사의 입력에 응답하여, 강의 콘텐츠와 연관된 회화 학습을 위한 제3 인터페이스를 디스플레이 장치를 통해 표시하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Financial-level two-place three-center high-availability MySQL database implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a financial grade two-place three-center high-availability MySQL database implementation method, which relates to the technical field of database high-availability architecture design, and is based on a same-domain main IDC machine room 1, a same-domain main IDC machine room 2 and a remote disaster-tolerant IDC machine room, and is characterized in that: the method comprises the following steps: s1, defining the IP, the library name, the user name and the password of the MySQL master-slave database which needs to be connected at the back end in ProxySQL, and belonging to a group for management; s2, when the application server is configured, the database master base IP is not directly used, but the host IP and the port where the ProxySQL is located are configured, when the application initiates a request, the ProxySQL middleware is accessed first, then the high-availability database master base IP located in the group where the request is located, and the port is forwarded to the corresponding database at the back end through the request. According to the financial grade two-place three-center high-availability MySQL database implementation method, the high-availability automatic switching between the main and standby of the two-place three-center is realized through the replay-manager, and the condition that services cannot be provided to the outside when a main library fails can be prevented.
assignees: NEWUP BANK OF LIAONING CO LTD

title_en: Deep learning-based system for predicting 3d thermal diffusivity into concrete structures after fire, and method for the same
title_ko: 딥러닝-기반 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물의 열확산경로 예측 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a deep learning-based system for predicting a thermal diffusion path of a fire-damaged concrete structure and a method thereof, configured to: predict a fire damage temperature for each damage depth of a fire-damaged concrete structure from a fire-damaged concrete structure sample collected, through coring, at the fire site and calculates a fire temperature curve so as to accurately predict a thermal diffusion path of the fire-damaged concrete structure and easily track and reproduce a flame movement path; directly collect a fire-damaged concrete structure sample from the fire site through coring and perform thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) analysis and other chemical analyses so as to accurately identify the correlation with a high exposure temperature through chemical and physical experiments; and apply a deep neural network (DNN) model using a deep learning analysis tool so as to increase the prediction rate of the fire damage temperature for the fire-damaged concrete structure.
abstract_ko: 화재현장에서 코어링 채취한 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물 샘플로부터 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물의 손상깊이별 화재피해온도를 예측하고 화재온도곡선을 산출함으로써, 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물의 열확산경로를 정확하게 예측하고 화염이동경로를 용이하게 추적 재현할 수 있고, 또한, 화재현장으로부터 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물 샘플을 직접 코어링 채취하고, 열중량분석(TGA), 푸리에변환 적외선 분광(FTIR) 분석 및 기타 화학분석을 병행함으로써, 화학적 및 물리적 실험을 통해 고온노출온도와의 상관관계를 정확하게 규명할 수 있으며, 또한, 딥러닝(Deep Learning) 분석 툴을 이용하여 심층신경망(DNN) 모델을 적용함으로써 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물에 대한 화재피해온도의 예측률을 높일 수 있는, 딥러닝-기반 화재손상 콘크리트 구조물의 열확산경로 예측 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Random sample consensus (RANSAC) algorithm-based multivariate random spot check method, system and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a random sample consensus (RANSAC) algorithm-based multivariate random sample check method, system and device, and relates to the technical field of random sample check. The invention comprises the following steps: step S10: acquiring original enterprise standard data, and setting a threshold value for a sampling model in the original enterprise standard data; step S20: selecting M standards, calculating the correlation between the standards and each sampling condition, and taking the error within a set threshold value as an inner point, namely, the matching is successful; step S30: and repeating the step S20 and the step S30, and saving the model parameters corresponding to the most interior points as the final sampling model after the iteration times reach the preset value. The invention forms the original relational database by extracting various attributes of the original enterprise standard data. The RANSAC algorithm is applied, and the optimal model of the sampling is calculated in an iterative mode, so that the requirement of accurately developing the post-incident supervision work of enterprise standards can be met.
assignees: ZHEJIANG FANGDA STANDARD INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Transformer fault identification method based on kernel function extreme learning machine
abstract_en: The application provides a transformer fault identification method based on a kernel function extreme learning machine, under the operating condition of a transformer, vibration signals are obtained to serve as analysis samples, after the vibration signals are denoised, each frequency energy characteristic value of the vibration signals is obtained based on wavelet packet decomposition and reconstruction, each frequency energy characteristic value is extracted to serve as a fingerprint vector and is divided into two sample sets, namely a training set and a testing set, an optimized kernel function extreme learning machine network model is established, model training is carried out by utilizing the fingerprint vector training set, the testing set is input into the model, an output checking result is analyzed and calculated, the working state of the transformer is obtained, and fault identification of the transformer is achieved. The method solves the problem that the system is abnormal due to dimension disaster, further optimizes and improves the performance of the fault judgment and analysis result, and realizes automatic identification of the abnormal fault of the power transformer.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Hyperspectral remote sensing image water body inherent attribute inversion method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device and equipment for inverting inherent properties of a water body of a hyperspectral remote sensing image. Constructing a reconstruction network, wherein the reconstruction network comprises: the system comprises a feature extraction network, a mixed regression network and a water body model, wherein the feature extraction network consists of a convolutional neural network and a cyclic neural network; the mixed regression network and the feature extraction network are mirror images of each other; the characteristic extraction network with the mixed network structure well extracts the spectral characteristics of the original hyperspectral remote sensing water body image, reduces the dimensionality of original data and avoids the unfavorable phenomena of dimensionality disaster and the like; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a prediction result of inherent optical properties of the water body by using a mixed regression network, then realizing physical reconstruction of a hyperspectral image by using a water body model, optimizing network parameters by using a gradient descent method by using a reconstruction error, and performing network training in an unsupervised mode without relation to actual values of the inherent parameters of the water body, thereby improving the generalization capability of the method.

title_en: Hyperspectral image target detection method based on sample mining and background reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hyperspectral image target detection method based on sample mining and background reconstruction, and mainly solves the problem of low target detection precision in the prior art. The scheme is as follows: carrying out coarse detection on the input hyperspectral image, and obtaining a training sample based on a coarse detection result; respectively constructing a generating type confrontation network, a reverse self-encoder network and a self-encoder network, and respectively training the networks by using training samples; calculating a reconstruction error and a preliminary detection result of the self-encoder network reconstruction input hyperspectral image; obtaining an optimized hyperspectral image and a feature map according to the primary detection result, and further realizing second-stage sample mining, network training and target detection to obtain a second-stage detection result; and fusing the primary detection result and the second-stage detection result to obtain a final detection result. The invention can fully utilize background spectrum information, effectively inhibit background interference, improve target detection precision, and can be used for environmental protection, mineral exploration, crop yield estimation and disaster prevention and relief.

title_en: Determining the risk of fire situation system by analyzing fire record information on the fire situation and method thereof
title_ko: 화재상황에 대한 화재기록정보를 분석하여 화재상황의 위험도를 판단하는 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a system and method for determining a risk of a fire situation by analyzing a fire record information on a fire situation. The system comprises: a user terminal that generates, in an event of a fire, a fire occurrence signal including a fire image information and a fire site location information; a management server that analyzes the fire occurrence signal, determines the risk level of the fire situation in real-time, and generates fire risk information based on the fire record information; and an administrator terminal that monitors the fire risk information in real-time based on a golden time, wherein the administrator server may provide, in real-time, the generated fire risk level information by determining the risk level of the fire situation in response to a lapse of the golden time.
abstract_ko: 화재상황에 대한 화재기록정보를 분석하여 화재상황의 위험도를 판단하는 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다. 상기 시스템은 화재가 발생한 경우, 화재영상정보 및 화재현장위치정보가 포함된 화재발생신호를 생성하는 사용자 단말기; 화재기록정보를 기초로 하여 상기 화재발생신호를 분석하여 화재상황의 위험도를 실시간 판단하여 화재위험도정보를 생성하는 관리 서버; 및 골든 타임을 기준으로 상기 화재위험도정보를 실시간 모니터링하는 관리자 단말기; 를 포함하되, 상기 관리 서버는 상기 골든 타임 경과에 대응하여 상기 화재상황의 위험도를 판단하여 생성된 상기 화재위험도정보를 실시간으로 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Foaming device for extinguishing fire of oil tank
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a foaming apparatus for extinguishing fire of an oil tank, which is detachably installed on an end unit of a hydraulic piston unit prefabricated to be movable and to at the same time have its length extended or reduced, to be easily applied to a site on fire of the oil tank, to control the refraction angle of a rear surface direction switch pipe and a front surface direction switch pipe, to control the spray direction of foam, and to increase user convenience by meeting the situations on the site on fire. According to the present invention, the foaming apparatus for extinguishing fire of the oil tank comprises: a mainframe detachably installed on an end unit of a hydraulic piston unit whose length is extended or reduced; a rear surface direction switch pipe connected to a rear surface of the mainframe; an air inflow pipe prefabricated on a rear end unit of the rear surface direction switch pipe; a bell mouth connected to a rear surface of the air inflow pipe; a front surface direction switch pipe connected to a front surface of the mainframe; a foaming pipe which is prefabricated on a front end unit of the front surface direction switch pipe to make foam; and a discharge pipe connected to a front surface of the foaming pipe.
abstract_ko:
이 발명은, 조립식으로 구성되어 이동이 가능함과 동시에 길이가 연장 및 단축되는 유압 피스톤부의 단부에 착탈가능하게 설치됨으로써 유류탱크의 화재현장에 적용하기가 용이하며, 후면 방향절환관과 전면 방향절환관의 굴절각도를 조정하여 포말의 분사방향을 조정할 수 있도록 함으로써 화재현장에서 화재상황에 맞추어 사용 편의성을 높일 수가 있는, 유류탱크 소화용 발포장치에 관한 것으로서, 
이 발명의 구성은, 길이가 연장 및 단축되는 유압 피스톤부의 단부에 착탈가능하게 설치되는 본체와, 상기 본체의 후면에 연결되는 후면 방향절환관과, 상기 후면 방향절환관의 후단부에 조립식으로 장착되는 흡기관과, 상기 흡기관의 후면에 연결되어 있는 벨마우스(bell mouth)와, 상기 본체의 전면에 연결되는 전면 방향절환관과, 상기 전면 방향절환관의 전단부에 조립식으로 장착되며 포말이 형성되는 포말관과, 상기 포말관의 전면에 연결되어 있는 토출관을 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: fire truck having water sprinkling vehicle capable of separating and moving
title_ko: 분리 이동이 가능한 방수차를 갖는 소방차
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting vehicle, of which the front side has a driver's seat, and the rear side has firefighting equipment, and which is characterized by comprising: a firefighting water tank which is provided at the rear side of a firefighting vehicle, and in which firefighting water is accommodated to suppress a fire; a water truck mounting unit which is provided to form a uniform mounting space at the rear side of an area at which the firefighting water tank is provided, such that a small-sized caterpillar water truck to be described hereinafter enters or exits therein to be accommodated; a tailgate which is provided to be rotatable around the lower portion at the rear side of the water truck mounting unit, and, when the water truck mounting unit is enclosed from the outside or opened, forms an inclined route such that the small-sized caterpillar water truck may be movable in or out of the water truck mounting unit; and the small-sized caterpillar water truck which is connected to the firefighting water tank, and is provided to be insertable into the water truck mounting unit along the tailgate so as to be carried in a state of being mounted on the water truck mounting unit during transport, and to be ejected from the water truck mounting unit to be moved on the scene of a fire. Therefore, provided in the present invention is a firefighting vehicle having a water truck which is separately movable, and which can be easily carried to the scene of a fire in a state of being mounted on a firefighting vehicle, to be moved by the caterpillar type moving means from the firefighting vehicle to the outside on the scene of a fire, in order to quickly and easily suppress a fire in areas where geographical features are rugged or downtown alley areas where the roads are narrow.
abstract_ko:
전방엔 운전석이 마련되고, 후방엔 화재 진압 장비들이 구비된 소방차에 있어서, 소방차의 후방에 구비되고, 내부에는 화재를 진압하기 위한 소화수가 수용되는 소화수 탱크; 상기 소화수 탱크가 구비된 영역의 후방에 일정한 탑재 공간을 형성하도록 구비되어 내부로는 후술할 소형 무한궤도 방수차가 진입 또는 인출되며 수용가능하게 구비된 방수차 탑재부; 상기 방수차 탑재부의 후방에서 하부를 기준으로 회동가능하게 구비되어 상기 방수차 탑재부가 외부로부터 밀폐되도록 하거나 개방시엔 소형 무한궤도 방수차가 상기 방수차 탑재부의 내외로 이동가능하게 경사진 경로를 이루는 테일 게이트; 및, 상기 소화수 탱크에 연결되며, 상기 테일 게이트를 타고 상기 방수차 탑재부로 인입 가능하게 구비되어 운반시엔 상기 방수차 탑재부에 탑재된 상태로 운반되며 화재 현장에서는 상기 방수차 탑재부로부터 인출 및 이동되는 소형 무한궤도 방수차;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
이에 의하여, 소방차에 실린 상태에서 화재현장으로 손쉽게 운반되고 화재현장에서는 소방차에서 외부로 무한궤도형 이동수단에 의해 이동되어 지형이 험준한 지역이나 도로가 협소한 도심 골목 지역에서의 화재도 신속하고 용이하게 진압하도록 할 수 있는 분리 이동이 가능한 방수차를 갖는 소방차를 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: DAE JIN JUNG GONG CO LTD

title_en: Flexible heating tube
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flexible heating tube. In accordance with the present invention, when a heating cable (Q) connected to a power cable (C10) through a connector (70) receives power and produces heat, thermal radiation pellets (R) in a flexible tube (F) are heated at the same time to radiate radiant heat omnidirectionally to enable the heating cable (Q) and the thermal radiation pellets (R) as well as the flexible tube (F) to act as one single heating element while performing a double function for the heat storage and thermal radiation of thermal radiation pellets (R), which can lead to the maximization of thermal efficiency. In particular, when the flexible tube (F) is filled with water or heat medium oil to conduct the heating of the heating cable (Q), thermal radiation pellets (R) eliminate the need to consider water and oil leaks unlike a risky factor caused by water and oil leaks (in case of installation for heating, risky factors such as reconstruction after the finding of a water or oil leak part as well as a fire and various accidents caused by a short circuit). Therefore, the flexible heating tube can be installed by being freely curved or bent with a gap between the thermal radiation pellets (R), in various places such as the floor of a building, a rooftop water tank or a pipeline (B1), and a facility house as well as a stockbreeding facility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전원케이블(C10)에 접속수단(70)을 통해 접속된 발열케이블(Q)이 전원을 공급받아 발열할 경우 플렉시블관(F) 내의 열방사알갱이(R)가 함께 가열되면서 복사열을 전방위로 방사시켜 플렉시블관(F)과 더불어 발열케이블(Q) 및 열방사알갱이(R)가 하나의 발열체로서 작용토록 함과 동시에 열방사알갱이(R)의 축열 및 열방사의 더블 기능으로서 열효율의 극대화를 도모할 수 있고, 특히 발열케이블(Q)의 발열을 전도시키기 위하여 플렉시블관(F) 속에 물이나 열매체유를 채울 경우 누수 또는 누액으로 인한 불안요인[난방을 위하여 설치된 경우 누수 또는 누액된 부분을 찾아내어 재공사를 하여야 할 뿐만 아니라 누전으로 인한 각종 사고 및 화재 등과 같은 불안요인]과 달리 열방사알갱이(R)로서 누수 및 누액 현상을 전혀 고려치 않아도 되어 건물의 바닥은 물론이거니와 옥상의 물탱크 또는 배관라인(B1) 나아가 시설하우스 더 나아가 축산시설 등 다양한 곳에 열방사알갱이(R)의 서로간 간극과 함께 자유롭게 휘거나 굽히면서 설치할 수 있는 플렉시블 발열관에 관한 발명이다.
assignees: ECO PLANNING CO LTD;JEONG WON CHEOL

title_en: Fall Prevention Safety Device for Fire Fighting and How to Use
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety device and usage method for preventing a fall for fire-fighting and, more specifically, wherein multiple pile equipment are screwed into a structure in a tripod shape and firmly fixed, a connection equipment is connected to a chain equipment after connecting the pile equipment and the pile equipment by the chain equipment, safety and quick entrance by firefighters are enabled by allowing firefighters connected to the connection equipment relying on the connection equipment to enter a fire scene after connecting the connection equipment connected to the chain equipment to the firefighter, allows to be firmly fixed to a structure since a wing of the pile equipment can be folded and unfolded, and increases a convenience of use since collection can be quickly achieved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방용 추락방지 안전장치 및 사용방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 다수개의 말뚝장비를 구조물에 삼각 대형으로 박아서 단단하게 고정하고, 상기 말뚝장비와 말뚝장비 사이를 체인장비에 의해 연결한 뒤, 상기 체인장비에 연결장비를 연결하며, 상기 체인장비에 연결한 연결장비를 소방대원에게 연결한 뒤, 상기 연결장비에 연결된 소방대원은 연결장비에 의지해서 화재현장으로 진입함으로써, 소방대원의 안전 및 빠른 진입이 가능하고, 상기 말뚝장비의 날개를 접었다 폈다할 수 있어 구조물에 단단하게 고정도 할 수 있고, 회수도 빠르게 이루어질 수 있어 사용의 편리성이 증가하는 특징이 있다.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster first-aid repair decision method considering information fusion of traffic network and power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network post-disaster rush-repair decision method considering information fusion of a traffic network and a power distribution network, which is used for establishing a rush-repair strategy optimization model considering traffic network interruption according to acquired non-electric quantity information such as road congestion interruption under typhoon disasters in order to adapt to the change of an external road environment; and finally, coordinating resources such as construction teams, rush-repair materials, emergency mobile power supplies, power distribution network racks, distributed power supplies and the like on the premise of meeting the safe and stable operation constraint of the distribution network, and deciding the material transportation, construction team restoration, mobile power supply scheduling sequence, network rack reconstruction and island division schemes by aiming at minimizing load loss. The invention fully considers the cooperative optimization of fault first-aid repair and load recovery, achieves the aim of minimum economic loss and simplifies the coding of each part of solution.

title_en: System and method for live stream control
abstract_en: Systems and methods for live stream control, including disaster recovery and/or load balancing, are provided including a first video encoding and distribution platform as a primary platform, a second video encoding and distribution platform running in parallel to the primary platform as a secondary platform, which secondary platform uses separate video transmission, independent video encoding, video packing, manifest generation, and an alternate content delivery network (CDN), and an application or module configured to direct playback requests to the primary or secondary platform, dependent upon an operational status of the primary platform.

title_en: Two-stage power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization method and a two-stage power distribution network post-disaster repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization system, which are used for evaluating the element damage condition of a power distribution system; partitioning the fault points; performing primary recovery by using a distributed power supply, establishing a nonlinear programming model of the primary recovery to obtain a linearized network reconstruction model, and solving to obtain a load recovery result of a first stage without considering a maintenance process as an initial recovery result; and solving a cooperative optimization model of allocation and load recovery of the first-aid repair personnel by taking the maximum load recovery amount and the minimum repair time as targets to obtain a network reconstruction time sequence change process, a first-aid repair personnel advancing line and a load recovery sequence result of a second stage of maintenance scheduling, which are taken into consideration, and taking the results as final results for guiding operating personnel to carry out post-disaster recovery to realize cooperative optimization. The invention improves the recovery capability of the power distribution network after disaster, reduces the downtime and economic loss and enhances the recovery force of the distribution system.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Guide rail type multipurpose elevator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elevator devices, in particular to a guide rail type multipurpose elevator, an elevator cabin is composed of a frame of an aluminum profile and a connecting piece, first strip-shaped protrusions are arranged on two side walls of an inner cavity of a clamping groove formed in the outer side wall of the connecting piece along the axial direction, an X-shaped guide rail is fixed on the surface of a buffer strip on a wall surface, side cavities are arranged on two sides of the center of the X-shaped guide rail along the axial direction, an opening groove which is in sliding clamping connection with the first strip-shaped protrusions is formed in the middle of the outer side of the side cavities along the axial direction, the outer edge of a guide wheel arranged on the surface of the first strip-shaped protrusions on one side of the clamping groove is tangent to the inner wall of the corresponding side cavity, an anti-falling clamping device arranged on the first strip-shaped protrusions on the same side of the guide wheel is positioned in the corresponding side cavity, the inner cavity of the side cavity on the other side of the guide wheel can accommodate racks, traction steel wires and cables, the assembly relation between the X-shaped guide rail and the elevator cabin is flexible, the installation of the elevator cabin is unnecessary, the elevator cabin is equipped, the elevator cabin can be used for an outer wall rescue elevator, a fire-fighting channel is not occupied during old building reconstruction, the fire fighting channel is shortened, safety and low cost.

title_en: Data acquisition and personnel and equipment positioning information platform suitable for mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an information platform suitable for data acquisition and personnel and equipment positioning of a mine, which comprises a positioning subsystem, a monitoring subsystem and a communication subsystem, wherein the positioning subsystem, the monitoring subsystem and the communication subsystem are connected with each other through an industrial-grade redundant optical fiber ring network; the positioning subsystem comprises a personnel attendance module, a tracking positioning module, a distress call alarm module, a post-disaster first-aid module, a daily management module and a personnel track playback module; the monitoring subsystem comprises a video monitoring module, a positioning video linkage module and an environmental data monitoring module; the communication subsystem comprises a voice communication module, a WIFI terminal APP interface module and an IP broadcast integrated module; the platform is connected with the face recognition gate, the holder camera, the multifunctional base station, the monitoring sensor, the scheduling system and the display terminal through a network, and the acquired data are analyzed respectively and then sent to the subsystems and displayed on the display terminal.
assignees: JIANGXI PENGXU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tailings pond dam break mud evolution simulation method based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing and three-dimensional SPH
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam break mud evolution simulation method of a tailing pond based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing and three-dimensional SPH, belonging to the technical field of mine geotechnical engineering and comprising the steps of delineating an area to be researched of the tailing pond and obtaining a planning scheme of the tailing pond; determining the research range of the evolution of dam-break slurry of the tailing pond; planning an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial survey line; processing the aerial survey data of the unmanned aerial vehicle by using a photogrammetric motion recovery structure algorithm, and reconstructing to obtain a high-resolution ortho-image and topographic data of a digital surface model; exporting topographic data, determining a breach form and establishing a three-dimensional geometric model; testing dam break mud rheological parameters; establishing a dam break mud evolution three-dimensional model based on an SPH algorithm; and compiling the SPH calculation program to realize the parallel operation of the CPU/GPU on the high-performance calculation cluster. The method provides scientific basis for the risk assessment of the dam break disaster of the tailing pond, overcomes the defects of a laboratory simulation method and a traditional grid method, and realizes the quantification and visualization of the risk assessment of the dam break disaster of the tailing pond.

title_en: caterpillar type mini water sprinkling vehicle for loading to fire truck
abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, a small tracked water sprinkling vehicle for loading onto a fire truck comprises: a vehicle body which is provided to be able to enter the rear of a fire truck by moving on a tailgate, is transported while being loaded onto the fire truck, and is retracted from the fire truck and moved to a fire site; a vehicle moving unit provided below the vehicle body in a tracked type to move the vehicle body; a hose winding unit provided on the rear of the vehicle body, and having a fire hose rotatably wound therearound and connected to the fire-fighting water tank of the fire truck; and a fire extinguishing water injection unit provided on the front of the vehicle body, and connected to the fire hose that is wound and unwound from the hose winding unit so that fire extinguishing water is injected to a fire point. Therefore, the small tracked water sprinkling vehicle can be easily transported to the fire site while being loaded onto the fire truck, and can be moved from the fire truck to the outside by a tracked moving means at the fire site, thereby quickly and easily extinguishing fires in rough terrain or narrow downtown alleys.

assignees: DAE JIN JUNG GONG CO LTD;KIM JANG DONG

title_en: Emergency lane for expressway non-stop reconstruction and extension project and illegal driving alarming method
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency lane of a highway non-stop reconstruction and extension project and an alarming method for driving in violation, wherein the highway comprises a bidirectional four-lane and an emergency lane, the extension project occupies two lanes on one side and the emergency lane on the side, a first lane on the other side and the emergency lane on the other side are taken as the bidirectional two lanes, and a second lane on the other side between the first lane on the other side and the emergency lane on the other side is taken as a reconstructed emergency lane; a plurality of emergency parking places which are not communicated with each other are arranged in the improved emergency lane, and the adjacent emergency parking places are used for the emergency driving of vehicles in lanes in different directions. The invention maximally utilizes the width of the road surface, gives consideration to the emergency rescue requirements of the lanes on two sides and greatly reduces the accident rescue difficulty.

title_en: Universal toilet seat device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a general toilet seat device, which belongs to the technical field of toilet seats. The technical problems of splashing prevention during toilet use and prevention of freezing in winter without water flushing are solved. The device comprises a cylinder body, wherein a closed structure is formed by fixedly connecting hard material plates at the inner part, the upper part, the lower part and the outer part, and the inner part of the horizontal section shape of the cylinder body has a certain distance with the outer plate; the middle of the cylinder body is hollow, and the upper part and the lower part of the cylinder body are provided with parallel openings. The first embodiment is a square cylinder, the inner plate is formed by splicing and splicing deep grooves in a half lap joint mode, and the upper portion, the lower portion and the outer plate are connected to the inner plate through fixing pieces. The second embodiment is a round cylinder, plastic is injected into a cylinder forming die to be integrally formed into a closed structure, and a connecting plate is arranged between an inner plate and an outer plate. The bottom of the cylinder body is pasted with a rubber plate, and the upper part of the cylinder body is sleeved with a soft cushion material layer. The utility model is used for the reconstruction of the agricultural toilet, the temporary use after disaster and the use of the bed for the old, the weak, the sick and the disabled. And various functional modules are added to meet diversified requirements and are universal to various spaces.

title_en: Accumulation layer landslide displacement prediction model and prediction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prediction, and particularly relates to a model and a method for predicting landslide displacement of a accumulation layer. The method comprises the steps of decomposing landslide accumulated displacement into an intrinsic mode component and a residual trend term through a CEEMDAN decomposition algorithm, reconstructing IMFs into a high-frequency component and a low-frequency component through a fine to coarse method, performing noise reduction processing on the high-frequency component through a wavelet noise reduction algorithm, synthesizing the denoised high-frequency component and low-frequency component into a periodic component, predicting the trend component and the periodic component respectively through an LSTM neural network, and adding prediction results of the trend component and the periodic component to obtain predicted accumulated displacement. The proposed model was used herein to study and predict the splayed gate landslide in the three gorges reservoir region. The results show that the proposed model has higher prediction accuracy, which brings a new solution to the landslide prediction.

title_en: Cooling installation, heating treatment installation and method for reconstructing cooling installation
abstract_en: To protect a cooling tower body from a disaster such as a tsunami and a tornado, in a cooling installation.SOLUTION: A cooling installation includes: a cooling tower body including a filler through which cooling object liquid circulates; a ventilator for causing a cooling gas to circulate through the filler; and a first protection wall surrounding a lateral side of the cooling tower body.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Rebuild well head emergency rescue device
