abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency rescue device for reconstructing a wellhead, which comprises a hydraulic drilling slip assembly, a blowout preventer, a rescue connecting part and a full-seal ram blowout preventer, wherein the hydraulic drilling slip assembly, the blowout preventer, the rescue connecting part and the full-seal ram blowout preventer are sequentially connected to the top of a cut wellhead casing; the hydraulic drilling slip assembly realizes quick connection of an emergency rescue device of an inverted blowout preventer and a wellhead sleeve, overcomes the problem that a conventional blowout preventer cannot be installed with the wellhead sleeve in blowout rescue operation, forms a sealing barrier for preventing liquid flow from leaking downwards with the wellhead sleeve of an out-of-control well, uses a fully-sealed flashboard blowout preventer on the upper part as a fully-sealed whole emergency rescue device, forms a sealed emergency rescue channel between the inverted blowout preventer and the fully-sealed flashboard blowout preventer, carries out emergency rescue operation through a side outlet of a connecting part for emergency rescue in the emergency rescue channel, and can completely avoid further expansion of accidents.
assignees: RONGSHENG MACHINERY MFT LTD OF HUABEI OILFIELD

title_en: Human rescue system using for radar sensor and navigater
title_ko: 정밀 레이더센서와 복수의 개별 네비게이터 및 메인 네비게이터를 이용한 화재현장 인명구출시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a lifesaving control system, and is provided with a sensor unit including a precision radar sensor, a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor, a gas sensor, a gyro sensor, and an illuminance sensor. In an emergency site lifesaving system using the precision radar sensor and a rescue navigator according to the present invention, a server automatically operates the rescue system by measuring the heart rate and respiration rate of people inside and outside the room with the precision radar sensor, so that lifesaving is possible without missing the golden time in an emergency situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인명구출 제어시스템에 관한 것으로서, 특히 건물의 각 방에 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용하여, 화재발생시 각 방에 사람이 있는 지를 검출하여 응급구조센터로 발송하고, 응급구조센터에서 현장의 소방관에게 정보를 송출하여 효과적인 인물구출이 가능하도록 구현된 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지 센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템에 관한 것이다.   
종래에는 인명사고 또는 화재를 포함한 위급한 현장을 제어하는 수단이 없었는데, 이를 개선하기 위해 본 발명에서는 룸 내부에는 사람의 심박과 호흡을 통해 사람의 위급상태를 감지하는 정밀 레이더센서와, 룸 내부의 온도 및 습도를 검출하는 온도센서 및 습도센서와, 위해 가스의 누출을 감지하는 가스센서와, 건물의 흔들림 및 주변 진동상황을 감지하는 자이로센서와, 룸 내·외부의 밝기를 검출하는 조도센서를 포함하는 센서부가 구비되고, 상기 센서부의 감지신호는 각 룸에 설치된 통신모듈에서 전송되어 중계기를 통해 서버에 전달되고, 상기 서버에서는 인명구조원을 통솔하는 소방관제서버와 건물의 관리실에 설치된 모니터부에 현재 상황을 실시간으로 전송하고, 상기 서버는 데이터베이스에 저장된 데이터에 의해 인명구출을 위한 구조동선을 출력하여 인명구조원에게 지급된 개별 네비게이터에 전송하는 것을 특징으로 하는 정밀 레이더센서와 구조용 네비게이터를 이용한 화재현장 인명구출시스템을 제안한다. 
따라서, 본 발명에 의한 정밀 레이더센서와 구조용 네비게이터를 이용한 위급현장 인명구출시스템은  정밀 레이더센서에 의해 룸 내·외부에 있는 사람의 심박수와 호흡수를 측정하여 서버에서 자동적으로 구출시스템을 작동시키므로, 위급상황에서 골든 타임을 놓치지 않는 인명 구조가 가능한 효과가 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 온도 및 습도센서와 가스센서, 자이로센서 및 조도센서 등의 복합적인 센서 들의 감지신호에 따라 다양한 위급상황에 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 특히, 본 발명의 서버에서는 인명구조원 각자에게 현재 시점에서의 가장 효과적인 구출동선을 제시하므로, 구출시간의 단축뿐만이 아니라, 인명구조원의 안전사고도 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A fire extinguisher with dry-ices
abstract_en: The present invention is to put water and dry ice inside a fire extinguisher, so that when used in a fire site, the fire extinguisher ejects carbon dioxide gas with internal pressure raised by an impact in falling to extinguish the fire. The fire extinguisher has a downhill groove to fall with an arrival part facing the ground, and a stopper is removed by a ground arrival impact, so that carbon dioxide gas spreads over the ground in the fire area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화탄 내부에 물과 드라이아이스를 탑재시키고, 이를 화재현장에 투입, 낙하할 때 충격으로 완충된 내부압력으로 이산화탄소 가스가 분출되어 화재를 진압하도록 한 것으로, 안착부가 지면을 향하도록 활강홈을 갖추어 하강하도록 구성되며, 지면안착충격으로 마개가 이탈되면서 이산화탄소 가스가 화재발생지역에 지면으로 분사되어 소화되게한 소화탄이다.
assignees: KIM MIN SUK;KIM JI HUN;KIM YOON SEO

title_en: Fire mask for dynamic reconstruction of fire scene map and edge detection of dangerous goods
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, and discloses a fire fighting mask for dynamically reconstructing a fire scene map and detecting edges of dangerous goods, which comprises a mask body, wherein a power supply module, a data acquisition module, a dangerous goods detection module, a data transmission module, a main controller and an ad hoc network positioning communication module are arranged on the mask body, the main controller comprises a data analysis module and a dangerous goods identification module, the data acquisition module is connected with the data analysis module through the data transmission module, the dangerous goods detection module is connected with the dangerous goods identification module, the data analysis module and the dangerous goods identification module are both in communication connection with an external control center through the ad hoc network positioning communication module, and the external control center stores data uploaded by each fire fighting mask to form a database. The method and the system are convenient for fire fighters to know fire scene information, avoid danger, facilitate rescue and retreat of the fire fighters, and avoid resource waste and time consumption of a map repeated reconstruction process. The invention is suitable for fire scene rescue.

title_en: Armored Vehicle for Fire Fighting
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an armored vehicle for firefighting which includes: a vehicle body including a plurality of boarding spaces in which a driver can ride on a front part of the interior and a firefighter and a requester can ride on a rear part of the interior; a crawler driving unit installed on both edges of the vehicle body to enable stable driving even on irregular road surfaces; and a robot arm installed on the front of the vehicle body and configured to move and transport a target to be moved. Firefighters can be brought to a fire place while on board the armored vehicle to effectively extinguish a fire through accurate and precise control.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 내부의 전면부에 조종수가 탑승가능하고 내부의 후면부에 소방대원 및 요구조자가 탑승가능한 복수의 탑승공간을 포함하는 차체; 상기 차체의 양 측 가장자리에 설치되어 불규칙한 노면에도 안정적인 주행을 가능하게 하는 크롤러 구동부; 및 상기 차체의 전면에 설치되어 피이동대상의 이동 및 운반을 할 수 있도록 구성되는 로봇 암(arm)을 포함하는 화재현장 진입용 장갑로봇을 제공한다.
assignees: JIN WOO SMC INC CO LTD

title_en: Hemispherical differential spherical self-reconstruction robot with independently moved unit modules
abstract_en: The invention provides a hemispherical differential spherical self-reconfiguration robot with independently moving unit modules, which is characterized in that an external structure and a hemispherical differential driving structure which simultaneously meet the sealing of a spherical shell and the working conditions of a sensor are newly designed, so that a single spherical robot unit has robust and accurate autonomous omnidirectional movement capability. With its modularized design on the basis of single spherical robot motion, the advantage of traditional spherical robot and self-reconfigurable modular robot has been combined, make this spherical robot possess autonomic butt joint reconfiguration ability through initiative butt joint interface, passive locking interface mechanism and swing mechanism and perception system, can become new configurations such as snakelike or wheel-legged robot according to the task needs after a plurality of spherical robot module butt joints reconfiguration, thereby reinforcing the robot trafficability characteristic, the robot can carry out more complicated collaborative work task. The spherical robot is mainly suitable for complex working scenes such as disaster prevention detection, danger elimination and rescue.

title_en: Data preprocessing method for geological disaster early warning based on Internet of things and 3S technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data preprocessing method for geological disaster early warning based on the Internet of things and a 3S technology, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of (1) establishing a data preprocessing system for geological disaster early warning, (2) starting the data preprocessing system for geological disaster early warning, controlling a data acquisition device to sample in an equidistant time sequence by an upper computer to obtain a corresponding displacement sequence Y, (3) acquiring the Y by the upper computer to obtain a displacement sequence Y1 without m displacement data, and (4) performing rough verification on the Y1 to obtain Y2; (5) Performing data interpolation by using a Lagrange interpolation method to reconstruct Y; (6) smoothing the data of Y to obtain G; (7) And then sending the G to an AI early warning module of the SOA platform for processing to obtain an AI early warning result. The displacement data is preprocessed by the processing methods of rough error checking, data interpolation, data smoothing and the like, so that timeliness and reliability of the data are guaranteed.

title_en: Urban waterlogging early warning system based on weather and rainfall flood model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban waterlogging early warning system based on a weather and rainfall flood model, which comprises the following components: the system comprises an internet of things data acquisition end, a data processing system, a data processing cloud platform module, a meteorological data storage and analysis system, an early warning release module and a decision scheduling module. The invention can realize real-time early warning and monitoring of rain conditions, water conditions, working conditions and disaster conditions, and real-time interaction of the working conditions of flood prevention business; the remote monitoring of the operation of the pump gate station improves the emergency capacity of a city management department for coping with crisis events such as pipeline breakage, rain flood, waterlogging and the like by providing decision support of management work such as monitoring early warning, flood prevention scheduling, post-disaster reconstruction and the like, and ensures the stable operation of a drainage system.

title_en: Method for estimating health state of battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating the health state of a battery, which comprises the following specific steps: step one, at the temperature of 25 ℃, three different test schemes are carried out on the lithium ion battery; step two, predicting each component to obtain prediction results IMF1, IMF2, IMF3, IMF4 and Residual and corresponding prediction errors of each component; and thirdly, reconstructing the prediction result of each component signal in the second step, wherein the final capacity prediction result is the sum of the prediction of each component. The hybrid model of the invention can accurately predict SOH and RUL of the battery in real time, avoid accident disasters caused by excessive use of the battery, decompose capacity data by utilizing an improved complementary set empirical mode decomposition algorithm with self-adaptive noise, and avoid noise interference in the data.

title_en: National Competency Standards-based Construction Machine Loader Training System and Training Method therefor
title_ko: 국가직무능력표준(ncs) 기반 건설기계 로우더 실습교육 시스템 및 이를 이용한 실습방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a construction machine loader practice training system and method based on the National Competency Standards (NCS). According to the present invention, as a new alternative that can supplement and reinforce construction machine practice education (pilot training) using advanced technology, it is possible to provide sufficient practical education to pilots by adding experiential and practical education in actual equipment training to the training guidelines of the NCS to improve the learning effect. Through safe practical training, insufficient job skills can be supplemented. It is possible to reduce risks in a safe environment by realizing a virtual environment similar to a construction machine operation site through computer simulation and operating virtual objects fused with hardware as if the same were real. By reprocessing the trained data, the data is analyzed in real time using web 3D, shortening the training period, and reducing the cost of practical training, it is possible to lay the foundation for the competitiveness of the construction equipment training institute. The VR HMD simulator, which reproduces the operating environment of actual construction machines, is used for practical training to obtain a pilot's license, and it is possible to experience the feeling of operations with the body by applying a real controller. The movement of the excavator is also implemented similar to the actual situation. In particular, by applying the VR HMD to an operator's active actions, immersion like a real situation is possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 첨단 기술을 활용하여 건설기계 실습교육(조종훈련)을 보완, 강화할 수 있는 새로운 대안으로 실장비 교육에서 체험형, 실습교육을 국가직무능력표준(NCS)의 교육 지침에 추가함으로써 조종사에게 충분한 실습교육을 제공하여 학습적 효과를 향상시키고, 안전한 실습교육을 통해 부족한 직무능력을 보완할 수 있고, 건설기계 조종 현장과 유사한 가상환경을 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션으로 구현, 하드웨어와 융합된 가상의 물체를 실제처럼 조작실습함으로써 안전한 환경에서 위험을 줄이고, 훈련된 데이터를 재가공하고, 이 데이터를 웹3D 이용한 실시간 분석하고, 훈련기간 단축과 실습교육 비용절감을 통해 건설기계 교육학원 경쟁력의 기반을 마련할 수 있고, 실제 건설기계의 운용 환경을 재현한 VR HMD 시뮬레이터를 조종면허 취득을 위한 실습 교육훈련에 활용하여 실제 콘트롤러를 적용해 조작감 등을 몸으로 체험할 수 있으며, 굴삭기의 운동 현상도 실제 상황과 유사하게 구현하며, 특히 VR HMD를 적용하여 운용자의 능동적 행동에 대응함으로써 실제 상황처럼 몰입이 가능한 국가직무능력표준(NCS) 기반 건설기계 로우더 실습교육 시스템 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Method and system for guiding evacuation route to persons to be rescued in disastrous site
title_ko: 재난 현장에서 요구조자에게 대피 경로를 안내하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a system for guiding an evacuation route to a person in need at a disaster site. An evacuation route guide method comprises the steps of: detecting the strength of a signal transmitted and received between one or more positioning devices and a smart device possessed by a requestor, and measuring the position of the requestor on the basis of the strength of the detected signal; detecting whether a disaster has occurred and a point of occurrence of a disaster on the basis of sensor information received from one or more disaster detection sensors; when a disaster is detected, determining the current status of victims, including the number and location of those who need rescue, and transmitting the same to a disaster management center; and determining an evacuation route to avoid the disaster point for each person in need of rescue, and providing the determined evacuation route to a smart device of the person in need. According to the present invention, artificial intelligence performs analysis so that people can safely evacuate within the golden time through positioning of a remaining personnel at the fire site, and the shortest distance evacuation route can be automatically determined and provided to the person in need.
abstract_ko: 재난 현장에서 요구조자에게 대피 경로를 안내하는 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다.  대피 경로 안내 방법은, 하나 이상의 측위 디바이스와 요구조자가 소지한 스마트 디바이스 사이에 송수신되는 신호의 세기를 검출하고, 검출된 신호의 세기에 기반하여 요구조자의 위치를 측정하는 단계; 하나 이상의 재난 감지 센서로부터 수신된 센서 정보에 기반하여 재난 발생 여부 및 재난 발생 지점을 감지하는 단계; 재난이 감지될 경우 구조가 필요한 미대피 요구조자의 인원수 및 위치를 포함하는 요구조자 현황을 결정하여 재난 관리 센터로 전송하는 단계; 및 구조가 필요한 요구조자마다 상기 재난 발생 지점을 회피하는 대피 경로를 결정하고, 결정된 대피 경로를 요구조자의 스마트 디바이스에 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.  본 발명에 의하여, 화재현장 잔류 인원의 위치 측위를 통하여 골든타임 내에 사람들의 안전한 대피가 가능하도록 인공지능이 분석하고 최단거리인 대피 경로를 자동으로 결정하여 요구조자에게 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV DONG A RES FOUND FOR IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Circuit breaker of waterproof dipping
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of circuit breakers, in particular to a waterproof circuit breaker, which comprises a shell and a mainboard, wherein the front end of the inner side of the shell is fixedly connected with the mainboard, the rear end of the mainboard is fixedly connected with a fan, a transformer, an electromagnetic rod, a knife switch and a water immersion detector, the left end and the right end of the water immersion detector are both fixedly connected with a lead, the other end of the lead is fixedly connected with a probe, the outer side of the lead is fixedly connected with a sucker, the inner side of the top end of the shell is fixedly connected with an electric telescopic rod, the waterproof function is realized through the arranged stainless steel frame, the steel wire and the probe, when encountering natural disasters such as flood, tsunami and debris flow, the short circuit caused by the water immersion can be prevented, electrical appliances are protected, the reconstruction after-disaster is facilitated, the economic loss is reduced while the safety of people is protected, and the heat is guided to the shell in a sealing state through the arranged fan and the radiating fins, and the case where the housing is exposed to moisture on the outside can rapidly conduct out the heat.
assignees: SHANGHAI XUYI ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Sliding Type Fire Door
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sliding type fire door capable of sucking and removing harmful elements such as smoke or toxic gas which can exist near the fire door during a fire, thereby facilitating evacuation from a fire site and improving airtightness to improve performance of the fire door. The sliding type fire door comprises: a pair of sliding doors slid in a horizontal direction to be arranged to open and close a passage; a suction means fixated to an upper side of the sliding doors to be moved together with the sliding doors, and sucking harmful gas generated near the sliding doors when the sliding doors are closed; a discharge means discharging pollutants of the harmful gas sucked in the suction means to the outside; and a control unit controlling operation of the sliding doors, the suction means, and the discharge means.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재시 방화문 근처에 존재할 수 있는 연기 또는 유독가스와 같은 유해요소의 흡입제거가 가능하여 화재현장으로부터 대피를 용이하게 하며 기밀성을 증진시킴으로써 방화문의 성능을 향상시킬 수 있는 슬라이딩 타입 방화문에 관한 것으로, 수평 방향으로 슬라이딩하여 통로를 개폐하도록 배치되는 한 쌍의 슬라이딩 도어; 상기 슬라이딩 도어의 상측에 고정되어 상기 슬라이딩 도어와 함께 이동되고, 상기 슬라이딩 도어가 닫힐 때 상기 슬라이딩 도어의 근방에서 발생하는 유해가스를 흡입하기 위한 흡입수단; 상기 흡입수단에서 흡입된 유해가스를 오염물질을 외부로 배출하는 배출수단; 및 상기 슬라이딩 도어, 흡입수단, 및 배출수단의 작동을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Building energy-saving design method and system based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of building design, and particularly relates to a building energy-saving design method and system based on BIM, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a virtual three-dimensional model according to the actual overall dimension of the existing building; generating an airflow ascending path according to the positions of a fire fighting channel, a ventilation shaft, a common position door leaf and a common position window sash, wherein the heights of two ends of the airflow ascending path are different; viewing the airflow ascending paths in the virtual three-dimensional model, and marking the overlapping areas among the airflow ascending paths; and generating an energy-saving facility setting scheme according to the distribution condition of the overlapping areas. According to the invention, through analyzing the indoor gas flow direction of the existing building and setting the corresponding cooling points, a continuous gas flow path is formed in the building, the energy saving performance of the existing building is improved by additional means, the energy consumption is reduced, and the method is suitable for new or reconstructed projects and has strong practicability.

title_en: Universal toilet seat device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a universal toilet device, and belongs to the technical field of toilets. The technical problems of splashing prevention during toilet use and prevention of freezing in winter without water flushing are solved. The device comprises a cylinder body, wherein a closed structure is formed by fixedly connecting hard material plates at the inner part, the upper part, the lower part and the outer part, and the inner part of the horizontal section shape of the cylinder body has a certain distance with the outer plate; the middle of the cylinder body is hollow, and the upper part and the lower part of the cylinder body are provided with parallel openings. The first embodiment is a square cylinder, the inner plate is formed by splicing and splicing deep grooves in a half lap joint mode, and the upper portion, the lower portion and the outer plate are connected to the inner plate through fixing pieces. The second embodiment is a round cylinder, plastic is injected into a cylinder forming die to be integrally formed into a closed structure, and a connecting plate is arranged between an inner plate and an outer plate. The bottom of the cylinder body is pasted with a rubber plate, and the upper part of the cylinder body is sleeved with a soft cushion material layer. The utility model is used for the reconstruction of the agricultural toilet, the temporary use after disaster and the use of the bed for the old, the weak, the sick and the disabled. And various functional modules are added to meet diversified requirements and are universal to various spaces.

title_en: Intelligent training system for fire-fighting professional skill identification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of education and demonstration appliances, and discloses an intelligent training system for fire-fighting occupational skill identification. The rotary motor drives the rotary table to rotate, a plurality of fire extinguishers are placed in the equipment box, targeted teaching can be conducted, the display screen can be rolled to learn knowledge, the fire extinguishing assembly pumps water from the water box to extinguish fire, and the ignition assembly can ignite ignition objects; a plurality of cameras, infrared sensor and microphone are at a plurality of angles to training process record, and the control panel can playback after the operation is accomplished in will recording storage to the memory, improves learning efficiency.

title_en: Rainfall-induced slope geological disaster scene simulation analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall-induced slope geological disaster scene simulation analysis method, which comprises the following steps: reconstructing a three-dimensional model of a slope scene based on oblique photography data to obtain surface contour line data; processing the surface contour control points and establishing a boundary model of the side slope; generating a slope rock-soil mass point set in a boundary model range to realize slope scene simulation; carrying out ground stress balance analysis under the action of self-weight by using a material point method; analyzing historical rainfall data of the slope site to obtain distribution characteristics of rainfall intensity, duration and rainfall; randomly generating water particles above a slope rock-soil body area to realize rainfall scene simulation; by adopting a two-phase material method, calculating the stress seepage coupling response of the side slope rock-soil body under the infiltration condition in time steps, and realizing the analysis of the whole process of the rainfall-induced side slope geological disaster evolution; fully considering the process of infiltration and surface runoff of rainfall in the slope rock-soil body; the method has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, advanced technology and high calculation precision.
assignees: INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS;SHIYAN HAISHENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;YUNXI HAIJIA CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Multi-layered disaster recovery manager
abstract_en: A system includes a production server, a backup server, a telemetry analyzer, a memory, and a hardware processor. The telemetry analyzer takes snapshots of various performance metrics of the production server. The memory stores a log of previous disasters that occurred on the production server. The log includes a snapshot of the production server performance metrics from the time each disaster occurred. The memory also stores recovery scripts for each logged disaster. Each script provides instructions for resolving the linked disaster. The hardware processor uses a machine learning architecture to train an autoencoder. The trained autoencoder receives new snapshots from the telemetry analyzer and generates a reconstruction of the new snapshots. The hardware processor then determines a threshold for distinguishing between server disasters and minor anomalies. This distinction is made by comparing the difference between the reconstruction of the new snapshots and the new snapshots with the threshold.

title_en: Ancient damming event reconstruction method based on sedimentary-geomorphic evidence chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water disaster prevention, in particular to a reconstruction method of an ancient damming event based on a deposition-landform evidence chain, which comprises the following steps: obtaining data information, analyzing and sorting the data, confirming barrier lake parameters, simulating reconstruction data, and comparing and analyzing to obtain results. The invention provides a practical and effective reconstruction method of an ancient damming event, which can obtain a real and reliable result, comprehensively judges the scale and the age of the ancient damming event from the perspective of a deposition-landform evidence chain by means of multiple evidences, ensures the reliability of a reconstruction result, improves the correct understanding of people on historical disasters, reveals the catastrophe history and the law of major disasters in a long-time sequence of a region, and provides a solid foundation for scientifically predicting the activity trend of future damming disasters and accurately identifying and predicting giant damming events.

title_en: Disaster relief movable 5G temporary base station platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a portable intelligent scaffold construction auxiliary device for construction, which solves the problem that signals in a disaster-affected area are lost and cannot be communicated with the outside due to natural disasters, refers to the characteristics that a 5G base station is not a necessary condition for wired signal transmission and has wide coverage, can be temporarily applied to the problem that the 5G base station is used as emergency equipment in post-disaster reconstruction, is fixedly arranged on a transportation device, is fixedly arranged on a lifting device, is fixedly arranged on the lifting device, is provided with other devices through the transportation device, is used for integrally transferring equipment through the transportation device and is suitable for various complex terrains, realizes the fixation of the equipment aiming at the complex terrains, completes vibration reduction and elevation, and realizes the functions of paving a temporary 5G base station in post-disaster reconstruction processes such as earthquake, flood and debris flow.

title_en: HHT pulse parameter identification-based far-field harmonic wave earthquake motion synthesis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a far-field harmonic and seismic motion synthesis method based on HHT pulse parameter identification. Based on a large amount of natural far-field harmonic and seismic oscillation original records, EEMD decomposition is carried out on a speed time course, each IMF component is subjected to low-frequency and high-frequency distinguishing according to a certain frequency value, a low-frequency time course and a high-frequency time course are reconstructed, a reaction spectrum is used for judging whether the frequency value is correct or not, the low-frequency time course is taken to distinguish main pulse components according to the previous steps and carry out simplified analysis, and characteristic pulse parameters including pulse amplitude V are identified A1 Pulse period Ts, pulse duration Tp, attenuation amplitude V A2 The attenuation period Ta and the attenuation index lambda, a main pulse velocity pulse model is provided, and finally high-frequency components are superposed to form artificially synthesized seismic oscillation, so that the method lays a foundation for research in related fields, and is suitable for being used forThe structure is designed to resist earthquake, so that loss caused by earthquake disasters can be prevented and reduced.

title_en: Traffic road safety evaluation method based on Gaussian process regression analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road traffic safety evaluation method based on Gaussian process regression analysis, relating to the technical field of traffic safety, by randomly selecting a preset number of traffic roads in a target area, extracting preset type reconstruction measures in the traffic roads, acquiring traffic accidents occurring in a period of time before the execution of the preset type reconstruction measures and traffic accident data, classifying the traffic accidents, after the preset type reconstruction measures are executed, the number of the traffic accidents occurring in the same time period is predicted, the probability of the traffic accidents occurring is further calculated, meanwhile, the traffic accident and the traffic accident data which actually occur after the reconstruction measures are executed in the same time period are obtained, the traffic safety effective factor is calculated, and updating the traffic road reconstruction measures according to the traffic safety effective factors and updating the traffic safety evaluation results. The technical scheme of the invention improves the accuracy and the reliability of traffic accident prediction and traffic safety evaluation.

title_en: Emergency shelter with modular retractable structure
abstract_en: Following post-disaster needs that should be addressed promptly, timely provision of shelter is a priority because it is effective in post-disaster tolerance. This need is met through an emergency shelter with a retractable structure. A shelter that is lightweight and would be set up with the least number of people, and also has a high setup speed can be applied in all areas with no installation training. Moreover, the advantage of an expandable structure that can be retracted and keep the environment safe is also considered. Also, modular structures make it possible for the units to be incorporated and provide larger spaces suitable for different numbers of people. This point can develop the field related to post-disaster reconstruction and be helpful in resolving pertinent issues.

title_en: Apparatus for fire-training
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a device for firefighting training, which is provided to practice a use method of a fire extinguisher by injecting a fire extinguishing agent, comprises: a fire model plate configured to realize different shapes of flames according to operating modes; and a controller changing the operating modes of the fire model plate. The controller is configured with the predetermined number of buttons for changing the operating modes of the fire model plate through manual control of a user or changing the operating modes by an amount of the fire extinguishing agent reaching the fire model plate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 소화약제를 분사하여 소화기 사용법을 실습하는 소방 훈련용 장치에 있어서, 동작 모드에 따라 각기 다른 불꽃의 모습을 재현하도록 구성된 화재 모형판; 및 상기 화재 모형판의 상기 동작 모드를 변경하는 컨트롤러를 포함하고, 상기 컨트롤러는, 사용자의 수동 조작을 통해 상기 화재 모형판의 동작 모드를 변경하거나, 상기 화재 모형판에 도달한 소화약제의 양에 의해 동작 모드가 변경되도록 하기 위한 기 설정된 개수의 버튼으로 구성된다.

title_en: Building waste classified incineration device based on disaster area reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction waste classification incineration device based on disaster area reconstruction, which comprises a shell, wherein extrusion cotton is arranged at the top end of the shell, an incineration assembly is arranged in the shell, rolling balls I are fixedly arranged on the inner sides of the extrusion cotton, the rolling balls I are fixedly connected with the incineration assembly, an incineration plate is connected with an upper pipe of the incineration assembly, three flame tubes are uniformly arranged in the incineration plate and are respectively connected with the pipeline of the incineration assembly, a connecting plate is fixedly connected with the inner sides of the two rolling balls I, rolling balls II are fixedly connected with the lower end of the connecting plate, the outer sides of the two rolling balls are connected with a shell spring, the incineration assembly comprises a gas pipe and an ignition bin, the gas pipe is connected with the pipeline of the ignition bin, and elastic sheets are arranged in the gas pipe.

title_en: Three-dimensional reconstruction method and device for fire scene, server and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of image visual processing, and provides a three-dimensional reconstruction method, a device, a server and a readable storage medium for a fire scene, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a panoramic image to be processed, wherein the panoramic image to be processed is a panoramic image shot by a depth camera at a fire scene; generating a point cloud according to the panoramic image to be processed; reconstructing according to the type of the point cloud to obtain a local three-dimensional model; and combining the local three-dimensional models to obtain a global three-dimensional model. Therefore, the method and the device automatically perform modeling through the acquired panoramic image, respectively establish local three-dimensional models according to different point cloud types in the modeling process, finally combine the local three-dimensional models to obtain a global three-dimensional model, fully consider the difference between object objects in a real scene of a fire scene, and improve the reality of the three-dimensional model.
assignees: CHINA GERMANY ZHUHAI ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;4DAGE CO LTD

title_en: Prefabricated and assembled composite steel pipe concrete lattice column and construction method
abstract_en: A prefabricated composite steel tube concrete lattice column is composed of prefabricated double-steel tube interlayer concrete column limbs and lattice connecting pieces among the column limbs. The steel pipes on the outer sides of the prefabricated column limbs are connected with the lattice type connecting piece through bolts, and the interlayer concrete between the steel pipes on the inner sides and the outer sides of the column limbs is made of ultra-high performance concrete. The prefabricated column limbs on the upper layer and the lower layer are connected through flanges and connecting pipes. The double steel pipe interlayer confined concrete can effectively reduce the steel distribution rate of the column member, save the consumption of the concrete and reduce the self weight. The lattice type column adopts a full-assembly mode, is simple and convenient to construct on site, and does not need wet operation. The hollow part of the inner steel pipe is used as strength storage, and the hollow part concrete can be poured for the second time to achieve the purposes of crane upgrading and workshop reconstruction in the using process. Based on the characteristics of simple design and flexible application, the invention can be widely applied to medium-sized industrial plants, and effectively improves the durability, fire resistance and earthquake resistance of the lattice column.

title_en: Construction method of pile foundation pile cap retaining wall foam concrete protection structure of disaster-damaged terrace
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of a disaster-damaged terrace pile foundation pile cap retaining wall foam concrete protection structure, which comprises the following steps: step one, pile foundation bearing platform construction; constructing an anchor cable and an anchor head; step three, prefabricating an outer rabbet retaining wall unit, an inner rabbet retaining wall unit and a corner retaining wall unit; step four, constructing the upper retaining wall foam concrete protective structure in stages; and step five, arranging longitudinal water stop strips at each step changing position of the prefabricated retaining wall. The invention has the beneficial effects that: according to the invention, the pile foundation bearing platform with the wedge-shaped bottom surface is adopted, the long pile foundation and the short pile foundation are arranged, and the anchor cable is arranged to be connected with the slope body into a whole, so that the integral anti-overturning capability is enhanced, the bearing capacity of the pile foundation bearing platform is improved, and the unfavorable geological conditions in disaster reconstruction are effectively overcome; the invention adopts the double anchor rods and the single anchor rod to anchor the prefabricated retaining wall unit, has simple and rapid construction and strengthens the stability and the integrity of the prefabricated retaining wall protective structure and the slope body.

title_en: Seismic inversion method, system, device and medium based on wave equation
abstract_en: The invention provides a seismic inversion method, a system, a device and a medium based on a wave equation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring and determining the calculation parameters of the single-frequency sensitivity kernel function according to the earthquake observation parameters and the initial velocity model parameters; generating a velocity model of the random boundary; performing wave equation forward modeling according to the calculation parameters and the velocity model to obtain a synthetic seismic record and a frequency domain incident wave field; determining a travel time accompanying seismic source according to the synthetic seismic record, and determining a single-frequency gradient of a travel time target functional according to the travel time accompanying seismic source; extracting a low wave number part from the single-frequency gradient, and performing seismic velocity inversion according to the low wave number; compared with the wave equation time-of-flight tomography technology based on the wave field reconstruction frame, the method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of calculation efficiency, memory occupation and algorithm complexity, and can be widely applied to the technical field of seismic velocity modeling.
assignees: GUANGDONG LABORATORY OF SOUTHERN OCEAN SCIENCE AND ENG ZHANJIANG;ZHANJIANG BRANCH OF CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORPORATION;SHANGHAI QINGFENG ZHIYUAN GEOPHYSICAL GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: The urethane foam insulation board and the manufacturing method thereof in which the flame penetration prevention function of exterior is improved
title_ko: 외면의　화염침투방지 기능이　향상된　발포우레탄폼　단열보드　및　그　제조방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a foamed urethane foam heat-insulation board having an improved flame-penetration preventing function on the outer surface thereof, and a method for manufacturing the same. More particularly, the method for manufacturing a foamed urethane foam heat-insulation board having an improved flame-penetration preventing function on the outer surface thereof comprises: an expanded graphite flame-retardant sheet forming step (S1); an expanded graphite flame-retardant sheet supply step (S2); a urethane liquid spraying and foaming step (S3); a compressing and shaping step (S4); and a cutting and packaging step (S5). A flame-penetration preventing function of the outer surface of a foamed urethane foam heat-insulation board is improved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 외면의　화염침투방지 기능이　향상된　발포우레탄폼　단열보드　및　그　제조방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 발포우레탄폼 단열보드의 연속생산라인에서, 발포우레탄폼의 상,하,좌우측면부에 팽창흑연난연시트를 일체로써 감싸도록 형성하여, 가볍고 단열성이 좋으면서도 화재발생시 발화시간을 지연시킴으로써 사람들로 하여금 화재현장으로부터 초기대피시간을 확보하여 신속하고 안전하게 대피할 수 있는 외면의 화염침투방지 기능이 향상된 발포우레탄폼　단열보드　및　그　제조방법에 관한 것이다. 
상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명인 외면의 화염침투방지 기능이　향상된　발포우레탄폼　단열보드　제조방법은, 팽창흑연을 바인더와 혼합한  팽창흑연혼합액(30)을 알루미늄필름(40)의 내측 일면에 도포하고 그 위에 또 다른 알루미늄필름(40)을 융착하여 일체로 된 팽창흑연난연시트(E)를 형성하는 팽창흑연난연시트 형성단계(S1)와; 외면의 화염침투방지 기능이 향상된 발포우레탄폼단열보드제조장치(100)의 우레탄액 분사대(140)의 하면부, 좌우측면부 및 상면부에 팽창흑연난연시트를 공급하는 팽창흑연난연시트 공급단계(S2)와; 상기 우레탄액 분사대(140)에 공급된 하면부 팽창흑연난연시트(E1)의 상부에 우레탄액을 분사하여 발포가 이루어지는 우레탄액 분사,발포단계(S3)와; 상기 우레탄액 분사,발포단계(S3)로부터 이송된 단열보드성형체(11)를 프레스 컨베이어(160)에 의해 압축되며 성형로(170, 오븐)를 거치면서 소정 형상의 단열보드체(12)를 성형하는 압축,성형 단계(S4); 및 상기 압축,성형 단계(S4) 에서 압축,성형되어 이송된 단열보드체(12)가 소정길이로 절단되어 본 발명의 외면의 화염침투방지 기능이 향상된 발포우레탄폼 단열보드(1)를 완성하여 포장, 적재되는 절단,포장 단계(S5); 를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 의하여, 가볍고 단열성이 좋으면서도 화재발생시 사람들로 하여금 화재현장으로부터 초기대피시간을 확보하여 신속하고 안전하게 대피할 수 있는 외면의 화염침투방지 기능이 향상된 발포우레탄폼 단열보드 및 그 제조방법이 제공되게 된다.

title_en: Static orbit meteorological satellite radar reflectivity factor inversion method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of strong convection weather early warning, in particular to a static orbit meteorological satellite radar reflectivity factor inversion method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: selecting a sensitive channel of a stationary orbit meteorological satellite imager according to a random forest method; the sensitivity channel is a channel with strong correlation with radar reflectivity factors; and receiving sensitivity channel data transmitted by the stationary orbit meteorological satellite imager, and inputting a radar reflectivity factor inversion model which is established and trained in advance to obtain an inversion result. The method of the invention provides basic detection and diagnosis data for the disaster weather of the area not covered by the radar, and can more intuitively know the beneficial effects of the strong convection system with incomplete radar data coverage and the typhoon cyclone intensity distribution; the time interval can be shortened, and the fast-developing convection system can be monitored more conveniently; and the method has stronger nonlinear reconstruction capability and higher inversion accuracy.
assignees: NAT SATELLITE METEOROLOGICAL CENTER NAT CENTER FOR SPACE WEATHER

title_en: Fire safety alarm method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an alarm method, an alarm device, computer equipment and a storage medium for fire safety, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving original image data acquired by a camera for a user living place; reconstructing the original image data into reference image data representing that a fire occurs in a residential site of a user; adjusting a pre-trained fire-fighting recognition model by taking original image data and reference image data as samples, wherein the fire-fighting recognition model is used for recognizing whether a residential site is in fire or not; receiving target image data acquired by a camera for a user living place; inputting the target image data into the adjusted fire-fighting identification model to identify whether the residential site of the user has a fire or not; and if the fire disaster of the residential place of the user is determined, executing alarm operation aiming at fire safety. The invention realizes the accurate determination of whether a fire disaster occurs in a household place, thereby carrying out fire alarm.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Elevator gentle slope reconstruction structure of registering one's residence
abstract_en: A gentle slope of elevator is built structures again of registering one's residence, reform transform the existing building stair structure of turning back, including elevator, elevartor shaft, elevator export, elevator platform, gentle slope corridor, inclined ladder, platform of registering one's residence, entrance door, the elevator adopts the steel frame construction, pass through chemical bolt fastening between current building, gentle slope corridor both ends connect elevator platform and platform of registering one's residence respectively, inclined ladder one end connects elevator platform, the other end connects the platform of registering one's residence of another floor, through the above-mentioned technical scheme, to the building that the floor height exceeds 3.2 meters, the elevator is built outside the existing building unit stair, and reform transform the existing stair of turning back, rebuild into the structure of inclined ladder and gentle slope corridor, connect elevator platform and platform of registering one's residence through gentle slope, realize gentle slope entrance, made things convenient for the old person to come in and go out on the one hand; on the other hand, the inclined ladder and the gentle slope corridor still keep walking paths, and the requirements of residents going upstairs and downstairs and fire fighting and elevator rescue channels are met.

title_en: Elevator full flat bed entrance reconstruction structure
abstract_en: A full flat floor of elevator is entered one's residence and is rebuilt the structure, reform transform the existing building and turn back the stair structure, including elevator, elevartor shaft, elevator exit, elevator platform, horizontal corridor, inclined ladder, platform, door of entering one's residence, the said elevator adopts the steel frame construction, pass the chemical bolt fastening between existing building and the horizontal corridor, the said horizontal corridor both ends connect elevator platform and platform of entering one's residence respectively, one end of the said inclined ladder connects the elevator platform, another end connects the platform of entering one's residence of another floor, through the above-mentioned technical scheme, the existing building unit stair is built the elevator in addition, and reform transform into the existing turn back stair, structure of inclined ladder and horizontal corridor, on one hand, design the height of elevator platform and platform of entering one's residence into unanimity, connect elevator platform and platform of entering one's residence through the horizontal corridor, realize the level is entered one's residence, have greatly facilitated the elderly to come in and go out; on the other hand, the inclined ladder and the horizontal corridor still keep walking paths, thereby satisfying the requirements of residents going upstairs and downstairs and also satisfying the requirements of fire fighting and elevator rescue channels.

title_en: Underwater ecology and environmental monitoring system
title_ko: 수중 생태 및 환경 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring life under water and an underwater environment, wherein the system for monitoring life under water and an underwater environment comprises: an underwater image input device that photographs an underwater environment and outputs image data; one or more underwater sensors that are disposed under water to detect the underwater environment indicators and to output the sensor data; one or more local servers connected to the underwater image input device and the underwater sensors; and a main server that exchanges the data with the local servers, and comprises the local environment information and the natural disaster information. The system for monitoring the life under water and the underwater environment of the present invention can improve a situational awareness ability by visualizing the underwater image and the underwater environment indicators measured from the sensor and reproducing the underwater image and underwater environment indicators on one screen.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수중 생태 및 환경 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로, 수중 환경을 촬영하여 영상 데이터를 출력하는 수중 영상 입력 장치; 수중에 배치되어 수중 환경 지표를 감지하여 센서 데이터를 출력하는 하나 이상의 수중 센서; 상기 수중 영상 입력 장치와 상기 수중 센서에 연결된 하나 이상의 로컬 서버들; 및 상기 로컬 서버들과 데이터를 교환하고, 지역 환경 정보와 자연 재해 정보를 포함한 메인 서버를 포함한다.   본 발명의 수중 생태 및 환경 감시 시스템은 수중 영상과 센서로부터 측정된 수중 환경 지표들을 시각화하여 한 화면에서 재현함으로써 상황 인식 능력을 개선할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster site reconstruction and cause analysis method and system using drones
title_ko: 드론을 활용한 재난현장 재구성 및 원인분석 방법과 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a system for disaster site reconstruction and cause analysis using a drone, which reconstruct a target site through 3D spatial information analysis on the basis of an accident site image acquired from a drone device flying over a disaster accident site, store a site situation as a recordable and manageable tangible data if necessary, and can analyze an accident cause on the basis of the recordable and manageable tangible data. The system of the present invention comprises: a drone device for acquiring disaster accident site information by flying over a disaster accident site to photograph the same, and transmitting the same to a control device; a control device for controlling the flight of the drone device and transmitting the disaster accident site information received from the drone device to an analysis device; and an analysis device for reconstructing a disaster site by analyzing the disaster accident site information received from the control device, and analyzing an accident cause on the basis of the reconstructed disaster site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 사고 현장을 비행하는 드론 장치로부터 취득한 사고 현장 영상을 기반으로 3차원 공간정보 분석을 통하여 대상 현장을 재구성하고, 필요에 따라 현장 상황을 기록 및 관리가 가능한 유형의 자료로 보관하며, 이에 근거하여 사고 원인을 분석할 수 있도록 하는, 드론을 활용한 재난현장 재구성 및 원인분석 방법과 시스템이 개시된다. 
개시된 드론을 활용한 재난현장 재구성 및 원인분석 방법과 시스템은, 재난사고 현장을 비행하면서 촬영하여 재난사고 현장 정보를 취득하고 통제 장치로 전송하는 드론 장치; 상기 드론 장치의 비행을 조정하고, 상기 드론 장치로부터 수신되는 재난사고 현장 정보를 분석 장치로 전달하는 통제 장치; 및 상기 통제 장치로부터 전달받은 상기 재난사고 현장 정보를 분석하여 재난 현장을 재구성하고, 재구성된 재난 현장에 근거하여 사고 원인을 분석하는 분석 장치를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Landfill treatment device is rebuild after landslide calamity
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of reconstruction equipment after landslide disaster, in particular to a reconstruction landfill treatment device after landslide disaster, which comprises a crushing box, wherein the crushing box has no top wall, two driving columns which are symmetrically arranged are arranged inside the crushing box, a crushing roller is fixedly sleeved on the outer ring of the driving columns, a connecting hole is arranged at the middle position of the bottom wall of the crushing box, a discharging box without a top wall is fixed inside the connecting hole, the bottom parts of the side walls at the two sides of the discharging box are both provided with discharging holes, a discharging pipe which is obliquely arranged is fixedly sleeved inside the discharging holes, the middle position of the bottom wall of the discharging box is rotatably connected with a vertical transmission column through a sealing bearing, a driving motor with an upward output end is arranged on the outer bottom wall of the discharging box through a motor frame, the bottom end of the transmission column is fixedly connected with the output end of the driving motor, the utility model is novel in design, the speed of dangerous solid waste crushed aggregates after landslide disaster is discharged is higher, the method is favorable for improving the working efficiency of reconstruction after landslide disasters, and has the advantages of higher automation degree and lower labor intensity.

title_en: Method and device for simulating and predicting pre-disaster fault scene of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for simulating and predicting a pre-disaster fault scene of a power distribution network, comprising the following steps: establishing a power distribution network fault probability model; generating a power distribution network fault scene set according to the preset disaster information and the total number of preset generation scenes; performing topology reconstruction in a power distribution network fault scene set to construct a fault topology reconstruction model; processing to obtain fault loss of each fault scene and scene topology similarity among the fault scenes; clustering fault scenes according to the fault loss to obtain a plurality of first scene clustering results; clustering each first scene clustering result according to the topological similarity to obtain a plurality of second scene clustering results; and obtaining a simulation prediction result of the pre-disaster fault scene of the power distribution network according to the second scene clustering result. And generating scenes according to the disaster forecast information, clustering the scenes by utilizing the fault loss and the topological similarity of the scenes, and providing a basis for optimizing decisions based on the scenes so as to analyze the influence of the disaster on the power distribution network before the disaster.

title_en: Interim fire control unit of building site
abstract_en: The utility model provides a temporary fire fighting device for a building site, which is used for a building main body, wherein the building main body comprises an operation floor, a template floor and a form removal floor which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, the temporary fire fighting device comprises at least three fire fighting vertical pipes which are connected with each other and are vertically arranged, the joints of two adjacent fire fighting vertical pipes are provided with socket fittings, each fire fighting vertical pipe is connected with a fire fighting branch pipe, and a temporary hanging basket is hung on the fire fighting branch pipe which is positioned at the uppermost layer; the temporary hanging basket is located an operation floor, the lower portion of the operation floor is sequentially provided with a template floor and a formwork removal floor from top to bottom, and the fire-fighting vertical pipe, the operation floor and the formwork removal floor are in one-to-one correspondence. The utility model discloses a set up interim hanging flower basket for place the fire control facility, make the installation of fire control facility keep unanimous with floor construction progress, and need not demolish the reconstruction after the completion of building subject, avoided the extravagant and time limit for a project delay scheduling problem of material.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION EIGHTH ENG DIVISION SOUTHWEST CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Elevator structure of rebuilding by mistake half floor to enter home
abstract_en: A half-floor-staggered entrance reconstruction structure of an elevator is based on a return stair structure of the existing building and comprises an elevator, an elevator shaft, an elevator exit, a return stair platform, a first inclined ladder, a second inclined ladder, an entrance platform and an entrance door, wherein the elevator is of a steel frame structure and is fixed with the existing building through chemical bolts, two ends of the return stair platform are respectively connected with the elevator and the entrance platform, the bottom of a car is consistent with the height of the return stair platform after the elevator reaches a specified floor, the elevator is additionally built on the outer side of the building on the basis of not changing the return stair structure of the existing building through the technical scheme, when the elevator reaches the specified floor, the bottom of the car is consistent with the height of the return stair platform, meanwhile, the first inclined ladder and the second inclined ladder still keep walking paths, the residential building is satisfied with going upstairs and going downstairs, and fire fighting and elevator rescue channels are also satisfied, in addition, the elevator steel structure is fixed with the existing building through chemical bolts, and the elevator steel structure is stable, safe and reliable.

title_en: Landslide mass identification method based on Laplacian pyramid remote sensing image fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide mass identification method based on Laplacian pyramid remote sensing image fusion, which comprises the following steps: firstly, reconstructing an original remote sensing image by using a Laplacian pyramid fusion module for the extracted local features and global features of the remote sensing image to generate a fusion image; then, a deep learning semantic segmentation model is constructed through a semantic segmentation network; then, respectively marking the place where the landslide disaster happens and the place where the landslide disaster does not happen in the fused image through a picture marking tool to obtain a landslide disaster label picture data set; and finally, training a deep learning semantic segmentation model by using a data set, and storing the model until the loss curve of the model is fitted and the precision of identifying a landslide body in the remote sensing image meets the requirement by modifying the semantic segmentation network structure and adjusting the model parameters. The method is combined with the image fusion model based on the Laplacian pyramid, and effective decision basis can be efficiently and accurately provided for disaster prevention and reduction of landslide disasters.

title_en: Method and device for making pre-disaster plan for toughness recovery of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for formulating a pre-disaster plan for toughness recovery of a power distribution network, which are used for formulating a contract for energy recovery by utilizing public transport resources during toughness recovery of the power distribution network, and the method comprises the following steps: establishing a distribution network toughness recovery contract model; establishing a topology reconstruction model of a power distribution network fault scene set according to preset disaster information, wherein the topology reconstruction model is used for representing a topology structure of the power distribution network after the disaster toughness is restored and reconstructed; determining a confidence parameter, wherein the confidence parameter is used for representing the risk preference of the power distribution network; and under the topology of the topology reconstruction model, optimizing the constraint model according to the confidence parameters and preset disaster information to obtain a pre-disaster plan result of the toughness recovery of the power distribution network. Public transportation resources are reasonably utilized in the toughness recovery of the power distribution network so as to improve the toughness recovery capability of the power distribution network; and a reasonable contract model is formulated and a pre-disaster plan result is obtained through solving, so that a basis is provided for the overall decision of improving the toughness of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Realistic fire-fighting simulator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a realistic fire-fighting simulator which allows a trained person to move a virtual space and perform suppression and response training of virtual fire in complicated and various virtual fire disaster situation in order to provide a training experience similar to real training to a trained person in a virtual contents based fire-fighting. According to one characteristic of the present invention, there is provided a realistic interaction simulator to have the same feeling as real fire-fighting in a virtual fire-fighting when a user wears HMD by providing floor movement possible in a fire disaster situation to trained persons. Feeling possible floor movement similar to a fire disaster situation is provided by reproducing a physical floor movement such as inclination, fall (vertical movement), and shake of a floor as base motion for realistic content experience.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상 콘텐츠 기반 소방훈련에 있어 실제 훈련과 유사한 훈련 경험을 피훈련자에게 주기 위하여 복합적이고 다양한 가상의 화재 재난 상황에서 피훈련자가 가상 공간을 이동하고 가상 화재의 진압 및 대응 훈련이 가능하도록 하는 소방훈련용 가상현실 시뮬레이터에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 한 특징에 따르면, 화재 재난 상황에서 발생 가능한 바닥 움직임을 피훈련자에게 제공하여, HMD를 착용한 가상 소방훈련시 실제 소방 훈련과 동일한 느낌을 갖도록 해 주는 체감형 상호작용 시뮬레이터가 제공된다. 실감 콘텐츠 체험을 위해 바닥의 기울임, 추락(수직이동), 떨림과 같은 물리적인 바닥 움직임을 베이스모션으로 재현하여 화재 재난 상황과 유사한 체감이 가능한 바닥 움직임이 제공된다.

title_en: Fire accident emergency treatment drilling system and treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire accident emergency treatment exercise system and a processing method, wherein the fire accident emergency treatment exercise system comprises a computing processing device, the modeling device models a petrochemical fire scene, a 3D printing device is utilized for carrying out scale reduction reconstruction, a head-mounted display and a mixed reality technology are utilized to realize superposition of a virtual fire scene and a real scene sand table, and the petrochemical fire accident emergency treatment exercise is carried out through three-dimensional interaction. A fire accident drilling processing method specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, determining a petrochemical typical fire emergency treatment process and an accident evolution process control method, carrying out procedural carding on a fire accident plan through the treatment process and the process control method, carrying out three-dimensional modeling analysis on a typical fire accident scene, and developing a petrochemical typical fire accident emergency treatment simulation exercise system. The drilling system and the processing method can simulate drilling and simulate reality interaction of fire accidents, and are convenient to use and high in reliability.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system toughness improvement method considering multi-stage recovery process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system toughness improvement method considering a multi-stage recovery process, which comprises the following specific steps: firstly, constructing a pre-disaster preparation stage model; secondly, constructing a disaster attack stage model, and identifying fault and non-fault areas in the comprehensive energy system after the disaster happens; then, constructing a fault isolation stage model and reducing the area of a fault region; then, constructing an energy supply recovery stage model based on rapid reconstruction of the net rack, and realizing energy supply recovery of users in a non-fault area; and finally, decomposing the original model into a series of fault scene sub-models capable of being solved in parallel by adopting a step-by-step hedging algorithm, and realizing efficient and rapid solving of the model. The invention provides a comprehensive energy system toughness improvement method considering a multi-stage recovery process and multi-energy flow coordination from the viewpoints of pre-disaster active defense, rapid post-disaster fault isolation and energy supply recovery, and provides a theoretical basis for extreme disaster response capability construction of a toughness comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Power distribution network advanced toughness reconstruction method based on environmental data prejudgment
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network early toughness reconstruction method based on environmental data prejudgment, which relates to the technical field of power distribution network early toughness reconstruction, and comprises fault isolation, power grid toughness characterization and measurement, model establishment, algorithm solution and optimization schemes, wherein the power grid toughness characterization and measurement is the characterization and measurement of absorption capacity, adaptability and restoring force of a power grid, the absorption capacity is expressed as the capacity of a system for absorbing influence caused by a disaster through passive adjustment during the period from the disaster occurrence to the minimum performance of the power grid, the adaptability mainly refers to the capacity of the system for rapidly repairing the performance after the system is interfered by the disaster through active adjustment and the response of standby reserve resources of the system to the disaster, the adaptability of the system to the disaster is expressed, the restoring force mainly refers to the capacity of the system for rapidly repairing the performance after the system is interfered by the disaster, and when the power grid toughness characterization is carried out, the whole dynamic process of the influence of the disaster on the power grid is based on the disaster, so as to reflect the change situation of the power grid performance before, during and after the disaster.
assignees: FUSHUN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Risk-based building anti-explosion value evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a risk-based method and system for evaluating an anti-explosion value of a building, and belongs to the technical field of petrochemical industry. The method comprises the following steps: determining an explosive source within a preset distance of the building; determining the frequency of occurrence of explosion accidents of the explosion source; for different explosion accident occurrence frequencies, carrying out explosion simulation on the explosion source to determine different explosion overpressure of the explosion source; and performing curve simulation on different explosion accident occurrence frequencies and corresponding different explosion overpressures to obtain an anti-explosion value curve of the building. The method provides a construction or reconstruction basis for the anti-explosion design of the building, and is also suitable for protecting the building according to local conditions.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP QINGDAO SAFETY ENG INST

title_en: Accident reconstruction system and method for chemical device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safety engineering technology and information technology, and provides an accident reconstruction system and method for a chemical device. The system comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring process data, accident data, disaster field data and emergency treatment data of the chemical device; a modeling module for constructing a risk device model of the chemical plant based on the process data, the accident data, and the disaster field data, for constructing an emergency treatment model for simulating an emergency treatment process for the accident phenomenon based on the emergency treatment data, and for constructing a three-dimensional scene of the chemical plant, and enabling each constructed model to be simulated in the three-dimensional scene; and the evaluation module is used for obtaining simulation results of the accident analysis conclusion to be verified, which are reproduced through the models, and evaluating the accident analysis conclusion to be verified. The invention utilizes the simulation model to accurately reproduce the accident development process and the emergency treatment process, thereby verifying the accident analysis conclusion.

title_en: Workbench of a life-saving work vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a trolley for a tower wagon for rescue, which ensures physical well-being of a rescuee and a rescue worker who rides a trolly arranged for rescuing people and enters into a fire, allows the rescue worker to rapidly approach an outer wall of a heated building, enhances mental stability of a rescuee throughout the rescue work, provides an effective moving path, and can be easily handled in use. The trolley for a tower wagon according to the present invention comprises: a boarding trolley (100) having a room which a rescue worker and a rescuee can ride to allow people to be rescued and blocking heat in a fire from being transferred to the room when approaching the fire, thereby ensuring the safety of a rescue worker and a rescuee; a boarding panel (200) connected to the boarding trolley (100) to compensate for a difference in locations of the fire and the boarding trolley and support a load applied thereon while defining a moving path for a rescue worker who approaches the fire and a moving path for a rescuee who escapes from the fire; and a fixing safety stand (300) connected to the boarding trolley (100), wherein a pair of the fixing safety stands are closely fitted and joined into both sides of the boarding panel in order to prevent the boarding panel (200) from being moved laterally and provide an area for gripping to allow people to maintain their balance when the rescue worker is approaching the fire or the rescuee is moving. Therefore, rescue work can be rapidly performed and emotional and physical stability can be ensured.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 피구조자의 구조를 위해 마련된 작업대에 탑승하여 화재현장으로 진입하는 구조요원 및 구조되는 피구조자의 신체적 안녕을 유지함과 동시에 가열된 건축물 외벽에 신속 접근을 가능케 하고, 인명구조 전반에 걸쳐 피구조자의 정신적 안정을 제고하면서 효과적인 이동경로를 제공하고 사용상 취급이 용이한 인명구조용 고소작업차량의 작업대에 관한 것으로서, 구조요원과 피구조자의 탑승공간이 마련되어 피구조자의 구조를 가능케 하고, 화재현장으로 접근시 화재현장의 고열이 해당 탑승공간에 전도되는 것을 차단하여 구조요원과 피구조자의 안전을 확보하는 탑승대(100); 탑승대(100)에 연결되어 화재현장과 탑승대의 위치 차이를 보상하고 구조요원이 화재현장으로 접근하는 이동경로와 피구조자의 피난 이동경로를 설정하면서 가해지는 하중을 지탱하는 이동판(200); 탑승대(100)에 연결되어 이동판(200)의 측방 유동을 방지하기 위해 2개 1조로 이동판 양측에 밀착 끼움 결합되고, 구조요원이 화재현장으로 접근하거나 피구조자의 이동시 신체균형 유지를 위한 파지영역을 제공하는 고정안전대(300);로 구성하여 신속한 인명구조와 구조요원 및 피구조자의 정신적·신체적 안정감을 확보하는 인명구조용 고소작업차량의 작업대에 관한 것이다.
assignees: JIN WOO SMC INC CO LTD

title_en: System and Method for Measuring and Monitoring Seismic data Applied to the City Building
title_ko: 건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for measuring and monitoring seismic data applied to a building, which can rapidly inspect rapidity of seismic event detection and effectiveness of an occurrence event and prevent wrong detection and wrong warning in order to construct a rapid seismic warning system for alleviation of a seismic disaster of the building, wherein the system for measuring and monitoring the seismic data comprises: multiple seismic data measurement systems positioned at different distances from a monitoring object, each including a GPS receiving module and a seismic accelerometer, and performing previous detection for a seismic event; and a seismic monitoring system processing visual synchronization for data transmitted by the multiple seismic data measurement systems to remove noises and reconfigure the data into single merged data, performing post-process detection for checking whether the seismic event occurs and finally determining whether a seismic event occurs by using the previous detection result for the seismic event in each seismic data measurement system and the post-process detection result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물의 지진재해경감을 위한 지진신속경보체계 구축을 위하여 지진 이벤트 감지의 신속성 및 발생 이벤트의 유효성을 빠르게 검사하고 오검출 및 오경보를 방지할 수 있도록 한 건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 감시 대상물과 서로 다른 거리에 위치하고, GPS 수신모듈과지진가속도센서를 포함하고 지진이벤트의 사전 검출을 수행하는 복수 개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들 상기 복수개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들로부터 전송된 데이터를 시각 동기화 처리하여 잡음제거 및 단일 중합데이터로 재구성하고, 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 확인하기 위해 후처리 검출을 하여 각각의 지진 데이터 측정시스템에서의 지진이벤트 사전검출 결과와 후처리 검출결과를 활용하여 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 최종 판별하는 지진 감시시스템 을 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: Operation System of the High-Rise Work Vehicle for Life-saving
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an operation system of a high-rise work vehicle for lifesaving, which remotely controls the operation of the workbench of a high-rise work vehicle that transports rescue workers to rescue people to be rescued from a fire scene, to enable the rescue workers to quickly access the fire scene without a separate hand signal, thereby increasing operability and convenience and promoting the physical well-being of the rescue workers and the people to be rescued. More specifically, the operation system of a high-rise work vehicle for lifesaving comprises: a remote control unit (100) gripped by a user and operated, and for transmitting a control signal according to the operation through setting communication and outputting image information and a specific signal input through the setting communication; a vehicle unit (200) for guiding a boarding space in which rescue workers board so that the same is leveled while allowing the boarding space to approach a fire scene according to a control signal transmitted from the remote control unit (100); and a high-rise work unit (300) having the boarding space for the rescue workers, and for photographing the fire scene as an image while approaching the fire scene by a vehicle unit (200), detecting the distance between the boarding space and the fire scene, transmitting the image information and the detected distance to the remote control unit (100), receiving a setting signal from the remote control unit, and outputting the same.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재현장으로부터 피구조자를 구조하기 위해 구조요원을 이송하는 고소작업차량의 작업대 동작을 원격으로 제어하여 구조요원이 별도의 수신호를 행하지 않더라도 화재현장으로 신속한 접근을 가능케 함에 따라 조작성, 편의성 제고 및 구조요원과 피구조자의 신체적 안녕을 도모하는 인명구조용 고소작업차량 운용시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 사용자에 파지되어 조작 가능하고 조작에 따른 제어신호를 설정 통신을 통해 전송하면서 설정 통신을 통해 입력되는 영상 정보 및 특정 신호를 출력하는 원격제어부(100); 원격제어부(100)로부터 전송되는 제어신호에 따라 구조요원이 탑승한 탑승공간을 화재현장으로 접근케 하면서 수평을 유지하도록 유도하는 차량부(200); 구조요원의 탑승공간이 마련되고 차량부(200)에 의해 화재현장으로 접근하면서 화재현장을 영상으로 촬영하는 영상 정보 및 해당 탑승공간과 화재현장의 거리를 감지하여 원격제어부(100)로 전송하고 원격제어부로부터 설정 신호를 전송받아 출력하는 고소작업부(300):로 구성하는 것에 특징이 있는 인명구조용 고소작업차량 운용시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: JIN WOO SMC INC CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network resilience and reliability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the resilience and reliability of a power distribution network, which are used for establishing a reliability model of power distribution system elements and determining the type of the influence of each element fault on each load in the reliability model of the power distribution system elements by using a minimum path method; establishing a fault influence table, simulating the operation of the power distribution system by using a Monte Carlo method, and reconstructing a power distribution system network when a fault occurs; and inquiring the corresponding influence type in the fault influence table, counting the power failure times and the power failure time, and calculating the reliability index according to the power failure times and the power failure time to realize reliability evaluation. The method can recover more loads, reduce the load shedding amount, improve the restoring force of the system after disaster and improve the elasticity of the power system.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery method for block chain network consensus node deployed across data centers
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster recovery method for a block chain network consensus node deployed across data centers, and relates to the technical field of block chains. The method comprises the following steps: monitoring whether each data center provided with the block chain network consensus node is available; when the data center is unavailable, creating and starting the ghost nodes of the common nodes in other data centers according to a node reconstruction strategy according to the digital certificate of the common nodes deployed in the unavailable data center. The disaster recovery method for the block chain network consensus node deployed across the data centers, provided by the invention, can be used for reconstructing the Orderer node deployed in the unavailable data center (similar to a cloning mode) in the available data center and quickly recovering the sequencing service of the Orderer cluster, so that the uninterrupted operation of services is supported, and the influence on upper-layer application is reduced to the minimum.

title_en: Real-time traffic accident detection and early warning method based on Seq2Seq self-encoder model
abstract_en: The application discloses a real-time traffic accident detection and early warning method based on a Seq2Seq self-encoder model. Firstly, in order to analyze traffic element sequence data before and after a traffic accident and the characteristics of traffic flow abnormity, the invention establishes a set of traffic abnormity detection model and early warning process based on a Seq2Seq self-encoder. Secondly, the invention introduces an Attention mechanism on the basis of the Seq2Seq model to capture important traffic state characteristics. Then, in the aspect of judging the abnormal traffic state, the real-time detection of the traffic accident and the classification of accident risk grades are realized by comparing the reconstruction errors of the original data and the predicted data and according to a set threshold value.

title_en: Training bicycle simulator system for children's safety
abstract_en: A bicycle simulator system for child safety education according to the present invention provides a speed detection method for detecting an actual bicycle riding speed, a sensing method for steering, a method for generating a slope to represent the slope of a road, a force sensation control method for bicycle pedals, and a motion recognition device that can recognize hand signals during bicycle safety education using virtual reality to make a bicycle education test site with virtual reality. A bicycle simulator makes a user always enjoy the bicycle education test site like a real environment. By providing virtual reality (VR) content linked with the bicycle simulator, users can experience a road environment when riding a real bicycle outdoors, thereby maximizing the reliability and satisfaction of the users in using the bicycle simulator as a whole. In order to prevent an accident when a user rides a bicycle in an actual outdoor environment, a bicycle road test site including traffic lights, bumps and slopes can be configured in virtual reality to induce the user to comply with safety considerations well through the experience of the simulator. While using the content that is played (reproduced) on a display device used by a user, whether safety regulations are well implemented in a situation where a physical environment such as an actual road is presented is evaluated, thereby making the content feel immersive and realistic. Therefore, it is possible to provide accident prevention education prior to actual bicycle riding.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 어린이 안전교육용 자전거 시뮬레이터 시스템은 가상현실을 이용하여 자전거 안전교육 시 실제 자전거 주행 속도 감지를 위한 속도 검출방법, 조향을 위한 센싱 방법, 도로의 경사면 표현을 위한 기울기 생성 방법, 자전거 페달을 위한 역감 제어 방법 및 수신호를 인지할 수 있는 동작인식장치를 제공하여 가상현실로 자전거 교육 시험장을 구현하게 하고, 이를 자전거 시뮬레이터를 통해 실제 환경처럼 항상 즐길 수 있게 하며, 자전거 시뮬레이터와 연동하는 VR(Virtual Reality) 콘텐츠을 제공하여 이용자 또는 사용자가 실제 자전거를 실외에서 주행할 때의 도로의 환경을 체감할 수 있게 하여 전체적으로 이용자 또는 사용자로 하여금 사용하는데 있어 신뢰도 및 만족도를 극대화하게 하고, 실제 실외환경에서 사용자가 자전거 주행할 경우와 안전사고를 예방하기 위해 신호등, 방지턱 및 경사면을 포함하는 자전거 도로 시험장을 가상현실로 구성할 수 있기에 시뮬레이터의 체함을 통해 안전 사항을 잘 준수하도록 유도할 수 있으며, 사용자가 이용하는 디스플레이장치에 재생(재현)되는 콘텐츠의 이용하면서 실제 도로와 같은 물리적 환경을 제시한 상황에서 안전 준수사항을 잘 이행하는지를 평가하여 콘텐츠의 몰입감과 현실감을 느끼게 하여 실제 자전거 운행에 앞서 안전사고의 예방교육이 가능한 것이다.

title_en: Rebuild well head emergency rescue device
