abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency rescue device for reconstructing a wellhead, which comprises a hydraulic drilling slip assembly, a blowout preventer, an emergency connecting part and a totally-enclosed flashboard blowout preventer, wherein the hydraulic drilling slip assembly, the blowout preventer, the emergency connecting part and the totally-enclosed flashboard blowout preventer are sequentially connected to the top of a cut wellhead sleeve; the hydraulic drilling slip assembly realizes quick connection of an emergency rescue device of the inverted blowout preventer and a wellhead sleeve, overcomes the problem that the conventional blowout preventer cannot be installed with the wellhead sleeve in blowout rescue operation, forms a sealing barrier for preventing liquid flow from leaking downwards with the wellhead sleeve of the out-of-control well, uses a fully-sealed flashboard blowout preventer on the upper part as a fully-sealed whole emergency rescue device, forms a sealed emergency rescue channel between the inverted blowout preventer and the fully-sealed flashboard blowout preventer, carries out emergency rescue operation through a side outlet of a connecting part for emergency rescue in the emergency rescue channel, and can completely avoid further expansion of accidents.
assignees: RONGSHENG MACHINERY MFT LTD OF HUABEI OILFIELD

title_en: Method for generating three-dimensional mine roadway model and constructing transparent working surface
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of virtual simulation of mines, and relates to a method for generating a three-dimensional mine roadway model and constructing a transparent working surface, which comprises the following steps: collecting modeling information of a roadway system and a transparent working face by using various conventional methods; processing the collected modeling information, and performing standardized and systematic storage by using a database technology; a 'parameterization' modeling method is provided, and a dynamic generation algorithm of a 'roadway and transparent working face' three-dimensional refined model is compiled based on the method; calling mapping and rendering technologies, and processing the constructed three-dimensional space model; an interactive operation function module is researched and developed to realize multi-functional operation display of a multi-level transparent model; optimizing and integrating an algorithm module, and researching and developing a tunnel and transparent working surface space model integrated dynamic reconstruction virtual simulation platform; the method is suitable for efficiently and dynamically constructing the mine roadway system and the transparent working face space refined model under different geological conditions, and provides support for intelligent comprehensive mining, disaster simulation and the like of the coal mine.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH NATIONAL SAFETY TRAINING CENTER OF COAL MINES;UNIV WUHAN SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Drainage treatment device for reconstruction engineering after flood period
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of drainage treatment devices, in particular to a reconstruction engineering drainage treatment device after flood season disasters, which comprises a main plate body and a water suction pump, wherein the side of the main plate body is provided with a supporting device, the top of the main plate body is provided with a connecting frame, the inner side of the connecting frame is provided with a round hole, the end part of the connecting frame is provided with a fixing nail, the water suction pump is arranged at the inner side of the main plate body, one end of the water suction pump is connected with a water inlet pipe, the end part of the water inlet pipe is connected with a filter pipe, the other end of the water suction pump is connected with a water outlet pipe, the top of the water suction pump is provided with an arc-shaped plate, the top of the arc-shaped plate is provided with a connecting rod, the side of the connecting rod is provided with an elastic spring, and the end part of the elastic spring is provided with a rotating plate; this scheme is convenient for the user to erect the device and high position control in the silt environment, and the user of being convenient for promotes the protection security effect of device, and the user of being convenient for promotes the damping nature effect of the actuating device of device.
assignees: ZHEJIANG XINKAI WATER CONSERVANCY CO LTD

title_en: Distributed virtual simulation earthquake emergency drilling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed virtual simulation earthquake application exercise system, which comprises: the system comprises a seismic environment resource database, an immersion display and interaction subsystem, an escape plan generation subsystem, a modeling and simulation subsystem, a three-dimensional view real-time rendering subsystem, a virtual drilling evaluation subsystem, a virtual drilling recording and playback subsystem and a communication subsystem. The distributed interactive simulation technology and the virtual environment modeling method are used in the earthquake emergency exercise technology, an HLA high-rise system framework structure is used as a standard followed by the distributed interactive simulation, the earthquake disaster scene simulation and the earthquake emergency exercise virtual simulation exercise technology are subjected to necessary technical development of interaction between equipment and objects in the virtual environment, and the feeling and experience of immersing in the equivalent real environment are generated, so that the on-site feeling of a trainee is enhanced, and the quick response and emergency handling capacity of earthquake emergency management personnel are improved.

title_en: Post-disaster debris flow repair method for ground power generation plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster debris flow repairing method for a ground power generation plant, belongs to the field of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering, and provides the post-disaster debris flow repairing method for the ground power generation plant, which can recover the production of the ground power generation plant as soon as possible and improve the debris flow disaster resistance of the ground power generation plant. According to the invention, the retaining wall is built in time after dredging, and the tail canal is reconstructed, so that the problems that the repair time is long after the ground power generation plant suffers from debris flow disasters, and potential safety hazards still exist after repair are solved, early repair and recovery production can be realized after the ground power generation plant suffers from debris flow disasters, the debris flow resistance of the ground power generation plant can be improved after repair, the long-term safe and stable operation of the hydropower station plant can be ensured, and the characteristic that the ground power generation plant is prevented from being damaged again after primary treatment is achieved.

title_en: SDN data center congestion control method based on priority experience playback DQN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a congestion control method of an SDN data center network based on priority experience playback DQN. The method is based on the network background of SDN and the congestion control thought of flow, and has the characteristics of intellectualization, centralization and initiative. The congestion control algorithm based on the priority experience playback DQN is introduced and improved, and an intelligent solution is provided for the congestion control problem of the SDN data center network. The invention distributes the rate globally to the flow of the whole network through the controller, so that the whole network can avoid congestion, and the utilization rate of the data link of the network can be as high as possible, thereby realizing the congestion control of the whole data center. Compared with a Q-learning-based method, the method solves the dimension disaster of the Q table; compared with the method based on DQN and DDQN, the method has better convergence speed and convergence effect. The invention relates to a congestion control method adapting to SDN data center network, which is in compliance with network intelligent development trend.

title_en: Fire control evacuation power carrier indicator lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting evacuation power carrier indicator lamp, wherein a power carrier module controls a relay control loop, the relay control loop instructs an LED lamp panel to display the fire-fighting evacuation direction, an uninterruptible battery pack provides an uninterruptible power supply for the relay control loop, on the basis of the structural topology of the traditional three-wire system evacuation indicator lamp system, the original electric circuit is not changed, the evacuation indicator lamp with the carrier function is replaced by the advantage of low upgrading and reconstruction cost, the real-time communication between an intelligent evacuation indicator lamp and a control host is realized, the networking communication function of the evacuation indicator lamp can be realized, the escape of an evacuee is guided to an error fire source danger area, and the life safety of people is ensured.

title_en: Fire extinguisher
abstract_ko:
소화약제가 충진되는 용기, 용기 입구에 결합되며 소화약제의 외부 방출 유로가 내부에 구비되는 플러그, 플러그의 유로에 결합되어 외부로 소화약제를 분사하는 통로를 포함하는 자동형 확산헤드, 플러그의 유로나 자동형 확산헤드의 통로 를 폐쇄하여 폐쇄상태가 되도록 하며 감열시에는 폐쇄된 곳을 개방하여 개방상태가도록 이루어진 감열식 개방장치와 같은 적어도 하나의 자동 요소를 가지는 소화기에 있어서, 감열식 개방장치는 저융점물질의 융해를 이용한 것이며, 확산헤드는 적어도 하나의 출구가 외측으로 수평보다 위로 향하도록 이루어지는 소화기가 개시된다.  
본 고안에 따르면 소화기는 화재 상황을 스스로 감지하여 소화약제가 자동 확산하게 되어 화재현장에서의 초기진화 및 조기진압의 확률지수를 높일 수 있고, 소화기에서의 자동 기능 동작에 의해 소화약제가 주변에 분사될 때 메인 분사노즐이 수평보다 상향으로 분사되도록 하여 소화 범위를 증가시키고 소화 효율을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Integrated charging supervision method and system for urban parking toll collector
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated charging supervision method and system for urban parking toll collectors, which comprises the following steps: creating a management platform of a roadside toll collector; the toll collector carries audio video equipment with a high-precision positioning chip, and the positioning chip on the audio video equipment feeds back the position data to the management platform through a wireless signal; the toll collector enters a preset toll interval to carry out patrol toll collection and event correlation at the same time, and the management platform supervises the moving position of the toll collector in real time; when an accident occurs, the audio recording equipment can give an alarm by one key, and the platform gives an alarm or performs related processing on the information. The invention can effectively position and supervise the toll collector in time, improve the supervising efficiency and ensure the good operation of the toll collection work by positioning the toll collector in real time, replaying the historical track, recording and replaying the sound of the toll collector in real time, identifying and early warning the voice key words of the toll collector, recording the moving track and carrying out video monitoring and recording correlation check on the whole process by the video monitor.
assignees: JIANGSU WIRELESS FLYING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire temperature field reconstruction method, system, computer equipment, medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire investigation in fire safety, and discloses a method, a system, computer equipment, a medium and a terminal for reconstructing a fire temperature field, wherein a fire numerical model for a specific scene is constructed by utilizing computational fluid dynamics software, a large number of fire scene simulations under different working conditions are developed, and a mapping relation between the fire temperature field and key influence factors is established based on a neural network technology; by constructing the depth correlation between the fire characterization parameters, the key influence factors and the fire temperature field, the fire temperature field can be quickly and accurately predicted. The method can quickly and accurately reconstruct the fire temperature field aiming at different scenes, thereby providing a new tool for fire investigation and fire risk assessment.

title_en: BIM model-based equipment operation and maintenance management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM model-based equipment operation and maintenance management method, which comprises the following steps: s1: carrying out light weight on the BIM model by adopting a light weight technology; s2: and carrying out equipment operation and maintenance management based on the BIM model after the weight is reduced. The equipment operation and maintenance management method is deeply associated with equipment, binding of the BIM and equipment information is realized, a safety point inspection system flow and related functions based on the BIM are realized, reconstruction and extension safety management based on the BIM is realized, an emergency response mechanism based on the BIM can be established, and emergency management is realized.
assignees: LASER FUSION RES CT CHINA ACADEMY ENGINEERING PHYSICS

title_en: Automatic fire rescue device for evacuation of old building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic fire-fighting rescue device for evacuating old buildings, which comprises an installation frame and a folding stair, wherein the folding stair is arranged in the installation frame and can be contained in the installation frame or extend out of the installation frame; the bottom of the folding stair is also provided with an automatic storage type ladder assembly, and the ladder assembly comprises a storage box body, a rotating shaft, a driving piece and a rope ladder; when the fire rescue device is unfolded, the folding stairs extend out of the mounting frame, and a rescue escape passage is formed between the rope ladder extending out of the storage box body and the folding stairs; the utility model improves the integral structural design, adopts the folding stairs as escape carriers, is matched with the automatic control of the ladder stand component, and is beneficial to saving escape time for residents through the automatic control of the fire-fighting rescue device, so as to solve the problems of emergency evacuation and escape of fire disasters of old buildings which are not subjected to escape channel reconstruction.

title_en: Concrete column reinforced structure based on super early strength grouting material
abstract_en: The utility model provides a concrete column reinforced structure based on grout material is super early excels in, is provided with vertical angle type at the bight of frame post along vertical logical length and protects the piece, protects a vertical direction even interval along the angle type and sets up a plurality of nuts, every the nut interval on the angle type protects the piece is 100 and adds in flour 200mm, and the nut on the adjacent angle type protects the piece sets up along vertical crisscross, twines a steel strand wires in frame post periphery from bottom to top through the nut, connects adjacent angle type through steel strand wires and protects the piece, and steel strand wires both ends are fixed respectively on the reinforcing apparatus at frame post both ends, form steel strand wires net, constitute integrative reinforced concrete frame post with inside frame post. The frame column adopts an integrated reinforced structure, and improves the shear resistance, the bending resistance and the integral lateral movement resistance of the original frame column. As a super early strength grouting material for buildings or structures, the anti-seismic performance of the post-disaster structure and the reliability of old city reconstruction and upgrading can be effectively improved, and the durability is good.

title_en: Throwing fire extinguisher
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a throwing fire extinguisher comprises a fire-extinguishing chemical pack having fire-extinguishing chemicals for extinguishing a fire therein and a storage container accommodating the fire-extinguishing chemical pack. The throwing fire extinguisher can be used in extinguishing a fire in an early stage by a quick and easy operation method and a weight to be carried with one hand in an urgent fire site situation. A spring is embedded to allow a user to quickly take out the fire-extinguishing chemical pack from the storage container while securing a safety distance between the user and the fire situation. The fire extinguisher has an attachable hanger and is easily carried in person. The fire extinguisher can be used as personal safety equipment of a firefighter when securing an entry path or an exit path during a life rescue of a firefighter or for extinguishing a fire in an early stage. Even an ordinary person can use the fire extinguisher for securing an escape route from a fire area or for extinguishing a fire in an early stage. To this end, the throwing fire extinguisher has the storage container accommodating the fire-extinguishing chemical pack. If a locking safety pin mounted on a main body and a lid of the storage container is pulled and drawn from a locking device by a pulling string, a lower portion of the fire-extinguishing chemical pack of the storage container is pushed and lifted by a force which vertically lifts the fire-extinguishing chemical pack by the expansion force of the compressed spring embedded in the lower portion of the fire-extinguishing chemical pack to automatically and quickly open the lid while the upper surface of the fire-extinguishing chemical pack pushes and lifts the lid to quickly expose about a half of the fire-extinguishing chemical pack to the outside. The fire-extinguishing chemical pack is held by a hand to be thrown to a fire portion to quickly extinguish the fire. A plurality of grooves are formed on the surface of the fire-extinguishing chemical pack to allow the fire-extinguishing chemical pack to collide with an external object to rupture the fire-extinguishing chemical pack in many directions to widely spread the fire-extinguishing chemicals in various directions.
abstract_ko: 본 발명인 투척식 소화기는 화재를 소화하는 소화약제가 들어간 소화약제팩과 이를 수용하는 보관용기로 구성되며, 긴급한 화재현장의 상황에서 한 손으로도 휴대가 가능한 무게와 신속하고 용이한 조작방법으로 인해 조기 화재진압에 사용이 가능하며, 사용자는 화재현장과의 사이에 안전거리를 확보한 상태에서 소화약제팩을 보관용기에서 신속히 인출할 수 있도록 스프링을 내장하고, 부착할 수 있는 걸이가 있어서 개인휴대가 용이한 소화기이며, 이는 초기화재의 진압용이나 소방관의 인명구조 시 진입로나 퇴로확보 시 소방관의 개인안전장비로 사용할 수 있고, 일반인도 초기화재 진압용이나 화재지역으로 부터의 탈출경로 확보용으로 사용할 수 있으며, 이를 위해 본 발명은 소화약제팩을 수용하는 보관용기를 구비하며, 보관용기의 뚜껑과 본체에 장착된 잠김안전핀을 당김줄로 잠금장치에서 당겨서 뽑으면 보관용기의 소화약제팩이 보관용기의 소화약제팩의 하부에 내장된 압축되었던 스프링의 팽창력에 의하여 수직상승하는 힘으로 소화액팩의 하부를 밀어 올림으로써 소화액팩의 상부면이 뚜껑을 밀어 올리면서 뚜껑이 자동으로 신속히 열려서 소화약제팩이 신속히 외부로 절반쯤 노출되며, 이를 손으로 잡아서 화재부분에 투척하여 신속하게 화재진압을 하고, 소화약제팩의 표면에는 다수의 홈을 형성하여 소화약제팩이 외부물체와 충돌하여 다방면으로 소화약제팩이 파열되게하여 소화약제가 여러 방향으로 광범위하게 퍼질 수 있도록 하는 것을 특징으로 하는 투척식 소화기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Configurable rule monitoring method for state and country enterprises based on knowledge graph and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a configurable rule monitoring method for state enterprises and national enterprises based on knowledge graph and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting supervision data from each level of national enterprise and establishing a national enterprise supervision map, wherein the supervision data comprises meeting information, item decision information, project information and fund trend information to establish a national enterprise online supervision system, and the national enterprise online supervision system is used for monitoring the supervision data in the national enterprise supervision map. The national resource and national enterprise supervision map is constructed and stored by adopting a map database, namely, the supervision entities and the relationships among the supervision entities are stored, so that the entity relationships of a plurality of indirect relationships can be effectively tracked and analyzed, a data base is provided for prediction analysis and blood margin analysis, and the post-incident supervision tracing is facilitated.

title_en: Geological disaster photographing monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster photographing monitoring and early warning method, which comprises the following steps: s1: determining the size of each target according to the distance from the video camera, the maximum displacement value and the magnification of the video camera by taking each target image which can be clearly obtained as a target; s2: adopting a video camera to carry out real-time image acquisition on each target of a plurality of measuring lines and a plurality of measuring points of the monitored landslide body; based on the collected video image, performing high-precision distortion correction on the lens camera by using a panoramic calibration field, filtering noise interference by wavelet transformation, and then restoring the image through image reconstruction; s3: the recovered image data are transmitted to a computer server, and the computer server carries out real-time calculation on the vertical displacement of each target and the displacement in the landslide direction; s4: the computer server outputs the calculation result in a chart or a format designated by a user; s5: and immediately performing acousto-optic early warning by the computer server when the computer server detects that the threshold value is exceeded.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;SICHUAN CHUANDA ANCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Strip mine distributed water resource storage system and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strip mine distributed water resource storage system and an implementation method thereof, wherein the system comprises the following steps: s10: obtaining contour maps and stratigraphic columns of the mining area and surrounding topography; s20: planning water storage area parameters of a distributed water resource storage system and reshaping landform contour lines; s30: partial storage systems are built during the internal drainage operation of the strip mine so as to realize the resource utilization of water burst and precipitation of partial mines; it includes: s40: and finishing the construction of the distributed water resource storage system during the pit closing period of the strip mine. The method effectively stores and timely converts mine gushing water into production water and greening water during the production period of the open-pit mine in the water-deficient area; the rainwater is stored and called through the height difference between distributed water storage areas and between the water storage areas and the reclamation area after the pit is closed; the volume of the water storage area is used for offsetting the volume of the resource amount to be extracted, so that the elevation of the area reconstructed by the internal drainage operation is close to the original landform, and the geological disasters such as landslide, debris flow and the like are avoided.
assignees: CHN ENERGY INVEST GROUP CO LTD;NAT INST CLEAN & LOW CARBON ENERGY;GUONNENG BAORI XILE ENERGY CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Intelligent obstacle-surmounting water curtain cooling type firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent obstacle-surmounting water curtain cooling type firefighting rescue robot. Including interior casing, shell body, casing bottom plate, many telescopic links, by interior casing, shell body, the retaining chamber that the casing bottom plate encircleed forms, install in the laser point cloud sensor of shell body, the controller, interior casing and shell body pass through spliced pole fixed connection, and interior casing bottom is provided with many bracing piece outer bars and nestification in the bracing piece inner rod in the bracing piece outer rod, and the one end of bracing piece inner rod is provided with the gyro wheel. The intelligent obstacle crossing device has the beneficial effects that the intelligent obstacle crossing device is high in mobility, water can be sprayed by the water curtain spray head to cool the local part, the phenomenon that the rescued personnel are influenced by smoke and high temperature can be guaranteed as far as possible, most of working parts are arranged at the bottom of the inner shell, water in the water storage cavity has heat insulation and cooling effects on the working parts, the failure rate of the working parts is reduced, the laser point cloud sensor can reconstruct a real-time map, a complex fire scene map can be reconstructed, and the rescue personnel can be helped to rush in and evacuate.

title_en: Foam concrete protection structure for pile foundation bearing platform retaining wall of disaster-damaged terrace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a disaster-damaged terrace pile foundation retaining wall foam concrete protection structure which comprises a prefabricated retaining wall, a bearing platform, a waterproof layer, foam concrete, vertical double-support anchor rods, a grouting reinforcement area, a graded crushed stone layer, anchor cables, an outer side long pile foundation, an inner side short pile foundation and vertical single-support anchor rods, wherein a drain hole, a reserved anchor hole and an anchoring groove are formed in the bearing platform, the outer side long pile foundation and the inner side short pile foundation are arranged at the bottom of the bearing platform, the anchor cables penetrate through the reserved anchor holes, one end of each anchor cable is fixed in the disaster-damaged terrace, the other end of each anchor cable is fixed in the anchoring groove through an anchor head, and the prefabricated retaining wall is arranged above the bearing platform in a stepped mode through anchor bolts. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the utility model adopts the pile foundation bearing platform with the wedge-shaped bottom surface, the long pile foundation and the short pile foundation, and the anchor cable and the slope body are connected into a whole, thereby enhancing the integral anti-overturning capability, improving the bearing capacity of the pile foundation bearing platform and effectively overcoming the unfavorable geological conditions in the disaster reconstruction.

title_en: Three-dimensional identification method for landslide slip surface based on unmanned aerial vehicle image and deep learning
abstract_en: A three-dimensional identification method for a landslide slip surface based on unmanned aerial vehicle images and deep learning relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring. The method aims to solve the problem that the specific positioning of the sliding surface by the existing method for detecting the landslide is not accurate. The method comprises the steps of collecting at least 5 images of a detected area at different angles by an unmanned aerial vehicle to serve as a detection image, distinguishing the types of all pixel points in the detection image by a semantic segmentation network to obtain a semantic segmentation result, reconstructing the detection image by a three-dimensional reconstruction algorithm to obtain a three-dimensional point cloud containing a landslide glide plane, calculating a two-dimensional coordinate of any pixel point A in the three-dimensional point cloud in a two-dimensional plane, substituting the two-dimensional coordinate of the pixel point A in the two-dimensional plane into the semantic segmentation result obtained in the step two to obtain the type of the pixel point A, and taking the type of the pixel point A and the three-dimensional coordinate of the pixel point A as the three-dimensional identification result of the landslide glide plane.

title_en: Auxiliary installation method and system for fire-fighting equipment, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire-fighting equipment auxiliary installation method and system, electronic equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target image in a preset fire space, obtaining a recognition result of the target image through a pre-trained target detection model, wherein the target detection model is obtained through machine learning training by using multiple groups of data, each group of data in the multiple groups of data comprises a sample image and preset feature labels in the sample image, the sample image is map reconstruction data established through SLAM data of a robot in the preset fire space, and the positions to be installed and the number of the fire-fighting equipment are obtained according to the recognition result and model information of the fire-fighting equipment. The application solves the technical problems of low processing efficiency, errors and omission in the fire control evaluation and installation process. The target recognition model based on the neural network realizes the installation and evaluation of auxiliary fire-fighting equipment.

title_en: Inspection method based on self-service inspection system of fire-fighting pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a patrol method based on a self-help patrol system of a fire-fighting pipe network, which comprises the steps of firstly designing and purchasing hardware equipment of the self-help patrol system of the fire-fighting pipe network, assembling the hardware equipment into the self-help patrol system of the fire-fighting pipe network, then based on the self-help patrol system of the assembled fire-fighting pipe network, and designing a software module of the system; according to the software module of the system, reconstructing an intelligent algorithm flow of the system, and then designing a use flow of the system based on the intelligent algorithm flow of the system; the invention realizes the real-time monitoring of the environment of the fire control pipe network, adopts the Bayesian and BP neural network related fusion technology, realizes the identification and classification of the monitoring result and the visualization of the detection result of the abnormal situation, can overcome the problem of insufficient manual recording by the fire control pipe network self-help inspection system, reduces the detection work difficulty, plays a promotion role in timely detecting the condition of a track traffic tunnel, the urban fire control inspection work and the daily information maintenance work, and is suitable for being widely popularized and used.

title_en: Column type goaf filling reconstruction coal seam comprehensive mechanical stoping method
abstract_en: A column type dead zone filling reconstruction coal seam comprehensive mechanical stoping method comprises the steps of analyzing the condition of a mine column type dead zone and determining a coal seam reconstruction area; in a coal seam reconstruction area, a coal-like functional material is used as a filling material and prepared into filling slurry for filling so as to perform stress reconstruction and form reconstruction, wherein the coal-like functional material is a fuel containing calorific value or a material with the function of the fuel containing calorific value, the stress reconstruction refers to reconstructing a two-dimensional stress state of a coal pillar of a column type dead zone of a mine into a three-dimensional stress state, and the form reconstruction refers to converting a residual form of the coal pillar of the column type dead zone into a complete solid form; after the stress reconstruction and the form reconstruction are completed, mining is carried out by adopting a longwall comprehensive mechanized stoping method. The invention effectively prevents the occurrence of mine earthquake caused by dynamic disaster due to large-area suspended ceiling in the column type dead zone, further improves the resource extraction rate, and provides a new way for resource utilization of coal slime/fine coal slag.

title_en: fire fighting drones capable of identifying the coalitions
title_ko: 탄착군 확인이 가능한 화재 진압용 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone which is able to be put in a fire site and help rapidly extinguish fire. More specifically, the present invention relates to a technology on a drone for extinguishing fire for a high-rise building which is not easily accessible. According to the present invention, the drone comprises: a body including a control unit; a plurality of driving units engaged with an outer side of the body while keeping a regular interval; a fire-extinguishing bomb launch unit mounted on a lower side of the body and launching a fire-extinguishing bomb toward a front side; a distance measuring unit placed on a front side of the body; cameras placed at a plurality of places including a front side of the body; and a shot group checking module generating a virtual shot group of the fire-extinguishing bomb or fire-extinguishing powder by using an image photographed by the cameras as well as the distance value to the fire site by using the distance measuring unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재현장에 투입되어 신속한 화재 진압에 도움을 줄 수 있는 드론에 관련되는 것이되, 특히 접근이 용이치 못한 고층 건물용 화재 진압용 드론에 관한 기술로서, 제어부를 포함하는 몸체; 상기 몸체의 외측으로 등간격을 유지하면서 결합되는 복수의 구동부; 상기 몸체의 하측으로 장착되어 전방을 향해 소화탄을 발사시킬 수 있는 소화탄 발사부; 상기 소화탄 발사부와 인접하게 배치되어 전방을 향해 분말 소화제를 분사하도록 하는 분말 소화제 발사부; 상기 몸체의 전방측에 마련되는 거리측정기; 상기 몸체의 전방측을 포함한 복수개소에 마련되는 카메라; 상기 거리측정기를 이용한 화재현장까지의 거리값 및 상기 카메라에 의해 촬영되는 영상을 이용하여 가상의 상기 소화탄 또는 분말 소화재의 탄착군을 생성하도록 하는 탄착군확인모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Flexible shaking base autonomous positioning and orientation method based on WT-DNN-HCT
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flexible shaking base autonomous positioning and orientation method based on WT-DNN-HCT, which is a method for positioning and orientation of a flexible shaking base, and belongs to the field of signal processing and machine learning, and is characterized by comprising the following steps: (1) Determining an orthogonal wavelet transform of the human motion inertia data; (2) determining thresholded wavelet coefficients; (3) determining wavelet reconstruction coefficients; (4) determining a human motion sensor model; (5) optimizing human motion sensor parameters; (6) determining a navigation reference random wobble model. The invention overcomes the defects of poor penetrating power, poor stability and easy influence by surrounding environment of the common positioning technology, combines the deep neural network with wavelet transformation and homogeneous coordinate transformation, is comprehensively applied to underground disaster shielding space scenes, and can accurately position and orient underground space personnel. The method with higher accuracy is provided for the autonomous positioning and orientation of the flexible shaking base.

title_en: Method for extracting disaster environment features based on AT-EnFCM-SCNN
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster environment feature extraction method based on AT-EnFCM-SCNN, which is a method for extracting features of a disaster environment, belongs to the field of image processing and machine learning, and is characterized by comprising the following steps: (1) determining a multi-scale opening reconstruction of the gradient image; (2) determining a clustering center; (3) calculating the membership degree; (4) determining whether an iteration condition is reached; (5) a loss function of the convolutional neural network is determined. The method effectively solves the problems that the traditional disaster environment image is single in segmentation form and needs a large number of training samples, provides more local spatial information, better improves the pre-segmentation performance, effectively improves the problems of noise interference and excessive segmentation in the traditional disaster identification image processing, overcomes the defect of incomplete target extraction under a single scale, and effectively ensures the correct extraction of a larger global target. The method with high extraction accuracy is provided for the disaster environment information feature extraction domain.

title_en: Side-sweeping water flow height measurement radar equipment and measurement method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy monitoring, in particular to a radar device for measuring the height of a side-swept water flow, which comprises a base, wherein a pillar is fixedly arranged on the base, a lifting rod is movably arranged in the pillar, an end head is fixedly arranged on the lifting rod, a cross rod is fixedly arranged on the end head, a mounting seat is fixedly arranged on the cross rod, a radar main body is fixedly arranged on the mounting seat, a ferrule is arranged on the mounting seat, a sliding rod is fixedly connected onto the ferrule, a movable ring is fixedly arranged on the sliding rod, an air bag is fixedly arranged on the movable ring, and a limiting structure is connected onto the ferrule; the invention can be limited when encountering flood disasters, so that the radar main body can be lifted, thereby avoiding flood, preventing from being damaged by water flow and ensuring the safety of equipment. According to the method for measuring the height of the side-swept water flow, the water surface height is estimated by adopting a super-resolution sparse reconstruction algorithm, so that the estimation precision of the river surface can be effectively improved, and the detection performance is effectively improved.
assignees: JIANGSU RAINENERGY HYDRAULIC ENGINEERING LTD COMPANY

title_en: Oil-immersed transformer device with oil discharge and nitrogen injection interface
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil immersed transformer with an oil discharge and nitrogen injection interface, which solves the technical problems of difficult interface modification, long construction time and high cost of the existing oil immersed transformer fire extinguishing device. The emergency protection system comprises an oil immersed transformer, a fire fighting cabinet and an emergency oil pool which are respectively connected with the oil immersed transformer, wherein a nitrogen cylinder is arranged in the fire fighting cabinet; be equipped with sample valve, fuel outlet valve and detachable manhole cover plate on the oil-immersed transformer, seted up the manhole on the manhole cover plate, the manhole links to each other with the accident oil pool through first oil extraction pipeline, and the fuel outlet valve links to each other with the accident oil pool through second oil extraction pipeline, and the sample valve links to each other with the nitrogen cylinder through annotating the nitrogen pipeline. The oil immersed transformer has the advantages of simple structure and scientific and reasonable design, the manhole, the sampling valve and the oil drain valve of the oil immersed transformer are used as interfaces, the original structure of the oil immersed transformer is directly utilized, extra holes are not needed, the reconstruction cost is reduced, and the reconstruction time is shortened.

title_en: Escape ladder stand for urban village fire-fighting transformation and lifting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an escape ladder stand for urban village fire-fighting reconstruction and lifting, and particularly relates to the field of escape ladder stands, which comprises a first frame, wherein one end of the first frame is hinged with a second frame, and transverse plates distributed in an array manner are detachably arranged on the inner sides of the first frame and the second frame; when the first limiting rod is stored back to the inside of the first frame, the second limiting rod is separated from the second limiting hole at the same time, the user can rotate the second frame by one hundred eighty degrees and loosen the pull rod at the moment, then the first spring and the second spring drive the limiting plate, the first limiting rod and the second limiting rod reset, the limiting plate is inserted into the second limiting groove, the first limiting rod is inserted into the first limiting hole, the first frame and the second frame can be quickly and stably spliced, the quick escape ladder stand is guaranteed to be used quickly and normally, the ladder stand is convenient to stably fold and store in the later stage, and the practicability is high.
assignees: WUHAN XINFENGTENG ENGINEERING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: System for Redeveloping fracture surface of Cultural Heritage
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a system for reproducing a fractured surface of cultural heritage, comprising: a leader unit which can lead a set fractured surface of an original member of cultural heritage to be restored; a processing unit which can process a set processing surface of a processing member according to a leading value of the leader unit; and an alignment unit which can move in a horizontal and/or vertical direction within a range set such that the leader unit and the processing unit can move in a set pattern while the leader unit and the processing unit maintain the same horizontal plane.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일실시예는 복원 대상이 되는 문화재 원부재의 설정된 파단면을 리딩할 수 있는 리더부, 상기 리더부의 리딩 값에 따라 가공부재의 설정된 가공면을 가공할 수 있는 가공부 및 상기 리더부 및 상기 가공부가 동일한 수평면을 유지한 상태에서, 상기 리더부 및 상기 가공부가 설정된 패턴으로 이동할 수 있도록 설정된 범위 내에서 수평 및/또는 수직 방향으로 움직일 수 있는 얼라인부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 문화재 파단면 재현 시스템을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Micro-terrain wind field analysis method and system for nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for analyzing a micro-terrain wind field of a nuclear power plant, which comprise the following steps of S1: establishing a 3D model of the nuclear power plant; s2: determining a CFD (computational fluid dynamics) computational domain of the 3D model of the nuclear power plant; s3: carrying out mesh division on the CFD calculation domain; s4: determining boundary condition parameters of a CFD calculation domain and at least one group of calculation conditions consisting of different boundary condition parameters; s5: and carrying out CFD numerical simulation based on the CFD calculation domain after the grid division and the calculation working condition to obtain the micro-terrain wind field distribution condition of the CFD calculation domain. According to the method, the function of acquiring the actual influence characteristics of the micro-terrain wind field in each local area in a plant area according to the macro wind field information of the nuclear power plant is realized by constructing the nuclear power plant micro-terrain wind field analysis method based on the CFD wind field simulation technology, the risk sensitive area of the nuclear power plant under different typhoon influence conditions is effectively identified, the problem of cognitive loss of the current nuclear power plant to the local wind field in the plant area is solved, and support is provided for typhoon risk identification, typhoon prevention preparation, emergency response and engineering reconstruction.
assignees: SUZHOU THERMAL RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY;GUANGDONG NUCLEAR POWER CO OPERATION LTD COMPANY;CHINESE GUANGDONG NUCLEAR GROUP CO LTD;CHINESE GUANGDONG KERNEL ELECTRIC POWER SHARE LTD COMPANY

title_en: Reuse system of diaster stricken surplus soil
abstract_en: To provide a reuse system of a disaster stricken surplus soil in which, in disposal of disaster stricken surplus soil generated in flooding of a river due to sharp increase of a precipitation amount caused by typhoon or heavy rainfall, and government and private sectors exchange opinions and cooperatively implement restoration and reconstruction from a disaster so as to significantly reduce the volume of refuse and to allow only the reduced refuse to be carried out.SOLUTION: A reuse system 1 of a disaster stricken surplus soil removes, by a primary separation undertaker 2 of a public institution, concrete, large stones and the like from disaster stricken surplus soil obtained by digging rivers having been struck by heavy rainfall, so as to reduce volume, then carries out the disaster stricken surplus soil with the volume reduced to a temporary depot 4 of a secondary separation undertaker 3, then, removes drift wood, waste wood, plastic, glass and garbage from the disaster stricken surplus soil at a plant constructed by the secondary separation undertaker 3 of a private entrepreneur, so as to convert the disaster stricken surplus soil into surplus soil for reuse resource, and performs, at the plant, classification and washing to produce reuse products with reduced volume, then carries out the reuse products to a product yard 192 to provide them for reuse.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: FUKOKU PACKAGING MAT CO LTD;TAKANO CONCRETE CO LTD

title_en: ENSO diversity prediction method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ENSO diversity forecasting method based on artificial intelligence, which extracts the first three main modes from equatorial Pacific SSTA observation data by using an EOF decomposition method, and projects CMIP6 historical simulation data on the three main modes to obtain three groups of PC values; three groups of PC values are used as forecast values, SSTA of an initial month and Tendency items of sea temperature data are used as input values of training, and a CMIP6 mode is used for training VGG-11; and inputting observation data into the trained model to obtain PC values at three future moments, and combining the PC values with 3 EOF main modes to reconstruct the SSTA space form of the equatorial Pacific region at the future moments. The method improves the forecasting skill of the middle Pacific type Erleno and breaks through the bottleneck of forecasting in the middle Pacific area in the previous dynamic mode. The method improves the forecasting skill of ENSO, is beneficial to forecasting and early warning of climate disasters, and is beneficial to reducing personnel and property loss.
assignees: ATMOSPHERIC PHYSICS RES INSTITUTE OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF

title_en: Prediction method and system for debris flow after forest fire disaster in high mountain canyon region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting debris flow after forest fire in a high mountain canyon region, belonging to the technical field of debris flow early warning after forest fire disasters, and comprising a forest fire data acquisition stage in the high mountain canyon region and a debris flow prediction stage after forest fire: in the stage of acquiring forest fire data in the mountain canyon region, sensing abnormal brightness and temperature by using high-resolution remote sensing thermal infrared spectrum characteristics, quickly finding fire points and combustion points, and monitoring the situation evolution and the fire situation development of a fire scene; the forecasting stage of the forest fire post-disaster debris flow carries out easiness evaluation on post-fire secondary hidden dangers such as potential debris flow ditches and the like, and provides an important decision support basis for pre-judging the secondary hidden dangers after fire, reconstructing after disaster and other disaster prevention and reduction activities; the method solves the problem that the debris flow data after forest fire disasters in the mountain and canyon regions and the secondary debris flow after disasters are difficult to predict.
assignees: SICHUAN PROVINCE SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE;SICHUAN ANXIN KIEJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and equipment for analyzing seismic wave propagation medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for analyzing a seismic wave propagation medium. The seismic wave propagation medium analysis method comprises the following steps: acquiring a seismic oscillogram, and removing an instrument effect in the seismic oscillogram; based on a wavelet tree decomposition algorithm and a signal reconstruction algorithm, reprocessing the seismic oscillogram after the instrument effect is removed so as to remove the seismic source effect; and analyzing the seismic wave propagation medium based on the seismic oscillogram after the seismic source effect is removed. By adopting the method, the instrument effect and the seismic source effect in the seismic oscillogram are removed, so that a more accurate research result of the seismic wave propagation medium can be obtained, the seismic motion result caused by the seismic wave propagation path can be obtained, the subsequent further research on the seismic wave propagation medium can be facilitated, and the exploration on the seismic induction and development process and the earthquake-proof and disaster-reduction research can be facilitated.
assignees: ELECTRONIC SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINESE ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECH GROUP COMPANY

title_en: indoor fire hydrant
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor fire hydrant having a new structure, wherein water can be prevented from being supplied to a spray nozzle to be sprayed before the spray nozzle is moved to a fire scene. The indoor fire hydrant according to the present invention further includes an auxiliary driving switch (44) arranged at one side of the spray nozzle (30) and connected to a water supply pump (42) to control the operation of the water supply pump (42), thereby enabling a user to manipulate the auxiliary driving switch (44) to drive the water supply pump (42) and to supply water to the spray nozzle (30) after moving the spray nozzle (30) to a fire scene. Therefore, water can be sprayed only to parts on fire differently from an existing indoor fire hydrant, wherein water can be supplied to the spray nozzle (30) to be sprayed while a user carries the spray nozzle (30) to a fire scene.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 분사노즐을 화재현장으로 이동시키기 전에 분사노즐로 물이 공급되어 분사되는 것을 방지할 수 있도록 된 새로운 구조의 옥내소화전에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 옥내소화전은 상기 분사노즐(30)의 일측에 상기 급수펌프(42)에 연결되어 급수펌프(42)의 작동을 제어하는 보조구동스위치(44)가 더 구비됨으로, 사용자가 분사노즐(30)을 화재현장까지 이동시킨 후, 상기 보조구동스위치(44)를 조작하면 상기 급수펌프(42)가 구동되어 분사노즐(30)로 물이 공급되도록 한다.

assignees: NETWORK TOP ENG CO LTD;CHOI GONG HO

title_en: Post-disaster recovery method and system for elastic power distribution network based on information physical collaborative optimization
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of elastic lifting of power distribution networks, and provides a post-disaster recovery method and system of an elastic power distribution network based on information physical collaborative optimization, wherein the post-disaster recovery method and system comprises the following steps: acquiring post-disaster physical information of an elastic power distribution network; according to the acquired information and a preset recovery model, post-disaster recovery of the power distribution network is realized; the recovery model comprises a first-stage recovery sub-model and a second-stage recovery sub-model, wherein the first-stage recovery sub-model takes the minimum load loss after the occurrence of faults as an objective function, and takes scheduling path constraint of maintenance personnel, time unified constraint of parallel maintenance personnel and network reconstruction constraint under the influence of information physical coupling as constraint conditions; and the second-stage restoration sub-model takes the minimum time cost of restoring the residual fault element after the load is fully restored as an objective function and takes the scheduling path constraint of maintenance personnel and the time unified constraint of parallel maintenance personnel as constraint conditions.

title_en: Geological disaster emergency management and decision making system, method and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster emergency management, and discloses a geological disaster emergency management and decision-making system, a method and a readable storage medium, wherein the geological disaster emergency management and decision-making system comprises: the pre-disaster prevention system is used for preventing and monitoring geological disasters; the emergency rescue command and scheduling system generates an emergency decision; and the post-processing system is used for carrying out handling summary of the sudden geological disasters. The pre-disaster prevention system comprises a geological disaster hidden danger monitoring and early warning subsystem, a ground disaster patrol subsystem, a plan database dynamic management subsystem and a propaganda and education training subsystem; the emergency rescue command and dispatch system comprises a disaster report subsystem, an emergency decision subsystem and an emergency command and dispatch subsystem; the post-processing system comprises a summary evaluation subsystem and a post-disaster reconstruction subsystem. The method and the system realize intelligent decision support based on emergency plans, and effectively improve the scientific and technological level of emergency decision support of sudden geological disasters.

title_en: Automatic following lighting system for rescue fire engine and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic following lighting system for an emergency rescue fire engine and a control method thereof, wherein the automatic following lighting system comprises a plurality of main lighting devices, a plurality of auxiliary lighting devices, an automatic following control device and a control box which are arranged on the emergency rescue fire engine, and a control terminal and/or a centralized control system which are not arranged on the emergency rescue fire engine. The invention improves the accuracy of illumination tracking of the illumination device of the rescue fire truck, can realize the reconstruction of the existing rescue fire truck illumination equipment and realize remote centralized control.

title_en: Natural gas pipeline valve chamber emergency repair operation method and emergency repair operation device
abstract_en: The invention provides a natural gas pipeline valve chamber emergency repair operation method and an emergency repair operation device, wherein the emergency repair operation method comprises station field response, maintenance and emergency repair unit response and natural gas pipeline valve chamber recovery emergency repair, the station field response comprises alarm receiving report, operation adjustment, field verification, edge detection, personnel evacuation, natural gas control and warning blockade, the maintenance and emergency repair unit response comprises starting response, dispatching, collective loading and investigation report, and the valve chamber recovery and emergency repair operation comprises pipeline stopping, natural gas emptying, nitrogen replacement, field entering operation, operation pit excavation, pipeline dismantling, gas isolation, valve foundation verification, prefabrication reconstruction, production recovery, valve foundation treatment and landform recovery. The invention has the advantages that the first-aid repair efficiency of the natural gas pipeline valve chamber process is improved; the leakage of a large amount of natural gas is effectively controlled, and the emergency response capability, decision-making capability and operation capability of natural gas pipeline valve chamber emergency commanders and operators are improved.
assignees: NAT PETROLEUM AND GAS PIPELINE NETWORK GROUP LIMITED COMPANY;SOUTHWEST PIPELINE LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY OF NAT PIPE NETWORK GROUP

title_en: Land and ocean temperature restoration method and system and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of meteorological monitoring, and discloses a land and ocean temperature restoration method, a system and computer equipment, which comprise the following steps: reconstructing large-scale surface temperature data by constructing a data restoration model based on MODIS surface temperature data; and analyzing the time-space change characteristics of the surface temperature under different time dimensions from the whole, local and single pixel multiple space dimensions, determining the area of the surface temperature abnormal change, and analyzing the surface temperature time-space change, particularly the driving factors of the annual abnormal change by combining multiple data information of earth surface, atmosphere, ocean and social and economic activities. The method effectively improves the data quality of the MODIS remote sensing surface temperature. The reconstructed monthly remote sensing surface temperature data cover a more complete earth surface area, and the actual application precision of the data reaches 1.5K; the method has important reference significance for restoration and reconstruction of remote sensing surface temperature data, climate change monitoring, meteorological disaster early warning and agricultural production work.
assignees: AGRICULTURAL RESOURCE AND AGRICULTURAL REGIONALIZATION RES INSTITUTE OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTU

title_en: Automatic water spraying fire extinguishing system and fire extinguishing method for cooling tower
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic water spraying fire extinguishing system of a cooling tower and a fire extinguishing method, wherein a pressure stabilizing device is arranged on a water outlet pipeline of a water tank, a check valve, a first fire pump, a second fire pump, a first pressure switch and a rain alarm valve group are arranged on the water outlet pipeline of the cooling tower, and an open type spray head, a fire detector and a closed type spray head are arranged in the cooling tower; responding to a fire signal, sending an instruction to an electromagnetic valve by a control box, and simultaneously heating, blasting and spraying water by a closed spray head, and opening a deluge valve; in response to the first pressure switch fire signal, the control box sends instructions to the electric valve, the first and second fire pumps, and the first and second pressure stabilizing pumps to cause the open sprinkler to spray water at a predetermined pressure. The system is independently arranged, is suitable for new construction and reconstruction projects, has high construction flexibility, small fire-fighting water tank volume and can recycle fire-fighting water.

title_en: Monitoring device system and monitoring method for reactor core melt after nuclear accident
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monitoring device system and a monitoring method for reactor core melt after nuclear accident, wherein the monitoring device system comprises a detection device, a data processing device and an image reconstruction device which are sequentially connected along the direction of a data transmission vector; the detection device comprises a plastic scintillator detector which monitors the flux and vector direction of muons. The monitoring method adopts the monitoring device system of the reactor core melt after the nuclear accident. The monitoring device system for the reactor core melt after the nuclear accident provided by the invention is used for monitoring the mu without being limited by the conditions of region, time and space. According to the monitoring method of the reactor core melt after the nuclear accident, provided by the invention, the internal structure of the reactor core melt, the thickness of the melt and other physical characteristics can be evaluated by monitoring the attenuation condition of the flux after the mu penetrates through the containment vessel, and the reactor core melt does not need to enter the containment vessel, so that the safety of operators is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Method for rapidly resisting earthquake and reinforcing pier
abstract_en: A method for rapidly reinforcing a pier against earthquake comprises the step of reinforcing by adopting fiber reinforced epoxy resin concrete, wherein the fiber reinforced epoxy resin concrete is obtained by uniformly stirring a cementing material, a recycled aggregate, natural river sand and fibers, and the reinforcing method is to pour the fiber reinforced epoxy resin concrete on the surface of a damaged pier for reinforcement. The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake resistance and disaster reduction, can ensure that a bridge is quickly repaired after an earthquake and meets the requirement of emergency traffic, and remarkably shortens the time for rescue and restoration reconstruction after the disaster.

title_en: Safety device for elevator installation, maintenance and reconstruction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety protection device for elevator installation, maintenance and reconstruction, which comprises a protection top frame, a working groove, an electric telescopic frame and an aluminum alloy bearing plate, wherein the working groove is fixed at the top of the electric telescopic frame. The elevator safety protection device has the advantages that the working groove, the illuminating lamp and the electric telescopic frame are arranged, so that the performance of the elevator safety protection device is optimized, when the elevator safety protection device is used, a user squats inside the working groove, on one hand, the electric telescopic frame is started to drive the electric telescopic frame to move up and down, the adjustment of the use height of the working groove is realized, the maintenance and transformation operations of different heights at the bottom of an elevator are facilitated for the working personnel, on the other hand, the illuminating lamp is uniformly arranged at the top inside the working groove, so that the elevator safety protection device realizes a better illuminating function, the functionality is enhanced, and in addition, the protection top frame is arranged at the top of the elevator safety protection device, the casualties caused by accidental falling of heavy objects, cars and the like can be avoided.

title_en: Block chain-based emergency transaction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, and discloses a block chain-based emergency transaction method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the service consumer side and the service provider side carry out information interaction in a face-to-face communication mode to generate a transaction order; the service consumer side performs initial block creation according to the transaction order and sends block information to a third-party node to perform new block creation; the plurality of third-party nodes finish a plurality of rounds of new block creating processes until the number of the third-party nodes required by the service provider side is reached; and the service provider side inquires the information of the nodes participating in the block chain generation under the preset condition, and if the node information is consistent and meets the block chain verification requirement, the service is released. The invention reconstructs the face transaction process under the emergency background, so that the service which needs to rely on remote communication has emergency support capability, and the data life quality and the cooperation efficiency after serious natural disasters and infrastructure faults can be effectively ensured.

title_en: Wireless control trainer for firefighting training
abstract_en: In accordance with one embodiment of the present invention, a wireless control firefighting trainer, which is provided to reproduce the scene of a fire for fire suppression training, includes: a travelling part including a wheel part travelling on a floor surface while kept supported by the floor surface, a frame part connected to an upper side of the wheel part and providing a flat installation space, a driving part driving the wheel part while kept placed on an upper side of the rear of the frame part, and a wheel control part changing a direction or a rotation speed of the wheel part in accordance with an inputted signal value; a flame generation part, while kept placed in the installation space, connected with the frame part, and generating flames upward; an extinguishing cover part connected with the frame part, and, while kept placed between the driving part and the flame generation part, moved to a cover position for covering the flame generation part and an opening position for opening the flame generation part; a firefighting part installed in the frame part, and extinguishing the flames generated from the flame generation part; a flame air-blast part formed on the edge of the frame part, and generating an air blast to the installation space; and a wind velocity setting part changing the intensity of the air blast from the flame air-blast part, while kept connected with the flame air-blast part. Therefore, the present invention is capable of preventing a fire-related accident by enabling practical fire suppression training.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 무선제어 소방 트레이너는, 화재진화 훈련을 위하여, 화재현장을 재연하는 훈련용 소방 트레이너에 있어서, 바닥면에 지지된 채 상기 바닥면을 주행하는 바퀴부, 상기 바퀴부에 상측에 연결되며, 편평한 설치공간을 제공하는 프레임부, 상기 프레임부의 후방 상측에 배치된 채, 상기 바퀴부를 구동시키는 구동부 및 입력된 신호값에 따라 상기 바퀴부의 방향 또는 회전속도를 변화시키는 바퀴제어부를 구비하는 주행부, 상기 설치공간에 배치된 채, 상기 프레임부에 연결되며, 상측을 향해 화염을 발생시키는 화염발생부, 상기 프레임부에 연결되되, 상기 구동부와 상기 화염발생부 사이에 배치된 채, 상기 화염발생부를 커버하는 커버위치와 상기 화염발생부를 개방하는 개방위치로 위치 이동되는 소화커버부, 상기 프레임부에 설치되며, 상기 화염발생부로부터 발생된 화염을 소화하는 소화부, 상기 프레임부의 테두리에 형성되며, 상기 설치공간으로 송풍을 발생시키는 화염송풍부 및 상기 화염송풍부에 연결된 채, 상기 화염송풍부에 의한 송풍 세기를 변화시키는 풍속설정부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: National Competency Standards based Construction Machine Bulldozer Training System
title_ko: 국가직무능력표준(ncs) 기반 건설기계 불도저 실습교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a national competency standard (NCS)-based bulldozer training system which is a new alternative capable of supplementing and strengthening practical training of bulldozers by using a virtual reality (VR) video technology. According to the present invention, experiential and practical training are added to training guidelines of NCS in actual equipment training to provide sufficient practical training to pilots, thereby increasing learning effect and supplementing job skills through safe practice training. A virtual environment similar to a bulldozer control site is implemented through computer simulation so that virtual objects fused with hardware are operated and practiced as if real objects, thereby reducing risks in a safe environment, reprocessing trained data, and analyzing the reprocessed data in real-time by using 3D. Foundation for competitiveness of educational institutions can be prepared through shortening a training period and reducing cost of practical training. A VR head mounted display (HMD) simulator, which reproduces an operating environment of an actual bulldozer, is used for practical education and training for a driver's license, so that a trainee operates an actual controller to experience a feeling of operation with the trainee's body. In addition, a movement phenomenon of the bulldozer is implemented similarly to an actual situation, and, in particular, an operator's active behavior is responded by applying the VR HMD, thereby enabling the operator to be immersed like a real situation. The NCS-based bulldozer training system comprises a control room and a plurality of simulators.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 VR 영상기술을 활용하여 건설기계 불도저의 실습교육을 보완, 강화할 수 있는 새로운 대안으로 실장비 교육에서 체험형, 실습교육을 국가직무능력표준(NCS)의 교육 지침에 추가함으로써 조종사에게 충분한 실습교육을 제공하여 학습적 효과를 향상시키고, 안전한 실습교육을 통해 부족한 직무능력을 보완할 수 있고, 건설기계 불도저의 조종 현장과 유사한 가상환경을 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션으로 구현, 하드웨어와 융합된 가상의 물체를 실제처럼 조작, 실습함으로써 안전한 환경에서 위험을 줄이고, 훈련된 데이터를 재가공하고, 이 데이터를 3D를 이용 실시간 분석하고, 훈련기간 단축과 실습교육 비용절감을 통해 교육기관 경쟁력의 기반을 마련할 수 있고, 실제 건설기계 불도저의 운용 환경을 재현한 VR HMD 시뮬레이터를 조종면허 취득을 위한 실습 교육훈련에 활용하여 실제 콘트롤러를 적용해 조작감 등을 몸으로 체험할 수 있으며, 불도저의 운동 현상도 실제 상황과 유사하게 구현하며, 특히 VR HMD를 적용하여 운용자의 능동적 행동에 대응함으로써 실제 상황처럼 몰입이 가능한 국가직무능력표준(NCS) 기반 건설기계 불도저 실습교육시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Method and system for providing information on the estimated time required to extinguish a fire by fire type
title_ko: 화재유형별 진압소요시간 예측 정보 제공 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing information on estimated required time for fire extinguishment by fire type, which comprises the following steps of: storing data for a fire occurring in the past, which include large classification of an object in a fire occurring in the past, middle classification of the object, information on factors influencing the required time for fire extinguishment, and required time for fire extinguishment; using the data for the fire occurring in the past to calculate one or more of a primary required time for fire extinguishment based on the required time for fire extinguishment for the fire occurring in the past, which corresponds to the large classification of the object in a reported fire, secondary required time for fire extinguishment based on the required time for fire extinguishment for the fire occurring in the past, which corresponds to the middle classification of the object in the reported fire, tertiary required time for fire extinguishment based on a regression equation derived by using the data for the fire occurring in the past, which corresponds to the large classification of the object in the reported fire, and quaternary required time for fire extinguishment based on a regression equation derived by using the data for the fire occurring in the past, which corresponds to the middle classification of the object in the reported fire; determining a minimum value of the primary to quaternary required times calculated for fire extinguishment as an estimated required time for fire extinguishment for the reported fire; and displaying information on monitoring and supporting activities in a field of a fire, which includes the estimated required time for fire extinguishment. Accordingly, information which allows difficulty of activities in a field of a fire to be estimated can be extracted in receiving a report of a fire and the information can be utilized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 화재유형별 진압소요시간 예측 정보 제공 방법은 과거 발생 화재사건의 대상물 대분류, 대상물 중분류, 진압소요시간에 영향을 미치는 영향 변인 정보 및 진압소요시간을 포함하는 과거 발생 화재 데이터를 저장하는 단계, 과거 발생 화재 데이터를 이용하여, 신고 화재사건이 속하는 대상물 대분류에 해당하는 과거 발생 화재사건의 진압소요시간에 기초하는 1차 진압소요시간, 신고 화재사건이 속하는 대상물 중분류에 해당하는 과거 발생 화재사건의 진압소요시간에 기초하는 2차 진압소요시간, 신고 화재사건이 속하는 대상물 대분류에 해당하는 과거 발생 화재 데이터를 이용하여 도출된 회귀식에 기초하는 3차 진압소요시간 및 상기 신고 화재사건이 속하는 대상물 중분류에 해당하는 과거 발생 화재 데이터를 이용하여 도출된 회귀식에 기초하는 4차 진압소요시간 중 하나 이상을 산출하는 단계, 상기 산출된 1차 내지 4차 진압소요시간 중 최소값으로 신고 화재사건의 진압예상 소요시간을 결정하는 단계, 및 진압예상 소요시간을 포함하는 화재현장 활동 모니터링 지원 정보를 표출하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: 3 dimensional simulation based medical educational system for providing orthopedic surgical technique
title_ko: 정형외과 술기 교육을 위한 3차원 시뮬레이션 기반 의료 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system. A 3D simulation-based medical education system for orthopedic skill education related to an example of the present invention includes: a simulation engine; a data server; a data/result reception unit; a display unit; a user signal input/transmission unit; and a message output unit.
abstract_ko: 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일예와 관련된 정형외과 술기 교육을 위한 3차원 시뮬레이션 기반 의료 교육 시스템은, 시뮬레이션 엔진; 데이터서버; 상기 시뮬레이션 엔진 및 상기 데이터서버로부터 정보를 수신하는 데이터/결과 수신부; 상기 수신한 정보를 3차원 형태로 출력하는 디스플레이부; 사용자의 명령에 대응하여 상기 시뮬레이션 엔진 및 상기 데이터서버 중 적어도 하나로 신호를 전송하는 사용자 신호 입력/송신부; 및 상기 시뮬레이션 엔진에서 처리된 메시지를 출력하는 메시지 출력부;를 포함하되, 상기 사용자의 명령에 따라 상기 데이터서버로부터 받은 파일에 정형외과 술기 시뮬레이션 진행하는 상기 시뮬레이션 엔진은, 상기 사용자의 명령을 수신하여 시뮬레이션 전개 계획을 수립하는 인터페이스 입력 수신부; 상기 데이터서버로부터 요구된 데이터를 전송받는 데이터 수신부; 상기 데이터서버로부터 받은 의료영상을 3차원으로 재구성하는 3차원 재구성부; 상기 3차원 재구성 영상에서 객체에 대한 분할 영역을 이동하고 변형하는 연산을 수행하는 구조 이동/변형 연산부; 상기 이동/변형된 객체에 대해, 상기 시뮬레이션 전개 계획에 따라 술기 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 시뮬레이션 알고리즘부; 시뮬레이션 단계별 사용자에게 전달할 가이드라인과 추가 메시지 문구 및 출력 시간을 조정하는 가이드라인/메시지 구성부; 상기 시뮬레이션에 대한 결과를 분석하고, 저장된 데이터 평가 기준에 따라 평가 결과를 수치화하는 결과 비교 분석 및 평가부; 및 상기 디스플레이부 상의 3차원 정보 제공이 가능하도록 상기 수치화된 평가 결과의 파일 형태를 변환하는 파일 변환부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle indoor real-time dense point cloud reconstruction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time dense point cloud reconstruction method, a real-time dense point cloud reconstruction system, real-time dense point cloud reconstruction equipment and a medium in an unmanned vehicle room, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the unmanned vehicle measures and detects distance through a laser radar and a TOF algorithm, and a depth camera acquires a depth image in real time; moving an unmanned vehicle by adopting a rapid exploration random tree algorithm to perform indoor exploration, and classifying depth images according to time to obtain a target image set; repeating the steps, calculating the obtained target images through an ORB-SLAM algorithm, obtaining pose information of the target images, and generating a three-dimensional sparse point cloud map; PCL point cloud registration is carried out according to the three-dimensional sparse point cloud map, and a three-dimensional dense point cloud map is generated; and optimizing the three-dimensional dense point cloud map by adopting a nonlinear global optimization algorithm to obtain the target three-dimensional dense point cloud map. The unmanned vehicle indoor autonomous exploration and three-dimensional point cloud dense mapping method realizes the parallel of the autonomous exploration and the three-dimensional point cloud dense mapping in the unmanned vehicle indoor, improves the timeliness, and can be applied to indoor emergency rescue and disaster relief.
assignees: CHONGQING INNOVATION CENTER OF BEIJING UNIV

title_en: Robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guiding evacuation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guide evacuation system and method, and belongs to the technical field of virtual simulation. The invention senses the environment by setting the number and the initial position of the robots, intelligently searches and rescues the indoor trapped people in disaster situations, collects the real-time three-dimensional image data of the scene, makes decision analysis and transmits the surrounding environment information to the scene rescue personnel in time. The evacuation method provided by the invention adopts the robot to perform simulation training, relies on a virtual reality technology, optimizes the evacuation path through an improved path planning algorithm, creates a more realistic evacuation environment and character reconstruction model, improves the evacuation efficiency, and can better simulate the real evacuation process, thereby providing references for effectively reducing casualties in personnel evacuation and establishing an optimal rescue scheme, having certain practical guiding significance, and being worth popularizing and using.

title_en: Visible light image and infrared image fusion method based on radiation characteristic inversion
abstract_en: A visible light image and infrared image fusion method based on radiation characteristic inversion belongs to the technical field of optical image processing, and specifically comprises the following steps of firstly utilizing multispectral visible light image inversion to calculate the total spectral reflection characteristic of ground objects in a scene, secondly utilizing infrared image inversion to calculate the thermal radiation characteristic of the ground objects in the scene, thirdly fusing the total spectral reflection characteristic of the ground objects and the thermal radiation characteristic of the ground objects to obtain a high-resolution infrared scene, reconstructing the infrared image through full-link simulation, and fourthly establishing a degradation relation between a real high-resolution infrared image and an actual measurement low-resolution infrared image, and correcting a reconstruction simulation result by utilizing the actual measurement infrared image to obtain a high-fidelity high-resolution infrared image. The invention can provide high-resolution image data for surface analysis, environment monitoring, disaster prevention and control and the like, and simultaneously provides characteristic prior and data input for research of related detection and identification methods.

title_en: Active thinking skills improvement essay writing worksheet
title_ko: 능동적 사고 능력 향상 논술 학습지
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an essay writing worksheet. More specifically, the present invention relates to an essay writing worksheet which is able to allow a learner to avoid the learning method by using the conventional worksheets for simply memorizing and learning knowledge, and develop active thinking skills. The present invention is able to provide a question for summarizing the content of the writing for each step of curriculum for improving the reading skills of the learner, and place a question mark symbol on the question. In addition, the present invention is able to, unlike the conventional worksheets mainly focusing on the learning progress, recompose the curriculum for each part, allow the learner to systematically learn in accordance with the type of writings, and allow the learner to practice writing by imitating the writings contained in a textbook. In addition, the present invention is able to make it easy to write a manuscript and make it easy to review the assessment and directions on the written manuscript. As such, according to the present invention, the essay writing worksheet is able to modify the questioning method of the learner, improve the reading skills of the learner, and allow the learner to systematically learn in accordance with the type of writings. In addition, the present invention is able to allow even students who are used to education focusing on memorization to easily write a manuscript and easily review the assessment and directions.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 논술용 학습지에 관련된 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 학습자로 하여금 종래의 단순 암기식, 주입식 학습지에 의한 학습방식을 벗어나 능동적 사고 능력을 개발하게 하기 위한 논술용 학습지에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 학습자의 독해력을 향상시키기 위하여 교육과정의 각 단계마다 글의 내용을 정리하기 위한 발문이 기재되는데, 상기 발문을 소정의 발문표시기호로 표시하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 또한, 종래의 학습 진도 위주로 구성되어 있는 학습지와는 다르게 교육과정을 갈래별로 재구성하여 글의 종류에 따른 체계적인 학습이 가능하며, 교과서에 기재된 글을 모방하여 글쓰는 연습이 이루어지도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 또한, 원고작성이 용이할 뿐만 아니라 작성된 원고에 대한 첨삭지도 내용의 검토가 용이한 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이상과 같은 논술용 학습지에 따르면 학습자의 질문방식을 수정하여 독해력을 향상시킬 수 있으며, 글의 종류에 따른 체계적인 학습이 가능하다는 효과가 있다. 또한, 주입식 교육에 익숙한 학생들도 원고작성을 용이하게 할 수 있으며 첨삭지도 내용에 대한 검토가 용이하다는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Replay system and method of ship collision accidents using free running model test
title_ko: 자유항주 모형시험을 이용한 선박 충돌사고 재현 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides ship collision accident reproduction system and method using a free running model test to verify a ship collision simulation in real-time.
