According to the present invention, the ship collision accident reproduction system comprises: a ship collision reproduction simulation system receiving a navigation trajectory of a ship collision accident to reproduce a ship collision accident; a free running model system using a free running model ship to perform a free running model test of a crash accident ship; and a free running control system performing the free running model test remotely. Reproduction of the ship collision accident is performed at the same time as simulation in the ship collision reproduction simulation system and the free running model test in the free running model system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선박 충돌 사고의 운항 궤적을 입력 받아 선박 충돌 사고를 재현하는 선박충돌 재현 시뮬레이션 시스템; 자유항주 모형선을 이용하여 충돌 사고 선박의 자유항주 모형 시험을 하는 자유항주 모형 시스템; 및 상기 자유항주 모형 시험을 원격으로 수행하는 자유항주 관제 시스템;을 포함하고, 상기 선박 충돌 사고의 재현은 상기 선박충돌 재현 시뮬레이션 시스템에서의 시뮬레이션과 상기 자유항주 모형 시스템에서의 자유 항주 모형 시험이 동시에 수행되는 것을 특징으로 하는, 자유항주 모형시험을 이용한 선박 충돌사고 재현 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: A System for Remote Fire Monitoring and Alarm
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote fire monitoring and alarm system which comprises a mobile phone, a mobile communication network, and a remote fire detection device. According to the present invention, when a fire is detected by a fire detection sensor including a smoke sensor and an infrared thermal sensor of the remote fire detection device, a picture of a fire scene is taken by a wide-angle camera of the remote fire detection device. A fire alarm text message, a fire alarm sound, and the fire scene picture are immediately transmitted to a registered mobile phone through a mobile communication device of the remote fire detection device and the mobile communication network. The fire alarm sounds through a speaker of the registered mobile phone and the fire scene picture and the fire alarm text message are displayed on a display screen. A mobile phone user can use a control button of an application program to observe a video of the fire scene through the wide-angle camera of the remote fire detection device. Accordingly, the remote fire monitoring and alarm device immediately notifies a mobile phone of a fire notification target at a remote distance from a fire scene of fire occurrence along with a picture of the fire scene, thereby providing an advantage of enabling rapid evacuation from the fire scene and immediate reporting to a fire station. In addition, the device provides an advantage of enabling a plurality of persons to check a video of the fire scene immediately after a fire occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원격 화재감시경보 시스템에 관한 것으로서 휴대전화, 이동통신망, 원격 화재감지 장치로 구성된다. 원격 화재감지 장치의 연기감지 센서와 적외선 열센서로 구성된 화재감지 센서에 의해 화재가 감지되면 원격 화재감지 장치의 광각카메라에 의해 화재현장 사진이 촬영된다. 다음에 즉시 원격 화재감지 장치의 이동통신 장치와 이동통신망을 통해 화재경보 문자, 화재경보음, 화재현장 사진이 등록된 휴대전화로 전송된다. 등록된 휴대전화의 스피커에는 화재경보음이 울리고 표시화면에는 화재현장 사진과 화재경보 문자 메시지가 표시된다. 휴대폰 사용자는 응용프로그램의 제어버튼을 사용하여 화재현장의 동영상을 원격 화재감지 장치의 광각카메라를 통해 관측할 수 있다. 본 발명에 의한 원격 화재감시경보 장치는 화재발생 현장으로부터 원격거리에 있는 화재알림 대상자의 휴대전화로 화재발생 사실을 화재현장 사진과 함께 화재발생 즉시 알림으로써 화재현장으로부터 신속한 대피와 소방서로의 즉시 신고를 가능하게 하는 잇점이 있다. 또한 화재현장 동영상을 화재발생 즉시 여러 사람이 확인할 수 있는 이점을 제공한다.
assignees: NAT UNIV CHUNGBUK IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Construction method and application of high-voltage switch cabinet fault fire extinguishing agent dosage prediction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method and application of a high-voltage switch cabinet fault fire extinguishing agent dosage prediction model. The ignition time t of the ignition of the fault point is obtained by simulating various typical fault defect modes On fire Gas fire extinguishing agentExtinguishing time t of fire source after action Extinguishment of (ii) a The fire extinguishing system determines the dosage L of the fire extinguishing agent needed for extinguishing the fire source based on the fire extinguishing time; presetting different adding time t by adding system Preset of Acquiring the ignition duration time delta t of the fault point Persistence ＝(t Preset ‑t On fire ) And establishing a unary linear regression piecewise prediction model of the fire extinguishing agent dosage and the fire duration according to the correlation relation between the required fire extinguishing agent dosage L. The invention solves the problems that the disaster-causing characteristic parameters of the typical fault defects of the high-voltage switch cabinet are rare and the use amounts of different fire extinguishing agents cannot be evaluated on line in real time.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Three-dimensional reconstruction and volume calculation method for landslide mass based on mobile photographic image
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological mapping, and particularly relates to a three-dimensional landslide mass reconstruction and volume calculation method based on a mobile photographic image. In order to overcome the defects of the traditional three-dimensional scene scale recovery, the invention provides a three-dimensional scene automatic scale recovery method based on computer vision; before a picture is taken, a two-dimensional code with a known size is placed in a scene, after the picture is obtained, four corner points of the two-dimensional code in the scene are detected through a computer vision algorithm, the corner points replace control points to serve as geographical references, and the real scale of the three-dimensional scene is recovered; and constructing a landslide reference surface by using a landslide model depth-based reference surface fitting method, and further calculating the landslide body volume through the reference surface and the landslide body surface three-dimensional model. By the scheme, the disaster size can be quickly evaluated and reported during road patrol; when emergency measures or rescue are implemented, the disaster area and the disaster size can be rapidly surveyed and mastered, so that the command is convenient.

title_en: Fire extinguishing system to existing building fire control transformation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of building water supply and drainage fire-fighting systems, and relates to a fire-fighting system for fire-fighting reformation of an existing building. The fire hydrant system comprises an original fire pool, a shared fire pump and a main ring network, wherein a wet alarm valve, a water flow indicator and a fire hydrant which are communicated with an original fire control cabinet are respectively arranged on the main ring network, and the fire hydrant system also comprises a newly-increased outdoor fire hydrant system which is communicated with the main ring network, and the fire hydrant system comprises an outdoor fire hydrant pump, a newly-increased fire pool and a pressure switch which is arranged on a water outlet pipe of the outdoor fire hydrant pump. According to the utility model, the number of the newly-added fire pumps and the number of the original fire pumps are set according to working conditions, so that the system can meet fire fighting flow and pressure under any condition, and the fire fighting pipeline is not exploded due to the fact that all the pumps are started simultaneously and the flow is too large, the flow speed of a pipe network is increased and the use load is increased; the additional increase of the original fire-fighting main ring network or the additional addition of an outdoor ring network for the newly added fire-fighting system is avoided. Thereby reducing the difficulty and cost of fire-fighting reconstruction of old districts and the existing buildings thereof.
assignees: MIDDLE MACHINE AND MIDDLE CONNECTION PROJECT LTD COMPANY

title_en: Autonomous real-time live-action three-dimensional reconstruction and detection robot system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous real-time live-action three-dimensional reconstruction and detection robot system which comprises a mechanical hardware subsystem and a software subsystem, wherein the mechanical hardware subsystem provides three-dimensional space motion capability, three-dimensional space information acquisition capability and data transmission capability for the whole system, the software subsystem is used for collecting three-dimensional space information and processing the three-dimensional space information, and the software subsystem provides decision-making capability for the whole system, wherein the decision-making capability comprises but is not limited to navigation capability, obstacle avoidance capability, three-dimensional reconstruction capability and control data transmission capability. The invention can work in the scene which is not suitable for the prior oblique photography technology, such as indoor or special scenes of mine holes, fire, earthquake and the like; the method can carry out real-time detection and three-dimensional reconstruction on the three-dimensional space, and can reflect real-time performance compared with the oblique photography technology.

title_en: National Competency Standards based Construction Machine Crane Training System
title_ko: 국가직무능력표준(ncs) 기반 건설기계 기중기 실습교육 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 VR 영상기술을 활용하여 건설기계 불도저의 실습교육을 보완, 강화할 수 있는 새로운 대안으로 실장비 교육에서 체험형, 실습교육을 국가직무능력표준(NCS)의 교육 지침에 추가함으로써 조종사에게 충분한 실습교육을 제공하여 학습적 효과를 향상시키고, 안전한 실습교육을 통해 부족한 직무능력을 보완할 수 있고, 건설기계 불도저의 조종 현장과 유사한 가상환경을 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션으로 구현, 하드웨어와 융합된 가상의 물체를 실제처럼 조작, 실습함으로써 안전한 환경에서 위험을 줄이고, 훈련된 데이터를 재가공하고, 이 데이터를 3D를 이용 실시간 분석하고, 훈련기간 단축과 실습교육 비용절감을 통해 교육기관 경쟁력의 기반을 마련할 수 있고, 실제 건설기계 불도저의 운용 환경을 재현한 VR HMD 시뮬레이터를 조종면허 취득을 위한 실습 교육훈련에 활용하여 실제 콘트롤러를 적용해 조작감 등을 몸으로 체험할 수 있으며, 불도저의 운동 현상도 실제 상황과 유사하게 구현하며, 특히 VR HMD를 적용하여 운용자의 능동적 행동에 대응함으로써 실제 상황처럼 몰입이 가능한 국가직무능력표준(NCS) 기반 건설기계 불도저 실습교육시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Rescuer input personnel calculation system for the scene of a fire
title_ko: 화재현장의 인명 구조를 위한 구조대원 투입 인원수 산출시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 현장에서 인명 구조를 위해 구조대원 및 구조장비를 투입하는 작업이 해당 화재의 규모 및 특성 그리고 이에 따른 요구조자의 수효 및 상태가 고려된 정략적 산출 방식을 통해 매우 효율적으로 이루어질 수 있게 하는 화재현장의 인명 구조를 위한 구조대원 투입 인원수 산출시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 화재현장의 인명 구조를 위한 구조대원 투입 인원수 산출시스템은 요구조자 측위부, 요구조자 상태정보 획득부 및 구조용 투입정보 산출부를 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 구조용 투입정보 산출부는 화재현장의 요구조자 움직임을 기반으로 구조 대원의 투입 인원수 및 구조 장비의 투입 개수를 결정하기 위한 구조조건 분석엔진이 탑재됨에 따라, 상기 요구조자 측위부에서 획득되는 요구조자 수효 및 개별 위치 그리고 상기 요구조자 상태정보 획득부에서 획득되는 요구조자의 움직임 데이터를 기반으로 상기 구조조건 분석엔진에서 구조 대원의 투입 인원수 및 구조 장비의 투입 개수를 산출한다.

title_en: Trailer system for fire drills
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방 훈련을 위한 트레일러 시스템에 관련되며, 이는 비교적 소량의 가스가 출력되어 불꽃이 초기 점화된 후, 비교적 대량의 가스가 공급되어 불꽃이 관형 노즐 전체 영역으로 확산되도록 구조 개선되어, 초기 가스 점화시 과도한 가스 공급으로 미연소 상태의 가스가 누출되거나 다량의 가스가 한꺼번에 점화되는 안전사고를 미연에 예방할 수 있도록 트레일러(100), 화재 재현실(200), 관형 노즐(300), 가스공급부(400), 가스점화부(500), 조작부(600)를 포함하여 주요구성으로 한다.

title_en: Post-vehicular incident reconstruction report
abstract_en: The disclosure herein describes systems and methods for generating a post-vehicular incident report. In some examples, the system includes receiving a notification from a user device indicating the user device has been involved in an incident, obtaining incident data from the user device that includes a timestamp and location data, retrieving third-party incident data corresponding to the timestamp and the location data received in the incident data, generating a timeline of the incident based on the obtained incident data from the user device and the retrieved third-party incident data, the generated timeline including events occurring prior to the incident and events occurring after the incident, generating a report of the incident based on the generated timeline, the obtained incident data, and the retrieved third-party incident data, the report including the timeline, and outputting the generated report to the user device and at least one of a plurality of approved devices.

title_en: Grooving equipment for fire extinguishing system reconstruction project
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting engineering tools, in particular to a slotting device for fire-fighting system reconstruction engineering. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: the drill bit is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the drilling machine, a groove is formed in the surface of the drilling machine, a sliding block is connected to the inner wall of the groove in a sliding mode, an installation block is welded to the surface of the output end of the cylinder, and an installation arm is hinged to the surface of the installation block. The transparent plate is driven by the air cylinder to move up and down and is arranged outside the drilling machine, the top and the periphery of the drill bit can be covered by the transparent plate, the transparent plate can resist the sputtering of broken stones when the drill bit works, part of working noise can be blocked by the transparent plate, the safety of surrounding personnel is protected, and in addition, the damping assemblies are arranged on the air cylinder and the transparent plate according to the characteristic of strong vibration force when the drilling machine works, so that the service life of the device is prolonged.
assignees: GUANGDONG WANJING WINE FIRE ENGINEERING LTD COMPANY

title_en: Method for quickly recovering power grid after earthquake disaster under V2G auxiliary support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly recovering a post-earthquake power grid under V2G auxiliary support, which comprises the following steps: establishing a power distribution network element fault rate model, and generating a power distribution network fault scene under the earthquake disaster through random sampling; based on the travel characteristics of the EV and the travel demand of the user, travel data are fitted by adopting a travel chain theory, and an EV scheduling model in the early stage of the disaster is built on the basis of a power distribution network fault scene; based on a consumer psychology theory, bringing an EV scheduling model in the early stage of a disaster into consideration of post-disaster response selection behaviors of EV users, formulating a post-disaster reverse transmission incentive response mechanism, guiding the EV to participate in power supply recovery, and obtaining the output of each V2G station; considering power distribution network reconstruction and V2G station reverse charging, and establishing a power distribution network reconstruction alternating current optimal power flow model considering two-dimensional cone constraints; and solving the distribution network reconstruction alternating current optimal power flow model to obtain an optimal reconstruction power supply recovery scheme. The invention improves the restoring force of the power grid after earthquake disaster and the economical efficiency of power supply restoration.

title_en: Method and system for predicting physical parameter change after earthquake
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing for prediction purposes, and discloses a method and a system for predicting physical parameter change after an earthquake; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the atmospheric water reducible quantity after an earthquake occurs in a target monitoring area in a historical time period; carrying out precision verification on the atmospheric degradable water collected in the historical time period; acquiring earth surface temperature thermal anomaly data after an earthquake occurs in a target monitoring area in a historical time period; determining a time difference between the peak value of the atmospheric degradable water content and the peak value of the surface temperature thermal anomaly based on the historical surface temperature thermal anomaly data and the historical atmospheric degradable water content which passes precision verification; when the target monitoring area generates an earthquake again, detecting a time point corresponding to the surface temperature thermal anomaly peak value of the target monitoring area; and adding the time difference to the time points to obtain a predicted time point of the atmospheric degradable water volume peak value, and outputting the predicted time point as the time point of occurrence of the secondary disaster. And a reference value is provided for secondary disaster prediction and post-disaster reconstruction work after earthquake.

title_en: Dam piling and breaking simulation device for tailing pond
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dam-piling and-breaking simulation device for a tailing pond, which is used for solving the problem that a dam-piling and-breaking physical simulation device in the prior art is difficult to simulate dam-breaking of the tailing pond under various natural conditions and different working conditions. The method comprises the following steps: the system comprises an earthquake simulation system, a reservoir body simulation assembly, a rainfall simulation system and an information acquisition system, and can simulate extreme conditions such as earthquake, heavy rainfall, flood overtopping, seepage failure and the like, and situations of coupling of various disasters; through model tests and numerical research, the evolution process and the disaster forming characteristics of the tailings pond under different conditions are explored, the disaster resistance characteristics of different dam body structures are known through reconstructing different dam bodies, the influence of factors such as the reservoir capacity, the material characteristics, the structural form, the extreme conditions and the surrounding topography of the tailings pond on the disaster forming mode of the tailings pond is revealed, a theoretical basis is provided for heightening and protecting the tailings dam, and the method has important significance for researching the fine-grained high tailings pond.
assignees: KUNMING PROSPECTING DESIGN INST OF CHINA NONFERROUS METALS INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Reconfigurable group robot finger control platform and obstacle surmounting control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconfigurable group robot finger control platform and an obstacle surmounting control method, comprising a mobile station system, wherein the mobile station system comprises a power supply template, a sensing unit, a motion control unit and a main control board, the main control board is used for controlling the sensing unit and the motion control unit, the sensing unit is used for collecting environment information and self information of the mobile station system, and the motion control unit is used for controlling advancing and reconstructing operation of a robot; the ground station system comprises a traveling control unit, a reconstruction control unit and a sensing display unit; the wireless communication system adopts a bidirectional wireless transmission module for completing data interaction between the ground station system and the mobile station system. The invention can realize accurate monitoring of disaster environment, control the robot to avoid and surmount the obstacle accurately, increase the safety and reliability of post-disaster searching work, promote the realization of popularization and application of intelligent and unmanned post-disaster searching, and remarkably improve the accuracy, rapidity and reliability of post-disaster searching.

title_en: Method for evaluating prevention and control effects of karst water damage in deep mining
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating a karst water damage prevention effect of deep mining, which is based on a traditional geophysical exploration technology and MapGIS system data interpolation mask processing technology to verify the prevention effect through sequence fusion. Firstly, carrying out qualitative evaluation on an aquifer subjected to ground directional near-horizontal drilling grouting reconstruction based on physical quantities such as permeability coefficient, permeability and the like of a reconstruction target layer, secondly, analyzing and processing grouting parameters of each coordinate point by utilizing a MapGIS system to obtain a grouting effect special subject partition evaluation chart, simultaneously carrying out double-chart data mask processing on the basis of a visual resistivity low-resistance abnormal region evaluation chart obtained by mining electric method investigation to obtain an abnormal region superposition analysis evaluation chart, and finally obtaining a deep mining karst water damage prevention and control effect comprehensive evaluation chart and providing a specific step of eliminating an abnormal region before mining. The invention can provide scientific theoretical basis for preventing and controlling karst water damage in deep coal resource exploitation and can effectively avoid accidents of water bursting and disaster causing in deep exploitation.

title_en: Protective Shield for Firefighting
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting shield. More specifically, the present invention relates to the firefighting shield which enables a firefighter or a survivor to move easily while protecting their bodies at a scene of a fire. The present invention exerts following effects. In other words, according to the present invention, at the scene of the fire, the firefighter or the survivors are protected from a heat of the fire. In addition, light emission and a notification sound are provided according to a temperature condition, and an image displaying means capable of securing a field of view is provided. Therefore, the firefighter or the survivor can move easily while protecting their bodies at the scene of the fire. The firefighting shield of the present invention comprises: first and second bodies (100, 200); a temperature sensor (400); a determination unit; and a control unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방용 방패에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 화재현장에서 소방요원 또는 생존자가 몸을 보호하면서 이동하기 용이한 소방용 방패에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 다음과 같은 효과를 발휘한다. 
즉, 본 발명에 따르면, 화재현장에서 소방요원 또는 생존자를 화재 열기로부터 보호할 뿐만 아니라, 온도조건에 따른 발광 및 알림음이 제공되고, 시야를 확보할 수 있는 영상표시수단이 제공되기 때문에, 화재현장에서 소방요원 또는 생존자가 몸을 보호하면서 쉽게 이동할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV TONGMYONG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Tunnel geological safety advanced ultra-deep detection vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel geological safety advanced ultra-deep detection vehicle, which relates to the technical field of tunnel geological structure and geological disaster detection, and mainly structurally comprises an automobile, a high-power ultra-deep geological radar antenna, a mechanical arm system, a positioning system, a radar data acquisition system, a video acquisition system and an electrical control system; the mechanical arm system mainly solves the problems of low efficiency and high danger of manually carrying the antenna at the front part, the vault and the side wall of the tunnel face in a tunnel complex environment, and the tunnel geological safety advanced and ultra-deep detection vehicle adopts a high-power ultra-deep geological radar antenna and can realize the detection of the tunnel ultra-deep geological structure; the tunnel geological safety advanced ultra-deep detection vehicle adopts a retractable mechanical arm design, so that the detection working efficiency can be improved; the positioning system adopts two distance measuring wheel encoders and two positioning receiving modules, and can acquire accurate coordinate information of a detection position; the real-time video data acquisition of the video acquisition system can provide field playback for the processing and interpretation of radar data, and reduce misjudgment and missed judgment of abnormal targets; the electrical control system regulates and controls the real-time position of the mechanical arm, the antenna posture can be changed more accurately and timely for detection, and the detection result provides accurate basis for tunnel site construction and repair.

title_en: Industrial robot disassembly sequence planning method considering product part failure characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for planning a disassembly sequence of an industrial robot by considering the failure characteristics of product parts, which comprises the following steps: constructing an incidence relation model of the disassembly time of the product failure part to other parts facing the disassembly process; establishing a disassembly information model; constructing an environment model facing to the problem of the planning of the disassembly sequence of the industrial robot, and determining the mapping relation between each element and the planning model of the disassembly sequence; constructing a double-layer network structure of a decision network and a target network, introducing an experience playback mechanism, and training a neural network to obtain a better network model; and finally, acquiring an optimal disassembly sequence of the disassembled product through a decision network model obtained by deep reinforcement learning. The invention considers the influence relation of the part failure characteristics on the product disassembling process, discloses a deep reinforcement learning method for solving the problem of planning the disassembling sequence of the industrial robot, solves the problem of dimension disaster when the state space is large, and is beneficial to improving the efficiency of the industrial robot in disassembling waste products.

title_en: Data center hot channel is reformed transform to old building in city
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a city old building reconstruction data center hot channel, belonging to the technical field of hot channel prefabrication modules, the key points of the technical proposal are that the hot channel is formed between two cabinets, the left and the right sides of the top of the hot channel are both provided with hot channel frames, a plurality of evenly distributed fixing frames are fixedly connected between the two hot channel frames, the height of the hot channel is 3m, the original space of the old building is fully utilized by reducing the height of the hot channel, only the old building needs to be reinforced without newly planning and constructing a new factory building, the construction cost of the new factory building is saved, the old building obtains good utilization effect, the construction of the data center can be completed, the problem existing in the current old building reconstruction is solved, the problem that the height of the traditional hot channel can not be satisfied, the height of the upper return air structure and the fire fighting integration is only about 1.0m, the problems of the wind speed of return air and the construction difficulty are seriously influenced.

title_en: Method and system for real-time monitoring and area reconstruction of accident disaster situation information
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing methods suitable for specific applications, and provides a method and a system for real-time monitoring and regional reconstruction of accident disaster situation information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time data of accident situations, predicting a spatial-temporal evolution rule of the accident situations based on a pre-constructed accident situation information prediction model to obtain a prediction result of the accident situations, and thus, rapidly predicting the evolution of the accident situations according to real-time monitored data; and finally, according to the prediction result of the accident disaster, performing regional risk reconstruction through a pre-constructed accident disaster risk assessment model. Therefore, a three-dimensional detail flow field at the place where the accident is located is constructed in advance through the deep learning model, and the flow field calculation burden of the accident is greatly reduced; and the area reconstruction under the condition of insufficient initial information during accident emergency is realized through the accident disaster situation risk assessment model, and risk early warning and emergency decision are realized.

title_en: Equipment for transporting fire hoses and extinguishing fire using drone
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 소방호스 운반 및 화재 진압장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting hose transport and fire-suppression apparatus using a drone, capable of quickly transporting a firefighting hose to the scene of a fire in a high-rise building or a highland area and suppressing the fire at an early stage by using a drone. To achieve the purpose, in accordance with the present invention, the firefighting hose transport and fire-suppression apparatus includes: a fixing plate installed on the inside of at least one pair of landing gears installed in a lower part of a drone body while installed to be horizontal with the drone body to support a hose reel-integrated nozzle and a driving part, and having a nozzle fixing groove formed in a center part of the body; the hose reel-integrated nozzle installed on the fixing plate to be rotatable and having a nozzle body and a hose reel integrated with each other; the driving part installed on one side of the fixing plate while placed in parallel with the hose reel-integrated nozzle, and rotating a motor through a control signal or a remote control signal transmitted from the drone body to generate and provide rotation power to the hose reel-integrated nozzle; and a firefighting hose having a nozzle combination part and a water source combination part formed at both ends of the body respectively, and winding or unwinding the hose reel through a rotating motion in a first or second direction of the nozzle body performed by the driving part. Therefore, the firefighting hose transport and fire-suppression apparatus can reduce a waste of manpower and time consumed when firefighters carry firefighting hose reels and climb a high-rise building or a highland area in case of a fire therein, and can quickly suppress a fire in a high-rise building or a forest fire in a highland area at an early stage.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드론을 이용한 소방호스 운반 및 화재 진압장치에 관한 것으로, 드론을 이용하여 고층건물 또는 고지대의 화재현장까지 소방호스를 신속하게 운반하고 화재를 조기 진압하기 위한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 드론몸체의 하부에 설치되는 적어도 한 쌍의 랜딩 기어 내측에 설치되되 드론몸체와 수평하게 설치되어 호스릴 일체형 관창 및 구동부를 지지하며 몸체의 중앙부에 관창 고정홈이 형성되는 고정판, 고정판에 회전 가능하게 설치되며 노즐 몸체와 호스릴이 일체로 형성되는 호스릴 일체형 관창, 고정판의 일측에 설치되되 호스릴 일체형 관창과 나란하게 이설 배치되며 드론몸체에서 전달되는 제어신호 또는 원격 제어신호에 의해 모터를 회전시켜 동력을 발생시키고 호스릴 일체형 관창에 회전 동력을 제공하는 구동부, 및 몸체의 양단부에 관창 결합부와 급수원 결합부가 각각 형성되며구동부에 의한 노즐 몸체의 제1방향 또는 제2방향 회전동작에 의해 호스릴에 감기거나 풀리는 소방호스를 포함하여, 고층 건물 또는 고지대의 화재 발생시 소방관들이 직접 소방용 호스릴을 짊어지고 올라가야만 하는 인력 및 시간 낭비를 줄일 수 있고 고층 건물 또는 고지대의 산림 화재를 조기에 신속하게 진압할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: Personnel positioning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a personnel positioning system, which comprises a positioning identification card, a positioning base station, a wireless positioner, a data gateway and a positioning and map server; the positioning identification card is carried by personnel and is used for identifying the related information and the positioning position of the personnel; the positioning base station covers a positioning area in a full range, receives a positioning signal of a wireless positioner and uploads the positioning signal to the positioning and map server through the data gateway; the positioning and map server comprises a real-time positioning module, a historical track playback module, an intelligent safety early warning module, a regional people counting module, an external visitor management module, an accident emergency rescue module and an operation management module. The invention can monitor the on-duty information of the production personnel in real time, and timely and accurately reflect the dynamic conditions of the personnel in each area, so that the management personnel can master the on-duty information and the motion trail of the production personnel at any time, thereby facilitating more reasonable scheduling management.
assignees: SINOCHEM XINGZHONG OIL STAGING ZHOUSHAN CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle full-coverage three-dimensional rescue path planning algorithm under complex disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-coverage three-dimensional rescue path planning algorithm for an unmanned aerial vehicle in a complex disaster environment. The method comprises the following steps: (1) establishing an environment model; (2) Dividing the model into different height layers through a hierarchical planning strategy, and reconstructing a map of the current height layer through a map reconstruction strategy to obtain a two-dimensional reconstruction map; (3) And carrying out two-dimensional full-coverage path planning on the two-dimensional reconstruction map: performing regional branch judgment on the position nodes, and screening according to the sequence from the dead zone to the local region to the global region; (4) Adopting an interlayer connection strategy to associate child nodes and father nodes among different layers; (5) judging whether all the height layers in the three-dimensional environment are traversed or not; (6) And (5) carrying out path tracing, finding out a complete three-dimensional path and outputting the path. The method effectively reduces the number of dead points involved, rapidly plans a shorter path in real time, reduces the path repetition rate, has better robustness, and is suitable for three-dimensional full-coverage path planning in complex disaster environments.

title_en: Intelligent optical distribution for fiber core remote exchange
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of optical fiber maintenance, in particular to a fiber core remote exchange intelligent optical distribution, which comprises OASS equipment, a power supply module, a central processing module, a communication interface module, an optical test module, a wire core exchange module and a wire core interface module, wherein the optical test module is arranged at the top of the OASS equipment, the power supply module is arranged at the top of the back surface of the OASS equipment, the wire core interface module is arranged at one side of the OASS equipment and below the power supply module, the wire core exchange module is arranged in the OASS equipment, and the central processing module is arranged, so that the utility model can avoid the influence of external factors such as weather, environment, traffic and the like during the use process, remotely position fault points, reduce the daily workload of workers, greatly reduce the repair time, simultaneously improve the operational reliability of an electric power communication network, and ensure the reliable electricity utilization of people's life, the emergency capacity under natural disasters is improved, and the post-disaster reconstruction speed is accelerated.
assignees: SHANGHAI GUANGMING OPTOELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent obstacle-crossing water curtain cooling type fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent obstacle-crossing water curtain cooling type fire rescue robot. Including interior casing, shell body, casing bottom plate, many telescopic links, by interior casing, shell body, the water storage chamber that the casing bottom plate surrounds and forms, install in the laser point cloud sensor of shell body, the controller, interior casing and shell body pass through spliced pole fixed connection, interior casing bottom is provided with many outer poles of bracing piece and the pole in the bracing piece of nestification in the outer pole of bracing piece, the one end of pole is provided with the gyro wheel in the bracing piece. The beneficial effects are as follows: the intelligent obstacle crossing capability is realized, and the maneuverability is strong; the water curtain spray head sprays water, so that the local temperature can be reduced, and the rescued people can be protected from being influenced by smoke and high temperature as much as possible; most of the working components are arranged at the bottom of the inner shell, and water in the water storage cavity has heat insulation and cooling effects on the working components, so that the failure rate of the working components is reduced; the laser point cloud sensor can be used for reconstructing a map in real time, and can be used for reconstructing a complex fire scene map and helping fire fighters to move in and out suddenly.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster zoning method integrating attributes and structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountain torrent disaster zoning method integrating attributes and structures, which relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster zoning and comprises the steps of (1) preprocessing rainfall and terrain factors, and spatially aggregating the rainfall and terrain factors to each small watershed scale as rainfall and terrain attributes of the small watersheds; (2) according to the small watershed boundary data, representing the small watershed by the center of the small watershed and using the center of the small watershed as a node of a graph, and constructing edges between the nodes by adjacent small watersheds so as to construct a space structure relationship of the graph structure representing the small watershed; (3) taking the attribute and the spatial structure relation of the small flow field as input, and constructing a graph self-encoder by using three graph convolution neural network modules so as to simultaneously carry out feature expression learning on the attribute and the spatial structure of the small flow field; (4) establishing a graph decoder according to the output of each graph convolution neural network module, and simultaneously realizing the reconstruction of a small watershed space structure and small watershed clustering; (5) and merging the small watersheds of the same category according to the optimal clustering result of the small watersheds to obtain a final mountain torrent disaster zoning scheme.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Large-screen visual screen-projection disaster tolerance system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-screen visual screen-throwing disaster-tolerant system and a method, wherein the system comprises a redundant screen-throwing workstation, a screen-throwing switching control client and screen-throwing switching software, the method comprises the steps of deploying the redundant screen-throwing workstation, the screen-throwing switching client and the screen-throwing switching software, when the screen-throwing workstation is abnormal and can not normally display content, sending a screen-throwing switching instruction to a screen-throwing switching client of the redundant screen-throwing workstation by using the screen-throwing switching software, and controlling the redundant screen-throwing workstation to reconstruct a screen-throwing data channel and display content by the screen-throwing switching client to replace a work task of a fault workstation; and the screen switching software sends a screen switching plan to the splicing controller, the splicing controller executes the integral adjustment of the video data output scheme according to the plan, and finally the content of the redundant workstation replaces the content of the fault workstation on the large screen. The invention provides an effective large-screen projection disaster tolerance solution, and the completeness and stability of large-screen display are guaranteed.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Integrated Insulation Block of Assembly-type Inside and Outside Walls and Construction Method of Zero Energy House in a Wooden Structure thereof
title_ko: 해체 후 재시공이 가능한 내외벽 일체형 레고 단열 블록 및 이를 이용한 제로에너지 건축물 시공방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an internal and external wall-integrated Lego insulation block which can be reconstructed after disassembly and a zero-energy building construction method using the same. The internal and external wall-integrated Lego insulation block which can be reconstructed after disassembly and the zero-energy building construction method using the same according to the present invention comprises the following steps of: (S1) installing a start bar at a lowest end part; (S2) seating and installing an adiabatic start block at an upper part of the start bar; (S3) completing a wall; (S4) installing a Lintel block; (S5) installing an upper end rail; (S6) installing a wood block plate for a slab, a wood plate and a roof; and (S7) constructing moisture-proof paper and a finishing material. According to the present invention, insulation performance of a building can be improved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 해체 후 재시공이 가능한 내외벽 일체형 레고 단열 블록 및 이를 이용한 제로에너지 건축물 시공방법을 개시한다. 
본 발명에 따르는 해체 후 재시공이 가능한 내외벽 일체형 레고 단열 블록 및 이를 이용한 제로에너지 건축물 시공방법은 해체 후 재시공이 가능한 내외벽 일체형 레고 단열 블록을 이용한 제로에너지 건축물 시공방법에 있어서, 최하단부에 스타트바를 설치하는 단계(S1)와, 스타트바의 상부로 단열스타트블록을 안착시켜 설치하는 단계(S2)와, 상기 단열스타트블록의 상부로 단열표준블록을 적층하여 벽체를 완성하는 단계(S3)와, 벽체, 창호 및 출입문부위 상단에 상인방블록을 설치하는 단계(S4)와, 상인방블록의 상부에 상단레일을 설치하는 단계(S5)와, 상기 상단레일의 상부에 슬라브용 목재블록판, 목재판 및 지붕을 설치하는 단계(S6) 및 내외부 벽체에 방습지, 마감재료를 시공하는 단계(S7)를 포함하는 것일 수 있는데, 이에 의할 때, 일체화된 단열 레고 블록을 공장에서 제작하고, 시공 시에는 일체형 단열 레고 블록을 적층하듯이 간단한 조립만으로도 건축물의 벽체를 시공할 수 있게 함으로써 시공편의성을 획기적으로 향상시키고, 공사기간을 단축시키며, 내외부 벽체를 공장에서 제작하여 사용하므로 작업자의 숙련도에 따른 시공품질 편차의 문제점을 개선하고, 단열 레고 블록에 마감재료, 하지철물, 스터드 체결을 위한 고정블록을 구비하여 후속공정의 설치 및 해체를 용이하게 하며, 시공, 해체 후 단열블록의 재사용 등 반영구적으로 사용이 가능하다. 뿐만 아니라 (준)불연단열재의 사용으로 화재안전성을 확보하고 단열재가 구조체와의 기밀성을 유지할 수 있으므로 건축물의 단열성능을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method and device for reinforcing geotechnical engineering landslide
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering geological disasters, in particular to a method and a device for reinforcing a geotechnical engineering landslide, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring slope data of the geotechnical engineering landslide, and acquiring measurement data of the geotechnical engineering landslide; reconstructing a side slope three-dimensional model of the geotechnical engineering landslide by using the measured data, and establishing a side slope three-dimensional geological model by combining side slope data; determining potential dangerous rock masses and key attention areas based on the three-dimensional geological model; and generating a landslide reinforcement strategy of potential dangerous rock masses and key attention areas by adopting a preset reinforcement mode. From this, solved and be difficult to the accurate danger area who consolidates the side slope among the correlation technique, and can't effectively restrain the side slope deformation and landslide calamity prevention and cure to increase the reinforcement cost, reduced the economic nature and the practicality of construction and prevention and cure, reduced the side slope and warp the precision of regulation and control, can't satisfy the accurate reinforced (rfd) demand scheduling problem of side slope.

title_en: Fire shutter control system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire shutter control system. More specifically, a beacon scanner is provided. Thus, heat of a flame and a body temperature of a person are similar to each other in an urgent fire scene, it compensates for a situation in which a person to be rescued cannot be recognized, thereby increasing accuracy and aiding in searches. In addition, a smart device operated with a control unit is provided. Thus, the control unit determines whether or not there is an occupant. Then, when a location of the occupant is identified, the location is transmitted to the smart device so that rescue can be performed quickly. In case of emergency such as fire suppression or rescue, the fire shutter is operated remotely from the smart device. Therefore, a fire shutter control system is capable of allowing access to a fire shutter conveniently.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방화셔터 제어 시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는, 비콘 스캐너를 구비함으로써, 촌각을 다투는 긴박한 화재현장에서 자칫 화염의 열기와 사람의 체온이 유사하여 사람을 인지할 수 없는 상황을 보완하여 구조대상자를 수색하는 데 정확도를 높이고, 수색에 도움을 주고, 제어부와 연동하는 스마트기기를 구비함으로써, 제어부에서 재실자의 여부를 판단하여 재실자의 위치가 파악되면 스마트기기로 전송함에 따라 신속하게 구조할 수 있도록 하며, 화재진압이나 구조 등의 유사 시에 스마트기기에서 원격으로 방화셔터를 작동하여 편리하게 방화셔터로 출입을 가능하게 하는 방화셔터 제어 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Sandwich panels for construction
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 건축용 샌드위치패널에 관한 것으로써, 특히 건물에 화재가 발생하였을 때 건축자재인 샌드위치패널에 화염이 전파되는 것을 지연시켜 화재의 확산을 방지함으로써 샌드위치패널의 심재로 사용되는 단열소재의 발화에 의한 유독가스의 발생을 억제하고 사람들이 화재현장으로부터 신속하게 대피할 수 있는 초기 대피시간을 확보함으로써 국민의 생명과 재산을 보호할 수 있는 개량된 건축용 샌드위치패널에 관한 것이다. 
상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 고안인 건축용 샌드위치패널(1)은, 소정 두께의 단열패널(110)을 중간에 위치시켜 심재(100)로 하고, 상기 단열패널(110)의 양면에 철판(200)이 접착되어 형성되는 건축용 샌드위치패널(1)에 있어서, 상기 심재(100)와 철판(200) 사이의 접합면에는 팽창흑연층(300)이 형성되고, 상기 심재(100)인 단열패널(110)의 상하좌우측변(111)(112)(113)(114)에는 팽창흑연혼합액(310)이 도포 또는 분사되거나 또는 팽창흑연띠(320)가 부착되어 일체로써 형성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
또한, 상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 고안인 건축용 샌드위치패널(1)의 심재(100)는, 소정 두께의 시트형상으로 된 단열패널(110)을 복수겹 이상 다수겹을 적층하고 그 적층접합면에 팽창흑연혼합액(310)을 도포 또는 분사 융착하여 팽창흑연층(300)을 형성하거나 상기 적층접합면에 소정 두께의 팽창흑연시트(330)를 융착 하여 팽창흑연층(300)을 형성함으로써 전체적으로 시루떡 형상으로 된 다층구조의 심재(100)인 것을 특징으로 한다. 
상기와 같이 구성되는 본 고안인 건축용 샌드위치패널에 의하면, 건물에 화재가 발생하였을 때 건축자재인 샌드위치패널에 화염이 전파되어 발화되는 것을 지연시켜 화재의 확산을 방지함으로써 샌드위치패널의 심재로 사용되는 단열소재의 발화에 의한 유독가스의 발생을 억제하고 사람들이 화재현장으로부터 신속하게 대피할 수 있는 초기 대피시간을 확보함으로써 국민의 생명과 재산을 보호할 수 있는 개량된 건축용 샌드위치패널이 제공되게 된다.

title_en: Mine CO abnormal disturbance intelligent identification and coal spontaneous combustion early warning value determination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine CO abnormal disturbance intelligent recognition and coal spontaneous combustion early warning value determination method which comprises the steps of obtaining historical time sequence data of upper corner CO concentration in a goaf coal spontaneous combustion free state in a working face normal pushing and collecting period, dividing the obtained data into subsequences, marking whether the subsequences are interference sequences or not, establishing an upper corner CO concentration time sequence classification model by adopting an LSTM (least squares) network, establishing a CO concentration time sequence data reconstruction model in the non-interference state by adopting an LSTM self-coding network, determining a goaf coal spontaneous combustion state abnormal early warning threshold according to reconstruction errors in the training period of the CO concentration time sequence data reconstruction model in the non-interference state, and carrying out real-time early warning on the goaf coal spontaneous combustion state. The method takes the upper corner CO concentration data actually measured on site as a drive, fully considers the correlation of the time dimension, can effectively reduce the false alarm of the spontaneous combustion of the goaf coal, and reduces the blindness of the goaf fire prevention and extinguishment strategy.

title_en: Novel auxiliary decision-making method for meteorological disaster prevention of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel auxiliary decision-making method for preventing meteorological disasters of an electric power system, which comprises the steps of obtaining a defect hidden danger set of a current whole network main device according to geographic coverage of meteorological disaster prediction and early warning information, screening the main device set in an early warning area, obtaining corresponding device reliability indexes in a production management information system, carrying out reliability secondary evaluation on the main device set related to the current meteorological early warning, generating a device operation and maintenance attention degree ranking table and corresponding device side operation and maintenance decisions according to the device reliability indexes and the reliability secondary evaluation results, reconstructing a fault set ranking table according to an N-X principle according to the operation attention degree of a power grid and the relevance among devices, screening the fault set according to the most serious condition, carrying out steady analysis and calculation of the electric power system according to the whole network range, generating a whole network system control strategy suggestion for the current meteorological early warning according to calculation results, and forming a complete power grid operation decision by combining the device side operation and maintenance decisions.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire-fighting robot, wherein a driving upright post (302) and an auxiliary upright post (303) of a fire-fighting platform (3) are vertically and rectangularly arranged, two ends of a cross rod (304) are respectively sleeved on the driving upright post (302) and the auxiliary upright post (303), a fireproof cloth roller (305) is fixedly arranged on the driving upright post (302), a cover plate (306) is arranged on the tops of the driving upright post (302) and the auxiliary upright post (303), a telescopic cylinder and a fire-extinguishing powder spray head (307) are arranged on the cover plate (306), an air suction port of a vacuum fan (309) is arranged between a double-layer bottom plate (301) and the cover plate (306), and a foam spray head (312) is arranged at the bottoms of the driving upright post (302) and the auxiliary upright post (303). The invention has the beneficial effects that: identifying the size of a fire hazard object, automatically adjusting the size of a fire extinguishing platform to cover and isolate the object, and preventing the expansion of the fire range; meanwhile, the fire extinguishing platform integrates various fire extinguishing means, and is easy to build and suitable for upgrading and reconstruction of a factory building.

title_en: The complex inorganic insulating material and the manufacturing method thereof in which the thermal ability is excellent and the toxic gas generation amount is reduced
title_ko: 단열성능이 탁월하고 유독가스 발생량이 저감되는 복합무기단열재 및 그 제조방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composite inorganic insulating material having excellent insulating performance and a reduced amount of generation of toxic gas, and a method for manufacturing the same. The method for manufacturing a composite inorganic insulating material, according to the present invention, comprises: a fabric rook wool sheet formation step (S1); an adhesive rock wool sheet formation step (S2); a perforation step (S3); a mesh-type rock wool sheet formation step (S4); a unit rock wool sheet formation step (S5); and a composite inorganic insulating material formation step (S6). According to the present invention, noise between floors can be significantly reduced.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 단열성능이 탁월하고 유독가스 발생량이 저감되는 복합무기단열재 및 그 제조방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 층간소음을 줄일 수 있고, 단열성능은 월등히 향상되되 실화재시 유독가스에 의한 인명피해 위험요인을 현저하게 저감하여 화재로부터 국민의 생명과 재산을 보호할 수 있도록 안출한 단열성능이 탁월하고 유독가스 발생량이 저감되는 복합무기단열재 및 그 제조방법에 관한 것이다. 
상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명의 단열성능이 탁월하고 유독가스 발생량이 저감되는 복합무기단열재 제조방법(2)은, 무기질단열재인 암면을 가공하여 소정의 시트형상으로 된 원단 암면시트(A)를 형성하는 원단 암면시트 형성단계(S1)와; 상기 원단 암면시트(A)의 양면에 점착력을 갖는 점착면 암면시트(B)를 형성하는 점착면 암면시트 형성단계(S2)와; 상기 점착면 암면시트(B)상에 길이방향의 일정 간격으로 다수열의 일자형 타공(301)을 형성하는 타공단계(S3)와; 상기 일자형 타공(301)을 형성한 점착면 암면시트(B)를 가온하며 좌우로 당겨 그물망형으로 확장한 후 냉각하여 고착시킴으로써 그물망형 암면시트(C)를 형성하는 그물망형 암면시트 형성단계(S4)와; 상기 그물망형 암면시트(C)의 양면에 외피(530)로써 알루미늄필름(Al)을 열융착하여 밀폐된 공기층(540)을 형성한 단위 암면시트(D)를 형성하는 단위 암면시트 형성단계(S5)와; 상기 단위 암면시트(D)를 다수층 융착 접합하여 복합무기단열재(1)를 형성하는 복합무기단열재 형성단계(S6);를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
상기와 같이 이루어지는 본 발명에 의하면, 층간소음을 월등히 감소시킬 수 있고, 단열성능은 월등히 향상시키면서도, 어떤 요인에 의해 화재가 발생되어 단열재의 전후면 및 상하좌우측변의 어느 방향에서 화염이 침투되더라도 발화되지 않아 화재가 확산되지 않고 유독가스를 발생시키지 않아 화재현장으로부터 초기 대피시간을 확보하여 국민의 소중한 생명과 재산을 보호할 수 있는 단열성능이 탁월하고 유독가스 발생량이 저감되는 복합무기단열재 및 그 제조방법이 제공되게 된다.

title_en: Combined integrated building system for sinking building
abstract_en: The invention provides a sinking building combined integrated building system which organically combines houses, soil bodies and production workshops to achieve three parts of function synergy, and mainly comprises the following components: the method mainly comprises the following steps: the mountain body is inlayed and is enclosed shape system structure, back-off railway carriage or compartment room formula workplace structure, encloses and closes mountain body open structure, geosyncline and wall device structure, house and roof planting structure, sunshine greenhouse structure, open garden structure, forest fire prevention isolation structure, filth, marsh gas, fertile water integral structure specifically includes formula of sinking house, soil body and production workplace, the house is arranged in the mountain body and is dug within the frame groove, forms the courtyard structure that sinks, and following digging groove is dug soil and is got for the below fill to frame groove periphery arrangement reconstruction mountain type encloses and closes the shape system and includes building area, construction area, tree planting district.

title_en: Emergency escape fire fighting access
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency escape fire fighting access which comprises an up-down through type safety access and a connecting platform, wherein an emergency escape door and an anti-theft partition wall are arranged between the safety access and the connecting platform, a door lock and a child lock are arranged on the emergency escape door, the safety access comprises an up-down ladder step and a safety exit, and a quick-descent upright post or a quick-descent slideway can be additionally arranged after the safety access is completely penetrated. The invention is beautiful and practical, and has good industrial and commercial prospect and social application value. The emergency escape passage can be used for industry or developers to build an emergency escape passage for emergency danger avoidance and fire safety; it can also be used for reconstruction, additional construction or extension projects on the basis of the existing balcony, anti-theft net, outdoor platform and ventilation shaft of air conditioner outdoor unit of high-rise residence. Even can be used for the comprehensive treatment project of urban unified planning and construction and the fire safety project matched with the house construction acceptance standard. The building facade can be decorated, the urban building can be beautified, a fire emergency safety passage can be constructed, and the urban safety level and the life safety index can be improved.

title_en: Rock damage fracture datamation recording method under seepage stress coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recording the damage and fracture datamation of a rock under the coupling action of seepage stress, which comprises the following steps: obtaining rock damage fracture data of a plurality of historical samples, and storing the data according to a preset template to obtain a database; calculating stability parameters of the samples according to state variables and characteristic information of the historical samples; establishing a correlation analysis model of the characteristic information and the stability parameters; collecting characteristic information of a working face, and inputting the characteristic information into an association analysis model to obtain a real-time stability parameter; if the real-time stability parameter is larger than the stability parameter threshold value, mapping the characteristic information of the working face into a database for verifying and reconstructing the correlation analysis model; and if the real-time stability parameter is less than or equal to the stability parameter threshold value, immediately stopping the operation. The invention realizes the standardized processing and recording of rock damage and fracture data, and can provide powerful data support and primary early warning judgment for the early warning of engineering disasters.
assignees: WUHAN JIUJIANG RAILWAY PASSENGER DEDICATED LINE HUBEI CO LTD;CHINA TIESIJU CIVIL ENG GROUP CO LTD;ANHUI ZHONGTIE ENGINEERING TECH SERVICE CO LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS;China railway 11th bureau group co ltd;CHINA RAILWAY SOUTHWEST RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Rapidly constructible emergency shelter with internal suspended bases
abstract_en: Millions of people yearly become homeless due to natural disasters. Incidents such as earthquakes and floods can cause a lot of damages and homelessness to a large number of people. So, the timely provision of shelter is a priority. This need is met through a lightweight emergency shelter with a high setup speed that can be applied in all areas with no installation training. Furthermore, a modular shelter with the least material waste in its assembling procedure can influence retaining the environment. This matter can have a significant impact on conserving vital resources. This issue can develop the field of post-disaster reconstruction and help resolve related difficulties.

title_en: Detachable prefabricated reinforced concrete beam-steel column connecting node and repairing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detachable precast reinforced concrete beam-steel column connecting node and a repairing method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) and cutting off the part of the cover plate II provided with the cover plate shear connector II, and simultaneously unscrewing the turned edge wrapped with the U-shaped steel and the bolt between the cover plate II. 2) And removing the damaged cover plate II and the connecting area, and pouring concrete. 3) And unscrewing the bolts of the shear connectors at the bottom of the groove. 4) And replacing a new cover plate II, a new cover plate shear connector II and a plurality of groove bottom shear connectors. 5) And (4) pouring concrete after the connecting area is refilled in the cavity H defined by the new cover plate II and the old externally-wrapped U-shaped steel, and finishing the repair construction. The connecting joint of the steel structure column and the precast concrete beam is detachably connected by the bolt, so that the damaged part of the joint can be quickly replaced after an earthquake, the post-disaster reconstruction speed is increased, and the post-disaster reconstruction cost is reduced.

title_en: Method and device for improving toughness of power distribution network and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network toughness improvement method, a device and a storage medium based on net rack reconstruction and V2G participation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the damage condition of a traffic system in a disaster scene; determining the travel selection of the electric automobile after the disaster based on a user balance principle and the damage condition of the traffic system; selecting and establishing a charging load distribution model based on the trip of the electric automobile after the disaster; determining an incentive mechanism of V2G users participating in power restoration after disasters based on a consumer psychology theory; determining the maximum V2G reverse transmission power of each charging station based on an excitation mechanism, user response rate, charging station electric vehicle flow, probability distribution of electric vehicle residual capacity and a charging load distribution model; establishing a distribution network toughness improvement model based on net rack reconstruction and V2G reverse power transmission; and determining a power supply recovery scheme based on the power distribution network toughness improvement model. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of real model, improvement of the toughness of the power distribution network, reduction of recovery cost and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Environment monitoring big data analysis method applying artificial intelligence and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an environment monitoring big data analysis method and electronic equipment applying artificial intelligence, which can carry out ecological index element vector mining of U environmental index dimensions on environment monitoring big data to be analyzed to obtain first ecological index element vector distribution of U environmental index dimensions, reconstruct each first ecological index element vector distribution and the ecological index element vector distribution correlated with the first ecological index element vector distribution to obtain second ecological index element vector distribution of U environmental index dimensions, analyze the environmental disaster trend of the second ecological index element vector distribution of U environmental index dimensions to obtain an environmental disaster trend analysis result, thus realizing joint analysis processing of ecological index element vectors among the correlated environmental index dimensions of the U environmental index element vector distribution, and further carrying out environmental disaster trend analysis based on richer and more complete environmental disaster prediction basis, the accuracy and the reliability of the environmental disaster trend analysis result are guaranteed.
assignees: WM ENV MOLECULAR DIAGNOSIS CO LTD

title_en: Fault recovery method for AC/DC hybrid power distribution network under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery method of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network under extreme disasters, which is characterized in that a time sequence process considering fault recovery is established by taking the minimum system loss load and the minimum line active power network loss as objective functions, a mobile emergency power supply is rapidly deployed after an accident, a model for collaborative reconstruction of alternating current-direct current parts of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network is carried out in real time, and a mobile emergency power supply deployment and switching action time sequence scheme which enables the minimum system loss load and the minimum line active power network loss is obtained under given constraint conditions.

title_en: Fire Safety Education System using Authentic Virtual Reality
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire safety education system using realistic virtual reality (AVR), comprising: a VR device centered on audio-visual; fire safety education contents; an electric lamp that heats the air; an electric fan that creates and supplies wind; a frame that fixes the electric lamp and electric fan; a power cutoff module; and a controller. The present invention focuses on the expansion of the tactile sense, so that the users can feel not only the audio-visual sense in the virtual reality space, but also the tactile sense, such as the temperature of a hot flame and wind to learn as if in a real environment. In a virtual situation where a fire occurs, because the heat lamp in front operates and enables the users to feel the heat, the users can feel a sense of reality as if being in a fire site. Through the present invention, there is a remarkable effect of improving the learning effect for users to experience learning by feeling and acting directly in an environment like a real site.

title_en: Stepped hydropower short-term optimization scheduling method based on segmented load reconstruction strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stepped hydropower short-term optimization scheduling method based on a segmented load reconstruction strategy, which aims at solving the problem of serious dimensionality disaster faced by large-scale hydropower short-term optimization scheduling, provides a short-term optimization model taking minimum water consumption as a general target by deeply analyzing the short-term scheduling characteristics, and performs dimensionality reduction solving on the stepped hydropower short-term optimization scheduling by adopting the segmented load reconstruction strategy. The scheme is as follows: firstly, dividing an original load process of a system with obvious peak-valley characteristics into a sectional load process with the peak-valley characteristics and a frequently-fluctuating residual load process; secondly, dividing the cascade power station into a peak shaving power station and a balance power station according to the adjusting performance, and respectively bearing the sectional load and the residual load; and finally, traversing and optimizing different segmentation modes through a particle swarm algorithm to find the optimal load segmentation mode and obtain the optimal calculation result. The method is beneficial to the dimensionality reduction solution of the short-term optimized scheduling of the cascade hydropower, and improves the calculation efficiency and the result quality of model solution.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Multi-region multi-stage factory network coordination recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-region multi-stage factory network coordination recovery method and a system, which are used for modeling the recovery problem of a power system by adopting a multi-region and multi-stage coordination method, wherein in a power generation and transmission system, the maximization of unit power generation under the consideration of framework network reconstruction is considered; and the contribution degree of the distributed power supply in the power distribution system to the power generation and transmission system in different time periods is represented by changing a factory network coordination recovery penalty function, so that the time-sharing support of the black start capability of the distributed power supply to the recovery of the power system is realized. The invention can be used as an important auxiliary tool in the post-disaster recovery process of the power system, comprehensively provides enough decision guidance for power system operators, and provides reference for the identification of key nodes.

title_en: Emergency disaster condition detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency disaster detection method and device, the method comprises the steps of distributing unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary terminals to detect a disaster according to channel conditions between each terminal and each unmanned aerial vehicle in a target area and the existing calculated amount on the unmanned aerial vehicle, distributing channels for each terminal by using a KM matching algorithm, enabling the uplink transmission rate and the maximum SINR value of each communication link of all terminals to be larger than a first preset threshold value, unloading a disaster image sequence to be detected on each terminal to the unmanned aerial vehicle distributed for each terminal through the channels distributed for each terminal, selecting a super-resolution network model on the unmanned aerial vehicle to reconstruct the disaster image sequence to be detected, and performing disaster detection by using the reconstructed disaster image sequence to be detected, wherein the reconstructed image quality is larger than a second preset threshold value, and the disaster detection integral time delay corresponding to the terminals is smaller than a third preset threshold value. The invention realizes the balance of the completion time delay and the detection precision of disaster detection.

title_en: Building rubbish regeneration insulating brick
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a construction waste regeneration insulating brick, which comprises a brick core, wherein the surface of the brick core is provided with a strengthening layer, the surface of the strengthening layer is provided with a sound insulation layer, the surface of the sound insulation layer is provided with a heat preservation layer, the surface of the heat preservation layer is provided with a waterproof layer, and the surface of the waterproof layer is provided with a flame retardant layer; the problem that the strength and the hardness cannot meet the requirements of the bearing wall and cannot be used for building the bearing wall is effectively solved through the arranged strengthening layer and the like, and the strength and the hardness of the brick core can be strengthened through the strengthening layer through the arranged strengthening layer, so that the purpose of strengthening the brick core is achieved, and the practicability of the device is improved; by arranging the sound insulation layer, the heat insulation layer, the waterproof layer, the flame retardant layer and the like, the problems of heavy rain, fire, cold tide, noise and the like which may occur due to the severe environment of a disaster area in the process of producing and reconstructing the architectural ruins in the disaster area are effectively avoided, and the applicability of the device is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHUANGLI ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network anomaly detection method based on incremental self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network and information security, and provides a network anomaly detection method based on an incremental self-encoder. The method comprises the following steps: collecting network flow data to obtain a label-free sample set; outputting a neuron set N and a connection relation set C; based on the initialization increment self-encoder, and an increment learning method is adopted, the increment self-encoder is trained based on the neuron set N and the connection relation set C, and an anomaly detection model is obtained; and inputting the received sample data into the anomaly detection model, calculating a reconstruction error score, comparing the reconstruction error score with an anomaly threshold value, obtaining a normal sample according to a judgment result, and inputting the normal sample into the improved SOINN network for incremental learning. The invention solves the problem of forgetting disaster, saves the calculation and storage expenses, ensures that the model continuously learns new sample characteristics and realizes the purpose of adapting to new network environment.

title_en: Method for repairing power-communication fault of active power distribution network under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for repairing an electric power-communication fault of an active power distribution network under an extreme disaster, which comprises the following steps of 1) updating a positioned fault set and the position of an emergency maintenance team, determining an information blind area, judging whether net rack reconstruction and island division can be carried out, and if so, entering the next step; 2) Calculating load recovery value conversion values of power and communication faults, and solving a fault first-aid repair task distribution objective function; 3) And (3) allocating the solved fault emergency repair tasks, dispatching emergency repair teams to carry out fault emergency repair, and turning to the step 1) after 1 fault is repaired. The method considers the influence of the communication fault on the system fault recovery process, uniformly repairs the power fault and the communication fault based on the load recovery value conversion, can effectively improve the elasticity of the active power distribution network, and has better engineering practicability.

title_en: Eight-foot special robot capable of dynamically reconstructing body
abstract_en: The invention discloses an eight-foot special robot capable of dynamically reconstructing a body and suitable for forest fire early warning, which comprises a core module, a protection module and a motion module, wherein the core module is connected with the protection module; an electric connecting bolt and a lifting mechanism are designed in the core module to realize the cylindrical pair connection of the motion module; the protection module is started when the robot is in danger to form an internally self-locking closed protection space so as to protect the core module; the motion module consists of mechanical legs and an end effector and finishes the walking and grabbing functions of the robot; according to the invention, repeated connection and unlocking of the mechanical feet are realized by using the electric connecting bolt, so that the position distribution of eight feet can be adjusted at any time when the robot moves to cope with complex forest land road conditions, the failed feet can be actively separated from the core module after at most any four mechanical feet fail, and the positions of the remaining feet are adjusted to ensure that the mechanical feet are always in central symmetry or mirror symmetry relative to the body distribution, thereby greatly improving the survival capability of the special robot in the forest environment.

title_en: Deterministic coefficient calculation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a deterministic coefficient calculation method and a deterministic coefficient calculation system, which belong to the technical field of geological disaster evaluation analysis and calculation and comprise the following steps: acquiring a preset precision raster data layer of a geological disaster target area, and acquiring a first output result based on the preset precision raster data layer; acquiring ground disaster vector point data of the geological disaster target area, and acquiring a second output result based on the ground disaster vector point data; connecting the first output result and the second output result to obtain a grid layer corresponding to the target disaster pregnancy factor deterministic coefficient; and determining the target pregnancy factor deterministic coefficient by using the grid layer. According to the invention, in the geological disaster evaluation analysis process, flexible configuration of data parameters is realized by means of a specific model constructor according to objective data information of geological disasters, one-key operation adjustment is adopted in model operation, and a deterministic coefficient result can be obtained quickly and accurately without reconstructing a model.

title_en: Method and device for collaborative recovery of post-disaster distribution network and micro-grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for collaborative recovery of a post-disaster distribution network and a micro-grid, which take the post-disaster distribution network and the micro-grid as research objects, consider flexible resources such as maintenance teams, distributed generators, energy storage and the like and recovery means such as network reconstruction, consider the autonomy of micro-grid operation, provide the collaborative recovery method of the distribution network and the micro-grid, establish a two-layer mixed integer linear programming model based on a linear DistFlow model, and solve the problem by using a double-layer reconstruction and decomposition algorithm based on relaxation. The invention takes into account flexible resources such as distributed generators, energy storage and the like, and makes full use of resources in the distribution network and the micro-networks to formulate an optimal post-disaster recovery scheme on the premise of ensuring the autonomous operation of each micro-network. The distribution network cannot directly interfere the operation of the micro network, all the resources in the micro network are automatically scheduled, the problem of different resource ownership is solved, and the efficiency of cooperation between the distribution network and the micro network is improved.

title_en: Strong local power grid optimization planning method and system considering isolated grid operation
abstract_en: The application discloses a strong local power grid optimization planning method and system considering isolated grid operation, which comprises the steps of constructing a strong local power grid optimization planning model considering isolated grid operation; equivalently converting a strong local power grid optimization planning model considering isolated grid operation into a two-stage sub-model; and solving the sub-models in the two stages by using an improved non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm to determine a strong local power grid optimization planning method considering isolated grid operation. The method takes a power transmission network maximum grading strengthening index, an isolated network operation capacity index and a reconstruction capacity index in a typhoon disaster area as objective functions, constructs a strong local power network optimization planning model, and provides a two-stage equivalent transformation solving method to reduce the model solving difficulty. According to the method and the device, the isolated network operation capacity of the strong local power grid in the disaster can be improved, the self-balancing operation of the strong local power grid under the condition that power supply is not recovered is guaranteed, and meanwhile, the pre-disaster grading strengthening capacity and the post-disaster reconstruction capacity are considered.

title_en: Smart lifesaving alarm system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart lifesaving alarm system. Firefighters who are to carry out firefighting work at a fire site wear smart lifesaving alarms with buckles on their firefighting suits. If there is no movement of the firefighter wearing the alarm for a preset time while entering the fire site and carrying out fire extinguishing work, a man-down alarm is output and an LED blinks. When a high temperature higher than a preset temperature is detected in the surroundings, a high-temperature alarm is output and the LED blinks. The time of entry to the fire site and the elapsed time of entry are displayed so that the time can be easily grasped. A GPS function is secured to recognize the location of a firefighter wearing the alarm. Wireless communication, such as Bluetooth communication, is connected to a transceiver of a field command department near a fire site such that the location and alarm status of each firefighter, the time of entry to the fire site and the elapsed time can be grasped from a terminal for field command. By sending a command to a smart lifesaving alarm through a command transceiver, a command can be displayed on a degree display window of the smart lifesaving alarm. The condition, location, and elapsed time of entry of firefighters who have lost consciousness or are at risk of high temperature at a fire site are easily identified by a command center near the fire site. The present invention is to ensure that firefighters who entered a fire site can keep the maximum entry maintenance time, thereby protecting the safety of firefighters.
