abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 인명구조용 경보기를 화재현장에서 소화작업을 수행하려는 소방관들이 소방복에 버클을 이용하여 착용하고, 화재현장으로 진입하여 소화작업을 진행하는 도중에 기설정된 시간 동안 착용한 소방관의 움직임이 없으면 맨다운 경보음을 출력하며 LED가 점멸작동되고, 또는 기설정된 온도 이상의 고온이 주변에서 감지되면 고온 경보음을 출력하며 LED가 점멸작동되고, 화재현장의 진입시각과 진입경과시간이 표시되어 용이하게 시간을 파악할 수가 있으며, GPS 기능을 갖추어 착용한 소방관의 위치를 인식하고, 블루투스 통신 등 무선통신으로 화재현장 인근의 현장지휘부 송수신기와 연결되어 각 소방관의 위치 및 경보 상태, 화재현장 진입시각과 경과시간을 현장지휘용 단말기에서 파악할 수 있고, 지휘부 송수신기를 통해 스마트 인명구조용 경보기로 명령을 송신하여 스마트 인명구조용 경보기의 정도표시창에 명령을 표시할 수 있어서, 화재현장에서 의식을 잃거나 고온으로 위험에 처한 매몰된 소방관의 상태와 위치, 진입경과시간을 화재현장 인근의 지휘부에서 용이하게 파악하며 화재현장에 진입한 소방관들이 최대진입유지시간을 지킬 수 있도록 하여 소방관들의 안전을 보호하는 것이 가능한 스마트 인명구조용 경보기 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Hodges-Lehmann-based fire-fighting dangerous goods image super-sorting method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for fire-fighting dangerous goods image super-sorting based on Hodges-Lehmann, and relates to the technical field of intelligent data analysis. Acquiring a gray value matrix under each color channel of a plurality of image points of a dangerous article image; zooming the original image to obtain a reconstructed image, mapping the reconstructed image to the original image according to the zooming times, and selecting sixteen sampling points which are closest to a target image point in a rectangular grid; calculating a Hodges-Lehmann value of a pixel value in an interpolation kernel according to the sixteen sampling points, and updating the pixel value of a target image point; and setting an image over-scoring evaluation index according to the Hodges-Lehmann value of the pixel value in the interpolation kernel, and finishing fire-fighting dangerous goods image over-scoring based on the Hodges-Lehmann. According to the method provided by the invention, robustness estimation is carried out on 16 pixel points in the interpolation kernel, the gray value of the target pixel point is updated, the phenomenon of uneven weight distribution and the like is avoided, the edge contour of the image is enhanced, more detailed information is introduced for identifying the small-size target image, and the identification precision is improved.

title_en: Power supply recovery method, device and equipment based on distributed power supply and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power supply recovery method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on a distributed power supply, which are characterized in that island division is carried out on a power distribution network region according to distributed power supply information and power distribution network node information by acquiring power distribution network node information and distributed power supply information and utilizing a preset island division model to obtain an island region and an undivided region; network reconstruction is carried out on an undivided area by using an ant algorithm to obtain a reconstructed area, wherein the ant algorithm and an island division model both meet preset constraint conditions, and power supply recovery is carried out on the island area and the reconstructed area based on distributed power supply information, so that network reconstruction is introduced on the basis of island division, the power supply recovery rate of the power distribution network is improved, the elastic recovery capability of the power distribution network after disaster is improved, and the stability of the power distribution network is further improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Nuclear disaster-damage resisting coal thermal electric power plant and nuclear disaster-damage resisting coal thermal electric power plant of carbon dioxide gas discharge suppressed type
abstract_en: To provide a coal thermal electric power plant covered with a strong wall, allowing scram of an apparatus by stretching gamma ray detectors on the wall, provided with means allowing restoration and reconstruction in a few days after bombing.SOLUTION: A site boundary of a coal burning thermal electric power plant is enclosed with an impact protection wall, and a lot of gamma ray detectors 1 are installed on a ground surface outside the impact protection wall or on apexes. The gamma ray detectors 1 are connected to motors and fans of a coal conveyor via underground electric cables, and causes scram of the power plant when neighborhood is subjected to nuclear attack. Discharged carbon dioxide gas is removed by a carbon dioxide gas removing preheater. When carbon dioxide gas is sufficiently reduced, steam is said to have higher greenhouse effect than carbon dioxide gas. A coal burning thermal electric power generation technique is secured until then.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Intelligent image processing method based on short wave channel transmission video
abstract_en: An intelligent image processing method based on short wave channel transmission video comprises the following steps: s100: the method comprises the steps that a short-wave radio station sending end carries out low-frequency sampling on video data input by a camera, a target detects and extracts an ROI (region of interest), an edge is extracted and converted into a binary image, the binary image is subjected to downsampling, lossless compression coding in a PNG8 format is adopted, and code streams are sent to a short-wave radio station receiving end frame by frame through the short-wave radio station; s200: and the receiving end of the short-wave radio station decodes the received code stream frame by frame in a PNG8 format to generate a binary image, then uses a generation countermeasure network to perform super-resolution reconstruction on the binary image to generate an ROI edge contour image, and performs frame interpolation by using an optical flow method to obtain an ROI video. The method has the characteristics of good real-time performance, narrow transmission bandwidth and high compression ratio, solves the problem of video transmission of a short-wave channel, can be widely applied to short-wave communication, and has wide application prospects in the fields of national defense and military industry, disaster-resistant rescue, field operation and the like.

title_en: A Fire Evacuation Equipment Equipped with Danger Signal Generator and Oxygen Supply Device
title_ko: 위험신호발생기와 산소공급 장치가 설치된 화재피난 개인용구
abstract_en: The present invention relates to personal equipment combined with a danger signal generator, an oxygen respirator, and an LED bulb for emergency evacuation, which, if emergency evacuation to a safe zone is required due to a fire, enables an evacuee to smoothly recognize an evacuation route with the light of a lantern in the dark due to thick smoke or electricity supply interruption while receiving oxygen and taking a breath even in a toxic gas generated during a fire, generates the location of the evacuee through an electronic circuit, and enables quick and safe evacuation through a fire. Since fires cause casualties every year, interest in measures to quickly respond to fires and large-scale disasters is increasing. In such a case, rapid evacuation should take precedence, such that if a danger signal generator, an LED bulb, and an oxygen respirator are provided as rescue equipment for rapid evacuation in the event of a fire, many lives can be saved. Therefore, the present invention is to provide personal evacuation equipment, which is required for safely and quickly overcoming difficulties such as flames and smoke to rapidly move to a safe region in the event of a fire, generates radio waves for the location of the evacuee himself or herself in a special situation of being unmovable in a fire site, and allows the evacuee to wait for safety personnel while being supplied with oxygen.
abstract_ko:
화재가 발생하여 안전지대까지 긴급 대피가 필요한 경우, 화재 시 발생하는 유독가스 속에서도 산소를 공급받아 숨을 쉬면서 짙은 연기 혹은 전기공급 중단에 따른 암흑 상태에서 랜턴의 불빛으로 대피 로를 원활히 인지하며, 대피자의 위치를 전자회로를 통해 발생시키고, 불길 속을 신속하고 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 한 긴급 대피용 위험발생신호와 산소호흡기 및 L.E.D 전구를 겸비한 개인용구에 관한 것이다. 
매년 화재로 인명피해 사고가 발생한 이후에 화재 및 대형 재난 사고시에 신속하게 대처할 수 있는 방안에 대한 관심이 고조되고 있는 실정이며, 
이와 같은 경우에는 신속한 대피가 우선해야 하는 바, 이처럼 화재 발생시에 신속한 대피를 위한 구호장비로 위험신호발생신호기와 L.E.D 전구 및 산소호흡기가 비치된다면, 많은 인명을 구할 수 있게 될 것이다. 
따라서, 화재발생 시 화염, 연기 등의 난관을 안전하고 신속하게 넘어 안전지역까지 신속하게 이동하는 데 필요하고, 화재현장에서 이동할 수 없는 특수 상황에서 자신의 위치를 전파로 발생시키며, 산소를 공급받으면서 안전요원들을 기다리는 개인대피용구를 제공하는 데 있다.

title_en: Operation safety device in electrified interval of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a protection device, and discloses a safety protection device for operation in a live interval of a transformer substation, which comprises a device body (1), wherein the device body (1) comprises a plurality of supporting columns (101), a cross beam (102) arranged at the upper end parts of the supporting columns (101) is arranged between every two adjacent supporting columns (101), all the cross beams (102) are connected end to form a closed frame (103), a protection plate assembly (2) capable of separating the live interval of the transformer substation from top to bottom in space is arranged at the closed frame (103), and the protection plate assembly (2) comprises a transparent protection plate (201) made of an insulating material. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the protection device, the protection problem of safety operation below the electrified body when the construction is carried out without power outage in the reconstruction and extension substation interval can be effectively solved, the personal safety of operating personnel in the interval is ensured, and meanwhile, the occurrence of power grid operation accidents is prevented.
assignees: ANHUI HONGYUAN ELECTRIC POWER CONSTRUCTION INVEST CO LTD;ANHUI TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Scene three-dimensional reconstruction method, device and equipment based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scene three-dimensional reconstruction method, a device and equipment based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: when the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to be positioned above the central position of the area scene to be shot, the surrounding flight track parameters of the unmanned aerial vehicle are set according to the average height value obtained in advance; setting a holder angle according to the surrounding flight track parameters; calculating all aerial photographing points of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the number of preset aerial photographing points and the surrounding flying radius; when the pre-acquired current shooting time is judged to be within a preset daytime time period, controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to carry out surrounding flight according to preset flight speed and surrounding flight track parameters, and shooting the scene of the area to be shot at each aerial shooting point according to the angle of the holder; and obtaining a plurality of images to be reconstructed shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle so as to be used for carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on the area scene to be shot. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the comprehensiveness and the authenticity of the reconstructed disaster scene information can be ensured, and powerful support is provided for disaster relief command decision.

title_en: Method and device for extracting morphological structure of shallow small landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for extracting a morphological structure of a shallow small landslide, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a digital orthographic image (DOM) and a Digital Elevation Model (DEM) according to original data shot in aerial survey of a shallow small landslide research area; selecting an optimal segmentation scale according to different ground objects in the DOM to construct a multi-level model; constructing a multi-feature rule set according to the interpretation features of various ground objects, and extracting landslide candidate areas layer by layer in a multi-level model to obtain a landslide space range; based on the range and DEM, the terrain of the landslide region is subjected to fine analysis by adopting a strip section method, and the morphological structure of the shallow small landslide is extracted after the optimal threshold value is determined. The method can construct a multi-level shallow layer small-sized landslide morphological structure extraction model in a sudden shallow layer small-sized landslide area, accurately quantizes topographic fluctuation changes of the shallow layer small-sized landslide, further realizes effective extraction of morphological structures, and has important significance in disaster assessment, emergency rescue, reconstruction planning and other aspects.

title_en: A Evacuation Rooms Of Buildings Safe From Disasters Such As Fire, Earthquake, And Robbery
title_ko: 화재, 지진 시와 강도 침입 등의 재난으로부터 안전한 건축물의 대피 룸
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a room for enabling evacuees to safely escape from disasters such as fire, earthquake, and robbery and, more specifically, to an evacuation room, which has personal equipment for fire evacuation installed therein to have a location signal generation device and an oxygen supply device, has incombustible materials installed on the front of an inner side thereof, and has oxygen bottles, bottled waters, a pressure measuring device for the oxygen bottles, and a charging device for a battery installed therein. If a fire occurs, it is important for evacuees to survive safely. Thus, the Fire Services Act of Korea stipulates that public facilities that can accommodate people and buildings having a size or more enable an emergency escape, and the installation of space for the devices is mandatory. The present invention can provide the evacuation room, which can store the personal equipment required when a fire suddenly occurs in high-rise buildings, apartments, public buildings, hotels, motels, and complex shopping malls in which fires have occurred, can continuously maintain performance, and can enable evacuees to wait for rescue from the outside in a safe place if quick escape is impossible. The evacuation room can enable evacuees to generate the locations by using radio waves, wait for safety personnel while receiving oxygen, preserve life from invasion of robbers, and wait for rescue from the outside, in a special situation in which the evacuees cannot move from a fire site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진이나 화재, 강도의 침입 등의 재난으로부터 안전하게 대피하기 위한 룸에 관한 것이며, 보다 상세하게는, 위치신호 발생장치와 산소 공급 장치가 설치된 화재 대피용 개인용구가 설치되고, 내측의 전면이 불연재가 설치되며, 산소통과 생수; 상기 산소통의 압력측정 장치와 배터리의 충전장치 등이 설치된 대피 룸에 관한 것이다. 
이처럼 화재 발생 시 대피 자는 안전하게 생존하는 것이 중요하기 때문에 우리나라의 소방법 상에 사람을 수용할 수 있는 공공시설은 물론, 일정 크기 이상의 건물에는 비상 탈출을 할 수 있고, 그 장치의 공간 설치가 의무화 되어 있다. 
화재가 발생한 고층건물, 아파트, 공공건물과 호텔, 모텔, 복잡한 상가 등에서 갑작스런 화재발생시 필요한 개인용구를 보관하고, 성능을 지속적으로 유지하며, 신속한 탈출이 불가능할 경우, 안전한 곳에서 외부로 구조를 기다릴 안전한 대피 룸을 제공하며, 화재현장에서 이동할 수 없는 특수 상황에서 자신의 위치를 전파로 발생시키며, 산소를 공급받으면서 안전요원들을 기다리는 한편, 강도의 침입으로부터 생명을 보존하며, 외부로부터 구조를 기다릴 수 있는 안전 룸을 제공하는 데 있다.

title_en: Device for door closing force increase and decrease
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for increasing and decreasing a door closing force, which operates with an automatic closing device for closing a fire door in case of a fire together to increase a closing force of the fire door, thereby preventing a phenomenon, in which the fire door is not completely closed due to a pressure difference between a differential pressure chamber and a corridor, and extinguishing the closing force that has been applied to the fire door when the fire door is completely closed so that anybody can easily open the fire door and quickly escape from the fire site. According to the present invention, the device for increasing and decreasing a door closing force includes: an operation unit which is guided into a case and moves forward and backward with respect to a door opening and closing a door frame; an electromagnet unit which is installed with the operation unit to face the door and comes in contact with the door when the door is closed according to a fire occurrence; a switch unit which is installed in the electromagnet unit and is pressurized by the door when the door operates in a closing direction to generate magnetism for attachment of the electromagnet unit and the door; and a driving unit which moves the operation unit backward to allow the electromagnet unit to pull the door for closing when the switch unit is pressurized by the door.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도어 폐쇄력 증감장치에 관한 것으로, 화재발생시 방화문을 폐쇄하기 위한 자동폐쇄장치와 함께 작동하여 방화문의 폐쇄력을 증가시킴으로써, 차압실과 복도 간의 압력차로 인해 방화문이 완전히 닫히지 아니하는 현상을 방지할 수 있고, 방화문이 완전히 폐쇄된 상태에서는 방화문에 가해지고 있던 폐쇄력을 소멸시켜 누구나 쉽게 방화문을 열고 화재현장을 신속하게 탈출할 수 있도록 함을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명에 따른 도어 폐쇄력 증감장치는, 상기 케이스에 안내되어, 상기 문틀을 개폐시키는 도어 대해 전진 또는 후진될 수 있는 작동부; 상기 작동부에 설치되어 상기 도어와 마주하고, 상기 도어가 화재발생에 따라 폐쇄될 경우, 상기 도어와 접촉되는 전자석부; 상기 전자석부에 설치되며, 상기 도어가 폐쇄 방향으로 작동될 경우 상기 도어에 의해 가압되어 상기 전자석부에 도어와 부착을 위한 자력이 발생되도록 하는 스위치부; 및 상기 스위치부가 상기 도어에 의해 가압될 경우 상기 전자석부가 상기 도어를 당겨서 폐쇄하도록 상기 작동부를 후진시키는 구동부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Apparatus, method and program for providing foreign language learning service
title_ko: 외국어 학습 서비스 제공 장치, 방법 및 프로그램
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for providing a foreign language learning service is provided. The apparatus comprises: an image selection unit which receives a mode input signal for selecting a word learning mode or a sentence learning mode, and receives an image input signal for selecting one of the plurality of learning images; a word learning unit which, when the mode input signal selecting the word learning mode is received from the image selection unit, receives a word input signal for selection of one word playback section among a plurality of word playback sections corresponding to the learning video according to the video input signal, plays a first word learning video, which is a portion of the learning video corresponding to the word playback section according to the word input signal, plays a second word learning video with the sound removed from the first word learning video, and calculates a first average evaluation score for the word playback section based on a user's voice received while the second word learning image is being played; and a sentence learning unit which, when the mode input signal selecting the sentence learning mode is received from the image selection unit, determines whether to perform the sentence learning mode based on the first average evaluation scores calculated in response to the word playback sections.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면, 외국어 학습 서비스를 제공하기 위한 장치가 제공된다. 상기 장치는, 단어학습모드 또는 문장학습모드의 선택에 대한 모드입력신호를 수신하고, 복수의 학습영상들 중 어느 하나의 학습영상에 선택에 대한 영상입력신호를 수신하는 영상 선택부; 상기 영상 선택부에 상기 단어학습모드를 선택한 상기 모드입력신호가 수신된 경우, 상기 영상입력신호에 따른 상기 학습영상과 대응하는 복수의 단어재생구간들 중 어느 하나의 단어재생구간의 선택에 대한 단어입력신호를 수신하고, 상기 학습영상 중 상기 단어입력신호에 따른 상기 단어재생구간과 대응하는 부분인 제1 단어학습영상을 재생하며, 상기 제1 단어학습영상에서 소리가 제거된 제2 단어학습영상을 재생하고, 상기 제2 단어학습영상이 재생되는 동안 수신된 사용자 음성에 기초하여 상기 단어재생구간에 대한 제1 평균평가점수를 산출하는 단어 학습부; 및 상기 영상 선택부에 상기 문장학습모드를 선택한 상기 모드입력신호가 수신된 경우, 상기 단어재생구간들과 대응하여 산출된 상기 제1 평균평가점수들에 기초하여 상기 문장학습모드의 수행여부를 결정하는 문장 학습부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Basic unit emergency management mobile intelligent series platform and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency management, and discloses a base emergency management mobile intelligent series platform and equipment, which comprise a primary management platform, a secondary management platform and a tertiary management platform which are communicated with each other, wherein a scene monitoring system, a command communication system, a rescue management system, a propaganda warning system and a post-disaster treatment management system are arranged in the primary management platform, the secondary management platform and the tertiary management platform, the scene monitoring system is used for monitoring and collecting disaster accident information, the rescue management system is used for comprehensively counting and updating rescue reserve information of each block of a base, the command communication system is used for intelligently managing disaster accidents and commanding and rescuing, the propaganda warning system is used for commanding personnel to conduct propaganda scheme exercise, and the post-disaster treatment management system is used for performing post-disaster damage assessment and generating post-disaster reconstruction suggestions. The invention can provide a dynamic, reliable and systematic intelligent emergency management scheme, and achieve a better emergency management effect.

title_en: Folding fireproof door
abstract_en: The invention discloses a folding fireproof door, which comprises a door frame fixed in a door opening, a primary door rotatably installed on the door frame through a hinge, a secondary door rotatably connected with the primary door through a hinge, a double-shaft door closer fixedly installed at the upper part of the primary door, a primary door link mechanism with one end fixedly connected with a first transmission shaft of the double-shaft door closer and the other end rotatably connected with a door frame at the top of the primary door, and a secondary door link mechanism with one end fixedly connected with a second transmission shaft of the double-shaft door closer and the other end rotatably connected with the secondary door; the first transmission shaft and the second transmission shaft are mutually linked and rotate in opposite directions, so that the main door can be completely opened and the sub-door can also be completely opened and folded on the back of the main door. The invention can be widely applied to the upgrading and reconstruction of the fireproof door in various occasions, can realize the quick synchronous opening of the sub door and the main door on the premise of meeting the normal fire-fighting requirement, not only ensures the effective clear width of an evacuation channel, but also reduces the occupation of other channels after the fireproof door is opened outwards, and has the advantages of safety, reliability and low production cost.

title_en: Method for rapidly evaluating disaster-resistant toughness of highway section
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid evaluation method for disaster-resistant toughness of a highway section, and belongs to the field of infrastructure disaster-resistant toughness evaluation. The method comprises the following steps: s1: selecting a survey road section; s2: acquiring the traffic volume of the section of the road section before and after a disaster, the initial construction cost and time, the post-disaster repair/reconstruction cost and time and the passing time of the adjacent replaceable road section from a road section operation management and maintenance mechanism; s3: determining the weight w of the comprehensive evaluation index of the toughness of each disaster according to the independent scores of the influence degree of each disaster on the evaluation road section by the p experts  i  (ii) a S4: calculating a traffic volume reduction ratio, a recovery degree and a substitution degree of the representative section; s5: calculating a road section disaster-resistant toughness overall evaluation index CRI; s6: converting the overall evaluation index CRI into a standard criterial CRI  Sign board  And determining the evaluation road section disaster-resistant toughness grade. The method improves the speed and the accuracy of evaluating the disaster-resistant toughness of the highway section, and can be used as reference for operation management, maintenance and technical consultation mechanismsThe preparation method is used.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS RES & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-channel antenna array amplitude-phase error and DOA joint estimation method under non-uniform noise
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-channel antenna array amplitude-phase error and DOA joint estimation method under non-uniform noise, which comprises the steps of reconstructing a covariance matrix of an array received signal by utilizing a covariance fitting criterion, and homogenizing noise to obtain the covariance matrix of the array received signal under uniform noise; establishing an objective function by utilizing an array receiving signal covariance matrix under uniform noise to perform coarse estimation on the amplitude error and DOA; the phase error is estimated in combination with the subspace characteristic and the coarse estimate of DOA. On the basis, the sampling covariance matrix of the received data is compensated and corrected, and the DOA high-precision estimation is further completed. The novel multi-channel antenna array amplitude-phase error and DOA joint estimation method under non-uniform noise does not need prior knowledge of DOA and array error and iteration, and avoids the problem of dimension disaster faced by multi-dimensional parameter optimization and the problem of local optimal point involved in the high-dimension optimization process.

title_en: Efficient sensor signal acquisition and processing device and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency sensor signal acquisition and processing device and a processing method thereof, wherein the device comprises a wireless sensor, a wireless receiver, a gateway, a processing sensor, an alarm and a wireless power supply; the wireless sensor is used for acquiring seismic signals, the acquired signals are subjected to denoising processing, the signals reaching an early warning value are subjected to early warning, simple denoising processing is performed on the signals through the GPS front-end module, the simply processed signals are transmitted to the processing sensor, interference signals and noise are removed through inherent modal decomposition, the remaining signals are reconstructed, the accuracy of the signals is improved, the reconstructed signals are transmitted into the alarm to reach the early warning value, and the alarm gives an alarm, so that early warning is performed on the occurrence of secondary seismic disasters, and the loss of the secondary disasters can be reduced to the minimum.

title_en: Optimal conservation power distribution network recovery method based on information decision and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal conservative power distribution network recovery method based on information decision and a storage medium, wherein an uncertain parameter is defined and a robustness function is required to be used for determining a risk avoidance area of power distribution line interruption and the total damage length of the risk avoidance area, an optimal topology reconstruction method is realized through a linear optimization model, and a method for adjusting the input of the model through a new conservative selection algorithm is realized. The method comprises the steps of establishing a resilience model based on an information gap decision theory, establishing an execution method of the resilience model, establishing a new conservative degree selection method, optimizing the resource allocation of the distributed power supply, performing topology reconstruction and the like. The method for recovering the power distribution network under the extreme uncertainty of the natural disaster is realized, the reliability and the recovery force of the power distribution network can be obviously improved, the optimal optimization effect can be obtained under the limited budget, and meanwhile, the tolerance to the length of the power failure line is improved under the same load level.

title_en: Building material protection device for reconstruction after geological disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rebuild after geological disasters and use building material protector, including manual formula telescopic link, roof and installation casing, solar energy silicon crystal board is installed at the top of roof, installs infrared ray LED remote control lamp and battery board in first mounting groove and the second mounting groove respectively, and the installation casing is all installed to the both sides of roof, and the roll-up axostylus axostyle that the installation casing internal rotation installation extends, the roll-up has the waterproof cloth who extends the installation casing on the roll-up axostylus axostyle, and the manual formula is installed to the tip of roll-up axostylus axostyle and is waved the handle. The utility model discloses a waterproof cloth on the roll-up axostylus axostyle waves with manual formula and makes protector realize area's expansion to because waterproof cloth is soft texture, so the physique of protection also can change according to actual protection demand, and its effect lies in protecting more building materials.

title_en: Power system network reconstruction method based on comprehensive evaluation index
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system network reconstruction method based on comprehensive evaluation indexes, which comprises the steps of reducing the load flow threshold crossing according to a load flow threshold crossing circuit and a network adjustment strategy, and searching to obtain an alternative path; determining a grid-connected loop closing circuit according to the alternative path, performing load recovery strategy control weakening a closing angle according to the alternative path and a phase angle of the grid-connected loop closing circuit, and determining a circuit recovery sequence in the alternative path; calculating a first evaluation index comprising a line operation reliability, a load flow out-of-limit reduction degree and a closing phase angle difference reduction degree according to a line recovery sequence, constructing a comprehensive evaluation index of an alternative path, and determining an optimal closed-loop path according to the comprehensive evaluation index and the alternative path; and according to the optimal closed-loop path, carrying out network recovery on the power system, and realizing network reconstruction of the power system. According to the embodiment, the network architecture of the power system is optimized, the power recovery strategy is improved, and the transient steady-state operation stability of the power system after disaster is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact reconstruction method and system for falling stone impact force
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-contact reconstruction method and a non-contact reconstruction system for falling stone impact force, which relate to the field of intelligent monitoring of geological disaster protection structures, and comprise the following steps: collecting a whole-process moving image sequence of the falling stone impact protection net; inputting the falling stone moving image sequence into a falling stone moving track prediction model, and outputting a falling stone track corresponding to the falling stone moving image sequence; the falling stone movement track prediction model is obtained by training a deep neural network; the falling stone track is a movement track of falling stones falling onto the protective net until the falling stones are separated from the protective net; reconstructing the dynamic impact force of the falling rocks impacting the protective net according to the falling rocks track and the impact angles of the falling rocks in each falling rocks moving image. The invention solves the problem that the contact sensing technology is easy to be damaged by falling stone impact, and reduces the monitoring difficulty.

title_en: Multidirectional stretching composite damping energy dissipation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidirectional stretching composite damping energy consumption device, relates to the field of house reconstruction and reinforcement technology and disaster prevention and reduction, and aims to solve the problems of large residual deformation, serious component damage and the like of the conventional house reinforcement. The combined energy consumption device comprises an outer sleeve, an inner sleeve, SMA tows, a viscoelastic energy consumption material, a spring and a nut. The self-resetting and high-energy-consumption capabilities required by the swinging component are realized by adopting the stretching deformation of the SMA tows and the shearing deformation of the viscoelastic energy-consumption material, the advantages of the two materials are cooperatively exerted, the bidirectional stretching deformation of the SMA tows is realized, the stretching efficiency of the SMA tows is effectively improved, and meanwhile, the viscoelastic energy-consumption material is compounded, so that the self-resetting and energy-consumption damping effects are realized, and the energy-consumption capability of the whole device is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI RES INSTITUTE OF BUILDING SCIENCES CO LTD;SHANGHAI JIANKE PRESTRESSED TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire fighting helmet
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligence fire helmet relates to intelligence and dresses technical field. This intelligence fire helmet includes: helmet shell body and the interior casing of nestification in the helmet shell body, and form helmet intermediate layer between interior casing and the helmet shell body, set up the main control board in the helmet intermediate layer that shell plane portion corresponds, wherein: the main control board is respectively and electrically connected with the battery module, the antenna module and the sensor module which are arranged in the helmet interlayer; the helmet shell body sets up camera, night walk lamp and audio playback module on the helmet shell body of brim of a hat top in the front, and camera and audio playback module pass through helmet intermediate layer electric connection main control board respectively, and night walk lamp passes through helmet intermediate layer electric connection battery module. The intelligent fire-fighting helmet can improve the accuracy, rescue timeliness and rescue intelligence for judging the rescue scene condition.
assignees: SHENZHEN YIYUN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flow guiding slope of mountain road
abstract_en: The invention discloses a guide slope of a mountain-by-side road, aiming at providing a guide slope for guiding falling rocks, debris flow or avalanche and the like to leave a road surface, so that the safety of the road surface and vehicles and pedestrians is effectively protected when a disaster happens; particularly, when disasters such as debris flow and the like occur, the good trafficability characteristic of the invention has obvious social significance compared with the prior road. The technical points of the invention are as follows: and a plate-type reinforced concrete or steel diversion slope is built above the pavement of the mountain-side road section and used for guiding debris flow and the like to pass along the diversion slope and avoid falling onto the pavement. The flow guiding slope of the mountain-side road is suitable for the construction and reconstruction of highways and railways.

title_en: Hydrogen production network operation method considering exiting of coal-fired unit and gas station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrogen production network operation method considering the exit of a coal-fired unit and a gas station. S1, establishing a low-carbon transformation model of a power system with the aim of minimum withdrawal cost of a coal-fired unit, construction cost of a power line, investment cost of new energy and power generation operation cost and maximum reduction of carbon emission; s2, optimizing and solving the model through a genetic algorithm; s3, determining a low carbon emission node through a carbon emission model, building a hydrogen production station on the node, and coupling a power grid, a gas grid and a hydrogen network into a comprehensive energy grid; s4, establishing a comprehensive energy low-carbon reconstruction model with the aim of minimum withdrawal cost of a gas station, pipeline construction cost, operation cost of a hydrogen addition station and hydrogen production cost of buying electricity and buying gas and maximum reduction of carbon emission; s5, optimizing and solving the model through a genetic algorithm. The method reduces the running cost of the comprehensive energy network and the carbon emission of the hydrogen energy supply side of the electric automobile, and has important significance for replacing traditional coal and petroleum resources and promoting the development of the hydrogen energy automobile.

title_en: A Emergency Escape Suit In Case Of Fire Equipped With Location Signal Function, Fire Extinguishing Device, Solid Oxygen, And Gas Filter.
title_ko: 위치발생신호기능과 소화 장치, 고체산소, 방독필터가 구비된 화재시의 비상탈출 복.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to emergency escape clothing equipped with a danger signal generation function for emergency evacuation, an oxygen respirator, a light bulb, and the like. If a fire breaks out and an emergency evacuation to a safe area is required, the present invention allows wearers to breathe by receiving oxygen even in the toxic gases generated during the fire and easily recognize the evacuation route with the light of a lantern in thick smoke or darkness due to interruption of electricity supply, and generates the location of evacuees through an electronic circuit while enabling quick and safe evacuation from the fire. Every year, after a fire causes casualties, interest in ways to respond quickly to fires and large-scale disasters is increasing. In such cases, rapid evacuation must take priority, and if a danger signal generator, a light bulb, a fire extinguisher, and an oxygen respirator are provided as rescue equipment for rapid evacuation in the event of a fire, many lives will be saved. Therefore, in the event of a fire, the present invention is to suppress the flames with a fire extinguisher and to allow wearers to avoid the smoke using clothing made of non-combustible fibers through oxygen supply and safely and quickly move over to a safe place. Also, in special situations where it is impossible to move from the scene of a fire, the wearer's location is generated via radio waves while waiting for rescuers and receiving oxygen.
abstract_ko:
화재가 발생하여 안전지대까지 긴급 대피가 필요한 경우, 화재 시 발생하는 유독가스 속에서도 산소를 공급받아 숨을 쉬면서 짙은 연기 혹은 전기공급 중단에 따른 암흑 상태에서 랜턴의 불빛으로 대피 로를 원활히 인지하며, 대피자의 위치를 전자회로를 통해 발생시키고, 불길 속을 신속하고 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 한 긴급 대피용 위험발생신호와 산소호흡기 및 전구 등을 기타 장치를 겸비한 비상탈출 복에 관한 것이다. 
매년 화재로 인명피해 사고가 발생한 이후에 화재 및 대형 재난 사고시에 신속하게 대처할 수 있는 방안에 대한 관심이 고조되고 있는 실정이며, 
이와 같은 경우에는 신속한 대피가 우선해야 하는 바, 이처럼 화재 발생시에 신속한 대피를 위한 구호장비로 위험신호발생신호기와 전구, 소화기통 및 산소호흡기가 비치된다면, 많은 인명을 구할 수 있게 될 것이다. 
따라서, 화재발생 시 화염을 소화기통으로 제압하고, 연기는 산소공급을 통한 불연섬유로 만든 옷 등으로 난관을 안전하고 신속하게 넘어 안전지역까지 신속하게 이동하는 데 필요하고, 화재현장에서 이동할 수 없는 특수 상황에서 자신의 위치를 전파로 발생시키며, 산소를 공급받으면서 안전요원들을 기다리는 비상탈출 복을 제공하는 데 있다.

title_en: Flexible connecting assembly of frame structure and filler wall and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible connecting assembly of a frame structure and a filler wall and a construction method thereof, and relates to the field of house reconstruction reinforcement and earthquake prevention and disaster reduction. The flexible connecting assembly of the frame structure and the filler wall comprises a structure beam, a structure column, an air-adding block, mortar, a constraint reinforcing steel bar, a viscous filling material, an embedded plate, a pin shaft, a constraint plate, a wedge-shaped rubber corner protector and a fixer. The invention can effectively release the rigid connection between the filler wall and the frame column, reduce the deformation constraint of the filler wall on the beam column node of the frame structure, reduce the plastic damage of the frame structure and the filler wall body when the structure is deformed greatly, and improve the integral shock resistance of the structure. Meanwhile, energy dissipation and shock absorption of the whole structure are realized by utilizing shearing and compression deformation of the viscous filling material and the wedge-shaped rubber corner protector, and the energy dissipation and shock absorption device has the advantages of simplicity and convenience in installation and maintenance, low manufacturing cost, stability in operation and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI RES INSTITUTE OF BUILDING SCIENCES CO LTD;SHANGHAI JIANKE PRESTRESSED TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: A Safe Room With Steam Room And Stress Relief Function
title_ko: 찜질방과 스트레스해소 기능을 설치한 세이프 룸
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safe room for safe evacuation from disasters such as earthquakes, fires, and invasion of burglars and, more specifically, to a safe room with stress relief functions such as a steam room and a karaoke room, in which incombustible materials are installed on a front side of the inside of the safe room, and oxygen cylinders and water bottles are installed and a pressure measuring device for the oxygen cylinders and a charging device for batteries are installed. In the event of a fire, it is important for evacuees to survive safely. According to Korea fire law, emergency escapes are allowed in public facilities capable of accommodating people and in buildings having a certain size or more, and installation of space for devices is mandatory. Thus, a safe room to evacuate in the event of a disaster and a safe room used for various purposes in normal times are required. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a safe room, which is used, in a daily life, for purposes such as steam rooms, karaoke rooms, and disease prevention rooms, and evacuees wait for rescue from the outside when the evacuees cannot quickly escape in the event of an earthquake or disaster and to provide a safe room, which evacuees can notify of a location thereof using radio waves in special situations where the evacuees cannot move from a fire scene, can wait for safety guards while receiving oxygen, can preserve life from invasion of robbers, and can wait for rescue from the outside.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진이나 화재, 강도의 침입 등의 재난으로부터 안전하게 대피하기 위한 세이프 룸에 관한 것이며, 보다 상세하게는, 내측의 전면이 불연재가 설치되며, 산소통과 생수; 상기 산소통의 압력측정 장치와 배터리의 충전장치 등이 설치되며, 찜질방, 노래방 등 스트레스해소 기능이 설치된 세이프 룸에 관한 것이다. 
이처럼 화재 발생 시 대피 자는 안전하게 생존하는 것이 중요하기 때문에 우리나라의 소방법 상에 사람을 수용할 수 있는 공공시설은 물론, 일정 크기 이상의 건물에는 비상 탈출을 할 수 있고, 그 장치의 공간 설치가 의무화 되어 있어, 재난 시 대피할 세이프 룸이 필요함과 동시에 평상시 다른 용도로 활용 효과가 가능한 다목적 세이프 룸이 필요하다. 
본 발명의 목적은 일상에는 찜질방 또는 노래방, 질병 예방 실 등의 목적으로 활용하다가 지진 또는 재난 시신속한 탈출이 불가능할 경우, 안전한 곳에서 외부로 구조를 기다릴 안전한 세이프 룸을 제공하며, 화재현장에서 이동할 수 없는 특수 상황에서 자신의 위치를 전파로 발생시키며, 산소를 공급받으면서 안전요원들을 기다리는 한편, 강도의 침입으로부터 생명을 보존하며, 외부로부터 구조를 기다릴 수 있는 세이프 룸을 제공하는 데 있다.

title_en: Container disaster tolerance method, system, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a container disaster recovery method, a system, a device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which are applied to the technical field of disaster recovery, wherein the method is applied to a first container cluster and comprises the steps of receiving a disaster recovery backup command issued by a container management platform; responding to the disaster recovery backup command, copying the container application metadata to obtain first disaster recovery data, and storing the first disaster recovery data to the first storage system, so that the second container cluster can reconstruct the container application by using the first disaster recovery data in the first storage system to obtain a reconstructed container application; and copying the container service data to obtain second disaster tolerance data, and storing the second disaster tolerance data to a second storage system, so that the second container cluster utilizes the second disaster tolerance data in the second storage system to perform container service recovery in the reconstruction container application, and obtain the recovered container service. The technical scheme can realize efficient and flexible container disaster recovery and ensure the quick recovery of the container service.
assignees: JINAN INSPUR DATA TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Composite thermal insulation material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite heat-insulating material, which is prepared from sodium hydroxide, diatomite, vitrified micro bubbles, magnesium sulfate, calcium chloride, sawn wood ash, inorganic mineral fiber, polyvinyl alcohol, sepiolite powder, sodium silicate, acrylic acid and calcium carbonate; the invention is environment-friendly and nontoxic, does not contain harmful components to human bodies, and is suitable for external wall external heat preservation, external wall internal heat preservation, individual wall heat preservation and heat insulation and energy-saving engineering of roofs, basements, garages, stairs, corridors, fire fighting passageways and the like of various wall base materials of newly-built, reconstructed and expanded public buildings and civil buildings in severe cold, hot in summer and cold in winter and hot in summer and warm in winter.
assignees: SHANDONG SHENGGEWEI NEW ENERGY SAVING INSULATION MAT CO LTD

title_en: Non-face-to-face rhythm training device and method
title_ko: 비대면 율동 교육 장치 및 비대면 율동 교육 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a non-face-to-face rhythmic dance training device for providing non-face-to-face rhythmic dance training to a trainee via a network. The non-face-to-face rhythmic dance training device comprises: at least one student system for inputting biometric data of the trainee, playing music, reproducing a three-dimensional rhythmic dance, and recording and transmitting a rhythmic dance video of the trainee; and an instructor system for storing individual learning information of each of the trainee and multiple levels of three-dimensional rhythmic dance data corresponding to the individual learning information of the trainee, retrieving individual learning information of each of the trainees from biometric data of the trainees received from the student system, and transmitting three-dimensional rhythmic dance data corresponding to the individual learning information to the student system. The non-face-to-face rhythmic dance training device has the effect of improving learning efficiency by allowing an instructor to interact with trainees as if the instructor were present in the field even in a non-face-to-face situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 네트워크를 통해 피교육생에게 비대면으로 율동 교육을 하는 비대면 율동 교육 장치에 있어서, 상기 피교육생의 생체 데이터를 입력하고, 음악을 재생하고, 입체 율동을 재현하며, 상기 피교육생의 율동 동영상을 촬영하여 전송하는 적어도 하나의 학생 시스템과, 상기 피교육생 각각의 개별 학습 정보 및 상기 피교육생의 개별 학습 정보에 대응하는 다수 단계의 입체 율동 데이터를 저장하고, 상기 학생 시스템으로부터 수신한 상기 피교육생의 생체 데이터로부터 상기 피교육생의 개별 학습 정보를 검색하여 상기 개별 학습 정보에 대응하는 입체 율동 데이터를 상기 학생 시스템에 송하는 강사 시스템을 포함하는 비대면 율동 교육 장치를 제공함으로써, 비대면인 상황에서도 강사가 현장에 있는 것과 같이 피교육생과 교감하면서 학습 능률을 높일 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A Safe Room Equipped With Virus Sterilization Air Shower And Indoor Air Purification Using Ion Wind
title_ko: 바이러스 살균 에어샤워장치와 이온 풍을 이용한 실내공기 정화장치 기능이 설치된 세이프 룸
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safe room for safely escaping from a disaster such as earthquake, fire, a raid, and the like and, more specifically, to a safe room, which has an inside front surface with non-combustible materials, has an oxygen tank, water, a pressure measurement device of the oxygen tank, a battery charging device, and the like, and is equipped with a virus sterilization air shower room and a household indoor virus sterilization and purification function. Since it is important for evacuees to survive safely in case of a fire, it is required to not only have a public facility that can accommodate people under the Korean Fire Protection Act but also have a multi-purpose safe room that can enable an emergency escape, serve as a safe room in case of a disaster, and be used for other purposes at ordinary times. An objective of the present invention is to provide a safe room serving as a safe place for waiting for rescue from the outside when quick escape is not possible in case of a disaster such as an earthquake while being used, at ordinary times, as a room for removing viruses contaminated when going out and being used as a virus sterilization air purifier of a household. Accordingly, the present invention can generate radio waves to enable a person to inform a position of the person in a specific situation where the person cannot move in a fire, wait for rescue workers while receiving oxygen, protect the life from a raid, and wait for rescue from the outside.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진이나 화재, 강도의 침입 등의 재난으로부터 안전하게 대피하기 위한 세이프 룸에 관한 것이며, 보다 상세하게는, 내측의 전면이 불연재가 설치되며, 산소통과 생수; 상기 산소통의 압력측정 장치와 배터리의 충전장치 등이 설치되며, 바이러스 살균 에어샤워 룸과 주거공간의 실내 바이러스 살균 정화 기능이 설치된 세이프 룸에 관한 것이다. 
이처럼 화재 발생 시 대피 자는 안전하게 생존하는 것이 중요하기 때문에 우리나라의 소방법 상에 사람을 수용할 수 있는 공공시설은 물론, 일정 크기 이상의 건물에는 비상 탈출을 할 수 있고, 재난 시 대피할 세이프 룸이 필요함과 동시에 평상시 다른 용도로 활용 효과가 가능한 다목적 세이프 품이 필요하며, 본 발명의 목적은 일상에는 외출 시 오염되는 바이러스 제거룸과 주거공간의 바이러스 살균공기정화기의 목적으로 활용하다가 지진 또는 재난 시신속한 탈출이 불가능할 경우, 안전한 곳에서 외부로 구조를 기다릴 안전한 세이프 룸을 제공하며, 화재현장에서 이동할 수 없는 특수 상황에서 자신의 위치를 전파로 발생시키며, 산소를 공급받으면서 안전요원들을 기다리는 한편, 강도의 침입으로부터 생명을 보존하며, 외부로부터 구조를 기다릴 수 있는 세이프 룸을 제공하는 데 있다.

title_en: Method for evaluating indirect damage of disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster indirect loss assessment method, which comprehensively considers the influence of the supply and the demand of fixed assets such as house plant equipment, traffic infrastructure and the like on each industry of an economic system after the fixed assets are damaged due to a disaster and a large number of people are damaged due to the disaster and cannot participate in production service, dynamically assesses the continuous indirect loss suffered by the economic system from the occurrence of the disaster to the complete completion of recovery and reconstruction, and monitors the recovery characteristics of the economic system in a disaster area in the post-disaster recovery and reconstruction period, thereby better improving the formulation of post-disaster emergency rescue and recovery and reconstruction strategies. The comprehensiveness and accuracy of natural disaster economic loss evaluation can be improved in mechanism, indirect disaster economic loss evaluation is supplemented, and the absolute value risk of the disaster is quantitatively represented by the height of economic loss. The invention can make the determination of the disaster insurance premium of the insurance industry more scientific and reasonable, and can promote the development of the disaster insurance industry to a certain extent.

title_en: Portable active millimeter wave imager for fire protection and imaging method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable active millimeter wave imager for fire fighting and an imaging method thereof, belonging to the technical field of fire fighting and disaster relief equipment. According to the invention, a sparse array two-dimensional electric scanning principle is adopted, broadband millimeter wave signals are transmitted, then algorithm reconstruction is carried out on echo signals, information of a horizontal dimension, a vertical dimension and a distance dimension of an object can be detected, a three-dimensional image is constructed and is matched with the actual environment of a site, the difficulty of blocking the sight of the site is overcome, more information can be provided compared with common optical and infrared two-dimensional images, and the development of fire fighting and disaster relief work is facilitated; and a millimeter wave two-dimensional sparse array architecture is adopted, no mechanical scanning structure is adopted, and the portability of the equipment is greatly improved.
assignees: BRAINWARE TERAHERTZ INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Recorded physical interaction playback
abstract_en: A method is explained. The method, in a simulated environment, comprises the steps of: obtaining records of one or more physical interactions performed in relation to one or more physical components; playing the records to make one or more physical interactions appear in the simulated environment; and detecting, in the simulated environment, user interaction with one or more physical components of the simulated environment. The method further comprises the steps of: determining whether the user interaction matches at least one corresponding physical interaction of one or more physical interactions in the records; and continuing the playback of the records in the simulated environment in response to the match.
abstract_ko: 방법이 설명되어 있다.  방법은, 시뮬레이션 환경에서, 나 이상의 물리적 구성요소와 관련하여 수행된 하나 이상의 물리적 상호작용들의 기록을 획득하는 단계, 하나 이상의 물리적 상호작용들이 시뮬레이션 환경에 나타나도록 기록을 재생하는 단계, 및 시뮬레이션 환경에서, 시뮬레이션 환경의 하나 이상의 물리적 컴포넌트들과의 사용자 상호작용을 검출하는 단계를 포함한다.  이 방법은 사용자 상호작용이 기록에서 하나 이상의 물리적 상호작용들의 적어도 하나의 대응하는 물리적 상호작용과 일치하는지 여부를 결정하는 단계, 및 그러한 일치에 응답하여, 시뮬레이션 환경에서 기록의 재생을 계속하는 단계를 더 포함한다.

title_en: Ecological reconstruction method for hillock and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hillock ecological reconstruction method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of environmental management and ecological restoration. The method comprises the steps of extinguishing fire and preventing reburning of the gangue dump system; shaping and draining the mountain; constructing an ecological system; the ecological system construction method comprises the following steps: and spraying a matrix layer, a shrub seed layer and a wood fiber surface covering layer on the surface of the gangue layer in sequence, and spraying Bacillus belief bacteria liquid between the shrub seed layer and the wood fiber surface covering layer to perform vegetation maintenance management. The method can effectively reduce soil pollution and dust pollution of the waste rock hills, reduce potential safety hazards such as landslide and spontaneous combustion explosion of the hills and realize vegetation recovery and ecological management of the waste rock hills.

title_en: Rapid three-dimensional terrain reconstruction method for emergency disaster field
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of three-dimensional reconstruction, in particular to a rapid three-dimensional terrain reconstruction method facing an emergency disaster site, which comprises the following steps: s1, synchronously coding video and unmanned aerial vehicle POS data at an onboard end according to an emergency disaster data acquisition requirement; s2, the ground terminal acquires the data after synchronous coding and carries out decoding processing on the data; s3, acquiring camera calibration data and extracting key frames of the real-time video according to the decoded POS data; s4, initializing the stereoscopic model by combining POS data; s5, matching the key frames and performing integral optimization by using a light beam method to obtain position and attitude data of each key frame and point cloud corresponding to the characteristic points; and S6, matching each pixel point in the image of the point cloud model obtained in the S5 by adopting a parallel dense matching technology to obtain a three-dimensional model of the reaction terrain. The invention utilizes the integration of POS information, SLAM technology, parallel dense matching and point cloud matching technology to rapidly realize the three-dimensional terrain reconstruction of the acquired image area, and solves the defect that the rapid three-dimensional reconstruction of an emergency disaster field is difficult to realize by the traditional method at present.

title_en: Lightning early warning distinguishing and releasing method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightning early warning distinguishing and relieving method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: reconstructing radar monitoring data and lightning positioning data; outputting and analyzing, updating the statistical area of the radar parameter data in real time according to the ground flash, and only counting the change rate of each parameter in the ground flash range; obtaining an inference of the duration of the thunderstorm activity process by adopting multiple linear regression analysis on a plurality of independent variables; the invention predicts or estimates the dependent variable by the optimal combination of a plurality of independent variables, is more effective than the prediction or estimation by only one independent variable, is more practical, and can more accurately infer the thunderstorm activity process, thereby predicting and obtaining the life cycle of the thunderstorm activity, enabling the thunderstorm activity to occupy initiative in front of natural disasters, and making relevant countermeasures in advance, thereby playing a vital role in practical application.

title_en: Disaster recovery backup method and related device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a disaster recovery backup method, which comprises the steps of mirroring real-time flow on a service line to a disaster recovery backup server; the method comprises the steps of monitoring the state of an online service of a business, triggering a disaster recovery backup server to intercept a request based on an interceptor when the online service of the business is monitored to have a fault, wherein the request is a stateless request, acquiring request information meeting an interception condition, and storing the request information and a timestamp corresponding to the request into a text file; and after the on-line service of the business is monitored to be recovered to be normal, closing the request interception of the disaster recovery backup server, and replaying the backup request in the set time window through a request replay interface provided by the disaster recovery backup server according to the time stamp of the request. The disaster recovery backup method is light backup, can realize individualized backup of stateless requests, and is low in cost. The embodiment of the invention also relates to a disaster recovery backup device, computer equipment and a storage medium.
assignees: GUANGZHOU DIANJINSHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-intrusive disaster recovery and resilience
abstract_en: A tool for network-based package monitoring and recovery. The tool scans a database to identify a gap in network traffic data. The tool determines whether at least one gap in the network traffic data is identified in the database, wherein the at least one gap is a gap in communication between a target device and a communication serve. Responsive to a determination that at least one gap in the network traffic data is identified, the tool determines a missing package from a package archive. The tool determines whether there is active network traffic between the target device and the communication server. Responsive to a determination that there is active network traffic between the target device and the communication server, the tool replays the missing package in the active network traffic between the target device and the communication server.

title_en: Distribution network toughness planning method considering distributed energy storage emergency power supply capacity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for planning toughness of a power distribution network by considering distributed energy storage emergency power supply capacity, which comprehensively considers fault state models of lines, towers and wind driven generator towers in a power distribution system and carries out detailed analysis on fault rates of different devices; comprehensively considering post-disaster network topology reconstruction and post-disaster first-aid repair schemes, fully considering the response condition of the power distribution network in the whole process of coming of a typhoon disaster, and selecting configuration energy storage as a toughness planning and improving scheme and a corresponding toughness index; and comprehensively determining a line reinforcing scheme and an energy storage configuration scheme based on a network reconstruction scheme and a post-disaster first-aid repair scheme. The method deeply compares different toughness planning schemes, comprehensively analyzes the power supply relation, weak links and reinforcement requirements of the power distribution network, determines an energy storage configuration strategy according to the regional differences of different regions, obtains an optimal line reinforcement scheme and an optimal energy storage configuration scheme based on an inner-outer double-layer planning model, and checks and examines the effect of a promotion strategy.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH;UNIV GUANGXI;GUANGXI MINHAI ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Mobile fire extinguisher with solar generator
title_ko: 태양열 발전기를 갖는 이동식 포소화 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile foam fire extinguishing device which is installed in an outdoor dangerous material facility place or on a fire extinguishing target to be protected from a fire to quickly extinguish a fire when the fire occurs. According to the present invention, the mobile foam fire extinguishing device with a solar power generator comprises: a main body consisting of a cuboid case and having a first door, a second door, and a third door on the front surface thereof; a water tank installed on the rear surface in the main body and receiving water from a feeding hole formed in an upper portion thereof to use the water as fire water; an engine pump connected to the water tank, operated by driving an engine, and pumping the water of the water tank; a foam tank formed on one side of the front surface of the main body to instantly mix and transport foam fire extinguishing chemicals and water transported by pumping of the engine pump; a hose connector formed to connect a fire hose to a transport pipe positioned on an upper portion of the foam tank to function as a mixer to mix foam fire extinguishing chemicals and water by a siphon method to spray foam fire water to a fire site; a solar heat collection plate installed on the upper surface of an upper cover of the main body to generate electricity to supply electricity required to drive the engine and the engine pump pumping the water of the water tank; a solar controller installed on one side of the main body to store and control the electricity generated by the solar heat collection plate; and a pressure gauge and opening/closing valve installed on a transport pipe connected to an outlet on one side pumped and discharged from the engine pump. The engine pump and the water tank are connected by a flexible pipe.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 야외의 위험물 시설장소 또는 화재로부터 보호해야 할 소방대상물 등에 설치하여 화재시 신속하게 진압할 수 있도록 한 이동식 포소화장치에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 이동식 포소화 장치는, 전면에 제1도어, 제2도어 제3도어를 갖고 직육면체의 함체로 이루어진 본체와; 상기 본체 내의 후면에 설치되고 상부에 형성된 투입홀로부터 물을 공급받아 소화수로 사용될 수 있도록 된 물탱크와; 상기 물탱크와 연결되고 엔진의 구동에 의해 작동되면서 물탱크의 물을 펌핑하는 엔진펌프와; 상기 엔진펌프의 펌핑에 의해 이송되는 물과 포소화약제가 즉석에서 혼합 이송되도록 본체 전면 일측에 형성된 포탱크와; 상기 포탱크 상부에 위치한 이송배관에 소방호스가 연결되도록 형성되어 포소화약제와 물을 사이폰 방식으로 혼합시켜 포소방수를 화재현장에 살포할 수 있도록 혼합기역할을 하는 호스연결구와; 상기 본체의 상부커버 상면에 설치되어 물탱크의 물을 펌핑하는 엔진 및 엔진펌프 구동에 필요한 전기를 공급할 수 있도록 전기를 발전하는 태양열집열판과; 상기 태양열집열판에서 발전된 전기를 저장 및 제어할 수 있도록 본체 일측에 설치된 솔라컨트롤러와; 상기 엔진펌프로부터 펌핑되어 토출되는 일측 토출구와 연결된 이송배관에 설치된 압력게이지 및 개폐밸브와; 상기 엔진펌프와 물탱크는 후렉쉬관으로 열결된 태양열 발전기를 갖는 이동식 포소화 장치를 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Disaster recovery method and system for dynamic disk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery method and a disaster recovery system for a dynamic disk, wherein the method comprises the following steps: recording the corresponding relation between the dynamic volume of the production environment and the disk identifier, and storing the corresponding relation into a file; creating a mirror image disc corresponding to the dynamic volume, wherein the size of the mirror image disc is the size of the dynamic volume plus the size of the partition table, constructing a partition table structure, initializing and backing up data of the dynamic volume to the mirror image disc, and monitoring the I/O change of the dynamic volume in real time by a volume filter driver and writing the I/O change into the mirror image disc; during takeover, a virtual disk is constructed based on real-time backup data, provided to a virtualization platform for creating a disaster recovery machine, and enters a repair environment; and the disaster recovery tool activates the guide partition, reconstructs the guide file and corrects the disk identifier, closes the disaster recovery machine after the execution is finished, changes the guide sequence, restarts the disaster recovery machine, and accesses the system to manage the service. The system comprises a backup module, a disaster recovery module and a repair module. The method and the system can reduce the disaster recovery cost and improve the success rate of the disaster recovery machine for taking over the service.
assignees: NANJING UNARY INFORMATION TECH INC LTD

title_en: Power transmission line icing monitoring method based on infrared image processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission line icing monitoring method based on infrared image processing, which is technically characterized by comprising the following steps of: acquiring infrared images of corresponding lines which are easy to cover ice by an infrared image acquisition device; the information processing station receives the infrared image acquired by the infrared image acquisition device, inputs the infrared image into a trained infrared image super-resolution reconstruction training model based on the improved SRGAN model, and obtains a line conductor infrared image with a more obvious boundary; comparing the infrared image with improved resolution with the infrared image of the line conductor in the non-icing state, and calculating the icing shape and the icing thickness of the line conductor; and if the icing shape and the icing thickness exceed the safe icing threshold value, related information is sent to the information interaction center, and the monitoring function of the icing of the power transmission line is realized. The invention has reasonable design, can effectively monitor and early warn the icing condition of the power transmission line, prevents the icing disaster of the power transmission line and ensures the operation reliability of the power transmission line.
assignees: STATE GRID JILINSHENG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: 15GHz full outdoor active phased array microwave transmission equipment for emergency communication
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a microwave transmission technology field especially relates to a 15GHz full outdoor active phased array microwave transmission equipment for emergency communication, adopts first transmission beam forming module to carry out beam forming with the upper sideband signal that the up-conversion module sent, and first receipt beam forming module carries out beam forming with the signal that antenna array element sent, carries out quick beam reconstruction in 15s, realizes antenna automatic alignment and tracking; the GPS, 5G and WiFi modules are combined with the active phased array antenna, so that the system can be used for GPS positioning function application of tourist attractions, earthquakes and fire rescue, 5G function application of data information transmission by using a base station and wireless network function application of system upgrading and engineering installation and debugging.

title_en: Thoracic vibration simulator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thorax vibration sense simulator relates to playback devices technical field, including the resin base, the fixed surface of resin base has the aluminium post, the surface sliding connection of aluminium post has long spring, the strong magnetic vibrator of neodymium iron boron and short spring, the outside of long spring and the strong magnetic vibrator of neodymium iron boron is provided with the hoop, the surface of hoop is provided with the coil, the surface of coil is provided with heat-resisting resin shell, there is power amplifier on the surface of coil through the line connection, the other end of the relative coil of power amplifier is connected with the audio line, the utility model discloses a thorax vibrations that vibration unit reduction stereo set drive, fireworks explosion, engine rumble and cause increase user's sense of hearing and immerse the sense, and fixed through the bandage, can conveniently adjust the elasticity, guarantee that the user wears comfortablely.

title_en: Power distribution network and drainage basin network emergency linkage decision method considering storm time-space diversity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and drainage basin network emergency linkage decision method considering the storm time-space distinction, which fills the technical blank of the current risk blocking method of the urban power distribution network and drainage basin network and the emergency linkage decision high-efficiency solving algorithm; the invention provides a dynamic zoning algorithm of a rainfall area projected by a hypercube space, and forms rainfall intensity probability density functions of all subregions according to historical rainfall data; establishing a distribution network reconstruction model integrating emergency power supply vehicle dispatching, and constructing a power-off-hydrodynamic network risk emergency linkage dispatching model with uncertain storm time and space so as to realize risk blocking of an urban distribution network and a river basin network under a storm disaster; the high-dimensional nonlinear constraint of the river basin network is converted into the convex constraint by adopting the convex relaxation technology, and a two-stage boundary tightening solving algorithm is provided for the network risk emergency linkage scheduling model, so that the solving process of the emergency linkage decision is more efficient.

title_en: Armored Vehicle for Fire Fighting Equipped Quick Coupler Capable of Quickly Combining Work Tools
title_ko: 작업도구의 신속한 결합이 가능한 퀵커플러를 구비하는 화재현장 진입용 장갑로봇
abstract_en: The present invention provides an armored robot for entering a fire scene having a quick coupler capable of rapid coupling of a work tool, which comprises: a vehicle body, in which a driver can board on a front side portion, having a plurality of boarding spaces in which a firefighter and a requester can board on a rear side portion; a crawler driving unit installed on both side edges of the vehicle body to stably drive on an irregular road surface; a robot arm installed on a front side of the vehicle body to move and transport an object to be moved; and a quick coupler configured to enable a work tool to be mounted in the robot arm for performing work required in a fire scene.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 내부의 전면부에 조종수가 탑승가능하고 내부의 후면부에 소방대원 및 요구조자가 탑승가능한 복수의 탑승공간을 포함하는 차체; 상기 차체의 양 측 가장자리에 설치되어 불규칙한 노면에도 안정적인 주행을 가능하게 하는 크롤러 구동부; 상기 차체의 전면에 설치되어 피이동대상의 이동 및 운반을 할 수 있도록 구성되는 로봇 암(arm); 및 화재현장에서 필요한 작업을 수행하기 위한 작업도구를 상기 로봇 암에 장착하도록 구성되는 퀵커플러를 포함하는 작업도구의 신속한 결합이 가능한 퀵커플러를 구비하는 화재현장 진입용 장갑로봇을 제공한다.
assignees: JIN WOO SMC INC CO LTD

title_en: Indoor fire evolution prediction method based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an indoor fire evolution prediction method and device based on a deep neural network, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing fire evolution simulation based on FDS, completing setting of physical model data and key parameters of the fire evolution model, establishing simulation data and fitting data of a preset fire scene, taking the simulation data as input, generating a temperature field diagram based on a preset first depth neural network model and a preset second depth neural network model, receiving field information when a fire happens, generating a predicted temperature field diagram based on the preset depth neural network model according to the field information, and completing prediction of fire evolution. According to the method, the input vector is reconstructed with high precision through the design of the two-stage deep neural network, and the simulation data of the field model are fitted, so that the instantaneity and the accuracy of fire evolution prediction are improved.

title_en: Reconstruction method for ground disaster dangerous case area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconstruction method of a ground disaster dangerous case area, which comprises the following steps: setting a geological disaster area and a public part of a minimum outsourcing rectangular frame of a rainfall amount set as a screening area; screening out a plurality of monotone chains based on the screening area; performing coarse-grained scanning on the monotone chains to obtain a monotone chain set with intersection points; and performing fine-grained intersection processing on the monotone chain set to obtain a plurality of target public parts, and performing region reconstruction on the target public parts. By adopting the method, the geological disaster area and meteorological data, the GIS and the scanning line algorithm can be combined, and the method is suitable for area reconstruction of multiple layers under complex situations.

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault recovery method, a system, equipment and a medium, comprising the following steps: and (3) establishing a two-stage robust optimization model for power distribution network fault recovery by considering uncertainty of wind power and photovoltaic output, and adopting a C & CG algorithm to iteratively solve a power distribution network reconstruction and load switching scheme. Firstly, in the first stage, according to the wind-light output predicted value, the operation variables such as the opening and closing state, the load recovery state and the like of a line are decided, and in the second stage, a wind-light output uncertainty set is constructed, the operation power of each distributed power supply is optimized, and the minimum economic loss cost and the load recovery plan under the worst scene are obtained. And (3) rapidly solving a two-stage model by using a C & CG algorithm, and alternately solving the main and sub problems until the model converges, so as to obtain an original problem optimal solution and determine a load recovery scheme. The method fully mobilizes the resources in the power distribution network, furthest recovers the power supply of the key load of the power distribution network, reduces the power failure economic loss caused by extreme weather disasters, and improves the toughness of the power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Operation replay system and operation method based on virtual DCS simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation replay system and an operation method based on a virtual DCS simulation training system, wherein the system comprises the following components: the system comprises an operator online operation module, a graphic editing module, an operation replay module, a dynamic characteristic and interactive characteristic definition script module, a page basic code module, an ActiveX control expansion module and a SimuRTS controller simulation module. The beneficial effect of this patent lies in: the invention uses the recording and playback management functions of the virtual DPU simulation software, can record each step of detailed process of the operation simulation machine by a learner, can adjust and take any time operation record playback to indicate the operation error of the learner, and carries out correct operation demonstration, thus truly realizing intelligent organic integration of simulation and industrial production, training a coach to record the standard process system operation or accident handling flow in advance, being used for simulation operation and accident exercise training of the operator, saving repeated operation time of the learner, reducing misoperation of the learner and reducing economic losses of enterprises and individuals.
assignees: DATANG WU AN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HANGZHOU HOLLYSYS AUTOMATION

title_en: Ecological reconstruction method for hard river bank
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological reconstruction method of a hard river bank, which comprises the steps of digging a channel, discharging a pipe, adjusting and installing water storage and paving greening. The ditch is to build a water storage ditch at the top end of the hard river bank. The lower pipe is provided with a plurality of through holes which are communicated with the river channel and are horizontally arranged in the water storage channel, and a water guide pipe is arranged in each through hole. The water storage adjusting installation is to install a plurality of water storage adjusting mechanisms in the water storage channel, and enable each water storage adjusting mechanism to correspond to the end part of each water guide pipe one by one. The laying greening is to lay a plurality of green planting boxes on the slope of the hard river bank, and connect and communicate any two adjacent green planting boxes to receive water led out by the water guide pipe. The ecological reconstruction method of the hard river bank can ensure diversity of ecological construction, resist flood disasters to a certain extent, ensure growth of green plants, ensure uniform irrigation of the green plants and have strong practicability.

title_en: Evaluation method for landslide range of earthquake-induced area
abstract_en: The application provides an evaluation method for landslide range of an earthquake induction area, which relates to the field of earthquake disaster evaluation and comprises the following steps: performing unit division on the area affected by the earthquake; classifying each unit into a potential landslide area and a non-landslide area according to the historical post-earthquake landslide data, so as to form an area to be detected; determining characteristic influence factors of landslide of an earthquake-induced area; after an earthquake occurs, respectively selecting landslide unit samples and non-landslide unit samples in a region to be detected to form training samples; constructing a machine learning model based on the characteristic influence factors and training samples, and performing model training; and evaluating landslide conditions of the region to be tested after the earthquake by using the machine learning model after training.
