The evaluation method can improve the prediction efficiency of the influence range of earthquake-induced landslide under the condition of meeting the prediction precision, and provides decision basis for related institutions to quickly formulate post-disaster rescue schemes, evaluate post-disaster loss and compile disaster area reconstruction schemes.

title_en: Post-disaster collaborative scheduling method and system for power distribution network based on rush-repair and network reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster collaborative scheduling method and system for a power distribution network based on rush-repair and network reconstruction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power distribution network information and fault line information; based on the power distribution network information and the fault line information, constructing a power distribution network fault recovery model which aims at minimizing the loss load and meets the emergency repair scheduling constraint, the fault point repair time constraint and the power distribution network constraint; and solving the power distribution network fault recovery model, obtaining a rush-repair scheduling result and a dynamic network reconstruction result, and carrying out cooperative scheduling on the power distribution network. The post-disaster collaborative scheduling method for the power distribution network provided by the invention can reduce the load loss as much as possible while meeting the requirements of rush-repair scheduling constraint, fault point repair time constraint and power distribution network constraint; the construction of the power distribution network fault recovery model synchronously considers the rush-repair work and the network reconstruction process, so that the network reconstruction process can dynamically update along with the fault rush-repair progress, the load loss is effectively reduced, and the recovery efficiency after disaster is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Upper cover type closed interchange smoke discharging model test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an upper cover type closed interchange smoke discharge model test device, and belongs to the field of fire test models. The model main body structure is reconstructed based on an actual model, and the interior of the model main body structure sequentially comprises a vehicle inlet, a toll plaza, a ramp and a vehicle outlet along the vehicle movement direction; the vehicle inlet section is provided with an air supply fan; the model main body is provided with a simulated fire source system, the simulated fire source system comprises a heating system and a smoke generating system, and smoke generated by the smoke generating system is heated by the heating system and then diffused so as to simulate a fire scene; the model main body is provided with a temperature measurement system, a temperature acquisition system, a wind speed test system and a smoke spreading observation system. The invention can better simulate the ventilation and smoke discharge conditions during the actual tunnel fire, and the simulation can realize rapid personnel evacuation and rescue while controlling the spreading of smoke, and has important engineering significance on the influence on the surrounding road network and the structural functions to the minimum.
assignees: GUANGDONG PROVINCIAL HIGHWAY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method for inhibiting migration and disaster control of loose layer based on rock stratum framework reconstruction
abstract_en: According to the method for inhibiting migration and disaster control of the loose layer based on the rock stratum framework reconstruction, the principle of the fluid mechanics Tesla check valve is introduced into the loose layer, the loose layer framework structure is reconstructed, the loose layer destabilization sliding area is divided into a plurality of parts to be reconstructed and fixed, the loose layer destabilization sliding area cannot be wholly destabilized, the occurrence of high static load side slope destabilization type ore shock is avoided in a large-span continuous goaf from the occurrence mechanism, and the time for collapse destabilization is prolonged. The reconstructed long-wall skeleton plays a role in blocking, and the reconstructed short-wall skeleton plays a role in transferring and guiding stress, so that the migration of the reconstructed long-wall skeleton is restrained by utilizing the fluid property of the loose layer. Grouting in a loose layer is a difficult point which is difficult to solve in the existing grouting operation process, and the method combines the advantages of two grouting methods, namely compaction grouting and split grouting, by locating the steady-state high-strength grouting reinforcement technology, a parameter calculation method and related operation flows, and also solves the problem of difficult locating the steady-state grouting in the loose layer in the rock stratum skeleton reconstruction process.

title_en: Post-disaster house reconstruction detection device and detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster house reconstruction detection device and a post-disaster house reconstruction detection system, and relates to the field of house detection devices. The post-disaster house reconstruction detection device comprises a movable base, wherein universal wheels are arranged at the bottom of the movable base, a hot air blower is fixedly connected to the top of the movable base, and a microcomputer and a temperature sensor are arranged on the side wall of the hot air blower. This detection device is rebuild in house after disaster overall structure is compact, can make things convenient for whole device to remove through the removal base that sets up, make through the air heater to rebuild in the house space after the disaster and heat when measuring to formaldehyde content measurement, in the measurement process, can be through temperature sensor real-time supervision temperature, after reaching the temperature, utilize motor main part and track main part to make formaldehyde detector carry out the measurement of different height, guarantee that measuring result's accuracy is good, and whole process need not handheld formaldehyde detector moreover, finally realize detecting conveniently.

title_en: User device and method for displaying disaster alarm message and server for providing disaster alarm message
title_ko: 재난 경보 메시지를 출력하는 사용자 단말, 방법 및 재난 경보 메시지를 제공하는 서버
abstract_en: A user terminal for outputting a disaster alarm message comprises: a message receiving unit receiving a disaster alarm message from a disaster alarm message provision server; an extraction unit extracting, from the received disaster alarm message, at least one character included in a zero-padding area; a detection unit detecting, from the extracted at least one character, a recognized character and a keyword located next to the recognized character; a reconstruction unit determining specific display information corresponding to the keyword among predetermined display information, based on the recognized character, and performing reconstruction so that the determined specific display information is to be included in the disaster alarm message; and an output unit outputting the reconstructed disaster alarm message. Therefore, the user terminal enables vulnerable groups such as foreigners and illiterate people who are not familiar with the character of a corresponding country to recognize the text of a disaster text message.
abstract_ko: 재난 경보 메시지를 출력하는 사용자 단말은 재난 경보 메시지 제공 서버로부터 재난 경보 메시지를 수신하는 메시지 수신부, 상기 수신한 재난 경보 메시지로부터 제로 패딩 영역에 포함된 적어도 하나 이상의 문자를 추출하는 추출부, 상기 추출된 적어도 하나 이상의 문자로부터 인식 문자 및 상기 인식 문자의 다음에 위치한 키워드를 검출하는 검출부, 상기 인식 문자에 기초하여 기지정된 표출 정보 중 상기 키워드에 대응하는 특정 표출 정보를 결정하고, 상기 결정된 특정 표출 정보가 상기 재난 경보 메시지에 포함되도록 재구성하는 재구성부 및 상기 재구성된 재난 경보 메시지를 출력하는 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Transparent rock body hydraulic coupling internal pregnancy and disaster real-time reconstruction method and analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a transparent rock body hydraulic coupling internal pregnancy and disaster real-time reconstruction method and an analysis method, wherein the transparent rock body hydraulic coupling internal pregnancy and disaster real-time reconstruction method quantitatively characterizes a space spreading rule of the internal pregnancy and disaster crack initiation expansion of a transparent rock body by designing a transparent rock body hydraulic coupling internal pregnancy and disaster real-time reconstruction device, breaks through the black box problem in the traditional rock mechanics field, and enables the whole process of rock degradation to be quantitatively visible; the analysis method for the real-time reconstruction of the internal pregnancy and the catastrophe of the hydraulic coupling of the transparent rock mass provides a catastrophe space evolution criterion based on fracture mechanics, can accurately represent the catastrophe evolution characteristics of the rock and can predict three-dimensional rock mechanics engineering disasters. The method can be applied to disaster prediction of rock mechanical engineering, can more accurately predict rock mechanical engineering disasters, and provides a new thought for the test method and the disaster prediction of the rock mechanical engineering.

title_en: Virtual machine data recording method, system, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of computers, and particularly relates to a virtual machine data recording method, a system, equipment and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of creating a video recording task based on a video recording unit and a video recording strategy determined by a user and executing the video recording task, and responding to the execution of the video recording task, and sending a snapshot request about the video recording unit to a cloud platform through the video recording task and based on the video recording strategy. The invention provides a data recording method of a virtual machine, which is based on the snapshot function of a file system, and can carry out snapshot video recording operation on disk data of the virtual machine by selecting different video recording units and video recording strategies, thereby rapidly realizing data playback, data rollback and incremental data acquisition of the virtual machine. Data playback may view historical data of the virtual machine, and data rollback may recover data when the virtual machine crashes or the data is lost. The incremental data acquisition can be used for backing up the virtual machine data, and the virtual machine incremental data migration, disaster recovery and other expansion functions are realized.

title_en: Image processing system and image processing method using split learning
title_ko: 스플릿 러닝을 이용한 영상처리 시스템 및 영상처리방법
abstract_en: An image processing system according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) configured to capture a video of a fire site, wherein each UAV has a control unit including an input layer and a first hidden layer (hidden layer 1); and a central server connected to the plurality of UAVs by wireless communication, wherein the central server includes a plurality of hidden layers and an output layer. The image processing system according to one embodiment of the present invention performs a learning process to determine whether a fire has occurred using a feature map in which an original image is difficult to recognize and personal information is protected. Thus, it is possible to fundamentally prevent the exposure and infringement of personal information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 영상처리 시스템은 화재현장의 영상을 촬상하고, 입력층(input layer)과 제 1 은닉층(hidden layer 1)을 포함한 제어부를 각각 구비한 다수의 UAV(unmanned aerial vehicle); 및 상기 다수의 UAV와 무선통신으로 연결되고, 다수의 은닉층(hidden layer)과 출력층(output layer)을 포함한 중앙 서버;를 포함한다.  
본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 영상처리 시스템은 원본 영상을 알아보기 힘들고 개인정보를 보호한 상태인 특징맵을 이용하여 화재발생여부를 판단하는 학습 처리를 수행하므로, 개인정보의 노출과 침해를 원천적으로 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fire scene three-dimensional reconstruction method and device for laser camera and spherical screen camera
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of image processing, and provides a fire scene three-dimensional reconstruction method and device for a laser camera and a spherical screen camera, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring image data and laser data corresponding to a target scene; the image data and the laser data are respectively data obtained by shooting a target scene at the same view of the laser camera and the spherical screen camera; the relative positions of the laser camera and the spherical screen camera are fixed. And performing depth estimation according to the image data to generate an initial point cloud. And obtaining a target point cloud according to the initial point cloud of the laser data. And performing geometric reconstruction according to the target point cloud to obtain a three-dimensional model. Therefore, the method and the device fully consider the difference between the object objects in the real scene of the fire scene, and improve the sense of reality of the three-dimensional model.
assignees: CHINA GERMANY ZHUHAI ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE INST CO LTD;ZHUHAI 4DAGE NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network recovery method and device considering switch uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network recovery method and device considering switch uncertainty, which is based on a three-layer robust post-disaster recovery model proposed by a linearization Distflow model and a traveling business model, considers faults of elements and a remote switch in the post-disaster recovery process, considers a distributed generator rescheduling and network reconstruction technology, solves the problem of maintenance personnel scheduling under the condition of uncertain fault types, solves the problem of scheduling of the maintenance personnel under the condition of uncertain fault types, and provides a high-efficiency tool for recovering the power distribution network under the condition of incomplete fault information, wherein the established model only needs a power distribution network operator to predict the maximum occurrence of various types of faults according to historical data, reduces the requirement of required information, effectively reduces the calculation burden of the scene needing to be added, can find the global optimal solution in a short time, and provides the high-efficiency tool for recovering the power distribution network under the condition of incomplete fault information.

title_en: System and method for field experience disaster prevention exercise in virtual geographic space based on VR technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual simulation, in particular to a system and a method for field experience disaster prevention exercise in a virtual geographic space based on a VR technology, comprising a data acquisition terminal: collecting user posture information, surrounding scene information and drilling participant information; and the control center: carrying out centralized processing and storage on the acquired information; a mobile terminal: presenting data information transmitted by a control center; and (3) a conveyor belt: the device is used for the movement of a user, and is adjusted according to the advancing speed of the user and the direction opposite to the advancing direction of the user, so that the position of the user is ensured to be maintained in situ. According to the invention, the data acquisition terminal acquires the user interaction data information in real time, the control center makes response measures to judge the user interaction data information, so that the information interaction between the user and the virtual scene is realized, and the objects in the virtual scene are adjusted in real time by the three-dimensional reconstruction method, so that the user can be helped to avoid the possible obstacles in reality, and new experience can be brought to the user, and the user experience is promoted.

title_en: Bridge transverse safety performance improvement method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of bridge construction, in particular to a method for improving and reforming the transverse safety performance of a bridge, which comprises the following steps: A. anchoring the first L-shaped steel on the side surface of the integral box girder; B. fixing a first spiral spring on a web plate of the first L-shaped steel; C. anchoring second L-shaped steel on the side surfaces of the stop blocks at two sides of the box girder and fixing the first spiral spring; D. and a second coil spring is fixed between the bottom plate of the box girder and the upper surface of the bridge abutment cap girder. The reconstruction method has the advantages of simple and quick construction procedures, definite stress of the components and safe and stable system; the method has the advantages that the normal operation of the single-pier bridge is ensured, the integral disaster prevention and resistance level of the bridge is improved, and the potential safety hazards of the bridge caused by unbalanced automobile load and earthquake load are prevented.

title_en: Fire disaster cause determining method, device and server for laser camera and spherical screen camera
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of image data processing, and provides a fire cause determining method, device and server for a laser camera and a spherical screen camera. The image data and the laser data are data obtained by shooting a target scene at the same view of the laser camera and the spherical screen camera respectively. And the relative positions of the laser camera and the spherical screen camera are fixed, a 3D model is reconstructed according to the image data and the laser data, and the 3D model is input into a discrimination network architecture to obtain the fire cause. Therefore, the 3D model is reconstructed by adopting the image data and the laser data, the modeling precision is high, and then the 3D model is further identified to judge the fire cause after the fire scene is modeled, so that the effect of automatically judging the fire cause is achieved.
assignees: CHINA GERMANY ZHUHAI ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE INST CO LTD;ZHUHAI 4DAGE NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Diffracted wave extraction method based on hook distance singular value selection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-resolution seismic exploration, in particular to a diffracted wave extraction method based on hook distance singular value selection, which is used for realizing singular value selection during diffracted wave separation through the hook distance, solving the problem of singular value selection in the reconstruction process of a reflected wave field, defining mathematical meanings represented by a threshold value, providing quantitative standards for singular value selection, avoiding errors caused by manually and empirically determining the singular value separation diffracted wave, improving the quality of the singular value decomposition extracted diffracted wave, accurately detecting a fracture-cavity body related to oil gas storage and water-guiding fracture, collapse column and the like related to coal field geological disasters, and has important practical application values in oil gas resource exploration and geological disaster prevention.

title_en: Power transmission and distribution cooperative power supply recovery method and system for urban power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recovering power transmission and distribution cooperation of an urban power grid, wherein a Gaussian Copula function is adopted to connect marginal probability models into a joint probability model; constructing an upper layer model of a power transmission and distribution double-layer cooperative power supply recovery model by taking the minimum load transfer quantity of a transmission line interface of a power transmission and distribution system as a target based on an alternating-current optimal power flow convex optimization model; reconstructing a high-voltage distribution network in an urban power grid area, scheduling emergency resources in real time, and constructing a lower layer model of a power transmission and distribution double-layer cooperative power supply recovery model by taking a typical prediction scene of new energy output as a constraint condition and taking the load shedding amount under a minimized fault scene as a target; the method comprises the steps of obtaining network data of a power transmission network of the urban power grid, network data of a high-voltage distribution network in the urban power grid area and fault scene information of the high-voltage distribution network in the urban power grid area under extreme disasters, and solving a power transmission and distribution double-layer collaborative power supply recovery model to determine a power supply recovery strategy of the urban power grid. The invention reduces the load cutting amount of the system while ensuring that the power flow of the transmission network line does not exceed the limit.

title_en: Freely separable multi-section type four-compartment combined ship body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a freely separable multi-section four-compartment combined ship body, which is basically characterized in that: the total length of the ship body is 225.5m, the ship length is 217m, the ship width is 60m, the profile depth is 12m, the design draft is 8m, and the structural draft is 10m; through the measures of structural reinforcement of the ship body, reconstruction of a key link structure, separation treatment of a kinetic energy device, risk separation of emergency rescue equipment and the like, the risk of accident of the large-scale transportation ship body under the condition of dangerous ocean navigation is reduced.
assignees: ZHONGYIN HENGSHENG BEIJING TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing realistic language learning contents based on virtual reality and voice recognition
title_ko: 가상현실 및 음성인식 기반의 실감 어학학습 콘텐츠 제공 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for providing realistic language learning content based on virtual reality and voice recognition. The apparatus comprises a storage module, a projection module, an audio module, a voice recognition module, and a content provision module. The storage module stores content including video and audio to reproduce virtual reality. The projection module projects video, and the audio module receives or outputs audio. The voice recognition module recognizes the audio of an answer or a question from a user about an object in virtual reality, received from the audio module and outputs a voice recognition result. The content provision module evaluates the answer or question of the user according to the voice recognition result, and enables the projection module and the audio module to output content including the audio and the video in which the object responds to the answer or question of the user in response to an evaluation result. Therefore, users can maximize the effectiveness of language learning without going abroad.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가상현실 및 음성인식 기반의 실감 어학학습 콘텐츠를 제공하기 위한 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 
발명의 장치는 저장모듈과 영사모듈과 오디오모듈과 음성인식모듈과 콘텐츠 제공모듈을 포함한다. 저장모듈은 가 
상현실을 재현하기 위한 영상 및 음성을 포함하는 콘텐츠를 저장한다. 영사모듈은 영상을 영사하고, 오디오모듈 
은 음성을 입력받거나 출력한다. 음성인식모듈은 오디오모듈로부터 수신되는 가상현실의 객체에 대한 사용자의 
답변 혹은 질문을 음성인식하여 음성인식 결과를 출력한다. 콘텐츠 제공모듈은 음성인식 결과에 따라 사용자의 
답변 혹은 질문을 평가하고, 평가 결과에 대응하여 객체가 사용자의 답변 혹은 질문에 대해 응답하는 음성 및 영 
상을 포함하는 콘텐츠를 영상모듈 및 오디오모듈이 출력하도록 제공한다.

title_en: 3D traffic accident analysis system using photogrammetry
title_ko: 포토그래매트리를 활용한 3차원 교통사고 분석시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a three-dimensional traffic accident analysis system using photogrammetry which is configured to analyze a traffic accident by reconstructing a three-dimensional image-based accident simulation and a real object-based simulation by using a three-dimensional printer and photogrammetry to allow three-dimensional comprehensive analysis, completely eliminate blind spots, allow 360° omnidirectional analysis at a point desired by a user, and allow engineering analysis of a collision position, an accident situation, a principal direction of force (PDOF) resulting from an action point of an impact force, and a vehicle moving trace of an accident vehicle to drastically increase the accuracy, precision, and reliability of analysis.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 포토그래매트리(Photogrammetry) 및 3D 프린터를 이용하여, 3차원 영상기반의 사고 시뮬레이션 및 실물 기반의 모의 시뮬레이션을 재현하여, 교통사고를 분석하도록 구성됨으로써 3차원의 입체적이고 종합적인 분석이 가능함과 동시에 사각지대를 완전히 해소할 수 있으며, 사용자가 원하는 지점에서 360°의 전방위적 분석이 가능할 뿐만 아니라 사고차량의 충돌자세, 사고 상황, 충격힘 작용점에 따른 충격력 방향(PDOF, Principal direction of force), 차량 진행궤적 등의 공학적 분석이 가능하여 분석의 정확성, 정밀도 및 신뢰도를 획기적으로 높일 수 있는 포토그래매트리를 활용한 3차원 교통사고 분석시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Test apparatus using heating of conductor
abstract_en: Disclosed is a testing apparatus using heating of a conductor. The testing apparatus using the heating of the conductor of the present invention comprises: a chamber which provides a space for placing a sensor unit; a conductor unit formed at the chamber interior and reproducing the conductor which transmits an electricity; and a heating unit (130) to reproduce heat generation of the conductor unit. The conductor unit is coupled to a fire symptom displaying target which receives the heat generation thereof at a set coupling position. Provided is the testing apparatus using the heating of the conductor, which provides a test for sensing a gas in the fire symptom displaying target.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 센서유닛의 배치공간을 제공하는 챔버, 상기 챔버 내부에 형성되고 전기를 전달하는 도체를 재현하기 위한 도체부 및 상기 도체부의 발열을 재현하기 위한 가열부(130)를 더 포함하고, 상기 도체부는 설정된 결합위치에서 자신의 발열을 전달받는 화재징후 표출대상과 결합되는 도체의 가열을 이용한 시험장치를 개시한다.

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network water quality risk and water supply reliability calculation method considering post-earthquake negative pressure effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calculating water quality risk and water supply reliability of a city water supply network by considering post-earthquake negative pressure effect, and belongs to the field of post-disaster water quality safety evaluation of the city water supply network. The invention comprises the following steps: calculating the area of a pipeline leakage opening under the daily operation situation; generating a seismic damage scene of pipelines in a pipe network under the action of the earthquake by Monte Carlo simulation sampling; determining the situation that the pollutants invade a pipe network after the earthquake; establishing a pipe network model of a pollutant invasion scene; calculating the average water quality risk of the nodes; calculating the reliability of the water supply of the pipe network; calculating the average risk mean value of the node average water quality; and (5) calculating the reliability mean value of the pipe network. The method is based on the urban water supply pipe network negative pressure scene under the earthquake damage effect, calculates the pipe network water quality risk and the water supply reliability through the pollution invasion scene, and has great significance for guiding post-earthquake water quality early warning and coping strategies of the urban water supply pipe network, anti-earthquake upgrading and reconstruction of the pipe network and emergency repair measures after the earthquake.

title_en: Municipal drainage pipe network state prediction method based on graph and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a municipal drainage pipe network state prediction method based on graph and deep learning, which comprises the following steps of collecting municipal drainage pipe network topological structures in target areas, acquiring characteristics of each monitoring point in real time, establishing a graph set of time-space sequences by using the information, preprocessing an established time-space sequence graph model, learning established graph data by combining a graph convolutional neural network and a gate control circulation unit, training a related model, predicting the drainage pipe network state by using the trained model, reconstructing prediction results into graphs, visually displaying prediction overflow amounts of each point, and finally performing fault investigation and flood prevention early warning on a drainage pipe network system by using the established graph model and algorithm prediction results. By the method, the complexity of model establishment can be reduced, the accuracy of drainage pipe network system state prediction can be improved, the areas which are blocked by the fault pipeline and possibly have disasters in a short period can be accurately detected and early-warned, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability of the city is effectively improved.

title_en: Ecological restoration system and restoration method for erosion coastal zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration system for an erosion coastal zone, which comprises: constructing a bank-connecting biological reef structure at the bank-connecting position of the coastal zone; a low beach biological reef structure which is constructed in a low beach area of the coastal zone and is positioned behind the shore-receiving biological reef structure; a first restored native vegetation planted in a beach area of the coastal zone and located behind the beach biological reef structure; a second remedial rural vegetation planted in a first half of the high beach area of the coastal zone; a plurality of tidal ditches are constructed in the front half section part of the middle and high beach area of the coastal zone at intervals along the direction vertical to the coastline; constructing a tidal pool in the latter half section of the mid-beach area of the coastal zone; and the ecological reconstruction slope protection is constructed on the sea wall slope protection. Also discloses a method for repairing the ecological repair system of the erosion coastal zone. The invention has the advantages of obvious treatment effect, obvious ecological support effect, outstanding disaster reduction effect and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI WATER ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Safety evaluation and optimization method for mountain road
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safety evaluation and optimization method of mountain roads, which comprises the steps of obtaining road alignment parameters and the motion state of vehicles, constructing a road operation index prediction model, screening significant variables from potential explanatory variables and screening optimal upstream and downstream distances, adopting a complex road operation index prediction model to verify the significant variables, if the significant variables pass the verification, predicting the vehicle operation index based on the road operation index prediction model, if the road operation index prediction model fails the verification, reconstructing the road operation index prediction model and verifying the redetermined significant variables until the verification passes, calculating accident substitution indexes, determining the relationship between the road alignment parameters and the accident substitution indexes based on the accident substitution indexes by using a descriptive statistical method, evaluating the safety of the roads, and optimizing the road alignment parameters. Compared with the prior art, the road safety evaluation and optimization method can realize prospective road safety evaluation and optimization in the road design stage.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system elastic operation scheduling method considering partition reconstruction of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system elastic operation scheduling method considering regional reconstruction of a power distribution network. According to the technical scheme, the regional reconstruction of the power distribution network is considered in the elastic operation process of the regional comprehensive energy system, the elastic operation of the post-disaster comprehensive energy system in the form of a plurality of independent micro-grids is realized, the local comprehensive energy is fully utilized after the power distribution network loses the power supply of the main network, the power failure time of important loads is effectively reduced, and the elastic operation level of the regional comprehensive energy system under the extreme disaster event is improved.

title_en: Outdoor fire hydrant with rotating function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hydrant box installed outdoors. More specifically, the outdoor hydrant box includes: upper and lower support bars individually installed at an upper end and a lower end of a body to support an upper end and a lower end of a door when multiple doors are opened and closed; a round roof connected to the upper end of a vertical frame of the body to protect an inner space; a rotation unit comprising an outer support member, a door roller, and a guide rail to rotate the round roof and the body; an inner support member installed to correspond to an outer support member forming the rotation unit and fixed to the ground by an anchor bolt by having multiple anchor fixing pieces integrally formed on the inner side; and multiple separation prevention brackets for preventing the door roller of the rotation unit from being separated from the guide rail by being installed on the inner support member. The outdoor hydrant box is installed outdoors and enables a user to rapidly extinguish a fire in an early stage before a fire engine arrives at a fire scene in case of fire. At the same time, the outdoor hydrant box has a rotation function to rapidly install a fire hose without bending by rotating so that the door of the hydrant box and the direction of the fire scene correspond to each other when the fire hose is installed to the fire scene by being unwound from a fire reel of the hydrant box in case of the fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 옥외에 설치되는 소화전함에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 몸체의 상단과 하단에 설치되어 복수의 도어를 여닫을 때 도어 상단부와 하단부를 지지되도록 하는 상단지지바 및 하단지지바와, 상기 몸체의 수직프레임 상단에 결합되어 내측 공간부를 보호할 수 있도록 설치된 원형지붕과, 상기 원형지붕과 몸체를 회전시킬 수 있도록 외측지지부재, 호차, 가이드레일로 이루어진 회전부와, 상기 회전부를 구성하는 외측지지부재와 대응되도록 설치되며 내측에 다수의 앙카고정편이 일체로 형성되어 지반에 앙카볼트로 고정할 수 있도록 된 내측지지부재와, 상기 내측지지부재 상에 설치되어 회전부의 호차가 가이드레일로부터 이탈되는 것을 방지할 수 있도록 다수개로 설치된 탈선방지브라켓을 포함하여 옥외 소화전함을 구성하는 것을 특징으로 한것으로 본 발명은 옥외에 설치하여 화재시 소방차가 화재현장에 도착하기 전까지 초기에 화재를 신속하게 진화할 수 있도록 하는 동시에 화재시 소화전함의 소화릴에서 소화호스를 풀어 화재현장까지 설치시 소화전함의 도어와 화재현장의 방향이 일치되도록 소화전함을 회전시킬 수 있도록 하여 소화호스를 신속하고 꺽임 없이 설치할 수 있도록 한 회전기능을 갖는 옥외 소화전함에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method and system for recording and playback multimedia contents
title_ko: 멀티미디어 콘텐츠 녹화재생 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for recording and playing multimedia content may comprise: a loading step where a background document having one or more pages is loaded; a recording start step where a transparent drawing layer is stacked for each page of the background document by an input recording start signal, and a timer is initiated and driven to form a first timeline as time goes by; a first producing step which, when a control signal containing control information on the background document is input, converts the drawing layer according to the control information, and produces scale information and coordinate information on a screen of the background document and the drawing layer, as well as a first time stamp which is time information on the first timeline having the control information input; a storage step which stores, in a database, a recording file containing the background document, the first time stamp, the scale information of the background document and the drawing layer, and the coordinate information on a screen of the background document and the drawing layer, by an input recording terminating signal; and a playing step which, by an input playing signal, displays the background document on the screen, stacks the drawing layer for each page of the background document, and when a playing elapse time becomes the first time stamp, displays the background document and the drawing layer on the screen according to the scale information and the coordinate information on the screen of the background document and the drawing layer. According to the present invention, the method and the system are efficient in terms of a storage space and have a rapid processing speed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 의하면, 멀티미디어 콘텐츠 녹화재생 방법은, 하나 이상의 페이지를 가지는 배경문서가 디스플레이 모듈 화면에 로딩되는 로딩단계; 입력된 녹화개시신호에 의해 상기 배경문서의 각 페이지마다 투명한 드로잉 레이어가 적층되고, 타이머가 시간의 흐름에 따른 제1타임라인을 형성하도록 초기화 및 구동되는 녹화개시단계; 상기 배경문서에 대한 제어정보가 포함된 제어신호가 입력되면, 상기 드로잉 레이어를 상기 제어정보에 따라 변환시키며, 상기 제어정보가 입력된 상기 제1타임라인 상의 시간정보인 제1타임스탬프와 함께 상기 배경문서 및 상기 드로잉 레이어의 스케일정보 및 화면상의 좌표정보가 산출되는 제1산출단계; 입력된 녹화종료신호에 의해 상기 배경문서, 상기 제1타임스탬프, 상기 배경문서 및 상기 드로잉 레이어의 스케일정보, 상기 배경문서 및 상기 드로잉 레이어의 화면상의 좌표정보를 포함하는 녹화 파일을 데이터베이스에 저장하는 저장단계; 그리고 입력된 재생신호에 의해, 상기 배경문서를 상기 화면에 표시하고 상기 배경문서의 각 페이지마다 상기 드로잉 레이어를 적층시키며, 재생 경과시간이 상기 제1타임스탬프가 되면, 상기 배경문서 및 상기 드로잉 레이어의 스케일정보 및 화면상의 좌표정보에 따라 상기 배경문서 및 상기 드로잉 레이어를 상기 화면에 표시하는 재생단계;를 포함할 수 있다

title_en: Old community safety transformation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety transformation method for old cells. Belongs to the technical field of cell transformation, and comprises the following operation steps: s1, soliciting opinion of community residents on community transformation, and carrying out key optimization transformation on common projects; s2, carrying out partition planning on the reconstruction projects and reconstruction sites according to solicited opinions of residents, community building distribution and building characteristics, and planning project reconstruction time; s3, reforming a district underground drainage system and a septic tank system; s4, repairing and modifying the district road. According to the invention, through replacing the aging circuit in the community and re-planning circuit arrangement, the phenomenon of private wire pulling of residents is eliminated, the fireproof separation and the safety distance between residential buildings are increased, all objects in a fire-fighting channel are moved out, the condition that the fire-fighting channel is unoccupied is ensured, and the fire-fighting facilities are additionally arranged according to the condition of the on-site residence, so that the original fire-fighting facilities are re-maintained and improved, the safety of the residents in the community can be improved, and the fire occurrence rate is reduced.

title_en: Transparent rock mass closed internal fracture frost heaving expansion test method and analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a transparent rock body saturated sealed internal crack frost heave expansion test method and an analysis method, wherein a visualized transparent rock sealed internal crack frost heave expansion test device is designed, the whole process of rock sealed internal crack frost heave expansion is quantitatively reconstructed, real-time three-dimensional reconstruction of internal crack frost heave space-time evolution is realized, the defect that description of frost heave cracks flows in qualitative in the past study is overcome, the analysis method of transparent rock sealed internal crack frost heave is provided, the obtained new criterion of internal crack frost heave crack expansion is obtained based on a real and quantitative test result, and compared with the criterion derived by the traditional analysis method, the accuracy is higher, and the real rock body frost heave fracture mechanism can be reflected. The new criterion of the invention is combined with a numerical algorithm, is applied to disaster prediction of cold region rock mechanical engineering, and can more accurately predict cold region rock mechanical engineering disasters.

title_en: Agricultural disaster prediction method based on remote sensing image space-time fusion and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an agricultural disaster prediction method and related equipment based on remote sensing image space-time fusion, and relates to the technical field of image processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first remote sensing image sequence and a second remote sensing image sequence generated by remote sensing imaging of a field to be predicted, wherein the first remote sensing image sequence comprises a plurality of first remote sensing images, the second remote sensing image sequence comprises a plurality of second remote sensing images, the spatial resolution of the first remote sensing images is higher than that of the second remote sensing images, and the temporal resolution of the second remote sensing images is higher than that of the first remote sensing images; inputting the second remote sensing image into the first sub-model, and performing high-resolution reconstruction on the second remote sensing image through the first sub-model to obtain a reconstructed remote sensing image output by the first sub-model; and adding the reconstructed remote sensing image into the first remote sensing image sequence to obtain a fusion sequence, inputting the fusion sequence into the second sub-model, and obtaining a disaster prediction result of the field to be predicted, which is output by the second sub-model. The method and the device can improve the prediction precision of agricultural disasters.

title_en: Training method for panoramic monitoring model of power transmission channel and related device and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a training method of a power transmission channel panoramic monitoring model, a related device and a method, wherein a video sequence is obtained by reconstructing a sample video for monitoring the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel, different feature spaces are obtained according to the video sequence, different feature weights are obtained according to the different feature spaces, so that a classification result of monitoring the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel is obtained, the sample video can monitor instantaneous artificial activities or disaster information and can monitor the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel in all weather in real time, the panoramic monitoring model of the power transmission channel is trained through the sample video, the classification result of the panoramic monitoring model of the power transmission channel can more comprehensively reflect the real-time change condition of the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel, the timeliness and the accuracy of monitoring the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel are improved, and the real-time monitoring of the panoramic environment of the power transmission channel is facilitated to timely cope with sudden situations.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method for treating mining subsidence land of shallow-buried coal seam in channel region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating a mining subsidence land of a shallow coal seam in a channel region, which comprises the following steps of dividing treatment strips; step two, mining subsidence land zonal treatment: the method comprises the steps of sequentially treating a plurality of treatment strips in a downstream-to-upstream sequence, firstly stripping and digging a subsidence land treatment area, and then filling a bottom water-resisting layer, a bottom water-bearing layer, a bottom soil layer, a top water-resisting layer, a water storage type core soil layer and a surface soil layer from bottom to top sequentially, and simultaneously setting a impervious wall and a drainage ditch. According to the invention, residual coal is recovered through stripping and digging type treatment, the spontaneous combustion hidden danger is removed, layered backfilling is carried out, the hidden danger of roof collapse is eliminated, a sponge stratum structure suitable for ecological restoration is reconstructed, water can be stored, permeated and purified during raining, the stored water is released and utilized during drought, the ecological restoration effect of a subsidence area and the capability of coping with natural disasters are improved, and the social and ecological benefits of a treatment area are improved.

title_en: Method and control device for determining damage index of concrete bent factory building
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a control device for determining damage indexes of a concrete bent factory building, and belongs to the field of industrial factory buildings. The determining method comprises the following steps: acquiring apparent characteristics of structural damage parameters indicating damage conditions of a bent structure of a factory building; quantifying the apparent characteristics of the structural damage parameters to obtain local damage indexes corresponding to the structural damage parameters; and determining the damage index of the concrete bent factory building according to the local damage index and a preset damage index relation. Recording the damage degree of the bent structure parameters through the damage investigation of the apparent characteristics of the concrete bent factory building; and quantifying apparent characteristics of structural damage parameters, determining a local damage index, and calculating the structural overall architecture of the concrete bent factory building based on the local damage index to obtain the damage index. The damage index of the apparent damaged concrete bent factory building can be rapidly obtained through the embodiment of the invention, and the damage index is used as a basis for pushing post-disaster placement and reconstruction work of the industrial factory building.
assignees: MCC TESTING AND CERTIFICATION CO LTD;CENTRAL RES INST BUILDING & CONSTR CO LTD MCC GROUP

title_en: Self-adaptive environment reconstruction and obstacle detection method for autonomous fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an autonomous fire-fighting robot self-adaptive environment reconstruction and obstacle detection method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a depth image based on the structured light depth camera, measuring the inclination angle of the structured light depth camera through the IMU inertial measurement unit, and acquiring coordinate information of a detected object corresponding to each pixel point in the depth image under a world coordinate system based on the inclination angle; constructing a two-dimensional environment gray level map through the coordinate information, and carrying out height threshold filtering processing on the two-dimensional environment gray level map to obtain a two-dimensional local environment point cloud map; creating a local environment point cloud image replacement template, updating pixel values corresponding to the global map, and obtaining an updated global single-color map; based on the global single-color map, the navigation and obstacle avoidance of the robot are performed according to a path planning algorithm. The invention can adaptively update the map in real time, more intelligently carry out obstacle avoidance or secondary path planning through the front environment, and realize active fire protection by reaching the ignition point at the highest speed.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Debris flow data anomaly identification method, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow data anomaly identification method, computer equipment and medium, and relates to the debris flow monitoring field; for each type of debris flow data, inputting a monitoring waveform of the debris flow data into a trained waveform reconstruction model corresponding to the type to obtain a reconstruction waveform; calculating waveform similarity according to the reconstructed waveform and the monitored waveform; judging whether the waveform similarity is larger than or equal to an abnormal state triggering threshold value, obtaining a judging result, and obtaining an identification result of whether the debris flow data is abnormal according to the judging result; the identification result is used for representing the risk of the debris flow disaster in the target area. According to the method, the reconstructed waveform of the debris flow data is obtained through the trained waveform reconstruction model, and whether the debris flow data is abnormal or not is judged according to the waveform similarity of the reconstructed waveform and the monitoring waveform, so that a great amount of manpower and material resources are avoided.

title_en: Cover layer reconstruction method of salt cavern storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for reforming a cover layer of a salt cavern storage, which comprises the following steps: s1: hydraulically cutting off a casing of a stable stratum at the upper part of the damaged or deformed casing, wherein the shale stable stratum with larger upper part thickness is used as a cover layer to form a stratum seal; s2: the exposed cement sheath is drilled out by the retractable drill bit; s3: lowering a suspended packer; s4: and (3) injecting thixotropic cement for sealing: s5: testing pressure after waiting for coagulation, and drilling a boiled water mud plug and a suspended packer after the pressure test is qualified; s6: and repairing the sleeve by a sleeve repairing method or an expansion pipe sleeve repairing method. The method for modifying the cover layer of the salt cavern reservoir, provided by the invention, does not modify a direct top plate, but modifies a shaft in stable stratum such as shale and the like at the upper part of the salt cavern reservoir, seals an annulus, provides favorable conditions for underground reservoir construction, disaster management and the like, and has universality.

title_en: Power utilization potential safety hazard supervision system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for supervising potential safety hazards of electricity, wherein the system comprises a data management module, an analysis display module, an information service module and a background management module; the data management module comprises a data acquisition sub-module, a data uploading sub-module and a data processing sub-module; the analysis display module comprises a real-time data sub-module and a historical data sub-module; the information service module comprises a short message service sub-module and a mail service sub-module; the background management submodule comprises a business management log information maintenance submodule and a digital system display and playback submodule. The invention effectively solves the problem that the prior art lacks early warning before electric fire disaster; the existing electrical circuit cannot meet the requirement of increasing electrical equipment loads; the electrical facility equipment is aged and oxidized seriously, and the idle operation time is too long to generate refusal action; the existing load is not matched with the line diameter of the line.
assignees: SICHUAN TOBACCO CO LTD LUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing big data processing method, system and cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing big data processing method, a remote sensing big data processing system and a cloud platform, relates to the technical field of big data, and solves the problems of classification, retrieval and reconstruction of remote sensing data. The remote sensing big data processing system comprises a communication interface, a data collection module, a data transmission module, a data storage module, a data processing module, a data retrieval module and a data reconstruction module, wherein the data classification module is arranged to classify data by adopting a classification unit of a 3D convolution hyperspectral image model with an improved double convolution pooling structure, the retrieval unit is used for extracting data required by a user, and the reconstruction unit is used for reconstructing the extracted data, so that the remote sensing big data processing system provides a rapid calculation mode for large-scale remote sensing image data for industries with timeliness requirements such as emergency disaster relief, military and the like, provides different service forms of remote sensing big data for disaster reconstruction, reconstruction and rescue, and meets the requirement of large-scale remote sensing data diversified processing.

title_en: Existing building reconstruction fire-fighting inspection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire-fighting inspection system for reconstruction of existing buildings, which comprises: the data input module is in charge of inputting current operation data of the existing building fire-fighting facilities; the verification request module is in charge of receiving a building fire-fighting verification request initiated by a user; the report generation module is responsible for judging the current operation data and the preset building fire-fighting qualified data; the qualification checking module is responsible for sending out qualification checking reports when the current operation data reach or exceed preset building fire-fighting qualification data; when the fire-fighting inspection of the existing building is unqualified, the invention simultaneously satisfies the following conditions through transformation: fire safety performance standard data, fire standard specification data and overall fire risk scoring data, namely passing fire control inspection; the adoption of the qualified inspection module finally achieves three conditions that the fire safety performance of the existing building is improved to some extent after modification, all the problems which do not meet the fire standard specification are rectified or compensated, and the overall fire risk scoring result is in an acceptable state.

title_en: Meteorological radar combined reflectivity inversion method based on sunflower number 8 satellite data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather radar combined reflectivity inversion method based on sunflower No. 8 satellite data, which uses a multi-resolution convolutional neural network as a main network of an inversion model to effectively extract deep information features in complex satellite data, and uses an attention mechanism to weaken interference brought by non-precipitation cloud to the inversion model, so that a reliable radar echo data inversion method is provided for radar uncovered areas, data support is provided for improving the actual short-term forecasting capability of a weather department, and important functions are played for timely identifying, early warning and post-disaster reconstruction of strong convection disasters.

title_en: Method for protecting security based on privileged account key
abstract_en: The invention provides a method based on privilege account key safety protection, which comprises a method based on privilege account key safety protection and terminal safety protection, wherein the method based on privilege account key safety protection comprises terminal safety protection, account key safety protection, pre-detection, in-process defense, post-event emergency, reconstruction, trust detection, firewall, anti-calculation, periodic scanning and password management. According to the method based on the security protection of the secret key of the privileged account number, through the arrangement of pre-detection in-process defense and post-emergency, the loophole is detected, then repair and rectification are carried out, and guarantee work is carried out for the defense, so that when the defending system is attacked, the defending system enters a defending state for the first time, hidden danger is blocked, and in case of emergency, immediate emergency response and urgent repair are carried out, so that loss is reduced.
assignees: SHANDONG MINGYUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;WANFANG ZHILIAN SHANDONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional drone for fire fighting
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire-fighting drone which is equipped with a fire extinguishing liquid spray technology to approach a fire site unmanned and remotely and suppress the fire site. The fire-fighting drone is equipped with a power module for flight and a fire extinguishing liquid processing module for fire suppression, thereby receiving the fire extinguishing liquid stored in an operating vehicle on the ground and spraying fire extinguishing liquid at the fire site. The multi-functional fire-fighting drone includes a main body; a plurality of blade modules; a fire extinguishing liquid processing part; a direct injection nozzle; and an arm side nozzle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화액 분사기술을 탑재하여 무인 및 원격으로 화재현장에 접근하여 화재현장을 제압할 수 있는 소방드론에 관한 것으로, 비행을 위한 동력모듈과 화재진압을 위한 소화액처리모듈을 구비하여 지상의 운용차량에 저장된 소화액을 전송받아 화재현장에 소화액을 분사하는 다기능 소방드론을 제공한다.

title_en: Portable flame shield
abstract_en: The present invention provides a portable flame shield to protect users from accidents such as burns by blocking flames released at a fire site. The portable flame shield comprises: a blocking screen having an area, folded flexibly, and made of a material with heat dissipation; and a folding means folding the blocking screen to be folded or unfolded. The folding means includes: a center post having a length; a moving body provided to be moved in the longitudinal direction of the center post; a plurality of fixing ribs wherein one end thereof is axially coupled such that an end of the center post can be rotated and moved, and the blocking screen is fixed thereon; and support ribs wherein one end thereof is axially coupled to the moving body to be rotated and moved and the other end thereof is axially coupled to one position of the fixing ribs to be rotated and moved to support the fixing ribs in a customized manner to be folded or unfolded when the moving body moves straight relative to the center post.

title_en: Block chain-oriented data disaster recovery method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data disaster recovery method facing a block chain, which comprises the following steps: detecting disasters, namely finding differences between the blockchain system state reflected by the service data set and the blockchain system state reflected by the block on the chain, and determining whether data disasters exist or not; disaster recovery: based on the difference between the verification certificate value list and the key attribute set value list, eliminating or correcting disaster data according to the replay of transactions in the blocks on the chain; even complete global verification of the business data set; the method solves the problem that the system state of the block chain reflected by the service data set caused by external active injection operation is inconsistent with the system state of the block chain marked on the basis of the blocks on the chain, namely solves the problem of disaster recovery of data oriented to the block chain, eliminates disaster introduced to the industrial application service data set caused by external injection operation, and ensures that the system state of the block chain reflected by the service data set is consistent and compatible with the system state of the block chain marked on the basis of the blocks on the chain.

title_en: Recorder type firefighter help calling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a recorder type firefighter distress call device, and relates to the technical field of distress call devices. The portable electronic device is characterized in that a controller module, a storage battery, an alarm module, a wireless transmission module, a timing module, a positioning module, a vibration sensor and an information storage module are arranged in the shell, an LED display screen and a front camera are arranged at the front side end of the shell, and a fixed bandage, a mobile camera and a physical characteristic monitoring device are arranged outside the shell. Through leading camera and mobile camera combined use, be more favorable to understanding the scene of a fire condition, be convenient for follow-up to scene of a fire condition analysis, utilize wireless transmission module can be with the outside rescue department of scene of a fire condition real-time conveyor belt simultaneously, the front side is provided with the LED display screen simultaneously, be convenient for broadcast the control and look the screen, need not external connection playback devices, utilize physical characteristics monitoring devices, be convenient for outside know firefighter's health in real time, utilize the microphone speaker to be convenient for firefighter and outside personnel communicate at any time simultaneously.

title_en: Directional drilling-based coal face triangular area multi-disaster cooperative treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directional drilling-based multi-disaster collaborative treatment method for a triangular area of a coal face, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining a stress concentration zone of the triangular area of the coal face, S2, designing a comb-shaped directional drilling main hole, a comb-shaped directional drilling branch hole distribution and control layer and a comb-shaped directional drilling distribution and control interval according to the step S1, S3, dynamically analyzing geological conditions, continuously correcting the detection of the branch holes, S4, designing the number and the length of the branch holes of comb-shaped directional drilling staged fracturing, drilling construction for a top plate comb-shaped directional drilling main hole, fracturing reconstruction for the branch holes, S5, determining hole sealing extraction and gas extraction parameters after comb-shaped directional drilling fracturing, S6, dynamic gas extraction control and real-time monitoring of mine pressure appearance. The method realizes the cooperative control of rock burst disasters and gas extraction in the triangular area of the end head of the working face and solves the problems of small control area, high cost and the like of rock burst drilling and gas extraction drilling in the prior art.

title_en: Existing community environment improvement and reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an existing community environment improvement and reconstruction method, which relates to the technical field of existing community reconstruction and comprises a preparation construction period and a gradual reconstruction period, wherein the preparation construction period comprises broadcast equipment and bulletin board construction, construction of a construction garbage station, temporary parking space division and main road surface cleaning, and the gradual reconstruction period comprises community linkage construction and ground environment pre-arrangement, ground removal, charging pile and shed construction, pipeline exploration, pipeline reconstruction, elevator establishment and outer wall treatment. According to the invention, the whole ground is broken to reduce the elevation, then the road surface is re-paved for outer wall treatment, the problems that water is not accumulated in a depression of the road and the wall body drops seriously are solved, the charging pile and the shed are built, the problem that the traffic is influenced by messy parking of external vehicles in a small area is solved, a private occupied ground is removed for building a hospital, a fire fighting channel is ensured to be opened in a main road, and the fire fighting vehicle can enter and exit or form microcirculation.
assignees: CHINA COAL NO 3 CONSTRUCTION GROUP ANHUI CONSTRUCTION AND INSTALLATION CO LTD;CHINA COAL NO 3 CONSTR GROUP CORP CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration system for erosion coastal zone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an erosion coastal zone ecological remediation system, include: constructing a bank-connecting biological reef structure at the bank-connecting position of the coastal zone; a low beach biological reef structure which is built in a low beach area of the coastal zone and is positioned behind the bank-connecting biological reef structure; a first remedial local vegetation planted in a beach area of the coastal zone and located behind the beach biological reef structure; a second remedial earth vegetation planted in a first half portion of a mid-beach area of the coastal zone; a plurality of tidal ditches are constructed in the front half section part of the middle and high beach area of the coastal zone at intervals along the direction vertical to the coastline; constructing a tidal pool in the latter half section of the mid-beach area of the coastal zone; and the ecological reconstruction slope protection is constructed on the sea wall slope protection. The utility model has the advantages of obvious treatment effect, obvious ecological support effect, outstanding disaster reduction effect and the like.

title_en: Noise reduction and feature enhancement for thermal imaging cameras
abstract_en: Thermal imagers, particularly inexpensive designs that are less complex, may provide high temperature resolution at the expense of less sharp display images. For many low visibility applications, such as fire fighting, it may be advantageous to sacrifice some temperature detail to obtain clarity and object identification. It may be beneficial to apply filters in series to the raw image data to reduce visible noise and reconstruct feature contrast without sacrificing the actual detailed temperature information available in the captured scene, in order to provide the user with a display image that allows easy object recognition while still providing the raw data to the thermographic module to maintain high resolution of the temperature information when desired. In addition, more efficient and useful edge highlighting techniques are disclosed. For very low contrast scenes, such as a smoke-diffuse room, other specific filters and equalization methods may be applied.

title_en: Head fixing device and radiation dose in-vivo electron paramagnetic resonance detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radiation dose in-vivo electron paramagnetic resonance detection device which comprises a head fixing device, a magnetic field generating unit and a supporting table. Wherein the head fixing device comprises a magnet connecting unit, a waveguide fixing unit, a head supporting unit and a head fixing unit; the magnet connecting unit comprises a first magnet connecting unit and a second magnet connecting unit; the first magnet connecting unit and the second magnet connecting unit are oppositely arranged, two ends of the waveguide cross beam of the waveguide fixing unit, the first supporting cross beam of the head supporting unit and the cross beam of the head fixing unit are respectively fixed to the first magnet connecting unit and the second magnet connecting unit, and the head supporting unit and the head fixing unit can be adjusted according to the use condition. The invention has higher sensitivity and lower detection lower limit, and can be applied to the individual retrospective dose reconstruction after a plurality of nuclear accidents for a plurality of times.
assignees: INST MILITARY MEDICINE ACADEMY MILITARY SCIENCES PLA

title_en: Regional traffic accident risk analysis method based on large-scale floating car track data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional traffic accident risk analysis method based on large-scale floating car track data, which comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out urban road network space-time line matching on urban large-scale floating car track data by adopting an improved Dijkstra space-time track reconstruction algorithm of fracture GPS positioning fusion matching, S2, finally generating all-weather multi-dimensional complex movable labels of a floating car by adopting a week-hour-land type multi-dimensional labeling processing method of all-weather multi-time fusion, S3, carrying out text clustering analysis on all-weather movable labels in each traffic partition, excavating potential space-time activity characteristics of the floating car in each traffic partition, and S4, constructing an urban road network regional traffic accident risk analysis model combined with the floating car, and obtaining importance ranking of traffic accident risk influence factors. The method is efficient in calculation and has important practical significance for realizing traffic safety evaluation of the urban road network.

title_en: Power distribution network and traffic network collaborative first-aid repair optimization method considering extreme disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and traffic network collaborative first-aid repair optimization method considering extreme disaster influence, which comprises the following steps: collecting information of a power distribution network and a traffic network after the influence of extreme disasters; establishing a model for recovering maximization of a power distribution network and a traffic network; modeling the recovery process of the power grid and the traffic grid; adding a virtual node and rebuilding a network; carrying out power flow constraint on the reconstructed network, and finally obtaining a power distribution network and traffic network cooperative first-aid repair optimization method by using an objective function of a maximized model; the invention provides an optimization method for cooperative first-aid repair of a power distribution network and a traffic network, wherein the repair of the power distribution network and the repair of the traffic network are performed in a cooperative manner; and converting the problem into a mixed integer linear programming model by taking the restoration resources and the working personnel of the power distribution network and the restoration resources and the construction personnel of the traffic network as optimization variables. After the restoration time is appointed, a corresponding restoration strategy can be obtained by the constraint condition and the objective function, and the power distribution network and the traffic network are restored as much as possible.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Asset management system of information machine room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an information machine room asset management system, which comprises a main control unit, an access authorization unit, a camera unit, a door lock control unit, a RFID system and a grating partition access control unit; the grating partition entrance guard unit comprises at least one upright post structure, an entrance guard control assembly arranged on the upright post and at least one group of vertical correlation gratings. The utility model provides an information machine room asset management system with simple structure, which is particularly suitable for the reconstruction of the existing machine room, has the advantages of low reconstruction cost and short construction period, and can improve the information machine room asset management level after the reconstruction is finished; by using the grating partition access control unit, the partition in the information machine room can be realized, the partition construction is convenient, and the use of the existing ventilation system, cooling system and fire-fighting system is not influenced; the grating entrance guard is specifically realized, and the appearance of false alarm can be obviously reduced by matching with an acousto-optic reminding function through double grating design.

title_en: Road network management system and method for disaster response
title_ko: 재난 대응을 위한 도로 네트워크 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A road network management system and a method for disaster response are provided. The road network management system and method for disaster response according to an embodiment of the present invention comprise: a road network processing unit that collects a vector road network, which is a vector road network, and reprocesses the same according to preset conditions to generate a graph road network formed in the form of a graph; and a road network application unit that reflects external information in the graph road network and generates and proposes a detour route according to the external information, thereby capable of reconstructing the road network that is the basis for deriving a detour route for disaster response.
abstract_ko: 재난 대응을 위한 도로 네트워크 관리 시스템 및 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 재난 대응을 위한 도로 네트워크 관리 시스템 및 방법은, 벡터 형태의 도로 네트워크인 벡터 도로 네트워크를 수집하고 기 설정된 조건에 따라 재가공하여 그래프 형태로 형성되는 그래프 도로 네트워크를 생성하는 도로 네트워크 가공부; 및 상기 그래프 도로 네트워크에 외부 정보를 반영하며, 상기 외부 정보에 따라 우회 경로를 생성하여 제안하는 도로 네트워크 적용부;를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV CHUNG ANG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Method and system for analyzing and evaluating fatigue life of bridge cable structure after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for analyzing and evaluating the fatigue life of a bridge cable structure after a fire disaster, which are used for simulating and reconstructing the fire scene environment after the fire disaster occurs to obtain the real thermal environment where a inhaul cable is positioned, carrying out finite element thermal analysis on the section of the inhaul cable by taking the real thermal environment as a thermal boundary condition, determining the specific temperature of each steel wire on the section, calculating the residual tensile strength and the fatigue strength of each steel wire according to a steel wire resistance degradation model after the high temperature obtained by experiments, and finally carrying out calculation and evaluation on the fatigue life of the whole inhaul cable after the fire disaster. Compared with the traditional research method, the method has clear thought, is convenient for flow use, more accurately reflects the stress condition of the inhaul cable after the fire, ensures that the residual resistance of each steel wire is more definite, and finally can more scientifically evaluate the fatigue life of the inhaul cable after the fire.

title_en: Self-resetting and replaceable steel reinforced concrete prefabricated assembled center column and construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-resetting and replaceable steel reinforced concrete prefabricated assembled center column and a construction method thereof, wherein the self-resetting and replaceable steel reinforced concrete prefabricated assembled center column comprises a top plate, a bottom plate and a center column, the center column is of a prefabricated steel reinforced concrete structure, and an upper flange assembly is arranged between the upper end of the center column and the top plate; the upper flange assembly comprises an upper flange seat, an upper steel backing plate and an upper flange plate, the upper flange seat is sleeved at the upper end of the middle column, the upper flange plate is arranged above the top plate, and bolts are arranged between the upper flange plate and the upper flange seat; a lower flange assembly is arranged between the lower end of the middle column and the bottom plate, the lower flange assembly comprises a lower flange seat and a lower steel backing plate, the lower flange seat is sleeved at the lower end of the middle column, and an embedded memory alloy rod is arranged between the lower flange seat and the bottom plate; and longitudinal steel bars are further arranged between the upper steel backing plate and the lower steel backing plate, and vertically penetrate through the middle column. The invention can improve the structural strength of the middle column, improve the anti-seismic performance, reduce the structural damage during earthquake, and realize self-resetting and quick replacement after earthquake, thereby being convenient for reconstruction after disaster.

title_en: Recyclable construction constructed using monocoque steel plate concrete composite plate
abstract_en: To provide a recyclable construction method allowing quality in structural strength, earthquake resistance, durability, fire resistance and the like of present constructions to be improved to make its construction period shorter and its construction cost lower.SOLUTION: A light and tough monocoque steel plate concrete composite plate is produced in a factory to integrate a steel mold and stiff-consistency concrete whose water content is suppressed low. Further, the steel mold constituting the composite plate is provided with a perforated steel plate dowel/truss frame, thereby since a steel plate part integrated with a concrete part and covering a mold serves as a monocoque structure, the composite plate becomes very tough. A recyclable construction allowing its reconstruction and diversion is constructed by connecting the monocoque steel plate concrete composite plate through an easy and recyclable method with bolt fixation and the like as base floor plates, wall plates, and roofing plates.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for improving land water reserve reconstruction accuracy based on variable screening reconstruction model
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of hydrology, and particularly relates to a method for improving land water reserve reconstruction accuracy based on a variable screening reconstruction model. The variable screening reconstruction model of the application combines a hybrid algorithm of a GT method and an LSTM neural network, and comprises the following steps: variable screening, model training and model prediction. The method provided by the application provides an effective means for reconstructing the TWSA with the loss, and provides reliable data support for flood disaster research in the intermittent period. Based on the implementation of variable screening reconstruction models, the influence of irrelevant input variables on model precision can be effectively avoided, and the accuracy of reconstructing GRACE/GRACE-FO intermittent land water reserves is improved.

title_en: Apparatus for Monitoring Fire
