abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composite sensor fire detection, and more specifically, to a composite sensor fire detection device and method for inducing safe and rapid evacuation in the event of a fire. The fire detection device comprises: a communication unit (110); a memory unit (120); a battery unit (130); a fire detection composite sensor unit (150); a buzzer (160); and a control unit (180).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 복합센서 화재감지에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 화재 발생시 발생하는 열, 연기, 불꽃 또는 연소생성물질을 감지하여 화재 발생시 안전하고 빠른 피난을 유도, 화재의 조기 진압을 위한 소방활동의 개시를 알리 기 위한 복합센서 화재감지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 이와 같은 본 발명은 화재를 복합적으로 감지하는 복합센서 화재감지 장치에 있어서, 유무선 통신이 가능하도록 구성되는 통신부(110); 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100)식별정보(ID)와 함께 상기 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100) 설치업체의 주소정보, 관리자 스마트폰 번호 정보, 주변소방서 번호 정보, 업종, 조명 정보가 저장되고, 관리자의 스마트폰 번호 정보, 주변 소방서 번호 정보가 저장되는 메모리부(120); 상기 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100)에 필요로 하는 전원을 공급하는 배터리부(130); 화재를 복합적으로 감지하는 다수의 센서가 하나의 모듈로 구성되어, 화재현장에서 발생될 수 있는 연기, 온도상승 및 불꽃을 감지하기 위하여 연기센서(151), 온도센서(152) 및 화염감지센서(153)가 하나의 모듈로 구성되는 화재감지복합센서부(150); 화재감지시나 상기 화재감지 복합센서부(150)의 이상(고장) 발생시 경고음을 발생시키는 부저(160); 및 상기 통신부(110), 메모리부(120), 배터리부(130), 화재감지 복합센서부(150) 및 부저(160)를 제어하며, 미리 설정된 주기마다 상기 화재감지 복합센서부(150)의 센서들을 미리 설정된 주기로 기동(파워 온)시켜 센싱(측정)된 데이터에 따라 화재가 아니면 설정주기까지 슬립(파워 오프)모드로 전환시키고, 화재인 것이 감지되면 상기 연기센서(151), 온도센서(152) 및 화염감지센서(153)로부터의 감지에 대하여, 연기인지, 온도이상인지, 화염감지인지 아니면 하나 이상의 복합적인 감지인지를 판단하고, 이를 상기 메모리부(120)를 참조하여 관리자스마트폰 번호 정보에 따라 관리자 스마트폰으로 해당 화재정보를 상기 통신부(110)를 통해 전송하거나, 소방서버로 화재가 발생한 상기 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100) 설치업체의 주소정보, 업종정보, 화재정보를 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부(180);를 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 복합센서 화재감지 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Apparatus for Monitoring Fire
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection device for early suppression of a fire, which comprises: a communication unit (110) for allowing wired and wireless communications; a memory unit (120); a battery unit (130) for supplying power required for a composite sensor fire detection device (100); a fire detection composite sensor unit (150); a buzzer (160); and a control unit (180) for controlling the communication unit (110), the memory unit (120), the battery unit (130), the fire detection composite sensor unit (150) and the buzzer (160).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 복합센서 화재감지에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 화재 발생시 발생하는 열, 연기, 불꽃 또는 연소생성물질을 감지하여 화재 발생시 안전하고 빠른 피난을 유도, 화재의 조기 진압을 위한 소방활동의 개시를 알리 기 위한 복합센서 화재감지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 이와 같은 본 발명은 화재를 복합적으로 감지하는 복합센서 화재감지 장치에 있어서, 유무선 통신이 가능하도록 구성되는 통신부(110); 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100)식별정보(ID)와 함께 상기 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100) 설치업체의 주소정보, 관리자 스마트폰 번호 정보, 주변소방서 번호 정보, 업종, 조명 정보가 저장되고, 관리자의 스마트폰 번호 정보, 주변 소방서 번호 정보가 저장되는 메모리부(120); 상기 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100)에 필요로 하는 전원을 공급하는 배터리부(130); 화재를 복합적으로 감지하는 다수의 센서가 하나의 모듈로 구성되어, 화재현장에서 발생될 수 있는 연기, 온도상승 및 불꽃을 감지하기 위하여 연기센서(151), 온도센서(152) 및 화염감지센서(153)가 하나의 모듈로 구성되는 화재감지복합센서부(150); 화재감지시나 상기 화재감지 복합센서부(150)의 이상(고장) 발생시 경고음을 발생시키는 부저(160); 및 상기 통신부(110), 메모리부(120), 배터리부(130), 화재감지 복합센서부(150) 및 부저(160)를 제어하며, 미리 설정된 주기마다 상기 화재감지 복합센서부(150)의 센서들을 미리 설정된 주기로 기동(파워 온)시켜 센싱(측정)된 데이터에 따라 화재가 아니면 설정주기까지 슬립(파워 오프)모드로 전환시키고, 화재인 것이 감지되면 상기 연기센서(151), 온도센서(152) 및 화염감지센서(153)로부터의 감지에 대하여, 연기인지, 온도이상인지, 화염감지인지 아니면 하나 이상의 복합적인 감지인지를 판단하고, 이를 상기 메모리부(120)를 참조하여 관리자스마트폰 번호 정보에 따라 관리자 스마트폰으로 해당 화재정보를 상기 통신부(110)를 통해 전송하거나, 소방서버로 화재가 발생한 상기 복합센서 화재감지 장치(100) 설치업체의 주소정보, 업종정보, 화재정보를 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부(180);를 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 복합센서 화재감지 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: How to provide multilingual services in the form of chatting.
title_ko: 채팅 형식으로 구성된 다국어 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for providing a multilingual service in a chat format. The method may comprise the steps of: displaying a learning script of the first language including a plurality of dialogues; receiving start input of a learning service; displaying a first translated dialogue text in a second language corresponding to a first dialogue text among the plurality of dialogues; displaying the first translated dialogue text and simultaneously playing the text to speech (TTS) voice of the first translated conversation text; receiving a voice input of a second language associated with the first translated dialogue text; and displaying a first practice sentence in the second language corresponding to the voice input, a translation of the first practice sentence in the first language, and a playback icon for a recording file of the voice input. According to the means of solving the problem of the present invention, by providing foreign language learning content in a chat format, it can provide users with interest in learning foreign languages and high foreign language learning efficiency. In addition, by receiving user voice input linked to foreign language learning content in the chat format, and providing/playing the TTS voice of foreign language learning content and the user's voice input in the chat format, it can provide users with interest in learning foreign languages and high foreign language learning efficiency.
abstract_ko: 채팅 형식으로 구성된 다국어 서비스 제공 방법이 개시되며, 상기 다국어 학습 서비스 제공 방법은 복수의 대화문을 포함하는 제1언어의 학습 대본을 디스플레이하는 단계, 학습 서비스의 시작 입력을 수신하는 단계, 복수의 대화문 중 제1 대화문에 대응하는 제2언어의 제1번역 대화문을 디스플레이하는 단계, 제1번역 대화문을 디스플레이함과 동시에 제1번역 대화문의 TTS(Text to Speech) 음성을 재생하는 단계, 제1번역 대화문과 연계된 제2언어의 음성 입력을 수신하는 단계 및 음성 입력에 대응하는 제2언어의 제1연습문, 제1연습문의 제1언어의 번역문 및 음성 입력의 녹음 파일 재생 아이콘을 디스플레이하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 전술한 본원의 과제 해결 수단에 의하면, 채팅 형식으로 구성된 외국어 학습 콘텐츠를 제공함으로써, 사용자에 게 외국어 학습의 흥미와 높은 외국어 학습 효율을 제공할 수 있다. 또한, 채팅 형식으로 구성된 외국어 학습 콘텐츠와 연계된 사용자의 음성입력을 수신하고, 외국어 학습 콘텐츠의 TTS음성과 사용자의 음성입력을 채팅 형식으로 제공/재생함으로써, 사용자에게 외국어 학습의 흥미와 높은 외국어 학습 효율을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Experiment teaching material, arrangement generation method, and method for using experiment teaching material
abstract_en: To provide an experiment teaching material which allows a user to learn principles of image reconstruction of a computer tomographic apparatus in a safer and easy-to-understand manner.SOLUTION: In an experiment teaching material 1, a block matrix body 4 is formed such that the same number of blocks formed of a raw material that transmits a light beam having a larger wavelength than a radiation are arranged in a plurality of X, Y axial directions orthogonal to each other, and makes the light beams incident in the X, Y axial directions travel in a straight line in the X, Y axial directions. A light source 11 makes an infrared ray IL on the block matrix body 4 along the X, Y axial directions. A detection unit 12 detects the intensity of the infrared ray IL passing through the block matrix body 4. A lid shields the blocks 10 constituting the block matrix body 4 so as not to be visually recognized. A first block 10a and a second block 10b having mutually-different attenuation degrees of the transmitted infrared ray IL are included as the blocks 10. The block matrix body 4 includes the first block 10a and the second block 10b so as to be freely arranged.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Air-ground integrated Internet of things joint resource allocation method based on deep double Q networks and federal learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation method based on a transverse federal learning and depth double-Q network for disaster emergency scenes, which is oriented to emergency scenes, an unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted air-ground integrated network is constructed, an unmanned aerial vehicle is clustered by adopting a function clustering idea, two tasks of calculation unloading and perception information transmission are comprehensively considered, a multi-objective optimization problem is constructed, an optimal channel allocation and emission power joint optimization strategy is obtained by utilizing a depth double-Q network model, federal learning is introduced, global aggregation is realized on the premise of protecting user data safety, a priority experience playback mechanism is introduced, the convergence speed of network training is accelerated, and the performance is improved. The HFL-DDQN algorithm used by the invention can minimize the time and energy cost of the system under the condition of meeting the constraints of time delay, power and the like, and effectively solves the joint optimization problem of channel allocation and power selection of vehicle users and sensing nodes in emergency scenes.

title_en: SDN-based power distribution network information physical collaborative recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for physical collaborative recovery of power distribution network information based on SDN, which are characterized in that SDN technology is utilized to obtain global information of the power distribution network and operation state data of a measurement and control device, and damage conditions of a line, a bus and communication equipment are determined; according to the information of the lines and the buses, the maximum load value is taken as a target, an information-physical coupling comprehensive optimization model of the post-disaster power distribution network is established, and a heuristic algorithm is used for solving the information-physical coupling comprehensive optimization model of the post-disaster power distribution network, so that an information physical coupling recovery strategy is obtained; recovering the power distribution network communication network through SDN technology according to the recovery strategy of information physical coupling; and controlling the power distribution network to carry out topological reconstruction to form a plurality of micro-networks according to the recovery strategy of the information physical coupling so as to recover the load. The method can be applied to recovery and load recovery of the communication path after the disaster of the power distribution network, and provides reference suggestions for the emergency repair department.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for rapidly acquiring glacier surface movement speed
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for rapidly acquiring the movement speed of a glacier surface, and relates to the technical field of glacier movement. The method and the device for rapidly acquiring the glacier surface movement speed specifically comprise the following steps: s1, shooting videos and images, S2, establishing a model, S3, comparing key feature points, S4, identifying disasters, and S5, caching video and image data. According to the invention, a binocular stereo semi-global matching algorithm (SGBM) is adopted to carry out three-dimensional reconstruction of glacier information on two groups of glacier images shot at different angles, three-dimensional point cloud model data of a glacier area are constructed, and the stereo matching effect is better and the precision is higher; and extracting key characteristic points of glacier images by using two frames of image data of the front and rear time periods of the video sensor and using a FAST acceleration segmentation test characteristic algorithm, completing space matching of three-dimensional point cloud data of the front and rear time periods by using the extracted characteristic points, extracting instantaneous displacement of glacier movement by using a three-dimensional LK optical flow algorithm optimized by a Gaussian Newton method, and identifying possible ice collapse disasters.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network dynamic network reconstruction method considering fault maintenance
abstract_en: A post-disaster power distribution network dynamic network reconstruction method considering fault maintenance, a maintenance material distribution method, a fault maintenance plan making method and a power distribution network dynamic network reconstruction method. According to the fault condition of the power distribution network, the distance between the material warehouse and the fault position is combined, and maintenance materials are distributed for each fault with the aim of minimizing the material conveying time; the method for planning the fault overhaul plan combines the fault conditions in the post-disaster power distribution network, aims at minimizing overhaul time, schedules overhaul personnel and plans the overhaul plan; the method for reconstructing the dynamic network of the power distribution network comprises the steps that the power distribution network is combined with a maintenance plan to update the state of a line switch, so that the reconstruction of the dynamic network of the power distribution network is realized, and the network topology of the power distribution network is dynamically adjusted. The invention realizes reasonable distribution of overhaul materials and establishes a fault overhaul plan on the basis of considering post-disaster fault overhaul, overhauls faults existing in the post-disaster power distribution network, and simultaneously carries out dynamic network reconstruction to optimize the distribution of power distribution network source load.
assignees: POWERCHINA HENAN ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA CENTRAL CHINA ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: New energy automobile trades electric installation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy automobile battery equipment, in particular to a new energy automobile battery exchange device, wherein a parking space is marked on the ground, an underground space is cut below the parking space, a charging device, a taking and placing device and a ventilation device are arranged in the underground space, after the new energy automobile is parked on the parking space, the taking and placing device takes down a battery pack on a chassis of the new energy automobile and sends the battery pack into the charging device, and then the battery pack which is fully charged in the charging device is arranged on the chassis of the new energy automobile. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the device does not occupy extra ground space, can be used for underground excavation reconstruction in the existing parking lot, and each independent charging bin can be independently used for sealing and blocking air to prevent fire spreading when a fire disaster occurs, so that fire loss can be reduced to the minimum extent. The battery pack capacity of the underground space is far greater than the number of the replaceable battery packs of the ground power exchange station, so that the power exchange times can be greatly improved, and the power exchange service efficiency is improved.

title_en: Construction method for development period and disaster history of large debris flow accumulation fan
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a development period and a catastrophe history of a large debris flow stacking fan, which comprises the steps of 1, dividing a debris flow deposition structure and a period unit in the field; step 2, geophysical prospecting analysis of mud-rock flow thickness fanning and boulder distribution; step 3, completing transverse and longitudinal profile layout sampling of the debris flow fan based on the steps 1 and 2; step 4, based on the collected information, completing year analysis and age constraint; step 5, according to the test analysis result of the step 4, establishing the development period and the chronology sequence of the debris flow fan; step 6, completing the evolution process of the debris flow fan and the construction of the catastrophe history based on the steps; the method can complete the year measurement of the top of the stacking fan and the soil accumulation system of the upper slope of the stacking fan and the year measurement of the bottom of the stacking fan and the river and lake sand layer system of the stacking fan; through the numerical simulation of the debris flow, the development period of the debris flow with long time scale can be rebuilt, the defect of short-term observation disaster data is overcome, and the actual requirements of the history reconstruction of the significant debris flow fan and disaster prevention and reduction engineering are met.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Cold passageway skylight fire control aggregate unit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire-fighting linkage device for a cold channel skylight. Comprising the following steps: the system comprises at least one signal collector for collecting a fire protection system starting signal, at least one skylight overturning controller and a plurality of skylight overturning devices; the signal collector is arranged beside a nozzle for spraying fire extinguishing gas or beside a fire sound-light alarm; the skylight overturning controller is arranged in the cold channel of the cabinet module; the plurality of skylight overturning devices are respectively and correspondingly arranged on each skylight; the signal collector is electrically connected with each skylight overturning controller; each skylight overturning controller is electrically connected with a plurality of skylight overturning devices. By the aid of the method, on the basis of ensuring consistency of skylight overturning control, gas fire extinguishment and warning, the construction or reconstruction of the cabinet is not limited by a fire-fighting system in a machine room, and the fire-fighting system is not influenced by the construction or reconstruction of the cabinet.

title_en: Drone station for fire suppression
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone station for fire suppression to enable rapid access to fire scenes in high-rise buildings that are difficult for firefighters to access and comprises: a plurality of station boxes with an empty space formed inside and a door that opens and closes on the upper side; a loading table provided on the bottom of the station box to move up and down and rising to a predetermined height; a leg grip means provided on the upper surface of the loading table to grip and fix the legs of a drone seated on the upper surface of the loading table. The station box is equipped with a control unit with a communication module and is linked to a central control center. When a fire report is received by the central control center, the fire report is transmitted to the station box in the area closest to the fire point and the drone is dispatched to extinguish the fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방관의 접근이 용이치 못한 고층 건물의 화재현장에 신속한 접근이 가능하도록 하기 위한 화재진압용 드론 스테이션에 관한 기술로서, 내부에 빈 공간이 형성되며, 상면측에 개폐되는 출입도어가 마련되는 복수의 스테이션함; 상기 스테이션함의 바닥면에 상하방향으로 승하강 동작되도록 마련되되 소정 높이까지 상승하게 되는 로딩테이블; 상기 로딩테이블 상면에 안착되는 드론의 레그를 붙잡아 고정시킬 수 있도록 상기 로딩테이블 상면에 구비되는 레그파지수단;을 포함하되,상기 스테이션함에는 통신모듈을 갖는 제어부가 구비되어 중앙관제센터와 연동되고, 상기 중앙관제센터로 화재신고가 접수되면 화재지점과 가장 가까운 지역의 상기 스테이션함으로 전송하여 화재진압을 위해 상기 드론이 출동할 수 있도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Quick-building honeycomb type building for earthquake relief
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quickly-built honeycomb building for earthquake relief, which belongs to the technical field of buildings and comprises an upper end plate and a lower end plate which are both regular hexagons, wherein the upper end surface of the lower end plate is provided with supports which are distributed in a hexagonal manner, and the supports are hinged with vertically-arranged supporting shafts; six containing grooves which are distributed in a regular hexagon shape are formed in the lower end face of the upper end plate, sliding seats are connected in the containing grooves in a sliding mode, and the sliding seats are hinged to the end portions of the corresponding supporting shaft; the upper end and the lower end of each supporting plate are detachably connected with the upper end plate and the lower end plate, and an inlet and an outlet are formed in one supporting plate; a power device for pushing the upper end plate to move upwards is arranged between the upper end plate and the lower end plate; the invention aims to solve the problems that the reinforced concrete cast-in-situ structure is commonly adopted in the traditional building, the structure has great weight, the construction time is long, the standardization and modularization degree is low, and the quick reconstruction can not be realized when natural disasters such as earthquake and the like are received.

title_en: Beidou ground disaster monitoring data encryption and decryption method
abstract_en: The application discloses a Beidou ground disaster monitoring data encryption and decryption method, which relates to the technical field of ground crack measurement and comprises the steps of cutting positioning coordinate data and converting the positioning coordinate data into numerical values through ASCII (integrated circuit code for identification) coding; performing Fourier transform; converting the frequency domain signal into a byte sequence, and performing primary encryption on the signal by using an encryption algorithm; generating a pseudo-random sequence based on a preset secret key, and performing exclusive OR operation; transmitting to the receiving end to complete encryption. Performing exclusive-or operation on the received data and a pseudo-random sequence generated based on the same key; decrypting the signal; the original positioning coordinate data is restored by inverse fourier transform. The application has better anti-interference capability, can recover even if being interfered in the transmission process, and has higher robustness; the method has good safety, the Fourier transform makes the original plaintext difficult to restore under the condition of not knowing the correct key, the cracking difficulty is increased, and the generated pseudo-random sequence can resist replay attack.

title_en: Disaster broadcasting reception facility for energy saving using sensor technology
title_ko: 센서 기술을 적용한 에너지 절감형 재난 방송 수신 설비
abstract_en: A tunnel-type disaster broadcasting reception facility is disclosed. The disclosed tunnel-type disaster broadcasting reception facility comprises: a broadcast signal replay unit having a constant broadcasting mode in which a constant broadcast signal from a broadcasting station is received through a reception antenna and then transmitted into a tunnel through a transmission antenna and a disaster broadcasting mode in which a disaster broadcast signal from a disaster management unit is transmitted through a reception antenna into the tunnel through the transmission antenna; a sensing unit installed in the tunnel to sense vehicles or passengers passing within the tunnel; and a control unit for maintaining the broadcast signal relay unit in an off state or switching the off state to an on state depending on the sensing signal provided from the sensing unit, wherein the off state is a state in which the constant broadcast signal or the disaster broadcast signal is not transmitted through the transmission antenna, and the on state is a state in which the constant broadcast signal or the disaster broadcast signal is transmitted through the transmission antenna. Accordingly, a battery backup effect can be maximized.
abstract_ko: 터널형 재난 방송 수신 설비가 개시된다. 개시되는 터널형 재난 방송 수신 설비는, 수신 안테나를 통해 방송국으로부터의 상시 방송신호를 수신한 후 송신 안테나를 통해 터널 내로 송출하는 상시 방송 모드와, 상기 수신 안테나를 통해 재난 관리부로부터의 재난 방송 신호를 상기 송신 안테나를 통해 상기 터널 내로 송출하는 재난 방송 모드를 갖는, 방송 신호 중계부와, 상기 터널 내에 설치되어 터널 내 통행 차량 또는 통행자를 센싱하는 센싱부와, 상기 센싱부로부터 제공되는 센싱 신호에 의존하여 상기 방송 신호 중계부를 오프 상태로 유지하거나 온 상태로 전환시키기 위한 제어부 - 상기 오프 상태는 상기 송신 안테나를 통해 상기 상시 방송 신호 또는 상기 재난 방송 신호를 송출하지 않는 상태이고, 상기 온 상태는 상기 송신 안테나를 통해 상기 상시 방송 신호 또는 상기 재난 방송 신호를 송출하는 상태임 - 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Indication system and method for accident handling guidance and escape route of chemical plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indication system and method for handling instruction and escape route of accident in chemical plant, belonging to the technical field of safety monitoring in chemical plant, comprising a temperature sensor, an air sensor, a monitoring module, an image processing module, a cascade extraction module, a 3D reconstruction module, an instruction database, an intelligent plan module, a route planning module, a voice broadcasting module and a maintenance recording module; the invention can accurately predict and process the accidents of the chemical plant, realize the early prediction and treatment of the accidents, reduce the occurrence probability of the accidents, simultaneously automatically update parameters, reduce the operation difficulty, improve the use experience of staff, design the optimal escape route for each target in real time, avoid casualties caused by untimely escape, ensure the personal safety and improve the escape success rate.

title_en: Digital reconstruction suit integrated box device for disaster site
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disaster site digital reconstruction suit integrated box device which comprises a main box body and a charging port, wherein the front end of the main box body is provided with a lifting structure, the inside of the main box body is provided with a layered structure, the inner wall of the main box body is provided with an anti-seismic and anti-collision structure, the rear end of the main box body is provided with a battery interlayer, the front ends of the battery interlayers are all provided with the charging port, and the top end of the inner wall of the main box body is provided with a camera. According to the sleeving integrated box device, the box door is driven to automatically lift through the mutual matching of the threaded rod and the lifting block, so that the problem of manually opening and closing the door is avoided; the bearing rod is inserted into a proper butt joint hole, so that the height of the laminate can be adjusted, the problem that the space division plate cannot be adjusted is avoided, and the accommodating space of the main box body is utilized to the greatest extent; the arrangement of the reinforcing rod and the spring piece increases the bearing capacity of the main box body after the impact.
assignees: NANJING XINDEYIN EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Train and emergency response vehicle collaborative optimization method under subway sudden interruption situation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative optimization method for a train and an emergency response vehicle under a subway sudden interruption situation. The method comprises the following steps: taking the minimum total waiting time of passengers as a first objective function, solving a schedule adjustment model to obtain an interrupted subway schedule, wherein a strategy for shortening a train number path is adopted to avoid running conflict between a train and an interruption area; aiming at the interruption area, adopting a cellular discrete road network to obtain a reconstructed discrete road traffic network; and for the reconstructed discrete road traffic network, taking the total travel time of the minimized emergency response vehicle as a second objective function, solving a real-time guidance model of the emergency response vehicle to obtain a path of the emergency response vehicle, wherein a dynamic traffic distribution method is adopted to capture real-time traffic conditions of the road so as to guide the path of the emergency response vehicle in real time. The invention can provide effective technical support for emergency rescue of subway to cope with sudden interruption accidents.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating shallow foundation horizontal bearing capacity on clay seabed
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean engineering, and discloses a method and a device for evaluating the horizontal bearing capacity of a shallow foundation on a clay seabed. According to the method for evaluating the horizontal bearing capacity of the shallow foundation on the clay seabed, provided by the invention, the seabed soil and the circulating wave load parameters corresponding to the preset time are collected at each preset time in the preset period, the three-dimensional seabed soil model corresponding to the preset time is reconstructed, and the circulating wave load parameters at the preset time are continuously applied to the shallow foundation model within the preset time starting from the preset time, so that the horizontal bearing capacity of the shallow foundation at the next preset time is measured. The horizontal bearing capacity corresponding to the shallow foundation at each moment in the whole period is obtained in such a way, and the obtained horizontal bearing capacity is higher in authenticity, so that the generated evaluation strategy is higher in accuracy, disasters such as slippage and overturning of the shallow foundation are avoided, and property loss is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent image transmission device and method with ultrahigh compression ratio
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for transmitting an intelligent image with an ultrahigh compression ratio, wherein the method mainly comprises the following steps: converting an input image into a binary code stream with ultrahigh compression ratio through a low code rate enhancement type reversible coding network; the binary code stream is sent to a low code rate enhanced reversible decoding network to reconstruct the input image. The invention has the characteristics of ultrahigh compression ratio, narrow channel transmission bandwidth and good instantaneity, can be used for transmitting images in real time by using a short wave channel with extremely low bandwidth, and has wide application prospects in the fields of disaster relief, field operation, unmanned aerial vehicle/robot remote teleoperation and the like.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning and monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning and monitoring device, which is characterized in that a connecting block is fixedly connected to the outside of a device main body, a camera is arranged outside the connecting block, a loudspeaker is arranged outside the device main body, a landslide monitoring system is applied to the device main body, the landslide monitoring system comprises a data acquisition module, a data monitoring module, a risk prediction module, an early warning module and a deep learning module, the data acquisition module transmits data to the data monitoring module, the data monitoring module transmits data to the risk prediction module, the risk prediction module transmits data to the early warning module, and the risk prediction module also needs model training of the deep learning module. In the invention, the data analysis module is applied with a super-resolution reconstruction algorithm, processes the information acquired by the camera, reduces the influence of the environment on information collection, and simultaneously performs model training of deep learning, thereby predicting risks better and carrying out early warning.

title_en: Mobile cloud computing server and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile cloud computing server and a use method thereof, wherein the mobile cloud computing server comprises a rack and a server, the rack is arranged in a carriage, the server is embedded on a frame body arranged on the rack, a temperature and humidity detector is arranged at the top of the rack, the server is communicated with an air outlet end of a water cooling mechanism, a water cooling mechanism and a cooling liquid storage tank are arranged on a frame of a vehicle, the cooling liquid storage tank is communicated with the water cooling mechanism through a conveying pipe, a generator set is arranged on one side of the water cooling mechanism, the generator set is electrically connected with the water cooling mechanism and the server, and a ventilation fan is arranged at the top of the carriage. The cloud computing server service system can flexibly push out different mobile cloud computing server service schemes, has high mobility and flexibility, meets the use requirements of large-scale task activities, post-disaster reconstruction or temporary sudden emergency tasks, and ensures the stable operation of the cloud computing server while reducing energy consumption by using a cooling mechanism, a ventilation fan and a refrigerating mechanism and applying optimal cooling measures.
assignees: NANJING PULANNI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Enhanced fire-fighting smoke-discharging system for garage
abstract_en: The application discloses an enhanced fire-fighting smoke-discharging system for a garage, which comprises a smoke-discharging system air pipe positioned in the garage and a smoke-discharging fan arranged at an inlet and an outlet of the garage. A flue gas cooling device is arranged in the flue gas discharging system air pipe, and an auxiliary flue gas discharging fan is connected in parallel at one side of the flue gas discharging fan. The flue gas cooling device is a spray nozzle which is arranged at the top in the flue gas discharging system air pipe along the length direction at intervals, and the spray nozzle can deflect in the same direction along with the flue gas discharging direction. Aiming at the fire disaster of higher high-temperature smoke and high heat release rate when the new energy automobile and the hybrid automobile are in fire disaster relative to the traditional fuel oil automobile with the internal combustion engine, the application provides the technical scheme of smoke guiding and air pipe spray cooling in a parking space, and solves the problem that the fire valve is required to be closed at 280 ℃ for smoke discharging in the prior specification, so that the high-temperature, toxic and harmful smoke cannot be discharged. Meanwhile, the upgrading and the reconstruction of the existing system can be conveniently realized.
assignees: SCEGC EQUIPMENT INSTALLATION GROUP COMPANY LTD;SHAANXI CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon positioning method based on social media
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon positioning method based on social media data, which mainly solves the problem of low typhoon positioning accuracy in the prior art when massive and complex social media data are processed. The method comprises the steps of obtaining space-time information in social media data, encoding the space-time information into a space-time encoding data set, extracting text semantic features of the space-time encoding data set by using a BERT model, carrying out semantic and spatial reconstruction on the semantic features according to space-time encoding to obtain a reconstructed semantic feature data set, constructing a convolutional neural network based on a three-dimensional convolutional layer and a convolutional-long-short-term memory artificial neural layer, predicting the distance from each grid center to a typhoon center by using the reconstructed semantic feature data set, and determining the latitude and longitude positions of the typhoon center by using the prediction result of the convolutional neural network through a space-time grid positioning algorithm based on location services. The invention improves the accuracy of typhoon positioning by reconstructing the social media data characteristics, and can be used for defending natural disasters.

title_en: Augmented reality based indoor fire training system
title_ko: 증강현실 기반 실내 소방 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: An augmented reality-based indoor firefighting training system is disclosed. The augmented reality-based indoor firefighting training system comprises: a plurality of access points (APs) disposed at preset intervals in an indoor firefighting training place and measuring and transmitting the received signal strength of Bluetooth signals transmitted by nearby Bluetooth devices; an augmented reality user helmet worn by a firefighting trainee who performs the firefighting training in the indoor firefighting training place and providing information to the firefighting trainee; a disaster reenactment device that re-enacts a disaster situation according to a pre-set training situation; and a central server that creates a training situation, transmits, to the augmented reality user helmet, training situation data and indoor map data for providing a training scenario set according to the training situation to the firefighting trainee, collects training data from the plurality of APs and the augmented user helmet during the firefighting training, and storing the training data collected after the training is terminated. The firefighting training system can support the firefighting training to cope with disasters.
abstract_ko: 증강현실 기반 실내 소방 훈련 시스템이 개시된다. 증강현실 기반 실내 소방 훈련 시스템은, 실내 소방훈련장에 미리 설정된 간격을 두고 배치되며, 주변에서 블루투스 기기가 송출하는 블루투스 신호의 수신신호세기를 측정하여 전송하는 복수의 액세스포인트(AP: Access Point), 실내 소방훈련장에서 소방 훈련을 수행하는 소방 훈련자가 착용하며, 소방 훈련자에게 정보를 제공하는 증강현실 사용자 헬멧, 미리 설정된 훈련 상황에 따라 재난 상황을 재연하는 재난 재연 장치 및 훈련 상황을 부여하고 부여된 훈련 상황에 따라 설정된 훈련 시나리오를 소방 훈련자에게 제공하기 위한 훈련 상황 데이터 및 실내 지도 데이터를 증강현실 사용자 헬멧으로 전송하고, 소방 훈련 중에 복수의 액세스포인트 및 증강현실 사용자 헬멧으로부터 훈련 데이터를 수집하고, 소방 훈련 종료 후에 수집된 훈련 데이터를 저장하는 중앙 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Shallow coal seam roof modification and reconstruction method
abstract_en: The application discloses a shallow coal seam roof modification and reconstruction method, wherein the rock stratum structure of a coal seam roof adjacent to a coal seam is two layers of hard rock stratum and a weak rock stratum clamped between the two layers of hard rock stratum, a fracturing hole is formed in the coal seam roof in a mining space, and fracturing liquid is injected into the fracturing hole to break the weak rock stratum into discrete particles; and then, injecting water-insoluble movable gel into the crushed weak rock stratum, filling gaps among the dispersion particles by the gel, increasing the cohesive force and compactness among the dispersion particles, enhancing the ductility and continuity of the dispersion rock, realizing the waterproofing of the weak rock stratum, and reducing the wave impedance of the rock stratum. The application is based on the physical property of rock, considers the compactness principle of compacting broken rock, and realizes the purpose of comprehensive treatment of water damage and dynamic disasters by modifying the weak rock stratum into dispersoid substances and simultaneously injecting water-insoluble gel substances into the broken weak rock stratum so as to change the permeable environment of the rock stratum and increase deformability.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHONGTAI ENERGY INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method based on Internet adding technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and discloses a geological disaster early warning method based on an internet adding technology, which comprises the following steps: establishing a geological disaster monitoring system based on the internet of things, arranging sensors in a region prone to occurrence, monitoring geological disaster influence factors in real time, and transmitting monitoring data acquired by the sensors to a data center through a network; analyzing and processing the collected monitoring data, establishing a geological disaster assessment model, and judging the type, time and range of possible geological disasters by using machine learning and deep learning algorithms; distributing geological early warning information to government departments and emergency management departments through an internet technology according to the monitoring data and the model analysis result; establishing interaction platforms of government departments, emergency management departments and the public by utilizing an internet technology; the internet adding technology is utilized to carry out informatization upgrading in the whole process of geological disaster monitoring, early warning, rescue and reconstruction, so that more accurate and efficient geological disaster management is realized.
assignees: CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY 119 PROSPECTING TEAM

title_en: Method for processing read request, distributed database and server
abstract_en: The application provides a method for processing a read request, a distributed database and a server side, wherein the method is applied to the distributed database for disaster recovery, the method takes the slowest playback progress in a plurality of current playback progress corresponding to a plurality of first nodes and a plurality of current playback progress corresponding to a plurality of fragments as a first target playback progress, and the target nodes only request to read data from the target fragments under the condition that the current playback progress corresponding to the target fragments is greater than or equal to the first target playback progress, so that the target fragments in the distributed database cannot be unreadable, and in addition, the method can ensure that the data about the first application read by different target nodes associated with the first application are consistent, namely, the read consistency is ensured.

title_en: Method for dynamically and quantitatively evaluating super-standard flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically and quantitatively evaluating a super-standard flood disaster, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring basic data of a research area; step 2, performing super-standard flood real-time dynamic simulation by using a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model based on GPU heterogeneous parallel acceleration; step 3, constructing the spatial distribution of the socioeconomic class data and establishing association with flood inundation characteristic parameters; step 4, calculating and establishing the relation between flood inundation characteristic parameters and various property flood damage rates; and 5, estimating the loss of the over-standard flood disasters. The method realizes real-time dynamic rapid quantitative assessment of the flood disaster exceeding the standard of the flood disaster, improves timeliness and accuracy of the flood disaster assessment, and provides references for the exceeding the standard flood dispatching decision and real-time coping; and the GPU heterogeneous parallel acceleration method is adopted to reconstruct a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, so that the consumption of computing resources is greatly reduced, and the computing efficiency of the model is improved.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Slice security mapping method and system for intelligent identification network
abstract_en: The invention provides a slice security mapping method and a slice security mapping system for an intelligent identification network, belongs to the technical field of Internet of things communication, provides an API (application program interface) externally accessed by a high-availability slice system, can respond to a user request at a higher speed and a lower cost, improves the efficiency of user identity data verification and the system performance when facing replay attack, and realizes the function of recording user interaction behavior; the method can accurately reflect the use requirement of a user, realize the VNF disaster recovery switching function when the node is unavailable in the slicing use process, introduce the constraint of safety control under the conditions of improving the resource utilization rate, the cost profit margin and the like through a safety arrangement algorithm, improve the safety performance of the arrangement algorithm, encrypt the data of the arrangement signaling, realize the programmable transmission forwarding function of a data layer, construct a slicing network for bottom transmission equipment, and convert the user data into the slicing data in different network protocol forms for transmission in the network.

title_en: Rapid analysis method for wind deflection of power transmission line based on tower-line-insulator system equivalent model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid analysis method for wind deflection of a power transmission line based on a tower-line-insulator system equivalent model, which comprises the following steps: (1) Determining the shape of a power transmission line curve, and establishing a suspension insulator string-power transmission line connection model; (2) Establishing a numerical model of an electric tower-insulator string-power transmission line system; (3) Obtaining the wind deflection of the insulator string under the action of stable wind, and carrying out preliminary evaluation on the risk of the wind deflection of the insulator under the action of strong wind; (4) Considering the pulsation wind component of strong wind, simulating pulsation wind speed V, determining pulsation wind load, automatically generating load files, importing limited analysis programs, and analyzing and obtaining dynamic time course of insulator windage under the action of pulsation wind; (5) And carrying out wind deflection safety evaluation to provide wind deflection disaster early warning. The wind deflection calculation method greatly improves wind deflection calculation efficiency, and scientifically and efficiently solves the problems of wind deflection assessment and replay of the power transmission line in short-time strong wind or strong convection weather.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle Ad hoc network monitoring system based on clustering architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc networks, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network monitoring system based on a clustering framework, which comprises the following steps: s1: selecting an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with a wireless communication interface; s2: the system is divided into an off-line stage and an on-line stage, wherein the off-line stage is a positioning stage, the actual position of the unmanned aerial vehicle is estimated through a positioning algorithm, and after positioning, the on-line stage is applied and comprises two subsystems which are respectively used for clustering and data transmission; s3: in the clustering process, all nodes can identify adjacent nodes, dynamic configuration and reconstruction of a network are carried out in a hierarchical management mode, and the unordered UAV nodes are initially clustered by adopting a K-means++ algorithm. The invention has the following advantages and effects: the unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network clustering structure is formed, the unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network is better managed, the communication efficiency is improved, and the constructed model is suitable for emergency communication after disaster.
assignees: SUZHOU XINGHANG COMPREHENSIVE TESTING TECH CO LTD;UNIV SOOCHOW

title_en: Extended reality-based fire drill method and apparatus
title_ko: 확장 현실 기반 소방 훈련 방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: An extended reality-based fire drill method and apparatus therefor are disclosed. The extended reality-based fire drill method includes the steps of: (a) acquiring each object in real space and depth information of each object acquired through a stereo camera; (b) reconstructing each object into a 3D mesh object based on the depth information of each object; (c) generating a virtual fire in at least one of the reconstructed 3D mesh objects and then simulating a virtual fire suppression training augmented reality environment and transmitting it to a head mounted display device; and (d) operating the virtual fire extinguisher object in the virtual fire suppression training augmented reality environment according to the user's actual operation of the fire extinguisher, and extinguishing the virtual fire object by firing a virtual powder object toward the virtual fire object according to the operation of the virtual fire extinguisher object. The present invention can enable safe fire evacuation training based on virtual reality.
abstract_ko: 확장 현실 기반 소방 훈련 방법 및 그 장치가 개시된다. 확장 현실 기반 소방 훈련 방법은, (a) 스테레오 카메라를 통해 획득되는 현실 공간의 각 객체와 상기 각 객체의 깊이 정보를 획득하는 단계; (b) 상기 각 객체와 각 객체의 깊이 정보를 기초로 3D 메시(mesh) 객체로 각각 재구성하는 단계; (c) 상기 재구성된 3D 메시 객체 중 적어도 하나에 가상 불을 생성한 후 가상 화재 진압 훈련 증강 현실 환경을 시뮬레이션하여 헤드 마운티드 디스플레이 장치로 전송하는 단계; 및 (d) 사용자의 실제 소화기 조작에 따라 가상 소화기 객체를 상기 가상 화재 진압 훈련 증강 현실 환경상에서 동작시키되, 상기 가상 소화기 객체의 동작에 따라 가상 분말 객체가 상기 가상 불 객체를 향해 발사되어 상기 가상 불 객체가 소화되는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV SEJONG IND ACAD COOP FOUD

title_en: Real-time foreign language pronunciation evaluation system and method
title_ko: 실시간 외국어 발음 평가시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time foreign language pronunciation evaluation system and method and comprises: a media content playing part for playing media content comprising at least one of a text expressed in a particular language and a native speaker's voice regarding the text; a user voice receiving part for receiving an input of a user voice corresponding to the text or the native speaker's voice during the playback of the media content; a real-time evaluation performing part for initiating a real-time evaluation of the user voice based on a time of the utterance of the user voice and generating an evaluation result based on the real-time evaluation; and a visualization processing part for visualizing and outputting the evaluation result via a playback screen of the media content once the evaluation result is generated. Accordingly, it is possible to improve the efficiency of learning foreign languages.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실시간 외국어 발음 평가시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 장치는 특정 언어로 표현된 텍스트 및 상기 텍스트에 관한 원어민 음성 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 미디어 컨텐츠를 재생하는 미디어 컨텐츠 재생부; 상기 미디어 컨텐츠의 재생 동안 상기 텍스트 또는 상기 원어민 음성에 대응되는 사용자 음성을 입력받는 사용자 음성 수신부; 상기 사용자 음성의 발화 시점을 기준으로 상기 사용자 음성에 대한 실시간 평가를 개시하고 상기 실시간 평가에 따른 평가 결과를 생성하는 실시간 평가 수행부; 및 상기 평가 결과가 생성되면 상기 미디어 컨텐츠의 재생 화면을 통해 상기 평가 결과를 시각화하여 출력하는 시각화 처리부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Assembled steel pipe constraint reinforced concrete bent bridge pier
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembled steel pipe restraining reinforced concrete bent bridge pier, which is characterized in that an upper pouring groove is formed in an upper transverse restraining section, a pouring sleeve is arranged in the upper pouring groove, concrete is poured, the connection between a pier stud and a bent cap can be realized, and an upper gap is formed between a steel pipe and the bent cap; similarly, the connection between the pier column and the foundation can be realized by arranging a lower pouring groove in the lower transverse constraint section, installing a lower pouring sleeve in the lower pouring groove and pouring concrete, and forming a lower gap between the steel pipe and the foundation; the upper/lower transverse stress weak points are respectively formed at the upper/lower gaps, and when geological disasters such as earthquakes occur, the upper/lower transverse stress weak points and the lower transverse stress weak points can fail first, so that other components can be protected from being damaged, and when the later repair is carried out, only the capping beam, the pier column and the foundation are required to be reset, concrete in the upper/lower casting sleeve is taken out and then is poured again, and the quick reconstruction recovery can be realized.

title_en: Geological disaster rainfall monitoring data missing value filling method
abstract_en: The application provides a filling method of a missing value of rainfall monitoring data of geological disasters, which comprises the following steps: processing the rainfall monitoring data according to the relative longitude and latitude where the rainfall sensor is located and the duration of the rainfall monitoring data to generate a three-dimensional characteristic diagram; dividing a time window for the three-dimensional feature map in a time dimension to form a plurality of samples with the same time length; inputting the three-dimensional feature graphs of a plurality of samples into an off-line training multi-core cavity convolutional neural network to perform off-line training treatment so as to obtain a network structure and network parameters after off-line training; inputting the three-dimensional feature map to be subjected to missing value filling, the network structure after offline training and the network parameters into an online filling multi-core cavity convolutional neural network, and carrying out online filling processing on the three-dimensional feature map to be subjected to missing value filling to obtain an online reconstructed three-dimensional feature map. By applying the technical scheme of the application, the technical problem that the monitoring effect is affected by the lack of geological disaster rainfall monitoring data in the prior art can be solved.
assignees: AEROSPACE SCIENCE AND INDUSTRY INERTIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Industrial conduction mechanism analysis method for disaster caused by typhoons during recovery period
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial conduction mechanism analysis method for disaster caused by typhoons during recovery, which comprises the following steps: collecting relevant data to construct an input-output table of the area; simulating a recovery path of the economic system after disaster; the distribution analysis of indirect economic losses caused by disasters among different economic departments; analysis of the industrial conduction mechanisms of disasters during recovery. The invention is not limited to evaluating indirect economic loss caused by disasters, but utilizes the adaptive regional input-output model to simulate the recovery period, and identifies the key industrial conduction path and key industrial departments of the recovery period through structural path analysis and network analysis. The method can more objectively reveal the influence of disasters on the industrial chain, help decision makers to make emergency management measures more comprehensively, improve reconstruction efficiency, and effectively guide and adjust the adaptability of the industrial system.

title_en: Three-dimensional space dynamic reconstruction method for working face gas flow field based on measured data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional space dynamic reconstruction method of a working face gas flow field based on measured data, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety. Firstly, adopting a unit measuring method to actually measure the gas concentration data of the three-dimensional space of the working surface; then, respectively constructing a gas flow field three-dimensional space model based on the whole sample and the sparse sample, and realizing high-precision modeling of small sample data; secondly, analyzing the data characteristics of the fixed gas sensor of the working face, and determining an optimal correlation sensor; and finally, based on the gas flow field three-dimensional space model, constructing a gas flow field three-dimensional space dynamic model based on measured data by taking the associated gas concentration sensor as a variable. The invention can realize continuous dynamic monitoring of the three-dimensional space gas flow field of the working face based on the monitoring data, lays a foundation for three-dimensional visualization of the gas flow field, improves the space sensing capability of the gas disaster of the coal face, and provides technical support for intelligent construction of the gas disaster.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Rainfall runoff prediction method based on multi-modal fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall runoff prediction method based on multi-modal fusion, which comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring and processing a weather feature data set to be predicted; 2) Two modalities are divided according to the dataset: numerical data and image data; 3) Respectively extracting features of the two modes by adopting a proper neural network; 4) Reconstructing dimensions of the finally obtained features, and performing multi-mode fusion to obtain new feature vectors; 5) And inputting the new feature vector into a prediction model to obtain a final prediction result, and comparing the final prediction result with a real result. The rainfall runoff prediction method based on multi-modal fusion in time sequence prediction and multi-modal fusion can accurately acquire numerical values and characteristic information in images, and an accurate runoff prediction value is generated by using a deep learning prediction model. The method can provide water resource management measures for preventing future drought and waterlogging disasters.

title_en: Planning method for disaster-resistant and bottom-protected power grid
abstract_en: The application provides a planning method of a disaster-resistant and bottom-protected power grid, which belongs to the technical field of disaster-resistant power grids and comprises the following steps: and (3) marking important areas and important equipment facilities in the urban range, selecting and installing a plurality of transfer stations underground according to the marked areas and density. The power grid supplies power to part of transfer stations, and a connecting cable between two adjacent transfer stations distributes and transmits the electric energy input by the power grid to other transfer stations. And one end of the trunk line is connected with the transfer station, the other end of the trunk line is paved in a direction away from the transfer station, and the power supply of important areas and important equipment facilities is realized by the trunk line. And a plurality of emergency lines are connected between two adjacent main lines, and the paths of electric energy transmission are changed through the emergency lines and a plurality of switches on the main lines, so that electric energy is kept away from a disaster area and is continuously conveyed. The planning method of the disaster-resistant and bottom-protected power grid reduces disaster loss and cost required by reconstruction, can stably run for a long time and has lower total planning cost.
assignees: CANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fire control unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle which is characterized by comprising an unmanned aerial vehicle body and a fire-fighting assembly; the unmanned aerial vehicle body comprises a body, a horn and an undercarriage, wherein the horn is arranged on one side of the body, the horn is provided with a rotor wing, and the undercarriage is arranged at the bottom of the body; the fire-fighting assembly comprises a water pipe, a spray head, a fire-fighting connector, a flange plate and a fastener; the flange plate is stuck and fixed to be arranged at the bottom of the machine body, the fastening piece is detachably connected with the flange plate and used for fixing the water pipe on the flange plate, one end of the water pipe is connected with a fire-fighting connector, and the other end of the water pipe is connected with a spray head. According to the scheme, the thick water tank is not installed on the unmanned aerial vehicle, but the fire-fighting water pipe is integrated on the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the characteristics of flexibility and portability of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be greatly brought into play, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is very suitable for high-altitude fire extinguishment; the scheme has simple structure, is very convenient to install and use, is suitable for reconstruction and installation of general unmanned aerial vehicles, does not choose the installation environment, does not choose the type of unmanned aerial vehicle, and has wider application range.

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling coal mine rock burst
abstract_en: A method for preventing and controlling coal mine rock burst comprises the following steps: step one: deploying underground fracturing drilling holes at the rock burst occurrence position, drilling holes and fixing the holes; step two: paving a fracturing pipeline, connecting ground fracturing equipment with a downhole fracturing borehole to perform fracturing, so as to form a fracturing crack wave-over area in a rock burst occurrence part, generate enough three-dimensional net-shaped cracks in the rock burst occurrence part, reconstruct stress, and destroy local stress concentration; step three: overflowing after fracturing, releasing residual pressure and fracturing fluid, and guaranteeing the safety of subsequent construction; therefore, the invention effectively reduces the occurrence of rock burst disasters, is safer and more efficient to operate, and has great innovation.
assignees: BEIJING JIUZUN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: geological information acquisition and processing, signal processing, geological disaster prediction, geological disaster classification, and geological disaster response and early warning. The invention belongs to the technical field of geological engineering, in particular to a geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system based on deep learning, wherein the scheme adopts a dynamic system reconstruction method to process historical geological disaster data, reconstruct a weight matrix, and convert a one-dimensional time sequence into a track in a high-dimensional phase space so as to obtain periodic change of geological disasters; the BP neural network is adopted to process multidimensional features, self-adaptive learning is carried out, and after the neural network training is completed, the BP neural network rapidly responds in practical application, so that automatic geological disaster prediction is realized; and combining the evidences by adopting logic or fusion rules, and selecting the category with the highest confidence as a final geological disaster classification result, so that the robustness is high and the fault tolerance is strong.

title_en: Data read-write method, system, electronic device and storage medium based on FlinkCDC
abstract_en: The invention provides a data read-write method based on FlinkCDC, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the technical key points are as follows: the method comprises the following steps: step 1, creating a new independent service instance at a database server where a disaster recovery library is located; step 2, scanning log files in slave library examples of the secondary disaster recovery library, and adding the log files into a management range of a newly built example; and 3, continuously extracting data from the log file view of the new instance by the FlinkCDC reconstruction program, and pushing the acquired data to a real-time computing platform. The invention realizes the access of stock and increment data, ensures the stability and data safety of the main library environment, and has the effects of less links, low maintenance cost, strong stability, high accuracy of reading and writing data, small delay of reading and writing data, high processing speed, less occupation of resources and higher instantaneity when reading and writing.

title_en: Network fault recovery method for coordinating network reconstruction and mobile energy storage system vehicle team
abstract_en: The invention provides a network fault recovery method for coordinating network reconstruction and a mobile energy storage system vehicle team, which comprises the steps of constructing a MESS vehicle team driving model; constructing a coordinated network recovery model according to the MESS motorcade driving model; and constructing a coordinated network recovery model considering the load and the DG output prediction uncertainty, and obtaining a robust variant of the coordinated network recovery model to recover the network power supply of the active power distribution network. The invention coordinates MESS, SESS, network recovery, DG scheduling and demand response resources in the power outage area to recover power supply, considers the uncertainty of load and DG output prediction in the robust variant of the coordinated network recovery model, and provides guidance and suggestion for recovering power supply after power distribution system disaster.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Karst water-rich metal deposit roof single-layer control drainage method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a karst water-rich metal deposit roof single-layer control drainage method, which comprises S1, roof hydrogeological condition exploration; s2, drilling and grouting the structural fracture zone and the water guide fault; s3, reserving waterproof ore pillars, and avoiding water for the structural fracture zone and the water diversion fault; s4, stope drainage is carried out; s5, mining by adopting a filling method. The invention utilizes the natural blocking effect of the water-proof layer, combines grouting reconstruction and active prevention and control measures of dewatering to inhibit disaster, so that the water pressure can not break through the artificial blocking of a grouting curtain, or can not cause damage when the water pressure is released under the condition of promoting new balance, thereby effectively controlling the underground water, and being very suitable for the conditions of complex hydrogeology conditions of mineral deposits and the condition that the structure of the water-bearing layer (belt) has certain difference in space.
assignees: NORTH MINING CO LTD;CHINA MINMETALS CHANGSHA MINING RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Cross-region same-earthquake landslide automatic identification method and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a cross-region co-earthquake landslide, which utilizes pre-earthquake and post-earthquake images to automatically identify the co-earthquake landslide. By constructing a cross-region co-earthquake landslide automatic identification GDSNet model, the model consists of a feature extraction branch, a feature control branch and a feature fusion module for carrying out feature fusion on the output of the feature extraction branch and the output of the feature control branch. The feature extraction branch can retain detail features, so that the missing identification of small landslide is avoided, the feature control branch realizes the self-adaptive transmission of related features of the landslide, the landslide features in the image are captured more accurately, the expression capacity and the robustness of the model are enhanced, the false alarm rate of the landslide identification is reduced, the precision is improved, and the feature fusion module further avoids the missing identification of the small landslide by capturing multi-scale features. The method and the technical support can be provided for the accurate identification of the same-earthquake landslide in the wide area strong earthquake area after the major earthquake, and an important scientific basis is provided for the post-earthquake emergency rescue and the post-disaster reconstruction.

title_en: A work assistance system using the image recognition-based virtual object registration method in the industrial field
title_ko: 산업현장에서의 영상인식기반 가상물체 정합방법을 활용한 작업보조 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a work assistance system utilizing a virtual object matching method based on image recognition in an industrial site. The work assistance system comprises: a worker terminal unit which performs video recording of construction work an industrial site performed by a worker wearing a preset worker terminal, displaying worker location information, transmitting and receiving notification data, and transmitting and receiving voice data; a work data providing unit which provides at least one work data among a work manual, precautions, playback of a similar work performance video, a work order, and a work method to the worker terminal unit; a construction area creation unit which creates a three-dimensional modeling image of a construction area in the industrial site using the building construction work video collected from the worker terminal unit; a work determination unit which determines whether to proceed with the following work in response to the three-dimensional image and transmits the same to the worker terminal unit; a monitoring unit which collects and monitors real-time images from the preset worker terminal unit and transmits a rescue request when a preset abnormal operation is detected; a coordinate assignment unit which segments the construction area in the industrial site, assigns individual coordinates corresponding to the segmented construction area, and displays the same on the preset worker terminal unit; and an object appearance display unit which displays an appearance of the construction area of an invisible area using the individual coordinates assigned in the coordinate assignment unit. Accordingly, construction situations at an industrial site occurring at multiple points can be grasped in detail.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산업현장에서의 영상인식기반 가상물체 정합방법을 활용한 작업보조 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 기설정된 작업자 단말을 착용한 작업자의 산업현장 내 시공 작업 영상촬영, 작업자 위치정보 표시, 알림 데이터 송수신 및 음성 데이터 송수신을 수행하는 작업자단말부, 작업 매뉴얼, 주의사항, 유사 작업 수행 영상 재생, 작업 순서, 작업 방법 중 적어도 하나 이상의 작업 데이터를 상기 작업자단말부에 제공하는 작업데이터 제공부, 상기 작업자단말부에서 수집한 상기 건축물 시공 작업 영상을 이용하여 상기 산업현장 내 시공 영역을 3차원 모델링 영상으로 생성하는 시공영역 생성부, 상기 3차원 영상에 대응하여 차기 작업 진행 여부를 판단하여 상기 작업자단말부에 전송하는 작업판단부, 상기 기설정된 작업자 단말로부터 실시간 영상을 수집하여 모니터링하고 기설정된 이상동작이 감지되는 경우 구조 요청을 전송하는 모니터링부, 상기 산업현장 내 시공 영역을 세분화하고, 세분화된 시공 영역에 대응하는 개별 좌표를 할당하여 상기 기설정된 작업자 단말에 표시하는 좌표할당부 및 상기 좌표할당부에서 할당한 개별 좌표를 이용하여 비가시 영역의 상기 상기 시공 영역의 외형을 표시하는 객체외형 표시부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System treatment method for spontaneous combustion hidden danger area of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of coal mining area treatment, and particularly discloses a system treatment method for a coal mine spontaneous combustion hidden danger area. According to the geological environment characteristics of the treatment area, a mode of treating the disaster and making the ground in the coal mine from the fire hidden danger area combined with strip type treatment, construction of a silted dam, drainage ditch water system dredging and transportation road material conveying is constructed, a treatment process of treating the fire hidden danger area by dividing block sections in the treatment strip and gradient interactive treatment of the strip type block sections is provided, and a natural-simulated soil reconstruction process and a soil improvement method based on risk management and control are constructed. The invention can effectively reduce land damage, eliminate hidden danger of spontaneous combustion, increase cultivated land area, promote biological diversity and restore ecological system function.

title_en: Elastic lifting method of three-layer robust optimized active power distribution system under typhoon
abstract_en: The application discloses an elastic lifting method of an active power distribution system under typhoons with three layers of robust optimization, which comprises the following steps: establishing a three-layer robust optimized elastic lifting frame based on a DAD model and an objective function thereof according to line reinforcement, unit combination, line repair, planned island and dynamic network reconstruction and various elastic lifting measures; establishing a power transmission line state identification frame 24 hours on a disaster day, and reflecting the influence condition of typhoons on the line in real time; and solving by using NC & CG algorithm to obtain the power grid elastic lifting strategy. The application can think about the power grid defense planning from three stages of pre-disaster, during-disaster and post-disaster of the typhoon, comprehensively apply various strategies of line reinforcement, unit combination, line repair, island planning and dynamic network reconstruction to provide power grid elasticity; in the face of typhoon disasters, the influence of typhoons on the power grid and the line fault time within 24 hours of the disaster day are considered, so that references are provided for the daily scheduling of the power grid; and the recovery time of the fault line is also taken into consideration, so that a more flexible elastic lifting strategy can be formulated.

title_en: Large-scale urban power grid anti-vulnerability capacity lifting planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving and planning the anti-fragile capacity of a large-scale urban power grid, which comprises the following steps: s1, generating a fault scene based on Monte Carlo simulation; s2, screening representative extreme scenes based on k-means cluster analysis; s3, establishing an urban power grid planning optimization model oriented to limit viability improvement; s4, after the model is solved, the corresponding power supply configuration condition under the line reinforcement scheme is obtained. The distributed power supply is deployed in the planning stage, the important power transmission paths are reinforced/upgraded, and island operation of the power distribution network is guaranteed to be realized through topology reconstruction under the limit natural disasters, so that uninterrupted power supply of more important loads is guaranteed.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Multi-level ciphertext domain reversible information hiding method based on secret sharing construction redundancy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-level ciphertext domain reversible information hiding method based on secret sharing construction redundancy. In the invention, redundancy is constructed and controlled through polynomial coefficients in the process of sharing and encrypting original plaintext data, the reversible embedding of first-layer secret information is realized while threshold sharing with disaster tolerance is carried out, on the basis, the first-layer shadow ciphertext obtained after sharing and encrypting is further implemented for ciphertext sharing and encrypting, the reversible embedding of second-layer secret information is realized, and a user attribute key distribution mechanism is combined, so that the controllable access range of secret information embedded in different layers is ensured, and the hierarchical management of ciphertext access is realized in cloud space; the invention has the threshold characteristic of secret sharing, can realize the lossless recovery of the original plaintext data and the accurate extraction of secret information of different levels on the basis of meeting the threshold reconstruction condition, can tolerate the loss of partial shadow ciphertext data, and has strong disaster recovery performance.
assignees: ENGINEERING UNIV OF CHINESE PEOPLES ARMED POLICE FORCE

title_en: 10kV overhead line regional induction lightning hazard risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the disaster prevention and reduction field of a power distribution network, and particularly discloses a 10kV overhead line regional induction lightning hazard risk assessment method and system, wherein the method is characterized in that a target area is divided into a first type grid and a second type grid according to collected information by collecting lightning ground flashing activity, earth surface object distribution and 10kV overhead line parameter information of the target area; obtaining induction Lei Shanlao rate indexes of class 1 grids and class 2 grids, obtaining a whole regional induction Lei Shanlao rate grid set, carrying out normalization processing, obtaining a normalized induction Lei Shanlao rate grid set, dividing each grid lightning hazard risk grade according to the numerical value in the normalized induction Lei Shanlao rate grid set, and outputting a risk assessment result; the method provides a target area for the operation and maintenance personnel of the power distribution network line, can accurately pre-judge and sense Lei Yi flash areas and areas with larger lightning hazard risks, and provides reference for configuring lightning protection resources, reasonably distributing the operation and maintenance resources and making a lightning protection reconstruction plan of the power distribution network line.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Cloud-based destination for block-level data replication processing
abstract_en: Systems and methods disclosed herein improve on current technology for block-level data replication to cloud computing environments. A new system architecture deploys one or more replication tail proxies in a cloud computing environment, locally (at the cloud) tracks replicated data and determines which replicated data meet criteria for reconstructing a desired point-in-time in the cloud, and persists data blocks received at the replication tail proxy until they are processed as recovery points. The disclosed approach presents resiliency and performance advantages. First, the resiliency of block-level data replication to cloud is improved by deploying the replication tail proxy in the destination cloud. Second, a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is reduced by enabling faster cloud deployment of virtual machines for disaster recovery, failover, and/or test purposes based on the replicated data.

title_en: Evacuation route guidance system for the visually impaired
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route guide system for the visually handicapped, capable of guiding the nonhandicapped as well as the visually handicapped to quickly evacuate the scene of a fire by providing a guide for an evacuation route in a building, and, in particular, applying a control force when a visually handicapped person is trying to walk to a fire occurrence spot, thereby guiding the visually handicapped person to safely evacuate to the other side of the fire occurrence spot.
