In accordance with the present invention, the evacuation route guide system for the visually handicapped includes: an entry/exit guide part installed on a wall, and having a plurality of protruding guide holes formed at regular intervals along a passage direction on a surface facing a passage; a guide part housed in each of the protruding guide holes, and, when rotated by a predetermined angle in a normal or reverse direction, having a predetermined area protruding to the outside of the protruding guide holes while forming a structure inclined to one side or the other side, guiding people in a direction for evacuation; and a rotation drive part installed in the entry/exit guide part, and rotating the guide part by a predetermined angle when receiving an emergency occurrence signal, wherein the guide part is rotated such that the guide part can guide the people to the other side of an emergency occurrence spot.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시각장애인을 위한 대피로 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건축물의 내부에 대피로를 안내하는 가이드를 제공하여 일반인과 시각장애인 모두가 화재현장을 신속하게 대피하도록 가이드해줄 수 있고, 특히, 시각장애인이 화재발생지점으로 이동하려고 할 경우 억제력을 부여하여, 화재발생지점의 반대 방향으로 안전하게 대피하도록 가이드해줄 수 있도록 함을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명에 따른 시각장애인을 위한 대피로 안내 시스템은, 벽체에 설치되며, 복도를 향하는 면에 다수개의 돌출가이드홀이 복도 방향을 따라 일정간격으로 형성된 인출입가이드부; 상기 돌출가이드홀에 각각 수용되며, 정방향 또는 역방향으로 소정각도로 회전될 시, 일측 또는 타측 방향으로 경사진 구조를 이루면서 일정영역이 상기 돌출가이드홀의 외부로 돌출되어 사람을 대피방향으로 가이드 할 수 있는 가이드부; 및 상기 인출입가이드부에 설치되고, 비상상황 발생신호를 수신할 시 상기 가이드부를 소정각도로 회전작동시키되, 상기 가이드부가 비상상황이 발생된 지점의 반대 방향으로 가이드할 수 있도록 회전작동 시키는 회전구동부를 포함한다.

title_en: Post-disaster data reconstruction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a post-disaster data reconstruction method, a post-disaster data reconstruction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data recovery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that a first bitmap of the main volume is unavailable, reconstructing the bitmap based on the last writing time of each data block corresponding to the first bitmap, and obtaining a reconstructed second bitmap; and determining target data which is different from the auxiliary volume in the main volume based on the second bitmap, and remotely backing up the target data into the auxiliary volume. The post-disaster data reconstruction method, the post-disaster data reconstruction device, the electronic equipment and the storage medium are used for reconstructing the bitmap when the bitmap is unavailable due to the failure of the disaster recovery backup system, and carrying out data backup based on the reconstructed bitmap.
assignees: SUZHOU YUANNAO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Obstacle vision reconstruction method and obstacle vision reconstruction device for fire scene
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a barrier vision reconstruction method and a barrier vision reconstruction device for a fire scene, and relates to the technical field of fire control assistance, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring thermal imaging data and obstacle sensing data acquired from a fire scene, and acquiring movement data of fire fighters; performing edge segmentation operation on the thermal imaging data to obtain segmented data; analyzing the obstacle sensing data to obtain point cloud cluster data of the fire scene; determining three-dimensional data of an obstacle based on the segmented data and the point cloud cluster data; and determining orientation information of the firefighter based on the motion data, and generating an obstacle vision reconstruction result based on the motion data, the orientation information and the three-dimensional data. The fire scene is reconstructed in three-dimensional vision and displayed, so that firefighters are assisted to perform more efficient and safe fire-fighting operation.
assignees: SHANGHAI YINGPAILUO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dem feature enhancement-based visual transform landslide identification method
title_ko: DEM 특징 강화 기반의 시각적 Transformer 산사태 식별 방법
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a visual transformer landslide identification method based on DEM feature enhancement, wherein in here, comprises: a step of acquiring a data set, wherein the data set comprises a remote detection data set D1 and a DEM image data set D2, D1 comprises a remote detection image in which a large amount of landslide areas are displayed, and D2 comprises a DEM image corresponding one-to-one to a remote detection image block; a step of constructing one landslide identification network comprising a DEM feature extraction unit and a swin-transformer network; and a step of learning the landslide identification network to obtain an identification model, and performing target identification with the identification model. The present invention obtains a mask matrix with the DEM feature extraction unit, and overlaps with each other the output of an image patch partition unit of the swin-transformer network, and the present invention sufficiently couples the DEM image information to improve the landslide identification effect, and is significantly improved in terms of reproducibility, accuracy, F1 value, and the like.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 DEM 특징 강화 기반의 시각적 Transformer 산사태 식별 방법을 개시하며, 여기에는 데이터 세트 획득 단계 - 상기 데이터 세트에는 원격 탐사 데이터 세트 D1 및 DEM 이미지 데이터 세트 D2가 포함되고, D1은 대량의 산사태 지역이 표시된 원격 탐사 이미지를 포함하고, D2는 원격 탐사 이미지 블록과 일대일 대응하는 DEM 이미지를 포함함 - ; DEM 특징 추출 유닛 및 Swin-Transformer 네트워크를 포함하는 하나의 산사태 식별 네트워크를 구축하는 단계; 및 산사태 식별 네트워크를 학습하여 식별 모델을 획득하고, 식별 모델로 목표 식별을 수행하는 단계를 포함한다. 본 발명은 DEM 특징 추출 유닛으로 마스크 행렬을 획득하고, Swin-Transformer 네트워크의 이미지 패치 파티션 유닛의 출력과 서로 중첩시키며, 본 발명은 DEM 이미지 정보를 충분히 결합하여, 산사태 식별 효과를 향상시키고, 재현율, 정확도와 F1 값 등 측면에서 유의하게 향상되었다.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;CHENGLIZHIYUAN TECH CHENGDU CO LTD

title_en: Reconstruction method and system of earth surface continuous deformation map
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and particularly discloses a reconstruction method and a system of a ground surface continuous deformation map, wherein the reconstruction method comprises the following steps: determining a region to be rebuilt according to the earth surface deformation map of the research region; training a ground surface subsidence prediction model based on historical ground surface deformation data and historical clustering multi-source heterogeneous data of a research area; inputting the current clustered multi-source heterogeneous data of the area to be rebuilt into the trained sedimentation prediction model to obtain a prediction deformation map of the area to be rebuilt; and fusing the surface deformation map and the predicted deformation map to obtain a surface continuous deformation map of the research area. The invention can fully utilize heterogeneous environmental factor data of various different sources, and reduce the dependence on the existing historical data; clustering the multi-source heterogeneous data can greatly reduce the influence of different source factor spatial heterogeneity on the construction of the ground surface subsidence prediction model; and the prediction result is more reliable and the precision is higher by using machine learning modeling prediction.

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery reconstruction method based on ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network fault recovery reconstruction method based on an ant colony algorithm, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a power distribution network fault recovery mathematical model; step 2: introducing an ant colony algorithm in the fault recovery of the power distribution network; step 3: recovering faults of the power distribution network based on an ant colony algorithm; step 4: constructing a power distribution network recovery reconstruction mathematical model; step 5: carrying out model solving by adopting an ICQPSO algorithm based on an integer type coding mode; step 6: analyzing an example; the method has the advantages of establishing a multi-target model, having global searching capability, being capable of being converted into single-target optimization, reducing searching space and avoiding reconstructing dimension disasters.
assignees: DENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method, system, chip and equipment for deducing rain flood disaster scene of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a chip and equipment for deducing a rain flood disaster scene of a power distribution network, and a vulnerability model of a power distribution network element is constructed based on urban geographic information; constructing a network reconstruction model comprising operation safety constraint and radial topology constraint; constructing a traffic inundation model based on the relation between the road water depth and the vehicle running speed, and determining the travel time under the urban inundation condition; determining submerged nodes according to the obtained vulnerability model of the power distribution network element, optimizing and modeling a travel route, and determining the travel route; and constructing a collaborative optimization model for power distribution system response and recovery based on the obtained network reconstruction model and the travel route, and quantifying the influence of road flooding on electric quantity loss and power failure time to obtain a power distribution network disaster scene under waterlogging. The method can embody the influence of road flooding on the electric quantity loss and the power failure time of the power distribution network and simulate the trip condition of trip personnel under waterlogging.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Prediction method and prediction early warning system for atmospheric pollution of industrial park
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method and a prediction early warning system for atmospheric pollution of an industrial park, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting the monitoring data of the environment monitoring points in the research area from year to year as a data source, performing data set missing value interpolation, meteorological factor screening and data normalization reconstruction on the data, and inputting the data into an SA-LSTM model and an XGBoost model for training to obtain a combined model; and constructing an industrial park atmospheric pollution data prediction and early warning system, and predicting and releasing pollutant monitoring data information by using modules in the system. The prediction method and the prediction early warning system for the atmospheric pollution of the industrial park can accurately and timely monitor and predict the atmospheric pollution index in the industrial park, provide scientific basis for intelligent management and control of the atmospheric pollution of the industrial park, and can greatly improve the risk monitoring, rapid early warning and emergency response capability of the industrial park.

title_en: Aerial image-based distribution network line fire area measurement method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a distribution network line fire area measurement method and a distribution network line fire area measurement system based on aerial images, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing image preprocessing on the aerial image of the region to be measured to obtain a preprocessed image; performing fire point contour extraction on the preprocessed image to obtain a fire point target area in the preprocessed image; performing point cloud conversion on the fire point target area to obtain three-dimensional point cloud data, and performing three-dimensional model reconstruction by utilizing the three-dimensional point cloud data to obtain a corresponding three-dimensional model; and calculating the surface area of the three-dimensional model by using a triangular mesh algorithm, and obtaining the fire point area information of the area to be measured according to the surface area. The invention is based on the mountain fire aerial photo of the unmanned aerial vehicle of the distribution network line, combines the technical application of image processing, computer graphics and the like, realizes the automatic calculation of the mountain fire passing area of the distribution network line on site, provides first-line fire information for basic-level operation and inspection personnel, lays a foundation for selecting reasonable disaster-resistant and damage-reducing measures in the next step, and is beneficial to the rapid adjustment of the site fire.
assignees: GUOLUO POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;QINGHAI SANXIN RURAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Self-stabilizing unmanned aerial vehicle for geological disaster reconstruction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly discloses a self-stabilizing unmanned aerial vehicle for geological disaster reconstruction, wherein a cradle head is arranged below the middle of the lower part of a machine body and is connected with a camera, the cradle head comprises a top plate, a rotating body, a second motor, a turnover body and a third motor, the top plate is arranged on the lower surface of the machine body, the rotating body is arranged below the top plate in a horizontal rotating mode, the second motor drives the rotating body to rotate, the turnover body is arranged in front of the rotating body in a vertical turnover mode, the third motor can drive the turnover body to turn up and down, the camera is arranged in front of the turnover body, a limiting plate is connected below the top plate, the limiting plate is sleeved on the periphery of the rotating body, and a plurality of rollers capable of horizontally rolling along the surface of the rotating body are arranged between the top plate and the limiting plate. The camera can horizontally rotate and vertically overturn, so that a larger photographing range can be obtained, and the cradle head is simple and compact in design structure, low in manufacturing cost and good in rotating stability.
assignees: ZHEJIANG DIBO SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Future disaster potential risk scene prejudging method integrating flood landform evidence and evolution mode
abstract_en: The future disaster potential risk scene prejudging method integrating flood landform evidence and evolution mode comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a flood comprehensive landform evidence system through field investigation, and recording natural flood; s2, constructing a flood age sequence, evaluating the stability of flood discharge sections, and reconstructing an ancient flood section based on a river development stage; s3, determining the flood cause type based on the parameters obtained in the steps S1-S2, and constructing different types of evolution modes according to the along-path flood evidence; s4, simulating and reconstructing the scale flood scale of the river basin by adopting a one-dimensional hydraulic model based on the steps S1-S3, and analyzing the landform effect and the flood master control factor by adopting a two-dimensional hydraulic model; step S5, based on the steps, the future potential risk scene prejudgment of the huge disaster is realized through similar hydrodynamic conditions; the method utilizes physicochemical indexes to discriminate and analyze different types of floods, establishes a comprehensive flood landform evidence system, has the characteristics of sufficient representativeness, high reliability and small difficulty in discriminating information, and has wide application range.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Mine monitoring data reconstruction and disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine monitoring data reconstruction and disaster early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of adopting a dynamic time window to read real-time monitoring data; calculating the data loss rate; based on a Lagrange interpolation algorithm and a Prophet model short-term prediction algorithm, the monitoring data set is intelligently reconstructed; based on the monitoring data set, adopting a Prophet model time sequence data decomposition algorithm to intelligently reconstruct the data evolution trend; and an improved counter-velocity method is adopted to realize advanced early warning of the potential geological disaster in the time dimension. The mine monitoring data reconstruction and disaster early warning system provided by the invention has the advantages that the visualization of the original monitoring data, the reconstruction trend data and the advanced early warning result is completed, and the one-key review of the stability condition of the monitoring area by mine personnel at any time and any place is realized.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN;HEILONGJIANG JIJIA ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for repairing deformation and uplift of surrounding rock of sedimentary rock tunnel substrate and reconstruction structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for repairing deformation and uplift of surrounding rock of a sedimentary rock tunnel substrate and a reconstruction structure, and relates to the field of related researches on inverted arch structure cracking and ballast bed cracking caused by expansion and deformation of the surrounding rock of the sedimentary rock tunnel substrate with large burial depth. The method for repairing the old inverted arch and the reconstructed new inverted arch can effectively inhibit the inverted arch from rising, the reconstructed inverted arch has stable adaptability, the settlement and the inverted arch of the tunnel vault are effectively inhibited, and theoretical references can be provided for solving the disaster problems of similar engineering.
assignees: YANCHENG INST TECH;UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH

title_en: Method for predicting disaster based on event and system thereof
title_ko: 딥러닝을 이용한 이벤트 기반의 재난 발생 탐지방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for detecting disaster occurrence based on an event using deep learning and, more specifically, to a method for an information system to analyze social data with deep learning after collecting the social data distributed through a social network system (SNS), detecting and providing an occurrence risk of a natural disaster or a social disaster, and an information system using the same. In accordance with the present invention, morphemes of social data with an unstructured data structure are analyzed and a point of interest (POI), an object and an event are extracted and made into structural data, and then, through a combination thereof, situation information is reconstituted to behavioral events by point of interest included in the social data are discovered, and, through temporal and spatial correlation analysis thereon, occurrence or symptoms of a disaster can be discovered, which can result in an effect of determining occurrence symptoms of a disaster or whether a disaster occurs with respect to each point of interest of a country at an early stage. In accordance with the present invention, even if an occurrence risk of a disaster is detected through social data, the truth thereof can be verified through a fake news verification model, and, as a result, the occurrence of a social chaos caused by fake news can be prevented. Moreover, due to the provision of a sensor-integrated verification model, the truth of the disaster risk detected from the social data can be verified with the sensor data collected from the corresponding spot, and, therethrough, the reliability of the disaster occurrence detection result can be improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 딥러닝을 이용한 이벤트 기반의 재난 발생 탐지방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게로는, 정보시스템이 소셜 네트워크(SNS)를 통하여 유통되는 소셜데이터를 수집한 후 소셜데이터를 딥러닝으로 분석하여 자연적 재난이나 사회적 재난의 발생위험을 탐지하여 제공하는 방법과 이를 이용한 정보시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 비정형 데이터 구조를 가지는 소셜데이터의 형태소를 분석하여 관심지점(POI : Point Of Interest), 객체 및 이벤트를 추출하여 구조적 데이터로 만든 후 이들의 결합을 통하여 상황정보를 재구성하여 소셜데이터 안에 포함된 관심지점별 행위이벤트들을 찾아내고, 이들에 대한 시간적 공간적 연관분석을 통하여 재난의 발생이나 징후를 찾아낼 수 있기 때문에 국가의 관심지점별로 재난의 발생 징후나 발생 여부를 조기에 판단할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 본 발명은 또한 소셜데이터를 통하여 재난의 발생위험을 탐지하더라도 그것에 대한 진위를 가짜뉴스 검증모델을 통하여 검증하기 때문에 가짜뉴스로 인한 사회적 혼란 발생을 예방할 수 있다. 이뿐만 아니라, 센서통합 검증모델도 제공하기 때문에 소셜데이터에서 탐지된 재난위험의 진위를 해당 지점에서 수집된 센서 데이터로 검중할 수 있게 되며, 이를 통하여 재난 발생 탐지결과의 신뢰성을 제고할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: VR environment for accident reconstruction
abstract_en: The following relates generally to providing virtual reality (VR) alerts to a driver of an autonomous vehicle. For example, a vehicle may be driving autonomously while the driver is watching a VR movie (e.g., on a pair of VR goggles); the driver may then receive a VR alert recommending that the driver take control of the vehicle (e.g., switch the vehicle from autonomous to manual mode). The following also relates to generating a VR feed for presenting real-time road conditions so that a user may preview a road segment. The following also relates to generating a VR feed corresponding to an event (e.g., a vehicle collision, a crime, a weather event, and/or a natural disaster).
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: SAR image simulation method and device for damage scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for simulating SAR images of a damage scene, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing three-dimensional models of explosion pits under different soil medium types, explosive amounts and explosive depths based on explosion mechanics; performing explosion pit and backscattering characteristic of scene where the explosion pit is located based on calculation electromagnetism; and simulating and imaging echo data of the explosion pit according to the three-dimensional model of the explosion pit and the backscattering characteristics of the explosion pit and the scene where the explosion pit is located. The method can indirectly acquire the post-explosion damage scene information, and has important significance for post-disaster quick evaluation, post-disaster reconstruction, engineering construction, fire-extinguishing rescue and other works.

title_en: Forest fire risk level data reconstruction method in non-satellite era
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reconstructing forest fire risk level data in a non-satellite era, which comprises the steps of acquiring a ground climate data daily value data set and ASTER GDEM data, and calculating an improved forest fire risk index of a meteorological site; backtracking the non-satellite time history MFFDI of each meteorological site based on a long-short time memory network; an Anusplin interpolation method based on a thin disk spline theory is used for interpolating an MFFDI value of a non-satellite age to the whole area range, interpolation results and other human activity elements are generated to generate a forest fire risk level diagram, and reliability and scientificity of the generated forest fire risk level diagram are verified by utilizing historical fire events acquired from historical data. The forest fire index is more scientific in describing forest fire; for checking the appropriateness of past forest fire management methods, it is important for emergency services and fire control departments to evaluate the effectiveness of forest fire prevention and extinguishment, to be space-time reasonable in the fire control field and to better understand the occurrence rules and evolution trend of future forest fires.

title_en: Earthquake indirect economic loss assessment method based on comprehensive disaster index
abstract_en: The application provides an earthquake indirect economic loss assessment method based on comprehensive disaster indexes, which relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster loss assessment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring public economic data of a seismic area, wherein the public economic data comprises input-output tables and GDP data; acquiring economic loss data of an earthquake region, wherein the economic loss data comprises enterprise outage time and comprehensive disaster indexes; calculating industrial association loss by using an input-output method based on the input-output table, and calculating enterprise outage loss based on GDP data, enterprise outage time and comprehensive disaster index; and calculating to obtain the indirect economic loss of the earthquake based on the industrial association loss and the enterprise outage loss. The method and the device can accurately evaluate the indirect economic loss of the earthquake, and provide scientific basis for disaster defense, post-disaster recovery reconstruction and other works.
assignees: NAT DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT SAT;NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE

title_en: Ka frequency band SAR image colorization method based on combination of BEMD and IHS conversion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Ka frequency band SAR image colorization method based on combination of BEMD and IHS transformation, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image fusion processing. The method comprises the steps of performing IHS (direct imaging system) transformation on an optical remote sensing image to obtain three component images of brightness, chromaticity and saturation, performing BEMD (binary image processing) on a Ka-SAR remote sensing image to obtain a high-frequency image and a low-frequency image, performing BEMD (binary image processing) on the brightness component and the low-frequency image respectively, fusing the brightness component and the low-frequency image, reconstructing the brightness component and the low-frequency image, and performing IHS inverse transformation to obtain a colorized Ka-SAR image. The invention reserves clear texture details, simultaneously endows Ka-SAR remote sensing images with real colors, greatly improves the identification, and is convenient for post-disaster analysis and visual interpretation.
assignees: SHANDONG FENGSHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire simulating device generating flame on the surface of water
title_ko: 수면에서 화염을 발생시키는 화재 상황 재현장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire simulation device which generates flames on a water surface. More specifically, the fire simulation device creates flames by igniting combustible and flammable fluids discharged onto the water surface through underwater spray means, simulates a fire situation, and allows the spray means to be located underwater, thereby reducing various damages caused by heat. Furthermore, the fire simulation device prevents various firefighting agents used in fire training from directly contacting the spray means, thereby removing contamination and malfunction of the spray means. Moreover, the fire simulation device can be efficiently maintained even if only water in a water tank is replaced, enhancing maintenance management efficiency and reducing maintenance time. Additionally, the fire simulation device allows for customization according to the test conditions specified by a client without requiring dedicated equipment for each test object, thus improving testing efficiency. Furthermore, the fire simulation device transfers ignition heat to an ignition device when combustible and flammable fluids discharged from the spray means installed underwater is ignited on the water surface so that the ignition device can efficiently operate even in humid conditions.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수면에서 화염을 발생시키는 화재 상황 재현장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 수중에 설치된 분사수단을 통해 배출되는 발화·인화성 유체를 수면에서 점화시켜 화염을 발생시키고 이를 통해 화재 상황을 재현함으로써, 분사수단이 수중에 위치됨에 따라 열에 의한 각종 데미지(damage)를 감소시킬 수 있도록 하고, 또한 화재 상황에 대한 훈련시 사용하는 각종 소화용제가 분사수단과 직접 접촉하지 않아 분사수단의 오염 및 고장 문제를 해결할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 이로 인해 수조 내의 물만 교체하더라도 장치가 효율적으로 유지 되는 등 정비 관리의 효율성을 향상시키고 정비 작업 시간을 단축시킬 수 있도록 하며, 아울러 시험대상물 별로 각각의 전용 장비를 사용하지 않더라도 시험 의뢰자의 의뢰 조건에 따른 커스터마이징(customizing)이 가능하여 시험 효율을 향상시킬 수 있도록 하고, 더욱이 상기와 같이 수중에 설치된 분사수단을 통해 배출되는 발화·인화성 유체를 수면에서 점화시킴에 있어 점화열을 점화장치에 전달하여 상기 점화장치가 습윤상황에서도 효율적으로 작동될 수 있도록 하는, 수면에서 화염을 발생시키는 화재 상황 재현장치에 관한 것이다.
assignees: ALLBE SOLUTION CO LTD;LEE KI WOO

title_en: Method and device for realizing redis second-level disaster recovery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of IT, and discloses a method and a device for realizing redis second-level disaster recovery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing persistence treatment on the RDB and the AOF; performing master-slave synchronization, adding master-slave marks, and searching time stamps through both a master library and a slave library to realize incremental synchronization; instructions are added and the timestamp is recovered. According to the method and the device for realizing the Redis second-level disaster recovery, the second-level disaster recovery function is realized on the premise that the cache read-write performance is not affected, the Redis data is recovered based on the time stamp, the stability of master-slave synchronization is enhanced, compared with the PSync synchronization of an open source version, the master-slave synchronization can cope with more faults of different scenes by increasing the record of the time stamp, for example, after the master library is restarted, the quick increment synchronization can still be completed, and the risks of slave library delay and reconstruction are greatly reduced.

title_en: Rapid fire-fighting disposal system and method for building charging berth fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire safety, and discloses a rapid fire-fighting disposal system and a rapid fire-fighting disposal method for a charged berth of a building. The system and the method for rapidly disposing the fire disaster in the charging berth of the building comprise a unit type foam-water fire safety emergency device, a narrow space bottom spraying pipe network component, a fire extinguishing cofferdam and a foam pipe hooking component. The rapid fire-fighting disposal system and method for the building charging berth fire solve the three problems existing in the existing building charging berth fire-fighting rescue technology: the fire disaster dangerous condition response speed of the indoor parking space fire control top spraying system is low, the chassis lithium battery pack fire disaster source cannot be directly hit at the first time, and the fire control and suppression efficiency is low; the water resource consumption is large due to the influence of the space position of the lithium battery pack during external fire rescue, and the long-acting anti-afterburning advantage cannot be established; and the design of a plurality of rows of bottom spraying nozzles has large workload of parking space reconstruction, the construction of fire-fighting facilities is difficult to meet the berthing habit of vehicles, and the environmental applicability of the system engineering is poor.
assignees: CSSC JIUJIANG CHANGAN FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster hidden danger three-dimensional identification method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional identification method, a system and a medium for hidden danger of geological disasters, which relate to the field of hidden danger identification of geological disasters, wherein the identification method comprises the following steps: reconstructing a three-dimensional scene of the target area, and determining three-dimensional topographic data; determining region characteristic information of a target region; inputting three-dimensional terrain data into a geological disaster hidden danger identification model to obtain a geological disaster hidden danger identification result, and inputting the geological disaster hidden danger identification result into a geological disaster hidden danger disaster bearing body identification model to obtain a geological disaster bearing body; determining a hidden danger corresponding relation set according to the geological disaster hidden danger identification result and the geological disaster bearing body; based on the three-dimensional topographic data, determining a three-dimensional identifier according to the regional characteristic information and the hidden danger corresponding relation set; analyzing the ground disaster hidden danger identification result according to the three-dimensional identifier, and determining current ground disaster hidden danger identification data of the target area; the invention can reduce the condition of missed judgment and misjudgment of the hidden danger of the geological disaster and improve the identification accuracy of the hidden danger of the geological disaster.
assignees: THE THIRD GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION DRAWING INSTITUTE OF MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Engineering supervisory equipment is rebuild to geological disaster
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of monitoring equipment, and particularly discloses geological disaster reconstruction engineering monitoring equipment which comprises a mounting plate fixed on the side surface of a first upright post and a telescopic rod, wherein one end of the telescopic rod is connected with the mounting plate; the telescopic rod comprises an outer sleeve, an inner pipe and a mounting pipe, wherein the left end of the outer sleeve is fixed outside the first upright, the inner pipe is telescopically inserted into the right end of the outer sleeve, the mounting pipe is mounted at the right end of the inner pipe, a second upright is arranged below the right end of the mounting pipe, a rotatable first camera is mounted at the bottom end of the second upright, a second camera and a third camera are arranged on the upper side surface of the mounting pipe from left to right, the second camera is rotatably mounted on a second roll-over stand, the second roll-over stand is rotatably mounted on a second base, and the second base is fixed on the mounting pipe; the third camera is rotatably arranged on the third roll-over stand, the third roll-over stand is rotatably arranged on the third base, and the third base is fixed on the mounting tube. The three cameras can be turned over to enlarge the visual field range, and the positions of the three cameras are adjusted, so that the three cameras are flexible to use and convenient to install.
assignees: ZHEJIANG DIBO SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent simple spraying fire early-stage suppression system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent simple spraying fire early-stage suppression system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a fire type prediction system, a simple spraying device, a spraying device optimization system and a server. The fire disaster prediction system comprises a smoke detector, a temperature detector, a data acquisition module, a data processing module and an output module and is used for predicting the type and degree of fire disaster. The intelligent simple spray fire early-stage suppression system disclosed by the invention utilizes an image recognition technology, combines turbulence statistics, a mode and a chaos theory, is used for screening the optimal specification selection spray head, improves the spray efficiency of the spray head on fire, maximally utilizes the existing water pressure, and further reduces the reconstruction cost. The system can also be combined with the control platform of the Internet of things to realize rapid early warning, remote control and timely extinguishing or controlling of the initial fire, thereby winning time for personnel escape and further extinguishing and minimizing fire loss.

title_en: Emergency tunnel device for fire site
abstract_en: An emergency tunnel device according to the present invention is an emergency tunnel device that can form a tunnel shape for rescue activities at a fire scene, and includes: a flexible and heat-resistant fabric cover; a plurality of shelter frames that hold and support the fabric cover from the inside so that the fabric cover can have a tunnel shape as an outer shell; and a deployment guide that is arranged between a first shelter frame and a second shelter frame that are adjacent to each other among the plurality of shelter frames and guides the expansion of the gap between the first shelter frame and the second shelter frame. Therefore, a technology for easily forming a tunnel for rescue activities at a fire scene is disclosed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 비상터널장치는, 화재현장에서 구호활동을 위하여 터널의 형태를 구성할 수 있는 비상터널장치로서, 유연성과 내열성이 있는 패브릭커버; 패브릭커버가 외피로서 터널형태를 갖출 수 있도록 내측에서 받쳐 지지하는 다수개의 쉘터프레임 및 다수개의 쉘터프레임 중 서로 이웃하는 제1 쉘터프레임 및 제2 쉘터프레임 사이에 배치되며, 제1 쉘터프레임과 제2 쉘터프레임 사이에 이격되는 간격이 확장되는 것을 가이드하는 전개가이드; 를 포함하므로 화재현장에서 구호활동을 위한 터널을 간이하게 형성할 수 있는 기술이 개시된다.

title_en: Toughness improving method for electrothermal communication system under endogenous uncertainty and nonlinear reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of toughness improvement of an electrothermal information physical system, and discloses a method for improving toughness of an electrothermal communication system under endophytic uncertainty and nonlinear reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of: an electric wired communication network model and a thermal wireless communication network model, and a natural disaster uncertainty set model established based on decision-dependent uncertainty; then taking the minimum total investment and running cost as an objective function, and performing dimension reduction and linearization treatment on the electric heating information physical system toughness collaborative lifting model by utilizing an improved Yen's algorithm, so as to establish an electric heating information physical system toughness lifting linearization model; and finally, reconstructing the uncertainty problem into a deterministic problem by a strong dual theory, and generating a robust cutting plane solving method by using the proposed relaxation columns and constraints. The invention realizes the toughness improvement of the electric heating information physical system more economically, reduces the threat of natural disasters to the system and ensures the operation safety of the system.

title_en: Method and system for detecting vegetation water content in corridor area of power transmission and distribution line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting vegetation water content near a power transmission and distribution line corridor; relates to the technical field of forest fire combustible water content detection; acquiring radar signals by taking a power transmission and distribution line as a linear target; carrying out sparse matrix representation on radar signals, establishing a linear blocking matrix of a power transmission and distribution line, and carrying out orthogonalization correction on the linear blocking matrix of the power transmission and distribution line; processing the sparse matrix by using a Gaussian Newton optimization SAR sparse reconstruction algorithm to obtain a sparse coefficient vector; establishing an electromagnetic mechanism model of vegetation water content near a power transmission and distribution line corridor based on the sparse coefficient vector; detecting vegetation water content based on an electromagnetic mechanism model of vegetation water content near a power transmission and distribution line corridor; according to the invention, a signal model with linear characteristics of the power transmission and distribution lines is established from the radar echo processing process, and a space-time processing algorithm of linear target detection performance is improved, so that an effective means is provided for vegetation information acquisition and forest fire prevention and control near the power transmission and distribution line corridor.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Geological drilling tool and method for treating thin unconsolidated layer coal mining subsidence area by using same
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster management of coal mining subsidence areas, in particular to a geological drilling tool and a method for managing a thin loose layer coal mining subsidence area by using the same. Adopting a prefabricated partition wall to block the water-bearing layer outside the through crack area to supply water to the through crack area, and then discharging all accumulated water in the through crack area; then, injecting fly ash material into the falling zone for compaction, and then injecting cement slurry into the water guide fracture zone for compaction; then stripping earth surface soil in the through crack region to be flush with the bottom boundary of the water-resisting layer in the non-staggered layer regions at the two sides, and paving the stratum structure which is the same as that of the non-staggered layer regions at the two sides from bottom to top; and finally, pulling out the top block of the isolation wall, and facilitating the top block of the isolation wall to reconstruct soil in the isolation ditch, thereby completing reclamation. Aiming at the working condition of a thin loose layer, the disaster treatment method for the coal mining subsidence area based on the partition wall is provided, waterproof materials are not required to be injected, a freezing technology is not required to be adopted, the subsidence area treatment efficiency is improved, and the subsidence area treatment cost is reduced.
assignees: THE FIRST PROSPECTING TEAM OF SHANDONG COALFIELD GEOLOGY BUREAU

title_en: Concentration Measurement System of Fine Dust Generated During Fire
title_ko: 화재 시 발생하는 미세 분진의 농도 측정 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for measuring the concentration of fine dust generated in the event of a fire, which allows firefighters to easily measure fine dust contained in high-temperature agricultural smoke that may be exposed to a fire site. The system for measuring the concentration of fine dust generated in the event of a fire generates dilution gas by mixing external air with smoke generated when combustibles are burned and has an effect of easily measuring the concentration of fine dust contained in smoke by performing a reduction model experiment for measuring the concentration of fine dust contained in the generated dilution gas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방대원이 화재현장에서 노출될 수 있는 고온의 농연 속에 포함된 미세분진을 용이하게 측정할 수 있도록 하는 화재 시 발생하는 미세 분진의 농도 측정 시스템에 관한 것으로, 가연물이 연소시 발생하는 연기에 외부공기를 혼합하여 희석가스를 생성하고, 생성한 희석가스에 포함된 미세분진의 농도를 측정하는 축소 모형 실험을 하여 연기에 포함된 미세분진의 농도를 용이하게 측정할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for creating a traffic accident site reconstruction report
title_ko: 교통사고 현장 재구성 리포트를 만드는 장치
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide an apparatus for creating a traffic accident site reconstruction report that finally generates a traffic accident site reconstruction report through sequential images, GPS information, sensor information, and input data of a window editing unit. An apparatus for creating a traffic accident site reconstruction report comprises: a data collection terminal for collecting sequential images at the moment of an accident and data that is GPS information; and an accident reconstruction device for creating a traffic accident site reconstruction report from the data information collected by the data collection terminal. The accident reconstruction device comprises: a video generation unit for showing an accident image edited from the sequential images; and a target vehicle path generation unit for generating a path of a target vehicle from the GPS information. The report according to the present invention may help to precisely analyze the cause of the accident by expressing the appearance of the traffic accident site in detail.
abstract_ko: 순차영상, GPS 정보, 센서 정보, 및 윈도우 편집부의 입력 데이터들을 통하여 최종적으로 교통사고 현장 재구성 리포트를 생성하는 교통사고 현장 재구성 리포트를 만드는 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 교통사고 현장 재구성 리포트를 만드는 장치는 사고 순간의 순차영상, GPS 정보, 및 센서정보인 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집 단말기; 및 상기 데이터 수집 단말기로 수집된 데이터 정보로부터 교통사고 현장 재구성 리포트를 만드는 사고복원장치를 포함하되, 상기 사고복원장치는, 사고복원장치에 편집 입력값을 입력하는 윈도우 편집부; 상기 순차영상으로부터 편집된 사고영상을 보여주는 비디오 생성부; 상기 GPS 정보로부터 대상차량의 경로를 생성하는 대상차량 경로생성부; 상기 윈도우 편집부를 통하여 교통사고 현장의 배경화면을 생성하는 배경도로 생성부; 및 상기 윈도우 편집부를 통하여 순차영상으로부터 이동객체를 만드는 이동객체 생성부를 포함하여, 비디오 화면 및 실시간 상면도를 포함하는 교통사고 현장 재구성 리포트를 생성하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 상기 리포트는 교통사고 현장의 모습을 상세히 표현함으로 인해, 사고 원인을 정밀하게 분석하도록 도움을 줄 수 있다.

title_en: Method for reconstructing supporting system under upper pipeline disassembly-free condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reconstructing a supporting system under the condition of no disassembly of an upper pipeline, which comprises the following steps: step one: erecting an unloading device above the existing pipeline, and step two: transferring the load of the existing pipeline to an unloading device, and step three: dismantling the attached facilities and the cast-in-situ surface layer, and step four: dismantling the prestressed hollow slab, and step five: installing steel box girders in sequence, and step six: re-casting the surface layer, and step seven: restoring attached facilities, and step eight: re-transferring the load of the existing pipeline to the underlying support system; the advantages are that: after the load transfer of the existing pipeline, the construction is safer, and secondary disasters are avoided; the existing pipeline is not stopped in the construction stage, so that economic loss is reduced, and economic benefit is improved.
assignees: NANJING WATER SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE RUIDI TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: System and method for industrial field emergency response using multi sensor robot
title_ko: 다중 센서 로봇을 이용한 산업 현장 응급 상황 대처 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for coping with an industrial emergency situation using a multi-sensor robot. The present invention comprises: an industrial site AI safety management robot performing monitoring for safety management of industrial site personnel and performing emergency response by using an AI algorithm; and a safety management robot control server remotely controlling the industrial site AI safety management robot to perform monitoring for safety management of industrial site personnel and perform emergency response. According to the system and the method for dealing with an emergency situation in an industrial site using the multi-sensor robot, the multi-sensor robot autonomously drives in the industrial site to detect a fall accident, drinking, overuse of a mobile phone, an unconscious state, and the like of industrial site personnel in real time and to deal with an emergency, thereby quickly dealing with safety accidents in various parts of the industrial site. In addition, various multi-sensor robots are configured to generate, collect, reconfigure, and utilize an industrial site map of an industrial site that frequently changes, such as a construction site, in real time, thereby securing the most reliable industrial site map in real time.
abstract_ko: 다중 센서 로봇을 이용한 산업 현장 응급 상황 대처 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다.  AI 알고리즘을 이용하여 산업 현장 인력의 안전 관리를 위한 모니터링을 수행하고 응급 대처를 수행하는 산업 현장 AI 안전 관리 로봇; 상기 산업 현장 AI 안전 관리 로봇이 산업 현장 인력의 안전 관리를 위한 모니터링을 수행하고 응급 대처를 수행하도록 원격 제어하는 안전 관리 로봇 제어 서버를 구성한다.  상술한 다중 센서 로봇을 이용한 산업 현장 응급 상황 대처 시스템 및 방법에 의하면, 산업 현장에서 다중 센서 로봇가 자율 주행을 하면서 산업 현장 인력의 낙상 사고, 음주, 휴대폰 과다 사용, 의식 불명 상태 등을 실시간 감지하고 응급 대처하도록 구성됨으로써, 산업 현장 곳곳의 안전 사고에 대해 신속하게 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다.  또한, 건설 현장과 같이 수시로 변화하는 산업 현장의 산업 현장 맵을 여러 다중 센서 로봇들이 실시간 생성하고, 이를 취합하여 재구성하여 활용하도록 구성됨으로써, 가장 신뢰성 높은 산업 현장 맵을 실시간으로 확보할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: SONID ROBOTICS CO LTD;SEOUL MEDIA INSTITUTE OF TECH INDUSTRY ACADEMY COOPERATION;NEW KOREA ELECTRONIC COMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Artificial intelligence fused drought index reconstruction method and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence fused drought index reconstruction method and a computer readable medium. Selecting a drought index reconstruction region, obtaining a meteorological sample, a hydrological sample, a leaf area index and a large-scale circulation factor sample, and calculating saturated steam pressure deficiency, specific humidity and wet bulb temperature; screening month runoff key factors and water reserve key factors, and calibrating a plurality of artificial intelligent simulation models and a month scale multi-model weighting model; and substituting the normalized vegetation index data as output into a drought event process regression model of vegetation observation months, calculating parameters of the regression model, and calculating by a weighted average method to obtain the drought index of each month in the reconstruction period. The method can be applied to drought risk assessment, disaster prevention and reduction, and can provide important and high-operability reference basis for global and regional water resource risk assessment and early warning under the climate change situation.

title_en: Electrical comprehensive energy system recovery optimization method and system considering load dispersion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery optimization method and a system of an electric comprehensive energy system considering load dispersion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a power generation capacity index and a load recovery capacity index, and distributing weights to the indexes; carrying out comprehensive modeling according to the black start, grid reconstruction and load recovery phase constraint of the post-disaster recovery of the power system; constructing load discrete and electric coupling characteristics in the post-disaster recovery process of the electric comprehensive energy system to obtain a post-disaster full-stage recovery optimization model of the electric comprehensive energy system; and obtaining an optimal post-disaster recovery strategy of the electric comprehensive energy system according with the actual running situation according to the recovery optimization model. The invention has the beneficial effects that all black start, grid reconstruction and load recovery stages in the recovery process can be considered, the load dispersion and electric coupling characteristics are described in detail, a more reasonable and effective recovery optimization strategy can be formulated, and the post-disaster collaborative recovery of the full-stage electric comprehensive energy system can be realized.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: End-to-end real tunnel point cloud three-dimensional reconstruction method based on local feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional reconstruction method of an end-to-end real tunnel point cloud with local feature fusion, which is mainly used for reconstructing element structural features of the tunnel point cloud into a tunnel surface aiming at the three-dimensional reconstruction task of the real tunnel point cloud, and mainly comprises tunnel original structures (such as transverse seams, circular seams, bolt holes, grouting holes and the like), tunnel internal elements (such as fire-fighting water pipes, electric cables and the like), tunnel wall marks (escape marks, hundred-meter marks and the like), tunnel defect information (leakage water, lining peeling and the like) and the like. Because the structural design of the tunnel is easy to generate the problems of deformation, cracks and the like, the safety of the tunnel is threatened, and the service life is shortened, so that the internal state of the tunnel needs to be highly focused, and the safety monitoring is carried out regularly. The network provided by the invention can reconstruct the tunnel scene with high precision without manual operation, and is beneficial to the later examination and manual observation of the tunnel.

title_en: Method and device for recovering faults and reconstructing network of micro-grid system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a method for fault recovery and network reconstruction of a micro-grid system, which comprises the steps of establishing a multi-objective optimization function of the micro-grid system, establishing a feasible topology structure from distributed energy sources to load nodes, establishing a fault retrieval sequence optimization strategy model, establishing an AC/DC line operation constraint condition of the micro-grid system based on the fault retrieval sequence optimization strategy model and the feasible topology structure, adopting mixed integer second order cone planning, and obtaining an optimal detection scheme through convex relaxation treatment and second order cone. According to the method and the device, when a plurality of faults occur to the micro-grid, a fault maintenance sequence optimization strategy is established, the faults are eliminated one by one according to the importance degree of the faults, so that the smoothness of a power supply line from a power supply to important loads is ensured, more important loads are ensured to be recovered, meanwhile, the reliability of the micro-grid is enhanced, the elasticity of the micro-grid is improved, and the resistance of the micro-grid in disasters is enhanced. The application also relates to a device, equipment and storage medium for recovering the faults of the micro-grid system and reconstructing the network.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_ko: 극한적인 폭염에 대한 영농지역의 온도조절용 신재생발전장치
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a solar and wind power generation device for temperature control of a farming area against extreme heat waves or cold damage in the farming area, and a harmonization system connected thereto. The present invention relates to a farming area (200) which comprises: a farming complex (251) in which an indoor space (251) for a vinyl greenhouse (279) or a livestock shed constructed in the farming area (200) is constructed; and a solar power generation device (420) constructed at the edge of the farming complex (251) to be used as new production energy due to climate change. The farming area (200) comprises: a chamber (370) for a pressure tank in which a buffer space (B) is formed; and an air passage force of the ground (215) by a strong driving force of a pump (337) requiring supply and exhaust force to perform reconstruction by pressurization or suction by control of a control device (485) in the chamber (370) for a pressure tank if necessary. The present invention provides an effect of preventing damage to natural disasters such as heat waves by being controlled by a control device according to a climate state.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 극한적인 폭염에 대한 영농지역 온도조절용 신재생발전장치에 대한 발명으로서, 상세하게는 영농지역, 실내작업장 등에서, 극한적으로 발생하는 폭염에 대한 온도조절을 위한 신재생발전장치에 관한 발명이다. 이는 기후변화로 나타나는 극한적인 폭연에 의한 가뭄에 대한 기온조절을 신재생에너지로 발전된 전력으로 조절을 위하는 발명이다.  
 일반적으로 경사지, 영농지역, 비닐하우스 등과 같은 농업용 작물을 재배를 위한 지역에 극심한 가뭄이 발생하면, 온열사고 발생, 용수공급 등의 문제로서, 신속히 적절한 온도로 조절하는 신재생발전장치가 요구되는 현실이다.  
고로 상기 설명되는 문제점을 해결하기 위하는 발명으로서,  
 영농지역으로 개간된 영농지역(200), 비닐하우스(279)용 실내공간으로 방출시켜 주도록 신재생에너지용 발전장치(480)에 연계된 냉각 및 가열장치의 구비와 이에 연결된 펌프(377)가 구비와 일기변화에 따라 미도시된 쎈서의 연계로서, 영농지역 등에 온도가 조절된 공기를 제공시켜 주기 위함이다. 
  또한 영농지역으로 영농지역(200)에 구축된 영농지역, 비닐하우스(279)용 실내공간(251)이나 축사 등이 구축되는 영농단지(251)와, 상기 영농단지(251)의 언저리에 가능한 넓은 면적의 태양광 발전장치(420) 단지가 구축으로, 기후변화로 인한 신제생에너지로 사용토록 제공되는 영농지역(200)이 확대로 제공하는 발명이다.  
여기서 본 발명의 목적인 풍력 및 태양광 발전장치(420)에서 잘전된 전력을 저장하도록 전력의 저장장치(ESS), 가열, 냉각장치와 연계된 제어장치(390)의 구비가 대부분 기본적으로 같추고 있는 추세이다.

title_en: Geological disaster rainfall data anomaly detection method based on space-time neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster rainfall data anomaly detection method based on a space-time neural network, which comprises the steps of generating a plurality of two-dimensional feature maps according to the relative longitude and latitude of a rainfall data acquisition sensor and different natural time period lengths in a data preprocessing step; in the feature fusion step, feature compression is respectively carried out on the feature graphs of different types to obtain processed features with the same dimension, and then feature fusion is carried out on all the processed features to obtain fusion features; in the space-time feature extraction step, features are extracted from the fusion features according to the time dimension and the space dimension respectively to obtain intermediate features; and reconstructing the intermediate features into a feature map with the shortest natural time period length in the data reconstruction step. The invention provides a multi-period space-time neural network based on the space-time neural network and combining the periodic characteristics of geological disaster rainfall monitoring data, and solves the problem of anomaly detection of the rainfall monitoring data by using the multi-period space-time neural network.
assignees: AEROSPACE SCIENCE AND INDUSTRY INERTIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for testing disaster recovery system, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for testing a disaster recovery system, a storage medium and electronic equipment. Relates to the field of financial science and technology or other related technical fields. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first flow data, wherein the first flow data comprises: recording flow data obtained by recording the flow generated by a target system in the process of processing at least one financial product transaction; desensitizing the first flow data to obtain second flow data; the second flow data is subjected to flow playback in the disaster recovery system, and in the flow playback process, the flow generated by the disaster recovery system is collected to obtain third flow data; and comparing the first flow data with the third flow data to obtain a comparison result, and generating a test report of the disaster recovery system based on the comparison result. The invention solves the technical problems of low accuracy of test results in the related art that the disaster recovery system of the financial institution is tested by manually initiating the transaction.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Mine emergency response task unloading method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine emergency response task unloading method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. Comprises the following steps: constructing a mine emergency response task unloading model; considering an emergency response equipment calculation model, wherein the model comprises a local calculation model and an unloading calculation model, and obtaining a task total unloading time delay of equipment through calculation to obtain a corresponding optimization function; a deep reinforcement learning algorithm is applied, and a Markov decision model is established; finally, based on the multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm, a deterministic strategy gradient algorithm based on an actor-critic model is adopted, and the agent is updated by combining a DQN (direct sequence number) with a target network and experience playback. The invention introduces global load balancing penalty factors to minimize the response time of global equipment tasks and relatively balance the load on the edge servers. The distributed operation of the invention solves the problems of dimensional explosion, expandability and poor dynamic property faced in the centralized task scheduling.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;YUNNAN WEISHIDUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Satellite remote sensing data reconstruction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a satellite remote sensing data reconstruction method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of remote sensing data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a target period of defect data in satellite remote sensing data of a latest period and satellite remote sensing data of a plurality of first historical contemporaneous periods of the target period; determining the distance level information of satellite remote sensing data under a clear sky condition in a target history period which is nearest to the latest period; and reconstructing satellite remote sensing data of the latest time period based on the range information of the satellite remote sensing data under the clear sky condition in the target history time period and the satellite remote sensing data of each first history contemporaneous time period. The invention can obtain the quasi-real-time satellite remote sensing data with continuous space-time distribution, and improves the timeliness and reliability of the satellite remote sensing data in the fields of natural disaster monitoring, crop growth monitoring, farmland irrigation management and the like.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Fire scene information detection robot and fire scene four-dimensional information reconstruction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene information detection robot and a fire scene four-dimensional information reconstruction method thereof, wherein the robot comprises a base, a detection module and a communication module which are arranged on the base, and an information processing module, a battery and bouncing feet are arranged in the base; the detection module and the communication module are both connected with the information processing module, the bouncing foot is positioned at the bottom of the base, a phase-change heat-absorbing medium is filled in a gap in the base, and the information processing module and the battery are sealed in the phase-change heat-absorbing medium; the information processing module is used for receiving, storing and transmitting signals of the detection module and the communication module, and is also used for controlling the bouncing foot; when the robot works, the detection module detects environmental parameters, the communication module and the information processing module are used for communication, and when the detection module detects that the temperature exceeds a preset value, the information processing module controls the bouncing foot to enable the robot to move, and detection and communication are performed again.

title_en: Water-retaining and anti-flushing coal mining method based on pressure relief fracture grouting to reconstruct anti-flushing water-resisting layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-retaining and anti-flushing coal mining method based on pressure relief crack grouting to reconstruct an anti-flushing water-resisting layer, which comprises the following steps: 1. exploration of mining area stratum information; 2. preparing a rock core sample and testing physical and mechanical parameters of each layer of stratum of a mining area; 3. layering the thick and hard sandstone layer; 4. carrying out multi-group directional drilling on a mining area; 5. hydraulic fracturing pressure relief; 6. constructing an anti-flushing waterproof layer; 7. constructing a fracture water-resisting layer; 8. water-retaining and water-flushing-preventing high-efficiency coal mining. The invention is characterized in that the pre-mining coal seam is layered and presplitting by covering the thick hard sandstone layer, the original hard sandstone layer is covered on the coal seam to be changed into the anti-impact waterproof layer, the impact problem caused by the thick hard sandstone layer in the coal mining process is solved, a great amount of slurry loss and waste in the grouting plugging process are avoided, the in-situ protection of the overlying strata is realized, the pressure relief fracturing and the grouting plugging are both realized by adopting the same drilling, the dynamic disaster and the permeable disaster in the coal mining process are prevented and treated, and the good effects of dual purposes of one hole and two disasters are realized.

title_en: Power distribution network information physical system rush-repair method based on information gap decision theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power information physical systems and discloses a power distribution network information physical system rush-repair method based on an information gap decision theory. Firstly, establishing a model considering the coupling relation between a power distribution network and an information network by taking the total cost of the information physical system of the power distribution network as a target; then, on the basis of the coupling model of the power distribution network and the information network, a post-disaster coordination recovery model of a post-disaster power distribution network information physical system is established; then, adding an emergency resource model such as network reconstruction of the power distribution network, a mobile emergency power supply, an emergency communication vehicle and the like; and finally, on the basis of an emergency resource model, based on an information gap decision theory, the condition of uncertainty of wind power output is considered, and a multi-source coordination recovery strategy after disaster of the information physical system of the power distribution network is established. The invention can improve the elasticity of the information physical system of the power distribution network after faults and reduce the influence and loss of natural disasters to the power distribution network and users thereof.

title_en: Assembly type steel bridge structure with string tensioning mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to an assembled steel bridge structure with a string tensioning mechanism. The method aims to solve the problems of small span, heavy weight, long assembly time, large bridge deflection when the span is large and the like of the existing steel bridge. The invention is composed of a main body structure and a string stretching mechanism, wherein the standard truss of the main body structure is connected with the high shear truss by pin joint. The string stretching mechanism consists of a supporting frame and a steel pull rod, and is arranged at the bottom of the main body structure, one end of the steel pull rod is fixed at the end part of the main body structure, the other end of the steel pull rod is fixed at the lower end of the supporting frame, the upper end of the supporting frame is connected with the bottom surface of the main body structure, and the main body structure is supported. The invention has strong crossing capability and light weight of components, can be quickly assembled and erected, and can be used as an emergency temporary project for quick emergency and an assembled steel bridge for conventional construction and post-war and post-disaster reconstruction projects. The invention can realize the coverage application of small and medium spans and large spans, is convenient for storage and maintenance, and has good applicability.

title_en: CEEMD and IWOA improved wavelet combined loaded coal rock internal heat source positioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for positioning a heat source in loaded coal rock by combining CEEMD and IWOA improved wavelets, and belongs to the technical field of heat source positioning. Firstly, monitoring the temperature of 4 points on the surface of coal rock by using a self-grinding loaded coal rock surface temperature acquisition device, and acquiring temperature data of the coal rock in real time; then CEEMD decomposition is carried out on each group of data, static interference in residual components obtained after the decomposition is filtered through average value solving, and simultaneously, the modal function signal attribute is identified by utilizing an autocorrelation function, and noise is reduced by utilizing an IOWA improved wavelet denoising method; and finally, reconstructing 4 paths of surface temperature signals of the loaded coal rock by utilizing the modal functions and the residual components obtained by processing, and obtaining the processed position of the heat source in the loaded coal rock based on a time difference principle. The method for positioning the heat source in the loaded coal rock provides a thought for acquiring the damage position in the coal rock by using the surface temperature of the loaded coal rock, and is beneficial to further improving the control effect of dynamic disasters of the coal rock.

title_en: Combustible gas alarm control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas detection, in particular to a combustible gas alarm control system and a method, wherein the system comprises an intelligent monitoring module, a risk identification module, a sensor strategy optimization module, an energy efficiency optimization management module, a predictive maintenance module, an emergency response module and a system dynamic reconstruction module. In the invention, environmental data fluctuation is analyzed by adopting a support vector machine, the relevance of risk factors is evaluated by a Bayesian network, the sensor layout and parameters are optimized by a genetic algorithm and a simulated annealing algorithm, the energy consumption distribution is adjusted by a particle swarm optimization algorithm and a dynamic programming algorithm, equipment faults are predicted by combining a long-period memory network with an anomaly detection algorithm, emergency response measures are formulated by a DSS technology and event-driven programming, and the system dynamic reconstruction is carried out by a reinforcement learning and genetic programming algorithm, so that the occurrence probability of accidents is greatly reduced by the system, the maintenance cost is reduced, and the operation safety and economic benefit are improved.
assignees: JIANGXI YIAI HONGTAI FIRE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide surface-like displacement prediction method, device and medium coupling InSAR and deep learning
abstract_en: The application provides a coupled InSAR and deep learning landslide surface-like displacement prediction method, which relates to the landslide disaster prediction and forecast field, and comprises the following steps: extracting the earth surface displacement time sequence of the target landslide body by a time sequence InSAR technology, performing projection conversion and spatial interpolation, and obtaining a planar raster data set of steepest slope displacement; establishing a spatial relation index according to the neighborhood window, extracting the steepest gradient displacement of grid points in the neighborhood window, and constructing an influence factor matrix by combining landslide displacement induction factors; establishing a weighted adjacency matrix for all grid points in the neighborhood window through landslide types and ground surface distances; and (3) reconstructing the influence factor matrix by using the weighted adjacent matrix through the GCN network, inputting the reconstructed influence factor matrix into the BiLSTM network, and predicting each grid point by using the bidirectional cyclic neural network to obtain a prediction result of the landslide surface displacement. By considering the physical space correlation of the whole planar landslide, the space refinement degree of deformation prediction is improved.

title_en: Surface soil reconstruction material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of ecological restoration, and discloses a surface soil reconstruction material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the surface soil reconstruction material comprises 30-70% of clay and 30-70% of sandy soil according to weight percentage; wherein, the clay contains clay particles of 85-90 wt% and the sand contains clay particles of 15 wt% or less. By adding sand into the surface soil reconstruction material, the pores and the permeability of the surface soil reconstruction material can be increased; and then when the surface soil reconstruction material is used for repairing the surface coverage, rainwater can infiltrate down at the time to form surface runoff, so that surface soil erosion and flood disasters can be avoided.
assignees: GUONENG LANGXINMING ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power supply management method and system based on intelligent portrait of area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply management method and a system based on intelligent images of a platform, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power supply of the platform and comprise the following steps: monitoring the state of the power grid in real time, and monitoring key power grid parameters; performing fusion analysis on the environmental sensor data and the power grid monitoring data to construct a district intelligent portrait; starting an intelligent demand response mechanism, and coordinating intelligent equipment and distributed energy resources; testing the performance of the power grid under different conditions by using a virtual power grid simulation technology, and adjusting a control strategy; performing power grid fault diagnosis and performance monitoring, and implementing self-healing measures to cope with the detected problems; emergency response and grid reconstruction are performed. The power supply management method based on the intelligent portrait of the area provided by the invention has quicker and more accurate response to faults. And can adapt to changing conditions and potential faults. The overall operation efficiency and the energy utilization rate of the power grid are improved. The frequency and the severity of faults are reduced, and the maintenance cost and the economic loss are reduced.
assignees: TAIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;XINTAI POWER SUPPLY COMOANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Cloud service system for disaster remote sensing monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud service system for disaster remote sensing monitoring, which comprises a measuring unit, a preprocessing unit and a cloud disaster early warning unit; the measuring unit is arranged in a disaster monitoring area, collects environmental information of the monitoring area, and is connected with the early warning processing unit to mutually transmit signals; the preprocessing unit is used for analyzing, comparing and judging the transmitted monitoring information, wherein the transmitted information comprises: a sync word, auxiliary parameters, and image data; the cloud disaster early warning unit displays the conditions in the monitoring area range on a screen and gives an alarm to the predicted disasters; the invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing monitoring, and discloses a measuring unit which comprises a remote sensing satellite, a rain gauge, a soil moisture sensor, a multipoint shifter, an osmometer, an inclinometer, a GPS positioning module and a camera device. The cloud service system for disaster remote sensing monitoring realizes the reconstruction of data information of disaster areas, accelerates the processing speed of disaster information and is beneficial to the rapid early warning of disaster areas.
assignees: NANJING TRUST DAVID STAR APPLIED RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Control equipment for lamps and lanterns and playback devices in ocean
abstract_en: The invention provides control equipment of each lamp and playing equipment of a sea hall, which comprises a 2048-channel lamplight control console, wherein the 2048-channel lamplight control console is respectively connected with a control room signal distribution cabinet and an audio frequency processor, the control room signal distribution cabinet is respectively connected with a power supply through box and a signal distribution cabinet, the power supply through box is respectively electrically connected with the control room signal distribution cabinet and the sea hall lamplight equipment, the signal distribution cabinet is respectively connected with the sea hall lamplight equipment, the audio frequency player is respectively connected with a digital tuning console, the digital tuning console is respectively connected with sea hall stage audio equipment and a digital audio frequency processor, and the digital audio frequency processor is connected with a network switch, and the invention has the beneficial effects that: the 2048-channel light control console is used for uniformly controlling all lamps and broadcasting equipment in the ocean, the data of the two 2048-channel computer light control consoles are mutually hot standby, one of the two 2048-channel computer light control consoles fails, performance is not affected, fire-fighting evacuation control signals can be received, and fire-fighting linkage is realized.

title_en: Fire source positioning and range measuring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire source positioning and range measuring method, which comprises the following steps: (1) Collecting field video data and identifying flame related information through a camera; (2) processing the image; (3) identifying a flame profile by a Canny edge detection algorithm; (4) constructing a flame profile convex hull through a Graham Scan algorithm; (5) calculating centroid coordinates of the flame profile; (6) calibrating the camera; and determining the position of the flame in a three-dimensional world coordinate system; (7) carrying out two-dimensional plane reduction reconstruction on the fire scene; (8) calculating the actual area of the flame spread range. The method for outlining the fire source and applying convex hull processing is adopted, so that the method has higher accuracy and comprehensiveness, and the fire source spreading range can be calculated more accurately.
assignees: NANJING TETRA ELECT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal-fired power plant nitrogen oxide emission prediction method based on improved random forest algorithm
