abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method for nitrogen oxide emission of a coal-fired power plant based on an improved random forest algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of flue gas denitration of the coal-fired power plant and comprises the steps of calculating maximum information coefficients between all independent variables and dependent variables, primarily screening the variables, constructing a random forest regression model, reconstructing the random forest regression model for a plurality of times, monitoring the prediction effect of the reconstructed random forest regression model in real time, carrying out comparative evaluation on the prediction performance of the random forest regression model by adopting model prediction performance evaluation indexes, and carrying out online prediction on real-time data of a flue gas system of the power plant. According to the invention, the threshold value of variable screening is automatically adjusted by using the out-of-bag error of the random forest, so that the difficulty of parameter adjustment is greatly reduced, and the efficiency of feature selection is improved; the robustness of the model is effectively improved through the combination of the sample random subspace strategy and the random subspace strategy; the adaptive updating mechanism evaluates the applicability of the model through a monitoring algorithm and effectively guides updating.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV EAST CHINA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Method for establishing three-dimensional model of beetle pest worm-eating tract by using CT image
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of longicorn pest control, and particularly relates to a method for establishing a three-dimensional model of a longicorn pest channel by using a CT image. The method for establishing the three-dimensional model of the beetle insect pest way by using the CT image is characterized by comprising the following steps of: s1: collecting longicorn pest victims Duan Biaoben; s2: cutting and sectioning the wood section specimen; s3: CT scanning treatment is carried out on the wood segment sample which is cut and segmented; s4: three-dimensional reconstruction of CT image moths of wood section specimens. The internal habit of the longicorn pest is further known through a CT scanning technology and a 3D reconstruction technology, the biological habit is supplemented, and theoretical basis is provided for exploring survival, propagation mechanism and population variation of the longicorn pest and relevant disaster prevention and control planning and teaching; overcomes the limitations of traditional manual dissection and other nondestructive detection techniques, and provides a new idea for controlling the longicorn pests.

title_en: Marine ecological disaster prevention and control enclosure experimental device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an experimental device for preventing and controlling marine ecological disasters, which comprises a floating grid assembly, wherein a plurality of enclosing pieces are fixed between the floating grid assembly, each enclosing piece comprises a vertical installation frame, a seawater containing bag is arranged in each vertical installation frame, the upper end of each seawater containing bag is open, and the upper edge of each seawater containing bag is fixedly connected with the upper end of each vertical installation frame. The device can ensure that the protection water body in the enclosure is not influenced by external environment, so that experimenters can conveniently identify potential disaster-causing algae in the water body in the enclosure, the reconstruction effect of protozoa on phytoplankton biomass and community structures under site conditions is researched, the prevention and control effect of the potential disaster-causing algae is evaluated, the research result provides data support for the test and site application of the protozoa prevention and control harmful algal bloom method, and scientific basis is provided for the development and application of the offshore typical harmful algal bloom biological prevention and control method in China.
assignees: THE SECOND GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST OF CHINA METALLURGICAL GEOLOGY BUREAU

title_en: Deep learning-based natural disaster damage assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a natural disaster damage assessment method and device based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target current image and a target reconstruction image of a target disaster-stricken facility set; processing the current image of the target by using a type recognition model to obtain the type of the target facility of each target disaster-stricken facility; processing the target current image and the target reconstruction image by using a scale evaluation model to obtain a target current scale and a target reconstruction scale of each target disaster-stricken facility; determining the target damage proportion of each target disaster-stricken facility according to the current target scale and the target reconstruction scale; and determining a target loss value of each target disaster-stricken facility according to the target damage proportion, the target facility type, the target reconstruction scale and the target area value. By introducing the deep learning technology, a large amount of data can be automatically processed, the loss of the building structure and the infrastructure caused by the natural disasters can be rapidly and accurately estimated, and the efficiency and consistency of natural disaster loss estimation are improved.

title_en: Fire-fighting inspection system applied to reconstruction of existing old building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting inspection system applied to reconstruction of existing old buildings, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting inspection information processing.
assignees: ZHEJIANG POST & TELECOMMUNICATION ENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Fault positioning and recovering method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault location recovery method and a system for a power distribution network, wherein the maximum load loss of the system is obtained according to a defense-attack-defense model; according to the distance between the nodes of the power distribution network and the maximum load loss of the system, the post-disaster recovery model is utilized to obtain the optimal load recovery scheme, the possible maximum load loss of the system can be accurately estimated, the number of scenes can be reduced by using a column and constraint generation algorithm, and the calculation time is effectively shortened; the optimal number and configuration places of the unmanned aerial vehicle configured by the system are determined, and a post-disaster inspection path is planned. The unmanned aerial vehicle is used for inspection, a large amount of manpower is not required to be input, the system traffic condition after disaster is not influenced, the time required for inspection is greatly reduced, and a foundation is laid for rapid recovery of a power distribution network; the post-disaster recovery strategy fully utilizes network reconstruction, distributed generators and energy storage to quickly recover the load, and compared with the situation that only a single means is considered, the provided recovery strategy can effectively reduce the weighted load loss of the system in each scene, and the post-disaster quick recovery of the power distribution network is realized.

title_en: Simple bridge structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a simple bridge structure, which comprises a beam body and bridge decks, wherein the beam body is arranged on the bridge decks, and the bridge decks are arranged on two sides of a river bed; the beam body comprises: the bridge comprises a bottom plate, side plates and a filling body, wherein the bottom plate is arranged on the bridge abutment, the side plates are arranged on the bottom plate to form a box body structure with an open top, and the filling body is arranged in a cavity of the box body structure; the beam body is simply and rapidly assembled by the bottom plate, the side plates and the filling body, so that the problems that the existing bridge is limited by geographical conditions, construction is slow and the development of post-disaster rescue work is not facilitated in the post-disaster recovery and reconstruction process are solved.
assignees: SICHUAN COMMUNICATION SURVEYING & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for acquiring temperature information of fire scene in building space
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for acquiring temperature information of a fire scene in a building space, which are used for carrying out fire risk analysis on a determined building space, constructing an FDS fire numerical model of the building under a corresponding fire working condition according to a fire risk analysis result, acquiring temperature field distribution data under a main fire working condition, fitting the temperature field distribution data under the main fire working condition through a neural network means, and determining a function mapping relation of discrete temperature data on space coordinates; obtaining the flying time of each sound wave ray by carrying out local integration on the function on the sound wave path; dividing the measured section into grids, and obtaining the distance of the sound wave rays passing through each grid unit; constructing an acoustic wave flying matrix equation according to the flying time and the distance; the matrix equation is solved, the average temperature of each grid cell is obtained, reconstruction temperature data are solved, verification is carried out, and the method can achieve real-time acquisition and presentation of the building space fire scene temperature data.

title_en: Method and system for protecting falling rocks in slope construction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of buildings, and discloses a method and a system for protecting a falling rock in slope construction, wherein a falling rock track and a control technology are applied in the construction period of a high steep rock slope; the method comprises the steps of applying a high-steep rock slope safety excavation technology and technology close to an operation expressway; the karst mountain area high-steep slope stability evaluation and control technology is applied; applying a health diagnosis and disaster prevention and control technology for the high and steep excavation side slope of the interchange area; the construction technology of sectional splicing of the large-span steel-concrete beam upper span operation expressway is applied; the design and construction technology of the continuous cast-in-situ box girder bracket with the small radius curve is applied. The invention not only provides positive technical support and safety guarantee for the construction of high and steep rocky slopes, but also provides a system and comprehensive theoretical basis and technical measures for solving similar engineering problems frequently encountered in the construction of expressways, especially the reconstruction and expansion engineering of mountain areas in China, has obvious technical and economic benefits and social benefits, is suitable for the national conditions of traffic infrastructures in China, and has wide application prospect.
assignees: THE 5TH ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 22ND BUREAU GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY 22ND BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Urban street tree disaster-bearing capacity simulation method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning and artificial intelligence, in particular to a digital twinning-based urban street tree disaster-bearing capacity simulation method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring image data by adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle through oblique photography, and carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on the whole scene of the region according to the acquired image data and position information; making a traffic photogrammetry route plan according to the distribution and the characteristics of the pavement tree; based on route planning, a data acquisition system is built through an unmanned aerial vehicle, and point cloud data and multispectral data of an uplink road tree of a route are acquired; taking data obtained by oblique photogrammetry as a digital twin base to construct a pavement tree fine model; simulating the influence on the pavement tree in the urban wind field by using fluid mechanics simulation according to the historical characteristic wind field grid data; and obtaining a disaster bearing capacity evaluation result and a distribution map of the street tree according to the simulation analysis. Compared with the existing artificial wind method, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the application scene is more abundant and the area is larger.
assignees: URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN INST CO LTD OF SHENZHEN

title_en: Sparse data-oriented meteorological missing information fusion filling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sparse data-oriented meteorological missing information fusion filling method, which relates to the technical field of meteorological detection and comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data source unit, a data preprocessing unit, a missing data detection unit, a missing data filling unit, a data reconstruction unit, a data fusion enhancement unit and a data evaluation unit; missing data shim cell, specifically for: the global information is fully mined, the local detail information is complemented, and the integrity of meteorological observation data is improved; the data reconstruction unit is specifically used for reconstructing fine scale details in the high-resolution image, complementing the space and time relevance, effectively solving the defect of insufficient details of the large-magnification image and improving the space-time resolution of the meteorological satellite image; the data fusion enhancement unit is specifically used for: and the accuracy and the reliability of the filled data are improved. By the structure, the invention solves the actual difficulties of difficult acquisition of the observed data, sparse observation stations, aging hysteresis and the like in the current prediction service of specific areas at home and abroad, meets the requirements of the meteorological service on the quality of the data, and promotes the high-quality development of modern meteorological enterprises such as smart weather monitoring, prediction early warning, disaster prevention and reduction and the like by high-precision meteorological element data.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY;NO 10 INST OF CETC

title_en: Comprehensive energy system toughness improving method considering thermal inertia under extreme ice and snow disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving toughness of a comprehensive energy system by considering thermal inertia under extreme ice and snow disasters, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a line fault model of a power grid system in the comprehensive energy system under the extreme ice and snow disasters by considering the influence of the extreme ice and snow disasters on a power distribution network line; then constructing a scene set of broken lines; and finally, constructing a comprehensive energy system toughness improvement model, searching an optimal configuration scheme of the heat storage capacity of the building before the disaster and a fault repair strategy of each scene after the disaster under the probability distribution of the worst scene based on the comprehensive energy system toughness improvement model, and finally realizing the comprehensive energy system toughness improvement. According to the invention, the potential of heat energy is fully excavated in the comprehensive energy system, the influence of heat energy characteristics on the capacity of the power system for resisting extreme ice and snow disasters is considered, the heat storage capacity of the building is configured through the heat storage characteristics of the building before the disasters, the connection switch is closed to perform topology reconstruction after the disasters, the post-disaster rush-repair strategy is optimized, and the toughness of the power system is improved through various means.

title_en: Security decision and cooperative control method based on real-time capability of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety decision and cooperative control method based on unmanned aerial vehicle real-time capability, which comprises the following steps: designing a track planning method adapting to system capacity; based on unmanned aerial vehicle energy analysis, calculating a safety threshold value, and designing a self-adaptive triggering safety decision mechanism; designing an inner ring safety controller of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the observer, and monitoring the system capacity of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time; when the unmanned aerial vehicle fails, safety decision is made according to the residual capacity of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and if the residual capacity is greater than a safety threshold, the unmanned aerial vehicle formation can fly normally; if the remaining capacity is smaller than the safety threshold but larger than the hovering threshold, adjusting the performance parameters to degrade the performance, and designing a reconfigurable cooperative controller to reconstruct the communication topology and the formation; and if the remaining capacity is smaller than the hovering threshold value, the fault unmanned aerial vehicle immediately executes a landing program. The method can effectively ensure the safety of unmanned aerial vehicle formation when serious actuator faults occur, and is suitable for special tasks such as post-disaster searching, emergency rescue and the like.

title_en: Three-dimensional scene simulation method, system and equipment for earthquake disaster process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional scene simulation method, a system and equipment in a earthquake disaster-stricken process, which belong to the technical field of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting historical data and aerial photographs of a disaster-stricken city, determining restored topography and restored plan views of the disaster-stricken city, comparing the restored topography and restored plan views, converting a digital elevation model in vectorized data into elevation points, creating a triangular irregular network, and generating 3D topography of the disaster-stricken city; reconstructing the building and surrounding environment of the 3D topography of the disaster-affected ancient city to restore the 3D scene of the disaster-affected ancient city; adding a blueprint file and a checkpoint sequence in Unreal Engine software, and simulating a seismic scene of a disaster affected city by adding a camera and a path for the camera to move in the checkpoint sequence; simulating the strength of geometric body fracture by adjusting the explosion equivalent of the fracture of the earthquake scene, and simulating a landslide scene; the formation scene of the barrier lake is simulated by adjusting the color and parameters of the water flow of the landslide. The method can simulate the disaster-stricken process rapidly and with high fidelity.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster real-time monitoring, in particular to a geological disaster early warning method and system. The invention provides a full-time empty dynamic three-dimensional scene catastrophe monitoring and early warning platform, which utilizes multi-source monitoring data to make up for the defect that conventional monitoring data lacks geological information support; the scheme solves the problem of dynamic fusion of multi-source monitoring data by utilizing a multi-source heterogeneous scheme; the scheme utilizes the 5G network to realize low-delay transmission of high-definition video data occupying huge network resources, and ensures the safety of multi-source monitoring data; the method constructs a ground disaster comprehensive judgment model to realize the prior judgment and early warning of sudden ground disasters; according to the scheme, the rapid reconstruction and high-performance display of the three-dimensional scene are realized, the real-time dynamic monitoring of the disaster situation is realized, the fastest and most accurate emergency response can be obtained when the disaster situation occurs, and the disaster early warning application services with different characteristics, various levels and multiple topics are satisfied.
assignees: CHANGQING ENG DESIGN CO LTD;CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP

title_en: Fire-fighting reconstruction low-smoke halogen-free cable laying device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire-fighting reconstruction low-smoke halogen-free cable laying device and a method, which relate to the technical field of fire-fighting reconstruction and comprise the following steps: the guiding mechanism is used for guiding the cable and the steel wire rope to be folded; the clamp comprises an upper clamping plate and a lower clamping plate which are mutually buckled and then clamp the cable and the steel wire rope; the clamping mechanism is used for buckling the upper clamping plate and the lower clamping plate which are separated; a separating and clamping mechanism for separating the combined upper and lower clamping plates; the control module is electrically connected with the clamping mechanism and the clamping separating mechanism and is used for controlling work; the guiding mechanism is transversely arranged and positioned at one side of the clamping mechanism, and the steel wire rope is fed into the winding machine after sequentially passing through the guiding mechanism, the clamping mechanism and the clamping separating mechanism. The application has the effect of saving more labor in cable laying.
assignees: CHONGQING YUNYI CONSTRUCTION AND INSTALLATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting system policy reconstruction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting system policy reconstruction method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining equipment access request information, and receiving newly added fire-fighting equipment information according to the equipment access request information; performing equipment classification on the newly added fire fighting equipment information to obtain a first equipment classification result; traversing the original fire-fighting equipment information, and extracting a second equipment classification result; acquiring fire control environment information, and calculating and correlating the correlation degree between the first equipment classification result and the second equipment classification result according to the fire control environment information and a preset linkage interval to obtain an equipment correlation result; and generating a new fire control strategy based on the equipment association result and a preset linkage rule, and updating the new fire control strategy into the original fire control strategy to complete the reconstruction of the fire control system. The invention realizes the cooperative work of the newly added equipment and the equipment in the original fire-fighting system, optimizes the overall linkage of the fire-fighting system, and improves the overall fire-fighting capability of the fire-fighting system.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JIASHENG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Light fireproof partition wall
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of protective walls, in particular to a light fireproof partition wall, which aims at the problems that a hollow building block has poor heat insulation effect and low fireproof limit, has larger potential safety hazard when a fire disaster occurs, and the wall body formed by the hollow building block also has larger weight without secondary reconstruction of business places such as a storehouse and the like; the heat insulation plate and the keel replace the traditional wall body, so that the self weight is reduced, the heat insulation effect and the fire resistance limit are improved, the whole weight is light, and the secondary transformation is facilitated under the condition of meeting the requirement of certain hardness.
assignees: HENAN ANZHU CONSTRUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smoke exhaust device for fire control reconstruction of dormitory building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a smoke exhaust device for fire-fighting reconstruction of dormitory buildings, which relates to the field of fire-fighting reconstruction smoke exhaust, and aims at solving the problems that the smoke exhaust effect of the existing fans is not ideal, a great amount of impurities are carried in smoke and the effect of the fans is degraded for a long time. The utility model has novel structure, the device filters different objects through the multiple filtering devices, and the smoke discharging effect of the device is increased by matching the fans.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION UNION DESIGN INST GUANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Self-resetting energy-consumption frame structure with energy-consumption components
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-resetting energy-consuming frame structure with energy-consuming components, which adopts discontinuous arrangement to avoid the accumulation of frame expansion when the self-resetting energy-consuming frame with the energy-consuming components swings; the frame which is coplanar with the self-resetting energy-consuming frame with the energy-consuming component is provided with a gap when the beam component is connected with the self-resetting energy-consuming frame with the energy-consuming component, so that the damage of the beam component and the self-resetting energy-consuming frame with the energy-consuming component caused by the expansion of the frame is avoided. In addition, when the floor slab is subjected to earthquake action, the continuous floor slab, the internal supporting frame, the hinged frame and the bottom of the continuous floor slab work cooperatively, so that the cracking of the floor slab and the damage of the second beam member or the truss can be avoided. The method has the advantages of being good in integrity, having a definite earthquake action transmission path, an energy dissipation mechanism, residual deformation control and a structural repair thought, being capable of realizing multi-stage damage mechanism design of a component level and a structural level, effectively guaranteeing the stability of the whole structure, being capable of greatly reducing repair difficulty in a post-disaster reconstruction stage, being free from overall dismantling reconstruction and reducing resource cost.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted mobile tower command system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of civil aviation air traffic control construction, and particularly relates to a vehicle-mounted mobile tower command system which consists of a square cabin vehicle of an integrated mobile tower and an emergency power supply vehicle. The integrated mobile tower shelter car consists of an equipment cabin section, a tower control room cabin section, an externally hung air conditioner and a foldable lifting platform on the roof. The invention is separated from the original tower construction site and the matching, and can completely and independently operate; when the temporary transition command is used, the operation pressure of the original tower can be thoroughly liberated, so that the time for upgrading and reconstruction is more abundant, the airport operation is guaranteed to be uninterrupted, and the temporary transition command is a perfect temporary transition operation scheme; is not affected by accidents such as earthquake, fire and the like. Even if external power supply and wired communication are interrupted, the control capability of the tower can still be quickly recovered by means of an emergency power supply vehicle and a wireless communication technology. Plays a very great role in improving disaster resistance of important airports; the airport rapid recovery tower control capability under emergency conditions is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI NEW ERA CIVIL AVIATION AIRPORT DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Transaction processing method, system and CDP replay and recovery method in redo record
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transaction processing method and system in a redo record and a CDP replay and recovery method, belonging to the technical field of disaster recovery backup. The method is used for the data backup end and comprises the following steps: acquiring identification parameters of the redo records; judging whether the redo record is a transaction ending point or not; several redo records belonging to the same transaction are encapsulated into one transaction structure. The system is used in a data backup terminal and comprises: a redo record identification parameter module is obtained; judging a transaction ending point module; the transaction fabric module is encapsulated. The invention realizes the display distinction and encapsulation of the transaction by acquiring the identification parameters of the redo records, ensures the consistency, the durability, the isolation and the atomicity of the data, lays a foundation for realizing the recovery of any transaction, and is safe and effective.
assignees: CHENGDU VINCHIN SCIENCE AND TECH COMPANY

title_en: Forest wildfire carbon emission measurement method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for measuring carbon emission of forest wildfires, which belong to the technical field of fire prevention, and are used for determining a lighting temperature threshold and a trust threshold of a judging fire point by reconstructing satellite data, carrying out secondary space-time positioning on a forest fire scene and determining the position and the area of a real fire point; constructing a CO2 dry air mixing ratio XCO2 background concentration value diagram of a forest fire field area, carrying out actual measurement on the forest fire field according to the position and the area of a real fire point, obtaining an actual measurement XCO2 and dry air mixing ratio XCO2 concentration background diagram, and determining the concentration rising amount I  XCO2  of XCO  2 ; constructing an XCO  2  concentration rise I  XCO2  directly connected with FRP by taking an actually measured XCO  2  background concentration value graph and FRP data as priori conditions, and simulating an XCO  2  concentration rise I  XCO2  value of a CO  2  monitoring blind area part in a forest fire to obtain an XCO  2  concentration rise I  XCO2 ; and measuring and calculating the emission of CO  2  of the forest wildfires based on the area of the fire area, the concentration rise I  XCO2  of the XCO  2 , the dry air density contour line and the fire plume height. The method can establish direct connection between the concentration of CO  2  and the fire intensity, thereby realizing the aim of rapidly and accurately measuring and calculating the global carbon emission of the forest wildfire area.

title_en: Post-disaster recovery method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster recovery method of a power distribution network, which belongs to the technical field of post-disaster recovery of the power distribution network and comprises the following steps: s1, constructing an objective function; s2, modeling; s3, establishing an upper model and a lower model; and S4, solving the upper model and the lower model. By carrying out detailed modeling on the transition process, topology transformation and voltage fluctuation of the network reconstruction, the provided model can solve the optimal transition track of the network reconstruction, ensure that the voltage of each node of the power distribution network in the network reconstruction process is in a safe range and minimize the voltage fluctuation in the network reconstruction process. The problem that the double-layer mixed integer linear programming model is difficult to solve can be solved by using a double-layer reconstruction and decomposition algorithm based on relaxation, and the algorithm can be used for processing a plurality of lower-layer problems, so that the calculation efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Civil fire extinguisher throwing control device and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a civil fire extinguisher throwing control device and a control method, which belong to the technical field of civil aviation emergency rescue aviation fire extinguishment, wherein a normal controller in the civil fire extinguisher throwing control device is combined with state information of an in-place sensor assembly after receiving a control instruction of an upper computer or a ground maintenance panel on the machine, controls an electric actuator assembly, and completes opening and closing of a left water throwing cabin door and a right water throwing cabin door; the invention provides a civil fire extinguisher throwing control device and a control method, which have the advantages of small plane reconstruction difficulty and good economy when a conventional passenger plane is refitted, high automation degree, low maintenance cost, high throwing control efficiency, clean and environment-friendly energy source and no need of laying a hydraulic pipeline, and can improve the reliability of emergency opening of a water throwing cabin door by normal and emergency different control channels and improve the safety of the fire extinguisher plane.

title_en: Numerical evaluation method for migration and diffusion of radionuclide in river nuclear accident
abstract_en: The invention relates to a numerical evaluation method for migration and diffusion of radionuclides in river nuclear accidents, which classifies accident types according to accident point occurrence positions, adopts corresponding calculation modes to carry out numerical simulation of migration and diffusion of the radionuclides in a river according to accident type types, wherein the accident type types comprise known river nuclear facility nuclear accidents and unknown river nuclear accidents, outputs numerical simulation results of migration and diffusion of the radionuclides in the river, and carries out numerical simulation according to different calculation models according to accident periods aiming at the known river nuclear facility nuclear accidents. By adopting the method disclosed by the invention, numerical simulation can be carried out on known river nuclear facilities or unknown arbitrary river accident points, and early, middle and late stages and retrospective response evaluation of river water environmental nuclear accidents can be responded, so that radionuclide prediction of global arbitrary river places is realized, and scientific and reasonable technical support is provided for relevant river nuclear facility result evaluation and system research and development.

title_en: Numerical evaluation method for migration and diffusion of radionuclide in ocean nuclear accident
abstract_en: The invention relates to a numerical evaluation method for migration and diffusion of radionuclides in ocean nuclear accidents, which comprises the following steps: dividing the marine water environment into offshore nuclear facilities and any point of an open sea accident; selecting a calculation mode based on accident point position information aiming at offshore nuclear facilities, and establishing a corresponding radionuclide migration diffusion simulation model to perform simulation evaluation; aiming at any point of the open sea accident, a rapid automatic numerical calculation model of any point of the open sea is established from the angles of particle track and concentration field respectively, simulation evaluation is carried out, and a numerical evaluation method of migration and diffusion of radionuclide in ocean nuclear accident is adopted to respond to early, middle and late stages and retrospective response evaluation of nuclear accident aiming at different nuclear accident scenes of ocean water environment.

title_en: Cross-cluster Redis disaster recovery method and system based on Gossip fault awareness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-cluster Redis disaster recovery method based on Gossip fault perception, belonging to the technical field of computers; the method comprises the following steps: obtaining data from a server node of a host computer room; synchronizing the data to a Replayer playback device by a Replicator replicator; synchronizing the data to a server node of the backup machine room through Replayer playback devices; acquiring the running states of a main machine room and a standby machine room; and carrying out disaster recovery switching according to the running state of the main machine room and a preset main-standby switching triggering condition. The invention also discloses a cross-cluster Redis disaster recovery system based on Gossip fault perception. The invention solves the Redis disaster recovery problem of crossing a plurality of Kubernetes clusters: the present invention is directed to achieving high availability and data consistency of Redis across clusters to meet the reliability requirements of Redis services in a distributed environment.
assignees: HANGZHOU HARMONY CLOUD TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster reconstruction method and system for power distribution network based on mixed quantum classical computation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster reconstruction method and system for a power distribution network based on mixed quantum classical computing, wherein a post-disaster power distribution network topology reconstruction model based on the mixed quantum-classical method is constructed according to the disaster condition of the power distribution network, the post-disaster power distribution network topology reconstruction model considers network topology reconstruction and distributed power supply island operation factors, the post-disaster power distribution network topology reconstruction model takes loss due to load loss and minimum switching action cost as objective functions, the post-disaster power distribution network topology reconstruction model comprises power distribution network topology constraint and power distribution network operation constraint, and the power distribution network operation constraint is set according to a radial structure of the power distribution network; and optimizing the post-disaster power distribution network topology reconstruction model to obtain an optimal solution of the post-disaster power distribution network topology reconstruction model after the disaster, forming a power distribution network topology reconstruction strategy, and objectively obtaining post-disaster power distribution network reconstruction distribution parameters, so that the post-disaster power distribution network can quickly recover power supply, and the power failure loss is reduced.

title_en: Building heating system capable of saving floor area
abstract_en: A building heating system capable of saving floor space relates to a building heating device, and aims to solve the problems that an additional floor space is large and site selection is difficult for secondary reconstruction of a building due to the fact that a heating water tank is arranged in the building. The heat preservation partition board is arranged in the original fire-fighting water storage tank, and divides the original fire-fighting water storage tank into a fire-fighting water tank and a heating water tank; the heater is arranged in the heating water tank; the heating water pump is communicated with the heating water tank through a heating water removing pipe; the fire-fighting water tank is respectively communicated with the heating water tank through a heating water inlet pipe and a fire-fighting water inlet pipe; the first one-way valve is arranged on the heating water inlet pipe; the second one-way valve and the radiator are both arranged on the fire-fighting water inlet pipe; the water inlet of the fire pump is communicated with the fire tank through a fire main pipe; the water outlet of the fire-fighting water pump supplies water to an external fire-fighting system; the fire-fighting water tank is supplied with water through the main water inlet pipe. The method has the beneficial effects of saving occupied area and solving the problem of difficult site selection of newly-added equipment for secondary reconstruction of the building.
assignees: STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV DALIAN MARITIME

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network rush-repair electricity method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, considering the uncertainty of the output of wind-light power generation during typhoon disasters, and predicting the power generation of wind power and photovoltaic by using a phase space reconstruction and Stacking integrated model; secondly, using pumped storage as a black start power supply, and establishing a mixed integer linear programming model of emergency power generation vehicles, gas generators, hydrogen fuel cells, wind-solar storage and other distributed power supplies participating in power distribution network rush repair scheduling and fault recovery; and solving by using a CPLEX solver to obtain scheduling strategies of the rush-repair teams and the emergency power generation cars under different scenes, and analyzing the influence of the output of each device on the power distribution network. The invention can accurately predict the output of the wind-light power generation equipment when key information such as meteorological environment is lost, greatly improves the power distribution network re-electricity efficiency under typhoon disasters, and effectively reduces the loss caused by power failure.

title_en: Motor rotor fault diagnosis method based on CNN-BiLSTM-residual error module-attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motor rotor fault diagnosis method based on a CNN-BiLSTM-residual error module-attention mechanism, which belongs to the technical field of fault diagnosis and comprises the following steps: s1, optimizing VMD parameters by using an improved Chernobelli disaster algorithm ICDO; s2, after the VMD decomposes the motor rotor fault initial data, IMF components with fault characteristic signal components are screened out according to a correlation coefficient criterion and kurtosis, and then signal reconstruction is carried out; s3, obtaining time domain features and frequency domain features of the reconstructed signals, and screening data features by using a comprehensive analysis method; s4, inputting the screened data characteristics into a CNN-BiLSTM-residual error module-attention mechanism network for fault diagnosis. The motor rotor fault diagnosis method based on the CNN-BiLSTM-residual error module-attention mechanism can accurately realize motor rotor fault diagnosis, and simultaneously, through the diagnosis of motor rotor faults and different faults of the bearing when noise interference is added, the proposed model is proved to have good noise robustness and generalization.

title_en: Bridge anti-seismic integrated management system oriented to regional road network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a regional road network oriented bridge earthquake-resistant comprehensive management system, which belongs to the field of bridge earthquake resistance and comprises a bridge earthquake-resistant management map module, a bridge earthquake resistance evaluation module, a bridge earthquake simulation and prediction module, a bridge emergency response and decision support module, a bridge recovery and reconstruction planning module and a database. The invention provides more refined and intelligent information and guidance for dealing with earthquake disasters.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Safety transformation monitoring system and method for building construction
abstract_en: The invention provides a safety transformation monitoring system for building construction and a method thereof, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a sensor network module, a data transmission module, a data processing and analyzing module, a real-time monitoring and early warning module, a historical data inquiring and analyzing module, an emergency response module and a system integrating and expanding module, wherein the sensor network module is wirelessly connected with the data transmission module, the data transmission module is wirelessly connected with the data processing and analyzing module, the data processing and analyzing module is wirelessly connected with the real-time monitoring and early warning module, the historical data inquiring and analyzing module is wirelessly connected with the output end of the real-time monitoring and early warning module, and the historical data inquiring and analyzing module is wirelessly connected with the emergency response module. The invention provides a safety reconstruction monitoring system for building construction and a method thereof, wherein a real-time registration unit, a real-time classification unit and a real-time registration unit are used for registering a person for recording when the constructor is used, and classifying the person for different construction projects after registering the information of the person.
assignees: YANCHENG POLYTECHNIC COLLEGE;YANCHENG HONGZHIXIN STEEL STRUCTURE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and equipment for accurately positioning personnel in mine water-permeable accident
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mine personnel positioning, and provides a method, a system and equipment for accurately positioning personnel in a mine water-permeable accident, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the pulse laser is processed and then emitted into the sensing optical fiber, so that the sensing optical fiber is caused to vibrate, and a vibration signal is obtained; processing the vibration signal, and outputting the processed vibration signal to a signal storage for storage; carrying out characteristic reconstruction on the vibration signal, obtaining characteristics of sample entropy, energy distribution and frequency bandwidth in the vibration signal, expressing the sample entropy, the energy distribution and the frequency bandwidth by corresponding x, y and z axis direction vectors respectively, and constructing a corresponding waveform diagram; analyzing a waveform diagram of the backward Rayleigh scattering light interference signal, and determining a time interval in which the vibration signal changes; and taking the time interval as a time delay t  0  of the incident pulse light and the received backward Rayleigh scattered light, calculating the position of the vibration signal, and correspondingly obtaining the position interval of the trapped person.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY;TAIYUAN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Video image geographic stitching method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a video image geographic stitching method, a video image geographic stitching device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time live images of a real scene acquired by a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and GNSS information of the unmanned aerial vehicles; performing input frame tracking on the live broadcast image in real time by using a visual SLAM algorithm, and performing pose estimation on the successfully tracked input frame by combining the visual track and GNSS information to generate a camera pose with geographic reference; performing densification processing on an input frame by using a camera gesture and a surface reconstruction algorithm to generate a depth map of a real scene, and projecting the depth map into a dense three-dimensional point cloud to construct a three-dimensional surface model of the real scene; and carrying out orthographic correction on the input frame by using the camera gesture and the three-dimensional surface model, integrating the orthographic corrected input frame into a global mosaic map, and generating a global image of the real scene. The embodiment of the application can quickly acquire the real-time picture in the real scene and provides powerful support for quick emergency response of the real scene.

title_en: Elastic operation method of rural power distribution network supported by light-biogas
abstract_en: The invention fully considers the elastic operation requirement of the rural power distribution network and the power supply capacity of the existing distributed resources, models the elastic rural power distribution network, considers various constraints of safe operation, and provides an elastic operation method of the rural power distribution network supported by light-biogas cooperation. The method comprises the steps of carrying out day-ahead scheduling in the first stage, and deciding a rural power distribution network by taking economic operation of the rural power distribution network as a main target; and in the second stage, on the basis of generating possible disaster fault scenes, the loss caused by each scene is weighted and calculated, and the reconstruction after the disaster of the rural power distribution network is completed, so that the rural power distribution network has the short-time island operation capability. The elastic operation method of the rural power distribution network supported by the light-biogas cooperation can fully improve the elastic operation capacity of the rural power distribution network.

title_en: Multi-mode fused precipitation dry-wet time sequence change reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode fused precipitation dry-wet time sequence change reconstruction method and system, which belong to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction and hydrological weather analysis, and are characterized in that a double-layer deep learning fusion architecture model is constructed by fusing CMIP6 mode libraries, overlapping precipitation event occurrence probability information and combining a computer parallel computing and big data mining technology, so that the dry-wet time sequence change and magnitude of climate mode precipitation are reconstructed. The invention not only realizes the space-time scale reduction from large-scale grid precipitation to point-scale ground precipitation, but also effectively improves the capturing capability of the mode precipitation to ground precipitation events, overcomes the defect of the output of the existing numerical mode, better provides basic support for watershed hydrological weather forecast and flood control and disaster reduction, and has higher practical application value.

title_en: Block chain-based forest fire intelligent detection and voice broadcasting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blockchain-based forest fire intelligent detection and voice broadcasting method and system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent analysis. The method comprises the following steps: collecting an image to be detected; detecting whether the image to be detected is a fire forest image or not by using a targeted multi-scale SVM forest fire detection model based on detection difficulty analysis; if yes, generating forest fire description text information; synthesizing a forest fire broadcasting voice signal by using a voice synthesis model based on combination of multidimensional evaluation and reverse verification, and broadcasting; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a multi-coding result optimized voice coding model based on signal reconstruction verification to code a forest fire broadcasting voice signal; and (5) uploading the forest fire description text information and the encoding result of the forest fire broadcasting voice signal. According to the invention, by combining a plurality of intelligent models, accurate and timely forest fire detection and broadcasting are realized; and the data are stored in a uplink mode by combining the block chain, so that the safety and reliability of the data are improved.

title_en: Fusion adaptation method of three-dimensional building model and digital earth
abstract_en: The invention provides a fusion adaptation method of a three-dimensional building model and digital earth, which realizes seamless conversion and fusion between three-dimensional BIM data and three-dimensional GIS data. Firstly, providing a conversion method to convert IFC data of a three-dimensional BIM into CityGML data of a three-dimensional GIS, and then reconstructing the geometric shape of a model, and carrying out semantic filtering and mapping; secondly, according to the detail level expression characteristics of the model, a fusion scheme with the multi-resolution terrain is provided for processing, so that the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of the model are ensured; and finally, fusing the model with the oblique photogrammetry model, and further enriching the physical three-dimensional space information. The method can accurately display the geometric shape, the spatial position and the attribute information of the building in the global scope, provides important technical support for urban planning, building design, disaster early warning and emergency response work, and has remarkable application value.

title_en: Landslide numerical model reconstruction method based on electric method and unmanned aerial vehicle aerial survey
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide numerical model reconstruction method based on an electric method and unmanned aerial vehicle aerial survey, which comprises the following steps: resistivity profile data acquired based on an electrical method are utilized to acquire landslide soil layer material information by utilizing a probability density peak value method and performing interpolation denoising treatment; based on DEM data acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring landslide surface layer information by using a curtain distribution method; according to landslide coating material information and landslide surface layer information, correcting the surface layer to a soil layer, and establishing a landslide three-dimensional visualization model; and preprocessing the landslide three-dimensional visualization model to obtain a landslide discrete element numerical model. Compared with the prior art, the method can accurately and quickly reconstruct the three-dimensional model of the side slope region, and reconstruct the original surface appearance of the side slope region, thereby providing an accurate model for the aspects of landslide prediction, side slope susceptibility evaluation, landslide disaster evaluation, landslide mechanism analysis and the like.
assignees: DALI DAYANG ERYUN EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Distributed energy storage hierarchical optimization configuration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed energy storage grading optimization configuration method, which comprises the following steps: step S1, constructing a distribution network line fault scene set under different types of extreme natural disasters; step S2, a three-layer robust optimization model of the flexible interconnection area distributed energy storage hierarchical configuration is built to improve the toughness of the power distribution network; and step S3, solving the three-layer robust optimization model, optimizing the hierarchical configuration of the distributed energy storage in the power distribution network and the topology structure of the power distribution network, and obtaining the position and the capacity of the energy storage system under the configuration cost of the minimum energy storage system and the topology structure of the power distribution network under the minimum load reduction. According to the invention, the hierarchical optimization configuration framework of the distributed energy storage of the flexible interconnection area is constructed, so that the power distribution network reconstruction optimization is performed when the flexible interconnection area faces to extreme natural disasters, the resistance of the low-voltage power distribution network to the extreme natural disasters is improved, the toughness of the power distribution network is obviously improved, and the configuration cost of the distributed energy storage system is reduced.

title_en: Multi-scale attribute characterization and penetration disaster evaluation system and method for tunnel fracture rock mass
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a system and a method for multi-scale attribute characterization and penetration disaster evaluation of a tunnel fracture rock mass, which relate to the technical field of underground structure evaluation and comprise the following steps: respectively extracting large-scale crack data and medium-scale crack data, and respectively modeling; fusing fracture attribute models of different scales, extracting multi-scale fracture characteristics from local and global angles based on CNN and Swin transformer network structures, introducing a t distribution self-focusing mechanism into the Swin transformer as priori knowledge, extracting accurate spatial characteristics of the fracture, using a full connection layer to promote mapping of input data to a weight space, carrying out up-sampling reconstruction through transposed convolution, outputting a multi-scale fracture attribute image, and constructing the multi-scale fracture attribute model; and acquiring permeability data of the underground structure, acquiring spatial distribution information of permeability, establishing a relation model between the fracture fusion attribute and the permeability, performing numerical simulation on the underground structure, and performing disaster assessment on the underground structure.

title_en: crisis-response drill and evaluation system using metabus
title_ko: 메타버스를 이용한 위기대응훈련 및 평가 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is to enhance the effectiveness of crisis-response training by integrating related technologies, enabling officials or citizens to recognize the risks of crisis situations and engage in realistic crisis-response drills within a metaverse environment. The crisis-response drill and evaluation system using the metaverse comprises: a step of constructing a three-dimensional (3D) or two-dimensional (2D) metaverse space based on digital data of actual buildings or physical environments; a step in which a supervisor and one or more users connect to the metaverse space via terminals, and through a supervisor or user interface, enable interaction among user avatars, articiail intelligence (AI) avatars, disaster elements, disaster prevention facilities and tools, and rescue components; and a step in which the supervisor observes, records, and evaluates the interactions between the users, AI avatars, and the respective elements. According to the present invention, the training process can be monitored and recorded, and the extent of simulated damage can be assessed to refine and improve crisis-response strategies.
abstract_ko:
실제 건물 또는 공간의 디지털 데이터를 기초로 구축된 3D 또는 2D의 메타버스 공간에 감독자 및 사용자 또는 다수의 사용자가 PC, 모바일 또는 VR기기 등의 단말을 통해 접속하고, 감독자 또는 사용자 UI를 사용하여, 사용자 아바타, AI 아바타, 재난요소, 방재설비와 방재도구요소, 구조요소가 상호작용 함으로써 위기상황대응 훈련을 구현하는 단계; 및 
상기 사용자 및 AI 아바타와 각 요소들의 상호작용을 감독자가 관찰, 녹화 및 평가하는 단계를 포함하는 메타버스를 이용한 위기상황 대응 훈련 및 평가 시스템. 
본 발명에 따르면, 실제를 모방한 메타버스 공간에서 재난 상황을 재현함으로써 사용자들에게 보다 현실감 있는 위기상황 대응 훈련을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 훈련 과정을 조망 또는 녹화하고, 피해정도를 산정하여 평가함으로써, 위기상황 대응방안을 보완 및 개선할 수 있다. 
또한, 녹화한 자료를 통해 시설 이용객들을 위한 위기상황 대응 안내 자료로 사용할 수 있다. 
또한, 짧은 시간 안에 반복적이고 다양한 위기상황 대응을 훈련하고 그 결과를 얻음으로써 사용자의 흥미를 제고할 수 있다. 
또한, 메타버스 공간을 갱신함으로써, 훈련에 재활용될 수 있다.

title_en: Elastic lifting method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to an elastic lifting method and system for a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1, topology structure information, equipment state information, rush-repair resource information and disaster condition information of a power distribution network are obtained, and a network reconstruction model with minimum load loss and a fault rush-repair model with maximum load recovery after the rush-repair is finished as an objective function are constructed according to the topology structure information, the equipment state information, the rush-repair resource information and the disaster condition information; and S2, the network reconstruction model and the fault first-aid repair model are mutually cooperated to realize rapid load recovery of the power distribution network system after extreme disasters. The application can realize the rapid recovery of power supply after the power distribution network faults and the effective improvement of the elasticity level of the power distribution network.

title_en: Method for determining side slope aftershock instability early warning level based on sliding danger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a side slope aftershock instability early warning level based on slip dangers. Defining a side slope residual shock instability coefficient, and determining the side slope residual shock instability early warning level according to the threshold value of the side slope residual shock instability coefficient, so that the instability levels of the side slopes under different damage conditions can be effectively divided; and different countermeasures are implemented according to different slope aftershock instability early warning grades, so that instructive opinion can be provided for post-disaster rescue and reconstruction work.

title_en: Coal mine underground CO2Comprehensive utilization integrated disaster prevention method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated disaster prevention method and system for comprehensive utilization of underground coal mine CO  2 , comprising the steps of mineralizing, sealing, preventing and extinguishing fire by CO  2 : injecting CO  2  into the goaf caving gangue pile to reduce the coal-oxygen composite speed, and simultaneously preparing carbonate slurry to fill the sealed goaf by utilizing the reaction of the coal-based solid waste associated with mining and CO  2 , thereby preventing the spontaneous combustion of residual coal in the goaf and realizing mineralization and sealing of CO  2 ; CO  2  weakens the pressure relief and anti-impact of the coal rock in advance: the method has the advantages that the CO  2  is utilized to reconstruct the pore-crack structure of the coal rock and weaken the mechanical property, the ground pressure monitoring system is combined to monitor microseismic and ground sound feedback information in real time, the rock burst disaster latency area is determined, and the pressure relief and impact prevention of the weakened coal rock are realized through pre-injection; liquid CO  2  mine geothermal enhanced production and cooling: the liquid CO  2  is used as a heat transfer working medium, and the remarkable temperature difference between the liquid CO  2  and the surrounding rock promotes the heat exchange between the liquid CO  2  and the surrounding rock, so that the liquid CO  2  is changed into gas to store surplus heat energy, the mine environment temperature is reduced, and the exploitation and the utilization of geothermal energy are promoted; liquid CO  2  fracturing permeability-phase change displacement gas/water injection moistening and dust reduction: the liquid CO  2  is used as fracturing fluid, the high permeability and low viscosity of the fracturing fluid enable the fracturing fluid to easily permeate into original pores of a coal body, and meanwhile, the low-temperature frost heaving characteristic of the fracturing fluid causes shrinkage and pore expansion of a coal matrix, so that the permeability of a coal bed is remarkably improved, and the wetting area of a subsequent water injection dust fall coal body is further increased. In addition, the liquid CO  2  can replace displacement gas through supercharging and phase-change expansion, so that the desorption rate and the release rate of the gas are improved, and the extraction of the gas is effectively promoted.

title_en: Portable fire emergency lamp on-line monitoring device
abstract_en: The portable fire emergency lamp on-line monitoring device comprises a box body, wherein a wireless communication module, a camera, a memory card and an optical sensor are arranged in or on the box body; the camera and the memory card are used for recording the test process of the fire-fighting emergency lamp, the light sensor is used for sensing the illumination of the fire-fighting emergency lamp, and the wireless communication module is connected with the mobile phone end through a wireless network and used for remote communication. The on-line monitoring device can watch, replay, judge and record the testing process at any time and any place through the mobile phone end without the field operation of fire fighters, and can also check whether external factors interfere with the testing result. Compared with the existing test mode, the on-line monitoring device is small in appearance and easy to carry; secondly, manual operation and on-site waiting are not needed, and the device has the advantages of time and labor saving and high testing efficiency; the test data can be automatically recorded and generated, and the test device has the advantages of high test accuracy and strong persuasion.

title_en: Disaster damage bridge traffic feasibility fast decision method and system based on flexibility identification
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster damage bridge traffic feasibility quick decision method and system based on flexibility recognition, which belong to the technical field of bridge engineering maintenance monitoring based on signal data processing and acquire exciting force signals and bridge response signals; the method comprises the steps of identifying modal parameter reconstruction of a bridge by using a complex modal indication function method to obtain a full-displacement flexibility matrix, disassembling and recombining the full-displacement flexibility matrix into a measuring point displacement loading matrix, obtaining the full-displacement loading matrix through curve fitting and interpolation, predicting static deflection of the bridge or dynamic deflection of a vehicle when the vehicle passes through the bridge at a low speed, and determining a traffic decision scheme according to a section deflection design limit value. The method is driven based on response data, is simple to operate, short in testing time consumption, high in environmental adaptability and capable of automatically controlling the prediction precision, overcomes the defect that the traditional flexibility recognition method needs to ensure the severe condition that the load acting position coincides with the measuring point position, realizes one-point calculation in the matrix disassembling process, saves storage space, improves the prediction efficiency, and enables the vehicle to be flexibly loaded during the bridge dynamic and static deflection prediction.

title_en: Post-disaster reconstruction robot
abstract_en: The application relates to a post-disaster reconstruction robot which can smoothly remove most of obstacles on a road through the cooperation of a mechanical claw mechanism and a bucket mechanism; the front driven wheel and the rear driven wheel in the lower driven wheel group are in linkage through the spring assembly, so that the robot can adapt to a road surface with rough and uneven amplitude, and the road surface adaptability and the shock resistance of the post-disaster reconstruction robot are improved.

title_en: LSTM-based fire spread prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire spread prediction method based on LSTM, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring a fire scene information image by using infrared imaging equipment; step 2, processing a fire scene information image to mark the position of a fire wire; step 3, three-dimensional reconstruction is carried out to obtain three-dimensional coordinates; step 4, calculating the three-dimensional coordinates of each live wire in two adjacent frames of images to obtain the spreading rate of the live wire; and 5, acquiring one or more environmental information of which the range of the fire scene is not limited by real-time wind speed, temperature and humidity by using a sensor, and predicting the fire scene spreading by using a deep learning method by combining the spreading rate of a fire wire as input. Through the mode, the fire spread prediction method based on the LSTM provided by the invention can accurately calculate the spread trend of the fire wire in the fire scene by adopting a frame-by-frame processing mode and combining various comprehensive environment information in a deep learning method from the real-time image, solves the problem that the fire is difficult to grasp at short time, and provides prediction information with extremely high reliability for fire rescue command.
assignees: HUOYAN FIRE FIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Powdered fire extinguishing agent spraying device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a powder fire extinguishing agent spraying device that can be quickly and easily moved to a fire scene and can spray powder fire extinguishing agent such as expanded lime powder uniformly and at an appropriate pressure to the fire source to quickly extinguish the fire. The powder fire extinguishing agent spraying device according to the present invention may include: a chemical storage container storing powder fire extinguishing agent; a pump unit transporting the chemical in the chemical storage container at a predetermined pressure; a hose connected to the pump unit to transport the powder fire extinguishing agent supplied through the pump unit; a nozzle connected to the end of the hose to spray the powder fire extinguishing agent transported through the hose to the fire source; and a power supply unit that supplies power for the operation of the pump unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재현장으로 신속하고 용이하게 이동할 수 있으며, 팽창질석 분말과 같은 분말 소화약제를 화재원에 균일하고 적절한 압력으로 분사하여 화재를 신속하게 진압할 수 있는 분말 소화약제 분사 장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 분말 소화약제 분사 장치는, 분말 소화약제를 저장하는 약제저장용기; 상기 약제저장용기 내의 약제를 소정의 압력으로 이송하는 펌프유닛; 상기 펌프유닛에 연결되어 펌프유닛을 통해 공급되는 분말 소화약제를 이송하는 호스; 상기 호스의 끝단부에 연결되어 호스를 통해 이송되는 분말 소화약제를 화재원으로 분사하는 노즐; 및, 상기 펌프유닛의 작동을 위한 전원을 공급하는 전원공급기;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Modularized robot output feedback optimal fault-tolerant control method and system with multiple sensor faults
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robot fault-tolerant control, which solves the technical problem that as the number of reconstruction modules in a modularized robot increases, a dynamic planning method can cause a dimension disaster problem, so that solving an HJB equation becomes more difficult, in particular to an output feedback optimal fault-tolerant control method of the modularized robot with multi-sensor faults, comprising the following steps: introducing a low-pass filter, establishing a mapping relation between a sensor fault and an actuator fault, and constructing an augmentation system fusing the robot system state and the output of the low-pass filter according to the mapping relation; and establishing a joint output type fault observer for identifying the dynamic information and the sensor faults of the robot system on line according to the input/output data of the neural network and the robot system. The method provided by the invention is suitable for solving the fault-tolerant control problem of the fault systems of various types of sensors, can achieve a satisfactory fault-tolerant control effect, meets application requirements, and can reduce design cost.

title_en: Distributed cluster disk reconstruction performance optimization method based on bandwidth perception
abstract_en: The patent provides a distributed cluster disk reconstruction performance optimization method based on bandwidth perception, which is applied to the field of data security storage, aims at solving the problems of high cluster load and low reconstruction efficiency in heterogeneous network disk reconstruction, and can ensure that a disk reconstruction scheme with highest efficiency can be obtained under the condition of minimum cluster overall load by adopting a plurality of algorithms. The method mainly comprises four algorithms, namely a cluster overall minimum load scheme searching algorithm, an approximate optimal disk reconstruction scheme generating algorithm, a cluster single-node error reconstruction scheme replacing algorithm and an optimal scheme searching algorithm. The method comprises the steps of finding all disk reconstruction schemes with the minimum inter-cluster flow through a cluster integral minimum load scheme searching algorithm, generating an approximately optimal disk reconstruction scheme through an approximately optimal disk reconstruction scheme generating algorithm, adjusting the reconstruction schemes through a cluster single-node error reconstruction scheme replacing algorithm in the process, building a search tree model, searching all schemes through an optimal scheme searching algorithm, and pruning the searching process through the approximately optimal disk reconstruction scheme. The patent can be used in the fields of data storage, disaster backup, data security management and the like.

title_en: Reconstruction, forecast and early warning method for deformation field in construction period of high arch dam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of arch dam construction deformation monitoring, in particular to a method for reconstructing, forecasting and early warning a deformation field in a high arch dam construction period. The input end of the acquisition system is connected with a flexible inclinometer in the measurement system, and the output end of the acquisition system is connected with the cloud server. The method can measure the deformation of the dam body in the construction period of the high concrete arch dam, analyze and obtain the deformation field and the stress field in the construction period to forecast the stress of the dam, and compare with the standard design value to perform disaster early warning so as to solve the problem that the self-weight deformation measurement in the construction period is lost by the conventional dam deformation observation perpendicular method.
assignees: SHAANXI DONGZHUANG HYDRO JUNCTION ENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;JIANGXI KIRND PREC INSTRUMENT CO LTD

title_en: VR fire scene simulation device for qualification identification of fire investigation personnel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a VR fire scene simulation device for qualification of fire investigation personnel, which comprises a fire scene three-dimensional reconstruction module, wherein the fire scene three-dimensional reconstruction module is in communication connection with VR glasses, the VR glasses are fixed on a helmet shell, the VR glasses are connected with a sound player, an odor player, an operating handle and a vibration coat, the helmet shell is worn on the head of a user, the sound player is worn on the ear of the user, the vibration coat is worn on the body of the user, and the odor player is worn on the neck of the user. Compared with the prior art, the utility model can truly simulate the fire scene for the use of fire adjustment personnel qualification identification, and can be reused, thereby effectively reducing the cost consumption.

title_en: Digital twinning-based disaster analysis method and system for multi-scale water supply system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a digital twinning-based disaster analysis method and system for a multi-scale water supply system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on the multi-scale relation and layout of the water supply system plant stations and the pipe network in the physical space, sequentially establishing BIM information models of all levels of structures of the water supply system; the BIM information model is imported into FEM software, a mechanical response numerical analysis model is built according to the boundary and constraint conditions of each level of structures, and stress and deformation responses of each level of structures of a plant station and a pipe network of the water supply system under the action of earthquake are calculated; and extracting a calculation result of the numerical analysis model, decoding and converting the calculation result, and importing the calculation result after decoding and converting into the BIM information model for reconstruction to generate a cloud image of the earthquake motion response of the BIM information model. The invention realizes the digital conversion from the BIM model to the disaster scene analysis twin model in the operation and maintenance process, and provides a high-efficiency mapping and global visual display method for the earthquake response of a water supply system.

title_en: Fire control supervision inspection management integration platform based on artificial intelligence
