abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting supervision and inspection management integrated platform based on artificial intelligence, belonging to the technical field of inspection management; the method is used for solving the technical problems of poor overall effect of the follow-up correction data processing analysis and expansion utilization of the fire supervision and inspection in the existing scheme; the fire supervision inspection data statistics integration module is used for carrying out data statistics and processing on fire supervision inspection carried out by the fire supervision inspection main body in different position areas, all abnormal inspection data of abnormal inspection objects are integrated and calculated to obtain corresponding individual correction degrees, targeted correction retrospective processing and digital representation can be carried out on the abnormal inspection objects analyzed by the early inspection according to the individual correction degrees, targeted individual correction influence data analysis is carried out on the abnormal inspection objects analyzed by the early inspection, and whether the individual correction influence states of the abnormal inspection objects are normal or not is determined according to analysis results.

title_en: Fire control positioning system that talkbacks based on radio communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control communication, and discloses a fire control intercom positioning system based on wireless communication. The system respectively collects data sets through the multidimensional collection module, and the intercom positioning module calculates and generates a risk index The environmental quality and the communication quality of the position of the firefighter are comprehensively evaluated, the safety of smooth communication rescue actions is higher, and the intercom positioning module calculates and generates a tracking track Real-time monitoring and replaying the dynamic track of each firefighter, strengthening safety management in emergency, and calculating and generating a three-dimensional model by a three-dimensional modeling unit The fire alarm system has strong site perception capability, is favorable for rapidly analyzing the fire point and the fire cause, and has the advantages that the early warning management module judges the safety state of the firefighter, generates corresponding alarm signals and transmits the alarm signals to the intercom device and the central control console, so that the standard operation rescue efficiency is high.

title_en: Collaborative air combat optimal killing chain searching method based on multi-criterion decision algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of collaborative combat chain evaluation, and discloses a collaborative air combat optimal combat chain searching method based on a multi-criterion decision algorithm. By evaluating the existing kill links, the kill link in the network that performs the best task is searched out and evaluated. Firstly, carrying out high-order network reconstruction on a collaborative combat network, capturing a high-order relation in a system through a simplex, and describing the relation of mutual collaboration among 3 nodes such as collaborative reconnaissance of the system, fire control level information providing and the like by using a 2-simplex. Taking the execution time of the OODA ring, the loss of completing execution tasks, link exposure risk, network topology, aircraft platform performance and characteristics into consideration as optimal link search indexes, and setting task weights to take task characteristics into consideration. And calculating the relative advantages of the attribute, the relative advantages of the link and the overall dominance by a multi-criterion decision algorithm, and sequencing the target values according to the overall dominance, wherein the larger the link advantage, the larger the target value.

title_en: Slope stability simulation system and simulation method in frozen soil environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope stability simulation system and a simulation method under a frozen soil environment, wherein the simulation system comprises a multi-source monitoring data acquisition module, a landslide geometric reconstruction module, a landslide influence factor and formation mechanism module and a sliding process numerical simulation and stability analysis module; the multisource monitoring data acquisition module is used for realizing landslide disaster attribution of the multispace dimension monitoring data; the landslide geometric reconstruction module is used for drawing a landslide geometric section; the landslide influence factor and formation mechanism module is used for analyzing environmental factors and engineering factors which influence landslide stability and deducing a disaster formation mechanism by utilizing the obtained influence factors; the sliding process numerical simulation and stability analysis module is used for simulating a sliding deformation process of the landslide, and calculating stability coefficients of the landslide under different working conditions based on analysis results of influence factors and disaster forming mechanisms. The invention can realize the research from data collection to cause analysis to analog reproduction of the one-stop permafrost region side slope.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG COMMUNICATIONS INVEST GROUP CO LTD;ENGINEERING CONSULTING AND DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD OF NORTHEAST FORESTRY UNIV;UNIV NORTHEAST FORESTRY;INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION TRANSP SCIENCE DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Grooving equipment for fire extinguishing system reconstruction engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses slotting equipment for fire-fighting system reconstruction engineering, which comprises a shell, wherein the shell is of a box body structure with an unsealed bottom, a first protective shell is fixedly arranged in the center of the top surface of the shell, a second protective shell is arranged on one side of the first protective shell, the first protective shell is communicated with the inner wall of the second protective shell, handles are fixedly arranged on two sides of the top surface of the shell, a grinding wheel is arranged in the first protective shell, a dust suppression component is arranged on the outer side of the shell, and the dust suppression component can reduce the floating of dust when the fire-fighting system reconstruction engineering is slotting. The technical effects achieved are as follows: dust floating can be reduced when the fire extinguishing system is remodeled and engineering is grooved through the dust suppression component.
assignees: FUJIAN YUANZUN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Rapid detection and evaluation method and system for shield tunnel disasters based on wall climbing robot
abstract_en: The application relates to a rapid detection and evaluation method and a rapid detection and evaluation system for shield tunnel disasters based on a wall climbing robot, which solve the problem that the internal environment and the structural condition of a shield tunnel are greatly changed after the disaster, and if a relevant tunnel detection machine is started without prejudgment, the internal detection and evaluation result cannot be successfully obtained, and the method comprises the following steps: starting a wall climbing robot to enter a disaster area according to a planned route, acquiring disaster related image information through identification processing, synchronously starting an electromagnetic signal acquisition processing device preset on the wall climbing robot to perform disaster electromagnetic signal identification processing, and determining a disaster center position through a preset disaster center determining algorithm; analysis determines the disaster action level. The application has the following effects: the wall climbing robot is used for improving the disaster detection range of the tunnel, reducing the disaster detection time effect, indirectly improving the comprehensive evaluation efficiency of the safety of the structure of the shield tunnel after disaster, and providing scientific basis for the repair and reconstruction of the tunnel.

title_en: Metal fire extinguishing system and fire extinguishing method through it
title_ko: 금속화재 소화설비 시스템 및 이를 통한 소화 방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a metal fire extinguishing equipment system and a fire extinguishing method using the same, which prevents a high-priced electronic device located in a place such as an integrated disaster prevention center from being damaged by pressure rising in a closed indoor area by spraying suffocation fire extinguishing liquid upon the operation of a disaster prevention system for indoor combustion and fire suppression due to a fire in the fire scene. The metal fire extinguishing equipment system comprises: a fire extinguishing facility system device (100) which initially extinguishes a fire by spraying a fire extinguishing agent to equipment connected to the inside of each indoor compartment of a building through a connection pipe after sealing the interior of an indoor space when a fire detection sensor installed on the ceiling of the indoor space detects the fire, and ventilating the indoor space by quickly discharging the air from the indoor space when detecting that the fire is completely extinguished; and a fire extinguishing equipment automatic remote control system (200) connected with a plurality of fire extinguishing equipment system devices for each indoor compartment through a network to monitor a site situation and an equipment state for each indoor compartment, and inspecting and controlling the connected fire extinguishing equipment system devices in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 금속화재는 화재 진압에 어려움이 있고, 위험성이 있어 질식소화 방식으로 소화분말을 분사하여 소화해야하는데 대형 건물의 통합방재센터와 같은 장소에는 고가의 장비가 내재되어 있어 금속화재가 발생할 경우 엄청난 재산피해와 인명피해를 줄 수 있고, 질식가스 소화설비의 감지기 오류 및 고장으로 인해 내부에 사람이 있는 상태에서 질식가스가 오방출되는 경우 질식 등의 인사사고 위험이 있고, 재산 손실, 방출된 약제로 인해 발생한 기기 손상에 따른 교체시 배전반이 무방비 상태가 될 수 있어 다른 소화설비보다는 더 신경써서 소화설비를 시공하고 안전 점검을 실시해야하는 문제점을 개선하고자, 소화설비 시스템 장치, 소화설비 자동 원격제어 시스템으로 구성됨으로써 화재현장에서 화재로 인한 실내연소와 화재 진압을 위한 방재시스템 작동으로 질식소화액이 분사되며 밀폐된 실내의 압력이 상승하여 통합방재센터와 같은 장소에 위치한 고가의 전자기기가 압력으로 인해 손상되는 것을 방지하고, 화재 진압 후 유독가스를 신속하게 배출하여 소방인력의 투입을 용이하게 하고, 화재감지기의 오류 및 고장으로 질식소화액이 오방출되는 것을 방지하여 인적피해 및 재산피해를 예방할 수 있고, 기존의 소화설비 시스템에 호환 설치할 수 있어 설치 비용을 대폭 절감할 수 있는 금속화재 소화설비 시스템 및 이를 통한 소화 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Traffic safety management system using reproduction
title_ko: 재현을 이용한 교통 안전 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a traffic safety management system using reproduction, which is improved to output safety information suitable for a field environment through reproduction of bad weather or disasters. through reproduction, safety control information for controlling field safety facilities that provide safety information to roads can be updated, and the probability of an accident in a field environment in which the same or similar bad weather as the reproduction environment is formed can be expected to be reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 악천후나 재난의 재현을 통하여 현장 환경에 적합한 안전 정보를 출력할 수 있도록 개선한 재현을 이용한 교통 안전 관리 시스템을 개시하며, 재현을 통하여 도로에 안전 정보를 제공하는 현장 안전 설비를 제어하기 위한 안전 제어 정보를 업데이트할 수 있으며, 재현 환경과 동일 또는 유사한 악천후가 형성되는 현장 환경에서 사고 발생 확률을 낮출 수 있는 효과를 기대할 수 있다.

title_en: Hospital emergency patient rapid response system and method by monitoring vital signs
title_ko: 생체신호 모니터링에 의한 병원응급환자 신속대응 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a rapid response system for emergency patients in hospitals based on biometric signal monitoring, wherein a server comprises: a data derivation unit for deriving time windows of a predetermined size based on received medical data of a patient as input; a preprocessing unit for extracting latent space features by inputting the derived time windows into an LSTM-VAE combining an LSTM encoder and a VAE encoder; and a clinical deterioration prediction unit for reconstructing latent space features to learn inter-class probability distributions by inputting the extracted latent space features into an LSTM decoder and deriving abnormality probabilities of the patient by inputting the latent space features into an FCN decoder. According to the present invention, the system enhances the performance of the RRS based on a deep learning model and enables early detection of clinical deterioration of the patient, thereby supporting the process through which a doctor diagnoses emergency situations and provides timely treatment via a critical pathway of the RRS to improve the efficiency of the emergency system and minimizing the mortality rate of the hospital and the burden on the medical system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호 모니터링에 의한 병원응급환자 신속대응 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 서버로 구현되는 생체신호 모니터링에 의한 병원응급환자 신속대응 시스템에서 서버의 데이터 도출부가 수신된 환자의 의료 데이터를 입력으로 기 설정된 크기의 창 시간(Window time)을 도출하고 전처리부가 상기 도출된 창 시간을 LSTM 인코더(Long Short Term Memory Encoder) 및 VAE 인코더(Variational Auto Encoder)가 결합된 LSTM-VAE에 입력으로 잠재 공간 특징을 추출하고, 임상 악화 예측부가 추출된 잠재 공간 특징을 LSTM 디코더에 입력으로 클래스 간 확률 분포를 학습하기 위한 잠재 공간 특징을 재구성하고, 잠재 공간 특징을 FCN(Fully connected network) 디코더에 입력으로 환자의 비정상 확률을 도출하는 구성으로 딥러닝 모델을 기반으로 RRS의 성능을 향상시켜 환자의 임상 악화를 조기에 감지함에 따라 RRS의 중요한 경로를 통해 의사가 응급 상황을 진단하고 시기 적절한 치료를 제공하는 과정을 지원하여 응급 시스템의 효율성을 향상시키고, 병원의 사망률과 의료 시스템의 부담을 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Image enhancement method and system for generating countermeasure network based on vector quantization
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to an image enhancement method and system for generating an countermeasure network based on vector quantization. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a rescue image set, preprocessing the rescue image set, and determining a preprocessing result; analyzing the pretreatment result and extracting a plurality of disaster detail features; generating an countermeasure network based on vector quantization according to a plurality of disaster-stricken detail features, reconstructing a rescue image set, and determining a rescue enhancement image; and outputting the rescue enhancement image for the rescue workers to check and analyze. The application outputs the rescue enhancement image for the rescue workers to check and analyze, so that the specific disaster detail of the current disaster-stricken is shown in the rescue enhancement image, and the rescue workers can quickly know the specific disaster situation of the disaster-stricken according to the rescue enhancement image, so as to formulate a corresponding rescue plan, take corresponding rescue actions, and prevent secondary injury to the disaster-stricken in the rescue process while guaranteeing the rescue efficiency.

title_en: Post-disaster house reconstruction detection device and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster house reconstruction detection device and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of house detection. The invention comprises a structural safety detection unit, an angle adjusting mechanism, a lifting mechanism and a cabinet body; the structure safety detection unit is fixed on the angle adjusting mechanism, the angle adjusting mechanism is fixed at the top end of the lifting mechanism, the structure safety detection unit is driven to incline in a mechanical transmission mode, and the bottom end of the lifting mechanism is installed in the cabinet body and drives the angle adjusting mechanism to lift in a mechanical transmission mode; also included is an environment detection unit. The invention has the advantages that the comprehensive performance of the detection device is better by arranging the structural safety detection unit and the environment detection unit, various detection functions can be concentrated, the detection efficiency and the detection precision can be greatly improved by arranging the cleaning mechanism, and the problems that the existing house detection device is insufficient in integration level, poor in comprehensive performance of detection and in-house impurities influence the detection efficiency and the detection precision are solved.
assignees: HUNAN XIANGKE ZHICE ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water logging disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water-logging disasters, which comprises the following steps: step S1, constructing an electric power-drainage network coupling model based on partial differential constraint of pressure and non-pressure unsteady flow hydrodynamic force, and representing dynamic interactive evolution processes of power failure, rainwater overflow and road ponding of a power grid under a storm disaster; s2, establishing an equivalent linear complex algebraic equation of a drainage network nonlinear hydrodynamic partial differential equation in a frequency domain; s3, deducing a multi-hyperplane formula of an electric power-drainage composite safety area, and representing a feasible operation boundary of an electric pump-sluice group under the injection conditions of complex electric power and rainwater; and S4, taking rainfall uncertainty in heavy rain into consideration, adopting multi-scene random optimization based on Monte Carlo simulation, and solving an emergency scheduling decision scheme at the current moment through rolling optimization. The invention realizes the coordination reconstruction of the network topology of the power distribution network and the drainage network under the disaster of rainstorm and waterlogging.

title_en: Power maintenance field operation risk management and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system maintenance, in particular to a power maintenance field operation risk management and control method, which comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a power maintenance operation risk database, and integrating historical operation data and environment data; s2: using big data analysis techniques to evaluate potential risks based on the job tasks and the site environment data; s3: formulating targeted risk management and control measures according to the risk assessment result, wherein the targeted risk management and control measures comprise safety early warning setting and safety training; s4: real-time monitoring in the operation process is executed, field data are collected through the Internet of things technology, and real-time analysis and emergency response of risks are realized; s5: and after the operation is completed, performing retrospective analysis, summarizing risk management experience, and optimizing a risk database and a management and control flow. According to the invention, through integrating a plurality of advanced technologies, the operation safety can be effectively improved, the dynamic risk management and the remarkable improvement of the operation efficiency can be realized, and the method has important practical value and wide application prospect.
assignees: WUXI ZEAN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Catastrophe sensor network topology control method based on link quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster sensor network topology control method based on link quality, which comprises the steps that firstly, nodes in a wireless sensor network broadcast and send data packets with maximum transmitting power, after receiving the data packets, the nodes decode the data packet information to obtain node data, a node neighbor list is formed, meanwhile, the nodes read RSSI values in the data packets, and the communication link quality between the two nodes is calculated; filtering based on energy limit value and filtering based on link energy consumption rate, filtering redundant links caused by common neighbor nodes, and updating a node neighbor list; and finally, the node establishes a post-disaster network topology structure according to the updated neighbor list, and transmits and distributes disaster information. Aiming at the network reconstruction process of the residual nodes after the disaster, the method of the invention improves the stability of the topology control method and prolongs the survival time of the reconstructed network by double node filtering and optimizing the communication link.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;XUZHOU KERUI MINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Complex disaster response appartus and method to reduce urban disaster vulnerability
title_ko: 도시 재난 취약성을 감소시키기 위한 복합 재난 대응 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a complex disaster response device for reducing urban disaster vulnerability, comprising: a road network reconstruction unit for constructing a multi-layered road network including information necessary for disaster response; and an evacuation route generation unit for deriving an evacuation route in consideration of characteristics and situation information of a specific disaster based on the multi-layered road network constructed by the road network reconstruction unit.
abstract_ko: 재난 대응에 필요한 정보를 포함하는 다층적인 도로망을 구축하는 도로망 재구성부 및 상기 도로망 재구성부에 의해 구축된 상기 다층적인 도로망을 기반으로 특정 재해의 특성과 상황 정보를 고려한 대피 경로를 도출하는 대피 경로 생성부를 포함하는 도시 재난 취약성을 감소시키기 위한 복합 재난 대응 장치가 개시된다.
assignees: UNIV CHUNG ANG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Reconstruction device of slope three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a reconstruction device of a slope three-dimensional model, and belongs to the technical field of machine vision. The side slope model body is arranged on the model support, the industrial CCD camera is arranged on the camera support, the projector is arranged on the projector support, the industrial CCD camera and the projector are both arranged on the opposite side of the side slope model body, and the industrial CCD camera and the projector are both electrically and mechanically connected with each other; according to the utility model, the three-dimensional model reconstruction of the side slope is carried out by utilizing the structured light, and the three-dimensional model of the side slope with higher precision is obtained on the basis of lower cost and more convenient operation, so that the analysis of the deformation behavior of the structure of the side slope is more intuitively facilitated, and the purposes of predicting and preventing landslide disasters are realized.

title_en: Assembly type steel bridge structure with string tensioning mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an assembled steel bridge structure with a string tensioning mechanism. The method aims to solve the problems of small span, heavy weight, long assembly time, large bridge deflection when the span is large and the like of the existing steel bridge. The utility model is composed of a main body structure and a string stretching mechanism, wherein the standard truss of the main body structure is connected with the high shear truss by pin joint. The string stretching mechanism consists of a supporting frame and a steel pull rod, and is arranged at the bottom of the main body structure, one end of the steel pull rod is fixed at the end part of the main body structure, the other end of the steel pull rod is fixed at the lower end of the supporting frame, the upper end of the supporting frame is connected with the bottom surface of the main body structure, and the main body structure is supported. The utility model has strong crossing capability and light weight of components, can be quickly assembled and erected, and can be used as an emergency temporary project for quick emergency and an assembled steel bridge for conventional construction and post-war and post-disaster reconstruction projects. The utility model can realize the coverage application of small and medium spans and large spans, is convenient for storage and maintenance, and has good applicability.

title_en: Post-disaster reconstruction rescue transportation robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a post-disaster reconstruction rescue transportation robot, which comprises a main box body, wherein two connecting shafts are arranged in the main box body, two ends of each connecting shaft are respectively provided with a side box body, the outer side of each side box body is provided with a plurality of half-wheel wheat wheels, and each side box body is internally provided with a first driving mechanism which is in transmission fit with a plurality of corresponding half-wheel wheat wheels; four crawler wheels are arranged between the main box body and the two side box bodies, the crawler wheels are provided with crawler belts, the crawler belts are positioned outside the main box body, a second driving mechanism is arranged in the main box body, and the second driving mechanism is in transmission fit with the four crawler wheels. The post-disaster reconstruction rescue transport robot integrates material transportation and personnel transportation, and is unmanned and automatic in the post-disaster reconstruction rescue transport robot, and aims to meet the requirements of post-disaster emergency requirements and reconstruction work, and provide quick, safe and reliable transport services so as to promote the recovery and reconstruction process of disaster areas.
assignees: SHAANXI BEIDOU LINGHANG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue wireless sensor network system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue wireless sensor network system, which comprises a node subsystem, a node post-disaster neighbor discovery method subsystem and a node post-disaster network topology reconstruction subsystem, wherein the node post-disaster neighbor discovery method subsystem is used for acquiring a node post-disaster network topology; the node protection device in the node subsystem is of a double-layer capsule shell structure, and the strong node wireless communication module comprises two main control modules, an array antenna module and a multi-source heterogeneous communication module; the node post-disaster neighbor discovery method subsystem performs multi-agent reinforcement learning through interaction between wireless sensor nodes and the external environment, discovers neighbor node information and establishes a communication link; and the post-disaster network topology reconstruction subsystem is used for carrying out post-disaster network reconstruction based on neighbor node information, preferably a communication link. The wireless sensor network system integrates the existing isolated sensor nodes, automatically discovers the survival nodes after disasters and reconstructs the network, and transmits disaster information to the outside, thereby providing assistance for emergency rescue.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;XUZHOU KERUI MINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy coupling power distribution network post-disaster recovery collaborative operation method based on TESS configuration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for recovering and cooperating after disaster of a multi-energy coupling power distribution network based on TESS configuration, belongs to the technical field of controlling and cooperating of the multi-energy coupling power distribution network, and solves the problem that an effective method for recovering and cooperating after disaster of the multi-energy coupling power distribution network is lacked in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of constructing an objective function of a multi-energy coupling power distribution network post-disaster recovery model comprehensively considering user cutting, TESS transportation and micro-grid power generation, wherein the objective function is used for minimizing the sum of user cutting cost, TESS transportation cost and micro-grid power generation cost, constructing constraint conditions of the multi-energy coupling power distribution network post-disaster recovery model, wherein the constraint conditions comprise TESS space-time constraint, TESS operation constraint, distribution network reconstruction topology constraint, micro-grid operation constraint and kirchhoff law constraint, and solving the multi-energy coupling power distribution network post-disaster recovery model to obtain a TESS optimized scheduling result in the multi-energy coupling power distribution network post-disaster recovery process.

title_en: Photovoltaic system residual current detection method and system based on support vector machine classification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic system residual current detection method and a system based on support vector machine classification, which are used for sampling a photovoltaic current signal to be detected according to sampling time, carrying out wavelet packet transformation on sampled data and reconstructing, and then carrying out pruning feature extraction on the reconstructed signal; the method and the device have the advantages that the types of the photovoltaic residual current are obtained by identifying the obtained pruning characteristics through the pre-trained SVM model, the accuracy and the rapidity of the residual current identification in the photovoltaic system are improved, the existing residual current identification types are supplemented, unnecessary energy waste and electric energy loss are avoided, fault diagnosis time and maintenance cost are reduced, and the reliability and maintainability of the photovoltaic system are improved; the invention is not easily affected by dimension disasters, and can process the problems of linearity and nonlinearity in high-dimensional data and feature space. This makes the method easier to implement and deploy, providing convenience for engineering applications.

title_en: Fire disaster ignition point detection method based on countermeasure self-encoder and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire disaster ignition point detection method based on an countermeasure self-encoder and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target input image of fire smoke; inputting a target input image into a pre-trained countermeasure self-encoder, so as to obtain a target reconstruction image corresponding to the target input image through the countermeasure self-encoder, and performing fire detection based on the target reconstruction image to obtain a fire detection result; the anti-self-encoder is trained by taking a reconstruction error of the minimized DCGAN generator and a discrimination error of the discriminator as training targets, generates a high-quality reconstruction image of a fire smoke input image through the anti-self-encoder comprising the DCGAN generator, and detects a fire point based on the reconstruction image, so that the influence of environmental interference is effectively reduced, and the accuracy and the effectiveness of detection are improved.

title_en: Tomography image modeling system of an x-ray computed tomography device for cultural properties, tomography image modeling method of an x-ray computed tomography device for cultural properties, and computer-readable storage media storing a program for performing the method
title_ko: 문화재 전용 x선 컴퓨터 단층촬영장치(ct)의 단층 촬영 이미지 모델링 시스템, 문화재 전용 x선 컴퓨터 단층촬영장치(ct)의 단층 촬영 이미지 모델링 방법 및 그 방법을 수행하기 위한 프로그램이 저장된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 저장매체
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a tomographic image modeling system of an X-ray computed tomography (CT) device dedicated to cultural properties that reconstructs a CT image of a cultural property in which metal distortion appears by correcting a region in which metal distortion appears in tomographic data with similar grayscale values around the same. The present invention relates to a tomographic image modeling system of an X-ray computed tomography (CT) device dedicated to cultural properties, which reconstructs a CT image of a cultural property in which metal distortion appears. The system comprises: a receiving unit for receiving tomography data; a detection unit for detecting an area in which the metal distortion appears in the tomography data; a correction unit for correcting the area in which the metal distortion appears with a similar grayscale value around the area; and a reconstruction unit for reconstructing a plurality of corrected tomography data into a 3D image.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 문화재 전용 X선 컴퓨터 단층촬영장치(CT)의 단층 촬영 이미지 모델링 시스템, 문화재 전용 X선 컴퓨터 단층촬영장치의 단층 촬영 이미지 모델링 방법 및 그 방법을 수행하기 위한 프로그램이 저장된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 저장매체에 관한 것으로, 단층 촬영 데이터에서 금속 왜곡이 나타난 영역을 주변의 유사한 그레이스케일 값으로 보정하여 금속 왜곡이 나타난 문화재의 CT 영상을 복원하는 문화재 전용 X선 컴퓨터 단층촬영장치의 단층 촬영 이미지 모델링 시스템, 문화재 전용 X선 컴퓨터 단층촬영장치의 단층 촬영 이미지 모델링 방법 및 그 방법을 수행하기 위한 프로그램이 저장된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 저장매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 문화재 전용 X선 컴퓨터 단층촬영장치(CT)의 단층 촬영 이미지 모델링 시스템은, 금속 왜곡이 나타난 문화재의 CT 영상을 복원하며, 상기 시스템은, 단층 촬영 데이터를 수신하는 수신부, 상기 단층 촬영 데이터에서 상기 금속 왜곡이 나타난 영역을 탐지하는 탐지부, 상기 금속 왜곡이 나타난 영역을 주변의 유사한 그레이스케일(gray scale) 값으로 보정하는 보정부 및 복수 개의 보정된 단층 촬영 데이터를 3D 영상으로 재구성하는 재구성부를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA CULTURAL HERITAGE ADMINISTRATION NATIONAL RES INSTITUTE OF CULTURAL HERITAGE

title_en: Actively operated intelligent sprinkler system for fire suppression
title_ko: 화재 진압을 위해 능동적으로 작동되는 지능형 스프링클러 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent sprinkler system actively operated to extinguish a fire. The intelligent sprinkler system comprises: a sensing unit located indoors and formed to sense flames, smoke, and positions of a set area; a fire extinguishing unit formed on an indoor ceiling and extinguishing a fire by spraying a fire extinguishing liquid by adjusting a spray pressure and a spray range according to a position where a fire occurs by the sensing unit; a hub analyzing fire data sensed by the sensing unit to determine whether a fire occurs, a fire range, and a fire direction, transmitting fire position data to the fire extinguishing unit, and transmitting real-time fire information data to the outside through wireless communication; and a user terminal formed to wirelessly communicate with the hub to receive an indoor fire status in real time and guide an evacuation route.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 진압을 위해 능동적으로 작동되는 지능형 스프링클러 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 실내에 위치되어 설정된 영역의 불꽃, 연기 및 위치를 감지할 수 있도록 형성되는 감지부와, 실내 천장에 형성되며 상기 감지부에 의해 화재가 발생된 위치에 맞춰 분사압력 및 분사범위를 조절하여 소화액을 분사하여 화재를 진압하는 소화부와, 상기 감지부로부터 감지된 화재 데이터를 분석하여 화재발생유무, 화재범위, 화재방향을 판단한 후 화재 위치 데이터를 상기 소화부로 전송하고, 무선통신을 통해 실시간 화재 정보데이터를 외부로 전송하는 허브와, 상기 허브와 무선으로 통신할 수 있도록 형성되어 실내 화재현황을 실시간으로 전송받고, 대피 경로를 안내할 수 있도록 형성되는 사용자 단말기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF KYUNGWOON UNIV

title_en: Disk reconstruction performance optimization method based on erasure codes
abstract_en: The patent provides a method for optimizing performance of a disk reconstruction process in a disk array based on erasure codes, which is applied to the field of data security storage, and aims at the problem of lower efficiency in the disk reconstruction process, analyzes efficiency of a disk reconstruction scheme and selects a theoretical optimal disk reconstruction scheme according to different erasure code systems. In the process of generating the theoretical optimal disk reconstruction scheme, a shortest path model is constructed, corresponding pruning operation is carried out according to the difference of erasure codes, and the generation efficiency of the disk reconstruction scheme is improved. And simultaneously, the execution result is recorded and fed back when the scheme is executed. The implementation architecture mainly comprises an erasure code system, a disk reconstruction performance optimization system and a disk reconstruction execution system. In particular to an erasure code system which provides a series of operation interfaces for erasure codes, and a disk reconstruction performance optimization system obtains a disk reconstruction scheme according to the data which is required to be reconstructed and the interface provided by the erasure code system, and optimally selecting a theoretical optimal scheme, and finally giving the theoretical optimal scheme to a disk reconstruction execution system for execution and feeding back a result. The patent can be used in the fields of data storage, disaster backup, data security management and the like.

title_en: Method for weakening hydraulic fracturing advanced area of roof of strong mine pressure disaster of multi-coal-seam mining overlying bias coal pillar
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for weakening a hydraulic fracturing advanced area of a roof of a strong mine pressure disaster of a multi-coal-seam mining overlying bias coal pillar. Based on the research results of the occurrence rule of the strong mine pressure disaster of the overlying legacy coal pillar and the disaster causing mechanism, the weakening prevention and control thought of the hydraulic fracturing advanced area of the strong mine pressure disaster of the overlying legacy coal pillar is determined based on the prevention and control idea of the supporting of the collapsing filling body, the weakening of the key rock stratum and the transfer of the stress transfer path, the interlayer key rock stratum is divided into three parts of a coal pillar inlet area, a coal pillar lower area and a coal pillar outlet area, the range of the mine pressure abnormal phenomenon of a working face in the coal pillar inlet area and the coal pillar outlet area is determined through a numerical simulation or laboratory similar experimental method, the roof fracturing control range is further determined, the weakening and reconstruction are carried out on the roof fracturing control range, and the effects of changing the transportation space of the coal pillar and the carrier, uniformly distributing concentrated stress and transferring the stress transfer path can be realized.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL AND CHEMICAL IND GROUP SUNJIACHA LONGHUA MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Anti-falling stone impact ecological assembly energy-absorbing shed tunnel, early warning system and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic road falling stone prevention and control engineering, in particular to an ecological assembly energy-absorbing shed tunnel resistant to falling stone impact, an early warning system and a construction method thereof. The shed tunnel comprises a shed tunnel main body, a rock accumulation drainage layer, an impact energy dissipation layer and a vegetation planting layer; the accumulated stone drainage layer mainly comprises a flexible cushion layer positioned at the lower part and an impact-resistant drainage plate positioned at the upper part. The accumulated stone drainage layer, the impact energy dissipation layer and the vegetation planting layer form an impact energy dissipation body which has an ecological effect and can conduct drainage on the falling stones, so that the falling stone protection effect can be improved, and the aim of ecological-disaster reduction cooperative treatment can be achieved. The early warning system is matched with the shed tunnel to be arranged, so that the accumulation condition of the accumulated stones can be effectively monitored and responded. The construction method is based on the modular structure of the shed tunnel, and can be used for constructing a new shed tunnel and can also be suitable for reconstruction of an established shed tunnel.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST NATIONALITIES;INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Post-disaster reconstruction comprehensive unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a post-disaster reconstruction comprehensive unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a loading unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the loading unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a first machine body and a plurality of first rotary wings fixed on the first machine body, a loading cavity is arranged in the first machine body, an opening is arranged on one side of the first machine body, and the loading cavity is provided with a containing mechanism and a first driving mechanism for driving the containing mechanism to move to the outside of the loading cavity towards the opening direction; and the accommodating mechanism is provided with a communication monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle, a medical unmanned aerial vehicle and a temporary power supply vehicle. The utility model can provide timely and effective assistance for disaster area people.

title_en: Disaster Evacuation Training System with Augmented Reality
title_ko: 증강현실을 활용한 재난 대피 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster evacuation training system using an augmented reality, comprising: a beacon that identifies a location and a movement path of an evacuation trainee in real time to transmit the location and the movement path to a control unit; a disaster state reproduction unit that visualizes and displays a location of generation and spread of flames or toxic gases according to the occurrence of a disaster to the evacuation trainee; a damage detection sensor that detects damage to the evacuation trainee; a training terminal that provides a simulated disaster state using an augmented reality technology on a video image captured by a camera module; and the control unit that evaluates a scale of the damage based on the measured evacuation time and the number of occurrences of damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 피난 훈련자의 위치 및 이동 경로를 실시간으로 파악하여 관제부로 전송하는 비콘, 피난 훈련자에게 재난 발생에 따른 화염이나 유독 가스 발생 및 확산 위치를 시각화하여 표시하는 재난 상태 재현 유닛, 피난 훈련자의 피해 발생 여부를 감지하는 피해 감지 센서, 카메라 모듈을 통해 촬영된 영상 이미지 상에 증강현실 기술을 통해 재난 발생 상태를 모사하여 제공하는 훈련용 단말, 측정된 피난 소요 시간과 피해 발생 횟수를 기반으로 피해 발생 규모를 평가하는 관제부로 구성되는 증강현실을 활용한 재난 대피 훈련 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Motion playback apparatus for learning
abstract_en: Disclosed is a motion playback apparatus for learning, comprising: an image storage unit for storing a learning image including a motion to be learned; an image playback control unit for dividing the learning image into preset divided sections and playing back same; a motion capture unit for capturing a motion of a user making the motion corresponding to a divided section of the learning image; and a motion analysis unit, which compares the learning image corresponding to the divided section with a captured image, captured by the motion capture unit, corresponding to the divided section, so as to determine similarity therebetween, wherein the image playback control unit determines, on the basis of the similarity determined by the motion analysis unit, a divided section to be played later.
abstract_ko: 학습 대상의 모션을 포함하는 학습 영상을 저장하는 영상 저장부; 상기 학습 영상을 사전 설정된 분할 구간 마다 분할하여 재생하는 영상 재생 제어부; 상기 학습 영상의 분할 구간에 대응되는 모션을 취하는 사용자의 모션을 캡쳐하는 모션 캡쳐부; 및 상기 분할 구간에 대응되는 학습 영상과 상기 모션 캡쳐부에서 챕쳐된 상기 분할 구간에 대응되는 캡쳐 영상을 비교하여 그 유사도를 판단하는 모션 분석부를 포함하며, 상기 영상 재생 제어부는, 상기 모션 분석부에서 판단된 유사도에 기반하여 이후 재생될 분할 구간을 결정하는 것을 특징으로 하는 학습용 모션 재생 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: Fire fighting monitoring personnel on-duty state analysis method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of state monitoring, and particularly relates to an on-duty state analysis method and system for fire fighting monitoring personnel based on artificial intelligence. The three-dimensional reconstruction method based on light source selection is adopted, so that the influence of shadow effect on three-dimensional reconstruction is reduced; dividing a shadow area of the face image by adopting an edge-free active contour model, and adjusting the position and shape of a dividing line; by adopting an uncalibrated photometric stereo technology, the GBR ambiguity is solved by capturing a plurality of images under different illumination conditions, geometric and normal information of the face surface is estimated and inferred in the three-dimensional reconstruction process, accurate light source and camera parameters are not needed, and the method is more suitable for the state detection of firefighting monitoring personnel under uncalibrated working conditions; and judging the unilateral human eye state according to the symmetry of the human eyes, so that the complexity of a human eye state detection algorithm is effectively reduced.
assignees: SITANDE XUZHOU CLOUD TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network dynamic network reconstruction method and terminal considering communication system faults
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic network reconstruction method and a terminal of a power distribution network considering a communication system fault, which are characterized in that after extreme weather occurs, the state of the communication function of a communication network node in the power distribution network and the fault area of the power distribution system are determined, an objective function and constraint conditions for minimizing the load shedding cost of the system are established, a dynamic network reconstruction model of the power distribution network is obtained, the model is solved based on the state of the communication function of the communication network node and the fault area of the power distribution system, an optimal post-disaster dynamic network reconstruction strategy, a load shedding strategy and a power supply output strategy are obtained, and the power distribution network is recovered based on the optimal post-disaster dynamic network reconstruction strategy, the load shedding strategy and the power supply output strategy, so that a more effective post-disaster dynamic network reconstruction strategy, a more effective load shedding strategy and a more effective power supply output strategy of the power distribution system are obtained through the determined state of the communication network node in the power distribution network and the fault area of the power distribution system and the dynamic network reconstruction model of the power distribution network, and the toughness level of the power distribution system under extreme weather disasters is improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Smart city monitoring super-resolution enhancement method and device based on hyperspectrum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image enhancement, in particular to a hyperspectral-based smart city monitoring super-resolution enhancement method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method is based on DnCNN image denoising method, which processes hyperspectral image, generates initial reconstructed image by encoder and decoder, obtains super-resolution coding feature and self-adaptive coding feature by super-resolution encoder and self-adaptive coding factor regulating block, enhances space and channel feature by space enhancing attention module and channel enhancing attention module, generates high resolution reconstructed image by super-resolution decoder, and reduces reconstruction loss and cross entropy loss by training of optimizer, thereby improving quality of image reconstruction. The method can more accurately identify and monitor various elements in the city by improving the image resolution, provide more detailed and accurate data support, and also improve the efficiency and accuracy of environment monitoring and emergency response.

title_en: Indoor autonomous fire-fighting linkage system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor autonomous fire-fighting linkage system and method. The fire sensing unit in the system comprises a fire detection module, an alarm module and a wireless communication module, wherein the alarm module is used for fire alarm, the fire detection module is used for monitoring fire information and controlling the alarm module to work, and the wireless communication module is used for wireless communication and is arranged to be capable of controlling the alarm module to work; the control priority of the wireless communication module to the alarm module is higher than that of the fire detection module; the fire extinguishing device electric control unit comprises an electric control module, a wireless communication module and a fire extinguishing device, wherein the electric control module is used for receiving control signals from the wireless communication module of the same unit so as to control the fire extinguishing device to work; the fire-fighting robot comprises a positioning and navigation module, a fire-fighting module and a wireless communication module, wherein the positioning and navigation module is used for reconstructing an indoor scene, positioning the fire-fighting robot, avoiding obstacles and planning a path, the wireless communication module is used for receiving and sending information, and the fire-fighting module is used for extinguishing fire. It can real-time supervision and accurate fire extinguishing.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI NORMAL;SHENZHEN YOUYONGGONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device for back-calculating daily maximum and minimum temperatures using daily average temperature and method for back-calculating using the same
title_ko: 일 평균 기온을 이용한 일 최고 기온과 일 최저 기온 역추산 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for back-estimation of a daily maximum temperature and a daily minimum temperature and a method thereof and specifically, relates to the device for back-estimation of the daily maximum temperature and the daily minimum temperature using a daily average temperature and the method thereof. The present invention may effectively reduce the time required to correct and reproduce a future climate with the current climate and implement thereof. In addition, the present invention enables to be utilized for analyzing climate disasters due to extreme temperatures such as heat waves and cold waves and the like by back-estimating the daily average temperature to the daily maximum temperature and the daily minimum temperature. The present invention can be utilized for analyzing future climate trends compared to the current climate for heat wave days or cold wave days, and can be utilized for analyzing future climate changes of a temperature extreme value of a specific region by applying the same to high-resolution detailed temperature.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 일 최고 기온과 일 최저 기온을 역추산하는 장치 및 그 방법에 대한 것으로서, 특히 일 평균 기온을 이용하여 일 최고 기온과 일 최저 기온을 역추산하는 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 현재 기후로 미래 기후를 보정 및 재현하고 이를 구현하는데 소요되는 시간을 효과적으로 단축시킬 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 일 평균 기온을 일 최고 기온 및 일 최저 기온으로 역추산하여 폭염과 한파 등 극한 기온으로 인한 기후 재난 분석에 활용이 가능하다. 본 발명은 폭염 일수나 한파 일수에 대한 현재 기후 대비 미래 기후 경향성 분석에 활용할 수 있으며, 이를 고해상도로 상세화된 기온에 적용함으로써 특정 지역의 기온 극값의 미래 기후 변화를 분석하는데 활용할 수 있다.

title_en: Motion playback apparatus for learning
abstract_en: Disclosed is a motion playback device for learning, which comprises: an image storage unit for storing a learning image including a motion of a learning target; an image playback control unit for dividing and playing the learning image for each preset division section; a motion capture unit for capturing a motion of a user taking a motion corresponding to the division section of the learning image; and a motion analysis unit for comparing the learning image corresponding to the division section with a captured image corresponding to the division section captured by the motion capture unit to determine the similarity. The image playback control unit determines a division section to be played later based on the similarity determined by the motion analysis unit.
abstract_ko: 학습 대상의 모션을 포함하는 학습 영상을 저장하는 영상 저장부; 상기 학습 영상을 사전 설정된 분할 구간 마다 분할하여 재생하는 영상 재생 제어부; 상기 학습 영상의 분할 구간에 대응되는 모션을 취하는 사용자의 모션을 캡쳐하는 모션 캡쳐부; 및 상기 분할 구간에 대응되는 학습 영상과 상기 모션 캡쳐부에서 챕쳐된 상기 분할 구간에 대응되는 캡쳐 영상을 비교하여 그 유사도를 판단하는 모션 분석부를 포함하며, 상기 영상 재생 제어부는, 상기 모션 분석부에서 판단된 유사도에 기반하여 이후 재생될 분할 구간을 결정하는 것을 특징으로 하는 학습용 모션 재생 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: Power distribution network toughness improving method based on source network load multi-resource cooperation in ice disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention develops a method for improving the toughness of a power distribution network by the cooperation of multiple sources of a source network and multiple sources under an ice disaster scene; the influence of ice disaster weather on the power distribution network lines, distributed generators and residential loads is considered, the distribution network line reinforcement, liquefied natural gas capacity allocation and maintenance team allocation schemes are formulated in the pre-disaster stage aiming at the resource differentiation requirements of system prevention, response and recovery, and the load loss is minimized through unit output scheduling, power distribution network reconstruction, maintenance team scheduling maintenance and toughness improvement strategies of differentiated cut loads during disasters. And establishing a two-stage mixed integer random programming model of the multi-fault scene based on the proposed strategy, solving the problem by adopting a Gaussian-Saidel method based on punishment so as to improve the calculation efficiency, and adopting a robust optimization method to treat the uncertainty of wind and light output. The method can improve the power supply effect of the key load of the power distribution network in the ice disaster period, and the load loss can be effectively reduced by the cooperation of multiple resources.

title_en: Dynamic botnet detection system based on incremental learning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information safety, and provides a dynamic botnet detection system based on incremental learning, which comprises a flow processing module, a model training module, an experience caching module and an experience replay module; the flow processing module is used for generating the characteristics of nodes and edges of the flow; the model training module is used for training a graph neural network model based on attention node sampling; the experience caching module is used for extracting key subgraphs of the nodes according to attention sampling results after the graph neural network model is trained, and storing the key subgraphs in an experience caching area after aggregation, and maintaining and updating the key subgraphs; and the experience replay module is used for selecting the key subgraph to replay in the new batch data, re-aggregating the new batch data characteristics and performing graph neural network model fine tuning. The application extracts the key control topology from the botnet and plays back the key control topology in the batch before the model retraining process, so that the model dynamic data evolves and has the disaster-resistant forgetting capacity.

title_en: Road network emergency rescue point layout method in reconstruction and expansion construction period of special highway section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road network emergency rescue point layout method in a reconstruction and expansion construction period of a special section of a highway, which comprises the following steps: collecting special road section environment and traffic information, and constructing a special road section comprehensive data set; carrying out risk assessment on each special road section by using the special road section comprehensive data set, and calculating the risk degree of each special road section; classifying risks according to the calculated risk degrees and carrying out quantization treatment; analyzing the road network accessibility of a special road section, and analyzing the demand quantity of rescue materials and the expected response time by combining the accident occurrence frequency and the risk level; and comprehensively considering the expected response time and the rescue material demand, and determining the optimal position of the emergency rescue point. The invention can dynamically reflect the actual risk condition of the special road section during the reconstruction and expansion by utilizing the real-time data and the geographic information, thereby determining the optimal position of the emergency rescue point and providing the most effective rescue in the shortest time.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic catastrophe test system and method for simulating river blockage and breaking of high-level landslide ice shingle bank
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a system and a method for simulating a dynamic disaster test of river blockage and collapse of high-level landslide ice shingle bank, wherein the system for simulating the dynamic disaster test of river blockage and collapse of high-level landslide ice shingle bank comprises a three-dimensional scanning system, a landslide test system, a river basin simulation system, a water supply system and a numerical control system; the full-three-dimensional dynamic visualization and digital characterization of the dam break cascade disasters are realized by simulating the full process of high-level landslide and ice dam accumulation formation, osmotic deformation, break evolution and dam break flood evolution disaster chains through a landslide test system, a river basin simulation system and a water supply system, acquiring high-definition images and data of the high-level landslide and ice dam formation and break by a three-dimensional scanning system, further carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on the soil-stone-ice mixture accumulation and the seepage break process by a numerical control system, uncovering the development and evolution law and a dynamic mechanism of the high-level landslide and ice dam break.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES;SICHUAN COMPREHENSIVE GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST

title_en: Post-analysis system and method for electric vehicle battery fire occurrence factors
title_ko: 전기 자동차 배터리 화재 발생 요인 사후 분석 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for post-analysis of a fire occurrence factor of a battery of an electric vehicle. The system comprises: a data collection unit collecting battery information related to a fire factor generated by a battery of an electric vehicle; a data classification unit classifying the battery information according to a preset classification condition and generating battery classification information related thereto; and a data storage unit classifying and storing the battery classification information according to a fire occurrence factor and a storage standard and generating fire factor data information related thereto.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기 자동차의 배터리에 의해 발생되는 화재 요인에 관련된 배터리 정보를 수집하는 데이터 수집부; 상기 배터리 정보를 기설정된 분류 조건에 따라 분류하고 이에 관한 배터리 분류 정보를 생성하는 데이터 분류부; 및 상기 배터리 분류 정보를 화재 발생 요인 및 저장 기준에 따라 구분하여 저장하고 이에 관한 화재 요인 자료정보를 생성하는 데이터 저장부;를 포함하는, 전기 자동차 배터리 화재 발생 요인 사후 분석 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fire Hose Backpack
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire hose backpack. The present invention relates to a technology for helping quick and easy fire suppression at a fire site where a fire truck is difficult to enter because a user can move while unfolding the fire hose while storing the fire hose. Specifically, the fire hose deployment device includes a backpack body 100 including a storage space in which the fire hose 1 is stored, and including a fire hose deployment part 110 formed to deploy the fire hose 1 to the outside.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방호스 배낭에 관한 것으로, 사용자가 소방호스를 수납한 상태에서 소방호스를 전개시키며 이동할 수 있으므로, 소방차가 진입하기 어려운 화재현장에서의 신속하고 수월한 화재진압을 돕는 기술에 대한 발명이다. 
구체적으로, 내부에 소방호스(1)가 수납되는 수납공간을 포함하며, 소방호스(1)가 외부로 전개되도록 형성되는 소방호스전개부(110)를 포함하는 배낭몸체(100);를 포함하는 주요 구성으로 이루어진다.

title_en: Fire information provision system and method using a moving object.
title_ko: 이동체를 이용한 화재 정보 제공 시스템 및 방법.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for providing fire information using a moving body. More specifically, the present invention relates to a system and a method for providing fire information, capable of checking an image of a fire scene in real time by a live map orthoimaged based on an image photographed vertically through a moving body, as well as checking fire characteristics (e.g., a fireship, a store, a residual fire, a fire direction, etc.).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이동체를 이용한 화재 정보 제공 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 좀 더 구체적으로 설명하면 이동체를 통해 수직하게 촬영된 영상을 토대로 정사영상화되는 라이브 맵에 의해 실시간으로 화재현장의 영상을 확인할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 화재특성(예, 화선, 화점, 잔불, 화재 방향, 등등)을 확인할 수 있는 화재 정보 제공 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System and equipment for simulating fight and evaluation of air defense soldier
abstract_en: The invention provides a combat soldier simulation combat and cutting evaluation system and equipment, wherein a combat situation design and simulation threat generation subsystem is in communication connection with a data acquisition and transmission subsystem; the battle situation design and simulated threat generation subsystem is in communication connection with the simulated combat subsystem; the data acquisition and transmission subsystem is in communication connection with the comprehensive service subsystem; the data acquisition and transmission subsystem is in communication connection with the combat effect grading system; the comprehensive service subsystem is in communication connection with the combat effect grading system; the comprehensive service subsystem is in communication connection with the multi-disc playback subsystem; the comprehensive service subsystem is in communication connection with the comprehensive fight process visual analysis subsystem. The invention constructs the training system which is close to actual combat, combined actual combat with virtual combat and combined electromagnetic combat with firepower combat, can effectively reduce training cost, shortens training period, assists tactical skills of combat personnel, strengthens grasping and flexible application of combat equipment and accelerates formation of combat capability.

title_en: Urban power grid two-stage toughness improvement optimization method based on improved rank generation algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage toughness improvement optimization method for an urban power grid based on an improved rank generation algorithm, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting network topology information of an urban power grid, and enabling disaster-resistant measures to be implemented and user power demand information after disaster; step 2, collecting historical damage data of the power transmission line, analyzing failure probability of the power transmission line, and establishing a power transmission line damage fuzzy set; step 3, a linear power flow model of the urban power grid before the disaster is built, the maximum user power demand which can be met by the urban power grid before the disaster is obtained, and a toughness evaluation index is built; step 4, establishing a two-stage toughness improvement optimization model considering pre-disaster defense and post-disaster quick recovery, and reconstructing the two-stage distribution robust optimization model into a two-stage robust optimization model; step 5, solving a two-stage robust optimization model by using an improved rank generation algorithm; step 6, outputting a two-stage toughness improvement decision: the first stage line reinforcement strategy, the distributed power supply arrangement strategy, the interconnecting line and switch installation strategy and are displayed in an image mode. The invention can help decision makers to formulate the optimal pre-disaster and post-disaster deployment strategies of the urban power grid, thereby maximally improving the overall toughness of the urban power grid and maximally meeting the post-disaster power supply requirements and reducing the influence of various disaster events.

title_en: System and method for analyzing low-voltage cable based on synchronous acquisition of fault arc images
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fault arc image synchronous acquisition-based low-voltage cable analysis system and a fault arc image synchronous acquisition-based low-voltage cable analysis method. The system comprises: an image synchronous acquisition system based on a plurality of high-speed cameras and a high-frequency pulse laser generator is built, so that the whole process of digital image acquisition and decoupling of multi-type fault arcs of the cables are realized; providing a fault arc image characteristic threshold value adjacent frame comparison algorithm, and automatically adjusting the threshold value of each frame image morphology processing algorithm by utilizing the binary image adjacent frame information difference calculated value to obtain fault arc image morphology characteristics in batches; the three-dimensional reconstruction method for the dynamic process of the cable fault arc based on the decoupling digital image is provided, the independent reconstruction of the fault arc and the generation of the carbonization path is completed by applying the three-dimensional reconstruction technology, and the whole process from arcing carbonization to fire disaster initiation of the cable is clearly analyzed.

title_en: Unmanned telemetry method for reconstructing field geological disaster model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earth science and remote sensing, relates to an unmanned remote sensing method for reconstructing a field geological disaster model, and aims to improve the efficiency, accuracy and safety of geological disaster monitoring and evaluation. According to the method, the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying the high-precision sensor, so that multidimensional data of a geological disaster site are collected in real time. In the ground control center, the acquired data is further processed and analyzed by means of advanced image processing and data analysis technology, so that high-precision reconstruction of the geological disaster model is realized. The reconstructed model can reflect the current condition of the disaster site, and the possible development trend of the disaster can be predicted through the combination of the historical data and the real-time data. The method has the characteristics of high efficiency, accuracy and high automation degree, and is suitable for monitoring and evaluating geological disasters under various complex terrains and severe weather conditions. The method greatly reduces the risk and cost of manual investigation, and provides reliable scientific basis for geological disaster prevention, emergency response and post-disaster recovery.
assignees: AERO GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY AND REMOTE SENSING CENTER FOR NATURAL RESOURCES OF CHINA

title_en: Daily compound salty drought index forecasting method and device for estuary area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for forecasting a daily compound salty drought index in a estuary area, which are used for solving the problem of low forecasting accuracy of the estuary compound salty drought disaster. Comprising the following steps: calculating a runoff marginal distribution function of daily runoff data and a salinity marginal distribution function of salinity data; calculating a normalized runoff index according to the runoff marginal distribution function, and calculating a normalized salinity index according to the salinity marginal distribution function; calculating a daily-scale composite salty drought index according to the runoff marginal distribution function and the salinity marginal distribution function to obtain a daily-scale composite salty drought index sequence; verifying the applicability of the daily-scale composite salty drought index by adopting a standardized runoff index and a standardized salinity index; when the verification is passed, decomposing the daily-scale composite salty drought index sequence into a plurality of sub-signal components; constructing a random forest model of each sub-signal component to obtain sub-composite salty drought index forecast data; and adding and reconstructing the sub-composite salty-upland index forecast data to generate a composite salty-upland index forecast value.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based three-dimensional map construction method for natural disaster areas
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional map construction method of a natural disaster area based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of natural disaster emergency rescue. The unmanned aerial vehicle flies above the disaster area according to a preset track; estimating the internal and external parameters of the camera and sparse point clouds by adopting an incremental motion restoration structure method; calculating a direct depth map and reconstructing a dense point cloud based on PATCHMATCH method; and carrying out GPS information attachment on the dense point cloud to obtain the dense point cloud with GPS information. The method is used for generating the disaster area three-dimensional map with the GPS information after the natural disaster occurs. The verification experiment is carried out on a plurality of groups of open source high-altitude data, and the method has the characteristics of strong robustness and high reliability under the scene; the dense point cloud provided by the invention has GPS information, provides the direction and navigation of geographic information for disaster-fighting teams, and has stronger practicability and functionality.

title_en: Radio access network and control method of the same
abstract_en: To provide a radio access network which automatically reconstructs a radio cell at an instance and performs a temporal recovering in the case where an installation is in partially down due to a natural disaster.SOLUTION: A radio access network 100 comprises: a plurality of radio slave stations 10 having a first antenna 11 whose communication speed is low and a communication available area is wide and a second antenna 12 whose communication speed is higher than that of the antenna 11 and a communication available area is narrow; a housing station 20 that is connected to the plurality of radio slave stations 10 via a front hall 22; and a radio master station 30 connected to the housing station 20 via the front hall 21. The radio master station 30 grasps a distribution situation of a user terminal in a radio cell 100A integrated by oneself, and reconstructs the radio cell 100A by instructing so that an output power of the second antenna 12 is increased toward an area of each radio slave station 10 that is in down against each radio slave station 10 that is adjacent to the radio slave station 10 that is in down, and is normally operated when any one of the plurality of radio slave stations 10 is in down, and an electric wave is discharged.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Method for reconstructing debris flow disaster history in alpine mountain area based on tree-wheel landform method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reconstructing debris flow disaster history in alpine mountain areas based on a tree-wheel landform method, which belongs to the technical field of debris flow disaster history reconstruction and comprises the following steps: s1: obtaining Landsat satellite remote sensing image data of a target cold mountain area; s2: determining the specific year of the debris flow disaster in the target cold mountain area; s3: collecting tree samples of a debris flow disaster inundation area of a target cold mountain area; s4: a chronology; s5: establishing a tree wheel disturbance level index system and a disaster response index standard suitable for reconstructing the disaster history of the debris flow in the alpine mountain area; s6: reconstructing an unknown debris flow disaster history of the alpine mountain area based on the established tree-wheel disturbance level index system and disaster response index standard suitable for reconstruction of the debris flow disaster history of the alpine mountain area; the invention can more accurately reconstruct the history of the mud-rock flow disaster in the alpine mountain area.

title_en: Map reconstruction system for emergency rescue unmanned aerial vehicle unit
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of map drawing, and provides a map reconstruction system for an emergency rescue unmanned aerial vehicle set; the system comprises: the disaster area estimation module can judge the disaster occurrence texture of the area to be built and estimate the disaster area based on the historical network data change of the communication equipment in the area to be built monitored by the mobile communication network; the map framework setting module is used for constructing a coordinate system framework of the region to be built, wherein the coordinate system framework comprises a world coordinate system and an unmanned aerial vehicle coordinate system, and the unmanned aerial vehicle coordinate system is marked in the world coordinate system; the reconstruction scheme setting module can set map reconstruction venation in a world coordinate system based on the disaster occurrence texture; the invention cooperates with the mobile communication network to realize purposeful searching, improve efficiency and ensure timeliness, and also meet the map reconstruction requirement of large-scale disaster areas.

title_en: Improved deep Q network-based non-prediction wind farm topology optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimizing the topology of a wind farm without prediction based on an improved deep Q network, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a state space of the deep Q network based on historical data; decoupling action scores and values Q, and constructing a mapping relation of the neural network which is input into a state containing historical data and outputs scores for all action switches and the values Q of the action scores to different topological structures; and constructing a reward function by taking the minimized voltage deviation and the network loss as optimization targets, and training by using an experience playback strategy based on multi-level experience guidance to establish a mapping relation between the historical output of the wind power plant and the topology optimization result. The invention aims to enhance the adaptability of the wind power plant to complex environments such as mountains, hills and the like through a topological reconstruction scheme of the DQN decision wind power plant on the next day so as to solve the problem of large voltage fluctuation, reduce the large action dimension caused by action switch change and solve the problem of dimension disaster caused by action scoring-value Q evaluation.

title_en: Vr controller for children and, fire fighting experience apparatus using vr controller for children and fire evacuation system using bracelet controller
title_ko: 어린이용 vr 컨트롤러와, 이를 이용한 소방체험장치 및 팔찌컨트롤러를 이용한 화재대피시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a VR controller for children, a firefighting experience device using the same, and a fire evacuation system using a bracelet controller. The VR controller comprises: a rod controller provided in a rod shape so that a child can hold and use the same in his/her hand, and having a gyro sensor mounted thereon to generate and transmit a control signal according to front, rear, left, and right movements; and a bracelet controller which is connectable to the rod controller in the form of a bracelet which can be wrapped around the child's wrist, and which is equipped with an emergency button on one side to be pressed in case of an emergency. Accordingly, the present invention provides a VR controller that can be efficiently used in a VR metaverse environment and also used to help people effectively evacuate from an actual fire scene.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 어린이용 VR 컨트롤러와, 이를 이용한 소방체험장치 및 팔찌컨트롤러를 이용한 화재대피시스템에 관한 것으로, 어린이가 손에 쥐고 사용할 수 있도록 봉형태로 제공되며, 자이로센서를 탑재하여 전후좌우 움직임에 따른 제어신호를 생성 및 전송하는 봉컨트롤러; 및 상기 어린이의 팔목에 감싸는 팔찌형태로 상기 봉컨트롤러에 연결 가능하게 구비되며, 외부면에 디스플레이화면이 구비되고, 일측면에 응급상황이 발생할 경우 누르는 비상버튼이 구비되는 팔찌컨트롤러;를 포함함으로써, VR 메타버스 환경에서 효율적으로 사용할 수 있는 VR 컨트롤러를 제공할 수 있으며, 실제 화재현장에서도 이를 활용하여 효과적으로 대피할 수 있다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Emergency power supply and distribution system network reconstruction method applied to comprehensive pipe rack
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power supply and distribution, and particularly relates to a network reconstruction method of an emergency power supply and distribution system applied to a comprehensive pipe rack, which comprises the following steps: building a power supply and distribution system network; detecting the node state of a power supply and distribution system network; forming a system network damage condition; performing a differential evolution algorithm to obtain a reconstruction instruction of a system network and executing the reconstruction instruction; judging whether the system completes a reconstruction instruction or not; judging whether the power supply and distribution system is stable or not; and (5) after the reconstruction is completed, maintaining and resetting. The invention designs and constructs a new pipe gallery power supply and distribution system, classifies the pipe gallery power supply and distribution system according to the importance degree of the load, reserves a standby line, builds a power supply and distribution system network, and adopts an intelligent optimization algorithm to realize the automatic self-healing of the power supply and distribution system network under the condition of damage; stability and reliability of the utility tunnel power supply and distribution system are enhanced, and the possibility of secondary disasters is effectively avoided.
assignees: SHANGHAI ELECTRICAL APPARATUS RES INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault rush-repair optimization method and device in typhoon weather, terminal equipment and storage medium
