abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault rush-repair optimization method and device in typhoon weather, terminal equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the acquired typhoon data, first running state data and preset load weight, aiming at the minimum sum of load recovery power supply quantity, network loss, voltage offset and switching operation times, under the conditions of power balance constraint, node voltage constraint, branch current constraint, line transmission quota constraint, new energy output constraint and connectivity constraint, solving a constructed post-disaster power distribution network reconstruction model, and updating the first running state data of the power distribution network according to the power distribution network line reconstructed after the disaster; and determining the lines and nodes to be salvaged according to the updated first running state data by taking the maximum sum of the recovery amounts of the load power as a target under the limitation of the rush-repair resources and the limitation of the rush-repair time, thereby improving the efficiency of repairing the nodes and the lines of the power distribution network by the rush-repair staff and the efficiency of recovering normal power supply of the power distribution network.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Numerical simulation method for moisture permeability behavior of individual protective fabric based on lattice Boltzmann method
abstract_en: The invention provides a numerical simulation method for the moisture permeability behavior of an individual protective fabric based on a lattice Boltzmann method, which comprises the following steps: scanning a fiber membrane sample of the individual protective fabric to obtain three-dimensional microstructure image data; binarization processing is carried out on the three-dimensional microstructure image data to obtain a two-dimensional sequence image; three-dimensional reconstruction is carried out on the two-dimensional sequence image, and a separated and communicated pore network model is generated; quantitatively analyzing the pore network model, and extracting pore structure characteristic parameters of the fiber membrane; and combining the two-dimensional sequence image and the pore structure characteristic parameter, and simulating the moisture permeability of the fiber membrane based on the lattice Boltzmann method. The invention explores the moisture permeability mechanism of the nanofiber material deeply, not only expands the understanding of the microstructure of the high-performance fiber material, but also provides scientific basis for improving the protection effect and wearing comfort of the firefighter uniform material, thereby enhancing the safety and the operation efficiency of firefighters in extreme environments.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;SHANDONG NEW SUNSHINE ENVIRONMENTAL PROT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: System and method for rapidly evaluating building safety after collaborative earthquake of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The system comprises at least three unmanned aerial vehicles (1), a three-dimensional reconstruction subsystem (2), a damage detection subsystem (3) and a structural state evaluation subsystem (6); the method comprises the steps that a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles (1) cooperatively shoot a post-earthquake building through path planning, and image information is transmitted to a three-dimensional reconstruction subsystem (2) and a damage detection subsystem (3), and when the number of images reaches a certain number, batch update information is obtained; the three-dimensional reconstruction subsystem (2) is used for reconstructing three-dimensional information of the post-earthquake building, finely classifying the components of the post-earthquake building and preparing for modeling of the structural state evaluation subsystem (6); the damage detection subsystem (3) is used for detecting damage conditions of post-earthquake buildings, can divide and quantify the post-earthquake building damage, and damage information can define the post-earthquake damage in a post-earthquake model of the structure state evaluation subsystem (6); the structural state evaluation subsystem (6) is combined with the three-dimensional information of the three-dimensional reconstruction subsystem (2) and the damage information of the damage detection subsystem (3) to rapidly model the post-earthquake building, and the overall safety performance of the post-earthquake building is evaluated and rapidly graded through the earthquake simulation analysis, so that powerful technical support is provided for post-disaster rescue and reconstruction work.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring structure under road
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for monitoring a structure under a road, wherein the method comprises the steps of arranging a vibration sensing module at a preset position of the road, collecting vibration data generated under the road by utilizing the vibration sensing module, extracting characteristics of the vibration data to obtain formant distribution characteristics of the vibration data, converting the formant distribution characteristics into a depth domain, drawing to obtain an underground structure image, carrying out stability assessment on the underground structure image according to an early warning rule matched with road characteristics to obtain a stability assessment result, and carrying out early warning on a road structure which does not meet stability requirements. The method and the system can acquire vibration characteristics of roads, airport runways and other important attention areas in real time, find potential safety risks, do not need to carry out large-scale reconstruction on traffic facilities, reduce installation and maintenance costs, and improve early warning capability of landslide disasters.

title_en: Visual monitoring method and system for reconstructing gas pressure distribution based on finite point data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and provides a visual monitoring method and a visual monitoring system for reconstructing gas pressure distribution based on finite point data. The method comprises the following steps: fitting the measured gas pressure of the coal-bed gas pressure measuring point and the extraction shortest distance between the coal-bed gas pressure measuring point and the corresponding gas extraction drilling hole to obtain a first coal-bed gas pressure regression model; fitting the fitting constant and the extraction time of each coal seam gas pressure measuring point in gas extraction to obtain a second coal seam gas pressure regression model so as to predict the gas pressure at any time at any position in the coal seam space. By the method, based on limited gas pressure test data in the underground coal mine, the gas pressure in the extraction process is regressed into a regression prediction model of extraction position and extraction time, and further, the gas pressures in different spaces and times can be predicted according to the regression prediction model, so that the gas pressure space distribution state of the coal seam can be intuitively perceived.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Earthquake disaster damage evaluation system based on python development
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic disaster damage assessment system based on python development, which is used for improving the damage assessment capability of the system. It specifically includes a direct loss module for making a direct loss assessment, an indirect loss module for making an indirect loss assessment, and an insurance pricing module. The invention is based on Python language development, and develops a system based on Django frames and Vue frames, and the function module structure arranged by the system is utilized to evaluate direct loss, indirect loss and insurance pricing after earthquake, so that the evaluation can be more quickly and comprehensively performed, the capability of evaluating the loss can be improved, and meanwhile, the effective data support is provided for subsequent recovery and reconstruction work.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring device and method for whole catastrophe process of side slope of distributed roadbed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed intelligent monitoring device and a method for the whole disaster process of a roadbed slope, and relates to the technical field of monitoring devices for civil engineering, wherein the monitoring device comprises a roadbed slope deformation sensing material unit, and the roadbed slope deformation sensing material unit comprises a geotechnical reinforcement belt layer, a flexible conductive polymer film layer and a stretchable flexible circuit film layer which are sequentially arranged in a protective shell; a plurality of roadbed slope deformation sensing material units are woven into a net to form a roadbed slope deformation intelligent sensing geogrid; the invention can realize distributed deformation monitoring of the whole process of slumping and catastrophe in roadbed and side slope engineering, and can prevent the pavement from cracking and improve the stability of the roadbed. The invention can play a role in the field of monitoring collapse and catastrophe in roadbed and side slope engineering, and has application potential in the fields of pavement crack monitoring, ground subsidence monitoring, road differential deformation monitoring during reconstruction and expansion, and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;UNIV CHONGQING;CHINA RAILWAY FIFTH SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION CORP LTD;CHINA RAILWAY 15TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Layout method and assembly process of electric propulsion system device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a layout method and an assembly process of an electric propulsion system device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, removing original equipment and matched accessories on a ship to be rebuilt; s2, preparing new equipment and matched accessories required by reconstruction; s3, cleaning an original ship fuel tank to be changed into a battery tank; s4, modifying a safety fire-fighting system, wherein a ventilator is respectively arranged at the left side and the right side of the battery compartment; s5, modifying an electric quantity monitoring system, and additionally arranging a direct current main distribution board and an intelligent wireless monitoring control cabinet of the ship on the basis of the original system; s6, modifying the propulsion system, removing the original ship diesel engine from the diesel engine base, arranging a propulsion motor base on the inner side of the original diesel engine base, and installing the propulsion motor in the propulsion motor base. The invention positively responds to the national energy-saving and carbon-reducing policy by taking electric propulsion as a ship propulsion mode, and has the advantages of flexible, convenient and accurate control, improving the comfort of the ship, reducing environmental pollution and the like by virtue of the system.
assignees: CHUANCHUAN SHIP ENG XUANCHENG CO LTD

title_en: Structure and maufactuing method of gas hydrate fire extingishing charcoal for fire suppression
title_ko: 화재진압용 가스 하이드레이트 소화탄의 구조 및 그 제조방법
abstract_en: Provided is a structure of a gas hydrate fire extinguishing bullet for fire suppression, wherein an impeller (20) to which a plurality of blades (24) are radially coupled is axially rotated in a sealed cylindrical reaction vessel (10), wherein the impeller (20) is made of a metal material having high thermal conductivity, and a fire extinguishing agent unit (a) is provided by generating a gas hydrate in which HFC-125 having uniform particles is collected by a plurality of holes (24a) arranged and formed in a main body of the blade (24) by a plurality of holes (24a) arranged and formed in the main body of the blade (24) by a predetermined pressure, temperature, and rotation of the impeller (20) in a state in which water, which is a polar solvent, and HFC-125 gas, which is a collection target gas, are introduced into the reaction vessel (10). According to the present invention, a manufacturing process of HFC-125 gas hydrate can be simplified, and a fire can be extinguished even if a person does not go nearby with respect to a fire which is difficult to respond with an existing fire extinguisher because the fire can fly far away by a launcher, that is, an accessible fire with a fire scale too large or difficult to respond with an existing fire extinguisher.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은  화재진압용 가스 하이드레이트 소화탄을 구성하기 위하여,  밀폐되는 원통형의 반응용기(10) 내에는 다 수개의 블레이드(24)가 방사상으로 결합된 임펠러(20)를 축회전되게 구성하되 임펠러(20)는 열전도성이 높은 금속재질로 구성하고,  반응용기(10) 내부에는 극성용매인 물과 포집 대상 가스인 HFC-125 가스가 투입된 상태에서 반응용기(10) 내부에 일정 압력과 온도 및 임펠러(20) 회전으로 블레이드(24) 본체에 배열형성된 다 수개의 홀(24a)들에 의하여 균일한 입자를 갖는 HFC-125가 포집된 가스 하이드레이트가 생성되게 함으로써 소화약제부(A)를 구비하고,  상기 소화약제부(A)를 발사체인 외피(40) 내부에 내장하되, 소화약제용기(A)을 구성하는 반응용기(10)의 축홈(12)에 축결합된 임펠러(20)의 축부(22)에 연소실(30)을 연결되게 구성함과 동시에 연소실(30) 내부에는 아지드화나트륨과 같은 고분자 물질이 담겨지며 연소실(30)에는 연소실(30)의 폭발을 유도하는 기폭장치로서 전기적신호 또는 열적신호를 주는 트리거(32)를 연결구성함으로써,  소화약제부(A)가 내장된 외피(40)가 화재현장으로 발사됨에 따라 트리거(32)에 의한 연소실(30)의 폭발로 팽창되면서 압력을 발생함과 동시에 열도 발생되고, 열전도가 높은 임펠러(20)는 연소실(30)에서 발생한 압력과 열을 방사상으로 배열된 블레이드(24)가 반응용기(10) 내에 들어 있는 가스 하이드레이트 전반에 걸쳐 열을 동시에 가해주면서 빠른 속도로 가스 하이드레이트 내에 포집된 HFC-125가스의 기화가 진행됨에 따라 반응용기(10)의 내부압력의 증가로 터짐으로 기화된 HFC-125 가스의 분출로 궁극적으로 화재진압을 하도록 한 것이다.
assignees: HANKOOK FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENTS CO LTD

title_en: System searching of sufferer based on unmanned aerial vehicle
title_ko: 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned flight-based victim search system. The present invention is to provide an unmanned flight-based victim search system which attaches a sound sensor to an unmanned flying drone to detect only a sound of a specific frequency band generated from a victim even in environmental conditions difficult to access at various disaster sites such as fire sites or collapse sites, thereby determining that the victim has occurred.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 무인 비행하는 드론에 음향 센서를 부착하여, 화재현장이나 붕괴현장과 같은 각종 재해현장에서 접근이 어려운 환경 조건에서도 조난자로부터 발생하는 특정 주파수 대역의 음향만을 탐지하여 조난자가 발생한 것으로 판단할 수 있는 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템을 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: Component standardization description method for elastic traffic information physical system
abstract_en: The invention provides a component standardization description method for an elastic traffic information physical system, which defines and describes components in the system in detail through a standardized language, and comprises classification, functions, functional domains and operation mechanisms of the components, thereby laying a foundation for modeling the elastic traffic information physical system based on the components, and providing references for relevant professionals to continue deepening and enriching the design, management and maintenance of the elastic traffic information physical system. The innovation of the method is that the elastic target is explicitly incorporated into the design of the traffic system, and the internal action logic and the cooperative relationship of the traffic system when the traffic system is used for coping with disturbance impact scenes are deeply described. By focusing on basic elements of the elastic traffic information physical system, namely the system component design, the method provides unified language and tools for cross-department and cross-mode traffic management and emergency response, and helps intelligent, interconnected, flexible and safe urban traffic system planning design and updating and reconstruction.

title_en: Atmospheric pollutant propagation path discovery method based on reconstruction density clustering
abstract_en: Aiming at the composite risk caused by cross-regional propagation of atmospheric pollution, the traditional monitoring and model method has the limitations of insufficient data coverage, simplified topography distortion, delayed dynamic response and the like. The invention provides an atmospheric pollutant propagation path discovery technology based on reconstruction density clustering, which comprises the steps of reconstructing pollution space distribution through a density accumulation strategy, enhancing air quality information and edge area identification capacity, simultaneously reversely pushing pollutant propagation process to obtain pollution sources, introducing relative distance parameters to simulate the influence of complex terrain on diffusion, and dynamically adjusting propagation paths by combining real-time meteorological data. The method realizes multi-source data fusion tracing, breaks through the limitation of a fixed monitoring station, finds that the dirt propagation path has a good effect, and provides key technical support for regional cooperative treatment and emergency response.

title_en: Power distribution network toughness improving method for cooperative scheduling of maintenance and switch operators
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness improving method for a power distribution network, which is used for cooperatively scheduling maintenance and switch operators, and the method is used for establishing a mixed integer linear programming model comprising a radial network reconstruction constraint of the power distribution network in a pre-disaster prevention stage, a pre-deployment constraint of maintenance personnel and switch operators, a power distribution network tide and safety constraint, a degradation stage fault area constraint, a power distribution network load loss constraint, a radial network reconstruction constraint of the power distribution network in a post-disaster recovery stage, a power distribution network tide and safety constraint, a fault area constraint, a maintenance personnel and switch operator scheduling constraint, a maintenance personnel fault repair constraint and a manual switch switching constraint of a switch operator by taking the minimum load loss of the power distribution network under extreme events into consideration as an objective function by adopting a random optimization method based on scenes. The rapid recovery of the load of the power distribution network is realized through the network pre-reconstruction in the pre-disaster prevention stage, the pre-deployment of maintenance personnel and switch operators in the team and the real-time scheduling, the cooperative fault repair and the network dynamic reconstruction of the maintenance personnel and switch operators in the post-disaster recovery stage. The coupling among links such as manpower resource scheduling, network reconstruction, fault repair and the like is comprehensively considered, and the capacity of resisting extreme weather and the capacity of recovering after disaster of the power distribution network are obviously enhanced through the optimized scheduling of emergency resources before and after the disaster.

title_en: Post-disaster recovery method and post-disaster recovery terminal for power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a terminal for recovering after a power grid disaster, which are characterized in that after a natural disaster occurs in the power grid, a load recovery task is determined, a topology change constraint containing flexible soft switches after the disaster is established based on the load recovery task, a multi-type electric vehicle cluster regulation model before the disaster and after the disaster and a post-disaster recovery optimization decision model are established based on the determined load recovery task and the priority thereof, so that a post-disaster recovery optimization decision model considering the flexible soft switches and the multi-type electric vehicles is generated, the model is solved, a line reconstruction result aiming at the load recovery task and a charging and discharging strategy of the electric vehicles are obtained, the affected area is rapidly isolated when the natural disaster causes the fault by utilizing a flexible soft switch technology, the risk of fault diffusion is reduced, the power grid is subjected to necessary topology adjustment after the disaster, and then the electric vehicle cluster is combined, so that the efficient distribution of post-disaster power support is realized, and the toughness and the sustainability of the power grid are effectively improved.

title_en: Expressway disaster monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning, and particularly relates to a step 100: calibrating a camera; step 200: planning a route; step 300: data acquisition and data transmission; step 400: three-dimensional reconstruction; step 500: data comparison and disaster early warning; step 600: identifying the road surface condition; step 700: information transmission and response measures; according to the method, the shortest path of the unmanned aerial vehicle operation is planned through path planning, automatic intelligent path generation in different scenes is achieved, sudden conditions of different roads are identified and classified through machine identification of the sudden conditions, so that monitoring accuracy is improved, differences are found through 3D models in comparison with 3D models of different time periods, and accordingly disasters to be occurred are predicted, and further the intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle can monitor the sudden conditions of the roads.
assignees: HUDA YUEGANG AODAWAN AREA INNOVATION RES INSTITUTE GUANGZHOU ZENGCHENG

title_en: Digital road model construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital roads, in particular to a digital road model construction method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source road data by using a sensor; acquiring real-time traffic flow through the unmanned aerial vehicle and the camera to obtain a real-time traffic flow monitoring video; performing spectrum separation on the real-time traffic flow monitoring video to generate image spectrum data; performing image enhancement processing on the real-time traffic flow monitoring image according to the image spectrum data to obtain an enhanced image; video reconstruction is carried out on the enhanced image, and a real-time traffic flow monitoring enhanced video is generated; and extracting video frame characteristics of the real-time traffic flow monitoring enhancement video to construct a real-time monitoring image matrix. Therefore, the digital road model can cope with complex traffic conditions in actual traffic scenes through the Internet of things technology, the data analysis technology, the intelligent control technology and the visualization technology, and the dynamic adjustment and emergency response capabilities of road traffic are improved.
assignees: TAIYUAN LINJIE ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real estate mapping method and system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real estate mapping method and a system based on machine vision, which relate to the technical field of vision mapping, and the method comprises the steps of calculating and evaluating an image quality index Tzls, quantifying the image quality and eliminating redundant data, and reducing the working pressure of subsequent data processing; by combining an image acquisition component and adopting a multi-source data fusion technology, the environmental adaptability of image mapping is improved; comprehensively calculating the total fitness Qhd by comparing the geometric shapes and textures of the pre-disaster model and the post-disaster model; dividing the total fit degree Qhd into gears according to a preset fit threshold value, and determining the damage degree of the disaster-stricken building; finally, based on the mapping data set, the damage characteristics of the building are extracted, damage indexes Shzs are calculated and evaluated, and the damage degree of the building is quantized; the multi-level repair advice from comprehensive reconstruction to slight maintenance is provided through the advice generating unit, so that the building repair requirements of different damage degrees are met; meanwhile, a targeted repair scheme is provided according to different damage degrees, so that resource allocation is optimized, and resource waste is avoided.

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network power supply recovery method based on expert demonstration guidance reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power distribution network power restoration method based on expert demonstration guidance reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing an expert demonstration data set, establishing a multiple priority experience playback pool, including expert demonstration, normal operation and constraint violation experience playback pool, extracting experiences in batches from the expert demonstration experience playback pool, pre-training a reinforcement learning model, constructing and integrating an invalid action shielding module after the pre-training is completed, shielding invalid operation, then simulating operation in a large number of fault scenes, respectively storing the normal operation and constraint violation experience into the corresponding playback pool, extracting experiences in proportion for priority playback, training the model, and finally, recursively solving in a real-time fault scene by utilizing the trained model, and outputting an approximate optimal decision of post-disaster power restoration. The invention obviously improves the accuracy and efficiency of power supply recovery of the post-disaster power distribution network, and solves the problems of high calculation complexity and poor real-time performance in the prior art.

title_en: High-speed rail wind speed prediction method based on secondary decomposition and reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of railway disaster monitoring, and particularly relates to a method for predicting wind speed along a high-speed railway based on secondary decomposition and reconstruction, which comprises the steps of S1, analyzing original wind speed data along the high-speed railway to construct a time sequence, S2, carrying out primary decomposition on the wind speed time sequence by utilizing CEEMDAN to obtain a series of signal components, S3, calculating SE values of signals, quantifying complexity of the signal components, dividing the IMF components into three groups according to SE, respectively reconstructing the signal groups to generate HIMF, MIMF and LIMF, S4, adopting VMD to further decompose HIMF to obtain a series of relatively stable subsequences, S5, respectively predicting the signal components, and adding the obtained results to obtain the final predicted wind speed. The method and the device avoid modal aliasing and noise introduction caused by excessive decomposition, improve the effectiveness of signal decomposition work, and improve the accuracy of high-speed rail strong wind prediction along the line.

title_en: Emergency transfer method, device, equipment and medium for power distribution network under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency transfer method, device, equipment and medium for a power distribution network under typhoon disasters. The method comprises the following steps: determining at least one node to be transferred in a power distribution network in a preset area according to a typhoon wind field model and rainfall corresponding to typhoons in the preset area; according to at least one candidate switching state combination corresponding to the preset switching switch between the nodes, carrying out iterative computation based on a preset algorithm to determine an optimal transfer strategy; and taking the opening and closing states of the preset switching switches in the network structure corresponding to the optimal transfer strategy as target opening and closing states of the preset switching switches, and controlling the preset switching switches to switch the current opening and closing states to the target opening and closing states so as to transfer loads to the at least one node to be transferred. According to the technical scheme, resource waste generated by the network structure of the reconstructed power distribution network can be reduced, and the corresponding load recovery amount is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of hyperspectral remote sensing basic large model of low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a hyperspectral remote sensing basic large model of a low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the steps of constructing a data set, wherein a sample is a hyperspectral sample of H multiplied by W multiplied by D; constructing a three-dimensional extended MAE model, wherein the three-dimensional extended MAE model comprises an image blocking layer, a 3D position coding layer, a dynamic mask layer, an MAE model and an HED model; constructing a total loss function L; training the three-dimensional extended MAE model to obtain a large spectrum model for reconstructing the hyperspectral sample to obtain a predicted hyperspectral image. According to the invention, the traditional two-dimensional MAE model is expanded to be three-dimensional, the reconstructed image can better express the spectral characteristics of different objects and surfaces by combining a dynamic shielding rate strategy and 3D position coding, and more accurate physical boundaries are provided by combining the HED model to strengthen edge details. The invention is suitable for precise material identification and classification, and is particularly suitable for complex environment monitoring and resource evaluation tasks in the fields of precise agriculture, environment protection, disaster management and the like.

title_en: Power distribution network topology reconstruction method based on extreme disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network topology reconstruction method based on an extreme disaster scene, which considers the uncertainty of disaster occurrence through a random optimization method, optimizes the power distribution network topology on the basis of accurately predicting the probability distribution of a power grid fault scene, and realizes the optimal topology reconstruction of the power distribution network under the extreme disaster fault. The virtual tide method is adopted to keep the radial operation of the power distribution network, and the power and voltage balance of the power distribution network under the topology reconstruction is considered, so that a power distribution network topology reconstruction model based on extreme disaster scenes is constructed. According to the invention, the current natural environment and the actual situation that severe weather frequently occur are considered, the fault occurrence scene is considered through a random optimization method, the topology of the power distribution network is reconstructed, and the power supply reliability and the safety of the power distribution network under extreme disasters are ensured.

title_en: Leak protection sensor mounting structure on fire control pipe in subway interval
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leakage-proof sensor mounting structure on a subway section fire-fighting pipe, which comprises a section fire-fighting pipe, wherein a fixing assembly is arranged at the outer wall of the section fire-fighting pipe, the fixing assembly is a split type butt-splice fixing assembly, the butt-splice fixing assembly is sleeved on the section fire-fighting pipe in a butt-splice mode, the butt-splice fixing assembly is fixed through a quick locking device, and a sensing unit is arranged at the butt-splice fixing assembly. According to the utility model, the anti-leakage sensor is installed by only one person, the sensing unit body can be quickly and firmly fixed at different positions of the fire-fighting pipeline, welding or drilling operation is not needed, the installation is convenient and flexible, the installation time is shortened to a great extent, the working efficiency is improved, and the anti-leakage sensor is more friendly to reconstruction application on the fire-fighting pipeline in the existing subway section. The utility model can replace manual inspection and periodic inspection by a fixed-point monitoring mode, thereby saving labor cost, improving detection efficiency and reducing potential safety hazard.

title_en: Urban block wind-induced disaster comprehensive risk early warning method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to a method and a device for comprehensively warning the risk of a city block wind-induced disaster, wherein the method comprises the steps of reconstructing a target city block wind field in real time based on a pre-established physical heuristic-data driving learning frame to obtain the real-time wind field of the target city block; inquiring a sub-model corresponding to the real-time wind field based on a pre-constructed multi-disaster-bearing carrier wind-induced disaster risk assessment model library, and calculating the wind-induced disaster-bearing carrier damage level and the comprehensive risk level spatial distribution result of the target city block according to the real-time wind field and the sub-model to generate an early warning prompt for risk early warning. The method can calculate and output the spatial distribution results of the damage level and the comprehensive risk level of the disaster-bearing carrier of the city block, and perform early warning prompt based on the results, so that the risks of different types of disaster-bearing bodies in wind-induced disasters can be estimated more comprehensively and accurately, and powerful support is provided for formulating effective disaster prevention and reduction measures.

title_en: Deep rock burst environment simulation and monitoring method
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for simulating and monitoring a deep rock burst environment. The deep rock burst environment simulation and monitoring method comprises the steps of digging a first rock burst environment excitation chamber in a deep roadway, arranging monitoring equipment to obtain rock burst parameters, determining the specification and the size of a reconstructed rock burst research rock pillar, digging a rock burst environment excitation rock pillar on the other side to form a second rock burst environment excitation chamber, arranging the monitoring equipment in the second rock burst environment excitation chamber, and analyzing deep rock burst based on the collected rock burst data in the first rock burst environment excitation chamber and the second rock burst environment excitation chamber. According to the scheme provided by the application, a rock burst environment can be created artificially, the rock burst disaster which is hard to cut is controlled to be in a fixed place, rock burst data generated by nearby disturbance is recorded, a real rock burst simulation experiment is realized, and real rock burst evolution, generation and process control data and change rules are obtained.
assignees: YUNNAN CHIHONG ZINC & GERMANIUM CO LTD

title_en: language teaching methods using a video content
title_ko: 동영상 콘텐츠를 이용한 언어 교육 방법
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a language education method using video content can be provided, comprising: a step in which a transceiver of a user device receives video content, audio information corresponding to the video content, and subtitle information matching the video data from a service server; a step in which a playback management unit of the user device plays a video using the video data in a first area on a display unit of the user device, and simultaneously outputs a subtitle using the subtitle information in a second area on the display unit while the video is being played. The subtitle information is output in a manner of being divided into sentences of a predetermined length.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 사용자 기기의 송수신부가 서비스서버로부터 동영상 콘텐츠, 상기 동영상 콘텐츠에 대응되는 음성정보 및 상기 동영상 데이터에 매칭되는 자막 정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 사용자 기기의 재생관리부는 상기 사용자 기기의 디스플레이부 상의 제1 영역에 상기 동영상 데이터를 이용하여 동영상을 재생하고, 상기 동영상의 재생과 동시에 상기 디스플레이부 상의 제2 영역에 상기 자막 정보를 이용하여 자막을 출력하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 자막 정보는 소정 길이의 문장으로 구분되어 출력되는 것을 특징으로 하는, 동영상 콘텐츠를 이용한 언어 교육 방법이 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: BP neural network-based hierarchical progressive meteorological element data reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a layered progressive meteorological element data reconstruction method based on a BP neural network, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting meteorological element data of a research area and surrounding meteorological stations, S2, dividing the meteorological stations into verification meteorological stations and training meteorological stations based on geographic position information of the research area and the surrounding meteorological stations, S3, determining observation data of corresponding characteristic parameters and target variables in the training meteorological stations according to a data reconstruction target, constructing and optimizing a corresponding target model based on the BP neural network according to the observation data, and S4, calling the optimized target model with optimal model parameters according to the data reconstruction target to reconstruct the meshed meteorological element data. The high-quality multi-element meteorological data reconstruction method provided by the invention provides a precious technical scheme for research and practice in a plurality of research fields such as hydrologic cycle, climate change, drought and waterlogging disasters and the like.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Analysis method and related device for influence of typhoon disaster on operation of power system
abstract_en: The application discloses an analysis method and a related device for the influence of typhoon disasters on the operation of a power system, wherein key information data of the typhoon disasters are obtained through an weather table, and a wind field model of the typhoon disasters is built according to a Jie typhoon model, so that typhoon encountered wind speed at any point of the power system is obtained; according to the vulnerability model of the power transmission branch, the power transmission branch of the power system consists of a plurality of power transmission line sections and a plurality of power transmission towers, faults of the whole power transmission branch are caused by the occurrence of typhoon disasters on any power transmission line section or each power transmission tower, the fault probability of each power transmission branch of the power system is calculated, a fault line set of the power system is screened according to an N-i criterion, and the expected load shedding amount of the power system is calculated through a state enumeration method and is used as a risk index. The method can quantitatively compare the influence of the typhoon disaster on the operation of the power system, and can provide reference for the subsequent operation such as network reconstruction, scheduling and the like of the power system for coping with the typhoon disaster.

title_en: Road traffic accident detection method and system based on road side radar perception
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radar perception, in particular to a road traffic accident detection method and system based on road side radar perception, comprising the following steps of S1, data acquisition, namely continuously acquiring motion data of traffic participants; the method comprises the steps of S2, multi-source data fusion and preprocessing, S3, real-time dynamic analysis, S4, accident identification and risk assessment, S5, virtual accident scene reconstruction, S6, alarm and information pushing, wherein the environment perception data are collected in real time, the collected motion data and the environment perception data are fused into multi-source data, the abnormal behaviors of traffic participants are identified in real time, the risk assessment is carried out on the results of the real-time dynamic analysis, and the alarm information is sent to related traffic management departments and emergency rescue units. The invention can reproduce the whole accident occurrence process and provides reliable data support for accident analysis, prediction and responsibility identification.
assignees: SHENZHEN TWIN CLOUD COMPUTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: the electric vehicle fire extinguisher system using the fire hydrant
title_ko: 소화전을 이용한 전기차량 화재진압 장치에 대한 특허
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a (1) fire extinguishing device for electric vehicles using a fire extinguisher installed in an underground parking lot of a technology-led apartment complex. The present invention is to provide solutions by (2) connecting four 2.5 m long steel pipes to a 25 mm pipe, drilling water injection holes at regular intervals, and injecting the invention in the event of an electric vehicle fire, then opening the fire extinguisher and spraying water directly into the battery room to extinguish the fire by cooling, thereby keeping people away from the fire scene and reducing casualties.
abstract_ko:
(1) 기술과제 
  공동주택 지하주차장에 설치된 소화전을 이용한 전기차량 소화장치 
(2) 해결하려는 과제 
  25mm 배관에 2.5m 길이의 강관 4개를 연결하여 일정 간격 물 분사구멍을 뚫어 전기차량 화재 시 본 발명품을 투입한 후 소화전을 개방하여 밧데리실에 직접 물을 분사하여 냉각소화하는 방법으로 사람은 화재현장으로부터 이격되어 인명피해를 줄이고자 함.

title_en: Geographic information mapping system based on remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing images, in particular to a geographic information mapping system based on remote sensing images, which comprises a first remote sensing image acquisition module for acquiring primary geographic information, a ground object marking module for processing the primary geographic information and identifying and marking ground object features, a map drawing module for calculating a danger degree index and an importance index and drawing a danger distribution map and an importance map, a safety area location module for selecting an optimal safety area and establishing a rescue place, an unmanned plane path planning module for planning an optimal path according to node positions, node weights and inter-node distances, a second remote sensing image acquisition module for acquiring and processing remote sensing images by using an unmanned plane to obtain secondary geographic information, a cloud computing module for acquiring and processing the geographic information to obtain a geographic information mapping map, and a geographic information display module for displaying the geographic information mapping map. According to the invention, accurate geographic information is mapped for rescue and reconstruction of mountain areas after disaster through the multisource satellite remote sensing image and the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image.

title_en: Two-stage anti-seismic toughness optimization method for transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage anti-seismic toughness optimization method for a transformer substation, which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting a network topology structure of the transformer substation, establishing a network topology diagram of the transformer substation, collecting equipment fault information, and establishing a fuzzy set of equipment failure probability, 2, establishing a transformer substation toughness index, establishing a transformer substation anti-seismic toughness optimization model from two stages before and after earthquake, 3, reconstructing the two-stage distributed robust optimization model into the two-stage robust optimization model, performing relaxation treatment on state variables in the model, and 4, solving the two-stage robust optimization model by adopting a nested column and constraint generation algorithm according to the reconstructed model. And 5, outputting reinforcement decisions of the pre-earthquake stage of the transformer substation, and displaying the reinforcement decisions in an image mode. The method and the system can help a decision maker to make an optimal reinforcement decision of the transformer substation, so that the anti-seismic performance of the transformer substation facing to uncertain disaster damage and the anti-seismic toughness of the transformer substation are improved to the maximum extent, and the influence of disasters on the transformer substation is reduced.

title_en: Trapped person identification and three-dimensional detection method suitable for fire disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trapped person identification and three-dimensional detection method suitable for a fire disaster environment, which belongs to the technical field of imaging detection and comprises the steps of constructing a detector, calculating a left-eye infrared polarization degree image through a photographed left-eye original image, inputting a model to obtain a target identification result, extracting position and size information of an identification frame, generating a parallax image through the photographed pair of the two-eye image, calculating a depth image through the parallax image, converting the depth information in the depth image into dense three-dimensional point cloud data, acquiring sparse three-dimensional point cloud data of a target through the laser radar, performing coordinate conversion on the sparse three-dimensional point cloud data and the dense three-dimensional point cloud data, calculating average depth of the sparse three-dimensional point cloud data in the identification frame, setting a threshold value, removing outliers which are larger than the threshold value in the dense three-dimensional point cloud data, obtaining a three-dimensional reconstruction result, and improving identification and three-dimensional detection capability of trapped persons in a fire scene.
assignees: SHAANXI QIANGPIANZHEN VISION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wireless remote fire control fan control system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides a wireless remote fire-fighting fan control system based on the Internet of things technology, and aims to solve the problem of complexity of fire-fighting fan control in a large building group. The system realizes remote monitoring and unified control of a plurality of fans through the integrated management platform, and has the functions of self-inspection, fault feedback, intelligent fire-fighting linkage and the like. The system adopts an advanced wireless communication technology, ensures stable transmission of signals under long distance, can rapidly start the fan when a fire disaster occurs, monitors the working state of the fan in real time, receives cloud linkage information, and improves emergency response speed and management efficiency. In addition, the invention also simplifies the maintenance and operation of the equipment, reduces the reconstruction cost and difficulty, and provides powerful guarantee for the fire safety of modern buildings.

title_en: Security monitoring big data processing method and system based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a security monitoring big data processing method and system based on cloud computing, which belong to the field of security monitoring and concretely comprise the steps of collecting and processing video monitoring data in real time through an Internet of things node, uploading the video monitoring data to a cloud computing platform to realize distributed storage, utilizing cloud computing resources, carrying out key frame splitting and feature extraction on videos by a system, comprehensively judging abnormal behaviors or dangerous intentions through a graph neural network by combining visual, audio, expression recognition, object recognition and time and space context information, establishing a normal behavior pattern library through historical data analysis, comparing and recognizing the abnormal patterns, classifying the abnormal patterns by adopting a multi-classification algorithm, carrying out multi-dimensional risk assessment to determine dangerous levels, automatically triggering self-adaptive alarms, linking an emergency system, locating abnormal places, and starting video playback and emergency response programs, thereby realizing quick and effective security control.

title_en: Power distribution network collaborative recovery method and system considering interconnection micro-network and network reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative recovery method and a collaborative recovery system for a power distribution network taking account of interconnection micro-grid and network reconstruction, belonging to the technical field of electrical engineering, wherein the method comprises the steps of simulating and guiding an EV (electric vehicle) running on a traffic network to enter a nearby charging station for refuge in a pre-disaster stage and participating in vehicle grid-connected reverse power transmission in a post-disaster stage; and in the post-disaster stage, according to the perceived line fault condition, EV information obtained through simulation and distributed resource information, optimizing to obtain a mixed integer second order cone model comprising the dispatching position of the rush repair team, the output condition of the distributed resource, the power supply range of each micro-grid and the interconnection state, carrying out post-disaster load quick recovery and line repair, and adopting a commercial solver CPLEX to solve the established mixed integer second order cone model to obtain the dynamic micro-grid regional division and interconnection state, the line switching state and the output condition of each distributed resource at different moments in the fault recovery period.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Underground space anti-breaking-loading integrated intelligent emergency equipment and application method
abstract_en: The invention relates to underground space 'anti-breaking-installing' integrated intelligent emergency equipment and an application method, wherein the equipment comprises a walking and expanding device, a sensing module and an intelligent control module which are arranged in the walking and expanding device, and a breaking and disassembling device and an installing device which are arranged at the top of the walking and expanding device, wherein the breaking and disassembling device and the installing device are adjacently arranged; the method comprises the following steps of 1, deploying and starting; the invention integrates the processes of breaking, installing and monitoring, can cover the whole emergency repair process, can effectively collect and analyze data automatically for various situations after the underground space disaster, carries out three-dimensional reconstruction and decision optimization, reduces the dependence on manpower, can automatically adapt to complex topography, carries out various tasks such as breaking, removing, supporting, monitoring and repairing, and simultaneously realizes real-time risk assessment and intelligent early warning.

title_en: Semantic map construction method based on semantic information and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a semantic map construction method based on semantic information and a readable storage medium, belonging to the technical field of firefighting maps. The semantic map construction method comprises the steps of obtaining historical semantic information data of a transformer substation fire-fighting map; the method comprises the steps of acquiring historical semantic information data of a transformer substation fire-fighting map, reconstructing the transformer substation fire-fighting map semantic model, training the transformer substation fire-fighting map semantic model by adopting the historical semantic information data, acquiring real-time radar coordinate information and real-time semantic information of a fire-fighting robot in the inspection process of the fire-fighting robot, inputting the real-time semantic information into the transformer substation fire-fighting map semantic model to obtain semantic content, and acquiring a real-time fire-fighting map by combining the real-time radar coordinate information and the semantic content.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV BRANCH

title_en: Power distribution network elastic lifting and rush-repair personnel scheduling combined optimization scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy safety, in particular to a power distribution network elastic lifting and rush-repair personnel scheduling combined optimization scheduling method and system, comprising the steps of obtaining active power distribution network topology parameters, diesel generator and energy storage equipment parameters, renewable energy prediction output and load curves and values; the method comprises the steps of constructing an active power distribution network post-disaster recovery model by taking elasticity as a guide, determining an adjustment strategy of distributed power generation resources based on a topology reconstruction and island segmentation strategy method, constructing an optimized scheduling model coordinated with maintenance personnel and network reconstruction by taking elasticity as a guide, performing relaxation treatment by using a second order cone relaxation method, determining a fault maintenance strategy, reconstructing an optimized problem based on an active power distribution network fault scene under disasters by using an active power distribution network topology parameter, a schedulable resource parameter and a renewable energy source prediction output condition, and solving the optimized problem with minimum economic loss of the fault as a target to obtain an active power distribution network topology structure and a fault maintenance strategy.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Regional avalanche history reconstruction method based on tree annual rings
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional avalanche history reconstruction method based on tree rings. The method comprises the steps of collecting a field tree wheel sample core aiming at avalanche disasters and focusing on angles and directions, processing the field tree wheel sample to obtain the sample core, obtaining the width of the sample core by matching with a high-power microscope, determining abnormal growth years according to the width change of the sample core, wherein the abnormal growth includes growth inhibition and growth release, identifying other interference signals in the sample core, wherein the other interference signals include scars, calluses and traumatic resin tracks, and judging the avalanche years according to the interference signals. The tree annual ring is used as a common annual fixing means, has the advantages of accurate annual fixing, high precision, wide distribution, easy acquisition and the like, can leave obvious signals including scars, calluses, traumatic resin tracks and the like in the tree annual ring after avalanche occurs, can accurately track the year of the occurrence of the avalanche by using the signals, and can prolong the regional avalanche recording time sequence.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Abnormality detection method and device based on low-rank embedding and multiscale and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of information processing technologies, and in particular, to a low-rank embedding and multiscale anomaly detection method and apparatus, and an electronic device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a hyperspectral image, preprocessing the hyperspectral image to obtain an original hyperspectral image, carrying out feature extraction operation on the original hyperspectral image by using a preset low-rank background feature extraction model to obtain low-rank background features, extracting global features and local features of the original hyperspectral image by using a pre-built multi-scale fusion feature extraction model, carrying out integration processing on the low-rank background features, the global features and the local features, comparing the obtained target reconstructed background image with the hyperspectral image, and identifying abnormal areas. Therefore, hyperspectral image disaster monitoring is realized by adopting low-rank background feature extraction and multi-scale fusion feature extraction, the problems of long time consumption, low efficiency, low precision and the like in the detection process of the existing detection method are solved, and the method has the advantages of automation, high precision, rapidness, high efficiency and the like.

title_en: Termite detection method and termite detection system based on microwave radar through-wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a termite detection method and system based on microwave radar through-wall detection, and belongs to the technical field of microwave radar through-wall detection. The detection method comprises the steps of scanning a region to be detected by using a multi-output microwave radar detection device to obtain radar echo signals, performing signal receiving processing on the radar echo signals to obtain discrete time domain intermediate frequency signals, removing background clutter by band-pass filtering, reconstructing the signals to achieve DOA estimation of an information source, screening white ant targets in amplitude and measuring target distances, and sending termite detection results comprising the target distances and the DOA estimation to target users. The detection system comprises a microwave radar detection device and a user terminal, wherein the microwave radar detection device is used for scanning an area to be detected, performing signal processing and analysis on radar echo signals to obtain termite detection results, and sending the termite detection results to the user terminal. The invention adopts a non-invasive detection mode to realize rapid, convenient and low-cost accurate termite self-detection so as to obviously reduce the hazard of termite disasters.

title_en: Digital Therapeutic Application Based on Sound Contents and Method for Preventing or Treating Obesity
title_ko: 비만의 예방 또는 치료를 위한 사운드 컨텐츠 기반의 디지털 치료 애플리케이션 및 방법
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a system for providing therapeutic sound content for the treatment and prevention of obesity. According to the present disclosure, the present invention may be configured to: receive information related to a patient's physical, mental, and behavioral conditions associated with obesity from a physician's prescription and health examination data provided by the National Health Insurance Service; determine a feature vector based on the obesity-related information, the feature vector including elements corresponding to the patient's physical condition, mental condition, and behavioral condition, and the risk and severity of obesity; determine, for a plurality of clusters in which a plurality of users are classified according to obesity conditions, relationship levels between reference vectors respectively corresponding to the plurality of clusters and the feature vector; transmit, based on the relationship levels, to a user terminal, a plurality of pieces of therapeutic sound content associated with a target cluster among the plurality of clusters; receive, by the user terminal, information indicating completion of playback of the therapeutic sound content; and transmit information regarding the playback of the therapeutic sound content to the prescribing entity and the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 비만의 치료 및 예방을 위한 치유 사운드 컨텐츠를 제공하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 개시에 따르면, 의사의 처방 및 국민건강보험공단 건강검진 자료로부터, 상기 환자의 비만과 관련된 신체 상황, 정신 상황, 행동 상황에 관련된 정보를 수신하고, 상기 비만 관련 정보를 이용하여 상기 환자의 상기 신체 상황, 상기 정신 상황, 및 상기 행동 상황에 따른 비만의 위험성 및 정도를 요소로 하는 특징 벡터를 결정하고, 비만 상황에 따라 복수의 사용자들이 분류된 복수의 클러스터들(clusters)에 대하여, 상기 복수의 클러스터들 각각에 대응되는 기준 벡터들과 상디 특징 벡터 사이의 관계 레벨들을 결정하고, 상기 관계 레벨들에 기반하여, 상기 복수의 클러스터들 중에서 상기 대상 클러스터에 관련된 복수의 치유 사운드 컨텐츠를 상기 사용자 단말에 송신하며, 상기 사용자 단말에서 상기 치유 사운드 컨텐츠 재생 완료 정보를 수신하여 상기 처방 주체 및 상기 사용자 단말에 상기 치유 사운드 컨텐츠 재생 정보를 송신할 수 있다.

title_en: Gamified vr education platform system and education method for pressure injury care
title_ko: 욕창 간호를 위한 게임화 가상현실 교육 플랫폼 시스템 및 교육 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gamification virtual reality (VR) education platform system (10) for bedsore nursing. The gamification VR education platform system (10) for bedsores nursing comprises: a VR server (11) which configures a bedsores scenario according to a bedsores occurrence clinical case, implements bedsores assessment and nursing performance according to the bedsores scenario based on VR, and operates a platform that provides gamification bedsores education content provided with game elements according to the nursing performance result; and a VR device (12) which accesses the platform and provides the gamification bedsores education content provided by the VR server (11) to a learner in VR. According to the gamification VR education platform system and an education method for bedsore nursing proposed in the present invention, experience contents according to the progress of bedsore scenarios in the gamification bedsore education content are debriefed, and the debriefing is performed in an interactive manner through an artificial intelligence chatbot, so that learning can be promoted through sufficient reflection, discussion, feedback, and the like even when learning alone without an instructor or other learners.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 욕창 간호를 위한 게임화 가상현실 교육 플랫폼 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 욕창 간호를 위한 게임화 가상현실 교육 플랫폼 시스템으로서, 욕창 발생 임상 케이스에 따른 욕창 시나리오를 구성하고, 욕창 시나리오에 따른 욕창 사정 및 간호 수행을 가상현실 기반으로 구현하되, 간호 수행 결과에 따라 게임 요소가 제공되는 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠를 제공하는 플랫폼을 운영하는 가상현실 서버; 및 상기 플랫폼에 접속해, 상기 가상현실 서버에서 제공하는 상기 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠를 학습자에게 가상현실로 제공하는 가상현실 장치를 포함하며, 상기 가상현실 장치는, 상기 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠 내에서 간호사 역할을 하는 학습자에게 욕창에 관한 강의와 퀴즈를 제공하고, 욕창 사정 및 간호 수행 시의 체크리스트를 가상현실 기반으로 제공하는 프리브리핑부; 상기 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠의 욕창 시나리오를 진행하면서, 상기 학습자에게 상기 욕창 시나리오에 따른 욕창 사정 및 간호 수행과 관련된 미션을 부여하고, 부여된 미션에 대응한 간호 수행 결과에 따라 포인트 제공, 배지 제공 및 레벨 이동 중 적어도 어느 하나의 리워드를 제공해 게임 요소를 제공하는 시뮬레이션부; 및 상기 시뮬레이션부의 욕창 시나리오 진행에 따른 경험 내용을 디브리핑하되, 인공지능 챗봇을 통해 디브리핑을 대화식으로 실행하는 디브리핑부를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 본 발명은 욕창 간호를 위한 게임화 가상현실 교육 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 상기한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명의 특징에 따른 욕창 간호를 위한 게임화 가상현실 교육 방법은, 욕창 간호를 위한 게임화 가상현실 교육 방법으로서, 욕창 발생 임상 케이스에 따른 욕창 시나리오를 구성하고, 욕창 시나리오에 따른 욕창 사정 및 간호 수행을 가상현실 기반으로 구현하되, 간호 수행 결과에 따라 게임 요소가 제공되는 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠를 제공하는 플랫폼을 운영하는 가상현실 서버; 및 상기 플랫폼에 접속해, 상기 가상현실 서버에서 제공하는 상기 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠를 학습자에게 가상현실로 제공하는 가상현실 장치를 포함하는 욕창 간호를 위한 게임화 가상현실 교육 플랫폼 시스템에서 각 단계가 수행되며, (1) 상기 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠 내에서 간호사 역할을 하는 학습자에게 욕창에 관한 강의와 퀴즈를 제공하고, 욕창 사정 및 간호 수행 시의 체크리스트를 가상현실 기반으로 제공하는 단계; (2) 상기 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠의 욕창 시나리오를 진행하면서, 상기 학습자에게 상기 욕창 시나리오에 따른 욕창 사정 및 간호 수행과 관련된 미션을 부여하고, 부여된 미션에 대응한 간호 수행 결과에 따라 포인트 제공, 배지 제공 및 레벨 이동 중 적어도 어느 하나의 리워드를 제공해 게임 요소를 제공하는 단계; 및 (3) 상기 단계 (2)의 욕창 시나리오 진행에 따른 경험 내용을 디브리핑하되, 인공지능 챗봇을 통해 디브리핑을 대화식으로 실행하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 욕창 간호를 위한 게임화 가상현실 교육 플랫폼 시스템 및 교육 방법에 따르면, 욕창 발생 임상 케이스에 따른 욕창 시나리오를 구성하고, 욕창 시나리오에 따른 욕창 사정 및 간호 수행을 가상현실 기반으로 구현하되, 간호 수행 결과에 따라 게임 요소가 제공되는 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠를 제공하고, 가상현실 장치에서 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠를 통해 학습자가 콘텐츠 내의 대상자와 상호작용하며 학습하도록 함으로써, 욕창의 사정과 간호를 가상현실 기반으로 실감 나게 수행할 수 있어 이론적인 교육을 벗어나 현실적인 교육을 할 수 있고, 게임 요소를 통해 교육 효과를 높일 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 욕창 간호를 위한 게임화 가상현실 교육 플랫폼 시스템 및 교육 방법에 따르면, 게임화 욕창 교육 콘텐츠에서 욕창 시나리오 진행에 따른 경험 내용을 디브리핑하되, 인공지능 챗봇을 통해 디브리핑을 대화식으로 진행함으로써, 교수자나 다른 학습자 없이 단독 학습 시에도 충분한 성찰, 토론, 피드백 등을 통한 학습 촉진을 할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire control transformation should whip water tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting reconstruction water tank whip, which comprises a water taking box main body, wherein a water outlet is formed in the outer surface of one side of the water taking box main body, a water inlet is formed in the other side of the water taking box main body, two groups of glass partition plates and two groups of fixing plates are fixedly arranged in the water taking box main body, a plurality of groups of ultraviolet lamp strips are arranged between the two groups of glass partition plates and the two groups of fixing plates, heat-insulating plastic is arranged between the two groups of fixing plates and the water taking box main body, a top cover is fixedly arranged at the top end of the water taking box main body, a plurality of groups of water level sensors are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the water taking box main body, and an electronic valve is arranged on the outer surface of the water inlet. Can prevent the corrosion of the water tank by microorganisms.
assignees: BEIJING JIANANDA FIRE SAFETY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, device and medium for reconstructing and optimizing grid target grid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of large power grid recovery, and discloses a power grid target grid reconstruction optimization method, a system, a device and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid operation data; the method comprises the steps of identifying fault lines based on power grid operation data, evaluating the probability of causing recoverable line faults by disasters within a preset period, dividing a power failure area into a plurality of recovery subareas, sampling recoverable states of analog lines in the recovery subareas, calculating node importance expected values based on the recoverable states, generating optimal particles of each recovery subarea by combining an ion particle swarm algorithm to optimize a target network frame, and converting the optimal particles of each recovery subarea into a corresponding target network frame scheme. The method avoids the optimization adjustment calculation of a large number of unreasonable net racks, improves algorithm efficiency, enables the method to be applied to online optimization, dynamically updates the target net racks online according to disaster information and power grid blackout scenes, and can provide decision support for dispatching operators for power grids in different recovery stages.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Function recovery method and recovery system after communication network disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication network post-disaster function recovery method and a recovery system, wherein the communication network post-disaster function recovery method comprises the steps of simplifying a communication network architecture into a communication network topological graph; the communication network topological graph comprises an independent sub-graph, logic nodes and lines, wherein the independent sub-graph comprises more than one base station node, the base station nodes are connected through the lines, the base station nodes are connected with the logic nodes through the lines, a post-disaster network recovery problem is abstracted to solve a multiple variation multiple source optimal problem based on the communication network topological graph, the multiple variation multiple source optimal problem is solved to obtain a communication network optimal reconstruction route from a cost optimal angle and a time optimal angle respectively, and post-disaster communication network functions are recovered in stages according to the communication network optimal reconstruction route. The invention can provide technical support for the recovery of the communication network after disaster more efficiently and reliably.

title_en: Mountain seasonal snow-melting regulation and control, water-melting radial mountain disaster prevention and control disaster reduction method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling mountain disasters in a mountain seasonal snow melting mode and a water-melting radial flow type mountain disaster prevention and control disaster reduction method and application. Aiming at the defects of the prior art, the mountain seasonal snow-melting regulation technology is provided. The method adopts carbon particle powder material to cover seasonal snow surface, and utilizes solar radiation absorption and convection heat transfer performance of carbon to provide snow surface heat, thus realizing snow melt water regulation. Through iterative calculation, the method can predict the daily data of the flow, thickness and area of the snow melt. The seasonal water-melting runoff regulation method for the mountain considers the water-melting quantity of the glaciers in the same period, and integrally regulates and controls the water-melting runoff of the regulation area. The method for preventing, controlling and reducing the disaster of the water-melting radial type mountain disaster introduces the threshold value of the induced daily runoff of the corresponding disaster in the regulation area as a monitoring object for preventing, controlling and reducing the disaster. The invention combines the performance of the carbon material with the natural illumination of the mountain, avoids the disadvantages of economy and technology, has little environmental interference, no toxicity or chemical carry-over, and provides a brand new concept for the fixed-point refined artificial reconstruction of the season snow-covered environment in the fragile ecological area of the high cold and high altitude.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Dust purification device for fire extinguishing system reconstruction engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust purification device for fire-fighting system reconstruction engineering, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting engineering construction. The utility model comprises a box body, wherein four corners of the bottom of the box body are fixedly connected with moving wheels, a first supporting plate and a second supporting plate are fixedly connected inside the box body, a collecting assembly is arranged inside the box body and comprises a stirring box, the bottom of the stirring box is fixedly connected with a motor, and the output end of the top of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft. According to the utility model, the collection assembly is arranged, specifically, the exhaust fan is opened to discharge external dust into the stirring box, the water pump is opened to enable water in the water storage tank to be discharged into the stirring box, the motor is opened to enable the dust and the water in the stirring box to be stirred, and the electric push rod is started to discharge the stirred dust into the dirt collection drawer, so that a worker can more conveniently clean the dust, the dust cannot permeate into the air again, and irreversible damage to the body of the worker can not be caused.
assignees: XINGQISHENG BEIJING CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting water tank energy-saving reconstruction structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an energy-saving reconstruction structure of a fire-fighting water tank, which is applied to reconstruction of a fire-fighting water tank of a thermal power plant, the thermal power plant comprises a coal-fired boiler, the fire-fighting water tank energy-saving reconstruction structure comprises a bag-type dust remover, an induced draft fan and a heating air inlet pipe, the bag-type dust remover is connected with the output end of the top of an ash warehouse, the induced draft fan is connected with the air outlet end of the bag-type dust remover through an air outlet pipe, an air inlet valve is arranged on the air outlet pipe and is communicated with the heating air inlet pipe, and the heating air inlet pipe is arranged in the fire-fighting water tank and is externally connected with a heating air outlet pipe. According to the utility model, high gasified air in the ash bin is filtered through the bag-type dust collector, the filtered flue gas with heat is led into the heating air inlet pipe, and water in the fire-fighting water tank can be effectively heated through the heating air inlet pipe, so that the problem that the fire-fighting water tank is frozen and the use of the fire-fighting water tank is affected is solved, and meanwhile, the fire-fighting water tank is heated by using waste heat of the high gasified air in the ash bin, so that the energy consumption is low.

title_en: Space-time Kalman model fusion InSAR and GNSS data reconstruction mining area earth surface deformation monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the surface deformation of a mining area by fusing an InSAR and GNSS data with a space-time Kalman model. Aiming at mining areas with uneven deformation space change, large gradient and high nonlinearity of time change, the invention fully utilizes the advantages of InSAR deformation high spatial resolution and GNSS deformation high time resolution. And a space model is constructed in a self-adaptive mode according to the space characteristics of deformation of the mining area, so that the automaticity and the efficiency of the algorithm are improved. Meanwhile, time characteristic constraint of priori deformation of the mining area is added, so that dependence of a traditional STRE fusion method on GNSS data is reduced, and deformation fusion precision is improved. The method can consider the deformation monitoring result of the mining area InSAR, the deformation monitoring result of the GNSS and the prior deformation characteristics at the same time, effectively fuses the three information to the greatest extent, and realizes the deformation monitoring of the mining area with high space-time resolution. Under the background of the vigorous demand of the resources of the mining area in China, the method has great significance for accurately monitoring, evaluating and preventing the geological disasters of the mining area.

title_en: Prediction method of time series data based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time sequence data prediction method based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of time sequence data prediction and provides a novel time sequence data analysis prediction scheme, so that the prediction capability of the existing time sequence data is further improved, long-time sequence data can be well extracted and refined, the overall prediction capability is improved, meanwhile, a model can have better disaster and forgetting resistance than MLP through an improved full-connection layer, only the region with data in the current stage is reconstructed by KAN for the data in the peak region in a one-dimensional regression task, and the previous region is kept unchanged, so that the problem of remodeling of the whole region data when the MLP faces new sample data is avoided.

title_en: Cooperative intelligent reconstruction method and device for emergency supply chain
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency supply chain collaborative intelligent reconstruction method and device, the method comprises the steps of obtaining demand point information, obtaining emergency warehouse reserve, supplier reserve, emergency warehouse transfer volume, emergency material volume purchased from suppliers according to different prices and material volume transferred from the suppliers to the demand points by utilizing a scene robust model constructed in advance according to the demand point information, wherein the scene robust model is constructed based on expected performance and actual performance variance expected according to pre-disaster reserve cost expectation and post-disaster emergency supply cost expectation under any scene, and reconstructing an emergency supply chain according to the emergency warehouse reserve, the supplier reserve, the emergency warehouse transfer volume, the emergency material volume purchased from the suppliers according to different prices and the material volume transferred from the suppliers to the demand points. The invention realizes the rapid repair after the interruption of the emergency supply chain from the angles of pre-disaster storage and post-disaster response, and ensures the supply of emergency materials.

title_en: Remote sensing image super-resolution reconstruction method and system based on priori diffusion model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to a remote sensing image super-resolution reconstruction method and a remote sensing image super-resolution reconstruction system based on a priori diffusion model, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting shallow characteristic information from a low-resolution image to obtain a shallow characteristic image, carrying out multi-scale downsampling and convolution fusion processing on the shallow characteristic image and a high-resolution image, extracting high-frequency information from the processed characteristic image and carrying out self-adaptive high-frequency enhancement processing to obtain condition information, the depth mining of high-frequency information is carried out on the low-resolution image which is input as the condition information in the denoising process of the diffusion model, so that the high-frequency information in the low-resolution image gradually approaches the high-resolution image, the reconstruction precision is improved, in addition, the noise prediction network model is introduced in the back diffusion process, the noise is gradually removed in the back diffusion process by the noise prediction network model, and the detail reduction capability and the precision of the super-resolution reconstruction of the natural disaster remote sensing image are improved.

title_en: Fire disaster intelligent detection method based on data enhancement
