abstract_en: The invention discloses a data enhancement-based intelligent fire detection method, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode time sequence signals used for representing a fire, respectively carrying out variable-mode decomposition reconstruction based on a Babbitt distance on each mode time sequence signal to obtain a first reconstruction signal corresponding to each mode time sequence signal, carrying out wavelet packet threshold denoising on the first reconstruction signal to obtain a second reconstruction signal corresponding to each mode time sequence signal, carrying out short-time empirical mode decomposition on the second reconstruction signal to obtain a time data matrix corresponding to each mode time sequence signal, respectively adopting a signal-to-image coding mode to obtain a pixel matrix with image property on each time data matrix, respectively carrying out principal component analysis on each pixel matrix to obtain a corresponding dimension-reduced matrix, and inputting the dimension-reduced matrix into a fire intelligent detection model to obtain a fire detection result.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Optimization method, system and related device for reconstruction of localized emergency power supply charging pile
abstract_en: A method for optimizing the transformation of a local emergency power supply charging pile comprises the steps of considering the distribution and load uncertainty of a building-level electric automobile, considering disaster occurrence frequency estimation, determining a disaster scene set, defining an operation complexity index by combining economic loss and operation cost caused by the transformation of the charging and discharging states of the building-level electric automobile, taking the sum of the transportation and transformation cost of a charging station, the dispatching cost of the building-level electric automobile, the economic cost loss caused by the loss of load power and the conversion cost of the operation complexity index as an objective function of a charging pile transformation optimization model, carrying out linearization treatment on the charging pile transformation optimization model, and solving by taking the objective function and constraint conditions into consideration under the disaster scene set by utilizing the charging pile transformation optimization model after linearization treatment, so as to obtain the charging pile transformation optimization scheme. The invention can formulate a reasonable optimization scheme for the transformation of the bidirectional charging and discharging interface of the charging pile for the localization emergency power supply recovery of the post-disaster building.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Drought and flood emergency prediction method and device based on artificial intelligence and satellite remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of climate prediction, in particular to a drought and waterlogging sharp turn prediction method and device based on artificial intelligence and satellite remote sensing, wherein the method comprises the following steps of determining saturated water vapor pressure deficiency and specific humidity by using a clausius-Krapolone thermodynamic equation; the method comprises the steps of calibrating a long-period memory model suitable for simulating land water reserves, extracting drought and waterlogging emergency events from a reconstructed long-series land water reserves inversion data set, dividing the combination of air temperature and drought and waterlogging emergency intensities of all grid points in a prediction river basin into a plurality of boxes with the same sample capacity by using a box scaling function, and predicting the drought and waterlogging emergency intensities of all grid points in a future period by using a scale coefficient so as to obtain a prediction result of the drought and waterlogging emergency intensities of all grid points in a target future period. Therefore, the problems that the drought and waterlogging disaster backtracking risk assessment with a long time span is difficult to realize, the evolution rule of drought and waterlogging emergency is less considered, and the drought and waterlogging emergency prediction cannot be carried out by fully utilizing the artificial intelligence technology are solved.

title_en: Expressway reconstruction and expansion simulation scene construction and evacuation rescue decision method and system based on SUMO
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing expressway reconstruction and expansion simulation scenes and carrying out evacuation and rescue decision-making on the same based on SUMO, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, establishing a dynamic scheme combination decision-making model based on rescue and evacuation route schemes during expressway reconstruction and expansion and combining traffic flow operation parameters; and step 2, carrying out traffic simulation during highway reconstruction and expansion by adopting SUMO simulation software to simulate the traffic running state of the reconstruction and expansion road section under the traffic accident state, and step 3, realizing a plurality of rescue and evacuation routes in the reconstruction and expansion simulation, collecting simulation data, carrying out regression fitting on a decision model, and carrying out statistics on simulation results and verification on the effectiveness of the decision model. The system comprises a model building module, a traffic simulation module and a result verification module. According to the invention, by constructing the scheme decision model and judging the proper rescue and evacuation scheme under the current traffic state according to the input traffic flow parameters, the rapid rescue and evacuation of accidents during reconstruction and expansion are achieved, and the normal traffic flow running state is effectively recovered.
assignees: JIANGXI GANYUE EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Mining area earth surface subsidence prediction method based on VMD-SSA-LSTM
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of address disaster prediction, and discloses a mining area earth surface subsidence prediction method based on VMD-SSA-LSTM, aiming at improving the accuracy and reliability of earth surface subsidence prediction. The mining area earth surface subsidence prediction method comprises the steps of obtaining mining area multi-time phase earth surface subsidence data, preprocessing the data, decomposing the preprocessed data by adopting variation modal decomposition, extracting natural modal functions of different frequency components, carrying out singular spectrum analysis on main IMFs, constructing and training a long-period memory network model, inputting a time sequence after SSA reconstruction, outputting a future earth surface subsidence predicted value, optimizing model parameters by using a cross verification method, and finally carrying out earth surface subsidence prediction by using a model after training.
assignees: SHANXI JINCHENG ANTHRACITE MINING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;SHANXI JINCHENG SONGYU COAL IND CO LTD;UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Gas-electricity combined distribution network distribution robust extension planning method considering system toughness constraint
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of planning of a gas-electricity combined system and toughness improvement, in particular to a gas-electricity combined network distribution robust expansion planning method considering system toughness constraint, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a gas-electricity combined network expansion planning model taking the sum of operation cost and planning cost as an objective function, considering the capability of changing fuel supply load when natural gas of a dual-fuel unit is insufficient under a disaster in the aspect of improving the toughness, further modeling the construction of the dual-fuel unit and a connecting line, and considering constraints such as power distribution network reconstruction at the operation level, and secondly establishing a two-stage distribution robust expansion planning model considering the toughness constraint of the gas-electricity combined network system under the extreme disaster by using a distribution robust optimization method based on KL divergence to consider the uncertainty of the influence of the extreme disaster. The method can improve the economical efficiency of the gas-electricity combined distribution network in normal operation and enhance the toughness capability in extreme disasters.

title_en: Intelligent early warning method and system for underground engineering dynamic disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent early warning method and system for underground engineering dynamic disasters, which relate to the technical field of underground engineering dynamic disasters, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring microseismic history monitoring data of underground engineering; preprocessing microseismic historical monitoring data to obtain relevant time sequence parameters to obtain a reconstructed signal, obtaining a plurality of rolling statistical features of the reconstructed signal, selecting a preset number of rolling statistical features according to importance to form a rolling statistical feature matrix, constructing an underground engineering dynamic disaster prediction model, inputting a rolling statistical feature matrix dataset into the underground engineering dynamic disaster prediction model for training, obtaining real-time microseismic monitoring data, extracting a real-time rolling statistical feature matrix dataset, inputting the real-time rolling statistical feature matrix dataset into the trained underground engineering dynamic disaster prediction model, and outputting disaster early warning results. The invention realizes the efficient, accurate and intelligent early warning of underground engineering dynamic disasters.

title_en: Natural disaster monitoring method, system, device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of disaster monitoring, and provides a natural disaster monitoring method, a natural disaster monitoring device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the natural disaster monitoring method is used for obtaining a natural disaster image based on reconstruction of a natural disaster event stream by responding to the acquired natural disaster event stream acquired by a dynamic vision sensor; the method comprises the steps of identifying natural disaster images through an edge detection algorithm and an optical flow estimation algorithm to obtain occurrence positions and spreading features of natural disasters, identifying the natural disaster images through a space wavelet transformation algorithm and a space neighborhood filtering algorithm to obtain disaster grades of the natural disasters, generating early warning prompt information based on the occurrence positions, the spreading features, the disaster types and the disaster grades under the condition that the disaster grades meet early warning conditions, and outputting the early warning prompt information.

title_en: Monocular vision forest fire positioning method for unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monocular vision forest fire positioning method of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which aims to realize rapid detection, accurate positioning and three-dimensional reconstruction of early fire. According to the method, a comprehensive fire monitoring system is built by integrating various sensors such as an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, a visible light camera, an infrared camera, an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and the like. And the attitude of the camera is recovered in real time through monocular vision simultaneous localization and map construction (SLAM) technology and IMU-GNSS information fusion. And (3) utilizing a triangulation method and combining semantic information of visible light and infrared images to perform three-dimensional positioning on the fire disaster point. The structure slave motion (Structure from Motion, sfM) technology is adopted, the camera pose and the image characteristic point are combined, and the camera pose and the three-dimensional point cloud are optimized through global beam adjustment (Global Bundle Adjustment, GBA), so that the positioning accuracy is improved. The invention has the characteristics of high efficiency, accuracy, real time and remarkable cost benefit.
assignees: JIANGSU XINCHEN COMMUNICATION CO LTD;ZHOU ZHENGJUN

title_en: Underground comprehensive pipe gallery electric power cabin plugging selection method based on fire situation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for plugging and selecting an electric power cabin of an underground comprehensive pipe rack based on fire conditions, and relates to the technical field of urban underground management. The invention utilizes FDS fire dynamics simulation software to construct a full-size model of the electric power cabin of the underground utility tunnel and a full-size model of the electric power cabin of the non-plugging underground utility tunnel, simulates fire spreading conditions under the two models, records extinguishing time and fire spreading images, determines fire evolution under different conditions, selects whether to plug or not based on the extinguishing time and the fire spreading images, improves the safety and the fire resistance of the electric power cabin of the underground utility tunnel, stops further spreading of fire in time, improves resident safety, ensures social resources, is beneficial to subsequent reconstruction, and reduces resource waste.
assignees: CHENGDU FIRE SAFETY MANAGEMENT TECH SUPPORT CENTER

title_en: Smart fire extinguishing robot
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a smart fire extinguishing robot capable of detecting and extinguishing an initial fire in an electric facility or a communication facility of a power plant to prevent fire expansion and alert the outside. The smart fire extinguishing robot comprises an autonomous driving robot (100), an autonomous driving unit (200), a fire detection unit (300), a fire extinguishing unit (400), an alarm unit (500), a fire image photographing unit (600), a storage unit (700), a human body detection unit (800), and a control unit (900).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 발전소의 전기설비나 통신설비 등에서 초동화재의 감지 및 진압하여 화재확대를 방지하면서 외부에 경보할 수 있는 스마트 화재 진화 로봇에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명의 특징은, 바퀴(110)를 회전시키면서 바퀴(110)의 방향을 조종하여 자율 주행하는 자율 주행 로봇(100)과, 자율 주행 로봇(100)을 설정된 순찰위치로 주행시키는 자율 주행부(200)와, 자율 주행 로봇(100)에 구비되어 화재를 감지하는 화재감지부(300)와, 자율 주행 로봇(100)에 구비되어 소화약제를 분사하여 화재를 진화하는 화재진화부(400)와, 자율 주행 로봇(100)에 구비되어 화재감지부재(300)가 화재를 감지하면 경보하는 경보부(500)와, 자율 주행 로봇(100)에 구비되어 화재현장을 촬영하여 외부로 전송하는 화재영상촬영부(600)와, 자율 주행 로봇(100)에 구비되어 생존키트가 수납되는 수납부(700)와, 자율 주행 로봇(100)에 구비되어 인체를 감지하는 인체감지부(800)와, 자율 주행 로봇(100)이 순찰위치로 이동되도록 자율 주행부(200)를 제어하고, 화재감지부(300)의 감지를 확인하면 화재진화부(400), 경보부(500), 화재영상촬영부(600)를 제어하고, 인체감지부(800)가 인체를 감지하면 수납부(700)를 제어하는 제어부(900)를 포함한다.

title_en: Data protection device and method using synthetic data
title_ko: 재현데이터를 이용한 데이터보호 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a data protection device, and the data protection device may include a collection unit that collects and stores management data including sensitive information; an extraction unit that extracts management data to be provided as a target of an information provision request when a request for information provision is made from a user terminal; a generation unit that generates synthetic data, which is virtual data corresponding to the management data to be provided, based on the management data to be provided for data protection; and a provision unit that provides the generated synthetic data to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 데이터보호 장치에 관한 것이며, 데이터보호 장치는 민감정보를 포함한 관리데이터를 수집하여 저장하는 수집부; 사용자 단말에서 정보제공요청이 이루어진 경우, 상기 정보제공요청의 대상이 되는 제공대상 관리데이터를 추출하는 추출부; 데이터보호를 위해, 상기 제공대상 관리데이터를 기반으로 하여, 상기 제공대상 관리데이터에 대응하는 가상데이터인 재현데이터(synthetic data)를 생성하는 생성부; 및 상기 생성된 재현데이터를 상기 사용자 단말로 제공하는 제공부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency evacuation broadcasting device and method to guide evacuation using an on-premise broadcasting device based on artificial intelligence-based real-time fire scene activity detection
title_ko: 인공지능 기반 실시간 화재현장 활동 감지를 기초로 구내방송장치를 이용하여 대피를 유도하는 비상대피방송 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency evacuation broadcasting method performed by a central control unit. The emergency evacuation broadcasting method comprises: an access number monitoring step of constantly checking each number of people in a plurality of predetermined spaces located in a building based on an access signal; a fire alarm signal generation step of generating a fire alarm signal when a fire detection sensor detects whether there is a fire; a fire alarm signal transmission step of transmitting the fire alarm signal to a plurality of voice transmission devices installed in the building; an evacuation broadcasting transmission step of transmitting an emergency evacuation broadcasting from the voice transmission device receiving the fire alarm signal; an evacuation situation monitoring step of monitoring an evacuation situation based on the speed of change in the number of remaining people in each predetermined space; a rescue order setting step of setting a rescue priority from a space with a slow evacuation speed based on the evacuation situation monitoring step; and a rescue information transmission step of transmitting rescue order information set by the rescue order setting step to a manager.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 중앙 제어부에 의해 수행되는 비상대피방송 방법이며, 출입 신호를 바탕으로 건물 내에 위치한 복수 개의 소정의 공간 내에 있는 인원 수 각각을 상시 체크하는, 출입 인원 감시 단계, 화재 감지 센서가 화재 여부를 감지하면 화재 경보신호를 생성하는, 화재 경보신호 생성 단계, 화재 경보신호를 건물 내에 설치된 복수의 음성 송출장치에 전달하는, 화재 경보신호 전달 단계, 화재 경보신호를 전달받은 음성 송출장치로부터 비상 대피방송을 송출하는 대피방송 송출 단계, 각각의 소정의 공간 내의 잔류인원 수의 변화 속도에 기초하여 대피 상황을 감시하는, 대피상황 감시 단계, 대피상황 감시 단계에 기초하여, 대피 속도가 느린 공간부터 구조 우선순위로 설정하는 구조순서 설정 단계, 구조순서 설정 단계에 의해 설정된 구조순서 정보를 관리자에게 송신하는 구조정보 송신 단계를 포함하는 비상대피방송 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Emergency resource scheduling method and system based on mountain mass-sending landslide hazard
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency resource scheduling method and system based on mountain mass-sending landslide disasters, and relates to the technical field of disaster resource scheduling. The invention considers the toughness of disaster-stricken bodies and the risk value of disaster-stricken bodies, calculates the dangerous dimension value of mass-stricken landslide disaster-stricken factors in a mountain mass-stricken landslide disaster area, the sensitivity of mass-stricken landslide disaster-stricken environment, the social system toughness of community units or village units and the potential loss value of mass-stricken landslide hidden danger points by using a fuzzy hierarchy method, so that daily emergency material reserves are more scientific, the feasibility and efficiency of resource quantity distribution of disaster-stricken points are improved, a road network distance planning rescue scheme is abandoned, the running time from each emergency reserve pool to each disaster-stricken area is dynamically acquired by considering the use of a real-time Gode driving path planning API, the total running time is minimum as an objective function, emergency resources can be obtained at each disaster-stricken point in a short time, the rescue speed and the material guarantee capability after disaster are effectively improved, and the disaster toughness of the area is enhanced, and the post-disaster reconstruction is facilitated.

title_en: Fire scene simulation method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The application provides a fire scene simulation method, a fire scene simulation device, fire scene simulation equipment, a fire scene simulation storage medium and a fire scene simulation product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining object information of entity objects existing in a fire scene, determining adjustment coefficients corresponding to the entity objects according to the object information, wherein the adjustment coefficients represent importance of the entity objects in a fire scene simulation process, determining restoration finesses corresponding to the entity objects in the fire scene according to the adjustment coefficients, and reconstructing a three-dimensional model of each entity object in the fire scene according to the restoration finesses corresponding to the entity objects to obtain a simulation scene of the fire scene.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE IOT CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Quick reconstruction method for regional marine environment field based on ViT neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional marine environment field rapid reconstruction method based on ViT neural network, which belongs to the technical field of environment field reconstruction and is used for rapid reconstruction of marine environment fields, and comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source marine data, preprocessing, calculating the preprocessed multi-source marine data to obtain a density field, and constructing a multi-element coupling field according to a temperature field, a salinity field and the density field; a deep learning sample set is made, a training ViT environmental field generation model is constructed, and a trained ViT environmental field generation model is used for regional marine environmental field reconstruction. The invention comprehensively considers the coupling of ocean multi-element fields, realizes the reconstruction of the regional ocean temperature, salinity and density three-dimensional environment field, has the characteristics of accuracy, high resolution and rapidness, and can play the roles of data support and application guarantee in the fields of ocean disaster prevention and reduction, ocean ecosystems, ocean climate change and the like.

title_en: Goaf gas and coal spontaneous combustion composite disaster simulation system and prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a goaf gas and coal spontaneous combustion composite disaster simulation system and a prediction method, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine thermodynamic disaster evolution process simulation tests. The simulation system comprises a transparent cover body, a simulation test bed, a mining working face simulation model, an air supply unit, a monitoring unit, a camera device and a balancing weight. The inclination angle of the base is adjusted by adjusting the telescopic supporting legs, the water bag is utilized to simulate a coal bed, and the coal pillar is used as a methane release channel in the simulated exploitation process. Simulating a mining process, conveying gas, monitoring the evolution rule of methane and oxygen concentration data, drawing a relevant contour map, interpolating to reconstruct a space dangerous area, and finally adopting a phase space reconstruction method to conduct chaotic prediction and analyzing disaster space morphological changes. The invention can realize simulation test and visualization of the gas and coal spontaneous combustion composite disaster evolution process, quantitatively characterize the dangerous area, provide theoretical basis for disaster prevention and control, and ensure energy safety and worker life safety.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning system based on intelligent platform
abstract_en: The application provides a fire early warning system based on an intelligent platform, which relates to the field of fire early warning and comprises a plurality of fire monitoring devices, an integrated monitoring platform and an industrial ring network switch, wherein the fire monitoring devices are configured at different monitoring points and are used for collecting temperature, smoke and video data of a monitoring area in real time, the integrated monitoring platform is used for receiving, displaying and managing real-time fire information of each monitoring point, the integrated monitoring platform presents monitoring pictures through a Web interface of a B/S (browser/Server) framework and has the functions of real-time warning, video monitoring, video playback and historical warning query, and the industrial ring network switch is used for establishing a stable communication channel between the fire monitoring devices and the integrated monitoring platform so as to realize high-bandwidth and low-delay data transmission. Based on the system provided by the application, the fire situation can be monitored in real time, the accuracy of fire detection is improved, the false alarm rate is reduced, and a visual interface is provided, so that the management and the traceability analysis are convenient.
assignees: JIANGXI NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD;ZHONGNENG RONGHE SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: Micro-seismic quantitative prediction method based on theoretical model constraint and data driving fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microearthquake quantitative prediction method based on constraint and data driving fusion of a theoretical model, which comprises the steps of 1, obtaining original microearthquake data of a coal mine working face to form an initial sample data set, 2, preprocessing the data, dividing a training set and a testing set, 3, constructing a long and short memory network LSTM model, 4, sampling historical microearthquake data to serve as a microearthquake event quantitative prediction sample, 5, constructing a multi-target optimization model containing a microearthquake time fractal dimension, a microearthquake space fractal dimension, microearthquake energy fractal dimension, microearthquake prediction total energy, microearthquake reconstruction mining stress, microearthquake activity working procedures and seven sub-objective functions of a microearthquake energy-frequency power law b value, and 6, and obtaining an optimal sampling sample to serve as a prediction value. According to the invention, quantitative prediction of the microseismic event based on the combination of theoretical model constraint and data driving is realized through the steps, the prediction effect is good, and the prediction result can effectively guide the on-site production activity procedure regulation and control and the implementation of pressure relief measures and disaster early warning.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;YANMEI HEZE ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: Large-span coal shed and coal shed steel connection structure of coal discharging ditch and installation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-span coal shed and coal shed steel connection structure of a coal discharging ditch and an installation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of dry coal shed reconstruction of a coal yard of a power plant, wherein the large-span coal shed and coal shed steel connection structure comprises a main coal shed, a first-stage coal shed and a second-stage coal shed, and the first-stage coal shed and the second-stage coal shed are symmetrical arc-shaped; the side coal shed comprises a side shed roof, a first support and a second support, wherein the first support and the second support are connected to each other at the two sides of the side shed roof, the two shed faces are overlapped, the side coal shed is arranged on one side of the second coal shed, the side coal shed comprises a side shed roof, and the first support and the second support are connected to the two sides of the side shed roof, and one side of the side shed roof is obliquely fixed on the outer shed face of the second coal shed. The invention solves the problems that coal-containing sewage is easy to generate if coal blocks are scattered in the coal transportation process in rainy days due to the fact that the coal sheds are spaced, has strong load capacity, and can resist natural disasters such as snow storm, strong wind or earthquake.
assignees: HUANENG PINGLIANG POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Homogenization dimension reduction decoupling method for cooperative recovery of large-scale heterogeneous non-constant multi-energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale heterogeneous non-constant multi-energy system collaborative recovery homogenization dimension reduction decoupling method which comprises the steps of constructing an electric-gas-water multi-energy post-disaster load recovery time sequence decision double-layer optimization model under multiple coupling non-constant partial differential constraint based on a power grid dynamic reconstruction model, an air network compressible dynamic energy flow model and a water network non-constant hydrodynamic energy flow model, respectively carrying out space-time grid discretization on the power grid dynamic reconstruction model, the air network compressible dynamic energy flow model and the water network non-constant hydrodynamic energy flow model to form a coupling algebraic equation set, constructing a modeling state space based on the coupling algebraic equation set of the power grid, the air network and the water network, carrying out load recovery time sequence decision optimization dimension reduction model, and decoupling the electric-gas-water multi-energy post-disaster load recovery time sequence decision optimization dimension reduction model into three mutually independent scheduling sub-models with different time scales, so as to obtain the optimal solution of an original electric-gas-water multi-energy post-disaster load recovery time sequence decision optimization dimension reduction model.

title_en: Geological disaster deformation monitoring method based on remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster deformation monitoring method based on remote sensing data, which relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring and comprises the following steps of S1, data source selection and preprocessing, S2, region feature extraction, S3, multi-temporal remote sensing image difference, S4, time sequence analysis, S5, three-dimensional reconstruction of a deformation region, S6, settlement and landslide monitoring, S7, fusion analysis of environmental and meteorological data, S8, data anomaly detection and automatic early warning, and S9, risk assessment and influence analysis. According to the geological disaster deformation monitoring method based on the remote sensing data, the defect of single data source dependence in the prior art is overcome by combining SAR, optical images and LiDAR data, and the multi-dimensional real-time monitoring of the surface deformation is realized by using dynamic data fusion and time sequence analysis.
assignees: YUNNAN QUANCE JINGDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forestry remote sensing data light weight method based on subspace optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forestry remote sensing data light-weight method based on latent space optimization, which belongs to the technical field of image processing and comprises the steps of obtaining a forestry remote sensing image data set D1 to be compressed, constructing a data light-weight network, training the variable self-encoder and the image classification network by using the D1, generating a clustering data set D2 based on the encoder and the clustering unit, updating latent space variables in the D2 by using the training data light-weight network, and reconstructing data by using a decoder. The compression data set with high precision and representativeness is generated by improving the data set distillation based on the variation self-encoder and the meta-gradient optimization, so that the bottleneck problem of forestry remote sensing data set storage and processing is effectively solved, and the data storage capacity can be reduced while the model training precision is maintained. The method is suitable for various practical application scenes such as forestry resource monitoring, forest health evaluation, disaster response and the like.

title_en: Drought and waterlogging emergency prediction method, system and storage medium integrating artificial intelligence and physical mechanism
abstract_en: The application discloses a drought and flood emergency prediction method, system and storage medium integrating artificial intelligence and physical mechanism, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data in a selected drought and flood emergency study area, optimizing key factors affecting land water reserves in each grid point in the study area, constructing and calibrating a time convolution network deep learning model, using a long-series key factor set to drive the deep learning model, reconstructing a long-series land water reserve inversion data set, extracting atmospheric ring flow characteristics in drought and flood emergency events, constructing an atmospheric ring flow-drought and flood emergency response pairing series, pushing out nonlinear scale relation between drought and flood characteristics, and predicting drought and flood intensities and risks in future periods of each grid point. The application provides a new view for the drought and waterlogging emergency prediction, has important scientific significance for disaster prevention and reduction, and provides theoretical and technical basis for evaluating the environment and disaster effect of the earth system evolution.

title_en: Real-time monitoring video and emergency scene fusion method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of video monitoring and emergency scene fusion, and particularly relates to a fusion method of a real-time monitoring video and an emergency scene based on a convolutional neural network. The method utilizes a unified video platform to integrate multi-source video resources, performs format conversion and coding, ensures compatibility, adopts self-adaptive histogram equalization to enhance video quality, establishes an emergency scene database, analyzes abnormality through a convolutional neural network and matches the abnormality with the database to realize fusion of video and emergency scenes, stores the fused video in a centralized manner, selects key frames based on scene characteristic changes, and realizes a playback function. The invention solves the problems of video data dispersion, poor compatibility, delayed emergency response and the like in the existing power grid monitoring system, and improves the accuracy and efficiency of emergency treatment.
assignees: SHANDONG LURUAN DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for processing coal mine disaster data based on principal component analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for processing coal mine disaster data based on a principal component analysis method, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing and standardizing working data to obtain effective data, performing dimensionality reduction analysis on the effective data by utilizing PCA (principal component analysis), converting the effective data into a plurality of feature vectors, constructing a dimensionality reduction space of the effective data, respectively calculating a reconstruction error and an interpretation variance ratio corresponding to each feature vector in the dimensionality reduction space, constructing a dimensionality information adjustment dimensionality reduction space corresponding to each feature vector, inputting the effective data into the adjusted dimensionality reduction space for processing, generating the dimensionality reduction data of a coal mine, screening abnormal dimensionality reduction data segments which do not meet the specified interpretation variance ratio, obtaining disaster data corresponding to the coal mine under different detection dimensionalities, effectively reducing calculation steps, reducing analysis cost, and providing a powerful reference for managing staff to understand coming pulse of data and environment safety.
assignees: BEIJING LIANCHUANG GAOKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Effective signal filtering and noise reduction method and system for tunnel water-bursting and mud-bursting disaster microseismic event
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for effectively filtering and reducing noise of a micro-seismic event of a tunnel water and mud bursting disaster, and relates to the technical field of signal processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an original signal of a water and mud bursting microseismic event, carrying out modal decomposition on the original signal by utilizing a variation modal decomposition method to obtain a plurality of modal components, calculating a cross-correlation coefficient of the original signal and each modal component, carrying out primary noise reduction on the plurality of modal components based on the center frequency of each modal component and combining the cross-correlation coefficient, carrying out trend removal fluctuation analysis on the modal components subjected to primary noise reduction screening to obtain a scale index of the modal components subjected to primary noise reduction screening, carrying out secondary noise reduction based on the scale index, and carrying out reconstruction on the modal components subjected to secondary noise reduction screening to obtain the microseismic signal subjected to noise reduction and filtering. The invention solves the problem of mixing of noise and effective signals in partial modal components, and improves the extraction capability of weak signals.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;SICHUAN TIBET RAILWAY CO LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-functional post-disaster reconstruction robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional post-disaster reconstruction robot which comprises a ship-shaped body structure, a crawler belt, a support rod, a tire, a five-axis mechanical arm, a paw placing rack, a hydraulic shovel, an unmanned aerial vehicle case, a multifunctional storage box, a water pipe interface and the like, wherein the crawler belt, the support rod, the tire, the five-axis mechanical arm, the paw placing rack, the hydraulic shovel, the unmanned aerial vehicle case, the multifunctional storage box, the water pipe interface and the like are arranged on the ship-shaped body structure. The multifunctional post-disaster reconstruction robot can complete the functions of cleaning the surfaces of complex ruins, post-disaster water transportation, post-disaster area detection and the like during post-disaster reconstruction.

title_en: Fire control transformation fume extractor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of smoke discharging devices, in particular to a fire-fighting reconstruction smoke discharging device, which comprises a smoke discharging pipeline and a blast assembly arranged on the side surface of the smoke discharging pipeline, wherein a mounting bracket is connected in the smoke discharging pipeline, a filter screen is connected in the smoke discharging pipeline, the mounting bracket is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft, one end of the rotating shaft is connected with a dust removing component, the dust removing component comprises a connecting piece, the connecting piece is connected with a sliding bracket, the sliding bracket is slidingly connected with a sliding piece, the top of the sliding bracket is slidingly connected with a spring bracket, the top of the spring bracket is connected with the sliding piece, the spring bracket is connected with a scraper bracket, and the scraper bracket is connected with a scraper.
assignees: ANHUI ZHONGDAAN ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Optical fiber intelligent monitoring type buckling restrained energy dissipation brace
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an optical fiber intelligent monitoring type buckling restrained energy dissipation brace which comprises a core energy dissipation assembly, an optical fiber monitoring device and a stress restrained protection unit, wherein the core energy dissipation assembly at least comprises a reinforced connecting section and an elastic plastic core energy dissipation section, the reinforced connecting section is positioned at two ends of the core energy dissipation assembly and is used for being connected with a building structure, the elastic plastic core energy dissipation section is positioned in the middle of the core energy dissipation assembly, an installation bin is formed in the elastic plastic core energy dissipation section, the optical fiber monitoring device is arranged in the installation bin, the optical fiber monitoring device is connected with a data transmission line and is used for being connected with an external data processing system, and the stress restrained protection unit is at least sleeved on the periphery of the elastic plastic core energy dissipation section. The buckling restrained brace solves the problems that buckling restrained brace in the prior art is wide in application, specific energy consumption conditions, deformation data and the like cannot be collected, and basis cannot be provided for post-disaster reconstruction and post-earthquake product performance evaluation.

title_en: Mobile energy storage vehicle dispatching optimization method and system for power distribution network reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dispatching optimization method and a dispatching optimization system for a mobile energy storage vehicle facing to power distribution network reconstruction, wherein the method comprises the steps of pre-distributing the configuration quantity and positions of mobile energy storage in a pre-disaster prevention stage; in the post-disaster recovery stage, the influence of disasters on traffic network passing time is considered, dynamic scheduling and time sequence output characteristics of the mobile energy storage and the electric vehicle are combined, a multi-source collaborative post-disaster recovery scheduling optimization model matched with post-disaster power distribution network reconstruction is established with the aim of minimum load reduction power in the fault duration, and the post-disaster recovery scheduling optimization model is solved to obtain a scheduling optimization scheme of output positions and output time of the mobile energy storage and the electric vehicle resources in each scheduling period. According to the invention, through setting the two-stage guarantee power supply strategy of pre-disaster mobile energy storage pre-layout and post-disaster dynamic scheduling, the recovery amount of the power failure load can be increased after the power failure of the power distribution network in a large area, the transportation time of the mobile resource vehicle is shortened, the resource utilization efficiency is improved, and the toughness of the power distribution network is enhanced.
assignees: CHANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Database disaster recovery method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of database disaster recovery, and provides a database disaster recovery method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product, wherein the method comprises the steps of stopping updating a first main database when a database cluster needs to recover data and a first disaster recovery slave database is in a delayed replication state, and setting the first disaster recovery slave database to be in a direct data playback state; and stopping the data playback of the first disaster slave database and setting the first disaster slave database into the second master database under the condition that the delay time for delaying the copying reaches the difference time. When the first main database fails or is in misoperation, the first disaster recovery slave database and the first main database have delayed copying, and the first disaster recovery slave database does not apply the data in time, so that the data can be quickly recovered to the moment needing recovery only by accelerating the data playback.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE SUZHOU SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fault recovery method for power distribution network, computer program product and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a fault recovery method of a power distribution network, a computer program product and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power distribution network data at fault moment; the method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data of a power distribution network in a fault recovery period, constructing an optical storage and charging integrated power station model according to the meteorological data, determining a total adjustable power interval of the optical storage and charging integrated power station model, drawing a moving track of the meteorological disaster according to the meteorological data, determining the moving speed of the meteorological disaster, dividing the fault recovery period according to the moving speed to obtain a plurality of time periods, reconstructing a network topology structure of the power distribution network in the time periods according to the power distribution network data to obtain a target topology structure, calculating loop closing impact current according to the target topology structure, carrying out safety check on the loop closing impact current, and adjusting the power of the optical storage and charging integrated power station according to the total adjustable power interval when the loop closing impact current does not pass through the safety check. The application solves the problem of lower safety in the fault recovery process of the power distribution network in the prior art.

title_en: System and method for providing reconstructing cultural assets based on augmented reality and augmented reality device for the same
title_ko: 증강 현실 기반 문화재 복원 서비스 제공 시스템 및 방법 및 이를 위한 증강 현실 디바이스
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for providing a cultural property restoration service based on augmented reality, a method using the same, and an augmented reality device therefor. The system for providing a cultural property restoration service based on augmented reality comprises: a cultural property identification unit for identifying a cultural property to be restored based on a restoration request signal for a partially lost cultural property received from an augmented reality device; and a restored image management unit for transmitting restored image information for a restored image of a lost part corresponding to the identified cultural property to the augmented reality device. The augmented reality device displays the restored image corresponding to the restored image information as a virtual image in an image output unit, thereby providing a cultural property image in which the lost part is restored to a user observing a cultural property, which is a real object in which a part is lost.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 증강 현실 디바이스로부터 수신한 일부가 소실된 문화재에 대한 복원 요청 신호에 기초하여 복원할 문화재를 식별하는 문화재 식별부; 및 상기 식별된 문화재에 상응하는 소실 부분의 복원 영상에 대한 복원 영상 정보를 증강 현실 디바이스로 전송하는 복원 영상 관리부를 포함하고, 상기 증강 현실 디바이스는, 상기 복원 영상 정보에 상응하는 복원 영상을 화상 출사부에서 가상 영상으로써 표시함으로써, 일부가 소실된 실제 사물인 문화재를 관찰하는 사용자에게 소실 부분이 복원된 문화재 영상을 제공하는 것을 특징으로 하는 증강 현실 기반 문화재 복원 서비스 제공 시스템 및 이를 이용한 방법 및 이를 위한 증강 현실 디바이스를 제공한다.

title_en: Dynamic network reconstruction strategy for digital power energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic network reconstruction strategy of a digital electric power energy storage system in the technical field of electric power energy storage, which comprises an intelligent layer, a control layer and a data layer, wherein the intelligent layer, the control layer and the data layer are built, the energy storage network is modeled, an optimal control strategy of the energy storage network is learned by adopting a graph capsule neural network, the dynamic network reconstruction is performed, a fault emergency response model is generated based on a Markov decision process, the rapid isolation of a fault area is realized by systematically optimizing the topological structure and the optimal control strategy of the energy storage network, the dynamic adjustment and reconfiguration of the working modes of energy storage equipment and load equipment are realized, the stable operation of the energy storage network under the fault situation is ensured, the flexibility and the elasticity (fault tolerance) of the energy storage system in a dynamic environment are improved, the technical problems existing in the prior art are solved by reducing the energy loss in the transmission process, the network load is balanced, and the local fault is prevented, and the sustainable development of a novel renewable energy system is promoted.

title_en: Texture protection-based historical neighborhood fire-fighting evacuation optimization method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a texture protection-based historical block fire evacuation optimization method and device, which comprises the steps of S1 extracting building data of a target historical block from a plan, S2 calculating to obtain an initial reconstruction scheme according to the building data, S3 randomly selecting a batch of buildings from the target historical block, deleting data corresponding to the batch of buildings from the building data to obtain building data of a current iteration round, S4 calculating to obtain a reconstruction scheme of the current iteration round according to the building data of the current iteration round, S5 judging whether to terminate iteration according to the reconstruction scheme of the current iteration round, the reconstruction scheme of the previous iteration round, the initial reconstruction scheme and preset termination conditions, if yes, executing S6, otherwise executing S3, and calculating to obtain an optimal reconstruction scheme according to all reconstruction schemes by S6. In a word, the method can generate the optimal reconstruction scheme for giving consideration to fire evacuation and traditional texture protection to the historical blocks.

title_en: Simultaneous gas multi-component analysis technique using GC-MS and LC-MS for forensic investigation
title_ko: 과학수사를 위하여 gc-ms와 lc-ms를 이용한 기체 다성분 동시분석 기법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simultaneous multi-component gas analysis method using GC-MS and LC-MS for forensic investigation. More specifically, by using the technique of the present invention, it is possible to identify an event through ignitable materials at the site in the event of a fire, and by applying the technique, it will be possible to expand and apply the technique to various sites where gas evidence may occur. The technique of the present invention is a technique that enables various material analysis of gas at an event site by applying and analyzing LC-MS with a wider analysis range than existing GC-MS for gas evidence analysis. That is, in the past, the target analyte was limited to volatile components using only GC-MS to analyze the gas at the event site, but it would be possible to analyze LC-MS by dissolving a gaseous material in a solvent through an impinger, and it would be possible to provide in-depth information on the fire site by cross-verifying GC-MS and LC-MS data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 과학수사를 위하여 GC-MS와 LC-MS를 이용한 기체 다성분 동시분석 기법에 관한 것이다. 더욱 구체적으로는 본 발명의 기법을 활용하면 화재 시 현장의 발화성물질을 통해 사건을 파악이 가능하며, 해당 기법을 적용하여 기체증거가 발생할 수 있는 다양한 현장에 확장 적용할 수 있을 것이다. 본 발명의 기법은 기체 증거 분석을 위해 기존의 GC-MS 보다 분석 범위가 더 넓은 LC-MS도 함께 적용 분석하여 사건 현장 기체의 다양한 물질 분석이 가능하게 만든 기법이다. 즉, 기존에는 사건 현장 기체를 분석하기 위해 GC-MS만을 사용하여 대상 분석물이 휘발성 성분으로 한정되었으나, 임핀저(impinger)를 통해 가스상 물질을 용매에 녹여 LC-MS의 분석이 가능하게 하고, GC-MS 및 LC-MS 데이터를 교차 검증하여 화재현장에 대한 심층적인 정보 제공이 가능할 것이다.

title_en: Multi-source traffic operation data analysis method and system based on AI sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a multisource traffic operation data analysis method and system based on AI sensor fusion, which can realize accurate reconstruction and dynamic monitoring of interchange space scenes of high-speed road sections. The traffic operation data flow is generated through the AI sensor fusion acquisition technology, the detailed traffic dynamic change map is further analyzed, meanwhile, the driving behavior data block and the non-driving behavior data block are effectively separated through block mapping and fine extraction of road domain perception data, a data base is provided for in-depth analysis of traffic state influence factors, the traffic dynamic change map after further optimization is combined with the interchange space scene, the traffic safety risk trend can be accurately estimated, and the traffic safety risk trend data with foresight can be generated, so that targeted safety prompt suggestion can be timely generated, the traffic safety management level and emergency response capability of a high-speed road section are remarkably improved, the occurrence of traffic accidents is effectively prevented and reduced, and public travel safety is guaranteed.
assignees: RES INST HIGHWAY MINI TRANSP;UNIV CHONGQING JIAOTONG

title_en: Energy storage unit for elevator outage descent control device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an energy storage unit for a power-off slow-descent device of an elevator, which is applied to the field of electric energy storage, and is characterized in that the power failure replay process is carried out in the idle period of the elevator, the emergency response effect of an energy storage module is tested, the energy storage module is effectively ensured to be in a good working state, the performance reduction or failure problem caused by long-term unused energy storage module is reduced, meanwhile, the failure fault of the energy storage module can be timely found, the casualties or the damage probability of goods caused by the failure of the energy storage module in the actual situation is greatly reduced, the stability of the energy storage module during charging can be effectively judged by monitoring and analyzing the voltage, the current and the temperature of the energy storage module during charging, the service life and the health condition of the energy storage module are further judged to a certain extent, the potential problem of the energy storage module is found in advance, and when the potential problem occurs, the life early warning is carried out to a remote monitoring terminal, meanwhile, the interval duration of the power failure replay is shortened, and the failure condition of the abnormal energy storage module is conveniently detected in time.
assignees: ZHONGJIE JIANZHAO JIANGSU INTELLIGENT ELEVATOR CO LTD

title_en: Grooving equipment for fire extinguishing system reconstruction engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses slotting equipment for fire-fighting system reconstruction engineering, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting engineering tools. The novel dust box comprises a connecting block and a dust surrounding box, wherein a moving assembly is arranged on the right side of the connecting block, a rocker is fixedly connected to the left side of the dust surrounding box, a telescopic assembly is arranged on the right side of the inner wall of the dust surrounding box, a T-shaped connecting rod is fixedly connected to the right side of the connecting block, a connecting rod II is fixedly connected to the left side of the T-shaped connecting rod, the moving assembly comprises a claw, and a connecting rod I is fixedly connected to the back of the claw. According to the grooving machine provided with the dust surrounding box, a worker holds the holding rod control device and drives the holding rod control device to move and work through the wheels, the worker does not need to bend down, the body loss of the worker is reduced, broken stone is surrounded by the dust surrounding box and is prevented from being sputtered, the damage to the worker is reduced, after the surrounding is finished, the broken stone can be concentrated, and the cleaning is convenient.
assignees: XINGQISHENG BEIJING CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Mechanical arm capable of realizing multifunctional integration of grabbing drill and sawing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mechanical arm capable of realizing multi-functional integration of a drill grabbing saw, which comprises a mechanical arm body and an end effector, wherein the end effector is provided with a fixing device, one side of the fixing device is provided with a connecting piece, the fixing device is hinged with a driving end of the mechanical arm body through the connecting piece, the other side of the fixing device is provided with a clamping jaw, an electric saw and a drill bit, the clamping jaws are arranged in a pair at intervals, each clamping jaw comprises a big claw and a small claw which are matched with each other, the big claw and the small claw are hinged with the fixing device, the big claw is driven by a claw motor II, the small claw is driven by a claw motor I, and the electric saw and the drill bit are arranged between the two clamping jaws. The mechanical arm is provided with the fixing device, and the clamping jaw, the electric saw and the drill bit are arranged on one side of the fixing device, so that the clamping jaw can be used for grabbing, and the electric saw and the drill bit can be used for respectively completing the work of the drill saw. The device can finish one or more of grabbing, drilling and sawing according to the needs, and can better meet the needs of disaster relief and post-disaster reconstruction.

title_en: Fire-fighting main machine of electric bicycle shed
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting host machine of an electric bicycle shed, wherein a water pressure pump and a sealed foam fire-extinguishing agent box are arranged in a water tank, the capacity of the water tank is the number of spray heads for controlling spraying, the flow rate/the spray head are the number of spray heads for controlling spraying, an insulating layer is arranged on the outer side of the water tank, after the scheme is adopted, the water pressure pump and the foam fire-extinguishing agent are arranged in the water tank without independently arranging the fire-extinguishing host machine, so that the fire-fighting host machine saves the cost, is suitable for fire-fighting reconstruction of the electric bicycle shed, and the insulating layer is arranged outside the water tank, so that the fire-extinguishing agent is convenient to use in winter in northern China.

title_en: Disaster simulation method, device and system for concrete dam lesions
abstract_en: The invention provides a concrete dam lesion catastrophe simulation method, device and system, which are characterized by analyzing and pre-judging influence factors influencing dam safety based on engineering basic information data and combining history experience, providing possible main influence factors of engineering lesion catastrophe, establishing a finite element model, setting lesion catastrophe indexes and grading standards, giving a threshold value of each grade, pre-generating an isolated unit grid model, adopting a finite element method to calculate and analyze to obtain dam deformation, stress and damage calculation results, carrying out dam concrete cracking judgment based on cracking indexes and threshold values, loading and adopting finite element calculation, carrying out local cracking when any dam unit reaches a cracking threshold value, reconstructing a dam body grid, and carrying out iterative calculation by adopting a finite element+DDA method until the dam deformation, stress, damage and cracking results are stable after reconstruction. The invention effectively solves the problems of calculation efficiency, calculation precision and concrete lesion catastrophe simulation.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle control method based on emergency event of chemical industry park
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle control method based on an emergency event of a chemical industry park, which comprises the steps of generating a three-dimensional temperature field image by matching a thermal imaging camera, a close-range camera and a three-dimensional laser camera of a fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle; the method comprises the steps of reconstructing flames in a three-dimensional temperature field image through a flame convolution neural network model to generate a flame three-dimensional slice, determining a fire extinguishing stage according to the flame three-dimensional slice, determining fire extinguishing agent types, foam multiples and release tracking positions of a fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle for executing a fire extinguishing agent foam echelon superposition release strategy according to the fire extinguishing stage, and determining control parameters, communication laser wavelength and energy transmission laser wavelength of a laser communication energy transmission system of the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle according to the release tracking positions and the flame three-dimensional slice. The fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle can automatically execute the foam echelon superposition throwing of the fire extinguishing agent, ensures that the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle can rapidly reduce the fire scene temperature of a chemical industry park, and prevents the expansion and the reburning of fire.
assignees: XINJIANG HUIYE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;XINJIANG TIANYE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Coating material for heat insulation to prevent flame penetration into the pipe insulation material
title_ko: 배관 보온재에 화염 침투를 방지하기 위한  차열용 코팅재
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to protect human life from toxic gas which can be generated by ignition of a pipe heat insulator by being formed in a liquid or dough form to be easily stored and transported to an installation site in a container to be easily applied to an outer circumferential surface of the pipe heat insulator and to easily adjust an application thickness. The present invention provides a coating material for heat insulation to prevent flame penetration into a pipe heat insulating material, which is formed of a mixed solution in which 70 parts by weight of expanded graphite formed by adding sulfuric acid to particles of graphite having a particle size of 50 mesh or more and 80 mesh or less of graphite particles and 30 parts by weight of a binder are mixed with 70 parts by weight of expanded graphite, and is applied to the outer circumferential surface of the pipe heat insulating material to a predetermined thickness. The present invention is easy to store and transport to an installation site, is liquid to be easily applied to the outer circumferential surface of a pipe heat insulating material, and can easily adjust the coating thickness to prevent penetration of flames to protect lives from toxic gases that can occur due to ignition, and can quickly and safely escape from a fire site to protect the lives and property of the people.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 배관의 외주면에 기 적용되어 있는 수지 발포폼으로 된 배관 보온재의 외주면에 도포되어 외부로부터 소정 온도의 고열이 가해졌을 때 스스로 산화되며 팽창하여 순식간에 소정 두께의 탄화막을 형성하여 산소의 공급을 차단함으로써 배관 보온재 내부로 화염이 침투되는 것을 방지할 수 있도록 배관 보온재의 외주면에 적용되는 배관 보온재에 화염 침투를 방지하기 위한  차열용 코팅재에 관한 것이다. 
상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명인 배관 보온재에 화염 침투를 방지하기 위한  차열용 코팅재는, 흑연 입자 50mesh 이상 80mesh 이하 입자크기의 흑연의 편상에 황산을 투입하여 형성한 팽창흑연(100) 70중량부에 바인더(200) 30중량부를 혼합한 혼합액(300)으로 형성되어, 배관 보온재(20) 외주면에 소정 두께로 용이하게 도포되어 배관 보온재 보호커버(500)의 내면에 적용됨으로써, 배관 보온재 보호커버(500)의 외부로부터 고열의 화염이 접근되었을 때 소정 온도에서 스스로 산화되며 팽창 발포되어 소정 두께의 탄화막(310)을 형성하여 산소의 공급을 차단함으로써 배관 보온재의 착화를 방지하고 배관 보온재를 통한 화재의 확산을 방지하게 되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
상기와 같이 구성되는 본 발명인 배관 보온재에 화염 침투를 방지하기 위한  차열용 코팅재에 의하면, 보관과 설치 현장 까지의 운반이 용이하고, 액상으로 되어 있어 배관 보온재 외주면에 도포가 용이함은 물론 도포 두께를 쉽게 조절할 수 있고, 화재 발생시 화염의 침투를 방지하여 발화에 의해 발생될 수 있는 유독가스로부터 인명을 보호하고 화재현장으로부터 신속하고 안전하게 탈출할 수 있도록 하여 국민의 생명과 재산을 보호할 수 있는 배관 보온재에 화염 침투를 방지하기 위한  차열용 코팅재가 제공되게 된다.

title_en: Method of Manufacturing Contaminated Fabric and Method of Evaluating Effectiveness of Cleaning Fire Protective Clothing using Contaminated Fabric Manufactured by the Method
title_ko: 오염포의 제조 방법 및 그 제조 방법으로 제조된 오염포를 이용한 방화복의 세척 유효성을 평가하는 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a contaminated cloth, which manufactures a contaminated cloth similar to a fire-fighting clothes exposed to toxic substances generated at a fire site to easily evaluate the cleaning effectiveness of the fire-fighting clothes, and a method for evaluating the cleaning effectiveness of the fire-fighting clothes using the contaminated cloth manufactured by the manufacturing method.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재현장에서 발생한 독성물질에 노출된 소방 방화복과 유사한 오염포를 제조하도록 하여 소방 방화복의 세척 유효성 평가를 용이하게 진행할 수 있도록 하는 오염포의 제조 방법 및 그 제조 방법으로 제조된 오염포를 이용한 방화복의 세척 유효성을 평가하는 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System for playing information for disabled people using artificial intelligence technology
title_ko: 인공지능 기술을 적용한 장애인용 정보 플레이 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an information play system connected to a user terminal through a network comprises: an information providing unit for transmitting and outputting provided information to the user terminal; a sign language playback unit for transmitting and outputting sign language information corresponding to the provided information output to the user terminal to the user terminal; and a playback control unit for controlling the sign language information output to the user terminal. The information play system increases information accessibility by providing information to a hearing-impaired user in real time, and provides accurate and rapid information using artificial intelligence so that the user can easily and accurately check the information in a form suitable for the user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 정보 플레이 시스템은, 사용자 단말기와 네트워크를 통해 연결되는 정보 플레이 시스템에 있어서, 사용자 단말기에 제공 정보를 전송하여 출력하는 정보 제공부; 사용자 단말기에 출력되는 제공 정보에 대응되는 수어 정보를 사용자 단말기에 전송하여 출력하는 수어 재생부; 및 사용자 단말기에 출력되는 수어 정보를 제어하는 재생 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 할 수 있고, 청각 장애인인 사용자에게 실시간으로 정보를 제공하여 정보 접근성을 높이고, 인공지능을 활용한 정확하고 신속한 정보를 제공하여 사용자로 하여금 자신에 적합한 형태로 용이하고 정확하게 정보를 확인 가능하도록 한다.

title_en: Apparatus for Simulating Felling Down of Tree Model for Education
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for simulating a felling down phenomenon for education, which can awaken the risk of a felling down phenomenon to a worker to prevent a safety accident during felling work. A simulation device (1) of the present invention includes a tree model (10) and an electromagnet adjusting means (30). The tree model comprises a notch part (11) which is concavely positioned in one side and a back cut part (12) which is positioned in the opposite side of the notch part and pursuit part and a hinge part (15) which is positioned between the notch part and the back cut part. In addition, the electromagnet adjusting means may apply or block electromagnetic force, by unit grid, between the upper surface and the lower surface of the back cut part. Such a simulation device is very useful as field education because it is possible to repeatedly simulate various felling down phenomena under the same conditions as in the felling down work site.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 벌도목 작업시 안전 사고 예방을 위하여 작업자에게 벌도 현상의 위험성을 일깨워줄 수 있는 교육용 벌도 현상 재현장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 재현장치(1)는 수목 모형(10)과 전자석 조정수단(30)을 포함한다. 상기 수목 모형은 일측에 오목하게 위치하는 수구부(11)와, 상기 수구부의 반대쪽 타측에 위치하는 추구부(12)와, 상기 수구부와 추구부 사이에 위치하는 벌도맥부(15)를 구비한다. 또한 상기 전자석 조정수단은 상기 추구부의 상면과 하면 사이에 단위 격자로 전자기력을 인가 또는 차단할 수 있다. 이러한 재현장치는 벌도작업 현장에서와 같은 조건 하에 반복적으로 다양한 벌도 현상을 재현할 수 있어 현장 교육로써 매우 유용하다.

title_en: Water and soil loss intelligent monitoring system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water and soil monitoring, in particular to an intelligent water and soil loss monitoring system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a ground surface remote sensing image data acquisition module, a remote sensing image data acquisition module and a data processing module, wherein the remote sensing image data acquisition module acquires remote sensing image data covering a monitoring area through a remote sensing satellite; the disaster tracing module carries out loss path reconstruction based on the remote sensing image data repaired by the perturbation sensing compensation module, simulates a diffusion path of water and soil loss and carries out loss tracing based on the diffusion path. According to the invention, water and soil loss control guidance of a key area is provided, the accuracy and efficiency of water and soil loss tracing are improved, and powerful technical support is provided for source identification and control decision of water and soil loss.
assignees: SOIL AND WATER CONSERVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF SHANXI AGRICULTURAL UNIV SHANXI SOIL AND WATER CON

title_en: Dust purification device for fire extinguishing system reconstruction engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust purification device for fire-fighting system reconstruction engineering, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting reconstruction. The utility model comprises a purifying box, wherein a filter box is arranged in the purifying box, a filter mechanism is arranged in the filter box, an air inlet mechanism is arranged on the purifying box and is communicated with the filter box, an air pump is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the filter box, a communication pipe is fixedly arranged at the air outlet end of the air pump, a humidifying mechanism is arranged at one end of the communication pipe, a water supply mechanism is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the bottom end of the purifying box, and the water supply mechanism is communicated with the humidifying mechanism. The utility model can carry out targeted dust fall on the area, thereby reducing the dust content of the air at the position of the constructor, and the air discharged through the humidifying pipe can increase the water vapor content, thereby further carrying out auxiliary dust fall and improving the air quality of the area where the constructor is located.
assignees: JIANGSU PEIXIN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Dust recovery mechanism is reformed transform in fire control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting reconstruction dust recycling mechanism, which comprises a first air suction pipe fixedly communicated with a hose at the output end of an air suction fan, wherein a second air suction pipe is arranged in the first air suction pipe in a sliding manner, a sealing plate is connected in the inner thread of the second air suction pipe far away from the end of the first air suction pipe, a positioning mechanism is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the first air suction pipe, the positioning mechanism can limit the second air suction pipe, the section of a dust suction opening is horn-shaped, the opening is arranged towards the outer end, a rubber block is arranged in a positioning groove in a sliding manner, the rubber block is hemispherical, the second air suction pipe is connected to the first air suction pipe in a sliding manner through the positioning mechanism, the second air suction pipe can slide out of the first air suction pipe by different lengths according to requirements, the dust suction area is increased, the dust suction efficiency is improved, the second air suction pipe is connected with the first air suction pipe into a whole through the positioning mechanism, and workers do not need to carry about, and the second air suction pipe is prevented from being lost.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA TIANXING SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data cleaning method for intelligent active early warning system for expressway safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data cleaning method of an intelligent active early warning system for highway safety, which comprises the steps of collecting highway environment data and data in a triaxial acceleration sensor in real time, generating a structured data table, transmitting the data in the structured data table to a cloud for storage by utilizing an encryption algorithm of a communication protocol, carrying out data abnormality judgment on the stored data, cleaning the stored abnormal data by adopting different data cleaning modes according to data abnormality judgment results, carrying out data reconstruction and result verification on the cleaned abnormal data to form the data cleaning method of the intelligent active early warning system for highway safety, and through the study of data cleaning, the method not only can improve the effectiveness and reliability of the data, reduce the misjudgment of the early warning system, improve the running efficiency of the early warning system, but also can ensure the trip safety of vehicle staff on the highway and effectively reduce the probability of traffic accidents.

title_en: AVAE-RF-based method and system for forecasting flood disaster risk level
abstract_en: The invention discloses a AVAE-RF-based method and a AVAE-RF-based system for predicting a flood disaster risk level, which are used for acquiring initial data of a research area, constructing an initial flood disaster sample matrix by utilizing key disaster causing factors and a flood disaster index, further comprising four flood disaster subsampled matrices, constructing a AVAE sample generation model, realizing sample matrix expansion based on a AVAE sample generation model trained by an countermeasure network to obtain a reconstructed flood disaster sample matrix, constructing an RF multi-feature flood disaster risk level intelligent prediction model, constructing a TPE super-parameter optimization module, optimizing super-parameters of the RF multi-feature flood disaster risk level intelligent prediction model by using the TPE super-parameter optimization module, and performing interpretable analysis on an intelligent prediction model by introducing contribution values SHAP of each key disaster causing factor of each sample in the flood disaster sample matrix to a prediction result. The method can realize the prediction of the risk of the flood disaster with high accuracy and high credibility.

title_en: Network reconstruction method and device for power distribution network considering typhoon disasters, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network reconstruction method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium of a power distribution network considering typhoon disasters, wherein the method is characterized in that according to typhoon data and the geographic position of each element in the power distribution network, predicting the line fault probability of each transmission line in the power distribution network, and then generating a plurality of fault scenes of the power distribution network according to the line fault probability to realize quantitative evaluation on the operation risk of the power distribution network under typhoon disasters. And constructing a two-stage network reconstruction model aiming at minimizing the network reconstruction cost and aiming at minimizing the load loss of the power distribution network according to the network topology model and the fault scene set of the power distribution network, solving the two-stage network reconstruction model, and finally obtaining a target network reconstruction strategy formed by target solutions of all decision variables according to the two-stage network reconstruction model. Therefore, the invention can provide a network reconstruction strategy which takes economy and feasibility into consideration for the power distribution network under the specific scene of typhoon disasters.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Highway tunnel fire time-varying temperature field reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a road tunnel fire time-varying temperature field reconstruction method, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining the ignition ranges of vehicles with different fire source powers of tunnel fires, S2, determining the ignition time of vehicles nearby fire sources in the development process of the tunnel fires, S3, calibrating the heat release rate of multiple fire sources in a tunnel fire scale test, S4, setting a tunnel fire spreading numerical simulation heat release rate curve, S5, establishing a tunnel fire temperature field database, S6, designing a tunnel fire reconstruction temperature field sensor array layout mode, S7, providing an interpolation method for reconstructing the tunnel fire temperature field, S8, generating a real-time temperature cloud image of the tunnel fire temperature field, S9, drawing reconstructed temperature field cloud images formed by combining different sensor array layouts and interpolation methods, S10, evaluating the interpolation precision of each layout of the tunnel fire temperature field reconstruction, predicting the fire spreading distance and time according to the temperature field reconstruction method, improving the fire fighting rescue intelligent degree, and guaranteeing the life and property safety of people to the greatest extent.

title_en: Forest fire early warning method and system based on super-resolution nerve operator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest fire identification and early warning, in particular to a forest fire early warning method and system based on a super-resolution nerve operator, which comprises the following steps of extracting a low-resolution forest fire image to be identified The initial feature map Constructing a super-resolution feature capturing network, and constructing an initial feature map by three HAFM hierarchical attention fusion modules, a MSMO multi-scale mapping operator module, a super-resolution feature fusion module and a super-resolution image reconstruction module Inputting the image to a super-resolution feature capturing network, and finally outputting a super-resolution image Constructing a forest fire identification module and forming a super-resolution image Inputting into ResNet-18 neural network model to obtain identification feature Finally, identifying the features And obtaining a recognition result of the forest fire image through the full-connection layer processing, and judging whether to perform early warning according to the recognition result. The invention can solve the problems that the low-resolution fire images cannot be accurately identified and early-warned in time in the existing forest fire identification and detection.
