title_en: Method, device and equipment for identifying same-earthquake landslide without supervision depth clustering
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for identifying the same earthquake landslide without supervision depth clustering, which relate to the technical field of graphic image processing and comprise the steps of acquiring a multi-source data set, preprocessing the multi-source data set, converting the multi-source data set into a preset image format, inputting a multi-spectrum remote sensing image in the multi-source data set into a remote sensing feature extraction branch to perform feature reconstruction to obtain a first type of feature, and inputting normalized vegetation index NDVI, topographic data, geographic data, geological map and seismic data in the multi-source data set into an implicit knowledge feature extraction branch to obtain a second type of feature; and under the supervision of the soft labels, the first type of features and the second type of features are fused and clustered, and the same-earthquake landslide category corresponding to the region to be detected is determined based on the clustering result. By constructing implicit knowledge features, a landslide disaster mechanism can be implicitly captured and expressed in a model through node features and graph structures, and the identification accuracy is improved.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction method based on transformer and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological engineering, in particular to a geological disaster prediction method based on a transformer and deep learning, which comprises the steps of collecting and processing geological information and deleting abnormal values in geological information data sets; the method comprises the steps of signal processing, namely determining embedding dimension and delay time, processing historical geological disaster data by using a dynamic system reconstruction method, reconstructing a weight matrix, and converting a one-dimensional time sequence into a track in a high-dimensional phase space so as to obtain periodic change of geological disasters. The method can effectively optimize the weight parameters and the bias parameters in the model by applying the Adam optimizer, thereby achieving the aim of minimizing the loss, and simultaneously, an effective model can be obtained by training the model, and the capability of the model is evaluated by using the models so as to be compared with other models.

title_en: Power distribution network running state determining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for determining the running state of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining environment data, a power distribution network fault model and the current running state of the power distribution network; the method comprises the steps of determining fault conditions corresponding to a plurality of nodes and a plurality of branches at a plurality of moments according to environment data and a power distribution network fault model, constructing an elastic lifting model of the power distribution network based on the current running state of the power distribution network, the fault conditions corresponding to the plurality of nodes and the plurality of branches at the plurality of moments and corresponding condition constraints, solving a target comprising the maximum value of the sum of load recovery degrees at the plurality of moments and the minimum value of switching times of the switching states at the plurality of moments, solving the elastic lifting model of the power distribution network, and determining the running state of the power distribution network in a preset time period. Based on the method, a multi-target long-time-effect dynamic power distribution network reconstruction scheme for improving the elasticity of the power distribution network can be obtained, and the load recovery amount of the power distribution network after a period of disaster evolution can be greatly improved.

title_en: Building fire drilling evaluation system and method based on WiFi signal positioning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building fire drilling evaluation system and method based on WiFi signal positioning, belonging to the technical field of rescue drilling, and comprising a vision capturing module, a visual monitoring module and a building fire monitoring module, wherein the vision capturing module is used for capturing drilling scenes and identifying rescue workers and rescuees in the scenes; the system comprises a WiFi signal module, a data processing module, an effect evaluation module and a control module, wherein the WiFi signal module is used for capturing WiFi signal changes and analyzing signal reflection characteristics so as to track personnel position and action changes, the data processing module is used for synchronizing and fusing video data collected by the video capturing module and WiFi signal data and extracting characteristics, and the effect evaluation module is used for automatically generating detailed exercise evaluation reports which comprise key indexes, behavior analysis and video playback. The invention can simulate the conditions of escape and position of personnel in the building and the rescue conditions of rescue personnel when disasters occur.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Emergency control method and medium for information-physical cross-space cooperation under false data injection attack
abstract_en: The invention provides an information-physical cross-space cooperative emergency control method and medium under false data injection attack, belonging to the technical field of intelligent power grids, comprising the steps of constructing an emergency control model according to the characteristics of information network attack and the running state of a physical system; the emergency control model comprises an information layer data recovery model for optimizing the accuracy rate and the deviation rate of data recovery and a physical layer power distribution network reconstruction model for optimizing the network topology, a multi-task residual error attention hypergraph neural network is adopted to solve the emergency control model, an optimal data recovery scheme and an optimal power distribution network topology reconstruction strategy are obtained, data recovery is carried out according to the optimal data recovery scheme, and power distribution network topology rapid switching is achieved according to the optimal power distribution network topology reconstruction strategy. According to the method, the influence of the accuracy and the instantaneity of data recovery on the reconstruction of the power distribution network is considered, an emergency control model based on cooperation of the data recovery and the reconstruction of the power distribution network is constructed, the emergency response capability of the power distribution network is improved, and the safe operation of the power distribution network is ensured.

title_en: A construction waste cleaning device for rebuilding after disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of construction waste cleaning, in particular to a construction waste cleaning device for post-disaster reconstruction, which comprises a first mounting seat, wherein two movable grooves are symmetrically formed in the inner wall of the first mounting seat, a cleaning mechanism is arranged between the two movable grooves, the upper end of the interior of the first mounting seat is rotationally connected with a mounting plate, the mounting plate is obliquely arranged, the height of one side of the mounting plate is higher than that of the first mounting seat, a conveying belt is arranged in the mounting plate, two side plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the side wall of one side of the mounting plate, and a bearing mechanism is commonly arranged between the two side plates. According to the invention, the receiving mechanism is arranged on the first mounting seat, the receiving plate of the receiving mechanism is obliquely arranged, and the distance between the receiving plate and the conveying belt is smaller than the distance between the conveying belt and the inner wall of the lower end of the mounting plate, so that the volume of building rubbish entering the mounting plate is smaller than the distance between the conveying belt and the inner wall of the lower end of the mounting plate, and the damage of the conveying belt and the mounting plate caused by the building rubbish can be avoided.

title_en: Experimental deep rock mass pore topology figure-of-things fusion intelligent deduction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent deduction method for fusion of pore topology data of a deep rock mass based on a test, which comprises the steps of obtaining a standard rock sample of the deep rock mass, marking the standard rock sample to obtain a test standard rock sample, carrying out a loading catastrophe test on the test standard rock sample to obtain a deep rock mass mining process and test data, obtaining point cloud information of the loading process of the test standard rock sample according to the deep rock mass mining process and the test data, carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on the test standard rock sample according to the point cloud data to obtain space dynamic evolution of loading behaviors of the deep rock mass, and carrying out feature extraction on the pore topology of the deep loaded rock mass according to the space dynamic evolution to obtain dynamic evolution features. The invention overcomes the problem of dynamic observation of the pore topology configuration of the deep loaded rock mass based on a digital fusion technology, can reflect the real evolution rule of the pore topology configuration of the deep rock mass, and has important significance for revealing the mining disaster and stability evaluation of the deep energy occurrence rock mass.

title_en: Post-disaster self-healing recovery method for regional electricity-heat-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster self-healing recovery method of an regional electricity-heat-gas comprehensive energy system, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a post-disaster self-healing recovery model, wherein the model comprises a multi-objective optimization function and constraint conditions, and further comprises a power distribution network operation model, a thermodynamic network operation model, a gas network operation model and an energy storage device operation model, wherein the power distribution network operation model, the thermodynamic network operation model, the gas network operation model and the energy storage device operation model are used for representing the operation characteristics of the comprehensive energy system; and finally solving a post-disaster self-healing recovery model, and controlling the operation of the comprehensive energy system by using the obtained self-healing recovery type. The method and the system realize the reconstruction of the network topology of the post-disaster power distribution network system, establish a post-disaster self-healing recovery model based on the to-be-recovered area, ensure the effective recovery of all nodes, reduce the energy loss in the recovery process and improve the energy utilization efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Imaging method, imaging system, electronic equipment and storage medium based on reflected waves
abstract_en: The imaging method comprises the steps of obtaining a first reflected wave, a second reflected wave and a third reflected wave, determining wave speeds of a transverse wave and a longitudinal wave of an earthquake, reconstructing an ascending wave field of a descending wave and an ascending wave field of the reflected wave, performing imaging processing on the ascending wave field of the descending wave and the ascending wave field of the reflected wave to generate initial imaging, extracting an incident angle imaging gather of an earthquake channel from the initial imaging, determining a reflection critical angle of the earthquake channel according to the wave speeds of the transverse wave and the longitudinal wave of the earthquake, comparing the incident angle of the earthquake channel in the incident angle imaging gather with the reflection critical angle, determining noise in the incident angle imaging gather, and performing superposition processing after cutting the noise from the incident angle imaging gather to obtain superposition imaging. And the transverse wave converted wave incident angle gather is processed through a critical angle, so that efficient constraint processing of spatial variation is realized, noise is eliminated from the superimposed image, and the imaging quality of transverse wave converted wave deflection is improved.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for constructing historical data in real-time backup of volume
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for constructing historical data in real-time backup of a volume, belonging to the technical field of data disaster recovery backup. The method is applied to a server and comprises the steps of dividing a mirror volume into data blocks, recording real-time change data in a log volume by taking the data blocks as units, creating an index bitmap, traversing the log volume and the mirror volume in sequence, writing pointing information of the data blocks into the index bitmap, and sending the mirror volume, the log volume and the index bitmap to a user space file system to generate a virtual file of the mirror volume at a target time point. The system comprises a data block dividing module, a log volume recording module, an index bitmap creating module, an index information recording module and a sending module. The invention effectively manages and reconstructs the data through the bitmap file, the construction process does not involve the reading and writing of the actual data, and additional space is not required to store newly constructed volumes, so that the reconstruction time is saved, and the storage space is saved.

title_en: Light and thermal camera integrated luminous fire hose for firefighters
title_ko: 소방관을 위한 조명 및 열화상 카메라 통합 야광 소방호스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a luminous fire hose integrated with lighting and a thermal imaging camera for firefighters. More particularly, the present invention is intended to solve problems in that a fire location covered by an obstacle cannot be accurately identified, thermal image data is insufficient, and a portion of a fire hose that does not emit light is not visible, thereby failing to protect firefighters in a dark environment. According to the present invention, a hose is manufactured from a non-combustible luminous material and is formed as a basic hose shape, thereby providing a luminous material hose (101). A nozzle is configured to discharge a constant amount of fire-extinguishing water at an end thereof. A nozzle body (102) is attached to the end of the nozzle and is formed in a narrowed discharge shape. An LED lighting unit (103) is installed on an upper portion of the nozzle body and is detachably mounted. A thermal imaging camera (104) visually detects flames and high-temperature areas to assist firefighters in safely extinguishing a fire and enables identification of essential information such as a fire location covered by an obstacle and a person to be rescued. According to the present invention, the luminous fire hose integrated with lighting and a thermal imaging camera reflects light in a dark fire scene, allowing easy identification of the position of the hose and the firefighter, and enables a person to be rescued to follow the luminous fire hose to find an emergency exit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방관을 위한 조명 및 열화상 카메라 통합 야광 소방호스에 관한 것으로, 야광소재 호스에 의하여 야광소재 호스는 어두운 화재현장에서 호스에서 빛이 반사되어 호스의 위치, 작업자의 위치를 쉽게 알 수 있으며 요구조자가 야광소방호스를 따라 나가 비상구를 찾을 수 있게 한다. 함으로써 장애물에 가려진 부분의 화재 위치 파악 및 열 영상 데이터 부족하며, 빛이 비춰지지 않는 소방호스 부분이 보이지 않아 어두운 환경에서는 소방호스로 부터 작업자들을 보호할 수 없다는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 것이다. 즉, 본 발명은, 소방 노즐용 랜턴에 있어서 야광소재 호스는 어두운 화재현장에서 호스에서 빛이 반사되어 호스의 위치, 작업자의 위치를 쉽게 알 수 있으며 요구조자가 야광소방호스를 따라 나가 비상구를 찾을 수 있게 한다. 야광소재 호스는 관창에 연결되는 부분이다. 불연성이며 야광소재로 이루어진 소재로 호스를 제작하며 형태는 기본 호스로 형성한 야광소재 호스, 관창은 노즐 끝에서 일정한 방수량의 소화용수를 방사할 수 있게한다. 노즐 끝에 달려있으며 좁아지는 형태의 분사구 형태로 형성한 관창, LED조명은 어두운 환경에서 소방관의 시야를 밝게 비추어 작업 가시성을 향상시킬 수 있게 한다. 관창 위쪽에 설치 되며 탈부착이 가능한 형태로 형성한 LED조명, 열화상 카메라는 불꽃 및 고온 지역을 시각적으로 감지하여 안전하게 화재를 진압할 수 있도록 도우며 장애물에 가려진 화재의 위치, 요구조자 등 필수데이터를 파악할 수 있게한다. 관창 오른쪽에 설치되며 탈부착이 가능한 형태로 형성 한열화상 카메라로 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 야광소재 호스에 의하여 야광소재 호스는 어두운 화재현장에서 호스에서 빛이 반사되어 호스의 위치, 작업자의 위치를 쉽게 알 수 있으며 요구조자가 야광소방호스를 따라 나가 비상구를 찾을 수 있게 한다. 하여, 장애물에 가려진 부분의 화재 위치 파악 및 열 영상 데이터 부족하며, 빛이 비춰지지 않는 소방호스 부분이 보이지 않아 어두운 환경에서는 소방호스로 부터 작업자들을 보호할 수 없다는 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써, 기존의 장애물에 가려진 부분의 화재 위치 파악 및 열 영상 데이터 부족하며, 빛이 비춰지지 않는 소방호스 부분이 보이지 않아 어두운 환경에서는 소방호스로 부터 작업자들을 보호할 수 없다는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Fire control device for electric vehicle using mobile floor open type closed damping tank st
title_ko: 바닥면 개방형 밀폐식 이동형 침수조 구조물을 이용한 전기자동차 화재진압장치
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a fire suppression device (1) for an electric vehicle using a mobile, open-bottom, sealed submersible tank structure. The device is constructed by loading an open-bottom submersible tank structure (primary) and, upon arrival at a fire scene, lifting it high with a crane and storing it under its own weight on top of a fire vehicle. When fire extinguishing water is sprayed, the device changes to a closed-bottom submersible tank structure (secondary), and the fire signal detected by each sensor is processed and transmitted to an output unit using the suffocation extinguishing method and the cooling extinguishing method of a gas-based fire extinguishing device and a water-based fire extinguishing device, thereby automatically and interlockingly controlling the device to extinguish a fire in an electric vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 이동식 바닥개방형 밀폐식 침수조 구조물을 이용한 전기자동차의 화재진압장치(1)로서 바닥개방형 침수조 구조물(1차)을 싣고 화재현장에 도착 후 크레인으로 높이 들어 화재차량 상부에서 자중으로 수납시키고, 소화수를 분사하면 바닥밀폐식 침수조 구조물(2차)로 변경되면서 가스계소화설비와 수계소화설비의 질식소화방식과 냉각소화방식으로 각 센서에서 검출된 화재신호를 연산처리하여 출력부에 전송하여 자동 및 연동으로 제어하여 전기자동차의 화재를 진압할 수 있다.

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system for collecting information regarding natural disasters to provide guidance on appropriate evacuation places and reconstruction support.SOLUTION: A system comprises means of: collecting information regarding natural disasters to automatically distribute evacuation places and evacuation routes according to disaster situations of the respective areas to a preliminarily registered guidance destination including image information; and guiding procedures of reconstruction support, providing places of relief supplies, and selling places of required items by unit of municipality by reporting damage situations in reconstruction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and device for reconstructing network of power distribution network, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network reconstruction method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a two-stage robust optimization model as a power distribution network reconstruction model, wherein a first-stage objective function is used for minimizing switching cost of a transmission line switch, a second-stage objective function is used for minimizing load loss under a worst disaster scene, constructing a first constraint set for the first-stage objective function, constructing a second constraint set for an outer-layer objective function, constructing a third constraint set for an inner-layer objective function, solving the power distribution network reconstruction model to obtain a solving result, and adjusting the switching of the transmission line of the power distribution network according to the solving result. According to the invention, by constructing a two-stage robust optimization model, the load loss under the scene of minimum transmission line switch switching cost and minimum objective function device and worst disaster is respectively used as objective functions of the first stage and the second stage, and a network reconstruction scheme with low cost and less loss is provided.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Distributed system disaster recovery fault drilling method and device based on chain tracking
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a distributed system disaster recovery fault drilling method, a device, electronic equipment and a readable medium based on chain tracking, which relate to the technical field of cloud computing and comprise the steps of inserting a custom observation probe into a source code; the method comprises the steps of monitoring dynamic context information when a program runs through a custom observation probe, exporting the dynamic context information into a log file, capturing the change condition of the log file by arranging an agent program in a distributed system, performing fault injection, recording flow data of a production environment, storing the flow data into mirror image flow, replaying the mirror image flow in a disaster recovery environment to generate a service logic link panorama, wherein the service logic link panorama comprises a normal service logic link panorama and an abnormal service logic link panorama, and comparing the normal service logic link panorama with the abnormal service logic link panorama to perform fault diagnosis. The invention can improve the fault coverage and the fault discovery accuracy.

title_en: Sponge for extinguishing fire and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire-fighting accessories, in particular to a sponge for extinguishing fire and a preparation process thereof, comprising an artificial sponge body, the outer surface of the artificial sponge body is provided with a water locking surface and a splash surface, and the surface density of the water locking surface is larger than that of the splash surface. The process comprises the following steps of preparing an artificial sponge raw material, cutting the artificial sponge raw material into a required pretreatment shape, heating part of the outer surface of an artificial sponge body, heating the surface of the artificial sponge body to form a water locking surface, forming a splash surface on the other outer surfaces of the artificial sponge body, and cooling to form a finished product. Due to the high-density design of the water locking surface, the sponge can stably keep moisture, and moisture loss or drifting is not easy to occur due to the influence of swing or wind power. Meanwhile, the artificial sponge is refined from rubber, so that the artificial sponge has the characteristics of environmental protection, combustibility and reconstruction.

title_en: Two-stage elastic recovery method, system, equipment and storage medium for power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage elastic recovery method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of a power distribution system, which comprise the following steps of S1, calculating the minimum repair time of a fault through a route and schedule model of a maintainer based on post-disaster data, S2, setting the recovery duration based on the minimum repair time, minimizing the load shedding in the recovery duration based on an optimal power distribution system recovery model, and outputting to obtain an optimal recovery strategy. A balance is struck between recovery duration and load shedding, an appropriate fault recovery duration is determined, and partitioning and fusion of the microgrid are considered, in comparison with existing dynamic network reconstructed recovery models. Finally, when a disaster occurs, the provided model can comprehensively consider the shortest restoration time and the tolerance of a decision maker, comprehensively consider the fusion between island micro-grids and the self-splitting of the micro-grids, and restore as much load as possible within one restoration duration time, thereby greatly improving the restoration capacity of the power distribution system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Forest fire early warning method and system based on Retinex algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire early warning method and system based on a Retinex algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of forest fire early warning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a low-light forest fire image, decomposing the image into a reflection image and an illumination image through a photosensitive decomposition module based on the Retinex theory, constructing a weak light detection module, capturing weak light characteristics in the illumination image through a multi-scale convolution layer to generate a weak light attention characteristic image, constructing a weak light enhancement module, combining the weak light attention characteristic image with the reflection image to generate a weak light enhancement illumination image, constructing a low-light image reconstruction module, combining the weak light enhancement illumination image with the reflection image through element-by-element multiplication and residual connection to generate a low-light reconstruction image, constructing a low-light image small sample classification module, dividing the reconstruction image into characteristic blocks, extracting local information, comparing the local information with a database image, obtaining a recognition result and determining whether early warning is performed. The invention can improve the recognition accuracy of forest fire images.

title_en: Disaster prevention radio transmission/reception system, disaster prevention radio transmission/reception method, and disaster prevention radio transmission/reception program
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention radio transmission/reception system that transmits disaster information according to the situation or settings of each dwelling unit, such as family composition.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention radio transmission/reception system is provided with a disaster prevention radio transmission/reception device that receives disaster information from an operation console of the disaster prevention radio transmission/reception device and selects and transmits the disaster information to an intercom of each dwelling unit. The selection may be made according to the family composition of each dwelling unit. The selection may be made according to the settings of the intercom in each dwelling unit. The intercom in each dwelling unit may be able to set a priority order between the disaster information and the intercom's call function in the event of a conflict. The lowered priority information may be recorded in the disaster radio transmission/reception device or in each dwelling unit's intercom and may be replayable at a later time. Safety confirmation information sent from each dwelling unit's intercom may be recorded by the disaster prevention radio transmission/reception device and sent to the operation console in batches upon request from the operation console.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Monocular vision forest fire positioning method for unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monocular vision forest fire positioning method of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which aims to realize rapid detection, accurate positioning and three-dimensional reconstruction of early fire. According to the method, a comprehensive fire monitoring system is built by integrating various sensors such as an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, a visible light camera, an infrared camera, an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and the like. And the attitude of the camera is recovered in real time through monocular vision simultaneous localization and map construction (SLAM) technology and IMU-GNSS information fusion. And (3) utilizing a triangulation method and combining semantic information of visible light and infrared images to perform three-dimensional positioning on the fire disaster point. The structure slave motion (Structure from Motion, sfM) technology is adopted, the camera pose and the image characteristic point are combined, and the camera pose and the three-dimensional point cloud are optimized through global beam adjustment (Global Bundle Adjustment, GBA), so that the positioning accuracy is improved. The invention has the characteristics of high efficiency, accuracy, real time and remarkable cost benefit.

title_en: Disaster-affected surface assessment method and system for realizing BIM rapid modeling based on visual large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-affected surface assessment method and a system for realizing BIM rapid modeling based on a visual large model, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting pictures of different angles of a local area of the disaster-affected surface; extracting feature vectors of each picture, carrying out feature fusion to obtain comprehensive feature vectors of a disaster-affected area local area, carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on the comprehensive feature vectors by using a trained ZeroRF model to obtain three-dimensional coordinate data of the disaster-affected area local area, constructing a disaster-affected area BIM model of the disaster-affected area local area according to the three-dimensional coordinate data, and carrying out difference operation by using the disaster-affected area BIM model and a complete BIM model of a target area to obtain a disaster-affected area evaluation result. According to the invention, the images are acquired in an automatic mode and processed by utilizing the visual large model, so that the time period from image acquisition to BIM modeling and evaluation is greatly shortened.
assignees: LIXIN TONGZHI TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution system recovery method and device under rainstorm waterlogging disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power distribution network fault handling and reliability research, in particular to a power distribution system recovery method and device under a storm waterlogging disaster, comprising the steps of generating a typical scene during the storm waterlogging disaster by adopting a Monte Carlo method based on a power distribution network equipment failure probability function during the occurrence of the storm waterlogging disaster; the method comprises the steps of solving a power distribution network reconstruction optimization model under a typical scene of a storm waterlogging disaster occurrence period to obtain a switch optimization result of the storm waterlogging disaster occurrence period, carrying out power distribution network reconstruction by utilizing the switch optimization result, solving a power distribution network fault recovery model after the storm waterlogging disaster is over to obtain a mobile emergency energy storage device dispatching result, carrying out power distribution network restoration after the storm waterlogging disaster by utilizing the mobile emergency energy storage device dispatching result, and obviously improving the recovery capability of a system, and particularly showing unique advantages in a complex scene of serious traffic disaster.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Robot for post-disaster reconstruction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a robot for post-disaster reconstruction, which comprises a machine shell and is characterized by comprising a crawler-type chassis, a front bucket, a bucket swing arm mechanism, a grabbing and releasing mechanism, a support column, a camera mechanism, a cutting hand mechanism, a controller, an unmanned aerial vehicle, a water quality detector, an air detector, a visual detection device and a power supply, wherein the crawler-type chassis is arranged at the bottom of the machine shell, the bucket swing arm mechanism is arranged on the machine shell, the grabbing and releasing mechanism is arranged on the machine shell, the camera mechanism is arranged on the support column, the unmanned aerial vehicle is positioned in a stand, the water quality detector and the air detector are respectively arranged on the machine shell, and the visual detection device is arranged on the machine shell.

title_en: Fire-fighting monitoring alarm method and system based on Internet of things sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire alarm, in particular to a fire monitoring alarm method and a fire monitoring alarm system based on an Internet of things sensor. A fire monitoring alarm system based on an Internet of things sensor comprises a fire preliminary judgment module, a voting calculation module and a fire judgment module. According to the invention, whether fire conditions occur or not is voted through all fire alarm sensors around the target fire alarm sensor, and information of all fire alarm sensors around the target fire alarm sensor can be fused, so that fire false alarm conditions caused by sensor faults or sensor failure are avoided, fire conditions are judged more accurately, and the traditional fire alarm system is directly modified, so that compared with the reconstruction of a set of intelligent fire alarm system, the cost is lower.
assignees: JIANGXI TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF MANUFACTURING JIANGXI MECHANICAL SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE JIANGXI MECHANIC

title_en: Roadbed slope digital twin model construction method based on multi-mesh array visual perception and computer system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadbed slope digital twin model construction method based on multi-mesh array visual perception, which comprises the steps of manufacturing a preliminary digital twin model by combining a slope design drawing and construction planning, setting cameras of different types and numbers according to construction site conditions to form a multi-mesh visual perception array, correcting, enhancing and denoising the picture of the change condition in the construction process, extracting key construction characteristics, using a deep learning algorithm, updating and refining the roadbed slope digital twin model by using a three-dimensional reconstruction technology, updating the digital twin model in real time, carrying out structural analysis and dynamic simulation on the digital twin model, evaluating risks possibly occurring in different construction stages, and combining risk identification to formulate an emergency response strategy and preventive measures. The invention has the advantages of high efficiency, real-time and accurate monitoring of the change in the slope construction process, and powerful support for monitoring the construction process, guaranteeing the quality and predicting the risk.

title_en: Compaction and regeneration coal reconstruction device for coal mine repeated mining working face
abstract_en: The invention provides a compaction regenerated coal reconstruction device for a coal mine repeated mining working face, which comprises a working frame, a transmission structure, a pulley structure and a compaction structure, wherein one end of the transmission structure is movably connected with the pulley structure, the other end of the transmission structure is movably connected with the compaction structure, one ends of the pulley structure and the transmission structure, which are close to the pulley structure, are respectively provided with a loading end and an unloading end, the loading end is used for applying pressure, the compaction structure is driven to apply pressure through the transmission structure, the unloading end is used for applying pressure, the compaction structure is driven to release pressure through the transmission structure, and the compaction structure is used for realizing the pressure and the pressure relief of broken coal and rock bodies in a die. The device solves the problems faced by the study of the coal body properties of the mining face of the continuous mining, provides experimental conditions for exploring the disaster causing factors of the regenerated coal body of the mining face, reconstructs the regenerated coal body formed by the caving coal rock body of the goaf of the coal mine under the action of overlying load compaction, and further provides experimental conditions for exploring the properties of the regenerated coal body of the mining face of the continuous mining.
assignees: SHANDONG JINING CANAL COAL MINE CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Fire accident video analysis method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire accident analysis, in particular to a fire accident video analysis method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product. The method comprises the steps of extracting fire feature data and personnel vehicle data in fire scene video data, classifying and identifying the fire feature data to obtain flame information, smoke information and light shadow information, reconstructing and identifying personnel behavior images in the personnel vehicle data to obtain personnel feature information, performing motion blur removal processing on the vehicle images in the personnel vehicle data to obtain license plate feature information, and finally generating a fire accident video analysis report based on the feature information. According to the method, the fire disaster characteristic data in the fire disaster site video data are automatically extracted by integrating various video analysis technologies, so that the efficiency and accuracy of data extraction and identification are effectively improved.

title_en: Natural disaster endophytic safety system for underground pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pipeline safety, and discloses an underground pipeline natural disaster endogenous safety system which is used for solving the problems that pipeline function safety, natural disaster backup safety and system information safety are mutually interwoven and are difficult to treat independently. The system comprises a safety monitoring module, a pipeline state judging module, a reconstruction mimicry simulation module, a multimode judging module, a pipe network disaster reverse reconstruction module and a linkage defense module, wherein the safety monitoring module is used for collecting safety monitoring data of an underground pipeline, the pipeline state judging module is used for judging pipeline state conditions and obtaining pipeline state data, the reconstruction mimicry simulation module is used for mimicry according to the pipeline state data and the safety monitoring data to obtain n reconfigurable mimicry simulation models, the multimode judging module is used for carrying out simulation calculation on disaster values based on the n reconfigurable mimicry simulation models, the pipe network disaster reverse reconstruction module is used for receiving the disaster values and carrying out data correction on the reconfigurable mimicry simulation modules and the multimode judging module, and the linkage defense module is used for carrying out linkage defense. The invention solves the problems of static property and deterministic limitation existing in the traditional protection mode.

title_en: Forest fire-extinguishing unmanned aerial vehicle airport system capable of automatically filling bomb
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic bullet filling forest fire-extinguishing unmanned aerial vehicle airport system, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a parking apron and a bullet filling device. The fire extinguishing bomb filling device comprises a bomb filling platform, a conveying belt for conveying fire extinguishing bomb and an inclined rail, wherein the lower end of the inclined rail is close to the conveying belt, so that the fire extinguishing bomb can roll into the conveying belt along the inclined rail. Be provided with fire extinguishing bullet anchor clamps on the unmanned aerial vehicle for press from both sides and get the fire extinguishing bullet on the conveyer belt. The system remarkably improves the bullet filling efficiency through an automatic bullet filling process, simplifies operation steps, runs stably and reliably, can effectively shorten the reconstruction and update time of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and is particularly suitable for forest fire extinguishing task scenes requiring quick response and frequent bullet filling.
assignees: NANNING GUIDIAN ELECTRONIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;GUANGXI YOUKEFU AVIATION TECH CO LTD;UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH

title_en: Urban illumination control integration gateway system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban illumination control, and provides an urban illumination control fusion gateway system which comprises a multi-mode sensing network module, a causal reasoning diagnosis module, a survivability topology reconstruction module, a physiological adaptation dimming module and a disaster chain blocking module. The multi-mode sensing network module collects structural displacement, environmental data and weather forecast of the lighting facility through the unmanned plane, the ground nodes and the weather radar. The causal reasoning diagnosis module analyzes the aging reasons of the facilities through causal graph modeling. The survivability topology reconstruction module optimizes the power supply network topology. The physiological adaptive dimming module generates a color temperature-brightness parameter according to the people stream and the atmospheric optical characteristics. The disaster chain blocking module identifies disaster propagation nodes and triggers reinforcement instructions. The invention can improve the reliability, energy conservation and safety of the lighting system and optimize the comfort and emergency response capability of urban environment.
assignees: ZHANGZHOU ELECTRONIC INFORMATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Tree wind load assessment method based on point cloud model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tree wind load assessment method based on a point cloud model, which comprises the steps of carrying out semantic segmentation on an image acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle, and extracting partial images of the tree crowns for three-dimensional reconstruction, generating a point cloud model, extracting point cloud data of the tree crowns and the tree trunks, and generating a three-dimensional point cloud model of the target tree. And calculating the wind load influence area of the crown by ALPHA SHAPE algorithm. And simulating wind load distribution under different wind directions and wind speeds by using ANSYS Fluent software in combination with the wind speed, the wind direction and the tree geometric characteristics, and calculating a wind load result under the wind load effect. Finally, based on a finite element analysis method, tree structure stress analysis is carried out by combining wind load data, and fatigue life and damage risk of the tree under the action of wind power are estimated. The method can accurately evaluate the dynamic response of the tree under the action of wind power, has the characteristics of high efficiency, accuracy and automation, and is widely applicable to the fields of wind disaster early warning, tree health monitoring, environmental protection and the like.

title_en: Post-disaster auxiliary on-site cleaning and reconstruction robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of post-disaster reconstruction robots, and discloses a post-disaster auxiliary field cleaning reconstruction robot which comprises a base with a travelling mechanism, a hydraulic seam lifting clamp and a hydraulic seam lifting clamp, wherein the travelling direction of the base along with the travelling mechanism is used as the travelling direction, and the hydraulic seam lifting clamp is arranged on the lower surface of the base along the travelling direction and the clamp teeth of the hydraulic seam lifting clamp extend out of the base. The hydraulic lifting motor on the hydraulic joint lifting pliers is controlled to push out the pliers teeth to different lengths, so that the pliers teeth of the hydraulic joint lifting pliers are conveniently inserted into the joint, the hydraulic joint lifting pliers are controlled to open to finish joint lifting operation, namely, the hydraulic joint lifting pliers are used for prying up heavy objects in cement boards, concrete blocks or other ruins to assist rescue, the pliers type clamping jaws are used for removing broken block plates after disaster, and the pliers type clamping jaw saw tooth parts on the pliers type clamping jaws provide cutting action while clamping, so that the equipment in the invention is more specialized, more specific and more efficient in rescue and post disaster reconstruction actions.

title_en: Reconfigurable power distribution line and overload protection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconfigurable power distribution line and an overload protection method thereof, the method dynamically adjusts the distribution path to cope with load fluctuation and sudden faults by combining real-time load monitoring, load prediction and topology reconstruction. Firstly, the system collects real-time load data of a distribution line, adopts an ARIMA algorithm to carry out load prediction, and starts an overload protection mechanism to cut off local load, transfer load or start a standby power supply when the load exceeds a set threshold value. By automating topology reconfiguration, the system reconfigures the distribution paths when an overload or fault occurs, ensuring load balancing and continuous power supply. The intelligent and flexible power distribution network management method provided by the invention can effectively improve the reliability of the power distribution network, avoid power interruption caused by overload or faults and improve the emergency response and recovery capacity of the power distribution network.

title_en: Dry sand loading box for fire suppression of PLS-equipped electric vehicles
title_ko: Pls탑재형 전기차 화재진압용 마른 모래 적재함
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dry sand loading box for extinguishing an electric vehicle fire mountable on a Palletized Load System (PLS), and more particularly, to a new concept of technology for quickly suppressing a fire through a smothering extinction method using dry sand in the event of an electric vehicle, battery, or metal fire. Conventional containers mounted on PLS trucks are used only for transporting various raw materials or goods, or for temporary residential and office purposes, leading to a problem of low utility as they cannot be utilized for fire suppression. As a solution to this problem, the present invention devised a technology for a new concept of a dry sand loading box with a drying-functional hopper inside a container loadable/unloadable on a PLS truck, which: converts wet sand into dry sand by self-drying using heating pipes installed on the inner surface and bottom of the hopper; and allows for smothering extinction by discharging the dry sand to the outside via a discharge screw installed at the rear of the hopper, bagging the sand, and transporting it to a nearby fire site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 PLS탑재형 전기차 화재진압용 마른 모래 적재함에 관한 것으로, 특히 전기차, 배터리 및 금속화재발생시 마른 모래를 이용한 질식소화의 방법으로 화재를 신속하게 진압하는 신개념의 기술에 관한 것이다. 
종래에 개시된 PLS트럭에 탑재되는 컨테이너는 다양한 원료나 제품, 상품을 운송하거나 임시 거주 및 사무실의 용도로 활용할 뿐 전기차의 화재시 화재를 진압하는 용도로는 활용할 수 없어 활용도가 저하되는 문제점이 야기된다. 
본 발명은 이러한 문제점을 일소하기 위한 방안으로 PLS트럭에 상·하차 가능한 컨테이너의 내부에 건조기능을 구비한 호퍼가 형성된 신개념의 마른 모래 적재함의 호퍼 내면 및 바닥면에 설치된 히팅파이프를 이용하여 젖은 모래를 건조하여 자체적으로 마른 모래로 변환하고, 상기 호퍼의 후방에 설치된 배출용 스크류를 이용하여 외부로 배출한 마른 모래를 포대에 담아 근거리의 화재현장으로 운반하여 질식소화를 할 수 있도록 하는 기술을 강구함을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Drone smart control tower system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone smart control tower system. The drone smart control tower system comprises: a drone moving to a fire scene in case of a fire while being attached to a vehicle to identify the fire scene; a control unit provided in the vehicle, connected to the drone through a wireless network to remotely control the operation of the drone, and receiving an image acquired by the drone in real time; and a display unit attached to a wall surface in the vehicle and displaying the image acquired by the drone under the control of the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 스마트 컨트롤 타워 시스템에 관한 것으로, 차량에 부착된 상태에서 화재발생시 화재현장으로 이동하여 화재현장을 식별하는 드론; 차량에 구비되고, 무선 네트워크를 통해 드론과 연결되어 드론의 동작을 원격으로 제어하고, 드론이 획득한 영상을 실시간으로 수신하는 관제부; 및 차량 내의 벽면에 부착되고, 관제부의 제어에 의해 드론이 획득한 영상을 디스플레이하는 디스플레이부를 포함한다.

title_en: System and method for estimating location at fire site
title_ko: 화재현장에서의 사고자 위치추정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system for estimating a location of a victim at a fire scene according to an embodiment of the present invention may include: storage boxes disposed on each floor of a building; a victim terminal stored in the storage box and carried by a victim to transmit RF data or IMU data; a storage box terminal installed in the storage box to estimate the location of the victim based on the RF data or the IMU data; and a searcher terminal carried by a searcher to receive the RF data or the IMU data from the storage box terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 화재현장에서의 사고자 위치추정 시스템은 건물의 각층에 배치되는 보관함, 보관함에 보관되어 사고자가 소지하고, RF데이터 또는 IMU데이터를 송신하는 사고자 단말, 보관함에 설치되고, RF데이터 또는 IMU데이터를 기반으로 사고자의 위치를 추정하는 보관함 단말 및 탐색자가 소지하여 보관함 단말로부터 RF데이터 또는 IMU데이터를 수신하는 탐색자 단말을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Karaoke box management system using iot technology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a karaoke box management system and, more specifically, to a karaoke box management system using IoT technology in which playback information about a sound recording is transmitted to a management server in real time through a wireless device mounted inside a karaoke device, payment for the use of the sound recording is made through the transmitted information to block manipulation of sound recording use details and enable accurate and convenient payment for the use of the sound recording, and the occurrence of fire is detected according to information such as the temperature and humidity around the karaoke device, smoke generation, and power consumption, and the size of the space in which the karaoke device is installed, and reported, thus making it possible to accurately detect and quickly respond to fires.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 노래방 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 노래방기기 내부에 장착되는 무선장치를 통해 음원의 재생정보를 실시간으로 관리서버로 전송하고, 전송된 정보를 통해 음원 사용에 대한 정산이 이루어지도록 하여 음원 사용 내역에 관한 조작을 차단하고 음원 사용에 대한 정확하고 편리한 정산이 가능하도록 하며, 노래방기기 주변의 온도, 습도, 연기발생, 전력사용량 등의 정보와 노래방기기가 설치된 공간 규모에 따라 화재발생을 감지하여 이를 알리도록 함으로써, 정확한 화재의 감지와 이에 따른 신속한 대처가 가능하도록 하는 IoT기술을 활용한 노래방 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Air disaster recovery image storage method, storage medium and equipment based on satellite service
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aerial disaster recovery image storage method, storage medium and equipment based on satellite service, which comprise the steps that a satellite transmitting end transmits an image disaster recovery instruction to a computer room receiving end, the computer room receiving end determines an image to be backed up according to the image disaster recovery instruction, the image to be backed up is classified according to service types and the return priority of the classified image is determined according to service weights, channel characteristic evaluation is carried out according to a channel between the satellite transmitting end and the computer room receiving end, an evaluation score is matched with the return priority, the image to be backed up is encoded and returned to the satellite transmitting end through the matched channel, the image returned to the satellite transmitting end is decoded, image quality reconstruction is carried out, and the image with the reconstructed quality is stored in a satellite. The invention backs up the image data to the satellite, avoids the influence of disasters, improves the recovery speed of the image data and ensures the return quality of the image.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fully-mechanized caving coal resource recovery method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fully-mechanized caving mining legacy coal resource recovery method, which can improve the recovery rate of coal, control disaster risk in the mining process and ensure the high efficiency and economical recovery of the recovery operation, and comprises the following steps: A roadway is driven in a goaf of a primary fully-mechanized caving mining working face of an adjacent solid thick coal seam, a roadway reconstruction technology of shallow part gel pressing and surface spraying is implemented in the roadway driving construction process, a roadway with good complete tightness is formed by the weight of regenerated coal with broken roadway peripheral goafs and more air leakage cracks, then a production system such as a gate way, a cutting hole and the like is arranged, and then a secondary fully-mechanized caving mining technology is adopted to recover coal resources left in the goaf due to the caving of the primary fully-mechanized caving mining top coal and protective coal pillars left between the adjacent working faces.
assignees: SHANDONG JINING CANAL COAL MINE CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Coal mine roof and floor multi-disaster cooperative treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster cooperative treatment method for a coal mine roof and a coal mine floor, which comprises the steps of drilling from the ground to the direction of the coal mine roof by using a directional drilling machine, drilling a drilling tool into the coal mine roof, drilling along the coal mine roof in a layer to form a horizontal section, putting a sleeve into the drilling hole, injecting holes into the sleeve by adopting a mode of combining hydraulic sand blasting perforation and bottom seal dragging fracturing, enabling high-pressure water to act in the ground, carrying out fracturing construction on the coal mine roof, pulling out all upper sleeves after the fracturing construction is finished, carrying out secondary drilling construction by using the directional drilling machine, enabling the drilling tool to penetrate through the coal seam to enter a water-containing layer in the coal mine floor, and grouting into the water-containing layer. According to the method, the fracturing is carried out on the coal mine bottom plate, the advanced exploration treatment is carried out on the coal mine bottom plate, the hydraulic pressure is carried out on the coal mine top plate, the high stress of the coal mine top plate is effectively released in the working face stoping process, the advanced exploration treatment is carried out on the coal mine bottom plate, and the grouting reconstruction is carried out on the three ash aquifers.

title_en: PFA-GRU-OL-MRT-based dynamic landslide displacement real-time prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic landslide displacement real-time prediction method based on PFA-GRU-OL-MRT, which belongs to the landslide prediction field, and comprises the steps of acquiring landslide displacement data monitored on line, preprocessing the data, optimizing gate control circulation unit (GRU) super parameters based on a Particle Firework Algorithm (PFA), establishing a PFA-GRU initial sub-model, training an input sub-model in real time and predicting the next round of displacement based on an on-line learning (OL) strategy every time the latest monitored data is acquired, finally, carrying out prediction accuracy evaluation by combining an on-line learning prediction result after the next monitored data is acquired, judging whether to use the PFA-GRU dynamic reconstruction (MRT) sub-model as a sub-model for the next round of prediction, and realizing the dynamic real-time prediction of the landslide displacement.

title_en: Power grid toughness assessment method for urban system functional requirements under earthquake disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid toughness assessment method for urban system functional requirements under earthquake disasters, which comprises the following steps of establishing a three-level partition model of a potential earthquake source area according to incomplete random distribution of earthquake activities in space, determining probability distribution conditions of different earthquake magnitude earthquakes in the potential earthquake source area, obtaining earthquake vibration peak acceleration under different earthquake mid-distance by adopting an earthquake attenuation elliptic model, further constructing a fault probability model of ground surface elements and buried pipelines under the earthquake scene, constructing an urban water supply network model and an urban air supply network model influenced by power supply capacity of a power grid based on power characteristics of a water pump station, a compressor and a gas turbine, constructing a power grid toughness recovery model which comprehensively considers the urban life line system functional requirements under the earthquake disasters based on configuration network reconstruction and island partition, and realizing the maximum measurement of toughness of urban power grids facing the earthquake disasters by meeting basic living requirements of disaster masses under limited power resources.

title_en: Road network traffic diversion method based on dynamic topology reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road network traffic diversion method based on dynamic topology reconstruction. The method accurately locates the position of the abnormal event and the affected node set by identifying the abnormal event and determining the influence range. And through dynamically updating the node representation, the event characteristics are transmitted to the nodes in the affected range, and dynamic attenuation is carried out according to the distance between the nodes and the core node and the event severity. On the basis, the connection weight of the bypass path is enhanced by reducing the connection weight of the affected area, and the reconstruction of the dynamic adjacency matrix is performed. And finally, based on the reconstructed adjacency matrix, comprehensively evaluating the traffic efficiency and congestion degree of the path by combining a path planning algorithm, generating an optimal shunt path and distributing the flow in proportion. According to the invention, through dynamic network reconstruction and intelligent path planning, traffic jam caused by abnormal events is effectively relieved, and the emergency response capability and the overall traffic efficiency of the traffic network are improved.

title_en: Computer distributed storage encryption system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer storage and discloses a computer distributed storage encryption system, which is characterized in that a quantum key segmentation and geographical binding technology is adopted to ensure that a single node leaks and a complete key cannot be reconstructed, a dynamic topology sensing module monitors the node state in real time and rapidly responds to side channel attack through a hardware fingerprint fusing mechanism, a space-time folding encryption module adopts chaos fractal cutting and PUF noise injection to enable the same data block to generate a differential ciphertext at different nodes so as to crack the single node and cannot threaten global data, an implicit disaster recovery channel is embedded through photon orbital angular momentum modulation and quantum trap state, quantum hidden transmission resistance and key self-repairing are realized, an improved NTRU algorithm is accelerated through chaos parameter injection and FPGA, encryption efficiency is remarkably improved, and decryption error rate is reduced. The system has high security, quantum computing resistance and dynamic environment adaptability, and solves the problems of key rigidification, fragment redundancy, security contradiction and the like in the traditional distributed storage encryption.

title_en: System and method for building fire fighting data based on IOT
title_ko: Iot 기반 화재진압데이터 구축 시스템 및 그의 화재진압데이터 구축 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an internet of things (IoT)-based fire suppression data construction system and a method for constructing fire suppression data thereof. The system comprises: a plurality of IoT modules mounted on at least one fire-fighting vehicle deployed at a fire scene and configured to sense and transmit fire suppression data related to fire suppression; a management terminal (Automatic Vehicle Location, AVL) configured to transmit the fire suppression data received from the plurality of IoT modules to a fire integrated situation control server; and a fire integrated situation control server configured to cumulatively store the fire suppression data received from the management terminal as big data and to analyze the accumulated fire suppression data to perform at least one of establishment of a fire response plan, extraction of data for fire investigation and fire research, establishment of a management plan for extinguishing agents used for fire suppression and discharged contaminated water, establishment of a fire scene safety management plan, and establishment of a public support management plan. The fire suppression data may include a water discharge amount used for fire suppression, a type and an amount of an extinguishing agent, fire-fighting vehicle state information, and an ambient temperature around the fire scene.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 IOT(Internet Of Things) 기반 화재진압데이터 구축 시스템 및 그의 화재진압데이터 구축 방법에 관한 것으로, 시스템은 화재현장에 배치된 적어도 하나의 소방차량에 장착되어 화재 진압과 관련된 화재진압데이터를 센싱 및 전송하는 다수의 IOT 모듈들과, 다수의 IOT 모듈들로부터 수신되는 화재진압데이터를 하기 화재 종합 상황 관제 서버로 전송하는 관리 단말기(AVL, Automatic Vehicle Location)와, 관리 단말기로부터 수신되는 화재진압데이터를 빅데이터로서 누적 저장하고, 누적 저장된 화재진압데이터를 분석하여 화재대응계획 수립, 화재조사 및 화재연구를 위한 데이터 추출, 화재진압을 위해 사용된 소화약제와 방출오염수 관리 방안 수립, 화재현장 안전 관리 방안 수립, 그리고, 대민 지원 관리 방안 수립 중 적어도 하나를 수행하는 화재 종합 관제 서버를 포함하고, 화재진압데이터는, 화재진압을 위해 사용되는 방수량, 소화약제의 종류와 수량, 소방차량상태정보 및 화재현장 주변온도를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-source collaborative optimization method and system for mobile energy storage scheduling and micro-grid reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source collaborative optimization method and a system for mobile energy storage dispatching and micro-grid reconstruction, the method is constructed by taking mobile energy storage equipment and micro-grid reconstruction into consideration, and solving the multi-source collaborative optimization model to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme comprising mobile energy storage equipment scheduling and a micro-grid reconstruction strategy. According to the invention, the toughness and the power supply reliability of the power distribution network under disaster conditions are improved by utilizing the synergistic effect of the mobile energy storage equipment and the micro-grid reconstruction.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION COMPANY;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Wounded information management and sharing method and system based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The application provides a wounded information management and sharing method and system based on cloud computing. The method comprises the steps of collecting and integrating multi-source heterogeneous data, synchronizing the multi-source heterogeneous data to a cloud platform in real time to generate a preliminary wounded information base, conducting complex association analysis based on the preliminary wounded information base by using a quantum heuristic optimization algorithm, simulating a quantum calculation process, achieving information instant update and dynamic adjustment by using a distributed edge calculation technology, generating an optimized wounded information file in a descending mode, conducting multi-dimensional data reconstruction based on the optimized wounded information file by using a holographic reconstruction algorithm, extracting hidden modes and characteristics, conducting multi-dimensional reconstruction processing on each wounded history and current health status data, supporting calculation on the encrypted data directly by using a homomorphic encryption technology, generating a high-dimensional data model, constructing an emergency response module based on the high-dimensional data model, and generating a wounded information management and sharing strategy. The technical scheme provided by the application obviously improves the safety and efficiency of wounded information management and sharing.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster spatial distribution characteristic simulation analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban waterlogging analysis, in particular to a method for simulating and analyzing urban waterlogging disaster spatial distribution characteristics, which is characterized in that basic information of a city to be analyzed is researched and collected, and storm waterlogging surface hydrologic factors are extracted based on the acquired basic information of the city, then a urban waterlogging simulation analysis model is built based on the acquired basic information of the city and the extracted storm waterlogging surface hydrologic factors, then the urban waterlogging simulation analysis model which is built finely is determined through the determination of rainfall and rainfall in a reconstruction period, an optimized urban waterlogging simulation analysis model is obtained, and the urban to be analyzed is subjected to waterlogging disaster spatial distribution characteristic analysis by utilizing the optimized urban waterlogging simulation analysis model, so that the urban waterlogging disaster spatial distribution characteristics are accurately predicted when extremely large rainfall events occur in extreme weather, and the influence degree of future disasters is predicted.
assignees: NANJING CHENXIANG SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Satellite image super-resolution-based change monitoring algorithm and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an algorithm and a system for high-efficiency super-resolution processing and accurate change monitoring based on satellite images. The system combines a blind image super-resolution model and a change monitoring model based on a transducer architecture, and aims to solve the problems of insufficient satellite image resolution and low change monitoring precision in the prior art. Experimental verification results show that the method is excellent in super-resolution reconstruction and change monitoring, and can remarkably improve image resolution and change monitoring precision. The system has wide application prospect in the fields of urban planning, environmental protection, disaster early warning and the like, and provides powerful technical support for the related fields.

title_en: Data-driven-based reactor core transient CFD flow field reconstruction technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data-driven reactor core transient CFD flow field reconstruction technology, which is applied to the technical field of reactor core flow field reconstruction, and is used for reconstructing a low-fidelity transient CFD model calculation result by combining a multi-fidelity model and an LSTM neural network to obtain transient flow field data which approximates to the high-fidelity transient CFD model calculation result to a certain extent. Therefore, the method can reduce the calculation burden and cost of the transient CFD calculation flow, help researchers to understand the thermodynamic and hydraulic behaviors in the reactor more deeply, predict the safety accident process more accurately, and be beneficial to safer core design optimization and more effective emergency response planning.

title_en: Cross-region landslide factor selection method based on feature division gain and MMD distance
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-region landslide factor selection method based on feature division gain and MMD distance, which is used for screening and reconstructing a shared landslide factor feature set suitable for a source region and a target region based on a specific threshold value by combining landslide feature similarity of the source region and the target region calculated by the MMD distance and landslide disaster-causing contribution of the source region and the target region calculated by the feature division gain on the basis of constructing a landslide factor database of the source region and the target region.

title_en: Landslide volume estimation method, equipment and medium based on post-disaster remote sensing data
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide volume estimation method, equipment and medium based on post-disaster remote sensing data, and relates to the technical field of remote sensing, wherein the method is used for acquiring the post-disaster remote sensing data; according to the aerial image data of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the boundary ranges of the left side and the right side of a landslide accumulation area, the boundary ranges of a landslide wall area and the boundary ranges of areas required by slope toe reconstruction are identified, according to the three-dimensional laser ground point cloud data in the areas required by slope toe reconstruction, the original slope toe topographic boundary line before landslide occurrence is reconstructed, the elevation data of the original slope toe before landslide occurrence is determined based on the original slope toe topographic boundary line before landslide occurrence is reconstructed, and the sliding interface is reconstructed based on the elevation data of the original slope toe before landslide occurrence, the boundary ranges of the left side and the right side of the landslide accumulation area and the three-dimensional laser ground point cloud data in the boundary ranges of the landslide wall area, and the landslide volume is determined according to the elevation data of the sliding interface and the elevation data of the landslide accumulation area. The application can improve the landslide volume estimation precision.

title_en: Moderate-intensity earthquake damage characteristic analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medium-strength earthquake damage characteristic analysis system, and relates to the technical field of earthquake damage analysis. The system comprises an earthquake information acquisition module and a post-disaster rescue analysis module, wherein the earthquake information acquisition module is used for acquiring a plurality of earthquake information, so that post-disaster rescue analysis can be rapidly carried out based on the acquired earthquake information, on one hand, rapid and effective post-disaster rescue guidance can be realized, and life and property loss after earthquake disaster is reduced, on the other hand, post-disaster reconstruction and pre-earthquake defense guidance can be given, and prevention of reducing the life and property loss is well carried out. Compared with the prior art, the method has stronger practicability, can provide earthquake damage analysis results with higher accuracy, and realize effective earthquake damage characteristic analysis such as post-earthquake disaster rescue analysis, post-disaster reconstruction analysis, pre-earthquake defense and the like, thereby improving the practicability and operability of each level of emergency plans and earthquake emergency rescue action schemes.

title_en: Method for identifying high-risk building with wood structure building group fire spread
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying high-risk buildings of fire spread of a wood structure building group, and relates to the technical field of prevention and control of fire spread of building groups. The method comprises the steps of acquiring building space vector data, obtaining building group fire spreading fire dynamics data, building a building group fire spreading network model based on a directed graph basic principle, providing a node importance, namely a high-risk building identification method based on path centrality by considering the fire spreading characteristics of a wood structure building group, and providing a building group high-risk building reconstruction sequence by combining a node deletion technology. The invention can fully consider the heterogeneity of each building node of the building group and the fire spreading influence of the multi-node fire scene, improves the pertinence and the accuracy of fire spreading prevention and control, realizes the low-intervention prevention and control target, and provides important support for disaster prevention planning and emergency planning of the wood structure building group.

title_en: Non-contact throwing system and method for autonomous positioning image control point device in steep mountain
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact throwing system and a non-contact throwing method for an autonomous positioning image control point device in a steep mountain, and relates to the technical fields of large reservoir construction protection and geological disaster monitoring. The device comprises a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform, a cable winding and unwinding device, a magnetic attraction device, an autonomous positioning image control point device, a ground control module, a aerial camera sensor and other modules. The application method of the unmanned aerial vehicle is that the autonomous positioning image control point device is mounted on a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform, the unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform is put in an operation position through the cable winding and unwinding device, and after the operation is completed, the autonomous positioning device is recovered through the magnetic attraction device, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform can be reused. The invention can realize the three-dimensional reconstruction in the steep mountain and the non-contact throwing layout of the ground surface deformation monitoring image control points, realize the automation of the measurement of the image control points, improve the measurable precision, the measuring efficiency and the safety of the periodic three-dimensional model, and effectively avoid the safety risk possibly faced by the traditional manual layout measurement in the steep mountain environment.

title_en: Water network reconstruction method based on forest water function compounding
abstract_en: The invention provides a water network reconstruction method based on a water-forest function composite, which comprises the following steps of water system characteristic identification and topology structure construction, multidimensional forest stand attribute fusion and evaluation, water network model optimization based on circuit theory, multi-path simulation of a water network regulation and storage function and water forest habitat construction. According to the invention, a water system network topological structure is established by adopting a spectrogram convolution network, multidimensional forest stand attributes are fused, a forest water interaction model is established by adopting a circuit theory, a hydrologic process is simulated, the form of a riverbed is adjusted, the water flow dynamics can be simulated under various situations, the regulation and storage effects of water networks under different paths are evaluated, the water system layout and the hydrologic analysis result are combined, the terrain transformation is implemented, the problems of water green space cutting, ecological function weakness, single greening landscape and the like are solved, the effective regulation and storage space of the riverbed which is green in normal times and water in disaster is increased, the ecological landscape of the forest on water is created, and important tools and strategies are provided for realizing forest water compounding and improving city toughness.
assignees: SHANGHAI ACADEMY OF LANDSCAPE ARCH SCIENCE AND PLANNING

title_en: CNN-BiLSTM-based gas concentration time sequence prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine gas disaster prediction, in particular to a gas concentration time sequence prediction method based on CNN-BiLSTM. Firstly, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used for carrying out feature extraction on input time sequence data, input features are optimized, the time sequence information of the data is captured by combining a bidirectional long-short-time memory network (BiLSTM) so as to enhance the sensitivity of a model to gas concentration change, then a sparrow search algorithm (SCSSA) is improved by fusing sine and cosine and Cauchy variation, the search performance, global convergence and complex nonlinear optimization capacity are improved, further model super-parameters are optimized, then the initial gas concentration data is decomposed and reconstructed through a fully adaptive noise set empirical mode decomposition (CEEMDAN) so as to extract multi-scale features of the data, finally, a CNN-BiLSTM prediction model is established by a training model, and the performance of the CNN-BiLSTM prediction model is verified through a comparison model and evaluation indexes. The gas concentration time sequence prediction method combines the capabilities of signal decomposition and reconstruction of multi-scale extraction data characteristics, improves the optimizing capability of a search algorithm and the time sequence characteristic extraction and learning capability of deep learning, improves the gas concentration prediction capability, and has great significance for preventing and controlling gas disasters in the coal mining process.

title_en: Deep learning three-dimensional climate simulation method for adding climate to real scene
