abstract_en: The invention relates to a deep learning three-dimensional climate simulation method for adding climate to a real scene, which belongs to the field of image processing and comprises the steps of inputting a real scene image into a jittor frame, emitting a ray from each pixel of the real scene image, sampling each ray to obtain sampling points and directions, coding, sending the sampling points into a nerve radiation field to predict the color value and the density value of each sampling point, substituting the parameters predicted by the nerve radiation field into a rendering equation, inputting the parameters into volume rendering, so as to keep the color, the depth and the opacity of the sampling points, dividing the weather disaster elements of an input weather disaster picture, reconstructing the weather scene corresponding to the weather disaster, and fusing the final scenes obtained in the previous two steps of the scene to realize effect simulation. According to the invention, through a three-dimensional reconstruction technology, the influence of meteorological disasters on the environment can be intuitively displayed, so that a user can visually feel the situation of the disasters, and the data visualization effect and the propagation efficiency are greatly enhanced.

title_en: Landslide identification method, landslide identification system, landslide identification equipment and landslide identification medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide identification method, a system, equipment and a medium, which relate to the technical field of disaster detection and comprise the steps of acquiring remote sensing image data and digital elevation data of a target slope section and taking the remote sensing image data and the digital elevation data as a landslide data set, dividing image data in the landslide data set into n multiplied by n pixels, inputting a token into a neural network model based on a coder and decoder structure, processing the token through the coder and decoder to acquire the token of a reconstructed image and reconstruction loss between the token and an original image token, acquiring an optimal neural network model by taking the minimized reconstruction loss as a target, and inputting remote sensing image data and digital elevation data of the real-time target slope section into the optimal neural network model for image interpretation, thereby acquiring a landslide map in the target slope section. According to the invention, the neural network model is optimized to perform image interpretation, and the image interpretation result of the region shows higher precision, so that the application potential of the neural network model in the disaster prevention and reduction field is further verified.

title_en: Flood drought salty tide disaster intelligent early warning, prevention and control emergency system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information technology and environmental science, in particular to an intelligent early warning, prevention and control emergency system for flood, which comprises a data monitoring and acquisition subsystem, a data processing and optimizing subsystem, a disaster evaluation and analysis subsystem and a disaster early warning, prevention and control subsystem, wherein the data monitoring and acquisition subsystem is used for detecting a monitoring river basin to obtain multi-source dynamic monitoring information of the monitoring river basin; the method comprises the steps of establishing a time sequence reconstruction model in a data processing and optimizing subsystem, obtaining a target information set of a monitored river basin after model processing, establishing a flood, drought, salty and tide disaster prediction model in a disaster evaluation and analysis subsystem, obtaining a disaster prediction and evaluation result of the monitored river basin based on the flood, and sending a disaster early warning signal and matching emergency prevention and control measures by combining the prediction and evaluation result and the information set through a disaster early warning and emergency prevention and control subsystem. The invention realizes monitoring and early warning, data optimization processing, disaster assessment and analysis and emergency prevention and control decision.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUAHAO MIAOSHUI ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Power distribution system disaster reconstruction method considering network reconstruction and island division
abstract_en: The invention provides a reconstruction method in a power distribution system disaster, which considers network reconstruction and island division. The method comprises the steps of constructing a network dynamic reconstruction and island division mathematical model in a disaster of a power distribution system based on a power distribution network topology, determining an objective function and constraint conditions of the model, determining a response situation of the power distribution system in the disaster approaching process based on a network reconstruction scheme, configuring a distributed power model in the power distribution system, and calculating an optimal network reconstruction scheme by using a mathematical optimization method based on a structure, the objective function and the constraint conditions of the network reconstruction and island division mathematical model, the response situation of the power distribution system in the disaster approaching process and the distributed power model configured in the system, so as to minimize cut loads and switching operation cost. According to the method, through resource allocation and network topology reconstruction of the disaster stage of the power distribution system, the elastic promotion of the disaster stage of the power distribution system is realized, the cut load and the running cost in the disaster of the power distribution system are reduced, and the supply of important loads is ensured.

title_en: Rock engineering slope stability classification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a rock engineering slope stability classification method. The technical scheme includes that spatial distribution characteristics of a side slope structural surface are obtained through combined detection of three-dimensional laser scanning and geological radar, a quantitative index system comprising structural surface occurrence, density and communication rate is established, a micro-seismic monitoring system is adopted to collect a side slope internal fracture signal in real time, a micro-seismic event energy release rate, a main frequency offset and a seismic source mechanism parameter are extracted through time-frequency analysis, a geological structure evolution inversion model is constructed, a geological structure evolution process is reconstructed based on a regional geological database and field drilling data, and a structure residual stress field distribution characteristic is calculated. The invention realizes comprehensive, accurate and real-time monitoring and classification evaluation of the stability of the rock engineering side slope, can effectively predict potential risks, provides scientific and accurate decision basis for side slope support and treatment, and greatly ensures the safety and stability of the rock engineering side slope.

title_en: Evaluation method, system, equipment and medium for wheel forging waste gas treatment furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method, an evaluation system, an evaluation equipment and an evaluation medium for a wheel forging waste gas treatment furnace, and belongs to the field of fire safety in production and manufacturing. The method specifically comprises the steps of obtaining a simulation model based on a fluid calculation domain of the waste gas treatment furnace, set boundary conditions and an initial state, solving the simulation model, extracting a change curve of oxygen mass fraction and molar volume concentration on the cross section of the electrode position along with time, repeating the process as a scheme result, and selecting a scheme with the optimal result for output. According to the invention, different schemes are compared transversely according to the oxygen change on the cross section of the electrode position, and the fire-fighting system of the waste gas treatment furnace is evaluated by a simulation means, so that the cost of the evaluation and verification scheme is reduced, and the efficiency of equipment reconstruction is improved.
assignees: CITIC DICASTAL CO LTD;QINHUANGDAO XINLI STORAGE SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Loess landslide crack evolution trend map construction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loess landslide crack evolution trend map construction method and device, and relates to the technical field of landslide disaster early micro-relief identification. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource remote sensing image data of a loess landslide, obtaining reconstruction data of the loess landslide according to the multisource remote sensing image data, extracting crack characteristics of the loess landslide according to the reconstruction data, establishing a characteristic extraction map library according to the multisource remote sensing image data, obtaining a classification result of the crack characteristics according to the characteristic extraction map library, the crack characteristics and position parameters of the crack characteristics, identifying the acquired crack characteristics in multiple periods according to the classification result of the crack characteristics, obtaining identification results of the crack characteristics in multiple periods, and constructing a crack evolution trend map of the loess landslide according to the identification results of the crack characteristics in multiple periods. Through the scheme, the occurrence position of the potential loess landslide hidden danger can be predicted.

title_en: Winter wheat drought remote sensing monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a winter wheat drought remote sensing monitoring method for fusing reduced-scale sunlight-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF) data. A winter wheat drought remote sensing monitoring method integrating reduced scale SIF data comprises the steps of S1, selecting SIF data reconstruction machine learning model input data, including MODIS reflectivity, fPAR, LAI, ERA5 analysis data temperature, saturated water vapor pressure difference, photosynthetic effective radiation and soil humidity data, S2, training and constructing a machine learning model, S3, constructing a long time sequence high resolution reduced scale SIF product data set and checking effects, and S4, constructing a novel drought fluorescence monitoring index. The winter wheat drought remote sensing monitoring method provided by the invention has the advantages of solving the problem of how to combine SIF information to mechanically improve the timeliness and accuracy of agricultural drought monitoring and effectively improve the disaster prevention and reduction capability of agricultural weather.

title_en: Forest fire monitoring system based on satellite remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire monitoring system based on satellite remote sensing, in particular to the field of forest fire monitoring, which is used for solving the problems of incomplete data coverage, inaccurate boundary identification, difficult restoration of a shielding area and the like in the forest fire monitoring process. The spectrum and vegetation dynamic change before and after the fire are continuously tracked, and continuous basic data is provided for evaluating the fire influence. The analysis of spectrum extremely poor and thermal signal propagation is combined, so that the fine recognition capability of a fire disaster high-temperature area and an edge area is enhanced, and particularly, the boundary recognition of a low disturbance area is effectively optimized. The space-time reconstruction and interpolation algorithm is adopted to comprehensively recover the data loss caused by the shielding of smoke and cloud, so that the integrity and continuity of the image are ensured, and the precision of disaster assessment and decision support is improved.
assignees: LINGBAO HUAXIANG WIND POWER DEV CO LTD;HENAN BRANCH OF CHINA THREE GORGES RENEWABLES GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle communication perception cooperative method under power grid fault scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle communication perception cooperative method under a power grid fault scene, which combines unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic topology reconstruction and a multi-stage optimization strategy, realizes efficient information acquisition aiming at an emergency scene of ground base station damage and large-area power failure in a disaster area after the power grid fault, optimizes communication unmanned aerial vehicle deployment by introducing tide entropy, solves an optimal communication coverage strategy based on a multi-objective gray wolf optimization algorithm, simultaneously optimizes an unmanned aerial vehicle inspection path by utilizing a graph theory method and a shortest path search algorithm Dijkstra, improves fault diagnosis efficiency, preferentially covers important load nodes and performs inspection in a first stage under a two-stage optimization framework, and performs complementary optimization on an uncovered area in a second stage to finally obtain a global optimal solution which takes account of unmanned aerial vehicle resource efficiency, communication quality and information acquisition.

title_en: Assimilation method for improving analysis precision of warm salt based on submarine pressure data
abstract_en: A method for improving the analysis precision of warm salt based on the data of the pressure of the sea bottom includes such steps as obtaining the observation data including the temp, salinity, sea surface temp, sea surface salinity and pressure of the sea bottom, increasing the altitude of sea surface, building the objective function of the space-time four-dimensional multi-scale data assimilation frame, setting the dynamic constraint condition of the space-time four-dimensional multi-scale data assimilation frame, inputting the prepared observation data, and assimilating the combined data to reconstruct the analysis field of warm salt. The invention can enhance the vertical structural precision of the thermal salt field, improve the data quality and reliability, and improve the overall precision of ocean state analysis, thereby improving the prediction precision of ocean disasters and improving the prediction and early warning of the ocean disasters.

title_en: Space-sky-earth-internal geological disaster three-dimensional monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-sky-earth-internal geological disaster three-dimensional monitoring system and a method thereof, the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring module, a satellite remote sensing monitoring module, a ground monitoring module, an underground monitoring module, a communication module, a data fusion processing module and an early warning signal issuing module. The invention realizes comprehensive monitoring of various observation contents under different space and time scales and different environmental conditions through cooperative monitoring of various different levels and different types of technical means, combines unmanned aerial vehicle rapid inspection and satellite remote sensing periodic monitoring, can monitor the ground environment all the time without interruption, improves the data updating frequency, and realizes high-precision investigation and monitoring of geological disasters in a small range and important sections by adopting ground sensing and underground ground penetrating radar monitoring. The monitoring data result of the invention is cooperatively monitored by multiple technologies, the advantages of various technical means are exerted to the maximum extent, and scientific basis and data support can be provided for disaster risk assessment, emergency response and post-disaster reconstruction.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;CHONGQING RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH;CHINA COMMUNICATIONS CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;XIAN CHINA HIGHWAY GEOTECHNICAL ENG CO LTD;CCCC INFRASTRUCTURE MAINTENANCE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Model simulation-based damage efficiency simulation and evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a damage effectiveness simulation and evaluation system based on model simulation, which relates to the technical field of explosive effect simulation analysis, and the invention obtains three-dimensional scanning data of a target simulated explosive structure, and a physical field simulation model of the target object is reconstructed based on the finite element grid, so that the stress behavior and stress distribution state of the structure in the actual blasting environment can be accurately restored. And the first correction module and the second correction module are used for correcting the explosive pressure field and the equivalent stress, so that the limitation that the traditional simulation model ignores the environmental complexity is broken through, and evaluation distortion or misjudgment is avoided. In the simulation process, a fragile region with concentrated stress in the structure is automatically identified, and a damage level distribution map is dynamically calibrated by combining the corrected pressure field and stress evaluation, so that a hierarchical early warning instruction is generated, and a scientific basis is provided for engineering protection design, emergency response and risk control.

title_en: Self-adaptive noise reduction method and system for coal rock acousto-electric monitoring signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive noise reduction method and a system for coal rock acoustic-electric monitoring signals, wherein the noise reduction method comprises the following steps of collecting underground working face acoustic-electric monitoring signals within a preset time period by using a coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring system to obtain acoustic emission intensity, acoustic emission pulse, electromagnetic radiation intensity and electromagnetic radiation pulse signals; the method comprises the steps of establishing a variation modal decomposition signal decomposition model, inputting the acoustic-electric monitoring signal into the model, carrying out modal decomposition on the coal rock acoustic-electric monitoring signal to obtain and update modal components with determined center frequency and bandwidth, establishing a Kalman filtering model, inputting each modal component into the Kalman filtering model to obtain internal characteristics of each modal component, removing redundant noise, reconstructing each modal component after Kalman filtering, and realizing self-adaptive noise reduction of the acoustic-electric monitoring signal.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for energy system capacity optimization and mobile resource space-time decoupling collaborative scheduling under extreme disaster disturbance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy scheduling, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for energy system capacity optimization and mobile resource space-time decoupling collaborative scheduling under extreme disaster disturbance, wherein the method comprises the steps of linking equipment failure probability and line failure probability according to extreme disaster event data and coupling load change parameters to form a disaster response database; the method comprises the steps of converting renewable energy output fluctuation and user load demand deviation into fuzzy variables, establishing a capacity configuration optimization model by combining a disaster response database to generate a multi-energy complementary capacity configuration, introducing mobile resources to establish an elastic lifting scheduling model, and generating an elastic lifting scheme by implementing damaged road network topology reconstruction, space-time transfer chain modeling and action state cooperative regulation of the mobile resources. The invention realizes double elastic gain of fixed resource optimization and quick response after the mobile resource disaster under extreme disaster event by collaborative decision of disaster response database driving equipment capacity optimization and mobile resource dynamic scheduling.

title_en: Real projective image generating method, storage medium and device based on three-dimensional Gaussian model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real projection image generation method, a storage medium and a device based on a three-dimensional Gaussian model, and aims to solve the problems of low image quality, low generation speed, detail loss and the like in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps of firstly obtaining image data through unmanned aerial vehicle or aerial photography, extracting camera gestures and sparse point clouds by utilizing a motion restoration structure (SfM) technology, constructing a three-dimensional Gaussian model based on the sparse point clouds, and carrying out iterative training through top-view orthographic projection combined gradient descent algorithm. In the training process, a densification strategy, a point deleting strategy, a blocking strategy and an image pyramid strategy are innovatively introduced, so that the image detail expressive force and the overall quality are remarkably improved. Specifically, the densification strategy realizes fine detail reconstruction by dynamically increasing the density of the Gaussian balls, and the point deleting strategy improves the rendering efficiency and optimizes the computing resource allocation by eliminating the redundant Gaussian balls; the image pyramid strategy generates a multi-level visual effect through multi-scale training, and the blocking strategy improves reconstruction accuracy through local optimization. Finally, based on the three-dimensional Gaussian model which is completed through training, real-time generation of high-quality real shot images in a large-scale scene can be realized. The method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of efficiency, precision and practicability, provides important technical support for the fields of geographic information systems, urban planning, disaster monitoring and the like, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Vertical articulated automatic fire extinguishing robot
abstract_en: A vertical multi-joint automatic fire extinguishing robot is disclosed. The present specification comprises: a robot arm assembly connected to a fire extinguisher to spray a fire extinguishing liquid at a fire scene; and a control device for controlling driving of the robot arm assembly at the fire scene. A robot arm assembly comprises: a plurality of multi-joint frames; and a plurality of robot arms. A spray hose provided inside a spray hose frame supported by at least one of the plurality of robot arms is connected to a fire extinguisher. A fire extinguishing liquid is sprayed through a nozzle of the spray hose. The switching valve is included in the spray hose frame in order to control the jet of the digestive fluid.
abstract_ko: 수직 다관절 자동 소화 로봇이 개시된다. 본 명세서는 소화기와 연결되어 화재현장에서 소화액을 분사하는 로봇팔 어셈블리 및 화재현장에서 로봇팔 어셈블리의 구동을 제어하는 제어장치를 포함한다. 로봇팔 어셈블리 복수의 다관절 프레임, 복수의 로봇팔로 구성되며 복수의 로봇팔 중 적어도 하나에 의해 지지되는 분사호스 프레임 내부에 구비되는 분사호스가 소화기와 연결되어 있으며, 분사호스의 노즐을 통해 소화액이 분사된다. 스위칭 밸브가 소화액의 분사를 조절하기 위하 분사호스 프레임에 구비된다.

title_en: A fire-fighting drone
abstract_en: The present invention can provide a firefighting drone which can quickly replace a battery to be quickly reintroduced into a fire scene, has a loading space capable of transferring various firefighting and rescue products, and can directly spray a fire extinguishing agent and water to a fire hydrant for fire suppression. In addition, the present invention comprises: a main body having a reinforcing bar installed on an upper end surface to reinforce rigidity against distortion; and a carrier disposed below the main body, wherein a fire extinguishing device for spraying water and a fire extinguishing agent to the front is coupled to the carrier, and when relief goods are transported through the carrier, the reinforcing bar can prevent damage to the main body.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 배터리를 빠르게 교체할 수 있어, 빠르게 화재현장에 재투입될 수 있고, 다양한 소방 및 구조용품을 이송할 수 있는 적재공간을 구비하며, 화재진압을 위해 화전에 직접 소화제 및 물을 분사할 수 있는 소방드론을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명은 상단면에 뒤틀림에 대한 강성을 보강하기 위한 보강대가 설치되는 본체 및 상기 본체의 하방에 배치되는 캐리어를 포함하여, 상기 캐리어에는 전방으로 물 및 소화제를 분사하는 소화장치가 결합되고, 상기 캐리어를 통해 구호물품이 운반될 때, 상기 보강대가 상기 본체의 파손을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Reconfigurable maritime search and rescue reconnaissance robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconfigurable maritime search and rescue reconnaissance robot which comprises a robot main body, reconfigurable mechanisms and rotor-paddle wheel integrated modules, wherein reconfigurable mechanism supports are obliquely arranged at tail ends of supporting legs of the robot main body, the reconfigurable mechanisms are arranged in the reconfigurable mechanism supports, support end covers with spherical structures are arranged on the reconfigurable mechanism supports, each reconfigurable mechanism is connected with one rotor-paddle wheel integrated module, the rotor-paddle wheel integrated modules are driven to rotate at 360 degrees on the support end covers when the reconfigurable mechanisms rotate, and meanwhile, the rotor-paddle wheel integrated modules do shearing motion around the support end covers to realize the reconfiguration of a robot motion mode. The invention can change the shape of the robot and realize the reconstruction of the movement mode of the robot, thereby solving the problems of low efficiency, poor stability and the like of the existing maritime search and rescue technology, and especially in the face of maritime emergency accidents, rescue ships can not enter disaster sites due to falling of goods or buildings.

title_en: Charging station depth defense protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station deep defense protection method, relates to the technical field of fire early warning and safety protection, and aims to solve the problems of high fire early warning false alarm rate, fire isolation delay and insufficient credibility of accident tracing data in the prior art. The method constructs a full-period protection system of 'monitoring-disposal-tracing', wherein a temperature field, electrical parameters and environmental data are collected through multi-source sensor fusion before disaster, a self-adaptive safety threshold is generated based on a dynamic game model, a digital twin deduction and prejudging risk path is combined, a three-level response mechanism is adopted in disaster, an operation log is stored in a slicing mode through a blockchain space-time anchoring technology after disaster, and a digital twin reverse reconstruction accident evolution chain is utilized to generate tamper-resistant judicial evidence. According to the invention, early warning precision is improved through dynamic threshold optimization, response time is shortened through multistage linkage control, traceability reliability is guaranteed through a quantum evidence storage technology, and a closed-loop optimization system for fire protection of the charging station is formed.
assignees: QUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Heterogeneous extreme event prediction method for data tail distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data tail distribution heterogeneous extreme event prediction method, which belongs to the field of disaster prediction and comprises the steps of collecting historical data of scene dependent event occurrence as a scene dependent event data set, generating a non-scene dependent event data set according to experimental simulation, constructing a distribution function set fitting a data distribution rule, splitting tail data to form a plurality of split data sets, fitting an optimal distribution function model of each split data set by using the distribution function model to serve as a priori data equation, splitting the non-scene dependent event data set into a plurality of continuous data sub-data sets, using the optimal distribution function model as a distribution equation of the sub-data sets, and predicting data about to happen of the scene dependent event by using a data reconstruction equation. The invention not only provides scientific basis for disaster prevention and control, but also provides data support for related decisions, and is beneficial to reducing the damage of extreme disasters to society.

title_en: Image super-resolution reconstruction method and system under deep disaster environment fuzzy view field
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of image super-resolution reconstruction, and discloses a method and a system for reconstructing an image super-resolution under a deep disaster environment fuzzy view field, wherein the reconstruction method is realized by a progressive Manba network and comprises the following steps that step 1, a high-resolution image is subjected to double-three downsampling to obtain a low-resolution image, and shallow feature extraction is carried out on the low-resolution image by a shallow feature extraction module; and 2, inputting the output characteristics of the shallow characteristic extraction module into the deep characteristic extraction module to extract the deep characteristics, and 3, fusing the output characteristics in the step 2 together, and carrying out reconstruction operation on the fused characteristics by using a reconstruction module to obtain a final high-resolution reconstructed image. The invention fully considers the important role of the large receptive field in the image reconstruction task, can effectively capture global information in the image, combines the pyramid structure with the Manba model, and realizes better balance among the model parameter quantity, the calculated quantity and the reconstruction performance.

title_en: Rapid probability forecasting method for offshore engineering safety risk in typhoon process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine engineering safe operation, and discloses a rapid probability forecasting method for marine engineering safe risk in a typhoon process, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting historical typhoons and associated disaster data, and reconstructing a typhoon-storm tide-strong current-storm wave combined process so as to obtain historical record information; S2, performing dimension reduction and cluster analysis on the historical record information to obtain hydrologic element occurrence probability distribution, performing correlation analysis on the current typhoon event and the historical typhoon to obtain ocean power factor set forecast, rapidly calculating the risk probability of the offshore engineering under the typhoon event, providing scientific basis for emergency management of the offshore engineering, rapidly responding to the new typhoon event, and providing timely risk information for a decision maker.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Method, system and related equipment for recovering containerized service based on double storage architecture
abstract_en: The invention provides a containerized service recovery method, a system and related equipment based on a double-storage architecture, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a server comprising an SSD main storage and an HDD standby storage; setting a main operating system of a containerized service in a main storage and setting a standby operating system of the main operating system in a standby storage, configuring a shared storage area which can be accessed by both the main operating system and the standby operating system in the standby storage, constructing a timed task in the main operating system to collect mirror image information and configuration information of the containerized service and store the mirror image information and the configuration information into the shared storage area through an incremental backup mechanism, presetting a system abnormal restarting switching mechanism in a management board of a server, switching to the standby operating system for starting when the main operating system fails to start, and reconstructing the containerized service based on the mirror image information and the configuration information in the shared storage area. The invention uses the dual storage architecture and the incremental backup technology to restore the containerized service, and has stronger disaster recovery capability and lower storage expense.

title_en: A outer wall safety evacuation passageway and building body for hospital
abstract_en: The invention provides an outer wall safe evacuation channel for a hospital and a building body, and relates to the technical field of building reconstruction, wherein the outer wall safe evacuation channel comprises a first spiral channel arranged on the outer side of the building body of the hospital, the first spiral channel comprises a corridor group arranged on the building body of the hospital at an inclined angle, and the corridor group comprises a plurality of corridor bodies connected end to end; the corridor body is connected to the hospital building body through a connecting structure. The first spiral channel is installed by machining the insertion hole on the wall of the hospital building body and manufacturing and forming the prefabricated corridor in a factory, the installation of the first spiral channel is finished by utilizing the installation column, so that the construction period is shortened, when a disaster occurs, a patient lying or sitting is pushed out of the first spiral channel from the interior of the hospital building body, the patient leaves the hospital building body from the first spiral channel safely, time and labor are saved, and the risk that serious safety accidents are caused by incapability of moving away from a ward when the disaster occurs in the hospital is solved.

title_en: MILP-based ground mobile communication network survivability reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground mobile communication network survivability reconstruction method based on mixed integer linear programming, which belongs to the technical field of communication network optimization and robustness enhancement and comprises the following steps. The method comprises the steps of defining parameter representations of attribute data of a ground mobile communication network, including node distribution, communication radius and the like, constructing a ground mobile communication network survivability reconstruction MILP model based on a k-connected graph theory, representing connectivity constraint under dynamic movement of nodes through a network flow model, and solving the model through a branch-and-bound algorithm to obtain optimal node coordinate configuration which meets the requirement of survivability topology reconstruction and minimizes total movement distance of network reconstruction. The method can break through the limitation that the traditional passive response cannot resist the network re-failure, improve the topology robustness of the partitioned network after recovery, effectively prevent the risk brought by the secondary damage of the future network, and can be widely applied to the engineering fields of unmanned aerial vehicle trunking communication, emergency disaster relief network and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle scanning sampling method for three-dimensional reconstruction of time-varying disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle scanning sampling method for three-dimensional reconstruction of a time-varying disaster scene, which comprises the steps of generating an initial three-dimensional curved surface model of the time-varying scene by using a satellite image or a geographic database; the method comprises the steps of carrying out downsampling, smoothing and coordinate registration on an initial three-dimensional curved surface model, calculating the surface integrity, smoothness and inter-region continuity of the three-dimensional curved surface model, calculating the space viewpoint fitness and solving a scanning sampling path optimization function, carrying out smoothing on a generated path sequence, carrying out scanning sampling and flying of an unmanned aerial vehicle, and finally outputting a three-dimensional reconstruction result of a time-varying scene. The invention assists the unmanned aerial vehicle to scan and sample the time scene rapidly and autonomously, provides more accurate three-dimensional reconstruction image input of the time-varying scene for operators, and reduces model distortion and region mismatch phenomenon in the time-varying scene reconstruction process.

title_en: Underground emergency rescue communication network construction method based on UAV-WSN
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground emergency rescue communication network construction method based on a UAV-WSN, which belongs to the field of mine emergency rescue, and comprises the steps of carrying out self-reconstruction of a communication network based on a residual WSN node, and constructing a local network taking the residual WSN node as a key node; and constructing communication links between adjacent UAVs, connecting different local networks comprising the UAVs and the WSN, constructing a global network based on the UAV-WSN, and completing the construction of the emergency rescue communication network. The invention starts with the node, realizes the construction of the global emergency communication network of the accident area through the node self-reconstruction and UAV auxiliary network communication on the premise of improving the emergency rescue supporting capability of the node, perfects the existing emergency rescue method, improves the emergency rescue efficiency and provides a new idea for emergency rescue.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;XUZHOU KERUI MINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban heat supply pipe network emergency knowledge graph construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing an emergency knowledge graph of an urban heat supply network, and relates to the technical field of emergency knowledge graph data processing. The method comprises the steps of collecting emergency knowledge base data of the urban heat supply pipe network, constructing an emergency knowledge map base model of the urban heat supply pipe network, acquiring real-time earthquake disaster information, if the emergency earthquake information is not updated, not adjusting, and if the emergency earthquake information is updated, reconstructing the emergency knowledge map base model of the urban heat supply pipe network according to the updated emergency earthquake information to obtain a real-time earthquake emergency knowledge map of the urban heat supply pipe network. According to the method, the urban heat supply network emergency knowledge graph construction method is optimized according to the disaster model construction comparison analysis result, the effect of improving the adaptability of the urban heat supply network emergency knowledge graph construction to external disaster changes is achieved, and the problem that the adaptability of the urban heat supply network emergency knowledge graph construction to external disaster changes is insufficient in the prior art is solved.
assignees: URBAN SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENT SCIENCE INSTITUTE BEIJING INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING

title_en: Structure is reformed transform in market fire control
abstract_en: The application relates to a market fire-fighting reconstruction structure, which comprises a fire-fighting safety box, wherein a fire hose and a fire hydrant are arranged in the fire-fighting safety box, a plurality of partition plates are arranged in the fire-fighting safety box, the partition plates and the inner side wall of the fire-fighting safety box enclose together to form a water collecting cavity below the fire hydrant, the bottom of the water collecting cavity is communicated with a drain pipe, a limiting plate positioned above the water collecting cavity is further arranged on the inner side wall of the fire-fighting safety box, limiting holes are formed in the limiting plate in a penetrating mode, gaps are formed in the tops of the limiting holes, and the limiting holes are used for limiting the end parts of the fire hose on the limiting plate. The application has the effects of conveniently draining fire water in the fire hose and further reducing the fire work load of staff.
assignees: WENZHOU YIHONG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional reconstruction method for coal mine karst collapse column based on morphological feature analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional reconstruction method of a coal mine karst collapse column based on morphological feature analysis, which is based on the data of the underground excavated and exposed collapse column, performs data fusion on the morphological features of the exposed collapse column by utilizing a mode of combining an analytic hierarchy process and an entropy weight process, then performs high fitting on the collapse column by utilizing regression analysis, and finally performs three-dimensional reconstruction on the collapse column by utilizing an interpolation algorithm and a Dironi triangle network, thereby accurately expressing the problem of specific detail features of the collapse column, providing an important collapse column model foundation for quantitative evaluation of hidden disaster factors of coal mines, and being suitable for large-scale industrial use and popularization.
assignees: XIAN MEIKE TRANSPARENT GEOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Earthquake building damage degree detection method and system based on multi-mode sensor data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster building detection, and particularly discloses a method and a system for detecting the damage degree of an earthquake building based on multi-mode sensor data fusion, which are characterized in that multi-mode sensor equipment is used for collecting multi-dimensional data, the sensor data is subjected to signal preprocessing, the characteristic representation capacity is enhanced through a data fusion module, a detection model is built based on an improved YOLOv algorithm, the model is trained by utilizing a data set, the final earthquake building damage degree detection model is obtained, the damage degree of a building can be detected and evaluated in real time, and the result is divided into four grades: intact, slightly damaged, severely damaged, and fully damaged. The invention can be used for quickly extracting the damage information of the building so as to assist rescue decision and post-disaster reconstruction work.

title_en: Multi-disaster Internet of things time sequence self-adaptive anomaly detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster Internet of things time sequence self-adaptive anomaly detection method and a system, which relate to the field of Internet of things, and the method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing an anomaly detection model; S2, acquiring a training data set, S3, training an anomaly detection model, S4, acquiring data to be detected, S5, analyzing a reconstruction structure of the data to be detected, S6, analyzing anomaly scores, and an emergency disaster early warning system comprising an acquisition unit, a storage unit, a calculation unit and an early warning unit, wherein the characteristics of a multi-scale time convolution network and a self-adaptive frequency spectrum characteristic module on a time domain and a frequency domain are fused, the characteristics of time sequence data on the time domain and the frequency domain are deeply mined, a gating memory mechanism is introduced to accurately capture and strengthen normal time-frequency characteristics in the data, the identification capability is improved, and a radial basis function layer is added to remarkably improve the detection capability of the model on fine anomalies, so that the model can more accurately detect fine anomaly changes.

title_en: Urban power distribution network fault prediction and reconstruction method and system under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting and reconstructing faults of an urban power distribution network in extreme weather, and relates to the field of power distribution network fault prediction and reconstruction. According to the invention, a data-driven power distribution network modeling mode is adopted, namely a numerical weather forecast model is introduced, a large amount of historical extreme weather event data are collected and prediction factors are generated to form a perfect dataset, a few oversampling technologies are adopted for balancing the dataset through statistical transformation and regression synthesis, extremum distribution of target variables is processed, and key multi-weather factors causing power failure events are identified, so that influence of extreme weather on the power distribution network is accurately predicted, and the problem of experience dependence of a conventional power distribution network fault model is solved. In the post-disaster power distribution network recovery stage, the distributed energy sources are scheduled based on a mixed integer nonlinear programming model to minimize the power distribution network reconstruction cost, so that the continuous power supply capacity of a power distribution system in the power failure period is met, and the power distribution network reconstruction is realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power system state estimation method considering unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling
abstract_en: The invention aims to solve the problem of insufficient robustness of a traditional power grid state estimation method in a post-disaster recovery and emergency communication scene, and provides an electric power system emergency state estimation method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative graph neural network. The method integrates unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic communication scheduling and a space-time diagram neural network, and solves the problems of data loss, topology time variation, communication interruption and the like. By constructing a simulation data set, designing a space-time diagram convolution network, generating a node voltage estimation and confidence coefficient thermodynamic diagram by combining a diagram characteristic reconstruction module, and formulating a recovery priority strategy. Meanwhile, an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency communication optimization model is built, and efficient communication resource allocation is achieved. The invention has the beneficial effects of providing a method for collaborative optimization of an information-physical system, providing a quick and reliable communication alternative scheme and solving the problems of measurement deficiency and topology time variation. And a closed loop feedback model is established, so that the communication resource allocation scheduling is dynamically optimized, and the real-time dynamic mode of the power system is adapted.

title_en: Fire-fighting nondestructive detection method based on multi-mode detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting nondestructive detection method based on multi-mode detection, which relates to the technical field of fire engineering and comprises the following steps of rapidly scanning fire-fighting equipment through an ultrasonic array, analyzing and positioning suspected defect areas based on time domain reflection signals, and generating a three-dimensional coordinate mapping model; and (3) carrying out multi-angle X-ray projection acquisition on the positioning area, and generating an internal structure tomographic image through a three-dimensional reconstruction algorithm. The fire-fighting nondestructive detection method provided by the invention realizes comprehensive and accurate identification of potential defects of the fire-fighting equipment by integrating various technical means such as ultrasonic array scanning, X-ray tomography, thermal imaging analysis and microwave sealing detection, improves the dimension and precision of defect detection, maintains the structural integrity of the equipment to the maximum extent, avoids extra risks caused by destructive detection, and improves the reliability and accuracy of detection through a data fusion algorithm.
assignees: JIANGSU GUOTAI FIRE FIGHTING TECH SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Special environment laser radar system and method based on polarization modulation and laser coding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special environment laser radar system and a method based on polarization modulation and laser coding, wherein the laser radar system comprises a polarization modulation laser emitting unit, a multi-channel receiving unit and a compressed sensing reconstruction unit, the polarization modulation laser emitting unit comprises a laser, a beam expanding module, a spatial light modulator, a micro-vibrating mirror array, a spatial filter and a first focusing lens which are sequentially arranged, the multi-channel receiving unit comprises a second focusing lens, a polarization beam splitter and a single-pixel detector array which are sequentially arranged, and the compressed sensing reconstruction unit comprises a compressed sensing processing module, an image reconstruction module and a ring-made self-adaptive control module which are sequentially arranged. The invention enhances the anti-interference capability under the complex environment through polarization modulation, combines laser coding to improve the detection resolution and the signal to noise ratio, greatly improves the imaging quality and the stability of the laser radar under the special environment, and can be widely applied to the fields of military reconnaissance, disaster relief, unmanned driving and the like.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring ice-condensation disasters of high-altitude tunnel portal and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring, and particularly discloses a method and a device for monitoring ice condensation disasters of a high-altitude tunnel portal and a computer-readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining ice condensation related parameters of the high-altitude tunnel portal; analyzing the relevant parameters of the frozen ice to determine the core parameters of the frozen ice, arranging a mobile monitoring device at the high-altitude tunnel portal, acquiring real-time monitoring data of the high-altitude tunnel portal based on the mobile monitoring device according to the core parameters of the frozen ice, executing three-dimensional meteorological field reconstruction operation based on the real-time monitoring data to generate a reconstructed meteorological field, and generating disaster monitoring results based on the reconstructed meteorological field. By combining the actual physical characteristics of the high-altitude tunnel portal, the ice condensation mechanism is analyzed, ice condensation monitoring and early warning are carried out around the ice condensation core parameters, so that the real-time performance, accuracy and comprehensiveness of ice condensation monitoring are improved, and the actual demands of enterprises are met.

title_en: Fire-fighting robot for unattended places
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting robots and discloses a fire-fighting robot for an unattended place, which comprises a chassis, wherein a tire is arranged at the bottom of the chassis, a mounting frame is arranged at the top of the chassis, a front camera is arranged at the front part of the mounting frame, a gas sensor, an audible-visual annunciator and a holder are arranged at the front part of the top surface of the mounting frame, an infrared camera and a fire-extinguishing agent spray gun are arranged at two sides of the holder, a fire-extinguishing agent storage tank is arranged in the mounting frame, the top of the fire-extinguishing agent storage tank is connected with the fire-extinguishing agent spray gun through a first conveying pipe, and a second conveying pipe is arranged at the rear part of the fire-extinguishing agent storage tank. By adopting the 4-wheel 4-drive structure, the laser and structured light are fused with slam, the depth camera environment is reconstructed and the like, so that the problems that the fixed fire extinguishing device in the traditional fire extinguishing system depends on preset conditions and is difficult to extinguish fire accurately in the face of complex fire are solved, and the problems of inaccurate response to the fire and poor alarm reliability are solved.
assignees: SHANGHAI SAIBIN SPECIAL ELECTRONIC COMPONENTS CO LTD

title_en: Online intelligent detection system for house integrity and periphery based on sensing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line intelligent detection system for house integrity and periphery based on sensing data, which relates to the technical field of structural health monitoring and comprises a distributed sensor module, an edge calculation node module, a dynamic topology communication network module and a cloud analysis platform module, wherein the distributed sensor module consists of a fiber bragg grating sensor array, an MEMS (micro electro mechanical system) environment sensor and an image acquisition unit and is respectively arranged in a house bearing structure, a periphery foundation, a drainage system and a greening area, the edge calculation node module is used for preprocessing sensor data and comprises noise filtering, temperature compensation and abnormal data marking, the dynamic topology communication network module adopts LoRaMesh and 5G mixed networking technology and supports node self-repairing and bandwidth self-adaptive distribution, and the cloud analysis platform module integrates BIM model reconstruction, multi-source data fusion analysis and early warning decision and outputs structural deformation prediction, energy consumption abnormal patterns and disaster risk assessment reports.
assignees: SHANGHAI HUACHUANG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Marine environment dynamic monitoring system based on cooperation of artificial intelligence and multi-source remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine environment dynamic monitoring system based on cooperation of artificial intelligence and multi-source remote sensing, which relates to the technical field of marine environment monitoring, and is used for realizing multi-dimensional monitoring of sea surface states by receiving multi-source data of a plurality of monitoring ends, dynamically triggering a subsequent processing flow by setting sliding window difference to detect chlorophyll concentration mutation in real time, improving the response speed of sudden events (such as red tides), remarkably reducing the space-time asynchronous error of the multi-source data by combining interpolation reconstruction, weighted fusion and ocean current compensation technology by utilizing AI prediction clock offset, generating a data cube fused with a backward scattering coefficient, a temperature field and chlorophyll gradient, calculating a diffusion speed field, and providing high-precision decision support for ocean disaster early warning. Breaks through the limitation of the traditional single data source, and realizes the real-time performance, the accuracy and the dynamic analysis capability improvement of marine environment monitoring by the efficient collaboration of the multi-mode data driven by the artificial intelligence.

title_en: Intermittent type water-bursting and mud-bursting filling structure anti-bursting body reconstruction simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intermittent water and mud bursting filling structure bursting body reconstruction simulation test device, which belongs to the technical field of tunnel disaster research test devices and comprises a water supply unit, a filling medium storage tank, a tunnel simulation unit, a water collecting unit and a measuring unit, wherein the water supply unit is used for storing water required by multiple tests and is used for flowing out water with set pressure, the filling medium storage tank is communicated with the water supply unit and is used for filling test media to simulate silt in a tunnel mud bursting process, the filling medium storage tank is communicated with the tunnel simulation unit, the water collecting unit is provided with a water collecting tank and a weight display device arranged at the bottom of the water collecting tank, the water collecting tank is used for collecting water flowing out through a channel, the weight display device is used for weighing the weight of water in the water collecting tank, the measuring unit comprises a soil pressure test box and a osmometer, and the technical problems that the conventional test device cannot simulate the tunnel intermittent water bursting mud bursting disaster state and is inconvenient to study the bursting body reconstruction process are solved.

title_en: Passenger dynamic evacuation guiding system for postal wheels
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of escape guiding of mail-wheel accidents, and discloses a mail-wheel passenger dynamic escape guiding system which comprises three modules, namely a monitoring alarm module, a path planning module and a dynamic identification module, wherein when a disaster or abnormal ship body posture of a mail-wheel triggers an alarm, the monitoring alarm module collects related data and transmits the related data in real time, the path planning module reconstructs a path network and distributes path weights according to the data, a Dijkstra algorithm for improving a searching strategy is adopted to search a globally optimal route, the dynamic identification module maps route data to an identification indication direction, the dynamic identification layout is optimized by combining with passenger perception behaviors when the system is deployed, the monitoring alarm module monitors the crowd gathering condition of each road section in real time in the escape process, and the related data is conveyed to the path planning module again to search for a new round. According to the invention, the optimal route can be planned in real time according to the accident scene of the mail wheel, and the indication direction of the evacuation mark can be dynamically adjusted, so that the dynamic guidance of crowd evacuation is realized.
assignees: SANYA SCIENCE AND EDUCATION INNOVATION PARK WUHAN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Deep learning building collapse ground penetrating radar inversion and life-span gap detection method
abstract_en: The application discloses a deep learning building collapse ground penetrating radar inversion and survival gap detection method, which is used for reconstructing dielectric constant distribution in a collapse building, wherein in a complex disaster environment, when the building collapses due to earthquake, explosion or structural failure, the internal structure of the building is influenced by various factors to form an irregular supporting space, and the hollows possibly become living spaces of trapped people; and finally, carrying out logarithmic normalization processing on the label data, optimizing the numerical learning capacity of the model, and carrying out inverse normalization in the post-processing stage so as to ensure the physical interpretability of the prediction result. The dielectric constant distribution can be reconstructed more accurately under the complex collapse structure environment, and reliable auxiliary support is provided for disaster relief.

title_en: Pre-disaster deployment method for mobile power supply of multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster deployment method for a mobile power supply of a multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a pre-disaster deployment frame of the mobile power supply of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system based on regional mutual assistance in consideration of trans-regional supporting potential of the mobile power supply, 2) establishing a pre-disaster emergency response model in consideration of distributed power supply and network reconstruction cooperative scheduling based on the pre-disaster deployment frame of the mobile power supply of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system, and 3) solving the pre-disaster emergency response model in consideration of the distributed power supply and network reconstruction cooperative scheduling by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning network to obtain a pre-disaster deployment decision of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system. The method can fully consider the trans-regional supporting potential of the mobile power supply, fully describe uncertainty of multi-region faults on the premise of guaranteeing solving efficiency, and improve elasticity of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Distribution station emergency response and power transferring method for distributed energy uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution station emergency response and power conversion method of distributed energy uncertainty, which comprises the steps of constructing a distributed energy output model, constructing a load weight model, clustering a fault recovery period by adopting an ISODATA clustering algorithm, establishing an island division model based on a clustering result and aiming at maximizing a recovery loss load, establishing a network reconstruction model based on network loss minimization, voltage offset minimization and switching operation frequency minimization, carrying out island division by adopting a breadth-first traversal method based on the island division model and the distributed energy output model, improving a whale algorithm by adopting a chaotic mapping and reverse learning strategy, carrying out network reconstruction by adopting an improved whale algorithm, integrating the island division result and the network reconstruction result, and outputting a distribution station fault recovery operation result. The method can effectively solve the problem of unreliable power supply of the distribution area.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV SHENYANG TECHNOLOGY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Forest fire smoke image generation method and system based on improvement CycleGAN
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire smoke image generation method and system based on improvement CycleGAN, belonging to the crossing field of forest fire safety technology, deep learning technology and computer vision identification technology. The method can learn potential distribution rules of fog without paired foggy images-foggy images, synthesize and output foggy images corresponding to input foggy images. The model adopts CycleGAN frames, a foggy image is synthesized by using a double-branch generator, and a physical formula of an atmospheric scattering model, a dense residual error module and a double-path attention module are introduced, so that a training scheme of characteristic reconstruction loss, countermeasure loss and characteristic matching loss is optimized. The pair of images with strong physical constraint corresponding to the pixels are generated and the precision of the generated images is improved. The method for generating the forest fire smoke image unpaired image provides an effective solution for solving the problem that a high-quality paired data set in an image defogging task is difficult to acquire in recent years.

title_en: Method for synchronously backing up disaster recovery historical data based on PLM and recovery method thereof
abstract_en: A PLM-based synchronous backup disaster recovery historical data method comprises the following steps of firstly grading service data to obtain incremental data and other data, then storing the incremental data and other data by adopting different backup strategies, processing the incremental data by adopting a lightweight incremental capturing technology, extracting a change data unit, generating a blockchain hash value to carry out integrity check to obtain data to be backed up, firstly storing the data to be backed up to at least two heterogeneous cloud storage nodes respectively based on a multi-cloud distribution strategy, establishing a cross-cloud redundancy index, when a disaster recovery event is triggered, loading core data preferentially by an intelligent recovery engine, reconstructing an incremental data link based on a time stamp to obtain recovered data, carrying out consistency check on the recovered data, and then repairing anomalies caused by version conflicts or data loss to obtain the complete recovered data. According to the invention, the data stored in different databases are synchronized, so that the safety of the data is improved.
assignees: NO 719 RES INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CO LTD

title_en: Mine dust concentration prediction and control method based on self-supervision learning of GNN and transducer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine dust concentration prediction and control method based on self-supervision learning of GNN and a transducer, and belongs to the field of coal mine disaster early warning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode mine environment parameters and historical dust concentration data, carrying out standardization and feature engineering treatment on the data, carrying out partial masking on the treated data by adopting an MAE strategy, and reconstructing the internal structure of the masked partial learning data, generating synthetic data similar to the actual mine environment by utilizing GAN (gas-oxygen) to expand a training set, fusing the spatial features extracted by a GNN module with the time sequence features extracted by a transducer module to generate comprehensive feature representation, predicting dust concentration values of all positions of a mine based on the comprehensive features, generating ventilation control parameter suggestions, and dynamically adjusting a mine ventilation system according to a prediction result to realize dust concentration control.

title_en: Method and device for providing customized information based on adverse drug reaction information
title_ko: 의약품 이상반응 정보에 기반한 맞춤형 정보 제공 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present disclosure provides a method for providing user-customized medical information. The method comprises the steps of: collecting medicine data based on at least one among public data, ministry of food and drug safety data, and korea drug safety management service data; classifying sections of the medicine data, tagging the medicine data based on at least one among importance and a preset subject for each section, and generating reconfigured medicine data based on tagging information; and providing the reconfigured medicine data corresponding to user medical information received from a terminal communicatively connected to the server to the terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예는, 사용자 맞춤형 의료 정보 제공 방법을 제공한다. 본 방법은, 공공 데이터, 식품의약품안전처 데이터 및 한국의약품안전관리원 데이터 중 적어도 하나에 기초하여 의약품 데이터를 수집하는 단계, 상기 의약품 데이터의 섹션을 분류하고, 상기 섹션별로 중요도 및 기설정된 주제 중 적어도 하나에 기초하여 상기 의약품 데이터를 태깅하며, 태깅 정보에 기초하여 재구성 의약품 데이터를 생성하는 단계 및 상기 서버와 통신 연결된 단말로부터 수신한 사용자 의료 정보에 대응되는 상기 재구성 의약품 데이터를 상기 단말로 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Control Speaker for Emergency Broadcasting with Laser Pointer
abstract_en: A control speaker for emergency broadcasting equipped with a laser pointer comprises: a fire detection unit(15) having a sensor which senses temperature and gas when the temperature and gas exceed a predetermined range; a main control unit(16) which controls to output an announcement and to emit a laser beam; a sound output unit(17) which performs an evacuation announcement; a speaker(22) equipped with a laser pointer(19) which displays an exit position with a straight line or an arrow; and a plurality of vibrators(21) which are installed on the floor towards an exit to vibrate by the control of the main control unit. The present invention has an effect of allowing evacuees to easily evacuate in a situation where it is difficult to secure a field of view due to haze and lighting off.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 레이저포인터를 구비한 비상방송용 관제스피커에 관한 것으로, 특히 화재 또는 긴급 재난발생시 경고음 및 대피안내방송을 하면서 레이저포인터를 통하여 레이저 빔을 화재현장 바닥에 비춤으로써 연무로 인해 시야확보가 어려운 상황에서 대피자들이 레이저 빔을 따라 대피할 수 있도록 함과 함께 비상탈출로 바닥에 점자블록형태로 진동자가 설치되어 있어 레이저 빔을 비춤과 동시에 진동자가 진동함으로써 대피자들이 진동방향을 따라 낮은 자세로 따라가면서 조명이 없거나 연무발생의 악조건에서도 안전하고 쉽게 대피할 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
본 발명은 온도가 기설정된 범위 초과시 이를 감지하는 화재감지부(15) 및 이 화재감지부(15)의 감지에 따라 소리출력부(17)를 통해 안내방송을 출력하고 레이저 빔을 발사하도록 제어하는 메인 콘트롤부(16)를 구비하며, 메인 콘트롤부(16)의 제어신호에 따른 화재 또는 긴급재난발생시 레이저 빔을 화재현장 바닥에 발사하여 출구 위치를 표시해 주는 레이저포인터(19)를 구비한 하나의 스피커(22)에 관한 것으로, 상기 스피커(22)가, 서로 평행하게 설치된 한쌍의 브라켓 레일(3), 브라켓레일(3)에 스크류(5)를 통해 결합되는 원형 브라켓 링(4), 브라켓 링(4)에 시계방향으로 돌려서 조이며 레이저 포인터(19)를 가지는 세트(2), 세트(2)의 홈에 끼우고 눌러 결합하는 그릴커버(1)로 구성되며, 메인 콘트롤부(16)의 제어에 의해 진동하도록 비상구쪽 바닥에 설치되는 다수의 진동자(21)로 이루어진다.

title_en: Interactive accident modeling methods and systems for accident reproduction.
title_ko: 사고재현을 위한 인터렉티브 사고 모델링 방법 및 시스템.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for simulating an accident in a vehicle and, more specifically, to a method for modeling an interactive accident for accident reproduction, which operates each object based on a timeline to efficiently synchronize and control the operation and viewpoint of the objects in the simulation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자동차 사고 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것으로, 좀 더 구체적으로 설명하면 타임라인 기반의 각 오브젝트를 조작하여 시뮬레이션 내 객체들의 동작 및 시점을 효율적으로 동기화하고 제어할 수 있도록 한 사고재현을 위한 인터렉티브 사고 모델링 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Island division and fault first-aid repair cooperation method for improving post-disaster toughness of active power distribution network
abstract_en: According to the island division and fault first-aid repair cooperative method for improving the post-disaster toughness of the active power distribution network, firstly, toughness evaluation indexes reflecting the recovery state and the recovery process of the system are constructed by combining the performance curve of the system. The island division model aiming at maximizing the system recovery state index is built, a directed multi-commodity flow model is adopted for network topology reconstruction in the model, DG utilization rate is matched and improved better, a fault rush-repair model aiming at maximizing the system recovery process index is built, power supply to a power loss load is quickened, and the two models dynamically interact and cooperatively improve system toughness in the post-disaster operation and recovery process. The calculation example result shows that compared with the traditional island division model based on spanning tree constraint and the fault rush-repair strategy formulated by the load importance degree, the method can improve the post-disaster power supply capacity of the system. The flexibility of the connection branch and the schedulability of the rush repair resources are utilized to mine the response potential of various DGs, and the post-disaster toughness of the ADN can be further improved.

title_en: Rescue emergency system and method for unmanned aerial vehicle and robot dog
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence rescue and discloses a rescue emergency system and a rescue emergency method for unmanned aerial vehicles and machine dogs, wherein the rescue emergency system for the unmanned aerial vehicles and the machine dogs comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster module, a wireless communication module and a wireless communication module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster module is used for acquiring aerial data, guaranteeing communication and delivering emergency materials; the system comprises a ground environment detection module, a machine dog cluster module, a communication coordination module, a central control module, a man-machine interaction interface module and a control module, wherein the machine dog cluster module is used for ground environment detection, sample collection and special task execution, the communication coordination module is used for ensuring information intercommunication and task coordination between space and ground equipment, the central control module is used for providing task instructions for unmanned aerial vehicle clusters and machine dog clusters, the man-machine interaction interface module is used for realizing effective communication between rescue personnel and a system, and the modules are used for cooperatively working to realize multi-source data collection, three-dimensional scene reconstruction, semantic segmentation, risk assessment, fire spread prediction and decision support information generation on disaster sites and provide reliable basis for rescue command decisions.

title_en: Quick establishment method of earthquake damage building dismantling scheme based on genetic algorithm and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of earthquake engineering and civil engineering, and particularly relates to a quick establishment method of a seismic damage building dismantling scheme based on genetic algorithm and reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a data information base of a target earthquake damage demolishing building, wherein the data information base mainly comprises building structure types, structure plane arrangement, building site categories and beam column member sizes, S2, establishing a structure continuous collapse analysis finite element model according to collected information, S3, determining a demolishing member range allowing demolishing when demolishing the structure collapse analysis is carried out according to the collected information, S4, calculating a single demolishing effect according to the continuous collapse analysis finite element model, and S5, selecting a genetic algorithm or a Q-learning reinforcement learning algorithm according to the fact whether the influence of demolishing sequence is needed to be considered or not, and obtaining an optimal demolishing scheme. The method can be used for quickly making a demolition scheme of a severely damaged building in the post-earthquake disaster repair and reconstruction.
assignees: CHENGDU DESIGN CONSULTING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system based on acoustic-electric signals
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system based on acoustic and electric signals, which belong to the field of coal mine safety monitoring and early warning, the invention adopts a mode reconstruction technology to collect signals through an acoustic emission sensor and an electromagnetic radiation sensor, effectively eliminates the interference of noise on monitoring and early warning results, therefore, the accuracy of monitoring and early warning is improved, meanwhile, a depth subdomain self-adaptive network model is adopted, precursor signals of coal mine dynamic disasters are accurately captured and early warning is carried out, and the intellectualization of the monitoring and early warning process and the prejudging capability of the coal mine dynamic disasters are realized.

title_en: Post-disaster collaborative scheduling method and post-disaster collaborative scheduling terminal for electric traffic coupling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster collaborative scheduling method and a post-disaster collaborative scheduling terminal of an electric traffic coupling system. According to the method, topology information, equipment information and road traffic flow of a fault area are acquired, a system isolation model of an electric traffic coupling system in a fault isolation stage and a system recovery model of the electric traffic coupling system in a service recovery stage are respectively constructed, the system isolation model and the system recovery model are respectively solved, a cooperative scheduling scheme of a reconstructed topology information generating system in the fault isolation stage is obtained according to the system isolation model, and a cooperative scheduling scheme of the reconstructed topology information generating system in the service recovery stage is obtained according to the system recovery model. The invention can comprehensively consider the mutual influence of the electric power system and the traffic system, quickly realize fault isolation and service recovery after disaster through the topology reconstruction of the power distribution network and the traffic network, effectively improve the toughness of the electric traffic coupling system, reduce the power loss load and the traffic jam, and ensure the safe and stable operation of the system.

title_en: Quick response flood disaster monitoring method and system based on super-resolution reconstruction
