abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring method and a system for fast response flood disasters based on super-resolution reconstruction, wherein the method comprises the steps of continuously acquiring a plurality of static orbit satellite remote sensing images of a disaster area and preprocessing the images; the method comprises the steps of inputting a preprocessed static orbit satellite remote sensing image into a trained super-resolution image reconstruction deep learning model, outputting a reconstructed disaster area remote sensing image, inputting the reconstructed disaster area remote sensing image into a trained flood disaster monitoring neural network model, and outputting a disaster range extraction result and a disaster condition evaluation result. According to the invention, by utilizing the high time resolution characteristic of the stationary orbit satellite, emergency response is provided when disaster occurs, cloud removal processing, super resolution reconstruction and flood disaster area extraction are completed based on pure vision and deep learning model algorithm, application under various extreme weather can be supported, and quick response basic data service is provided for timely rescue and relief work and economic loss estimation.

title_en: Park fire-fighting early warning management system and method for property management
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire control and discloses a park fire control early warning management system and method for property management, wherein the park fire control early warning management system comprises the steps of constructing a conduction reachability matrix to quantify the physical association strength of a sensor in a building heat conduction network, activating a conduction path association device to perform data cross verification when the sensor alarms, and outputting a three-level credibility label; the deconstructing fixed plan is a detecting element, a control element and a suppressing element basic unit, a plan execution chain containing an execution sequence is generated based on real-time fire simulation dynamic assembly, and intelligent migration of the response rule of the new park is realized through building a topology vector matching historical case library. The invention breaks through the limitation that the traditional system depends on single sensor threshold judgment, endows the sensor network with self-interpretation capability through a physical conduction model, eliminates the kidnapping effect of false alarm on system decision, reconstructs an alarm-confirmation-response linear flow into a multipath parallel decision mechanism, and avoids the secondary disaster risk caused by false start of a smoke discharging system in the traditional scheme.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN CUIHENG PROPERTY SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent collaborative sensing and decision-making system for emergency response of storage channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic scheduling, and particularly discloses a enter into Tibet-channel emergency response intelligent collaborative awareness and decision-making system, which comprises a multi-level heterogeneous module, a data linkage inquiry module, a channel parameter prediction module, a traffic state evaluation module, an emergency fluffing scheduling module and an information playback and display module, wherein the multi-level heterogeneous module is used for receiving information from a user; the invention ensures that workers in different departments and levels can efficiently acquire the required information through the functions of quick inquiry, such as keyword retrieval, advanced retrieval of complex inquiry conditions, one-stop full text retrieval, batch retrieval and the like, can promote the circulation and sharing of the information, ensures that all relevant departments can make decisions based on the latest and comprehensive information, reduces the information island phenomenon, improves the overall emergency rescue efficiency, and can realize the whole process of recording and revising event perception-comprehensive decision-rescue guarantee based on a comprehensive Geographic Information System (GIS).
assignees: HIGHWAY MONITORING & RESPONSE CENTER MINISTRY OF TRANSP OF THE P R C

title_en: Remote personnel positioning and high-definition image monitoring system based on 5G network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote personnel positioning and high-definition image monitoring system based on a 5G network, which relates to the technical field of 5G intelligent monitoring and positioning and comprises a 5G fusion positioning module, an intelligent image acquisition and processing module, a dynamic aperture camera and super-resolution reconstruction, a 5G edge calculation and transmission module, a federal learning frame and dynamic code rate adaptation, a dynamic networking module, a multi-mode fusion module, an intelligent early warning module and the like, wherein the intelligent image acquisition and processing module is matched with the dynamic aperture camera and the super-resolution reconstruction to support 8K image quality and full-scene perception, and the system further comprises the modules of dynamic networking, multi-mode fusion, intelligent early warning and the like, so that the anti-interference and synergistic capacity is improved. The invention realizes 5G fusion positioning and 8K high-definition monitoring, has strong anti-interference capability, intelligent early warning, privacy protection and long endurance, is suitable for scenes such as intelligent security, industrial inspection and the like, greatly improves emergency response efficiency, and promotes 5G intelligent application to the ground.

title_en: Mixed reality disaster escape route guiding method and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of mine safety intelligent emergency, and particularly provides a mixed reality disaster escape route guiding method and related equipment thereof, wherein the method mainly comprises the steps of obtaining raw data of underground mine holes, and performing three-dimensional reconstruction and feature extraction processing on the raw data to obtain basic environment features; the method comprises the steps of performing topological skeleton extraction and disaster field fusion processing on basic environment characteristics to generate characteristic evolution early-warning signals, performing node collaborative decision processing on the characteristic evolution early-warning signals to generate collaborative decision characteristics, performing path growth and disaster recursion detection processing on the collaborative decision characteristics, and outputting escape path chain characteristics. According to the application, dynamic planning and intelligent adjustment of an escape path can be realized, a real-time escape route is visually presented by combining a mixed reality technology, the perception capability of personnel to a complex environment is improved, the escape decision time is shortened, the trapped risk caused by route blocking or information lag is reduced, and the safety and efficiency of disaster escape are improved.
assignees: NOVENCO BLOWER FAN BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Nerve radiation field DSM generation method constrained by two-dimensional triangular network
abstract_en: The invention provides a nerve radiation field DSM generation method based on two-dimensional triangular mesh constraint, which comprises the following steps of step 1, implicit body density and radiation field modeling, step 2, extracting density field gradient and surface normal, step 3, constructing a two-dimensional triangular mesh, step 4, realizing normal consistency constraint based on the two-dimensional triangular mesh, step 5, calculating uncertainty perception rendering loss, and step 6, performing end-to-end joint optimization. The method of the invention optimizes geometric constraint and rendering loss through end-to-end combination, reduces root mean square error of three-dimensional reconstruction compared with the traditional NeRF method, and provides a high-precision DSM generation scheme for remote sensing applications such as city planning, disaster monitoring and the like.

title_en: Light prediction method and device for deformation displacement of rock with anchoring fracture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightweight prediction method and device for deformation displacement of anchored fracture rock, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent early warning of geotechnical engineering disasters. The method comprises the steps of constructing a prediction model by adopting a random configuration network method, removing hidden nodes with low partial contribution degree in the prediction model by utilizing a singular value decomposition method, reducing the number of hidden nodes in the prediction model, reducing the weight of the prediction model, searching for excellent new hidden nodes to replace original hidden nodes in the prediction model by utilizing a random replacement hidden node technology, reconstructing the weight of the prediction model, improving the prediction precision, and realizing the prediction of deformation displacement of the anchored fracture rock by utilizing the light-weight prediction model.

title_en: Building economic loss assessment method and device under coupling effect of earthquake and secondary fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a building economic loss assessment method and device under the coupling effect of earthquake and secondary fire, and relates to the technical field of earthquake engineering. The method comprises the steps of obtaining damage states of a building structure after earthquake through nonlinear time-course analysis according to earthquake input data, establishing a secondary fire CFD analysis model, determining the highest probability ignition point according to the position of inflammable and explosive components, carrying out CFD analysis, outputting temperature field data and smoke spreading data of the structural entity part, the non-structural entity part and the outer surface part of each component, carrying out analysis according to the temperature field data to obtain damage states of the structural part and the non-structural part of each component, obtaining smoke pollution conditions of the outer surface of each component according to the smoke spreading data, further calculating to obtain economic losses of each component, and summarizing losses of all components to obtain total loss of the building. The invention fills the technical blank of multi-disaster coupling loss evaluation, and provides more effective and scientific decision basis for post-earthquake emergency and reconstruction.

title_en: Mobile energy storage pre-layout and moving path two-stage optimization method and device for improving toughness of power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mobile energy storage pre-layout and mobile path two-stage optimization method and device for improving the toughness of a power distribution system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a two-stage random optimization model, optimizing investment decision and initial deployment of mobile energy storage in a normal operation stage, and determining the installation position and capacity of the mobile energy storage; the method comprises the steps of rapidly deploying mobile energy storage to a disaster area through an emergency operation decision in an emergency stage, dynamically reconstructing a micro-grid in the emergency stage to form an independent power supply area taking the mobile energy storage and a distributed power supply as cores, and solving a two-stage random optimization model by adopting an asymptotic opposite-impact algorithm to obtain investment and operation decisions of a mobile energy storage unit. The invention improves the economical efficiency of the power distribution system under normal operation and the recovery capability under disaster scenes.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method and system for virtual reconstruction of accidents
abstract_en: A system and method for generating simulations of a vehicular accidents and detecting inconsistencies between different sources of data for the accidents are disclosed. The system obtains reports and other data describing the accident and processes the information for use by a keyword model. The keyword model is configured to detect terms in the data that are more likely to provide insight into the accident. The keywords are provided to a generative engine that is configured to generate a simulation of the accident based on visual elements corresponding to the keywords. In some cases, the simulation may include an animated video and/or a 3D model of the accident. Individual simulations may be generated for each source of data obtained. The simulations can then be compared to detect potential inconsistencies.

title_en: Offshore early warning threshold judgment method for land frame wave-induced abnormal waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore early warning threshold judgment method of land frame wave-induced abnormal waves, which belongs to the technical field of marine disaster risk management and comprises the steps of acquiring bottom water flow pressure data acquired by a preset submarine pressure sensor array and sea surface micro deformation data of satellite remote sensing, carrying out reverse deduction according to the bottom water flow pressure data and the sea surface micro deformation data, reconstructing a land frame wave three-dimensional energy field, carrying out coupling calculation by utilizing the land frame wave three-dimensional energy field to generate dynamic energy coupling parameters, and outputting abnormal wave early warning signals according to the dynamic energy coupling parameters and the preset dynamic early warning threshold. According to the invention, three-dimensional energy fields are reconstructed through multi-source monitoring data, the terrain and tide dynamic coupling calculation is fused, the self-adaptive early warning threshold decision is realized based on the energy focusing characteristics, and the accuracy and timeliness of offshore engineering disaster defense can be remarkably improved.

title_en: Method for constructing development working face to liberate shallow portion safety coal pillar resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for freeing shallow security coal pillar resources by constructing a development working face, which comprises the following steps of 1, analyzing exploitation conditions, determining a roof water control thought, determining a grouting reconstruction water control thought, 2, determining a grouting reconstruction object and a grouting reconstruction range, wherein the grouting reconstruction object is a loose layer bottom water-containing sand layer, an air oxidation zone and a key fault top, 3, determining drilling and grouting construction parameters, 4, engineering construction, dynamically optimizing a scheme, drawing a grouting P-Q-T dynamic curve, adjusting scheme design, and 5, checking and evaluating engineering effects. According to the invention, by carrying out comprehensive grouting reconstruction on the loose bed bottom containing, wind oxidation zone and fault structure, a roof water-bearing layer in the mining influence range is transformed into a relative water-resisting layer, meanwhile, a fault water-bursting sand channel is plugged, the stability of roof surrounding rock is improved, three formation conditions of a water sand source, water pressure and a bursting sand channel are destroyed, and double disaster prevention and control of the source and the channel are realized.

title_en: Construction method and system of coal mine geological transparent working face
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a transparent working face of coal mine geology, which relate to the technical field of intelligent mines and geological information and comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing visible light, near infrared images and point cloud data, extracting texture, reflectivity, curvature and density characteristics, constructing a three-dimensional structure reconstruction model, a rock stratum inversion model and a geological stress prediction model, generating a three-dimensional geometric structure coordinate set, a rock stratum moisture rate matrix and a vertical stress distribution matrix of each region, setting abnormal judgment conditions, outputting three-dimensional coordinates of abnormal regions and carrying out grading early warning, synthesizing a three-dimensional visual image, and realizing holographic and transparent expression of the geological state of a working face. The method realizes centimeter-level three-dimensional reconstruction of the transparent working surface of the coal mine, conceals accurate positioning of the water-bearing region and the stress abnormal region, constructs a full-attribute dynamic visual scene, remarkably improves disaster early warning timeliness and accuracy of water burst, rock burst and the like, provides real-time geological decision support for intelligent exploitation, and ensures safe and efficient production.
assignees: XIAN LINGRUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene three-dimensional reconstruction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a three-dimensional reconstruction method and device for a fire scene and electronic equipment, which are used for solving the problem of low accuracy of three-dimensional reconstruction of the fire scene. The method comprises the steps of extracting feature points of a plurality of images to be processed to obtain image feature points of each image to be processed, calculating matching relations between the image feature points and the image feature points to obtain a basic matrix, representing geometrical relations between any two matching images in the plurality of images to be processed by the basic matrix, performing sparse reconstruction on the matching relations between the image feature points, the image feature points and the basic matrix to obtain sparse point clouds and camera parameters, converting a relative coordinate system of the sparse point clouds according to geographic positions and the camera parameters of the images to be processed when shooting to obtain real scale point clouds under a world coordinate system, and constructing a three-dimensional model of a target fire scene according to the real scale point clouds and the camera parameters.

title_en: Method, device, system and storage medium for distributing fire power of patrol projectile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a system and a storage medium for distributing fire of a patrol projectile, which comprise the steps of S1, dividing a fire distribution process into a multi-step decision-making process, S2, optimizing a decision-making reward value through a trained D3QN network by single-step decision-making, realizing target distribution of a single patrol projectile, wherein the D3QN network is trained through a random sampling strategy by utilizing distribution experience in a priority playback pool, S3, completing the whole patrol projectile fire distribution process by sequentially carrying out distribution decision-making on the patrol projectile, and calculating rewards and updating the rewards into the priority playback pool after one round of fire distribution is completed. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the optimal distribution of the multi-target striking tasks is realized.

title_en: Distributed monitoring and early warning method and system for tailing pond
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed monitoring and early warning method and system for a tailing pond, and relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring data of a target tailing pond area through tailing pond monitoring equipment to obtain a tailing pond monitoring data set; dividing according to the position identification to obtain a plurality of regional monitoring data sets, carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction to generate a plurality of dynamic three-dimensional models of the tailing pond, calling the historical disaster data sets to carry out disaster analysis to obtain a single disaster data set and a composite disaster data set, carrying out single disaster risk analysis to obtain a single disaster risk index, carrying out composite disaster risk analysis to obtain a composite disaster risk index, and carrying out risk situation emergency early warning. The invention solves the technical problems that the prior art mostly adopts a single type of sensor, only can monitor specific disaster types, and cannot comprehensively evaluate all potential risks facing the tailing pond, so that the accuracy and timeliness of the tailing pond early warning are poor.

title_en: Method for dynamically reconstructing power distribution network disaster based on look-ahead-pre-algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic reconstruction method in power distribution network disaster based on a look-ahead-pre-algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution network reconstruction. The dynamic reconstruction method in power distribution network disaster based on the look-ahead-pre-algorithm comprises inputting initial running state of the power distribution network, and acquiring system state at current moment Generating all feasible action sets at the current moment For each action Executing an evaluation flow, constructing a future disaster scene by using a Monte Carlo method, simulating a system evolution process by combining a basic strategy, and evaluating actions Selecting the action with the minimum expected cost as the optimal action at the current moment to execute and update the system state Updating the time step if the current time step Returning to S2 to continue decision, otherwise, stopping algorithm execution. The reconstruction method optimizes the current decision, considers the influence of the current decision on the future, realizes the efficient and rapid dynamic reconstruction decision in the disaster, and improves the reliability and the toughness of the power distribution network.

title_en: Rock burst prediction method based on improved WOA optimization FTWSVM
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster prediction, in particular to a rock burst prediction method based on improved WOA optimization FTWSVM. Firstly, selecting rock burst intensity level prediction index data, and reconstructing a disaster sensitive index set by adopting a Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA). Then adding nucleation expansion, introducing a fuzzy weight improvement double twin support vector machine to obtain FTWSVM model, and applying M-Map chaotic mapping and opposite learning improvement whale search algorithm to obtain IWOA optimization model key super-parameters. Finally, training a model, establishing a IWOA-FTWSVM-based prediction model, and verifying the performance of the model through a test set. The rock burst intensity level prediction method combines the parameter self-adaption and the small sample modeling method, improves the rock burst intensity level prediction capability, and provides a solution for effectively and timely preventing rock burst disasters in mine exploitation.

title_en: Urban comprehensive energy system toughness improving method under earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving toughness of an urban comprehensive energy system under earthquake disasters, which belongs to the technical field of urban comprehensive energy safety management and comprises the steps of establishing an objective function, restraining an urban comprehensive energy system model by considering short-term load supporting action of natural gas pipes, clustering faults of the urban comprehensive energy system, manually designating rush-repair batches and rush-repair sequences, and reconstructing the urban comprehensive energy system model once again after each fault node is rush-repaired until all fault nodes are rush-repaired. The invention utilizes the short-term load supporting function of the natural gas pipe to realize the energy supply of the comprehensive energy system in a short period, effectively recovers the important load power supply through the action of the interconnecting switch in the power distribution network system, can furthest reduce the load loss through the combined maintenance strategy among all subsystems, and simultaneously can coordinate the maintenance and improve the recovery efficiency of the whole system through the action of the interconnecting switch in the maintenance process.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Intelligent emergency exercise method and system for chemical enterprises based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality-based intelligent emergency exercise method and a virtual reality-based intelligent emergency exercise system for chemical enterprises, which relate to the technical field of virtual reality emergency management and comprise the steps of collecting individual behavior paths, historical accident data and chemical production process flow parameters, and constructing a multivariate fault evolution knowledge graph based on the historical accident data and the chemical production process flow parameters to obtain a multidimensional coupling matrix; the method comprises the steps of inputting a multidimensional coupling matrix into a virtual reality scene generating unit to obtain exercise initial data, constructing a behavior event sequence based on the exercise initial data to obtain an operation track data set, and converting the operation track data set into a directional behavior path. According to the invention, the error mode template set is matched with the individual behavior path to obtain the scene replay parameter set, so that the automatic identification and parameterization extraction of behavior deviation and error type are realized, and the individual path is combined for dynamic adjustment.

title_en: Fire suppression method and system using multiple drones flying in clusters
title_ko: 군집 비행하는 복수의 드론을 이용한 화재 진압 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire suppression method and system using cluster flight of drones flying in clusters, and more specifically, to a fire suppression method and system using a plurality of drones flying in clusters, which can be quickly and accurately applied to a fire site occurring in a high-rise building that is difficult to access by sequentially operating a first drone capable of firing an open coal that removes obstacles before firing a fire extinguishing bomb, a second drone capable of firing a large amount of fire extinguishing bomb through cluster flight, and a third drone capable of checking whether a fire is suppressed, and a system thereof.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군집 비행하는 드론의 군집 비행을 이용한 화재 진압 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 소화탄을 발사하기 전 장애물을 제거하는 개방탄을 발사할 수 있는 제1 드론, 군집 비행을 통해 소화탄을 다량 발사할 수 있는 제2 드론, 화재의 진압 여부를 확인할 수 있는 제3 드론을 순차적으로 운용하여 접근하기 어려운 고층건물에 발생된 화재현장에 신속하고 정확하게 적용 가능한 군집 비행하는 복수의 드론을 이용한 화재 진압 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Box-in top noise reduction device applicable to extra-high voltage converter station converter transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Box-in top noise reduction device suitable for an extra-high voltage converter station converter transformer, which comprises a grid frame arranged at the top of the converter transformer, sound insulation plates arranged at two sides of the top of the converter transformer and an external controller, wherein hooks capable of lifting are respectively arranged at the edges of two sides of the grid frame, the hooks at each side of the grid frame are connected with the sound insulation plates at the same side, so that the sound insulation plates can lift along with lifting of the hooks, the sound insulation plates comprise a mounting frame, two layers of flame retardant plates and sound insulation materials, the two layers of flame retardant plates are arranged on the mounting frame, the sound insulation materials are filled between the two layers of flame retardant plates, a temperature sensor is arranged on the grid frame, and the external controller is in communication connection with the temperature sensor and the hooks. The invention can meet the requirements of sound insulation and noise reduction during daily operation of the converter transformer, can conveniently carry out operation, maintenance and overhaul, can also adapt to automatic falling off of the converter transformer when a fire disaster occurs, has simple design, and can be widely applied to noise control and fire control reconstruction of the converter station.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV COMPANY;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-element main body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information processing, and discloses a multi-element body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment method, a system, a medium and equipment, wherein the multi-element body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment method acquires earthquake emergency treatment information and effects of different departments and different objects, carries out statistical analysis, and summarizes the requirements, effects and characteristics of the different departments and different objects on disaster information and emergency treatment in an earthquake emergency period; and constructing an emergency treatment refinement strategy in a specific scene, and providing a seismic emergency treatment scheme oriented to a multi-element main body. The system comprises a quick response module, an emergency rescue module and a transitional placement and restoration reconstruction module, wherein the system provides a multi-element main body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment scheme, improves the applicability, rationality and scientificity of the earthquake emergency treatment scheme, and provides technical support for effectively integrating earthquake emergency products and emergency decisions.

title_en: Plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent detection early warning device based on hyperspectral reconstruction technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly discloses a plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent detection early warning device based on a hyperspectral reconstruction technology, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a hyperspectral reconstruction and image processing module, a path planning module, an algorithm model optimizing module and a communication and data transmission module are arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle body, an innovative physical model and a deep learning technology are used for fusing spectrum and space information, interference is eliminated, normal and disaster-stricken rice classification precision is improved to 98.28%, disaster-stricken degree identification precision is up to 98.79%, data quantity is reduced, delay and loss risk are reduced, decision information under complex topography is ensured to be timely acquired, disaster-stricken and GPS information is integrated, an optimal path is dynamically planned, working efficiency is improved by 50%, complex environmental adaptability is enhanced, a millimeter-level variable spraying scheme is formulated by combining the factors such as rice growth state, disaster-stricken degree and farmland and soil condition, pesticide spraying precision is up to 98.85%, and effective utilization rate is improved by 88.79%, and a precise pesticide application closed loop is formed.

title_en: Visual early warning function improving method
abstract_en: The invention provides a visual early warning function improving method which comprises the steps of S1, unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic path planning and variance-containing method optimization, S2, distributed sensor data fusion, S3, three-dimensional electric field intensity reconstruction and vector field analysis, S4, partial discharge mode identification, S5, dynamic risk probability assessment, S6, self-adaptive early warning threshold adjustment, S7, visual interface rendering optimization, S8, emergency response path generation, S9, self-organizing communication network construction, S10, system efficiency continuous optimization, and intelligent early warning of a power transmission and distribution line through multi-physical field coupling analysis. The system integrates three core modules of electromagnetic field three-dimensional reconstruction, unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic path optimization and abnormal discharge probability prediction, and solves the problems of low spatial resolution, large abnormal positioning error and the like in the traditional power inspection.
assignees: CHENGDU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Tailing pond monitoring method based on passive source seismic joint inversion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tailing pond monitoring method based on passive source seismic joint inversion, which comprises the steps of 1, carrying out passive source data observation, 2, obtaining time-division continuous background noise and microseism surface wave data through signal demodulation of the passive source data, preprocessing, 3, carrying out multi-channel cross correlation and frequency dispersion extraction after preprocessing, then carrying out two-step surface wave inversion imaging to obtain underground space transverse wave velocity structure models in different periods, 4, carrying out microseism effective event inversion by using a double-difference positioning algorithm to obtain space distribution of microseism events in a subsurface space rock mass, 5, carrying out time-frequency analysis on the background noise and the microseism surface wave data respectively, establishing time-frequency parameters and time correspondence relation of internal evolution of the subsurface space, and 6, forming a tailing pond subsurface space three-dimensional dynamic reconstruction perception system, and realizing functions of full life cycle potential geological disaster real-time monitoring and risk early warning of the tailing pond.

title_en: Typhoon space-time characteristic-based power-traffic network multi-source dynamic scheduling method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: A typhoon space-time characteristic-based power-traffic network multi-source dynamic scheduling method, equipment and medium relate to the technical field of power scheduling. The application aims to solve the problem that the traditional superposition method has larger randomness in calculating the series model of the wire pole tower under typhoon disasters. The method comprises the steps of inputting power grid parameters into an element fault rate model to obtain a strong wind-induced guide wire tower fault rate curve, inputting typhoon disaster information into a typhoon space-time evolution model to reconstruct wind fields, combining the strong wind-induced guide wire tower fault rate curve with the reconstructed wind fields to obtain a distribution network disaster damage thermal distribution map, accumulating fault rates of all power grid branches in the distribution network disaster damage thermal distribution map at all time periods to obtain a distribution network branch rolling update fault rate, inputting the distribution network branch rolling update fault rate into a two-stage robust toughness lifting model to obtain load reduction power, an MESS arrangement result and a power grid reconstruction result, and performing power-traffic network dynamic scheduling.

title_en: Three-phase jet flow cooperative fire extinguishing device and fire judgment method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire control, in particular to a three-phase jet flow cooperative fire extinguishing device and a fire judgment method. The jet unit is used for emitting water, foam and dry powder probe flows, the detection unit is used for capturing flame interaction characteristics through the high-speed camera, the analysis unit is used for generating fire source characteristic data through the STA-CNN model, and the jet unit is used for dynamically adjusting medium proportion, jet morphology and jet angle. According to the application, by means of the multiphase medium self-feedback recognition and dynamic reconstruction technology, fire recognition accuracy and fire extinguishing efficiency are improved, the problems of low single medium efficiency and poor response capability of the traditional device are solved, intelligent and multifunctional integrated fire extinguishing is realized, and a high-efficiency solution is provided for a complex fire scene.
assignees: HENAN AIWEISHENG XIAOAN TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for simulated 3d video replay of workflows based on device data
abstract_en: A visual recreation system of visually generating a recreation of a medical incident associated with a patient. The system includes a memory and a processor. The memory includes instructions that, when carried out by the processor, cause the processor to receive, from one or more sensors, a location information and a time information of the medical incident. The instructions further cause the processor to generate a visual simulation of the medical incident including an avatar of the patient and a visual reconstruction of a medical environment based on the location information and the time information of the medical incident.
assignees: BAXTER MEDICAL SYSTEMS GMBH CO KG

title_en: Tailing pond disaster hidden danger intelligent identification early warning system based on three-dimensional reconstruction
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent identifying and early warning system for disaster hidden danger of a tailing pond based on three-dimensional reconstruction, which relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning, and comprises a digital modeling module, a target tailing pond and a target tailing pond, wherein the digital modeling module is used for establishing a three-dimensional digital model of the target tailing pond; the system comprises a disaster simulation module, a risk assessment module and an early warning module, wherein the disaster simulation module is used for collecting environment geographic information, loading the environment geographic information into a three-dimensional digital model, carrying out numerical simulation of preset disaster events and generating preset disaster simulation results, the risk assessment module is used for carrying out risk assessment based on the preset disaster simulation results and generating risk indexes, and the early warning module is used for carrying out disaster hidden danger identification early warning based on the risk indexes. The method and the device can solve the technical problems of insufficient real-time performance of data acquisition and limited disaster simulation precision in the prior art, and further influence on disaster hidden danger early warning accuracy, realize accurate evaluation and real-time early warning of disaster risk of the tailing pond, and achieve the technical effects of improving disaster risk identification and early warning accuracy and timeliness.
assignees: MCC INSPECTION AND CERTIFICATION CO LTD;HEBEI EMERGENCY MAN PUBLICITY AND EDUCATION CENTER;UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Phonetic communication method based on pinyin and voiceprint coding and low-power consumption voice terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a phonetic communication method based on spelling and voiceprint coding and a low-power consumption voice terminal, which firstly converts voice into spelling and voiceprint packet codes for transmission, the method is restored to a personalized voice mode at the receiving end, and breakthroughs of low data volume, low power consumption and high semantic restoration rate of voice communication are realized. The embodiment reduces the traditional voice communication data volume by more than 90%, reduces the power consumption by more than 30-50 times, and improves the terminal access quantity by more than 10 times. The method and the device are suitable for various scenes such as interphones, smart phones, emergency and military communication, and have revolutionary potential for reconstructing a voice communication mode in the smart phones. The embodiment transmits standardized text information, so that the data volume is greatly reduced, the system becomes simple, secret and easy to deploy, and a low-cost and low-power consumption emergency disaster relief communication system capable of being connected with a satellite network can be quickly established in remote areas or under the condition of resource shortage caused by war and disasters.
assignees: CHENDU WESTVALLEY DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Physical similarity simulation experiment crack identification platform
abstract_en: The application discloses a physical similarity simulation experiment crack identification platform, which realizes the full-flow intellectualization from data acquisition to analysis and display by integrating a multi-mode data synchronous acquisition module, a self-adaptive preprocessing assembly line, a mixed deep learning module and an interactive three-dimensional visualization engine, wherein the multi-mode acquisition system solves the problem of asynchronous traditional data, the preprocessing assembly line automatically processes high-throughput data and filters noise, the mixed model combines images and stress field characteristics to improve crack identification precision, the three-dimensional visualization engine supports crack evolution dynamic playback, parameter automatic calculation and immersive interaction, the bottlenecks of high manual dependence, dynamic analysis fault, three-dimensional characterization missing and the like in the traditional method are broken through, the efficiency and the precision of rock crack research are obviously improved, and a full-period digital solution is provided for mineral engineering, geological disaster prevention and the like.

title_en: Method and system for designing dual-purpose logistics network considering demand robust matching
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency management, and particularly discloses a method and a system for designing a dual-purpose logistics network for peace and emergency by considering requirement stable matching. The method comprises the steps of constructing a fixed investment decision model, constructing a 'flat-emergency dual-purpose' logistics network operation decision model, wherein decision contents of the model are respectively a network transportation decision of life materials before a disaster and a network transportation decision of emergency materials after the disaster, processing the demands of life materials by adopting a Wasserstein uncertain set to meet the demands of uncertain parameters, road loss conditions and pre-disaster demand points so as to integrate the two models into a two-stage distributed robust optimization model based on the Wasserstein distance, performing peer-to-peer conversion on the robust optimization model, decomposing the model to linearly reconstruct, solving the decomposed model, and obtaining a final logistics network design result through iterative optimization. The invention can fully exert the cooperative advantages of the 'emergency dual-purpose' mode in the aspects of improving emergency response capability and optimizing resource allocation.

title_en: Automatic fire detection system based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire early warning and discloses an automatic fire detection system based on image recognition. The fire disaster automatic detection system comprises an image acquisition module, an image preprocessing module, a fire disaster feature extraction module, a fire disaster recognition and classification module, an early warning and alarm module and a recording and playback module, wherein the image acquisition module is used for acquiring image information of a monitoring area in real time, the image preprocessing module is used for processing and analyzing acquired image data, the fire disaster feature extraction module is used for extracting colors, shapes and motion tracks of flames and smoke by using a computer vision technology, the fire disaster recognition and classification module is used for classifying and recognizing features extracted by features by using a machine learning algorithm, the early warning and alarm module is used for immediately sending early warning or alarm signals once a fire disaster is detected, and the recording and playback module is used for recording a fire disaster detection process and supporting subsequent inquiry and analysis. According to the invention, through an image recognition technology, the system can more accurately recognize flame and smoke, and false alarm and missing report are avoided.

title_en: Remote sensing-based investigation and mapping method and surveying instrument thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geophysical exploration, in particular to a remote sensing-based exploration and mapping method and a surveying instrument thereof. The remote sensing-based investigation and mapping method comprises the following steps of 1, dynamically collecting multi-platform cooperative data, 2, carrying out vegetation noise filtering on laser radar point cloud data, reconstructing a surface topography model under vegetation coverage, constructing an underground medium physical property joint distribution model by combining seismic wave velocity data and ground penetrating radar dielectric constant data, associating multispectral image reflectivity characteristics with underground physical property parameters, identifying a geological abnormal region, and 3, hiding geological body dynamic modeling and risk assessment. By the method, real-time monitoring and risk assessment of complex geologic bodies can be realized, and geological disaster prediction and prevention and control capabilities are greatly improved.
assignees: SHANDONG GOLD GEOLOGICAL AND MINERAL EXPLOR CO LTD

title_en: Drought early warning method and device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly provides an drought early warning method and device based on artificial intelligence, comprising the steps of collecting data of a drought early warning river basin; the method comprises the steps of constructing a deep learning model considering hydrologic process to simulate daily runoff, reconstructing long-series daily runoff data, constructing a month-scale vegetation-meteorological hydrologic drought regression model, calculating comprehensive meteorological hydrologic drought indexes, extracting drought events, constructing K artificial intelligent models, inputting meteorological hydrologic observation data into the K artificial intelligent models to simulate, adopting a Bayesian mode averaging method to calculate the weight of each artificial intelligent model, constructing a combined distribution function of drought index observation and forecast values based on Copula functions, and adopting an artificial intelligent-Bayesian coupling model to develop drought forecast. The method solves the problems of data scarcity, model uncertainty and the like in drought early warning, and provides high-precision and quantifiable decision support for water resource management, disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Unmanned cluster society heuristic collaborative crowd-sourcing method for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned cluster society heuristic collaborative crowd-sourcing method for emergency rescue, which constructs a task matching and path planning framework taking auction games as cores. Firstly, an initial path planning model is constructed by combining coverage rate, task balance rate and capability matching degree through a multi-element capability modeling and auction mechanism. And then, combining fire situation prediction and personnel dynamic evaluation, realizing dynamic adjustment of task demands and region state classification, and introducing a process path reconstruction mechanism to form a self-adaptive optimization model of the double-region target. Finally, through the improved auction game and hybrid ADMM distributed solving strategy, the high-efficiency coordination and intelligent scheduling of the unmanned system in the complex dynamic environment are realized, and the intelligent scheduling capability and task execution coordination of the unmanned system in the complex fire environment are obviously enhanced.

title_en: Anaerobic working face construction method and mine safety exploitation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anaerobic working face construction method and a mine safety exploitation system, and aims to radically cure the risks of gas explosion and spontaneous combustion of coal beds and simplify the mine system. The key point is that an anaerobic working face with the oxygen concentration less than or equal to 2% is constructed through a triple intelligent sealing door and a dynamic nitrogen injection gas barrier, and the necessary conditions of disasters are cut off; the traditional multi-lane multi-system is reconstructed into a machine-rail integrated system, a special return air lane and a large ventilator are omitted, the cost and the energy consumption are reduced, and the matched electric trackless rubber-tyred air emergency vehicle can ensure the emergency operation of 8 people for 24 hours. The system reduces the safety risk by more than 99 percent, saves comprehensive cost by more than 10 hundred million yuan in tens of millions of tons of mines, and has safety, high efficiency and economy.

title_en: Resource scheduling method based on shared energy storage cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing of power systems, and discloses a resource scheduling method based on a shared energy storage cloud platform, which comprises the following steps: the cloud platform issues a resource promise request containing task parameters, and after the energy storage node autonomously receives the resource promise request, the energy storage node sets a local state parameter dead zone and enters a silent execution state, and the energy storage node triggers event reporting only when the dead zone boundary or abnormality is reached. According to the invention, the energy storage node locally and autonomously maintains the charge state interval to absorb the power grid fluctuation by reconstructing the data interaction mode through the promise-dead zone mechanism, and meanwhile, the emergency response without communication dependence is realized based on the power grid frequency monitoring, so that a dual-guarantee system of economic dispatch and safety response is formed.

title_en: Apparatus and method for training speech
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a speech training apparatus and method capable of improving presentation and conversation capabilities. A speech training method according to an embodiment of the present invention is a speech training method performed by a processor of a speech training device. The speech training method comprises the steps of: setting a virtual speech environment for speech training; loading virtual reality-based speech training content corresponding to the virtual speech environment; transmitting the speech training content to a head mounted display (hmd) worn by a user, and playing the speech training content on the hmd worn by the user in response to reception of a playback request signal; receiving a recorded image for a situation uttered by the user in response to playback of the speech training content; and generating and providing solution information for improving speech technology corresponding to the user through analysis of the recorded image.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 발표 및 대화 능력을 향상시킬 수 있는 스피치 트레이닝 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 스피치 트레이닝 방법은, 스피치 트레이닝 장치의 프로세서에 의해 수행되는 스피치 트레이닝 방법으로서, 스피치 트레이닝을 위한 가상의 스피치 환경을 설정하는 단계와, 가상의 스피치 환경에 대응하는 가상현실 기반의 스피치 트레이닝 콘텐츠를 로딩하는 단계와, 스피치 트레이닝 콘텐츠를 사용자가 착용한 HMD(head mounted display)로 전송하고, 재생 요청 신호의 수신에 대응하여 사용자가 착용한 HMD 상에 스피치 트레이닝 콘텐츠를 재생하는 단계와, 스피치 트레이닝 콘텐츠의 재생에 대응하여 사용자가 발화하는 상황에 대한 녹화 영상을 수신하는 단계와, 녹화 영상의 분석을 통하여 사용자에 대응하는 스피치 기술 향상 및 개선을 위한 솔루션 정보를 생성하고 제공하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Empty house regeneration system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an empty house playback system, comprising: a user information collection module for collecting purchase conditions of an empty house provided by a user; and an empty house recommendation module for recommending at least one empty house corresponding to the purchase conditions among pre-secured empty house sellers' empty house sellers to the user. According to the present invention, empty houses corresponding to a purchase condition of a user are automatically recommended to assist the user to easily select, purchase, and reproduce the empty houses, thereby improving user convenience.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 빈집 재생 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사용자가 제공한 빈집의 구매 조건을 수집하는 사용자 정보 수집 모듈; 및 미리 확보된 매물 관리자의 빈집 매물들 중 상기 구매 조건에 대응하는 적어도 하나의 빈집들을 상기 사용자에게 추천하는 빈집 추천 모듈을 포함한다. 
이러한 본 발명은, 사용자의 구매 조건에 대응하는 빈집들을 자동으로 추천하여 사용자가 빈집을 용이하게 선택 및 구매하여 재생할 수 있도록 사용자를 보조함으로써, 사용자의 편의성을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle fire scene quick explosion suppression system based on multi-mode sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire protection systems, in particular to an intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle fire scene rapid explosion suppression system based on multi-mode perception. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of providing the intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle fire scene rapid explosion suppression system which can integrate intelligent perception, risk prediction, dynamic reconstruction and collaborative explosion suppression, rapidly respond to initial reconnaissance requirements, ensure sufficient post explosion suppression force and remarkably improve equipment utilization rate. The utility model provides an intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle scene of a fire quick explosion suppression system based on multimode perception, includes integrated anti-electromagnetic interference communication module's modularization multi-machine nest carries on platform, is provided with explosion suppression module, data acquisition module, trading electric module, explosion suppression agent supplementary module on it. The invention integrates intelligent perception, risk prediction, dynamic reconstruction and collaborative explosion suppression, not only rapidly responds to the initial reconnaissance demand, but also ensures sufficient post explosion suppression force, and remarkably improves the utilization rate of equipment.
assignees: QUANZHOU YIXIAO FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Disaster site multidimensional image cooperative processing method based on unmanned aerial vehicle-satellite cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster site multidimensional image cooperative processing method based on unmanned aerial vehicle-satellite cooperation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource heterogeneous image data, carrying out space synchronization preprocessing, achieving time stamp correction through constructing a communication delay prediction model, then adopting a segmentation processing strategy driven by boundary evidence intensity, establishing a three-dimensional evaluation system based on time evidence, space evidence and consistency evidence, carrying out differential registration processing on image boundaries, achieving balance between boundary information and continuity under a constraint optimization framework through a boundary continuity constraint propagation mechanism and a sliding window reconstruction technology, carrying out quality perception multidimensional image fusion, and outputting a high-precision disaster situation map and a loss evaluation result. The method solves the technical problems of low image registration precision and ghost boundary generated by boundary fusion under heterogeneous timestamps, and improves the accuracy and reliability of disaster loss assessment.
assignees: GANSU HUIENYUAN EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting equipment power supply detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power detection and discloses a method and a system for detecting a power supply of fire equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting voltage fluctuation, current phase and ripple coefficient through a multichannel sensor group, generating a characteristic sequence through sliding window noise reduction, performing Z-score standardization to calculate Euclidean distance, generating a calibration command through super threshold, adjusting frequency output detection parameters through Kalman filtering, performing fast Fourier transform to extract harmonic amplitude to generate a suppression vector, and performing least square reconstruction model output state identification.
assignees: WEIFANG PINGAN FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Dust explosion risk prediction method, system, equipment and program
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dust explosion risk prediction method, a system, equipment and a program, which relate to the technical field of industrial safety and disaster prevention and control, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring spectral data corresponding to space-time coordinates in a region to be detected; the spectrum data comprises wavelength and intensity, elements and chemical concentrations of the elements contained in the dust are obtained based on an element identification model and the spectrum data, a three-dimensional concentration field is reconstructed to obtain spatial concentrations of each element in the voxels, and explosion risk dynamic coupling is carried out based on the elements contained in the dust, the chemical concentrations of the elements and the three-dimensional concentration field to obtain an explosion probability index. Through the treatment scheme of the present disclosure, dust explosion risk can be predicted in advance, explosion suppression is accurate in a small range, safety is improved, and explosion suppression cost is reduced.
assignees: ZHONGANGUANGYUAN INSPECTION AND EVALUATION TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent property management system and method based on Internet of things application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of application of the Internet of things, and discloses an intelligent property management system and method based on the application of the Internet of things. Through an innovative state-work order mapping mechanism, real-time sensing and dynamic analysis of the state of the equipment are realized, the work order can be automatically generated in the initial stage of the occurrence of potential abnormality of the equipment, and the problem of traditional fault hysteresis is avoided. The shortest response path is calculated by using a graph algorithm through intelligent scheduling optimization resource allocation, so that the maintenance efficiency and the response speed are improved. In addition, the dynamic emergency plan reconstruction module flexibly handles superposition of complex events, and the adaptability and the processing capacity of emergency response are enhanced.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN CUIHENG PROPERTY TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning method, system, equipment and medium with multiple spatial scales
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent reinforcement learning method, system, equipment and medium with multiple spatial scales, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting each micro-grid in a distributed new energy power system as an agent, setting the new energy power system as a distributed power grid agent at the same time, constructing a decentralised part observable Markov decision process, designing a strategy network and a value network based on the decentralised part observable Markov decision process, and training to obtain an optimal strategy of each agent by adopting the multi-agent reinforcement learning method and an experience playback technology based on the decentralised part observable Markov decision process and the design of the strategy network and the value network. Therefore, the exponential reduction of the control space dimension is realized, the dimension disaster is avoided, the multi-agent reinforcement learning convergence speed is accelerated, and the algorithm performance is improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Ballastless track plane line reconstruction method and system under basic large deformation condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ballastless track plane line shape reconstruction method and system under a basic large deformation condition, which are used for judging whether a railway line is broken on a long straight line or a curve, determining a line shape reconstruction mode, determining the intersection position of the railway line and a fracture zone, establishing a plane rectangular coordinate system, collecting line basic data, carrying out fitting reconstruction on straight line clamping edges on two sides of a line damage center and between the two straight line edges, determining the slope range and the change step length of the straight line clamping edges, determining optimization variables, constraint conditions, objective functions and fitness functions, adopting a genetic algorithm and a local search algorithm to find an optimal plane line shape reconstruction scheme under the slope value of each straight line clamping, summarizing and comparing the fitness value of the optimal plane line shape reconstruction scheme under the slope value of each straight line clamping, and selecting a scheme with the maximum fitness value. The method analyzes the damage form of the plane line shape of the ballastless track aiming at the large deformation of the railway foundation, and provides a reference for the post-disaster repair of the ballastless track.
assignees: CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST

title_en: Slope protection monitoring method and system based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slope protection, in particular to a slope protection monitoring method and system based on image recognition. The technical scheme includes that the system comprises an image acquisition module, an edge calculation module, a center management module and an early warning execution module. The invention solves the problems of illumination change and vegetation shielding, realizes the improvement of crack detection recall rate, reduces false detection rate caused by environmental factors, realizes the identification accuracy of small-scale cracks by adopting a three-stage cascade structure of pixel-level segmentation, time sequence deformation tracking and three-dimensional reconstruction, obviously improves the detection accuracy, simultaneously realizes high-efficiency reasoning by a lightweight model obtained by processing based on a neural architecture search method, reduces data processing delay, and establishes a multistage early warning strategy to improve the intellectualization and reliability of slope disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Virtual power plant collaboration and transaction settlement-based power distribution network toughness improvement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network toughness improving method based on virtual power plant cooperation and transaction settlement, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-type virtual power plant participation power grid dispatching and power transaction whole-flow management framework comprising a virtual power plant management platform, a power transaction platform and a dispatching platform to conduct planning on VPP disaster accidents, S2, constructing a multi-type VPP cooperation optimized power distribution network power supply restoration model before and after disaster to formulate a network reconstruction strategy, a real-time dispatching strategy of emergency resources and a regulation strategy of the VPPs in each period, and S3, calculating the power supply restoration incentive unit price and compensation income of each VPP participation according to the actual response quantity of the VPPs issued by the dispatching platform, the declared response quantity reported by the virtual power plant management platform and the VPP historical participation degree by the power transaction platform. The invention solves the key problems of insufficient resource coordination, stage cutting, excitation rigidification and the like by integrating the full-flow closed-loop management of pre-disaster plan generation, post-disaster dynamic adjustment and transaction settlement.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Emergency response organization toughness evaluation method and system based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency response, and particularly discloses an emergency response organization toughness evaluation method and system based on a complex network. The method comprises the steps of constructing an organization relation matrix according to actual response data and emergency plan data to establish relations and interaction mechanisms among all main bodies in an emergency response process, constructing four stages of organizing networks of a pre-disaster plan, an emergency rescue, a recovery reconstruction and a post-disaster plan according to the organization relation matrix, evaluating node importance, evaluating toughness of network organization representing emergency response by simulating network operation conditions under a single attack strategy, coupling multiple network attack strategies by utilizing an entropy weight method, simulating different high-risk scenes, obtaining weights of the attack strategies by calculating information entropy, evaluating network efficiency under multiple attack scenes, and obtaining overall toughness level of the emergency response organization in all stages. The invention can clearly reflect the emergency response capability and the recovery capability of the organization in different stages.

title_en: Daily runoff intelligent forecasting method and system based on mixed feature optimization and variation prediction, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a storage medium and electronic equipment for predicting daily runoff based on GWO-VMD feature reconstruction and hybrid deep learning models. Optimizing VMD parameters through GWO algorithm, decomposing original runoff sequence and fusing multi-scale features, combining the local feature extraction capability of Mamba model and the global time sequence modeling advantage of transducer to realize high-precision prediction, and further correcting prediction error by adopting CNN. The method solves the problems of poor adaptability of the traditional model to non-stationary and nonlinear data, and has remarkable application value in flood control and disaster reduction and water resource scheduling.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid dispatching and communication network recovery, and provides a post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery system and a post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery method, wherein the system comprises a power network model, a power distribution system and a communication network collaborative recovery system, wherein the power network model is used for distributing power supply resources to each node by taking power supply of power network nodes of a shortest time recovery target area as a target; the system comprises a line restoration model, an electric vehicle path planning model, an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment communication network restoration model, an optimal scheme solving unit and a power communication network node, wherein the line restoration model is used for taking an electric vehicle as a load supply and mobile restoration unit, and realizing joint optimization of power network topology reconstruction and power restoration of a target area by coordinating path planning and resource allocation of the electric vehicle, the electric vehicle path planning model is used for taking maximum restoration of power supply of the target area as a target, enabling the electric vehicle to quickly restore the power network within a limited time by optimizing a moving path of the electric vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle deployment communication network restoration model is used for taking minimum restoration of the communication network as a target, and combining cooperative work of the electric vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is deployed as a temporary air base station while power is supplied by a base station node, and the optimal scheme solving unit is provided with a layered multi-target optimization problem for maximizing total power communication coverage time as a target function under the condition of minimizing the restoration time of the power communication network.

title_en: Security system for cross-domain communication and data sharing of network platform software
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer network security, in particular to a security assurance system for cross-domain communication and data sharing of network platform software, which comprises a data security transmission module, an identity authentication and access control module, an encryption module, a security audit and anomaly detection module and an anti-interference disaster recovery module. The invention realizes the cooperative guarantee of key safety and transmission continuity in cross-domain audio transmission by linking with AI risk prejudging, reinforcement learning path planning, digital twin preverifying and failure automatic switching technology through the equipment fingerprint end-to-end encryption, threat self-adaptive dynamic key updating and time stamp-random number replay prevention mechanism, so that the encryption strength is dynamically upgraded along with threat, the transmission path is optimized in advance, and the audio stream is ensured to resist various network attacks and interferences in low-delay transmission.

title_en: Power distribution network line potential risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential risk early warning method and a potential risk early warning system for a power distribution network line, which are characterized in that a Batts typhoon model is adopted to establish a mapping relation between distance and wind speed, vulnerability modeling is carried out on the power distribution network line, a fault set of the line in a typhoon scene is generated based on the obtained mapping relation between wind speed and fault rate of the power distribution line, the generated fault set of the line in the typhoon scene is input into a mixed integer programming model of the power distribution system, load recovery quantity is maximized when multiple line faults occur, meanwhile, trend constraint and radial topology constraint are met, the maximum power supply quantity of the power distribution network in each fault set is obtained through statistics, the maximum power supply quantity of the power distribution network in each fault set is used as data input, a Copride method is used for carrying out line importance sorting, and an enhancement strategy of the power distribution network line is formed according to a sorting result. And the dynamic linkage of risk early warning and defense strategies is realized by integrating typhoon disaster modeling and power distribution network reconstruction optimization.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Flood disk-restoring method based on distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood restoration method based on a distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling mode, which comprises the steps of compiling a data set of a historical mountain flood disaster, determining a topological structure relation of a river basin, and drawing up a key node corresponding to the river basin, and based on the key node, constructing a hydrologic model above the key node, constructing N computing units based on the data set and according to the topological relation of the river basin, adjusting the parameters to obtain an optimal flood simulation result and a parameter result, constructing a hydrodynamic model below the key node in the river basin, carrying out simulation analysis on regional application and flood evolution of the flood based on the optimal flood simulation result and the parameter result, constructing the hydrodynamic model, more accurately reflecting the generation, confluence and evolution processes of flood in the river basin, improving the application effects of the flood in aspects of flood simulation, early warning and response, helping to restore the actual situation of the flood disaster more accurately in the flood restoration process, and providing reliable basis for post-disaster assessment, reconstruction and planning.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;HYDROLOGY BUREAU OF HAIHE RIVER WATER CONSERVANCY COMMISSION MINI OF

title_en: Distributed affine recovery method for power transmission and distribution-electric integrated energy system considering geological landslide under typhoon disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed affine recovery method of a power transmission and distribution-gas integrated energy system for taking geological landslide into consideration under typhoon disasters, which is characterized by calculating mechanical stress fault probability of an electric power line based on a typhoon field model, calculating failure probability of a pole tower caused by landslide based on effective rainfall and landslide probability models of the landslide, modeling new energy output and load demand into affine forms, constructing a power transmission network flow constraint, a power distribution network reconstruction constraint and a gas network slow dynamic gas storage model containing affine operators, establishing a cooperative recovery model with minimized load loss by an electric-gas coupling equipment equation and a power transmission and distribution network mutual aid equation, adopting an affine self-adaptive alternating direction multiplier method to parallelly solve recovery strategies of the power transmission and distribution subsystem and the gas network subsystem, updating factors based on original punishment and dual proportion, and outputting a switching state, a unit start-stop and a load recovery scheme.

title_en: Geological disaster knowledge graph construction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge graph construction, in particular to a geological disaster knowledge graph construction method and system based on artificial intelligence; the method comprises the steps of extracting a geological semantic triplet set by using a semantic physical collaborative type preprocessing method to construct a three-layer semantic ontology graph, generating a space section structure chain and a time sequence state chain by using a double-chain type space-time graph construction method to construct a double-chain coupling graph structure, carrying out node state propagation calculation by using a disturbance perception graph neural network mechanism to obtain a risk state prediction result of a landslide structure unit layer under each time node, generating a landslide risk propagation path chain by using a reverse causal path chain reconstruction method, and migrating propagation parameters and response rules in a historical landslide graph structure into the double-chain coupling graph structure to construct a double-chain coupling space-time geological disaster knowledge graph. According to the invention, landslide state prediction and causal path reasoning are realized through the double-chain diagram structure and the disturbance perception diagram neural network.

title_en: Light modeling and scale regularized rendering system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightweight modeling and scale regularization rendering system, and belongs to the field of three-dimensional point cloud modeling. The system comprises a point cloud generation module, an outlier filtering module, a point cloud registration splicing module, a scale regularization rendering module, a similarity detection module and the like. The RGB image and depth information are acquired by adopting a handheld binocular camera with high convenience, point cloud splicing is realized by matching an internal shape feature (INTRINSIC SHAPE signalizes, ISS) based on region growth with a registration method of an iterative nearest point algorithm (ITERATIVE CLOSEST POINT, ICP) based on a probability model, and the visual quality of a three-dimensional reconstruction model is effectively improved by restricting a pruning 3DGS rendering network through a normal line diagram.
