The system is suitable for scenes with high real-time requirements such as disaster response and rescue, emergency infrastructure repair, military countermeasure and investigation, accident site reconstruction and the like, and has good application prospects.

title_en: End cloud collaborative detection method and system for traffic abnormal event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terminal cloud collaborative detection method and a terminal cloud collaborative detection system for traffic abnormal events, and relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic control. The method comprises the steps of collecting traffic video streams through edge equipment, identifying abnormal behaviors by using a lightweight YOLOv-tiny model and generating structured event data, uploading video clips and data to a cloud when confidence coefficient exceeds a dynamic threshold and event types are high-risk categories, fusing historical road condition maps, meteorological data and real-time traffic stream states by the cloud, reconstructing a three-dimensional event scene by adopting a space-time attention pyramid network, verifying event authenticity by combining a traffic stream mutation detection algorithm, generating a signal lamp forced switching instruction for a risk level overrun event, and issuing the signal lamp forced switching instruction to road side equipment within 3 seconds to execute emergency response. The invention realizes the full-link closed loop control from the recognition to the response of the traffic accident, and greatly reduces the false alarm probability while ensuring the recognition accuracy.

title_en: High-sensitivity fire-fighting detection system for existing building reconstruction engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-sensitivity fire-fighting detection system for the existing building reconstruction engineering, which comprises a smoke sensing part, an auxiliary sensing part, a detection host and a fire-fighting alarm system, wherein the detection host is arranged in the middle layer of a building to be reconstructed, the smoke sensing part and the auxiliary sensing part are respectively arranged along each layer of the building to be reconstructed, the detection host is provided with an air suction type smoke sensing detector, a wind speed detection part is further connected to a fan of the air suction type smoke sensing detector, the wind speed detection part is connected with the detection host, the sensing part is connected with the air suction type smoke sensing detector, the auxiliary sensing part is connected with the detection host, and the fire-fighting alarm system is connected with the detection host.
assignees: CHENGDU ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-vision multi-mode perception
abstract_en: The invention provides an IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-visual multi-mode perception, which comprises the functional modules of initial calibration and semantic map initialization, pre-integral prediction and key frame judgment, dense point cloud reconstruction and relative pose estimation, semantic embedding extraction, semantic guidance loop detection, semantic three-dimensional map incremental update and the like, wherein IMU motion priori, depth geometric constraint and language model semantic factors are jointly modeled through a graph optimization framework, and high-precision positioning and labeled map construction under a complex dynamic environment are realized. Compared with the prior art which only depends on geometric or inertial information, the invention reduces the loop error matching rate, improves the closed loop convergence efficiency and long-time repositioning robustness, and provides semantic interfaces for upper-layer tasks such as natural language navigation, target retrieval and the like. The invention can be widely applied to the fields of service robots, security inspection, intelligent driving, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Method and system for generating remote centralized control plan of step hydropower
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydropower system control, in particular to a method and a system for generating a remote centralized control plan of a step hydropower station, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous dynamic data of a target step hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of carrying out statistics reconstruction on multi-source heterogeneous dynamic data to generate dynamic characteristic tensors, carrying out risk identification on a target cascade hydropower station according to the dynamic characteristic tensors to obtain a risk index sequence of the target cascade hydropower station, carrying out dynamic weighted superposition on a preset plan template set based on the risk index sequence to generate a self-adaptive plan set, carrying out dynamic matching in the self-adaptive plan set based on the real-time running state of a cascade hydropower remote centralized control system, and determining an optimal plan so as to control the cascade hydropower remote centralized control system based on the optimal plan. According to the invention, through dynamic data fusion and risk quantitative analysis, real-time self-adaptive matching of the step hydropower station risk early warning and the emergency plan is realized, and the emergency response accuracy and timeliness are obviously improved.

title_en: Urban flood simulation method based on deep learning reconstruction image model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban flood simulation method based on a deep learning reconstruction image model, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring basic data of a research area, 2, constructing a one-dimensional-two-dimensional hydrodynamic coupling model, 3, preprocessing data, 4, constructing a U-Net deep learning reconstruction image model, 5, setting and training the U-Net deep learning reconstruction image model, and 6, simulating urban flood. The method improves the response speed of urban flood simulation on spatial resolution, combines simulation precision and calculation efficiency, rapidly and accurately obtains the high-resolution flood ponding simulation result under the condition of only using limited training data, and provides scientific support for urban flood disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Method for tracking unknown multi-target motion trail in non-line-of-sight scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for tracking unknown multi-target motion tracks in a non-line-of-sight scene, which comprises the steps of acquiring target echo signals in a non-line-of-sight area by using a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, preprocessing the echo signals to obtain a time distance graph containing the motion characteristics of a human body target, extracting the target motion tracks by adopting an improved self-adaptive track extraction algorithm based on gridding and condition constraint, reducing cross interference among different tracks by adopting a fusiform front track energy suppression algorithm provided by the invention, completing track attribution judgment and target attribution judgment according to Doppler consistency in track segments and Doppler similarity among tracks, simultaneously completing target counting, determining the echo orders of various multipath by adopting a track order matching algorithm, completing target positioning by adopting an elliptic cross positioning algorithm and reconstructing the target motion tracks by combining a multipath propagation model. The method is suitable for tracking the motion trail of the unknown multiple targets in the non-line-of-sight scene, has the advantages of no need of target priori information, strong robustness, high precision and the like, and can be widely applied to the fields of automatic driving, security monitoring, disaster rescue and the like.

title_en: Scene modeling method based on fuzzy superposition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of scene modeling, and solves the problems of fusion distortion, uncertainty expression loss and static model self-adaptation deficiency of multi-source heterogeneous data. The method comprises the steps of uniformly processing physical sensing data and subjective description data through a differential fuzzy processing mechanism (continuous quantity is mapped by using a trapezoidal membership function and discrete quantity meaning rules), realizing data collaboration based on a space association matrix by adopting a dynamic weight superposition strategy, adding an aging attenuation factor for dynamic optimization, synchronously outputting a deterministic model frame and fuzzy boundary thermodynamic diagram during scene reconstruction, and establishing a real-time feedback closed loop optimization membership function parameter and weight strategy. The method has the innovation points that a confidence level conversion mechanism eliminates semantic distortion, an adaptive superposition operator switches operation modes according to a confidence level threshold, and three-dimensional semitransparent rendering visualizes uncertainty distribution. The multi-source fusion semantic distortion rate is reduced by 62%, the disaster early warning accuracy rate is improved by 55%, and the continuous operation accuracy attenuation rate of the model is controlled below 3%.
assignees: NANJING QIANCHENGJIAMING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Audio and video data compression method and system for satellite portable station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of satellite communication, and relates to a satellite portable station audio and video data compression method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a multi-dimensional environment label containing communication stability and disaster grade characteristics; the method comprises the steps of evaluating bandwidth quality based on an environment label, carrying out self-adaptive noise reduction and dynamic key encryption on audio and video data, extracting space-time key characteristics to generate a compressed encryption code stream, dynamically dividing the compressed code stream into a core layer and an enhancement layer to form a priority code book, distributing a code book level transmission path and marking a destruction-resistant priority label for the core data according to multi-network congestion state and satellite switching cost, packaging redundant fragments by using the self-adaptive erasure codes, sending high-priority data to a low-delay link through a hardware encryption unit, and reconstructing a synchronous audio and video stream after the integrity of the fragments is verified by a block chain. The invention solves the problem that the architecture of a single dependent satellite link cannot cope with instantaneous interruption caused by shielding or interference, and the multipath switching response delay is high.
assignees: JIANGSU ANRUIXUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for removing impurities by cutting and irrigation through transformation of low-efficiency forest tending
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for removing impurities by cutting and irrigation in low-efficiency forest tending and reconstruction, which comprises the steps of manual cleaning, mechanical cleaning, chemical cleaning, biological cleaning, residue treatment and the like, so that the accurate removal of low-efficiency forest impurities, miscellaneous bamboos and rattans is realized, the competition of the low-efficiency forest impurities, the miscellaneous bamboos, rattans and target trees is effectively solved, the light, the moisture and the nutrients are contented for, and the resource competition can be reduced after the removal. The risk of fire is reduced, fire spreading is easily caused by mixed irrigation, mixed bamboo and rattan thorns, and hidden danger of forest fire can be reduced after cleaning. Promoting the natural updating of the forest stand, creating a growth space for seedlings and saplings, and improving the natural restoration capacity of the forest.

title_en: Two-stage fault recovery method for improving elasticity of power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage fault recovery method for improving elasticity of a power distribution system, which comprises the steps of constructing a typhoon space-time evolution model to generate a predicted fault scene, simulating a power distribution line in the predicted fault scene by utilizing a Monte Carlo simulation method to generate a plurality of fault scenes, constructing an uncertain set based on an information entropy value of the fault scenes and a fault weight, further constructing a robust optimization model, solving the robust optimization model, determining a pre-layout scheme of a mobile energy storage system and a static reactive compensator in the worst fault scene before disaster, constructing a multi-source collaborative post-disaster multi-period multi-objective fault recovery model, and realizing recovery of a power loss load and the fault line of the power distribution system by reconstructing and optimally scheduling the mobile energy storage system, the static reactive compensator, a maintenance team and electric vehicles through a network. The invention remarkably improves the overall elasticity of the power distribution system, not only enhances the disaster resistance capability, but also improves the capability of quickly recovering power supply.

title_en: Method and device for identifying landslide hidden danger association elements through multi-mode fusion and pruning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hidden danger association element identification method and device based on multi-mode fusion and pruning, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster identification. The landslide hidden danger association element identification method comprises the steps of obtaining initial data, wherein the initial data comprise aviation optical map data, inSAR deformation data and topographic data, performing band level superposition on the initial data to generate a multi-channel fusion data matrix, performing channel pruning, network reconstruction and fine tuning learning on a first lightweight model network based on the multi-channel fusion data matrix to obtain a target lightweight model network, obtaining data to be identified, inputting the data to be identified into the target lightweight model network, and outputting landslide hidden danger association element data. The method and the device can combine the multi-mode data fusion and the lightweight pruning technology, and improve the identification precision and the real-time processing capability of the landslide hidden danger associated elements.

title_en: Emergency material reserve point planning method based on dynamic reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency material reserve point planning method based on dynamic reconstruction, relates to the technical field of post-disaster planning, and solves the problems that in the prior art, the planning of emergency material reserve points does not consider the in-place order of materials and the dynamic reconstruction of a power distribution network. According to the method, firstly, a deceleration coefficient and a road damage coefficient are introduced when the road section passing time is calculated to reflect the influence of disasters on traffic road capacity, then all possible paths are traversed, the shortest road section passing time is used as a screening condition of an optimal path between two nodes, and finally, an objective function is built and an optimal planning scheme is solved based on the construction cost of a material reserve point, the maintenance cost and the disaster damage loss of all typical scenes as influence factors. According to the invention, the material reserve point planning can be performed by considering different electric materials and space requirements thereof, and the recovery speed of the power distribution system after disaster can be improved by applying the invention to perform electric emergency material reserve point planning, so that the disaster economic loss is effectively reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Assembly interface stress prediction method
abstract_en: The application discloses an assembly interface stress prediction method which comprises the steps of remolding an assembly error parameter into a first assembly surface stress image based on a constructed modal mutual mapping network, and carrying out resolution enhancement operation on the first assembly surface stress image based on a constructed image reconstruction network to generate a second assembly surface stress image, wherein the resolution of the second assembly surface stress image is larger than that of the first assembly surface stress image. According to the scheme, through a two-stage architecture, features are captured by Legendre polynomial compression parameters and a multi-scale residual error module, a key region is strengthened by combining an attention mechanism, efficiency and precision collaborative optimization is realized, a dimension disaster is solved, model generalization and robustness are improved, and real-time requirements are met.

title_en: Foundation deep three-dimensional vibration testing device and method in dynamic compaction construction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geotechnical engineering test, in particular to a device and a method for testing deep three-dimensional vibration of a foundation in a dynamic compaction construction process, wherein the device comprises a centering positioning pipe which is vertically inserted into the soil body of the foundation; the self-adaptive centering structure is arranged on the electric push rod-vibration sensor composite structure. According to the invention, through the real-time linkage of the multidimensional and adjustable deep sensing network and the construction process, the limitation of planarization and discretization of traditional monitoring is broken through, the dynamic tracking and three-dimensional reconstruction of the vibration wave full-space propagation track are realized, and the core technical support is provided for accurate regulation and control of ramming energy, quantitative evaluation of foundation treatment effect and active prevention and control of engineering disasters, so that the intelligent transformation from experience driving to data driving of dynamic compaction construction is promoted.
assignees: CHINA UNITED NORTHWEST INSTITUTE FOR ENGINEERING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Geophysical data driving-based deep coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster risk identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geophysical data-driven deep mine composite dynamic disaster risk identification method, which comprises the following steps of firstly, acquiring multi-source geophysical data related to coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster risk, then, optimizing the acquired multi-source geophysical data based on a rough set theory, selecting an index which is most sensitive to composite dynamic disaster response, establishing a deep coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster risk identification index, and finally, weighting, reconstructing and comprehensively analyzing the identification index based on an entropy weight method to construct a multi-parameter index identification system based on geophysical data-driven deep coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster risk identification. The method plays the characteristics of multi-source geophysical data, and utilizes the advantages of a rough set theory and an entropy weight method, so that redundancy and conflict existing in indexes are greatly reduced, the weight distribution of index fusion is more reasonable, and the high-efficiency and accurate prediction of the deep coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster risk is realized.

title_en: Method and system for pre-warning trip of induction lightning of 10kV overhead line in plain town area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power distribution networks, and particularly discloses a method and a system for pre-warning tripping of a 10kV overhead line induction mine in a plain town area. Aiming at the problems that the existing method relies on full-wave electromagnetic simulation, is complex in calculation and low in efficiency, the invention provides a simplified model based on parameter dimension reduction. The method comprises the steps of determining key parameters such as lightning ground flash density, soil resistivity, insulator dry arc distance, wire average height and the like, constructing a tripping rate conversion model by establishing a nonlinear mapping relation between an inductive lightning tripping rate and the parameters, and avoiding traditional three-dimensional electromagnetic field simulation by combining characteristics of flat terrain and soil homogenization in a plain town area and coupling line parameters and lightning electromagnetic effects through functions. During calculation, the tripping rate is rapidly output according to the parameter range, and the risk dynamic assessment is realized by matching with the early warning level. The method solves the problems of high calculation force dependence and complex modeling, and provides an efficient tool for lightning protection reconstruction and digital management of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Optimal path planning method based on firefighting rescue road network directed graph
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of emergency rescue, relates to an optimal path planning method based on a firefighting rescue road network directed graph, utilizes multi-source data such as an open street map road network, road conditions, investigation data, real-time road conditions and the like, and the remote sensing image data are fused, the road network directed graph is reconstructed according to the road priority principle, and an optimal path planning algorithm based on the firefighting rescue road network directed graph is further constructed based on the dynamic weight model. The application of the invention can effectively make up the defect of using the online map path planning in the existing research, so that the path planning is more suitable for the path planning requirement in the real fire rescue scene, and the running path of the fire rescue can be accurately calculated by the invention, thereby planning the path more reasonably and improving the efficiency of the fire rescue.

title_en: Firefighting robot that is easy to enter narrow alleys
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting robot capable of easily entering a narrow alley to suppress a fire by being inserted into the narrow alley where it is difficult to enter or a fire site where it is difficult for firefighters to enter due to a severe fire. The firefighting robot capable of easily entering a narrow alley comprises: a firefighting robot vehicle body; a driving unit provided on the firefighting robot vehicle body; a firefighter nozzle unit (32) provided on the firefighting robot vehicle body; a moving path detection unit for detecting a moving path; a requester detection unit for detecting a requester; and a control unit for controlling the operation of the firefighting robot. In a state where firefighting hoses are connected, houses are concentrated, so that the firefighting robot can easily enter a narrow road such as a place where the alley is narrow, thereby having an effect of easily suppressing a fire at an early stage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 진입이 어려운 협소골목 또는 화재가 심해 소방대원의 진입이 어려운 화재현장에 투입되어 화재를 진압할 수 있도록 하기위한 협소골목 진입이 용이한 소방로봇에 관한 것으로, 소방로봇차체와, 상기 소방로봇차체에 구비되는 구동부, 상기 소방로봇차체에 구비되는 소방수노즐부(32)와, 이동로를 감지하는 이동로감지부, 요구조자를 탐지하기 위한 요구조자탐지부 및 소방로봇의 동작을 제어하는 제어부로 구성되어 소방호스를 연결한 상태에서 주택이 밀집되어 골목이 협소한 곳과 같이 좁은 길을 쉽게 진입할 수 있어 초기에 화재진압을 쉽게 할 수 있는 효과를 갖는 것이다.
assignees: CHEONGJU UNIV INDUSTRY & ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Potential landslide movement path and accumulation state prediction method based on graphic data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential landslide movement path and accumulation state prediction method based on graphic data, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a basic numerical model, 2) generating a sample combination, 3) solving a control equation and saving a sample calculation result, 4) extracting and reconstructing channel data to form a data set, 5) training the model to an suspension condition, and 6) outputting the model to predict the landslide movement path and the final accumulation state according to given information. The method has the advantages that the method can solve the problems that landslide disasters in engineering have multiple uncertain factors, movement paths and damage ranges cannot be accurately predicted, and has a more efficient prediction analysis process for potential landslide disasters with uncertainty under the condition of ensuring accuracy.

title_en: Emergency broadcasting decision method for dynamic reconstruction broadcasting list
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency broadcasting decision method for a dynamic reconfiguration broadcasting list, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of 1, monitoring running state parameters of a broadcasting link in real time, wherein the running state parameters comprise signal quality parameters, network link parameters, server resource parameters and audio stream content parameters, 2, carrying out fault diagnosis based on a preset knowledge base when the running state parameters are monitored to be abnormal, wherein the knowledge base stores mapping relation between fault characteristics and a disposal plan, 3, generating a broadcasting list reconfiguration strategy according to diagnosis results and multi-dimensional characteristic factors of a current broadcasting program, wherein the multi-dimensional characteristic factors at least comprise program types, importance levels and switching smoothness requirements, and 4, executing automatic switching of emergency audio streams according to the broadcasting list reconfiguration strategy. The invention can solve the problems of untimely emergency response, inaccurate decision, discontinuous fault handling and the like in a complex broadcasting environment, realize the rapid dynamic reconstruction of broadcasting content and ensure the continuity and service quality of broadcasting.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle relay system self-adaptive scheduling method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive scheduling method and a self-adaptive scheduling system of an unmanned aerial vehicle relay system based on reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of simulating a replay of a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles to execute fire-fighting tasks, and analyzing spatiotemporal requirements of unmanned aerial vehicle relay communication and potential changes thereof in the replay process; and carrying out unmanned aerial vehicle relay system scheduling on the actual execution of fire-fighting tasks of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles according to the unmanned aerial vehicle relay communication scheduling plan by utilizing a scheduling model which is based on reinforcement learning training in advance. And the scheduling model trained through reinforcement learning is utilized to adjust the unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling strategy in real time, so that the efficient completion of tasks and the optimization of communication links are ensured. By the self-adaptive scheduling method driven by reinforcement learning, flexible and efficient relay system scheduling can be realized in the dynamically-changed fire-fighting tasks, the stability of a communication link is effectively ensured, and the task response speed and the success rate are improved.

title_en: Cerebral hemorrhage magnetic induction tomography three-dimensional reconstruction method based on parameterized level set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional reconstruction method of cerebral hemorrhage magnetic induction tomography based on parameterized level sets, which comprises the steps of circularly exciting and detecting an open electromagnetic coil array to obtain boundary measurement data in a cerebral hemorrhage detection area, reconstructing initial distribution of conductivity change in the cerebral hemorrhage detection area by using a space constraint optimization Tikhonov regularization method, determining a central point of a radial basis function, realizing low-order parameterized representation of the level set function by using the radial basis functions with different weights, and realizing three-dimensional image reconstruction of cerebral hemorrhage by utilizing theoretical relation between the conductivity distribution in the cerebral hemorrhage reconstruction area and the parameterized level set function. The invention can solve the problems of reconstruction accuracy limitation and calculation disaster caused by huge calculation grid number in the three-dimensional reconstruction of cerebral hemorrhage by the magnetic induction tomography technology, and improves the imaging quality of cerebral hemorrhage.

title_en: Coal mine load clustering method based on dynamic reconstruction and cohesive separation loss optimization
abstract_en: The invention is used in the technical field of industrial process control, and discloses a coal mine load clustering method based on dynamic reconstruction and cohesive separation loss optimization, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring historical time sequence data of the coal mine power load, and carrying out data preprocessing on the original data with the resolution of 15 minutes to obtain a daily load power data set. According to the coal mine load clustering method based on dynamic reconstruction and cohesive separation loss optimization, by means of a layer-by-layer unsupervised pre-training and global fine tuning mechanism of a stacked self-encoder (SAE), deep time sequence characteristics of high-dimensional load data can be automatically learned, nonlinear time-space correlation characteristics in the data can be effectively captured, compared with the traditional methods such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and discrete wavelet transformation, the limitations of insufficient nonlinear characteristic extraction, limited non-stationary data processing effect and the like are avoided, effective mapping from high-dimensional data to a low-dimensional embedded space is achieved, and the influence of 'dimension disasters' is reduced.

title_en: Weapon escort route dynamic optimization and risk early warning platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent security and path planning and discloses a weapon escort route dynamic optimization and risk early warning platform which comprises a multi-mode data acquisition module, a dynamic risk assessment module, a quantum collaborative optimization module, a hypergraph emergency response module, a strategy collaborative updating module and a strategy collaborative updating module, wherein the multi-channel space-time characteristic tensor is constructed by integrating traffic flow, geographic elevation and threat public opinion data through space-time alignment and tensor filling, the dynamic risk assessment module generates a dynamic risk field based on balanced solution of an anti-game model and Nash, quantifies a risk gradient under an attacker strategy, the quantum collaborative optimization module generates quantum parameters through tensor hidden variable decomposition, solves a multi-target optimal route by combining a quantum annealing algorithm, the hypergraph emergency response module reconstructs a mutually exclusive redundant route and feeds back an updating strategy space when detecting a super-threshold risk, and the strategy collaborative updating module fuses the risk gradient and game utility to generate a combined rewarding signal so as to drive a reinforced learning model to dynamically optimize a decision strategy. The invention improves the safety, efficiency and reliability of escort tasks.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG SECURITY SERVICE GROUP GUOXIN NURSING GUARD CO LTD

title_en: Cooperative type dynamic affix vulnerability breaking and resource management table game system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of desk game design and discloses a desk game system and a method for breaking and managing resources of cooperative dynamic affix weak points, wherein the system comprises seven core modules, namely, the dynamic affix weak point breaking module cooperates with a forced sequence breaking strengthening team through a hierarchical affix sequence; the heart protection and French management module realizes double-resource replacement payment and heart protection return to zero prize punishment and judgment, the team blood bank and reviving module is based on shared bronze crown standard reviving rules, the staged flow control module circularly advances according to four stages of natural disaster-player-enemy-replenishment, the card learning and public display module provides flexible cards to form a long path, the cross-office equipment linkage module realizes weapon-card effect binding and the cross-office reserved transaction of a breaker, and the plot exploration rotation module promotes immersion feeling through layered narrative and automatic plot triggering. The invention enhances the strategy depth through module cooperation, reduces the dependence of the host, improves the replay value and the commercial expansibility, and is suitable for PVE scenario adventure class desktops.
assignees: LUOYANG AIFUBI CULTURAL AND CREATIVE CO LTD

title_en: Skid-mounted AI intelligent control active air supplementing self-suction three-dimensional flame plume reconstruction device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a skid-mounted AI intelligent control active air supplementing self-priming three-dimensional flame plume reconstruction device and method, which relate to the technical field of crossing of fire engineering and intelligent control technology and comprise a three-dimensional flame plume reconstruction combustion system, a modularized integrated system, a multi-mode monitoring system, a multi-dimensional wind field simulation system and an AI intelligent iteration control system, wherein the three-dimensional flame plume reconstruction combustion system can reproduce three-dimensional flame gradient forms, the modularized integrated system consists of a plurality of skid-mounted units, a gas supply, power distribution control and explosion prevention device are integrated, full-terrain mobile deployment is supported, the multi-mode monitoring system acquires data through a panoramic camera, a thermocouple and an ultrasonic anemometer, a multi-dimensional wind field simulation system is combined to accurately simulate a complex wind field, the AI intelligent iteration control system fuses flame forms, temperature fields and wind field data in real time, the opening degree of a gas valve and the inclination angle of a fan are dynamically optimized, and high-fidelity reproduction of a three-dimensional flame gradient form fire scene under the effect of coupling of a real environment wind field is realized.

title_en: Disaster prevention capability assessment method and device for power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power systems, and provides a disaster prevention capability assessment method and device for a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-disaster superposition probability model based on disaster data and power grid data, solving to obtain comprehensive failure rate of power distribution network elements under a multi-disaster superposition scene, calculating economic and social security influence weights of all load nodes based on an improved analytic hierarchy process by fusing trend betweenness, population density and unit load economic loss indexes, generating a post-disaster failure scene based on the comprehensive failure rate, constructing a network reconstruction model with minimum weighted cut load quantity as a target by combining the economic and social security influence weights, and solving to obtain a power distribution network disaster prevention capability assessment result, wherein constraint conditions of the network reconstruction model comprise operation constraint of a power system, power distribution network reconstruction constraint, user demand response constraint and operation constraint of flexible resources. The evaluation result can comprehensively reflect the actual effect of the disaster resistance of the power distribution network.

title_en: Remote sensing image three-dimensional reconstruction method based on nerve rendering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image three-dimensional reconstruction method based on nerve rendering, which uses an irradiance model to independently model sunlight and sky diffuse reflection light, uses sun correction rays to accurately learn a solar visibility function, and finally adds an attention mechanism to optimize a network architecture so that the network can dynamically allocate corresponding weights according to the importance of features. The method solves the problem of complex sampling and calculation by improving the sampling method, adopts an irradiance model, can capture the dynamic characteristics of transient objects and shadow areas more accurately, adds an attention mechanism into a network, fully utilizes key characteristic information in remote sensing images, improves reconstruction precision and optimizes detail expression. The invention can be applied to urban planning, digital twinning, ecological environment monitoring, disaster emergency response, cultural relic protection and other scenes, and provides more lifelike visual experience and more accurate shadow effect for users.
assignees: HUNAN XIGU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method of psychological first aid simulation for disaster shock recovery
title_ko: 재난 충격 회복을 위한 심리적 응급 처치 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a psychological emergency treatment simulation system for disaster shock recovery. Provided is a psychological first aid simulation system for disaster shock recovery, comprising: a user terminal playing a PFA game according to a user input; and a PFA game simulation server simulating the PFA game.
abstract_ko: 구급 요원의 신체에 장착되며, 재난 충격 환자를 촬영하여 PFA 영상을 생성하는 구급 요원 카메라 장치; 상기 구급 요원 카메라 장치에서 생성된 PFA 영상을 저장하는 구급 요원 단말; 간호사의 신체에 장착되어 재난 충격 환자를 촬영하여 PFA 영상을 생성하는 간호사 카메라 장치; 상기 간호사 카메라 장치에서 생성된 PFA 영상을 저장하는 간호사 단말; PFA 전문가 의견을 입력받는 PFA 전문가 단말; 상기 구급 요원 단말에 저장된 PFA 영상 및 상기 간호사 단말에 저장된 PFA 영상을 수집하여 저장하고, 저장된 PFA 영상에 대한 상기 PFA 전문가 단말에서 입력받은 PFA 전문가 의견에 따라 PFA 빅데이터를 생성하여 저장하는 PFA 빅데이터 생성 서버; 상기 PFA 빅데이터 생성 서버에 저장된 PFA 빅데이터에 기반하여 재난 충격 환자를 표준화하여 표준화 환자를 생성하여 저장하는 표준화 서버; 사용자 입력에 따라 사용자 아바타를 이용하여 PFA 게임을 플레이하는 사용자 단말; 상기 PFA 게임의 결과를 기반으로 디브리핑을 하기 위한 PFA 교육자 의견을 입력받는 PFA 교육자 단말; 상기 표준화 서버에 저장된 표준화 환자를 이용하여 상기 PFA 게임을 시뮬레이션하고, 상기 사용자 단말의 사용자 입력 및 상기 PFA 교육자 단말의 PFA 교육자 의견에 따라 상기 PFA 게임의 시뮬레이션 결과에 대한 디브리핑을 수행하는 PFA 게임 시뮬레이션 서버를 구성한다.
assignees: UNIV CHUNG ANG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Data disaster recovery ammeter with disaster recovery strategy and disaster recovery system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data disaster recovery ammeter with disaster recovery strategy and a disaster recovery system, in particular to the field of the data disaster recovery ammeter, comprising a disturbance signal detection module, a disturbance signal detection module and a control module, wherein the disturbance signal detection module is used for constructing a synchronous disturbance characteristic frame based on a voltage change sequence, a current change sequence and a harmonic spectrum value sequence, and identifying whether a disturbance abnormal state exists in a current period through multi-threshold judgment of disturbance change indexes; the mapping module solves a power response vector based on the voltage change sequence and the current change sequence, and compares the output behavior deviation descriptive quantity through a behavior template. The five-stage disaster recovery processing chain of disturbance perception, behavior mapping, fingerprint comparison, structure judgment and path reconstruction is constructed, so that the whole-process identification and state self-recovery of the measurement offset state caused by non-invasive physical disturbance are realized, and the problem that the existing intelligent ammeter system lacks an autonomous detection and response mechanism and cannot cope with data disaster recovery vacuum caused by camouflage type power perception attacks is solved.
assignees: YIXING HUACHUN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster risk assessment method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of image processing, and particularly relates to a geological disaster risk assessment method and system based on big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and acquiring multi-level remote sensing videos with different time spans, performing STL decomposition on pixel value sequences of pixel points at the same position in the same layer of the Laplace pyramid of each level of the remote sensing videos, determining amplification factors according to the obtained change of trend items and the level numbers of the corresponding remote sensing videos, amplifying periodic items of each group of pixel points, further reconstructing the Laplace gold sub-tower, acquiring all levels of remote sensing videos after action amplification, and determining geological deformation probability in the corresponding time span according to edge changes in all levels of remote sensing videos after action amplification, thereby acquiring geological disaster probability. The invention amplifies the fine geological change in the remote sensing video and evaluates the geological disaster risk more accurately.

title_en: Virtual reality reconstruction and interactive investigation system and method for fire scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality reconstruction and interactive investigation system and a method for a fire scene, and relates to the technical field of disaster emergency. The method comprises the steps of synchronously obtaining thermal imaging data, millimeter wave Lei Dadian cloud data, gas component data and building surface deformation data through a multi-mode sensing array, calculating a structural collapse rate index based on the building surface deformation data, extracting flame dynamic diffusion characteristic vectors from the thermal imaging data, triggering a dynamic data compensation mechanism when the collapse rate exceeds a preset safety threshold, switching a three-dimensional reconstruction data source to millimeter wave radar point cloud data, fusing the compensated multi-source data to generate a virtual scene, otherwise adopting a standard registration mode to generate the scene, and dynamically optimizing data fusion weight parameters according to space-time continuity indexes of the virtual scene. The invention effectively solves the problem of reconstruction distortion of the traditional method through a multisource data dynamic compensation mechanism and space-time continuity verification, and improves the reliability and real-time interactivity of virtual reconstruction of a fire scene.

title_en: Fire extinguishing action mechanical arm simulation reproduction method based on motion capture and gesture reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire extinguishing action mechanical arm reproduction method based on motion capture and gesture reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of respectively setting marking points at a plurality of preset positions of upper limbs of a firefighter, setting at least one reference point at a central shaft of a trunk, collecting motion data of the marking points and the reference points when a professional fire extinguishing hand performs fire extinguishing action by using a motion capture system, preprocessing the motion data, building a space model based on the preprocessed motion data of the marking points, further calculating a gesture quaternion of the tail end of the mechanical arm, mapping a world coordinate system to a coordinate system of a base of the mechanical arm based on the reference points, and generating a control instruction according to the gesture quaternion of the tail end to drive each joint of the mechanical arm to reproduce the fire extinguishing action. The invention realizes high-precision and standardized reproduction of the fire extinguishing actions of the professional fire extinguishing hand, and ensures the stability and fluency of the simulation actions of the mechanical arm, thereby providing objective, repeatable and strong-consistency technical support for evaluating the fire extinguishing performance of the fire extinguisher.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Method and system for evaluating landslide surge disaster influence of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge disaster influence assessment method and system in a reservoir area, and relates to the technical field of landslide surge disaster assessment. The method comprises the steps of performing direct loss evaluation, quantifying damage condition and economic operation loss of the disaster to the tangible asset, performing indirect economic loss evaluation, summarizing the integral influence of the disaster to society and economy, including the influence of economic growth, involved economy and financial balance of a warehouse area, performing post-disaster reconstruction cost evaluation, evaluating intervention measures required for starting recovery work in a short period and realizing comprehensive post-disaster recovery reconstruction fund requirements, performing macroscopic economic influence analysis, evaluating the influence of the surge disaster to long-term development of the warehouse area, performing personal and family influence evaluation, and analyzing the influence of the disaster to personal and family income and living standard. The invention provides a comprehensive methodology guidance for the economic evaluation of the reservoir area, and is helpful for making an effective landslide surge disaster coping strategy and a restoration plan.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;UNIV HOHAI;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban building three-dimensional visual lightweight system based on data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of three-dimensional visualization of buildings, and particularly relates to a three-dimensional visualization lightweight system of an urban building based on data fusion, wherein the system comprises a real image acquisition module, a bridging module and a building object updating module. According to the method, point cloud data comparison and vector analysis are adopted, vanishing building point clouds are removed, newly added buildings are added, the unchanged model of an unchanged part is ensured, meanwhile, the large-scale point cloud processing calculated amount is reduced, octree block optimization nearest neighbor search optimization is adopted, the point cloud matching calculated amount is further reduced, verification and model correction mechanisms are utilized, compared with a traditional static city model, the method is more suitable for dynamic scenes such as city planning and disaster monitoring, the method is started from an unmanned plane view angle, the height is reduced layer by layer, an intermediate view angle virtual image is rendered through an initial rough model, the characteristic gap between the intermediate view angle virtual image and a ground view angle is gradually reduced, and the cross-view angle three-dimensional reconstruction quality is improved.

title_en: Dynamic risk assessment method and system based on safe production video
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic risk assessment method and a system based on safe production videos, which comprise the steps of collecting production site video streams in real time and converting formats, carrying out target detection on video frames at an edge part YOLOv model, intercepting video fragments based on target detection results, carrying out secondary verification through a multi-mode large language model to generate a target event authenticity probability score, triggering linkage when the temperature exceeds a preset threshold value, fire alarm or electronic fence invasion by a docking fire and dangerous gas monitoring system, constructing a three-dimensional factory model based on CAD drawings, dynamically marking equipment positions, displaying environmental parameters in real time, carrying out flickering prompt on alarm points, and calling real-time videos or historical playback through clicking icons. According to the invention, through integrating video monitoring, intelligent analysis and cloud collaborative technology, multidimensional monitoring, intelligent hidden danger identification and dynamic early warning of the production environment are realized, emergency response is optimized, human risk is reduced, and safety management efficiency is improved.

title_en: Path optimization and resource intelligent scheduling method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path optimization and resource intelligent scheduling method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a digital twinning three-dimensional model of disaster area infrastructure to realize three-dimensional scene reconstruction; constructing an rush repair path optimization model based on a multi-objective function, and optimizing paths among all places in the digital twin three-dimensional model; the invention can realize the collaborative optimization of the rush-repair path and the resource scheduling, generate an optimal scheme by combining the topography and the risk constraint, and improve the rush-repair operation efficiency.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Prediction method for collapse range of weak area of high-valley heap type dumping site
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method of a collapse range of a weak area of a high-valley heap type dumping site, which comprises the steps of obtaining high-precision topographic data of the dumping site and an original earth surface through a three-dimensional modeling technology, constructing a triangular net model, carrying out grid reconstruction processing on the triangular net model to generate a hybrid hexahedral closed grid model suitable for numerical calculation, calculating and delineating a maximum strain increment position based on three-dimensional strength folding and subtracting method and combining field physical test and laboratory mechanical test data, determining the weak area of the high-valley heap type dumping site, establishing a landslide particle flow model of the weak area of the Gao Gudui type dumping site, and predicting three-dimensional spatial distribution of the collapse influence range through fluid dynamics simulation. The method breaks through the limitation of traditional plane strain analysis, realizes three-dimensional visual prediction of landslide influence range under complex terrain, remarkably improves disaster early warning precision of the dump, provides scientific decision basis for mine safety protection, and effectively reduces landslide accident risk and protection cost.
assignees: SINOSTEEL MAANSHAN GENERAL INSTITUTE OF MINING RES CO LTD

title_en: Automatic driving inspection method and system for fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic driving inspection, in particular to an automatic driving inspection method and system for a fire-fighting robot, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a grid structure to count complex sections of a connection number channel width and a connection angle mark, extracting an overlapping proportion of an original path of a passing path calculation to generate a path segment to be reconstructed, generating an updating path segment sequence screening intersection number and path length by a shortest path combination, collecting a fire source dense smoke coordinate, evaluating a heat source and a diffusion change to predict a shielding path segment, judging that the path falls into the shielding segment to reconstruct the connection path, calculating the redundancy length and overlapping times, and generating an automatic driving inspection path by fuzzy comprehensive evaluation screening. In the invention, complex sections are marked by counting the widths and angles of the connecting channels, repeated paths are identified to avoid crossing redundancy, the reconstructed paths reduce cross interference, the heat source dense smoke change prediction shielding area is evaluated, the screening paths improve safety and continuity, and the path adaptability and execution efficiency are enhanced.
assignees: WEIFANG PINGAN FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Self-insulation structure house system of movable modular mechanism and construction method
abstract_en: The application discloses a house system with a self-heat-insulating structure of a movable modular mechanism, and provides a living solution which is quick to construct, easy to move and has excellent fireproof, heat-insulating, light, sound-insulating and earthquake-resistant performances. The house system is composed of a plurality of house units which are integrally cast by adopting a lightweight steel structure and foam concrete, and the house units are detachably connected and stacked through connecting parts. The design not only reduces the manufacturing cost and shortens the construction period, but also remarkably improves the heat preservation, heat insulation, fire prevention and earthquake resistance of the house through the unique performance of the foam concrete. Meanwhile, the house system can be easily disassembled into a single unit, is convenient to migrate and reorganize, and is suitable for various scenes such as disaster area reconstruction, remote area construction, military campsite and the like. In addition, the application combines the advantages of high-efficiency construction, excellent performance and flexible migration. Finally, after the house system is poured and molded, the decoration work is finished synchronously, and a user can directly enter the house without secondary decoration.

title_en: Cloud computing extension cluster high availability method based on dynamic fault domain and intelligent scheduling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cloud computing extension cluster high availability method based on dynamic fault domain and intelligent scheduling, and relates to the field of cloud computing extension cluster high availability. The method comprises the steps of collecting hardware health data and network performance indexes of physical nodes in real time, calculating fault association degree between the nodes based on the hardware health similarity and a network topology attenuation factor, dynamically generating and updating a logic fault domain topological structure according to the fault association degree and a preset threshold value, executing virtual machine scheduling decisions of multi-objective optimization based on the logic fault domain topological structure and a preset SLA strategy library so as to balance service quality, fault domain risk and resource cost, responding to detected fault events, and triggering corresponding hierarchical migration flows according to service priority and fault level. The invention can realize the real-time reconstruction of the dynamic fault domain in the cross-region cloud computing extension cluster and the closed-loop linkage of intelligent scheduling, and remarkably improve the disaster recovery capacity and the resource utilization rate of the system.
assignees: JINAN INSPUR DATA TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Flood control and debris flow prevention geological disaster control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood control and debris flow prevention, and particularly discloses a geological disaster prevention method and system for flood control and debris flow prevention, comprising the following steps of firstly, carrying out real-time monitoring and data acquisition on disaster conditions of flood and debris flow, deploying a multi-parameter sensor network in a target area, and acquiring rainfall, soil moisture content, earth surface displacement, underground water level, debris flow velocity and flow data in real time; the intelligent disaster prevention system based on the intelligent drainage system and the self-adaptive flood control gate realizes comprehensive sensing of disaster characteristics through collaborative monitoring of the sensor network and the unmanned aerial vehicle, dynamically generates risk levels based on a machine learning model, improves early warning accuracy, realizes active intervention of disasters through facilities such as the intelligent drainage system and the self-adaptive flood control gate, ensures disaster condition data to be credible based on a block chain and machine learning technology, provides scientific basis for post-disaster reconstruction, and improves public disaster prevention awareness and emergency capability through VR simulation and a user terminal.
assignees: XINDIAN COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Power grid topology toughness enhancement method based on pre-disaster prediction of graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid topology toughness enhancement method based on pre-disaster prediction of a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of constructing a grid graph structure taking grid equipment as nodes, predicting node damage probability through the graph attention network, defining a high-risk node set, constructing a mixed integer programming model according to the high-risk nodes and propagation paths thereof, solving to generate an optimal grid structure adjustment strategy before disaster, generating a resource scheduling scheme by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning algorithm in combination with the strategy, calculating a grid toughness core index after simulation operation, optimizing the structure adjustment strategy if the index is lower than a preset threshold value, and uploading the optimized strategy and scheduling scheme to a scheduling platform to finish pre-disaster active defense deployment. The invention realizes the cooperative linkage of pre-disaster risk prediction and topology reconstruction and resource deployment, automatically generates a differential pre-disaster defense scheme, converts post-emergency repair into pre-disaster prevention and distribution, and remarkably improves the pre-disaster prevention and control response efficiency.

title_en: Complex domain SAR image super-resolution reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex domain SAR image super-resolution reconstruction method and a system. The method comprises the following steps of S1 preprocessing complex domain data, S2 constructing a data set and amplifying the data, S3 constructing a deep learning model, dividing a training area and a verification area, training the model, S4 evaluating precision by using high-resolution original image data, and S5 obtaining a high-resolution SAR product according to the deep learning model of an optimal training scale. According to the scheme, under the condition that the processing capacity of hardware is improved, the result which is superior to the result reconstructed only by means of the amplitude graph superminute is obtained, more ground object details can be recovered, and the application value of the existing image data in the natural disaster field and the identification capacity of military targets are improved.

title_en: Three-dimensional perception equipment of disaster scene live-action of air-ground cooperation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to three-dimensional sensing equipment for a disaster scene with air-ground coordination, which comprises a lower computer, an upper computer and a server, wherein the lower computer comprises an edge computer, a single chip microcomputer, a laser radar, a binocular camera, a 5G module, an IMU module and a GNSS module, the edge computer is connected with the laser radar through the single chip microcomputer, the single chip microcomputer is respectively connected with the binocular camera, the 5G module and the GNSS module, the GNSS module is connected with the IMU module, the GNSS module and the IMU module are connected with the edge computer, the binocular camera and the 5G module are connected with the edge computer, the 5G module is connected with the server, and the server is connected with the upper computer. The disaster scene reconstruction and analysis method and device have wide application in the disaster scene reconstruction and analysis field, and have the advantages of high data acquisition response speed and good real-time performance, and can comprehensively acquire real-scene environment information in a disaster scene. Under the condition of reducing field contact, the disaster investigation efficiency is ensured, and the safety of personnel in dangerous environment operation is improved.

title_en: Port wave spectrum parameterized modeling algorithm based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a harbour wave spectrum parameterized modeling algorithm based on machine learning, which relates to the technical field of ocean engineering and realizes high-precision modeling through three steps, wherein a federal learning framework is constructed in the first step, training sub-models of all data parties only share parameters, homomorphic encryption fusion characteristics are combined, weights are dynamically adjusted, privacy protection type data fusion is realized, a generated countermeasure network is deployed in each local node, multiscale wave characteristics are extracted through a frequency domain hierarchical attention branch network, sea wave energy conservation constraint is implanted, a generator is optimized, extreme samples conforming to physical laws are generated, a mixed training data set is formed, and a CNN-LSTM basic model is trained in the third step, and dynamic model optimization is realized through sliding windows, forgetting factors, bayesian optimization and performance monitoring reconstruction. The method effectively improves the prediction precision and long-term stability of the wave spectrum, reduces the maintenance cost, and can be used for the scenes of berthing, disaster prevention and early warning of port ships and the like.

title_en: Real-time monitoring method for surmounting amount based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring method of surmounting amount based on machine vision, which integrates a binocular vision technology, a YOLO target detection algorithm, a LoFTR image matching algorithm and a flow rate-area method. If a sea water crossing dyke and beach crossing event occurs, a crossing wave boundary is identified in real time through a YOLO algorithm, a LoFTR matching range is constrained to reconstruct three-dimensional information, and the crossing wave quantity is calculated by combining a flow velocity-area method. The method strengthens the image matching technology by combining with the YOLO target detection algorithm, calculates the surmounting amount, provides basic data for storm surge and embankment disaster early warning models and coast engineering flood control design specifications, and has important significance for disaster prevention and reduction work in coastal zone areas.

title_en: Charging and discharging scheduling method for electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric automobile charge and discharge scheduling method which comprises the steps of receiving disaster early warning and activating corresponding response modes in real time, dynamically establishing a geofence, screening candidate vehicles, reconstructing a multi-stage charge and discharge priority strategy, issuing charge and discharge instructions in a layered manner, and recovering scheduling in a 24-hour period after disaster. According to the method, seamless switching between disaster period and daily scheduling is realized, emergency power supply efficiency and system reliability are improved through a space density model and a weight decision system, and smooth transition after disaster is ensured through a preferential electricity price excitation mechanism.
assignees: ZHISHAN INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT NANJING CO LTD

title_en: Global landslide remote sensing rapid identification model modeling method based on improved DeepLab-V < 3+ > and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a global landslide remote sensing rapid identification model modeling method based on improvement DeepLab-V < 3+ > and application thereof, which are used for conducting general investigation on global landslide disaster points, compiling landslide catalogues, investigating the spatial distribution characteristics of landslide and providing basic information for global disaster area reconstruction and recovery, landslide risk assessment and landslide early warning and forecasting. The method comprises the following steps of S1, selecting a target area data acquisition point to acquire data characteristics, S2, making a landslide remote sensing image dataset, S3, based on DeepLab-V3+, improving ASPP and fusion CBAM, establishing an applicable landslide identification algorithm, S4, training, verifying and testing by using the dataset pair to obtain a global landslide rapid detection model, S5, inputting global influence, and making a detected landslide result into a global landslide distribution map. A total of 10016 landslide areas were detected, and 2304 landslide areas were detected in the Qinghai-Tibet plateau. The result shows that the invention can initially detect landslide in the global range, and has popularization and application prospects and possibility.

title_en: Intelligent sensing-based fire-fighting fire real-time monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sensors and discloses a fire-fighting fire real-time monitoring method and system based on intelligent sensing, wherein the fire-fighting fire real-time monitoring method and system comprises the steps of deploying a fire monitoring device in a target area of a fire to be monitored, wherein the fire monitoring device comprises a cavity optical force sensor, a surface acoustic wave resonator and a gas sensor; the method comprises the steps of collecting sensor data in a target area through a fire monitoring device, synchronizing oscillation rhythms of the sensor data to obtain an oscillation phase matrix, mapping the oscillation phase matrix into a three-dimensional torus manifold, performing topological reconstruction on the three-dimensional torus manifold to obtain a risk field manifold in the target area, wherein the risk field manifold comprises curvature distribution, coherent group basis vectors and risk intensity, and analyzing a fire abnormal area, a fire spreading path and a fire spreading duration in the target area by using the risk field manifold. The invention can synchronously generate space path topology and time evolution quantization indexes of fire spread.

title_en: Disaster area three-dimensional point cloud modeling method through unmanned aerial vehicle cluster cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster area three-dimensional point cloud modeling method for unmanned aerial vehicle cluster cooperation, which comprises the steps of dividing areas of disaster areas based on different terrain types, carrying out task distribution on the unmanned aerial vehicle clusters by adopting a task distribution algorithm based on the divided areas to obtain a flight track of each unmanned aerial vehicle, obtaining sensor data of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the flight process based on the flight track, carrying out real-time detection on the integrity of the collected data to obtain a disaster area data set, and adopting a three-dimensional reconstruction algorithm to process the disaster area data set to obtain a disaster area three-dimensional point cloud model. The invention can effectively cope with complex terrain environment, realizes accurate analysis and comprehensive data acquisition of disaster areas, and provides important support for disaster assessment and rescue decision.

title_en: Anti-interference method for multi-band radar
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-interference method of a multi-band radar, which comprises the following steps of firstly obtaining an enhanced model in an offline state through offline dynamic countermeasure training, secondly obtaining an original echo signal in an online state to carry out self-adaptive filtering, carrying out space-time spectrum feature extraction by using the enhanced model, thirdly carrying out feature fusion and target separation according to the extracted space-time spectrum feature, fourthly carrying out optimization according to the separation result and judging whether a termination condition is achieved, if so, ending and outputting a multi-dimensional data packet, otherwise, returning to the step two. The method disclosed by the invention achieves the industry leading level on the anti-interference performance and vital sign monitoring precision through triple technical breakthroughs of hardware reconstruction, dynamic countermeasure training method and closed loop feedback, and is particularly suitable for extreme scenes such as firefighting rescue, battlefield search and rescue and the like. And the next step can focus on optimizing the light weight of the model, and further improve the deployment efficiency of the mobile platform.
assignees: HUAINAN UNION UNIV HUAINAN EMPLOYEE UNIV HUAINAN BRANCH OF ANHUI OPEN UNIV

title_en: Data security transmission method based on digital archive multiple protection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data security transmission method based on multiple protection of a digital archive, which relates to the field of data security transmission and comprises the steps of generating random seeds in real time based on quantum states, carrying out iterative blocking on the quantum seeds in combination with Logistic chaotic mapping, outputting variable-length key fragments, carrying out symmetrical encryption on archive data by adopting a lightweight SM4 algorithm to obtain fragmented encrypted data, calculating abnormal behavior probability by a hidden Markov model, calculating risk scores by a security interval, triggering hierarchical response when the score value exceeds a security threshold value, adopting n nodes to generate key fragments, at least k fragments to reconstruct signature monitoring block chain node states, and automatically switching to a three-layer architecture when the node abnormal rate exceeds the node threshold value. The invention has the advantages that an active multiple protection system is constructed through quantum dynamic key, risk driving hierarchical response and blockchain disaster recovery switching, so that the transmission of quantum attack resistance and dynamic adaptation to network risks is realized.

title_en: Landslide identification method, landslide identification system, computer equipment and landslide identification medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide identification method, a landslide identification system, computer equipment and a landslide identification medium, and belongs to the technical field of disaster identification. According to the method, a two-dimensional RGB image of a known landslide and a non-landslide side slope and a corresponding three-dimensional laser scanning real-point cloud image are obtained, and a training data set and a verification data set are constructed by combining an NYU Depth V2 data set. Reconstructing a point cloud image of a verification data set by using an improved encoder-decoder convolutional neural network model, verifying the reconstruction effect, extracting three-dimensional information such as the number of cracks in a slope, the length of the cracks in the slope, the relative height difference of a slope body, the length of the longest crack, the width of the largest crack and the like, screening landslide identification indexes by using an improved nonlinear NT hyperplane algorithm, constructing a landslide identification model, and selecting an optimal model by the verification data set to realize landslide identification based on a two-dimensional RGB image. The invention reduces the complexity of landslide identification modeling and avoids falling into dimension disaster.

title_en: Fire scene internal structure reconstruction method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of reconstruction of internal structures of fire fields, in particular to a method for reconstructing internal structures of fire fields based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: and receiving millimeter wave radar original data, identifying and separating independent fire scene wall structure point clouds and internal obstacle point clouds from non-ground point clouds, obtaining segmentation point cloud clusters, and independently marking each cluster based on the segmentation point cloud clusters to form marking structure unit point clouds. According to the method, point cloud data acquired by the millimeter wave radar are extracted, the ground, wall structures and internal obstacle areas are judged and distinguished by utilizing the point cloud elevation difference and neighborhood attribution, the accuracy of point cloud data segmentation is improved, the problem of structural information confusion is solved, in the geometric analysis process, the plane geometric fitting deviation of each structural unit is calculated and compared, effective normal vectors and intercept parameters are extracted, the space geometric expression capacity of structural elements is enhanced, and the structural identification error is reduced.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Forest fire detection method suitable for edge calculation and adopting double-channel time sequence data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Forest fire detection method suitable for double-channel time sequence data of edge calculation, which comprises the steps of obtaining an original RGB image and an infrared image corresponding to the original RGB image when Forest fires occur, carrying out normalization processing on the infrared image to obtain a normalized infrared image, carrying out smoothing processing on the normalized infrared image by Gaussian filtering to obtain a smoothed infrared image, carrying out time domain statistical feature extraction processing on the smoothed infrared image to obtain a reconstructed infrared image, selecting and removing a static light source to obtain an infrared image after eliminating the static light source, constructing a third image set, constructing a novel Forest-fire structure model, and inputting the third image set into the novel Forest-fire structure model to obtain the position of a fire point to finish the detection of the Forest fires. The invention obviously reduces the rate of missing report and false report, and achieves better effect when operating on the edge equipment with limited resources.

title_en: Post-disaster recovery method for power distribution network integrating V2G and electric hydrogen coupling of electric automobile
abstract_en: A post-disaster recovery method for a power distribution network integrating V2G and electric hydrogen coupling of electric vehicles comprises the following steps of S1, before a disaster occurs, making an economic compensation strategy, guiding the electric vehicles in an area to a V2G charging station or a centralized refuge station, and integrating a schedulable vehicle cluster after the disaster occurs, scheduling the electric vehicles of the refuge station to a target V2G charging station, scheduling the hydrogen fuel cell vehicles of the refuge station to the target V2G charging station or the hydrogenation station, and exciting the vehicles to reversely supply power to the power distribution network through the economic compensation strategy, S3, performing topology reconstruction on the power distribution network, and establishing a power supply recovery model of the power distribution network to form a micro-grid system comprising the V2G charging station and/or the hydrogenation station as power sources so as to recover emergency load power supply. The invention constructs a cooperative scheduling system of two energy forms, can realize the stable operation time length of the post-disaster power distribution network, and has remarkable advantages.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle moving edge calculation track planning method based on multi-target reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle moving edge calculation track planning method based on multi-target reinforcement learning.
