Aiming at the problems of limited energy and uneven task allocation of unmanned aerial vehicles in a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary mobile edge computing system, the method evaluates the target preference of the system (minimizing service interruption time or maximizing task calculation amount) by collecting real-time state data of the unmanned aerial vehicles, builds a distributed partially observable Markov decision process model, combines a crowding distance optimization experience playback mechanism, and iteratively updates model parameters to dynamically generate an optimal flight track. Experiments show that the method can adaptively balance the calculation task quantity and service continuity, effectively improve the system stability and the resource utilization rate, and is suitable for dynamic scenes such as disaster relief, intelligent traffic and the like.

title_en: Method and device for generating reconstruction plan during disaster recovery period of power distribution network based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for generating a reconstruction plan during disaster recovery of a power distribution network based on reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of disaster emergency of power systems. The method comprises the steps of establishing a reconstruction model in a disaster recovery period of a power distribution network and converting the reconstruction model into a Markov decision process model, establishing a reinforcement learning agent corresponding to the power distribution network, generating a training sample based on the Markov decision process model for offline training of the reinforcement learning agent, and finally obtaining the trained reinforcement learning agent, and generating a reconstruction plan in the disaster recovery period of the power distribution network on line by using the trained reinforcement learning agent. According to the method and the device, the reconstruction plan can be generated according to the branch fault probability of the power distribution network before the disaster occurs, so that the elasticity of the power distribution network when coping with the disaster is effectively improved, and the load loss condition caused by the disaster is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Information control system, information control method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a system for supporting preparation or modification of a plan related to recovery or reconstruction.SOLUTION: An information control system includes: a recovery state acquisition unit which acquires recovery state information on recovery or reconstruction state in a target area, the state being determined based on sensing data obtained by measuring the target area using a flying vehicle after an incident; a recovery objective acquisition unit which acquires recovery objective information on a recovery or reconstruction objective; a determination unit which determines, based on the recovery state information and the recovery objective information, recovery or reconstruction progress with respect to the objective, or an estimated recovery or reconstruction completion period; and a determination information output unit which transmits, display or voice-outputs information on the progress or the estimated completion period.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Forest fire satellite remote sensing image reconstruction method and system under thin smoke interference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for reconstructing a forest fire satellite remote sensing image under the interference of thin smoke, comprising the following steps of firstly, constructing a forest fire remote sensing image data set under the interference of thin smoke; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-branch forest fire remote sensing image reconstruction model with thin smoke interference, training to obtain a trained multi-branch forest fire remote sensing image reconstruction model, and inputting a forest fire satellite remote sensing image under the thin smoke interference into the trained multi-branch forest fire remote sensing image reconstruction model to obtain a forest fire remote sensing reconstruction image with the thin smoke interference removed. The invention effectively solves the problem that the existing remote sensing image reconstruction method under the light common atmospheric interference is not suitable for the remote sensing image reconstruction of the forest fire scene under the thin smoke interference, and can provide reliable and applicable satellite remote sensing image support for forest fire situation research and judgment, accurate positioning of a combustion area, resource scheduling, personnel evacuation, traffic control and other emergency command decisions.

title_en: Systematic disaster recovery backup method for distributed satellite management and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a systematic disaster recovery backup method for a distributed satellite management and control system, and relates to the technical field of space survey, operation and control and information. The invention divides the dynamic backup group aiming at the distributed satellite management and control system deployed at a plurality of nodes, performs standardized processing and synchronous backup on the data of the dynamic backup group, performs system reconstruction and data recovery when disaster recovery backup is needed, and performs system recovery verification and control right switching to complete systematic disaster recovery backup for the distributed satellite management and control system. The invention realizes the compatibility of heterogeneous data sources, the disaster recovery switching automation, reduces the synchronous data volume, improves the resource utilization rate and improves the fault tolerance of the system.
assignees: THE 54TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: E-commerce search service recovery method and device, equipment and medium thereof
abstract_en: Starting a local search service deployed by a current fault node, sending a missing data request to a remote search service of any healthy node, wherein the request comprises a latest timestamp of a latest log record in a local transaction log library, and the healthy node and the fault node are disaster recovery nodes; receiving a complete transaction log file generated after the latest timestamp returned by the remote search service, grouping log records in the complete transaction log file according to commodity identification, determining a target log record with the largest global version number in each group, constructing the target log record into an incremental transaction log file, writing the incremental transaction log file into a local transaction log library for playback to search engine index data, and re-registering the local search service to a service registration center after the playback is completed. The application can quickly recover the fault node and ensure that commodity data among the searching service nodes has high consistency.
assignees: GUANGZHOU SHANGYAN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Basic disaster backup drilling and disaster switching method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data disaster recovery, and provides a method and a system for basic disaster recovery exercise and disaster switching, wherein the method comprises the steps of automatically identifying multi-source heterogeneous database assets through a rule engine and a machine learning algorithm and constructing a disaster recovery topological graph; the disaster recovery method comprises the steps of generating and optimizing a disaster recovery strategy by an intelligent algorithm based on a disaster recovery topological graph, dynamically adjusting the disaster recovery strategy by combining real-time business requirements, fusing historical disaster recovery data with real-time monitoring data to reconstruct the disaster recovery strategy, collecting execution data in real time in exercise, optimizing the disaster recovery strategy by a closed loop feedback mechanism, monitoring the whole flow state by a visual interface and displaying key indexes, quantitatively analyzing exercise results based on a multidimensional evaluation model, determining a target disaster recovery strategy, authorizing key operation by a safety verification mechanism, matching a disaster recovery scene scheme according to fault types, and controlling an automatic execution unit to finish disaster switching based on the target disaster recovery strategy. The disaster recovery switching method and the disaster recovery switching device improve disaster recovery switching accuracy in complex scenes.

title_en: Intelligent safety belt early warning method for aerial work based on 5G Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aerial work, and discloses an aerial work intelligent safety belt early warning method based on a 5G Internet of things, which comprises a multidimensional acquisition module, an emergency positioning module and an early warning management module. The system respectively collects data sets through the multidimensional collection module, and the emergency positioning module calculates and generates a risk index The environment quality and the communication quality of the position of the operator are comprehensively evaluated, the communication smoothness and the rescue action safety are higher, and the emergency positioning module calculates and generates a tracking track Real-time monitoring and replaying the dynamic track of each operator, strengthening safety management in emergency, and calculating and generating a three-dimensional model by an emergency response unit The on-site perception capability is strong, the fire point and the fire cause can be analyzed rapidly, the early warning management module judges the safety state of the operator, and the safety state is transmitted to the intercom device and the central control console after the corresponding alarm signal is generated, so that the standard operation rescue efficiency is high.
assignees: CHONGQING GANGYOUSHEN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling method for multi-line interleaving logistics conveying line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-line interleaving logistics conveying line scheduling algorithm, which particularly relates to the technical field of logistics conveying line scheduling, and aims to realize online self-adaptive optimization of a graph model by constructing a dynamic graph structure model, carrying out embedded learning on node states by utilizing a graph neural network, identifying an abnormal transmission area in real time when faults occur, pruning a scheduling graph, removing high-risk nodes and paths, reconstructing a safe and feasible task path, guaranteeing scheduling execution accuracy through conflict detection and feasibility verification, and realizing online self-adaptive optimization of the graph model by combining a data acquisition and feedback mechanism in an operation process, so that the prediction capability of the scheduling system on complex anomalies, disaster tolerance scheduling capability and overall operation robustness are obviously improved.

title_en: Mining earthquake risk main control factor analysis method based on rock stratum macro-micro numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method of mine earthquake risk main control factors based on rock stratum macro-micro numerical simulation, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting rock samples and testing to obtain micro rock mechanical parameters, then constructing a standard sample model based on discrete element numerical analysis software, carrying out non-homogeneity parametrization on the standard sample model by utilizing Weibull functions and fractal dimension and the micro rock mechanical parameters to realize accurate matching of rock mass micro-macro mechanical characteristics, converting the micro rock mechanical parameters into macro rock mechanical parameters for discrete element analysis through rock quality index and rock mass strength conversion relation to realize high-fidelity reconstruction of the discrete element macro model, and carrying out orthogonal test and extremely poor analysis to quantify the macro non-homogeneity main control factors to realize priority sequencing of the macro non-homogeneity main control factors serving as key disaster causing factors. The method can simulate the rock stratum under the heterogeneous condition, so that the result is attached to the actual rock stratum condition, and data support is provided for subsequent rock stratum mining risk prevention and control treatment.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;INNER MONGOLIA YITAI COAL CO LTD;UNIV XINJIANG

title_en: Load recovery method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of post-disaster reconstruction of power distribution networks and discloses a power distribution network load recovery method, which is used for adjusting the service range of a communication base station operated based on a standby battery after disaster and carrying out topology dynamic reconstruction on the power distribution network after disaster based on a regulation and control instruction data packet sent by the communication base station, and comprises the steps of constructing communication constraint based on the regulation and control instruction data packet to be transmitted and the states of the communication base station and a contact switch in the power distribution network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a power flow constraint based on a Distflow tide model, constructing a topology dynamic reconstruction constraint by using a reconstruction topology of a power distribution network to meet the radial condition, constructing a maintenance constraint by using the monotonicity of a repair state of a power distribution line and the time required for maintenance, constructing an optimization objective function by using the minimum sum of load reduction of all nodes of the power distribution network in load recovery as an optimization objective, constructing a load recovery model by combining the constraints, solving the model, obtaining an optimal load recovery scheme, and dynamically reconstructing the topology of the power distribution network to realize load recovery.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Intelligent mine disaster early warning device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent mine disaster early warning device and system, comprising a multi-mode sensing array, an adaptive communication network, a dynamic risk assessment server and a threshold evolution engine, wherein the multi-mode sensing array comprises a bionic mine pressure sensor group, a gas spectrum fingerprint identification module and a microseismic beam forming array, the adaptive communication network comprises an edge preprocessing unit and a dual-mode communication module, and the dynamic risk assessment server is provided with a space-time characteristic fusion neural network and the threshold evolution engine. According to the invention, the three-dimensional reconstruction of the stress field is realized through the tree-shaped groove substrate of the bionic mine pressure sensor group and the three-dimensional piezoelectric network, and the broad spectrum gas fingerprint identification of the miniature Fourier infrared spectrometer and the electrochemical sensor group is combined to form a multi-mode sensing system for covering stress, gas and microseism, so that the space resolution and gas type identification coverage rate can be remarkably improved, the dynamic correlation analysis of the cross-mode data is realized through the space-time characteristic fusion neural network, the capturing sensitivity of disaster precursor characteristics can be effectively improved, and the false alarm rate is reduced.
assignees: SHAANXI ENERGY ZHAOSHIPAN MINING OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: Disaster resisting method and device based on distribution information physical system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network safety and discloses a disaster resisting method, a disaster resisting device and a storage medium based on a power distribution information physical system, wherein the disaster resisting method comprises the steps of obtaining a composite fault scene set of power failure of a communication base station caused by interruption of a power distribution line, and constructing an optimization objective function by taking the minimum sum of the load loss of all nodes as an optimization objective when the composite fault degree is maximum; the method comprises the steps of constructing a reinforcement resource quantity constraint, an active power balance constraint comprising a communication base station shutdown constraint and a remote control enabling constraint, constructing a target disaster resisting strategy model by combining a reactive power balance constraint, a branch voltage drop constraint, a line bearing capacity constraint, a line on-off power flow constraint, a fault logic constraint, a voltage amplitude constraint, a load reduction constraint and a reconstruction constraint of a distribution line, solving and obtaining an optimal disaster resisting scheme, and reinforcing the target distribution line.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;XIAN JIAOTONG LIVERPOOL UNIV

title_en: Autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance system of fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance system of a fire-fighting robot, and relates to the technical field of navigation and obstacle avoidance. According to the method, the accuracy and feasibility of path planning are effectively ensured by constructing the three-dimensional state unit set and eliminating the non-accessible area; the system can realize local reconstruction and continuity recovery of the path through the graph structure updating and path correcting module, and avoid delay and resource waste caused by global re-planning in the traditional system. The invention also merges the space overlap ratio calculation and jump detection method, thereby effectively improving the reliability of key frame node identification and the stability of task switching.

title_en: Multi-mode remote sensing image weak and small target detection method based on super resolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting a weak and small target of a multi-mode remote sensing image based on super-resolution. Firstly, carrying out feature fusion on input RGB and infrared remote sensing images through BFM to generate comprehensive features, wherein the BFM can effectively overcome the defect of insufficient information of weak and small targets in a single mode. These features are then fed into the backbone network to generate multi-level features. Secondly, the backbone network in SA-YOLO is responsible for further merging the multi-level features in the feature pyramid network, and then classifying and regressing in the detection head. The branch network in SA-YOLO selects low-level and high-level characteristics output by the backbone network, and respectively fuses local texture and semantic information to reconstruct super resolution. The method provided by the invention effectively improves the detection precision of weak and small targets in the multi-mode remote sensing image, and has wide application prospects in the aspects of military reconnaissance, civil monitoring, disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Geological mineral product based three-dimensional modeling accurate positioning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological information and discloses a geological mineral product three-dimensional modeling accurate positioning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of deploying a laser ranging, microseismic and fiber bragg grating sensing array and synchronously collecting multi-source deformation and stress data; after space-time alignment and filtering, reconstructing a millimeter-level precision three-dimensional point cloud model by adopting an improved ICP algorithm, calculating a safety coefficient cloud image by combining a geomechanical constitutive equation, automatically defining a risk area according to a three-level threshold, and generating closed-loop control instructions such as voice alarm, thermodynamic diagram pushing, grouting coordinates, avoidance paths and the like. The system comprises a sensing deployment unit, a data preprocessing unit, a point cloud reconstruction unit, a mechanical analysis unit, a risk setting unit, an instruction distribution unit and an execution unit. The invention realizes deformation millimeter-level positioning of the goaf, sub-hour level early warning and full-automatic intervention, the early warning accuracy exceeds 95%, the emergency response is shortened to minute level, and the mine safety and exploitation efficiency are improved.

title_en: Mining area watering cart running control method based on animal avoidance real-time re-planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining area watering cart running control method based on real-time re-planning of animal avoidance, which realizes intelligent obstacle avoidance through multi-mode sensor fusion detection, target recognition of deep learning driving, three-dimensional dynamic path planning, a multi-stage acousto-optic early warning system and self-adaptive speed adjustment, and shortens detection response time and reduces false alarm rate by adopting a radar, a camera, a bionic compound eye vision module and the like. Constraint conditions such as terrain gradient and soil humidity are integrated through an RRT algorithm, continuous processing of path curvature is achieved, the sprinkler can complete path reconstruction without stopping completely under an animal sudden-prevention scene, a hierarchical early warning mechanism triggers three-level acousto-optic warning according to animal approaching degree, a dynamic speed regulation model is matched, and continuity of spraying operation is guaranteed while safety margin is guaranteed. According to the mining area complex environment operation safety and operation efficiency are remarkably improved through the environment interference compensation, the geological disaster early warning interface and the driver behavior simulation unit.
assignees: BEIJING LUKAI ZHIXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent detection device for longitudinal resistance of railway ballasted ballast bed and evaluation system thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ballast track discrete ballast bed state detection, in particular to an intelligent detection device and an evaluation system for longitudinal resistance of a railway ballast track bed, comprising a detection vehicle, wherein the inner side of the detection vehicle comprises an automatic bolt disassembling device, a running control device, an intelligent ballast removal backfilling device, an automatic track lifting device, an intelligent loading and sleeper displacement testing device, a measuring point mileage recording device, a driving device, a display, a real-time detection and evaluation system for longitudinal resistance of the track bed and a night lighting system, the intelligent detection device and the intelligent evaluation system thereof rely on a multifunctional detection module and an intelligent evaluation system of the intelligent detection vehicle to greatly improve the efficiency and accuracy of the detection of the longitudinal resistance of the ballast bed, can realize the intelligent detection and evaluation of the longitudinal resistance of the ballast bed and the accurate prediction of the lateral stability of the line, and provide important data support for the maintenance and the post-disaster reconstruction of the railway line.

title_en: Cross-platform integration-oriented enterprise data collaborative scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-platform integration oriented enterprise data collaborative scheduling method and a system, which particularly relate to the field of enterprise data scheduling and data disaster recovery control, and comprise the steps of obtaining task execution records of all service platforms, analyzing a cross-platform data calling sequence, constructing a scheduling path set consisting of data processing nodes, and calculating the dependence intensity of each path as an evaluation value; according to the invention, a data processing path structure taking a task process chain as a core is constructed, a target state configuration, state snapshot generation and state check record construction mechanism is fused, and a dynamic evaluation and disaster recovery reconstruction strategy based on a path stability index is introduced, so that the problems of scheduling interruption and disaster recovery failure caused by inconsistent data states and missing state recovery processes in a multi-platform heterogeneous system in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Binocular vision highway slope displacement monitoring method, binocular vision highway slope displacement monitoring system, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a binocular vision highway slope displacement monitoring method, a binocular vision highway slope displacement monitoring system, electronic equipment and a binocular vision highway slope displacement monitoring medium, which belong to the field of geological disaster monitoring, and the binocular vision highway slope displacement monitoring method comprises the steps of calibrating two cameras arranged on one side of a highway to obtain calibration parameters; the two cameras form a binocular camera, a preset interval is kept, an optical axis covers a plurality of ArUco targets distributed on a slope protection structure, the binocular camera is used for collecting monitoring area images based on calibration, unique codes and corner pixel coordinates of each ArUco target are extracted from the images, corner three-dimensional coordinates are reconstructed based on calibration parameters and the pixel coordinates, center fitting is conducted to obtain fitting three-dimensional coordinates to serve as monitoring points, and slope displacement is monitored according to three-dimensional coordinate changes of the monitoring points at front and rear moments. The invention realizes convenient, efficient and reliable monitoring of the side slope displacement.

title_en: Geographic mosaicking method and apparatus for video images, and computer device and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to a geographic mosaicking method and apparatus for video images, and a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises: acquiring real-time live streaming images of a real-world scene that are collected by a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, and GNSS information of the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles; using a visual SLAM algorithm to perform input frame tracking on the real-time live streaming images, and performing pose estimation on successfully tracked input frames by combining visual trajectories and the GNSS information, so as to generate georeferenced camera poses; using the camera poses and a surface reconstruction algorithm to perform densification processing on the input frames, so as to generate a depth map of the real-world scene, and mapping the depth map into dense three-dimensional point clouds, so as to construct a three-dimensional surface model of the real-world scene; and using the camera pose and the three-dimensional surface model to perform orthorectification on the input frames, and integrating the orthorectified input frames into a global mosaicked map, so as to generate a global image of the real-world scene. By means of the embodiments of the present application, a real-time picture of a real-world scene can be quickly acquired, thereby providing robust support for a rapid emergency response in a real-world scene.

title_en: Geotechnical engineering slope stability real-time monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a geotechnical engineering slope stability real-time monitoring method and system, which are characterized in that an original displacement time sequence and an environment temperature time sequence of a plurality of GNSS measuring points are regarded as multichannel mixed signals by introducing a blind source separation technology combining independent component analysis and physical constraint, periodic environment noise, instrument random noise and drift and a real slope deformation signal are effectively separated from a mixed observation signal by utilizing statistical independence among signal sources, and then, the separated source signals are automatically calibrated through correlation verification of physical quantities such as field environment temperature, and the like, and temperature effect source signals with physical labels and long-term creep source signals are accurately identified and extracted, so that accurate rejection of noise components and high-fidelity reconstruction of pure deformation signals are realized. Therefore, the accuracy of monitoring the stability of the geotechnical engineering slope in real time can be effectively improved, and a solid data basis and a decision basis are provided for early warning and prevention and control of the slope disaster.
assignees: SHANDONG SANJIAN ENG TESTING CO LTD

title_en: Debris flow slumping material source bottom surface reconstruction and volume estimation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a debris flow slumping material source bottom surface reconstruction and volume estimation method, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and prevention. The method comprises the steps of obtaining vector boundary and elevation data of a debris flow slumping material source, constructing a basic data set by unifying coordinates, generating a trend fitting elevation vector by utilizing a main trend constraint function in a slip direction of elevation data point fitting in a debris flow slumping material source buffer zone, carrying out interpolation propagation and expansion on the basis of a structure tensor and the trend fitting elevation vector to obtain an initial bottom slip surface elevation, constructing a sparse matrix system, carrying out global optimization fitting on the bottom slip surface elevation by utilizing a generalized minimum residual error method, extending the bottom slip surface to the ground surface, and naturally intersecting the top surface of a digital elevation model to form the volume of a closed slip body. The method solves the problems that the existing method for reconstructing the bottom sliding surface interpolation of the debris flow sliding material source has insufficient control of interpolation direction, is not strict in boundary constraint and cannot form a closed volume through natural intersection.

title_en: Assembled domestic hot water system of reconstruction fire-fighting high-level water tank coupling air source heat pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to an assembled domestic hot water system with a reconstructed fire-fighting high-level water tank coupled with an air source heat pump, belongs to the technical field of building energy conservation, and solves the technical problem that an existing roof fire-fighting water tank and an air source heat pump heat storage water tank are independently arranged in the same area, and the building area occupies a large area. The invention comprises a machine room water tank unit, a fire-fighting system unit, a heat supply unit and a water supply unit, wherein the machine room water tank unit comprises an assembled high-level fire-fighting water tank room prefabricated machine room, a coupling common water tank and a heat exchanger, the assembled high-level fire-fighting water tank room prefabricated machine room is arranged on a building roof, the coupling common water tank is arranged in the prefabricated machine room, and the heat exchanger is arranged in the coupling common water tank. The invention can reduce the area of a building machine room, improve the utilization rate of the building area, simplify the system form and reduce the purchase cost, maintenance and management cost of equipment by coupling the shared water tank as a core component and simultaneously bearing the dual functions of fire-fighting storage water and heat storage and heat exchange media of the domestic hot water system.

title_en: Flame smoke detection method and system based on improvement YOLOv s
abstract_en: The application discloses a flame smoke detection method and a system based on improved YOLOv s, and relates to the technical field of fire disaster identification, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an up-sampling update layer based on common convolution, dynamic convolution and cavity convolution corresponding to different receptive fields; the method comprises the steps of constructing an aspect ratio consistency penalty according to an aspect ratio difference term based on nonlinear transformation, replacing an upsampling initial layer in YOLOv s network architecture by an upsampling updating layer, reconstructing a YOLOv s basic model according to the aspect ratio consistency penalty and a loss function in YOLOv s network architecture by linear interval mapping, training YOLOv s basic model based on historical fire image data, obtaining a flame smoke detection model, obtaining real-time image data, and obtaining a flame smoke detection result according to the real-time image data and the flame smoke detection model. The application has the beneficial effects of improving the accuracy and comprehensiveness of identifying extreme forms such as flame, smoke and the like.
assignees: HANGZHOU INTELLIGENT LINGTONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent signal scheduling and management system for satellite transmission uplink station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent signal scheduling and management system of a satellite transmission uplink station, which particularly relates to the technical field of satellite communication, and innovatively adopts a three-layer architecture of intelligent decision-agile execution-closed loop optimization, namely a reinforced learning decision engine based on multi-source data fusion dynamically generates a spectrum-power-modulation combined strategy, realizes millisecond-level reconstruction of carrier parameters through a software-defined radio interface, and triggers disaster recovery switching in a grading manner by depending on service SLA. The method solves the problems of the traditional uplink station such as resource scheduling rigidness, interference response delay and extensive fault recovery, and achieves the core effects of dynamic optimal allocation of transmission resources, self-adaptive anti-interference of complex electromagnetic environment and zero interruption guarantee of high-value service.

title_en: Emergency data fusion and decision method under cross-mode dynamic routing mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency data fusion and decision method under a cross-mode dynamic routing mechanism, which relates to the field of emergency management and disaster response and comprises the following steps of collecting multi-mode emergency data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction by adopting a lightweight grouping separable convolution network to generate attribute capsules of corresponding modes, fusing attribute capsules of different modes through a cross-mode dynamic routing mechanism to generate a decision capsule representing a global emergency situation, simultaneously inputting the decision capsule into an attribute reconstruction channel and a reinforcement learning channel to carry out parallel processing, generating an emergency strategy through joint optimization, issuing the emergency strategy to edge equipment for execution, and updating a weight matrix in the routing mechanism based on execution effect feedback data. According to the method, lightweight edge feature extraction and adaptive cross-modal dynamic route fusion at a disaster stage and edge and cloud collaborative decision closed loop are utilized, so that the accuracy and decision efficiency of multi-source data fusion in emergency response are remarkably improved.

title_en: Fire blocking method and related device for urban cable tunnel network node
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire blocking method and a fire blocking device for network nodes of an urban cable tunnel, and belongs to the technical field of fire control. According to the invention, a space-time hybrid prediction model is constructed by fusing multi-source sensor data, a fire prevention partition instruction is dynamically generated, a node partition response system based on a fire prevention and ventilation and smoke exhaust linkage execution strategy is implemented by using a feedback updating and strategy reconstruction mechanism driven by a Comprehensive Control Index (CCI). The invention solves the problems of lag response and insufficient multi-source data fusion of the traditional method, and has the advantages of improving the timeliness and accuracy of fire blocking, optimizing the linkage control effect of a ventilation system, and reducing the risk of fire spreading and loss of secondary disasters.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Roof strata global deformation and motion monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract_en: The application discloses a system and a method for monitoring global deformation and movement of a roof strata, which are characterized in that flexible monitoring cables integrated with nine-axis inertial sensors are arranged inside drilling holes of the roof strata, a gravitational field and a geomagnetic field are used as absolute space references, and accurate sensing of three-dimensional postures of strata can be realized without relying on underground unstable external references. Based on the dynamic calibration algorithm, the sensor installation deviation is automatically compensated, discrete measuring points are fused into a continuous three-dimensional track through a Bezier curve, the global kinematic behavior of the high-level rock stratum from initial micro deformation, gradual revolution until collapse and breakage is intuitively reconstructed, data acquisition and transmission are realized, three-dimensional reconstruction is realized, a pre-warning closed-loop mechanism is finally driven, deterministic precursor characteristics are captured before structural instability through correlation of rock stratum attitude change rate and vibration energy evolution law, passive response type post-disaster treatment is converted into advanced response active prevention and control, and the accuracy and timeliness of mine roof disaster pre-warning are improved.

title_en: Storm early warning method based on dynamic fusion of multisource forecast products
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and discloses a storm early warning method based on dynamic fusion of multisource forecast products, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode rainfall forecast data, constructing a rainfall cumulative distribution function, and dynamically updating based on Kalman filtering to obtain each mode frequency correction rainfall forecast product; the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical forecast and live monitoring data samples, calculating comprehensive weight coefficients corresponding to precipitation of each level to obtain a fusion initial precipitation distribution field, carrying out matched reconstruction on a corrected precipitation forecast field to generate a reconstructed precipitation distribution field, collecting latest live monitoring data, carrying out space-time dynamic correction on the reconstructed precipitation distribution field to generate a real-time heavy rain potential field, comparing the real-time heavy rain potential field with a multi-level heavy rain early warning threshold to generate heavy rain early warning information, and releasing the heavy rain early warning information. The method improves the timeliness and accuracy of the storm warning response, ensures the personal safety of the public and improves the urban emergency disposal capacity.
assignees: HENAN METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY YELLOW RIVER BASIN METEOROLOGICAL CENTER HENAN ENV METEOROLOGICAL F

title_en: Anomalous transaction recovery in database systems
abstract_en: An apparatus comprises at least one processing device configured to detect, utilizing a machine learning model, anomalous transactions in a database system comprising first and second databases, the second database having a configurable disaster recovery delay time period relative to the first database. The at least one processing device is also configured to determine a recovery time point for the database system based on a transaction time of a given anomalous transaction, and to replay, from the first database to the second database, a first set of transactions occurring during the configurable disaster recovery delay time period up to the determined recovery time point, to validate recovery of the first set of transactions, and to replay, from the first database to the second database, a second set of transactions of the database system occurring after the determined recovery time point responsive to validating recovery of the first set of transactions.

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling water damage of overlying strata for dwarfism coal seam mining
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mining, and provides a method for preventing and controlling water damage of a overlying strata in dwarf coal seam mining, which comprises the steps of S1) acquiring and analyzing geological and hydrologic conditions of a stope area, determining whether an overlying strata roof has an overlying strata, S2) acquiring an overlying strata parameter if the roof has the overlying strata, judging the type of the overlying strata and the type of the water damage of the overlying strata according to the delamination parameter, S3) cutting an aqueous layer of the roof or cutting a water channel flowing to the overlying strata through a strong runoff fracture zone of surrounding strata if the type of the overlying strata is determined to be disaster, S4) draining accumulated water in the overlying strata through an upper deflector hole and/or a lower deflector hole, S5) conducting pre-splitting cutting on a key layer of the roof to reconstruct a fracture structure of the overlying strata, and S6) executing coal seam stope operation. The control method can find hidden danger of water storage in the separation layer in an early stage, adopts measures of cutting off a water source and guiding and draining water storage to reduce water damage in the separation layer in a germination stage, and solves the problem that a system for controlling water damage in the separation layer is lacking in the prior art.
assignees: CHN ENERGY GROUP NINGXIA COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Electric load prediction method under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric load prediction method under extreme weather, which belongs to the technical field of electric load prediction and comprises the following steps of determining an electric power transmission source in the influence range of the extreme weather, analyzing whether renewable energy sources are contained in the electric power transmission source to generate electricity, and evaluating whether the electric power generation facilities are influenced by the extreme weather so as to predict the total electric power; the range affected by extreme weather is divided into a plurality of different areas according to the connection relation of the power grid. According to the method, the total power generation power is predicted by combining the extreme weather forecast and the geographic information, the region is divided according to the power grid connection relation, the total electric load demand is predicted by combining the conventional load reconstruction and the post-disaster load reconstruction, the load condition is finally identified, and the power allocation is optimized, so that the power generation prediction accuracy, the power grid risk resistance and the power allocation efficiency can be improved, and the stable operation of the extreme weather and the post-disaster power grid is ensured.

title_en: Structural response reconstruction and ground vibration inversion system and method based on monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention provides a structural response reconstruction and ground vibration inversion system and method based on monitoring data. The method is based on deep learning framework design, integrates a graph neural network and a time sequence modeling mechanism, and is divided into two stages, wherein the first stage is used for realizing rapid reconstruction of post-disaster building structure response, and the second stage is used for inverting ground vibration signals by using reconstructed structure response data, so that efficient acquisition of post-disaster monitoring information and disaster assessment support are realized.

title_en: Emergency deduction method for total disaster seeds
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full disaster emergency deduction method, which relates to the technical field of emergency management and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a space-time coupled deduction basic frame, dividing a deduction area by taking hexagonal lattices as basic space units, associating a ground object attribute set with each hexagonal lattice, defining a time step as a deduction minimum time unit, quantifying action time into an integer step value, establishing a mapping relation between the hexagonal lattices and the time step, and realizing dynamic association of space displacement and time consumption, and S2, executing deduction decision based on a modularized decision engine, wherein the deduction decision comprises decoupling a rule module into a deduction rule base and a decision executor, and the deduction rule base comprises a multi-disaster physical model. According to the full disaster emergency deduction method, the rule base is decoupled from the engine, so that the configuration efficiency of the newly added disaster is improved, and a core code does not need to be reconstructed.
assignees: BEIJING LITUO XINAN SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Weak forest fire alarm method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire alarm, and discloses a weak forest fire alarm method, a weak forest fire alarm device, weak forest fire alarm equipment and a storage medium, which are used for reading thermal infrared spectrum data of a target satellite image by calculating an instantaneous ground surface temperature baseline field, inversion is carried out to obtain a first instantaneous surface temperature field, the first instantaneous surface temperature field is converted into a second instantaneous surface temperature field, a sub-pixel thermal increment image is obtained through calculation, false color image synthesis is carried out by utilizing a first wave band image and a second wave band image in a target satellite image, and a weak forest fire alarm signal is generated. Therefore, the method for rapidly identifying the forest grass initial ignition and the small fire by utilizing the thermal radiation incremental images is provided, the subaperture instantaneous thermal radiation bright Wen Jixian field synchronous with remote sensing is constructed, the sub-pixel thermal incremental images are reconstructed, the early forest fires are represented and identified based on the thermal increment mutation characteristics and the thermal steady-state characteristics of the forest and grassland distribution areas, the monitoring efficiency and the accuracy of the fire points are effectively improved, and the technological level of forest fire monitoring is improved.

title_en: Disaster recovery database data synchronization method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a disaster recovery database data synchronization method, device, equipment and storage medium. Relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of writing logs of all nodes into log queues corresponding to all nodes, determining that a transaction corresponding to a queue head log in each log queue is a single-node transaction or a distributed transaction, writing commit transaction identification of the single-node transaction and corresponding transaction information, writing the commit transaction identification of multi-node transaction with minimum commit transaction identification and the sequence of the corresponding transaction information, writing the commit transaction identification and the transaction information of the queue head log into a global playback queue, analyzing the transaction information in the global playback queue to obtain statement blocks, writing the statement blocks into at least one playback queue according to the commit transaction identification corresponding to the statement blocks, and sending the statement blocks in each playback queue to a disaster backup database to enable the disaster backup database to execute the statement blocks so as to synchronize data of a source database in real time. The problem of longer disaster recovery switching time is solved.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORP;CCB FINTECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster scene-oriented double-stage diffusion remote sensing hyperspectral reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster scene-oriented double-stage diffusion remote sensing hyperspectral reconstruction method which comprises the steps of obtaining a multispectral image and a hyperspectral image data set, generating a priori noise image, constructing a condition priori, generating an intermediate hyperspectral image through reverse diffusion iteration, and further optimizing through a spectrum correction network to obtain a finer hyperspectral image. The method adopts a priori guided diffusion method, utilizes spectrum priori information to realize high-spectrum accurate construction under a single sample, can effectively generate high-spectrum data in a scene with deficient high-spectrum data, adopts progressive design to divide an input image into a plurality of layers in a spectrum correction process, gradually eliminates noise problems introduced in the diffusion process in the layers with different resolutions, and completes high-quality generation of the high-spectrum image. According to the method, the spectral super-resolution generation task can be completed based on a single sample, and on the other hand, the structural accuracy of the hyperspectral image generated by an algorithm can be improved, and the hyperspectral data generation effect is remarkably improved.

title_en: Fire control of building is reformed transform structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting reconstruction structure of a building, relates to the technical field of fire-fighting drainage, and aims to solve the technical problems that the current water pit is inconvenient and effective in filtering sundries and affecting drainage quality, and comprises a bottom box, a middle box and a linkage mechanism, wherein the middle box is arranged in the middle of the upper end surface of the bottom box, both sides of the middle box are provided with side boxes, the roof is installed to the open-top joint of well box, and the outlet has been seted up to the array on the roof, the side tank has all been seted up to the both sides of well box, and the grafting has the cavernosum in the side tank, the upside at well box is installed to the interlocking mechanism, and the downside of link mechanism laminating roof, the slope has been seted up to well box upper end opening inboard, and the spacing groove has all been seted up at the slope both ends. The utility model has the advantages of convenient and fast filtering of sundries, blockage prevention and drainage quality assurance.
assignees: XIAN JIZHUN FANGZHONG BUILDING DESIGN CO LTD;JIZHUN FANGZHONG ARCH DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Medical place automatic door data sharing and privacy protection system based on block chain
abstract_en: The automatic door data sharing and privacy protecting system for the medical places based on the blockchain is characterized by comprising an edge perception module, an encryption storage module, a certificate sharing module, a right management module and a double-chain audit module, wherein the edge perception module is used for processing biological identification data through edge nodes, outputting desensitization feature vectors and packaging device fingerprints and time stamps, the encryption storage module is used for dynamically generating encryption keys, carrying out anonymous right verification by combining zero knowledge proof, carrying out data encryption and key slicing storage, the certificate sharing module is used for constructing a alliance chain, carrying out data intercommunication on desensitization encryption data through a multi-channel uplink certificate, nodes on the alliance chain are communicated through cross-chain protocol data, the right management module is used for deploying three-layer intelligent contracts, automatically executing right control according to alliance chain setting rules, and the double-chain audit module is used for adopting a double-chain structure to automatically detect abnormal access behaviors and automatically triggering intelligent contract adjustment right strategies. The invention reconstructs the data management mode of the medical place and shows remarkable advantages in compliance, efficiency improvement and emergency response dimension.
assignees: DONGGUAN CHAMP AUTOMATIC DOOR CO LTD

title_en: Method for solving landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for solving landslide, and relates to the technical field of geological engineering. A method for solving landslide comprises the following steps of paving a drain pipe, building a reservoir, building a water storage tower and paving a water supply pipe. The invention can timely guide and discharge accumulated water in the mountain through the drain pipe, reduce pore water pressure, enhance the stability of the mountain, effectively prevent landslide and debris flow caused by continuous rainfall or short-time heavy rainfall, realize the resource utilization of rainwater by the cooperation of the reservoir and the water storage tower, have the functions of irrigation and power generation, improve ecological and economic benefits, and reduce surface runoff by terrace type reconstruction, and further reduce geological disaster risks. The system has remarkable application prospect in both disaster prevention and sustainable development, the filter screen can effectively prevent sediment from blocking a drain pipe, the long-term stability of drainage efficiency is ensured, the power generation device generates power by utilizing water level difference in rainy seasons, clean energy is provided for peripheral facilities, and the water suction pump operates by combining peak-valley electricity price mechanisms, so that the energy cost is reduced.

title_en: Virtual-real fusion traffic twin simulation test system and method for air-ground cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground cooperation oriented virtual-real fusion traffic twin simulation test system and an air-ground cooperation oriented virtual-real fusion traffic twin simulation test method, belongs to the field of intelligent traffic design optimization, verification or simulation, and aims to provide a highly flexible multi-scene experiment platform for teaching and scientific research through the concept of 'entity twin-dynamic mapping'. Based on a dynamic display technology, the system twines real traffic scenes such as urban roads, emergency evacuation, three-dimensional parking and the like into a small-scale experimental space, supports rapid scene and space layout switching, and realizes seamless mapping of virtual and real environments. The central control system synchronizes the motion trail and virtual traffic flow of physical devices such as unmanned aerial vehicles, intelligent vehicles and the like in real time through a virtual-real fusion technology, and forms a bidirectional interactive closed loop of 'small space entity-central control virtual'. The multi-scene self-adaptive integration idea is taken as a core, and the space-ground coordination capability is combined, so that the dynamic reconstruction and nonlinear migration of tasks such as logistics distribution, emergency response and the like are supported, and the cross-scene experiment can be completed without hardware transformation.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY;BEIJING QIANCHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-position geological disaster chain risk quantitative evaluation method suitable for high-cold high-altitude environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-position geological disaster chain risk quantitative evaluation method suitable for a high-cold high-altitude environment, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and control. The method comprises the steps of constructing an irradiation and albedo combined observation layer to extract light intensity characteristics, generating an exposure time sequence fingerprint base line, extracting a trigger point boundary by adopting coherent phase decomposition and inverse facts playback, reconstructing a continuous track, predicting overexposure risk based on time-frequency scoring, controlling an exposure rhythm by linkage spectrum gating and polarization rotation, and implementing inverse phase traction and phase conjugation intervention in a steady-state window to achieve boundary information maintenance and risk identification precision improvement.

title_en: Space-time spectrum combined super-resolution reconstruction method based on giant remote sensing star group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time spectrum combined super-resolution reconstruction method based on a huge remote sensing star group, which comprises the steps of collecting time sequence, multi-view and multi-spectrum data of the same area from a plurality of heterogeneous satellites, carrying out radiometric calibration and atmospheric correction, adopting a combined registration model to realize sub-pixel level alignment of multi-source data, utilizing three-dimensional convolution to extract time variation characteristics, two-dimensional convolution to extract space structure and texture characteristics, one-dimensional convolution to extract and dimension-reduction spectrum characteristics, carrying out self-adaptive weighted fusion on the time, space and spectrum characteristics through a attention mechanism to generate a combined characteristic tensor, and carrying out super-resolution reconstruction to obtain a target image with high space resolution, high time resolution and high spectrum fidelity. The method gives consideration to resolution improvement and spectrum authenticity, and is suitable for high-precision remote sensing application scenes such as fine city mapping, agricultural monitoring, ecological environment assessment, disaster emergency and battlefield situation sensing, remote reconnaissance, target change detection, damage assessment and the like.

title_en: Intelligent identification and digital reconstruction method for rock mass fracture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rock mass engineering, in particular to an intelligent identification and digital reconstruction method for rock mass cracks, which comprises the steps of collecting rock mass crack images; manually marking color blocks, introducing marked medical image cell membrane samples and road crack samples based on transfer learning, performing joint training on a crack recognition model, inputting a rock mass crack image into the crack recognition model to split cracks, constructing a snake-shaped convolution network to extract multi-scale features of the image, digitally reconstructing a binary image to obtain block set and fold line set data, and restoring the digital data from a pixel scale to an engineering scale. The invention realizes the intelligent identification of the rock mass fracture image and the full-flow automation of the digital reconstruction, and can be widely applied to the fields of geotechnical engineering design, slope disaster identification, underground space stability analysis and the like.

title_en: Safety monitoring management system and method for coal mine equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a coal mine equipment safety monitoring management method and system, which belong to the technical field of coal mine monitoring and aim to realize reliable transmission of safety monitoring information and configuration management of equipment resources in a complex mine environment. The method comprises the steps that the monitoring terminal obtains multi-dimensional environment parameters of underground equipment, pattern matching is conducted on the multi-dimensional environment parameters according to a preset disaster feature library, abnormal feature vectors are generated, the monitoring terminal realizes dynamic reconstruction of network topology under disaster scenes through multi-dimensional environment sensing and equipment state fusion analysis, efficiency and reliability of communication link establishment are remarkably improved, monitoring blind areas caused by failure of fixed network nodes are avoided, and therefore the monitoring terminal can optimize an energy distribution strategy through a hierarchical power supply control and equipment collaborative management mechanism, stable operation of key monitoring equipment is guaranteed preferentially, and effective working time of a system under the condition of abnormal power supply is prolonged.
assignees: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD

title_en: Fire protection system for reconstruction of existing building fire protection facilities
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting system for reconstruction of existing building fire-fighting facilities, which comprises a production fire-fighting water tank and a high-level water tank, wherein one end of the production fire-fighting water tank, which is supplied with water, is communicated with a first fire-fighting pump and a second fire-fighting pump through fire-fighting pipelines, the other sides of the first fire-fighting pump and the second fire-fighting pump are communicated with a water supply pipe through first outlet pipes, the water supply pipe comprises a first water supply pipe and a second water supply pipe, the first water supply pipe is communicated with the high-level water tank, the second water supply pipe is communicated with a workshop, one end of the production fire-fighting water tank, which is returned water, is communicated with the water supply pipe through fire-fighting pressure relief pipelines, and a pressure reducing valve is arranged on the fire-fighting pressure relief pipelines. The utility model aims to provide a fire-fighting system for reconstruction of the existing building fire-fighting facilities, which meets the existing fire-fighting standard requirements, ensures the redundancy of a fire-fighting water pump and reduces the difficulty and cost of fire-fighting reconstruction.
assignees: HAINING HAILIDE FIBER TECH CO LTD;ZHEJIANG HAILIDE NEW MAT CO LTD

title_en: Building underground parking lot electric vehicle fire response system
abstract_ko:
건축물 지하주차장 전기자동차 화재대응 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 건축물 지하주차장 전기자동차 화재대응 시스템은, 주차장 내 장착된 화재 감지기 및 열화상 카메라를 통해 화재를 감지하고, 화재 발생 구역 근무자에게 화재 감지 정보를 전달하며, 화재 발생 구역 소방시설을 작동시키는 화재 인지부; 화재 인지부로부터 획득한 데이터를 바탕으로 소방 방재센터 근무자에게 현장 출동 정보를 전달하고, 화재 발생 구역 소방시설 정상 작동 유무를 확인하여 소방 방재센터 근무자에게 전달하는 화재현장 출동부; 화재 인지부로부터 획득한 데이터를 바탕으로 화재 발생 구역 전기차충전시설에 공급되는 전력을 차단하는 충전기 비상제어부; 및 화재 인지부로부터 획득한 데이터를 바탕으로 화재 발생 구역에 설치된 질식소화포 장치를 작동시키고, 화재 발생 전기차를 담수처리하는 소방시설 제어부;를 포함하는 것을 구성의 요지로 한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 화재 발생에 대해 신속히 대응하여 화재피해를 최소화 할 수 있는 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Real triaxial CT real-time scanning experimental device for dynamic disturbance hard rock of deep engineering
abstract_en: A real-time CT scanning experiment device for a hard rock true triaxial under dynamic disturbance of deep engineering belongs to the technical field of rock mechanics experiments, and comprises a base, a true triaxial loading mechanism and a CT real-time scanning mechanism. The method can realize CT real-time scanning of the whole process of the dynamic disturbance true triaxial experiment, can acquire information of the crack development process in the rock at different loading moments, overcomes the problems that the rock crack cannot be directly observed and other monitoring means have large errors and inaccurate results in the traditional true triaxial experiment, can develop the stress release and dynamic disturbance coupling effect true triaxial experiment, simulate the working condition of a deep engineering hydraulic fracturing technology for preventing dynamic disasters, acquire the crack development process in the rock at different moments through CT real-time scanning, and enable the crack development process in the rock to realize accurate three-dimensional reconstruction, and can develop three-direction dynamic disturbance true triaxial experiment, long-term fatigue true triaxial experiment and hydraulic fracturing dynamic disturbance coupling true triaxial experiment, and realize CT real-time scanning and three-dimensional reconstruction in the experimental process.

title_en: Load recovery method and system for power distribution network fault area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of micro-grids, and provides a load recovery method and a system for a power distribution network fault area, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out network reconstruction and load reduction on the power distribution network after disaster information of the power distribution network is acquired; the method comprises the steps of modeling a power distribution network by adopting a graph representation learning method, abstracting the power distribution network into a graph structure, modeling a fault management problem of the power distribution network into a Markov decision process model based on the graph structure, and realizing the rapid load recovery of a micro-grid cluster in the power distribution network fault through cooperative control based on the Markov decision process model. The invention fuses the graph representation learning and Markov decision process with the micro-grid cluster depth to form a closed loop scheme of topology dynamic reconstruction, source network load storage coordination and important load zero power failure, and the invention can be embedded into the existing distribution automation terminal without newly adding hardware, thereby obviously improving the toughness, new energy consumption rate and key load power supply reliability of the distribution network under extreme disasters.
assignees: CHANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: All-weather remote sensing image cloud removing method and system based on lightweight AI
abstract_en: The invention relates to an all-weather remote sensing image cloud removing method and system based on a lightweight AI. Aiming at the problem of optical remote sensing failure caused by cloud and smoke in a disaster site, a satellite-borne multi-mode data dynamic fusion engine is constructed to cooperatively process optical images, microwave SAR, infrared thermodynamic diagrams and meteorological data, a physically-guided lightweight hybrid neural network (CNN-converter double-branch architecture) is innovatively adopted, an countermeasure training mechanism constrained by an atmospheric scattering model is embedded, an edge-cloud cooperative computing architecture is deployed, and disaster site real-time processing is realized through 5 G+space-based relay. The cloud thickness self-adaptive dynamic fusion weight distribution algorithm is firstly provided, the SAR penetration characteristic is utilized to reconstruct a cloud layer shielding region, and the infrared heat source is combined to enhance the surface characteristics. The system realizes real-time cloud removal processing of <2 seconds at the edge equipment, SSIM is improved by more than 40%, and the system supports all-weather situation awareness under extreme environments such as heavy rain/dense smoke and the like, and is remarkably superior to the traditional single-source cloud removal method.

title_en: Dynamic characteristic enhancement method for noise robust speech recognition
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of voice signal processing, in particular to a dynamic characteristic enhancement method for noise robust voice recognition. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-dimensional acoustic context information set, analyzing masking and interference relation between noise dynamic characteristics of disaster sites and voice key characteristics of rescue workers based on the multi-dimensional acoustic context information set to obtain a voice characteristic dynamic damage evaluation parameter set, analyzing competition and masking relation between target voice of rescue workers and interference voice of disaster sites and noise in an acoustic characteristic space based on the multi-dimensional acoustic context information set to obtain a target sound source dynamic separation degree evaluation parameter set, analyzing composite stress intensity of residual noise and voice distortion to final recognition performance based on the voice characteristic dynamic damage evaluation parameter set and combining the target sound source dynamic separation degree evaluation parameter set, executing a dynamic optimized characteristic reconstruction and enhancement instruction, and generating and outputting a target voice enhancement process log. And the reliability of rescue communication is improved.

title_en: Landslide identification method based on earth surface vibration monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and discloses a landslide identification method based on earth surface vibration monitoring, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a stationary-phase background vibration signal of a geological body and reconstructing the stationary-phase background vibration signal into a stationary-phase state vector sequence; and calculating a steady-stage dynamic consistency residual error corresponding to the steady-stage state vector sequence by using the steady-stage dynamic model, and determining an abnormality judgment threshold according to the statistical distribution of the steady-stage dynamic consistency residual error. By establishing a stable dynamic model capable of adaptively evolving and an abnormal judgment threshold, the problem of monitoring model failure caused by slow-change factors such as seasonal environmental changes is effectively solved, so that the situation that the normal evolution is misjudged as a landslide precursor is avoided, and the reliability and the robustness of the system are improved.

title_en: Building system with assembled double-framework structure and capable of growing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembled double-framework structure growth building system, which relates to the technical field of building structures and comprises a double-framework structure system, an assembled enclosure structure and a space adjusting assembly, wherein the assembled enclosure structure system comprises a framework structure, a framework structure and a space adjusting assembly; the invention realizes the high-efficiency construction and flexible growth of the building through the design of the double-framework structure system, the double-framework is formed by overlapping steel structure grid frameworks with different spans in 45-degree horizontal oblique crossing, the factory prefabricated standardized component can greatly shorten the field construction period and adapt to the requirements of staged construction, the rapid construction requirements of emergency scenes such as disaster building and the like, and simultaneously, the space expansion is realized through dismantling or increasing the steel structure grid frameworks, and the detachable assembled enclosure structure and the retractable top cover are matched, so that the space function and layout of the building can be flexibly adjusted along with the change of the use requirements, the problems of fixed functions and difficult expansion and reconstruction of the traditional building are solved, and the life cycle of the building is remarkably prolonged.

title_en: Extreme climate construction site target detection method and system based on antagonism generation network and depth information enhancement
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extreme climate construction site target detection method and system based on an countermeasure generation network and depth information enhancement, and belongs to the technical field of computer vision and artificial intelligence. And generating construction site synthetic data of an extreme weather environment by combining an countermeasure generation network and a deep learning technology, and improving the accuracy of target detection by combining depth information. Firstly, a style migration technology in an countermeasure generation network is adopted to convert a conventional weather construction image into an extreme weather image. Then a four-channel YOLO-Depth model is proposed, depth information is combined with the RGB image, and the spatial perceptibility of target detection is enhanced by Depth estimation. And finally, the three-channel RGB image knowledge is migrated to the four-channel image through an improved migration learning framework, so that the detection precision is improved. The method can effectively improve the target recognition capability of the construction site under extreme weather, and has important significance in the fields of construction safety, post-disaster reconstruction and the like.

title_en: Replaceable eccentric support energy dissipation beam
abstract_en: The utility model provides a replaceable eccentric support energy consumption beam, which comprises an upper flange plate and a corresponding lower flange plate, wherein a web plate is connected between the upper flange plate and the lower flange plate, the length of the web plate is matched with the upper flange plate and the lower flange plate, a plurality of transverse rib plates which are in one-to-one correspondence are respectively arranged on two sides of the web plate, the upper end and the lower end of each transverse rib plate are respectively connected with the upper flange plate and the lower flange plate, and connecting assemblies are respectively arranged at two side ends of the web plate, the upper flange plate and the lower flange plate and are used for detachably connecting with an external frame beam. Conventional eccentric bracing energy-consuming beams are typically welded together and are difficult to replace once damaged. The energy-consumption beam is detachably connected with the frame beam through the connecting component, so that the energy-consumption beam can be conveniently and independently replaced after being damaged, the whole structure is not required to be repaired in a large scale, and the maintenance cost and the post-disaster reconstruction difficulty are greatly reduced.
assignees: SHENZHEN CONSTRUCTION ENGINEERING GROUP CO LTD;SHENZHEN CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP WEST CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;SHENZHEN CONSTRUCTION ENG SOUTH CHINA CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;SHENJIANGONG GUANGZHOU CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;SHENZHEN CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP HEHAI CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic scene three-dimensional reconstruction method and equipment based on hydrogen energy unmanned aerial vehicle stepping investigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic scene three-dimensional reconstruction method and equipment based on hydrogen unmanned aerial vehicle stepping investigation, which comprises the steps of obtaining dense time sequence multi-view image data of a target area through a hydrogen unmanned aerial vehicle platform, carrying out preprocessing of radiation correction and geometric correction, then carrying out optical flow analysis and deformation rate clustering on the preprocessed image, identifying a pseudo-static anchor point and constructing a dynamic reference field, introducing the dynamic reference field as soft constraint in the binding adjustment process, optimizing the pose of a camera to generate a space-time consistent three-dimensional point cloud, mapping the point cloud to a space-time voxel grid, constructing a surface evolution model by utilizing a graph neural network or an anisotropic diffusion algorithm, calculating a surface deformation vector, and realizing continuous and high-precision three-dimensional reconstruction of a disaster scene surface deformation process.

title_en: Intelligent sensing and dynamic grouting reinforcement method and system for tunnel collapse
