abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent sensing and dynamic grouting reinforcement method and system for tunnel collapse, which comprises the following steps of S1, inputting processed collapse image data, acquired engineering parameters and crack indexes into a reinforcement decision prediction model, S2, carrying out multi-task training on grouting reinforcement parameters by the reinforcement decision prediction model, S3, carrying out dynamic adjustment on a multi-task training process, optimizing and adjusting the reinforcement decision prediction model to obtain a trained reinforcement decision prediction model, and S4, inputting target engineering parameters into the trained reinforcement decision prediction model to output a target engineering grouting reinforcement scheme. According to the invention, the three-dimensional reconstruction and the fracture index dynamic calculation are combined, so that the slump volume measurement error is reduced, the fracture identification accuracy is improved, and the disaster assessment precision is remarkably improved. The multi-task learning network is combined with the physical constraint model, so that prediction errors of reinforcement parameters are greatly reduced, the classification accuracy of support types is improved, and the efficiency is remarkably improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning target tracking method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle visual perception and intelligent control, and provides an unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning target tracking method and device, wherein the invention strengthens human body characteristic characterization through a double-path fixed weight attention fusion module, the detection precision of targets with different distances is optimized by combining a multi-scale self-adaptive detection head, and meanwhile, direct mapping of visual detection to flight control is realized by adopting a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm. By reconstructing the target detection framework and deeply integrating the reinforcement learning control strategy, the end-to-end real-time control capability is realized on the premise of ensuring the tracking precision. Along with the wide application of unmanned aerial vehicle technology in fields such as emergent search and rescue, security protection control, but intelligent tracking algorithm that combines deep learning and reinforcement learning wide application in disaster relief, public safety and sports event shooting field, promotes autonomous tracking and intelligent decision-making ability under the complex scene.

title_en: Multi-stage heat supply dynamic scheduling method considering emergency response and mobile heat storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-stage heat supply dynamic scheduling method considering emergency response and mobile heat storage, which comprises the steps of establishing personalized heat utilization images of enterprises in a non-heating season, combining the influence of weather on road traffic, taking optimal heat supply and operation cost as required as targets, establishing a mobile heat storage vehicle optimal scheduling model, in the heating season, if a central heating system is not in an emergency response state, not performing heat load flexible response, taking minimum mobile heat storage operation cost and unit operation cost of each type of heat source as targets, establishing a global optimal operation model, and if the central heating system is in an emergency response state, performing heat load flexible response and heat network disconnection reconstruction, taking minimum mobile heat storage vehicle arrangement cost, flexible response cost and heat network disconnection reconstruction as targets, establishing a first-layer optimal layout model, and establishing a second-layer optimal operation model.
assignees: CHANGZHOU YINGJI POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting telephone extension interconnection system and method based on voice recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire-fighting telephone extension interconnection system and method based on voice recognition, comprising an IP fire-fighting telephone exchange, a plurality of fire-fighting telephone extensions, a voice recognition control server and a system database, wherein the IP fire-fighting telephone exchange is provided with a routing rule, communication between the fire-fighting telephone extension for establishing a call by a primary route and the voice recognition control server is carried out according to the routing rule, communication between the fire-fighting telephone extension for establishing the call by a secondary route and a fire-fighting telephone extension of a target is carried out, the voice recognition control server carries out man-machine voice interaction and recognition according to a set voice guiding flow to generate a control instruction, user intention is captured by utilizing a voice recognition technology, and a call routing flow is reconstructed by utilizing the IP telephone technology, so that the revolutionary crossing from 'manual switching' to 'intelligent direct dialing' is realized on the basis of completely not changing traditional fire-fighting extension hardware, and a long-standing pain point in the fire-fighting emergency communication field is solved.
assignees: SHENZHEN HIGH NEW INVEST SANJIANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Phase optimization method, device, medium and equipment for large gradient deformation zone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and discloses a method, a device, a medium and equipment for optimizing the phase of a large gradient deformation zone, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring SAR data of a region to be monitored and processing the SAR data to generate a differential interference atlas; the method comprises the steps of calculating phase gradients of a differential interference image set in multiple directions to obtain a direction gradient image set, carrying out time sequence stacking and multi-direction fusion to obtain a phase gradient rate image, determining a binary boundary image through threshold segmentation, traversing the differential interference image by utilizing a sliding window, carrying out structural consistency screening on neighborhood pixels in the window according to the binary boundary image to obtain a candidate pixel set, carrying out amplitude consistency detection to determine a homogeneous pixel set which is homogeneous with a center pixel, constructing a complex covariance matrix, decomposing a characteristic value, and obtaining an optimized phase of the center pixel. The method enhances the monitoring stability and accuracy, improves the reliability and the interpretability of the point selection result, and provides an accurate phase reconstruction method for the large gradient deformation region.

title_en: Coal mine water inrush and impact composite dynamic disaster multidimensional prevention and control system selection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional prevention and control system selection method for a coal mine water burst and impact composite dynamic disaster, which belongs to the technical field of coal resource exploitation, wherein when a roof stratum of a coal seam is respectively a high-position soft rock, an anti-impact water isolation key layer and a low-position soft rock, the distance from the roof to the bottom of an aquifer is smaller than 1.3 times of the height of a fracture zone, high-position soft rock grouting is adopted to prevent seepage, when the roof stratum is respectively a high-position soft rock or a hard rock, an anti-impact water isolation key layer and a low-position hard rock, and the distance from the roof to the bottom of the aquifer is larger than 1.3 times of the height of the fracture zone, the low-position hard rock is adopted to break, expand and control the fracture rock burst, when the roof stratum is respectively a high-position soft rock, an anti-impact water isolation key layer and a low-position hard rock, and the distance from the roof to the bottom of the aquifer is smaller than 1.3 times of the height of the fracture zone, double-chain collaborative prevention and control are adopted, and when the water guide zone is completely penetrated, the composite disaster is filled and reconstructed to prevent and control the fracture source. The method provided by the invention realizes the cooperative treatment of water burst and rock burst disasters.

title_en: Goaf three-dimensional subsidence basin reconstruction system based on multi-source remote sensing image fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of remote sensing image processing and geological disaster monitoring, in particular to a goaf three-dimensional subsidence basin reconstruction system fused by multi-source remote sensing images, which comprises a heterogeneous data preprocessing module, a data fusion module based on differential geometry, a three-dimensional subsidence basin reconstruction module, a subsidence dynamic monitoring module and a virtual reality interaction module, wherein the system creatively introduces differential geometry theory to solve the heterogeneous fusion problem of high-resolution optical satellite images, SAR satellite images and airborne remote sensing Lidar point cloud data, mapping multi-source data to a unified feature space through manifold learning, calculating self-adaptive fusion weights through curvature analysis, constructing a multi-scale feature correlation matrix based on geodesic distances, generating a high-precision fusion image, carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction by combining subsidence basin geological parameters and a physical constraint method, ensuring that a reconstruction result accords with an actual subsidence physical rule, realizing dynamic monitoring and virtual reality interaction of a subsidence process, and supporting parameter adjustment and model optimization.
assignees: THE FIFTH GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF JIANGSU GEOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Geographic entity automatic generation method and system based on geographic information element data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geographic information systems, in particular to a geographic entity automatic generation method and a geographic entity automatic generation system based on geographic information element data, comprising the following steps: collecting geographic information element data, recording topography and ground feature information, analyzing geographic position and attribute data of the geographic information element data, using nodes to represent geographic information elements, and using edge connection to represent spatial connection among the elements to obtain a spatial connection structure diagram. According to the invention, the space geometrical relationship of the data layout is improved by reconstructing the data structure, the logic and the functionality of the whole data set are improved, the relevance between the attribute information and the geographic entity can be more accurately analyzed when the geographic entity is automatically processed through the optimization of the space and the logic, a geographic logic relationship model is constructed, the application capability of a geographic information system in the fields of urban planning, environment monitoring, disaster management and the like is enhanced, and the manual errors and the operation cost are greatly reduced.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LANTU GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building fire-fighting reconstruction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for building fire control reconstruction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining building information corresponding to a building to be modified, determining an index set and a weight set for fire fighting capacity evaluation corresponding to the building to be modified based on the building type, wherein the weight set comprises weight coefficients corresponding to all indexes in the index set, determining fire risks corresponding to the building to be modified and risk evaluation values corresponding to the fire risks based on the index set and the weight set, determining a fire fighting modification strategy corresponding to the building to be modified based on the fire risks and the risk evaluation values, and performing fire fighting modification on the building to be modified based on the fire fighting modification strategy if the overall fire fighting safety performance of the building under the fire fighting modification strategy passes through the examination of a preset fire fighting safety algorithm. The application can improve the quality and safety of fire control reconstruction, effectively reduce the risk of fire control after reconstruction and ensure the safety of personnel and property in the building.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TESTING CENTER OF CONSTRUCTION QUALITY & SAFETY CO LTD;GUANGZHOU INST OF BUILDING SCIENCE GROUP CO LTD;GUANGZHOU MUNICIPAL ENG TESTING CO LTD

title_en: Bridge typhoon monitoring and early warning method for fusion of meteorological data and bridge site in-situ data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge structure health monitoring and bridge wind engineering, and discloses a bridge typhoon monitoring and early warning method for fusing meteorological data and bridge site in-situ data, which comprises the following steps of reading atmospheric data in a space meteorological database; drawing geographical information such as a continental boundary, a river and the like, reading longitude and latitude of a bridge position, reconstructing potential height and wind field space distribution, extracting potential height, wind speed and wind direction change of the bridge position, extracting bridge structure health monitoring data including wind speed and wind direction and power response, drawing a rose diagram according to the wind speed and wind direction data, calculating frequency of the power response, predicting and evaluating typhoon influence according to meteorological data and bridge site in-situ data, and providing early warning indexes and catastrophe indexes of disasters typhoons. The system overcomes the defect that the traditional healthy system only depends on the bridge site structure and cannot effectively predict typhoon disasters, and has important significance for typhoon early warning and typhoon disaster forecasting of bridge management departments.

title_en: Building fire safety control method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a building fire safety control method based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of constructing a sensor-middle station-model bidirectional mapping, reconstructing a dynamic scene by adopting a nerve radiation field technology, constructing a building full-element dynamic digital mirror image based on federal migration learning fusion cross-domain desensitization data, positioning a fire source in real time and predicting a flame spreading track through a spectrum analysis algorithm, operating fire simulation by linking the full-element dynamic digital mirror image, optimizing a fire resource scheduling path through a multi-target particle swarm optimization algorithm, generating a multi-target rescue scheme, utilizing an asynchronous blockchain to store a fire prevention decision instruction, plotting rescue key areas and planning an optimal evacuation route, converging federal node data quantization data contribution degree, reproducing historical fire conditions and deducing a new scene for iterative optimization. The application solves the problems of data perception fragmentation, difficult cross-domain fusion, fire prediction lag, underscience in resource scheduling, slow iteration of a drilling scheme and the like in the traditional management and control.

title_en: High-order geological disaster chain monitoring node deployment method based on wireless ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless ad hoc network-based high-level geological disaster chain monitoring node deployment method, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning and comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring interference characteristics through a time-frequency observation layer triggered by an earthquake and establishing a time base line; the method comprises the steps of S2, identifying a cross-channel coupling relation according to an energy spectrum and a drift baseline, determining a sensitive node, S3, reconstructing a convergent path by using a shadow link to replace a distortion channel, S4, constructing a time stack, restraining route oscillation by a hysteresis gate, S5, generating a time-varying virtual impedance route according to the time stack to realize peak-shifting stable forwarding, S6, completing loop breaking control of residual crosstalk through reverse phase traction and a super-surface antenna, and finally enabling a network to keep long-term stable operation. The invention realizes stable convergence and closed-loop regulation of the ad hoc network through interference feature extraction, path reconstruction, time stack hysteresis vibration suppression, virtual impedance peak-shifting forwarding and reverse phase loop breaking disturbance control.

title_en: Distribution network dynamic partition duplicate optimization method considering uncertainty resource support under typhoon extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic partitioning duplicate supply optimization method of a distribution network considering uncertain resource support under typhoon extreme disasters, belongs to the technical field of partitioning duplicate supply of the distribution network, acquires dynamic fault probability under typhoon conditions by constructing a time-varying fault model of an electric element, generates a representative fault scene by using Latin hypercube sampling and spectral clustering methods, evaluates the output characteristics and damage degree of a distributed power supply such as photovoltaic wind power energy storage and the like under typhoon conditions, dynamically divides a region capable of centralizing duplicate supply and a region incapable of centralizing duplicate supply by using a depth-first search algorithm, respectively constructs a multi-objective optimization model of fault reconstruction and island duplicate supply aiming at different regions, establishes a dynamic feedback adjustment mechanism based on a load recovery rate, realizes dynamic power supply recovery of multi-source coordination in the whole process of typhoon disasters, and solves the technical problems of lack of dynamic self-adaption capability and multi-source coordination scheduling mechanism of the power distribution network duplicate supply method under typhoon disasters.

title_en: Physical model device capable of simulating multi-working-condition disaster response of roadbed and side slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a physical model device capable of simulating multi-station disaster response of a roadbed and a side slope, which is characterized by comprising a model box body, a loading assembly, a rainfall assembly and a coordination control assembly, wherein the model box body comprises a rigid frame and a transparent panel, a detachable baffle is arranged in the model box body and is used for separating a side slope simulation area and a roadbed simulation area in the same box body, the loading assembly comprises a vertical loading module and a horizontal loading module, the seepage assembly comprises seepage water tanks arranged on the left side, the right side and the rear side of the model box body and is used for realizing control of seepage water boundaries and seepage flow on the single side, the double side or the three sides, the rainfall assembly comprises a rainfall nozzle and is used for simulating rainfall working conditions with different intensities and durations, and the coordination control assembly is electrically connected with the loading assembly, the seepage assembly and the rainfall assembly and performs data interaction with an external computer. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of high spatial reconstruction and functional integration level, fine control and synchronous coupling of multi-disaster working conditions, high reliability of test results and the like.

title_en: Robot group detection scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a machine crowd detection scheduling method and system, and relates to disaster monitoring, wherein scene reconstruction is carried out according to collected real-time sensing information, a three-dimensional digital model of a disaster scene is generated, a discrete monitoring grid based on sampling points is established, a disaster risk assessment model is established on the discrete monitoring points, risk values of all monitoring points are calculated according to actual measurement data aiming at gas and fire to form a discrete risk distribution map, a spatial variation trend of the risk is calculated by adopting a neighboring point difference method, a directional gradient is calculated through the risk difference value and the distance of adjacent monitoring points, when the risk of any two disasters is increased simultaneously, the potential coupling risk point is marked, a transmission path of the risk is identified based on connectivity analysis of a monitoring network, and the machine crowd is scheduled by adopting a risk avoidance path planning algorithm. According to the application, the spatial distribution and evolution trend of the disaster field are accurately reconstructed through local gradient estimation under the sparse sampling condition.

title_en: Fire escape device using fire extinguisher
abstract_ko:
본 발명이 해결하고자 하는 과제는 화재 발생 시 효율적인 대피를 가능하게 하는 소화전을 이용한 화재대피용 방염기구를 제공하는 것에 그 목적이 있다. 
상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위하여 다음과 같은 해결 수단을 제시한다. 본 발명에서는 화재경보기와 램프 또는 소방에 필요한 장비가 포함되어 있는 소화전에 있어서, 내부에 공간이 성형되어 있고 건축물의 벽면에 설치되는 케이스부와 상기 케이스부의 전면에 위치하고 도어에 의해 개폐되며, 상기 케이스부로부터 분리되도록 성형된 개구부와 상기 개구부가 상기 케이스부와 결합되거나 분리될 수 있도록 상기 개구부와 상기 케이스부의 연결부위에 형성된 결합부와 상기 개구부의 일부에 위치하고 개구부의 안쪽 또는 바깥쪽에서 반대편을 볼 수 있도록 성형된 투명창부와 상기 케이스부 내부에 위치하고 방염이 가능한 방염천 직물로 구성되되, 
방염천 직물의 한쪽 면과 반대편 쪽의 면을 결합되고 결합이후 결합부위 양쪽으로 구멍이 성형되거나 결합부위 없이 방염천 양쪽으로 구멍이 성형되도록 제작되고, 상기 구멍이 형성된 방염천 양쪽 면의 구멍 중 한쪽 면 구멍의 둘레 크기가 반대 쪽 구멍의 둘레 보다 크게 형성되며, 상기 구멍이 형성된 방염천의 양쪽 구멍 가운데 둘레 크기가 작게 성형된 한쪽 면의 방염천 둘레 끝단이 상기 개구부의 내부 끝단에 결합되도록 성형된 방염천부와 상기 방염천의 전체 면이 접히거나 말려서 부피가 압축되고, 압축된 부피의 방염천이 상기 개구부의 일부분에 고정될 수 있도록 설치된 내부 고정부로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 소화전을 이용한 화재대피용 방염기구를 제시한다. 
본 발명에 의하면 소화전의 구성품을 이용하여 건물에서 발생한 화재로부터 건물 내에 있는 사람이나 동물이 신속하게 자신의 몸을 방어하고 이를 이용하여 아파트, 빌딩 등 높은 건물에 화재 발생 시 신속하고 안전한 대피를 가능하게 한다. 소화전과 결합되어 있는 개구부를 방패로 이용하고 소화전 내에 있는 방염천을 펼쳐서 화재 대피시 화염으로부터 화상을 입는 것을 예방할 수 있게 된다. 본 발명품을 이용할 경우 화재현장에서 주민 또는 생존자를 화재 열기로부터 보호할 뿐만 아니라, 화재 대응 시간을 단축하여 화재 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Semiconductor PKG internal 3D defect reconstruction system based on multiple OCT images
title_ko: 다중 oct 이미지 기반 반도체 pkg 내부 3d 결함 재구성 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 주차장 상황을 모니터링 하는 "CCD 카메라와 이동통신망을 이용한 주차장 모니터링 시스템 및 그 제어방법"에 관한 것으로, 특히, 주차장에 설치되며, CCD 카메라를 통해 주차장 상황을 촬영하여 모니터링하고, 화재를 감지하고, 관리자와의 통화를 수행하며, 주차장 영상과 주차장상황정보(화재 발생 정보, 응급 호출 정보)를 인터넷망을 통해 중앙관제시스템으로 전송하는 주차장시스템; 상기 하나 이상의 주차장시스템이 인터넷망을 통해 접속되고, 하나 이상의 이동통신단말기가 이동통신망을 통해 접속되어, 첫째, 상기 주차장시스템에서 전송하는 주차장 영상 및 주차장상황정보를 수신하여 주차장 상황을 모니터링하고, 둘째, 주차장 영상 등을 해당 이동통신단말기로 전송하는 중앙관제시스템; 및, 이동통신망을 통해 상기 중앙관제시스템에 접속하여 주차장 상황을 모니터링 하는 이동통신단말기;를 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 CCD 카메라와 이동통신망을 이용한 주차장 모니터링 시스템 및 그 제어방법이다.

title_en: Water network toughness assessment method based on network topology structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water network toughness assessment method based on a network topology structure, which comprises the steps of constructing the water network topology structure based on a complex network theory, abstracting reservoirs, lakes and the like into nodes, abstracting channels, channels and the like into edges to form an undirected network, introducing information entropy to improve the importance index of the traditional nodes, comprehensively assessing by combining a Weighted Rank Sum (WRSR) method, determining index weights by using a CRITIC method, and constructing a toughness assessment formula by taking network efficiency and a maximum connected subgraph as indexes and combining the weights. The method and the system integrate adjacent node association information through information entropy to realize the transition of an index system from isolation to system evaluation, integrate multidimensional indexes, avoid single index unilaterality, consider local connection and global roles of nodes, adapt different water networks and are movable. In practical application, toughness change under energy water network disasters and aging scenes is used for guiding the reconstruction engineering to supplement short plates preferentially, so that the key node identification precision is improved, and the water network stability and risk resistance are improved.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER;WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER PLANNING AND DESIGN GENERAL INST MWR

title_en: Dynamic self-organizing network lamp ranging method and system based on PLC-IoT
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic self-organizing network lamp ranging method and system based on PLC-IoT, and relates to the technical field of intelligent city internet of things. The method and the system improve the stability of the ranging precision in a complex scene by sensing the transmission characteristic of the power line and dynamically compensating the environmental interference, realize the automatic identification and reconstruction of the network topology by means of the distributed protocol and collaborative verification, adapt to the large-scale node change without manual intervention, ensure the long-term reliable operation of the system by combining the layered calibration and the predictive maintenance mechanism, and finally provide accurate, flexible and stable positioning support for core applications such as intelligent management and control, emergency response and the like of the smart city.
assignees: YUNFU MINGLIANG STREET LAMP MAN CO LTD

title_en: Bionic rescue robot system with vision system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bionic multisection centipede type robot system with self-reconstruction capability for disaster relief. The system consists of an environment sensing module, a multi-mode decision module, a reconstruction execution module and a communication-energy management module. The hardware adopts a raspberry 4 B+raspberry Pico distributed architecture, realizes the rapid separation/recombination of multiple units through a magnetic butt joint device, completes the semantic segmentation and obstacle detection of disaster areas through DeepLabV & gt3 & MobileNetV & lt 3 & gt, extracts disaster time sequence characteristics through LSTM, and drives gait and reconstruction actions through PPO+DRL strategies. The system can complete autonomous obstacle surmounting, life body searching and task level reorganization in narrow space, broken wall and other extreme scenes. The invention also provides a complete control method and an embodiment, and the 'perception-decision-execution-feedback' closed loop can be realized without external manual intervention, so that the rescue response efficiency and the extreme environment adaptability of the robot are obviously improved.

title_en: Network security detection method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security detection method and system based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. The device comprises the following steps of streaming data access and processing according to standardization, real-time feature extraction and vectorization, online anomaly detection and scoring, synchronous interpretability analysis, attack chain reconstruction and evaluation of influence and automation response and feedback. The system shortens the delay of data from acquisition to abnormal early warning to a second level through streaming data access and lightweight integrated AI model, can effectively cope with scenes needing real-time response such as zero-day vulnerability exploitation, APT attack and the like, avoids loss caused by attack hysteresis, realizes synchronous triggering of abnormal detection and interpretability analysis, generates a visual report containing characteristic contribution degree and decision rules through an optimized algorithm and a safety rule base, shortens the time of positioning the attack root by a safety team from the small time level to the minute level, and greatly improves emergency response efficiency.
assignees: HEBEI NETWORK SECURITY AND INFORMATION TECH CENTER

title_en: Big data security management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a big data security management system, which aims at the problems of source end unreliability, link leakage, centralized storage single point, rough authorization, disposal lag and the like, and provides a security management system for covering a full life cycle. The system comprises acquisition security, transmission encryption, storage security, access control, threat detection, situation awareness, tracing and emergency response modules. The method comprises the steps of generating a session basis through multi-factor authentication, deriving a dynamic key according to time slices and encrypting data slices by slices, adopting distributed storage and uplink metadata to realize non-falsifiability, using attributes as cores to implement fine-grained authorization, utilizing a sequence model linkage knowledge graph to identify abnormality and calculate a risk index, and automatically reconstructing a log chain and executing isolation, alarm or recording when the threshold is exceeded. The system realizes trusted acquisition, confidential transmission, traceable storage, fine authorization and automatic treatment, and remarkably improves safety and compliance.
assignees: QINGYI SHUKE BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-agent deep reinforcement learning method considering user-power distribution network cooperation under topology reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning method considering user-power distribution network cooperation under topology reconstruction, wherein independent interactive user agents are modeled through a multi-agent reinforcement learning MADDPG algorithm, users independently make decisions according to self states and interact with a power distribution network, and the power distribution network performs topology reconstruction. The virtual tide method is adopted to keep the radial operation of the power distribution network, and the power and voltage balance of the power distribution network under the condition of extreme disasters is considered, so that a novel method for the interactive operation of independent users and the power distribution network is provided. According to the invention, the actual situations that the extreme events with high influence and low probability frequently occur and the distributed photovoltaic permeability is improved are considered, and the power supply reliability and safety of the power distribution network under extreme disasters are ensured and the privacy of the user is protected through independent user autonomous scheduling and reconstruction of the topology of the power distribution network.

title_en: Disaster recovery environment determining method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining disaster recovery environments, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an object operation set from a production environment, wherein the object operation set comprises operation record data which are respectively matched with a plurality of object operation requests, processing the object operation set based on at least one reference container object in a current disaster recovery environment to obtain task playback results which are respectively used for executing task playback on the plurality of object operation requests, determining environment description parameters which are respectively matched with the current disaster recovery environment according to the task playback results of the plurality of object operation requests, wherein the environment description parameters are used for indicating playback performance of the current disaster recovery environment, and determining the current disaster recovery environment as a target disaster recovery environment when the environment description parameters indicate that the current disaster recovery environment meets target conditions. The invention solves the technical problem of inaccurate configuration of disaster recovery environment parameters.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery method, device, equipment, medium and product based on instance playback
abstract_en: The application provides a disaster recovery method, a device, electronic equipment, a computer storage medium and a computer program product based on instance playback, wherein the method is applied to the technical field of computers and comprises the following steps of carrying out changing operation on service instances in a main cluster according to an instance changing request when the instance changing request is received; and after the change operation is finished, storing an operation record of the change operation in a database, extracting unrereeled target operation records from the database at intervals of preset time intervals, carrying out operation playback on backup service instances in a backup cluster according to the target operation records to obtain a target backup cluster, and switching calling routes to the target backup cluster when the main cluster fails.
assignees: RES INST CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS CORP;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mountain land low-temperature refined monitoring prediction method and system based on satellite-ground fusion and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain land low-temperature refined monitoring prediction method and a mountain land low-temperature refined monitoring prediction system based on satellite-ground fusion and deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of ecological meteorological monitoring and agricultural disaster prevention and reduction. The method aims at solving the problems of insufficient coverage of the mountain low-temperature monitoring space, neglect of local factors, coarse prediction resolution and poor terrain suitability in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of multi-source data acquisition, acquisition of high-density weather station, multi-source satellite and weather pattern data, space-time characteristic analysis, correlation analysis and screening of key variables, correlation of weather types and star-earth fusion air temperature reconstruction, generation of fine monitoring data based on a CNN-ANN deep learning framework, short-term prediction modeling, construction of a prediction model by combining an LSTM with a topographic attention mechanism and two-dimensional reliability verification. The method can improve the mountain low-temperature monitoring precision and forecast the terrain suitability, provides accurate support for low-temperature disaster prevention and reduction of mountain cash crops, and has remarkable practical value.
assignees: ZHEJIANG CLIMATE CENTER ZHEJIANG ECOLOGICAL REMOTE SENSING CENTER ZHEJIANG AGRICULTURAL METEOROLOGIC

title_en: Cooperative power restoration scheduling method and device for power distribution system in typhoon disaster scene
abstract_en: The application discloses a cooperative power restoration scheduling method and a device of a power distribution system in a typhoon disaster scene, which relate to the technical field of power grid operation and are characterized in that by fusing a high-precision typhoon disaster model, the improved beluga optimization algorithm is applied to dynamic island division, so that the reconstruction time of the power distribution system can be greatly shortened, and the minute-level decision requirement for post-disaster power restoration is met. The method comprises the steps of constructing a device fault probability model in a typhoon disaster scene in advance, carrying out island division on a power distribution system according to the device fault probability model in the typhoon disaster scene to obtain islands meeting first constraint conditions in the power distribution system, constructing a fault re-electricity optimization model on the basis of the islands obtained by division in the power distribution system, and solving the fault re-electricity optimization model by utilizing an improved white whale optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal power supply path suitable for collaborative re-electricity scheduling in the typhoon disaster scene.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ecological environment real-time monitoring method based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological environment real-time monitoring method based on the technology of the Internet of things, which comprises the following steps: and acquiring monitoring strategies and task allocation data from the central command center through the layered command architecture, determining an intelligent device selection scheme and acquiring optimal device configuration parameters. And deploying sensor network nodes, predicting pollution diffusion trend by using a pollution diffusion model, and performing verification analysis on abnormal data. When the abnormal event feature exceeds the threshold value, triggering an emergency response linkage flow, and starting a dense monitoring mode. And transmitting the health state data of the equipment through the communication link of the Internet of things, performing fault diagnosis and parameter adjustment, optimizing the transmission bandwidth and realizing self-adaptive speed limiting control. And finally, reconstructing a network topology structure through a network topology self-adaptive adjustment algorithm, and realizing real-time continuous coverage monitoring of the ecological environment. The invention remarkably improves the real-time performance, accuracy and system stability of environment monitoring through dynamic adjustment and intelligent optimization, and is suitable for complex and changeable environment monitoring scenes.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Intelligent injury detection and classification rescue evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue evaluation, and discloses a rescue evaluation system for intelligent flaw detection classification. The system comprises a data acquisition unit, a feature reconstruction unit, a core feature extraction unit and a dynamic evaluation unit. The system comprises a data acquisition unit, a characteristic reconstruction unit, a core characteristic extraction unit, a dynamic evaluation unit and a processing unit, wherein the data acquisition unit acquires multi-source heterogeneous data of a rescue scene, the multi-dimensional data set of the wounded is formed through space-time alignment, the data cover vital signs, wounded images, environmental parameters and rescue resource states of the wounded, the characteristic reconstruction unit fills the dynamic tensor of the data set to generate a standardized characteristic tensor and an abnormal characteristic identification set, the core characteristic extraction unit combines a wounded classification knowledge base to construct a wounded characteristic matrix, a dimension association graph is determined, a wounded evolution map is generated, and the dynamic evaluation unit extracts characteristic vectors, calculates wounded dimension entropy and screens core characteristic sequences to generate a wounded priority classification scheme. The system can integrate multi-source information, realize dynamic evaluation and is suitable for rescue evaluation of various disaster accident sites.
assignees: The 8th Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: DEWMA-IForest-based flight data anomaly detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aviation safety and data processing, in particular to a DEWMA-IForest-based flight data anomaly detection method, which comprises the following steps of preprocessing original flight data; initializing a smoothing coefficient and a sliding window size parameter, calculating an arithmetic average value and a standard deviation by taking data in the sliding window as statistical samples, respectively serving as a DEWMA statistic initial value and a control limit calculation reference value, setting an initial control limit range, calculating DEWMA statistic and standard deviation of data to be tested, dynamically updating the control limit range, and calculating DEWMA fitting reconstruction data and control limit. The invention improves small-amplitude trend abnormal sensitivity by dynamically controlling and adapting the time variability of QAR data, fuses and avoids high-dimensional data dimension disasters by multiple algorithms, does not need a large amount of tagged data, can explain abnormal criteria and provides scientific basis for aircraft operation monitoring and intelligent maintenance decision.

title_en: Building fire control feedwater supercharging system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building fire-fighting water supply pressurization system, which comprises a base, wherein two groups of water storage tanks with water pumps are arranged on the base, one group of water storage tanks are connected with a living water supply external network interface of the fire-fighting water tank, the other group of water storage tanks are connected with a fire-fighting water supply network interface of the fire-fighting water tank, a control cabinet is arranged between the water storage tanks, a fire-fighting control module is arranged in the control cabinet, one side of the control cabinet is provided with a filtering mechanism, the filtering mechanism comprises a filtering tank, two groups of filters are arranged in the filtering tank, the front sides of the two groups of filters are connected with an external water source through a three-way joint, the rear sides of the two groups of filters are respectively connected with the two groups of water storage tanks through connecting pipelines, reversing pipelines are arranged between the connecting pipelines, and control valves are arranged on the connecting pipelines and the reversing pipelines. When the fire-fighting water supply system is in reconstruction construction, the fire-fighting water supply system can supply water to the fire-fighting water tank stably, and has good reliability.
assignees: STATE GRID XINYUAN COMPANY LTD;JILIN JIAOHE PUMPED STORAGE CO LTD

title_en: Cloud removal method and system based on SAR (synthetic aperture radar) assistance for optical remote sensing image, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: According to the method, SAR data are mapped to an optical image domain by using a conditional diffusion model to generate a pseudo-optical image with consistent spatial spectrum, fusion distortion caused by SAR imaging mechanism difference in the traditional method is overcome, secondly, a cloud pollution area and a cloud-free area are dynamically distinguished by introducing a Fmask cloud mask fine cloud area detection mechanism and combining an anti-training strategy, the problem of error correction of the cloud-free area in the reconstruction process of the traditional method is effectively solved, in addition, a multi-source integrated sample dataset is built in stages, and a training paradigm of multi-index joint optimization such as PSNR, SSIM and the like is adopted, so that texture detail recovery and spectrum fidelity of a thick cloud coverage area are realized in a complex scene. In downstream application tasks such as land utilization classification, disaster dynamic monitoring and the like, the visual quality and quantitative index of the cloud removal result have good effects, and reliable technical support is provided for high-precision reconstruction of multi-cloud-area remote sensing information.

title_en: Automatic closing robot control system for gas cylinder leakage at dangerous chemical accident scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dangerous chemical emergency robot control, in particular to a dangerous chemical accident scene gas cylinder leakage automatic closing robot control system, which comprises an environment data acquisition module, a physical equipment device and a control module, wherein the environment data acquisition module acquires multi-mode sensor data in real time and adopts a timestamp synchronization algorithm for alignment; the system comprises a state reconstruction module, a dynamic risk assessment module, a self-adaptive exploration decision module, a control output module and a system coordination engine, wherein the state reconstruction module reconstructs a three-dimensional environment map through a deep convolutional neural network and a point cloud segmentation algorithm, the dynamic risk assessment module integrates a Bayesian inference network to predict risks and output a dynamic risk field map, the self-adaptive exploration decision module adopts a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework and a risk constraint strategy to adjust exploration and utilization balance, the control output module converts a decision action sequence into a robot joint track, and the system coordination engine aggregates all modules to output coordinated operation through a federal learning framework. The system realizes global self-adaptive decision through multi-module co-evolution, effectively balances exploration and utilization, and improves the reliability and efficiency of autonomous closing control.

title_en: Three-dimensional atmospheric live field fusion product generation method, device and equipment based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for generating a three-dimensional atmospheric live field fusion product based on machine learning. According to the invention, the hundred-meter resolution reconstruction of three-dimensional meteorological elements is realized by fusing the space texture generation capability of GAN with the long-distance dependent modeling of a transducer, and the MLP correction model based on the sounding reference eliminates the systematic errors of different observation systems. The method breaks through the three-dimensional space grid point visualization of multiple meteorological elements such as temperature, humidity, wind field, radar reflectivity factors and the like, achieves comprehensive deployment and deep fusion with the existing business system, remarkably improves the visualization capability of meteorological data, mainly expands emerging application scenes such as disaster prevention, disaster reduction, low-altitude economy and the like, deeply digs the value potential of the meteorological data in the fields of industrial energization, disaster early warning and the like, and continuously injects innovative kinetic energy into the high-quality development of new-quality productive energized meteorological industry.

title_en: Grooving equipment for fire extinguishing system reconstruction engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses slotting equipment for fire control system reconstruction engineering, which relates to the technical field of fire control slotting and solves the technical problems of lower construction efficiency and slotting precision in the prior technical scheme, and the slotting equipment comprises a main machine box, wherein a guide structure is fixedly arranged on the lower wall surface of the main machine box, a swinging frame is fixedly arranged on the main machine box, a slotting structure is rotatably arranged on the swinging frame, and a sound insulation and discharge structure is arranged on the slotting structure; by means of the guide structure and the swing structure, accurate grooving operation can be achieved, accuracy of pattern cutting and depth adjustment in construction is improved, and technical and standard requirements of fire-fighting system transformation are met.
assignees: DALIAN SHENGYUAN FIRE FIGHTING ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for quickly reconstructing power distribution network after disaster based on radial constraint
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the post-disaster reconstruction field of a power distribution network, and discloses a post-disaster rapid reconstruction method, a system, equipment and a medium of the power distribution network based on radial constraint, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining post-disaster power distribution network data and constructing a post-disaster reconstruction model; the method comprises the steps of establishing an optimization objective function and a plurality of constraint conditions based on a post-disaster reconstruction model, establishing a mixed integer linear programming model based on the optimization objective function and the plurality of constraint conditions, judging whether the set constraint conditions are met by combining a particle swarm optimization algorithm, solving the optimization problem of the mixed integer linear programming model to obtain a final decision result, obtaining a switch operation sequence based on the decision result, calculating a recovery result of each power supply unit, obtaining a reconstruction decision scheme of the post-disaster power distribution network, improving reconstruction calculation efficiency and engineering applicability, and realizing quick recovery of key loads and stable operation of the post-disaster power grid.

title_en: Ship smoke monitoring system based on wind direction and speed retrospective tracking
title_ko: 풍향풍속 역추적 기반 선박 매연 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 일 실시 예에 따라, 미세먼지 모니터링 서버는, 통신 모듈 및 통신 모듈과 작동적으로 연결된 프로세서를 포함하고, 프로세서는, 통신 모듈을 통해, 항구에 대응되는 적어도 하나의 미세먼지 측정 장치로부터 미세먼지 데이터 및 바람 정보를 획득하고, 통신 모듈을 통해, 적어도 하나의 선박으로부터 선박 정보를 획득하고, 미세먼지 데이터에 포함된 복수의 성분들 중 적어도 하나의 성분의 수치가 설정된 임계치를 넘는 경우, 항구에서 임계치가 넘는 시점으로부터 설정된 시간 이전까지 측정된 바람 정보에 기반하여 미세먼지의 경로를 추정하고, 추정된 경로 및 선박 정보를 기반으로, 추정된 경로에 포함된 지점에 대응되는 시점에 지점과 특정 거리 내이며, 추정된 경로의 일부 영역에 대응되는 시간 대에 일부 영역의 방향과 특정 각도 내에 위치하는 선박을 확인하고, 적어도 하나의 미세먼지 측정 장치와 확인된 선박의 거리, 추정된 경로와 확인된 선박의 거리, 확인된 선박과 설정된 거리 내에 위치한 다른 선박의 개수 및 확인된 선박에서 발생되는 것으로 추정되는 미세먼지의 성분 별 수치를 포함하는 데이터 셋을 생성하고, 통신 모듈을 통해, 데이터 셋 중 적어도 일부가 외부 장치에 의해 표시되도록 외부 장치에 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: Day runoff prediction method based on adaptive signal decomposition and deep learning fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a daily runoff prediction method based on self-adaptive signal decomposition and deep learning fusion, which comprises the steps of obtaining daily runoff sequence data of a historical period, adopting ICEEMDAN algorithm to decompose a standardized runoff sequence into a plurality of eigenvalue function components and 1 residual component, calculating the arrangement entropy of each IMF component and screening noise dominant components, adopting wavelet hard threshold noise reduction processing on the screened noise dominant components, carrying out superposition reconstruction on the noise dominant components after noise reduction, effective characteristic components and residual components, constructing ICEEMDAN-CNN-LSTM mixed prediction model, constructing a sample set, training a mixed prediction model, and predicting based on the daily runoff prediction model. The method and the system remarkably improve the prediction precision of the non-stationary runoff sequence, reduce the dependence on hydrologic observation conditions, have strong model adaptability and low application threshold, and can be widely popularized to the scenes of flood control, disaster reduction, water resource optimization configuration and the like.

title_en: Method for acquiring intra-day scheduling strategy of comprehensive energy urea chemical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for acquiring a daily scheduling strategy of a comprehensive energy urea chemical system, which belongs to the technical field of new energy control, wherein a daily scheduling model corresponding to each element is built by using state parameters of each device in the comprehensive energy urea chemical system, and the objective function is the minimization of the daily operation cost of the system. On the premise of meeting the stable operation of the electricity-heat-hydrogen-comprehensive energy urea chemical system, the daily operation cost is minimized. And reconstructing the intra-day scheduling model into a Markov decision process and solving to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme. By the design, the state and decision variable space can be reduced, the problem of dimension disaster is avoided, the solving efficiency is remarkably improved, and the scheduling efficiency and stability of the system are further improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Multi-source fusion-perceived space-world integrated geological disaster identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a multisource fusion-perceived space-earth integrated geological disaster identification method and system. The method comprises the steps of acquiring satellite images of a target area acquired by a static orbit satellite, a synthetic aperture radar satellite and a polar orbit satellite in real time, performing time interpolation and spatial super-resolution reconstruction on multi-source heterogeneous satellite image data to obtain three types of satellite images with consistent space and time and uniform resolution, synchronously inputting the three types of satellite images into a pre-trained coarse-granularity disaster recognition model to obtain a macroscopic probability map reflecting geological disaster risks, identifying a local area with high risk, then mutually matching with ground monitoring equipment, an unmanned plane and the like to obtain a complete high-resolution image, and finally inputting the high-resolution image into a pre-trained fine-granularity disaster recognition model to obtain a geological disaster recognition result. The invention solves the problems of the existing geological disaster monitoring scheme in real-time and accurate aspects.
assignees: ANHUI MINGSHENG HENGZHUO TECH CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Mining intelligent voice and video interactive communication method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of communication, discloses a mining intelligent voice and video interactive communication method and system, and aims to solve the problems of poor quality of audio and video signals, low bandwidth utilization rate, lack of semantic understanding and interaction lag in a complex mine environment. The method comprises the steps of collecting original signals through an intrinsic safety type audio and video terminal, carrying out voice enhancement by adopting sound source azimuth estimation and a depth complex network, reconstructing a high dynamic range video based on a physical imaging model, realizing audio and video semantic alignment and key event extraction by utilizing a light space-time feature fusion network, dynamically distributing bandwidth by combining event confidence and channel state, transmitting high/common priority data in a grading manner, and realizing ground and underground real-time communication through a bidirectional interaction channel. The application obviously improves the signal usability, the bandwidth efficiency and the emergency response capability, and ensures high-stability, low-delay and high-fidelity communication.

title_en: Axial chain type rock burst pregnancy disaster geological identification method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological identification, in particular to an axial chained rock burst pregnant disaster geological identification method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring microseismic monitoring data in the process of deep buried hard rock tunnel excavation; the method comprises the steps of identifying an axial chain rock explosion and pregnancy disaster area according to microseismic monitoring data to obtain a pregnancy disaster area range, calculating normal vectors of fracture surfaces according to the pregnancy disaster area range and the microseismic monitoring data, establishing a parameter system and constraint conditions required by ST-DBSCAN clustering according to the normal vectors of the fracture surfaces and the microseismic monitoring data, carrying out ST-DBSCAN clustering processing according to the required parameter system and constraint conditions to obtain microseismic event clusters reflecting potential rock mass structural surfaces, and carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction processing on a rock mass structural network according to the microseismic event clusters to obtain a three-dimensional geometric model of reconstructed axial chain rock explosion and pregnancy disaster geology.

title_en: Cross-layer security event real-time association and attack path tracing method, system and equipment based on unified entity map
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-layer security event real-time association and attack path tracing method, system and equipment based on a unified entity map, wherein the method comprises the following steps of firstly, constructing and dynamically maintaining the unified entity map; the method comprises the steps of carrying out real-time event association based on graph calculation, carrying out automatic tracing on a bidirectional attack path, breaking a data island through unified entity graphs and cross-layer entity alignment fusion, forming a global entity view covering multiple layers, greatly improving the integrity and accuracy of attack cognition, realizing real-time processing of data access, graph update and event association by means of a streaming architecture, capturing cross-layer attack signs in time, obviously shortening average detection and response time, automatically reconstructing an attack chain through an automatic bidirectional tracing mechanism, analyzing potential transverse moving paths, freeing manual work, reducing emergency response thresholds and cost, identifying abnormality through entity behavior association, and having the potential of resisting unknown threats without depending on a fixed rule base.

title_en: Regional geological disaster rapid early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid early warning method for regional geological disasters, in particular relates to the field of geological disaster early warning, and aims to solve the problems of early warning lag and inaccurate positioning caused by the existing dependence on a single monitoring index. The method comprises the steps of obtaining slope deep inclination angle, earth sound event count and ground micro-displacement data of a geological early warning area, constructing a multidimensional monitoring data stream with space-time continuity, generating an area deformation synchronization index based on phase space reconstruction and correlation dimension analysis, calculating a system entropy value through density clustering and displacement fluctuation analysis, carrying out real-time identification on an area critical state by adopting a critical state judgment model with double threshold grading, and finally carrying out space superposition division on multistage warning subareas and outputting corresponding early warning signals by combining real-time rainfall intensity data. The invention can realize the capturing of the pre-disaster megaly from the instability angle of the internal structure, improves the accuracy and the foresight of the early warning of regional geological disasters, and ensures the public safety of the region.

title_en: Multifunctional robot for post-disaster reconstruction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional robot for post-disaster reconstruction, which moves through a walking chassis, can shovel off an obstacle through a bucket, can lift the obstacle through a lifting hydraulic cylinder, is convenient for a worker to operate, and can improve the stability of the walking chassis by pressing the ground through the bucket when the lifting hydraulic cylinder lifts the obstacle. Shortening through the pneumatic cylinder that slides, and then make the backplate stretch out to the walking chassis outside, the extension of backplate can drive the telescopic link and shorten, then the extension of slope pneumatic cylinder, and then drive the telescopic link and rotate, and then drive the backplate motion, make the backplate stretch out to the outside part of walking chassis and fall to the ground, the staff of being convenient for carries the backplate with the material, operating personnel is fixed through material and chain free end, then the extension of jacking pneumatic cylinder, and then drive the wheel carrier and rise, and then drive A pulley and C pulley rise, and then drive the direction removal of chain free end to jacking pneumatic cylinder, and then drive the material and remove to the backplate.

title_en: Post-disaster reconstruction robot
abstract_en: The utility model aims to provide a post-disaster reconstruction robot which comprises a base, a travelling mechanism, a rotary table, a mounting seat, a bucket assembly, five-degree-of-freedom mechanical arms and a mechanical arm, wherein the base is mounted on the travelling mechanism, the mounting seat is mounted on the base through the rotary table and can rotate 360 degrees along with the rotary table, a group of five-degree-of-freedom mechanical arms are respectively arranged on the left side surface and the right side surface of the front part of the mounting seat, the mechanical arm is mounted at the front end of the five-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm, and the bucket assembly is mounted at the rear part of the mounting seat. The utility model has scientific and reasonable structural design, can be applied to the field of reconstruction after military and disaster, has the functions of clearing road obstacles, reconstructing soil-digging construction, grabbing objects by the mechanical arm and the like, has high flexibility, and can effectively improve the working efficiency.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Fire Scene Investigation Using a Fixed Lidar Device
title_ko: 고정형 라이다 장비를 이용한 화재현장 조사 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고정형 관측장비를 이용한 화재현장 조사 방법에 관한 것으로서, 카메라로 획득한 영상 데이터를 기반으로 객체를 1차 식별하고, 라이다로 획득한 점군 데이터를 통해 각 객체의 반사 강도를 결정하며, 상기 반사 강도 정보를 인공지능 모듈에 입력하여 객체를 2차 식별하는 단계를 포함한다. 이를 통해 화재에 의한 손상 특성을 정밀하게 분석할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for improving toughness of AC/DC distribution area based on mobile energy storage soft switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for improving toughness of an AC/DC distribution area based on a mobile energy storage soft switch, which belong to the technical field of power distribution network fault recovery, wherein the method comprises the steps of considering a moving path of a meteorological center, constructing a line fault rate model under extreme ice and snow weather, and sampling to obtain a fault scene; the method comprises the steps of traversing all fault scenes, obtaining deployment positions with minimum total loss load of a network reconstruction and island division distribution network under different deployment positions of a mobile energy storage soft switch, carrying out pre-disaster placement according to the deployment positions, taking the positions with faults into consideration when traffic is not recovered after extreme weather faults occur, carrying out power restoration by adopting island division and network reconstruction modes around the pre-placement positions, and optimizing a repair strategy and updating the system topology by taking the sequence and the pre-placement scheme of fault position repair after traffic recovery after the disaster. The invention is based on the mobile energy storage soft switch, and obviously improves the power supply recovery capability and the operation reliability of the urban power distribution network for coping with extreme ice and snow disasters.
assignees: QINGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: SAR video stream enhancement method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a SAR video stream enhancement method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a continuous three-frame SAR image sequence, extracting multi-scale space-time characteristics by utilizing a characteristic extraction network, adopting an attention mechanism to adaptively fuse clear area information of each frame to inhibit blurring, calculating an inter-frame motion vector by an optical flow estimation module, realizing accurate alignment and compensation of adjacent frames, and finally reconstructing a high-quality clear image by an image fusion network. The SAR image blurring method and the SAR image blurring device effectively solve the problem of SAR image blurring caused by gesture disturbance and track deviation of the moving platforms such as unmanned aerial vehicles, remarkably improve the image detail restoring capability and visual quality, and can be widely applied to the fields with high requirements on image definition such as low-altitude remote sensing, disaster monitoring and automatic driving.

title_en: Distributed fault-tolerant consistency control method based on chord decomposition and semi-Markov process, electronic equipment and readable storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed fault-tolerant consistency control method based on a chord decomposition and a half Markov process, which is based on the chord decomposition theory and the half Markov random process, comprehensively considers the multi-factor influences of physical coupling, topological random reconstruction, actuator multiplicative faults, external disturbance and the like, establishes a unified error dynamic model, takes system asymptotic stability and robust performance as control targets, converts a global high-dimensional control problem into a low-dimensional sub-problem by combining chord graph decomposition, and finally realizes the extensible fault-tolerant control under the concurrency of multiple faults by utilizing the Lyapunov stability theory, schur's supplemental theory and a Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI) technology and designing a local distributed controller of the maximum group of each chord graph first and coordinating the overlapping state among sub-systems. The method breaks through the limitation of dimension disasters, and remarkably improves the control reliability and calculation efficiency of industrial systems such as micro-grids, continuous casting and rolling and the like under random topology and mixed fault scenes.

title_en: Flood loss assessment method and system based on carrier attribute and flooding characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood loss evaluation method and a flood loss evaluation system based on carrier attributes and submerged characteristics, comprising the steps of acquiring carrier space data, submerged characteristic data and socioeconomic data, performing three-dimensional coordinate space transformation to realize space-time alignment, calculating to obtain a submerged overlapping area based on the aligned carrier space data and submerged characteristic data, constructing a four-dimensional enhancement layer for the submerged overlapping area, and calculating to obtain the enhancement strength of the four-dimensional enhancement layer Calculating submerged population by using space metering economic model in combination with aligned socioeconomic data And submerged area Creating a multi-scale assessment model to enhance the intensity Submerged population And submerged area Obtaining flood loss values as input evaluation . Compared with the traditional method, the method has the advantages that the coverage is improved, the whole process quantification from physical damage during disaster occurrence, social and economic linkage influence caused by the disaster to the post-disaster reconstruction cost is realized, and the traditional method is avoided to only pay attention to the unilateral property of direct loss in the disaster.
assignees: JIANGSU WATER CONSERVANCY SCI RES INST;NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST

title_en: Slope erosion monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle images
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope erosion monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle images, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-angle image sequences through an unmanned aerial vehicle, extracting initial slope profile data, obtaining a slope ratio preliminary estimated value, correcting a slope model, obtaining a model after deformation correction, extracting a crack distribution coordinate set, carrying out matching calculation on the crack distribution coordinate set and the slope ratio, analyzing deviation and updating projection parameters, reconstructing a three-dimensional slope model by utilizing the updated projection parameters, extracting slope length ratio and slope ratio parameters, generating an erosion distribution layer diagram, obtaining a synchronous matching result of cracks and ratio, carrying out iterative adjustment projection according to the ratio deviation distribution circulation of the synchronous matching result and the initial image sequence until deviation is lower than a threshold value, judging final matching consistency, and outputting complete erosion part positioning data. The invention realizes the accurate positioning of the erosion part and the accurate quantification of the slope surface characteristics, and provides powerful support for the evaluation and prevention of geological disasters under complex terrains.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE;BEIJING CLIMATE CENTER

title_en: SAR-to-optical image generation method and device for fire monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire monitoring-oriented SAR-to-optical image generation method and device, and aims to solve the problems that SAR images are difficult to interpret and optical telefeeling is blocked in fire monitoring, and the existing generation method is unstable in training, high in calculation cost, discontinuous in structure and the like. The method comprises the steps of obtaining SAR images, preprocessing the SAR images to construct pseudo RGB images, extracting near infrared and short wave infrared bands of multispectral images, calculating NBR indexes to generate fire masks, constructing spectrum guiding loss functions, generating trunks by DDPM, embedding cross-domain translators, combining hierarchical structure guiding mechanisms, weighting and fusing global and local reconstruction results, and outputting optical style images. The invention can generate optical images with clear details, consistent spectrum and consistent structure under the shielding of smoke and cloud layers, balance the generation quality and efficiency, improve the accuracy of fire monitoring and post-disaster evaluation, and is suitable for multi-scene fire monitoring.

title_en: Fire control robot remote monitoring control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire-fighting robot remote monitoring control system, and belongs to the technical field of wireless self-organizing networks. The system comprises a communication link detection module, a central decision module, a remote monitoring interface module and a task execution module. The system comprises a communication link detection module, a central decision module, a remote monitoring interface module, a task execution module and a remote control interface module, wherein the communication link detection module periodically acquires communication parameters among robots, fuses and generates an anti-instantaneous-interference comprehensive link health degree, the central decision module identifies regional concurrent failure, node silence decoupling or directional gradient deterioration abnormal modes based on a global state view, dynamically marks a risk area, generates four types of candidate schemes of multi-hop route redirection, position fine adjustment, task handover and dispatch relay on a deteriorated link in parallel, strictly avoids the risk area and sorts according to ascending order of system disturbance degree, and the remote monitoring interface module provides a man-machine cooperative confirmation interface, and the task execution module sends a command to drive a reconstruction action according to the abnormal modes. The invention realizes intelligent and steady self-healing of the communication network in a high-risk environment on the premise of ensuring the safety of personnel equipment.

title_en: External decorative curtain wall reconstruction and fire rescue window channel and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an external decoration curtain wall reconstruction and fire-fighting rescue window channel, which comprises a wall body, wherein transverse connecting keels are welded on a curtain wall inner side vertical keel and a curtain wall outer side vertical keel which are positioned at two sides of a wall fire-fighting window respectively, the transverse connecting keels are respectively arranged at the bottom end and the top end of the wall fire-fighting window, the other ends of the transverse connecting keels are welded with channel vertical keels, the channel vertical keels are positioned at two sides of the wall fire-fighting window and are at least arranged at two positions in the directions of the wall fire-fighting window and the curtain wall window, a channel bottom layer horizontal keel positioned at the bottom end of the wall fire-fighting window and a channel top layer horizontal keel positioned at the top end of the wall fire-fighting window are welded on the channel vertical keels, a plurality of channel bottom layer longitudinal keels are welded between the two channel bottom layer longitudinal keels, and a plurality of channel top layer longitudinal keels are welded between the two channel top layer horizontal keels. The fire rescue window is opened on the external decorative curtain wall corresponding to the original fire rescue window and is connected through the steel platform, so that the fire rescue requirement is finally met.
assignees: BCEG NO 4 CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Self-organizing task diversion disaster recovery previewing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of task diversion disaster recovery previewing scheme design, in particular to a self-organizing task diversion disaster recovery previewing method and system. The method comprises the steps of setting a replay area, disaster recovery levels and corresponding temporary storage areas in a robot control system, responding to area alarms, automatically identifying related tasks, automatically determining task processing strategies based on preset rules according to task types and disaster recovery levels, including path diversion or reassignment to the temporary storage areas, executing diversion in a simulation environment, dynamically changing the number of tasks and AGVs to test system limits, and finally generating replay data for evaluating system performance. The corresponding system comprises functional modules for realizing the steps. The invention solves the problem that the prior art lacks automatic disaster recovery replay capability, can expose the system bottleneck in advance, and provides data support for optimizing the scheduling strategy and improving the system toughness.

title_en: Early fire smoke detection method based on semitransparent feature
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing and fire disaster early warning, and discloses an early fire disaster smoke detection method based on semitransparent characteristics, wherein images are synchronously acquired by using a polarization analysis camera and a reference camera; tracking a stable polarization anchor point in a polarization image, compensating global motion of a camera, extracting refractive disturbance representing dynamic semitransparent characteristics of smoke in a reference camera image, determining an interested region, and calculating linear polarization degree variation of the region representing scattering semitransparent characteristics by using a polarization analysis camera. The method comprises the steps of verifying whether physical causal relation exists between two semitransparent features of dynamic and scattering through a preset turbulence and polarization relation model, carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on a disturbance source, verifying whether a space form accords with a real smoke plume feature, and finally confirming fire smoke only when one area passes the double verification of the causal relation and the three-dimensional form, so that the detection accuracy and the anti-interference capability are improved.
assignees: LIAONENG LIAONING SMART ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Beidou geological disaster anomaly detection method combining time domain features and spectral domain features
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Beidou geological disaster anomaly detection method combining time domain features and spectral domain features.
