The method comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing data, determining a time window, reducing noise of the data, extracting three-dimensional displacement information, secondly extracting time domain features, thirdly extracting spectral domain features, fourthly fusing features and reducing dimensions, generating a time domain-spectral domain joint feature vector by using the time domain features and the spectral domain features, fifthly, detecting a dynamic threshold abnormality, detecting geological disasters, calculating the degree of deviation between a new feature vector of latest monitoring data and a normal reference, judging that the current displacement is disaster possibility based on a sliding window self-adaptive threshold, triggering early warning, otherwise, reconstructing the normal state reference by using the latest data, and repeating the judging process. The method has the advantages of improving the accuracy and reliability of identifying the geological disaster abnormality, realizing accurate early warning and reducing the phenomena of false alarm and false alarm of the geological disaster.
assignees: GUANGXI TRANSP SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD;UNIV GUILIN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method and device for three-dimensional reconstruction of airborne array interference SAR point cloud building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for three-dimensional reconstruction of an airborne array interference SAR point cloud building, which belong to the technical field of three-dimensional point cloud data processing, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring an original airborne array interference SAR point cloud and preprocessing, wherein the preprocessing comprises point cloud denoising, point cloud registration and point cloud filtering; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing point cloud data, extracting building point clouds through a double-threshold cooperative mechanism of point cloud grid density and point cloud height characteristics, constructing building contours through an improved Alpha-Shape algorithm based on the extracted building point clouds, and constructing a three-dimensional building model through a RANSAC algorithm based on the building point clouds and the constructed building contours. The invention also relates to a three-dimensional building model and application thereof, which effectively solves the technical problem of airborne array interference SAR point cloud in building three-dimensional reconstruction, improves reconstruction precision and efficiency, and has important application value in the fields of digital city construction, building post-disaster reconstruction, city planning management and the like.

title_en: Rural micro-energy network power distribution method based on multi-agent collaborative decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rural micro-energy network power distribution method based on multi-agent collaborative decision, and relates to the technical field of micro-energy networks. The method comprises the steps of obtaining basic information of each power utilization unit in a rural micro-energy network, constructing a power distribution module of the power utilization unit to obtain an initial power distribution vector of the rural micro-energy network, inputting the initial power distribution vector of the rural micro-energy network into a pre-trained daily power distribution vector of the rural micro-energy network to generate the daily power distribution vector of the rural micro-energy network, obtaining comprehensive early warning information of the rural, judging whether the power utilization unit has a disaster situation, if the disaster situation does not occur, using the daily power distribution vector of the rural micro-energy network to perform power distribution, if the disaster situation does not occur, constructing a power distribution reconstruction module when the disaster happens to the rural micro-energy network, generating the power distribution vector when the disaster happens to the rural micro-energy network, and performing power distribution. The disaster-time power distribution mechanism based on disaster early warning information solves the problem that emergency guarantee capability is insufficient due to lack of efficient allocation of resources for disaster-time power supply.

title_en: Method for restoring green ecology of mine goaf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for restoring green ecology in a mine goaf, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises the steps of firstly carrying out rock surface treatment, cleaning the exposed rock surface of a mine, preventing broken stone from falling during construction, then carrying out restoring green planting, carrying out seedling transplanting on the prepared rock surface, and then carrying out vegetation maintenance, and carrying out maintenance on planted seedlings and sown grass seeds, so that the vegetation can root and sprout. According to the invention, through vegetation reconstruction and ecological restoration, the surface coverage is quickly recovered, water and soil loss is reduced, geological disaster risks such as landslide and debris flow are effectively restrained, life and property safety of mining areas and surrounding residents are prevented from being threatened, super-accumulated plants can be utilized to purify heavy metal pollution of soil, vegetation is matched for adsorbing dust and adjusting microclimate, air quality and ecological environment of the areas are obviously improved, and meanwhile, the mining areas after being re-greened can be transformed into ecological parks, carbon-sink forests or agricultural bases, so that the land value is improved.

title_en: Method for predicting instability volume of reservoir side slope deformation body
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the instability volume of a reservoir bank slope deformation body, which comprises the steps of respectively obtaining surface displacement and rock mass internal deformation data through a millimeter wave radar and an inclination angle sensor, and identifying a key deformation area and generating a data set after processing through a self-adaptive noise decomposition algorithm. And carrying out space-time alignment on the data by utilizing the engineering coordinate system and the topological relation to generate a fusion matrix. And reconstructing a potential slip surface geometric model by combining the slip surface characteristics of the historical cases, and calculating the instability volume probability distribution by adopting Monte Carlo simulation. And finally, inputting the multidimensional data into a space-time prediction model, and outputting a destabilization volume prediction result with probability distribution. The method can improve the accuracy and reliability of the prediction result, and provide scientific basis and technical support for safety monitoring and disaster early warning of the bank side slope.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Mountain highway disaster identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing image restoration and super-resolution reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plateau mountain road disaster identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing image restoration and super-resolution reconstruction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source remote sensing images of mountain areas of a plateau, preprocessing, extracting geomorphic metering parameters based on a digital elevation model, constructing a super-resolution reconstruction network integrating deformable convolution and a Transformer, reconstructing low-resolution images by utilizing composite loss function constraint training comprising the geomorphic metering parameters, carrying out feature extraction and self-adaptive weighted fusion on the preprocessed images and the high-resolution images obtained by reconstruction, identifying landslide, debris flow and subgrade subsidence disasters along the road by utilizing a multi-task deep learning model based on the fused images, carrying out morphological optimization and boundary refinement under GIS constraint on identification results, and outputting disaster thematic map. The invention effectively improves the accuracy and reliability of highway disaster identification under complex terrain environments.

title_en: Operation and maintenance business cooperation method for multi-system railway passenger station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for coordinating operation and maintenance services of a railway station aiming at multiple systems, and relates to the technical field of intelligent transportation and building automation. The method comprises the steps of analyzing on-site multi-system real-time monitoring data, mapping to obtain a unified operation state view representing the logic state and the physical position of the total station equipment, instantiating a target plan action sequence according to a pre-constructed joint model in response to an emergency event, carrying out state matching and mode constraint comparison based on the unified view, generating action executable judgment results and mode conflict mark information through incremental local simulation, identifying failure actions based on the judgment results, searching functionally equivalent resources and spatially reachable paths by utilizing the joint model, and reconstructing to generate an optimal substitution action sequence. The invention solves the linkage failure problem caused by mode conflict or equipment failure of the traditional plan under the complex working condition, realizes the dynamic consistency check and flexible resource reconstruction of emergency response, and ensures the operation safety of the station.

title_en: Disaster weather distribution network grid power failure prediction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of distribution networks, in particular to a disaster weather distribution network grid outage prediction method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein a panoramic disaster sensing system is constructed by fusing meteorological satellites, sensors and multi-source heterogeneous data of power grid operation, and a topological-electric coupling complex network model is established to quantify node level fault probability; the method comprises the steps of analyzing a multi-level risk conduction rule from a meteorological factor to a user level based on machine learning and knowledge graph technology, realizing accurate prediction of grid outage probability, synchronously generating a multi-dimensional early warning information driving dynamic response mechanism, integrating flexible load regulation, energy storage cooperative scheduling and network reconstruction strategies, linking emergency repair resources to realize rapid fault suppression, forming prediction-defense-recovery closed loop management, and remarkably improving the power distribution network fault treatment efficiency and disaster prevention toughness under extreme weather.

title_en: Remote sensing image generation method driven by multi-mode semantics and physical laws
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image generation method driven by multi-mode semantics and physical laws, which belongs to the technical field of computer vision and remote sensing image generation, and aims at the problems of insufficient alignment of cross-mode semantics, low reliability of generated results and insufficient fusion of physical mechanisms, and the method comprises the steps of firstly removing low-quality samples from original data and unifying spatial scales; the method comprises the steps of extracting multi-mode semantic vectors by using BLIP and CLIP models, introducing remote sensing physical rules to perform vector optimization, embedding position coding and physical constraint conditions in a latent space, realizing multi-source information joint modeling by using a cross-mode encoder, and finally performing denoising reasoning based on a transducer architecture by taking text description, physical priori knowledge and diffusion time steps as joint conditions, and completing reverse diffusion reconstruction by using a cross-attention mechanism. The method improves physical rationality and semantic consistency, and provides a more reliable technical paradigm for remote sensing image generation in the fields of disaster monitoring, military simulation and the like.

title_en: Omnidirectional intelligent advertisement management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital marketing and discloses an omnibearing intelligent advertisement management system, which comprises an advertisement data acquisition module, an intelligent evaluation analysis module, a strategy optimization engine module, a cross-channel execution module, a closed-loop feedback module and a safety audit module, wherein logic deviation between advertisement content characteristics and user behavior data is identified in real time through a multi-source cooperation mechanism, and a dynamic compensation algorithm is used for eliminating cooperation conflicts; the environment sensing unit continuously tracks the change of the equipment state and the network condition, triggers the self-adaptive decision path reconstruction to prevent the delivery deviation, the spectrum analysis engine carries out layered deconstruction and evaluation on the composite advertisement materials to realize element-level accurate optimization, and the emergency response mechanism rapidly copes with the environmental mutation and public opinion risk through the feasibility of a sandbox previewing verification strategy. The method solves the core problems of multi-source data fusion failure, strategy environment adaptation misalignment, composite material evaluation deviation, crisis response lag and the like, and improves advertisement putting accuracy and marketing efficiency.

title_en: Geological disaster risk double-control data processing method and system based on data center platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster risk double-control data processing method and system based on a data center, which are characterized in that a service system, an internet of things device and external department heterogeneous data are integrated through configuration of a special rule in the field of ground disaster, a 15-bit hidden danger point coding system is unified and reconstructed by space coordinates, a language big model is adopted to map threat objects to a standardized dictionary, a data physical model comprising association rules and constraints is constructed, a core hidden danger library and a risk point library are split, monitoring priority is divided, three types of binding of hidden danger point-monitoring devices, responsible persons and disposal flows is realized based on administrative regions, a geological disaster type exclusive parameter library is constructed, a risk index is calculated by fusion of monitoring data, an emergency task is triggered and closed-loop feedback is performed, hierarchical API service and third-order data quality detection are adopted, high-efficiency treatment is realized, a full-flow closed loop of risk identification, management and feedback is formed, and the geological disaster prevention and control intelligent level is improved.
assignees: Jiangxi Geological Museum;JIANGXI MINERAL RESOURCES SUPPORT SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Material storage and distribution device for intelligent mutual aid disaster relief
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of storage and distribution of material for mutual aid disaster relief, and provides an intelligent material storage and distribution device for mutual aid disaster relief, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein one side of the cabinet body is fixedly connected with a display screen body, the bottom of the cabinet body is provided with a lower monitoring mechanism, the lower monitoring mechanism comprises a mounting plate II, one side of the mounting plate II is fixedly connected with a plurality of cameras II, the flexible division of the space inside the cabinet body is realized through the matching of a sliding plate, a cross beam and a partition plate, the space utilization rate is improved, the external adjusting action is accurately transmitted to the inside by virtue of a linkage structure of a balance rod, a sliding sleeve and a short rod, the reconstruction efficiency is improved, the sliding plate is quickly locked and prevented from sliding by virtue of an elastic limiting mechanism formed by a plug rod, a jack, a spring and the like, the adjacent sealing doors can be physically connected by virtue of the combination mechanism to form an integral door body, the problem that one-door of a unified cabinet cannot be linked is solved, the material taking efficiency is improved, and the abrasion is reduced.

title_en: High-resolution building image extraction method, program, equipment and storage medium based on redundant perception wavelet transformation network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution building image extraction method, program, equipment and storage medium based on a redundant perception wavelet transformation network, and relates to the technical field of remote sensing building image extraction. The method utilizes a wavelet decomposition and reconstruction mechanism to effectively separate low-frequency structural information and high-frequency edge details of an image, enhances the accuracy of building contour extraction by introducing an inter-band attention interaction mechanism and a direction perception convolution module, and combines a redundancy suppression module to enhance the effectiveness and robustness of feature expression so as to realize the identification of a coarse-to-fine building region. The invention can reduce false detection and missing detection caused by shadow, shielding and texture similarity to a certain extent, has higher detection precision and stability, and can be suitable for various remote sensing application scenes such as urban planning, disaster assessment, environmental monitoring and the like.

title_en: Air-ground dual-purpose fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The application relates to an air-ground dual-purpose fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle system which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a flight assembly, a ground traveling assembly, a control assembly and a fire-fighting operation assembly. The flying assembly is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle body through a first connecting piece and comprises a rotor wing mechanism and a driving piece, the ground traveling assembly is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle body through a second connecting piece and comprises a traveling track and a driving piece, and the control assembly comprises a control piece and a sensor array. In addition, the system also comprises modules such as a self-reconstruction power cabin, a quick-change fire extinguishing cabin and the like. The application realizes amphibious switching of the air and the ground, has high-efficiency fire detection, terrain modeling and accurate fire extinguishing capability, and remarkably improves the flexibility and adaptability of fire-fighting operation.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Active power distribution network dynamic reconstruction system oriented to graph neural network induction under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graph neural network-induced active power distribution network dynamic reconstruction system oriented to typhoon disasters, which comprises a graph neural network module, a preprocessing filter module, a post-processing selection module, an optimization solving module and a scene generating module. The system dynamically simulates topology reconstruction through a switch door control message transmission mechanism, adopts a topology independent local predictor to realize the expansion of cross-network configuration, combines pre-filtering non-key switch and post-processing confidence degree selection, and combines GNN prediction with MIP optimization on the premise of ensuring physical feasibility. In the actual measurement of an IEEE 33 node system, 1.64 times of calculation acceleration is realized, only 0.67% average optimality gap is generated, the problem of low calculation efficiency in the traditional method is effectively solved, and the toughness level of the power distribution network for coping with extreme weather is remarkably improved.

title_en: Charging pile variable frequency load management method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging pile variable frequency load management method and system based on artificial intelligence, the method comprises the steps of data acquisition, data preprocessing, design of clustering objective functions, design iteration solving, super-parameter searching and charging pile variable-frequency load management. The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a charging pile variable frequency load management method and system based on artificial intelligence, wherein the scheme improves clustering precision and robustness by introducing a re-weighting term; the method comprises the steps of adding projection subspace terms to reduce dimension disasters, restricting sparsity of clustering results and reducing noise influence based on 21 norms and reconstruction projects, designing mutation strategies based on combination of individual advantages and population advantages, accelerating convergence speed, intersecting mutation positions through intersection strategies, helping to preserve individual position diversity, selecting final positions based on greedy, improving search efficiency, finally realizing optimal super-parameter combination, and improving clustering efficiency and accuracy.
assignees: GUILIN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Existing high-rise building fire safety risk identification and reconstruction management method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying and reforming the fire-fighting safety risk of an existing high-rise building, which comprises the following steps of S1, logging in a fire-fighting safety risk identification management platform of the building by using handheld equipment, S2, and displaying the fire-fighting safety risk of the building on a map after logging in the fire-fighting safety risk identification management platform of the building by using the handheld equipment. The invention can display the risk building.

title_en: Storm surge disaster frequency prediction method and system based on LSTM
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a storm surge disaster frequency prediction method and system based on LSTM. The method comprises the steps of collecting sea surface air pressure, wind speed and wind direction and sea water temperature through multi-source marine meteorological monitoring equipment to form an observation data set, extracting time sequence characteristics of meteorological elements to obtain a storm surge characteristic vector sequence, converting the storm surge characteristic vector sequence into time sequence training samples through tensor reconstruction algorithm, constructing a bidirectional LSTM neural network for training to obtain a prediction model, carrying out reasoning prediction on the real-time characteristic vector sequence, and comparing the real-time characteristic vector sequence with historical records for verification, so as to finally obtain storm surge disaster frequency prediction data. The method solves the technical problem that the storm surge disaster frequency prediction precision is insufficient because the existing storm surge prediction technology cannot effectively capture the long-term time sequence dependency relationship and the multi-time scale change rule of storm surge.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST;HUANENG ZHEJIANG ENERGY DEV CO LTD CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH;HUANENG OFFSHORE WIND POWER SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional accident playback method and device for natural disaster damage area
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional accident playback method and device for a natural disaster damage area, and relates to the technical field of natural disaster monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining pre-disaster digital surface model DSM data and post-disaster DSM data of a target area after natural disasters occur in the target area, combining the pre-disaster DSM data and the post-disaster DSM data to generate combined data, generating three-dimensional accident playback animation of the target area according to the combined data, and adding the three-dimensional accident playback animation into a preset three-dimensional scene of the target area. According to the method, the DSM data before and after the disaster in the target area is obtained and combined, the three-dimensional accident playback animation of the target area is generated through the combined data, and the animation can display the surface height change condition before and after the disaster in the target area, so that the terrain change of the disaster area is effectively compared, the occurrence process of the natural disaster is fully restored, and the investigation evaluation accuracy and the safety and rationality of rescue scheme formulation are improved.
assignees: AERIAL PHOTOGRAMMETRY AND REMOTE SENSING CO LTD

title_en: Space-time interpolation method for multi-disaster historical data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geographic information systems and disaster monitoring, in particular to a space-time interpolation method of multi-disaster historical data, which comprises a space-time collaborative interpolation module, a disaster-causing factor identification module and a quantitative characterization module, wherein the space-time collaborative interpolation module is used for constructing a space-time variation function based on an optimized Kriging method and spline interpolation to realize collaborative interpolation of space and time dimensions, the disaster-causing factor identification module is used for carrying out system identification and weight distribution on the multi-disaster-causing factors based on a variable fuzzy optimization theory and an entropy value method, and the quantitative characterization module is used for realizing dynamic quantification and grading characterization of the disaster-causing factors based on a natural breakpoint grading method and an AHP weighting method. The method realizes high-precision space-time reconstruction of historical disaster data and dynamic quantification of disaster factors in multi-disaster complex terrain areas, effectively solves the problem that the traditional interpolation method is insufficient in precision in space-time heterogeneous areas and insufficient in dynamic factor capture, and provides a reliable data basis for multi-disaster risk assessment and disaster chain analysis.

title_en: Cross-modal feature fusion tri-spectral fusion imaging method and image data acquisition device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-modal feature fusion imaging method and an image data acquisition device, which are used for acquiring visible light image, near infrared image and thermal imaging image data, preprocessing the image data, carrying out color space conversion on the visible light image, extracting important features of preprocessed modal data respectively by using a deep neural network, carrying out cross-modal fusion on the important features of each mode, reconstructing the obtained fusion features by using a decoder module, calculating weighting loss of the fusion image based on the fusion image, an original visible light image and the thermal imaging image, and carrying out iterative training again by taking the loss as feedback until the weighting loss meets the preset requirement. The provided cross-modal feature fusion imaging method and the image data acquisition device effectively improve the image detail fidelity and visual quality, and can be applied to target detection, security monitoring and intelligent perception tasks in complex environments such as low light, haze, fire scene and the like.

title_en: Multi-source meteorological data-based artificial influence weather operation training system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source meteorological data-based artificial influence weather operation training system and method, comprising a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time meteorological data and equipment state data through meteorological monitoring equipment, an ammunition launching device and an environment sensor; and the data fusion module is used for constructing a weather-equipment association model. The historical meteorological data is reconstructed in a multi-source mode through the internal network subsystem, so that the virtual simulation scene has space-time characteristics which are highly matched with the actual combat scene, the grid error of the precipitation field is reduced to +/-0.42 mm from the average +/-0.5 mm of the industry, decision bias caused by historical data distortion in traditional simulation is effectively avoided, the historical training data is stored in a localized encryption container through the design of the physically isolated internal and external network subsystems, and the real-time combat data is unidirectionally transmitted to an operation terminal through a firewall, so that data authority management and control of the whole process of training-actual combat is realized, and the data leakage risk is reduced.

title_en: Flood disaster condition monitoring method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a flood disaster condition monitoring method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-time phase synthetic aperture radar image data of a target area, preprocessing the multi-time phase synthetic aperture radar image data to obtain a synthetic aperture radar image retaining flood boundary characteristics, extracting a multi-scale feature image of the preprocessed synthetic aperture radar image through a self-adaptive polarization fusion multi-scale pyramid structure, dynamically weighting the multi-scale feature image through a space-time joint attention weight image, carrying out self-adaptive noise suppression and reconstruction on the dynamically weighted multi-scale feature image to obtain low-dimensional feature representation, carrying out feature calibration on the low-dimensional feature representation based on historical flood data of the target area, carrying out multi-scale feature fusion and attention weight adjustment on the calibrated low-dimensional feature representation, combining full-connection mapping and probability calculation to output flood classification results of the target area, and generating flood disaster distribution information based on the flood classification results.

title_en: AI multi-agent layered stepped emergency response system supporting elastic power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI multi-agent hierarchical emergency response system supporting an elastic power grid, which relates to the technical field of substation power response and comprises a global situation sensing module, an area autonomous control module and an equipment toughness executing module, wherein the global situation sensing module integrates multi-source disaster monitoring information, a disaster chain deduction model is built, the disaster intensity of an area is quantized, a risk map is generated, the area autonomous control module extracts a high-risk area to divide a balanced island, second-level splitting and black starting are realized through agents, autonomous stability coefficient is built, island stability is evaluated, the equipment toughness executing module identifies potential fault areas, the agents are driven to dynamically reconstruct the power grid topology, linkage distributed energy is compensated according to load gap differentiation, and a recovery speed coefficient is calculated to judge core load recovery quality. The system improves disaster pre-judging precision and emergency response efficiency, ensures reliable power supply of core loads such as medical treatment, industry and the like, and enhances disaster resistance elasticity of the power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: 30-Meter resolution evapotranspiration estimation method for area of cooperative multi-star shortwave infrared detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 30-meter resolution evapotranspiration estimation method for a region for collaborative multi-star shortwave infrared detection, which comprises the steps of firstly acquiring regional weather radiation data of a research region and spatially forming driving data of an evapotranspiration model, secondly acquiring satellite remote sensing data of the research region, thirdly, reconstructing a 1.24-micrometer shortwave infrared band, fourthly, calculating shortwave infrared water indexes and reconstructing remote sensing vegetation index time sequences, fifthly, constructing an evapotranspiration estimation model, sixthly, constructing a relative evaporation ratio parameter model based on the remote sensing shortwave infrared, seventhly, determining model parameters, eighthly, verifying and evaluating regional evapotranspiration, supporting requirements of application fields such as arid region regional water resource management, agricultural water efficiency evaluation, regional drought monitoring, agricultural water conservation and the like, and providing a thought for estimating regional evapotranspiration, wherein the estimated evapotranspiration data product can provide key support for regional water disaster monitoring, agricultural water management and the like.

title_en: Personnel search and rescue method after earthquake disaster and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a post-earthquake disaster personnel search and rescue method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of post-earthquake disaster personnel search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of randomly dividing a target area into a plurality of subareas, generating a search and rescue path based on the seismic source position of the target area and the seismic magnitude and personnel density of each subarea, determining whether disaster-stricken personnel exist in the subareas and the position information of the disaster-stricken personnel when the disaster-stricken personnel exist on the basis of infrared thermal imaging images and radar echo signals of the subareas in the process of controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along the search and rescue path to a path node corresponding to one subarea, performing three-dimensional reconstruction on the subarea based on SAR images of the subareas if the disaster-stricken personnel exist, obtaining a three-dimensional terrain model of the subareas, marking the position information of the disaster-stricken personnel in the three-dimensional terrain model, and obtaining a search and rescue indication model for guiding the search and rescue process of the subareas. The application can improve the search and rescue efficiency of personnel after earthquake disaster.

title_en: Disaster situation-oriented harbor power grid toughness optimization method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a harbour power grid toughness optimization method, system and medium for disaster situations, which comprises the steps of determining the optimal energy storage equipment layout and capacity configuration by adopting a pre-disaster optimization model in a pre-disaster stage of a harbour power grid, wherein the pre-disaster optimization model is a two-stage optimization model, the first stage is used for optimizing the arrangement and investment of energy storage equipment, the second stage is used for simulating load reduction and power flow optimization adjustment in the most unfavorable scene after disaster, the scheduling scheme of a distributed power supply, the energy storage equipment and an electric automobile is obtained by adopting the in-disaster optimization model in the disaster stage of the harbour power grid so as to optimize power supply, the in-disaster optimization model aims at minimizing load loss and guaranteeing important user power supply priority, and the post-disaster recovery stage of the harbour power grid adopts a post-disaster recovery reconstruction model to optimize the switching state, the node electrification condition and the load recovery strategy of the harbour power grid. Compared with the prior art, the invention can effectively pre-configure the distributed power supply and the mobile energy storage.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: County-level weather risk early warning method and system based on visual dynamic adjustment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a county weather risk early warning method and system based on visual dynamic adjustment, and relates to the technical field of disaster risk management and emergency. The method comprises the steps of constructing a first early warning model based on geological environment sensitivity and rainfall inducibility analysis and a second early warning model based on rainfall process deviation historical characteristic analysis through fusion of multi-source heterogeneous data, generating a rainfall threshold value query table, utilizing an ASP.NET framework to develop an automatic analysis control console, integrating the dual models to form a regional weather early warning model and output prediction data, realizing early warning process backtracking and parameter dynamic adjustment through a visual early warning risk distribution map, storing the early warning data into an experience playback pool through combination with a weather expert evaluation mechanism, and finally outputting an early warning map, a forecast text and a precaution suggestion through a provincial geological disaster scheduling system. The system realizes closed loop optimization and man-machine collaborative decision-making of the early warning process, and effectively improves the accuracy, timeliness and business application level of county weather risk early warning.
assignees: SHAANXI GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION SHAANXI PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER CENTER

title_en: Real-time modeling method and system for power transmission line disaster scene unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time modeling method and a real-time modeling system for a disaster scene unmanned aerial vehicle of a power transmission line, relates to the technical field of power operation and maintenance, and aims at a global positioning system signal loss scene to solve the problems of pose drift and difficult alignment of subgraphs in the case of weak common vision in the traditional method. The global pose optimization model fuses the historical constraint of preprocessing training data, the single machine positioning result of local pose data and the visual characteristics of an operation key frame image set, an internal constraint system without external positioning signals is constructed, pose errors are corrected, strong dependence on an image common view area is broken, efficient fusion of multi-unmanned aerial vehicle pose stability and local data is realized, early data preprocessing, pose resolving and later three-dimensional reconstruction are combined, a real-time dense map generating period is shortened, support is provided for positioning faults after power transmission line disasters, damage assessment and emergency repair scheme formulation, and emergency response efficiency and reliability are improved.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Assessment method and system for pipe network safety accident emergency resource configuration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method and a system for the configuration of emergency resources of pipe network safety accidents, and relates to the technical field of data analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing multi-source sensing sampling on pipe network accident areas and establishing a three-dimensional risk density distribution map; the method comprises the steps of inserting an autonomous dispatcher after emergency resource formation, executing formation decision and determining a formation scheme set, importing the scheme set into a coordination unit, coordinating and calibrating a first determined deployment and a second iteration distribution diagram according to the distributed resource demand, generating a resource configuration scheme in a round robin manner, obtaining a configuration evaluation result through toughness quantification and survivability reconstruction evaluation, and displaying and scheduling management on a platform terminal interface. The invention solves the technical problems of poor targeting of the emergency resource allocation of the safety accident of the pipe network and insufficient data support caused by difficult accurate integration of the multi-source sensing data of the pipe network in the traditional data acquisition and processing mode, and achieves the technical effects of accurate integration of the multi-source sensing data of the pipe network and improvement of the targeting of the emergency resource allocation of the safety accident of the pipe network and the data support capability.

title_en: Method for estimating importance of clusters in information network and apparatus thereof
title_ko: 정보 네트워크 군집의 중요도를 평가하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 재난 피해에 관한 텍스트 정보로부터 생성된 정보 네트워크를 관리하는 기술에 관한 것으로, 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함하는 평가 장치가 정보 네트워크 군집의 중요도를 평가하는 방법은, 텍스트 데이터를 입력받아 주제 분석을 통해 재난 피해 주제별로 군집을 생성하고, 미리 설정된 목적함수에 따라 군집을 구성하는 문장 또는 단어를 포함하는 표본의 특징값을 이용하여 군집별로 재난 피해 주제에 관한 군집의 중요도를 측정하며, 측정된 군집의 중요도에 따라 재난 피해 주제를 군집별로 표시하는 정보 네트워크를 재구성한다.

title_en: Intelligent radiation safety interlock integrated control forming device and method through edge-type AI control module for PSIS
title_ko: Psis용 엣지형 ai 제어모듈을 통한 지능형 방사선 안전인터락 통합제어형성장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 기존의 PSIS 기술의 구성요소 중 PLC 기반 제어로직부 간 연결된 잠금 신호선 단선시 '정상'신호로 오인되어, 오작동 가능성이 발생되어, 가속기 운전 중 작업자 출입 상태를 정확히 감지하지 못해, 작업자에게 방사선이 노출되는 위험이 자주 발생되는 문제점과, 여러 차폐문, 미로문, 출입문이 하나로 연결된 경우에, 중앙 제어기에서 전체 상태를 취합하는데 지연이 발생되고, 수백 ms로 반응속도가 제한되어, 온도, 영상, 인체, 방사선 등 복합 조건 인식이 불가하고, 사고 징후 사전 판단과 사고 대응이 어려운 문제점, 그리고, 도어의 단순 온(ON)/오프(OFF) 상태만 제공하므로, 사고 발생시 원인 추적이 어렵고, 사용자별 접근 기록 파악이 어려운 문제점을 개선하고자, 안전방호용 차폐문 스마트 제어모듈(100), 다채널 실내 센싱노드 모듈(200), PSIS용 엣지형 AI 제어모듈(300), 초전도 선형가속기용 구동멈춤 액츄에이터 제어모듈(400)이 구성됨으로서, 안전방호용 차폐문 스마트 제어모듈를 통해, 작업자 출입 인증데이터, 차폐문 상태 센싱데이터, 차폐문용 방사선센싱데이터를 기반으로 오경보·과제어 현상을 기존보다 비상시 현장에서 자율반응제어시킬 수 있어, 이벤트 발생시, 안전성과 인명보호율을 기존보다 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 다채널 실내 센싱노드 모듈이 구성됨으로서, 온도, 인체, 영상, 방사선 센싱을 동시에 수집하여 복합 조건 판단하도록 해줌으로서, 사고 징후 인식 정확도를 기존보다 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 영상과 센서를 통해 실내 작업자 감지율을 기존보다 1.5배~2배 높일 수 있으며, SCL동, 고에너지 실험A동, 고에너지실험B동, 저에너지실험A동, 저에너지실험B동의 방사선관리구역 실내에 위치되어, SCL동, 고에너지 실험A동, 고에너지실험B동, 저에너지실험A동, 저에너지실험B동의 방사선관리구역 별로, 실내온도데이터, 실내인체감지데이터, 실내영상데이터, 실내방사선센싱데이터를 기록하고 저장시킬 수 있어, 사고 발생시 시간순 재구성과 함께, 사고 추적 정밀도를 기존에 비해 80% 향상시킬 수 있으며, PSIS용 엣지형 AI 제어모듈이 구성됨으로서, AI 연산 프로세서부를 통해, 실내 작업자 감지, 방사선 수치, 출입기록, 영상, 패턴, 복합조건을 분석하여 오판율 대폭 감소시킬 수 있어, 기존보다 위험 판단 정확도를 85% 향상시킬 수 있고, 방사선 누출, 및 실내 작업자 감지, 기기이상에 따른 이벤트 발생시, 판단, EDL 제어, 가속기 멈춤으로, 평균 반응속도를 기존보다 1.5배~3배 빠르게 할 수  있으며, RTC 기반 타임스탬프와, AI 로깅으로 출입 인증, 영상, 방사선, 온도 등 복합 데이터를 자동 연동 저장시켜, 사고 발생 경로 90% 이상 재현시키고, 법적 감사자료 제공 및 안전통계 기반을 확보시킬 수 있고, 온도상승, 미세 방사선 누출, 실내 작업자 감지를 통해 사고발생을 예측하고, 선제적 폐쇄 및 경고를 수행하여, 사고율을 기존보다 80%이하로 감소시킬 수 있으며, 초전도 선형가속기용 구동멈춤 액츄에이터 제어모듈이 구성됨으로서, DO수신포트부를 통해 PSIS용 엣지형 AI 제어모듈과 직접 연동되는 현장 반응 신경망시스템으로, 초전도 선형가속기(SCL:Superconducting LINAC) 구동멈춤의 지연시간을 기존보다 1.5배~2배 단축시킬 수 있고, 초전도 선형가속기 특성 맞춤형 다단계 안전정지 흐름구조를 만들 수 있어, 비상정지 상황에서도 기기 수명 보존 및 무손실 정지시킬 수 있으며, 가속기형 RMH(Reflective Memory Hub)부를 통해, μs급 상태 동기화 및 다노드 대응시킬 수 있어, 다중 시스템 정합성과 사고경로 투명성을 기존보다 80% 향상시킬 수 있는 PSIS용 엣지형 AI 제어모듈을 통한 지능형 방사선 안전인터락 통합제어형성장치 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Redundant And Co-Operative Multi-Radio Communication In Aerial Vehicles
abstract_en: A multi-radio communication system for drones enables enhanced reliability and throughput by concurrently utilizing distinct radio technologies, such as cellular (e.g., LTE, 5G) and point-to-point wireless links (e.g., Wi-Fi). A communication management module dynamically selects between single, cooperative, and redundant transmission modes based on operational context parameters, communication link quality metrics, or other application requirements. In cooperative mode, unique data packets are distributed across both links to maximize throughput; in redundant mode, identical packets are sent concurrently to improve reliability. An error correction module aggregates data from multiple links to reconstruct complete messages and recover lost packets. The system adapts intelligently to varying mission demands and environmental conditions, providing robust, low-latency communication suitable for critical drone operations such as public safety surveillance, disaster response, and tactical deployments.

title_en: Method for verifying precision of pre-alarm information of sea wave disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for verifying the precision of pre-alarm information of sea wave disasters, which relates to the technical field of intelligent management and comprises the following steps of dividing a three-dimensional space-time grid based on the time characteristics of the sea wave disasters, and calculating the wave energy characteristics, reconstructing monitoring data of the problem node, generating an analysis link, performing first verification on the alarm information, and updating the alarm information according to a first verification result. According to the invention, the global sea area is divided into three-dimensional grids with uniform space-time resolution, three-dimensional Hilbert curve coding is adopted to realize space-time alignment of multi-source monitoring data, precision and consistency of sea wave energy characteristic extraction are improved, a comparison mechanism of theoretical energy and actual energy is constructed based on an inter-node energy propagation model, reliability and robustness of monitoring data are improved, accuracy and authority of early warning information are improved by constructing an analysis link, and a strategy of checking a problem node and a reliable node later is adopted to treat the node with the highest error risk preferentially.
assignees: SHANDONG MARINE FORECAST AND HAZARD MITIGATION CENTER;QINGDAO ROBOTFISH MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional ocean element field reconstruction method based on multivariate empirical orthogonal function decomposition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine environment monitoring and numerical simulation, and relates to a three-dimensional marine element field reconstruction method based on multivariate empirical orthogonal function decomposition. The method comprises the steps of S1, multi-source data collaborative preprocessing, S2 and MEOF joint mode extraction, S3, vertical projection operator optimization construction, S4, three-dimensional element field dynamic reconstruction, S5 and multi-source data fusion verification. The method breaks through the limitations of precision, efficiency and adaptability in three-dimensional field reconstruction in the prior art by organically combining multivariate modal decomposition and physical constraint projection, provides a key technical support for real-time monitoring of marine dynamic environment, and can be widely applied to the fields of marine disaster early warning, underwater engineering safety guarantee and the like.

title_en: Fire scene spreading time sequence reconstruction method and system based on Doppler weather radar mountain fire echo
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest fire monitoring and power grid safety prevention and control, and discloses a fire scene spreading time sequence reconstruction method based on Doppler weather radar mountain fire echo, which comprises the steps of collecting Doppler weather radar mountain fire echo original data and performing quality control processing to obtain radar echo data; the method comprises the steps of automatically segmenting a smoke plume region by adopting an optimized Otsu-Unet network model on radar echo data, extracting barycenter coordinates of a mountain fire echo region, predicting future motion trend of the barycenter coordinates of the mountain fire echo region by utilizing a Kalman filtering algorithm in combination with external three-dimensional wind field data, reconstructing a continuous fire scene spreading time sequence voxel sequence, carrying out 3DTiles slicing processing on the fire scene spreading time sequence voxel sequence, carrying out real-time rendering and displaying on a power grid monitoring platform by utilizing a WebGL technology, obtaining an outer expansion boundary of fire scene spreading based on the fire scene spreading time sequence voxel sequence, and calculating the distance between the outer expansion boundary and GIS data of a power transmission line in real time. The fire disaster prevention and control capability of the power transmission line of the power grid is improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Multi-network cascading failure propagation prediction method based on heterogeneous graph neural network under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-network chained fault propagation prediction method based on a heterogeneous graph neural network under a disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of the disaster, electric power, communication and traffic networks, constructing a four-layer heterogeneous graph model, defining multi-type interlayer edges, establishing a mapping relation between disaster physical quantity and physical node health states, predicting initial fault states at disaster impact time, defining multi-scale multi-mechanism propagation rules based on the interlayer edges, simulating chained fault processes, constructing a space-time heterogeneous graph neural network model, stacking a heterogeneous graph neural network module and a gating circulation unit module, adopting a double-head prediction layer to predict node continuous running states and discrete functional states in an autoregressive mode, carrying out post-processing on a state time sequence output by the model, and reconstructing a cross-domain chained fault propagation path through a causal attribution algorithm. The invention can accurately simulate the whole evolution process from disaster occurrence to multi-network cascading failure, and realize multi-scale failure prediction and causal analysis.

title_en: Reservoir capacity calculation method and system based on multi-source three-dimensional data reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir capacity calculation method and system based on multi-source three-dimensional data reconstruction, and belongs to the technical field of reservoir capacity analysis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source three-dimensional data such as laser radar point cloud, photogrammetry, topography measurement and the like, generating a three-dimensional point cloud data set through denoising, coordinate unification and fusion treatment, constructing a high-precision three-dimensional topography model by adopting a three-dimensional reconstruction algorithm, calculating the reservoir capacity through the steps of intersection of a water surface plane and the model, voxel volume segmentation and the like by combining water level elevation data, and realizing dynamic trend prejudgement based on historical data. The method breaks through the limitation of a single data source, improves the integrity of topographic modeling and the precision of reservoir capacity measurement and calculation, realizes the span from static calculation to dynamic prejudgment, and provides scientific support for reservoir dispatching, flood control and disaster reduction and water resource optimization configuration.
assignees: TUOLIN HYDROPOWER PLANT OF STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Non-supervision deep learning rainfall dry-wet period classification and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unsupervised deep learning rainfall dry-wet period classification and monitoring method, which adopts a drying period CML signal training, learns normal signal characteristics through a self-encoder, a variation self-encoder and a fusion model thereof, and realizes rainfall abnormal attenuation detection by taking reconstruction errors and potential distribution deviation as discrimination indexes. The intelligent rainfall monitoring system can automatically identify rainfall events without additional equipment and manual labeling, has the capability of cross-link and cross-regional generalization, has strong robustness to non-rainfall interference such as wet antenna effect and the like, can realize large-scale real-time monitoring in smart city and 6G integrated sensing scenes, and is widely applied to the fields of weather, hydrology and disaster early warning.
assignees: INST ATMOSPHERIC PHYSICS CAS;UNIV HENAN POLYTECHNIC

title_en: Urban catchment area reconstruction effect simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation method of a reconstruction effect of an urban catchment area, which comprises the steps of dividing cell units, calculating a production flow by using a Green-Ampt model, combining a pipe network and a river network by using a Saint Violet process to obtain a residual production flow, simulating cell overflow to realize the reconstruction of the catchment area, and calculating road confluence by using a two-dimensional hydrodynamic force equation. The invention provides a method for simulating the reconstruction effect of an urban catchment area, which solves the problem that the prior art cannot capture abrupt change of a catchment path and has poor predictability of waterlogging. Through the merging process of the dynamic simulation district overflow and the catchment area, local sudden waterlogging risk points can be identified in advance, scientific decision basis is provided for urban flood prevention and control, such as drainage facility layout, emergency material deployment, flood control plan making and the like, flood disaster occurrence probability is reduced, and urban flood toughness is improved.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Disassembling and assembling transformation method for wet-type modified dry paint spray booth
abstract_en: The application relates to a disassembly, assembly and transformation method of a wet-type modified dry paint spray booth, which comprises the steps of firstly removing and flushing paint slag attached to the surface of an original wet-type venturi paint mist capturing system before removing the original wet-type venturi paint mist capturing system in a filtering layer section, providing fire-fighting equipment and installing ventilation facilities, removing a water supply pipeline, a water return pipeline, a water flowing plate, an air duct side plate, a venturi water tank, a water baffle, a bottom plate and an exhaust pipe, reserving a supporting structure and a concentrated air duct, and installing a single-row dry paint mist capturing system on the supporting structure, wherein the single-row dry paint mist capturing system comprises an air inlet chamber, a dry paint mist filtering module and an exhaust system, the dry paint mist filtering module is communicated between the air inlet chamber and the exhaust system, and an exhaust port of the exhaust system is communicated with the concentrated air duct. The application fully utilizes the residual structure of the original wet venturi paint mist capturing system in a limited space, reduces the dismantling work as much as possible, and reduces the construction time and the reconstruction cost.

title_en: Disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To make it easy to hear an alarm sound outputted in a disaster prevention system.SOLUTION: In a disaster prevention system 1, a fire receiver 20 includes a storage part 22, a setting part 212, and a sound output part 26. The storage unit 22 stores voice data indicating the alarm voice. The setting unit 212 sets a playback speed for each event according to a user's operation. When an event occurs, the sound output unit 26 outputs an alarm sound by reproducing sound data corresponding to the occurring event at a reproduction speed set for the occurring event.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Communication tower risk monitoring method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication tower risk monitoring method and system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of environmental monitoring and disaster early warning, and the method and system provided by the invention have the advantages that a voiceprint signal is used for replacing a failure vibration sensor, so that the continuous monitoring capability of an ice coating period is ensured, a monitoring blind area of a traditional system under extreme weather is avoided, 1D-CNN time sequence separation operation is combined with framing windowing and a Mel cepstrum coefficient, raindrop impact noise and ice layer falling sound are effectively stripped, the unique low-frequency resonance characteristics of metal cracks are accurately extracted, LSTM-Autoencoder reconstructs a theoretical vibration value based on historical data, the false judgment of tower body deformation caused by ice coating weight is eliminated, the similar signal characteristics of structural damage and environmental load are distinguished, a dynamic weighting fusion strategy is used for giving the main weight of voiceprint evidence, the decision ratio is adjusted to be high only when vibration deviation is obvious abnormality, and the false triggering risk of single-mode detection is avoided.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGCHENG COMMUNICATION ENG SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Hydrogen leakage positioning method for hydrogen station inspection robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrogen leakage positioning method for a hydrogen station inspection robot, belongs to the technical field of gas leakage detection and positioning, and solves the problems of low positioning precision, unscientific quantitative evaluation and slow emergency response caused by environmental interference due to insufficient detection precision of the existing hydrogen leakage source. The hydrogen leakage source position determining method comprises the steps that a patrol robot detects the hydrogen volume fraction in real time, when the hydrogen volume fraction is larger than a preset threshold value, the patrol robot takes the current position as an initial point position and carries out multiple movements and sampling along the determined hydrogen leakage source direction, corresponding local hydrogen concentration fields are respectively built based on sampling data of all the point positions, the patrol robot samples to obtain a sparse sampling data set at any one point position, a trained hydrogen concentration field reconstruction model is input, the local hydrogen concentration field around the point position is obtained through reconstruction, the hydrogen leakage source direction of the current point position is obtained based on the local hydrogen concentration field, and the position of the hydrogen leakage source is determined based on the point position coordinates and the corresponding hydrogen leakage source direction.
assignees: ZHONGAN GUOTAI BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;CHINA ACADEMY SAFETY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method and system for recovering abnormal call in trunking communication system
abstract_en: A method for recovering abnormal call in cluster communication system includes storing call information in real time by main MC server when call is established and synchronizing to standby MC server by database synchronization mechanism, presetting recovery strategy based on at least one dimension of call type, priority and speaking right state by user, judging whether call is in accordance with recovery condition by standby MC server after main and standby switching, generating SIPINVITE message containing reconstruction field by standby MC server in accordance with strategy, reassigning media port and constructing original media stream format for sending to terminal, analyzing field by terminal, setting up new media receiving channel and returning response for recovering media stream, sending SIPBYE message by standby MC server to end abnormal call if it is not in accordance with condition. The invention can ensure the service continuity of the cluster communication system during disaster recovery and backup switching and improve the reliability of the system.
assignees: SHENTIE SIGNAL TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD;SHENZHEN SED WIRELESS COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rock mass catastrophe acoustic wave detection sensing method and system for deep solid resource exploitation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of deep mineral resource development, and provides a rock disaster sound wave detection sensing method and system for deep solid resource exploitation, wherein an observation system is arranged, a controllable source is arranged in the middle of the observation system for excitation of earthquake waves, a sensor is arranged on a cutter head of exploitation equipment for detection of a passive source, and the positions of the controllable source and the sensor are adjustable, so that a certain depth adjustment range is provided; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a controllable seismic source to actively detect underground media, then conducting passive source detection, adopting a mutual interference method to process signals, removing mutual influence among sensors of an observation system, adopting a wave field superposition technology to enhance data of the signals processed by the mutual interference method, adopting a reverse time migration imaging technology to invert the enhanced signal data, and reconstructing a rock structure. The method solves the problem that the disaster information of the rock mass cannot be obtained in time in the traditional method.

title_en: Power distribution network important load post-disaster power supply recovery method based on data driving convex optimization
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network fault reconstruction, and particularly discloses a power supply recovery method after important load disaster of a power distribution network based on data driving convex optimization, which comprises the steps of carrying out island division on the power distribution network after fault according to the priority level of the load; the post-disaster power supply recovery method comprises the steps of carrying out reconstruction communication on each island by considering the position and output change of distributed resources such as an electric automobile and the like, constructing a power distribution network restorability reconstruction model, relaxing non-convex constraint conditions in the power distribution network reconstruction model by adopting a convex optimization method based on data driving, and solving to obtain a power distribution network reconstruction strategy and an important load. The method solves the problems that the non-convexity of the operation of the power grid is increased due to a large amount of access of distributed resources, various distributed resources are difficult to fully utilize by the existing method, and proper fault reconstruction results are difficult to obtain due to excessive relaxation of non-convexity constraint of the model when a reconstruction model is built, and the reliability of key load power supply and the economy of the load operation of the power distribution network are affected.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;AVIC CHENGDU AIRCRAFT DESIGN & RES INST

title_en: Method for identifying mao-bamboo forest snow disaster damage of airborne laser radar based on differential point cloud encryption strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forestry disaster monitoring, in particular to an identification method of an airborne laser radar phyllostachys pubescens disaster damage based on a differential point cloud encryption strategy; according to the method, the three-dimensional structure of the bamboo forest is reconstructed through fitting the axis of the bamboo trunk and image post-processing, different types of disaster damage are identified, virtual point clouds are generated to fill the scanning missing area, the accuracy of the axis of the bamboo trunk is effectively improved, the image expression of the bamboo trunk and the tree crowns is enhanced through layered reconstruction and principal component analysis technology, a finer disaster damage characteristic diagram is provided, and accurate disaster assessment is facilitated. In addition, the accuracy and reliability of disaster damage analysis are further improved through targeted image processing based on disaster damage types. In the whole, the invention provides high-efficiency and accurate technical support for post-disaster evaluation and ecological restoration of the bamboo forests.

title_en: Forest Fire Extinguishing System Using Drones
abstract_ko: 드론을 이용한 산불진화시스템은 소화전으로부터 소화수를 공급받아 소화수를 산불화재현장으로 이동시키는 소화호스체인, 소화호스체인의 길이방향을 따라 소정 간격으로 배치되며 영상을 촬영하는 드론카메라 및 외부장치와 통신하는 드론통신부를 갖는 복수의 드론, 복수의 드론과 통신하는 통신부, 사용자로부터 산불화재현장에 대한 위치정보를 수신하면 수신된 위치정보에 기초하여 복수의 드론이 소화호스체인을 들고 산불화재현장으로 이동하도록 제어하며, 복수의 드론으로부터 산불화재현장에 대한 산불화재영상을 수신하면 수신된 산불화재영상에 기초하여 산불화재현장에 소화수가 공급되도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: portable oxygen respirator
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 휴대용 산소 호흡기에 관한 것으로, 상세하게는 산소가 충진되는 산소통과, 상기 산소통 내부로 산소를 충진하는 충진 밸브와 산소통 외부로 산소를 배출하는 배출 밸브와, 상기 배출 밸브의 개폐를 위한 스위치와 산소가 배출되는 산소 배출관 및 산소통의 산소 잔량을 표시하는 잔량 센서와 산소통의 산소 농도를 표시하는 산소 센서와, 센서에서 수집된 정보를 외부로 표시하는 디스플레이부가 형성되며, 상기의 센서와 디스플레이부의 동작을 위한 전원부가 구비됨을 특징으로 한다. 
이러한 본 발명은 화재발생 또는 재난으로 인해 자연적인 산소 호흡이 곤란한 위급상항에서, 이동형 산소 호흡기를 통한 산소 호흡으로 사용자에게 산소를 공급하는 효과를 가진다.  
특히, 본 발명의 효과는 짧은 시간에 신속한 대피가 요구되는 화재현장이나, 밀폐공간에서 사용자에게 자가 호흡을 제공하므로, 사용자가 해당 위험지대에서 안전지대로 이동하는 시간을 제공하여, 사용자의 생명을 보전하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Open pit coal mine slope monitoring and early warning method and system by means of multimode satellite fusion AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses an open pit coal mine slope monitoring and early warning method and system by fusing multi-mode satellites with AI, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting multi-source data; S2, data transmission in real time, S3, data preprocessing and space-time registration, S4, multi-band InSAR phase reconstruction and deformation field extraction, S5, multi-source data depth fusion, S6, AI intelligent prediction and hierarchical early warning. By adopting the method and the system for monitoring and early warning the slope of the open pit coal mine by fusing the multimode satellite with the AI, the invention realizes the monitoring of the millimeter-level precision continuous deformation field of the whole area of the slope, reduces the vegetation topography shielding interference, expands the monitoring range, eliminates the monitoring blind area, improves the data processing efficiency, constructs the deformation field with high reliability, and reduces the early warning false alarm rate.
assignees: XINJIANG INST OF INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Electric fire extremely early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of early fire early warning, in particular to an electric fire extremely early warning system, which carries out pretreatment and interference intensity classification on a current signal through a data quality classification module and divides data into three interference intensities according to electromagnetic abnormal disturbance parameters. The multi-mode analysis module carries out differentiation processing aiming at different interference levels, namely extracting comprehensive feature vectors from the data of the first interference intensity and the second interference intensity and judging state deviation, and detecting potential electrical fire abnormality from the data of the third interference intensity through a compression reconstruction technology, so that false alarm caused by electromagnetic interference is effectively restrained. The intelligent early warning decision module further performs reliability evaluation on the data with fault bias, and comprehensively judges whether to trigger early warning. The system realizes accurate identification and early warning of the hidden danger of the electric fire disaster in the complex electromagnetic environment, and remarkably improves the early warning accuracy and reliability.

title_en: Multi-mode target identification method and system for low-altitude high-density high-isomerism unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode low-altitude high-density high-isomerism unmanned aerial vehicle target rapid and accurate identification method, and discloses a system and a medium of the multi-mode low-altitude high-density high-isomerism unmanned aerial vehicle target rapid and accurate identification method. Through high-quality characteristic reconstruction and scale self-adaptation mechanism, the system can realize the detection of fine and multi-category targets at different scale levels, provides accurate positioning and intelligent recognition capability for the electric power inspection unmanned aerial vehicle, and simultaneously provides real-time, stable and extensible visual basic support for quick response and target locking of the anti-unmanned aerial vehicle system. In the future, the framework can be expanded to a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicle cooperation scenes such as forest fire prevention, traffic monitoring, disaster emergency and the like, and has good universality and engineering application prospect.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ZIBO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Highway high slope deformation monitoring and disaster early warning method and system based on point cloud fusion and three-dimensional reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway high slope deformation monitoring and disaster early warning method and system based on point cloud fusion and three-dimensional reconstruction, and relates to the technical field of highway high slope monitoring. The method comprises a data acquisition step, a data preprocessing step, a point cloud data registration step, an analysis step and an early warning step. The invention combines the point cloud fusion and the three-dimensional reconstruction technology, can quickly acquire the slope slip condition and perform early warning, and establishes a highway high slope protection system integrating highway monitoring, early warning and disposal.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU BRANCH OF HENAN TRANSP INVESTMENT GROUP CO LTD;HENAN CHINA INDUSTRY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Storm surge coupling numerical simulation method and system based on climate change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm surge coupling numerical simulation method and system based on climate change, and relates to the technical field of numerical simulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the size of a regional grid according to pre-acquired regional characteristics, and carrying out data reconstruction processing on acquired heterogeneous space data based on the size of the regional grid to obtain a comprehensive heterogeneous data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a comprehensive heterogeneous model, carrying out model coupling to obtain a comprehensive coupling model, carrying out friction coefficient adjustment to obtain a storm surge coupling numerical simulation model, carrying out storm surge simulation on comprehensive observation data obtained in real time, and carrying out evaluation optimization on the storm surge coupling numerical simulation model to obtain a storm surge simulation model for storm surge coupling numerical simulation under climate change. The invention breaks through the limitation of the traditional single water increasing simulation through the comprehensive coupling model, and obviously improves the simulation capability of the polar water level, the near-shore water increasing and the composite disaster process.

title_en: Reservoir landslide displacement prediction method, storage medium and device based on dynamic hysteresis identification and fuzzy entropy optimization
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster prediction, and particularly provides a reservoir landslide displacement prediction method based on dynamic hysteresis identification and fuzzy entropy optimization, which comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing landslide time sequence monitoring data; combining a distributed lag nonlinear model with a maximum information coefficient, dynamically analyzing the lag relation between displacement and rainfall and reservoir water level by a sliding window, outputting a self-adaptive lag period and constructing a lag characteristic set, decomposing the self-adaptive decomposition displacement sequence by a fuzzy entropy optimized variation mode, determining the optimal mode number according to the minimum fuzzy entropy, reconstructing an eigen mode function into a trend, a period and a random term, extracting local characteristics of a multi-lag characteristic space by CNN, inputting the local characteristics and the reconstructed displacement component into GRU capturing time dependence, introducing a attention mechanism weighting key time step, and outputting a predicted value and a confidence interval by quantile regression. The method integrates dynamic hysteresis capture, self-adaptive decomposition and CNN-GRU-Attention, and realizes high-precision and high-robustness prediction.

title_en: Building structure thermal stress image analysis and fire risk assessment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal stress image analysis and fire risk assessment system of a building structure, which relates to the technical field of image analysis and fire risk assessment, and comprises an infrared thermal image acquisition and temperature field reconstruction module, a structural thermal stress calculation and failure risk prediction module, a material thermal physical characteristic database and self-adaptive correction module and a rescue safety path planning and real-time early warning module, through cooperation of multi-module deep coupling and closed loop, accurate analysis of thermal stress of a building structure and accurate prediction of failure risk under fire conditions are realized, scientific decision support is provided for fire rescue, and safety of rescue workers is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Elastic lifting method for power system under extreme climate condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to an elastic lifting method of an electric power system under extreme climate conditions, which aims at the extreme climate to exacerbate the fault risk of a cable line and a joint, establishes a fault rate model of the cable line and the joint, synthesizes cable parameters and an operation state, accurately evaluates the fault probability, provides data support for post-disaster recovery, and determines the position of a movable energy storage warehouse by designing a temporary warehouse site selection model in a pre-disaster stage and combining the line fault probability, a road network structure, the node load and the importance degree with the minimum expected power loss as a target so as to ensure the adjacent key load, reduce the resource allocation cost and promote the response speed. The method comprises the steps of calling mobile energy storage resources to participate in load recovery after disaster, balancing load recovery benefits and scheduling cost, reconstructing an optimal power flow model by combining a second-order cone constrained power system according to the mobile energy storage as emergency equipment, balancing recovery benefits and scheduling cost by reasonably scheduling the mobile energy storage resources, realizing quick recovery of load after disaster, and enhancing elasticity of the power system under extreme climate conditions.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Typhoon-resistant toughness enhancing method for net cage
