abstract_en: The application discloses a method for enhancing typhoon resistance of a net cage, which belongs to the technical field of marine culture equipment and comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional fluid-solid coupling model, carrying out fluid-solid coupling load calculation, quantifying the space-time distribution characteristic of coupling load on the net cage, simulating the stress-strain response of a net cage structure, positioning the weak part of the net cage, identifying a failure conduction path, combining the space-time distribution characteristic and the identification result of the failure conduction path, designing three-level enhancement measures to enhance toughness, carrying out simulation test, verifying structural stability, carrying out closed-loop optimization according to the verification result, being applicable to upgrading and reconstruction of the existing net cage, obviously improving the structural integrity maintaining capability of the net cage in typhoon environment, resisting high-grade typhoon impact, reducing economic loss caused by typhoon disasters, providing a new paradigm for design of marine culture equipment in extreme environment resistance, and having obvious industrial value and social benefit.

title_en: Low-carbon operation output optimization method and system suitable for low-carbonization reconstruction of coal-fired unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon operation output optimization method and system of a coal-fired unit suitable for low-carbonization transformation, which are characterized by selecting a biomass-doped coal-fired coupled carbon capture generator set under the condition of coal-electricity low-carbonization transformation to be researched to obtain relevant data of the transformed coal-fired unit, constructing a mechanism model of the biomass-doped coal-fired coupled carbon capture generator set under the condition of coal-electricity low-carbonization transformation by adopting a mechanism-data hybrid driving modeling method, constructing a low-carbon economic objective function of the biomass-doped coal-fired coupled carbon capture generator set under the condition of coal-electricity low-carbonization transformation, constructing a calculation model of relevant low-carbon economic parameters in the objective function, constructing constraint conditions of the biomass-doped coal-fired coupled carbon capture generator set under the condition of coal-electricity low-carbonization transformation, simultaneously constraining input and output variables of the mechanism model, analyzing and considering an optimal low-carbon economic operation output scheme under the condition uncertainty, and obtaining an optimization result of the operation output of the biomass-doped coal-fired coupled carbon capture generator set under the condition of uncertainty by minimizing the objective function. The invention can provide guidance for the operation output of the biomass blended combustion coal coupled carbon capture power station in each period of the day.

title_en: Rock mass structure intelligent detection method and system based on multi-platform cooperation and space-time evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock mass structure intelligent detection method and system based on multi-platform cooperation and space-time evolution, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and precise measurement. According to the method, firstly, a standardized acquisition task script decoupled from a hardware platform is generated according to geographic information of a target area through an independent task planning and control center, a scheduling unmanned aerial vehicle and a fixed track image acquisition device acquire multi-period high-frequency data according to a preset path, a pose and parameters, the acquired data are subjected to real-time three-dimensional reconstruction through a semantic SLAM flow enhanced by a nerve radiation field, and a multi-period point cloud map with geometric precision and semantic consistency is constructed. And encoding the multi-period point cloud data into a space-time diagram sequence, introducing a space-time diagram neural network (ST-GNN) to model and predict deformation evolution trend, outputting future deformation field and risk thermodynamic diagram, and realizing deformation region identification and hierarchical early warning. The intelligent closed loop from passive monitoring to active early warning of rock deformation is realized.
assignees: SICHUAN 915 CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;UNIV JILIN

title_en: Elevator intercom system based on AI real-time identification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent man-machine interaction, in particular to an elevator intercom system based on AI real-time identification. According to the invention, logic mapping is realized in a space domain through voice tasks, the corresponding relation between voice instructions and positions is more accurate, structural processing is allocated to instruction identification and tasks, concurrent conflict and channel interference are reduced, dynamic reconstruction of conversation contents during alternating between manual intercom and intelligent voice accompaniment is kept, semantic continuity and smooth communication are kept, the rhythm is regulated and controlled according to state lock values in the execution of the semantic tasks, instruction dislocation and response lag is avoided, multi-car voice resource distribution is spatially optimized, communication channel interference is restrained, voice interaction forms a cooperative mechanism on safety, response efficiency and semantic consistency, and emergency response stability and interaction continuous experience are improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN LINGYUN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Health detection method, device and equipment for power transmission tower and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a health detection method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of a power transmission tower, and relates to the technical field of electric power, comprising the steps of converting a plurality of metal rods of the power transmission tower into space truss units, and connecting the space truss units based on a structural design drawing to obtain a simulation result of the power transmission tower; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an analysis result by using a normal load standard static analysis iron tower simulation result, carrying out modal analysis on the iron tower simulation result under the working condition of no external disturbance to obtain a modal analysis result, constructing reference data, reconstructing an image acquisition result to obtain a point cloud model, carrying out filtering and curved surface fitting to obtain a target space coordinate, exciting the iron tower simulation result, analyzing the excitation result to obtain a dynamic analysis result, carrying out differential analysis on the dynamic analysis result and the target space coordinate and the reference data to obtain a difference matrix, determining a health detection result of the power transmission iron tower after forest fire, and improving the efficiency of detecting the power transmission iron tower.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Two-dimensional data local differential privacy distribution estimation method based on improvement of expectation maximization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional data local differential privacy distribution estimation method based on an expectation maximization algorithm improvement. The terminal equipment acquires two-dimensional numerical value type private data of the user, maps the two-dimensional numerical value type private data to a predefined two-dimensional grid domain, and generates disturbance data by applying a two-dimensional disturbance mechanism meeting local differential privacy and sends the disturbance data to the aggregation server. The aggregation server builds a non-uniform grid based on the edge distribution characteristics of noise data to compress dimensions, builds a compressed two-dimensional transfer probability matrix by utilizing the Kroneck product of a one-dimensional transfer matrix, performs dimension reduction preprocessing on the data, then executes an improved expectation maximization iterative algorithm, applies a maximum entropy regularization strategy in the maximization step, builds a log-likelihood objective function containing a shannon entropy regularization term, and calculates a new distribution estimation vector by utilizing a nonlinear update formula based on a Lambert W function or power law scaling. The method effectively solves the problem of dimension disaster in two-dimensional distribution estimation, inhibits the overfitting phenomenon under sparse data through maximum entropy regularization, and remarkably improves the calculation efficiency and accuracy of two-dimensional numerical distribution reconstruction.
assignees: GUANGZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF XIDIAN UNIV

title_en: Loess landslide displacement prediction method and system based on improved education competition optimization algorithm and ICEEMDAN-LSSVM
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of landslide displacement prediction, and discloses a loess landslide displacement prediction method based on an improved education competition optimization algorithm and ICEEMDAN-LSSVM, which comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing and normalizing acquired landslide data; decomposing the original displacement sequence into a plurality of eigenvalue functions and residual items by using self-adaptive noise complete set empirical mode decomposition (ICEEMDAN), establishing a Least Squares Support Vector Machine (LSSVM) model, and adopting an improved education competition optimization algorithm (IECO) to automatically optimize the nuclear parameters and penalty coefficients. The IECO algorithm enhances population diversity through Latin hypercube sampling, and introduces a self-adaptive t distribution variation and multi-scale Gaussian collaborative variation strategy to realize dynamic balance of global exploration and local development. And finally, overlapping and reconstructing the prediction results of all the components to complete the displacement prediction. The method has the advantages of high prediction precision, strong robustness and the like, and provides reliable technical support for landslide disaster early warning, prevention and control.

title_en: Intelligent fire fighting big data analysis method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire fighting big data analysis method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting multi-source fire fighting monitoring data of an intelligent fire fighting system, generating a fire fighting time sequence data set, S2, marking time sequence breakpoints, identifying key breakpoints, generating a breakpoint marking data set, S3, constructing an improved PatchTST model, introducing a breakpoint reconstruction layer, generating a counterfactual track candidate set, S4, constructing reinforcement learning state vectors, setting reinforcement learning action space, constructing reinforcement learning environment, S5, constructing reinforcement learning reward functions, executing strategy updating, generating fire fighting decision results, S6, executing stability analysis and retraining operation, and forming updated fire fighting decision results through incremental strategy updating operation. The invention improves the analysis capability and the treatment efficiency of the intelligent fire protection system to the complex fire evolution process.
assignees: LIAONING CHUANGRONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Quick water supply fire extinguishing system for forest fire control
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of forest fire control equipment and emergency rescue, and discloses a rapid water supply fire extinguishing system for forest fire control, which comprises a hydraulic relay unit, a self-adaptive rapid connection hose and a command and dispatch platform, wherein the hydraulic relay unit integrates an unmanned mobile chassis, a water storage bag, a micro pump with double modes of pumping and turbine generators and an energy subsystem, the command and dispatch platform is used for planning deployment points of the hydraulic relay unit according to three-dimensional topographic data and dispatching a heavy-duty unmanned aerial vehicle cluster to carry out air drop, the mobile chassis is linked with an intelligent connection port after an HRU lands, the self-adaptive rapid connection hose is assisted to complete automatic alignment and locking of waterways, circuits and communication links, and the platform is also responsible for symbiotic full-link resonance pumping, hydropower network operation and dynamic position reconstruction. The application solves the problems of slow water supply deployment, poor maneuverability, low energy efficiency and insufficient adaptability in complex terrains.
assignees: HANGZHOU EPOCHFIRE SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Substation network topology disaster recovery optimization method based on heterogeneous graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation network topology disaster recovery optimization method based on a heterogeneous graph neural network, which comprises the steps of modeling a heterogeneous graph of the transformer substation network to obtain a heterogeneous graph neural network model with multiple types of nodes and multiple relation edges, constructing a multiple-time-slice graph under normal and abnormal evolution scenes to record the time characteristics of the network, performing inverse fact simulation evaluation by using the heterogeneous graph neural network, defining inverse fact knockout influence by the reduction of toughness indexes after nodes are removed and the reduction of toughness indexes after edges are removed, training the heterogeneous graph neural network model according to the impact, and performing topology reconstruction optimization on the trained heterogeneous graph neural network model through a mask mechanism. The method utilizes the heterogeneous graph neural network to encode the graph structure and the multi-type characteristics thereof, carries out soft selection on the nodes and links with larger potential influence, combines the micro-optimized objective function and the constraint condition, and outputs an executable topology reconstruction and link weight adjustment scheme.

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network optimization reconstruction method based on distributed power supply participation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power distribution network optimization reconstruction method based on distributed power supply participation, which relates to the technical field of power distribution network optimization reconstruction and comprises the following steps of inputting a frequency state discrete vector set into a disturbance cross recognition model, calculating a frequency disturbance propagation factor and a response difference gradient between any two distributed power supplies based on a disturbance sensitivity algorithm of covariance deviation judgment, and recognizing a frequency disturbance source and a frequency inconsistency problem according to a determined local frequency state; constructing an adaptation capability assessment tensor, fusing a frequency disturbance propagation factor, a response difference gradient and a frequency state discrete vector set, executing fuzzy clustering and weight self-adaptive fusion mapping operation, generating a frequency adaptation index, and judging grid-connected adaptation capability of an island region. The method solves the technical problem that the frequency control isomerism of the post-disaster island region is difficult to identify the grid-connected suitability, and realizes the safety and coordination judgment of the multi-source isomerism distributed power supply access.

title_en: BS-based page plug-in-free communication system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of computer network communication, and discloses a BS-based page plug-in-free communication system, which operates in a browser Service workbench environment, intercepts a view layer request through a virtual gateway layer, and establishes a unique stream backbone tunnel with a server by utilizing a standard HTTP protocol. The system is internally provided with a request interception and serialization module, a global time sequence label is distributed for concurrent requests through maintaining a virtual logic clock, a data frame sequence with strict whole sequence is constructed, and a transactional sender box module is adopted to synchronously write data into a local persistent storage before network transmission, so that the data integrity is ensured. When the network abnormality is monitored, the failover reconstruction module freezes the sending state and performs data sequence replay based on the breakpoint confirmed by the server after connection reconstruction. The application solves the problem of multi-label page connection resource consumption, ensures the consistency of service logic sequences, and realizes the persistent disaster recovery and the non-inductive recovery of broken networks of communication data.
assignees: NINGXIA VOCATIONAL TECHNICAL UNIV NINGXIA OPEN UNIV

title_en: Intelligent fire event analysis method based on multi-mode fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting event intelligent analysis method based on multi-mode fusion, which comprises the following steps of collecting fire-fighting data to generate a multi-mode input sequence, preprocessing to generate a multi-mode preprocessing sequence, executing asynchronous mode self-adaptive time calibration according to a physical evolution mechanism of a fire-fighting event to generate a calibration feature sequence, executing mode degradation detection to generate a mode degradation judgment result, executing inverse reconstruction according to the mode degradation judgment result to obtain fusion input features, creating event nodes based on the fusion input features to generate a topological time sequence coupling diagram structure, executing recursive reasoning on the topological time sequence coupling diagram structure input diagram neural network to generate a fire-fighting event state identification result and an event development trend prediction result, and generating fire-fighting event risk output data according to the result. The invention adopts multi-mode fusion and graph neural network reasoning to realize the accurate recognition and trend prediction of the fire event, and has the advantages of strong synchronism, high robustness and reliable early warning.

title_en: Intelligent tracing system and method for mine disaster water source
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent tracing system and method for mine disaster water sources, and belongs to the technical fields of mine safety production, flood control and disaster emergency treatment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a hydraulic network diagram based on hydrological data acquired in real time by each observation point sensor in a mine roadway, reconstructing a mine global flow field in the hydraulic network diagram, carrying out path backtracking along the reverse water flow direction based on the mine global flow field, generating a plurality of reverse backtracking paths, calculating cumulative probability weights corresponding to all positions of the mine according to probability weights of all reverse backtracking paths, and drawing a probability thermal distribution diagram by using the cumulative probability weights of all positions. According to the method, path backtracking is carried out along the reverse water flow direction, potential water source positions are estimated from each observation point at the same time, a plurality of reverse paths are formed, probability weights of the reverse paths are calculated, the most probable water source areas can be identified under the complex roadway network and multi-source water inrush conditions, and decision reference value of identification results is improved.

title_en: Landslide motion simulation method taking terrain reconstruction into consideration
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide motion simulation method considering terrain reconstruction, which solves the logic contradiction of the traditional method that the terrain simulation is performed after landslide. The method collects high-precision terrain, square quantity, geological parameters and rainfall data after landslide, iteratively corrects the terrain before landslide by volume conservation, reasonable flow direction and flow rate and rock-soil body strength adaptation constraint by taking the terrain after landslide as a starting point, and forward simulates the landslide movement process, inversion speed, acceleration, stacking depth and other information based on the reconstructed terrain by coupling rainfall infiltration, pore water pressure evolution model and a material point method. The invention eliminates initial condition errors from the root, has high simulation precision, and provides a scientific tool for landslide mechanism research and disaster prevention.

title_en: Disaster early warning and emergency resource intelligent dynamic allocation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligent optimization operating systems and discloses an intelligent dynamic allocation system for disaster early warning and emergency resources, which comprises an input mapping unit, a drift monitoring unit, a topology evolution controller, a double-tower reasoning unit, an output fusion unit and an allocation instruction, wherein the input mapping unit maps non-stationary time sequence data streams into node characteristic tensors, the drift monitoring unit judges characteristic distribution drift based on Kullback-Leibler divergence, the topology evolution controller calculates a reconstruction structure by using a Hubble rule and covariance when the divergence is over-limited, and constructs a dynamic pruning threshold according to synaptic age, and the double-tower reasoning unit parallelly operates a static base and a dynamic residual sub-network and outputs an allocation instruction.
assignees: HUNAN XIANGJIANG CITY OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Underground temperature field reconstruction and thermal disaster early warning method and system based on acoustic tomography
abstract_en: A method for reconstructing underground temperature field and early warning thermal disasters based on acoustic tomography includes arranging explosion-proof loudspeaker arrays and microphone arrays on two sides of a roadway in a monitoring area in a staggered mode, synchronously transmitting/receiving multi-frequency-band acoustic waves by utilizing a frequency division multiplexing technology to form a physical acoustic wave path data set, constructing an overdetermined equation set, realizing virtual path enhancement by adopting a virtual sound ray method, realizing high-resolution temperature field reconstruction of a roadway cross-section temperature field by combining a sound velocity-temperature linear model, inputting continuous multi-frame temperature field images into a TimesNet model, extracting multi-scale features by self-adaptive period decomposition and two-dimensional space-time convolution, and outputting fire early warning grades and abnormal area coordinates. The system comprises an explosion-proof loudspeaker array, a microphone array, an edge computing node and an upper computer, wherein the edge computing node is respectively connected with the explosion-proof loudspeaker array and the upper computer. The invention can realize the global temperature sensing and hidden fire source advanced early warning of the target monitoring area.
assignees: HUAIBEI MINING IND CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING;HUAIBEI VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Identity and flight trajectory-based unmanned aerial vehicle network double-factor authentication method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an identity authentication method in the field of information security, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle network double-factor authentication method based on identity and flight trajectories. The method comprises the stages of system initialization, unmanned aerial vehicle registration, authentication, key negotiation and the like, and realizes safe bidirectional authentication of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a ground control station by verifying the identity mark and flight path characteristic double factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle and combining technologies such as dynamic false identity updating, digital signature and the like, and can be suitable for application scenes such as military reconnaissance, disaster relief, agricultural plant protection and the like. The invention solves the problems of weak security, insufficient anti-attack capability and the like of the prior proposal, and realizes eight security requirements of message authentication, message validity, anonymity and untraceability, forward security, known key security, physical capture attack resistance, replay attack resistance, counterfeit attack resistance and the like, thereby ensuring confidentiality, integrity and availability of communication data.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system based on multi-temporal remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system based on multi-temporal remote sensing images, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and are used for collecting multi-temporal SAR images and multi-temporal multi-spectral optical images of a target area and carrying out standardized processing, carrying out super-resolution reconstruction and registration on the images after the standardized processing to generate a multi-modal remote sensing data cube, inputting the multi-modal remote sensing data cube into a pre-trained deep learning model, carrying out inversion and outputting a physical parameter map, dynamically calibrating parameters and boundary conditions of a three-dimensional geomechanical model pre-constructed for the target area based on the physical parameter map, and utilizing the dynamically calibrated three-dimensional geomechanical model to predict and generate a space-time evolution map and critical instability time, carrying out uncertainty fusion analysis on the physical parameter map, the space-time evolution map and the critical instability time, and generating dynamic hierarchical early warning information according to fusion analysis results.
assignees: EAST CHINA UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY NANCHANG CAMPUS

title_en: Mangrove forest ecological restoration system after standardized typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a mangrove ecological restoration system after a standardized typhoon disaster. The method comprises the steps of dividing disaster degrees of typhoon damaged mangroves into heavy disasters, medium disasters and light disasters based on remote sensing images and field investigation, carrying out lodging tree classification cleaning operation and landform restoration aiming at the heavy disasters, selecting large seedlings for field planting in combination with tidal flat elevation to form reconstruction of a standardized mangrove ecological system, carrying out pruning and supplementing planting operation based on forest windows aiming at the medium disasters, improving primary forest stand recovery efficiency, adopting unmanned motor to monitor forest stand canopy closure degree aiming at the light disasters, and adopting corresponding grade intervention to realize accurate restoration. According to the method, the tidal flat environment and the salinity are based to adapt to the species of the rural tree, and differential restoration operation is adopted, so that the cooperative reconstruction of the mangrove ecological system structure and the coast protection function is realized, and the limitation of traditional restoration is broken through by a standardized operation system.
assignees: HAINAN ACADEMY OF FORESTRY HAINAN MANGROVE RESEARCH INST

title_en: Mountain fire disaster risk assessment method based on interaction relation of mountain fire and electric power facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain fire disaster risk assessment method based on interaction relation of mountain fire and electric power facilities, and particularly relates to the field of safety monitoring and disaster risk assessment of electric power systems, which comprises the steps of acquiring monitoring data by utilizing satellite remote sensing equipment, an unmanned aerial vehicle observation device and a ground meteorological sensor, performing space-time correction on each source of monitoring data according to time stamps and geographic coordinates, adjusting sampling density according to related weights, and outputting a monitoring data sequence; the invention realizes continuous collection of monitoring data, self-adaptive evaluation of node states and real-time coupling calculation of risk results by constructing a multi-layer data closed-loop flow integrating multi-source monitoring, dynamic transmission, health prediction and path reconstruction, so as to solve the problem of risk evaluation misalignment caused by unstable data transmission and fault prediction hysteresis in the prior art.
assignees: JILIN ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle infrared image enhancement method for disaster risk early warning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle infrared image enhancement method for disaster risk early warning, and relates to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a low-quality infrared image, carrying out degradation treatment on the low-quality infrared image by utilizing a self-adaptive quantization model based on Gaussian distribution to generate a quantized image, carrying out preliminary super-resolution reconstruction on the quantized image by utilizing a multi-level feature fusion network to obtain a rough restored image, encoding the image into a latent space, carrying out reverse denoising by utilizing a pre-trained potential diffusion model taking the image as a condition to reconstruct latent features rich in texture details, decoding the latent features back into the image space, carrying out post-treatment by utilizing a denoising device based on a transform, and generating a final high-quality and high-reality infrared image so as to remarkably improve the accuracy and reliability of subsequent disaster identification and early warning.
assignees: JIEYANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ocean solitary wave triggering submarine landslide risk monitoring device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean geological disaster monitoring, and discloses a submarine landslide risk monitoring device triggered by ocean solitary waves and a use method thereof, wherein the device comprises an outer frame; the hydraulic driving mechanism is arranged in the outer frame and used for driving the outer frame to move along the up-down direction, the monitoring sensing array is arranged in the outer frame and comprises an oil bag compensation bin positioned at the top, a penetrating cone tip positioned at the bottom, a plurality of natural potential sensing sections and pore water temperature pressure sensing sections positioned between the oil bag compensation bin and the penetrating cone tip, and the vibration penetrating assembly is arranged in the outer frame and used for outputting exciting force along the vertical direction. The number of pore water temperature pressure sensing sections and natural potential sensing sections can be flexibly increased and decreased according to the monitoring requirements of different sea areas, the whole structure is not required to be reconstructed, and the technical problems of poor adaptability and high reconstruction cost of the existing integrated structure are solved. The penetration and recovery are stable and reliable, the environment and operation adaptability are outstanding, and the recovery efficiency and the operation reliability under the complex marine environment are obviously improved.

title_en: Method for integrally designing, separating and sectionally constructing explosion-proof wall facility of dangerous chemical fire station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for integrally designing and separating and sectionally constructing an explosion-proof wall of a dangerous chemical fire station, belongs to the technical field of dangerous chemical storage and fire protection engineering, and aims to solve the technical problems that the existing explosion-proof wall of the dangerous chemical fire station is long in overall construction period, large in construction and operation interference, inconvenient to later-stage reconstruction and maintenance, and disjoint in explosion-proof and fireproof functions. The method realizes the efficient construction and function integration of the anti-explosion wall facilities through the core flow of integral function planning, separation segmentation splitting, modularization prefabrication, site segmentation installation, system linkage debugging and segmentation acceptance and application, synchronously integrates the anti-explosion and explosion venting integrated structure, links the anti-explosion wall units constructed in a segmentation way through an interconnection pipe network component, realizes the hierarchical absorption of explosion impact, the dynamic scheduling of fire-fighting media and the active response of fire extinguishing and explosion suppression, gives consideration to construction flexibility and protection reliability, adapts to the construction requirements of dangerous fire-fighting stations with different scales and different site conditions, greatly shortens the construction period, reduces the construction risk, and is convenient for later operation and maintenance and function upgrading.
assignees: HAIBO XIAOAN DESIGN GUANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Landslide multi-time scale displacement prediction method based on time sequence and physical double-flow structure
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and particularly discloses a landslide multi-time scale displacement prediction method based on a time sequence and physical double-flow structure, which comprises the steps of preprocessing data of an original displacement sequence, and carrying out multi-scale signal decomposition and noise reduction signal reconstruction by adopting ensemble empirical mode decomposition to obtain a displacement sequence after noise reduction; the method comprises the steps of inputting a noise-reduced displacement sequence into a prediction model to obtain a global time sequence dependency feature, determining physical feature quantity based on the noise-reduced displacement sequence, inputting the physical feature quantity into a gradient lifting tree model to perform nonlinear mapping and feature embedding to obtain a physical constraint feature, performing bidirectional interaction and weighted fusion on the global time sequence dependency feature and the physical constraint feature by using a common attention mechanism, and inputting fusion characterization vectors into a plurality of parallel regressors to respectively obtain landslide displacement prediction values with multiple time scales. The generalization capability and the prediction precision of the model can be improved through the application.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;CSCEC INT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method based on troposphere delay decoupling
abstract_en: The application discloses a geological disaster early warning method based on troposphere delay decoupling, which relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring and navigation positioning, and comprises the steps of multi-modal data space-time synchronous acquisition; the method comprises the steps of performing geological decoupling on a troposphere delay component, converting atmospheric noise into a geological signal, constructing delay-catastrophe parameter dynamic mapping, performing terrain self-adaptive reference station dynamic reconstruction, performing virtual GNSS reference point network with the same height as a monitoring point by using Digital Elevation Model (DEM) dynamic reconstruction, performing three-dimensional reconstruction on a disaster risk field, fusing delay mapping factors and ground surface deformation data to generate a multi-dimensional risk field, constructing an early warning threshold self-evolution mechanism, and constructing a multi-cascade control early warning decision. The method can improve the accuracy of geological disaster early warning and provide intelligent technical support for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: NO 230 RESEARCH INST OF NUCLEAR INDUSTRY

title_en: QR-Code-Based Authentication for Closed Mesh Networks
abstract_en: A method for secure onboarding to a closed mesh network in which a camera-equipped device scans a QR code embedded in a durable physical carrier (e.g., adhesive bandages, photographs, ID cards) to extract an access credential, configuration profile, or secure URL that automatically configures the device for network access, authenticates the device to the mesh without manual credential entry or transmission of plaintext credentials over insecure channels, and establishes end-to-end encrypted communications between network nodes; the method supports cryptographically random, single-use or time-limited credentials with periodic refresh to prevent replay, encoding of VPN/WireGuard or proprietary configuration profiles, substantially real-time onboarding (e.g., under five seconds), optional multi-factor verification (biometric or PIN), immediate initiation of secure messaging, voice/video or data sessions upon onboarding, audit logging for compliance and revocation based on detected unauthorized activity, and covert or overt embedding of QR codes in environment-resistant carriers for emergency, disaster response, first responder, or covert deployment, with the QR code rendered unreadable or deactivated after successful onboarding to prevent credential reuse.

title_en: Multi-event superimposed disaster indirect economic impact assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster indirect economic impact assessment method based on multi-event superposition. The evaluation method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster condition data of multi-disaster events in a target area, constructing a simulation framework based on an improved inter-area dynamic input-output model, dynamically tracking the conduction of economic losses in an industrial chain network by taking day as time resolution, introducing an excess capacity mechanism into the model, only allowing production departments in the disaster-affected area to operate under overload under the driving of reconstruction requirements, realizing the internal simulation of a post-disaster recovery process, forcibly superposing new external disturbance at each disaster occurrence time point in the simulation process, realizing continuous disturbance simulation of the multi-disaster events, and effectively capturing accumulated pressure and nonlinear amplification effects generated by the interruption of the recovery process. By comparing single disaster benchmark scenes, extra economic cost brought by disaster superposition is quantified, and scientific basis is provided for improving regional economic toughness.

title_en: Multi-degradation flame image recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-degradation flame image recovery method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting a smoke sample and a flame real image of a cable fire in real time by simulating the situation of a high-voltage cable fire of an underground pipe gallery in reality, constructing an atmospheric scattering model, combining the smoke sample characteristics of the cable fire, generating smoke degradation images under various working conditions based on the flame real image, constructing and training a smoke image enhancement model based on an improved DCGAN framework, wherein the smoke image enhancement model comprises a generator and a discriminator, the generator is used for reconstructing the smoke degradation image to generate a flame restoration image, and the discriminator is used for carrying out true and false judgment on the flame restoration image and the real flame image, so that the difference between the flame restoration image and the flame real image is ensured to be continuously optimized by the generator. The invention effectively removes the dense smoke interference, restores the occluded image details and provides clear and reliable visual information for the subsequent fire disaster identification.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;FUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Landslide hidden danger identification method, device and storage medium based on three-dimensional geometrical morphology features of slope plane section and machine learning model
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide hidden danger identification method, a device and a storage medium based on three-dimensional geometric features of a slope plane section and a machine learning model, relating to the technical field of landslide hidden danger identification and comprising the steps of acquiring the planar geometric features and the section geometric features of a slope unit based on a main sliding surface and a main section of the slope unit of a historical landslide disaster or known landslide hidden danger point in a target working area; the method comprises the steps of standardizing high-dimensional slope geometric feature data to obtain corresponding high-dimensional geometric feature vectors, inputting a sample set into a trained self-encoder model, outputting corresponding reconstructed feature vectors, determining a discrimination threshold value, inputting the high-dimensional geometric feature vectors corresponding to all target slope units to be identified extracted from a target working area into the self-encoder model, obtaining corresponding reconstruction errors through calculation of the self-encoder model, judging potential landslide hidden danger, and eliminating isolated erroneous judgment units in the potential landslide hidden danger. By adopting the identification method provided by the invention, the hidden danger of landslide can be identified rapidly and accurately.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INST GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECHNOLOGY GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIS;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;YUNNAN GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INST YUNNAN ENVIRONMENTAL GEOLOGY RESEARCH INST;BEIJING SHUSHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Channel transformation structure for loess plateau landslide flow disaster chain control and construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of loess plateau hilly and gully region collapse flow disaster chain treatment, in particular to a channel reconstruction structure and construction method for loess plateau collapse flow disaster chain control. The source area is provided with an energy dissipation device and a matched step at the upper half part of the ellipse and the lower half part of the trapezoid, the superposition area is provided with a diversion pile, a sedimentation channel, a diversion channel and a flood discharging channel, the sedimentation channel is internally provided with a siltation farmland and a drainage blind ditch, the dam area comprises a flood discharging section, a sedimentation section and a drainage step, and the corresponding area of the channel side slope is provided with an excavation step. The construction firstly carries out engineering geological investigation and data supplementation, then carries out regional transformation by an algorithm, and finally regularly dredging and maintaining. The structure and the method realize channel energy dissipation, siltation utilization and flood control, and adapt to loess plateau landslide flow disaster chain channel treatment requirements.

title_en: Intelligent early warning method for abnormal oxygen concentration of intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for intelligently pre-warning abnormal oxygen concentration of intelligent equipment, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent equipment of power grids, and comprises the steps of preprocessing an original monitoring data sequence through a sliding window to extract an environment physiological feature vector, inputting a lightweight oxygen deficiency abnormal recognition model trained based on a dynamic topology reconstruction sparse connection learning framework to perform reasoning calculation to output abnormal risk scores of oxygen concentration, judging abnormal grades according to the risk scores, starting a corresponding grading pre-warning mode, dynamically adjusting the sampling frequency of a sensor, the transmitting power of a wireless communication module and a video transmission strategy under different pre-warning grades, packaging the abnormal grades, monitoring data and personnel position coordinates into pre-warning data packets, and uploading the pre-warning data packets to a monitoring center server in real time to trigger an emergency response flow, so that the technical problem that the real-time accurate pre-warning of the abnormal oxygen concentration of the wearable intelligent equipment is difficult to realize under the condition of limited resources is solved.
assignees: STATE GRID CO LTD SPECIAL HIGH VOLTAGE CONSTRUCTION BRANCH

title_en: ARM architecture-oriented hybrid precision and vectorization collaborative optimization CGFDM seismic wave solver and simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CGFDM seismic wave solver and a simulation method for ARM architecture-oriented hybrid precision and vectorization collaborative optimization, which aim to break through the memory bandwidth and calculation efficiency bottleneck of ARM platform seismic simulation. According to the method, firstly, the key physical quantity is adapted to the FP16 range through dimensionless reconstruction of an elastic wave equation, and the mixed precision strategy of FP16 storage and FP32 calculation is adopted, so that the memory consumption is reduced by about 50% on the premise of ensuring the precision. Secondly, aiming at ARM Scalable Vector Expansion (SVE), CGFDM differential templates are mapped to vector registers, SIMD parallel computation is realized, and throughput is remarkably improved. Finally, the FP16-SVE solver realizes data rearrangement and conversion between FP16/FP32, solves the alignment and efficiency problems in mixed precision operation, and realizes synchronous improvement of storage and calculation efficiency. Tests show that the method can maintain the accuracy, simultaneously halve the memory and obtain a speed-up ratio of approximately 3 times, and provides an efficient scheme for ARM platform large-scale earthquake simulation and real-time disaster evaluation.
assignees: NAT SUPERCOMPUTING CENTER IN SHENZHEN SHENZHEN CLOUD COMPUTING CENTER

title_en: Image high-quality transmission reconstruction method oriented to complex channel environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication and image semantic transmission, and provides an image high-quality transmission reconstruction method facing to a complex channel environment, which comprises the following steps of extracting and encoding multi-scale semantic features of an image to be transmitted to obtain multi-scale encoding features; the channel state sensing modulation module is used for carrying out channel state driven self-adaptive modulation on the multi-scale coding features to generate potential features, carrying out power normalization operation on the potential features to obtain real-value potential signals meeting the constraint of transmitting power, carrying out space anti-interference reconstruction on the real-value potential signals to obtain channel input features, transmitting the channel input features to a receiving end through a wireless physical channel to be processed to obtain channel output features, and inputting the channel output features into a decoder to carry out multi-scale feature decoding to output reconstructed images. The invention can maintain the structural integrity and semantic legibility of disaster images under extremely low signal-to-noise ratio, and is suitable for emergency communication, unmanned aerial vehicle disaster monitoring and other scenes.

title_en: Breath apparatus for fire fighting
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방용 공기공급장치에 관한 것으로, 안면부에 형성되는 호흡기 산소분압(P3)을 검출하는 PO2 센서를 구비하며, 화재현장에서 활동하는 소방관 안면부에 착용되며 안면마스크; 상기 압력조절기에 연통하는 공급관로의 일측에 연결설치되며, 상기 공기가 미리 설정된 압력(P1)으로 내부에 충진되는 제1 공기저장 용기; 상기 공급관로의 타측에 연결설치되며, 산소가 미리 설정된 압력(P2)으로 내부에 충진되는 제2 산소저장용기; 상기 공급관로에 설치되는 PO2 조절밸브; 소방관의 생체상태신호(VS)를 검출하기 위해, 상기 안면마스크 일측에 설치되는 호흡검출센서; 상기 P1의 압력이 미리 설정된 범위 이하로 판단되고, 상기 생체상태 신호(VS)는 미리 설정된 기준값 이하로 판단되며, 상기 호흡기 산소분압(P3)이 기준값 이하로 판단되는 경우, 상기 PO2 조절밸브의 개구도를 비례적으로 제어하여 상기 호흡기 산소분압(P3)을 기준값 범위 이내로 조절하는 제어기할 수 있다.

title_en: Visual inspection method for multi-risk prevention and control power transmission line channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-risk prevention and control visual inspection method for a transmission line channel, which relates to the field of monitoring of risk hidden dangers of a transmission line and comprises the following steps of collecting multi-source data of the transmission line channel, reconstructing three-dimensional space coordinates of a transmission line and a risk source by using monocular depth estimation corrected by catenary constraint, and extracting a risk source motion vector by using a dense optical flow algorithm; and constructing a dynamic graph structure based on the transmission line physical safety margin, inputting the dynamic graph structure into a deep neural network, carrying out multidimensional feature fusion analysis, outputting risk types and risk grades, and executing hierarchical acousto-optic separation. The invention is used for solving the problems of easy misjudgment and delayed emergency response of the transmission line inspection.
assignees: XUANCHENG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;CEEC ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network rapid reconstruction and emergency power supply recovery method oriented to extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid reconstruction and emergency power supply recovery method of a power distribution network facing extreme weather in the field of emergency management of an electric power system, which is used for constructing an integrated emergency response framework integrating multisource data sensing, intelligent decision and cooperative control and realizing accurate positioning of fault minutes through meteorological early warning, satellite remote sensing, unmanned aerial vehicle inspection and fault indicator data; the method comprises the steps of providing an offline previewing-online matching rapid reconstruction strategy based on deep reinforcement learning and graph theory fusion, pre-constructing a typical disaster scene plan library, rapidly activating an optimal plan by combining real-time information, forming a dynamic island by using a distributed power supply, mobile energy storage and a micro-grid, realizing millisecond self-healing of a non-fault power-losing area, introducing an elastic evaluation index to optimize a recovery path, and preferentially guaranteeing key loads. The invention obviously improves the disaster resistance toughness and the power supply recovery speed of the power distribution network and provides an intelligent solution for safe and stable operation of the power grid in extreme weather.
assignees: LUOYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fire initial behavior inversion method based on crowdsourcing video space-time alignment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire monitoring and emergency rescue, and particularly relates to a fire initial behavior inversion method based on crowdsourcing video space-time alignment, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring a multi-source crowdsourcing video stream; the method comprises the steps of S2, carrying out short-time Fourier transform (STFT) on each audio track to extract spectrum characteristics, S3, determining the relative pose of each video shooting device, S4, establishing a smoke plume root estimation model, and S5, carrying out 3D scene reconstruction based on the relative pose and the fire point coordinates to generate a virtual animation comprising the fire point labeling and the fire point spreading process. According to the invention, through the combination of the rough alignment of the audio fingerprints and the precise matching of the visual features, the space-time unification of the multi-source crowded-package video is realized, the technical problems of non-unification of time stamps and messy visual angles of videos of different sources are solved, the time alignment error is controlled at millisecond level, and the space alignment precision meets the positioning requirement of the fire point.
assignees: JINAN JIAMU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: PostgreSQL file system level transient recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PostgreSQL file system level instantaneous recovery method and system, and relates to the technical field of disaster recovery backup. The method applied to the backup end comprises the steps of receiving and storing an initial full-volume backup image of a database, analyzing a file change data structure body, updating a metadata file, a reverse incremental log file and the full-volume backup image according to operation types, marking a recovery consistent point in the metadata file, synthesizing a virtual file at a specified time point and mounting the virtual file to a generating end and a recovery end, and receiving and storing database file change data redirected by the recovery end. The backup end system comprises a first synchronization module, a change data receiving module, a change data analyzing module, an updating module, a recovery point management module, a virtual file creating module and a post-recovery change receiving module. The invention can quickly restore the PostgreSQL database to any appointed time point by replaying the transaction log, ensures the consistency of data and obviously shortens the restoring time.

title_en: Nuclear accident environment gamma radiation field reconstruction method based on same-variable assimilation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nuclear accident environment gamma radiation field reconstruction method based on same variable assimilation, which comprises the steps of constructing an initial gamma dose rate field numerical calculation model, conducting grid scale division on a three-dimensional space region, determining gamma dose rates obtained through calculation at grid points as background state variables, obtaining real-time environment gamma dose rate data of a plurality of observation site positions, constructing an observation vector, constructing a mapping relation between a model space and the observation space based on the background state variables and the observation vector, determining an observation operator, adopting a three-dimensional variation assimilation method, carrying out assimilation correction based on the background state variables by taking the minimum objective function as an optimization target, and obtaining an assimilation state variable solution. By constructing a dose rate field model, the gamma dose rate is directly used as an assimilation variable without subsequent parameter conversion, so that the purposes of assimilating the gamma dose rate, directly correcting the gamma dose rate, obtaining the theoretical optimal solution of the gamma dose rate and improving the accuracy of constructing a gamma radiation field are achieved.

title_en: Fire simulating method of various fire scenario using the fire simulating device
title_ko: 화재 상황 재현장치를 이용하여 다양한 화재 시나리오로 화재 상황 재현이 가능한 화재 상황 재현방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 상황 재현장치를 이용하여 다양한 화재 시나리오로 화재 상황 재현이 가능한 화재 상황 재현방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 화재 상황 재현장치를 이용한 화재 상황 재현 시, A급화재(일반화재) 상황, B급화재(유류화재) 상황 또는 C급화재(전기화재) 상황 별로 가장 적합한 시험 대상물 모형을 제작한 후 상기 각 화재 상황별로 가장 적합한 시험 대상물 모형을 선택적으로 교체하여 화재 상황을 재현함으로써, A급화재, B급화재 또는 C급화재 등 다양한 화재 시나리오에 대해 더욱 현실감있는 화재 상황을 재현할 수 있도록 하며, 이로 인해 각종 소방 훈련, 체험, 교육 등의 효율을 더욱 향상시킬 수 있도록 하고, 또한, 본 발명은 화재 상황 재현장치를 이용한 화재 상황 재현 시, 무선 리모트 컨트롤러를 통해 화재 상황 재현장치의 제어부를 조작하여 발화·인화성 유체의 공급량 및 점화장치의 작동 등을 상기 화재 상황에 맞게 최적화하여 제어함으로써 화재 상황 재현장치의 사용을 더욱 안전하고 간편하게 할 수 있도록 하면서도 화재 상황에 대한 현실감을 더욱 극대화시킬 수 있도록 하는, 화재 상황 재현장치를 이용하여 다양한 화재 시나리오로 화재 상황 재현이 가능한 화재 상황 재현방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: ALLBE SOLUTION CO LTD;LEE KI WOO

title_en: Corridor area comparison and selection method applied to expressway reconstruction planning
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of engineering planning and design, in particular to a corridor comparing and selecting method applied to expressway reconstruction planning, which comprises the following steps of according to information magnitude for measuring susceptibility to geological disasters Obtaining a geological risk score Obtaining economic cost scores according to the removal cost and the engineering cost Obtaining environmental protection scores according to the influence on the ecological environment and the generated noise influence Obtaining social influence scores according to population density to be removed and placement difficulty ; Will 、 、 And And comparing the route total scores of different routes to obtain an optimal central line, so that the optimal central line can be obtained as much as possible after the comprehensive multi-factor consideration.
assignees: JIAXING LAND SPACE PLANNING RES CO LTD

title_en: Ship cabin duty guard system based on Bluetooth positioning and operation method
abstract_en: A ship cabin duty guard system based on Bluetooth positioning and an operation method thereof are provided, wherein the system comprises a portable operation end, a receiving control end and a ship dead man alarm system, the portable operation end is a portable signaling positioning device integrating a button, a Bluetooth module and a microprocessor, and the receiving control end receives signals through Bluetooth and controls a time relay to link the dead man alarm system. When the system runs, a person on duty remotely starts a dead man alarm system through the portable device, sends out local early warning when the countdown inside the device is finished, enables the person to press a reset button at any time to reset the timer, triggers a whole ship alarm if the time-out is not reset, and further supports emergency call one-key triggering whole ship alarm, bluetooth positioning real-time monitoring of the position and track playback of the person, and a motion sensor monitors the static time-out and alarms. The design solves the defect that the traditional system needs fixed point reset through the Bluetooth remote control and positioning technology, and remarkably improves the operation convenience, humanized early warning and emergency response capability.
assignees: COSCO SHIPPING ENERGY TRANSP CO LTD

title_en: Method for designing reinforcement of damaged railway concrete simply supported beams
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reinforced design method for a damaged railway concrete simply supported beam, which comprises the following steps of determining a disaster type, detecting the state of a box girder, determining the states of a top plate, a bottom plate, a web plate, a flange plate and a support, analyzing and evaluating, determining the reinforced degree according to an evaluation grade when the design requirements are met when the evaluation grade is determined and confirmed, performing test evaluation, determining the reinforced degree according to the performance meeting degree, wherein the state is slight damage, no measures are taken, the state is severe damage, and the durability repair is performed, and the state is complete damage, demolition, replacement or reconstruction. The technical scheme comprises detection, theoretical evaluation and experimental evaluation of the concrete box girder after disasters, and reinforcement design is carried out on a top plate, a bottom plate, a web plate, a flange plate and a support of a box girder structure based on the detection and evaluation results of the concrete box girder after disasters, so that technical support is provided for reinforcement and reinforcement of the concrete box girder after disasters.
assignees: CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;CARS RAILWAY ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Geological disaster live-action three-dimensional reconstruction device capable of controlling modeling quality
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster live-action three-dimensional reconstruction device capable of controlling modeling quality, in particular to a geological disaster live-action three-dimensional reconstruction device capable of controlling modeling quality, which comprises a camera module, a cradle head module, a slide rail module and a base module. The three-dimensional modeling quality can be ensured by accurately controlling the image overlapping rate through the graduated scale on the sliding rail module and the marks of the holder module, the synchronous acquisition of multi-angle images is realized by adopting the five-lens camera, the data acquisition efficiency is improved, and the wide-angle image acquisition is realized by controlling the pitching and the tilting angles of the camera module through the spherical rotating head and the camera base. The method has the advantages of simplicity and convenience in operation, controllable modeling quality, high efficiency in data acquisition and the like, and is suitable for the field of three-dimensional reconstruction of geological disaster live-action.
assignees: SICHUAN XINLU LINGWU ECOLOGICAL ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Summer precipitation prediction correction downscaling method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a summer precipitation prediction correction downscaling method and system based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of weather prediction and climate simulation. Aiming at the technical problems of systematic deviation and space detail deficiency in forecasting, a deep learning scale-down model is built by combining summer multi-mode climate forecast data issued 6 months in advance with high-resolution observation data and terrain data, deviation correction and space super-resolution reconstruction are carried out on a summer rainfall forecasting result, and a target area kilometer-level summer rainfall field is output. The model improves the space feature capturing capacity of the multi-scale climate elements through an attention mechanism, and realizes the self-adaptive fusion of the climate elements and the topography factors through a topography sensing module, so that the medium-long-term prediction accuracy of summer precipitation in a complex topography area is enhanced. The invention can effectively integrate global climate information and local topography characteristics, and provides high-precision technical support for regional summer precipitation medium-long-term prediction, flood season disaster prevention and reduction and water resource scheduling.

title_en: Disaster chain full-element collaborative driving method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster chain full-element collaborative driving method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the steps of obtaining dynamic hydrologic factors and distributed static geological factors; generating a time feature vector and a distributed space feature vector, executing conditional probability coupling mapping to generate a distributed disaster chain risk conduction path, executing space correlation risk conduction to output a multi-disaster coupling risk space-time evolution map, generating a disaster chain risk real-time map, performing transient slice comparison to locate heterogeneous parameter sensitivity offset, driving multi-modal parameters to co-evolve to obtain a co-evolution parameter set, and executing dynamic map reconstruction to generate a multi-disaster coupling risk correction evolution map. The disaster chain analysis method and the disaster chain analysis device solve the technical problems that in the prior art, the disaster chain analysis is dependent on a limited single data source or a preset model, interaction of different factors in a disaster chain cannot be comprehensively estimated, and accuracy of disaster risk estimation results is affected.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Cross-test class increment learning method and classification method of motor imagery classification model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-test class increment learning method and a classification method of a motor imagery classification model, which belong to the field of brain-computer interfaces, and aims to cope with distribution deviation, apply Euclidean space alignment to eliminate data distribution deviation among different tests, introduce a playback strategy in global and local aspects to minimize catastrophic forgetting, save global knowledge by playing back Euclidean space alignment matrixes of previous tasks, and in addition, introduce a clustering centroid nearest neighbor method for local playback, the method selects samples with the most representativeness and diversity to reserve local information of each class, and perform feature dimension reduction before applying the local playback strategy to relieve dimension disasters, thereby relieving the problem of dimension disasters while maintaining original data information.

title_en: Rock mass structure information intelligent extraction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image data processing, in particular to an intelligent rock mass structural information extraction method based on deep learning, and aims to solve the problems that the traditional rock mass structural surface identification method is low in automation degree, sensitive to point cloud density change and difficult to accurately express plane direction information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining high-quality rock mass images through combination of multi-view unmanned aerial vehicle near-earth photogrammetry and high dynamic range fusion and polarization calculation, reconstructing three-dimensional point cloud by utilizing a motion recovery structure and a plane perception improved multi-view stereoscopic vision algorithm, constructing a neighborhood by adopting furthest point sampling and sphere query, extracting layering embedded features layer by layer through a point cloud deep learning network, and providing a plane perception layering density space clustering algorithm to fuse embedded representation similarity and normal vector consistency to perform structural surface clustering. The invention can realize full-automatic, high-precision and robust identification of the rock mass structural plane and accurate extraction of the occurrence parameters, and provides reliable technical support for slope stability analysis and geological disaster early warning.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-branch estuary toughness assessment method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and disaster prevention and reduction, and discloses a toughness assessment method of a multi-branch estuary, which comprises the following steps of establishing an estuary directed graph, collecting real-time water level and flow velocity, and extracting a static working point by utilizing low-pass filtering; the method comprises the steps of calculating the reactance of a differential real part resistor and a wave flow coupling imaginary part to synthesize dynamic differential complex impedance, executing open circuit or short circuit reconstruction according to the impedance and the energy flow state to generate a variation topological graph, further constructing a Laplace matrix to extract algebraic connectivity, calculating a system toughness index by combining residual moisture capacity, and finally comparing the index with a threshold value, identifying a key impedance bottleneck and outputting a water conservancy scheduling suggestion. According to the application, a dynamic differential complex impedance model based on linearization of a fluid working point is constructed, and the hidden risk of physical smoothness but hydrodynamic blocking of a channel special for a estuary area can be sharply captured by introducing wave flow coupling imaginary reactance.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST FOR WATER TRANSPORT ENGINEERING M O T

title_en: Genetic algorithm-based power distribution network pre-disaster investment scheme optimization system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for optimizing a pre-disaster investment scheme of a power distribution network based on a genetic algorithm, after basic data are acquired, the two-stage optimization model comprising pre-disaster investment and post-disaster recovery is constructed, and expected values of post-disaster load recovery can be maximized under the conditions of budget constraint, node capacity, load recovery, network connectivity and the like. The disaster scene is independently modeled according to the representative intensity and the spatial distribution, a genetic algorithm encodes a pre-disaster investment scheme, the load evaluation fitness is expected to be recovered based on multiple scenes, global optimization is realized through selection, intersection and variation, a distributed power supply deployment, line reinforcement and controllable switch configuration scheme meeting budget is output, and rapid recovery is realized in cooperation with post-disaster fault isolation and network reconstruction. The method and the system remarkably improve the post-disaster load recovery level and the resource utilization efficiency of the power distribution network under the condition of limited resources, give consideration to economy and reliability, and can be used for disaster-resistant planning and transformation of the power distribution network.
assignees: ECONOMIC RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;WUHAN NARI LIMITED LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Broadband triaxial microseismic monitoring and early warning method and system based on reconstructed longitudinal and transverse waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broadband triaxial microseismic monitoring and early warning method and system based on reconstructed longitudinal and transverse waves, and relates to the technical field of underground engineering disaster monitoring and early warning, comprising the steps of obtaining a coal rock fracture shock wave signal of a region to be monitored; decomposing and reconstructing a coal and rock fracture vibration wave signal to obtain a longitudinal wave signal and a transverse wave signal, determining the arrival time of the longitudinal wave signal and the arrival time of the transverse wave signal respectively, constructing a seismic source positioning iteration function based on the longitudinal wave first arrival time, the transverse wave first arrival time and the arrival time difference of the longitudinal wave signal and the transverse wave signal of the same vibration signal in different sensor positions in a region to be monitored, positioning a microseism source by using a particle swarm algorithm, constructing a microseism multi-dimensional index system, constructing a multi-parameter early warning index based on the microseism multi-dimensional index system, and monitoring and early warning a target mine in the region to be monitored based on the multi-parameter early warning index. The invention relieves the technical problems of low seismic source positioning precision and easy false report and missing report of rock burst early warning in the prior art.

title_en: Nuclear power station security situation early warning scheduling system based on multispectral video perception
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nuclear power station security situation early warning scheduling system based on multispectral video perception, which comprises an image acquisition unit, an image preprocessing unit, a deep learning unit, a scheduling decision engine and a plurality of linkage systems, wherein the image acquisition unit is used for acquiring a multimodal video image of a preset area in a nuclear power station, the image preprocessing unit is used for carrying out denoising processing according to the multimodal video image to reconstruct a real image in a nuclear power station radiation environment, the deep learning unit is used for extracting a characteristic image in the real image based on the real image and carrying out object detection according to the characteristic image to obtain semantic classification of a detection object and identify abnormal behaviors of the detection object, and the scheduling decision engine is used for controlling the plurality of linkage systems to start emergency response according to the abnormal behaviors of the detection object.
assignees: BEIJING NERA STENTOFON COMMUNICATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Power supply capacity improving method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply of a power distribution network, and discloses a power supply capacity improving method and a power distribution network power supply capacity improving system, wherein a basic network containing multi-source resources is firstly built by relying on topology data of the power distribution network, and a multi-constraint multi-period optimal scheduling model is built with the aim of minimum loss of load loss; and then realizing topology dynamic reconstruction by a Big-M method, introducing a dynamic shortest path algorithm to acquire a mobile energy storage optimal migration path, establishing virtual power flow consistency constraint, forming a post-disaster power supply capacity optimizing and scheduling model, then adopting a mixed integer second order cone planning and solving mode to solve the post-disaster power supply capacity optimizing and scheduling model under a rolling period frame, dynamically updating a traffic and node state parameter solving model, generating a multi-source collaborative scheduling scheme, and finally applying the scheme to disaster scenes to carry out simulation verification. The method and the system realize the coordination of mobile energy storage and topology reconstruction, and improve the key load recovery rate and the system power supply toughness.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;JINZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Cooperative control system for disaster sensing and emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and discloses a cooperative control system for disaster sensing and emergency rescue. The system comprises a disaster situation sensing unit, a rescue resource scheduling unit, a multi-target decision making unit, a dynamic path planning unit, an emergency response executing unit and a closed-loop updating unit, wherein the disaster situation sensing unit is used for acquiring field data through a multi-mode sensor network and generating a real-time situation map, the rescue resource scheduling unit is used for carrying out hierarchical coding on rescue resources according to the situation map, establishing a resource distribution thermodynamic diagram and carrying out superposition analysis with disaster areas, the multi-target decision making unit is used for receiving the thermodynamic diagram and the situation map, generating a rescue task sequence through a priority algorithm and outputting a decision instruction set, the dynamic path planning unit is used for carrying out topology reconstruction on a rescue route based on the instruction set and generating an obstacle avoidance navigation path set in combination with topographic obstacle data, and the emergency response executing unit is used for driving rescue equipment to execute standardized operation according to the path set and feeding back execution state data to the sensing unit to form closed-loop updating. The system realizes the whole-flow cooperative control of disaster sensing, resource scheduling and rescue execution.
assignees: RENAN CONSTRUCTION TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Energy storage ship safety early warning and emergency response method
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy storage ship safety early warning and emergency response method.
