The energy storage ship safety early warning and emergency response method comprises the steps of collecting and correlating full-flow data of power, conveying and charging, conducting charge and discharge safety early warning based on the collected full-flow data, synchronously sending early warning information to a power grid dispatching and ship control system, conducting charge and discharge scene emergency response according to the early warning information, and conducting system reconstruction and closed loop assessment after the emergency response is completed. The energy storage ship safety early warning and emergency response method can improve the system safety management level and adaptability, effectively reduce the running risk of the energy storage ship, improve the safety and stability of the charging and discharging process, and ensure the task completion rate of the ship in the power and conveying scene.
assignees: SHANGHAI XUANYI NEW ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Firefighting robot operating vehicle and firefighting robot operating system comprising it
title_ko: 소방로봇 운용차량 및 이를 포함하는 소방로봇 운용시스템
abstract_ko:
최소한의 인력으로 다양한 소방임무를 수행할 수 있으며, 소방인력의 안전을 확보하고 화재진압의 효율성을 극대화할 수 있는 소방로봇 운용차량 및 이를 포함하는 소방로봇 운용시스템이 개시된다. 
개시된 소방로봇 운용차량은, 
화재현장을 모니터링하는 모니터링 단말기와 통신하며 인명탐지 솔루션이 탑재된 제1 소방로봇과, 모니터링 단말기와 통신하며 화재진압 솔루션이 탑재된 제2 소방로봇과, 모니터링 단말기와 통신하며 화재현장 주변환경 정보를 수집하기 위한 소방용 드론이 내부에 수용되는 적재함; 적재함 내에 설치되며 제1 소방로봇과 제2 소방로봇을 각각 고정 및 충전시키는 로봇 스테이션; 적재함 내에 설치되며 소방용 드론을 고정 및 충전시키는 드론 스테이션;을 포함한다.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for extracting road topology structure of remote sensing image through multitasking cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing image processing, in particular to a method, a system and equipment for extracting a road topological structure of a multi-task collaborative remote sensing image, which comprise the steps of data preparation, model training and road extraction, wherein a multi-task collaborative mechanism is introduced to fuse segmentation tasks with topology modeling tasks, and the process from feature extraction, key point detection and dynamic prompt generation to topology restoration forming end-to-end collaborative optimization is realized, so that unified modeling of road mask segmentation and topology structure reconstruction is realized, the topology connectivity and structural consistency of a road network are obviously improved while high segmentation precision is maintained, and the method has the advantages of clear structure, high calculation efficiency, strong generalization capability and the like, and can be widely applied to the fields of intelligent traffic, urban planning, disaster emergency, map automatic drawing and the like.

title_en: Modularized electric control box with multi-loop intelligent monitoring function
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electrical control and discloses a modularized electrical control box with a multi-loop intelligent monitoring function, which comprises a box body, a gas monitoring device, a concentration monitor and an electrical loop, wherein the box body is used as a basic component of an integral device and is used for bearing and assembling each processing mechanism and a subordinate structural member of each processing mechanism, the gas monitoring device is arranged in the box body and is used for monitoring gas in the box body in real time, the concentration monitor is communicated with the gas monitoring device through a self-cleaning structure and is used for monitoring the gas concentration in the box body in real time, the electrical loop is arranged in the box body and is used for supplying power for a load, and an internal integrated monitoring unit of the electrical loop is used for collecting key electrical parameters of each loop in real time. The monitoring unit comprises a high-speed synchronous data acquisition module which is used for acquiring and reconstructing the electrical parameters of each independent electrical loop in parallel. And (3) simulating a future multiple probabilistic evolution path of the system by constructing a random power system model and applying a path integral control theory, and calculating a risk spectrum evolving to a disaster state and an optimal intervention strategy.
assignees: JIANGSU MAIRUIFU ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Phi-OTDR phase demodulation method and system based on diffusion model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phi-OTDR phase demodulation method and system based on a diffusion model, and belongs to the technical field of distributed optical fiber sensing. The method utilizes an iterative noise prediction mechanism in a diffusion model to compress and map a digital intermediate frequency signal to a low-dimensional continuous vector space of high-dimensional original data through an encoder, gradually denoises by means of the diffusion model, and finally reconstructs an initial phase. The system integrates the modules of a phase encoder-decoder, a condition extraction model, a diffusion model and the like, and realizes accurate separation of noise and phase information through multi-step optimization loss functions. The method can remarkably improve the phase extraction precision and the anti-interference capability of the phi-OTDR system, and is suitable for high-precision sensing scenes such as optical fiber distributed acoustic wave detection, vibration monitoring, geological disaster early warning, structural health detection and the like.

title_en: Cross-regional data disaster recovery backup and collaborative monitoring service system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data disaster recovery backup service and discloses a cross-regional data disaster recovery backup and collaborative monitoring service system which comprises the steps of detecting whether video frames received by a local end are blocked or not, utilizing the video frames smooth at the local end of a local area network as backup frames, scaling the backup frames, converting audio corresponding to the backup frames into texts, synchronously displaying the texts and the backup frames, collecting and analyzing audio of a remote conference in real time, detecting whether behaviors of a wrong microphone are present or not by utilizing monitoring to obtain behavior characteristics of a participant, positioning the local end of the wrong microphone, filtering mixed audio according to the pre-recorded voice audio of the participant, retaining the audio of the speaker, calculating conference participation degree, marking low participants, setting participation feedback of different grades, recording real-time participation degree of all participants during the conference, setting importance labels on a conference playback interface, and improving intelligent management capability of the mixed conference.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Hospital service-oriented server and storage virtualization system integration and disaster recovery reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storage virtualization, in particular to a server facing hospital business and a method for integrating and reconstructing disaster recovery systems of a storage virtualization system, which comprises the following steps of constructing and deploying hierarchical integrated construction of a simulation system, constructing a resource pool infrastructure with deep coupling of calculation and storage and optimization for medical business load; the progressive online migration technology based on the service portraits realizes the controllable and smooth seamless migration of the risk of the service system from the physical platform to the virtual platform, the old machine room is reconstructed into a degradation type disaster recovery center, the old machine room is transformed into an economic and practical disaster recovery site meeting the core service recovery target, and the method has the advantages of remarkably improving the resource efficiency and the economy, improving the average resource utilization rate from less than 20% to more than 60% through deep resource pooling, reducing the purchase quantity of new equipment, fully utilizing old assets and reducing TCO.
assignees: THE SECOND CONSTRUCTION LIMITED CO OF CHINA CONSTRUCTION EIGHTH ENGINEERING DIVISION

title_en: Power emergency repair disaster-resistant RIS beam dynamic optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless communication service, and discloses a power emergency repair disaster-resistant RIS beam dynamic optimization method; the method comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring RIS auxiliary communication parameters to form operation data, identifying interrupt events based on comparison of the data and threshold values, determining positions, types and ranges, generating event descriptions, classifying and evaluating disaster factors by using the descriptions, extracting influence parameters, associating power rush-repair scenes, establishing an interrupt model, generating a beam adjustment scheme according to the model, selecting phase shift configuration, planning a reconstruction path, integrating emergency priorities to form an instruction sequence, reconfiguring a phase shift matrix according to an execution sequence, adjusting the direction and amplitude of a beam, coordinating signal routing, circularly acquiring update parameters after reconfiguration, returning interrupt and identifying to form a closed loop monitoring mechanism.
assignees: HUBEI SIJI TECH CO LTD;WUHAN BRANCH OF HUBEI SIJI TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUHAN POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Remote sensing image semantic change detection method based on text assistance and contrast learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semantic change detection method based on text assistance and contrast learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining remote sensing images collected by the same region in different time phases, inputting a twin multi-scale encoder with shared parameters to extract multi-level features, secondly introducing a pre-training visual-language model and a text encoder in a training stage to generate a text describing changes and injecting the text into a high-level visual feature to obtain migration features and construct a reconstruction constraint based on contrast learning, thirdly, adaptively fusing the multi-scale features by a construction context and channel perception fusion module, fourthly, designing the multi-scale decoder to recover spatial resolution and output a semantic change graph, and fifthly, adopting a joint training target consisting of spatial mask supervision loss and reconstruction loss to optimize the network end to end. The method is suitable for scenes such as remote sensing monitoring, disaster assessment, urban dynamic analysis and the like.

title_en: Meteorological early warning service platform based on city characteristic data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meteorological early warning service platform based on city characteristic data, which comprises an area characteristic acquisition module, a meteorological monitoring module, an area characteristic analysis module and an area meteorological early warning module, wherein the area characteristic acquisition module is used for acquiring district-level geographic characteristic data of a target area, the district-level geographic characteristic data comprises a relief elevation, a peripheral river distribution distance, a building construction time length, a drainage reconstruction mark and a building height, the meteorological monitoring module is used for acquiring precipitation, wind speed and temperature data in real time, the area characteristic analysis module is used for generating vulnerability scores reflecting inherent risk levels of areas by fusing the relief elevation, the peripheral river distribution distance, the building construction time length, the drainage reconstruction mark and the building height, and the area meteorological early warning module is used for generating dynamic grading early warning signals by coupling the vulnerability scores with the real-time precipitation, the wind speed and the temperature data. The method can integrate urban characteristics and meteorological data, dynamically quantize risks, and accurately early warn to improve urban meteorological disaster prevention efficiency.

title_en: Building functional damage assessment method based on lifting rail InSAR
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of remote sensing monitoring and disaster assessment, and particularly relates to a building functional damage assessment method based on lifting rail InSAR, which comprises the following steps of 1, lifting rail InSAR data acquisition and damage information collection before and after damage; the method comprises the steps of step 2, reconstructing and fusing digital surface models DSM before and after damage, step 3, detecting and quantifying building change based on differential DSM, step 4, quantitatively extracting building damage characteristic parameters, step 5, evaluating and grading building functionality based on multidimensional characteristics, and step 6, generating a building functional damage evaluation report. The method realizes the evaluation and upgrading from two-dimensional change to three-dimensional refined structure change, maps the extracted three-dimensional geometric change characteristics to the direct influence on the core function of the building, effectively solves the mapping problem from deformation to function, and improves the automation degree and objectivity of evaluation.
assignees: BEIJING RESEARCH INST OF URANIUM GEOLOGY

title_en: Disaster-tolerant backup system and method for extreme scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-tolerant backup system and method for an extreme scene, and relates to the technical field of data protection and disaster recovery. The system receives the backup and recovery requests through the user access module, encrypts the original data by adopting a symmetric key mechanism based on quantum key distribution QKD, and codes and distributes and stores the data by combining an erasure code algorithm. The data blocks and the check blocks are distributed and deployed in a plurality of geographically isolated storage nodes, so that the data blocks and the check blocks have high fault tolerance and quick recovery capability. The computing resources are pre-deployed in the form of container images, and after disaster triggering, the environment reconstruction is completed through automatic scheduling. The network communication adopts multipath encryption transmission, and the monitoring module supports the automatic execution of fault detection and recovery plans. The invention reduces the storage cost, supports the local repair and self-healing mechanism, has high destructiveness, high recovery efficiency and expandability, and is suitable for data protection and service continuity guarantee under extreme conditions such as natural disasters, network attacks and the like.
assignees: AEROSPACE YIJINZHI JIANGSU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Industrial data disaster recovery backup method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial data disaster recovery backup method and system based on edge calculation, which relates to the technical field of industrial Internet and data security, the invention constructs a decentralized collaborative backup grid to enable scattered industrial edge nodes to be automatically found and connected to form a dynamic backup neighbor relation network, the nodes automatically construct a grid topology through mutual perception and authentication of a service discovery protocol, on the basis, any node generates data to be backed up, the method is characterized in that the method comprises the steps of encoding the data into segmented data blocks and check blocks through erasure coding technology, intelligently scheduling the segmented data blocks and check blocks to a plurality of backup neighbor nodes for distributed storage, monitoring the states of all nodes in a grid in real time through continuous heartbeat detection and multidimensional health index analysis, and automatically triggering a data reconstruction flow based on erasure codes without a central instruction once node abnormality is detected, and recovering original data by using the surviving coding blocks to form a self-organizing and self-healing disaster recovery system.
assignees: TAIYUAN YUANYUAN INDUSTRIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power supply capacity evaluation method and device after disaster of power distribution network and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating power supply capacity of a power distribution network after disaster and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining a power failure area under the condition that equipment faults in a distribution network are affected by disasters, determining actual photovoltaic output, total V2G output and energy storage and discharge power for emergency power supply after the disasters are carried out on the power failure area based on a multi-source output model, determining target transfer load of the power failure area based on a tie switch network reconstruction model, determining predicted time sequence load of the power failure area in a current power utilization period, and determining a power supply capacity evaluation result of the distribution network in the current power utilization period based on the actual photovoltaic output, the total V2G output, the energy storage and discharge power, the transfer load and the predicted time sequence load. The method solves the technical problems of untimely power restoration caused by inaccurate power supply capacity evaluation after disaster of the power distribution network after the disaster causes the power distribution network equipment failure and power interruption in the related technology.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional quantitative dynamic checking method for flood prevention capacity of transformer substation based on digital twin and multisource coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional quantitative dynamic checking method for flood control capability of a transformer substation based on digital twin and multisource coupling, belongs to the technical field of evaluation and checking of flood control capability of the transformer substation, integrates multidisciplinary theories and technologies such as hydrology, hydraulics, geographical science, artificial intelligence, digital twin and the like, integrates multisource data such as high-resolution satellite remote sensing, unmanned plane laser radar, GIS space analysis, hydrologic monitoring and the like, builds a digital twin and distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling model of the transformer substation, builds a disaster-causing mechanism three-dimensional quantitative index system covering dangers, expositions and vulnerabilities, realizes a whole-flow technical closed loop from data acquisition-model simulation-quantitative checking-three-dimensional visualization-dynamic early warning, adapts to different scenes such as a lack of data area, a transformed transformer substation and the like, and accurately outputs a transformer substation flood control capability level, a thin-state distribution and flood risk evolution situation, and provides scientific support for flood control reconstruction design and emergency treatment.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE;JILIN ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting robot for unattended places
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting robots and discloses a fire-fighting robot for an unattended place, which comprises a chassis, wherein a tire is arranged at the bottom of the chassis, a mounting frame is arranged at the top of the chassis, a front camera is arranged at the front part of the mounting frame, a gas sensor, an audible-visual annunciator and a holder are arranged at the front part of the top surface of the mounting frame, an infrared camera and a fire-extinguishing agent spray gun are arranged at two sides of the holder, a fire-extinguishing agent storage tank is arranged in the mounting frame, the top of the fire-extinguishing agent storage tank is connected with the fire-extinguishing agent spray gun through a first conveying pipe, and a second conveying pipe is arranged at the rear part of the fire-extinguishing agent storage tank. According to the utility model, by adopting a 4-wheel 4-drive structure and technologies such as laser and structured light fusion slam, depth camera environment reconstruction and the like, the problems of inaccurate response to fire and poor alarm reliability due to the fact that a fixed fire extinguishing device in a traditional fire extinguishing system depends on preset conditions are solved.
assignees: SHANGHAI SAIBIN SPECIAL ELECTRONIC COMPONENTS CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting reconstruction support for building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting supports, in particular to a building fire-fighting reconstruction support which comprises a back plate, a mounting plate, a top plate and a placement seat, wherein the mounting plate is fixedly connected to the top end and the bottom end of the back plate, an anti-slip pad is arranged on one side of the back plate and one side of the mounting plate together, an embedded groove for mounting the top plate is formed in the upper part of one side of the back plate, which is far away from the anti-slip pad, one end of the top plate is connected with a screw rod in a threaded manner, the lower part of one side, close to the top plate, of the back plate is fixedly connected with the placement seat, and a first arc-shaped groove for placing a fire-fighting pipeline is formed in the placement seat. Through screw-thread fit of lead screw and roof to make the lead screw can be with the clamp plate push down, until making the protruding inserting that the clamp plate lower extreme face is located the first arc wall on seat top of placing, the second protection pad and the fire control pipeline in close contact of protruding bottom, thereby fix the fire control pipeline in placing the seat, this structure can be suitable for the fire control pipeline of different thickness and fix, has the advantage that the practicality is strong, easy operation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LIEN ENG DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: DCDC power failure diagnosis method and system suitable for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting weak current boxes, in particular to a DCDC power failure diagnosis method and system suitable for new energy automobiles, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, quantum dot enhanced self-reconstruction digital twin modeling, namely, a quantum dot film sensor is implanted on the surface of a DCDC power core device, the fluorescence intensity of the sensor generates nonlinear response along with the tiny changes of temperature, stress and electric field, and the hidden physical characteristics which cannot be identified by the traditional sensor can be captured; the full-dimension perception of hidden faults is realized by combining the characteristics of microscopic stress, electric field distortion and the like of a quantum dot sensing capturing device and combining electromagnetic-thermal-mechanical-environment four-field coupling characteristic fusion, and false association is eliminated by a causal reasoning model and a Do-Calculus algorithm, so that the direct causal relation of characteristic-root cause is quantized.

title_en: Reservoir landslide ground water level fluctuation master control factor identification method based on data mining
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of groundwater monitoring and analysis, in particular to a method for identifying master control factors of groundwater level fluctuation of a reservoir landslide based on data mining, which utilizes time sequence monitoring data and combines a two-step clustering algorithm and an Apriori association rule mining technology to systematically identify the master control factors of groundwater level fluctuation of a reservoir landslide area and a combination relation thereof, reconstruct and expand the original method in the aspects of response mechanism, data structure, analysis scale and the like, the method effectively solves the problems of lag response variable, incomplete mechanism identification, poor data scale adaptability and the like in the existing landslide disaster master control factor identification method, and can effectively capture landslide precursor signals, realize early identification and early warning, and remarkably improve the response speed and prediction accuracy of intelligent landslide disaster early warning by carrying out system identification on the coupling characteristics of the groundwater level and external environment factors.

title_en: Emergency guarantee movable plank house reconstructed after earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of emergency guarantee, in particular to an emergency guarantee movable plank house reconstructed after an earthquake disaster, which comprises a first framework, wherein four rectangular frameworks are arranged between the first frameworks, connecting pieces are fixedly connected between the first adjacent frameworks, supporting columns are fixedly connected to the top ends of the connecting pieces, wallboards are fixedly connected between the adjacent supporting columns, the top of each supporting column is provided with a second framework, and a protection mechanism is arranged on the second framework.
assignees: QINGLONG MANCHU AUTONOMOUS COUNTY EMERGENCY MAN BUREAU

title_en: Customized safety and health management operation system utilizing artificial intelligence-based field data collection
title_ko: 인공지능 기반의 현장 데이터 수집을 활용한 맞춤형 안전보건관리 운영 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 신용평가기관과 연동하는 안전보건관리 운영 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건설 사업을 수행하는 건설 기업의 회사명, 종업원 수, 업종, 시공 능력, 현장 수, 재해 현황을 포함하는 기업 정보와 상기 건설 기업의 안전보건경영에 해당되는 경영방침, 계획수립, 관리 규정 정보를 포함하는 본사 정보와 현재 수행 중인 건설 현장에 대하여 공사명, 공사 기간, 공사 금액, 현장 책임자, 안전 담당자, 작업자 수, 작업자 건강 지수, 공정률, 공사 종류, 공법, 작업환경 정보, 건설 현장에서 실시되는 안전 교육 이행 정보, 사고 정보를 포함하는 현장 정보를 입력하여 안전보건경영 컨설팅을 요청하는 기업용 단말기; 상기 기업용 단말기로 입력되는 상기 본사 정보를 수신받아 저장하는 본사 정보 처리부;와 상기 현장 정보를 수신받아 저장하는 현장 정보 처리부;와 상기 본사 정보와 현장 정보에서 수집되는 사고 정보를 저장하고 관리하는 사고 이력 관리부;를 포함하여 구성되고, 수신된 상기 현장 정보가 상기 본사 정보에 해당되는 경영방침, 계획수립, 관리 규정에 기초하여 안전보건경영에 따른 미이행 사항이 발생한 경우 해당 사항을 상기 기업용 단말기에 이행 요청 명령을 제공하여 이행 결과를 수신받아 관리하며, 상기 기업용 단말기로부터 입력되는 본사 정보와 현장 정보를 기반으로 안전보건관리 경영에 해당되는 관리체계, 실행 수준, 운영관리, 재해 발생 수준, 안전수준 증진 각각의 항목에 대하여 평가를 평가점수를 부여하는 평가 관리부를 포함하고, 상기 평가 관리부는 각각의 항목에 대하여 사전 평가, 실시 평가, 사후 평가로 분류하여 기업의 안전보건경영 평가를 수행하는 컨설팅 플랫폼 서버; 상기 컨설팅 플랫폼 서버에서 기업의 안전보건경영 평가 결과를 수신받아 최종 평가를 수행하여 최종 평가 보고서를 생성하여 상기 컨설팅 플랫폼 서버로 제공하는 신용평가기관 서버; 및 상기 기업용 단말기를 통해 입력되는 본사 정보를 기반하여 발생한 사고, 공사 종류, 사용 장비, 근로자 유형을 포함하는 사업 특성을 정의하고 이에 따른 안전보건경영방침 항목과 안전보건경영목표 항목을 추천해주고, 여기서 추천된 안전보건경영방침 항목과 안전보건경영목표 항목을 통해 해당 기업의 안전보건경영방침과 안전보건경영목표를 수립하도록 상기 컨설팅 플랫폼 서버에 제공하는 인공지능 처리 서버;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Mandatory alarm sound generation for rapid rescue teams Rescue alarm device and method for mandatory alarm sound generation
title_ko: 신속구조팀용 강제 경보음 발생 구조용 경보기 및 강제 경보음 발생 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 신속구조팀용 강제 경보음 발생 구조용 경보기 및 강제 경보음 발생 방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 구체적으로 설명하면, 화재현장에서 소화작업을 수행하는 소방관들이 경보기를 휴대하고 화재건물로 진입하여 소화작업을 진행하는 도중에 경보기를 휴대한 소방관(요구조 소방관)의 움직임이 없으면 신속구조팀용 강제 경보음 발생 구조용 경보기에서 상기 요구조 소방관의 경보기에서 강제 경보음 및 강제 조명이 출력되게 하여 신속구조팀의 소방관들이 상기 요구조 소방관인 의식불명 소방관이 휴대한 경보기에서 발생되는 강제 경보음 및 강제 조명을 인식할 수가 있으므로 의식불명의 소방관의 위치의 추적이 가능하게 되어 화재현장에서 매몰된 소방관을 용이하게 구조하는 것이 가능한 신속구조팀용 강제 경보음 발생 구조용 경보기 및 강제 경보음 발생 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Power transmission and distribution line simulation evaluation method under disaster condition
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of point cloud model construction, in particular to a power transmission and distribution line simulation evaluation method under disaster conditions, which comprises the steps of scanning the environment where a power transmission and distribution line is positioned to generate point cloud containing reflectivity and color information; classifying point clouds, marking each object, calculating a first characterization value, a second characterization value and a tower evaluation value of each object, marking an object corresponding to a power transmission tower, calculating a wire evaluation value of each object, marking an object corresponding to a power transmission and distribution line, determining a rejection coefficient of each point cloud, identifying and rejecting abnormal point clouds on the object corresponding to the power transmission and distribution line, performing three-dimensional reconstruction on the object corresponding to the power transmission and distribution line after refilling the point clouds, performing simulation on the reconstructed three-dimensional point cloud model under disaster conditions, and evaluating the running state of the power transmission and distribution line. The three-dimensional reconstruction method and the three-dimensional reconstruction device can improve the three-dimensional reconstruction precision of the power transmission and distribution line and improve the evaluation accuracy and reliability of the operation state of the power transmission and distribution line under disaster conditions.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-stage toughness improving method, equipment, medium and product for power distribution network based on mobile energy storage flexibility under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The application discloses a multistage toughness improving method, equipment, medium and product of a power distribution network based on mobile energy storage flexibility under extreme disasters, and relates to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling. The method comprises the steps of taking a set as an input condition, constructing a multi-target optimized scheduling model of a power distribution network before an accident, constructing a scheduling model after the accident, solving the pre-accident model, taking the obtained result as an initial condition, and solving the scheduling model after the accident to obtain a real-time output and scheduling strategy of distributed resources. The method applies the local flexible resources to the optimized operation of each stage, considers the network reconstruction and the equipment output characteristics before the disaster, schedules the position and the output of the mobile energy storage, and dynamically schedules the cooperative operation of each distributed resource after the disaster to recover the load power supply so as to improve the toughness of the power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;JINAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Systems and methods for three-dimensional rendering of building structure outside walls to facilitate fire inspection
abstract_en: Systems and methods for facilitating a fire inspection of a building structure. Multiple digital images (e.g., a video) of the outside walls of the building structure are processed to generate a three-dimensional (3D) sparse point cloud. An estimated perimeter of the building structure is determined based on the sparse point cloud and aligned with a geospatial perimeter to generate a geospatially-aligned 3D sparse point cloud. The geospatially-aligned cloud is then volume-rendered to generate a 3D reconstruction of the outside walls. One or more portions of this 3D reconstruction are displayed on a display screen, based on a position, orientation, and/or field of view (FOV) of an observation/inspection point relative to the building structure. A fire inspection may be performed based on respective displayed portions of the 3D reconstruction, in which one or more displayed objects that pose an ignition risk may be tagged and annotated for wildfire mitigation actions.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating line safety margin under mountain fire influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating line safety margin under the influence of mountain fire, and relates to the field of electric power systems and automation thereof. The method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining space information of a power transmission line based on a power grid geographic information system, generating a path evaluation point set, simultaneously obtaining multi-source real-time monitoring data of an area where the path evaluation point set is located by utilizing an air-space-ground integrated monitoring network, S2, carrying out synchronization and space registration processing on the multi-source real-time monitoring data, reconstructing to obtain a dynamic fire scene parameter set, calculating a line heat stress index, S3, carrying out Monte Carlo scene simulation by adopting a probability risk evaluation method based on the dynamic fire scene parameter set and the line heat stress index, generating a probability safety margin index, S4, determining a risk level according to the probability safety margin index and the line heat stress index, and outputting a visual risk evaluation result. Through multi-source data fusion and probabilistic evaluation, the accumulative performance, the accuracy and the robustness safety margin judgment of the power transmission line under mountain fires are realized.
assignees: BAODING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-based attack simulation and response system for road traffic infrastructure protection
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 도로교통 인프라 공격 시뮬레이션 대응 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반 도로교통 인프라 공격 시뮬레이션 대응 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 도로교통 시스템에서 사이버 공격 시나리오를 자동 생성하고, 이를 시뮬레이션하며 대응책을 분석 및 제시하는데 있다. 
일례로, 현실 도로교통 인프라로부터 수집된 데이터를 시간 동기화하여 가상 도로망을 구성하고, 상기 가상 도로망에 교통 시뮬레이션 모델을 연동하여 실제 교통 흐름을 재현하는 가상 도로망 생성부; 현실 도로교통 인프라 구성 장비의 보안 취약점 정보를 기반으로 공격 시나리오를 생성하고, 상기 공격 시나리오의 실행 가능성과 공격 특성을 평가하는 공격 시나리오 생성부; 상기 공격 시나리오를 상기 가상 도로망에 적용하여 교통 흐름 변화 및 이상 현상을 시뮬레이션하고, 시뮬레이션 결과에 따른 교통 성능 및 안전성 영향도를 분석하는 공격 영향 평가부; 및 상기 공격 영향 평가부의 공격 영향 분석 결과를 기초로 미리 정의된 규칙 또는 학습된 대응 정책에 따라 대응 전략을 도출하고, 대응 전략을 적용 가능 상태로 설정하거나 적용 여부를 결정하는 대응 전략 관리부를 포함하는 디지털 트윈 기반 도로교통 인프라 공격 시뮬레이션 대응 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Subway station fire dynamic evacuation path planning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rail transit and discloses a subway station fire dynamic evacuation path planning method which comprises a fire simulation module, a network topology construction module and a global path planning module, wherein the fire simulation module is used for constructing a fire simulation model of a subway station, acquiring whole station railway scene data and extracting disaster causing factor change data at key evacuation nodes again, the network topology construction module is used for establishing a network topology diagram of 'starting point-key evacuation nodes' according to pedestrian distribution and the key evacuation nodes, and the global path planning module is used for planning key node selection of each crowd by using Dijkstra algorithm based on the network topology diagram. And the grid topology construction module optimizes local path details among the key nodes through a Q-learning algorithm on the basis of global planning. And the path reconstruction module is used for reconstructing the evacuation path in real time in different development stages of the fire scene by combining the available time of the key evacuation nodes. The method can be used for planning a safer evacuation path for escape passengers according to the dynamic evolution condition of the fire scene while relieving the congestion.

title_en: Method for monitoring caving of coal wall caving and roof based on dynamic three-dimensional reconstruction and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent mine perception and disaster monitoring, and discloses a monitoring method and computer equipment for coal wall caving and roof caving based on dynamic three-dimensional reconstruction, wherein the method firstly adopts a global reference model and a local dynamic monitoring window to generate instant coal wall surface point cloud; the method comprises the steps of mapping point cloud to voxel grids, counting geometrical attributes, fusing semantic features extracted from a self-supervision visual model to generate single-frame voxel tensors, constructing relative transformation mapping by utilizing the pose of a coal mining machine, performing space transformation on historical data through a tri-linear interpolation resampling mechanism to construct four-dimensional space-time input tensors with consistent space-time, inputting the four-dimensional space-time input tensors into a lightweight three-dimensional convolution network to predict disaster risk probability field, and finally achieving disaster positioning and visualization in the global model through abnormal region judgment and global coordinate inverse transformation. The method effectively solves the problem of difficult alignment of space-time characteristics in a dynamic high-dust environment, and improves disaster identification precision and instantaneity.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RESEARCH INST CO LTD;TIANDI YULIN MINING ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire control is reformed transform and is used fire control water supply installation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting water supply, and discloses a fire-fighting water supply device for fire-fighting reconstruction, which comprises a water storage mechanism and a conduction mechanism, wherein the conduction mechanism is fixedly connected to the side surface of the water storage mechanism, the conduction mechanism comprises a connection unit and a discharge unit, the connection unit is fixedly connected to the side face of the water storage mechanism, and the discharge unit is fixedly connected to the side face of the connection unit. This fire control is reformed transform and is used fire control water supply installation, through being provided with a plurality of control valves, the device can switch the communication state of pipeline in a flexible way, the staff can conveniently pass through control valves, through introducing compressed gas, can compress the mud in the pipeline, and discharge it through the mud pipe, can clear away the long-pending mud and the dirt in the pipeline effectively, keep the pipeline unobstructed, through optimizing the setting of pipeline communication state and filter unit, the device can improve fire control water supply system's stability and reliability, can be quick clear up the silting up state, reduce work load.
assignees: HUBEI CHENGYU ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional visualization method for photogrammetry information based on grid real-time non-uniform division
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional visualization method of photogrammetry information based on grid real-time non-uniform division, which is used for realizing high-precision three-dimensional earth surface information acquisition and visualization presentation and relates to the crossing field of the photogrammetry technical field and the computer graphics processing technical field. Firstly, high-precision photogrammetry information data of a region to be measured are acquired, and are analyzed and processed by combining with a grid real-time non-uniform division technology, so that accurate measurement and identification of three-dimensional information such as ground surface landforms, buildings, vegetation and the like are realized. Meanwhile, the invention also provides a front-end visualization method, which presents the measurement result in an intuitive and interactive mode, so that a user can quickly acquire, analyze and apply the surface information. The invention has higher use value in the aspects of geological disaster emergency rescue, geological disaster reconstruction, real-time surface detection, refined measurement and the like.

title_en: Demonstration Test Bed System and Demonstration Method for Verifying Soundproof Tunnel Fire Response Performance
title_ko: 방음터널 화재 대응 성능 검증을 위한 실증 Test Bed 시스템 및 실증방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 방음터널 화재 대응 성능 검증을 위한 실증 Test Bed 시스템은 3차원 구조체로 제작되어 방음터널을 구현하는 가변형의 터널 모듈부와, 상기 터널 모듈부의 내부에 구비되어 화재를 재현하는 화재 재현부와, 상기 터널 모듈부의 내부에 구비되어 화재 실험 시 발생하는 다양한 데이터를 실시간으로 수집 및 기록하는 계측 모니터링부와, 상기 계측 모니터링부와 연계되어 상기 계측 모니터링부에서 수집된 감지 데이터를 기반으로 AI 예측 알고리즘을 통해 화재 확산 경로와 감지 신뢰도를 분석하는 AI 통합 제어부와, 화재 실험 후 수집된 데이터로부터 정량적 위험성을 계산하고, 계산 결과를 리스크 매트릭스 기반으로 등급화하여 시나리오별 위험도를 도출하는 분석 검증부를 구비할 수 있다.
